content.text: The Federal Law Office (BBauG-Novelle) of 1976 has included the implementation of plans (par. 39a et seq.) in urban planning law. In the context of legal research, the Difu has been investigated by means of an empirical survey to what extent municipal practice has been used by this instrument. The survey of 223 cities = 45 proz. shows that only 21 cities have issued formal bids under the amended BAUG until 1981. The use of the tools is primarily seen in its "drand potential" for reaching mutually agreed solutions. The study examines the conditions and possibilities for using the implementation of plans in consequence and recommendations. An annex contains, among other things, municipal documents on the practice of building and adaptation bids.
content.title_en: Plan implementation requirements in municipal practice

content.text: The post-mile columns of the Kursächsisches Postmeilen, which were built by the Elector Frederick August I of Saxony in 1721 in the Electorate of Saxony, were brought into the public light at the beginning of our century - after they had long since lost their importance in transport technology - and were brought to light. The history of this column is a part of the history of the Electorate of Saxony. The presentation of the individual objects is therefore sent to a historical outline of the political situation of Kursachsen in the European area, a description of the economic and social conditions and a detailed description of the postal history of this period.

content.text: The unbuilt Hamburg: visions of another city in architectural designs of the last hundred and fifty years. Review: The book "The unbuilt Hamburg" opens up spaces for thought and vision for a city that does not exist in this way: unrealized concepts, buildings and visionary designs, however, allow the city to contemplate the fitkive building history - with all its effects and suggestions on the actual construction process. The buildings presented in this book remained unrealized because they were submitted to competitions, considered untimely or unknown. The focus is on challenging construction tasks such as the search for a large hall, the discussion about the destroyed Nikolai church, the competition for Fuhlsbüttel Airport, plans for a car-friendly city, a new location for the university, among others, with numerous illustrations, draft sketches and time-historically important information, the view of the unbuilt Hamburg is focused on and makes past considerations fruitful for today's solutions.
content.title_en: The unbuilt Hamburg: visions of another city in architectural designs of the last hundred and fifty years

content.text: Brain and language: fossil testimonies to the origin of man. Australopithecus, homo habitis and homo erectus are considered as the most important intermediate stages in the development of modern man. What are the indications of the corresponding fossils and artifacts on the level of development of brain, language and behaviour? The present work gives a description of the results and discussion of the research of the last decades. For the assessment of the overall problem, skull interiors, bone remains and ancient stone-age artifacts are taken into account. Contrary to the widespread view of the evolution of man as a continuous development process, the available data results rather a discontinuous picture: Uncontested transition members, which demonstrate a gradual transformation from the rather human-ape-like Australopithecines to the real humans, are not documented without doubt.
content.title_en: Brain and language: fossil testimonies to the origin of man

content.text: Current problems of urban development : Results of the 1986 survey at the members of the conference of the departments of urban development planning of the German City Day. The German Institute of Urban Studies has been asking the following questions annually since 1979 using a questionnaire to the municipal departments represented in the conference of the departments of urban development planning of the German City Day: 1. Current problems: Which problems in the area of development planning have been up-to-date in your municipality in the last 12 months a) in the Council and b) in the Administration? 2. Current projects: Which analyses, forecasts or planning works in the area of development planning are currently working on your municipality? 3. Existing materials: Which work results are available on the points mentioned in Questions 1 and 2? Since 1985 the survey has been extended by the question: 4. Future problems: Which (existing or not yet mentioned) problem will you consider as a) in the next year and b) in the next ten years in the order of urgency and importance are above? content.text: Reverse of morality: sexuality and pornography in Victorian England. Klappentext: The era of Victorianism is in the reputation of rigid regulation of feelings, impulses and everyday imagination. The rise and development of the British bourgeoisie from the mid-19th century onwards were closely linked to the implementation of a principle of morality and reality that was based on systematic order; one of its guiding principles was rationality. Splitting away from this rationality developed a secret culture and another morality, which sought expression in particular in deviating sexual behaviour and in extensive erotic fantasies. Marcus analyses this double moral of a society and its causes in some outstanding documents: the diary "My Secret Life" and the writings of William Acton and Henry Spencer Ashbee, in which the unconsciousness of a culture against its civilizational domestication has been reflected.

Personal information systems as techniques of discipline are discussed in detail by Günther Ortmann from a business perspective. Jürgen Glaubitz's lecture deals with the effects of technological rationalisation in the retail trade and the possibilities of a trade union resistance. Hermann Korte reports on the research results of a project that has dealt with the conditions and consequences of computer-aided construction (CAD). The Bremen legal computer scientist Wilhelm Steinmüller examines the effects of the second technical revolution on the rationalization processes and from a data protection perspective on the basis of concrete examples.

content.text: Atlas of the Roman water pipelines to Cologne. The Eifel water pipeline to Cologne was one of the longest pipelines in the Roman Empire with a length of 95.4 km. It supplied Cologne with high-quality drinking water in the 1st to 3rd century AD. The pipeline was equally an expression of high standard of living, as was the result of perfect technical skills. The Atlas opens up this important area of urban infrastructure in Roman times. A documentation of archaeological finds from the past 120 years provides insights into the various areas of such an ancient large building. 60 Atlas sheets form the topographical part of the work. On these pages all the sites of the Cologne water pipelines are mapped and supplemented to an overall complex. The text explains every site, rich pictorial material facilitates understanding. No water pipeline of the Roman Empire has so far experienced such a meter accurate topographic and cartographic treatment as the Cologne pipeline by Klaus Grewe.
content.title_en: Atlas of the Roman Water Pipes to Cologne

content.text: The city and the surrounding area in financial compensation: an empirical study using the example of the central urban burden in Lower Saxony. From historical, regional planning and economic causes only a part of the municipalities - central local authorities - of a country has public institutions whose scope exceeds the respective territorial boundaries. By building and maintaining these central institutions, the institutions must accept financial burdens which increase with increasing centrality. Therefore, there are very diverse approaches in the individual Länder to achieve compensation or reduction of such burdens. In this study, these different approaches are compared. However, the main emphasis is on an analysis of the annual results of the municipalities of Lower Saxony for the year 1979. On the basis of these data, it can be shown for a country which financial links exist between individual bodies and to what extent a compensation of central local burdens can be achieved.
content.title_en: City and surrounding area in financial compensation : an empirical study using the example of the central urban pressures in Lower Saxony

content.text: Anti-poisons: organized irresponsibility. Anyone who observes can hear the question of this age: How shall we live? Natural destruction and ecological-technological hazards - that is the argument of this book - can and must be understood and decoded, however, as mystified, external, contemplative twisted forms of social self-encounter and self-determination. Society itself encounters itself in the dangers that shake it, and only to the extent that the dangers are understood as a sign of its own history and its changeability can - perhaps - the paralysis that governs be broken.

content.text: What colour does the future have? : Political culture in the technical age. content.text: Outer world - Inner world : the emergence of time, space and psychological structures. Envelope text: The author, who became known through his book "Affect Logics", opens up new surprising connections between psyche and physique on the basis of the question of the nature of time and space. His central thesis that time and space do not exist from the outset, but are generated by material events themselves, processes modern scientific findings that are about to fundamentally revise our conventional world view. Equal temporal laws, self-regulatory mechanisms, structural couplings and escalation processes are effective in physical, psychological and social systems. The new image of man and his psyche, which results from these findings, leads to a variety of practical consequences for everyday and psychiatric psychotherapeutic dealing with time and space. In particular, the idea of progress is questioned through ever greater speed.

content.text: Nonverbal communication through images. In many areas of practice, information is to be transmitted through images, for example in advertising, in didactic material, in print media, etc. The receiver's recording of information is not exhaustively described by the previous psychology of visual perception. While verbal-conceptual communication can be understood as more "sender-controlled", the visual communication is more "received" by the authors of this volume. This is the subject of the eye diaper of various schools of psychology (e.g. cognitive psychology, psychoanalysis, ethology) and for various content areas (e.g. didactical material, instructions, children's drawing, graffiti). The subject: nonverbal communication through images is originally constituted here in the subject of psychology. The results of art science on this subject flow into the contributions to this volume, because many of the authors are not only internationally recognized psychologists, but also renowned art scientists.

content.text: Interest in animal and plant species and actions in nature-environmental protection: an empirical study of adults and their consequences for environmental education. Knowledge of animal and plant species is generally considered to be of significant personal value; it is also considered a prerequisite for activities in nature-environmental protection. However, there are almost only assumptions as to how interest in species arises. Over 300,000 data were obtained through consultation of members of nature conservation associations (and a control group). This results in a multitude of interesting conclusions: which factors of stimulation and age are particularly important for the development of species interest; what high specificity these interests have; what value the employment with species has; what interactions with other biological interests, etc. A focus of the study is to clarify the influence of species interest on nature-environmental protection action. A seven-step model shows how species interest can arise and this can lead to personal commitment.

content.text: The world in fairy tales. Folk tales are world-like, they open up a world view and world experience of a universal nature. To prove this far-reaching determination from the detail, nine renowned researchers from literature, folklore, religious science, mythology and history have undertaken. In ten individual investigations they trace the world stage of fairy tales in individual motifs. The treatise on the world of this world and beyond in fairy tales is the stage frame within which individual significant world phenomena from the unlived, natural world are presented: the path, the forest, the fountain, the sky-high tree, the sea, the folding rocks, the castle on the duck leg and the glass mountain. With the question of the picture of the future in European and non-European fairy tales, the world frame is opened up into the perspective of time; here the transition from the It was once the old stories into the topicality of our days visible: what do the fairy tales have to tell us about our own world attitude and our future belief? It becomes clear that the world in fairy tales is not reduced to one dimension, only the other side, but that it is always present in the whole universe and that it contains the whole in the world in the world.
content.title_en: The world in fairy tales

content.text: Death, modernity and society : Design of a theory of death displacement. Klappentext: The fact that death is "repressed" in modern societies is one of the seemingly secure knowledge of everyday world-wide common-sense. The main objective of the investigation is to critically examine this supposedly secure judgment on its content with social theoretic means. After an epistemological and intellectual historical introduction to the topic, the formulation of a socially scientifically sound theory of death displacement, which avoids the usual cultural-critical slides of a totalitarian critique of reason and modernity, is given a central place. The "overcome attempts" of modern death suppression, formulated in a last major step of thought, refer to the criteria of their critique from the categories of modernity itself and not from an extra-mundane standpoint.

content.text: The call for rethinking has become incomprehensible and goes across all areas of society. It is raised by politicians, business leaders and scientists as well as by the man on the street. In the most diverse contexts, a new, holistic thinking is required. Meaning an integrated, concatenating thinking based on a broader horizon, from larger contexts and takes into account many factors of influence that is less insulating and disintegrating than the usual approach. A thinking that corresponds more to the many things assembled into a whole picture than the analytical approach of the specialist limited to a narrow field of expertise. The building blocks of holistic thinking are explained in detail and developed a methodology that becomes more and more necessary for the management of our complex problems. It is those problems that confront the acting man of today. The typical features of such problem situations in all areas of society can be described with networkedness, complexity, feedback, instability and other expressions. A rational behavior and leadership in such situations, moreover, requires a practical approach to the world's healthcare and management of such situations, and thus requires a response to the world's medical world.
content.title_en: Guide to holistic thinking and acting: a Brevier for executives

content.text: Comparative policy research: an introduction to problems and methods. In political science, comparison is preferred as a research strategy by more and more empirically working scientists and students. It is usually not possible to include all the population (e.g. political systems, parties) in the comparison. Selection processes are therefore necessary. The results of different research approaches offer an important orientation, because works on institutionalism, pluralism, behaviorism, corporatism, political culture and policy research have analysed the complex reality from different political science perspectives. The author offers an introduction to the different approaches and critically considers the respective methodological approach.
content.title_en: Comparative Policy Research: An Introduction to Problems and Methods

content.text: In search of homeland. Citizens' initiatives that fight for the preservation of their built environment; song groups that articulate themselves in dialect; discriminated minorities that include themselves in ghettos: are they all in search of homeland? The author shows both the danger of an understanding of »home« that has become an ideology, and the need to give people in an increasingly anonymous society those »homes« in which they are recognized and recognized. Ina-Maria Greverus is director of the Institute of Cultural Anthropology and European Ethnology at the University of Frankfurt. She wrote a fundamental work on the »territorial people« and in the Beck's Black series the volume »Culture and Everyday Life« (BSR182). content.text: The geography on the journey to postmodernism?. Thus, postmodernism strikes its tracks into space: In addition to high-tech and communication technology-oriented "flowering" locations and services, other cities and regions are shrinking. In addition to "super cities" with its glittering milieus, architectural collages and cultural stagings, other urban spaces and regions are in the shadow of the legacy of their economic and social cultural holdings. But also in the "province" there are impulses of cultural originality and specific ambiences. In relation to two research projects - on development perspectives for East Frisia and the image of the city of Oldenburg - the philosophical, social-theoretical and spatial-scientific-theoretical background is illuminated, on which pluralistic spatial developments can be interpreted. However, the view goes on into the future: in the plea of a constructive postmodernist and a social geography linked to it. Thus, a piece of concrete utopia is ventured: the perspective that a more just urban and regional development can only be achieved in the democratic opening of modernism for the development of different socio-economic forms and cultural life.
content.title_en: Geography on the journey to postmodernism?

content.text: Social systems: the basis of a general theory. Klappentext: Sociology remains at present before a theoretical threshold. Classics are worked up with alexandrine zeal, and theorems which can be combined with concepts such as action, structure, system, internal action, evolution are combined. Progress is hardly evident, however, and above all since Parsons' death every connection to the very rapidly progressive interdisciplinary discussion is lacking. From this theoretical crisis only much more complex theoretical offers can be made. Niklas Luhmann tries to lead beyond the stage of discussion in sociology. He assumes that a paradigm shift in general system theory opens up new opportunities for the theory of social systems and clears out the usual objections to a "technological" use of the system concept. The book tries to present a conceptual complexity and interdependence with the means of normal language. The unity of theory lies in the abeadingness of a large number of conceptual decisions, partly in the review of the sociological tradition and partly in connection with the theory of combination, the theory of the kybernet, and the theory of the theory of the theory is gained in the essential.
content.title_en: Social systems : basic principle of a general theory

content.text: The aim of the work is to provide a differentiated content recording and evaluation of selected environmental reports from the municipalities according to a standardised scheme. All the information required for the evaluation was entered in a specially installed literature pool, coupled with the ORLIS literature information system of the German Institute for Urban Studies. The evaluation presented in chapter 4 documents the current state of environmental reporting: the focus is on the relationship between areas of action and measures assigned to them, the cartographic representation of stress priorities and the question of primary data for the municipal environmental protection. The aim is to provide the municipalities with the possibility to inform themselves about the state of environmental reporting on specific content and methodology, to review their own state of play and to acquire knowledge and experience from other municipalities in order to make use of these possibly for their own local situation and to develop further approaches to environmental policy action.
content.title_en: Evaluation of environmental reports by municipalities

content.text: Contributions to ecological spatial development / [ed.: Institut für Ökologische Raumentwicklung e.V.]; 1: Festschrift für Gerd Albers zum 75. Geburtstag. On the occasion of Gerd Albers' 75th birthday, the chairman of the founding committee and later after the founding of the IÖR as a member of the scientific advisory board, this Festschrift was created. The institute published a selection of individual contributions from its staff of all research areas. The authors' efforts are aimed at understanding concepts, definitions, methods and procedures as well as attempts to order and systematize the research areas and studies that address current questions of spatial development.
content.title_en: Contributions to ecological spatial development / [ed.: Institut für Ökologische Raumentwicklung e.V.] ; 1: Festschrift für Gerd Albers zum 75. Geburtstag

content.text: The amendment to the Federal Building Act, which entered into force on 1 January 1977, has substantially changed Section 34 and 35 of the German Civil Engineering Act (Bundesbaugesetz) in the section entitled "Applicability of projects", which contains the admissibility of projects in the planning area for systematic reasons. The study also deals with the interpretation of Section 34 and 35. It describes the importance of the statutes in accordance with Section 34 para. 2 of the Federal Civil Engineering Act for the determination of the district under consideration. It also explains the extent to which the scale narrowing of Section 34 para. 1 is applied and how the general reliability measure according to Section 1 of this provision applies to Section 3, which in certain cases determines the rules of construction use. The expected consequences of the scale narrowing are also shown. The privilege granted by the former farmers to houses under Section 35 is examined on legal requirements and legal consequences as well as the facilitated approval of the change of use, extension or re-establishment of the defined outdoor outdoor projects.
content.title_en: Construction in the planning area, in the unplanned indoor and outdoor areas : a guide

content.text: The use of additional housing land remains unbroken, although political and planning statements indicate that the use of land is intended to reduce it. The Ministry of Urban Development and Transport of the State of North Rhine-Westphalia has commissioned the German Institute of Urban Studies to review the possibilities of managing land use - especially in the commercial sector - and transport development across all areas of the measure/instrument. This is to be done in the form of workshops on different priority areas. The publication was prepared as an introduction to the problem of land use and transport development. The general developments in land use and transport are described with the aim of creating a prerequisite for the identification of essential and successful control instruments. The purpose of the publication is, on the one hand, to provide the basis for the planned workshops and, on the other hand, to stimulate general discussion on the problem area.
content.title_en: Possibilities for managing land use and transport development : land use as a basic problem of urban and transport development

content.text: The changes in the maritime culture between Alsensund and Eckernförder Bay have been significant in the area of maritime culture along the Baltic Sea fore and the Baltic Sea coast since 1945. A SW-photo documentation was compiled to mark the 10th anniversary of the Flensburg Maritime Museum in 1994, which illustrates this change. For the accompanying volume, photos of the topics of small-scale shipping, coastal fishing, boat construction, port operation and change of location were selected and commented on in detail; in-depth essays convey background information. The bilingual Danish and German illustrated volume shows how much life on the coast has changed for residents. Cheap price, recommended. (Hanewald)
content.title_en: The changing Fördenland : Changes in maritime culture between Alsensund and Eckernförder Bay

content.text: The paper book : production, use, printability; the book for buyers, producers, print professionals and all those who want to know more about graphic papers. So far a desiderate: this newer, comprehensive presentation to one of the most important materials. In addition to sufficient history, the "PaperBuch" conveys essentials to raw materials, their preparation, for the actual paper/carton production and finishing up to the ready-to-ship goods. The different qualities, test methods and formats are also negotiated. Walenski introduces in the jargon of the paper industry easily in the context of this. The excellent illustration of the book - often schematical representations and photos parallel - supports the text optimally, even if references to pictures are missing in the text and the detailed image signatures to these often redundant. The historical photographs do not require a certain industrial romanticism. A book that may also interest the layman, with a mini lexicon and a time table, literature specifications, addresses and index. Very good addition to the "Dictionary Book ..." by the same author (BA 9/94). (Of Kapte) (3).

content.text: The aim of the book is to give an overview of the most important features of religions in today's world and to illustrate the attitude towards important current topics, such as environmental issues or the position of women on 34 maps. The Atlas focuses on the worlds of ideas of Buddhism, Christianity, Hinduism, Islam, Judaism, Sikhism and traditional worlds of faith. The appendix briefly presents the basic ideas of religions, and then gives a commentary on each map with references. As with the "Political World Atlas" (BA 4/93) and the "Eco-Atlas" (BA 12/91), interested readers only receive initial information, which can be used profitably in teaching. Unlike the expensive "Atlas of World Religions" (BA 1/95), here is a critical representation of the topics prevailing. (2 A,S) (LK/B: Burchert)
content.title_en: World Atlas of Religions

content.text: At the edges of the cities: poverty and exclusion. Social polarization and ghetto education are increasingly shaping themselves with increasing poverty and migration and with changes in the housing market. Racism, violence and defamation of the inhabitants of certain quarters are also increasing. 10 scientifically sound contributions by sociologists demonstrate the effects of exclusion and new urban poverty in the USA, the Netherlands and France and make clear the differences. For Germany, exclusion processes are described in Berlin and the situation in Hamburg's problem-urban parts. Many of these disturbing developments are already teaching topics, but with this concentrated, modest Suhrkamp-affiliation and the jargon of expertise, only performance courses can be arranged. For all social scientists mandatory reading. (2 S)
content.title_en: At the outskirts of cities: poverty and exclusion

content.text: "What I am doing right now is not necessarily second choice!": Teacher training graduates report on alternatives to school service. The present study was developed as part of the project 'Practical and environmental learning', which was carried out at the University of Oldenburg and financed by the Oldenburg Labour Office from funds for measures to create jobs. The study on teacher training graduates in extracurricular fields of activity states: - 'Analysis and approaches to the need and use of pedagogical skills in non-school occupational fields' and - 'Special approaches to promoting the professional mobility of students and graduates of the teacher training courses within the framework of the scientific results obtained. The appendix shows the interview guide used for the interviews. <dt.>
content.title_en: "What I'm doing right now is not necessarily second choice!" : Teacher training graduates report on alternatives to school service

content.text: The system approach in pedagogy: an introduction based on general system theory. Starting from the general system theory described as integration science with a subject of positive effects in the individual sciences, the author examines individual characteristics of self-transforming systems, such as conflict, identity, autonomy. The focus of the model analysis is on the question of the conflictability of systems. Using individual examples from didactics, curriculum research, adult education, company education and social work, system theoretical approaches are compared in pedagogy. The conclusion is the evaluation of a recruitment study with high school students on school problems. <dt.>
content.title_en: The system approach in pedagogy: an introduction based on general system theory

content.text: Ascetic Eros and the reconstruction of nature as a machine. Delimitation from the woman and appropriation of the female form the background for the epistemological examination of Bacon and Descartes. "Any attempt which does not understand the nature of the subject of knowledge on the one hand, and the reduction of women to nature as a historical process, writes the dualism of spirit/man and nature/woman, which it is nevertheless necessary to dissolve." Therefore, it is not about the much-conspiratorial conflict between male versus female, male urge to power and knowledge and female closeness to nature, but the dialectic of inner and outer natural domination is above all understood as a dialectic of patriarchal domination and exploitation of female labor. The concept of love for the Identian and the idea-historical elaboration of Christian asceticism, an effort for virgin purity and killing of the flesh, developed by Hans-Jürgen Krahl after <d.>
content.title_en: Ascetic Eros and the reconstruction of nature to the machine

content.text: The Müll-Book : Proposals for interdisciplinary material lessons on the topic of "Müll-Recycling". Several Oldenburg scientists from different disciplines provide teaching aids on the topic of waste recycling. Strong emphasis is placed on the self-activity of the students. <dt.>
content.title_en: The Waste Book : Proposals for interdisciplinary material teaching on "Müll-Recycling"

content.text: The Scope of Science. Carl Friedrich von Weizsäcker: "Die Größe der Wissenschaft", 6th edition. With the previously unpublished 2nd part in authorized translation and a new preface by the author. About the 2nd part a. d. Engl. v. Hans Dietrich. Hirzel Verlag, Stuttgart 1990. XXIII, 481 pp., kt., 38,- DM
content.title_en: The Scope of Science

content.text: The pain a museum visitor suffers, one only knows that since a museum shop has relieved them: here you can touch, buy and take everything home; here the consumer finds after the spirit world of the untouchable and unsold into true life. Is he happy there? That is the question Walter Grasskamp pursues in his numerous wanderings through the world of goods. On them he portrays tea drinkers and cigarette smokers, sofa picture owners and pop music fans, jewellery wearers and brand-dresses in relation to the goods for which they give the most valuable thing they have, their money - unless they are among the shop thieves to whom a special consideration is devoted.
content.title_en: Consumer happiness : the commodity redemption

content.text: In modern ecology quantitative studies, quantitative surveys and statistical methods are part of the scientific routine. In this data collection, current numerical values are presented in tabular form, broken down according to the sub-areas of ecology, nature conservation and anthropogenic influences. The numerical material is prepared in such a way that it can be used in teaching at universities and universities of applied sciences as well as in biology classes at high schools. In addition, it can serve as a source of information for students and ecologically interested readers. How big? How hard? How fast? How often?. Such and other questions can be met with record-suspicious answers. This collection collects numerical values, data and facts on general and applied ecology in tabular form. A treasure trove of information worth knowing with interesting data of extreme values! Suitable for this: - Biology in figures - The human being in numbers - Ecology in numbers
content.title_en: Ecology in figures : a collection of data in tables with over 10,000 individual values

content.text: Environment - Ecology : Selection bibliography, proof of essays from German-language journals. Journal articles, documented in the journal service between 1993 and 1995 (where: evaluation of about 180 German-language journals of all subject areas), developed by keywords or keyword chains. Price-worthy and helpful means of information on current topics and developments in the field of ecology and environment. (2 A) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: Environment - Ecology : Selection bibliography, proof of essays from German-language journals

content.text: Wood construction atlas. Handbook for architects, engineers and students; overview Building material Wood (wood types, strength, solid wood, laminated wood, wood materials, wood protection); structural structure (dragwork development, connections, stabilization, stiffening); wooden structures, wooden structures
content.title_en: Woodwork Atlas

Updated in the steel sector compared with the 7th edition 1984 (BA 7/84), and adapted to the new (Euro) standard. Suitable for a wide range of technical readers (the old edition must be replaced.) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Small material science for welding steel and iron

content.text: The Aral Sea: an ecological catastrophe. The special feature of this first comprehensive monograph on the history and problem of the 'Aral Sea' ecosystem is its multidisciplinary approach. The range ranges from the explanation of the geological formation of the Aral Basin to its settlement and economic history to the description of the ecosystemal connections and their massive impairments caused by civilization and economy. In addition to the causes and mechanisms that led to this hitherto biggest ecological crisis caused by humans, the authors also address the consequences that can be derived from this as well as possible countermeasures.
content.title_en: Lake Aral : an ecological disaster

content.text: We can only build a secure, meaningful future if we know about our evolutionary past. The author continues this thought, outlined in his book "Flow" (BA 5/92), which deals with the origins of man, the consequences and the control of evolution. He emphasizes that man should not only be concerned with his individual development, but also focus his energy on the development of a "good society", which enables joy through his own forms and complexity. As a goal, he is confronted with a "faith community" that supports positive trends and combats negative ones. The statements, which are picked with illustrative examples, are worth reading and the advice. (2)
content.title_en: Give a future to the meaning of life: a psychology for the 3rd millennium

content.text: Methods of humanities pedagogy : Introduction to hermeneutics, phenomenology and dialectics : with 28 illustrations and detailed examples of texts. This book introduces fundamentals into hermeneutics, phenomenology and dialectics. The author explains central concepts, basic ideas and possibilities for working with the methods. This happens on a general philosophical level as well as on the basis of original texts and their interpretation. Numerous illustrations and overviews illustrate the contents additionally. An indispensable basic reading for students of all disciplines of humanities!
content.title_en: Methods of humanities education : Introduction to hermeneutics, phenomenology and dialectics : with 28 illustrations and detailed examples of texts

content.text: Mathematical-logical foundations of computer science. Compact introduction to the mathematical foundations of computer science (mathematical logic, set theory, Boolian networks, relations, functions, count theory, algebraic structures, recursivity, fuzzy logic) for computer science students in the main and minor subject, which is supplemented by a free e-learning course on the Internet. Presumes only basic mathematics course knowledge, subdivides the material enriched with examples and definitions into individual "knowledge building blocks", whereby the emphasis is placed on the teaching of mathematical-logical structures. Do not give up detailed mathematical evidence without the visuality would suffer. A meaningful addition to textbooks of theoretical computer science, usable as the by no means outdated titles of Rainer Beedgen (BA 4/94) or Peter Bachmann (ID 35/92). (2)
content.title_en: Mathematical-logical foundations of computer science

content.text: Making cities smarter : designing, interactive, urban, applications. User perspective - urban infrastructure - technologies for an intelligently connected city - intelligent citizens - intelligent citizen - participation in urban planning - interface between citizens and smart city systems - Martin Tomitsch transfers principles of user experience design and its applications to the urban environment, and is dedicated to the related specific problems - such as having to plan for a wide range of uses and users, as well as linking analogue and digital practices. The manual provides a first comprehensive guide on the experience-based development of applications for the intelligently connected city, focusing on the citizen as an end user.
content.title_en: Making cities smarter : designing, interactive, urban, applications

content.text: Events have become an integral part of our everyday life. They are professionally planned, designed by sophisticated dramaturgy and convey a sense of exclusivity. The concept of events represents a specific field of tension between economic exploitation contexts and popular practical dimensions. Against the background of this conceptual blurry, the book focuses on processes of urban development and the normative potential of patterns of event production and reception. One of these is that urban development and event production are seen as drivers of exclusion processes. On the other hand, eventization is seen as an interlocking of production and reception processes. We all take part more or less actively in processes of eventization and usually also gratefully take them to the other side of eventization and the inequalities they cause, but most of the time they remain invisible. Therefore, the question of how event cultures and practices of social self-conciliation are reorganized and networked is addressed in Zurich.
content.title_en: Eventization of the city

content.text: Berlin and its builders : when the capital became a world city. Due to the determined entrepreneurial spirit and the often creative power of builders, architectural idea buildings can only be realized in the first place. Against this background, the book is dedicated to the multifaceted work of six selected construction contractors who worked as Berlin flourished with vehemence to the world city. The compact treatises on life and work are not least seeking to illustrate their far-reaching but widely unknown influence on the development of Berlin's city shape and architecture.
content.title_en: Berlin and its builders : when the capital became world city

content.text: Basics and practice of rock determination. According to the main rock groups magmatites, metamorphites and sediments structured determination book with extensive introduction in their geological history. (2)
content.title_en: Basics and practice of rock determination

content.text: The digital: Market, value creation and justice in data capitalism. How does economic added value arise in capitalism? And how should it be redistributed? These were the central questions that Karl Marx answered in a radical way at the transition to industrial capitalism in "The Capital". Viktor Mayer-Schönberger and Thomas Ramge re-re-invent the same questions at the transition to global data capitalism. We can re-invent the market with data - and create prosperity for all. Big data, automation and artificial intelligence must be able to fully realise their potential. The efficiency gains cannot be reaped by the large data monopolists alone. Only if this benefits all, we will create a digital social market economy. But money and banks will play a subordinate role in this. A milestone in economic literature. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: The Digital: Market, Value Added and Justice in Data Capitalism

content.text: The present guide explains the basic techniques of geo-detic data collection, the conversion of such data into topographic maps and elevation profiles, as well as the basic geological measurement techniques and the creation of geological profiles. Both simple "freehand techniques" that can be used by a person in the process of prospecting, as well as the use of professional precision instruments, are included in this book. In the first section, map coordinate systems and the handling of map coordinates are presented. In the second part, a detailed presentation of the geo-detic and geological measurement techniques important for the geoscientist and the geoscientist is completed as well as a brief introduction to the creation of geological profiles. The textbook concludes with an instrument science in which the instruments used in the measurements are presented.
content.title_en: Fairs in the field

content.text: Urban Design. This book provides a guide to prospective architects, city and landscape planners in the process of urban design projects and designs. This edition has been extended by two chapters on informal urban design and regional urban design. The contents presented and their preparation are based on the design process in practice and embed them in a theoretical framework of necessary background knowledge. As an introduction, an overview of the understanding of city, urban structures and the prevailing legal frameworks is given. In order to make the complex structure of the city more understandable, this is divided into different layers and building blocks. The approach of urban design is described by means of the "shift method" in the form of successive phases. Examples of urban design projects and competitions illustrate the individual design steps. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Urban Design

content.text: Art, politics and society in Europe since the 19th century. "The development of the arts has been shaped by processes of nationalization, internationalization and transnationalization and the tensions that have arisen from it. The authors of this volume examine these interactions between art, politics and society in modern times. Using selected sources, they use the history of the production, mediation, reception and use of artistic works in relation to the history of European societies and political and economic systems. Their focus is on cross-border exchange processes and relationships. The volume, conceived as a study and textbook, is divided into three parts. Part one deals with the role of art in the civil public sphere and the development of the art market. Part two analyses the functions of culture, art and artists in various political systems and in the field of tension between nationalization and internationalization of cultural relations. Part three deals with the relationship between art, architecture and urban development in Europe"-Back cover
content.title_en: Art, Politics and Society in Europe since the 19th century

content.text: How science creates knowledge: Science theory and ethics for social and economic sciences. Knowledge creates science through its (empirical) methods.This book shows social and economic sciences how their methods are theoretically based on science.A pluralistic concept is used to discuss key topics and show how to test scientific research standards for their justification in the competition for ideas.This book is aimed at students, teachers and scientists from social and economic sciences alike.
content.title_en: How science creates knowledge : Theory and ethics of science for social and economic sciences

content.text: Delighted : Berlin and its monuments : Citadel. The richly illustrated accompanying volume documents the origin of the exhibition, deepens the topics addressed in the media stations and contains a series of essays on the Berlin monument landscape.
content.title_en: Discovered : Berlin and its monuments : Citadel

content.text: The intervention book: Stop bullying at schools: practical book with copy templates and download material. Technically and practically based, this book leads through a serious topic that can suddenly affect everyone in the school environment: bullying among schoolchildren. It provides a look behind the stage of group-dynamic processes and answers fundamental questions from the practitioner's point of view, e.g.: What drives students to bullying? How do I recognise bullying? How do I react to it? The heart of this is a step-by-step guide that clearly defines school responsibilities and thus safely accompanies teachers through the intervention process in bullying incidents. Practical case studies are prepared for teachers in a case-by-case manner. Practical assistance, including against cyberbulbing, legal provisions as well as literature tips and contact addresses complete this school intervention book. In the annex and online work sheets for all the intervention steps described are provided. Horst Lehner is a respected expert on the subject of bullying with more than 1,000 class assignments and as a speaker at educational universities in Tyrol/Austria.
content.title_en: The Intervention Book: Stop bullying at schools : Practice book with copy templates and download material

content.text: Progress and regression. The abolition of slavery, the introduction of social security systems, the sanctioning of rape in marriage are generally regarded as social progress - a change for the better. Nevertheless, the idea of a general movement for progress has lost its old splendour, yes, it even evokes skepticism. On the other hand, the diagnosis of regression is on the whole. It is presented with various time phenomena, from right-wing authoritarian populism to democracy fatigue. In her book, Rahel Jaeggi defends the concept of progress and regression as an indispensable social philosophical tool for the critique of our time. As progressive or regressive, she sees not only the result, but above all the form of social transformations themselves. By asking about the obstacles to experience, the regressive tendencies are promoting, she develops a concept of progress that avoids Eurocentric distortions just as the idea of an inevitable trend towards development. Progress, it shows, is not the advance to an already known goal, but the never-complete process of emancipation.
content.title_en: Progress and regression

content.text: The terrestrial manifesto. A series of political storms has confused the world. The instruments with which we used to orientated ourselves no longer work. If we long understand politics as a time ray that would lead from a local past to a global future, we realize that the globe is too small for our globalization plans. The path to a more protected past also proves to be fiction. We are hanging in the air, the sudden crash threatens. In this explosive situation it is first of all necessary to regain firm ground under our feet and then to reorient itself. Bruno Latour attempts to re-measure the landscape of the political and to direct our political passions to new objects. Beyond the traditional distinctions such as left and right, progressive and reactionary, he pleads for a radically materialistic policy that not only involves the production process, but also the ecological conditions of our existence.
content.title_en: The Terrestrial Manifesto

content.text: Building Energy Consulting: Basics - Systems - Application. The regulations of the Building Energy Act (GEG) as well as the current precarious energy situation have been highly relevant to the topic "Building Energy Consulting" and there is still a need for qualified personnel. The technical book was first published in 2007 (see ID-B 13/08), last published in 3rd edition 2010 (not shown here). The changes have been of course large since then. Structure and content have been completely revised with a new team of authors. In 5 chapters, topics such as sustainability, basics for heat transfer, building energy planning, building energy management as well as the actual approach to a qualified energy consulting are now dealt with. Numerous diagrams, sample calculations and illustrations (black-and-white). The contents are written intelligibly for the target group of the incoming building energy planner, consultant and manager - for self-study or as accompanying technical book for further trainings. Much more comprehensive than "The On-site Energy Consulting" (ID-A 43/19), in which only the practical implementation of the consultation is dealt with. Clear old requirements. (2).
content.title_en: Building Energy Consulting : Basics - Systems - Application

content.text: iCloud & Apple ID: more security for your data on the Internet. Apple's iCloud is available on the Internet with a 5 GB memory, which can not only be used to store mails and backups, but also as an online hard drive since OS X Yosemite or iOS 8. The well-known authors have continuously revised and updated their predecessors for this issue. The differences are not serious, but those who want to revisit the topic as Apple users will be grateful to include the clarifications and additional information. Among the numerous available color illustrations are some new or replaced screenshots. The important information that is provided in color appears now in black on light yellow background (M. Lobeck had rightly criticized the color scheme) and are now perfectly readable.
content.title_en: iCloud & Apple ID: more security for your data on the Internet

content.text: Building for Democracy : History and Present of the Lower Saxony Parliamentarism and its Buildings. Publisher's info: Residential Building, Opera, Barracks and finally the seat of the Lower Saxony State Congress: the Leine Castle has already had many functions in its 380-year history. With the inauguration of the new plenary hall on 27 October 2017, another chapter of Hanoverian urban development ends. In addition to the change of the Leine Castle, this volume also addresses the development of Lower Saxony's parliamentarism and its buildings. Immerse yourself in history and discover the historical identity of Lower Saxony.
content.title_en: Building for Democracy : History and Present of Lower Saxony Parliamentarism and its Buildings

content.text: The banking industry is changing: status quo and current challenges. The book provides a scientifically sound overview of current developments in banking and the resulting challenges for credit institutions. Based on the study of the current economic situation and taking into account historical events, the book presents both general trends – in particular digitalisation, demographic change, social development towards sustainability and globalisation – as well as industry-specific developments – such as the worsening regulatory, low interest rate and the continuing loss of confidence in the banking industry – and analyses them in terms of possible fields of action and alternative actions. In addition to scientifically sound consideration, the relevance to practice is particularly important. Therefore, the book is of great interest not only for economists but also for experts from the banking industry as well as for interested experts in the financial sector.
content.title_en: The banking industry in transition: status quo and current challenges

It is about questions about faith and loss of faith, about the Church between adaptation and arbitrariness, about the relationship between norm and reality and the "Phenomenon Francis"
content.title_en: Praying in fog : does faith have a future?

content.text: Gorbachev: the man and his time: a biography. Publishing info: Revered and admired abroad as the man who opened the gate to a new age, he is considered among his compatriots as a weakling and gravedigger of the Soviet empire: Mikhail Gorbachev is a great statesman for some and a failure for others. Pulitzer prize winner William Taubman now presents the basic biography of this century figure - meticulously researched, invented in the verdict and captivatingly written. When Mikhail Gorbachev became the youngest general secretary in the history of the KPdSU in 1985 at 54 years, the Soviet Union was one of two superpowers. But only four years later Perestroika and Glasnost had changed the Soviet Union forever and Gorbachev more enemies as friends. His policy ended the Cold War. But the year after he had to take a failed coup - without wanting to - to look at the collap of that empire which he had tried to save. William Taub described in his book as a peasant boy to the top of America.
content.title_en: Gorbachev : the man and his time : a biography

content.text: Violence on the ground : Space - Body - Communication. For some years now, the interest in spatial theoretical analyses has been growing in the field of violence research. Based on qualitative case studies, the contributions of this volume explore the question of how violent dynamics shape or change social spaces and how, in turn, social spaces influence violent dynamics.
content.title_en: Violence on site : Space - Body - Communication

content.text: So you'll be rich like Norway: brilliantly simple to build a fortune. The Norwegian financial formula for private investors Norway has just risen to the happiest country on earth. That's probably also because the Norwegians don't have to worry about money. The reason for this? Norway has oil. And from the sales revenues the largest sovereign fund in the world is fed: the Norwegian oil fund. Clemens Bomsdorf extracted the Norwegian financial formula from the fund's strategy and adapted it to the needs of private investors. With the advice from the school of passive investing, security-oriented investors can also build a solid fortune. And since one of the principles is ethical investing, they do good with their investment. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: So you'll be rich like Norway : awesomely easy to build a fortune

content.text: The last coal mines in Germany close in 2018: the age of coal from 1750 to today. On this occasion Franz-Josef Brüggemeier tells the history of the raw material, which marked an entire age. For a long time, coal stood for progress and prosperity. It enabled an undreamt-of productivity boost and delivered the energy to break out of the premodern production methods. Without the coal the Industrial Revolution would not have been possible. With its help, European societies reached an unprecedented level of development until the 20th century. But this coal-driven leap into modern times also had its dark sides: the coal supplied the energy for two disastrous world wars, and the conditions of their mining underground were devastating for the health of the workers. Finally, the environmental impact caused by the coal production heralded the beginning of the end of the most important fossil energy source in mankind's history.
content.title_en: Mine gold : the age of coal from 1750 to today

content.text: Sexual violence: experiences of young people today. Forms, frequency and effects of sexual violence in young people. Results of a study conducted in Hesse in schools (9th and 10th grade). (2S)
content.title_en: Sexual Violence: Youth Experiences Today

content.text: Children's images on the social web: An empirical study on the internet-based image presence and image use of under 12 years old. The omnipresence of child photos on the internet has long been a subject of much public debate and above all controversial discussion. Up to now, almost exclusively adults have been expressing themselves about this image presence. The study closes a research gap by examining the perspective of 11- and 12-year-old children on the basis of guide-centric interviews. Here, questions about their usage preferences and presentation strategies are investigated as well as the intra-amilial rules on media use and the attitude of parents to dealing with child and family images in online environments.Due to the detailed presentation of the methodical approach, the volume is particularly suitable for students for introducing data collection with guide interviews and their evaluation on the basis of qualitative content analysis.
content.title_en: Child images on the social web : An empirical study on the internet-based image presence and image use of under 12 years old

content.text: What will happen to us? : Thinking about nature. "What is part of nature and can you find it everywhere?" "Where does nature have such a great power?" "Where does winter know when it has to come?" " Always win the stronger?" "Life nuts?": Short questions, placed on photos and illustrations, open up a space for everyday and philosophical considerations. A family book! For all those who love nature. From 6 years (Deutschlandfunk – Die besten 7 Bücher für junge Leser im Monat August 2018)
content.title_en: What will happen to us? : Thinking about nature

content.text: How democracies die : and what we can do about it. The book of the two Harvard professors is the most profound confrontation at the moment with the dangers that democratic states of the West threaten... Symptoms of the democratic collapse are shown above all by the behavior of the American President Trump, who repeatedly violates norms and disregards rules to destroy the balance of the division of powers. (1)
content.title_en: How democracies die : and what we can do about it

content.text: The day I became my mother: being a daughter between love and liberation. Nicole Zepter, born in 1976, describes the influence of a mother-daughter relationship on patterns of behavior, partner choice and bonding behavior. She tells of the visible and invisible power of the family, of subterranean messages and "adaptation codes" from which she learned to understand why so much of her life has been repeated in her mother's life. In relation to scenes from her life, similar from the life of the mother, which also gives information about her own motives and developments, is reflected in an infinitely seemingly intelligent and individual way.
content.title_en: The day I became my mother : being a daughter between love and liberation

content.text: Radical digital : because man makes the difference - 111 management recipes. From the publishing news: "Klar ... reduces the challenges of digitalization to three core tasks for managers: customer - cooperation - creativity..."
content.title_en: Radical digital : because man makes the difference - 111 leadership recipes

content.text: Would : what makes us strong - as individuals and as society. We all want to die in dignity, but should we not live in dignity for the first time? - Dignity is a great concept. Just as in Article 1 of the Basic Law it says: "The dignity of man is inviolable." But what exactly is dignity? What does it mean if our dignity is taken from us, because we are only counted as a record in the digital world or are being revered on the net? If we ourselves behave in a state of unwarrantedness or degrading others? In his new book, brain researcher Gerald Hüther shows that dignity is not only an ethically philosophically founded human right, but a neurobiologically sound inner compass that enables us not to lose ourselves in the diversity of external requirements and constraints in the highly complex world. It is therefore all the more important that we learn to strengthen the perception of one's dignity. For: whoever is aware of his dignity is not feasible.
content.title_en: Would : what makes us strong - as individuals and as society

content.text: TOP 50 Conversions : renovate, modernize, expand. The book offers 50 examples on four pages each for the renovation, modernization and extension of single-family, double- and terraced houses, town-farm houses, but also of listed buildings. Ideas for professionals and builders with floor plans, building data, architectural directory
content.title_en: TOP 50 Conversions : renovate, modernize, expand

content.text: Digitalization in libraries: scan much more than just books. "This volume focuses on the retro-digitization of decision-makers and experts on the latest technical application (crowdsourcing tools or comprehensive digitalisation software). However, topics such as the extremely complex integration of heterogeneous digital collections into a single portal, the digitization of various media genres (newspapers, theatre leaflets, videos, manuscripts, funeral sermons, personal writings), a federal-wide open access infrastructure project and digitalization within a very specialized One Person Library are also covered."
content.title_en: Digitization in libraries: much more than just scanning books

content.text: Statistics for sociologists. Introduction to statistics for sociology studies.The textbook contains all important topics of basic statistical education: from the description of individual variables to multivariate analysis. It provides a clear overview of the current state of social science statistics education.
content.title_en: Statistics for sociologists

content.text: A Generation Y Manifesto for a New Leipzig Charter: the neo-European city. In 2007, the European Ministers for Urban Development and Regional Planning in Leipzig adopted the "Leipzig Charter for a Sustainable European City". The aim of the Leipzig Charter 2007 was to anchor an integrated, urban urban development as an essential approach in order to strengthen and further develop the European city. A special focus was also on districts with special development needs. What demands does the young generation place on the Leipzig Charter? 2017, on the ten-year anniversary of the Charter, students formulated a manifesto for a "neo-European" city.
content.title_en: A Generation Y Manifesto for a New Leipzig Charter: the neo-European city

content.title_en: Smart tasks for mechanics and heat : learning with video experiments and co.

content.text: Empirical research into internet-based communication. The volume presents seven research contributions that have been made in connection with the interdisciplinary DFG network 'Empirical research into internet-based communication'. Questions of modelling and analysis of language and interaction in the network are addressed on the basis of written and multimodal data. Michael Beisswenger, University of Duisburg-Essen, Essen, Germany.
content.title_en: Empirical research on internet-based communication

content.text: Wild Forests. The publicist and filmmaker Roger Deakin (1943-2006) had a surprise success during his lifetime with "Logbuch eines Schwimmers" (ID-G 12/16), in the UK. In this he explores the united kingdom swimming and describes his journey in haunting nature descriptions. From the estate he wrote this book, in which he describes his intimate relationship with the forests wherever he experiences them. Starting from the trees of his Suffolk garden, his journey through the forests of Great Britain leads across Europe to Central Asia and Australia. He asks questions about the nature and cultural history of the forest and the function and importance of the wood. His subjective natural experiences, his encounters with people and his excursions into philosophy and literature are wonderful to read. (2-3)
content.title_en: Wild forests

content.text: Fake instead of fact: how populists, bots and trolls attack our democracy. Public space has changed fundamentally. What starts as tweet or post leads to practical violence and has direct influence on election results. A real information war has arisen that should divide our society and make democratic institutions untrustworthy. It is about moods, not facts. Populists and extremists need a story: with victims and perpetrators, clear enemies and heroes. Thus, the echo and opinion rooms on the Internet are a biotope for both. Ute Schaeffer has gone undercover for almost two years into these spaces. She describes the actors behind the campaigns, analyses the stories and shows how the functions of the network enhance the effect of propaganda. Digital disinformation. Keywords: mass media; miscommunication; disinformation; democracy; manipulation; Internet ; propaganda ; fake news ; disinformation; elections, elections -- corrupt practices ; populism
content.title_en: Fake instead of fact: how populists, bots and trolls attack our democracy

content.text: Zero oil. Zero gas. Zero coal : how climate policy works : a proposal. Climate policy does not fail because it would be too complicated. On the contrary, it would be so simple if you were to admit it: it becomes warmer mainly because mankind burns oil, coal and gas. Therefore, climate policy can only work if it works to ban the fossil fuels from the market. The CO2 emission does not simply have to sink. It must go down to "net zero". Basically, the governments of the world have recognized this with the climate agreement of Paris. And yet politics, economics and also the economic sciences do everything to complicate the simple - or rather: in order not to have to realize that the time of super-cheap, abundant energy is over. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Zero oil. Zero gas. Zero coal: how climate policy works : a proposal

content.text: The power of digital platforms: a guide to the age of expanding digital spheres and artificial intelligence. This book provides an introduction to the complex world of digital platforms, their essence is conveyed in a comprehensible way and illustrated in practical examples. The author thus highlights a characterising core element of digitalisation. A better understanding of the nature and power of digital platforms is urgently needed, as digital platforms increasingly play a strategic role in all economic and living areas. The author explains the core building blocks and the internal mechanisms of digital platforms. In addition, there are suggestions and principles for the design of digital platform ecosystems. The content • Core elements of digitalisation and the phenomenon of disruption • Core building blocks and mechanisms of digital platforms • The artificial machine intelligence of algorithms • Digital platform ecosystems in practice - Case studies • The prevailing spirit of time in Silicon Valley and the concept of technological singularity The target groups • CEOs, CFOs, CIOs of companies and associations • Policymakers and practitioners • Dozierende und Studieren der Informatik • Angebieter Bürger zum Digitale Business Models The author Michael Jaekel has long-termin der Geschichtsprachen und Beitung der Gänzungs-Bewerberangschaftsetzung in die Gänwerbermarkt-Bewerberschidungen, die Gäntradungen- und Bewerbermarkt
content.title_en: The Power of Digital Platforms: Signposts in the Age of an Expanding Digital Universe and Artificial Intelligence

content.text: For a sustainable traffic turnaround / Heiner Monheim, with the collaboration of Dörte Monheim; Volume 2: Paths to the pedestrian city : analyses and concepts. Klappentext: This book explains the great general importance of walking, demonstrates the multiple ignorance of traffic planning against the needs of walking and shows that the previously isolated "flickschusterei" is not sufficient to achieve more and systematic pedestrian friendliness. It names modern methods of walking traffic analysis and shows with which strategies and elements one can regain the public space for walking.
content.title_en: For a sustainable traffic transition / Heiner Monheim, with the collaboration of Dörte Monheim; Volume 2: Paths to the pedestrian city : analyses and concepts

Examples of optimization problems, e.g. when baking cakes or correctly assembling the right wild boar feed, help to classify the contexts. To deepen the substance, QR codes are inserted in many places, which link to live recordings and short summaries.The aim of the book is to convey a safe handling of numbers and functions. Furthermore, financial mathematical problems can be solved. The second chapter introduces basic functions that are relevant in business practice.
