The fourth chapter on the topic of economics is the topic of economics.
content.title_en: Mathematics in the business cycle : application-oriented and understandable

content.text: Gold: from myth to investment. From ancient mesopotamia 5,000 years ago to the role of precious metal in colonial times to the gold standard of modernism – gold is a large part of our history or has significantly influenced and shaped it. And even today it plays a very special role.The 2nd revised edition of the book offers an exciting and varied introduction to the topic of "gold". The author ranges the arc from the use of precious metal in history, the extraction and mining, to the investment possibilities of today.
content.title_en: Gold : from myth to investment

content.text: Handbook on Poverty : Causes, Trends, Measures. How do we talk about poverty? What do we know about poverty? How do we work on poverty? The handbook provides answers to these questions and provides both overview and detailed information. It is aimed at students and teachers of the social sciences, but also at practitioners from social work who have to do with the phenomenon of poverty. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Handbook on Poverty : Causes, Trends, Measures

content.text: The City Region : Planning - Politics - Management. "This title spans the spectrum of historical, geographical and urban aspects, economic and administrative, and political aspects of the City Region Classical urban-Umland conflicts are discussed with solutions. Numerous case studies make the presentation concrete, vivid and practical. Ideal for study and practice." (Verlagsinformation)
content.title_en: The urban region : Planning - Politics - Management

content.text: The Committee of the Regions also calls on the Commission to ensure that the European Parliament and the Council are fully informed of the progress made in the field of employment and social security in the Member States, and to ensure that the Commission is fully informed of the progress made in the field of employment and social protection in the Member States.
content.title_en: Should and can the freedom of movement of workers be limited?

content.text: The geology of Europe. How does the white chalk coast of Dover form and when did the rugged peaks of the Alps emerge? What processes did the fjord coasts in Scandinavia or the North German lowlands form? Graham Park explains in a compact and understandable way how the continent of Europe was created. He chronologically leads through the geological events that shaped Europe during the course of the Earth's history and shows how the different regions and landscapes emerged. On the latest state of research and literature, the book impresses with its modern design and vivid representation with many coloured illustrations, photos and overview maps.
content.title_en: The geology of Europe

content.text: Reforms beyond revolt: Zurich in the long sixties. "68" stands for student movement, strikes and street battles in Berlin, Paris or Zurich, as well as for protesting against the Vietnam war, for the Prague Spring or experimenting with new lifestyles. But what was before "68"? What kind of reform currents developed independently and beyond it? The New Year's Bulletin 2018 of the Antiquarian Society shows a variety of upheavals between the 1950s and the 1970s in the Zurich area in an interplay with Switzerland and the world. The "long sixties" of the 20th century saw reforms and initiatives that began in the 1950s and gained momentum in the following decade. Jazz clubs and educational reforms, traffic planning and construction boom, the presence of foreign workers, the emancipation of women or the question of nuclear armament, but also the expansion of psychoanalysis shifted to the center of political and social debate. This upheaval was influenced by the worldwide effective events and changes that were reflected in the local environment. The new city of Zurich occasionally broadcasts its new members in the world, and the new members in the new city in 1968.
content.title_en: Reforms beyond revolt : Zurich in the long sixties

content.text: The car industry is able to reinvent itself by the diesel scandal, by the use of the type approval, by price and strategy agreements: the doubts about whether the will to reform is in fact present at all in the car manufacturers and whether the industry is able to transfer the drive forms or even to develop new mobility offers are increasing. ... Because the German car industry really likes it as it is now, very well: it is a powerful industry with many industrial jobs, politically well connected and spoiled by success for decades. ... In order to survive in the mobility of the future, the companies have to reinvent themselves completely. But this does not succeed by itself. Changed political framework conditions, new alliances and consumers will have to force the companies to their happiness. ?Tumbling giants. Will the car industry succeed in reinventing? shows which course to make the turn still to be made. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Sumbling giants : is the car industry able to reinvent?

content.text: Smart green world? : Digitalisation between monitoring, consumption and sustainability. "Everything will change!" This prophetic reputation from the IT industry has become a common assessment of the scope of digitalization. But what brings digitalization to ecology and justice? Does it lead us into a smart green world in which everyone benefits from technological progress and at the same time we treat the environment more gently? Or do we steer into a digital capitalism in which money and power are concentrated in few and the economy is growing even further beyond the planetary boundaries? Steffen Lange and Tilman Santarius analyze how digitalization has had an impact on energy and resource consumption, jobs and income distribution so far, and develop design principles for sustainable digitalization
content.title_en: Smart green world?: Digitalisation between monitoring, consumption and sustainability

content.text: Fake News : a handbook for school and teaching. The development of youth's intelligence skills must be understood as an indispensable task for school and teaching. Otherwise, young people in our increasingly digitized world will be less and less able to assess news offers in terms of quality and seriousness. Armin Himmelrath (see last ID-B 24/16) and his co-author clarify the terms, inform about the theoretical contexts, present relevant studies and provide practical ideas, suggestions and suggestions for how to promote youth media literacy, so as to learn to distinguish truth and fake news, assess the seriousness of Facebook news, deal with hatred on the web and more. A further and practical help for teachers and for those working in extracurricular youth work; (2S)
content.title_en: Fake News : a handbook for school and teaching

content.text: Marble and asphalt: social surfaces in Berlin of the 20th century. Elegantly curved glass facades, in front of which smooth asphalt roads lead through cut convertibles - in the 1920s Berlin, the feeling of modern life can be read first and foremost on the material of the buildings and traffic routes. After 1945, in the divided city, the ideological debate between East and West is held not least on its house facades: vertical, upward-looking windows for the socialist person in Stalinallee are facing the rousing view from the horizontally stored windows in the Hansaviertel in West Berlin. After the fall of the wall, the city had to reinvent itself between the desire to recover the old Berlin, the struggle for sophisticated architecture from modern materials and the ideas of international investors. Monika Wagner, art historian and expert for the material in modern art, looks at the city of Berlin and its public spaces in three striking historical moments of the 20th century, focusing on the surfaces that one first perceives, on the basis of the fabric that the city consists of, Wagner's new urban perspective.
content.title_en: Marble and asphalt : social surfaces in Berlin of the 20th century

content.text: The historian Franziska Bruder (cf. "Hundreds of such heroes", ID-G 31/13) in her extensive book Jewish, who fled from deportation to the extermination camps Belcec, Sobibor and Treblinka in the context of "Aktion Reinhardt" (cf. Lehnstaedt: "Der Kern des Holocausts", ID-A 12/17) pays tribute to the fact that they fled as an act of resistance. The focus is on numerous short biographies of Springer and Treblinka, which were compiled on the basis of autobiographical testimonies and testimonies from investigations against Nazi terrorists and other documents. She investigates what the victims knew about the extermination camps and under what conditions the escape took place, which contributed to the success or failure. It depicts the escape as an act of resistance, which is not possible without solidarity and support of those who were left behind in the wagon. The numerous photos are not yet seen in the appendix, the large number of the photographs are not considered in the context of the deportation, the large number of the deportations, the number of the items is not considered in the context.
content.title_en: Determine your own fate: Escapes from deportations of the "Aktion Reinhardt" in Poland

content.text: Berlin : Stadt der Revolte. Verlagsinfo: "Wer nicht hehrt, lebt verkehr". Everywhere in Berlin there are places where revolts took place: the student movement in the West, the oppositionists in the East, the feminists, squatters and punks in both parts of the city. As much as the reactions of the respective state power to the young rebels on both sides of the wall differed, surprisingly similar were the motives and courage of the people who were in favour of outdated orders and authorities. Michael Sontheimer and Peter Wensierski tell the younger story of a rebellious metropolis by means of apartments, houses, streets and squares. Supported by extensive research and discussions with the participants, they create a topography of revolts that invites you to stroll, discover and marvel. (2)
content.title_en: Berlin : City of the Revolt

content.text: For years, young far-rights have been deliberately settling in rural areas to do "national grassroots work" across generations. This inconspicuous actionism is directed against the modern and liberal society of large cities, with old gender images and authoritarian educational patterns prevailing. The right-wing exiters are engaged in ecological agriculture, maintain old crafts and national customs, organize land purchase groups and their own economic networks that operate nationwide. They engage in local associations and enter local politics to combine environmental protection with "popular protection" and prevent alleged "alienation"
content.title_en: Volkische Landnahme : old clans, young settlers, right eco

content.text: Basics of light and electron microscopy. Basic knowledge for students, doctoral students and practitioners: Learning, understanding and experiencing microscopy. This textbook provides an extensive introduction to the basics of light and electron microscopy. The structure of the microscopes, their operation, functioning and their application are described in detail. Complex physical relationships are understood by means of meaningful illustrations. Additional info boxes highlight special aspects. From beginner to experienced user: this hitherto unique microscopy textbook is suitable for building up knowledge and learning individual units through its detailed presentation and modular structure.
content.title_en: Basics of light and electron microscopy

content.text: The Hobrechche Berlin: Growth, Change and Value of Berlin's Urban Expansion. Klappentext: With the development plan of Berlin's surroundings , a foundation was created in 1862 on which the inner city is built up to this day. The present volume gives insights into the ideas and real history of the large Berlin city's expansion planning and explains general principles of the emergence and transformation of urban structures of the 19th century as well as the planning discipline. The book is the beginning of alternative readings of the Hobrecht Berlin, the city expansion planning of the 19th century and the discipline history of urban planning and urban development. For the first time, the plan was superimposed with the foundation plan of today's Berlin with the help of new cartographic methods of the urban development plan of 1862; this plan forms the basis for the richly-bearing imagery of the present collection.
content.title_en: The Hobrechsche Berlin: Growth, Change and Value of Berlin's Urban Expansion

content.text: Gender Studies : an Introduction. Popular study and examination subject: Gender Studies. The questions about the meaning of gender and gender relations occupy a fixed place in teaching and research. What methods and theories do gender studies base on? The textbook provides information about this and presents various disciplines and their handling of the gender category. In the new edition with the latest literature and current overviews of institutions and research initiatives
content.title_en: Gender studies : an introduction

content.text: Mathematics and language: empirical research and teaching challenges. The contributions follow on from the extensive research on mathematical textual tasks, but in their topicality and focus they add value to the hitherto known and also show perspectives for a careful subject-related and language-focused mathematics teaching. Those who want to explore the topic along current empirical works in depth will not miss this volume. – Esther Brunner, in: Beiträge zur Lehrerinnen- und Lehrerbildung 1/2019, p. 129. For some time now it has been recognised that the use of language not only concerns language teaching or preferably German teaching, but also plays an important role in the success of teaching in subjects such as mathematics or the natural sciences. Against the background of an increasing heterogeneity of the students, an awareness and knowledge generation about the importance of language in technical instruction is indispensable. To what extent language skills in technical instruction are important, this volume addresses exemplarily for mathematics teaching.
content.title_en: Mathematics and Language: Empirical Research and Teaching Challenges

content.text: Young boys' support in school: monoeducation as a solution to a controversial problem?. Young boys' school performance has become increasingly subject to discussion in recent years. While on the one hand, the qualitative and quantitatively worse performance of boys compared to girls is used as an opportunity to postulate the need for boys' support, others see little or no reason for this. The author shows in the first part the status of gender-typical school performance and addresses key issues of discussion. Possible reasons for poorer school performance, the question of existing or not existing boys' problem, finally promotion opportunities in general and the topic of monoeducation in particular. In the second part, results from the monitoring of a process of setting up boys' classes in a previous girls' gymnasium are described. The statements are analysed with a view to central topics, especially ‘Dramatisation of gender', ‘Chances and risks of monoeducation', ‘Passing boys into the school system', ‘Feminancing of education'. In conclusion, relevant positions are not only critically analysed in school-related gender research.
content.title_en: Promotion of boys in school : Monoeducation as a solution to a controversial problem?

content.text: Numerical Python : work with NumPy, Matplotlib and Pandas. There are some introductions to Python and the additional libraries commonly used in the field of machine learning and data science ("modules") such as NumPy, Pandas and Matplotlib (e.g. J. VanderPlas), which are much less recommended than the book available because: The present book impresses with the clarity of the central features of the language Python and guides purposefully to the advantages of this language for complex numerical tasks from mathematics, statistics, machine learning and data science in general regarding efficiency and performance (e.g. class integers with very large value range, lists and dictionaries). NumPy provides efficient array structures (flexibly by reducing or increasing the number of dimensions etc.) for machine learning, Pandas handles large files and Matplotlib presents complex data structures simply graphically - all very clearly described. As preparation for reading this book, the author recommends its "Introduction to Python 3":
content.title_en: Numerical Python : working with NumPy, Matplotlib and Pandas

content.text: The modern age was not without pre-conditions the brains of its protagonists or the historical shocks that release them, but was deeply rooted in European cultural development. Why then could it become so radical, as a definitive break with history, inscribe itself into collective consciousness? The high-rise building and community - as vocabulary of the great attempt to break with all historical standards - form the thematic brackets of the present essay, which seeks to answer this question.
content.title_en: High-rise building and community : to the inheritance of the modern age

content.text: Human and machine: how artificial intelligence and robots change our lives. Computer programs can recognize human faces more reliably than humans. They beat us in board game Go, which requires strategic thinking and intuition, and they bluff better than the best poker players in the world. Machines make complex decisions - often better and faster than we do. Thomas Ramge explains in a knowledgeable and understandable way how machines are learning and discussing the question: What becomes of us humans when smart machines become increasingly intelligent? (publishing text)
content.title_en: Human and Machine: How Artificial Intelligence and Robots Change Our Life

content.text: Costa Smeralda. The Costa Smeralda holiday settlement in Sardinia is the result of the idea of developing an unspoilt region with a large-scale tourism project. It was planned and realized by a consortium founded for this purpose in 1961 under Karim Aga Khan IV. It created a simple, natural holiday world for an international circle of super rich, which in 1976/77 also served as a backdrop for the James Bond film Der Spionker.0This first monograph on the architecture of the Costa Smeralda draws an extremely multifaceted picture of the project and its dazzling protagonists. For the first time ever, the book has been able to examine essential source material and analyse a variety of images and plans of the founding works from the archive of the architect Enzo Satta. This personal collection of the long-standing house architect of the current Aga Khan provides an exclusive insight into the life of the jet set of the 1960s and 1970s.0The book takes up the themes of urban construction, architecture, the treatment of the landscape and the lifestyle of the inhabitants in the centre and places the remarkable influence of the Sardinia tourism settlement on architectural development until today.
content.title_en: Costa Smeralda

content.text: Rail 2017: Competition-policy construction sites : Special reports of the Monopol Commission pursuant to § 78 ERegG. The Monopol Commission submitted its 76th Special Reports entitled "Competition-policy construction sites" in August 2017. In this report, it deals with competition-policy issues relating to the operation of railways. It deals with the new Railway Regulation Act and shows the improvements for the legal application by the Federal Network Agency, but also the shortcomings of the new legal requirements. The report contains proposals for the reduction of competition barriers in tariff and distribution cooperation as well as in incentive systems for improving punctuality in local transport. If an integral timetable is introduced in long-distance transport, this should be competitively designed. In addition, a transparent cost-benefit balance should be established for the railways and the competing modes of transport in order to use public funds where they bring the best return.
content.title_en: Train 2017: Competition policy construction sites : Special reports of the Monopol Commission pursuant to § 78 ERegg

content.text: How refugees are made: about the causes of flight and the causes of flight. Allenthalben means that the causes of flight must be fought against. For what reasons people flee, they remain in the dark. Because then it would be possible to name what causes this and by whom this is caused. For Georg Auernheimer it is fundamental that the globally unleashed capitalism and the geopolitics of the USA and its allies, which have created regions of life hostile to the world, which force people to migrate. This is demonstrated among other things by the destruction of Yugoslavia and Libya and the wars in the Middle East. He also discusses the effects of neocolonial rule assurance through the structural adjustment programs and free trade agreements imposed on sub-Saharan Africa in order to secure its economic dependence on the western metropolises. Similar power strategies characterise the politics of the USA against Central America in the alliance with local oligarchies. Social upheavals, ecological devastation, misery and lack of perspective still come there a culture of violence. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: How refugees are made: about causes of flight and causes of flight

content.text: The teaching of geometry for secondary school I. This book introduces students, referendars and teachers of all types of schools into the didactic and methodological foundations of the geometry teaching of secondary school I and shows, on the basis of numerous practical examples, possibilities for problem-oriented teaching. Building on the educational standards, the important aspects of proof and argumentation, construction, problem solving as well as conceptual learning and conceptual teaching are discussed. On the other hand, the central topics of geometry teaching are addressed: figures and bodies, area content and volume, symmetry and congruence, similarity and trigonometry. The use of the computer is integrated into all chapters, an overview of the development of central ideas in geometry and geometry teaching completes the book. In this new edition, current extensions and new approaches are integrated, especially in the context of the further development of digital media. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Didactics of geometry for secondary school I

content.text: The practical book Sport in Prevention and Therapy. Sports as a preventive measure is an issue that is becoming increasingly important. It is therefore all the more important for physiotherapists to access evidence-based specialist information in order to be able to treat patients individually and specifically. "Sport in Prevention and Therapy" provides a compressed presentation of the scientific situation. All clinical symptom complexes (neurology, psychiatry, psychosomatics, pain syndromes, orthopaedics, rheumatology and internal medicine) are covered. In addition to the current state of science, the reader also receives therapy recommendations and guidelines for the implementation in therapy and practice.
content.title_en: Practice book Sports in prevention and therapy

content.text: Java – short & good. In the introduced "short & good" series of O'Reilly publishing house there is another narrow reference work for the programming language Java. It contains a selection of the most important terms and is suitable for quick re-examination. The last edition was displayed, adapted to the version Java 8. This 3rd edition also has the usual three-division into the areas language, platform and attachments. As a new addition, the consideration of the version Java 9. This contains two new features: the Java shell (JShell) and the Java module system. The latter allows a modularization of the source code. For both topics there is an additional chapter. The remaining chapters remained largely unchanged, except for three smaller additions. The volume of the book has increased by about 40 pages. It is recommended as a supplement to manuals (C. Ullenboom) and introductions (M. Kofler)
content.title_en: Java – short & good

content.text: Maker projects with JavaScript: build intelligent machines with Espruino and JavaScript from everyday objects. The book is aimed at readers who use JavaScript to build intelligent machines only with everyday materials and tools that can be found in every household. The author is based on the Espruino Pico microcontroller and the JavaScript script language. The first ones are addressed with JavaScipt basic knowledge, such as that taught by Philip Ackermann. The book begins with an introduction to the basics (including programming of a microcontroller, ...) and then quickly comes to applications, divided into experiments, where the reader learns to build simple motors and use these motors, for example when building a simple robot. It is well explained also the topic of "communication", which allows e.g. the transmission of commands to the robot. Final highlights are the construction of a working printer or the crafting of a digital camera. Many colored illustrations, graphically highlighted tips and tricks. Often also evidence of sources of reference for individual components.
content.title_en: Maker projects with JavaScript : build intelligent machines with Espruino and JavaScript from everyday objects

content.text: Media use in mathematical and natural science teaching: cross-disciplinary perspectives on central issues. Publisher's info: Media is an important part of the teaching today. The progressive introduction and further development of digital media raises, among other things, the question of which functions media - be it analogue or digital - can take on during learning. Against this background, the interdisciplinary team of authors - which represents not only the didactics of the natural sciences but also mathematics and computer science - has addressed central questions about the use of media in mathematical and natural science teaching as well as at the interface to extracurricular learning places. Using concrete examples such as the model experiment on the development of moon phases or the use of digital media in guided tours for school classes in the Deutsche Museum, five vivid chapters show the technical didactically justified potential of media use. In the final sixth chapter, a heuristic approach is proposed to describe media use in the field of teaching. The following topics are: Functions of media in teaching, operation and use of digital media for innovations, digital media for diagnosis of student achievements, media for networking of learning locations.
content.title_en: Media use in mathematical and natural science teaching : interdisciplinary perspectives on central issues

content.text: The fourth industrial revolution, which has been awarded a brand name with the slogan "Industry 4.0", is supposed to bring about spectacular changes in industrial production by means of the comprehensive digitization and computerisation of manufacturing. On the one hand, the debate here shows all the characteristics of a "hype". On the other hand, this term combines real development perspectives, whose long-term consequences for qualification and work are currently difficult to foresee. In this book, well-known experts from the social and engineering sciences try to give a first in-depth assessment of the possible consequences of Industry 4.0 for industrial work.The contributions ask about the fields of application and areas of use of digital technologies, the alternatives of work design and social development perspectives. Their common starting point is a holistic view of the new technologies, which focuses on the socio-technical overall system of production in the context of social conditions. With contributions byMarlies Achenbach, Daniela Ahrens, Wilhelm Bauer, Peter Brödner, Felix Busch, Jochen Deuse, Klaus Dörre, Berndworschak, Rolf Smitl, Heinrich Smitl, Thomas Smitl
content.title_en: Digitalization of industrial work: the vision of Industry 4.0 and its social challenges

content.text: Decision theory. Decisions. However, it remains open how to decide 'right'. Is this possible at all?This book introduces the reader to the decision theory and represents the differences between normative and descriptive decision theory, i.e. how to decide and how to actually decide. It is written in a comprehensible manner and enriched with over 150 clear examples.In addition, the appendix contains numerous questions and tasks as additional learning aid.The book is aimed at students of economics, lecturers and practitioners who want to acquire the tools for solving decision problems.
content.title_en: Decision theory

content.text: Cruise tourism. Holidays on the high seas: curse or blessing? Cruises are booming and cruises are in discussion. The study book provides basic knowledge, outlines the market and presents important target areas. It also highlights the ambivalence of this market segment and addresses the economic, ecological and socio-cultural effects of the high seas cruises on the target areas. Numerous illustrations and case studies illustrate the material.
content.title_en: Cruise tourism

content.text: The other Franz Kafka: a Prague dandy between Einstein's theory of relativity and Mozart's music. Until now, the occupation with the world writer Kafka has not been carried out in a really fundamental reconstruction of that "blood brother" by Heinrich v. Kleist, Søren Kierkegaard and Franz Grillparzer, when the Kafka himself was repeatedly understood, described, reflected: Hence, as he wrote. The Pragueer was mostly "theoretical-controlled", instead of in the sense of the now announced "New Historicism" after the "real-day-stimulations for his writing, to ask about the social coordinates of his existence in the so turbulent period between 1900 and 1918 (world war end). With the other Franz Kafka this changes. A Prague dandy emerges anew between the Poles Einstein and Mozart, the relativity theory and music.
content.title_en: The other Franz Kafka: a Prague dandy between Einstein's theory of relativity and Mozart's music

content.text: As simple as this, mathematics is: basic knowledge for beginners of all disciplines. Verl. Beschr.: You start a study. Congratulations. Your studies contain mathematics. No reason to despair. Mathematics is logical, and you think logical. This book links your logical thinking with the brittle signs of mathematics. It answers questions on how you learn mathematics and write down how you deal with exams and examination anxiety and what you start with a proof. The book shows you how to fill mathematical symbols, concepts and relationships with life and connect them with your vision. It is based on students' experiences and discusses typical difficulties. The translation of mathematical language into simple-to-understand facts is your key to mathematics. This translation helps you to deal with breaks and potencies as well as with understanding functions and integrals. The book tells mathematical facts in light tone, and smaller tasks encourage you to develop your own ideas, sketches and approaches. If you have seen yourself abstract problems from geometry and logic in vivid images, you will say: Yes, the complete interpretation of mathematics is more simple than any other, and the interpretation of mathematics is more simple.
content.title_en: Mathematics is so simple: basic knowledge for beginners of all disciplines

content.text: Smart Building Design : Conception, planning, realization and operation. How can intelligent technologies open up new scope for design – for the planning, realization and operation of buildings and for the digitization of building practice? An unusual view of the building as a cybernetic architectural system forms the basis of this integral design approach. As planning experienced architects and engineers, the authors add an overview of the current technical components of automation and communication systems as well as a summary of relevant laws, standards and guidelines. Six project examples show implemented applications in different scales from single-family houses to administrative buildings to Elbphilharmonie, vividly presented in texts, plans and photos.
content.title_en: Smart Building Design : Conception, planning, realization and operation

content.text: Microcontroller technology with AVR : Programming in assembler and C - circuits and applications. The book is a new edition of a proven textbook on microcontrollers and their programming in assembler and in C based on AVR microcontrollers by G. Schmitt. The revision of the new edition after Schmitt's death was carried out by A. Riedenauer while maintaining the numerous program examples and was supplemented by tasks (multiple with solutions). The topic is still addressed with knowledge of mathematics and technical computer science as well as readers with basic knowledge in the ARDUINO platform. Well considered are changes in AVR microcontrollers and the Atmel studio as further development of the AVR studio. The almost 40-page command set from the preliminary edition was not taken over, but is still available for download on the Microchip website. Didactically well prepared. Many illustrations and tables, comprehensive literature directory. The previous edition should be replaced in any case if required. (2-3)
content.title_en: Microcontroller technology with AVR : Programming in assembler and C - circuits and applications

content.title_en: Design and calculation : textbook for engineers in mechanical engineering

content.text: An architecture model for SAP® applications: Easy to maintain, expandable and team-oriented SAP® proprietary development with ABAPTM Objects. This book presents a new programming model that can be used for the development of SAP applications. This design pattern provides the possibility to structure ABAP programs in such a way that they meet the requirements of team-oriented development as well as effective maintenance and expandability. In addition, an object-oriented concept for a standardized and application-crossing implementation of ALVs is presented. This concept can be used easily and quickly and enables a generic evaluation of any tables. In the first part of the book, theoretical principles of the ABAP Objects language are explained. In addition to a clear introduction to the concept of object orientation and its expression within the language ABAP Objects, the concepts of ABAP Objects are discussed at this point, in particular the concepts of object orientation in ABAP Objects and in a new architecture model for SAP-in-house development – A model for application-crossing, a program-based software developer – a broad overview of the ABAP applications.
content.title_en: An architecture model for SAP® applications: Easy to maintain, expand and team-oriented SAP® proprietary developments with ABAPTM Objects

content.text: Hospitals : a design manual. The hospital has undergone major changes in recent years as a construction type: the change in health care, evidence-based medicine and health economics (such as the bundling of certain procedures in specialist hospitals) pose new requirements for planning. Private health institutions are driving the paradigm shift from functional engineering to design-affine health construction with hotel character. This book presents the requirements for the design and planning of hospitals in a broad systematic part. The example part documents in six categories – general hospitals, children's hospitals, university hospitals, specialist hospitals, ambulances and polyclinics as well as rehabilitation and aftercare facilities – about 40 international projects
content.title_en: Hospitals : a design manual

The book is such an interesting alternative, e.g. to D. Louis, who begins his book on Java programming with an introduction to object-oriented programming. The authors begin with absolute basics such as access to processing. The reader learns in all details how to install the optimal processing version for his computer. content.text: Work 4.0 actively shaping the future of work between agility, people analytics and digitalization. This practical work offers a current and concise overview as well as a vivid analysis of work 4.0. The interdisciplinary approach between psychology, sociology and law ensures a broad and profound introduction to this complex topic. Furthermore, implications of agility, people analytics and strategic aspects are presented profitably. Furthermore, working environments 2050 are presented on the basis of various future scenarios regarding recruiting, personnel development, organizational development, organizational structures as well as personnel management and occupational health management from different sides. Authors of different disciplines from companies and startups as well as universities and research institutes represent the entire range of competences. Since up to now systematic and sound foundations for work 4.0 were missing, this book is now a big gain for all executives and personnel experts who would like to intensively deal with this explosive topic area of work by means of the German Startup and HR Consultants Association.
content.title_en: Actively shape Work 4.0: the future of work between agility, people analytics and digitalization

content.text: Career in transition: Strategies for managers in the digital world of work. This career guide shows how digitalization changes work, what consequences it has and how you can actively manage your career. - Exit - Strategy in separation, dismissal or dismissal - Digitalisation - Economy and working life in transition - Entrepreneur in your own cause - the right attitude is decisive - The success booster - Profiling through career strategy - Personal Branding - optimal self-presentation in the application process - Employed or self-employed - two promising alternatives - Extra: E-Book inside The world of work and business is undergoing a radical change, whose main driver is digitalization with disruptive business models and communication technologies. The organizational forms are changing dramatically, as are the management styles and the way of cooperation: Whole hierarchies disappear without a single time, while more and more international, middle-class work is going through. A difficult situation for many managers who are not 'digital natives'. They run the risk of landing on the line. With one time, career in transition - it is becoming more and more appropriate to find a job in a new age.
content.title_en: Career in the transition: Strategies for managers in the digital world of work

content.text: Media didactics: Conception and development of digital learning offers. The digitalisation of education is progressing. Media didactics helps to classify the changes in educational work that result from it and to understand it as a design task. In the first part of the book, the basics of learning are introduced with media. An interdisciplinary view is created – at the interface between educational science and computer science. The second part of the book describes how digital learning offers can be systematically planned and developed. To this end, the approach of design-oriented media didactics is described, which aims to solve educational problems and/or educational concerns and to enable "education in the digital world". This 5th edition of the standard work, which is often recommended, has been completely revised and adapted to the latest developments. With the extended didactics check, you have an online tool at your disposal, which allows you to develop and evaluate your didactic concept with more than 100 fields. Prof. Dr. Michael Kerres heads the Learning Lab at the University of Duisburg-Essen. As a study director, he is responsible for the online study programmes "Educational Media" and "Educational Leadership".
content.title_en: Media didactics : Conception and development of digital learning opportunities

content.text: 21 lessons for the 21st century. How do we distinguish truth and fiction in the age of fake news? What should we teach our children? How can we act morally in our confusing world? How do we preserve freedom and equality in the 21st century? Humanity has been brooding over the questions of who we are and what we should do with our lives for millennia. But now the growing ecological crisis, the growing threat of weapons of mass destruction and the rise of new disruptive technologies under time pressure are putting us in a position to decide how to use the power, artificial intelligence and biotechnology. This book wants to encourage as many people as possible to participate in the great debates of our time so that the answers are not given by the blind forces of the market. (publisher text)
content.title_en: 21 lessons for the 21st century

content.text: Audio History of the film : Sonic Icons - Auditive Histosphere - Authenticity. Klappentext: Film is considered a visual medium, but almost every film has a soundtrack. In this book, three authors examine the relationship between film tone and history. They open up a research field that opens passages between film science, sound studies and history. Winfried Pauleit examines the aesthetic potential of film to produce history in the form of "Sonic Icons" in moments of self-reflection. Rasmus Greiner explores the connections between the audiovisual construction of historical experiences and sound design as an "auditive histosphere". Mattias Frey analyses the interaction between history and sound using the example of dialects in history film and discusses the "authenticity feeling". The focus of the "Audio History of film" is on the aesthetic interplay of sound, image and text, as well as the potential to model or even produce history, as well as the discourses on the reception of film tone, which are presented on the basis of empirical viewer studies.
content.title_en: Audio History of the film : Sonic Icons - Auditive Histosphere - Authenticity

content.title_en: Returning to Fukushima : Roman

content.text: Library education: Teaching and learning in scientific libraries. In recent years, scientific libraries have begun to develop concepts for the development of information competence. They try to become not only loaned libraries but also teaching institutions. They want to convey their collections, their special collections and cultural assets to different target groups beyond the library level. But how do you organize educational work in the scientific library? This book is the first time that the theory and practice field "Library education" is trying to outline and describe for scientific libraries. In addition to a theoretical part, readers find numerous practical examples in this book. The book is aimed at educators, academic and cultural mediators, library teachers and librarians who want to penetrate deeper into the new field of work.
content.title_en: Library Education : Teaching and Learning in Scientific Libraries

content.text: Digital Humanism: an ethics for the age of artificial intelligence. Philosophical reflections on cultutrelle and ethical aspects of "Artificial Intelligence", illustrated by examples of well-known science fiction films such as "Matrix" or "Metropolis". Counter-project to the mechanistic "Silicon Valley Ideology" and plea for a "digital humanism". Review: According to their joint book project "The Socrates Club" (ID-A 41/12), the Munich philosopher J. Nida-Rümelin and his wife, the doctoral cultural scientist and writer N. Weidenfeld, make cultural and ethical aspects of artificial intelligence a key technology of the future on their subject. They deal with this topic in 20 chapters, each of which they describe the content of a well-known science fiction film from Hollywood such as "Matrix" or "Metropolis" as examples of reflections on the conditio humana before philosophically reflecting on artificial intelligence, which they speak of principle, of being able to speak up, of being and of being in the current human mind.
content.title_en: Digital Humanism: an ethics for the age of artificial intelligence

content.text: The high-rise jumper : Roman. Riva is a high-rise jumper - a perfectly functioning person with millions of fans. But suddenly she refuses to train. Cameras are omnipresent in her world, but she doesn't know that she is being watched specifically: Hitomi, another young woman, is supposed to make Riva docile again. If she doesn't fulfill her mission, expulsion to the periphery where people live in the dirt, without the possibility of serving society. What makes people human when it works perfectly? "The high-rise jumper" leads to a brilliant new world that is as plausible as bitterly cold
content.title_en: The skyscraper : Roman

content.text: The reinvention of dictatorship: how China builds up the digital surveillance state and challenges us. "China is Boomland, one of the engines of the world economy for a long time. In terms of domestic politics, the country remained authoritarian, and foreign policy reserved. But under Xi Jinping, the most powerful head of state and party since Mao, the authoritarian state reinvents itself in open competition with the West. Kai Strittmatter describes the mechanisms of dictatorship and shows what China's development means to us (No. 8 of the Deutschlandfunk Best Book of Culture in November 2018).
content.title_en: The reinvention of dictatorship: how China builds up the digital surveillance state and challenges us with it

content.text: The present introduction to programming is aimed at beginners without any prior knowledge. It is an interesting alternative to L. Lo Iacono, but in its explanations of basic concepts and examples it is based only on a single (easy to learn and often used) higher programming language, Python 3. Another big difference is that the book consistently uses new insights into learning theory and relies on, for example, many language-based illustrations or explanations in dialogue form or puzzles. Also, redundancy is used very strongly to repeat the same things but to explain them in different ways. The author follows a procedural approach (instructions, conditions, loops, ...); he only finally goes into object-oriented programming. At the very end there is a compilation of the untreated topics. - Introduction that leads to reading and hardly releases one and also conveys general basic concepts such as data structures, storage or modularization.
content.title_en: Learning to program from head to toe

content.text: Agile School : Methods for project teaching in computer science and beyond. Agile project work makes school. The method known from software development can be transferred profitably to the project teaching. Interested teachers, educators and educational leaders find in this book the necessary background information, methods and implementation instructions. The author team provides concrete practical examples and shows how agile project work can guide students to self-organized learning
content.title_en: Agile School : Methods for project teaching in computer science and beyond

content.text: Biodiversity of the Rivers of Germany : Results of the R+E project "Development of the Biodiversity of Rivers of Germany" (FKZ 3513 85 0400). Maps: Development of aquatic vegetation in the Rastatt Rhine-Aue, development of terrestrial and semiterrestrial vegetation between Greffern and Iffezheim
content.title_en: Biodiversity of the River Ows in Germany : Results of the R+E project "Development of the Biodiversity of River Ows" (FKZ 3513 85 0400)

content.text: Residential houses : 103 icons of architectural history. "Residential houses" presents 103 of the most influential houses in the architectural history of the 20th and 21st centuries - from groundbreaking works by Le Corbusier, Frank Lloyd Wright and Mies van der Rohe to architectural masterpieces by contemporary architects such as Tadao Ando, Rem Koolhaas and Herzog & de Meuron. (Verlagsang.)
content.title_en: Residential houses : 103 icons of architectural history

content.text: In a brilliant local way, the food transition is moving. Organic apples from Argentina, bread dough from Lithuania, strawberries from China. Food usually has a long journey before it lands on our plates. It is the product of a globally active agricultural and food industry. This is ecologically insanity and it makes poor: people in the global south in the sense of the word; the freedom of choice and participation in the global north. The time is ripe for a food transition. However, the politics show little commitment and thus make civil society initiatives the change to their cause. Food Policy Councils provide the model for the many 'food councils' founded in this country. Farmers and gardeners from the region sit at a table with food activists from the city and citizens who want to know where their food comes from. Their common demand to the politics is: food democracy! 'All power the Councils!' therefore, is the motto of this book, which is committed to a regionalized food supply as far as possible.
content.title_en: Genial local : so the food turnaround comes into motion

content.text: The Alps: the disappearance of a cultural landscape. The geographer and proven alpine expert Werner Bätzing has been fighting for decades as a researcher and activist for the preservation of the natural and cultural area of the Alps. Mass tourism, motorways, reservoirs and new industrial areas are currently changing the Alpine region strongly and the natural and cultural landscape is threatening to disappear. Werner Bätzing takes a stand and criticises the current developments of the Alps. This picture book – as well as the author – thus intervenes in the current social discussion about the future of the Alps. For the reader, this is a way of combining sound expertise with the highest level of visual pleasure.
content.title_en: The Alps : the disappearance of a cultural landscape

content.text: Lenin today : Remind, repeat and work through. Reading with Žižek Lenin means looking behind its facade. It is said to return to the Soviet Union of the 1920s with an expert companion. With sensitivity he presents the unknown late work of Lenin, in which urgency and revolutionary force are condensed in a special way. Using selected letters, speeches and notes, the philosopher and excellent Lenin expert Slavoj Žižek shows a new page of the Soviet government, far from personality cult and transfiguration
content.title_en: Lenin Today : Remind, Repeat and Perform

content.text: Delivery concepts in quarters - make the last mile sustainable: solutions with cargo bikes, cargo cruisers and micro hubs. One third of urban transport is commercial traffic, i.e. freight traffic as well as service and business trips. Current trends in labor division, online trade and customer demands such as fast delivery times or smaller time windows lead to smaller shipment sizes as well as shipment and travel growth. These developments have various effects on economic traffic. Especially the resulting sharp increase in delivery traffic burdens the narrow streets in inner cities and residential areas, where most of the commercial traffic targets are located. In addition, other journeys in commercial traffic such as garbage disposal, road cleaning, forwarding deliveries, care services, crafts, etc. The current nitrogen oxide problem exacerbates the problem, as most delivery vehicles have diesel engines. The reduction of this delivery and service traffic and/or delivery with other transport modes - especially cargo bikes - are city-friendly solutions. Various studies show that in inner cities a large part of the shipments could be presented with alternative delivery concepts.
content.title_en: Supply concepts in quarters - make the last mile sustainable : solutions with cargo bikes, cargo cruisers and micro hubs

content.text: Data visualization : from the diagram to virtual reality. The book focuses on the addition of images and videos by computer-generated additional information and thus on essential topics of the computer visualistics course, which is offered at the universities in Magdeburg, Koblenz-Landau and Hamm-Lippstadt. The aim is to familiarize prospective students, but also the general public with the essential contents of this course. Literature on the subject has not yet been discussed. The book is based on many examples with numerous illustrations and tables; each chapter begins with a definition of the learning goal and ends with a literature proof. Definitions are highlighted graphically. The author begins with elementary methods for the creation of diagrams and infographics, then comes to geometric modelling and image editing. References to augmented reality and virtual reality are only briefly striped. The last chapter, which deals with manipulation possibilities by means of pictograms and image editing, is very interesting.
content.title_en: Data visualization : from diagram to virtual reality

content.text: Devaluation: a history of the world in seven cheap things. We have arrived in an age in which man could disappear - and with it the world that he so mercilessly exploits. For what is not cheap and fast for us today - at the expense of the many people who are less privileged than we? We ruin our earth if we do not quickly find cooperative ways of living and economicizing and tame Western predator capitalism. That is the message of economist Raj Patel and historian Jason W. Moore. In seven chapters they each devote themselves to one aspect of this devaluation of the world: nature is as devalued as money, work, care, food, energy and life. As impressive as comprehensively they describe that the crises of our time are in reality a single crisis and that this has a long history advance. If today cheap workers process cheap chlorine hills to cheap chickenswings, then that is how they exemplarily describe, a destructive economy, to keep it from being shaped, to keep it from being over centuries, to keep it from being over-the-arched, to keep it from being over-arched, to be over-arched, to think about our economy.
content.title_en: Devaluation: a history of the world in seven cheap things

content.text: The order of time. Why are we standing on the ground with our feet? Newton meant that because masses are attracting, Einstein said because space time is curving. Carlo Rovelli has another explanation: maybe because it always draws us to where time is passing most slowly. If, yes, if there is something like time at all. Hardly anything is interested in theoretical physicists of rank as much as the concept of time. Since Einstein packed them with space to space time and subjected to gravity, it is being ridiculed by great physicists such as Stephen Hawking and Carlo Rovelli. When it comes to the elemental, what holds the world together in its innermost, past, present and future in the formulas of the great theories do not exist anymore. But is it really without time? The new, exciting book of the Italian exceptional physicist revolves around this question.
content.title_en: The Order of Time

content.text: Reformislam: the struggle for democracy, freedom and women's rights. There is modern Islam, which advocates gender equality, democracy, freedom, religious tolerance and human rights, and calls on the Koran! Katajun Amirpur describes the history of reformislam and makes known with his most influential thinkers in the Islamic world and in the West, for which the future of Islam has already begun. Her dedicated book impressively shows that Islam is more diverse and modern today than bearded Islamists and Western Islamists want to see.
content.title_en: Reformism : the fight for democracy, freedom and women's rights

content.text: R in projects apply for dummies. A detailed introduction, starting with the installation of the system and a description of the methodological and graphical instruments, follows a wide selection of suitable projects and fields of application of R or RStudio. Review: The competent author, also author of "Statistics with R for Dummies" (2017), introduces in the loose style of this series, occasionally provided with caricatures, first into the basics of the software system developed already in 1990, here in the framework of Windows (also Mac is possible). It begins with instructions for installation. A detailed general description of the system, usually a picture of the current screen, then follows a selection of various projects, which are then independently understandable from each other. The reader should be encouraged and enabled to treat and solve other, self-selected problems accordingly independently with the system.
content.title_en: Apply R to projects for dummies

content.text: No More Bullshit! : the manual against sexist tribal tishwitnesses. The Pay Gap is a myth!", "Biologically speaking, women and men have different skills!" or "Do you not enjoy it?" If these sentences trigger eye rolls in your eyes, then you need this book. If you want to question traditional tishwitnesses, femininity myths and traditional prejudices, then you need this book. And if you just think: Bullshit!, then you need this book absolutely. The women's network Soority has made it its task with the event series "No More Bullshit!" to counter well-known killer phrases: facts. Together with female scientists, experts from different industries and artists, the sisterhood now relentlessly trains the gaze for standing sentences and provides powerful arguments for the next tishkid. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: No More Bullshit! : the manual against sexist tribal tishwitnesses

content.text: Lise Meitner : Pioneer of the atomic age. Lise Meitner's biography shows the incredible story of a woman who prevailed against all social and political resistance. Albert Einstein was considered to be "our Madame Curie", the Nazis as an undesirable Jewess, the tabloid press as "Mother of the atomic bomb". She earned her doctorate in physics as the second woman at the University of Vienna in 1906 and established herself in man-dominated science. Meitner fled to Sweden in 1938 from the National Socialists, where she achieved her greatest breakthrough together with Otto Frisch: the discovery of the principle of nuclear fission. But the deserved Nobel Prize remained a failure for her. She spent the last years of her life in Cambridge. The authors trace Meitner's life against the backdrop of the rapid development of atomic physics and the great catastrophes of the 20th century and give new insights into the world of the scientist.
content.title_en: Lise Meitner : Pioneer of the atomic age

content.text: The dawn of a new era: how virtual reality changes our lives and our society. Jaron Lanier, tech guru and father of virtual reality, gives a fascinating insight into his life, the beginnings of Silicon Valley, the great dream of virtual reality, and why it will soon fundamentally change our lives. In a captivating mix of autobiography, expertise and philosophical considerations, he describes his extraordinary career from his poor childhood as a child of Holocaust survivors in the desert of New Mexico, to the first steps in virtual reality, to their modern possibilities of use. His new book is a visionary declaration of love for a technology that offers unsuspected opportunities and at the same time has an immense potential for abuse. He takes a incomparable look at what it means to be human today in the face of unlimited possibilities. (Editor text)
content.title_en: A New Age: How Virtual Reality Changes Our Life and Society

content.text: Living diversity – shaping society: opportunities and challenges of cultural plurality in Germany. Different religions, traditions and languages have always been a reality in Germany. What a successful approach to cultural diversity looks like is a much discussed question. Respectful living together in diversity must be practiced and actively designed. This happens in everyday life on site: in neighbourhoods and schools, at work and in leisure time. The publication of the Reinhard Mohn Prize 2018 "Living diversity - shaping society" provides impetus for this social future task. It analyses the current approach to diversity in Germany, asks for good practice in other countries and formulates recommendations for action for the shaping of coexistence. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Living diversity – shaping society: opportunities and challenges of cultural plurality in Germany

content.text: The young people and their dealings with sexuality, love and partnership. First love and first sexual experiences are usually a major challenge for young people. The author presents an interesting study on the psychological condition of young people in connection with sexual development. Eva-Verena Wendt is an award-winning psychologist for her scientific work and presents current facts and figures on the sexual behavior of young people. Especially in chapter 6 "LSBBT*I*Q youths" (pages 134 to 146) she proves herself to be a clever analyst of social developments that help young people grow up. A very scientific approach to a very important topic
content.title_en: The young people and their dealings with sexuality, love and partnership

content.text: Eros, Wollust, Sin : Sexuality in Europe from antiquity to the early modern era. This book provides a broad overview of the history of European sex cultures from antiquity to the early modern era. Franz X. Eder shows from numerous examples and sources that sex life in earlier centuries had a fundamental importance for the coexistence of couples and communities, for the self- and foreign view of individuals and for the maintenance of the social, economic and political order. He spans the arc from the politicization and socialization of Eros in Greek-Roman antiquity to the skeptical handling of the sexual world in early Christianity and the ambivalent sexual world of the Middle Ages to its regulation and discipline during and after the Reformation.[Verlagshomepage]
content.title_en: Eros, lust, sin : sexuality in Europe from antiquity to the early modern age

content.text: TIMSS 2015 : Scales manual for documentation of survey instruments and work with data sets. Germany participated in the trends in International Mathematics and Science Study (TIMSS) in 2015. This manual documents the survey instruments used in the study. This volume includes the instruments that are part of the international study design as well as national supplements for Germany. Descriptive statistics of the instruments allow an assessment of the distribution of data and the data quality. In order to facilitate the work with the data sets of the studies, system, organisational and linking variables as well as generated indices are documented. The scale manual is intended to complement materials that are extensively documented by the international study management at another point. It is intended to facilitate the work with the data sets of the study.
content.title_en: TIMSS 2015 : Scales manual for documentation of survey tools and work with data sets

content.text: The artist's work is an important vehicle of self-narration. Numerous studies show the importance of media body stagings in terms of processes of subjectivation, star formation and image constitution. In the context of physical self-perception and narrative, the recursive plays a decisive role in the past. In their capacity to fix physicality and transform into cultural artifacts, media narratives are on the one hand resources of biographical self-reflection and self-narration; on the other hand, these occasions, life and its body-impaired limitations, offer to imagine differently and to think newly, such as the interlinking of body and technology. With this perspectivity of being, the band is a crucial factor for identity-theoretical reflections: body images are not static symbolic stocks, which are only appropriated by subjects, but rather arise in processes of mutual perception of subjects in the course of time.
content.title_en: Body Stories : Body as escape points of medial biographical practices

content.text: Why we have never been so well and yet we are constantly talking about crises. Sociological investigation of whether we are really as bad as we think we are. Academically, we supported the argumentation that we have never been as well as we are today. (2)
content.title_en: Why we have never been so well and we still talk about crises

content.text: Urban construction of normality: the reconstruction of urban urban districts in the Ruhr area. The reconstruction after the Second World War is mostly associated with settlements and urban landscapes. However, there was a direction in the Ruhr area during this time, which followed an explicitly urban idea. These districts, which mostly emerged from the city extensions of the late 19th and early 20th century, consisting of streets, squares and block border construction with a functional mixture, were often damaged after the war, but not extinguished. As dense, mixed urban districts rebuilt, they still shape the structure of many Ruhr areas. They stand for a purposefully normal urban construction, which is presented here for the first time with texts by renowned experts and photographs by
content.title_en: Urban development of normality : reconstruction of urban districts in the Ruhr area

content.text: Eclipse : Getting to know the book. Understanding. Using it efficiently. The author's goal is well described in the subtitle "Learning to Know ...", the book cannot replace the tool's online help because of its powerful functionality. The general part chapters 1 to 4 and the embedding of Git (Chapter 5) were taken over with a few adjustments from the author's book "Entry into Eclipse" (5th edition: 2014) without reference to this book (also no reference in the literature list). An overview of the Eclipse innovations in the intervening four versions (between 2014 and 2019) was missing. Advantages of this book over the aforementioned previous book lie in the understandable description of embedding new tools and black-and-white technologies in Eclipse. The reader does not need any prior knowledge in these areas (only Java basic knowledge is required). As an editorial deficiency of the book, the incomplete literature list would be mentioned.
content.title_en: Eclipse : Getting to know. Understanding. Efficient use

content.text: Smart City - critical perspectives on digitalisation in cities. "Smart City" stands for the promise of a future with a high quality of life for all – but also for a future of monitoring and controlling public and private spaces. How does the use of digital technologies and infrastructures change the current perception of space, space production and space use in cities? 35 urban researchers look at the different assessments of "Smart City" and give an overview of the controversial debate. They describe the linking of real-time data and the use of geoinformation in urban everyday life by practical examples and discuss their contribution to sustainable urban development, participatory democracy and social justice in cities. They show: The digital transformation is a competitive terrain of IT companies, city governments and urban political movements.
content.title_en: Smart City - Critical Perspectives on Digitalization in Cities

content.text: Criminal Chamber Report: Facts and conclusions from a legal investigation of land-based criminal proceedings (2009-2014). The "Chamber of Criminal Court Report" contains a comprehensive inventory of first-instance land-based criminal proceedings from five years of the survey, thus providing a deeper insight into this important part of German criminal justice. It is the first comprehensive legal investigation of land-based criminal proceedings since the investigation of Dölling/Felts, among others, from the year 2000. The new survey examined over 11,000 criminal proceedings from 2009 to 2014. The author presents the results and shows the neuralgic points of major criminal proceedings, such as the average length of proceedings, the number of judges appointed in the large criminal chambers, the average number of bias requests or execution losses due to long trial duration. The results of the data collection result from both interesting conclusions for the court administration and concrete proposals for legal policy.
content.title_en: Criminal Chamber Report : Facts and conclusions from a legal investigation of land-based criminal proceedings (2009-2014)

content.text: Berlin: Biography of a Great City. Klappentext: Parvenü der Großstadten, Labor der Moderne, Symbol des ripped 20. Jahrhunderts: In Berlin, not only German but also European history is concentrated. Jens Bisky has both in mind when he describes the development of the city since its rise to the Prussian residence. Berlin was extremely versatile and open: for the persecuted French Huguenots and the thinkers of the Enlightenment under Hohenzollern rule; later as a metropolis of proletarians and large industrialists, the artists and journalists and as a "Place to be" of the Golden Twenties. All this is clearly experienced by Bisky, but also the destruction of the Second World War and the tense atmosphere after 1945, when the great power blocks are faced here. Jens Bisky presents an overall picture of the history of Berlin, as it has not existed for decades, from the Thirty Years' War to the present. A narrative of the emergence and rise, fall and new beginning - and at the same time a gripping panorama of German and European history in the mirror of a unique metropolis.
content.title_en: Berlin : Biography of a great city

content.text: Algorithms are important building blocks in the development of the program. A good introduction for readers without the greatest prior knowledge is J. Mueller, who in his examples - unlike large manuals like A. Solymosi - does not rely on Java, but on the language Python. The present book is addressed to the same reader circle, also uses Python, but relies much more on visual explanations with many explanatory images. The author begins with an introduction to algorithms (binary search, runtimes, fundamental structures, recursions...) and then comes to a variety of application possibilities (hash tables, graph algorithms ...). Finally, there are short comments about random and distributed algorithms. Didactically well designed; each chapter begins with an overview sketch and ends with exercises (solutions in the appendix) and with a summary. Good for self-study and use in schools.
content.title_en: Understanding algorithms : Visually learn and understand : with illustrations, everyday examples and Python code

content.text: Electromobility: Fundamentals and Practice. The Electric Car - Vehicle of the Future? All about electromobility in one book - technical basics and current backgrounds on the topic of electric cars, prepared in an appealing and clear manner: For all those who are looking for a sound insight into the promising technology of e-mobility! This textbook provides the physical and engineering basics of electric vehicles compared to cars with combustion engines. Calculation bases and simulations are developed for core statements. The influence of legal requirements and the interlinking to the energy transition are discussed. The overall objective view shows under which boundary conditions electric vehicles make sense and what future development will look like including opportunities and risks. Prof. Dr.-Ing. Anton Karle worked for many years as a development engineer in automotive technology. Today he teaches at the University of Applied Sciences Furtwangen, among others in the fields of technical mechanics, control technology and project management.
content.title_en: Electromobility : Basics and Practice

content.text: The pirate principle: the secret to success and career. Manfred Schmid is an independent business consultant and interim manager. The mechanical engineering and industrial engineer was in management positions and as managing director for various hidden champions. In procurement and project management he acts internationally for medium-sized and DAX companies Do you always do what is expected of you? Then you are certainly considered nice and reliable. You are often just the wind in the sails of others. A pirate does not happen ... This success guide shows in an entertaining way how the approach of historical pirates is transferable to our present working world. With small use pirates achieve great business and also private benefits. It is good times to sail: The 21st century is particularly suitable for the modern pirate. He knows with uncertain waters, strong changes and the chances that result from it to deal with. Therefore, the pirate principle is still today a clever and motivating concept for a new beginning. Concentrated, lean, fast, risk-free, unpredictable, radical: The image of the pirate helps to make these six success principles vividly clear. Practical examples, checklists and instructions make the pirate principle of life in the sea by means of your personal privacy.

content.text: Software Agents in Industry 4.0. This work summarizes contributions to the state of the art and research of agent systems, which were developed by experts from science and industry in the GMA's Technical Committee 5.15 »agent systems«. An automation system that adapts to changes is one of the keys of Industry 4.0. This is already evident in the high networking of embedded systems in a wide range of industrial and public areas. In order to further improve functionality, instrumentation and thus the complexity of machine and plant engineering, building automation and energy management is increasing. The automation software must be fl exible and adaptable without much effort to meet these requirements of flexibility, reliability, and adaptability. Agents are a key paradigm to solve these challenges. Agents can be used to complete the step towards Industry 4.0 – away from hierarchical, static systems, towards flexible and decentralized networks, which are composed of cooperating, reconfiducible, self-healating and reassembling elements after disturbances.
content.title_en: Software Agents in Industry 4.0

content.text: - Sustainable planning, construction and housing: criteria for new construction and construction in the existing building. This book serves as a planning tool for sustainable construction in residential buildings, both for new buildings and for building in the existing building. All relevant criteria to be observed during sustainable construction are explained. In addition to concrete measures for achieving the goal, it explains how the presented criteria can be systematically addressed during a sustainability certification with the German Quality Seal for Sustainable Building (DGNB) and the Quality Seal for Sustainable Housing (NaWoh).Each chapter offers summary checklists with which upcoming construction and modernization tasks can be addressed.The content: Introduction.- Sustainable development in the building sector.- Special features in the building sector.- General planning principles.- Ecological quality.- Economic quality.- Sociocultural quality.- Summary and Conclusion The target group: Architects and construction engineers as planners of buildings Operators and managers of housing holdings.- Specifics in the building and real estate industry.

content.text: Resonant Education & School Management : new impulses for school development. The (individual) school is always faced with the task of developing itself in terms of social, educational and individual changes. For school managers, this means advancing processes at the levels of teaching, personnel and quality development. Hartmut Rosa's resonance theory can provide impulses to look at school development with a different view. In this book, Hartmut Rosa and Claus G. Buhren take a look at various fields of action and tasks of school leaders in conversation with Wolfgang Endres. They investigate, among other things, the questions how all involved can be appreciatively and motivatingly integrated into change processes and which new impulses the resonance education offers in order to further develop school.
content.title_en: Resonant Education & School Management : new impulses for school development

content.text: The ESP32-Praxisbuch : program with the Arduino-IDE. The book deals with the ESP32, a inexpensive wireless module of the Chinese company Espressif, which is considered the successor of the ESP8266 radio module of the same company. ESP32 now also has Bluetooth functionalities. The author is a specialist in the field of electronic crafts and is known for his books on the ESP8266 and the Physical Computing Platform Arduino. The author starts with an introduction to the ESP32 (installation and programming, in Linux-Mint) based on many colored illustrations. He designs an easily remodeled "ESP32-Pico-Discovery-Board", which can also be ordered as a kit at Elector. The following projects (step by step explained, with graphically highlighted tips and hints on misguided paths) treat, among others, temperature measurement, the retrieval of weather data, digital analogue-walling, web server for relay control, message protocols for transmission of telemetry (MTT) but more advanced-knowledge of DTT.

content.text: New homeland: the face of the Federal Republic of Germany: Buildings and projects 1947-1985. The New Homeland built hundreds of thousands of apartments in the Federal Republic between 1947 and 1985. It was the largest housing company in Europe. According to the motto "We do everything", it also built universities, congress centres, large hospitals, hotels, schools, holiday, shopping and sports centres, as well as the TV tower and cable car. The Group shaped the face of the Federal Republic of Germany sustainably - urban planning and architectural. The New Homeland was a flagship of the trade union community economy, which was intended as an alternative to a capitalist economy that was strictly profit-oriented. Its concept was convincing in itself: it offered itself as a general contractor, delivered complete offers and promised low prices. In the reconstruction period after the war and in the "golden age" between 1957 and 1973, the company embodied the hope of a better life for broad sections of the population ... until the social democratic utopia got shaken and the company was settled in the 1980s for the proverbial "1 DM".
content.title_en: New homeland : the face of the Federal Republic : Buildings and projects 1947-1985
