content.text: Digital customer experience management of the platform team: HMD Best Paper Award 2017. In the course of digitalization, design and management of the Digital Customer Experience are becoming increasingly valuable. Technology leaders in various industries are particularly well known for successfully organizing digital interactions between users, third-party providers and other stakeholders. In this essential, the video game platform Steam is examined using the case study method. Based on the analysis of Steam, recommendations for action are derived, which are also applicable for companies in traditional industries. Focus is on the orientation of services and service portfolio to customer needs, the management of consumer technology as well as the development of trust and loyalty by anchoring values and norms on a digital platform. The recommendations for action are then illustrated in the automotive industry, in TV streaming providers and on the basis of a platform for auto repair. content.text: The Quaternary in the tropics: a reconstruction of the paleoclimate. The Ice Age (Quartary) is a time of extreme climate fluctuations that led to the growth and melting of huge ice sheets in the high latitudes. The tropical deserts, savannas, rain forests and mountain regions experienced equally dramatic climate changes, whose traces have been preserved in sedimentary deposits. The knowledge of tropical climate history is of utmost importance, since in the tropics and peripheral tropics natural and - recently - man-induced processes control the global climate decisively. Nevertheless, only relatively few paleoclimate data are known from these regions. This book presents the climate archives of the tropics and critically discusses their paleoclimate significance. With its holistic view on the basis of decades of own research, the author shows that lack of geoecological knowledge of the tropic world can lead to misinterpretations in the modelling of the climate future. The results presented here call for a correction of many widely used views on the importance of atmospheric greenhouse gases for global warming of the last 50 years.
content.title_en: The Quaternary in the Tropics: a reconstruction of the Paleoclimate

content.text: The blind spot of digitalization: how sustainability and digital transformation can be reconciled. Digitization is the largest transformation of our time across society. Its technological development is exponential and makes innovation leaps and their side effects increasingly unpredictable. Nevertheless, politics and industry stress the need not to limit digitalization and follow the path of technological development. However, the devastating consequences for sustainability are not being ignored. The enormous increase in the demand for energy, raw materials, logistics and transport, production and disposal create huge problems. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: The blind spot of digitalization: how sustainability and digital transformation can be reconciled

content.text: Normative decision-making: Tasks and characteristics of decision-making and expectation-benefit theory. In a short form, this essential represents the theory of the expectation-benefits intelligible. Those who want to acquire a safe handling of models of benefit maximization in a short time do not miss this book. It starts with the origin of the theory of expectation-benefits, directs the models from the thesis of rational behavior and discusses their effectiveness in general cases such as the problem of the driver in choosing his route or the investor's problem in choosing the mixture of two securities. The essential guides the reader in an original way to the scientific path of normative decision on uncertain profits or losses. content.text: The law of the technical product: Practice manual for corporate lawyers. The basics of the law of the technical product -- Requirements for technical design -- Other market access regulations -- Postmarket phase The work deals with the public-law obligations of economic operators in and after the provision of technical equipment. This is confronted with a variety of different legal sources, different regulatory approaches and sometimes contradictory requirements. The work systematically presents the complex matter, takes into account Union and national requirements and their relationship with each other. The first part explains the basics and presents the historical development. The second part deals with the requirements for technical design with the focus on product safety, environmental product law, road traffic registration law and other product law. The third part deals with the non-design-related market access requirements, while the final part of the postmarket phase applies. The "Law of the technical product" is intended as a hand tool for the corporate lawyer to make the matter understandable and manageable for the daily work for him. The content ● Foundations of the law of the technical product ● Requirements for technical design ● Other market access regulations ● Postmarket regulations ● Postmarket phase The author Matthias Kjurist is an industrial lawyer (established)

content.text: Artists on the move: ways and limits of travel. Traveling for artists and musicians is a part of everyday life, both in the past and today. The goal is not only to be on the way, but also to be on the way. The book shows these connections and interfaces between art, music and travel over the past centuries and today. Travelling is just as much a part of artists, and musicians, and everyday lives today as it was in the past. Their goal is not only to reach a place, their temporary destination, but also to be on the road. This book shows these connections and reveries where and how art, music and traveling have overlapped in previous centuries and continue to do so today.
content.title_en: Artists on the move: Paths and Limits of Travel

content.text: Methodical action in social work: basics and work aids for practice. "Professional skills" requires central, scientifically sound working rules. Often, practitioners, but also students, lack the tools to plan and post-prepar their work. Professional action is predominantly intuitive and with recourse to experiences and routines. Whether and why this is appropriate in a given situation remains unclear. The book shows here ways out by offering suggestions for a methodical action that is systematically planned and oriented towards scientific action. It establishes and describes work aids that bring the professional action structure and the knowledge stocks relevant for social work into a reflective context. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Methodological action in social work: basics and practical work aids

content.text: The recent financial crisis has made clear how closely the link between real estate finance, the real estate market and the financial market is affected by the crisis. However, the real estate markets in the individual economies have reacted very differently to interest rate changes and other macroeconomic developments. While the United Kingdom and Spain have been affected by the US-American problems, the German real estate market has proved to be extremely stable. Generally speaking, the precautionary principle in German real estate finance is dominant, which can have a calming effect on the market. For example, long-term loans could significantly increase against short-term loans. An expansion of variable loans would transfer interest risks to the private households and increase the vulnerability of the real estate market to capital market changes.
content.title_en: Real estate financing after the financial crisis : connections, international differences and regulatory risks

content.text: Doing Space while Doing Gender - Networking Space and Gender in Research and Politics. Every place, every body is connected to others and becomes only in this structure of relations to itself. Accordingly, this volume designs further escape lines in the Doing Space while Doing Gender. In a first book section, articles present central terms such as "Exposure", "Mediality" and "Transsectionality".A second book section gathers studies - for example to the marriage market at the end of the 19th century, to queer bodies in New York, the poetry Gloria Fuertes' or to manhood in the structural change of Berlin's urban transport.Through the content-based networking of the contributions, the volume is also usable as a manual - it invites discussion and shows in many places that dynamics of space and gender not least concern political questions of the present This volume, which can also be used as a manual due to the linking of its contents, shows how dynamics of space and gender also affect contemporary political issues of the present.
content.title_en: Doing Space while Doing Gender - Networking Space and Gender in Research and Politics

content.text: Forgiveness, reconciliation, forgetting: sociological perspectives. The topic of "forgiving" is much discussed in the human and social sciences. It can be seen as a universal, anthropological constant of human coexistence, which links its universality to the flaws of human beings.However, despite its wide range, forgiveness in sociology has been rather little considered.Based on numerous historical examples of societies hit by a serious human catastrophe, the contributors highlight the indispensability of this category for social theory and emphasize the hitherto scarcely systematically exploited social-funding potential of forgiveness Illuminated universally as an anthropologically variable yet hardly yet as a sociological category: the potential the act to prevent has for the social and society theory!
content.title_en: Forgive, reconcile, forget : sociological perspectives

content.text: Tourism management: the business-based basis. Tourism is one of the world's most growing, but also one of the most complex economic sectors. Successful management of tourism companies is a major challenge. This is all the more true as digitalization is advancing and the business models and power structures are changing strongly. The ecological and social sustainability of travel is also becoming increasingly important in business decisions. This textbook provides a comprehensive, solid basic business-based knowledge for the tourism industry, which tourism students can build on and draw on. It covers all areas of tourism business economics, with case studies, sustainability aspects and digitalization as complementary priorities. The book helps to develop a business-based thinking attitude towards responsible, active action ("management") in the tourism business.
content.title_en: Tourism Management : the business basics

Challenges, problems and paradoxes of data protection -- State monitoring -- Data protection through technology -- Enforcement of data protection -- Development of data protection law Data protection is not sufficiently geared to the challenges of modern information technology with Ubiquitous computing, big data, artificial intelligence and learning systems. This also applies to the General Data Protection Regulation. The contributions of the collection volume examine the requirements of digital change to concepts, instruments and institutions of data protection; they discuss solutions for hitherto unregulated data protection problems, design concepts for modern basic rights and data protection and develop models for an evolution of data protection in the future digital world. The content Challenges, problems and paradoxes of data protection State monitoring Data protection through technology Enforcement of data protection Further development of data protection law The target groups Dozierde and students of the legal, social, cultural and economic sciences are responsible for the administration, business and politics, jurists and journalists. content.text: Preparation and execution of construction acceptances: Quick start for architects and civil engineers. Preparation of acceptance and defects -- Acceptance execution and acceptance protocol -- Effects of acceptance -- Checklists and acceptance patterns The professional and proper acceptance of construction services and buildings is complex for all those involved in construction acceptances in the area of object monitoring and contains many pitfalls. The author describes what to consider in the organizational, technical and legal preparation of acceptances and what to do in the event of faults in the acceptance of construction. He informs about what documents, quality certificates and explanations are required in the acceptance process. Overviews, checklists and sample forms complete the rapid start into the subject matter. The content Preparation of acceptance and defects Acceptance execution and acceptance protocol Effects of acceptance Checklists and acceptance patterns The target groups Architects and construction engineers, construction and specialist construction managers, contractors and authorities The author Dipl.-Ing., Dipl.-Ing.-Ök. content.text: The Light Pollution in Metropolises, the New York City -- Boston -- Toronto -- Warsaw -- Hannover -- Simulation of urban scenes and spaces -- Solutions for reducing urban light pollution Light pollution (light smog, light pollution or light emissions) are a fundamental problem in metropolises with effects on flora, fauna and people. Accordingly, the first part of the book discusses the basics of light pollution and its effects on different organisms. Subsequently, the characteristics of the light smog in the cities of Hanover, Warsaw, Boston, New York City and Toronto are analysed and compared. But how can the problem be addressed? To this end, existing measures for the prevention of light pollution are discussed and illustrated by comparing the cities with other, innovative approaches. The book focuses primarily on practitioners in this field and helps to identify emission sources and identify suitable mitigation measures. The content What is light pollution impact of light pollution is a light pollution study in the city of Hamburg.
content.title_en: Light pollution in metropolises : analysis, impact and solutions

content.text: Everything under heaven: the past and future of the world order. Zhao Tingyang is considered one of the most important Chinese philosophers of the present. With this main work his thoughts on a new political world order are now available for the first time in German translation. They are based on the old Chinese principle of tianxia - the inclusion of all under one heaven. In the discussion of occidental theories of the state and peace from Hobbes to Kant to Habermas as well as using the historical science, the economy and game theory, Zhao opens us a highly original view of the conception of universality. A pioneering book, also to understand China's current world political thinking. (Verlagstext)

content.text: The Digital Culture of Sharing Sustainable Economics. The "Ecological Survey" is a research project on the topic of sustainable business. The authors of this collection investigate the motives, attitudes and effects of this innovative digital culture of sharing and reveal their potential for sustainable business. They shed light on innovative online platforms of peer-to-peer sharing, ranging from socially oriented initiatives to globally active mediation companies. They discuss the disruptive effects of the new business models and provide comprehensive data on the environmental impacts of the sharing economy for the first time. Finally, they discuss the framework conditions that can promote a sustainable sharing economy. The content • Dissemination, potentials and target groups • Ecobalance of peer-to-peer sharing • Development perspectives for business models • Sustainable governance The target groups • Lecturers and students of business economics, social sciences, environmental sciences • Practitioners in the field of sharing economy and decision makers from sustainability and economic policy The editor Dr. Siegfried Behrendt is Research Manager Technology and Innovation at the IZT Institute for Future Studies and Technology Assessment. Christine Henseling is a Technology Consultant at the Institute.

content.text: Under pressure: how Germany is changing. The German economy is growing, the world admires Germany for its strength, stability and openness to the world. At the same time, the middle class is shrinking, wealth is more unequally distributed than two decades ago. Every sixth German is at risk of poverty, the social chances of advancement are as low as in hardly any other Western country. The right-wing populist AfD achieves two-digit results in elections and is now sitting in the Bundestag. A large part of the Germans are under considerable pressure. What does this mean for the life of individuals and for the whole country? Based on various life stories, journalist Jana Simon draws a differentiated picture of Germany, which impressively reflects the political, social and economic power of the changes. Some protagonists are: the former ECB director Jörg Asmussen, who is now an investment banker; a policeman from Thuringia; a single-parent nurse; an "influencerin" and the AfD chairman Alexander Gauland. "Since 2013, the reporter Jana Simon Alexander Gauland (AfD) has accompanied the former ECB chief executive in Germany or a female nurse. She describes the six in her single-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-con-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-of-the-the-the-the-of-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-
content.title_en: Under pressure: how Germany changes

content.text: Blockchain for developers: Basics, programming, application. After a brief sketch of the blockchain idea developed by S. Nakamoto and the cryptocurrency Bitcoin, the authors will present the basics of a blockchain in detail. Afterwards, the authors will devote 100 pages of the book to the development of a blockchain generated in Java. Follow-up chapters will deal with smart contracts as used in Bitcoin blockchains. Afterwards, the authors will go into the programming language Solidity in detail, the basis for Smart Contracts in the blockchain platform Ethereum. The syntax of Solidity is similar to that of JavaScript, so that previous knowledge in JavaScript is helpful for understanding. Since blockchain procedures are particularly suitable for processes where confidence in a process step or a party is lacking, many questions about security and deployment (software distribution) are discussed. The final chapters will deal with decentralized applications (DApps) and a view of the future, in which blockchain technologies may pursue completely different approaches.
content.title_en: Blockchain for developers : basics, programming, application

content.text: Problem areas of child development : Contributions from the perspective of different disciplines. The book examines questions about childhood from different perspectives. In the course of life, the contributions group around prenatal and early childhood development, preschool education, the contexts of parents - family - school, society - law - culture as well as the questions of faith and religion
content.title_en: Problem areas of child development : Contributions from the perspective of different disciplines

content.text: PRINCE2 : the success method explained. The 2012 London Olympics was a nearly perfectly managed major event in the history of the Olympic Games. But what was the secret behind the project success from London? What tricks and tricks did the people in charge have in store? It became a success on the basis of PRINCE2®! PRINCE2® is considered the world's most successful best practice methodology, formed from around 30 years of project management experience. This book provides you with an understanding and insight into what is behind the PRINCE2® methodology and how you can use it in practice. Using the example project »Olympia«, the authors build up the methodology step by step. A glossary and solutions to the practice questions can be found at the end of this book. They will be able to successfully participate in PRINCE2® projects and pass the official PRINCE2® foundation examination.
content.title_en: PRINCE2 : the success method explained simply

content.text: Climate: a new perspective. In climate, Eisenstein concludes that it is not enough to introduce only new forms of energy production or consumption to enable a "sustainable development". Rather, a radical rethinking in the sense of "interbeing", a holistic feeling and action that places the connection of all people, but also the connection of man and nature in the centre, in order to enable a positive change. We all have to learn to take responsibility for our actions and contribute to the healing of our ecosystem; for only in this way can we achieve a healing of our climatic and social systems. (clip text)
content.title_en: Climate : a new perspective

content.text: As a daily end of the world, we are fighting against the digital waste of our brains. Why we ignore the news in the face of loud news. In her non-fiction book, neuroscientist Maren Urner explains why the flood of information in modern media is over-exhaustive and what ways out of it is. Whether in the morning in the newspaper, in the evening on TV or the whole day in the liveticker on the smartphone: wars, scandals, terrorist attacks, catastrophes. The world seems to be going as bad as never before, and in the future everything will get worse. This view of things is pushed up when we inform ourselves in the media about the state of the world. Maren Urner warns of the fatal effects of this kind of reporting: We are constantly stressed, our brain is permanently in fear, and our view of the world is distorted by black-white painting and panic machining. Thus we do not gain an overview of the events, but remain over-constrained and helpless. With her scientific expertise, the author explains what goes wrong in the modern media world and how our stone-time brain daily the pioneering of the information landscape is called "in" by a daily.
content.title_en: End of the daily end of the world: how we fight against the digital waste of our brains

content.text: Media history : from Asian printing to computer. Media has influenced perceptions and knowledge, politics and culture, leisure and communication for centuries. In this study book, Frank Bösch shows the historical development and social significance of the mass media in modern times - from book printing, whose history began in Asia in the 11th century, through newspapers and magazines to film, radio, television and computers. He illustrates the role that media played for central historical processes, for example for the Reformation, for revolutions, wars and globalization processes, for the formation of social groups, as well as for the dictatorships and democracies of the 20th century. (Verlag) "An introduction that can be recommended without reservation."
content.title_en: Media History : from Asian Book Print to Computer

content.text: The extremes of society are: what we know about radicalization. Extreme political views have a short-term economic situation. On the right and left side of the political spectrum, but also in religious environments, positions are radicalised and democratic values and institutions are challenged. This volume gives an overview of the central aspects of this phenomenon: the radicalization of individuals, groups and societies, deradicalization, online radicalization and prevention measures.
content.title_en: Society extreme : what we know about radicalization

content.text: Children of the Koran : what Muslim students learn. Anti-Semitism among Muslim youth, lack of conceptions of equality, a different understanding of democracy and religious freedom - some Muslims do not give anything to the liberal values of the West. But where does that come from? A possible answer: because young Muslims learn it this way. Constantin Schreiber examines school books in the Islamic world, among others from Iran, Turkey, Afghanistan, Saudi Arabia. What is taught there in religious or historical lessons? What do students learn about philosophy? Schreiber talks to teachers, parents and students and notes: In some countries, schools are not a place of education, but places of ideologisation. Young people learn to see the world with different eyes than we do in the West. And this also has an impact on Germany and Europe.
content.title_en: Children of the Koran : what Muslim students learn

content.text: Quantum economy: what comes after digitalization?. The rapid development of artificial intelligence, the first quantum computers and the automation of ever-increasing life and work areas will have massive effects on our future and our economic model. Algorithms will become authorities and these will inevitably compete against each other. But technology alone can and will not be the answer to all our challenges. Still, we humans are the drivers and links that can control our environment, society, economy and reality. Anders Indset develops three scenarios for the next 10 to 20 years in which our future is irreversibly decided. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Quantum economy: what comes after digitalization?

content.text: Identity: how the loss of dignity threatens our democracy. Over the last ten years, the number of democratic states worldwide has been shrinking alarmingly. Are we experiencing the end of liberal democracy? US political scientist Francis Fukuyama, author of the world's best seller The end of history, in his new book, is looking for the reasons why more and more people are turning to anti-democratic tendencies and reject liberalism. He shows why the politics of the hour are marked by nationalism and anger, the role left and right parties play in this development, and what we can do to revive our social identity and thus liberal democracy. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Identity: how the loss of dignity threatens our democracy

content.text: The history of colours. "Colour systems are a mirror of their time in practical and conceptual terms," says a thesis by the author, art historian and curator A. Loske. But how do colours develop? How (be-)uses) artists colours? What triggers colours (also psychologically)? And, precisely, how did the understanding of colour change in the course of history? In the attractively presented, richly illustrated in color, 240 pages of specialized book (from English) Loske goes on to answer these questions in 5 chapters (i.e. periods of time) after: 18th century, early/late 19th century, early 20th century and now; including glossary, bibliography, evidence of images and registers. Starting with Newton's optical experiments in the early 18th century until the present time, in which artists like O. Eliasson create museum spaces of experience from colored light and the company Pantone regularly exclaims the "color of the year", she makes various abstracts in the art, culture and scientific history of each text individually assigned to one of the chapters;
content.title_en: The History of Colors

content.text: Architecture : Insights into construction and details : from the Colosseum to the World Trade Center Transit Hub. In medical anatomy textbooks, cross-sections and details are often reproduced not only by means of photographs, but also elaborately designed 3-D drawings. This visualisation concept is followed by the authors of this illustrated book: Rubrated into the categories of public buildings, monuments, culture, living and sacral buildings, a total of 50 buildings are presented on 4 or 6 double pages with short texts, photos and drawings. These include historical examples such as Parthenon (Athens), Colosseum (Rome), Capitol (USA) or Angkor Wat (Kambodscha), but also modern buildings such as Absolute Towers (Canada), London Aquatics Centre, Dulles Airport (USA), Bauhaus (Dessau) or Berlin Reichstag
content.title_en: Architecture : Insights into construction and details : from the Colosseum to the World Trade Center Transit Hub

content.text: GRM: The Children's Museum of the Great Britain, where capitalism was once invented, has now perfected it. But four children who do not play with it – but rather against the rules. And this with all consequence. Welcome to the world of GRM. Sibylle Berg's new novel begins in Rochdale, UK, where neoliberalism has done particularly thorough work. The heroes: four children who know nothing else but the reality of the failed state. Their food comes from private relief works, their parents have long since given up. The hope that they flee to home is Grime, short GRM. Grime is the greatest musical revolution since the Punk. Grime is getting new YouTube stars every day, Grime is always living new Role-Models. When the four realize that there is no hope for them at home, they are almost breaking down to London. Here, the promise of survival is not made.
content.title_en: GRM : Brainfuck : Roman

content.text: Chemical Balances in Analytical Chemistry: The Theory of Acid Base, Complex Formation, Falling and Redox Balances. Introduction -- The Chemical Balance -- Acid Base Balances -- Complex Balances -- Solubility Balances -- Redox Balances -- Titrations This textbook provides a modern and understandable presentation of chemical balances in solutions. Because of their importance, aqueous solutions are mainly treated without neglecting non-aqueous systems.The theory and the resulting findings for experimental work form the basis of analytical chemistry and are, on the other hand, essential for all solution reactions in environmental chemistry, biochemistry, geochemistry, and medicine. For several decades, this textbook has been the first in which chemical balances in solutions are once again presented as an independent teaching area, which has been of fundamental importance for all chemistry.The book has been the subject of chemistry, biochemistry, pharmacy, environmental science and all other study programs with chemical modules.
content.title_en: Chemical Balances in Analytical Chemistry : The Theory of Acid-Base, Complex Formation, Falling and Redox Balances

content.text: Botany in motion : Alexander von Humboldt and the Science of Plants : an interdisciplinary course. O. Lubrich is Professor of Comparative Literature and Editor of several works by Alexander von Humboldt (see A. v.Humboldt: "Die Russland-Expedition", 2019). In this monograph he points out the outstanding importance of Humboldt for botany. Through his research trips, especially through South America, he developed a new understanding of nature and gave Anstöe a new program of botany. His view of a dynamic geography of plants was the pioneer of Darwin's evolutionary theory. His ecological thinking in contexts of effects can be applied to current problems of biodiversity, climate change or species extinction. Humboldt has thus set botany in motion, as shown by an exhibition conceived in Bern. Numerous pictures originate from this exhibition.
content.title_en: Botany in motion : Alexander von Humboldt and the science of plants : an interdisciplinary course

content.text: Question of trust : the crisis of today's parliamentarism. "No institution has been declared dead as often as Parliament in Germany. Populists abhor it and demand more direct democracy. Is the parliament in Germany only there to obey the will of the government? The lawyer Florian Meinel analyses the threats to parliamentarism and provides suggestions on how to reform himself to survive the attacks (No. 8 of the non-fiction list for February 2019, No. 2 of the non-fiction list for March 2019)
content.title_en: Question of confidence : the crisis of today's parliamentarism

content.text: Digital Follow-up: on the way to a new tribal society. "Platforms such as Twitter, YouTube and Facebook are not information portals, but clan spaces of digital tribal societies, the philosopher Christoph Türcke warns, explaining why digital media are a breeding ground for despotism and populism. He names the dangers and shows ways out of the digital one-way street (The best non-fiction books in March 2019, place 9).
content.title_en: Digital Follow-up: on the way to a new tribal society

content.text: Make your own way instead of buying - garden and balcony : 111 projects and ideas for the natural bio garden. Nature-oriented gardening does not depend on a large garden! Here there is a wealth of ideas, how the ideals of permaculture and urban gardening can be implemented sustainably. On the website of the publisher there are many deeper information, to which the text is referred. Review: The trend themes permaculture and nature-oriented gardening are initiated in this book, as well as the currently popular urban gardening and upcycling. Again and again to deepen on special subpages of the publisher's website, which then actually provides punctual supplementary information (e.g. recipes for edible flowers). When the book is used as a stube-entry in conjunction with the numerous tips on the website, a wealth of suggestions for practical implementation for sustainable gardening projects is revealed. If one leaves the book without the digital supplement, then many impulses remain at the surface and hardly practically umbenzugängig. A rough structure, with coloured register keys in the cut visually easy and a certain variety of photos "the search for a very simple and a lot of the text" should not be easy.
content.title_en: Make your own instead of buying - Garden and Balcony : 111 Projects and ideas for the natural organic garden

content.text: Plastic Saving Book: more than 300 sustainable alternatives and ideas that we can use to escape the plastic flood. This title could have replaced some advisors on reduced plastic consumption with its abundance of "recipes" for alternatives in kitchen, bathroom and on trips. Among them, new ideas such as bioshoe cream or self-folded garbage bags again. The special plus of this volume are however the numerous concrete references to corresponding places of the smarticular internet presence, in order to be continuously supplied with new ideas and the thirty-page comprehensive introduction. This provides not only arguments for a necessary containment of plastic consumption, but also good methodological aids, such as the "pyramid of sustainable consumption" or the "plastic matrix", which puts the potential damage to the availability of alternatives into relation. (2)
content.title_en: Plastic Saving Book : more than 300 sustainable alternatives and ideas that we can use to escape the plastic flood

content.text: Demographic change: Myth - Illusion - Reality. The "demographic question" is the fearmaker in public debates: Whether it is the discussion about pensions, the poverty of old age or the assessment of Germany's economic performance - demographics always play an important role in explaining and answering the questions associated with these topics. The book provides an overview of demographic development in Germany, its reasons and model calculations for the future depending on factors such as migration. It discusses the influence of population development on prosperity, wages, security or the environment and also discovers positive consequences for society behind the much-inspiring decline scenarios. Demographic development - as a result of the volume - does not provide a reason for panic. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Demographic change : myth - illusion - reality

content.text: The Kramlich Residence and Collection : editor: Nicholas Olsberg. The publication deals with the history of Kramlich Residence, home of American art collectors Richard and Pamela Kramlich in the beautiful landscape of the Napa Valley in California and also established exhibition space for the groundbreaking collection of media art of the couple. Created after a design by Swiss architects Jacques Herzog and Pierre de Meuron, the unique character of the Kramlich Residence - product of an idea laboratory of its designers - since the completion of artists and works of art offers the rare creative opportunity of exchanging ideas with this dedicated home of media art. Each single contribution in this publication, which includes essays and discussions with historians, curators, architects and collectors, but also new artistic commissioned works, relies on the treasure of different experiences from the project and explores how new ways of looking and thinking have emerged from the field of tension between architecture, nature, moving images, sound and living and meeting spaces.
content.title_en: The Kramlich Residence and Collection : editor: Nicholas Olsberg

content.text: The inferior human being: the future of humanity in the face of algorithms, artificial intelligence and robots. Everyone talks about digitalization. Wonderful future prospects are being designed. Comfort and prosperity, more health and possibly digital immortality await us. These new amenities are just one side of the coin. Increasing dependence on digital technologies, the risk of total surveillance, mass takeover of human jobs by robots, manipulation of public opinion, the threat of loss of control of humans over technology - this other side shows threatening features. In this book, the physicist, philosopher and Germany's leading technology assessment expert Armin Grunwald creates a critical picture of the world of tomorrow and shows what we have to expect if we don't consciously shape digitalization and make ourselves fully replaceable. (Editor)
content.title_en: The inferior man: the future of humanity in the face of algorithms, artificial intelligence and robots

content.text: Manual series : Older than (co-)producers of district networks - Impulse from the project QuartiersNETZ / Forschungsinstitut Geragogik, Fachhochschule Dortmund (ed.) ; Manual 4: Participative technology development : Methodology and implementation examples. In the form of a collection book manual 4 describes the opportunities and challenges of participatory technology development based on practical examples from the research and development project QuartiersNETZ. The topics range from the idea of a corresponding process for the development of a digital neighbourhood platform to legal aspects in the development of software to the technical possibilities of the connected home. In order to allow a broad audience access to the experiences and insights gained, a special attention is given to a comprehensible and understandable explanation of the respective technical facts.
content.title_en: Manual series : Older than (co-)producers of district networks - Impulse from the project QuartiersNETZ / Forschungsinstitut Geragogik, Fachhochschule Dortmund (ed.) ; Manual 4: Participative technology development : Methodology and implementation examples

content.text: Lifetime: cooperation between the disabled and the elderly. Demographic change affects the whole society, and besides that, the overall better medical and nursing care leads to a significantly longer life expectancy of people with disabilities. However, their special feature is that they age within the given structures and are usually not or hardly designed for the ageing of disabled people. They usually have the choice: stay in the usual environment and live in a group of people with disabilities with a mixed age, but where they are not sufficiently prepared to meet the changed, possibly also nursing needs of an elderly person. Or leave the previous life world and move to a nursing home where many others are cognitively fitter and more independent and the structures are not designed for the care of people with disabilities, but the care needs are optimally met. Both are not ideal. What is needed are comprehensively interrelated flexible concepts that meet these criteria: adequate care and support for people with a disability who are becoming older, who are able to meet their existing living conditions and the realities experienced therein.
content.title_en: Age of life : on cooperation between the disabled and the elderly

content.text: New concepts for economic areas: Challenges and trends based on the example of the Berlin-based urban development plan. Growing cities face specific challenges in the planning, development and safeguarding of industrial and commercial areas: Here, high demand for space on the part of the economy, increasing competition for use and changing location requirements of the companies in the course of technological and structural change have to be brought into line with the demand for sustainable and efficient land use. The volume describes the current trends and challenges in the development and planning of industrial and commercial areas. It describes the contribution economic area concepts can make to demand-oriented and sustainable land development. Based on a city comparison, status quo and development requirements of such specialist concepts are shown. The volume gives suggestions and concrete indications for the development of own specialist concepts.
content.title_en: New concepts for economic areas: Challenges and trends based on the example of the Berlin-based urban development plan

(Elke Nibbrig in ID/B 10/16 for preliminary edition) Now the new edition is extended by a good 30 pages and the Word versions 2019 and 365. The purchase of the new edition is recommended. content.text: Reverse mentoring: Impuls-Mentoring with Digital Natives for more innovation. In an experimentally designed project by the European Institute for Experience and Management – METIS of the Rheinische Fachhochschule Köln, top managers were first brought together with pupils of a secondary school in a reverse mentoring project, which was awarded by the renowned Donors' Association for German Science. It was examined whether managers can gain relevant impulses from such a format, which must be adapted to the pupils and how the format of reverse mentoring is.A new instrument was created from the reverse mentoring project: the Impuls-Mentoring. This purpose is to provide impulses for a forced change in companies and organizations.The book is divided into two parts: the research report of the Reverse mentoring pilot project of the Institute METIS of the Rheinische Hochschule Köln (part A ) and the fieldbook (part B), in which an adaptable project framework with many practical checklists and tips for practice was developed from the research results.
content.title_en: Reverse Mentoring : Impulse Mentoring with Digital Natives for more innovation

content.text: Algorithmic Mathematics. Introduction -- Full Number Presentations -- Full Number Computing -- Approximate Figures -- Approximate Figures -- Calculations with Errors -- Graphs -- Simple Graph Algorithms -- Sorting Algorithms -- Optimal Trees and Ways -- Matching and Network Flows -- Gauss-Elimination -- Literature Index -- Symbol Directory -- Index Algorithms play an increasingly important role in almost all areas of mathematics. This textbook is suitable for the beginning of the study and provides the classical lectures on analysis and linear algebra with a third basic mathematical lecture, which the authors have held several times at the University of Bonn in recent years. The aim of this work is to impart basic mathematical skills, especially in terms of design and analysis of algorithms, as well as their implementation. In addition to some fundamental algorithms (e.g. Sieb des Eratosthenes, Euclidis algorithm, Sorting Algorithms, Algorithms on graphs, Gauss-Elimination) are also taught in basic mathematics.

content.text: The future of the earth's inhabitants: a manifesto. How would the world present itself to us with its problems and possibilities when we look at them from outer space? Marc Augé shows in his visionary manifesto that the earthlings have a future in the face of ecological, demographic, economic and political challenges only when they see themselves as a truly global community and finally act accordingly. While we can hardly keep up with the incessant technological upheavals and the complete global networking, the world population has divided into three classes: few powerful, a mass of rich consumers and the great army of those excluded from work and goods. Only if we recognize each other as earthlings on the smallest personal level as in the world's social scale can a new overarching solidarity arise - at the center of this is a resource that is infinitely often divisible without becoming less: the world's knowledge. (publishing text)
content.title_en: The future of the earth's inhabitants: a manifesto

content.text: Hacking for dummies. Unlike the somewhat provocative (and ultimately misleading) title, it is a guide on the topic of "IT security" with the focus on so-called ethical hacking. The aim is to detect or avoid weak points in own systems by hacker-typical methods. Although explicitly not updated or revised officially (only "5th edition"), there seems to have been some changes: slight increase in the page size, changed subtitles on the book cover and recently inclusion of macOS. Jutta Schmidt's translation portion, to which reference was made in the last review to the pre-release, is omitted. All in all, a fundamental introduction to an increasingly important topic; the well-known layout and provocative titles generate attention in the presentation area. Due to the short half-life of IT books, the separation and, if necessary, replacement of the older editions is urgently required, the preliminary edition can expire.
content.title_en: Hacking for dummies

content.text: This book will give you all the important information you need to know about business information technology. Stephan Thesmann and Werner Burkard will first explain the importance of information technology for society and for companies. Step by step, they will examine the diverse operational IT systems and explain how IT management works, what you need to consider in terms of data protection and security, and how you network IT in the various departments of a company. They will also learn how to design and model individual software systems and what you need to consider when purchasing a finished solution. Finally, the most common problems of business technology and solutions are highlighted. Visual examples from practice and numerous practice tasks round off the book. (Verlag text)
content.title_en: Business Informatics for Stupids

content.text: The Orbit organization: in 9 steps to the company model for the digital future. Schüller is always worth a recommendation. As already in the excellent "Fit for the Next Economy" (ID-B 28/17) started with the conversion of companies, it continues here (again with co-author Steffen) and creates an organizational model that she calls the "Orbit Organisation". In the first fifth of the book the reader is convinced that and why it needs a new innovation culture to survive in the future. Each chapter is preceded by the Orbit model sketch, which simply illustrates what the following 9 steps are about. About the purpose, customers and customer focus, about employees and employee focus, about managers and business partners, about recommendation marketing and about the field of action of management. Clearly structured, practice-oriented and convincing, with many comprehensible examples from companies. (publisher text)
content.title_en: The Orbit Organization: in 9 Steps to the Company Model for the Digital Future

You will learn a lot about money in general at the beginning, then the author explains how cryptocurrencies stand out from money as you know it. Below he briefly looks at the technical aspects of these currencies and explains how money is earned. So this book helps you if you are looking for reliable and somewhat deeper information but don't want to turn a thick waltz. (Verlag text)

content.text: Scrum: Quick start. The Scrum method for agile software development is becoming increasingly popular in many companies. The introduction to Scrum philosophy, which is interspersed with English terms and its frequent team interactions and close feedback with customers, requires a lot of concentration. This book is limited to the essential elements of Scrum and includes frequently occurring questions, which the author has collected as a certified trainer and coach. In the 4th edition the newly introduced chapter "Scaling" was revised and updated, but the 3rd edition can still remain in existence. The style is to be read fluently, short chapters, listings of important points and scattered graphics facilitate (self-)learning. Therefore, the book is easier to access than the title of S. Roock: "Scrum - understand and successfully use". The possible counter-current F. Franken: "Scrum compact for dummies" is to appear soon.
content.title_en: Scrum : Quick start

content.text: Practical IT risk management : Concept, implementation and review. The rapid development of IT technology has a very large influence on the security measures and organisational forms of companies with its impact on business models of different kinds. IT risk management is therefore of ever greater importance. The author of this book has already dealt with the topic five years ago in a first edition (not discussed here, but should be replaced by the book here if necessary). IT managers, but also students of computer science and business informatics are addressed. The basics as well as organizational structures and elements of IT risk management in companies of different organizations no matter what size order are explained. Each chapter begins with a summary of the chapter objectives; many illustrations, tables and examples. Definitions, practical advice and recommendations for action are highlighted graphically. The appendix includes an overview of standards, standards and further specifications for IT risk management and a helpful list of abbreviations. (3) The second edition has been completely revised and extended to include topics such as DevOps/DevSec, Shadow IT, Industry 4.0 and data-based business models.
content.title_en: Practical IT risk management : Conception, implementation and review

content.text: Supported communication among children and adults. This book offers prospective and practical speech therapists everything important to the methods of supported communication in children and adults, their application areas, their effectiveness and the concrete implementation within speech therapy and provides numerous work materials for download. Use Supported communication in speech therapy and ensure your patients an optimal treatment success! [Verlagshomepage]
content.title_en: Supported communication in children and adults

content.text: Internet Geography : Observations on the relation of Internet, space and society. This volume brings together two interdisciplinary fields of research: the study of the social significance of the Internet and the theoretical discussion on the relationship between space and society. The spatial and social dimensions of the Internet are analysed on the basis of physical, material, structural, perceptive and communicative aspects. It is also visible which impulses the space debate on the research object Internet can gain. The first part of the volume deals with the problem of location of the Internet. The second part identifies in two ways a structurally generating geocode of the Internet. The detailed determination and investigation of various spaces of the Internet is devoted to the third part of the volume.
content.title_en: Internet Geography : Observations on the relation of Internet, space and society

content.text: Haus Stadt Mensch: über Architektur und Gesellschaft. Profit as a scale or a decent city for everyone? Bruno Flierl has designed houses, streets, squares. Pariser Platz in front of the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin for example looks like it looks like it, because Flierl made the specifications and prevented high-rise buildings. The Berlin Senate raised the proposal to the law. Private builders build how they have money to make more money from it. Concrete gold means that cities are primarily there to live, that people have to feel comfortable there, mostly not interested investors. Bruno Flierl. He criticizes the architecture, the city planning today, because it is often only profit-oriented. Not those architects win competitions, which are original and for people build, but those who make the cheapest proposals and therefore promise highest return. Flierl ignores the economy by no means, but also sees the social and social side of building today. Rents must be affordable, apartments must be habitable. The housing not can be fought with containers. Now 92-year-old Bruno Fl can be the Nestor among the architecture houses and has lived in Berlin.

content.text: Web or dieb! : successful corporate communication in times of digital change. Mobile devices, voice assistants, multimedia content are part of the everyday life of the German population - for consumers as well as for B2B decision-makers. But digital communication in many companies lags dramatically behind. The lead may soon be unstoppable. What to do? The author shows how you develop a meaningful, tailor-made communication strategy for your company. You will get a comprehensive overview of knowledge, tools and resources you need to survive in digital change. Content: Success factors for corporate communication in the digital age - Crafts for cross-media communication strategies - Content marketing and social media in practice - Numerous checklists and step-by-step instructions - Completely revised and updated edition (publisher text)
content.title_en: Web or die! : successful corporate communication in times of digital change

content.text: Microsoft Office for Mac: Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OneNote, OneDrive. This compact guide for Mac users covers five applications of the Microsoft Office package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote). The focus is on describing the common functions, optimizing operation and highlighting the most sought-after functions. The latter are based on the author's experience as an IT trainer. This edition is an updated version of the predecessor to Office 2016. The structure of the now considered version 2019 remained largely identical and also large parts of the text are almost unchanged. Added to this are new freehand tools, some functions, translation and editing tools and animated graphics (e.g. text translation into another language, providing all perspectives with 3-D images, morphs in the slides transitions to PowerPoint) Beginners with previous knowledge and transitions benefit from the well-structured and understandable written explanations, accompanied by numerous colored images and graphics.
content.title_en: Microsoft Office for Mac: Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OneNote, OneDrive

content.text: Proper ventilation in apartments. Proper heating and ventilation in apartments, especially in new buildings and renovated, newly insulated houses, is essential. Improved thermal insulation and airtightness can quickly lead to unpleasant moisture damage if wrong behaviour is carried out. Mould mould formation is the most well-known symptom here. This brochure, now in revised reprint, shows how such "housing damage" and unnecessary conflicts between builders and tenants can be avoided on the one hand and builders and architects or craftsmen on the other hand.
content.title_en: Real airing in apartments

content.text: Christianity and the aliens: with the Bible into space. When the age of space travel was dawned in the 1950s, there was the idea of taking Christian missionaries on board, as was the case with the great voyages of discovery by sailing ship. If aliens were to be encountered, the Good News should not be withheld from them. The first Bible on the moon measured four square centimeters, unfortunately it was not suitable for mission. The question of how the Christian faith could deal with other worlds and with extraterrestrials has been dealt with theologians since the early Christianity. Since then, aliens have also been used for their own interests: to testify to the infinitude and omnipotence of the Creator or to herald the fall of Christianity. The latter has not yet been proved to happen. This book provides insights into a centuries-old discussion of how Christian faith has changed in view of the possibility of existence of aliens and how it may change in the future without having to fear its demise.
content.title_en: Christianity and the Aliens: with the Bible into Space

content.text: Marx and the robots: networked production, artificial intelligence and living work. Robots, artificial intelligence and digital networking drive the automation of production. Living work will disappear, man will finally be replaceable, warn the one excited. The other see growth potentials, location advantages – or even new opportunities for overcoming capitalism. Karl Marx was fascinated by the potentials of technology during his life, productive power was the concept he coined for it. How can an analysis oriented to Marx today explain technological change? What is the new, where only the old comes on stage in a different form? Does the critique of capitalism need new concepts?
content.title_en: Marx and the Robots : Networked Production, Artificial Intelligence and Living Work

content.text: The GDR's architectural heritage includes a remarkable number of works of art in public space. These works were an integral part of the building of society and played an important role in the artistic design of the city centres and residential areas. In their definition, they were not merely decorative elements, but had political messages to convey in relation to the idea of a socialist society that was to be developed from scratch. The contents set by the clients were often converted into remarkable works of art by the artists who led them in an individual way and using the most diverse techniques. Today, many of these works are acutely threatened by destruction. The Cottbus architect Martin Maleschka has made it his task to capture this endangered art genre photographically. Over the years, he has built up the most extensive picture documentation of the GDR's architectural art. For
content.title_en: Building-related art GDR : Art in public space 1950 to 1990

content.text: The book combines the many positive approaches in the global north and the south to achieve a better future through common-interest, ecological action. It pleads for a new left narrative, whose politics are oriented towards the needs of people and not towards those of the market. Review: The journalist begins her book with an overview of "neoliberal narratives", which suggest to people that everyone can succeed with Fleiss - which is not true in experience. She pleads for a new left narrative, which instead of simply being against something, works positively for a future that is oriented towards the needs of people and the common good and not towards those of the market. These social approaches already exist: the "care revolution" e.g., the network of those working in the care of those who keep their patients in mind. There are the "buen vivir" movements that originated in the global south, which are originally carried out by indigenous people and who strive for a life in harmony with the human beings.
content.title_en: Deep red and radically colorful : for a new left narrative

content.text: Vegetarian and vegan nutrition. Fourth edition of the standard vegetarian diet on a scientific basis, extended to include the topic of veganism. The various aspects of vegetarian nutrition and lifestyles are presented with a focus on nutritional approaches, in particular on disease prevention and nutrient care in vegetarian lifestyles. In addition, the historical, social and ecological aspects of vegetarian and vegan nutrition are presented in detail. The book is primarily addressed to scientists and students in the fields of nutrition, medicine and related areas, as well as to persons working in nutrition counselling and health promotion, but also to lay people interested in plant nutrition. The preliminary edition was not available for comparison, but an exchange was nevertheless useful due to the extended topic and the integration of numerous current sources and studies.
content.title_en: Vegetarian and vegan diet

content.text: Platform Europe_ : _why we talk badly about the EU and how we can overcome nationalism with a new digital network. Many people in Europe don't feel like Europeans. The EU and its institutions are foreign to them. There is a lack of European public opinion, a European reporting that creates such a WE-feel. A digital, common-interest platform could close this gap. - Review: The author deals with language and its targeted use in politics. This time, his focus is on the EU, or its Member States and the problems with the growing alienation of Europe in some countries. European-critical politicians such as Kurz or Orban use the targeted use of language (Framing) to promote their idea of the Europe of the nation states. Hillje talks about the role of the media, which only reports on the crises in the EU, about the insufficient reporting e.g. from the European Parliament. This leads to the fact that there is no common European public, that mainly feel as Europeans, the broad population in many countries does not feel together. To make this so necessary, we do not fund the network for digital services, we call for the services.
content.title_en: Platform Europe_ : _why we are not talking about the EU and how we can overcome nationalism with a new digital network

content.text: Between rationality and religion : Interdisciplinary perspectives. Content: After the triumphal march of natural science and enlightenment on the one hand and the imperfection - and probably also inconceivability - of the "Project of Modernism" (J. Habermas) on the other hand, we all live "between rationality and religion". This leads to tensions within man as well as in society. The lectures presented in the "Academic Forum Albertus Magnus" (Regensburg) by renowned scientists follow the different lines of tension, whereby the question arises: Does the "intermediation" have to be seen exclusively as a burden or can this tension be positively assessed? Do rationality and religion perhaps even support each other?
content.title_en: Between rationality and religion : Interdisciplinary perspectives

content.text: Business analytics : how you use data for controlling companies. Why do some companies fully exploit the potential of business analytics and others not? The reason for this is not a lack of mastery of algorithms. Rather, other aspects of business analytics are not sufficiently considered! This includes, in addition to mastering algorithms, the interpretation and visualization of the results of the algorithms, but also the organizational location of the analytics function.
content.title_en: Business analytics: how to use data for controlling companies

content.text: Dealing with diversity: innovative teaching concepts in teacher education for dealing with heterogeneity and inclusion. Heterogeneity is a theoretical construct that can be perceived as a challenge for teacher education. In the present interdisciplinary volume, highly indebtedidactic concepts are presented that aim to address the topics of inclusion and heterogeneity for teacher studies. Subject-dactical and educational science offerings are equally described in their appendix and presented in relation to different dimensions. This includes the perspectives from which school and teaching are considered, as well as the question of how the student community can be integrated as a heterogeneous group of learners. In addition, there are indications that innovative teaching projects that deal with complex content can be adequately investigated and evaluated. All of the contributions gathered here are based on innovative teaching projects within the framework of quality offensive teacher education at Münster. This funding programme offers the possibility to systematically develop teacher education in the field of inclusion and heterogeneity.

content.text: Innovative public bike rental systems: Results of the evaluation and recommendations from the model projects. The positive impact of public bike rental systems (ÖFVS) goes far beyond their actual use. ÖFVS increases the quality of an integrated system of public transport services from ÖFVS, ÖV and car sharing and contributes to sustainable mobility behaviour in the long term. In addition, ÖFVS contribute to the image gain of the city and cycling traffic. It is therefore strongly recommended not only to keep an eye on the direct mobility-related costs and effects, but also the indirect positive effects in the decision on the system structure and in operation. The model experiment has successfully shown that ÖVFS can be an important instrument for promoting cycling traffic, but also the entire environmental network. With the help of the new findings about the systems as well as the users, it becomes possible to further advance the ÖFVS and thus make an important contribution to sustainable mobility in the municipalities.
content.title_en: Innovative public bike rental systems: results of evaluation and recommendations from model projects

content.text: Product design for additive manufacturing. Additive manufacturing technology - 3D printing - will in the future be a key technology, especially in the context of Industry 4.0 and increasingly individualized production. To fully exploit the potential of this manufacturing technology, deep knowledge about the entire process chain, from pre- and post-processing, to manufacturing, data handling and available materials and machines is required. The foundation stone is provided by virtual, three-dimensional computer-based models from which the physical components are generated. The handling of 3D construction programs and the creation of 3D models are thus the prerequisite for the independent application of additive manufacturing technologies. This book aims to provide beginners and users in the additive manufacturing technology field with a basic and at the same time detailed expertise on the design of components. The book focuses particularly on the following topics: classification of additive manufacturing processes and overview; potentials of additive manufacturing; development of component design and design; challenges and opportunities for designers; lasers of the bedding components.

content.text: Conversion as an opportunity for regional development. Conversion, in its social and regional significance, goes far beyond the civilian transformation of individual objects and resources. In many cities and regions, which have often been characterised by military forces for centuries, large areas suddenly become vacant. The federal or state-owned former military areas were to form a basis for the initiation of sustainable economic development and for a politically formulated, but hitherto hardly feasible ecological reconstruction of urban and regional structures. The issue presents the papers of a workshop conducted at the IRS in May 1994, in which scientists and practitioners discussed opportunities and obstacles to conversion. In this context, fields of action and concepts are identified and a comparison is drawn with the regional conversion in the USA. The final report of the EU project "Conversion of the Panzerkaserne Neurupin" is also included.
content.title_en: Conversion as an opportunity for regional development

content.text: The aim of this report is to identify the factors which are important for the development of Bavaria's economic power and to describe alternative development possibilities in scenarios based on these factors, as well as to outline the necessary economic policy measures to safeguard and strengthen its economic power.The Free State of Bavaria has developed from a highly agriculturally oriented economic area to a modern industrial state, especially since the end of the Second World War. Together with Baden-Württemberg, it has shaped the image of the prosperous south of the Federal Republic. Measured by the GDP per inhabitant, the Bavarian economy has caught up with the federal average in a first phase between 1954 and 1961 and again from 1975 to 1987. From 1988 onwards, the Bavarian indicator already exceeded the federal value, and this has been more marked from year to year. This development has impressed many observers, and one wonders whether it will continue in the future or whether a trend change should be expected.
content.title_en: Development prospects of the Bavarian economy: ways to secure and strengthen Bavaria's economic power

content.text: Environmental problems and environmental policy in Central and Eastern Europe : Economy, ecology and system change : with 11 illustrations. The book tries to identify the dimension and structure of environmental problems in the economic systems of the former Comecon countries and to show alternative and alternative action and needs. It analyses how and in which areas environmental policy has responded to the ecological and economic challenges and why lasting successes could only be realized in exceptional cases. In the analysis, the existence of system-specific contradictions in environmental policy in connection with economic stagnation trends is emphasized. As the accumulated environmental problems in the initiated transformation prove to be an economic bottleneck factor, the ex-RW states could become a test case for how the conflict "economic growth versus ecological rehabilitation" can be solved in a first step.

content.text: ICE: the ghost train: the dilemma of high-speed trains. The author of this thought-provoking study with the somewhat irritating title - according to his own statement a railway friend - sees the development of the German Federal Railways in a direction that ultimately leads to the "death" of the railway as a public mass transport means, to its privatization. Essentially to this contributes the tendency towards high-speed trains, a railway especially for managers, fast but energy-intensive, to this landscape-destroying. Their financing is at the expense of a nationwide railway network, which alone could be an alternative to individual traffic. As a deterrent example he calls the railway development in Japan, as a positive example Switzerland. With his reading-worthy study he also wants to encourage resistance against this railway policy. A book for (not against!) the railway, which the federal railway uppers will not taste. Good addition to W. Wolf (BA 9/87) and "Alptraum Auto" (BA 7/86). Recommendable! (3) (Leo Prawitt)

content.text: The concept of "soft tourism" has led to a striking revival of tourism policy since the early 1980s, combining different ideas of a qualitative reorientation of tourism development, which is to be brought into line with the preservation of nature and the environment, as well as the interests of holiday regions and the people living there. The aim is to create a new relationship between tourism, the environment and the region, which is determined by the principles of understanding and conservation. Although the idea of "soft tourism" has already been theoretically far differentiated, the practical implementation of appropriate approaches to action is still lagging behind the discussion. The present volume therefore gathers together several contributions, which document various examples of concrete tourism projects under the guiding principle of "soft tourism". In particular, these projects are both older, already established and newer, some of which are only planned projects, from Tuscany via grey-bounds, the western Austrian Alpine region, the Mühlviertel, the German North Sea coast and the eastern Frisia region to the north.
content.title_en: Soft tourism in concrete terms: towards a new relationship between tourism, environment and region

The restriction to a material cycle economy exposes them as a recycling lie. They rely on a sensible waste prevention strategy, which must already be used in production and consumption. Possibilities for this at industrial, municipal and consumer level are shown. The non-fiction book, due to the evocative style, should be especially suitable for pupils, besides the above titles. content.text: Planning of hazardous material storage in universities: Help for the spatial programming of special waste intermediate and chemical supply storage. With the present planning aid, a review of the applicable legal regulations with their structural, safety and organizational specifications and the methodological basis for a space program is given. Also a critical examination of sub-shelter concepts, storage functions and storage methods takes place. Structure: 1. Introduction 2. Basics (concept definitions - legal framework - basics for storage planning - materials: literature, HIS materials) 3. Storage planning in universities (provisions for storage size and stock allocation - specifications for the construction equipment - specifications for the location choice) 4. Preparation of a planning basis (room programme) (room allocation - design of the spatial size - description of the space) 5. Operation of the storage (staff - acceptance of hazardous materials - occupational safety when handling dangerous materials) 6. Costs of a hazardous material storage 7. Storage examples (chemical storage - special waste intermediate storage) 8.
content.title_en: Planning of hazardous material storage facilities in universities : Assistance for spatial programming of hazardous waste intermediates and chemical supply storage facilities

content.text: The symbolic exchange and death. "The symbolic exchange and death is a disturbing diagnosis of the state of the present. Baudrillard shows in his most important book the rapid loss of the real behind the modern sign games and delusions. He proves to be a theoretical frontier-goer who reveals the system with his tendencies of capture as a simulation. Baudrillard's resistance consists in bringing this phenomenon of modernity to vibrate and into the drab of destruction. Starting from extensive investigations of phenomena of our time such as fashion, body cult, catastrophes or accidents, he concludes that death is the last meaningful enclave in a world filled with the universal capital movement.
content.title_en: The symbolic exchange and death

content.text: Settlements of prehistory in Germany, 300 000 to 15 B.C. The author of "Die Entstehung von Sprache und Schrift" (BA 1/90) deals with another aspect of human social life, the history of settlement. He is limited to archaeological sites in Germany, which can stand as examples of individual prehistoric periods: Bilzingsleben, Gönnersdorf, Federsee, Heuneburg, Manching etc. The well illustrated book also illustrates the possibilities of knowledge of modern archaeology and is already accessible to readers with little prior knowledge. Tips for visiting sites and museums as well as a detailed literature list encourage further study of the topic. Only slight overlap with the geographically wider, but narrower "Siedlungen der Steinzeit" (ID 6/90), thus usefully supplementing this title. (Erst Zimmermann)

content.text: The production of renewable energy sources has grown extremely rapidly in recent years. Since the amendment of the EEG in 2004, the biogas sector has experienced a boom in the area, where the number of plants in Germany has doubled to this day and the installed electrical power has increased to five times. Lower Saxony and in particular the Weser-Ems region have taken part in this development disproportionately, as there have already been many years of experience in biogas production and in the technology used. Therefore, innovative biogas concepts for the optimal use of energy potential and for reducing nutrient surpluses in regions with intensive livestock farming have been used in this region. Numerous processes for fermentation treatment are currently being reported. In contrast, studies on the renewable raw materials in biogas plants with a high frequency of waste are being used in the field of biogas treatment.
content.title_en: Nutrient flow analysis of a biogas plant with fermentation waste treatment in the district of Vechta

content.text: Geotourism: innovative approaches to tourism and sustainable regional development. Summary: Geotourism combines geosciences with tourism (planning). Unlike the classical nature or cultural trips, the topic "Geo" has only recently attracted an increased interest from the tourism side. This development has been substantially supported by the international Geopark movement, which has created at the same time increasingly sought-after goals of sustainable tourism by predicting large-scale areas with high-quality geopotentials. Geotourism can make a relevant contribution to sustainable regional development and to regional value creation in regions with high-quality geopotentials, provided that appropriate quality standards and implementation criteria are observed. In summer 2006 the first German manual on geotourism was presented. It offers an overview of current trends and trends as well as marketing and evaluation strategies for geotourist offers based on historical development. Case examples of a wide range of orientation illustrate the theoretical background. A revised reprint was published in summer 2008.
content.title_en: Geotourism : innovative approaches to tourism and sustainable regional development

content.text: Edition Manual of Production Technology: Manual of Original Forms. The volume of Original Forms consists of two parts: original forms of metallic materials and original foams of plastics. Each part contains the most relevant manufacturing processes in industry. In the metals, these are casting, galvanoforming and powder metallurgy, in the plastics injection moulding and extrusion. In each of these main sections, the basics, process engineering, materials, quality and cost aspects as well as the means of production are discussed.
