content.text: Möbius and his volume : The rise of mathematics and astronomy in Germany of the 19th century. The biography of the mathematician Moebius has a rather exemplary function here: In the 19th century mathematics and astronomy in Germany experienced an upsurge, which is primarily due to a restructuring of the education system and thus of the entire intellectual life in Prussia. This renewal led e.g. to the unification of research and teaching in the office of the professor and to a higher importance of mathematics as a scientific discipline. This background, in front of which Moebius and with him other greats such as Gauss, Bessel or Fraunhofer could lead their scientific work to an international top level, is illuminated here in six generously illustrated contributions by well-known scientists. A very informative representation of this important epoch in the German scientific history. (2) (Heidi Debschütz)
content.title_en: Möbius and his band : the rise of mathematics and astronomy in Germany of the 19th century

content.text: The nature conservation restrictions of forestry: economic catastrophe or small-scale disasters?. The main factors for assessing the consequences of the nature conservation regulations are the initial situation of the stocks and the required measures. Due to the different growth characteristics of the tree species and the resulting product ranges with the respective prices, a large number of shifts can arise in the economy. In the direct comparison of the hectare values for timber production and annuities, a significant influence of tree species and location quality is evident. [...] The economic effects that arise from the implementation of the FFH Directive in Germany must be assessed from two angles. In current and current terms, the effects for forestry as a whole are moderate and do not represent a materially dangerous change. Nevertheless, the implementation of the Directive means a reduction in the economic performance of the sector. For affected forest areas the effects are much more serious. The average reduction in the wood production values reaches a magnitude which represents a fundamental impairment of affected farms. However, the present results also indicate that the resulting opportunity costs can be minimized by the use of the options.
content.title_en: Nature conservation restrictions on forestry : economic disaster or a small-scale disaster?

content.text: Baustatik / Raimond Dallmann ; 3: Baustatik 3 : Theorie II. Ordnung und computerorientierte Methoden der Stabtragwerke. In the construction of structural engineering, solid knowledge of theory II. Ordnung and computer-oriented methods of structural structural engineering are important for the qualified application of calculation software. This textbook for students in civil engineering provides a clear understanding of the fundamental theoretical contexts. After the basics of theory II. Ordnung, simple systems are calculated using differential equations and iteration via deformations. The rotation angle method is extended to the application of theory II. Ordnung and the general way size method is clearly derived. Further contents of the book are approximation methods of structural engineering based on the principle of virtual work and the method of transmission matrices. The approximation methods and the way size method provide an initial access to the method of finite elements. Numerous examples facilitate understanding and enable the verification of the plausibility of computer calculations. By means of numerous tasks, the solution of which is specified at the end of the book, the teaching material can be practiced independently.

content.text: Dictionary of the Present. What comes after universalism? Many of the categories and concepts of modernity continue to write historical interpretation patterns, of which critical, postcolonial and feminist thinkers worldwide distance themselves. But how can we communicate about a globalized present without agreeing on certain basic concepts? The dictionary of the present shows fear, image, thing, violence, justice, body, market, politics, language, animal, truth and time, how fixed writings can be re-perspectived by situational voices. Exclusion mechanisms and assumptions with regard to race, class and gender, but also to space and time, become visible in this way. At the same time, shifts in meaning and extensions arise in order to reshape the world linguistically.
content.title_en: Dictionary of the Present

content.text: The Federalism in Historical Comparative Perspective; Volume 5: Excessionalism on the German Empire's Financialism. The importance and functioning of federalism in the German Empire's political system has so far been little appreciated by the Federalism's government. While the Federal Council was considered as an imperial institution in which the Prussian Hegemonic power could determine politics, the role of the other countries in political decision-making has been increasingly under way.On the basis of various source-based legislative processes in the field of imperial finance policy, Philipp Höfer shows that the possibilities of individual states to influence the Reichspolitik have been significantly exceeded by the Federal Council.

content.text: Sitt Marie-Rose : a Lebanese story; with an autobiographical epilogue. "I saw Marie-Rose. I expected her to be crushed, perhaps disfigured, intimidated. No. She stands before me as beautiful as we were when we were both sixteen years old and went to the high school of Beirut together. She is now thirty-two and she is like a queen. I swear she is beautiful," says Mounir. Beirut 1975: The Lebanese Christian Sitt Marie-Rose supports Palestinian refugees. Now she stands, beautiful and proud like a queen, before Mounir. In the conflict between Lebanese and Palestinians, she dared to break through the friend-enemy schema, as a traitor she is arrested and is now to be condemned by him, of all things, of all her old childhood love.
content.title_en: Sitt Marie-Rose : a Lebanese story ; with an autobiographical epilogue

content.text: Waste + hazardous waste : Environmental problem No. 1 ; Facts - Hazards - Alternatives. Rebuts the alleged non-dangerity of hazardous waste dumps using concrete examples and presents alternatives such as hydrogenation, fermentation plants, etc. (Gisela Jonas) G. A. Ulmer, committed author, co-author and publisher of numerous publications (not discussed here) on environmental problems and questions of healthy nutrition, critically examines the possibilities and techniques of waste disposal. Using the special waste dumps in Malsch, Georgswerder and Bünzheim, he refutes the alleged non-dangerity of landfills and presents alternatives such as thermoselect methods, hydrogenation, fermentation plants, bio-puster processes and control and landfills. However, according to Ulmer, the priority is still to prevent waste. Given the dangers posed by outdated incineration plants and landfilling methods, an important writing. Register. (2) (Gisela Jonas)
content.title_en: Waste + hazardous waste : Environmental problem No 1 ; facts - hazards - alternatives

content.text: People in dark times. Rosa Luxemburg, Karl Jaspers, Tania Blixen, Hermann Broch, Martin Heidegger, Walter Benjamin, Bertolt Brecht, Nathalie Sarraute, Tania Blixen and other poets, writers and philosophers portray Hannah Arendt in this volume. The essays "contemplate with persons - the way they lived their lives, how they moved in the world and how they were touched by the historical time ... Together is the age in which their lifetime fell, the world of the first half of the twentieth century with its political catastrophes, moral disasters and an amazing development of art and science."
content.title_en: People in Dark Times

content.text: The discussion about 'foreigners' - whether they are recruiting workers or asylum seekers - is not only very emotional in the Federal Republic of Germany, but also usually conducted as if other European countries did not have very similar problems. To raise the awareness of the outside world, a new book has been published in the series 'Materials of the Centre for Educational Practice' by the University of Oldenburg. Dr. Rolf Meinhardt, who teaches intercultural education and foreign education at the University of Oldenburg, presents texts in this volume that are intended to enable the comparison of the situation of migrants in the two countries. In addition to historical breaks on the immigration history in the states - with the special situation in the Netherlands due to their colonial history being particularly taken into account - there are numerous contributions to the political, legal and social position of migrant groups and to social work with them in the reader. For the Dutch part, the editor succeeded in winning three well-known Dutch experts to cooperate. The Netherlands are considered a particularly liberal country. Whether the reader also finds a special answer to this question of ethnicity - the general public interest in the issue of 'foreigners'.
content.title_en: Foreign policy and intercultural work with ethnic minorities in the Netherlands and in the Federal Republic of Germany : texts for comparison

The book, published by Frank Bieler and Gunnar Schwarting, provides a sober inventory of what has been achieved and shows the essential framework conditions for the successful expansion of e-Government. It works out important problem areas and makes courage to see e-Government as a great opportunity for the future.

content.text: Two degrees more in Germany: how climate change will change our everyday lives; [the scenario 2040]. Two opposing positions determine the debate about climate change: catastrophism and trivialization. The truth, also the predicted, will lie in between, according to the editors F.-W. Gerstengarbe of the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research and H. Welzer (University of Flensburg, focus on cultural science climate impact research). With 17 other experts of different research fields, they present a scenario for the year 2040 based on current, scientifically collected data. The globally effective temperature rise is very different, for Germany comparatively moderate. Accordingly, its effects are different. Comparative coloured maps of Germany show the consequences of climate change on forests, waters, cities, infrastructures, agriculture, health and the social structure. Compared to "hot times for the earth" (ID-A 8/13) and L.C. Smith: "The world in 2050" (ID-A 24/11) the daily life is more discussed. With a detailed literature list. Broadly, the scenario is also used in the school library.
content.title_en: Two degrees more in Germany : how climate change will change our daily lives ; [Scenario 2040]

On many border-revenue sites in Central Europe open and rich in species have emerged. Today many of these have fallen, and the species communities living there have changed as a result of the succession to bushes and forest societies. Currently, nature conservation experts are trying to preserve or restore the original significance of such areas as habitats of endangered animal and plant species by keeping open.

content.text: The release of information: GNU, Linux and the consequences. A material-rich volume about the "Free Software" (newly called mostly open source programs) and its transmission to today's and future communication and dissemination of information in the broadest sense. "Free" does not mean free, meaning the release of the software for other programmers, which can make changes and improvements, which are again freely available. At the beginning stood Richard Stillman's program GNU (an acronym for "GNU is not UNIX") and its Free Software Foundation (FSF). He also conceived the GPL (General Public Licence), which was very soon put on a solid foundation by the development of Linux. The author describes the connections very knowledgeable and with accurate source references. He also addresses the commercial interests, which lead e.g. in the music and film industry to inaccessible source code of programs, to encrypt the content and to changes in copyright in the USA and us. A section of the book worth reading is dedicated to the breathtaking development of free encyclopedia Wikipedia. (1) (Martin A. Lobek) The history of the distribution of the software (now) Free Source and the information.
content.title_en: The Liberation of Information : GNU, Linux and the Consequences

content.text: The rise and fall of the German nuclear economy. A detailed and critical history of the use of nuclear energy in Germany, beginning with the naive euphoria of the 1950s, and continuing with the protest movements to the decline caused by Chernobyl and Fukushima. (Rolf Raschka) The renowned historian wrote an extensive book on the environmental movement with "Era der Ökologie" (ID-G 15/11) and is now dedicated to the civilian use of nuclear energy in Germany. Radkau has revised and updated his habilitation, published 30 years ago, with the nuclear energy expert Hahn. Those who expect dry theory are pleasantly disappointed, because despite the enormous amount of detail the text is well understandable. It seems astonishing how coincidentally the plans of the 1960s, the high-flying plans, security problems, the emergence of protest movements and the descent, which was accelerated by the misfortunes of Chernobyl and Fukushima. It informs about the naive euphoria of the 1950s, the high-flying plans of the 1960s, the emergence of protest movements and the descent, which was accelerated by the misfortunes of Chernobyl and Fukushima.
content.title_en: Rise and fall of the German nuclear industry

content.text: The research project : planning, execution and evaluation of a quantitative study. This textbook is aimed at all those who (for the first time) carry out their own empirical research project. The basics, all important steps and possible sources of errors are explained. In addition, the book is supplemented by online materials, which include an example data set as well as a short introduction to SPSS and a statistical formula collection.
content.title_en: The research project : planning, implementation and evaluation of a quantitative study

content.text: Baron Sattag or the life after death: novel. Hans Christoph Buch is the great traveller among German writers. His new novel invites readers to a journey through time, an expedition into the self that leads the narrator to the places of his youth spent in the south of France: to the monastery of La Sainte Baume, where he learned French, to Marseille, where his father served as a consul, and to Sanary, where he traces the traces of Bertolt Brecht, Thomas Mann and other prominent exiles - and to Buch's second home: Haiti destroyed by the earthquake. The path to memory leads to fiction: book tells a mysterious journey into the interior, from life as a journey into the realm of death, as a search for God, whose protagonist and narrator transforms into a living dead, full of new ease and yet condemned to repeat the errors and errors that have passed through him during his lifetime. "Hans Christoph Buch has written a pre-intentionally autobiographical novel, which, however, widens and as a disturbingly fascinating, world-longing theatre with various acts.
content.title_en: Baron Saturday or the life after death : Roman

content.text: Wastewater treatment with plants: Construction instructions for 4 to 400 inhabitants. The author is one of the founders of the European cooperative "Longo mai", has been operating since 1995 the structural biological conversion of the farm Ulenkrug in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern to a "centre for applied environmental projects". Here, various methods for the natural wastewater treatment from the simple compost toilet to the large plant sewage treatment plant are developed and tested. Principles of the natural wastewater treatment, construction of compost toilets and sewage sludge earthing plants, detailed construction instructions for pipes, pits, shafts, plant beds, soil filters, sewage ponds, as well as operation and maintenance are presented. The present guide convinces by practical proximity, understandable texts, sample calculations, numerous detailed photos, design drawings and helps in deciding which plant comes into question, which work is possible in own performance and where the experience of professionals is indispensable. So far without comparison title. B. Goldberg (ID 36/04) is only short on plant clarification plants, K.B.o.

Part 1 clarifies the basic categories of the subject (space, environment, region, etc.), part 2 deals with the socially relevant processes (migration, urbanisation, globalization, etc.) and part 3 deals with the central cultural and social geography methods.
content.title_en: Key concepts of cultural and social geography

content.text: Kinematics and kinetics: with detailed task solutions, basic concepts, formulas, questions, answers. Publisher's text: This textbook covers all areas of kinematics and kinetics. It is structured in such a way that the three components basic concepts and formulas, tasks with solutions as well as questions and answers always follow each other. Thus, there is a balanced connection between theory and solved exercise tasks. The content is limited to the necessary and is easily understood by many images. In this new edition the chapter "Relative Movement" was included, the chapter "Questions and Answers" was extended and an overview of the solved tasks was added. The book addresses students and lecturers of engineering sciences at universities of applied sciences and universities.
content.title_en: Kinematics and kinetics : with detailed task solutions, basic concepts, formulas, questions, answers

content.text: Rammelsberg Gold : Presence, extraction, processing and use. In the Rammelsberg ore, besides lead gloss, copper gravel, zinc blend, sulfur gravel and silver, gold with 0.2 g/t - 2.0 g/t is present, which is already known in historical times as a mountain product. From 1710 to 1984 the hut-manically produced Güldischsilber is regularly divorced in gold and silver. In the first 8 Scheinjahrten the gold of Rammelsberg cannot be economically won. The divorce has state-representative and financial reasons for the Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttler and Hanoverian state lords. It comes to coin and medal mintings from Rammelsberggold, which are to make known the own gold reserves. Since the middle of the 19th century, the Rammelsberg gold can be distinguished with good profit. It reaches the precious metal market and is now available to a wide range of uses.
content.title_en: The Rammelsberger Gold : Deposits, extraction, processing and use

content.text: What do you want, you still live: Chronicle of an industrial settlement; a lesson with original statements, documents, songs and graphics as well as a poster by Klaus Staeck. Between Dinslaken and Voerde a coal-fired power plant is to be built in 1966. However, a citizen initiative is fighting against it. Günter Wallraff and Jens Hagen present in this book original material, which gives information about how the green lung of the Ruhrpott was alienated from the majority interest. Since such a process includes all available possibilities and levels, the two authors have written a lesson which is intended to serve as an example to other citizens' initiatives to confront the exemplar of this case with their own experiences. The lesson can be staged as a whole or in parts with simple means (e.g. projections, banners, songs).
content.title_en: What do you want, you still live : Chronicle of an industrial settlement ; a lesson with original statements, documents, songs and graphics as well as a poster by Klaus Staeck

content.text: Building with green : the construction and vegetation technique of gardening and landscaping ; 276 tables. For all those who need to know or want to learn about the handling of green, this work describes how to deal with soil, concrete, stones, wood, steel and road building materials. The special application of this work illustrates in many examples how the harmonious interaction between built and planted can be realized. (Source: www.buchkatalog.de 26.04.2010)
content.title_en: Building with green : the construction and vegetation technique of gardening and landscaping ; 276 tables

content.text: Electrical drive technology: basics, design, applications, solutions. From a user's point of view, this book deals with all aspects of modern electrical drive technology. It is aimed at practitioners who want to understand, interpret, deploy and maintain electric drives, and also at skilled workers, technicians, engineers and students who want to gain a comprehensive overview of electric drive technology. Jens Weidauer describes the basics of electric drives, their design and application, and even complex automation solutions. He presents the entire spectrum of drive solutions with their respective focus on application. A special aspect is the combination of multiple drives to drive systems and the integration of drives into automation solutions. In simple and clear language, supported by many graphic representations, complex connections are explained and presented intelligibly. The author deliberately refrains from comprehensive mathematical considerations, but instead focuses on an understandable explanation of the operating principles and contexts. This enables the reader to understand electric drives in their entirety and solve drive problems in everyday work. (publisherence)
content.title_en: Electrical drive technology : Basics, design, applications, solutions

The publication focuses on the interlinkages of institutions and officials in the Nazi dictatorship, continuity and breakage after the end of the war, as well as on materials for human rights education, which have been newly developed for state institutions.
content.title_en: NS history, institutions, human rights : educational materials for administration, police and justice

content.text: Pigafetta : Roman. "The cargo is a priority", so the passengers are assigned aboard the nameless freighter, who once travels around the world from Hamburg. Why, so the paying guest, who is also the telling guest on the ship, does one undertake such a trip? Other questions are not so easy to answer: Why does no one seem to know what is in the containers that the ship has loaded? Why does the restless captain necessarily want to leave? And why does the cook have a single cookbook with him for the many months?
content.title_en: Pigafetta : Roman

content.text: Biohacking: Genetic engineering from the garage. Three science journalists dare to try themselves: for two years they dive into the biohacking scene, meet insiders and achieve amazing results in the garage laboratory. What is long established practice in information technology or archaeology is increasingly successful in biology. With the simplest means from the pharmacy or online providers, amateurs can operate almost on a professional level and thereby analyze diseases and manipulate the genetic code. The authors link their adventurous encounters and experiences with professional excursions into the current genetic engineering, partly at the edge of legality, but always with the ethical and political consequences in view. Everything indicates that the Bill Gates quoted in the flap text will retain the right: "Whoever really wants to change the world today, here he should start: with the biomolecules." This change may be motivated by the research spirit or also the will to destroy - broad information is indispensable. So far nothing comparable in German language. (2 S) (Oliver Mites) Genetic research in the hobby cellar allows the most simple recipe for the layman.
content.title_en: Biohacking : Genetic engineering from the garage

content.text: Basic experimental technology in physics classes. Meyn presents experimental techniques and experiments for a demanding physics class in upper secondary school. He describes the technical details and the test procedures very precisely, also gives hints for technical optimizations and makes suggestions for the use of teaching. A successful practical help for referendars and physics teachers, now continuously revised and also with some new topics (1st edition: ID-B 25/11). (2 S)
content.title_en: Basic experimental technology in physics

content.text: Sexual abuse by professionals in institutions : Prevention and intervention - a workbook. Violations of personal rights, physical assaults, deprivation of liberty and sexual violence are extreme variations of exploitative or unprofessional behavior. These behaviours of employees towards minors are also evident in the context of institutions that should actually be devoted to the treatment, care, care and education.
content.title_en: Sexual abuse by professionals in institutions : Prevention and intervention - a workbook

content.text: Bauhaus Dessau : architecture, design, concept; architecture, design, idea. The Bauhaus Dessau, designed by Walter Gropius, was the home of the Bauhaus Dessau School of Design from 1925 to 1932. The world-wide concept of 20th century design, attracts around 80,000 visitors from Germany and abroad every year. In 1996, the building was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. In more than 80 unique photographs, taken in the still empty rooms immediately after the comprehensive renovation of 1996-2006, this volume shows the transparency and lightness of an extremely sensual modern architecture whose surprising, powerful colour reveals the 'white modern' as a myth. In addition to the history and architecture of the house, the book also describes the work in the workshops and the most important products, because architecture, design and idea of the Bauhaus are inseparably linked. Biographies of the most important Bauhaus houses round off the book. 'Bauhaus Dessau' offers aesthetic pleasure, timeless inspiration and vivid viewing - here the legendary building becomes tangible.
content.title_en: Bauhaus Dessau : architecture, design, concept; architecture, design, idea

content.text: In view of the strained financial situation in the educational sector, universities and university hospitals have been looking for savings potential in building operating costs for a long time. Cleaning is a field of particular interest for the core processes of research and teaching due to its high cost share and its supposedly low strategic importance. However, it is often unclear to what extent it can be reduced, which cleaning services are forfeitable and how the quality of cleaning can be ensured. In the presented work these problems are taken up and criteria for performance profiles in the building cleaning are compiled, which can be used especially for questions of the reorganization of self- and external cleaning. At the same time, basic objectives of a modern building cleaning have been systematically worked out. The results are mainly based on experiences from universities and university hospitals. They are shown in the extensive annex. Among other definitions of the types of services, performance descriptions, cleaning plans, quality measurement (checklist, inspection form...), performance measurements as well as extracts from the REFA manual, composition of the hourly calculation rate for employees in the building cleaning organization.
content.title_en: Cleaning of buildings in universities and university hospitals

The basics are presented for beginners more understandable and more detailed. Markings characterise deepening chapters. Notes on computer applications are systematically highlighted in boxes. And especially interesting for users and exam preparation: A new accompanying website contains instructions for the calculation of the BORT's and student's teaching tools.

content.text: Sustainable development: Strategies for ecological and social Earth policies. Since the UN Conference in Rio 1992 the guiding principle of sustainable development has become the central reference for ecologically just, socially just world policies. Huber discusses once again the factors and points of reference that are important in this regard: material flows, intensity and efficiency of resource use, social justice in the global distribution struggle, etc. On the subject there is now a rich title range. Huber offers a convincing analytical consolidation of the discussion for ecopolitical and economically interested readers.
content.title_en: Sustainable development: strategies for environmental and social Earth policy

content.text: Rebellious cities: from the right to city to urban revolution. The fact that cities are political spaces is already revealed by the origin of the word politics from the Greek "polis". Cities are governed and demonstrated, most recently in Cairo or New York. But in cities, money is also invested, and money is transformed into houses, skyscrapers and suburban settlements. And finally, city planning has always been an instrument of political control since Georges-Eugènes Haussmann rebuilt Paris at the latest. All these topics are explored by David Harvey in "Rebellian cities". He deals with the connection between high-rise boom and economic crisis, with the rapid growth of Chinese cities and explores the emancipatory potential of urban protest movements such as "Occupy Wall Street" and "Right to City"
content.title_en: Rebellious Cities : From the Right to City to Urban Revolution

content.text: Die Zeitschrift als Manifesto : Essays on architectural trends in the 20th century. Journals from Europe and America in the fields of architecture and art; excerpts from several famous essays by Adolf Loos, Peter Behrens, Aldo van Eyck, Egon Eiermann, Walter Gropius, Ernst May; Journals among others The Studio, Ring, Jahrbuch des Deutschen Werkbundes, De Stijl, L'Esprit Nouveau, Die Form, bauhaus, Forum, Archigram, ABC
content.title_en: The Journal as Manifesto : Essays on Architectural Currents in the 20th Century

content.text: Market success through user-friendly design: success factor "usability" for consumer and investment goods. Content: Definition of usability and clarification of related terms. Importance of usability for the commercial success of a product. Importance of the target group for the design of an interactive product. Offer of functions and communication of application possibilities for the user. Preparation of operating instructions. Recommendations for the evaluation of user interfaces and their design according to principles of accessibility. The following standards, DIN standards, are addressed: Software Ergonomics/Accessibility: DIN EN ISO 9241 ff. Design of machines: DIN EN 614-1, DIN EN ISO 12100, DIN EN ISO 26800. Other key words: interaction design, interaction design, user interface, functionality, design process of user interfaces, innovation. Prototyping.
content.title_en: Market success through user-friendly design: success factor "usability" for consumer and capital goods

content.text: The sugar mafia makes us sick. Narcotic sugar: Research shows that children are already programmed for addiction, often already in their wombs. Many eat sugar without wanting to, hidden as a preservative in industrial food. The avalanche rolls: Worldwide more and more people suffer from the consequences of sugar consumption. Independent scientists warn of the risks, among others of obesity, Alzheimer's, cancer. And above all: the diabetes diabetes. 44 billion euros it costs annually in Germany alone. The sugar mafia: For decades the sugar lobby has been under control the politics. The sales are promoted, the side effects are trivialized, with friendly support from the state and science. Grimm makes public for the first time the scandalous connection between state sugar promotion and common diseases. Hans-Ulrich Grimm shows the global interdependencies, he reports about the suffering of the victims, the interests in the background and the ways out of the sugar trap.
content.title_en: Guaranteed health-threatening : how the sugar mafia makes us sick

content.text: Expert interviews and qualitative content analysis as instruments of reconstructive investigations. Many social science studies are based on reconstructions of situations or processes. The textbook provides application-ready knowledge about all phases of such reconstructive investigations and presents a survey and an evaluation method in detail. The interview partners are understood as experts who have specific knowledge about the facts to be reconstructed. The qualitative content analysis enables a systematic extraction of relevant information from the interviews and is at the same time open to unanticipated findings. With learning questions after each chapter and a clear structure, the book is suitable as a practice-oriented introduction.
content.title_en: Expert interviews and qualitative content analysis as instruments of reconstructive investigations

content.text: Decentralisation and environmental governance structures in Central and Eastern Europe: a comparison of the EU accession countries Poland, Czech Republic, Hungary, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. In almost all candidate countries to the European Union, comprehensive processes of decentralisation are currently taking place, resulting in the municipal and regional level again more competences than in the last decades. However, these processes vary greatly in terms of dynamics, course and characteristics, as the study shows in the countries of Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. While the formal conditions for regulating local community affairs are created on their own responsibility in all the countries examined, there are still considerable deficits in terms of administrative, financial and other framework conditions. Accordingly, the possibilities for action of the central and eastern European municipalities in the field of environmental protection are to be considered.
content.title_en: Decentralisation and environmental governance structures in Central and Eastern Europe: a comparison of the candidate countries of the EU Poland, Czech Republic, Hungary, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania

content.text: Through the wild reconstructionist: over built historical images. How much historical truth do we have to ourselves? Can reconstructions be authentic? How much "fake" do we want to endure? What happens in a simulated reality with man? Mostly the conceptions of historical reality are as far away from the truth as the "real" Orient was from the fantasies of the writer Karl May, on which the title of the book refers. We do not have to approve the historical infatuation of our epoch. As a phenomenon however, we should take them seriously.
content.title_en: Through the wild reconstructionist : over built historical images

content.title_en: Mobile usability: for iPhone, iPad, Android and Kindle

content.text: The open society: immigration and integration. The debate about people with a migrant background is often conducted in this country very simplistic. This is due to the fact that the Federal Republic of Germany has been difficult for more than 50 years with the term "immigration country". After the entry into force of the immigration law in 2005, it seems that the insight that the balance of immigration and immigration is to be assessed positively has prevailed. The contributions of this volume ultimately lead to the question of how to design an immigration and integration concept that takes into account not only the economic but also the cultural and social dimension and how the coexistence of people of different origins can succeed.
content.title_en: Open society: immigration and integration

content.text: The chemical elements: a traverse through the periodic table. The main part is preceded by the development of the element concept, the history of the PSE and the emergence of the elements. Following the group concept of the PSE, each element, divided into the sub-chapters Discovery, History and Ethymology of the name, occurrence, extraction, properties, important connections, applications and modern technologies, is treated, whereby in the context of oregenesis and geochemistry, coupled with the cosmochemistry, are presented. In the latter part, a special feature of the title exists. In addition, it is recommended to this extent that the author (chemist, metallurgist, material scientist and science journalist) has personally known all stable elements at their "source" and experienced the representation of the technically most important connections on site. Even without special prior knowledge very well understandable - discussed. In addition to textbooks and reference works, it is recommended, because extensive, vivid and exceptionally enriching e.g. for students, students, teachers, but also interested practitioners and laypersons of different fields of expertise. (2) (LK/B: Müller)
content.title_en: The chemical elements : a traverse through the periodic table

content.text: The art of the Bausünde. Bastian Sick is known as a collector of linguistic stylistic sins. Fröbe, art historian, can be described as a fan of the Bausünde. Her book typifies (planerical misconceptions, fashion change, construction sins through annexations, overform, painting and decoration) and illustrated by examples from all over Germany from the 1960s to today, from private houses to God's houses to the business house in the middle of Berlin. Some buildings are - according to today's taste - so borderline that it has charm again, from Fröbe is classified as "good Bausünde" in contrast to anonymous everyday architecture. The photos do not achieve picture volume quality, but illustrate the short image signatures, which as well as the chapter introductions betray a dry humor of the author. Their picture volume shows that the ridge between good architecture and construction sin is narrow and pleads for a courageous Bausünde and against the stranging architecture without stylistic risk. As entertaining and contemporary collection, the Bausünden is also known as "Bausünden" (Bausünden) and "Bausünden" (Bausundin) since 1960.
content.title_en: The Art of the Bausinde

content.text: Wood pellets are a new, ecologically unproblematic fuel, made from waste from wood processing. With this form of renewable energy wood, fully automatic heaters with high operating comfort are possible, which can also compete with oil heating in a cost-effective way, in a family house as well as in larger buildings. Wood, as an experienced practitioner, gives an overview of the technology, construction forms and areas of application of wood pellets heaters. It shows what is important in the planning process and also addresses questions of approval and promotion. Builders, owners and planners interested in this new technology are presented here, supplemented by a detailed list of addresses, valuable information - briefly and intelligibly. (1)
content.title_en: Wood pellets heating : planning, installation, operation

content.text: Businesses with the devil : the tragedy of the Jewish savior Rezső Kasztner; report of a survivor. Reszö Kasztner managed to save thousands of Jews during the Nazi period. In Israel, where he later lived, he was accused of collaboration and shot by a fanatic. To this day, his role is controversial, he is seen as a hero or criminal
content.title_en: Businesses with the Devil : the tragedy of the Jew rescuer Rezső Kasztner; report of a survivor

content.text: Ways to Remember : Memorials and places for the victims of National Socialism in Berlin and Brandenburg. Ways to Remember" lead to the places of persecution and resistance in National Socialism, which are described here comprehensively and on current status. The places are at the same time memory rooms that bring the historical event back to the present. Memorials, monuments, documentations and memorial signs contribute to this in different ways.
content.title_en: Ways to Remember : Memorials and Sites for the Victims of National Socialism in Berlin and Brandenburg

content.text: Methods of social work : an introduction. Basic introductory work in 10th edition (here last: 1st edition, BA 12/98), which provides an overview of the most important concepts of methods in social work and is based on the content of the courses in social education and social work. The volume puts the discussion of methods in the context of the discussion of theory and questions under which framework conditions methodological action is taking place in social work. A historical-systematic examination of the discussion of methods follows. In the 3rd, most extensive chapter, the most important concepts of methods in social work - including their limitations and opportunities - are critically presented. The work is mainly aimed at students and provides this target group with support and guidance on practical work in the fields of social work. Since the author (most recently Professor of social education at the University of Kassel) died in 2011, this edition is only a formally reviewed update of the 9th edition published in 2009. (3)
content.title_en: Methods of social work : an introduction

content.text: Urban transport planning: a new concept for urban general transport planning. The previously widespread ingenieurative planning approach of urban general transport plans could not achieve a socially just compromise because of its unilateral orientation to the mobility needs of the car owners. Building on a critique of the previous planning concept, a target system for future urban general transport planning is derived. On the basis of this target system, a concrete planning process is developed and implemented according to structure, methodology and content. The work is seen as a social science contribution to the field of urban transport planning, which is dominated by traffic engineers.
content.title_en: Urban transport planning: a new approach to urban general transport planning

content.text: Workbook Microcontrollers: Program microcontrollers and use them in practice. Various books have already been discussed about the use and programming of microcontrollers by Atmel. Among other things, reference is made to S. Feldkord (ID-B 22/11 - C programming on ATmega 32), G. Spanner (ID-A 7/11 - C programming of AVR microcontrollers in general) or G. Schönfelder (ID-G 27/10 - measurement technology with ATmega128). This book is dedicated to the microcontrollers ATtiny2313 and ATtiny26, 2 inexpensive microcontrollers of the industry standard of Atmel, which can be used to solve many tasks from the field of hobby electronics. Programming of the experiments presented here is carried out this time in AVR assemblers. The author begins with the construction and special characteristics of the two presented microcontrollers and then introduces the installation of the Atmel "AVR-Studio", which provides all functions from the assembler to the simulator. The experiments concern subjects with practical proximity, e.g. a F.A.A.
content.title_en: Workbook Microcontrollers : Programming and using microcontrollers in practice

content.text: Computer interfaces and bus systems: for PCs, tablets, smartphones and embedded systems. Interfaces and bus systems are important for internal communication in computers and for connecting to external peripheral devices, but also for controlling and controlling work with embedded systems, which are now hidden in almost all everyday devices. The author is known for books on the subject (last ID 7/98 - unfortunately completely outdated). The present book is a completely revised re-edition, which is understood as a compendium for practical work in electronics developments. Technicians and developers are addressed, but also for students of computer science and electronics the book may be of interest. The author now also addresses the many devices, which are increasingly competing with the classical PC in Internet usage (tablet, smartphone,...) and also takes into account wireless systems (WLAN, Bluetooth, ...). Many detailed drawings and software examples. The focus is on component interfaces (inter integrated bus, one-wire bus), peripheral bus systems (USB, SCSI, ...) and networks and radio systems (2).
content.title_en: Computer interfaces and bus systems : for PCs, tablets, smartphones and embedded systems

content.text: Marketing in tourism and leisure. Pleasant to read textbook that takes up the latest developments in tourism and leisure marketing. Review (ekz): The Bremer Professor follows the "classical" marketing structure unafraidly and offers a textbook that describes the marketing of products and services in tourism and leisure industry. Loosely built up, with many inserts, and pleasant reading is conveyed the feeling of seriousness and ethical claim. First, clarity about subject and content is created, then followed by marketing analysis, strategic and operational marketing, at the end implementation and controlling. Formulated learning goals, case studies, core statements and control questions for each chapter are very helpful for understanding and learning. A comparison with "leisure science" with Hartmann as co-author is pressing. As the expectations of customers and thus their behaviour in the leisure sector are changing sharply, also through digital information and communication possibilities, literature should be subject to a rapid aging process. Libraries should access to the latest state of play. (2)
content.title_en: Marketing in tourism and leisure

content.text: Field-to-pearl herbs : determination, biology, agricultural significance. *Additional information Content: Not only for agriculture is the knowledge about the accompanying field flora of importance, but also for the botanic interested one can find in these plant societies some rarity or beauty. This determination book of the most important plants and co-herbs also provides information about their location and their agricultural significance. Numerous detailed drawings, supported by colour photographs, allow a rapid recognition of the respective plant. Over 300 species are described
content.title_en: Agricultural herb : determination, biology, agricultural importance

content.text: Hearing impaired pupils in general school: theory and practice of integration. The integrative education, support and promotion of hearing impaired pupils in general schools is a policy goal. However, for integration to succeed, a variety of factors must work together. The book provides on the basis of current empirical studies and thus experiences with the integration of application-oriented knowledge for a successful implementation of integration. Numerous case studies and from the perspective of teachers and students provide insights into successfully designed integration processes. Detailed explanations are given about concrete didactic and methodological teaching measures, but also possibilities and prerequisites for the successful interaction of pupils, parents and educators.
content.title_en: Hearing impaired pupils in general school : theory and practice of integration

Standing in the shadow of Augustin in the past, Optatus of Mileve was only recently recognized as an important witness to the development of the Christian faith. content.text: Architecture and Umstülpung : Studies on organic-dynamic spatial consciousness : a training path for architects. "In the present studies, which are made accessible again as 'architecture and Umstülpung', Paul Schatz describes first steps on the way to the origin of the organic architectural style. The path described minutely and from different perspectives exceeds the boundaries of Euclidean geometry in architecture. Thus, the Umstülpung proves the key to an understanding of the living in architecture."

content.text: Technical German for training and occupation : Teaching and workbook. The book closes a long-standing gap on the textbook market for German as a foreign language and second language. It provides basic linguistic means and strategies for communicating in the field of metal and electrical occupations, in internships, in training and in the company in a professional and professional manner. The teaching work works in action-oriented manner with numerous coloured illustrations, original texts and links to relevant training companies of the Federal Employment Agency. Users get an impression of the work in German metal and electrical occupations in industry and crafts. Training opportunities in the EU are presented.The teaching work can be used by specialist teachers and language teachers without specialist knowledge.
content.title_en: Technical German for training and occupation : textbook

content.text: The Magical Mystery or: the return of Karl Schmidt: Roman. When Karl Schmidt, victim of a depressive nervous breakdown on the day of the Wall's opening, is found by chance after years of sinking old buddies in Hamburg as a resident of a drug therapeutic institution, this is the beginning of a strange collaboration: the old friends, meanwhile to fame and wealth, want to conciliate with the hippie spirit of the 60s with their record label in Germany the rave of the 90s and need one that must remain always sober. That is right Karl Schmidt, because he has no longer the desire to hide in a parallel world of drug-wG, help house master job and group dynamic weekend trips. And so a journey through a country and a time in transition, undertaken by a handful of techno-freaks, supervised by a mentally unstable ex-artist, for which this should be the way back into an independent life. "Sven Regener again acts as a protocoltend idiotic dialogue, taken by a handful of techno-freaks, supervised by a mentally unstable ex-artist, for which this is not the way of a new world.
content.title_en: Magical Mystery or: the Return of Karl Schmidt : Roman

content.text: My immoral offer to the Chancellor : because the energy transition must not fail! Matthias Willenbacher, founder and owner of the energy company juwi with 1,800 employees, wishes Chancellor Merkel a 100% decision per renewable energy. And offers in exchange to give company shares worth millions to the energy cooperatives. Get to know the founder and owner of the energy company juwi closer. Go with him on a journey through time through the energy transition, over continents, from wind turbines in Costa Rica to solar plants in Eritrea. Willenbacher describes his diverse experiences with politicians, and he marks in his master plan the cornerstones of a new energy system
content.title_en: My immoral offer to the Chancellor : because the energy transition must not fail!

content.text: Post-growth society : Concepts for the future. This book takes up and goes beyond the criticism of growth. It shows the systemic constraints that let us keep on the growth path and presents alternative development opportunities for a society that does not depend on growth - for a society in which it can live well even without growth. It wants to invite to a discussion about how the constraints can be overcome and new perspectives can be gained: perspectives for a post-growth society.
content.title_en: Post-growth society : Concepts for the future

content.text: The German military officer was involved in the military mission abroad. He also had experience of fire fighting there. Afterwards he received "post-traumatic stress disorders" (PTBS) and became unfit for service. Supported by a historian and biographer, he describes his military operations and his illness. PTBS has been widely recognized in the USA and many other countries since Vietnam - only not with us. Timmermann is critical of the poor conditions of use, but the focus is on his bureaucratic struggles for the recognition of his "damage to service" and a victim's pension. Unlike H. Groos: "This is also your war!" (BA 11/10), he draws political consequences from his personal experience up to the foundation of a self-help organization. Thus an impressive document on the bad handling of the many war-damaged soldiers by politics and military leadership was created. An important aspect of German war operations, whose importance is being taken on board, is well explained to the civil public. (2) (Helmut's attitude to the military) The war of his own soldiers was described by the military as a result of his dealings with his own military officers.
content.title_en: They talk - we die: how our soldiers become victims of German politics

content.text: E-Recruitment and e-assessment: recruitment, selection and consulting of staff in the internet and intranet. Companies are increasingly relying on the Internet when recruiting, selecting and developing employees. Candidates and employees are also increasingly using the Internet and its services to find jobs, apply and assess themselves. As a result of this development, a sharp increase in job exchanges, career portals and online applications has been noted in recent years. The book presents findings and practical strategies for the selection and design of e-recruitment and e-assessment from the perspectives of personnel marketing, personnel selection, personnel development and workflow management. Concrete solutions for practical use complete the presentation
content.title_en: E-Recruitment and e-Assessment : recruitment, selection and advice of staff in the internet and intranet

content.text: God's invisible cubes: physics at the limits of the research. "In this book I want to show how the various boundaries of the world that we can reach have been discovered ... and how they helped shape our image of the world". It is about boundaries in the realm of the ever smaller (building up of matter) and always size (universe). What was the trigger for the Big Bang, why does the finally discovered Higgs boson give the quarks different properties, what is hidden in the quantum lake of virtual particles? Not always is (at least currently) decisive what is physically experimentally feasible; even with mathematical models the question arises of a physical reality behind it: "The solutions of general relativity theory are not necessarily solutions of physics itself". This also applies to quantum theory, since an association of quantum and relativity theory still exists. An exciting and fascinating boundary approach; individual questions always resurface in literature on fundamental research. Here a fairly profound and yet widely understandable summary, often recommended.
content.title_en: God's invisible cubes: physics at the limits of the research

content.text: Can climate change be stopped? : Researchers think yes - if we act now. Energy and climate. "Spectrum Spezial" on the top topic climate change, the article international scientists and science journalists gathers about the current findings, the emergence of the greenhouse effect, climate policy, measures to contain anthropogenic climate change, alternatives to fossil fuels and energy efficiency. Graphically attractively designed booklet, which addresses the demanding interested layman. Also for school meetings a productive source, which should already be included in the stock of smaller public libraries, despite magazine format - especially if these relevant periodicals like GEO or spectrum of science cannot provide - especially since the price is comparatively favorable (see also "Die Erde im Treibhaus", BA 5/05). (1 S)
content.title_en: Can climate change be stopped? : Researchers think yes - if we act now. Energy and climate

content.text: How children grow today: Nature as a development space: a new look at child learning, thinking and feeling. The author duo knows about child development and health (Renz-Polster, H. ID-A 46/11, ID-B 02/11, BA 12/09; Hüther, G. ID-B 11/13, BA 07/08). Both can prepare the topics well-founded, conclusive, instructive, understandable, easy to read and successfully on the market. Thus, in their common book: in eight vividly written chapters they consider child development and nature as an optimal development space for children. They are not concerned with a nostalgic "back to nature", but with four elements indispensable for healthy child development: freedom, resistance, affection and immediacy as well as a balance between indoor and outdoor, real and virtual world. The lovingly designed book - quality paper, colored pages, photographs of children in nature - offers an exciting reading for professionals as well as for parents and some thought-out mind-telling.
content.title_en: How children grow today : Nature as a development space : a new view of child learning, thinking and feeling

content.text: Algebra, cryptology and coding theory: mathematical methods of data security: with 31 images, numerous examples and 73 tasks. Cryptology and coding theory attract readers time and again, whether it is for interest in the mysterious but historically decisive (e.g. Enigma), whether it is for practical reasons (e.g. how secure is the encrypted data traffic during online banking). These topics are covered well understandable, among others by A. Bagspacher (BA 1/03) or S. Singh (BA 10/02). The present book deals with the mathematical foundations of cryptology and explains concepts and methods. The reader is familiarized with the algebraic structures of the group, the body, rings and the integrity areas. Prim numbers and prime number tests are also well taken into account. He learns the importance of these basics for symmetrical and asymmetrical chiffren and linear and differential cryptoanalysis. Another focus is on coding theory. The book is based on linear functions in the University of Kassel.
content.title_en: Algebra, cryptology and coding theory : mathematical methods of data security : with 31 images, numerous examples and 73 tasks

content.text: Basics of Geometry. Klappentext: David Hilbert's groundbreaking work "Grundlagen der Geometrie" has been published by B. G. Teubner since 1899. This classic axiomatic foundation of geometry has emerged from a holiday course for teachers and a lecture that followed it in Göttingen. The edition published by Michael Toepell as part of the "TEUBNER-ARCHIV zur Mathematik" collection contains Hilbert's original text and the supplements of Paul Bernays, as well as current contributions and previously unpublished archival papers. The editor writes in his foreword: Hilbert's book "marks the transition from empirically anchored to formal-deductive geometry. His clear axiomatic structure has also been pioneering for mathematical thinking in the 20th century."
content.title_en: Basics of Geometry

content.text: Simplicity: the ten laws of simplicity. 10 laws are meant to make technology and economy more manageable and human life more meaningful by organizing the necessary rationally and not distracting the useless. (Ellen Schmid)
content.title_en: Simplicity : the ten laws of simplicity

content.text: Smart new world: digital technology and human freedom. Silicon Valley is thanks to the technical achievements that make our world so different from what it once was. More than that, the thinkers from the corner offices of Google, Apple and Facebook provided the philosophy that goes along with it - and we all internalized it. The Internet age is considered an epochal cut. The digital revolution challenges the existence of traditional structures and institutions. Politics, economy, culture and our ways of life are now transparent, individualized and available at any time. Evgeny Morozov questions this smart new world with Verve. Is it really better, safer, more livable?
content.title_en: Smart New World: Digital Technology and Human Freedom

content.text: In 2006, M. Yunus received the Nobel Peace Prize for the establishment of Grameen banks, which, by granting micro-credits, primarily to villagers, effectively combat poverty, to read in M. Yunus: "For a world without poverty" (here last ID 52/06) and at P. Spiegel (BA 2/07). Here he develops his far-reaching concept of "social enterprises" that offer products and services in different sectors and even in cooperation with a multi such as the yoghurt producer Danone - but always in terms of reducing poverty and without own profit interests. Behind this is the optimistic vision of being able to defeat poverty and also to use globalization for the benefit of people. Poor not as passive recipients of aid, but actively to consider those who discover and develop their own abilities: this basic conviction forms the difference between many other aid projects in poor countries. Besides the above mentioned titles or recommended for initial information. (2)
content.title_en: Defeat poverty: [the Nobel Peace Prize winner's programme]

content.text: Literature as a Prerequisite of Cultural History : Locations from Shakespeare to Benjamin. Note International Hölderlin Bibliography: pp. 124-126: The Relationship of the Artwork to Tragic
content.title_en: Literature as a Prerequisite of Cultural History : Locations from Shakespeare to Benjamin

content.text: The volume is the result of an interdisciplinary symposium organized in 1994 by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Aesthetik e.V. (German Society for Aesthetics) and the study of generals at the University of Applied Sciences Hannover. The focus is on the relationship between art and nature, with the perspectives of philosophy, art history, music and literature complement each other. The spectrum of the more than 30 contributions ranges from themes such as the Flower Moly in the Kirke adventure of Odysseus or the Parmenidean hymn of nature to the explicitly aesthetic debate of the last three centuries, which encompasses the most diverse perspectives of poets, composers and visual artists.
content.title_en: Aesthetics and Nature Experience

content.text: Successful business processes through standardized commodity management systems: market analysis, product overview, selection process; with 18 tabs. Goods management systems are of paramount importance for successful business processes in commercial companies today.The book describes the requirements for modern commodity management systems and supports the selection of suitable standard software systems. Based on the latest and most extensive research on commodity management systems in the German-speaking countries, answers are given to the following questions: How to proceed with the selection of standardized commodity management systems?What technological and functional market developments are there?What alternatives are available on the market?What characteristics and strengths do the current systems have? For the new edition, brand new data (mid-2002) were added to the considered commodity management systems and about twenty new commodity management systems, the methodological part has been revised and updated. TOC:Business and information strategy.- Selection process of standardized commodity management systems.- Market vision.- Product management systems in the perspective.- Outlook
content.title_en: Successful business processes through standardized commodity management systems : market analysis, product overview, selection process; with 18 tabs.

content.text: The decisive struggle for the abolition of slavery began in a London book printing plant. 12 men, including the Quaker Thomas Clarkson and the MP William Wilberforce, met on May 22, 1787 to start their struggle for the abolition of slavery. A bold undertaking for the time, as if one were demanding a worldwide ban on cars today. The abolitionists used modern advertising media such as posters and buttons for their campaign, organized a sugar boycott and filed petitions. The American author, who had already scourged the colonial terror there with "shadows over the Congo" and praised the human rights movement, describes in his detailed book the exciting and worth reading story of this group of idealists, who, despite the threats from the advocates of slavery, co-curagulated their goal. The story of a group of 12 men who took up the struggle for the abolition of slavery in a London book printing plant on May 22, 1787. (Ulrich Kühne)
content.title_en: Explosion of the Chains: the Crucial Fight for the Abolition of Slavery

content.text: Urban geography: 6 tables. The complete basic knowledge of urban geography is presented in a compact and understandable way. Heinz Heineberg's standard work on urban geography in the fourth updated and expanded edition introduces numerous important topics – now with the collaboration of Frauke Kraas and Christian Krajewski: urbanization / urbanization, urban agglomeration spaces, city types, city systems, theories and models of urban structure and development, urban divisions, inner-city centres. Further focus is on urban development and urban development in Central Europe, in Germany in the West-East comparison as well as in numerous non-European cultural areas. In addition, metropolises are given special consideration in the globalization process, postmodern urban development as well as urban tourism and urban culture. Numerous, sometimes multi-coloured illustrations, definitions of terms and other learning aids complement the text and make the volume a valuable tool for working – for bachelor and master studies in geography as well as in neighbouring disciplines.
content.title_en: Urban geography : 6 tables

content.text: Food hygiene : Practical guide on food storage in the household. How can you tell if a food is still edible? How can you store food hygienically? Answers to these and many other questions are provided by this brochure. It explains why food spoils, which pathogens are involved and how they multiply. In addition, the brochure shows how to store food in the refrigerator or freezer and in stock correctly and there are tips for optimal packaging. In addition, the hygienic handling of food in the kitchen is described. For all important food groups, there is also detailed information on purchasing, processing and storage. The list ranges from eggs and fish to meat, bread, dairy products, fruit and vegetables to sugar and beverages (source: Aid).
content.title_en: Food hygiene : Practical manual on food storage in the household
