content.text: Professionally qualified study - challenge for universities : Results of the model project Open University of Applied Sciences Lower Saxony. The model project "Open University of Applied Sciences Lower Saxony (OHN)" opens the universities at four model locations for students who have no traditional study qualification but are professionally qualified. The book presents the results of the cross-university model project. Students were asked at all locations about their needs and expectations for universities and their professional objectives. The evaluation of this survey allows a differentiated and often surprising view of this particular student group. (Verlag)
content.title_en: Professionally qualified study - Challenge for universities : Results of the model project Open University of Lower Saxony

content.text: Google code: [the secret of the best search results]. Google is a standard among search engines, but with insufficient search strategies you get little satisfactory results. The author, science journalist, internet specialist and trainer, gives good help to all users to make the search more effective - he calls his method "Google code". Using conclusive examples he proves, among other things, that one drives better if one chooses search words more carefully or creatively modified (by conversion, use of the majority etc.), as often as possible uses quotation marks, instead of using questions with answers or with restrictions by special commands ("filetype", "inurl", "index" etc.). Above all, however, the appeal to be imaginative, before entering briefly think what one really wants and use the above principles not only but also to vary. Certainly, besides the ability to improvise some practice and embodimental terms is necessary, but one is rewarded with manageable hit rates and useful references. (2)
content.title_en: The Google code: [the secret of the best search results]

content.text: The new features of version 9 of Adobe's home-designed image editing and management software are manageable. Accordingly, R. Klassen has also slightly revised its entry-level title to Elements (pre-release and so on. "Photoshop Elements 8 for digital photos", BA 2/10). The chapter Image Management has been adapted, for example, as the organizer is now available for Mac users instead of Bridge. New are workshops on the use of layer masks - this Photoshop function now also offers elements - and explanations on some new effects and assistants. On the DVD are the sample data, test versions for Windows/Mac, and some lessons from the parallel video training of the author. Furthermore, an attractive, clear and easy title for the uncomplicated entry into image editing with Photoshop Elements. Those who want more should be better at books like C. Westphalen (BA 3/10, new edition for review) or J. Wolf (Bolz) can use the new version of the new version of the new version (Bolz) for easy access to the new version of the new version.
content.title_en: Getting started in Photoshop Elements 9 : Edit your photos easily

content.text: - Mechanical engineering at universities and universities of applied sciences - Structural and organisational planning, planning of requirements, programming of the programme. The aim of the study was to estimate the future resource requirements of the mechanical engineering department. The results are designed to take account of both general planning recommendations and special requirements in detailed planning. The starting point for the present approach to the planning of requirements is the structural changes in research and teaching. The main points are the changing working methods, the new study structures and the increasing interdisciplinary interdependencies of mechanical engineering with adjacent fields such as electrical engineering or computer science. The common topics are important for the future. However, it is also acceptable that, for example, changing prerequisites in teaching (new bachelor and master courses) are difficult to estimate their future consequences, as only few concrete concepts and no experience are available so far. Structure: 1. Research (1.1. Structure of the mechanical engineering department. - 1.2. Work Profiles. - 1.3. Technical Services. - 1.4. Development Trends). - 2. Teaching (2.1. Numbers of students. - 2.2. Spatial Organisation. 2.3.
content.title_en: Mechanical engineering at universities and universities of applied sciences : structural and organisational planning, needs planning, programming

content.text: "Why my brother?": Grief for siblings; experiences, reports, help. Klappentext: Children and young people mourn differently. And when a brother or sister dies, the affected parents overlook the siblings in their own pain too easily. Employees of the association "Oorphaned Parents Hamburg" report in detail about their experiences with siblings who care for them during mourning seminars. Young people speak with their own texts, which they have worked out in a writing workshop. Reading and painting is also a great help in dealing with grief, which illustrates many examples and suggestions.
content.title_en: "Why my brother?": Grief for siblings; experiences, reports, help

content.text: Lifelogging: how digital self-measurement changes our society. The technological apparatus of "lifelogging", thus the technical cutting of our life statements, is described by their inventors as "black box" for humans, as a digital life writer active in at least 5 dimensions: self-measurement of the body (see "Quantified self" at T.R. Köhler, ID-B 4/13; C. Grasse, ID-B 32/13), recording activities and whereabouts, digital memory, digital immortality, transparency including the sousveillance, i.e. the conscious location notification in case of a threat. The scope of application therefore extends from conscious self-monitoring to complete monitoring in the interest of health insurance companies, state, economy etc. The author, sociology professor in Furtwangen, succeeds in a well-readable, self-experipheral narrative of the new technology; he wants to read with his book, which is to be seen as a warning, not too late!
content.title_en: Lifelogging: how digital self-measurement changes our society

content.text: Introduction to spatial and environmental planning. Scientific textbook on spatial and environmental planning in Germany, which provides an up-to-date overview of this extensive and complex field of tasks and research, and addresses "geographers, scientists and engineers and those who want to become it". The focus of the work, which is equipped with numerous special graphics, tables and plans, is on the formal and legal field; it deals with both European influences and the foundations of individual procedures at local, regional and national level. Environmental testing procedures are widely distributed within the overall topic, legal regulations of individual federal states are presented as well as planning phases at different political levels. The work, which is supplemented by source index and registers, is addressed to students. (3)
content.title_en: Introduction to spatial and environmental planning

content.text: The "Wow" factor for the "Kirchein" (school teacher) is the world-wide analysis of the quality of artistic education. For several years, an exchange on the quality of artistic education has been taking place worldwide. In Germany, too, the focus has been on the education and education of the arts. Anne Bamford (University of the Arts London) has been decisively driving this discourse and presented the study The Wow Factor commissioned by UNESCO in 2006. Her study demonstrates the fundamental importance of artistic education based on empirical data from more than 40 countries. An important result is that children and young people only benefit from the good offers of artistic education - those with Wow Factor. - The book has been translated into Spanish, Korean and Norwegian. The findings of the study, which led to a series of national and regional studies and artistic education on the political agenda, are also available for the first time in German with this translation.
content.title_en: The Wow Factor : a Worldwide Analysis of the Quality of Artistic Education

content.text: The entire world of Christian symbolsThe meaning of many signs and symbols is often difficult to understand in a world where a vast variety of images penetrate human beings. This lexicon helps to discover the power of symbol language and offers in text and image a scientifically sound and at the same time meditative access to the world of Christian symbols.
content.title_en: Lexicon of Christian Symbols

content.text: Crime scene statistics: how do you recognize dubious data and questionable interpretations. Facts, facts, facts ... But to what extent can you trust the numbers in the media? Are four million women actually beaten to death by their husbands or friends every year? Does a young person really take his life every thirteen minutes in the United States? Does methamphetamine present the biggest drug problem today? Every day we are bombarded by alarming statistics lurking in the news, on the Internet and apparently everywhere on us. However, in many cases even the most honorable publications contain figures or percentages that are miscalculated, misinterpreted, overstated or simply misleading. With this book, Joel Best offers us a statistic guide for everyday life, with which we can easily recognize questionable statistics. Crime scene statistics is entertaining, informative and concise - the ideal book for anyone who wants to take up news and information more critically and with more expertise.
content.title_en: Crime scene statistics: how to detect dubious data and questionable interpretations

content.text: Carbon dioxide - Carbonic acid - CO2 : Production, distribution, application. History, properties, production, use of COexp 2 and its derivatives with indications of environmental protection, fire control, etc. A very brief first overview with a focus on technical applications (e.g. in food technology, fertilizer industry, cooling technology). The topic is also dealt with in collection books and in more specific investigations (e.g. on the greenhouse effect); a direct comparison title is not known. - Mainly for laymen. (2) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Carbon dioxide - Carbonic acid - CO2 : production, distribution, application

content.text: Our future in space. The American physics professor develops detailed ideas about the energy development and settlement of humans in space.
content.title_en: Our future in space

content.text: The exhibits and areas of the newly designed permanent exhibition are presented: from shipping technology to rail transport. What links an old Germanic bohlenweg, a fall-fight bomber from the Second World War and a set of billiard balls? They are among the objects of the permanent exhibition of the German Museum of Technology in Berlin and are presented in this volume alongside many others. At the same time, the authors also highlight social aspects of technology, technical utopias or ethical implications. The exciting guide through the renowned Berlin house shows a lot from a completely new perspective and invites you to a tour through the extensive collection.
content.title_en: Man, technology! : a journey of discovery through the cultural history of technology

content.text: Architecture in a transdisciplinary perspective : from philosophy to dance : current approaches and positions. Architecture has a high cultural and sociopolitical relevance. As a visual and kinesthetic medium, it not only structures space, but also knowledge systems and modes of perception. But how can they be described or scientifically explored? - This volume undertakes an overarching reflection of architecture in a transdisciplinary perspective. It gathers a series of current approaches from the philosophy, sociology, media, culture, art, film, literature, dance and music studies, which each address the cultural significance of architecture from the perspective of their own discipline.
content.title_en: Architecture in transdisciplinary perspective : from philosophy to dance : current approaches and positions

content.text: Friendship and community on the social web : image-related actions and peer group communication on Facebook & Co. How social is the social web? Along the categories friendship and community, the present volume shows which topics and practices are used to manifest social relationships on the Web 2.0. Other key questions are: How far are differences and similarities in the use of social web applications in German-speaking countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland)? What are the functions and meaning of images for the user interactions on social network sites? What are the effects of privacy settings on the actions of users and providers of social web portals? First, the current use of social network sites is described in the mirror of international audience research. An analysis of the diverse image worlds on social network sites follows. Further social web offers such as partner exchanges, microblogging portals, MMOGs and youth websites are discussed in terms of the development of social relationships.
content.title_en: Friendship and community on the social web : image-related action and peer group communication on Facebook & Co.

content.text: Economic effects of tourism in biosphere reserves in Germany : Results of the R & D project (FKZ 3510 87 0200) "Economic effects of tourism in biosphere reserves". Biosphere reserves are international protected areas recognised by UNESCO. They pursue the goal of sustainable development and serve as model regions for new methods and economic practices. A sustainable tourism development, which aims to protect resources with an economic development involving the local population, represents an opportunity to fulfil the goals and functions.
content.title_en: Economic effects of tourism in biosphere reserves in Germany : Results of the R & D project (FKZ 3510 87 0200) "Economic effects of tourism in biosphere reserves"

content.text: New media and their shadows : Media use, media impact and media competence. The reader provides a comprehensive overview of all aspects of media impact research. Praiseworthy, though not always persevering, the effort to bring scientific knowledge to lay people - parents, teachers, consultants - in a comprehensible and differentiated way. The authors have deliberately focused on the potentially negative effects of media on children and young people. According to the introductory part "Media in Research and Practice" "central problem areas of media use and effect" are addressed: e.g. cyberbulbing, sexual harassment, violent video games, online forums for young people with self-harming problems (e.g. pro-ana blogs, suicide boards). Finally, considerations on the effectiveness of prevention and intervention using the example of cyberbulbing. With extensive literature and work tasks. Priority for studies, education and further education. (3 S)
content.title_en: New media and their shadows : media use, media impact and media competence

content.text: Lust und Freiheit : the story of the first sexual revolution. With seductive flair and analytical acumen, the author tells the story of modern sexuality. He vividly describes the life worlds of people in the transition from the 17th to the 18th century and the serious changes in the way they deal with sexuality since the Middle Ages.We live in a period of sexual freedom and self-determination. Our modern conceptions of sexuality are the result of a profound historical change. In his brilliantly written and widely respected book, Faramerz Dabhoiwala re-interprets and re-interprets the history of sexuality. The author describes in a source-strong and entertaining way how dealing with one's own body, with pleasure and passion, with new revolutionary ideas, changed radically in the century of enlightenment. It is the story of countless men and women who have not been respected so far by history, works of art, literature and philosophy and their influence on the modern world.
content.title_en: Lust and Freedom : the story of the first sexual revolution

content.text: Ach, Afrika : Reports from the interior of a continent. This is not a conventional representation of the changing African continent, but a collection of fascinating reports by the Africa correspondent of "time", exciting journeys through history and present, which connects Grill with the question of the ongoing modernization crisis of the continent called "lost" by many. Based on his profound knowledge, he describes the devastating consequences that slave trade and colonialism still have on the societies of Africa today, focusing on the power-sick, corrupt, mostly Western-supported black elites, writing about AIDS, the genocide in Rwanda and, in his strongest chapter, on the politics of contemporary South Africa. Africa, the author says, has a chance when it takes its fortune into its own hands. Grill is critical-analyzing, taking part, subjective, accusing and he can present complex historical-political events in an understandable and sometimes witty manner. Excitingly read; widely recommended. Register, literature directory. (2)
content.title_en: Ach, Africa : Reports from the interior of a continent

content.text: Virtual and Augmented Reality (VR/AR) : The basics and methods of virtual and augmented reality. Virtual and extended reality complement the areas of human perception. After multifunctional applications such as "Second Life" were not successful in a broad, lasting manner, special offers are more met. The central technical challenge in the development of hardware and software is the implementation of hand, head and eye movements of a user in projections on glasses, screens or screens. An author's team from research and business presents an introductory textbook with 10 independent chapters for students with an information technology or design focus (eXamen.press series, lastly ID-G 8/14). "Virtual Reality" by M. Brill (ID-G 4/09) is no longer entirely up to date on the software side. The clear language and consistent explanations of the technical foundations also allow for self-study by interested lay people. The current discussion about Google's data glasses points to a broad need for information. (2)
content.title_en: Virtual and Augmented Reality (VR/AR) : Basics and Methods of Virtual and Augmented Reality

content.text: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix. Volume 5 - It's summer holidays and once again Harry is stuck in the Liguster way with the impossible Dursleys. But this time he is more troubled than ever - why do his friends Ron and Hermine write so mysterious letters? And above all: Why does he not know about the dark forces that have now been re-born and are spreading unstoppably about Harry's world? He still does not know what the mysterious Order of the Phoenix can do against Du-know-shon-wen ... - When Harry's fifth school year begins in Hogwarts, his worries only become bigger. The new teacher Dolores Umbridge makes his life hell. She simply doesn't believe Harry that Voldemort is back. But soon the Dark Lord strikes again. Now Harry has to rattle his friends around him, otherwise there is no escape. Harry Potter is convinced that Lord Voldemort has returned. But in the Ministry of Magic nobody seems to want to believe the 15-year-old teenager. Fortunately, the Order of the Phoenix is still fighting for the good leadership of the Phönix.
content.title_en: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

content.text: Emotions make history: the effect of collective emotions - from Hitler to Obama. Human history is a story of great feelings in both positive and negative. Luc Ciompi and Elke Endert merge insights from psychology, sociology, politics and history into a separate explanatory approach. Natural disasters, war and terror, major political, sporting and cultural events: television, radio and the Internet transmit new images of collective anger, fear or joy to us every day. Luc Ciompi and Elke Endert explain how emotions massively influence perception, attention and memory and thus thinking and action in this cross-disciplinary essay. Among other things, the power of the We-feelings in National Socialism, in the Israeli-Palestine conflict and in Barack Obama's election as president of the United States. Thoughts about the consequences of this on our human image, for crisis intervention, mediation and the treatment of collective traumas are decided by the sharp-sighted analysis.
content.title_en: Feelings make history: the effect of collective emotions - from Hitler to Obama

content.text: The Ghd of Terror: The Terrorist Leaders of September 11th; the Insider Report of Al-Qaida. Interview with the Terrorist Leaders Ramzi Binalshibh and Khalid (Omar) Sheikh Mohammed, who have made known the practical and intellectual origin of Al-Qaida in the terrorist attack of September 11th 2001. With life data of the terrorists and information about Al-Qaida. (Harald Pilzer) Located between the investigative insider literature à la M. Sifaoui (BA 8/03) and the "Terrorist Hunter" (BA 8/03) on the one hand, and the journalistic descriptive representation à la O. Schröm (BA 9/03) on the other hand, this volume revolves around the well-known J.F.A. in April 2002 the Terrorist Leaders Ramzi Binalshibh and Khalid (Omar) Sheikh Mohammed, who are today arrested, in their interview about half a practical arrest of the Ghd of the Fhd of Terrorists and of the Ghd of Terrorists, and of the Ghd of the Ghd of Tah of Terror.
content.title_en: Masterminds of terror: the leaders of September 11 report; the insider report of al-Qaeda

content.text: Language and integration: on multilingualism and migration. The question of how European multilingualism can be successfully organised in a number of ways, on the one hand, and immigration and integration individually and collectively. In the context of integration, language not only provides decisive access, it is also one of the most important identity drivers: if you want to know something about the conditions and possibilities of integration, then the knowledge of the primary linguistic-identitarian locations of people is the basis for this. Interested in this are not only the target language of the majority society, but also the respective first languages. The specific linguistic skills of people with a migrant background are currently hardly perceived, let alone used in programs for linguistic integration, on the labour market or as an advantage for the domestic economy. However, there is much individual and overall social potential here. In this volume, the current situation in Germany is contrasted with those in countries with prominent multilingual constellations (from Switzerland to India) with that in which there are prominent multilingualist constellations (from Switzerland to India)
content.title_en: Language and integration : on multilingualism and migration

content.text: The study also provides an overview of the variety of applications in the social sciences. It shows how appropriate analyses can be carried out using widespread programs with empirical data. The textbook is designed for advanced events in statistics and multivariate analysis methods.
content.title_en: Structural equation models in the social sciences

content.text: The NSA complex: Edward Snowden and the way to total surveillance. Edward Snowden has revealed how largely the intelligence services are monitoring our lives. New details of the all-encompassing espionage come to light almost every day. The SPIEGEL authors Marcel Rosenbach and Holger Stark were able to evaluate large parts of the documents provided by Edward Snowden and classified as top secret from the databases of the NSA and the British GCHQ. In their book they show the entire dimension of a surveillance apparatus that not only threatens privacy, but also the foundations of democratic societies and thus even those who have believed they had nothing to hide.
content.title_en: The NSA Complex : Edward Snowden and the Way to Total Surveillance

content.text: Basic circuits of electronics : theory and practice with multisim. The book explains on the basis of Multisim the different discrete and integrated semiconductor modules and their various switching possibilities; it serves professional, master, technician students and (specialist) practitioners as overview or reference work
content.title_en: Basic circuits of electronics : theory and practice with Multisim

content.text: The water monopoly : of a general good and its privatisation. Regional examples (e.g. Berlin, Manila) illustrate market interests and mechanisms in terms of water supply and disposal.
content.title_en: The water monopoly : from a general property and its privatization

content.text: Tractor-Prospects from 1950 to 1970 - Eicher. According to the company Lanz (cf. K. Häfner, ID 16/91 etc.) the tractor expert of the Bavarian company Eicher took up his position. The company made first attempts in the tug-building from 1935, belonged in the 50s to the highlights on the market, lost his independence in 1972. Vehicles from 1948 to 1972 are presented in a collection of brochures and advertisements, which present photos, technical data and descriptions, of course also a lot of advertising. Is supplemented by a short company chronicle. For collectors and oldtimer fans. (3) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Tractor Prospects from 1950 to 1970 - Eicher

content.text: Punishment, beating, abuse: violence in education. The author takes up the current violence and abuse phenomena in educational institutions and systematically deals with them. He shows cultural and educational historical ideologies of a
content.title_en: Punishment, beating, abuse : violence in education

content.text: The divine engineer: the evolution of technology. How does technical progress take place? Where does it come from? Where does it lead? Why does it appear in certain places and at certain times almost inevitably? Can we influence technical progress? To answer these questions, the author examines the history of technology – with its successes and failures – in connection with human evolution. We discover that technical progress results from an ever-recurring challenge based on a fundamental physical principle. When reading, we realize that the character of technology is obvious. We realize that we are succumbing to a technical illusion and learn what opportunities there are still to influence technical progress.
content.title_en: The Divine Engineer : the Evolution of Technology

content.text: Contaminated landscapes. The official victims of the 20th century are memorials and warrior monuments. But where do we remember the thousands of namesless, secretly buried dead – Jews or Roma, anti-communists or partisans? How do we live in landscapes contaminated with the countless covert massacres of Central Europe – in the Burgenland Rechnitz as well as in the Slovenian Kocevski Rog or in Kurapaty near Minsk? Martin Pollack is concerned with the careless, but careful drawing of another, more true map of our continent. A map in which memory and location take place poisoned secrets and anonymous graves. "His books are documentation and literature. Martin Pollack, son of the Gestapo boss of Linz, takes up in his book "Contaminated landscapes" the recent past of his home and eastern Central Europe. The stubborn researcher lets the corpses that are to be forgotten, not rest.
content.title_en: Contaminated landscapes

content.text: Ways to Image Science : Interviews. The interview project Pathways to Image Science aims to contribute to the idea of a general, interdisciplinary image science, by pursuing the following specific objectives: 1. contribute to the understanding of the connection between image science and media theory, 2. define the role that philosophy has to play in this, 3. stimulate a terminology clarification of the different traditions of philosophical image theory, 4. present the image discussion to a wider public
content.title_en: Ways to Image Science : Interviews

content.text: Tschernobyl Baby: how we learned to love the atom. For the journalist born in 1969 (BA 7/06, 2/09), the accident of Tschernobyl with the fears and protests in Germany was a defining event. In 2009 and 2010 she travelled several times to the restricted zone between Belarus and Ukraine divided with her environment and experienced strange disaster tourism, seemingly untouched nature, the dangers defying residents and seriously ill, radiation-damaged people. Introduced are experiences of a woman born there in 1986 (Tschernobyl Baby!), who was friends with the author (personal contacts described A. Hilliges: BA 6/06). Furthermore, there are realistic insights into the hard everyday life of the inhabitants of both states. Another aspect is the importance of Tschernobyl for the German anti-atom force movement, where living people in prosperity cared more than the directly affected. An equally oppressive and enlightening book, which is also recommended in view of the events in Japan, about the great picture volume Rashnah recording (Babies) (Babiesin) in Weißin: The Beißin: The Beißin: The Beißin: Bauthin: Theißin: Theißin: Theißin: Theißin
content.title_en: Chernobyl Baby : how we learned to love the atom

content.text: What is a good religion? : twenty answers. Renowned theologians, philosophers, psychologists, etc. (including the bishops Huber and Lehmann, the Egyptologist J. Assmann or the philosophers Spaemann, Theunissen and Tugendhat) give answers to the title question in short essays. Religion is ideology-prone. But it is not the same as ideology. It does not have to become fundamentalistic, it can. What is a "good", what a "bad" religion? This question is followed by eighteen authors who have been thinking for some time - and sometimes quite practically - dealing with religious faith. Religions have taught us recently again fear. They can become intolerant, fanatical, self-governing, contentious and violent. But religions do not have to be "bad". One and the same religion can preach violence and stand for peaceful coexistence. When is a religion good - good for the believers and for the others?
content.title_en: What is a Good Religion? : twenty Answers

content.text: Report and analysis of the so far secret nuclear disaster in the USSR. Medvedev reports in this book about a huge nuclear explosion that occurred in the Soviet Union in the late 1950s and was concealed from the world public by the Russians and the Americans.
content.title_en: Report and analysis of the nuclear disaster in the USSR, which has been kept secret so far

content.text: From the right and wrong in the elementary algebra: a booklet to find sources of error, especially for people who sometimes believe in the need to despair of mathematics. A booklet to find sources of error, especially for people who sometimes believe in the need to despair of mathematics. Using the description of frequently occurring errors, lecturers can develop a feeling for the students' initial difficulties in dealing with equations and algebraic operations. Students can use the text to provide an ideal basis for entering Tietze's "Applied Business Mathematics". Under guidance, they learn to discover their own sources of error themselves. Thus, they can develop a better understanding of their problems and relativize them. Each error is not so bad if one understands why it is a mistake.
content.title_en: From the right and wrong in the elementary algebra: a booklet to find sources of error, especially for people who sometimes believe they have to despair of mathematics

content.text: The author describes the factors that favour negative development and divorce, but also shows how a couple can learn to deal with these challenges in a competent way in everyday life. The author shows many examples of what couples need to pay attention to if they want to keep their relationship alive. At the same time, it opens up possibilities for self-reflection.
content.title_en: Recognizing, Understanding and Coping with Relationship Crisis

content.text: Position and perspectives of Saxony-Anhalt in the New Economy : Study commissioned by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Labour of the Land of Saxony-Anhalt. Summary 1. Introduction 2. Theoretical principles 3. Sectoral delimitation of the subject matter of the study 4. Selection of the comparative region 5. Objective characteristics of selected location factors in Saxony-Anhalt 6. Basics of empirical analysis 7. Analysis of the state and potential of development of sectors 8. Analysis of the significance and significance of the location factors 9. Summary 10. Economic policy implications
content.title_en: Position and perspectives of Saxony-Anhalt in the New Economy : Study commissioned by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Labour of the State of Saxony-Anhalt

content.text: In the usual understanding, time is considered the framework and order of the event. The phenomenological approach digs deeper up to the layers of time needed for identity, subjectivity, detail and the world (in the particular singular). Preliminary investigations in Chapter 1 allow, among other things, to reveal the originally intense nature of the duration and the surplus of the open future over the closed. Beginning and possible end of time and their apories are treated as well as the time form of the course of history. A detailed final chapter looks at the history of time in the hands of philosophers.
content.title_en: Phenomena of time

content.text: The collection of miracles, the monstrous madness: scenes from the history of passion. "The most important piece of a collection is what is missing." Why do people accumulate so many things that they don't need? Millions of collectors give themselves to a passion that can take on delusional traits and celebrate such ravenous triumphs. Perhaps it is a heroic attempt to bring order - some order - into the chaos of appearances? From the chambers of wonder and art cabinets of the Renaissance to the birth of the museum and the classicational raptus of modern science, the author follows the story of this obsession, which has taken hold in democracy the masses. There is no such fantastic object that would not have aroused the desire of a collector. Thus, dragons and children's hawks, butterflies and nails have been hoarded by the Holy Cross as well as unpayable paintings and cheap plastic cups. Philip Blom carries his immense docility easily. His book is profoundly meaningful and entertaining at the same time: a portrait gallery, a European cultural history in nuce, a cabinet of the spleenature and a narrative of the human figure.
content.title_en: Collecting Wonders, Arrogance : Scenes from the History of a Passion

content.text: Present Shock : if everything happens now. Are we giving up the future in favor of the present? Rushkoff (last BA 7/06) has already been critical of the consequences of a digitalized everyday life on several occasions. Here he makes 5 epochal consequences of a temporal omnipresentity of information, communication offers, business dialogue etc.: The world no longer contracts long narratives, neither in the fictional nor in the political area ("narrative collapse"); we disintegrate into various simultaneous identities ("digiphrenia"); we are overexhausted; we constantly looked for patterns ("fractalnoia") and in the "apocalypse" many were convinced with the end of the world. One may not agree with all theses and not consider everything to be conclusive, all times interesting is the thesis of the end of the "narration", also of the "golden future", and of the dissolution of our time cycles in favour of an endless and aimless occupation, as they are for example in the banking sector, in short-term strategies for profit.
content.title_en: Present Shock : if everything happens now

content.text: The author (gas-water installer, heating engineer, electrician) is a certified building biologist. In his book he sets the building technology in relation to the building biology and its basic rules. Structured according to the topics earth (earth heating, built space in the soil, building envelope, etc.), air (air conditioning technology, ventilation concept, ventilation systems, etc.), water (sanitary, drinking water, grey water use, etc.), heat (heating, residential heat, heat supply, etc.) and power (electricity supply, light, house technology, etc.) he presents constructive and technical possibilities using an example house, how the individual areas of the house technology can be linked to a holistic building concept within the framework of building biological criteria.
content.title_en: Building biological building technology : ventilation, water, heating, electricity

content.text: The risk paradox: why we fear the wrong one; [what really threatens us]. What really threatens us and how we handle it properly. Almost daily the media bring us new messages of Job: rising crime, bird flu or electrosmog. Will our lives not become more dangerous, more uncertain, more risky? Ortwin Renn, the internationally recognized risk researcher and renowned technology and environmental sociologist, says: no. The average life expectancy is constantly rising, in many ways we are getting better. How, so Renn, are we afraid of ?wrong? dangers, but close our eyes to risks that threaten us and our posterity considerably. Renn shows which of these are, why we underestimate them and how we can deal with them responsibly in the sense of sustainability. (Verlag)
content.title_en: The risk paradox : why we fear the wrong one; [what really threatens us]
