content.text: The Mathematical Guide and Guide for Professionals answers all questions about the subject of study - from the choice of the subject of study, to the course of study, possible combinations of subjects to study financing - as well as about the career start and the possible fields of activity. Review (kz): The Mathematical Guide and Guide for Professionals informs about a course of study which is not easy to cope with, but which opens up a wide range of occupations after successful completion and rewards with best career prospects. It is equally aimed at Abitur students, students, graduates and career starters in this field. The book answers in detail all questions about the subject of study - from the choice of the subject of study, through course of study, possible combinations of subjects to study financing - as well as about the start of the career and the possible fields of activity. In addition, there are Praktikerporträts and 2 specials on financial and insurance mathematics as well as modelling, simulation, optimization. The author team, consisting of mathematicians at universities, research institutes and schools, experts from industry and business.
content.title_en: Study and vocational planner Mathematics: key qualification for technology, business and IT; for students and university graduates

content.text: Separation, death and grief during the first years of life: support and advice for children and parents. As heterogeneous as the three thematic focal points of the book are, they are common to them that they often occur unexpectedly and the effects of all three are similar, that the reference persons are unsure or overrepresented or have insufficient knowledge in dealing with the respective situations. Here the title aims to remedy the above-mentioned incisive experiences - both for parents and for all "people concerned with child development" . Experts of (development) psychology, early, social and promotion pedagogy as well as the paediatric medicine and psychiatry with selected practical reports of their disciplines on the basis of the respective current research level are mentioned. Reference is made to infants between 0 and 3 years of age; with few examples also older children come to the attention. "Early Risks and Early Aids" discussed here by the editors (ID-G 22/10). Apart from the precise positioning problem as a general supplement to the titles on dealing with children in the individual crisis situations. (3)
content.title_en: Separation, death and grief in the first years of life : Support and advice for children and parents

content.text: Germanic castles. The author presents the results of special archaeological investigations on the subject, which are limited to the north-west German lowlands and adjacent central mountains, for example from the middle of the 1st millennium BC to the 7th century AD. Also about numerous castles of the districts Halle and Magdeburg.
content.title_en: Germanic castles

content.text: Sound of the time: sounds, sounds, voices: 1889 to today. The sound of history between the media revolutions of the beginning and end of the 20th century. How did cities and factories sound at the beginning and at the end of the 20th century? How did recording media develop? How did the First and Second World Wars differ acoustically? How did and is politics developed with sounds? What hits, fighting songs and hymns have immortalized in our memory? Did the GDR have a different sound than the FRG? What songs and melodies determine the self-understanding of people, groups and nations? How did acoustic surveillance develop? We gain a large part of our orientation in the world through listening. The ear takes up the emotional aspect of an information. Some sounds are stored in the subconscious for life. Sounds can be places of memory and identity. Music can stir up and excite, it can generate resistance, but with it can also be tortured "with it" the research sound music.
content.title_en: Sound of the time : sounds, sounds, voices : 1889 to today

content.text: Cultures of youthful rebellion : youth protest and social inequality. Barricades and blogs, flash mobs and color bags, seat blockades and school strikes Youth protest is not only an element of youthful life in its forms and structural characteristics, but also a counter-diagnostic reference to the constitution of societies. In times of advancing globalization, youth revolt has also changed. This is linked to the life-world experience of poverty and wealth, descent and ascent, the shadows and sun sides of globalization. Growing social inequality in a globalized world seems to be a motor of youth protest
content.title_en: Cultures of youthful rebellion : youth protest and social inequality

content.text: Introduction to methodological design : for study and practice; with ... 30 tab. Short textbook for Bachelor's education, based on VDI guidelines, in which the method of design is explained. Practical layout, developed after a lecture script at a university of applied sciences. It is not oriented towards detail and is limited to the description of essential methods with special consideration of function structure and cost-effectiveness. It is aimed at students of mechanical engineering, in particular also engineers and technicians in design departments. Current addition to H. Geupel (BA 11/96). (2)
content.title_en: Introduction to methodological design : for study and practice; with ... 30 tab.

content.text: Canary Islands : Lanzarote, Fuerteventura, Gran Canaria, Tenerife, Gomera, La Palma, Hierro ; with 13 tables in the text and on 1 supplement. The reworking of this geological guide (ID 36/87) published in 1986 has increased considerably in scope after more than 20 years of geological and geographical research of the Canary Islands. The author, geology professor from Mannheim, (lastly "Die Geologie Deutschlands": BA 6/05) has "considered the current journal literature, which documents above all the considerably refined temporal classification of volcanic events" (klappentext). In addition to the geological description of the individual islands, the interested person in natural science finds suggestions for one-day excursions in the final chapter. With a literature directory, register and a supplement (maps, geological profiles, climate and vegetation zones). Primary for geologists, geographers and ambitious hobbyists. (3)
content.title_en: Canary Islands : Lanzarote, Fuerteventura, Gran Canaria, Tenerife, Gomera, La Palma, Hierro ; with 13 tables in the text and on 1 supplement

content.text: The convivialist manifesto: for a new art of living together. Global problems such as climate change, poverty, terrorism or financial crises suggest that we think about changing forms of living together and perception. Many movements, initiatives and groups are already looking for alternative ways. They all share the quest for a new art of living together (con-vivere). Convivialism means exploring ways in which people can provide for each other and at the same time take care of nature without therefore avoiding legitimate conflicts. - The manifesto of renowned authors discussed worldwide makes it clear that this can only succeed in a social order that calls for a common humanity, on principles of common socialization, on the principle of individuality and on the acceptance of creative opposition.
content.title_en: The convivialist manifesto : for a new art of living together

content.text: Salafism in Germany : Origins and dangers of an Islamic fundamentalist movement. "Not all Salafists are terrorists, but all of us known Islamist terrorist suspects have a Salafist background
content.title_en: Salafism in Germany : Origins and dangers of an Islamic fundamentalist movement

content.text: Building physics compact : heat, humidity, sound. Publisher's text: Knowledge of building physics is an essential prerequisite for the planning, execution and repair of buildings from the point of view of energy-saving construction. A large number of building damage can also be attributed to the ignorance of important building physics foundations. In this book, the most important laws and relationships of heat, humidity and sound protection are presented in a compact and clear form and explained with numerical examples.
content.title_en: Building physics compact : heat, humidity, sound

content.text: Image : an interdisciplinary manual. From the panel image to the film to the 3D image. Images flood us in all areas of society, the handling of digital images is becoming increasingly important. Since the Pictorial or Iconic Turn, the cultural sciences of the topic have also taken on the topic and founded a science of image and image perception. The manual provides a comprehensive overview for the first time, explains basics such as semiotics, phenomenology and iconology, analyses various individual media and subsequent image discourses. A final part illuminates the image theories of different disciplines, and how they understand themselves as image science.
content.title_en: Image : an interdisciplinary manual

content.text: What are the energies of the 21st century? The race for the deposits. In its aspec- ical and data-rich, sober and factually presented overview of the energy question (storage sites, energy stocks, energy consumption and demand, energy as economic goods, energy use, efficiency, energy supply and scenarios for the future - globally as well as in relation to Germany) Wagner (Professor of Energy Systems and Energy Economics at the Ruhr University Bochum, cf. BA 8/98) draws on the environment, climate and population growth. Almost comparable publications such as C. Morris: "Zukunftsenergien" (BA 7/05) or "Sichere Energie im 21. Jahrhundert" (BA 3/07) are more concerned with individual energy sources (pres and cons), but do not offer this broad spectrum or the mentioned contexts. With glossary as well as numerous tables and diagrams. To continue the extremely deserving 12-part-time series "Forum für Verantwortung" (see W. Mauser on the topic of water and St. Rahmstorm on the threat of the oceans in this issue) Energy Council, as a broad overview for energy consumption, energy consumption, for the 21st.
content.title_en: What are the energies of the 21st century? : The race for the deposits

content.text: Ecology of the Mind : anthropological, psychological, biological and epistemological perspectives. Review: "Bateson's work is of a range of variations and relevance that detests all individual scientific barriers and limitations of academic research. Bateson has compared data, findings and experiences from biology, sociology, linguistics, history, psychology, cybernetics and art and analyzed their structures and development processes." (Fritz B. Simon)
content.title_en: Ecology of the Mind : anthropological, psychological, biological and epistemological perspectives

content.text: The zero-border cost society: the Internet of Things, collaborative commons and the withdrawal of capitalism. Capitalism is approaching its end. This does not happen from today to tomorrow, but it is still unstoppable. And the signs are long since unremarkable: falling production costs, share economy, Internet of Things. Jeremy Rifkin, visionary and best-selling author, finally brings the coordinates of the new era together to form a recognizable picture. From our industrially shaped, a global, community-oriented society emerges. In it, parts are worth more than possessions, citizens are politically active across national borders and stand the quest for quality of life above the pursuit of wealth. How this fundamental change will determine our future?
content.title_en: The Zero-Limit-cost-Society: the Internet of Things, collaborative commons and the withdrawal of capitalism

content.text: Statistics without fear of formulas : the study book for economists and social scientists. Verl.Beschr.: Statistics without fear of formulas: A current and lively textbook for students, economists and social scientists and all users of statistical methods in everyday work. This book offers an understandable introduction to all basic statistical methods. Without requiring any prior knowledge, the contents are presented in a vivid and understanding way. For this 4th edition the book has been extensively updated and extended
content.title_en: Statistics without fear of formulas : the study book for economists and social scientists

content.text: The scientific illustration : from cave painting to computer graphics. Cave drawing and computer image are far apart in time. But both testify to the same human effort: to capture and understand natural events. This richly illustrated book calls for a careful examination of the variety of scientific illustrations that have been part of our cultural heritage since prehistoric times.
content.title_en: The scientific illustration : from cave painting to computer graphics

content.text: Handbook of Sociology. Manuals for sociology itself are rare, more often such as the one on individual areas of sociology are published. Previous manuals - such as the "Handbuch Soziologie" (BA 2/09) published by N. Baur - offered lemmatas on individual topics of sociology in alphabetical order. This work, written by renowned sociologists, offers a clear structure with the areas of sociological view, basic concepts, social theory (individual theorists and their approaches), fields of study and current challenges. Thus, the reader can obtain a complete picture of the structure and get a quick start on individual topics. As the name of the series says: useful for the basic study of social science courses or for academic professions with a socioscientific reference, which want to refresh their knowledge about sociology. Comparatively written, well equipped and equipped with material and person registers. (2)
content.title_en: Handbook of Sociology

content.text: Writings on pedagogy. In 2002 the last volume of Niklas Luhmann's epochal theory of society appeared with The Educational System of Society. However, Luhmann has devoted great attention to the educational system of society since the seventies and published a large number of texts ranging from a lexicon article on system and system theory in a pedagogical dictionary to the "child as a medium of education" and reform education. This volume gathers these widely published texts for the first time and thus offers an excellent overview of Luhmann's theory of the educational system.
content.title_en: Writings on Pedagogy

content.text: Dining rooms: the food transition begins in the city. "The book examines the background to urban food supply and shows, on the basis of the international discussion and many reports from practical projects, how citizens and municipalities can tackle the task of sustainable urban food supply."--
content.title_en: Dining rooms : the food transition begins in the city
Standards on wood

content.text: Microsoft Office Project 2003 - the manual: [Insider-Knowledge - practical and competent; with 120-day trial version of Project 2003 and Project Server 2003]. The project software project of Microsoft has already been described in detail by the authors in the version 2002 (M. Jäger, BA 1/03), should remain in existence. The successor version 2003 differs only slightly from the version 2002. It is explained in a presentation for beginners by A. Albuschat (BA 6/04). Albuschat is nevertheless recommended also for libraries with narrow budget due to the sophisticated didactic concept. This book is recommended especially for libraries with pronounced computer-focused focus, which have to pay attention to completeness. The focus is on project planning and resource management, project planning and project analysis and reporting. Good consideration is also given to the use in the company and the team communication, the interaction between the project and the office family as well as the adaptation and extension of project with VBA. Numerous tips and tricks. Often, theoretical background knowledge is provided for project planning.
content.title_en: Microsoft Office Project 2003 - the manual : [Insider-Knowledge - practical and competent; with 120-day trial version of Project 2003 and Project Server 2003]

content.text: Brain, psyche, education: Opportunities and limitations of neuropädagogik. Brain research is today considered the spearhead of scientific progress. Brain researchers are now also in great demand for the topics of childhood, development, education, learning and education in the media. Research theses and tempting promises arouse high expectations with regard to easier, more sustainable and more effective learning. The book critically examines the findings, suggestions and arguments that were introduced by brain research into the educational discourse. It is also clear that the reverse of neurodidactic optimization utopias are also evident. Sceptically compared to the feasibility fantasies of the brain boom, the book reminds us that learning, experiencing and developing children and young people do not follow evidence-based science.
content.title_en: Brain, psyche, education : Opportunities and limitations of neuroeducation

content.text: The author consciously focuses on the project management of software objects. This is based on the fact that the design of processes, the planning and control procedures as well as the use of metrics differ greatly from other development projects. The title "Software Management" (ID 37/02) goes on, since it pursues software throughout the entire life cycle even after its creation. Certain parallels arise to the title "Software Technology" (ID 11/00). However, this book continues here, since it also takes into account the importance of work in the group in software development and contains many explanations for team management (motivation theories, leadership theories). In the structure of the book, the author follows the classical procedure - defining project objectives, planning, realization and control, final evaluation and transfer to the client. In the first place, students of computer science are addressed. In each chapter, the formulation of learning objectives and tasks. Numerous tabular overviews, checklists. (3)
content.title_en: Basic course Software Project Management

content.text: High-voltage direct current transmission - properties of the transmission medium overhead line. The change in the generation mix in Germany requires the addition of new transport capacities. The new task of the high-performance/long-distance transport of electrical energy for the German network requires the use of high-voltage direct current transmission lines (HVDC lines), embedded in the synchronous three-phase interconnected network. Open lines can be used as transmission medium. The present publication deals with the technical foundations and a comparison of the technology variants currently in use. Depending on the voltage level, the expected emissions of electric and magnetic field emissions are described for the purpose of the current generation of future open lines. The analyses are carried out using the 26th BImSchV, the professional-cooperative rules on worker protection and current studies of the World Health Organization on electromagnetic interference issues.
content.title_en: High voltage DC transmission - characteristics of the transmission medium overhead line

content.text: Key works of sociology. A quick access to the great minds of sociology is provided in this volume. 202 central works - the classics of sociology - are discussed by proven experts. The contributions on each page follow a uniform pattern, which takes into account in detail both the origin and content as well as the impact of the "key work".
content.title_en: Key works of sociology

content.text: Mind in the Net : Models for Learning, Thinking and Acting. Unchanged paperback edition of the original 1996 (ID 43/96; then DM 58,00). The psychiatrist Spitzer introduces, in a comprehensible and comprehensive way, the neurophysiology of nerve cells (neurons) and the theory of their interaction as so-called neuronal networks in the state of higher mental achievements as well as their disorders. From more recent titles to comparison with S. Pinker: "How Thinking in the Head Is Created" (ID 44/98). - Furthermore, primarily for performance course students, students and scientists. (3 S) (Uwe-Friedrich Obsen)
content.title_en: Spirit on the Web : Models for Learning, Thinking and Acting

content.text: Development promotion in childhood : Basics, diagnostics and intervention. Development promotion in childhood is a multi-layered process for which differentiated knowledge about development phases, diagnostics and appropriate interventions is necessary. The book first introduces generally into the basics of development promotion. In the second part, specific functional areas of child development are addressed, such as motor skills, language, intellectual, social and emotional skills. In addition to these general areas, academic competences (mathematical competences, reading and spelling skills), giftedness, musical and media competences are discussed.
content.title_en: Development support in childhood : basics, diagnostics and intervention

content.text: The most recent curricula and educational standards have recently led to substantial changes in arithmetic teaching. In this highly revised re-edited re-editing of the proven didactics of arithmetic, we prepare for these and other desirable changes thoroughly by
content.title_en: Didactics of arithmetic : for teacher training and further education

content.text: The Land Management Model (HIS) has developed a method for the needs-oriented budgeting of the Land's universities in the area. This is a consistent proposal for the integration of investment funds into the processes of the result-oriented management of universities through the (formally-based) allocation of budgets which can be used by the universities themselves to achieve the objectives agreed with them. This has been achieved by focusing from the (one-time) investment expenditure on the ongoing costs of the provision of land through capital commitment, depreciation and necessary maintenance. These costs arising from the provision of land in any case can be placed in the responsibility of the departments as users without causing additional costs on the part of the country. The implementation of the Land Management Model involves the second largest cost block of university financing in the resource responsibility of the universities, thus significantly strengthening the text of the Land Management Model. Structure: 1. Conception of the Land Management Model. - 2. Definition of the model parameters. - 3. Implementation of the Land Management Model of the Land Management Model (Hochschulen Model).
content.title_en: Land management Rhineland-Palatinate : a control model for the construction and construction of the universities of the country

content.text: Album. Hannah Höch is considered a pioneer of material collage and photo montage and has always been looking for motifs for her works. "I collect everything that seems to me of value or may be needed". One of her works, an album, is now completely available in a facsimile-like form for the first time. It was probably created around 1933 and is now owned by the Berlinische Galerie. Höch has cut out about 400 pictures from magazines for this album (114 pages) and glued them into 2 magazines (carrier material). The pictures are summarized according to motifs such as nature, animals, plants, film, dance, sport, etc. A three-language text comments on the creation and construction of the album, although it remains unclear what the artist has created the work for. Perhaps as a motif material collection, sketchbook or as an independent artistic object. Complement to "Hanna Höch: Eine Lebenscollage" (ID 34/96). (3) (LK/K: Weber)
content.title_en: Album

content.text: The Wild Continent : Europe in the years of the anarchy 1943-1950. Review: The important study of the novelist (last BA 6/04) and long-standing historians, awarded with a British literary prize, characterizes the years after World War II not as usual as a new beginning, but as a lasting epoch of lawlessness, chaos and violence, in which the war, with effects to this day, has actually continued to work. With a supranational approach, which also significantly includes Eastern Europe, Lowe describes the inheritances of war such as hunger, displacement, material and moral destruction, describes the importance of revenge and retribution, and finally outlines how the various conflict fields that had overlaid themselves during the war resulted in ethnic cleansing and civil wars. The book, which was worked out from extensive study of sources and literature, is excellently written for a wider, historically educated audience, and describes how the various fields of conflict, which had overlaid themselves during the war, resulted in ethnic cleansing and civil wars.
content.title_en: The wild continent : Europe in the years of anarchy 1943-1950

content.text: Place and displacement : exhibition architecture. The field of architecture – seemingly immovable and permanent – remains a challenge in the world of modern gathering and exhibiting. Since the late 18th century, divergent conventions of exhibiting have been fused with intense discussions on how cultural goods should be passed on, disseminated, appreciated and evaluated. Place and Displacement: Exhibiting Architecture investigates historical and contemporary ways of exhibiting architecture; whether they are 1:1 implementations, fragments, models or two-dimensional representations. The publication addresses questions of circulation and temporality, aspects of institutionalization and canon, as well as the discourse and politics of exhibiting architectural spaces. Essays discuss the ambiguity of architecture as an exhibition object. Contributions by leading scientists who are concerned with the new field of research in the history and realization of architectural exhibitions show how central the exhibition is for the definition and interpretation of the concept of architecture and its history.
content.title_en: Place and placement : exhibition architecture

content.text: Ecological management : re-(world-oriented) thinking in the business administration : with 104 tables. Ecological responsible action has become an important element of companies. This requires a rethinking of the business administration system in the management system i.S. of environmental and quality management in the formulation and strategy development, as well as consideration of the various stakeholders and functional areas. Other topics are e.g. eco-balance and implementation (implementation, environmental reporting).
content.title_en: Ecology-oriented management : re-(world-oriented) thinking in the business cycle : with 104 tables

content.text: Hybris: the overwhelmed society. Great madness and self-overestimation are part of human nature. But only today they are cultivated as success factors. The consequences are pathologically proliferating economic activities, unleashed financial markets, dysfunctional education and infrastructure, major projects running out of control, uncontrollable data volumes and global aspiration for omnipotence. Meinhard Miegel, one of Germany's most prominent thinkers, sees this ubiquitous hubris as the main cause of the profound crisis of politics, economy and society.
content.title_en: Hybris: the overwhelmed society

content.text: What is a good question? : the systematic evaluation of the quality of questions. The quality of data associated with surveys depends largely on the quality of the survey tools used. Although international survey research has gained numerous insights into the effects of the quality of questions on respondents' response behaviour, these findings have not yet sufficiently been condensed into methods of systematic evaluation of questions. Exceptions are the so-called 'Question Appraisal Systems' (Question Assessment Systems) developed in the USA, which allow us to identify shortcomings of questions already before the use of empirical pretest procedures and thus create the basis for optimization. The book has set itself the task of developing an evaluation system (FBS) that is suitable for systematic evaluation of the quality of questions and the role of the quality of questions in minimising the error of the survey. The book addresses all persons who have to develop or evaluate survey questions in any way.
content.title_en: What is a good question? : the systematic evaluation of the quality of questions

content.text: Topography of the buildings of modernism : TOPOMOMO. This travel diary of the German-Czech EU project "TOPOMOMO - Topography of the buildings of modernism" opens up new perspectives. So far, the Euregion Neisse is more known as a natural and hiking paradise. Now visitors can experience it from a new and unusual side. The building culture of the early 20th century flourished even outside the big metropolises in the spirit of modernism. The volume documents impressive testimonies of a time of faith in progress and the enthusiasm for technology in eastern Saxony and northern Bohemia and describes the exciting stories behind the unusual buildings
content.title_en: Topography of Modernist Buildings : TOPOMOMO

content.text: Symphony of the Living : Attempt to a General Resonance Theory. Note International Hölderlin Bibliography: pp.150-160: Nutrition - Bread and Wine; p.217-223: World Resonance
content.title_en: Symphony of the Living : Attempts to Achieve a General Resonance Theory

content.text: Robots build special with Arduino : the instruction for beginners ; [easy to get into, no prior knowledge required ; all basics: Arduino programming, electronics, robotics ; build their own robot and gradually expand them by new skills ; for craft beginners of all ages]. Arduino is a physical computing platform consisting of open source hardware and software, usually from a simple I/O board with a microcontroller with many inputs and outputs. The Arduino platform just like its widely used alternative Raspberry Pi is often used by users without any prior knowledge of hobby electronic crafting. Books with many well-explained examples are here M. Schlenker (ID-A 39/14 - Arduino) or E.F. Engelhardt (ID-B 39/14 - Raspberry Pi). The author of this book introduces in the robot construction with Arduino, also addresses young people and sees his book as an interesting learning and teaching material for schools (already from secondary school I). Ampberry Pi is used for the introduction of the platform.
content.title_en: Robots build with Arduino : the guide for beginners ; [just get in, no prior knowledge required ; all basics: Arduino programming, electronics, robotics ; build your own robot and gradually expand it by new skills ; for craft beginners of all ages]

content.text: The capital of the state: another history of innovation and growth. Extended version of a report to the British government on the need for more state initiatives to promote economic development and to reduce subsidies. The prejudice of a sluggish state (private sector myths) is to be refuted by numerous examples from different countries, including China. Above all, it is about support programmes from the USA for well-known products (often IT industry). The good cooperation of universities and industry is highlighted there. Nationally initiated also in EU countries the beginnings of energy transition and green revolution, but often stagnating and need special incentives. Interesting remarks are given about the problem of public risk and private profit creation. Many examples show that the market itself does not regulate, better be an entrepreneurial state. The author is a professor, EU consultant and in the British environmental think tank Green Alliance. Due to the austerity rates in the EU is currently burning.
content.title_en: Capital of the State: a different history of innovation and growth

content.text: The field of action Water and space management requires integrated planning approaches and a concerted approach by the stakeholders involved. Current change processes such as climate change and demographic, economic and technological change as well as the requirements of water-related EU directives impose new requirements on water management, flood risk management as well as on spatial planning and building management planning. The traditional division of tasks between spatial planning and water management (as well as other environmental planning, especially nature conservation) seem partly outdated. The interdisciplinary group of authors from practitioners and scientists discuss the tasks of water management and spatial planning as well as control options and make recommendations on measures for joint strategy development, instrument bundling and coordination of planning processes.
content.title_en: Sustainable use of water in the space

content.text: No Limit : how much doping does society tolerate. Ines Geipel, himself a doping victim, tells the story of doping and its social consequences. And she shows us that doping not only changes people, but also the whole society Ines Geipel, himself a doping victim, tells the story of doping and its social consequences. And she shows us that doping not only changes people, but also the whole society.
content.title_en: No Limit : how much doping does society tolerate

content.text: This all went on our roads. Exciting picture-text-documentation of the German road picture of the post-war period. The author, a well-known motor journalist, recorded with his camera new cars, such as veterans, curious own buildings and products of the micro car manufacturers from 1955. With historical black-and-white photos, informative texts on vehicle types and manufacturers of that time as well as facsimilated advertising brochures and press extracts a piece of automobile and everyday history comes alive. This attractive, large-format volume, whose first edition appeared already in 1969 (not discussed here), is conceivable for traffic stocks of any size. (2)
content.title_en: All this drove on our roads

content.text: This thousand-fold proven basic work covers the entire spectrum of precision mechanics from miniature mechanics to the elements of precision large mechanics. It also presents novel construction elements, which were created by the application of microelectronics in precision mechanics. In the third edition, the chapters on computer and micromechanics were reworked due to the rapid development and with the transition to the European EN standards the field of construction materials was updated. In addition, in-depth addition to the calculation and design of construction elements were carried out. New DIN and DIN ISO standards as well as VDI/VDE guidelines were taken into account. The bibliographies were updated to the latest state of the art.
content.title_en: Mechanical engineering elements

content.text: Mathematics for natural scientists: what you really need in the Bachelor's degree and not learn in school. The work, which was developed from a lecture, provides beginners of natural science subjects, far from physics, with a selection of relevant topics and facts of mathematics. The transparent and easy-to-read presentation conveys without further mathematical draught some central objects of linear algebra (matrices, determinants, linear equation systems), higher analysis (vetoran analysis, differential equations) and probability calculation (combinatory, elementary sentences, probability distributions), thus providing very clearly abstract-like selected basic knowledge for practice and also provides a usable access to further studies. Numerous examples and illustrations illustrate concepts and facts, tasks (solutions on the Internet) allow an active examination of the material. The work is not a bridge course and consistently presupposes solid knowledge of mathematics of the upper level.
content.title_en: Mathematics for Natural Scientists : what you really need in the Bachelor and don't learn in school

content.text: Educational geography. Educational geography examines educational institutions, educational processes and educational behaviour in their spatial dimensions. This textbook outlines theoretical-methodical approaches and developments in educational geography. Using examples, insights into research practice are given and perspectives for future work are shown. Education determines the self-image of modern societies to a large extent and is considered an important resource for social, economic and cultural developments. This book not only plays a role in formal educational institutions such as schools or universities, but also increasingly in non-formal education and informal learning. Educational geography examines educational institutions, educational processes and educational behaviour in their spatial dimensions. Briefly, structured and intelligibly written, this textbook provides an overview of the theoretical, methodological and thematic diversity of educational geography research. Using a selection of current and classical approaches as well as illustrative examples, concrete insights into educational geographic research practice are conveyed and perspectives for future work shown.
content.title_en: Educational geography

content.text: Integration: Yes! - But how? : Results from model experiments to promote disabled children and young people. From the preface: Prevention and integration are the major topics and challenges of disability education over the last twenty years. The processes of further development and restructuring of social and educational support systems were initiated by model experiments, which were planned and carried out in all federal states, financed by the Federal State Commission (BLK). This evaluation report describes 45 model experiments in the Federal Republic of Germany. It was about: the early education of disabled children and young people threatened by disability; the improvement of transitions between the various areas of education; the pedagogical support of special groups of pupils including vocational training.
content.title_en: Integration: Yes! - But how? : Results from pilot experiments to promote disabled children and young people

content.text: Because a #excuse is not enough: for a feminism of today. Anne Wizorek triggered a huge storm in the net with her Twitter hashtag. Thousands of women use "excuse" as a valve to make their experiences with everyday sexism air. The success of the action makes clear: We are still far from gender justice, sexual harassment and discrimination remain a burning problem. Refreshingly unacademic Anne Wizorek shows why our society urgently needs a new feminist agenda. She describes her way to become an activist very personally and encourages her to become active in the big as well as in the small. (Verlag text)
content.title_en: Because a #outcry is not enough for a feminism of today

content.text: Design and calculation boards for civil engineers. New reference work for students and practitioners of civil engineering and architecture. Included are scarce information, calculation bases, construction aids and numerical examples for important areas of construction technology on the latest state of the art. Topics are among others: statics, reinforced concrete, wood construction, masonry, geotechnics, construction physics, construction construction construction, transport, water etc. On the CD-ROM temporary test versions to 2 static programs as well as technical additions to individual chapters. Overviewally structured, opened by a handle register. Among the standard reference works for civil engineers presented so far there are large overlaps. The "construction tables for engineers" (last BA 5/01: 14th edition 2001, 47.00 EUR) differ only in 2 chapters, also the "construction technical number boards" of R. Wendehorst (last BA 3/03: 30th edition 2002, 49.90 EUR) - however, both are not on the latest state of standardization. In Karlsruhe all such table stocks are used for the most part of the purchase.
content.title_en: Design and calculation boards for civil engineers

content.text: The silent revolution: how algorithms change knowledge, work, public and politics without making much noise. The anglizisms that have become embedded in our language show that a dramatic change is taking place in front of all of us. We mail, google, skype and tweet. The digital revolution, according to Mercedes Bunz's thesis, could have as dramatic consequences as the industrial one in the 19th century. The software ?Pudding?, for example, is able to provide background information through voice recognition during a telephone conversation. The program ?Stats Monkey? already independently writes sports reports. Just as the machines changed the activity of the workers at that time, the algorithms now change the professional everyday life of the middle class.
content.title_en: The silent revolution: how algorithms change knowledge, work, public and politics without making much noise

content.text: Phonographs and Grammophone. Publisher's text: The book phonographs and gramophones by Dr.-Ing. Herbert Jüttemann, first published in 1979, is now published in its 4th edition.
content.title_en: Phonographs and gramophones

content.text: Luhmann's manual: Life - Work - Effect. Luhmann has promoted system theory as a sociologist and administrative scientist. He is known for his bulky texts. This manual is all the more helpful, which - like comparable works by Metzler's publishing house on sociological theorists, for example the "Habermas Manual" (ID 34/09) or the "Arendt Manual" (ID-B 5/12) - opens up his work well. Biography, basics, theory, terms, works, references, reception and discussions are the parts of the work supplemented by a dignified appendix (including a time table, bibliography and persons register). The work is more broadly structured and structured than the comparable "Luhmann-Lexikon" (at last discussed: 4. edition, ID 25/05), which is strongly oriented towards conceptualities. An acquisition is useful where Luhmann's works are present in a significant number and the Luhmann-Lexikon is well used. Target groups are more intensive in the scientific field.
content.title_en: Luhmann Manual : Life - Work - Effect

content.text: Leave your children alone! : against the fad of support in education. Children are being promoted more and more earlier today: bilingual kindergartens, intelligence trainings, music lessons, baby swimming: everything from the desire to give the child a good starting position and that from the beginning. Engaged parents don't want to miss anything. But is it really right to confront the little ones with a full timetable so early? The line between promotion and over-stress is narrow, the uncertainty is great
content.title_en: Leave your children alone! : against the delusion of support in education

content.text: The work, which is based on lectures, provides students of mathematics and physics with a compact, basic introduction to the theory of measurement and integration from the 3rd semester onwards. Review (ekz): Mass and integration theory is a central component of higher analysis and forms an important basis for numerous areas of pure mathematics (including functional analysis) such as applied mathematics (including stochastics). The work, which is based on lectures, now provides students of mathematics and physics with a compact basic introduction to the theory of measurement and integration, based on solid basic knowledge of analysis and linear algebra, from the 3rd semester onwards. The presentation, which is provided with examples and illustrations, provides central knowledge specifically for their use in further events and is comparable here with the introduction of M. Brokate, which is not entirely comprehensive. Therefore, a systematic structure is not required. The work is suitable for a sufficiently thorough study of the necessary foundations, which requires further studies. In addition to the comprehensive works of H. BROKATE, the work is also used for a systematic set-up.
content.title_en: Measure and integral: an introduction for Bachelor students

content.text: Josef Wiedemann - the effect of things: three buildings of the Munich architect. "...I have looked at your alliance building in the Queen Street with great pleasure and must tell you my gratitude for having created something noble. I have to caress everything, the wood, the fabric, the Nymphenburg ceramic, the glass well, the staircase railing. How imaginative are the ornaments in the openings to the hall, the hall wall itself ..." writes in 1955 the 78-year-old Paul Bonatz in Euphorie to the young Wiedemann. content.text: The Rheinauhafen in Cologne is inseparably connected with the history of the city. Already at the time of the founding of Cologne about 2000 years ago by the Roman general Agrippa, the location on the Rhine was of central importance for the people and the development of the city. - At the beginning of the 3rd millennium, the Cologne Rheinauhafen experiences a new orientation: The harbour area is transformed into a pulsating center of life and work. - The outstanding history, the planning and construction phase and the urbanity of the newly designed Rheinauhafen wants to document the J.P. Bachem Verlag in cooperation with the Architekten- und Ingenieurverband KölnBonn e.V. with this book project. Thus, the series "Cologne - His Buildings" of the AIV, which impressively describes the urban development of the Dom-Metrolpole, is extended by a seventh volume. - The extensive illustrated work describes with contributions from the developers, planners, architects and conservationists the history and the "rewaxing" of the port, after long decades of the Brachliegen and the high-quality of the work of the old buildings and the re-quirestory of the old buildings.
content.title_en: The Rheinauhafen

From the preface: Although this book also contains a presentation of the economic and social statistical areas which are important for international organisations, the focus is on critical methodological considerations, which should clarify the content and limits of information and gaps and propose ways of improving them.
content.title_en: International Economic and Social Statistics : Textbook on the methods and problems of their main areas

In addition to installation, configuration and administration, the step-by-step construction of a project is explained. (LK/SZ: Schleiwies) F. Bongers has been writing practical books on the Open Source CMS Typo3 for a long time. Version 6.2 offers LTS (Long Term Support) and is available since March 2014. A new LTE with version number 7.7 is planned for autumn 2015. The content jump to the pre-release is not so big, the backend template creation with Fluit has now a separate chapter, but the book for the new LTS should be set additionally to replace version 4.5 LTS (ID-B 28/11). The title is more suitable for CMS experienced users with previous knowledge of the matter and administrator tasks. Scope and price are unchanged. Especially for users, e.g. editors, Michael Biesza (ID-B 26/14) is preferred. Before Robert Meyer: "Praxiswisseno 3 CMS" (LX) all versions should not be displayed here. (Predeaderial version 6.2).

This publication is supplemented by the 2nd completely new and extended edition of the book "Wirtschaftsinformation: Online, CD-Rom, Internet", published as volume 15 of the series "Materialien zur Information und Dokumentation" and by the 3rd revised edition of the book "Information Retrieval", published as volume 5 of the same series of writings
content.title_en: Scientific and technical information : Online, CD-ROM, Internet

content.text: Terror before Europe's gates: the Islamic State, Iraq's disintegration and America's impotence. Historical development and current analysis of developments in decaying Iraq. (Daniela Neuenfeld-Zvolsky) Review: Historical development and current analysis of developments in decaying Iraq. Iraq is on the verge of decay, the IS has taken over the rule in large parts of the country and the confessional civil war between Sunnis and Shiites seems insoluble. As this development could come about, the Islamic scientist Buchta, who worked as a political analyst of the UN in Baghdad from 2005 to 2010, describes with knowledge and authenticity. Understandably, the larger political contexts and complex structures of influence in the region become more and more complex. Intensively, the role of the US and the dilemma of its Middle East policy in recent years is examined. For all those who are closer to the developments in a region whose terror is approaching Europe, want to deal with it and seek a factually-sober, well-written analysis, this book is particularly recommended. (3)
content.title_en: Terror at Europe's Gates: the Islamic State, Iraq's Disintegration and America's Powerlessness

content.text: Brutal and uncontrolled : Student violence and intervention possibilities in primary school. The authors investigate the manifold causes of student violence and show how to intervene in primary school. Many factors are concentrated in the "violent acts": home, teaching structure, working relations in the college, school organization, external organization of the school etc. Many acts of violence look similar; nevertheless, individual factors may be involved differently. For the various approaches of teachers, school leaders, educational counseling centres and training institutions, perspectives and intervention possibilities are presented that meet the complexity of the phenomenon of violence.
content.title_en: Brutal and uncontrolled : Student violence and intervention in primary school

content.text: From student sport to university sport. Student sport in the former GDR embodies one of the success stories of sports development in Germany. As a mandatory part of the academic canon of subjects, it was originally intended to guarantee the ideal image of the "all-sidedly formed personality" in adult education. However, the target size of the "socialist personality" derived from this, led to overforms of sports education and leisure organization by political instrumentalization, educational influences and patronage of organized sports. On the basis of a previously unseen data set and of time witnesses statements, however, the efforts to establish a separate student sport association are investigated. In particular, the first view of the Arbeitsgemeinschaft Deutscher Studentensport (ADS) and the Presidium for high and technical school sports (PfHFS) is presented the modest scope of international contacts in the FISU or in dealing with representatives of the ADH.
content.title_en: From student sport to university sport

content.text: Integration of landscape framework planning into regional planning : Experiences from Saxony and approaches in Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia. The volume contains, in addition to the country-specific presentation of the development and the framework conditions of the integration of land planning and landscape planning in the countries Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia, a practical presentation of the experiences in the Free State of Saxony with the model of primary integration of landscape planning into regional and regional planning. For these countries, it also documents the intention to derive the claim of landscape framework planning from the traditions of East German landscape planning and the available basic materials, and calls for concrete experiences, successes and obstacles in the integration of landscape planning in regional planning in the three countries and provides practical recommendations for the further development of landscape framework planning and regional planning.
content.title_en: Integration of landscape planning into regional planning : Experiences from Saxony and approaches in Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia

content.text: The Islamic scientist, a connoisseur of the Arab world, fears that a decade of religious war could ruin the Arab countries. He compares the situation with Europe in the 30-year war, where only the insight to separate state and religion created peace and prosperity. (Daniela Neuenfeld-Zvolsky) The Islamic scientist and journalist of the "FAZ" presents the phenomenon of Islamic state in the context of the collapse of state structures and the resulting power vacuum in the Middle East. This approach is not new, but is described here in a very vivid and compact form and analyzed. In particular, the comparison with "stable" states such as Tunisia and Egypt or the Gulf region and the decaying states of Syria and Iraq, in which the IS is largely the dominant actor, are illuminating. The IS as a new form of totalitarian ideology is not based on terror alone, but offers identity and a "state replacement" with half-functioning structures. Herrmann's well-founded prediction is that "the Lord is still interested in the age of the century."
content.title_en: Islamic State End Station? : State Failure and Religious War in the Arab World

content.text: Environmental Microbiology. This book addresses the global and local environmental problems and the involvement of microorganisms in the development and elimination of these problems.
content.title_en: Environmental Microbiology

content.text: The third industrial revolution: the future of the economy after the nuclear age. After the upheavals in the Arab world and the nuclear disaster of Japan, it is clear that we need a turning away from fossil energies and nuclear power cannot be turned into a turning point. Chancellor Merkel wants to transform Germany into a green energy country, but the exit from nuclear energy has its price for citizens, companies and politics. It will change the foundations of society. Even today, entire districts are being created day after day, in which a new era of mobility, housing, education and energy production becomes reality - and Jeremy Rifkin is its chief planner. He reports on the meetings with the top managers of large corporations such as IBM, Siemens, EnBW, Daimler and takes the reader to the backrooms of top politicians such as Angela Merkel, David Cameron and Romano Prodi, where he tirelessly enters for a new world.
content.title_en: The Third Industrial Revolution: the Future of the Economy after the Nuclear Age

content.text: Internet of Things: via smart objects, intelligent environments and the technical penetration of the world. The Internet of Things will be praised as a new stage of digitisation and the future of our computer-supported world access: Invisible, smart, miniaturized and ubiquitous gadgets and devices are intended to permeate our everyday lives. The networking of things through chips, tags and sensors transforms our relationship to technology and gives things a new place in the world. This volume brings together first translations of paradigmatic English texts as well as current analyses of German-speaking authors and provides an overview of the current state of discussion on history, epistemology, techniques and applications of the Internet of Things. With contributions by Natascha Adamowsky, John Seely Brown, Mercedes Bunz, Ian Bogost, Ina Bolinski, Keller Easterling, Christoph Engemann, Jennifer Gabrys, Sebastian Gießmann, Kai Hofmann, Gerrit Hornung, Sabina Jeschke, Timo Kaerlein, Linus Neumann, Jussi Parikka, Stefan Rierö, and Weißmann
content.title_en: Internet of Things: smart objects, smart environments and the technical penetration of the world

content.text: The book provides an overview of the current state of research on both topics. The current spatial sociology complements the current concepts of urban sociology and presents them with the most important representatives, concepts and application areas. An Empirie part and tips for students round off the whole process. An urgently necessary contemporary and "classic" city introduction
content.title_en: Introduction to urban and spatial sociology

content.text: The free trade lie: why TTIP only benefits the corporations - and harms us all. In Germany and Europe, resistance to the planned TTIP free trade agreement is growing. Thilo Bode describes vividly and with analytical sharpness how TTIP threatens consumer rights and environmental standards. The corporations threaten to determine our future – stronger workers and consumer rights depend on their mercy as well as an effective environmental protection. This must be prevented with all the power. Thilo Bode shows what is happening during the secret negotiations between the European Union and the USA and what is at stake for us all. "Thilo Bode describes the context, i.e. the elimination of parliamentary opinion formation, the negotiation by lobbyists and the intention to establish a parallel justice for investors. TTIP continues the neoliberal policy unmistakeably, the deregulation/privatization threatens on grown municipal services such as water supply, public passenger traffic, social services and hospitals – processes that are partially implemented... The TTIP continues to provide detailed information on the resistance to ThiloIP (the German newspaper "Thilo-Tübe").
content.title_en: The Free Trade Litigation: Why TTIP only benefits the corporations - and harms us all

content.text: Scientifically working with Excel: [from Excel 2000 to Excel 2003]. The daily guide for working with Excel for students: It guides students through typical tasks that occur in thesis and dissertations. Systematics help to look up. Using the example of a company analysis and a data collection, the mathematical possibilities of Excel are shown in practice. The results are illustrated by diagrams.
content.title_en: Scientifically working with Excel: [from Excel 2000 to Excel 2003]

content.text: Social responsibility in the digitally networked world. "The Forum Computer scientists for Peace and Social Responsibility (FIfF) has been working on the interactions between computer science and society for 30 years. This anniversary volume with a series of contributions by well-known authors takes a look at a range of current and explosive topics ranging from surveillance and data protection, armor and computer science, computer science and gender, responsibility and fairness in computer science to creative work and intangible goods."
content.title_en: Social responsibility in the digitally networked world

content.text: My introduction to sociology: 15 lectures in free speech. In his last lecture, held in the summer of 2000 at Kiel's Christian-Albrechts-Universität, sociologist Lars Clausen (1935 - 2010) gave an unusual introduction to sociology. Following his own biography, he tells very personally about the emergence and development of a - his - social-theoretical thinking. He spans the arc of ancient protosociology about the foundation of the subject by Ferdinand Tönnies, the further development by Georg Simmel and Max Weber, the paths of German sociology in the "Third Reich", towards the innovations of post-war, the emergence of development country sociology, system theory, ethno- and catastrophe sociology. (I. Müller-Boysen) In his last lecture, held in the summer of 2000, at Kiel's Christian-Albrechts-Universität, the sociologist Lars Clausen (1935 - 2010) gave an unusual introduction to sociology along his own biography. (I. Müller-Boysen)
content.title_en: My Introduction to Sociology : 15 Lectures in Free Speech

content.text: Operating systems : Basics, concepts, system programming. This textbook provides students of computer science with the basics of operating system theory. In addition to the principles, their use is also discussed in system-related programming. (3)
content.title_en: Operating systems : basics, concepts, system programming

content.text: From the preface: This book on the chemistry of transuranics wants to overcome a "communication barrier": it wants to explain what is a chemical element, what benefits it has to deal with as a chemist and what moves science to invest so much time and money in the effort to continuously increase the number of natural elements by producing artificial elements? After authors and editors of this experiment dared to do this in a series of broadcasts for West German television, they now present it in book form.
content.title_en: Elements from the Retort

content.text: Energy! : discover what moves the world. The powerful energy provider RWE makes it possible and clarifies in the trendy form of the knowledge adventure young people between 10 and 15 years old on almost all topics around the complex energy. And this in 2 complementary ways in line with target groups: As a framework serves a comic story around the pupils Nestor and Polly, which is introduced by the "spirit" celebrity (from Prometheus, the fire carrier) by time travel into the history of energy use. Parallel to this then the non-fiction book part, in which detailed background information is appealing, understandable and age-wise represented: from the physical foundations over the use of the various energy sources throughout the history of humanity to the topics of renewable energies. To whom "RWE" seems suspicious, must rethink: Always, also with regard to nuclear power plants, the arguments pro and contra respectively the chances and limits of the controversial like of the alternative energy forms are named; and from Group-PR no trace. - Given the fact that there is hardly a comprehensive overview: always, also with regard to the topic of energy, the subject matter of detailed information is recommended to all.
content.title_en: Energy! : discover what moves the world

content.text: Small art history of the German city in the Middle Ages. In the present presentation, places will be treated as cities when at least export-oriented production, trade and a central function are recognizable. With cities created according to the same layout only the thus specified scope in the further the emergence of a nevertheless different individual city image in the tear up possible.
content.title_en: Small art history of the German city in the Middle Ages

content.text: A little more brain, please : an invitation to rediscover the joy of one's own thinking and the desire for common form. The end of collectivism came faster than expected. But also the individualism of the Western world has not proved to be a sustainable model of society. Apparently, people need both: individual freedom and social inclusion
content.title_en: A little more brain, please : an invitation to rediscover the joy of one's own thinking and the desire to form together

content.text: Very interesting electronic projects with Scratch, Arduino and Raspberry Pi: [learning to program with Scratch playfully; building great things with Arduino & Raspberry Pi yourself; understanding electronics easily]. Introduction to programming electronic crafting, created with Arduino and Raspberry Pi using the educational visual programming language Scratch. (Klaus Barckow) The author of this book is known by books that beginners use with many examples using the single-platinum computer Raspberry Pi, also in conjunction with the physical computing platform Arduino, introduced into electronic crafting (ID-A 34/14; 33/13). He now resumes this topic, using the pedagogically oriented visual programming language Scratch to program, thus avoiding that beginners in the discussion with text-based electronic code lose the desire to program. The projects start with the very simple control of an amplifying system and increase to the construction of a sound machine and a customized robot. In addition to the basic programming, the Beow-playing is explained in terms of the basic text.
content.title_en: Fascinating electronic projects with Scratch, Arduino and Raspberry Pi : [learning to program with Scratch; building great things yourself with Arduino & Raspberry Pi; understanding electronics easily]

content.text: The end of the times: Apocalyptic and the turn of the millennium. Religious, historical and cultural conditions and backgrounds of apocalyptic end-time beliefs from antiquity to the present are discussed in this particularly current presentation in the near turn of the millennium. From the revelation of John to the idea of a millennium empire to the Japanese aumsect and the Davidians in the USA, numerous "millenarian" movements and their partly curious, partly frightening thoughts are dealt with. The work of the English theologian and journalist is not a cheap sensation shasher, but a careful work, which also contains revealing material about new Christian sects. Thematically more comprehensive than H. Schwartz: "Zeitenwende - Weltende?" (ID 1/93) and for the discussion of the topic a solid basis for serious interested parties. (2) (Erdmann Steinmetz)
content.title_en: The End of Times : Apocalyptic and the Millennium
