content.text: Pioneers in architecture: a history of modern architecture. The author examines the history of the first female architects in Germany, their work, which was created between 1907 and 1949, and his tradition. From the struggle for admission to study and the discussions whether women were at all suitable for the profession, the study, whose focus is Berlin, leads to the dawn of modernity and shows that women were also part of the avant-garde at that time and made an important contribution to the reform movements. National socialism, war and the first reconstruction plans end the time of these pioneers.
content.title_en: Pioneers in architecture: a history of modern construction

content.text: The decision: Capitalism vs. Climate. In her new book, the well-known Canadian critic of globalization argues that climate protection fails on capitalism and can only help a radical turning away from neoliberal economic ideology. It sets out the catastrophic consequences of climate change for our civilization very drastically if nothing decisive is still done. She hopes for a mass movement "from below", only through this can the catastrophe be averted. A provocative title with broad media echo. Spiegel-Bestseller KW 13 place 17. (I. Müller-Boysen) Provocative and drastic, the critic of globalization presents her thesis of the fatal connection between climate protection and capitalism and her hope for a mass movement from below to the averting of the threatening climate catastrophe. (I. Müller-Boysen)
content.title_en: The Decision : Capitalism vs. Climate

content.text: The subject of "social diversity": encounters between science and practice. The coexistence of social diversity is a multifaceted topic and requires transdisciplinary reflection on how social habitats can be designed that exclude anyone from the study of gender, origin, age or sexual orientation. The book deals with studies of the research focus >>Heterogeneity and cohesion<< University of Graz with impulses from social, political and artistic practice. The results of the reflection process provide insight into different dimensions of diversity and allow to reflect on the possibilities of transdisciplinary work.
content.title_en: Tension field "Societal diversity" : encounters between science and practice

content.text: The Koran and the genealogy of Islam. "For a long time, it had been believed in the West that between religion, society and state in the epoch of European enlightenment an agreement was found. This security has been shaken in the past decades. In the name of 'of' Islam terrorist attacks are being carried out and wars are being waged. Many people perceive 'of' Islam as a religion that does not distinguish between religion and civil society and endangers the state of peace. But is there ever 'of' Islam or 'the' Koran? Islam is often reduced in a problematic simplification to the Koran and the Prophet Mu?ammad. From this the short conclusion is drawn, Islam can be defined from this origin. Against this ahistorical originality and the stereotypes associated with it to 'the' Islam and 'the' Koran, Reinhard Schulze attacks the story. He pursues in his learned and analytically precise study the history of the origin of the Scripture Koran over its linguistic apprehension (the Arabic) and intertexts; looks at the revelation to Mu?ammad from a historical perspective and reflects - not least - of the pre-biologicalism of the 19th century, and the pre-question of the discourse of the Koran and the doctrine of the doctrine.
content.title_en: The Koran and the genealogy of Islam

content.text: Preventing eating disorders effectively: the programs PriMa, TOPP and Torera for the prevention of anorexia, bulimia, eating attacks and obesity. The focus of the discussion about the misdevelopments of eating and movement behavior are skinny TV stars and models. Less "visible", though more often, are bulimia and eating attacks. Even less known is that a quarter of the 12-year-old girls already show pre-forms of eating disorders. The rate of pathological obesity (adipositas) has doubled in the last 15 years with boys and girls. In order to counteract these developments, the programs "PriMa", "TOPP" and "Torera" for girls and boys from the 6th grade were developed at the University Hospital Jena in cooperation with the Thuringian Ministry of Culture and Culture, and successfully tested and evaluated at over 50 schools.
content.title_en: Preventing eating disorders effectively : the programs PriMa, TOPP and Torera for the prevention of anorexia, bulimia, eating attacks and obesity

content.text: Android 5: Apps develop with Android Studio. Introduction to app development for mobile devices under Android 5. The new features associated with release 5.1 are also taken into account. (LK/HB: Isigkeit) Android has become the market leader among mobile device platforms. With Android 5.1, a new release has been available since March on the basis of which Künneth has updated its proven introduction once again (ID-B 37/12). Since Lollipop (from version 5.0.x onwards) brings a number of innovations (including 64-bit capability), the differences in pre-release are quite clear. Although the 5-part structure has been preserved, the content has been revised and expanded in almost all chapters (183 pages more). Let's go with an introduction to the new development environment (Android Studio), which explains installation and usage. The numerous example projects cover further innovations (including the interfaces Camera2 API or the Job Scheduler API). A completely new chapter is devoted to apps for the smartwatch. Each chapter now ends with a summary and some black-and-white app.
content.title_en: Android 5: Developing apps with Android Studio

content.text: The identity of a city has a major influence on the well-being of the people in it. City identity always has to do with perception, but also with aesthetic awareness. It is about experiencing, but also about designing urban space of space for our lives. As a result, city identity changes constantly and always, but not by itself. On the contrary: it has to be repeatedly re-wrote with its present significance for citizens and visitors. There is no responsible office for the mental well-being in the city. Instead, paths and concepts of identity development develop in various places. In the book City Identity of the Future - How cities make us happy, well-known authors show the importance of city identity in very different disciplines, how it can be used and, above all, how it can be further developed for our living future.
content.title_en: City identity of the future : how cities make us happy

content.text: The struggle of cultures: the redesign of world politics in the 21st century. The American political scientist interprets world politics after the end of the Cold War and designs a model of interpretation for global development. Cultural identities are defining forces, no longer economic, military power or ideologies. Huntington draws 7 cultural circles with the respective nuclear states with material. Conflict-prone are already the fault lines between cultures. He shows the need to renounce universalism, accept differences and seek common ground. He strongly advocates the cooperation of North America with Europe in order to protect the Western cultural circle. A book that contributes much to the orientation in the global scene. (2) (Klaus Hohlfeld)
content.title_en: The Struggle of Cultures: the Redesign of World Politics in the 21st Century

content.text: The future of rural areas: developments and innovations in peripheral regions of north-east Germany. Peripheral rural areas are facing increasing population migration and ageing as well as economic stagnation. At the same time, however, the demand for natural resources of rural areas is increasing, which is expressed, for example, in rising prices for land area and agricultural raw materials, but also in the growing appreciation of environmental services. The book, following an introduction to the development dynamics of rural areas, is developing scenarios for land use that are more oriented to social demand and values than previously. The research report, prepared by the interdisciplinary working group LandInnovation of the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences, focuses on five possible fields of innovation for future-oriented land use, which are developed exemplarily for the rural areas of north-east Germany, but also relevant to other peripheral regions: the energetic and material use of renewable raw materials, livestock farming in site-adapted intensities, the cultivation of plants with novel characteristics, quality of life and infrastructure in the areas of mobility, education, health and care and the construction of markets for ecological services.
content.title_en: The future of rural areas: developments and innovations in peripheral regions of North-East Germany

content.text: Iraq : a state decays; backgrounds, analyses, reports. According to readers about Libya (titles respectively "Libya", BA 5/10, and ID-G 49/11) and Syria (ID-G 20/13), the predominantly Austrian team of scientists is now studying Iraq. The authors investigate various aspects in their contributions: Inner-Iraq are these ethnic groups, cultures and religions in the country, modern history and here in particular the political role of oil, the 2nd Gulf War and its consequences up to the occupation. Furthermore, political, economic and sociological questions concerning the regional Greater Region are also examined. Like the previous volumes, this collection also contains sound scientific contributions, partly on very special topics; by the structure of the collection volume not chronologically, not comprehensive. (3) Readers of a predominantly Austrian team of scientists on various political, sociological, historical and economic issues concerning Iraq. (Elisabeth Mair-Gummermann)
content.title_en: Iraq : a state is falling apart ; backgrounds, analyses, reports

content.text: Tone minerals and clays : Structure, properties, applications and use in industry and environment. The first part of the book describes the clay minerals in detail and their reactions (ion exchange, swelling, colloidal dispersions, interaction with all kinds of organic compounds including polymers). The main part contains the behaviour of clay minerals in soils and the various uses in geotechnics and all possible sectors of industry. In these chapters, information on the binding of toxic substances and pesticides and the use as sealing materials is also available. The book addresses the scientists, technicians and engineers who work in practice with clays and examine their use and the students of relevant fields of study. The practical use of clays and possible applications are mainly addressed. (www.booklooker.de Publisherstext 10.08.2012)
content.title_en: Ton minerals and clays : structure, properties, applications and use in industry and environment

content.text: The book decides on the promotion of anxiety and anxiety disorders. Aggressive, violent children or those with attention and hyperactivity disorders have so far received broad attention as disruptors in educational fields of action. Fear and anxiety in children are equally widespread in educational practice and cause significant problems. Here, teachers need basic knowledge to identify the initiation or consolidation of such disorders, to take specific professional assistance, but also to contribute their pedagogical part to the work on the disorders. In the first part, the book provides basic information on the ways of appearance, dissemination and explanation of fears, anxiety and anxiety disorders. In the second, action-oriented part of the book, possibilities for pedagogical diagnosis are discussed and approaches of prevention as well as possibilities, concepts and concrete approaches of educational promotion are presented.
content.title_en: Promoting anxiety and anxiety disorders

content.text: Volcano winter 1816 : the world in the shadow of the Tambora. The eruption of the Indonesian volcano Tambora 1815 led to a global cooling and extreme weather conditions in many parts of the world: failures, famines, pandemics and social unrest. It becomes very clear how dependent mankind is on the climate and what threat climate change poses today. It is highly recommended. (2) The eruption of the Indonesian volcano Tambora 1815 led to a global cooling and weather extremes in many parts of the world catastrophic consequences: failures, famines, pandemics and social unrest. (Ingrid Rall-Haiss)
content.title_en: Volcano winter 1816 : the world in the shadow of Tambora

content.text: Mathematics for beginners: Pre- and bridge course at the beginning of the course. Introduction for beginners of mathematics. With numerous tasks and solutions. Review (ekz): In addition to G. Walz: "Bridge course mathematics" there is another proven and also recommended preparatory course in revised and supplemented edition for good accessibility (last 2nd edition: "humorous and in all-time fleeting style written, well built, rich and inexpensive). Where Walz comes to the point, Fritzsche chooses a quote as an entry into each chapter, introduces historical references or changes the information density, in order to explain in so-called "clartext"-inputs difficult terms and methods even more in detail. With numerous new illustrations and exercises (solutions now on the author's homepage). For preparation for a mathematical-natural studies and as accompanying reading during the first semester, gladly recommended next to the above mentioned, comparable title of G. Walz: "Bridge course mathematics mathematics
content.title_en: Mathematics for beginners : Pre- and bridge course at the beginning of the study

content.text: If time stops: small psychology of border experiences. In exceptional states of consciousness - in meditation, in drug rush, in states of fear and happiness, in near death experiences or in frightening customers - time consciousness is greatly changed. These border experiences were difficult to access for a long time; however, for some years scientists have succeeded in capturing them with exact methods. Wittmann (cf. his report on our dealings with time, ID-A 34/12) describes these neuroscientific and psychological experiments as well as the conceptual findings now in detail and with numerous scientific evidence. They suggest for him that time experience, ego experience, body signals and feelings are closely related to each other; e.g., boredom felt stretches the time and makes it depressive. The report reads itself quite understandable for lay people, but is particularly illustrative when it quotes plastic signs of such border experiences from writers and philosophers.
content.title_en: When time stops : small psychology of border experiences

content.text: Geniusally protected: sophisticated packaging in nature. Overview of various "packagings", e.g. coconut, cell membrane, atmosphere, which are found in nature and partly imitated by man; with many photos and pictures Whether tree bark or egg shell, plant pollen or seed capsules, bee honeycomb or earth crust: Nature is an ingenious inventor when it comes to protecting herself. Many of these packagings of nature are amazing biological masterpieces, whose construction has been researched and imitated by industry for some time. With this great illustrated volume, the authors invite you to discover and marvel. They make curious about seemingly everyday things and give insights into unknown, often overlooked structures.
content.title_en: Genially protected : refined packaging in nature

content.text: Photoshop Elements 10 for digital photos. Understandable introduction to the software with workshops for fast and easy editing, administration and output of digital photos. On the included DVD you will find a trial version of Elements 10 for Windows/Mac, sample photos and video lessons. (LK/MZ: Steiner) In the slightly revised reissue of its proven textbook, R. Klassen offers a very easy to understand introduction to Photoshop Elements (pre-release: ID-A 2/11, under the title "Initiation in Photoshop Elements 9"). The book has remained unchanged from the structure, the detail improvements that Elements 10 offers (extended search functions, some new effects and assistants) have been incorporated. As always, on the DVD supplement the sample photos, test versions for Windows and Mac and some video lessons from the corresponding Galileo video training of the author (ID-A 4/12). Furthermore, a solid and practical textbook with many workshops, which makes the first steps with Elements 10 easy - compared to the pre-release version also recommended. The 5K should be replaced with a cheaper version.
content.title_en: Photoshop Elements 10 for digital photos

content.text: Requirements management in product development: Reduce complexity, optimize processes, and ensure quality. "The authors show how to systematically analyze and manage customer requirements in product development in this book. The processes presented here focus on reducing complexity in product development and optimising innovation processes. The focus is on the claim to ensure cost-effectiveness and quality at a high level. Current examples from the aviation, automotive and software development industries make this volume a valuable guide for product developers, engineers and innovation managers."--
content.title_en: Requirements management in product development: reduce complexity, optimize processes, ensure quality

content.text: Geoinformatics. The volume provides a compact overview of concepts and processes in geoinformatics and shows the entire process of processing geoinformation - from collection, administration and analysis to presentation. In addition to the basics, the authors also present the diverse application possibilities of geoinformatics.
content.title_en: Geoinformatics

content.text: The second machine age: how the next digital revolution will change our lives. For years we have been working with computers and computers for us. Meanwhile, the machines have become so intelligent that they are capable of achievements that were unthinkable recently: they drive cars, write their own texts and defeat Grandmasters in chess. This leap in development is only the beginning. In their new book, two renowned professors show what breathtaking developments are still ahead: The second industrial revolution is coming!
content.title_en: The second machine age: how the next digital revolution will change our lives

content.text: Farming, men's, prefabricated houses : house research as social history : a gift of friendship for Thomas Spohn for the 65th birthday. House research as social history - in almost inexhaustible productivity the house researcher and monument keeper Thomas Spohn has been conducting research with this comprehensive scientific claim for decades. His publications and discussion contributions, whether it be studies on certain architectural details or the framework conditions of historical construction, whether it be house and site monographs or fundamental analyses of structural phenomena, have inspired a multitude of scientists to think further and discuss. - - This volume, written on the occasion of his 65th birthday by 20 colleagues, professional companions, students and students, appreciates the extraordinary performance of Thomas Spohn with a journey through the construction and architectural history of North and West Germany. Spatially, this volume goes from the island of Rügen to the North Frisian islands and the Elbe marches through Lower Saxony to Westphalia and the Rhineland, with a side trip to the neighbouring Netherlands. The tour starts in the 18th century and ends in the present day, the mill-like-men- and workers- reflect on the mill-houses- and the mill-men-houses-are-are-are-are-are--are---are--are-----------are-are-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
content.title_en: Farm, man-made houses : House research as social history : a gift of friendship for Thomas Spohn for his 65th birthday

content.text: Enzymes : Structure, kinetics and applications. The knowledge about enzymes, which are among the most effective substances, has increased extremely. According to the author's experience (Professor of Biochemistry) enzyme kinetics is one of the "traditional fear subjects of the students of the natural sciences". This intelligibly written and nevertheless sufficiently in depth textbook is intended to take this fear especially students of the natural sciences with main and secondary subject biochemistry. Numerous vivid, elaborately designed colored illustrations (diagrams, experimental arrangements, structural formulas and reaction mechanisms) accompany the entire teaching material. At the end of each chapter there is a list of further literature as well as on the publishing website useful additional material (including 8 content-rich PowerPoint animations)
content.title_en: Enzymes : Structure, kinetics and applications

content.text: Crime prevention - Right-wing extremism, anti-Semitism, xenophobia. "The Infopool Prevention of the Federal Criminal Office is an information collection on national and international prevention actors, activities, projects and models, which began in November 1995. The objectives of the Infopool Prevention are, among other things, to identify developments, focus on but also shortcomings in the field of crime prevention, to identify relevant topics for prevention-related research including the initiation and implementation of research projects. The Infopool Prevention is also to be understood as an offer for a forum for the national and international exchange of experiences between police and other actors of crime prevention. Imitational prevention projects are regularly published in the form of a 'country-bund project collection' or thematic special volumes. This volume was prepared on the occasion of the working day of the Federal Criminal Office in November 2000 on the subject of 'Right-wing sexism - Anti-Semitism - Xenophobia', in order to show the diverse approaches and possibilities of the preventive crime fight against this topic. (Author's abstract).
content.title_en: Crime prevention - right-wing extremism, anti-Semitism, xenophobia

content.text: Packaging is seduction: decryption of the packaging code. This book explains how you systematically design the packaging to access customers. The author shows you the effective way to the attractive case that charges your products with importance and inspires sales success in the trade. Packs are designed to increase the attractiveness of products, signal the rational and emotional benefits and seduce you to purchase. However, the average viewer uses only a few seconds to perceive a package and make a purchase decision. Seconds in which the product must convince. Discover the possibilities of the different packaging codes and use the potential. Known examples from the consumer goods and food industry illustrate the increase in value that can be achieved with the right package. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Packaging is seduction : decryption of the packaging code

content.text: The author, born and raised in Rostock, is now Professor of Sociology at the University of Bremen. Mau first travels around his subject. What is the middle class? Who is part of it? What happens when the middle class erodes (there are dangers for democracy and social cohesion)? Then the author diagnoses its shrinking and the growing threats to which the middle class is exposed: globalization and flexibilization of the labour market, withdrawal of the (welfare) state, a lag behind the top and constipated rise channels, danger of precarization and fear of social descent. Inspired by R. Dahrendorf, the author develops at the end with the model of "life chance credit" a counter-project that combines ascension opportunities, flexibility and security ("flexicurity") in an original way. The representation, which is also developed from an East German perspective, offers an excitingly written, committed, differentiated and very readable social diagnosis with important thinking instincts (2).
content.title_en: Life chances: where does the middle class drift?

content.text: Ludwigshöhe: Roman. The three siblings Berg - Clarissa, Monika and Ulrich - make a tricky legacy. Their uncle Robert considers them with enormous and widely branched assets, especially with a villa on Lake Starnberg. All this could liberate them at one stroke from their tiring, not necessarily promising struggle for existence. But he makes them a condition: they have to run this house as a shelter and refuge for life fatigue and also have some useful utensil ready for them; not only a legal ridge hike. Full of scruples and fears, but also keenly on the inheritance open the villa at Ludwigshöhe for a steadily growing number of "finarists". There find herself a desperate seller beside the stage designer with certain physical deficits, a burned-out teacher beside an united actress, a drug-dependent widow next to the love-sick Domina, a bankrott publisher, but also a 17-year-old Syrian immanitin, who is afraid to become victims of an honorary murder. While the sisters do not fill the cold-shocked and the old house with more practical conversations.
content.title_en: Ludwigshöhe : Roman

content.text: Augmented Reality (AR) is a virtually expanded reality that complements human perception. In addition to artificial intelligence, it is considered one of the most promising areas of innovation in information technology, especially in terms of 3-D glasses, smartphones and tablets. D. Schart and N. Tchanz are less concerned with technical aspects than with the potential in marketing and digital communication. Accordingly, the examples of product presentation, trade fair appearance, promotions or location-related services are detailed. Via Wikitude and youtube, AR content is directly linked to the book for trying out. The authors also present the conceptual steps and project management for a successful own AR application. The book is aimed at practitioners and decision-makers from advertising and public relations. It is also interesting for a wider audience as well as for a wider audience, because of the lack of new, German-language collections as alternatives. (2)
content.title_en: Augmented Reality Practice Guide : for Marketing, Media and Public Relations

content.text: The introduction outlines the abilities of children, presents methodological backgrounds of interviews (and group discussions) and provides tips for planning and conducting interviews with children. The book »Interviews with children lead« provides a practical guide for planning and conducting interviews with children. From a multidisciplinary perspective, verbal, cognitive and interactive skills of children are outlined in their development, methodological backgrounds of interviews are presented and implications for the use of interviews with children are shown. The aim is to provide knowledge about the prerequisites for the interviewing of children in order to make informed and well-founded decisions for the respective research project in all phases of the empirical research process.
content.title_en: Interviews with children : a practical introduction

content.text: Gendoping : Scientific basics - Ingenuity gates - Control. Like a phantom, "Gendoping" has been haunting the debates on the future of competitive sport for years. Often, corresponding fantasies and visions culminate in the image of superathletes who are permanently manipulated in their genetic equipment. However, the expected application scenarios will be much less spectacular but more likely and nearer. One will soon have to expect a use of new substances as well as gene and cell therapeutic methods for the targeted manipulation of gene activity. Their use promises a highly efficient performance increase and will, if at all, be difficult to prove. This volume comprehensively answers the key questions of further development: Which scientific results could be used for possible gendoping, where will ingenuity gates be in top and broad sports, and how can they be reacted by means of prohibition and control structures?
content.title_en: Gendoping : Scientific foundations - Inventors - Control

content.text: Urban security comprises a wide variety of tasks. A large number of actors are involved in the creation and preservation of safe cities. Security is basically a state task. For many citizens and thus also in public discussion, however, the cities and municipalities are the first contact persons when it comes to maladministration. Integrated approaches to municipal security policy are linked with the involvement of a large number of actors in the local administration from the municipal planning office to the youth office and beyond the administration.
content.title_en: Urban safety: framework conditions, practical examples, international experiences

content.text: The trained ear: a cultural history of sonification. How does the human body sound? Like a circular motor - or like an undersea object? Acoustic media not only allow for the storage and transmission of sounds. They also allow the supposedly silent phenomena to be heard. The fourth volume of the "Sound Studies" is dedicated to the question: How do new scientific findings and aesthetic forms emerge through trained ears and acoustic representation? The publishers thus present a first comprehensive cultural history of sonification in German language.
content.title_en: The trained ear : a cultural history of sonification

content.text: Digital transformation: why the German economy is drowsy and what needs to be done now! The author describes in his book the impact of digital media on the economy and how it can be used. From marketing to products, to the digitization of application procedures and the new working world, Tim Cole already gives an outlook on the further changes in the future. He also integrates the reader with questions at the end of each chapter and explains areas that have already been modernised in the digital age. But he also criticizes areas in which he still sees potential in digital development. His perspective is strongly focused on the German economy. A book that is recommended for all those who are concerned with business and digital media. (2)
content.title_en: Digital transformation: why the German economy is drowsy and what needs to be done now!

content.text: Fear is a force: about the active and creative handling of everyday fears. "Completely revised re-issue of the standard work.- Based on his long-standing experience as a psychotherapist and scientific findings, Willi Butollo explains different fear triggers and the ongoing psychological processes using case examples and offers deep-reaching solutions for people suffering from fears, phobias and panic attacks. This enables a positive influence and coping of fear through more attention, insight and authenticity." www.botello.de
content.title_en: Fear is a force: about the active and creative handling of everyday fears

content.text: Time : what she does with us and what we do with her. A book about life: what does time do with us? And what do we do with her? Rüdiger Safranski encourages us to regain the wealth of time experience. Beyond the clocks that give us an objective amount of time, we experience time quite differently: in boredom, in dedication, in sorrow, in view of the end, strictly divided into music and loosely filled with play. And again differently in the social timing transmission, in the accelerated economic world, in the media, in the global simultaneity. Safranski describes in many facets the tension between passing and perseverance and encourages us to deal attentively with this valuable property.
content.title_en: Time : what she does to us and what we do to her

content.text: Successful research - political and social sciences. The volume Successful researched political and social sciences provides a comprehensive overview of the information resources in all areas of political and social sciences. The volume is presented not only by the central research instruments such as library catalogues, specialist bibliographies, internet search engines, essay databases, full text offers and statistical data collections, but also strategies for successful literature and information research. The volume is rounded off by hints on literature procurement and administration as well as for correct citation. Whether for the first paper or the final thesis - here you get a competent guide for successful political and social research. (publishing) The volume Successfully researched political and social sciences provides a comprehensive overview of the information resources of the subject political and social sciences. Here you can learn in a short time all important about the library catalogues, subject bibliographies, internet search machines, journal literature and reference books, and how to use the library effectively, digital and virtual. Whether for the first paper or the doctoral thesis, the reader gets a competently competently research guide for the research.
content.title_en: Successful research - Political and Social Sciences

content.text: University of Applied Sciences and Humanities: Theoretical approaches and empirical inventory. The contributions gathered here provide a basic inventory of theoretical and empirical work on diversity at universities. The focus is on the barriers to access and exclusion mechanisms due to social origin, gender, disability, migration, sexual orientation, world view and age of the various status groups. Desiderates in research on diversity and university are named as well as research problems in the approach to these topics. Content: Heitzmann, Daniela/Klein, Uta: Access barriers and exclusion mechanisms at German universities. - Metz-Göckel, Sigrid: Theoretical sketches of the university in the knowledge society. - Dobusch, Laura/Hofbauer, Johanna/Kreissl, Katharina: Disability and University. Inequality and interdependence theory approaches to the explanation of exclusion practice. - Rothmüller, Barbara: Social barriers in the access to an artistic study. Conception and results of an empirical study in anti-criminatory intention. - Bellenttöger, Ilke: Introspective for High Levels.
content.title_en: University and Diversity : theoretical approaches and empirical inventory

content.text: Sociologist Martina Löw has presented a fundamental foundation for a sociology of space. It is the emergence of space a social phenomenon and therefore only from the social developments to be understood as a process-like phenomenon. Therefore, Ms Löw understands space as a synthesis of social goods, people and places as well as as as a spacing by placing those goods, people and places in the process of building. Naturally, the constitution of space in everyday life often takes place through routines which disguised and institutionally invisible the peculiarity of space. In contrast, the newly debated sociology of space is to take up the task of acting on this. So far, a majority of sociological theories have cultivated an absolutistic concept of space, which only reflects the euclidian geometry as a reference system. Frau Löw, on the other hand, designs a process-based concept of space, in which space is no longer understood as a rigid background.
content.title_en: Space sociology

content.text: The book of the same name documents the series of lectures conducted at the Technical University of Graz in the summer semester 1991. Women who study at a technical university or are employed in technical professions still have the status of exotic women. The fact that women are underrepresented in technical fields is not only historically conditioned, but also a consequence of the power structures in our society. The authors of this volume investigate the causes and backgrounds of this phenomenon in their contributions and try to show solutions and perspectives. From the content: Sheikh, Elvira: The Two Genders in Natural Science: Ideology, Objectivity, Relationship. - List, Elisabeth: What is "natural"? Theory production and gender politics using the example of sociobiology. - Maurer, Margarete: On the patriarchal character of natural sciences and the possibilities of feminist alternatives - Using the example of bioscience. - Erlemann, Christiane: Frauenforschung in Naturwissenschaft und Technik. - Buber-Schwab, Renate: Frauenforschung und feministischen Wissenschaft an aus Österreichischen Universitäten - Betreichung.
content.title_en: Women in science and technology

content.text: Quantitative research : a practical course. All prospective social scientists need basic knowledge and practice-oriented practice in the methods of quantitative social research. This application-oriented textbook introduces the necessary steps into the basic questions of empirical social research and explains the research process at all stages of its development. The focus is on social science practice, the analysis and translation of data with SPSS.
content.title_en: Quantitative research : a practical course

content.text: A strange feeling or change about a German: novel. In her virtuoso novel, the American author (Jg. 1952) who lives in Berlin combines CVs from the most diverse layers of a society that drifts apart - in the midst of German-German reunification.
content.title_en: A Foreign Feeling or Change About a German : Roman

content.text: The plural in the title shows clearly that sustainability development is only possible if a wide range of perspectives are combined. Accordingly, the textbook is divided into a methodological, scientific-technical and human scientific part before a synthesis is attempted in case studies on energy, space and municipal development. In the large number of authors, mainly from the faculty of sustainability (founded in 2010) at the University of Lüneburg, differences in the information density of the individual contributions can hardly be avoided. The chapters on ecosystems and material cycles are particularly successful. Alternative textbooks, such as "sustainability" (ID-G 41/12) or Armin Grunwald (ID-A 28/06), are strongly influenced by the humanities with less than half the scope. The unique features of the title and the broad relevance of the topic do not only suggest the acquisition of university locations where economic and political study programmes can be combined with an environmentally-oriented orientation. (2)
content.title_en: Sustainability sciences

content.text: The "taz" journalist Wolf Schmidt presents the results of his research in the militant Islamist youth scene in Germany. The author has come up with a fluidly written report, which presents biographies of individual Muslims or converted to Islam German and shows possible social, personal and family motivations for drifting away into a militant circle. The author also sheds light on sensational cases such as those of the so-called "Sauerland Group" or the assassination of US American soldiers at Frankfurt Airport in 2011. Furthermore, he goes on to fundamentalist groups such as the Salafists and the spread of Islamist ideology on the Internet. He performs his descriptions and classifications soberly, pointing out that it is about the thinking of a small minority within the Muslim community, but which has a dangerous potential. Due to his current and explosive subject matter, the title is recommended for a broad readership from medium library-sized-sized-groe. (2) For some years they have established themselves in Germany a youth-militant?
content.title_en: Young, German, Taliban

content.text: Android apps are also developed for beginners. Easy-to-reach introduction for new entrants to the development of Android apps. The creation of apps for the smartwatch is also taken into account. (LK/HB: Isigkeit) Easy-to-reach introduction to the development of Android apps. Already when the pre-release (ID-A 10/15) appeared, Android 5 had seen the light of the public, but only with this revised and updated new edition the last operating system version is taken into account. While the version change does not involve any too big changes in content, the transition from Eclipse to Android Studio has a more obvious effect. New chapter contents are available for both the installation of the development environment and an introduction to the studio application. Post has also failed to introduce some interesting apps in this new entrant introduction, 2 of them are new. Also, a chapter on the creation of apps for Android armband clocks has been added, although this is more likely to be addressed to advanced developers. Since the example chapter for marketing of self-generated apps has also received an update, a provision of this issue is worth even more than the previous version of the previous version (HID: Is/H-H-en) 32.
content.title_en: Developing Android apps for beginners

content.text: The digital education revolution: the radical change of learning and how we can shape it. In "Dichter, Denker, Schulverager" (ID-A 37/11), educational expert Dräger had already outlined "Ways from the educational crisis", now he is doing butter with the fish with colleagues Müller-Eiselt. Her credo: There is also "no stop button" in the education sector for digitization. Therefore, one must influence the development - in view of its shadows too -. The authors have changed themselves especially in the USA and generalize their findings for school and academic education. The advantages of digital education over traditional teaching forms: the simultaneous training of masses of learners around the world; the extreme individualization of content; online cooperation through networks: "WeQ instead of IQ". The authors also do not play down the dangers of big data, the revolutionary role of the teachers associated with digitalization has already been shown by the two media researchers who have influenced the wider world (U-R) on the basis of their digital education.
content.title_en: The digital educational revolution: the radical change in learning and how we can shape it

content.text: The Japanese bag : Roman. Beat Schneider has done something unforgivable that costs him his marriage to LouAnne. She is an extraordinary artist who is not only dependent on his love but also on his care. He is all the more precious to him the Japanese bag that LouAnne gave him and which he does not let out of his sight. Until he loses her too. Schneider's life, an original historian who is not interested in career, is under the special protection of his former child wife, whom he calls Alcina, and which left him a considerable legacy after her disappearance. She told him fairy tales and the dream logic of fairy tales seems to be alive in Schneider's life as well.
content.title_en: The Japanese Bag : Roman

content.text: For Germany in war : Foreign missions of the Bundeswehr and what soldiers, their relatives and German society must know about it. Foreign missions are increasingly shaping the appearance of the Bundeswehr. But what does it mean to move into war in concrete terms? How do families manage this situation? How can one deal with the issues of death and injury? What happens after an attack with the soldiers? Dietger Lather was in Kosovo himself and as commander in Afghanistan. His book is not only a practical advisor for soldiers and their relatives. He also wants to convey to a broad public what it means when German soldiers are in war on behalf of their country. The range of topics ranges from shortcomings in the equipment of the soldiers over the extraordinary case of the Colonel Klein and personal violence experiences up to considerations about a often suppressed "ethics of killing"
content.title_en: For Germany in war : foreign missions of the Bundeswehr and what soldiers, their relatives and the German society must know about

Infants out of the bounds and bands, ten-year-olds, for whom respect for parents and teachers is a foreign word, 17-year-olds who are no longer able to work - children to power? Prevent social misdevelopments and their own problems of adults, separate and structurally behave towards the child and thereby enable a normal development of their psyche. (publisher text) - Spiegel-Bestseller.
content.title_en: Why our children become tyrants : or: The abolition of childhood

content.text: The easy entry into electrical engineering & electronics: [components of electrical engineering, solar technology, power supplies, motors and generators, measuring instruments, lighting]. In this book the topics from electrical engineering prevail; the content is thus almost identical to the similar title of the author "The easy entry into electrical engineering" (BA 1/05). Only infrared diodes (2 pages) and a 15-page chapter "Digital TV technology" were added to this. The latter is completely new, the IR diodes were already included in his "... easy entry into electronics" (last BA 5/05). If the earlier title on electrical engineering is not in existence, this should be purchased, since recently except H.-J. Bauckholt (BA 3/08) and possibly also some professional customers for vocational training has not appeared anything comparable (for amateur electronics and interested in technology).
content.title_en: The easy entry into electrical engineering & electronics : [components of electrical engineering, solar technology, power supplies, motors and generators, measuring instruments, lighting]

content.text: The future of energy: the answer of science. Article collection with understandable, scientifically sound contributions to the future supply of energy, taking into account climate protection, oil shortages, fuel production. Replaces no textbook, but offers a wide range of topics with numerous suggestions. Published by the Max Planck Society. Focuses not only on the increased use of renewable energy, but also includes other energy sources (polymers, fusion power plants). With illustrations, without material register. Can be used alongside O. Prussia (ID 53/05), S. Geitmann (BA 10/04), "Renewable energy" (Wiley-VCH; BA 11/07) and others. The topic is not new, but still in demand. (3)
content.title_en: The future of energy: the answer of science

content.text: Bridges in Bavaria: history, technology, preservation of monuments. Bridges are technical structures that have to meet the natural characteristics of the material, static and artisanal conditions and meet specific requirements for use. From the simple beginnings of wood and medieval stone structures to the iron and concrete bridges of the 19th and 20th century, the spectrum that man conceived reached. Innovative constructions and building materials made it possible to overcome ever greater obstacles and carry ever greater loads. The engineering construction art at all times at the same time pursued a high design standard and created sometimes widely admired works. - The permanent preservation and proper repair of historical bridges are among the special challenges of the preservation of monuments. In addition to the clarification of the repair possibilities, this includes in particular the adaptation - modern usage requirements such as a greatly increased traffic volume. A comprehensive knowledge of the historical construction and material stock, a mapping of the damage images and an analysis of the causes of damage form the basis for each repair. - The standard solutions common in the new building and a comprehensive standard fulfillment are usually unsuitable for historical bridges.
content.title_en: Bridges in Bavaria : History, Technology, Monument conservation

content.text: The gender lie: the power of prejudice over women and men. Women are considered empathetic, caring, child-loving, sensitive; men as ambitious, competitive, analytical and aggressive. It has become almost fashion to attribute these characteristics to the different brains of women and men, as in L. Brizendine: "The female brain" (BA 4/07). The psychologist and neuroscientist Cordelia Fine (born 1975) who is researching in Australia shows that such research results often come from swindling, methodological shortcomings and inconsistencies. She points to the danger that these researches cement the gender images still prevailing in society. Based on the critical analysis of numerous studies, she makes clear how strongly gender stereotypes and social expectations - and not biology - influence thinking, even among those who are aware of it. An engaged, ambitious, popular scientific book whose reading requires an interest in scientific questions. (2)
content.title_en: The sex lie: the power of prejudice over woman and man

content.text: On the way to urban society: the multicultural city between global reorientation and restoration. Today, modern cities are under global pressure. They are the scene of comprehensive transformation processes, which are also influenced by the sustainable resistance, especially of the "old-established" population groups, but sometimes also by unsettled immigration groups. It is above all the new mobility, not least the immigration, which forces the city societies to reorganize their everyday lives and drives development.
content.title_en: On the way to the city society: the multicultural city between global reorientation and restoration

content.text: The future of the energy industry: the sun, wind, water, biomass, geothermal energy. Topics such as climate change, the scarcity of conventional energy reserves or nuclear exits are present in all media every day. The paradigm shift away from fossil, finite fuels to a sustainable energy economy is in full swing. Renewable energies play an increasingly important role here: everywhere, roofs are equipped with solar systems and wind farms are long-standing landscape images in many regions. This volume presents all usable regenerative energies from solar energy, wind and hydro power to biomass and geothermal energy in a general way. It provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of the art and shows economic and ecological aspects both in Germany and worldwide. Numerous illustrations and info boxes, example economic calculations, a register and a glossary make it easier for the reader to comprehensively inform himself about this highly topical topic. "It is not a book for the behind-the-scenes reading of the German report, but rather a reference work for those who want to know it exactly. It is perfect for the purpose of this study (dradio.de). "It is a hybrid book – a mix of energy is easy to understand, a good and a good choice for the reader to find a good for the reader to find a good and a good for the future.
content.title_en: Energy of the future : Sun, wind, water, biomass, geothermal energy

metadata.authors: Kitzing, Steffen; Duracak, Admir; Hafner, Matthias

content.text: Cities - often referred to as powerful actors and "engines of development" - are exposed to an increasingly dense network of external constraints and requirements in the context of progressive liberalisation, deregulation and privatisation and a far-reaching shift in change. These changes affect all municipal areas: from economic and social and settlement structures to political administrative organisation. At the same time, the scope for action and competences of cities are increasingly restricted, municipal policies and strategies as a result of increasing competitive pressure are increasingly determined by the mainstream of supply orientation. Are cities still powerful actors under these conditions or are they hardly more powerless than powerless actors? Can they intervene in the current challenges in a controlling and controlling manner or does it require a profound paradigm shift that involves not only the municipal level but all the relevant actors? With this change situation and the related questions, the band deals with the question in a concisssive and pointed form.
content.title_en: (Ohn-)mighty cities : in times of neoliberal globalization

content.text: This highly revised and updated pocket atlas (concept see dtv-Atlas Biology) was rated very positively by K. Bock (BA 8/94). There is nothing to change about this: textbook character (for students of the first semester, parts also suitable for Sek II students). Very good structure of the content (formulas, reaction relationships, metabolic processes, important organs etc.), strict double page layout (left text, right multi-coloured colour boards of high quality). An important title, to set priority. (2 S) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: Bag atlas of biochemistry

content.text: Refugees Welcome : Concepts for a Decent Architecture. "Based on a design project at Leibniz University Hannover, the book presents strategies for action and concrete architectural concepts for innovative and prototypical forms of living for refugees."--
content.title_en: Refugees Welcome : Concepts for a Decent Architecture

content.text: The culture of the city. Culture, not political or economic structures, distinguish the city from the country. According to Georg Simmel, it is the 'spiritual life' that makes the metropolis a special place. Walter Siebel draws on this idea. Today, according to his central thesis, two characteristics characterize the urban way of life: the relief of necessary works and the constant encounter with strangers. In his historical and theoretical monograph, Siebel designs a detailed picture of this culture of the city, traces its ambivalent developments and from this he founds the renaissance of the city and its cultural productivity.
content.title_en: The culture of the city
