content.text: The city's times and spaces: theory and practice. The structural change in the cities replaces old-fashioned time-space patterns with new ones: parents bring their children to school with their own car, while children were able to cope with these paths alone and on foot. The time conflicts and paths between family, work and leisure activities – triggered by changing lifestyles in the »Knowledge Society« – lead to new »Time rooms«. Using a series of examples (e.g. Hamburger Schanzenviertel, Bremer Stephaniviertel, Hamburger HafenCity) the authors of the book are taking a look at the change in the city.
content.title_en: Times and Spaces of the City : Theory and Practice

content.text: Child and nature: the importance of nature for psychological development. Human beings are bound to the state of nature as part of nature in the biological-material sense. Ulrich Gebhard is concerned with the psychological side of this fundamental ecological context and how it affects the development of children. To this end theoretical assumptions - especially psychoanalysis and environmental psychology - are developed and empirical findings and observations are evaluated against this background. In this updated and comprehensively revised edition, further results from over 300 new empirical studies are discussed. To illustrate how outer nature - animals, plants and landscapes - influences the inner nature of man and how an appropriate deficiency - 'inhospitable cities' and environmental destruction - affects, new topics have been added: 'nature experience and health', 'nature experience and environmental awareness' and 'natural aesthetics'.
content.title_en: Child and Nature: the importance of nature for mental development

content.text: Read cultural landscapes : Identify and understand diverse habitats. In Central Europe, landscape ecology is almost exclusively concerned with nature that is considerably remodelled by man: cultural landscape. This book also deals with the eco-profiles of secondary biotopes such as parks, railway bodies, industrial wasteland, forest and agricultural habitats as well as the eco-tons (pathways, field terrain or dams). It is largely dispensed with or explained by specialist terminology. The aim of the book is to recognize the value of the described structures and thus to awaken a certain motivation for their preservation from the reader. (2)
content.title_en: Read Cultural Landscapes : Identify and Understand a Varied Habitat

content.text: From controlled over-exploitation: how politics and economy heat up the climate, destroy nature and produce poverty. The big sustainability lies In view of the climate catastrophe, all hopes rest on the green economy, which is supposed to make the economy sustainable and social. Electric cars instead of CO2 slurry, biofuel instead of gasoline, aquaculture instead of over-fishing. Subsidized by politics, supported by environmental organizations, awarded sustainability prizes. Economic growth and excessive consumption, according to the good message of the so-called third industrial revolution, are good for the world as long as they are innovative and intelligently made. The tech-entic middle class hears this. But also the raw material hunger of green capitalism is huge: Even for sustainable palm oil, which is contained in biodiesel and finished products, rain forests are cleared and people are driven, as Kathrin Hartmann shows in stirring reports from Indonesia. Also shocking are their researches in Bangladesh: shrimps from breeding pools are exported with eco-soil, thereby against the will of the population rice fields and mangrove forests destroyed. To fight against the evil of hunger there, to the peasant.
content.title_en: From controlled over-exploitation: how politics and economy heat up the climate, destroy nature and produce poverty

content.text: From gardening in the city: the new landlust between concrete and asphalt. The author describes urban garden projects that deal with the natural foundations of our existence and require new productivity. The prerequisite is the support with advice and action by citizens, alternative organizations and administration. The variety of forms and functions is documented, among other things, in examples from Andernach, Berlin, Dresden, Göttingen, Hanover, London and Munich; Garten is redefined: "Another world is plantable." The vision is gardens in a wide variety of shapes and organizational forms that do not fit into a conventional scheme, make food experienceable, make their production more transparent, promote ecological and social awareness and mean political action in the connected world. Cultural experimentation with material, plants and soil is interspersed with corresponding background information and practical tips. Finally, 10 theses on the future of the city and gardening, urban garden projects in Germany and an commented list of literatures provide insight into the need for a change. (1)
content.title_en: From gardening in the city: the new landlust between concrete and asphalt

content.text: Environmental guide BAU : Practical manual for construction and real estate specialists. The environmental factor plays an increasing role in the construction and real estate industry. Be it due to the need for environmental investigations to clarify a possible suspicion of waste loads, whether it be through cost-intensive measures for the rehabilitation of building pollutants, it is due to increased expenditures for the disposal of contaminated earth masses. The guide Bau explains in lexical form the most important concepts relevant in practice from the areas of waste management and disposal, waste and soil protection, occupational safety and safety technology, environmental analysis, toxicology, environmental geology and process technology. The lexical structure, the general understandable concepts tailored to the target group and its professional practice as well as a variety of illustrations enable a fast initial orientation in a complex matter. (Verlagsinfo)
content.title_en: Environmental guide BAU : Practical manual for construction and real estate specialists

content.text: Convivialism : a debate. The »Convivialist Manifesto« (published in German in 2014) has re-formatted the global debate on the question of how we want to and must shape coexistence in the face of climate catastrophe and financial crises. The contributions of this volume now open the discussion about the possibilities and limits of the manifesto in German-speaking countries: Where are its strengths, where the weaknesses lie? What would be the aim of a convival society – in politics, culture, civil society and economy? What new forms of coexistence are desirable and what opportunities exist to enforce them? A book not only for social and cultural scientists, but also for civil society actors and the interested public. With contributions by Micha Brumlik, Christian Felber, Naika Foroutan, Silke Helfrich, Claus Leggewie, Stephan Lessenich, Steffen Mau, Franz Walter and Gesa Ziemer.
content.title_en: Convivialism : a debate

content.text: Memorial Pedagogy : Context, Theory and Practice of Educational Work on Nazi Crimes. Klappentext: For many years, memorials have been places of learning for the victims of Nazi crimes. This volume provides an overview of the current state of education work on site. It examines the socio-political framework conditions, introduces fundamental debates and presents the diverse educational work as well as a wide range of memorials. As a link between theory and practice, the book addresses employees of memorials, teachers in schools and extracurricular institutions as well as students.
content.title_en: Memorial Education : Context, Theory and Practice of Educational Work on Nazi Crimes

content.text: Quick start Raspberry Pi 2. Author Immler has now adapted his book to the first series of models of the popular single-platinum computer ("Quick start Raspberry Pi", not discussed here) to the current generation Raspberry Pi 2, Model B. The beginner learns easily and with the help of many photos and screenshots as well as inserted info boxes, what is needed to start, which accessories are available, how the operating system Raspbian is built, and how the Raspberry Pi can be configured and programmed (with Python and Scratch). Extensively the topic of networking including cloud services is also covered. A book that could be put together well with the current hardware on the Gabentisch. Even LibreOffice runs on the device, and it can be used as a media center. The example source codes are available for download from the Internet. A book that can be placed well together with the current hardware on the Gabentisch. More detailed information is provided by M. Kofler: "Raspberry Pi" (for review). The Predecessive version of the BK can be used in a versatile manner.
content.title_en: Quick start Raspberry Pi 2

content.text: Digital burnout: why our permanent smartphone use is dangerous. Computer science professor Markowetz provides the factual supplement to the emotionally charged warnings against the excessive use of M. Spitzer's digital media ("Digital Dementia", ID-A 35/12; "Cybersick", ID-A 47/15). Like Spitzer in his new work, Markowetz also focuses on the "Allesskönner" smartphones. With the help of his app, 300,000 participants were willing to document their usage behaviour across all ages and layers. The result: 88 times a day, the view of the display falls; every 18 minutes, work/free time is interrupted; about 2 hours a day, the smartphone steals every user - it throes the digital burn-out. What cognitive, mental and social skills are endangered by the digital continuous alarm readiness, the author describes in the example of the action fields of workplace, leisure time, happiness, children and school largely in the wake of Spitzer. As a remedy, Markowetz recommends a "digital diet": Only 3 times a day, switching to the voice in the mail.
content.title_en: Digital Burnout : Why Our Permanent Smartphone Use Is Dangerous

content.text: Manual of Marine Natural Protection Law in the North and Baltic Seas : national law including international and European requirements. The work serves to systematically process the regulations of marine nature protection applicable in the German AWZ and in the coastal waters of the North and Baltic Seas. Taking into account international and European requirements, the paper explains the relevant national provisions and provides practical assistance for the management of conflicts between protection and exploitation interests. In addition to the mechanisms of habitat, biotope and species protection law as well as the intervention regulations, the focus is on the requirements of the specialized legislation relevant for marine nature protection, which ensure the natural implementation of local interventions and enable the management of fisheries, scientific marine research and shipping that are relevant to nature conservation concerns. Questions concerning the monitoring and implementation of nature protection-related requirements are also addressed as are the conceptual-plannerical aspects of marine nature protection.
content.title_en: Handbook on the law on marine nature in the North and Baltic Seas : national law including international and European requirements

content.text: The wheel is a moving story. The wheel is one of the most important inventions of human history. But where are the origins of the wheel? When was a wheel used for the first time? Who invented it? - - This book describes the history of the wheel from its beginnings and its development to the present day and focuses on the representation of the most important technical development steps in the automotive industry.
content.title_en: The wheel: a moving story

content.text: City Bound : experience educational activities in the city ; with 7 tables. Table of contents: New education needs the city projects and action fields of City Bound: Anders (er)live - in wheelchair about new obstacles. Please quite friendly - group photo with policeman and poodle. "Greenfood for the rabbit" - food without money. Sherlock Holmes - city searches. "When the night has come" - overnight projects. Guest in foreign worlds. Change pages - social projects. Switch project interview. Interior views. Solo in the city. What I always wanted to do. Course designs and implementation of City Bound: With pupils on the way. Connection of city and nature. City Bound with women, in professional training. Management skills. Safety in the city. Reflection. The choreography of the unpredictable -- seminar management from A to Z fold text: Whether in youth work or in training for managers, urban space offers diverse opportunities for experiences: with the wheelchair through the city, an overnight stay in the garden or in the garden without having to steal the garbage, or in high-level meetings.
content.title_en: City Bound : educational activities in the city; with 7 tables

content.text: Handbook Indonesia. Dedicated authors analyse the history, society, politics, economy, environment and art and culture of the island state. Review: Indonesia is the world's largest island state and the fourth most populous country on earth; this autumn the Southeast Asian country was also host country of the Frankfurt Book Fair. In 40 articles, distinguished authors analyze the history, society, politics, economy, environment and art and culture of the country. Each thematic section is initiated by a longer and comprehensive overview article, followed by short contributions to the theme complex. The contributions always conclude with recommendations for a deeper (English-speaking) reading. Some black and white photos are also available and the appendix offers a short presentation of important historical developments and a glossary as well as a small language guide. A rich source of information for everyone interested in the archipelago state, which seeks more detailed information about the Indonesia portraits of Franz Magnis-Suseno (2015) and Christina Schott (2015); also for pupils in upper secondary school II. (2 S)
content.title_en: Manual Indonesia

content.text: Programming with Kara: a playful approach to computer science. The author J. Nievergelt wrote a well-used introduction to "data structures and algorithms" about 15 years ago (BA 8/87), which is also suitable for computer science teaching in upper secondary school. The present book is in the tradition of this earlier work. The authors assume that computers today shape our everyday life and therefore the basics of information and communication technologies, in other words a sound understanding of the functioning of computers and software systems for general education. Based on the programmable lady beetle Kara (a robot implemented as a finite machine) they introduce in a playful way into basic algorithms of computer science. But also more complex topics such as the coordination of parallel processes or the modeling of two-dimensional Turing machines are taken into account in detail. With often surprising examples the significance of these concepts is demonstrated in everyday life. The programming environment Kara is available free of charge on the Internet. (1 S) (Klaus Barckow)
content.title_en: Programming with Kara : a playful access to computer science

content.text: Smart Cities in cyberwar. There is practically no system that can't be hacked, disturbed, manipulated and paralyzed. Florian Rötzer shows how a national disaster can arise from a failure of the power grid in our smart cities because everything is connected and dependent on a single source
content.title_en: Smart Cities in Cyberwar

content.text: Century of modernity : Architecture and urban planning : Essays and texts. "The century of modernism is also called the age of cities. Thilo Hilpert has written an impressive and exciting social history of modernism and its spread from its beginnings to its future perspectives. Bauhaus, Le Corbusier, the history of world exhibitions, manhatts and the big bridges are just a few stops on his cultural-historical route through the architecture of the 20th century."
content.title_en: Century of modernity : Architecture and urban planning : Essays and texts

content.text: The Peacemakers: how the Versailles Treaty changed the world. Review: This voluminous, award-winning study is dedicated to the six-month peace conference in Paris in 1919, whose significance went far beyond the work known here as the "Versailler Treaty" (in the title of the English original, which was unaltered until the foreword of 2001), and the concept of "the world" was not revealed in the complex negotiations around Germany (most recently E. Kolb: BA 11/05), but also arrangements were negotiated that fundamentally changed the world in the Middle East and in the Middle and South East European region and still shape it today. MacMillan, who teaches history in Oxford, describes the abundance of reluctant partial interests with which the victorious powers, which were in turn engaged with different interests, were tired of war. In the end, the Mammut Congress failed to create a lasting peace order accepted all over. Image section, bibliography, personal register. For a general, historically interested audience (2).
content.title_en: The Peacemakers: how the Versailles Treaty changed the world

content.text: The dictionary of symbolism. Those who do not content themselves with the surface of the phenomena, but rather ask for their meaning, their meaning, receive a reliable guide through the world of images and symbols, as they repeatedly encounter modern man: reading a work of world literature, visiting a museum, viewing a church portal, during a divine service, during a study trip on the traces of ancient cultures ... and not least in our own dreams. The articles prepared by competent experts are designed in such a way that they also convey the status of research to the non-specialist; at the end of the book there is an explanation of the more important technical expressions. The literature information accompanying almost every article facilitates the user's study of special questions. - The > dictionary of symbolism < opens the door to the many forms of symbolism in visual art, music and literature, religion and philosophy. The articles written by more than 1000 experts present the latest results of symbolism research.
content.title_en: Symbolic Dictionary

content.text: Living in disadvantaged residential areas. Study of influences that life in a residential area has on the inhabitants with a high proportion of welfare recipients.
content.title_en: Living in disadvantaged residential areas

content.text: London - its most beautiful gardens: a spectacular discovery tour. The band presents 30 gardens in London, botanical highlights of the English metropolis, but mostly rather little known and yet extremely impressive gardens. With lots of photo material and visitor information about the presented gardens. (Reinhold Heckmann) The well-known garden journalist Victoria Summerley presents 30 gardens in London. Some botanical highlights of the English metropolis are present, but mostly they are rather little known and yet extremely impressive gardens. Some are not accessible to the public at all or only at certain times, for example the garden behind Downing Street 10. Besides the informative texts written with typical British humor, the particularly well-known, often large-format photo material of two professional photographers is equally important. Most of them are from the renowned garden photographer Marianne Majerus (see last "Modern Garden Concepts", ID-G 24/15). At the end there is still 1 map, visitor information about the presented gardens and indications of further beautiful gardens in all London and on events. An attractive and by London lovers and garden enthusiasts well asked for by Heckmann (2).
content.title_en: London - its most beautiful gardens : a spectacular discovery tour

content.text: The dance around the ego: risks and side effects of psychology. Psychology, which claims to be able to help people in crisis situations, is itself in a permanent crisis, the author believes. There is hardly any progress in knowledge, instead blind activity and mostly irrelevant studies. Nevertheless, psychologists are everywhere in demand and also felt responsible in many social areas; psychology has become the "religion of our time". The psychologist and science journalist explains his critical attitude towards psychology in detail and precisely in 5 chapters, often deals with the history of the subject area, has numerous examples and quotations ready and comes to the conclusion: one does not have to miss psychology as science. A criticism, which is deliberately exaggerated here and there, but is quite stimulating and worth discussing; for all those interested in psychology. (2)
content.title_en: The Dance around Me : Risks and Side Effects of Psychology

content.text: Efficiency through workflow management : Procedure model for ERP systems. The book takes up a situation that is often unsatisfactory in the practice of operational information processing: Enterprise resource planning systems (ERP systems) do not support the business processes of companies in a way that would be desirable and likely due to the investments made in this information technology. For such a starting situation, the book "Efficiency through workflow management" designs a procedure model that compensates deficits of function-oriented ERP systems by the use of workflow technology
content.title_en: Efficiency through workflow management : Procedure model for ERP systems

content.text: Mindfulness in nature : 84 nature-related mindfulness exercises and theoretical foundations. Nowhere is mindfulness easier than in nature, and nothing else is more dependent on nature than on the mindfulness of people. To all those who want to understand, learn or intensify the attitude of mindfulness; all those who can imagine nature being more involved in therapy, prevention and counselling and all those who develop the relationship with nature in natural education with adults and children, this book is addressed. 25In 84 nature-related exercises, nature is not a backdrop, but part of a careful encounter. The book shows how to open up natural experiences. The authors reconstruct the efforts to date to find careful natural experiences in natural education, psychotherapy, life counselling and natural ethics and look for possible further developments. "Awareness in nature" is therefore both an exercise book and a basic text for further practice and research in various fields of work.
content.title_en: Mindfulness in Nature : 84 Nature-Related Mindfulness Exercises and Theoretical Foundations

content.text: The geology of Europe. He emeritusly reconstructs the paleogeographical conditions and shows how Europe has been joined together from many different crustal parts in the course of the Earth's history. The focus is on the plate tectonic, tectonic and stone-forming processes. The remains of oceanic crust and the complicated movements of microcontinents are particularly important. Starting from an overview of the global development of the large plates, which are represented at least partly in today's Europe, regional developments and the landscape history are presented in basics. Changes in climate zones, flora and fauna are included. Knowledge in geology is required. With many photos, satellite photographs, simplified coloured maps, schematic profile sections and extensive glossary. Before "Geology of Central Europe" (R. Walter: ID-G 21/08) gladly recommended.
content.title_en: The geology of Europe

content.text: 120 years of weather observation on the Brocken (Harz) : a chronicle of the weather observatory and the observatory. "This is how the first chapter describes the history of the weather observatory in detail, extended by the period after the turn of the millennium. In the second chapter, witnesses of the times speak out, who describe from their point of view extraordinary experiences and events at the weather observatory. Especially mention Elfriede Glass, who was available for an interview 90 years ago, in which she described the time after the Second World War. In the third chapter, the climate on the Brocken is described. The Brocken is the windiest place in Germany - a corresponding study can also be found in this chapter, which also contains two excerpts from publications by Dr. Richard Assmann"-Summary
content.title_en: 120 years of weather observation on the rock (Harz) : a chronicle of the weather observatory and the observatory

metadata.authors: Sosna, Peter-René; Kinkeldey, Marc; Nitschke, Ingo; Adler, Klaus; Nöth, Gertrud; Schulze, Olaf

content.text: Metzler Lexikon literarischer Symbole. For the text interpretation helpful reference work on the most important literary symbols of Western literature. (LK/M: Reinwald) The unrivalled reference work offers with 456 articles on the most important symbols of Western literature a valuable tool for text interpretation without any claim to completeness. The articles contain in addition to the explanation of the symbolic basic meanings and their history based on exemplary references also a reference to the most important related symbols within the lexicon as well as further bibliographical information. An alphabetical article directory as well as an article directory according to subject areas at the beginning of the lexicon facilitate the overview, also the 44 newly recorded articles of the 2nd edition (1st edition BA 4/09) are extra listed. Still "for every larger stock of reference works and information means recommended with reprint". (2 A) (LK/M: Reinwald)
content.title_en: Metzler Lexicon of Literary Symbols

content.text: Physics of sport. From force parallelogram and impulse conservation to sporting peak performances and records Sport is applied physics - who would have guessed that? On closer inspection, however, this thought is not so absurd. We are particularly fascinated by two times watching professional athletes at "work": with their trained bodies they perform seemingly perfect movements. Novel materials, improved equipment and training led by medicine and sports science help athletes to achieve ever better performances. Indeed, no world championships and Olympic games take place without new records. But how long is that possible? Starting with solid physical considerations, the limits of human skills are explored. The authors approach the physics of sport from an interdisciplinary point of view: Starting with the once-in-a-lifetime mechanics, they calculate optimal values for jump and throw, around these laws then apply to the human body and practical, sport-related conditions. From ball sports to device turns to activities in the water, Mathelitsch and Thaller impressively demonstrate the universality of natural laws, and the use of these mathematical models, the use of these methods and the use of the visual program.
content.title_en: Physics of Sports

content.text: Social media: a challenge for libraries, politics, business and society. The increasing importance of social media (Synonym: Social media) is also noticeable in libraries, for which it is now important to actively shape this development or to be helped by it. The increasing importance of social media (Synonym: Social media) is also evident in libraries, for which it is now necessary to actively shape this development or to be co-formed by it. Information institutions such as libraries and courses of study in the fields of library and information science are called upon to face the new challenges and to provide adequate solutions. The information and communication technology and business-economic share are increasingly being brought to the fore. But also the social, cultural, political and economic implications are to be integrated into the teaching, in order to ultimately find a way of coping with a complex, crisis-ridden world like ours. The following contributions deal with the potential of social media and show, in addition to theoretical considerations, practical examples.
content.title_en: Social Media: a challenge for libraries, politics, business and society

content.text: Automation technology : Methods for monitoring and controlling continuous and event-discrete systems ; with 93 application examples and 99 exercise tasks. The course of the Electrical Engineering and Information Technology program at the University of Bochum focuses on this demanding introduction to the tasks and methods of automation technology to students of engineering courses and experts in practice. Particularly emphasized are the equivalent treatment of automation tasks of both system classes - continuous and event-discrete systems, which are so far taught separately due to the different stages of development. Provided good knowledge of matrice calculation and linear ordinary differential equations, knowledge of functional transformations are not expected, knowledge of discrete mathematics only in basic concepts. The numerous exercise tasks with solutions facilitate a self-study, the application examples come not only from the highly specialized but also from the everyday field (e.g. window lifter, room temperature regulation). Issue 2003. (3) (LK/SH: Preisler) Introduction to the tasks and methods of automation technology with application examples and exercise tasks. (LK/SH: Preisler)
content.title_en: Automation technology : Methods for monitoring and controlling continuous and event-discrete systems; with 93 application examples and 99 exercise tasks

content.text: Peter Behrens, Zeitloses und Zeitbewegtes: Essays, Vorträge, Konpräche 1900 - 1938. Peter Behrens (1868-1940) is without doubt one of the most important European masters of modernism. After beginnings as a painter he quickly becomes a protagonist of the art trade reform and the German Werkbund around 1900. Be his work as chief designer of the AEG unites graphics, object design and architecture for the first time to a corporate design. - - The decisive design collections of the world present his works, his buildings are not missing in any encyclopedia of modern architecture. But not his last realized work, the Synagogue of Zilina in Slovakia, has remained in the world of science in memory, but his design for the AEG administration in the context of Speer's Berlin planning. It overshadows the aftermath of his magnificent work. In addition to his design work Behrens participated with lectures, articles and books decisively in the theory discussion of his time. - These scattered, often forgotten writings from four decades are here a textual including the reference illustrations of the originals.
content.title_en: Peter Behrens, Timeless and Timeless : Essays, Lectures, Talks 1900 - 1938

content.text: PowerPoint for office, school & study: [perfect presentations with PowerPoint 2002, 2003]. PowerPoint is almost worldwide standard for professional presentation of facts and figures for the screen, the screen or on foil/paper. Here it is worth noting that the first pages deal with a general introduction, because PowerPoint can only be a supporting tool, but not a burden. How to make a presentation, for example, to convey information correctly and to have an impressive and lasting effect. One can quickly work with text and foil layout, present numbers and connections in tables, and create diagrams and organizational charts. All work steps are extensively illustrated. Unfortunately, there are no coloured pages. The attached CD-ROM contains exercise files and templates. The idea of addressing school and study in the title is interesting, but the book is so generally held that all other readers will also get their money's worth here. For scientific work, please refer here to Tobias Ravens (BA 2/05). Generally, the series of Microsoft Press is still recommended. (BA 12/03) (2).
content.title_en: PowerPoint for office, school & study : [perfect presentations with PowerPoint 2002, 2003]

content.text: Negative discrimination : Youth revolts in the Parisian banlieues. Robert Castel examines the stigmatization and declassification mechanisms that make migrants second-class citizens, as well as the new forms of precariousness and exclusion resulting from it. The reduction of these disadvantages can be achieved through positive discrimination measures, through education promotion laws and a changed urban policy. As the problems of living together of different ethnic groups are reinforced by migration flows and a new demographic constellation, the prerequisites for a pluricultural and pluriethnic state must be developed. Insofar as the banlieue is a building site where much work is to be done but also much to learn.
content.title_en: Negative discrimination : Youth revolts in the Parisian banlieues

content.text: Bullying at school: the prevention and intervention program ProACT + E : with CD-ROM and DVD. The harassment of schoolmates is an everyday phenomenon in schools. ProACT + E is a proven program that reduces the negative effects of bullying on victims and perpetrators and changes the behaviour of students. The prevention program, which psychologists carry out together with teachers, students and parents, gives the children skills - as they adequately fight against harassment or - what they can do as fellow students when they see bullying. By involving parents, these skills are also tried to apply in non-school everyday life. Motto: Children should be made self-confident, then they can fight socially competently. ProACT + E is evaluated and has shown what positive effects it can achieve. A video illustration on DVD supports teachers and school psychologists in their work with parents and gives them tips on how they can help their children in problem situations. All work materials can be printed out by the CD-ROM book edition.
content.title_en: Bullying at school : the prevention and intervention programme ProACT + E : with CD-ROM and DVD

content.text: Material science and materials technology: a ride on the razor blade. The author and the reader undertake a journey of exploration through the past and present of the production and use of materials, along the development path of an ancient, familiar cultural technology, wet shaving technology - from stone scrapers to high-tech shaving equipment. The reader learns how man's handling of materials has become an industry and finally an independent science and how materials have shaped entire epochs. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Materials Science and Technology : a ride on the razor blade

content.text: The debate on integration between assimilation and diversity: demarcations in theory, art and society. Is assimilation a "crime against humanity" (Erdogan) or is Germany threatening to abolish it without it (Sarrazin)? The heated debates on assimilation, integration and diversity are based on the question of whether political, social and cultural integration can and should be based on cultural unity or plurality. The volume presents these concepts according to the latest research. Analyses of various locations in the debate – from the German Islam conference on negotiations of assimilation and diversity in literature and film to terrorism in England – and historical perspectives show how the integration question meets the self-definition of modern societies in their core
content.title_en: The debate on integration between assimilation and diversity: demarcation in theory, art and society

content.text: The power of the many: the new cult of digital networking. The «power of the many» has significantly shifted the tectonics of contemporary culture. The everyday use of social media has produced a new culture of participation and networking – with a multitude of participatory and collaborative projects that are both economically usable and normatively charged. The collectives involved in processes of mediaization and visualization are anchored in the popular cultural mainstream and can only be understood if they are addressed in the (genealogical) context of media technology and visual culture. Ramón Reichert's studies show that the «power of the many» originates from the social function of digital networking. Consequently, social media can be understood as a self-description of social conceptions of order. Against this background, he deciphers the contexts of media-technical operations and their representational dimensions and thus develops a comprehensive time diagnosis of the digital world in which we live.
content.title_en: The Power of the Many: About the New Cult of Digital Networking

content.text: Architecture as an exhibit : Discussions about exhibiting. Exhibitions are an important instrument of architectural communication. With their help, trends are set and balances drawn. They can arouse interest, convey knowledge, occupy positions. But how can architecture in galleries and museums be conveyed at all? Which approaches and formats are possible, what potentials and challenges arise in this process? Who should be addressed by architectural exhibitions? And how will they change in future, especially in terms of the use of digital technologies? In thirteen discussions, representatives of renowned exhibition houses in Germany, Austria and Switzerland provide an insight into the conception and realization of exhibitions. They report on experiences from their curatorial practice and discuss the future perspectives they see for the medium of exhibition in architectural communication. Discussions with Hubertus Adam (S AM, Basel), Matthias Böttger (DAZ, Berlin), Kristin Feireiss (Aedes, Berlin), Andres Lepik (Architecture Museum of the TU Munich), Peter Cachola Schmal (DAM, Frankfurt am Main), Dietmar Steiner (Az W, Vienna)
content.title_en: Architecture as an exhibit : Discussions about exhibiting

content.text: A future for our past: the 40th anniversary of the European Monument Protection Year (1975-2015). Under the motto "A future for our past" the European Monument Protection Year of 1975 was the most important and successful campaign to preserve and enhance the architectural heritage in Europe. In recognition of the importance of urban ensembles, in consideration of the plurality of the categories of monuments, in the partial commitment of citizens and in legal or administrative settings this year was a lasting event. Programmatics and ideas of 1975 are still virulent and challenge a new interpretation under the conditions of the present. On the 40th anniversary of 2015, this publication presents the first comprehensive appreciation of the European campaign of 1975. With over 40 international contributions, the event is being addressed from the perspective of the European countries involved at that time, which investigates influence on the former Eastern European block states, and beyond that, has addressed the reception outside Europe. ICOMOS Austria, in conjunction with ICOMOS Germany, Luxembourg and Switzerland, initiated this third MONUMENTA volume and directed by the editors, has taken to the path.
content.title_en: A future for our past: the 40th anniversary of the European Year of Monument Protection (1975-2015)

content.text: Criticism of the Green Economy. "Green Economy", which sounds good, means the inclusion of nature and its concerns in the economy. However, this book, published by the Heinrich Böll Foundation, questions what the concept of the concept is, which is also hidden behind this term used by international actors such as the World Bank and the OECD. In intensive discussion, the authors deal with the view that the ecological and survival problems of our world could be solved, i.e. the economy could become green without the functioning of our growth-based market economy being fundamentally questioned. In contrast, they formulate the necessity of a fundamental transformation of the economy, in which a radical redefinition of structures, decision-making processes, lifestyles and power relations must be addressed. Innovations in the sense of the green economy are not sufficient for this, so their conclusion and pleas for a broad social debate about a "political ecology", which they stimulate with this profound contribution. (2) (Reinhild Khan) What should the economy of the future look like? The authors from the Heinrich Böll Foundation criticize the assumption of the "hier green economy" that sufficient technological ecology is achieved in the sense of a political transformation.
content.title_en: Criticism of the Green Economy

content.text: Designing parks : Berlin's park on the Gleisdreieck or the art of creating lively places. Using the example of the Berlin park on the Gleisdreieck, authors investigate: How can you manage to visit as many people as possible to make a park or place, because it promises relaxation, variety and quality of stay and makes the benefits of life in the city clear?
content.title_en: Designing parks : Berlin's park on the track triangle or the art of creating vibrant places

content.text: Clothing lexicon : Fashion, design, cut construction, graduation, equipment, cutting, processing technology, ironing, management and marketing. The first edition of this comprehensive lexicon was presented in BA 11/78; the second, extended and updated edition appeared in 1982; a fundamentally revised reprint was therefore overdue. In addition to the fashion-influenced trends and changes, especially developments in clothing technology (not least because of computer-assisted manufacturing) are the reason for a complete revision. The basic concept of a reference work, which is equipped with numerous photographs and drawings, for all employees in the textile industry has not changed.
content.title_en: Clothing lexicon : fashion, design, cutting, graduation, equipment, cutting, processing technology, ironing, management and marketing

content.text: Successful research - history. Publishing info: The volume Successful research history offers a comprehensive overview of the information resources for all areas of history. Not only the central research instruments such as library catalogues, specialist bibliographies, internet search engines, essay databases and reference books are presented, but also strategies for successful literature research. A separate part of the book is dedicated to the further processing of the information found and the correct citation The volume Successful research history provides a comprehensive overview of the information resources for all areas of history.Not only the central research instruments such as library catalogues, specialist bibliographies, internet search machines, essay databases and reference works are presented, but also strategies for successful literature research.
content.title_en: Successful research - history

content.text: The motto of the regional working group Streetwork/Mobile Youth Work North Rhine-Westphalia, which pursues the development of parts of public space through and for youth cliques, is "entering the public space". After discussing theoretical foundations for understanding the behaviour of young people in public space, 10 projects examined in 2 evaluation rounds against the displacement and exclusion of youth cliques in small and medium-sized cities in North Rhine-Westphalia are presented. In the final perspectives, examples from Greven and Berlin are presented with 2 best practice projects, the legal and urban planning aspects of public space control are investigated. The contribution "One city for all" is a plea for a city in which children and young people can also live and participate. For a specialist audience, besides street workers and social educators, also for municipal politicians, city planners and spatial planners of interest.
content.title_en: Allowed to enter! : Projects against the displacement of young people from public space

content.text: Material Science and Materials Engineering: an introduction. Standard material science and materials engineering work, translated into German for the first time. The English edition has been published in 8th edition since 1985. The translation has been adapted to the German-speaking university and research landscape. Where necessary, adaptations and modifications have been made, e.g. for material designations and their conversion into the EN and DIN standard system, as well as for symbols and formulas. In contrast to the original edition, all chapters are available in printed form in this translation. For students and lecturers, the publisher offers further information and teaching materials on its homepage. In the annex, among other things, a glossary and a compilation of material properties. The clearly designed and well illustrated work is aimed at students at university of applied sciences and universities and also offers further fields of study (physics, chemistry, mechanical engineering etc.) a comprehensive introduction to the basics. From the publisher in similar layout, see also "Material Science" (ID-G 31/11). (3) (LK/SH: Preisler) For the first time in the German translated standard material science and material engineering work for the University of applied at the University of Applied Sciences and Materials Engineering.
content.title_en: Materials Science and Materials Engineering : an Introduction

content.text: 1000 [thousand] Years of School : a cultural history of learning in pictures. Horst Schiffler/Rolf Winkeler: "thousand years of school". A cultural history of learning in pictures. Belser Verlag, Stuttgart, Zurich 1985. 146 pp., ill., born, 78,- DM
content.title_en: 1000 [thousand] years of school : a cultural history of learning in images

content.text: New construction with straw in Europe. A well-founded introduction to the construction of low-energy and passive houses with straw bales. The ecological construction of straw bales has now become established in Europe, including certified building straw bales with "European Technical Approval". Professionalization is also shown by the fact that straw bales with load-bearing wall systems, wooden stand construction or prefabricated components can be realized. Compared to the 3rd edition 2008 continuously revised and updated, brought to the latest state of construction technology and supplemented by new construction projects. Recommended as an initial step into the topic before the more expensive and comprehensive "handbook straw bale construction" (2)
content.title_en: New construction with straw in Europe

content.text: More than housing : planning for a cooperative – a model case from Zurich. The settlement ‘more than living' in Zurich is a lighthouse project for sustainable cooperative living. Thirteen buildings offer living and working space for 1100 people and serve as an innovation platform for the participating 30 cooperatives. New building materials and energy concepts are applied beyond unusual family, age and cluster apartments as well as services (guesthouse, restaurant, mobility station).
content.title_en: More than living : planning for a cooperative - a model case from Zurich

content.text: Europe in the oil rush: the consequences of a dangerous dependence. Current study of the consequences of the oil dependence of the Western developed countries for political decisions, also about war and peace, in the last 100 years. (Reinhild Khan) In 1850 the "oil age" began, which on the one hand - especially between 1950 and 2000 - promoted the enormous economic upswing in Europe and the USA, but at the same time led to a strong dependence of the West on cheap and constantly available oil. The historian and head of a Swiss peace research institute analyses the influence of this dependence on political developments, on war and peace in the last 100 years to today. Chronologically, he traces the importance of the question of resource security, which already expires in the background during the First World War, which increasingly - the recent conflicts and wars in the Middle East testify this - determines the policy. Meanwhile, it is clear: The time of cheap oil is over, the energy turn must replace the oil rush. The author puts his hope on this change and thus an end of resource wars. The comprehensive study is very well readable and brings interesting and z.T. Surprising background analyses.
content.title_en: Europe in the oil rush: the consequences of dangerous dependence

content.text: The gardens of the Bauhaus: Design concepts of modernism. Who doesn't know Walter Gropius' famous Bauhaus buildings in Dessau? Their unique architectural appearance is also shaped by an exceptionally innovative garden design for the time being, whose modernity is demonstrated above all in the very novel interpretation of the interplay between architecture and nature. In this volume, the author, Professor of Landscape Design and Garden Architecture at the Anhalt University, is for the first time fundamentally concerned with the Bauhaus gardens. A thorough garden archaeological examination of all the gardens of the Bauhaus buildings that were created between 1925 and 1930 not only allows valuable insights into design planning and realization, but also reveals the partly significant interventions in the building material by numerous renovation measures. Thus, the book presents a meaningful and necessary supplement to the numerous publications on the changing history of the Bauhaus and its architecture. As the first standard work to explore the gardens of the Bauhaus building in Dessau, this liberally illustrated innovative volumes the theme plays the theme and its theme by the theme.
content.title_en: The Gardens of the Bauhaus : Design Concepts of Modernism

content.text: The determination of the relevance of bioversidity damage according to the USchadG: Basic data for the FFH habitat types. On 14 November 2007 the German Environmental Damage Act came into force, which can be used to require the polluter to restitution for certain damage to the environment, provided that these are "significant". To determine the "considerability" a method proposal was developed at the Brandenburg Technical University Cottbus (BTU) with the support of the German Environmental Foundation DBU. It is based on the criteria of the underlying European Environmental Liability Directive, which are to be used by the German law as evaluation relevant. However, the nature conservation practice has subsequently criticised this methodology, because the FFH Performance Assessment (FFH-VP) already provides an established relevant procedure for the assessment of the relevance of the relevant environmental liability. The present volume takes up this criticism and develops the original model, taking into account the transferable criteria of the FFH-VP, so that the own theoretical claims as well as the pragmatically oriented standards of practice are satisfied.
content.title_en: The determination of the relevance of bioversidity damage according to the USchadG : Basic data for the FFH habitat types

content.text: The city: from the Polis to the Metropolis. Elisabeth Lichtenberger gives a comprehensive overview of the city's development, function and shape as well as its future prospects. It shows that cities change profoundly with the succession of political systems. Her view is particularly relevant to the urban development of the 20th century. Numerous well illustrated examples show guiding principles in the areas of politics, urban planning and technology. The small-scale examination illustrates the structure of the different urban spaces and their functions for society. The author works on the various living spaces and housing forms, the institutionalization of public facilities and the development of retail shops as a shopping mall, from the backyard industry to the industrial state, from small office to the office high-rise. Finally, she focuses on the future of the city and its importance as a living innovation center of European culture.
content.title_en: The city : from the Polis to the Metropolis

content.text: The book "Control Loss" brings together contributions on questions of emancipatory and practical criticism of the current surveillance society. It brings together very different strategies and perspectives of left-wing surveillance criticism. Critical scientists, activists and initiatives engage theoretical, but above all strategic and action-oriented considerations, reflect on their experiences of action and shed light on problems and potentials of movement(s) against increasing surveillance and control ... (Source: Text Verlagsinband / Verlag)
content.title_en: Loss of control : interventions against surveillance

content.text: Family - no thanks?! : Family happiness between new freedoms and old duties : with 15 illustrations and 3 tables. The book combines family sociological and developmental psychological perspectives: What has been socially done and how does this affect the individual "family happiness"? The starting point of the book was a series of events of the Lindauer Psychotherapiewochen 2011. Seiffge-Krenke researches at the University of Mainz (here last "After PISA", ID-G 21/06) and explores the question of what family is and how our understanding of family has changed. In addition to a historical outline, she shows that the variety of family forms is characterized by social structures and individual design. Families are facing particular challenges here in the separation process, single parents and patchwork families. The book tries to offer assistance for families in difficult situations: therapists, consultants and educators. Cf. also "Family, Education and Socialization" by J. Ecarius (ID-G 1/11). With a detailed literature directory and a conciliatory outlook: "Familys are not simply robust but amazing." (3)
content.title_en: Family - no thanks?! : Family happiness between new freedoms and old duties : with 15 figures and 3 tables

content.text: City kids : Children's life between street and school. The author tries to follow the processes of modernization that have created the domestication of today's childhood. He wants to show why streets and schools continue to form cornerstones of urban childhood, regardless of the increasing importance of private family space for growing up.
content.title_en: City kids : Children's life between street and school

content.text: The discovery of the landscape: Introduction to a new science. An economic, cultural and social history-introducing into landscape science as well as its ecological and economic significance. (Erdmann Steinmetz) "Landscape science can not only be used by specialists, but also by lay people", because landscape is a cultural asset, Köster judges, Professor of Plant Ecology - see "Beautiful Prospects" (BA 7/09) - in its cultural, economic and social history-introducing into a often emotionally occupied subject that extends between natural and spiritual sciences to numerous disciplines. The focus is on the constant change of environment and landscape since early hunters and collectors, thereby giving new accents to the question of "nature" or "culture". Agricultural reforms and conservation are further focal points of the work, which is equipped with coloured illustrations, notes and registers, and offers a compact and recommendable introduction to both important and interesting historical and current questions. (2) (Erdmann Steinmetz)
content.title_en: The discovery of the landscape: introduction to a new science

content.text: Two-way downfall: the destruction of the German Reich and the end of European Judaism. Andreas Hillgruber: Two-way downfall. The destruction of the German Reich and the end of European Judaism. Siedler Verlag, Reihe Corso, Berlin 1986, 112 pages, 20 marks
content.title_en: Two-way downfall: the destruction of the German Reich and the end of European Judaism

content.text: Encyclopedia of Home Culture : from antiquity to the present. The large-format volume, rich in technical quality, offers a sense of pleasure and scientifically sound information in a general way. From antiquity to postmodern design of the present, spatial divisions of the home buildings, interior decoration and furnishings, furniture and equipment of the European cultural epochs are represented within the framework of their social function in the respective society. It is in the nature of genre painting or the historical castles depicted in photographs that mainly bourgeois and aristocratic living forms are treated; peasant and worker culture are excluded. A splendid volume completed by glossary, bibliography and register at a price that allows the purchase even where the subscription of the multi-volume "history of living" (BA 11/96) must be dispensed with. (2) (Irmgard Andrae)
content.title_en: Encyclopedia of Home Culture : from Antiquity to the Present

content.text: The Italian disaster. Publishing info: Italy has not yet started again in the sixth year of the great crisis. The figures are alarming: 44 percent of Italians under 25 have no work; after 2012 and 2013 the Italian economy is shrinking again in 2014. Economically coincides with a fundamental crisis of state institutions. Trust in politics and parties is at a historic low, the protest movement of the cabaretist Beppe Grillo became the second strongest party in the parliamentary elections; Matteo Renzi, celebrated by the media as a hopeful bearer, is cungling with his scandalous predecessor Berlusconi and celebrates the former English Prime Minister Tony Blair as a model, although in his home country he has long since become a persona non grata. In his much-regarded essay, the historian Perry Anderson presents an Italian disaster chronology. Italy he does not regard it as an "anomaly within Europe, but as a kind of concentration" of the problems of a continent, which is increasingly characterized by dedemocratisation, corruption and growth weakness.
content.title_en: The Italian disaster

content.text: Neukölln is everywhere. Heinz Buschkowsky, SPD mayor of Neukölln, has written a book about his neighborhood, which has become synonymous with failed integration and juvenile crime. Buschkowsky is in it wedged through the underclass thicket - and is laying himself in series with integration politicians. (stern.de)

content.text: South Africa: the path from apartheid to democracy. Neville Alexander (born 1936), a literary scholar who holds a doctorate at the University of Tübingen, was imprisoned for 11 years because of his commitment to the Apartheid regime as a political prisoner on Robben Island. Today, Nelson Mandela's companion is the director of the "Health, Education and Welfare Society" in South Africa and director of the study program "Alternative Education" at the University of Cape Town. He describes "from a left-wing perspective without going into the trap of rhetoric and propaganda, as far as I can prevent this", South Africa's path from apartheid to democracy. Main topics are: the term "race" and class in South Africa's history writing, the dynamics of the liberation movement, the peculiarities of South Africa's transition to democracy, the state of the new South Africa, the construction of the nation and identity policy, and the politics of reconciliation. Critically, he questions at the end the image of the new South Africa: role model or illusion? Deeper, than A. Hagemann "Small History of South Africa" (BA 6/01), therefore more for larger libraries. (P.)
content.title_en: South Africa: the path from apartheid to democracy

content.text: Numerical linear algebra: a concissical introduction with MATLAB and Julia. Introduction to algorithmic-numerical thinking by means of fundamental problems of linear algebra preferably for students of mathematics from the second semester onwards. Review (kz): Numerical mathematics (numerics) is a sub-area of mathematics that deals with the development and analysis of efficient algorithms for continuous mathematical problems. The teaching work based on a lecture now primarily supplies students of mathematics from the second semester onwards, but also students of natural and engineering sciences, for example, a concisical introduction to numerical linear algebra, which is a fixed component of numeric education in basic mathematics. The presentation, which is endowed with numerous examples and tasks (without solutions), deliberately confines itself to this part of the numeric to introduce the mathematical theory based on a clear thematic coherence based on fundamental problems in algorithmic-numeric thinking. Algorithms and numerical examples are provided with program codes that are associated with the numerical development environment MATLAB or the freely available programming language MATL.

content.text: From case to case: case comparison and case contrasting in qualitative social research. The construction of categories and the formation of types by case comparison and case contrasting are central methods of interpretative social research. In the volume methodological foundations and the research practice of category and type formation are illustrated and discussed using numerous empirical examples.
content.title_en: From case to case : case comparison and case contrasting in qualitative social research

content.text: Better than reality! : why we benefit from computer games and how they change the world. The US game developer explains her theory of the social avant-garde role of online games and demonstrates their impact by means of examples. (Uwe-Friedrich Obsen) The influence of computer games on thinking and acting is constantly being declined. After so far most cultural pessimism indicated the tone, which online games acted as a dull waste of time, the tongues are changing. Increasingly it is pointed out that there can be a connection between online games and creativity such as empathy of gamers. Trendsetter for the change of direction is the US game developer Jane McGoniga. In her 2011 published and now translated bestseller "Reality is broken - Why games make us better and how they can change the world". In her 2011 published and translated bookshop "Reality is broken - Why games better and how they change direction, one of the ways to follow the way of acting.
content.title_en: Better than reality! : why we benefit from computer games and how they change the world

content.text: The barbarism: a phenomenal cultural critique. A new barbarism permeates our society, since knowledge and culture are divided for the first time. Since the "Galilean project" natural science wants to be the only objective knowledge and excludes the sensual qualities of nature as well as the associated subjectivity: that is, our life itself. Because culture is especially the increase of life itself as art, religion and ethics, it finds itself excluded from modernity. This fundamental negation of life, which allows Husserl's life world rehabilitation to be seen deeper, is completed in the process of technology, which in its indestructible path of life leaves the individual only the "medial existence" of the audiovisual as a place of escape for his exchange of needs. Against every desperately irrational cultural pessimism, a phenomenology of living self-revelation sets the reality of immanent affectivity, which remains more fundamental than any imaginable knowledge and can lead to "historial" re-contemplation.
content.title_en: Barbarism: a phenomenal cultural critique

content.text: The guiding idea of "data and chance" is one of the five main areas of content for mathematics education in upper secondary education, which are defined by the mandatory educational standards in Germany. But how can this guiding idea be filled with life? How can statistics and probability calculation be linked to the one guiding idea data and chance for the school? The book "Leitidee Daten und Random für die Schule I" gives practical and didactic-methodical answers to this question. It deals with concrete problems relevant to teaching and develops the current questions of stochastic didactics. Sustainable examples are linked to content and process-related stochastic standards in order to enable the learning of life-related statistical phenomena to be experienced in the classroom.
content.title_en: The guiding principle of data and chance: of concrete examples of the didactics of stochastics

content.text: Small and medium-sized cities in Germany: an inventory. In public perception, small and medium-sized cities are often considered to be "province", as the epitome of romance with restored historical buildings, paved pedestrian zones, homely public squares and an attractive, historic city centre. The enormous importance of these regional centres for the social and economic development of Germany is often overlooked. Almost two thirds of all German residents live in small and medium-sized cities, more than half of them also work there. What is the situation and development of these cities? What is the situation and development of these cities? What is the situation regarding infrastructure? Are the inhabitants satisfied with the living conditions? What are the problems facing the cities and how can they face policy? These and other questions are addressed by the analysis of the BBSR, which is based on a broad data base.
content.title_en: Small and medium-sized cities in Germany : an inventory

content.text: Planning in Germany and Poland from a municipal perspective. The brochure "Planning in Germany and Poland from a municipal perspective" presents a novel format in the series "Planning concepts in Europe" published by the ARL. Especially for actors at the municipal level, an overview of the planning system and essential planning concepts of the Federal Republic of Germany and the Republic of Poland is provided.
content.title_en: Planning in Germany and Poland from a municipal perspective

content.text: Violence and bullying in schools: possibilities of prevention and intervention. Schubarth provides an overview of the main results of school-related violence and bullying research, presents concepts and programmes for the prevention and intervention of violence and bullying and makes them critical. A useful orientation aid for teachers, educators, social educators and other practitioners, for those working in further education and representatives of the school supervision and for students; now in a continuously updated and slightly extended edition (see ID-G 3/10 for the first edition). The relevance of the topic is more and more increasing, therefore now more broadly and also recommended in addition to "anti-mobbing strategies for the school" (ID-B 24/11). (2 S)

content.text: History and the public: the dispute over Daniel J. Goldhagen. Goldhagen's book and theses have disappeared from the public agenda - the discussion within and outside science continues, according to the editors (both co-workers of the Center for Anti-Semitism Research, Berlin) of this volume, by studying Goldhagen's central lines of argument (eliminational anti-Semitism) and his point of view within history more intensively. Goldhagen's book in the (media) public sphere is equally a red thread, which could achieve this success and extraordinary effect through almost all contributions - reason enough to explore and understand the different expectations that large parts of science and the public have against each other. Besides Goldhagen's book and alongside "Briefs to Goldhagen" (BA 12/97), Wolfgang Wippermann (ID 23/97) and "Eine Nation auf dem Prüfstand" (BA 6/98). (2) (LK/F: Dankert)

content.text: A new Mainz? : Controversies about the shape of the city after 1945. "The city of Mainz, which was destroyed to a large extent in 1945, was to be rebuilt immediately after the end of the war under the direction of architect Marcel Lods, a pupil of Le Corbusier. The internationally acclaimed project provided for a new road network and the consequent separation of residential, administrative and commercial areas, but was never implemented. The book offers for the first time a systematic reworking of these comprehensive plans. It is the result of decades of research by renowned architectural historians Jean-Louis Cohen and Hartmut Frank"--- French construction policy on the Rhine: Precedences and reconstruction programmes / Jean-Louis Cohen, Christine Mengin -- French construction policy on the Rhine: Monument protection and architecture / Jean-Louis Cohen, Christine Mengin -- Gross-Mainz / Hartmut Frank -- Conflict field Reconstruction planning / Jean-Louis Cohen, Hartmut Frank -- Another Mainz / Jean-Louis Cohen -- A new old city / Hartmut Frank -- Powerless Expert Jean-Louis Cohen
content.title_en: A new Mainz? : Controversies about the shape of the city after 1945

content.text: Psychology of Proverbs : Does science know more than grandma?. This book examines common proverbs of popular language from a psychological and scientific perspective: Does the old proverbs agree with the findings of modern science? Does science know more or less than grandma, who explained many of the connections of everyday life through "life-proofs"? 33 compact chapters illuminate 33 well-known proverbs and explain what science knows about the conditions under which a proverb applies and where the limits of its validity may be. A book for students and lecturers of psychology, because it provides an overview of many phenomena and theories of psychology through the breadth of the topics - but also for interested laymen who seek psychological explanations for everyday phenomena.
content.title_en: Psychology of Proverbs : Does science know more than grandma?

content.text: Python 3. Python is a universal, object-oriented programming language. The interpreter allows a playful introduction to programming and Python is available on many platforms. The clear syntax combined with the powerful extensions in the standard library allows short, easy-to-read programs. -- The book introduces the Python 3 instructions and syntax to then introduce modules from the standard library and its application by means of simple examples. Among other things, the handling of files, working with date and time, processing command line parameters, network programming with sockets, the use of various Internet protocols (HTTP, SMTP, POP3), multithreading and multitasking are dealt with. Also, the reader is able to solve the various tasks from daily programming practice. -- The reader is able to use file-based databases with SQLite, the PostgreSQL and MySQL databases, regular expressions, random numbers and mathematical functions, handling binary data, serialization of Python types and data, and the testing of programs.
content.title_en: Python 3

content.text: The Water Atlas: a world atlas on the most important resource of life. Two experienced authors have clearly prepared the topic of water in its most important aspects (final resource, ecological pressure, water for life, water for production, contaminated water, water for the future). M. Black writes about international environmental policy topics for UNICEF, J. King has already presented the "World atlas of climate change" (BA 2/08). A knowledgeable, informative and critical text at the beginning of a chapter, based on current data material, is concretely defined and visualized by coloured maps, tables and infographics. For each country of the earth, water consumption and water footprint (m3 per person), irrigation, water power, wetlands of international importance in km2 are recorded tabularly. With glossary, source references, registers. A useful, aspect-rich overview on one of the most important present and future topics, which are most useful in connection with e.g. with inventories such as "World Power Water" (in this no.) or Farce (in German) (if the German language: "Büdtf.
content.title_en: The Water Atlas : a World Atlas to the Most Important Resource of Life

To examine this human-machine interaction in all its facets for the benefit of optimal software engineering, this book is intended for interested parties from computer science, media, design, information technology and related disciplines. The presentation is emphatically designed with signaling elements, the chapters are individually and in the overall context well usable. The book describes in 2 parts "basics" and "implementation", i.e. on the one hand human perception and on the other hand design determinants such as regulations, norms, hardware design, graphical dialogue systems, usability and in it overall more further as title for "software engineering" by M. Herczeg (ID 7/05) and R. Dumke (ID/04).

content.text: The architecture of the separation is a global development. The architecture of the division is based on the Israeli "space order" in the occupied territories, which is shown by an architecture of demarcation and control that is used worldwide: whether it is to lock out impoverished parts of the population from the metropolises or at the high-level borders between North and South, poor and rich.

content.text: Simple GEN:ial : Green genetic technology: opportunities, risks and profiles. Critical analysis of the opportunities and risks of green genetic engineering. The book provides an overview of the current genetically modified plants and the plant genetic products in development. The impact and effects, in particular the risks and dangers of genetic engineering on health, the economic situation in agriculture, the environment and the living conditions in the 3rd world are analysed. The author assesses the opportunities and benefits of the new technology, with few exceptions, rather sceptical. It provides detailed background information on methods and practices of affected food and seed groups. A committed, not always balanced and compared to M. Lappe (BA 9/00) or "Gentechnique in Lebensmittel" (BA 9/99) current contribution to the pro and contra of green genetic engineering, which provides above all critics and opponents with useful argumentative aids. Recommended for many libraries.

content.text: Time diagnosis : theological orientation in the age of acceleration. What problems does the increasing acceleration of all processes in industrial societies pose? Do we need a new ethics and can theology and philosophy contribute to the formulation of such a "kin ethics"? Hans-Joachim Höhn re-misses the field of time ecology and describes the concept of an ethics that arises under the sign of accelerated modernization processes. At the beginning, the accelerating elements in the history of modernity are considered, which also put moral and religion under higher probation pressure. Then, the ethical models are considered under the aspect of temporality and finally the orientation performance of an "ethics of time" in the context of modern social system is asked.
content.title_en: Time Diagnosis : Theological Orientation in the Age of Acceleration

content.text: Complex event processing : Processing of event patterns in data streams. Complex Event Processing (CEP) is a new software technology that enables the analysis and processing of large amounts of data and their transmission via networks in real time. CEP plays a major role in the field of big data. A short introduction to the topic "CEP" has already been made to R. Bruns by means of a case study (monitoring of a machine-to-machine system). The present book deepens this introduction and focuses on detection oriented CEP, whereby event patterns are already known and are to be recognized in large data volumes for the purpose of predicting subsequent events. The author proceeds in his book application-oriented and relies on examples from the monitoring of buildings (smart home), vehicle monitoring and stock trading. Great importance is attached to the precise explanation and definition of terms, events and event flows. The individual chapters end with a reference to further literature. - Many graphically highlighted definitions are based on the exact explanation and definition of terms, events and events.
content.title_en: Complex event processing : Processing of event patterns in data streams

content.text: Albert Einstein: Academy Lectures : Proceedings of the Prussian Academy of Sciences 1914 - 1932. *Further information Author: The Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences, founded in 1992 by the state treaty between the federal states of Berlin and Brandenburg, is the most recent embodiment of the frequently changed first Academy, founded by Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz 1700 in Berlin. During the first World War as a 'Royal Prussian Academy of Sciences', it was simply called the 'Prussian Academy of Sciences' between the world wars. Einstein's contributions in this volume are available to the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences as special prints from the reports of the previous sessions. Professor Dr. Dieter Simon is the current president of the Academy
content.title_en: Albert Einstein: Academy lectures : Proceedings of the Prussian Academy of Sciences 1914 - 1932

content.text: The Minaret: the political culture of the conflict over Islamic symbols. Conflicts about the establishment and use of mosques are relatively new in this country (as in other immigration countries of the EU). At least they are younger than the presence of minorities who have migrated from Islamic-inspired societies of origin. The present volume contributes to understanding conflicts around Islamic symbols against the background of their attachment and their framework conditions. For this purpose and with a view to the German context, it uses an explorative, case-based analysis that reveals its connections to contemporary sociological theory. According to this analysis, the framework conditions that shape the course of the conflict do not exhaust themselves in formal forms of political system or positive law. Rather, they are also anchored in a life-world dimension. The analysis of political culture, its opportunities and barriers, therefore, focuses also on life-worldly-sediated legal concepts, on informal power asymmetries in the city society, on the limitation of argument and habitus, on the symbolic identity of the local resource-identity.
content.title_en: The Minaret : on the political culture of the conflict over Islamic symbols

content.text: The subject of occupational health and safety is gradually at the top of the agenda in the awareness of companies, workers' representatives, trade unions, trade unions, occupational health associations, etc. The focus of this volume is on the previously neglected area of mental stress at the workplace. The author presents both the theoretical-psychological concepts of work analysis and the concrete analysis tools for measuring and evaluating mental stress using the example of the risk analysis procedure. - In addition to the studies of K. Wenchel ("Psychische Anforderungen am Arbeitsplatz": ID 34/01) or Rolf Senzer (BA 2/03) especially for major city centres. (3) (LK/HB: Obsen)
