content.text: Standardization and standardization : Basics. Interdisciplinary introduction to standardization and standardization, which is particularly relevant for internationally oriented companies. Basic, compactly worked textbook for students at universities and universities of applied sciences, which introduces in the development, types, application of standards and which points to important legal regulations. Exercise tasks with solutions complement the volume, which is rounded off by addresses of organizations, by a list of abbreviations and by a index of subject matter. Handier and cheaper, but also much less than the well-known teaching and reference work "Introduction to DIN standards" (BA 2/08).
content.title_en: Standardisation and standardisation : basic principles

content.text: Self-organized companies: Management and coaching in the agile world. Agility is on everyone's lips. Hardly any company that doesn't want to become more mobile and responsive - or at least talks about it. But what must happen to keep it from being agile rhetoric? What exactly do managers have to do to enable agile transformation? What should coaches focus on to do to meet their role as an impulse provider? And what special opportunities arise from the combination of leadership and consulting skills? Siegfried Kaltenecker offers practical answers to all these questions in this book that underline that entrepreneurial agility is not to be had without self-organization. Central control, hierarchical decisions and a pyramid-shaped construction organization are incompatible with this. Kaltenecker bundles practices from over 40 companies to eight design areas for agile organizational design: consistent customer focus, transparent control of processes, short feedback loops, customer-oriented decisions, experimental improvement and innovation culture, and lean organization of management tasks, and how to use existing management tasks and coaching skills.
content.title_en: Self-organized companies : Management and coaching in the agile world

content.text: PHP for WordPress : Design themes and templates yourself. Although the title is only about "PHP for WordPress", the complete installation of WordPress is described step by step without any hesitation. followed by the download of Java, Eclipse and Aptana Studio with further plug-ins. If you follow the precise instructions, nothing can go wrong (but every PC is an individual). Gull is very committed to translating the jargon of Wordpress and the blogger scene from the Chinese language into German or at least explaining it. Thus, the book is also described in detail for untrained Internet users - certainly also for senior citizens - a real vademecum, even since the internal structure of WordPress and the functioning and syntax of PHP are shown. The design of themes and templates is well structured and clearly presented. The editing of the start file and the modification of themes are described in detail. - Many WordPress books contain a CD-ROM with all the necessary programs, here is only referred to an Internet address for download. The book is not cheap, yet recommended (2).
content.title_en: PHP for WordPress : Designing themes and templates yourself

content.text: Berlin - today. "Berlin today" has many faces and as a whole, it is once again a European metropolis with a fascinating charisma. Hardly any city in the world is in such a profound transformation process as Berlin. After the destruction of the Second World War and decades of separation into East and West, Berlin has once again declared itself the capital as a new architectural figure. - Focusing on 35 different areas of the city, this book presents the new face of the German capital, including the former West, the new centre and the government district, in photographs look at the contrasts between new and old. Architectural historical Christiane Kruse examines Berlin's past, offering insights into its resurrection as a THRING, thoroughly modern metropolis and using texts that present developments in a historical context.
content.title_en: Berlin - today, today

The latest developments and innovations are described in detail. The exports of German submarines are accurately recorded. Although industry supports with advertisements and illustrates with effective photos, here an informative book has been successfully produced, which is a basis for military policy discussions. (2)

content.text: The future of the oceans - too warm, too high, too acidic : special reports. New research results show that the unchecked emissions of carbon dioxide caused by man will have serious consequences for the oceans. The progressive warming on the one hand and the acidification of the seas on the other threaten the marine environment and the fish stocks already weakened by overfishing. Due to the rise of the sea level, the coasts are increasingly exposed to flood and cyclone risks. To keep the disadvantages for humans and ecosystems within limits, new paths must be taken in the coastal protection, marine protected areas must be established and regulations for the handling of refugees from endangered coastal areas decided. However, these measures can only be successful if the global warming and acidification of the seas are significantly limited. An ambitious climate protection is therefore a decisive prerequisite for successful marine and coastal protection.
content.title_en: The future of the seas - too warm, too high, too acidic : special reports

content.text: Gardens of the Gods : plants, colours, elements and their meaning ; with practical tips for designing your own garden. This book invites you to look at gardens in a new way, namely as a "holy space" that can transform the visitor in religious, mystical or philosophical terms. A garden should not only be a collection of decorative plants, but a place of meaningful importance. Examples of "senseful gardening" can be found in all cultures. Using Chinese, Japanese, Islamic and European garden traditions, the author makes clear the influence of religion, magic, esotericism and similar directions. In this context, no dry, scientific work has been created, but an informative book that can really captivate the reader. In addition to many historical examples, the personal impressions of the author of gardens of the present and their creators are particularly interesting. The motivated reader also receives suggestions for designing his own garden with particular intensity and magical radiance. Despite the sprawling image material, a fascinating book whose purchase is an absolute must for the corresponding audience. (2)
content.title_en: Gardens of the Gods : plants, colors, elements and their meaning ; with practical tips for designing your own garden

content.text: The flying mountain : Roman. "The Flying Mountain" is the story of two brothers who, from the southwestern coast of Ireland, set out in the Transhimalayas, for the land of Kham and the mountains of East Tibet, to seek, against better (satellite and computer navigation) knowledge, an unclimbed nameless mountain, perhaps the last white spot of the world map. In their search, the brothers encounter not only the archaic, with Chinese occupiers and the constraints of the present war-ridden world of the nomads, but also death in very different ways. Only one of them returns from the mountains to the sea and into a life in which he begins to grasp the mystery of love as his and his lost brother's actual, long hidden, never entirely to be measured and never to be conquered.
content.title_en: The Flying Mountain : Roman

content.text: The Potsdam Manifesto 2005: "we have to learn to think in a new way"; Potsdam's Denkschrift 2005. In the middle of the 20th century prominent opposition movements formed around the world to stop the nuclear arms race and the worsening confrontations between East and West. On 9 July 1955 Bertrand Russell and Albert Einstein published the 'Russell-Einstein-Manifest'. It ultimately demanded a new thinking, which guarantees in future wars as a means of politics and instrument of conflict resolution rigorously to banish. - - 50 years later Hans-Peter Dürr and J. Daniel Dahm, together with Rudolf zur Lippe, the Potsdam Manife 2005, and its 'mother', the Potsdam Manifesto 2005, were discussed and discussed in Potsdam from 24 to 27 June 2005 in the context of an internationally accompanied symposium. On 14 October 2005, it was presented to the public in Berlin. - Thought and Manifesto 2005 are linked to a central but no longer executed genein-Manifest as a radical way of learning about the different ways of life. We must learn about the different ways of life.
content.title_en: Potsdam Manifesto 2005 : "we have to learn to think in a new way" ; Potsdamer Denkschrift 2005

content.text: Youth, pop, culture: a transnational history. Shappering sounds, loud behavior and shrill fashion: The vocabulary, with which contemporaries described a new youth scene in the middle of the 20th century, marked a cultural break. Aesthetic conflicts culminated in street riots, police measures and censorship laws. At the same time established tours, pirate stations and fan clubs cross-border new content. Bodo Mrozek analyses a change that took place in the 1950s and 1960s and shaped society: what was initially fought as a youth inquisitiveness was considered a epitome of urban culture ten years later. Documents from six states form the material of this transnational history of pop culture.
content.title_en: Youth, Pop, Culture : a transnational history

content.text: Engineering mathematics compact : textbook for technical study programmes. As the title already says, a compact representation of the entire mathematics, adapted to the needs of the technical universities, arose from lectures of the author at the FH Landshut and the GH Paderborn. Very oriented to the "computer practice" (extensive examples) without much to respond to concrete applications (only quite a few examples from physics and technology). However, "mathematical rigour" is by no means omitted. Most theorems are precisely proven. A total of 106 tasks with solutions in the annex. More detailed (and also suitable for universities) is L. Papula (2 volume edition cf. BA 1/89) or the 5 volume work of K. Burg (Band 1 in ID 1/93). - Well suited also for students at universities who would like to supplement the theory offered there mostly "hard". (2) (LK/M: Silk)
content.title_en: Compact engineering mathematics : textbook for technical courses

content.text: The urban and landscape development in the area of Saxon Elbe - a medium-scale evaluation and action concept of the urban area in the district of Dresden - is dominated by the urban and landscape development in the district of Elbe. The potential acquisition in the framework of the basic analysis was made from topographical, historical and thematic map works, from GIS data, from a literature research and own field investigations. Planning spragmatically oriented were then for four river landscape areas (e.g., through the river basin of Saxony Switzerland, Dresden Elbe valley expansion, Elbe breakthrough by the Meissen Syenit-Granit-Platte including Nassau, North German lowlands) the natural, settlement-relevant and socioeconomic factors on the spatial planning evaluated, from landscape-related strengths-weakness profiles the planning orientations and recommendations for action for environmentally-friendly land use in the form of guidelines with a medium- and long-term implementation perspective of the urban area and the regional area in the district of Dresden.
content.title_en: Settlement and landscape development in the area of Saxon Elbe - a medium-scale assessment and action concept

content.text: Global library and information science. The International Federation of Library Associations and Institutions (IFLA) is the leading international umbrella organisation representing the interests of libraries and information services and their users. It is the worldwide voice of the library and information professions. The IFLA Publications series discusses a wide range of ways in which libraries, information centres and employees in information and documentation professions around the world can formulate their goals and perceive their influence as a group, represent their interests and develop solutions to global problems.
content.title_en: Global library and information science

content.text: Making your own instead of buying - Kitchen: 137 healthier alternatives to finished products that save money and protect the environment. This title has emerged from contributions from the Internet portal "Smarticular.net", which deals with topics relating to healthy life, self-making, home and garden. It contains over 100 recipes for kitchen basic products (divorces, sauces, pasta, dairy products, vinegar), pastries and bread, spreads, residual recycling, drinks, sweets and snacks. With some instructions for home products in case of health problems. Optimally kept rather simple, the variety of recipes, tips and suggestions is nevertheless presented appealingly. All recipes are well usable, suitable for everyday use and mostly uncomplicated in the preparation. The own production of food is still in trend. Accordingly, the corresponding book market segment is also well stocked; actually, it is hardly possible to stand out from the crowd of comparison titles.
content.title_en: Make your own instead of buying - Kitchen : 137 healthier alternatives to finished products that save money and protect the environment

content.text: The idea of the library and its future. About the often underestimated necessity of libraries in the 21st century. The users flock in crowds into the reading rooms and group working rooms of the scientific libraries. Their task seems to become increasingly unclear in times of the Internet: Isn't the most important thing already available on the web? What function does the library have then - is it a "learning center"? A logistics center of information? A social place? Does sharing and exchanging the essence of the library become more unclear? This book deals with the fact that scientific libraries have a main task, and indeed since the oldest days of Nineveh and Alexandria: The responsibility for the availability of knowledge. Its purpose is to provide information about the state of knowledge achieved at each time. The realization of this idea becomes a squarer for the individual library. Libraries need to work much closer together than before. The idea of the library only works in the system of libraries. However, in Germany the libraries sit with their unfinished community tasks in the federalism trap. In order to make the idea of the library work more effective, it needs a hearty library policy. The former director of the duchessess Anna Am Bibliothe Library asks the future and her history and her library questions about the idea of the future.
content.title_en: The idea of the library and its future

content.text: The discussion about the rapid breeder SNR 300 in Kalkar has not only led to a sharp criticism of state technology policy since Chernobyl. The study of the structural moments of this controversy leads to the distinction between consensus- and non-consensus-capable criteria. Due to its coupling of basic scientific research and commercial use in the Federal Republic, the breeder policy has not been able to reach a social consensus.
content.title_en: Consensus and dissent in the field of breeding policy

content.text: The social welfare states are not only required by the circles of the economy to be rebuilt. Conversion in the sense of cost reduction, mostly at the expense of the beneficiaries of the social welfare state. The domestic economy can no longer bear the burden of the social welfare state, it must remain competitive on the world market. Politicians also talk about the conversion in view of massive losses in tax revenues. As therapeutics in the increase in expenditure, experts recommend market-based remedies: privatization of public services, competition, business methods. Do the social state not have to start again? What opportunities does European integration offer? These and other questions are addressed by the authors of this book, renowned social policy, educational and social science experts. They develop in their contributions sharp analyses of today's social state and give impetus to its future. They provide arguments against social policy restrictions, with which they want to encourage them to resist them.
content.title_en: Falling welfare states: arguments against social degradation

content.text: Fundamentals of acoustic oceanography. An introduction to the topic of water sound and its relation to oceanography, remote sensing, biological aspects and underwater communication.
content.title_en: Fundamentals of acoustic oceanography

content.text: An island between heaven and sea. The second children's novel (previously "The Year I Learned to Lie") by the American author is about the girl Crow and plays in 1925 on a fictional island next to the real Elizabeth Islands off the coast of Massachusetts. Found as a baby by the self-brotherly Osh on the beach and raised with much love with the help of the good-natured Miss Maggie, Crow wonders where she comes from. The opposite island Penikese once housed leprosy and was isolated from the outside world. The islanders suspect that Crow sprang there and avoided it accordingly. Crow makes a search for her origin. Gradually, the puzzle unfolds around her past. Poetically written, the description of the intimate relationship between people and the sea arouses a peculiar seizure. However, it is questionable whether children here voluntarily access. History and cover seem to be more likely to address adults who, for example, are looking for a touching and unusual J.
content.title_en: An island between the sky and the sea

content.text: Practical manual IT basics for librarians. The basics of computer science and information technology are easily understood, which are needed to understand the applications in everyday life of libraries. Information systems, distributed applications, linked data and sematic web concepts are explained comprehensively with a high degree of practical relevance and examples from the library context, thus creating comprehensive knowledge of terminology.
content.title_en: Practical manual IT basics for librarians

content.text: Postmodern Berlin : Residential buildings of the 80s. In Berlin there is a worldwide unique density of buildings from the postmodern period, which are being rediscovered and which need to be re-discovered. The city and time enabled the most contradictory architectures of the internationally most important architects of this era in form and appearance. These are veritable constructed manifestos of the 80s, which gave the West of the divided city a new face, shortly before the fall of the wall and reunification. Claudia Kromrei presents in this volume 30 residential houses, which were interpreted and re-photographed from today's perspective about 30 years after their emergence. Through uniform floor plan drawings, which make the respective residential concepts clear, the structural similarities, regardless of the different architectural means, can be precisely worked out.
content.title_en: Postmodern Berlin : Housing of the 80s

content.text: The new scientific spirit. Gaston Bachelard: "The new scientific spirit". From Franz. von Michael Bischoff. Suhrkamp Verlag, Frankfurt/M. 1988. 177 pp., born, 38,- DM
content.title_en: The new scientific spirit

content.text: Philosophy of Time : Fundamentals and Perspectives. Time flows or stands, it is what clocks measure, and yet every thing has its time, at the moment it seems to be particularly scarce: time is a fundamental dimension of human existence, which occurs in various forms - as physical time, as individually experienced time, as social-intersubjective and as historical time. But almost never do the connections of these thematicizations become clear. This gap closes the present volume, which takes time into consideration as the subject of metaphysics, philosophy of science, philosophy of mind and ethics as well as as as as the medium of our everyday experience.
content.title_en: Philosophy of the times : Basics and perspectives

content.text: Time - Media - Perception. The simulated image worlds of electronic media have a profound influence on the human perception of time. The authors of this book investigate from different perspectives the opportunities and risks arising from the new forms of media perception of time.
content.title_en: Time - Media - Perception

content.text: Creative paper creation: plant papers, recycled paper, coloured paper. This excellently equipped introduction to paper creation is aimed at experimental beginners. The author describes in detail the tools (mainly in self-building), raw materials and working processes. Her special love is for decorating with natural materials (various plants, straw, wool, etc.), dyeing and discovering new raw materials. "The secret of paper lies in the banality of its raw material and in the immense richness of its field of application", under this motto she encourages further processing with many examples. Because every paper creator wants to convey his tricks and tricks, the relatively expensive volume is recommended if further need be. Cf. also "Kunstwerkstatt Papier" (BA 8/94), "Paper Creating" A. Fuchs-Waser (BA 4/93) and "Paper Creating" by T. Hartel (BA 11/93). (2) (Rosemarie Scholand)
content.title_en: Creative paper creation : plant paper, recycled paper, coloured paper

content.text: The publication was initiated by the University of Limburg in Maastricht to give students and scientists an idea of the historicity of the environmental problem. The author, the historian of science of biology, succeeds in this excellently: starting from the peoples of the river valleys to our time, he describes very concretely the respective production conditions and the positive and (increasingly) catastrophic effects on nature. Who suspects, for example, what importance the invention of the cummet in agriculture was to have, or that "The Dark Day" by Fr. Bruegel d.ä. also illustrates a dramatic wood shortage. The strength of the book lies in the embedding of historical working everyday life in economic and ecologically long-term contexts. A time table on environmental issues as well as a list of literature and names complete the volume, which is well-readable and variedly illustrated for lay people. (2 S) (Haike Wirrmann)
content.title_en: Ecology and the environment in history

content.text: Old car recycling and disposal: state of the art and activities in automotive recycling. A collection of the state of automotive recycling with contributions to process engineering, material preparation, disposal, computer planning. The topic, previously mostly dealt with in journal articles or in research reports, is practical and addresses a wider reader group. Replaces no textbook, but offers a solid worked cross-section. A comparison title is not known. (3) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Old car recycling and disposal : state of the art and activities in automotive recycling

content.text: Pseudonyme : a lexicon ; cover names of the authors of German-language narrating literature. After barely 4 years the lexicon of the Pseudonyme is reissued considerably. (ID 43/91) Now the volume contains about 3500 entries (before 2000). The real names of authors of German-language mass literature are given with life data and notes in which genre was published. The pseudonyms used are opened by a register. In large information stocks the old edition should be replaced. (3 A) (LK/HH: Kappus)
content.title_en: Pseudomes : a lexicon ; aliases of the authors of German-language narrational literature

content.text: Tanzania. The series shows in problem-oriented presentation, here the example of Tanzania for East African states, the correlations between geographical and demographic, agricultural and industrial factors, education and changing social structures - in this case especially the (unfortunate) negative effects of Ujamaa socialism - and describes their interdependence and influences especially on the development of states of the "Third World". An important book of difficulty level 4-5 (on scale 1-6) for pupils of upper secondary school and students, with numerous tables and illustrations and literature list, which should be available in urban libraries, in addition to the guide by R. Dippelreither (BA 5/94).
content.title_en: Tanzania

content.text: The way forward: the future of the information society. With optimism and realism, the Microsoft boss takes the reader on a journey through the data highway and outlines the influence that the expected technical innovations will have on our coexistence. (Roland Schwarz) Microsoft boss Gates presents here his long (first under the title "The Vision") announced reflections on the changes of our society caused by PC and "Information highway" over the next 10-20 years. However, the first chapters are nothing else than (admittedly very vivid) after-work on the history, basics and development of computer science. Gates comes to the point after about 1/4 of the volume, where he illuminates technical, content, commercial and educational aspects, his own project as an example of a "cyber home" before he presents forecasts and approaches important questions. In this case, the relevant reader will find out that this is not all visionary (sometimes frighteningly) his own project as an example of a "cyber home" before he presents forecasts and approaches important questions.
content.title_en: The way forward: the future of the information society

content.text: The planet as a patient: about the contradictions of global environmental policy. From the introduction: In the past, the environmentalists demanded new social Tugends. Today they call for better management strategies. In the past they urged more democracy and local autonomy, but now they are caring for a global seizure of power by governments, corporations and science. It is long ago that they campaigned for cultural diversity, now they see hardly any other possibility than to build on a worldwide rationalization of lifestyles. In fact, as ever more frequently environmental issues on the agenda of international politics take an important place, to become more tame parts of the environmental movement. Thus, in recent years a discourse on global environmental policy has become active, which does not allow for reflections on power, culture or morality and instead betrays the aspirations of an ascending ecocracy, the nature (and people) of the present-day threat to be subjected to benevolent planning. A movement that once warned people to be humble has produced a paradoxically expert, which can often resist the temptation to pride. Various observers had taken a number of opinions about the UN conference on environmental development - at least in Rio and the beginning of 1992 they saw the fact that the fact that the world's of being a failure.
content.title_en: The planet as a patient : about the contradictions of global environmental policy

content.text: The questionability of censorship: texts and investigation reports. The German-language standard work on censorship. Not what students learn, determines their school success, their chances of life, but how they are censored. This book shows with many investigation results that censorship is more a lottery game than a responsible assessment instrument. It shakes the naivety of our censorship practice and encourages theoretical and methodological reflection.
content.title_en: The questionability of censorship: texts and investigation reports

content.text: Small dictionary of Hellenism. "Small dictionary of Hellenism". Edited by H. H. Schmitt and E. Vogt. Verlag Otto Harrassowitz, Wiesbaden 1988. XIII, 745 pp., ill., born, 78,- DM
content.title_en: Small dictionary of Hellenism

content.text: Parking garages: basics, planning, operation. The special volume of the book series Building constructions is dedicated to the planning of the parking garage. Starting from the problem of the stationary traffic, the planning basis of the design and the operation, all areas of a functional and economical parking garage are covered. In simple examples, numerous plans, sketches and pictures the complex connections of a parking garage or the parking garage operation are discussed. For the daily planning work, different templates for parking arrangements are available in the book.
content.title_en: Parking garages : basics, planning, operation

content.text: Energy-saving buildings and plant technology: basics, effects, problems and weaknesses, paths and solutions for the application of EnEV. The book contains comprehensive information on the effects and regulations of the Energy Saving Regulation and the new calculation methods for structural thermal protection and plant technology. It provides numerous application examples with reference to practical results and economic data. In detail, it presents: consequences on design and design, new insulation layer thicknesses, standards for the various components (roof, walls, ceilings), avoidance of thermal bridges, ecologically safe building materials as well as window and glazing requirements.
content.title_en: Energy-saving buildings and plant technology: basics, impacts, problems and weaknesses, ways and solutions in the application of EnEV

content.text: Information transfer: Basics of communication technology. Basics: Signals and systems -- Basic methods for the transmission of digital signals -- Special methods for the transmission of digital signals -- Transmission of analog signals -- Transmission channels, channel models -- Digital transmission via linearly distorting channels -- Information theory, source and channel coding -- Sub-methods, multiplex -- Multiple access procedures, networks, communication systems. The aim of the textbook is to provide a basic understanding of the principles and procedures used for the transmission of information in communication systems. Students of electrical engineering and information technology, but also development engineers in practice as well as mathematicians, physicists and computer scientists are addressed. The first chapters focus on the digital transmission necessary for the basic understanding of additive Gausss channels. Subsequently, the time-varied channels are treated, which are becoming increasingly important as the use of radio transmission media becomes increasingly important. Optimal receivers and the necessary adaptive decerrification procedures are considered, an introduction to the information theory explains the theoretical limits necessary for understanding, the basic principles of channel and source coding are also addressed to the transmission of multiple-over-spectrum-spectrum-spectrum-spectrum-relation.
content.title_en: Information transfer : basics of communication technology

content.text: Numerics of linear equation systems: Direct and iterative procedures. Basics -- Direct procedures -- Orthogonalization methods -- Splitting methods -- CG methods -- GMRES and related methods -- Further Krylov space methods -- Multigrid methods. This book gives a comprehensive presentation of the most important methods for numerical solution of linear equation systems. It requires only very little mathematical knowledge to understand, as is usually already available after a single-semester course in a mathematical or engineering course. For this reason, the book not only addresses students of mathematics, economic mathematics or technomathematics, but also the natural and engineering scientist, who is confronted in many practical applications with the solution of linear equation systems. In terms of content, the book deals with both the direct and the iterative methods. In this context, great importance is attached to a careful derivation of these methods. In addition, the book contains very detailed pseudocodes, with the help of which the respective procedures can be immediately realized in any programming language.
content.title_en: Numerics of linear equation systems: direct and iterative methods

Agent-oriented software engineering -- Selection and evaluation of the presented methods and tools -- Howdini — A common application scenario -- Gaia -- MASSIVE -- Zeus-method -- MaSE -- Aalaadin -- Summary of the methods -- FIPA-OS Toolkit -- JADE -- Zeus-toolkit -- MadKit -- agentTool -- JACK -- Summary of the tools. First, the concept of agent-oriented software development is explained and the young field of agent-oriented software development is presented in an overview. Subsequently, several well-known methods (Gaia, MASSIVE, Zeus, Aalaadin, MaSE) and tools (FIPA-OS, JADE, Zeus-toolkit, MadKit, agentTool) are described in detail, the methods and tools are illustrated in a uniform case study, and evaluated using various application-oriented and agent-specific criteria.
content.title_en: Agent-oriented software development : methods and tools

content.text: Landscape forms: Our Earth in transition — the forces of design on the trail. How do mountains, deserts, glaciers or volcanoes emerge? What natural forces have created the impressive Grand Canyon? The answers in this magnificently illustrated book are as diverse as the face of the Earth. From the position of the Earth in the solar system to the influence of man on the landscape, it explains the origin of the surface forms. Individual image sequences illustrate numerous processes such as the emergence of an earthquake. In addition to precise, understandable texts, many photos, graphics and maps provide fascinating reading material. A comprehensive glossary completes the book. The Earth A dynamic planet -- Partner in space The Earth in the solar system -- Time witnesses The age of the rocks -- Forms giving who what causes -- From the inner vulcanism and earthquakes -- Wrinkle-rich mountain formation and tectonic -- Power of water Rivers and valley -- Power of the sea Islands and coastal forms -- Power of ice Glacier and inland ice -- Power of the wind Desert and the last sluff meteorite Risk of the All- What makes man - What is man - What is man - What is man - What is man - What is man - What is man - What is the nature - What is the world - What is changing?

content.text: Agile Modeling with UML: Code Generation, Test Cases, Refactoring. Introduction -- Compact overview of UML/P -- Principles of Code Generation -- Transformations for Code Generation -- Basics of Testing -- Model-Based Tests -- Test Patterns in Use -- Refactoring as Model Transformation -- Refactoring of Models -- Summary and Outlook. Two current trends emerge in the growing portfolio of software development techniques. On the one hand, UML dominates as a modeling language, and on the other hand agile methods are increasingly used in ever new areas. This book presents elements of a development methodology that uses UML class, object, sequence diagrams, state charts and OCL to generate a viable system as well as tests for the test framework JUnit. On the other hand, further techniques for the development of test cases and for evolutionary development of designs with refactoring rules are being introduced to students who want to be able to use them in application domain requirements, to develop their own business practices and to develop their own business practices.
content.title_en: Agile Modeling with UML : Code generation, test cases, refactoring

content.text: The basics of semiconductor physics -- Diode -- Bipolar transistor -- Field effect transistor -- The transistor as an amplifier -- Transistor basic circuits -- Operating amplifier -- Frequency behavior of analog circuits -- Feedback in amplifiers -- Logic circuits. This textbook introduces the basics of semiconductor circuit technology. The aim is to convey to the reader the principles and the functioning of components and circuits. The basic semiconductor physics is addressed insofar as it is necessary to understand the function of semiconductor components. The author deals with the most important basic circuits and derives the corresponding equations in such a way that the reader can transfer the procedure to other complex circuits. In addition to the analog basic circuits and their properties - from single-stage voltage amplifier to integrated operation amplifier - the book provides an overview of the design of digital circuits in different technologies. The interactive PS program S.m.i.L.E allows to view complex connections with interactive applets themselves. The CD files of the reader's library can be presented in the form of the user's sample.
content.title_en: Introduction to semiconductor circuitry

content.text: Dispute issues in the natural sciences: A contribution to the debate on science and society. This work represents an (unusual) form of biography. It is not about the chronologically ordered life story of a scholar, but about the description and analysis of the disputes experienced in the natural sciences.Initially, the philosophically trained natural scientist quotes from his perspective those elements that make up (natural) science in its innermost sense. Against this background, the author reports on important experiences and insights that were given to him during his trips to the natural sciences, from philosophy and theology to technology, economics and medicine to politics and society.Posted for:High School Teacher, Gymnasial Teacher, Students Interested in Science/Philosophy/PoliticsKeywords: The Ethos of ScienceEvolutionary Theory of KnowledgeTechnology AssessmentTruthness as a Secure KnowledgeScience Theory
content.title_en: Dispute issues in the natural sciences: A contribution to the debate on science and society

content.text: Computing with machines: A history of computer technology. This extensive work, which was published almost 40 years ago, has been extensively illustrated in the history of computing technology – from the Abacus of the Romans to the program-controlled digital computing systems. "de Beauclair" has been out of print for many years. This facsimile reprint, supplemented by a preface by Professor Brauer, TU Munich, and Professor Vollmar, Universität Karlsruhe, opens the eyes to the beginnings of the computer age. Introduction -- The development of mechanical computing machines -- The punch card as program and data storage — the third root of data processing technology -- The punch strip as data carrier -- Computers in electromechanical design -- Relay calculators -- Computers in tube technology -- Computers in semiconductor construction -- Internal components of computing systems -- Peripheral devices of computing systems.
content.title_en: Computing with machines : A visual history of computing technology

content.text: The basic theory of mathematics is not to be considered as a basic theory of physics. The basic theory of physics is to be considered as a basic theory of physics. The seven volumes of the series "Basic theoretical physics" are intended as a direct-guide to the university studies of physics. They are to be given in a compact form the most important theoretical-physical tool on which to build up more sophisticated topics and problems in advanced studies and in physical research. The concept is designed in such a way that the first part of the course, Classical Mechanics (Band 1) Analytical Mechanics (Band 2) Electrodynamics (Band 3) Special relativity theory, Thermodynamics (Band 4), as part of a theory of an "Integrated Course", is to be understood from experimental physics and theoretical physics, as it is now offered to numerous German universities from the first semester. The presentation is therefore conscious of the fact that sometimes at the expense of a certain elegance, and is kept in itself completely unresolved so that the course is not always considered as to be used for the purpose of secondary literature.
content.title_en: Basic course Theoretical Physics 4 : Special Theory of Relativity Thermodynamics

content.text: Common differential equations: Theory and practice - deepened and visualized with Maple®. The theory of ordinary differential equations is a fundamental and unchanged current field of mathematics. This book not only introduces extremely carefully and comprehensively into theory, but also provides insight into its application practice due to the numerous fully calculated examples. Another special feature is the bridge to computer application. With sophisticated Maple worksheets, it is shown how to design, convey ideas and impressively visualize them with the computer. Thus, more computational examples can be treated than is usual. With its wealth of material, clear and precise style and thought-out didactical conception, the book is ideally suited as a basis and guide for students and teachers of mathematics, physics, economics and engineering sciences. content.text: Manual of the Purest Gases. Introduction to the physics of gases -- Production and cleaning -- Equipment for production and filling -- Mixtures of purest gases -- Pressure gas containers -- Analysis of purity and composition -- Handling -- Data sheets. Technical gases are used in almost all areas of industry, science and medicine as well as for control by state offices and institutions. In this manual the physical foundations of purest gases and mixtures as well as their production, cleaning, analysis, storage and transport are comprehensively presented. content.text: Hello, I'm Eliza : fifty years of conversations with computers. The volume contains the contributions of a conference that dealt with the topic of "language assistants" in 2016. 50 years after Weizenbaum's Chatbot program "Eliza" (1966) - a kind of parody of psychotherapists therapy - many contributions to this program, but also his modifications in other programming languages are addressed. Weizenbaum was shocked, as his quite simple program, which worked with pattern recognition and repetition of the written questions, was taken seriously as a therapeutic. Here you find both Wheatbaum's script and variants in BASIC. The development of language assistants in the last 50 years from simple chatbots to NLP-based dialogue systems is noteworthy. Three chapters are only printed in English. Many data can be found, understandably, several times. - The volume is interesting, perhaps partially, for lay people, because of the large spread of modern language assistants such as Alexa, Siri or Cortana.

content.text: The Muslims and Islam : who or what belongs to Germany?. "Is Islam – is it now part of Germany or not? At the latest since Christian Wulff's statement this is controversially discussed in this country. Hanna Joshua traces the current debate against the background of increasing migration from Islamic countries, leaves different voices to speak and does not evade unpleasant questions. But just as there are not "the Islam and "the Muslims exist", there can be no simple "yes" or "no" on the initial question. Muslims and non-Muslims still have to move on many questions and decide together which Islam can have a future in Germany. Limits of tolerance must be named, common features must be recognized and used to promote peaceful coexistence in an unpeaceful world. It is about nothing less than the future viability of our society. The discussion has just begun!" (Verlagsinformation)

content.text: Innovations through environmental management: Empirical results on the EC Eco Audit. Problem and objective of the study -- State of research: a literature review -- Research-conducting hypotheses and impact model -- Case studies -- Telephone broad-range survey -- Conclusions and recommendations for action. An important objective of ecological modernisation is the combination of environmentally friendly economies with an improvement in competitiveness. Central instruments in this context are standards for environmental management systems, such as the EC Eco Audit (EMAS). While EMAS's cost-benefit ratio has already been researched, the impact of innovation and competition has not yet been systematically investigated. This research gap is closed in this study with depth case studies and a telephonic broad-range survey. The ZEW and IÖW study can derive the recommendation for action from companies to strengthen their competitiveness by interlinking environmental and innovation management. The key factor is the R&E department, which should be involved in the further development of EMAS in order to achieve a stronger link to product-related and strategic issues.
content.title_en: Innovations through environmental management: Empirical results on the EC Eco Audit

content.text: Pedestrian protection: accident events, vehicle design, test procedures. Pedestrians as victims of traffic accidents are to be better protected by EU legislation. The framework conditions require knowledge of accident events and injury development. This book deals with the aspects of active and passive safety of vehicles and presents appropriate solutions. The book discusses the typical pedestrian accident against the background of international findings. Fundamentals, kinematic and mechanical processes as well as injury mechanisms are presented, already implemented and in future possible technical measures to improve passive and active safety are presented and evaluated. The book addresses the international legislation on pedestrian protection. An alternative assessment procedure for vehicle fronts is presented, which avoids many of the disadvantages of today's legal or consumer protection organizations. The procedure is capable of quantifying and opposing the benefits of various active and passive measures. The book addresses readers from the fields of vehicle development and accident research, who find useful detailed knowledge for their own research or development tasks in this book. Social aspects - mechanisms of the pedestrian accident - measures to protect pedestrian protection - evaluation.

Information and communication technology (IT) today is the backbone of modern financial services business. Almost all topics of banking, insurance business and asset management affect computer science. The book presents the main concepts of IT management in the financial sector. It is noted that IT is not only made up of a variety of methods, models and technologies, but also that active design is necessary by IT managers. content.text: Game of Life : how man tamed nature and himself. Verl. Beschr.: For hundreds of thousands of years our ancestors were dependent on wild plants and animals to survive. They were hunters and collectors, perfect experts in food search, and took the world as they found it. Then it came to a revolution - the interaction of our ancestors with other species changed decisively: they began to tame them. People settled down, the population boomed and whole civilizations could arise. Alice Roberts masterfully tells the captivating stories of ten species that put our entire life on the head: dogs, wheat, cattle, corn, potatoes, chickens, rice, horses, apples - and finally the man himself. She shows how animals and plants have changed after we made them part of our world. And how their development is inseparably intertwined with our development. If you want to know who and why we are - this book provides answers

It is not predictable how many people access a web site at what times with what knowledge and behavior. At company web sites, errors of any kind drive visitors directly to competitors. These circumstances make the quality of a business-relevant web application a critical success factor for a company, especially as the technical possibilities of WWW are constantly changing. The author describes the measures that ensure the quality of a web application. He explains how quality is defined and measured and explains the necessary test procedures and their support by test software. With concrete work aids in the form of checklists, testers and webmasters receive the tools for their tests. The book allows test managers and project managers to properly evaluate quality risks and plan required quality assurance measures in time. content.text: Computer setup and computer architecture. Processor landscape -- Performance measurement and evaluation -- Pipelining -- Superscale -- Experiments with the MMIX meta simulator -- Jump prediction -- Storage systems -- Virtual memory -- Modern parallel processing techniques. The theme of this work is the construction of modern microprocessors and computer systems based on them. Following an overview of common processors, basic properties of command sets are presented, and it is outlined how the performance of computers can be assessed. The focus is on the treatment of techniques such as pipelining, including out-of-order execution and speculative command execution. Furthermore, the author goes into the construction and organization of the main memory as well as techniques for jump prediction. Using a freely available simulator and visualization tools, all basic concepts are illustrated. To this end, especially the model processor MMIX developed by Donald E. Knuth (Stanford University) is used. Using these tools, the reader can perform his own experiments and thus deepen his knowledge.

content.text: Everything could be different: a social utopia for free people. Today nobody believes that it will be better for our children. Does that have to be like this? Don't have to be! The sociologist and proven future architect Harald Welzer designs a good, a possible future for us. Instead of criticizing or lamenting, he thinks about what a good future could look like: in realistic scenarios he outlines concrete future images, among other things in the areas of work, mobility, digitalization, life in the city, economics, dealing with migration, etc. Refreshing and encouraging Welzer shows: The much-confused »alternativelessness« is in fact only fantasylessness. We have also achieved a lot that can be built on. It has only been forgotten or replaced by other priorities. It can actually be anything else. One needs only one idea of how it should be. And one has to make it. The reward: a life-worthy future that we can look forward to. "Harald Welzer brings us with his admittedly somewhat polemic manifesto from the comfort zone. He really criticizes our society as a good way of life.

content.text: The risk of the contract is under control: a guide to risk analysis for construction contractors. When awarding construction services, construction contractors must submit offers at binding prices. The award is awarded in many cases to the company with the most favourable offer. This offer involves certain risks. "The risk of the contract is under control" gives the contractor a practical guide and overview of risk analysis for construction projects in the supply, execution and warranty phase. A clear explanation, practical examples as well as numerous checklists and forms enable the quick and above all simple implementation in the construction practice. A properly lived risk management will in many cases help to identify, control or exclude risk that is likely to be at risk of success early on. In addition, it also opens up the possibility of positive influence on a rating of banks that they carry out on the basis of BASEL II within the credit allocation process. "The risk of the contract is under control" offers the practitioner valuable advice at this point and thus provides the prospective user with an overall insight into the topic of risk management.The forms described in the book can be downloaded via the website and via the phase II.
content.title_en: The risk of contracts under control : A guide to risk analysis for contractors

Through this unique structure, it has been possible to create a book for practice that quickly finds and applies the right tools in the project work.

content.text: Active filters and oscillators: design and circuit technology with integrated components. Introduction -- System theoretical basics -- Basic structures of active filters -- Active basic elements -- Cascade technology -- Direct filter synthesis -- Active filters in SC technology -- Computer-supported filter design -- Linear oscillators. The rapid development in the field of wireless communication technology – especially mobile services – has resulted in new challenges and additional areas of application for analog technology in recent years. This book on active filter technology introduces readers to the modern methods of analog signal processing – in a scope and detail level that no other German-language technical book has reached at present. These include in particular: System theoretical foundation, circuit technology of active assemblies with conventional and novel amplifier ICs (strengthening, integrators, impedance converters), design, calculation and comparison of the different filter structures, possibilities of PC programs for filter design, design and simulation of switched capacitor filters, sinus oscillators with integrated amplifiers.
content.title_en: Active filters and oscillators : Design and circuit technology with integrated components

content.text: Efficient diversity: The third revolution in the automotive industry. Historical developments in the automotive industry -- The drivers of the third revolution -- The conflict between efficiency and diversity -- The solution to the conflict: Modularization -- Quantitative changes between OEMs and suppliers — the new value creation -- Qualitative changes between OEMs and suppliers — the new relationships -- Ten theses of theses on the third revolution in the automotive industry. The chance that you see your VW Golf on the road just as much as a second time is less than the chance of a six in the lottery. The variety of variants driven by consumers who insist on their individuality is in full swing. The third revolution in the automotive industry is well-initiated. It is different from Henry Ford's first and Toyota's second revolution in that it not only affects the car manufacturer but the entire value chain. In this book, the authors show that the conflict between efficiency and diversity must be solved when developing new vehicles. A response to this challenge are modular concepts. These open up completely new business models in the automotive industry that require a rethink of all companies. The book is not only a duty to consider the same situation of a car door.
content.title_en: Efficient diversity: The third revolution in the automotive industry

content.text: Service-oriented architecture: architectural principles and implementation into practice. The ability to quickly and efficiently implement innovations in business models in operational processes and IT systems is of central importance in today's competitive situation. In many companies, the existing IT architecture, which has grown over the years, limits the responsiveness to new requirements. A service-oriented architecture (SOA) is a promising approach to increase the speed and quality of enterprise-wide application development and integration and to reduce its complexity and costs. This book describes the central principles and concepts of a SOA and assigns them to the topic of corporate architecture. Using case studies, it shows concrete manifestations as well as drivers and potential benefits in practice. It further discusses measures for implementation and shows approaches for the development and control of a SOA. Basics -- Principles of service-oriented architectures -- case studies on SOA -- architecture management and service design -- Summary and Outlook.
content.title_en: Service-oriented architecture : architectural principles and implementation into practice

In addition to the elementary functions of warehouse management such as quantity and storage location management, conveyance control and disposition, methods and means for controlling system states as well as operating and optimization strategies are included. The processing for this 3rd edition focuses on the ideal system properties and components of the systems. The book includes a CD-ROM with a fully operational WMS (Open Source). The associated simulation environment enables the autarkic operation on a standard PC (Windows). Warehouse Systems and Warehouse Management -- Basics of Warehouse and Conveyor Engineering -- Basics of Operational Optimization -- Information and Communication Technology -- Software Engineering -- Data model of a WMS using the example myWMS -- Selection and introduction of WMS.

content.text: Identification systems and automation. Barcode, intelligent labels (RFID), artificial intelligence: Interdisciplinary, the authors explain the automation of modern logistics and production, right up to the necessary automatic identification of objects (AutoID). With numerous examples, many hints for practical application and theoretical backgrounds. Compact, profound and vivid: a detailed reference work for teaching and practice
content.title_en: Identification systems and automation

content.text: Intralogistics : Potentials, perspectives, forecasts. Intralogistics includes the organization, control, implementation and optimization of the internal material flow, the information flows as well as the goods handling in industry, trade and public institutions. The tasks and importance of intralogistics are explained in practical examples. Recognized experts from the circles of manufacturers and users as well as from research and teaching describe the potentials and perspectives of intralogistics and present their forecasts on the development opportunities in this future market for discussion. The topics of the contributions cover the whole range of intralogistics, from a strategic, functional and technical point of view the book informs about the status and the potentials for creative design in intralogistics.
content.title_en: Intralogistics : potentials, perspectives, forecasts

content.text: Dispensation of human resources: A flexibility-oriented view. Introduction -- Flexibility As a central challenge For Dispensation Management -- On the way to Flexible Human Resources Architecture -- Instruments To Management A Human Resources Dispensation Focused on Flexibility -- Final View. Human Resources (HR) not only contribute to success but also to the failure of companies. The failure is attributed to a quantitative and qualitative lack of growth-oriented perspective, but it is often too much. Since the causes of staff shortages often cannot be planned, human resources management is faced with the challenge of being able to (re-)act flexibly, and thus with the need to establish a flexible HR dispensation. In order to prepare companies adequately for HR dispensation, Daniel Ebert develops a strategic concept of flexibility-oriented dispensation management. Against the background of the dynamic capacity approach, he develops concrete control levers for flexibility in the preparation of HR dispensation, and presents effective resource and process-level utilization on a more effective level of HR.
content.title_en: Dispensation of human resources: a flexibility-oriented approach

content.text: Company codes: Types and standardization strategies for the implementation of corporate ethics. Corporate ethical codes are documents that describe morally relevant and corporate-wide binding standards. Despite their practical dissemination, it is still unclear whether and to what extent codes in the intended sense are behavioural influencing, uphold moral norms in the company and improve the moral quality of corporate decisions. Till Talaulicar presents a comprehensive normative analysis of corporate ethical codes and develops a code typology based on design-relevant code features. To this end, he chooses a determined design-oriented perspective. The aim is to identify the essential design dimensions of corporate ethical codes and develop recommendations for their appropriate design. The work was awarded with the 2007 Science Award of the Plansecur Foundation.
content.title_en: Business codes : Types and standardization strategies for the implementation of an enterprise ethics

content.text: Governance of spatial competition units: An approach to tourism destination. Local and regional spaces are the result of the consolidation of economic, political, social and cultural activities. They compete with each other, but also offer a designable environment for action. The management of their development to support their competitiveness is a complex process. Governance describes changes in the governance discussion, not unilateral concepts, but the interaction of self-organisation and steering in the foreground. Based on the political control theory Frieda Raich examines the specificities of the management of spatial competition units at regional level and shows points of approach for a competitive development of regional spaces. It combines the discussed control levels and elements into a model of the governance of tourism destinations, establishes a practical reference by means of an empirical study and finally concreteises the essential determinants in tourism spaces. Introduction -- Governance -- Governance of spatial, regional competition units -- Governance of tourism—Destinations -- Empirical investigation -- Final consideration and outlook.
content.title_en: Governance of territorial competition units : An approach for tourism destination

content.text: Management of international financial and currency risks : With exercises and solutions. The rapid globalization of financial markets not only confronts professionals in banking circles daily with new situations. Every international company needs today secure knowledge in this field to remain permanently competitive. Klaus Stocker introduces vividly and instigates into this topic. Step by step, a fundamental understanding of which financial risks are exposed to globally active companies and which instruments are available for efficient risk management. Exercise questions and cases in each chapter deepen the material. Based on the solution instructions, the learning success can be reviewed at any time. 'Management of international financial and currency risks' has been completely revised for the second edition and now takes into account much more currency and exchange rate problems. Professor Dr. Klaus Stocker, with longstanding international banking experience, teaches international financing and foreign economics at the University of Applied Sciences Nuremberg as head of the International Business study program. He is also a consultant to numerous international banks and companies.
content.title_en: Management of International Financial and Currency Risks : With Exercises and Solutions

content.text: The book presents current qualitative country studies by leading experts in the field in the light of the theory of social democracy by Thomas Meyer. The exhibition will be presented in Sweden, Japan, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom and the USA. The focus will be on the overall relationship between all social areas that are crucial for social democracy, from political culture and the political system, to the education system and the welfare state, to the political economy. The context will be analysed. The USA and Japan are involved in the first case to illustrate the contrast to a libertarian democracy and in the second case to prove that social democracy is a universal project. A new index for measuring social democracy is also presented. Based on a quantitative OECD country comparison, it allows a highly informative ranking of social democracy in terms of its political and social inclusion ability.
content.title_en: Practice of Social Democracy

content.text: Implementation of controlling instruments: Identification and overcoming implementation barriers. The implementation of controlling instruments is confronted with considerable difficulties over and over again by managers and controllers. So far, different aspects of implementation problems have been analysed - mostly case-based - but a comprehensive picture is missing to the basic understanding of the many possible problem areas. Natalie Parvis-Trevisany develops a comprehensive typology of implementation barriers to derive starting points for the successful introduction of controlling instruments. It is based on a cognitive-scientific and structuring theoretically inspired perspective, as the implementation of controlling instruments usually requires a reorientation and cognitive interpretation performance of the involved persons and acts, instruments and systems, corporate culture and internal models of the involved actors are interdependent. Their concept can be used as a framework of thought and checklist for the implementation of implementation projects. Introduction -- Conceptual reference framework: Dynamic theory of economic actors as a starting point -- Modelling the implementation of controlling instruments -- For the implementation success of controlling instruments -- Identification of potential implementation barriers - Conceptual approach barriers - Overcoming implementation barriers.
content.title_en: Implementation of controlling tools : Identification and overcoming implementation barriers

content.text: Inter-company recycling: cooperation for sustainable development using the example of industrial recycling networks. Inter-company recycling activities in corporate networks are mostly examined from a process-based perspective, for example with regard to the requirements for the quality of residues or the manufacturing processes in which secondary raw materials are used. Based on the premise that recycling-oriented residue flows between network companies are the result of acting and deciding human actors, Alfred Posch deals with inter-company recycling cooperations from a social and economic perspective. He analyses the theoretical approaches, especially from the field of organizational theory, which are suitable to explain the phenomenon of industrial recycling networks and designs an innovative concept with which industrial recycling networks can be developed into sustainability networks. He reviews his hypotheses using an empirical survey in industry. Fundamentals and definitions -- Theoretical approaches to industrial recycling networks -- Recycling networks and sustainable development -- Empirical analysis -- Summary and conclusions.
content.title_en: Inter-company recycling : cooperation for sustainable development using the example of industrial exploitation networks

content.text: Implementation of environmental information systems: Industrial environmental protection and communication of environmental information in companies and networks. Terms and basics -- Communication of environmental information at the company level — Operational environmental information systems -- Networks as the basis of a corporate communication of environmental information -- Empirical investigations into operational and over-company environmental information systems -- Development of an implementation concept for operational and over-company environmental information systems -- Summary and outlook. Environmental information plays an important role in industrial environmental protection in order to be able to implement environmental protection activities at the company and over-company level effectively and efficiently. Elke Perl examines how environmental information in companies must be processed and how environmental information systems must be designed to support measures on industrial environmental protection. The following questions are at the heart of this: " Fulfill existing theoretical concepts and software on operational environmental information systems the requirements placed upon them? " Give software providers sufficient attention to the operational framework conditions and barriers when introducing them? " How does the implementation of environmental information systems depend on the initial situation in the company? " Which framework conditions must be fulfilled for successful implementation of environmental information systems at the company and over-company level?
content.title_en: Implementation of environmental information systems : Industrial environmental protection and communication of environmental information in companies and networks

content.text: The institutionalization of New Public Management : Disciplinary dynamics of administrative science under the influence of economic theory. Introduction: Administrative reform as an economic project - Administrative science as an economic theory? -- Disciplinary dynamics -- Institutionalization milieu: Neoliberalism, Economization -- Institutionalization process and result: Empirical findings of a bibliometric study -- Conclusion: Economicization of administrative science - Threat or opportunity? Public administration was and is subject to many criticisms. For example, it is accused of bureaucraticising economic and social life and of hindering necessary social change. New Public Management (NPM) essentially wants to contribute to solving the problems by re-cutting the public sector on the one hand and internal optimization of administrative structures and processes on the other. Rick Vogel examines the disciplinary dynamics that triggered the reception of NPM and the associated economic theoretical imports of German administrative science. Here, it is not about administrative, but rather about scientific transformation under NPM: The economicization of administrative science is a discussion. The author shows the dual division of the discourse into oppositional meaning-provinces on which economic economics can only be recognized as a reality, and the result of a phenomenon of a phenomenon that is exclusively re-represented.
content.title_en: Institutionalization of New Public Management : Disciplinary Dynamics of Administrative Science under the Influence of Economic Theory

content.text: Avoidance of Earnings Management of Revenues : An economic analysis of international accounting standards. The considerable reactions of the capital market to changes in the revenue of companies result - also from an economic point of view - in the demand to make the relevant accounting standards resistant to manipulation. Christian Herold examines under which conditions manipulation of the accounting can occur. In this regard, the incentives derived from human behaviour and the institutional framework play a central role. The emphasis lies on the standards for the turnover realization according to US GAAP, IFRS and HGB. Based on numerous examples, the author demonstrates a standard failure that can be corrected by the fundamental orientation on principles-based or regulation-based standards. The work offers numerous proposals for standard clarification and extensive disclosure requirements in order to prevent manipulation of revenue and to make it easily recognizable for the final addressee. Theoretical and empirical aspects of the earnings management -- Standards of turnover realization -- Economic analysis of the law -- Thesis-shaped summary.
content.title_en: Avoidance of Earnings Management of Revenues : An Economic Analysis of International Accounting Standards

content.text: The audit of financial statements and business risk: Standardative requirements for the audit of financial statements and its fulfilment by a business risk-oriented audit process. The audit of financial statements is considered to be an effective and efficient form of auditing of financial statements. Without having been subject to intensive scientific discussion, it has developed into a state of the art. Robert Link examines the specific benefits of a business risk-oriented audit approach against the background of legal requirements. The analysis of the regulatory requirements for the audit shows that in order to fulfil the statutory audit mandate, sound knowledge of the business activities of the entity to be audited and the resulting business risks are required. The author shows how the audit technical requirements can be specified and the requirements for the audit can be met. Finally, he illustrates the conditions under which a business risk-oriented audit procedure contributes to improving audit quality and efficiency. The basis of the investigation -- development of a business risk understanding -- examination of the statutory audit standards against the background of a business risk-oriented audit process -- examination of selected professional statements regarding the consideration of the business performance of the audit of the business and the result of the financial statements in the business risk-related business risk assessment of the business risk.
content.title_en: Audit and business risk : Standardative requirements for the statutory audit and its fulfilment by a business risk-oriented audit process

content.text: Structural analysis of web-based document. Structural aspects of hypertextual units -- Limits of content-based categorization of hypertext structures -- Graph theory and structural similarity: Known methods -- Graph-based analysis and retrieval: New approach -- Excursion: Structure prediction -- Summary and outlook. Web mining, which consists of the sub-areas of Web Structure Mining, Web Content Mining and Web Usage Mining, is becoming increasingly important in the course of web-based communication. Due to inconceivable data volumes in the web, powerful methods for obtaining and analysing web-based information are of great importance. Matthias Dehmer is moving the web structure mining, especially the structural analysis of web-based hypertexts based on directed graphs, to the centre of his study. The author presents a graphentheoretical model for determining the structural similarity of a class of directed graphs. Based on the model addressed, he conducts experiments with existing hypertexts and describes novel applications in web structure mining and other areas.
content.title_en: Structural analysis of web-based document

content.text: Development of spatial clusters: The example of Internet and e-commerce creations in Germany. Since the late 1970s, the American Silicon Valley has been seen as a guiding principle for successful regional development. Its proximity allows the technology foundations there to exploit collective location advantages and to grow successfully. In the example of the newly created business area Internet/E-Commerce, Lutz Krafft investigates location advantages and self-enhancing effects that have been involved in the development of such spatial clusters. The basis of his study is the most extensive survey of Internet/E-commerce formations in Germany so far: more than 12,500 companies were surveyed via Internet research, surveyed online and observed over a period of three years to monitor the development of the industry and clusters in detail. The comparison of location patterns and location factors shows which factors are relevant for the choice of the location and which influence the regional failure rates. Finally, the author derives starting points for the promotion and successful development of spatial clusters. Theoretical foundations -- Investigation design and methodology -- Overall economic environment and development of the economic sector -- Locations and location selection -- Dynamic development of the results of the spatial clusters - Summary of the results of the spatial results.
content.title_en: Development of spatial clusters : The example of Internet and e-commerce creations in Germany

content.text: The Devil's Cloth : a cultural history of stripes and striped fabrics. Folding text: In the Middle Ages the strip marked the socially excluded; it was associated with the devil and threatened the - monochrome - order. On the way from the Renaissance through the French Revolution to the 20th century, the attitude of society towards the striped changes sustainably: the stripes become an expression of freedom, youth and joy of life.
content.title_en: The Devil's Cloth : a Cultural History of Stripes and Striped Fabrics

content.text: Systems of external quality control in the professional status of auditors: A play-heoretical consideration. and problem--Current quality assurance measures for auditors -- External quality control in international comparison -- Information economic analysis of external quality control -- Survey on external quality control in Swiss professional status -- Summary. The impact of external quality control in the professional status of auditors on the quality of published company data depends on the behaviour of the accounting officer, the auditor and the auditor for external quality control. Due to the behavioural interdependencies to be considered, the forecast of the effects of a new introduction of external quality control is complex. In particular, it is not clear which system of external quality control - peer review or monitoring - is more suitable to achieve an improvement of the quality of published company data. Günther Gabor examines the effects of the different system variants of external quality control on the independence of the auditor, the work performed in the audit and the management's balance sheet policy are expected to be achieved. He also analyses how the considered strategic interdependencies on the investment behaviour of the audit society, which is aimed at improving its quality assurance system, is shown in the analysis of the evaluation.
content.title_en: Systems of external quality control in the professional profession of auditors : A play-heoric consideration
