content.text: Resource-restricted project planning for specified work volumes. Introduction to problem setting -- Modelling and problem structure -- Lower barriers -- Project planning procedures -- Experimental performance analysis. An important sub-area of operations research is project planning. Their methods can be used to plan the flow of different projects occurring in practice. Cord-Ulrich Fündeling develops exact and heuristic solution methods for different variants of a resource-restricted project planning problem, in which instead of durations and resource utilization work volumes, e.g. in man-days, are given for the processes and the project duration is to be minimized. The performance of the procedures is demonstrated in the context of an extensive experimental performance analysis.
content.title_en: Resource-restricted project planning for specified work volumes

content.text: Corporate Reputation and Purchase Behavior : Methodical Aspects of Complex Structure Models. Motivation -- Reputation as an Entrepreneurial Target Size -- The Relevance of Corporate Reputation for Business Act -- Design Specification: Methodical Aspects for the Applicability of Structural Equation Analysis -- A Design of Investigation for the Customer Effect of Corporate Reputation -- Results of Empirical Investigation -- Implications and Outlook. Among the much discussed intangible assets, the Reputation of a company has a special significance. Although it has many positive effects, especially on the company's customers, there is no evidence that a good reputation can attract more customers or a higher product price. Markus Eberl develops a comprehensive purchasing behaviour model that examines the influence of corporate reputation on pricing and purchasing behaviour, and also takes into account moderators and mediators of this relationship. The psychological effects of a global reputation judgment can be demonstrated for the first time in an experimental study. Building on the existing operationalization paradigms that he develops for formative constructs, the author's randomly-based and buy-based configuration.
content.title_en: Business reputation and purchasing behaviour : Methodical aspects of complex structural models

content.text: Blended Learning to improve the management of conversations in sales: Use and evaluation in the training of sales interviews in retail. Responsible personnel development budget often have reservations when it comes to promoting soft skills. They doubt, for example, that the ability to conduct sales talks can be improved measurable. Services in this training field are therefore only used very reluctantly. Thorsten Bosch places the measureability of training success in the soft skills area at the centre of his investigation and evaluates the "Bosch model" he developed himself, a blended learning concept to improve the ability to conduct sales talks. Here, he relies on ongoing customer projects of his consulting company and measures them in real time. It becomes clear that soft skills can be measurably improved by his model and that framework conditions, e.g. personality characteristics, significantly affect the implementation of the learned in practice problem--- Instructural approaches -- Blended Learning in business training and further training -- The Bosch model - Evaluation of environments - Summary of learning methods - Assessment - Assessment - Assessment - Assessment - Assessment - Research questions
content.title_en: Blended Learning to improve sales management : Use and evaluation in the training of sales talks in the retail trade

content.text: Optimization of customer loyalty in mass markets: An empirical study in the Austrian mobile phone market. Conceptual basics -- Development of a causal model to explain customer loyalty in the mobile phone market -- Empirical findings -- Final consideration. Customer loyalty is one of the most important strategy options of marketing. This shows, among other things, the multitude of scientific studies on this topic. However, the findings are very different and not easy to implement into business practice. Harald Kindermann identifies and analyses determinants that are relevant for the sustainable bonding of customers. He integrates theories and findings of psychology and social psychology and shows completely new aspects of customer loyalty. Thus, an extensive empirical study in the Austrian mobile phone market confirms, for example, his thesis that the "classical" customer loyalty determinants have to be replaced by the attitude of the construct. Concrete proposals for the entrepreneurial practice and implications for science complete the work.
content.title_en: Optimization of customer loyalty in mass markets : An empirical study in the Austrian mobile phone mart

content.text: Leisure properties and urban development in Hamburg: Real estate project development, event management and location factors. The increasing international city competition forces cities to sharpen their location profile. The leisure infrastructure of a city, which can be expanded or improved by targeted major events, such as the Olympic Games, thus represents a significant competitive advantage. New challenges for urban development arise and spatial networking changes. Stephanie Gamm, using the example of the Hamburg Arena, examines the question of what city-economic effects can be proven in the process of real estate project development of an arena. The author integrates urban planning-related elements into a business-geographical level of view and develops concepts and solutions for the project development of leisure sites. The general framework conditions of real estate project development in event management and its sustainable urban economic effects -- Basic aspects for real estate project development -- Essential aspects for event management -- Importance and environment of sustainable urban economic effects -- Urban economic structures of the free and Hanseatic city of Hamburg in connection with the development of a multi-functional large-scale event hall - Conceptualization of a strategy - Assessment of a framework of the arena.
content.title_en: Leisure real estate and urban development in Hamburg : Real estate project development, event management and location factors

content.text: Employee surveys as an intervention tool : To investigate their effectiveness on the basis of the criterion of job satisfaction. In many companies employee surveys are considered as the standard repertoire of change management and personnel management. Integrated into operational processes, they can initiate and control change processes and thus contribute to improving the competitiveness of a company. Despite the high degree of dissemination, however, there are hardly any evaluation studies available to evaluate the effectiveness of this instrument. Christian Liebig examines the effectiveness of employee surveys and shows that the following points are essential for their success: The results must be communicated in a differentiated manner, the problem areas identified and corresponding intervention measures derived, implemented and evaluated. If this does not happen, the potential of employee surveys will not be exhausted and even negative effects can occur. Background -- Employee surveys as an intervention tool -- Conceptualization of work satisfaction -- Effects of intervention instruments on work satisfaction -- Concreteization of research questions -- Empirie: Effectiveness of employee surveys -- General discussion -- On the effectiveness of employee surveys — Conclusion.
content.title_en: Employee surveys as an intervention tool : study of their effectiveness on the basis of the criterion of job satisfaction

content.text: Financial assessment of environmental investments. and course of investigation -- Basics — For the financial assessment of environmental investments in enterprises -- The financial assessment of investments -- The determination of the financial assessment of environmental investments from the contexts of production theory and production programme planning -- The financial assessment of environmental investments -- Summary. The financial assessment of environmental investments has so far been neglected in business research. While financing theoretical studies are increasingly focusing on equilibrium approaches and market values, environmental economic work involves non-monetary aspects in the assessment, but often insufficiently depict the payment level. Heinz Eckart Klingelhöfer develops an approach to assessing such investments on imperfect capital markets under uncertainty. This requires the inclusion of production economic contexts in order to determine the individual economic relevant payment flows and to take due account of the effects of the environmental conditions given by the environment. By formally identifying the determinants of the marginal price of an environmental investment, it is possible to gain insights for the calculation of correct capital values and the consequences of changes in the framework conditions for the profit-sharing of investments, it is not desirable to follow these changes.
content.title_en: Financial assessment of environmental investments

content.text: Precarious statehood and international order. Threats to global security are now primarily caused by weak and decaying states. Wherever governments can no longer ensure public order, violence is not only escalating and people suffer. The state-free zones are occupied by "warlords", internationally operating terrorists and organized crime and abused for their purposes. Therefore, since the terrorist attacks of September 11, questions of state and nation formation are at the center of international attention. The stability of the international order itself depends not least on the fact that its building blocks, the states, are functional and resilient. The book examines exemplarily the causes of precarious statehood and discusses how the European Union and the international community can support the construction of viable states. In addition to classical approaches to state formation, other forms of governance (imperias, shared sovereignty, global governance) are also discussed.
content.title_en: Precarious Statehood and International Order

content.text: Planning of photovoltaic systems: basics and project planning. Photovoltaic systems are currently many – but only a few have been perfectly implemented. Unfortunately, inexperience and lack of expertise of planners often lead to serious execution errors in configuration and installation. Basic prerequisites for good yield and high efficiency of photovoltaic systems – such as the calculation of shading by far-off objects – are often not taken into account and the selection of suitable components is operated with too little care. Planning of photovoltaic systems supports the planner from the first consideration to the dimensioning of a PV system to the creation of finished contract preprints for regulating feed-in compensation. Technical terms such as "Performance Ratio" or "maximum power point" are also explained in a clear and practical manner. Basics -- Funding/Approvals -- Investment -- Building requirements -- Economicity -- Final consideration and outlook.
content.title_en: Planning of photovoltaic systems : Basics and project planning

content.text: Electronic signatures in modern business processes: Implement slim and efficient processes with the own-handed electronic signature. Introduction and overview -- Legal foundations of electronic signature -- Technical realization of electronic signatures -- The electronic signature in business processes -- Case study -- Summary and outlook. In many business processes, signing legally binding documents by customers or employees is necessary. The creation, processing, evaluation and archiving of such documents causes long process times and high costs. Due to the legal equality of electronic signatures with the own-handed signature, it is possible for a short time to sign documents electronically in a legally secure manner, e.g. by using the own-handed electronic signature. This book explains the measurable benefits resulting from this and shows ways to carry out appropriate IT projects correctly and successfully.
content.title_en: Electronic signatures in modern business processes : realize slim and efficient processes with the personal electronic signature

Numerous program examples and exercises demonstrate the application of the presented communication concepts. content.text: Quality measurement of services in the service centre: Conception and empirical review of the example of a transport airport. The service sector is becoming increasingly important in all economies and thus also increases the customer requirements for the quality of the services offered. Service providers respond to this trend by offering their services more in cooperation with other companies in the form of service centres. Examples of such service centres are, among other things, traffic airports, amusement parks, shopping centres and medical centers. Sandrina Meldau develops a process by which the quality of these centres can be measured. Its model enables the identification of the origin and effect of the quality of services and the quality drivers within a service centre to be accurately identified. Based on the findings gained, the author explains the contribution of the results in the framework of a management system to create, safeguard and increase the quality of a service centre. "Quality measurement in service centres" is used by the management centre as a central influence on the overall assessment of the customer.
content.title_en: Quality measurement in service centres : Conception and empirical review using the example of a transport airport

content.text: Logistics networks : Models for location selection and route planning. Methodological support for decisions regarding location selection, freight flows and route planning is an important component for maintaining competitiveness in complex value-added networks. This book describes models for planning logistics networks and presents practical solutions. Numerous examples and tasks complement the explanations.
content.title_en: Logistics networks : Models for location selection and tour planning

content.text: Public procurement marketing: a key figure system for procurement management. So far, many different approaches to improving profitability have been pursued in the administrative reform, but the input side of performance creation has often been overlooked. However, public procurement has enormous potential for each individual administrative operation, and any euro saved in public procurement can be used to relieve the budget or to generate further services. However, there are no corresponding concepts to this effect. Constantin Blome develops a basic model for public procurement marketing. By embedding it in a key figure system, it is able to meet the specific conditions of public procurement, e.g. public procurement law, and can be used directly in practice. Due to the modularity of the key figure system, the model can be adapted to the needs of administrative enterprises of any size and any level of reform. Introduction -- The status quo in local administration -- The procurement law -- Conception of private and public procurement marketing -- Key figures and key figures systems in the management of public procurement marketing -- Implementation -- Summary and outlook.
content.title_en: Public procurement marketing : A key indicator system for award management

content.text: Risk management for IT projects. The competence to successfully carry out IT projects is crucial to be able to compete. Failing or not completed projects have a negative impact on the company's success. How can appropriate risks be minimized? Based on practical experience from the IT consulting industry, Jessica Wack develops a quantitative method for measuring and describing the risk potential of IT projects as well as a computer-based risk prevention process by means of a cost-optimised set of measures. In addition to a stochastic view of the risks, the focus is on the methods of Monte Carlo simulation and linear optimization. Basics of project management -- Risk analysis in the context of project management -- Management of project risk for IT projects -- Dimensions of risk analysis based on a "Project Risk Models" -- Empirical survey to determine relevant risk and measure sizes -- Risk analysis using Monte Carlo simulation without taking into account risk minimising measures -- Development and implementation of an optimization model for risk prevention -- Risk analysis using advanced forecasting -- Risk analysis - Risk analysis after the assessment of the risk analysis.
content.title_en: Risk management for IT projects

content.text: Real estate portfolio management for the public sector: objectives, benefits and practices in practice based on benchmarks. Unlike private real estate management (Corporate Real Estate Management), public real estate management organisations do not have to compete with each other because they implement the policy guidelines for general interest. Nevertheless, the properties entrusted to them are increasingly seen as assets whose value it is necessary to maintain or increase. Therefore, management tools must be used in the future to enable the valuation of public real estate and the demonstrable optimisation of the overall portfolio by the development of individual real estate. Stephan Seilheimer shows how public real estate assets can be analysed, evaluated and managed and how they can be brought to the market. To this end, he develops a five-stage model for the introduction of a key-number-based portfolio management by benchmarking including a valuation system for public real estate. The application of the model in practice is illustrated by a public real estate portfolio with 500 000 m2 of usable area and economic efficiency over a period of three years.
content.title_en: Real estate portfolio management for the public sector: objectives, benefits and practices in practice based on benchmarks

content.text: In-house application integration: IT management in corporate networks. Introduction -- Basics and methodological requirements -- Investigation of existing integration methods -- Method for integration planning and evaluation in corporate networks -- Evaluation of the integration method -- Final consideration. The integration of application systems has been discussed for some time in science and practice. However, it is questionable whether the results achieved so far are transferable to corporate networks, since there are often no classic business processes in order to create contracts in networks. Based on the "Method Engineering" Florian Stadlbauer examines the integration process in network practice using four case studies. He identifies network-specific integration requirements and compares them with existing integration methods. On this basis, he develops his own method approach, which uses detailed techniques to help identify network-specific integration areas and their evaluation, planning and economic evaluation.
content.title_en: Inter-company application integration : IT management in enterprise networks

content.text: Total Quality Management in Tourism. Basics and Management of Tourism Organizations -- Quality and Quality Management -- Quality Management Research -- Quality Management Conceptualization of Quality for Tourism Organizations -- Empirical Survey Research Design -- Organisational Quality of Tourism Organizations -- Organizational Quality -- Organizational Quality Management -- Conclusion. Total Quality Management (TQM) has been used in many industries for some time and is becoming increasingly a strategic success factor for tourism service providers. Birgit Muskat examines the importance and application of Total Quality Management in local and regional tourism organisations, which is equally geared to processes, employees and customers. The author reveals factors that promote or rather inhibit the implementation of quality management in tourism organizations and shows that high internal quality requires the involvement of all employees and the process-oriented processing of the work processes that is oriented towards customer requirements. Based on the results of a survey of all 5,400 German public tourism agencies, the author gives indications on structural improvement and organizational optimization.

content.text: The organizational culture as the influence of export performance: An empirical analysis in the context of small and medium-sized enterprises. In increasingly international-oriented competition, a good performance on the export market is required to exist as a small and medium-sized enterprise. Research and practice are informed about the effects, for example, that dominance and uniqueness of the offered product, competitive situation on the export market or price concept on the export performance. However, it raises the question whether, in addition to these economic factors, other factors determine the export performance of the companies. Ursula Christine Loisch examines in an empirical analysis the influence of organizational-cultural values on export performance in small and medium-sized enterprises. It presents different organizational-cultural concepts and values and shows that export performance is influenced by the following values: the adaptability of a company, thus the ability to adapt quickly to adapt to these conditions, the ability to change in terms of strategic performance, the ability to perform and to react to a significant degree.

content.text: Psychic Distance and Internationalization of SMEs: Empirical Research using the example of the Saxon-Czech border region. Radka Hodicová looks into the question of how the owners of SMEs proceed in the search for a foreign cooperation partner and what factors influence the considerations and decisions of these entrepreneurs. content.text: Optical networks: A field-theoretical approach. Based on the field-theoretical principles, a theory for solving practical problems of high-bitrate optical message transmission is developed for light as an electromagnetic wave. An approach with all three components of the respective field vector can be used to indicate elimination possibilities for adverse polarization-dependent damping, polarization-mode dispersion and disruptive mode coupling in the form of the extended Jones and coherence matrice calculus. The above-mentioned disadvantages can be identified by switching optical assemblies, e.g. optical waveguides, with optical transformation networks, using new synthesis methods to realize them. Furthermore, it is shown how the developed theory can be applied to optical current sensors to eliminate the negative double-break effect on the faraday effect. To apply the above-mentioned theory, numerous invention reports were submitted and some patents were granted.
content.title_en: Optical networks : A field theoretical access

content.text: Development of a key figure system for marketing tourist destinations. Destination management has the task of effectively and efficiently marketing a place or region. When coordinating the service providers involved, strategic decisions must be made tangible in order to enable controlling. To date, there are only a few controlling approaches in destination management. Using interviews with destination managers from the German-speaking countries, Manuel Becher identifies the criticisms of traditional destination management and develops a key figure system on this basis for better marketing tourist destinations. In particular, the expansion of a strategic perspective by incorporating preliminary indicators into the concept represents an improvement compared to the existing controlling concepts for destination management organisations. content.text: Mystery Shopping : Performance of an instrument for measuring service quality. Comprehensive empirical studies have shown in the past the causal relationship between service quality, customer satisfaction and company success. However, since the customer survey methodology is subject to a large number of disadvantages, many service providers have been prompted to develop new data collection tools such as the Mystery Shopping Methodology. Based on selected theoretical concepts, Karsten Schmidt leads a prerequisite catalog for the successful use of the Mystery Shopping Methodology for evaluating service quality. Subsequently, the question of the reliability and validity of test purchase results is answered using three test purchase studies and an oral or written customer survey. The findings obtained are derived from concrete design recommendations for market research practice and from connection points for further scientific research. Mystery Shopping — An instrument for evaluating service quality -- Methodological foundation of the psychometric quality assessment of service quality judgment of Mystery Shoppers - Measurement approaches and correlations of the performance of the survey results of the survey.

Politicians of all parties repeatedly promote proposals for a simplification of income taxation. The reasons for the discrepancy between perceived and actual tax inequality treatment remain unconsidered. Olga Sava, in view of the dualism of income types in German tax law, asks which objectives should be achieved with a tax reform and which measures would be necessary to achieve the objective. content.text: Labor obligations and their control-heoretical assessment. Introduction -- Labor obligations in an international comparison -- Empirical evaluations of labor obligations -- Model theoretical foundations -- Theoretical analysis -- Political implications -- Final consideration. In many Western countries, social state reforms have been implemented in the past decade aimed at reducing the dependency on transfer of unemployed people. In essence, labor obligations have been established, i.e. the granting of a basic transfer has been made dependent on the performance of a non-profit work. Tim Lohse presents social policy in various states with special consideration of labor obligations, which are referred to as workfare in Anglo-American writing. By varying the tax theory model according to Mirrlees, the author derives basic characteristics of optimal tax transfer systems with labor obligations. It is evident that labor obligations should be part of such systems, provided that the activities carried out within their framework generate a population-based output. Labor obligations then not only lead to a welfare increase, but even a paretoimprovement under circumstances, and are also compatible with the concept of a negative income tax (and thus not a combination of income tax).
content.title_en: Work commitments and their control-heoric assessment

content.text: Conflicts and synergies in multicultural teams: Virtual and face-to-face collaboration. The new media enable virtual collaboration of multicultural working groups, but intercultural misunderstandings often make cooperation difficult. Therefore, the question arises whether multicultural teams are reaching out to the effectiveness of monocultural teams, especially if their members communicate only through media. Petra Köppel identifies the various forms of conflict and synergy of multicultural groups and compares them in virtual and face-to-face environments. Based on this, she develops a multicultural input-process-output model (MIPO model), which provides starting points for the design and management of multicultural working groups. In particular, the author places great emphasis on a differentiated and synergy-oriented breakdown of the influence factor culture, in order to replace the hitherto too simplistic and deficit-oriented approaches. The topic -- Basic concepts -- Group processes, structures and models -- Theoretical embedding of conflicts and synergies -- Empirical investigation into conflicts and synergies -- Empirical modeling: The MIPO model - Conclusions.
content.title_en: Conflicts and synergies in multicultural teams : Virtual and face-to-face cooperation

You want to ensure the necessary quality of the specifications and obligations, and you want to invest little time in market analysis and tendering. The authors show several currently available procedures for the software selection. A procedure where effort and results are in the right relationship is described in detail. You can also take into account compliance and other legal requirements. The necessary comprehensive contract work is made transparent. You control your overall project. The results are in the interest of your company. Three experts provide you with the most important information from practice, theory and law. Focus on the essentials: your business.
content.title_en: The right way to choose software: specifications, specifications, compliance, success control

content.text: Food Physics: Physical Characteristics - Measurement and Application. Food Physics deals with the physical properties of food and its collection. The physical properties of food play an essential role wherever modern food technology processes are used for the extraction of raw materials or the production of food. The determination of physical quantities of food and commodities are no longer to be taken away from the planning, control and automation of the manufacturing processes in the food, pharmaceutical and cosmetics industry and adjacent areas. Besides chemical quality control, the determination of physical properties also plays an important role in the determination and assurance of the quality of our food. The consumer increasingly demands "less chemistry" in food production and large areas of the food industry will have to meet these desires increasingly by using modern physical processes in production. The book is therefore an essential prerequisite for this, too, to understand the physical properties of food and the possibilities and limits of its measurement technology collection. This book describes food physics from a basic perspective and focuses exclusively on the requirements of food practice without giving up the important foundations for the study of food chemistry and the use of the technology of the universities.
content.title_en: Food Physics : Physical Characteristics - Measurement and Application

content.text: Descriptive statistics: An introduction with exercises and examples with SPSS. Statistical methods are used in the economy as well as in the natural and social sciences. Statistics are nevertheless considered difficult. To overcome this barrier, the authors provide a didactically sophisticated, application-related introduction to the methods of descriptive statistics and data analysis. Based on practical examples, the ideas of data management and data evaluation are described using SPSS and R. Many exercise tasks (with solutions) support the (self-) study of the readers. The book covers the subject Statistik I completely at German-speaking universities. New in this edition are the use of the statistical software package R and a short introduction in its practical handling. The introduction to SPSS was also revised and supplemented.
content.title_en: Descriptive statistics : An introduction with exercises and examples with SPSS

content.text: Nanotechnology: Research, development, application. Nanotechnology has the potential to fundamentally change entire technology fields. In the future, it will not only have a significant influence on technological development, but will also bring economic, ecological, ethical and social implications. It will combine hopes for significant sales potential in all sectors of the economy. The reduction of dimensions to the nanometer range often leads to characteristic material properties that can be used for completely new applications. Nanotechnology can thus be used to realize completely new architectures and process processes. The first survey on nanotechnology addresses these diverse concrete applications in a well-prepared form. This study not only provides policy-making support, but also provides the interested public with a sound, broad-based, generalized presentation of the current state and expected perspectives of nanotechnology.
content.title_en: Nanotechnology : Research, development, application

content.text: Descriptive statistics: Interactive graphics. In addition to the formal presentation of a conventional textbook, the authors provide visual access to descriptive statistics. In the form of interactive JAVA applets, which can be used with a common Internet browser, basic graphical methods are presented. The applets, due to their ease of use, not only allow a fast visual-oriented learning success but can also be used to create simple presentation graphics. Each applet has a detailed description, which explains the importance and meaning of the presented procedure in detail and shows its functionality and operation. Due to the variety of available graphics, the book focuses on the presentation of the essential concepts and methods of descriptive statistics and presents them interactively, i.e. from a different perspective. The presented applets and various data sets can be downloaded via the Internet. In addition, the possibility to read and display own data is available. The applets complete the following features: screen-filling representation, free labeling of graphics, printing function.
content.title_en: Descriptive statistics : Interactive graphics

content.text: Introduction to probability theory and statistics. This book provides a systematic introduction to the basic ideas and concepts of probability calculation. The presentation is elementary, i.e. without the use of measuring theoretical aids and without the greatest possible generality. In case of doubt, the raising of an intuitive understanding is given preference over mathematical rigour. The essential concepts and results are introduced first for discrete experiments, and always illustrated by examples. In the second part of the book, dense-distributed random variables are the focus. In this context, the most important distributions of parametric statistics are introduced and the essential computational techniques are discussed. For the second edition, a chapter on the basic concepts of test theory was added.
content.title_en: Introduction to probability theory and statistics

Does the city competition affect a division in declining, stagnating or prosperous urban regions? Can the state actors control this development? With what strategies do the big cities in the policy fields of urban development, local democracy, administrative modernization and labour relations meet the challenges? Despite a multipolar control mix, reforms are possible in the big cities through hegemonic projects. The upper mayor plays the decisive role with his pre-decision structures.
content.title_en: Large cities between hierarchy, competition and cooperation

However, in recent years, the unique nature of places and landscapes has gained in importance. In competition for capital and skilled work, they increasingly determine the locations. Questions of spatial perception and symbols in space, the role of culture and the character of the landscape form the basis for rediscovering the peculiarity of place and landscape. This book discusses theoretical concepts and tells stories of space. In modern cities, the functionality and mobility of people, goods and information are still at the center of attention. content.text: Work and justice: Dismissal and wage cuts in the verdict of the population. A large majority of the German working population considers wage cuts and redundancies unfair. The authors analyse judgments of justice in the population and consequences of actions in labor organizations. They ask whether and to what extent principles of procedural and distribution justice, the business and household context, general sociodemographic characteristics and value orientations influence the evaluation of personnel policies. Finally, the results are compared with preliminary studies in the USA and Canada Why a study on the topic "Work and Justice?" -- Theoretical reference framework and methodological approach -- What influences the acceptance of redundancies and wage cuts? -- Gender and justice -- Work motivation, fluctuation, sickness - How do redundancies and wage cuts affect the impact? -- The attitude towards dismissal protection - How important are justice norms and dismissal experiences? -- Justice judgments in international comparison -- Work and justice: A conclusion

content.text: The transition to ecological agriculture as a decision-making process. Since the beginning of the 1990s, a strong growth in organic agriculture can be seen. Starting from the theory of rationality (Rational Choice Theory), empirical research is conducted into the reasons why farmers choose against conventional and organic agriculture. A second focus is on how environmental awareness can be integrated into the Rational Choice Theory. In addition, problems of operationalization and measurement of rational choice variables are discussed Ecological agriculture: Definition and development -- State of research and theoretical considerations -- Sampling, data collection and structure of the sample -- Operationalization of the central variables -- Review of hypotheses -- Summary and Conclusion
content.title_en: The transition to organic farming as a decision-making process

content.text: Social Democratic Reform Policy and Public Relations. Social Democratic parties have long faced a particular difficulty: on the one hand, they face the challenge of comprehensive reforms, especially of the welfare state, and on the other hand, they are particularly committed to those groups of society that are most affected by reforms. In this context, mediation plays a crucial role in the public sphere. This volume highlights examples from European countries. Frans Becker is a member of Wiardi Beckman Stichting in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. Karl Duffek is director of the Renner Institute in Vienna, Austria. Tobias Mörschel is an employee of the Friedrich Ebert Foundation in Berlin. Social Democratic parties have long faced a particular difficulty: on the one hand, they face the challenge of comprehensive reforms, especially of the social state, and on the other hand, they are particularly committed to those groups of society that are most affected by reforms. In this context, mediation plays a decisive role in the public sphere.

content.text: Iron Materials - Steel and Cast Iron. Iron Materials contribute to the technical development to a considerable extent. They span an astonishingly wide range of properties and applications. Part A of the book is dedicated to the fundamental relationship between the structure and properties of iron materials. Part B, which is more extensive, is about standard materials, recent developments and application in industrial practice, which also touches aspects of processing. General construction materials, but also high-strength, warm-resistant, non-rusting and wear-resistant qualities, as well as tool and functional materials, are discussed. The book closes the gap between steel and cast iron. Therefore, in each chapter, the sliding transitions between the two areas of iron materials are discussed. The authors show that steel and cast iron are not part of the old iron, but remain young and adaptable, which speaks for their future. Part A: Basics of iron materials: Constitution -- Warm-Flows -- Heat-treatment -- Properties -- Part B: Iron Materials and their application: Materials for general use -- High-strength materials - Materials for the edge- Processing - Tools - Chemical-Founding - Materials - Chemicals-Stable Materials - Chemicals - Chemicals.

content.text: Thermodynamics of the motor vehicle. Thermodynamics is a challenge for engineers due to its complexity and scope, as well as its phenomenological approach. The book links the theoretical foundations and their mathematical representation with the fields of application in automotive engineering. Many specific examples of automotive engineers and students facilitate the understanding and practical application of basic knowledge. Prof. Dr.-Ing. habil. Cornel Stan teaches technical thermodynamics, combustion engines and alternative propulsion systems at the universities of Paris, Pisa, Perugia and the University of Applied Sciences in Zwickau, where he also acts as chairman of the board of the research and transfer centre there. Professor Stan studied the research areas of aeronautics technology, which received a doctorate in the field of combustion engines and habilitation in automotive technology, include the motor vehicle drive systems, direct injection processes, combustion processes, alternative fuels and heat exchange in the motor vehicle. He is the author or co-author of numerous books, articles and patents.
content.title_en: Thermodynamics of the motor vehicle

content.text: Molecular Gas Dynamics : Introduction to the kinetic theory of gases and lattice-boltzmann methods. This book offers an understandable and well-structured introduction to molecular gas dynamics, showing solutions and applications from an engineering point of view. Starting from the simplest microscopic models, through the equilibrium distribution according to Maxwell to the Boltzmann equation, classical approaches are derived and interpreted from flow mechanics and thermodynamics. In addition, the book also shows current trends, e.g. in numerical method development. Important gas kinetic simulation methods are presented, especially the Lattice-boltzmann methods, which are widely used as new and efficient methods in numerical flow mechanics. The work is suitable as a textbook in engineering and natural sciences and serves as an important basis for engineers in aerospace and process engineering. The author is a professor at the University of Duisburg-Essen and has many years of teaching and research experience in the field of flow mechanics.
content.title_en: Molecular Gas Dynamics : Introduction to the kinetic theory of gases and lattice-boltzmann methods

content.text: Leading IT service companies: Making the future a success. Break out your beliefs -- IT — an industry has normalized -- Become an engineering company -- Outlook: Become a service architect and utility engineer. The IT service industry has been in a state of crisis for five years. Like other industries, it is confronted with shrinking project sizes and falling prices. Skills that were still at the forefront a few years ago has now become a "commodity" book about how to overcome this crisis by its own strength. Service and sales managers not only in the IT industry are sensitized that the profitable future of service companies depends not on their size, but on their service design and engineering strength: in the future, not just the largest companies will have the greatest success, but the companies that have the most top forces in terms of service distribution, project management and technology. These paths from the crisis will be described as practical recommendations for practitioners as concrete recommendations for individual business areas, such as sales, product development, personnel development and technology.

content.text: Spare parts management : Efficient spare parts logistics for industrial companies. Economic management of spare parts is becoming increasingly important due to the increasing use of plants and the increase in capital invested there. Automation, mechanization and the efficient interlinkage of the plants lead to considerable losses in the operation of the plants, which can be prevented by a suitable replacement or reserve part storage. This book deals with spare parts management from the user's perspective. Taking into account different objectives of maintenance and material management, the book is equally valuable, based on numerous examples from theory and practice, and instructions for planning, procurement, disposition and organization of spare parts. The sections maintenance strategies, procurement program planning, spare parts management, stock segmentation and IT support have been adapted to the current state of economic and business sciences.
content.title_en: Spare parts management : Efficient spare parts logistics for industrial companies

content.text: Concept development and design of technical products: Optimized products - systematically from requirements to concepts. The adapted use of development methods and product models by action-oriented implementation of a systematic concept development and design of technical products is the focus of this book. In addition, the mastery of the complexity of product and process is clearly structured. The book sets out on basic knowledge of systematic problem solving and methodical product development. A navigation model for the development process, from requirements to functional, active and construction models is introduced. In addition, the handling of different main objectives in the sense of a "Design for X" demonstrates on examples of the topics safety and reliability, weight, assembly justice, variety of variants and sustainability. A uniform chapter structure and numerous practical examples support the clarity and visuality of the reader. An annex with checklists to support the practical application of the methods and aids completes the book.
content.title_en: Concept development and design of technical products : Optimized products - systematically from requirements to concepts

content.text: The competition for market shares and attractive niche markets forces automotive manufacturers and suppliers alike to reduce model life cycles and to expand the model range with new variants more than ever before. Therefore, series production runs are not only more frequent, but also at shorter intervals. For this reason, the systematic start-up management is a critical success factor for the automotive industry. It is primarily aimed at achieving the set quality, timing and cost targets and supports companies in making the series start-up both technically and economically successful. The book presents the scientifically sound "start-up management model" with the areas start-up strategy, start-up organization, change management, cost management, production management, supplier management and logistics management. On this basis, it provides the current practical knowledge of the international automobile manufacturers and suppliers on the topic start-up management and provides design recommendations. Thus, the publishing house combines the latest knowledge from science and practice and is intended to support practitioners in sustainably increasing the start-up performance of their companies.
content.title_en: Successful implementation of start-up management in the automotive industry : A guide to practice

Targets and ways of cryptography -- Symmetric ciphers -- Hash functions -- Asymmetric ciphers -- Authentication protocols -- Security protocols and key management -- Chip cards and security modules. Cryptographic procedures are indispensable in the realization of electronic business processes. They secure billing in mobile networks and form a basis for security on the Internet and in end devices as well as for the electronic awarding of licenses. In this book, security services and security mechanisms are conceptually introduced and simple cryptographic mechanisms are illustrated using historical methods. Modern cryptographic algorithms are based on discrete algebra; these can be intuitively replicated with simple examples. Elliptical curves and quantum cryptography are also addressed in newer areas. In addition to basic cryptographic mechanisms and protocols, the book provides insight into applications such as newer security processes on the Internet and in mobile networks, operating systems of chip cards, Trusted Computing and public key infrastructures.

In times of increasing flexibility, leisure orientation and frequent job changes, sustainable identification with the employer is often the exception rather than the company normality. For companies, the consequences are associated with high costs, which is why the conscious strengthening of organizational identification is one of the core tasks of personnel management. Stephan Böhm develops a cause-effect model of collective organizational identification and checks it on the basis of a quantitative longitudinal analysis. He shows how transformational leaders can create a sustainable identity that strengthens the identification and commitment of their employees, while the intention to terminate is reduced. By means of qualitative methods, the author conducts justified practical recommendations. In this context, he particularly addresses the need to convey strategic future perspective and organizational pride. content.text: Transfer pricing systems for horizontal forwarding networks: Simulation-based design and evaluation. Cooperation in forwarding networks also enables small and medium-sized forwarding companies to offer the transport networks required by the market. An appropriate division of the cooperation success is of particular importance for the stability of large networks. A decisive instrument is the calculation pricing system, which regulates the evaluation of the services provided and used by the partners. Martina Weddewer analyses evaluation systems for forwarding networks with hub-and-spoke structures. After a fundamental consideration of the transfer problems within the cooperation management, it summarizes considerations for the design of concrete transfer pricing systems for unit-value networks. Based on this, the author develops a simulation system, which allows the evaluation of alternative transfer pricing systems from the point of view of cooperation and the individual partners and thus effectively supports the decision-making processes. Transfer pricing systems for undertaking networks -- Cooperations of logistics service providers -- Transfer pricing systems for forwarding networks -- Simulation-based design and evaluation of transfer pricing systems for unit-value networks - Sample analysis.

content.text: Open innovation processes: The commercial development of open source software. Acquisition of innovation pensions -- Open source software: Basic -- Empirical analysis: Embedded Linux -- Model theoretical analyses of collective innovation processes -- Summary and outlook. The use of open source software (OSS) is now widespread in companies. OSS and the open source approach also play an increasingly important role in the innovation process. Many companies continue to develop OSS programs and make their developments available to the public and free of charge – especially to their competitors and customers. Joachim Henkel shows, by using the example of "embedded Linux", that selective release of developments enables open, collective innovation processes, from which all parties benefit under suitable conditions. Precious parallel work can be avoided and companies concentrate their resources on developments that create real value for their customers. Open innovation processes of this kind require a rethinking of the over-coming attitude to protect intellectual property as comprehensively as possible. The book applies to lecturers and students of business economics with the emphasis on technology and innovation management, and to develop software economics.
content.title_en: Open innovation processes : The commercial development of open source software

content.text: Successful through network competence : Handbook for Regional Development. Networks as social systems that connect people and organizations are a key tool and instrument for managing regional development. In particular, regional development means: The knowledge about the many is linked to the knowledge about the essentials. Recognizing trends and acting accordingly requires systemic knowledge about the interaction of many individual actors from the economy, politics and administration, interest groups and moving citizens from social, cultural and environmental initiatives. The author team, which looks back on years of experience at national and international level in this area, shows possibilities to strengthen regional innovation and economic power through networks, to manage regional development processes and to make joint learning effective. Numerous examples and case studies of projects carried out show the success of the methods and approaches of the authors.
content.title_en: Successful through network competence : Handbook for Regional Development

content.text: Renewable energies and competition in the electricity industry: State regulation compared between Germany and the UK. André Suck is a research associate at the Chair of Comparative Policy Research and Administrative Science at the University of Konstanz. Across Europe, the energy industry faces two key challenges that it faces with new state regulation: the regulation of compliance with climate protection policy objectives and the introduction of competition in the formerly monopolistic sectors. In the British-German comparison, the author analyses in view of an increasing regulatory influence of the European Union, how own approaches to the introduction of the various technologies for the use of renewable energies, but also to liberalise the electricity industry, have emerged from divergent state organisational structures and different historical development paths since the 1970s until 2005.
content.title_en: Renewable energy and competition in the electricity industry: State regulation compared between Germany and the UK

content.text: The internal restrictions of foreign policy decision-making are an important factor in the action of governments at the international level. However, the study uses the theoretical instruments of the Principal Agent approach to analyse the domestic scope of action of governments in two-level constellations. It is the central concern of the volume to resolve this theoretical deficit. The study uses this theoretical toolbox to develop an analysis concept for determining the domestic restrictions of foreign policy in two-level games. With the help of this concept, the volume examines the outstanding landmarks of British European policy under Tony Blair. It thus provides a balance sheet of the European political successes and failures of New Labour at the end of the Blair era.
content.title_en: Principals and agents in two-level games : The domestic restrictions of UK European policy under Tony Blair

content.text: Overweight as a political category? : Normative considerations on the food policy of Renate Künast. Overweight is politicized. It is communicated as a problem in the political sphere and linked with the expectation that politics can put it to its feet. In Germany Renate Künast had a significant part in this politicization. She has made the topic under keywords such as equal opportunities and cost development in the health sector the subject of coordinated state action and also moral appeals. Should this be from a normative point of view, however? Will not such a genuine private matter, our eating habits, be dragged into the light of the public and thus perhaps even contribute to the stigmatization of overweight people? If our diet can be understood as a part of the private sector, what does this mean for politics? Which measures appear more problematic and which ones are offered? With these questions Felissa Mühlich deals.

content.text: The software development process has been in crisis for decades. About half of all resources used in IT production are still lost. Announced programs delay or are lagging behind expectations. Does this have to be the case? The thesis of this work is that the reasons for this are to be looked at in the paradigms underlying the software construction. Instead of looking primarily at applied technology, best practices or processes, the author conducts cause research in the sense of Total Quality Management and puts the thinking and working methods of the developers to the test. He questions the underlying assumptions, searches for new solution paradigms and transfers them to industrial-ready work concepts. An interdisciplinary approach describes how software can become more efficient, cost-effective and qualitatively better, because employees have learned to handle the upcoming tasks holistically. For personnel developers and managers in IT as well as for software developers who want to deal with their further qualification and advance these. Prolog -- mispaths and ways of life--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
content.title_en: Ways out of the software crisis: Improvements in software development

content.text: Compendium of Media Design: Production and Technology for Digital and Print Media. The fourth edition of this standard work was completely revised and significantly expanded. content.text: Master Course Parallel and Distributed Systems: Basics and Programming of Multicore Processors, Multiprocessors, Cluster and Grid. This book provides a systematic presentation of the state of the art and current developments in the field of parallel and distributed computing. It presents all relevant hardware architectures for multiprocessors and multicore processors as well as their operating systems up to the Google cluster. Parallel programming is a focus of the work. These include client server models and service-oriented architectures as well as programming models for different storage architectures. A detailed explanation of performance measurements, parallelization techniques and distributed algorithms shows the programmer possibilities and limits of distribution. Methods of static and dynamic computing load distribution are included as well as modern virtualization techniques. The final chapters on cluster and grid computing provide an insight into the current topics of the area and an outlook on future developments.
content.title_en: Master course Parallel and distributed systems : basics and programming of multicore processors, multiprocessors, clusters and grid

content.text: The aim of this work is to present the most important technologies and materials that can be used. The authors describe the principles of action of individual processes as well as the level and type of risks of chosen sealing methods. The authors also take into account the "electrophysical processes" which are discussed in the field of technology and use. The authors advise the reader on all legal "case tricks" that can occur from the supply of construction services to the acceptance of construction and do not require any legal preliminary training. content.text: Social inequality and care : Contributions to social science oriented nursing research. Social inequalities in the context of care provision represent a growing challenge for social and health policy. The contributions of applied nursing research illustrate from a scientific and practical perspective how serious resource differences influence the quality of care. This applies to the design of care arrangements, the effectiveness and efficiency of the care services provided and the function of care care care in the reproduction of social-related health inequalities.
content.title_en: Social inequality and care : Contributions to social science oriented nursing research

content.text: European public relations through public relations? : The European Commission's information policy. The EU has a communication problem: European integration has remained an elite project that many people are not understanding. A solution is expected from the development of a European public sphere. Therefore, promoting such a communication forum between the EU and citizens is the declared goal of the EU Commission. It understands communication as the subject of a new policy: information policy. Can a European public sphere be constructed through public relations work? Where are the possibilities and limits for dialogue with citizens? Michael Brüggemann explains why the demands and realities of the new EU information policy are falling apart. In doing so, he combines the discussion about an effective PR for the EU with the normative question of transparency and a democratic public sphere.
content.title_en: European public relations through public relations? : The European Commission's information policy

content.text: The social constitution of the environment. Environment: sociologicalSocial issues are either ignored or treated in a subordinate way in the environmental and sustainability debate. In contrast, the book provides a general sociological approach to the social dimension of the environment. The focus is on social practices that transform and transform the physical environment. The analyses of the "social constitution of the environment" form the basis for a sociological critique of the various sustainability concepts. In demarcation with the naturalistic primacy of the sustainability debate, societal spaces for design are explored, which do not exhaust themselves in purely adaptation services to the physical limits of growth. In particular, social opportunities for the extended sustainable exploitation of environmental potentials are considered, which can contribute to a de-escalation of ecological and social conflict. From the contentThe sociological deficits of the sustainability debate - environment in environmental sociology - environment in sociological theory - The social constitution of the environment - environment and distribution - environment as social conflict - environment and social integration
content.title_en: The social constitution of the environment

content.text: International (government) organisations have a significant influence on international politics and are increasingly being conceived as the cornerstone of a global governance architecture. Starting from this observation, the work asks how these processes of independent international organizations can be (partially) explained to independent actors. In addition to theories of international relations, the focus is on organizational sociological approaches and, in particular, on system theory and sociological neo-institutionalism, which are made fruitful for the study of international organizations and their processes of independentness. The organizational theoretic added value is illustrated by the example of the World Trade Organization and the Central Commission for the Navigation of the Rhine. Martin Koch is a research assistant at the Faculty of Sociology at Bielefeld University and Managing Director of the Institute for World Society.
content.title_en: The process of independence of international organisations

content.text: Computer simulations and social pedagogical practice: case presentations, modelling and methodological reflections. In the context of the stationary youth aid, violence is now part of everyday life. The teachers working in this field of action often find themselves helpless in contrast to violent behaviour, as existing analyses and approaches to help are often inadequate. Computer simulation programs could provide a remedy here. Matthias Herrmann presents the practical application of computer simulation programs developed by the research group COBASC (Computer Based Analysis of Social Complexity) by Prof. Dr. Jürgen Klüver. He shows that simulation techniques for social science and especially social pedagogical problems represent adequate analysis and control instruments. The practical application of the so-called "soft computing" is carried out by the simulation of a real group of young people within an institution of stationary youth assistance. Matthias Herrmann examines whether computer simulation programs of the so-called 'soft computing' are suitable for the analysis of social pedagogical problems and to what extent solutions for the practice are derived from this. Dr. Matthias Herrmann holds a doctorate with Prof. Dr. Thomas Heinze at the University of Duisburg.
content.title_en: Computer simulations and socio-pedagogical practice : case presentations, modelling and methodological reflections

content.text: The book offers an easy to understand introduction to the construction of reinforced concrete and the basics for the calculation of components. In addition to the design and construction rules, mechanical foundations and the mode of operation of the composite material are explained. The often perceived as difficult design is explained in many graphics. Simple design tasks for each chapter show the application of the formulas in exemplary fashion. Silke Scheerer is working as a scientific assistant at the Institute for Massive Construction of the TU Dresden. She deals with high-strength light concrete under multiaxial stress. Dirk Proske studied construction in Dresden and London. He worked as a construction engineer at the TU Dresden, South Africa and Indonesia. Since 2006 he has been working at the University of Natural Sciences Vienna. Silke Scheer and Dirk Proske conducted teaching events on the subject of steel concrete construction for almost ten years. The aim of these only one semester of teaching events was the rapid entry into the topic of steel concrete construction. This principle also follows the resulting book.
content.title_en: Reinforced concrete for Beginners : Basics for design and construction

content.text: Descriptive statistics: An introduction to methods and applications with R and SPSS. Basics -- Frequency distributions -- Measurements and graphics for one-dimensional characteristics -- Measurements and graphics for the connection between two characteristics -- Two-dimensional features: Linear regression -- Time series -- Ratios and indices -- Missing data -- Introduction to SPSS -- Introduction to R. Statistical methods are used both in the economy and in the natural and social sciences.Statistics are nevertheless considered difficult. To overcome this barrier threshold, the authors provide a didactically sophisticated, application-related introduction to the methods of descriptive statistics and data analysis. Using practical examples, the ideas of data management and data analysis are described using SPSS and R. Many exercise tasks (with solutions) support the (self-) study of readers. The book covers the subject of statistics I at German-speaking universities completely. New in this edition are the use of the statistical software package R and a short introduction to its practical handling. The introduction to SPSS was also revised and supplemented.
content.title_en: Descriptive statistics : An introduction to methods and applications with R and SPSS

content.text: Energy application technology: ways and techniques for more efficient energy use. Introduction and basic concepts -- covering process heat requirements -- space heating and air conditioning -- lighting -- stationary drives -- energy application in transport -- data gain and processing. The spectacular development of energy prices makes the thoughtless consumption of energy for citizens and companies increasingly expensive in the rich industrial countries. In this context, the supply of heating oil or natural gas, the refuelling of petrol or the electricity from the socket only a preliminary goal of our desires. But what is behind this? By consuming these energies, for example, in boilers or motors, we convert them into "use-making", such as heat or work. Thus, we fulfil the "energy services" we want, such as the heating or lighting of rooms, the operation of stationary or mobile drives and more. The two authors describe the complex connections to this topic systematically and scientifically based. The various energy services are divided into the physical and legal aspects of the energy industry, which are also used in the context of the energy industry and which are also used in a more efficient way.
content.title_en: Energy application technology : ways and techniques for more efficient energy use

content.text: Introduction to algebra and number theory. Prerequisites from basic lectures -- Natural and whole numbers -- Divinability and prime numbers -- Main ideal rings, euclidean algorithm and diophane equations -- Congruences and ideals -- Groups -- Operations of groups on quantities -- Abelian groups and characters -- Prime residual class group and square remnants -- Body and body extensions -- Final body -- Factorization of polynomials -- Supplement: Galois Theory. The book offers a new composition of materials that combines elementary topics from algebra and number theory and is designed for use in bachelor's studies and modularized teaching courses. It leads the abstract concepts of algebra in constant contact with concrete problems of elementary number theory and with a view to applications and offers prospects on advanced topics. In both areas, a level is reached that is necessary for non-specialists to the most applications (for example in discrete mathematics, cryptography or signal processing) but also provides a supplementary alborian theory on a supplementary number basis.
content.title_en: Introduction to algebra and number theory

content.text: Theoretical Physics 5 : Statistical Theory of Heat. Basic concepts of the Theory of Heat -- Classical Thermodynamics -- Geometric aspects of thermodynamics -- Probabilities, states, statistics -- Phase mixtures, phase transitions, stability of matter. This volume begins with the basic concepts of the Theory of Thermodynamic Systems in equilibrium, combines all important thermodynamic potentials and their interrelationships with Legendre transformation and discusses the main propositions of thermodynamics. The study of geometric aspects of theory leads to a deeper understanding of the second main proposition and the associated terms. The statistical theory of heat clarifies the concept of the state and allows the direct comparison of classical and quantum gases. The text, which contains many elaborated examples, is supplemented by tasks that are provided with clues or solutions.
content.title_en: Theoretical Physics 5 : Statistical Theory of Heat

content.text: Documentation of procedural installations: practical manual with checklists and examples. Specifics and tasks of documentation of procedural installations -- Legal aspects and regulations for documentation -- Structure and components of documentation of procedural installations -- Compliance with documentation in the plant contract and project management -- Creation and use of documentation during the plant realization -- Use and maintenance of documentation during plant operation -- Introduction of a document management system for plant documentation. Due to the increased requirements for safety, health and environmental protection, but also for liability and warranty reasons, documentation in procedural installations becomes increasingly important and more complex. The only part of the cost of all documentation services is up to 10 percent of the plant euvalue. While for the "classical" technical product documentation there are numerous publications, these are almost completely missing for documentation of procedural installations. The book closes the gap by systematizing the various aspects of these extensive documentation and discussing them in practice-related terms. Numerous checklists, examples and sample documents are available to illustrate the statements. The book is intended to be used as a guide or expert in the field of assembly, as well as a reference for the technical documentation.
content.title_en: Documentation of process engineering installations : practical manual with checklists and examples

content.text: Introduction to nonparametric statistics with SAS and R: An application-oriented textbook. Basic statistical terms -- Introduction to SAS -- Introduction to R -- Sorted statistics and ranking statistics -- Sample problems -- Two-sample problems for independent samples -- Two-sample problems for connected samples -- C-sample problem -- Independence and correlation -- Nonparametric density estimation and regression. Christine Duller (University of Linz) gives an easy-to-understand introduction to nonparametric statistics in this book, especially for students of economic and social sciences and all interested readers who (only) have basic statistical knowledge. In this book, she describes not only the statistical methods but also implements them in SAS and R. The author briefly introduces them in both programming languages, so that no prior knowledge is required. The book is suitable for self-study and is also suitable as a reference work for simple statistical analyses. Numerous examples with solutions complement the presentation.
content.title_en: Introduction to nonparametric statistics with SAS and R : An application-oriented textbook

content.text: Signals and systems : Teaching and workbook with MATLAB® exercises and solutions. The convincing structure of the book lies in the parallel treatment of the time-continuous and time-discrete case. The focus is on understanding the mathematical context and the application of mathematical methods based on tasks to be solved from applications of information technology. Numerous images, tables and calculated examples illustrate the application, so that the book can be used as a reference work very well. All examples are provided with detailed sample solutions. The new edition has been completely revised and the contents reorganized, so that the material becomes much more manageable. The formulation of learning objectives at the beginning of each chapter makes orientation and training in the material much easier. A new important chapter has been added which makes the book more attractive for a larger reader group. With the new chapter on state-space representation, potential interested parties from the field of control and regulation technology are increasingly addressed.
content.title_en: Signals and systems : Teaching and workbook with MATLAB® exercises and solutions

content.text: Chassis manual : Basics, driving dynamics, components, systems, mechatronics, perspectives. Despite all support from electronic control and control systems, the latest generation of passenger car chassis does not do without conventional chassis elements. With regard to driving dynamics, the conventional elements and their interaction with mechatronic systems are presented in this volume. The basics and design are presented first, then in a particularly practical presentation the driving dynamics. Detailed descriptions and explanations of the modern components follow. A separate section is dedicated to the axles and processes for the axle development. With some revised illustrations and updates in text and literature, improvements have already been made compared to the first edition. and basics -- driving dynamics -- components of the chassis -- axles in the chassis -- driving comfort -- suspension development -- systems in the chassis -- future aspects of the chassis.
content.title_en: Chassis manual : Basics, Driving dynamics, Components, Systems, Mechatronics, Perspectives
