content.text: Tax havens: Payable ways into tax respect. Foreign assets from the perspective of German tax law -- Fiscal bonds in Germany -- Risks of discovery for untaxed foreign assets -- Arguments for legalizing untaxed foreign investments -- The criminality of tax evasion -- Other criminal risks -- Self-report -- Are there alternatives to self-reporting? -- Practical advice on how to process a self-report -- Successful investment after legalization -- Black money from the perspective of tax advisor -- Black money from the perspective of banks and bank employees -- Is Germany a tax haven?. Real tax havens are no longer available today. In view of increasing international cooperation, illegal investments at the treasury are becoming increasingly risky and therefore are not a viable model for the future. The probative alternative is legalization and repatriation of illegal capital investments abroad. The book helps tax advisors in particular in the practical implementation, informs about the legal risks and protects against potential stumbling-blocks.
content.title_en: Tax havens: ways to achieve tax integrity

content.text: The contributions of the volume investigate the media change from early European media cultures to current forms of Internet communication from sociological, cultural science and linguistic perspectives. Although the mass media have detached themselves from the limitations of social interactions, they assign a distant, merely receptive role to the audience. On the other hand, new forms of "interactive" media open up increased possibilities for feedback and participation for users. The volume in question asks about the quality of this media change: Are media actually interactive? What does the interactivity of new media mean? Will the possibilities for participation opened up by new media be realized?
content.title_en: Media change as a change of forms of interaction

content.text: Water conflicts are power conflicts: causes and solutions in Morocco. Conflicts about water are increasing - but despite the growing scarcity of resources, the conflicts are based on political rather than ecological causes. The study shows Morocco's example of power interests behind water policy and how conflicts arise through increasing marginalization processes, but also which actors can mediate in water conflicts. In addition to the critical analysis of a public-private project for irrigation supply, the options for action in development cooperation are also shown. The book provides easy-to-understand access to the topic and illustrates water-related conflict potentials and cooperation opportunities in the Arab world and beyond. Dr. Annabelle Houdert received her PhD from PD. Dr. habil. Jochen Hippler at the Institute for Political Science and Development and Peace at the University of Duisburg-Essen and Prof. Dr. Yves Sintomer, Department of Science Politique, Université Paris 8. She is Senior Project Manager at Adelphi Research in Berlin.
content.title_en: Water conflicts are power conflicts : causes and solutions in Morocco

content.text: The Arenen integration of national public opinion : The case of the reunited German public sphere. Twenty years have passed since the political reunification of Germany, and yet it remains doubtful to what extent a common political public sphere has developed in the meantime, in which citizens and citizens in East and West Germany share equally. The present book has made it its task to question the often taken for granted cohesion of national public opinion theoretically and to empirically examine for the special case of the (re)united German public sphere.
content.title_en: The Arenen integration of national publics: The case of the reunited German public

content.text: Simulation and visualization of the dynamics of spatial processes : Interactions between structural structures and social-spatial organization of urban societies. The problem of the present study is how spatial, social and economic principles and their interactions can be mapped and with which methods the effects of different planning can be investigated. The question is examined how urban processes can be understood by means of computer simulations using agent-based systems and cellular automats and their results can be analyzed by means of visualizations and different measurement methods. Because only if one understands - at least in principle - how a city works with its complex interwoven processes in essence, a meaningful urban planning is possible.
content.title_en: Simulation and visualization of the dynamics of spatial processes : Interactions between structural structures and social-spatial organisation of urban societies

content.text: Fragile sociality: stagings, worlds of meaning, existence-based artists. Leading basic assumption in Ronald Hitzler's work is that of a fragility of the social. Human beings are forced to live a "risky life". This insight gained from Goffman makes risk management appear as a basic requirement of the interaction order that makes individuals a living-based artist. According to Hitzler, the actors live in stagings not only in the (late) modern age. This festive publication for Ronald Hitzler on the occasion of his 60th birthday contains his essay "The Goffman. Considerations on a dramatological anthropology?" and gathers contributions from colleagues who accompanied him in his previous scientific-academic career in various ways and different distances.
content.title_en: Fragile Sociality : stagings, meaning worlds, existence-bassists

content.text: The prognosis of election results: Approaches and empirical performance. With the lead words of Prof. Dr. Monika Jungbauer-Gans and Prof. Dr. Thomas Hinz Dr. Jochen Groß, Professor of Empirical Social Research, Professor Thomas Hinz, Professor of Social Sociology at the University of Konstanz, is a research associate at the Institute of Sociology at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München. The prognosis of social phenomena is a central objective of social science research. Jochen Groß examines existing approaches to predicting election results from scientific theoretical and empirical perspectives. He also assumes that systematic analyses of the forecast quality of election planning questions and models for predicting election results have been lacking. The core of the study is the comprehensive empirical analysis of the prognosis of election planning questions for the 1949-2009 Bundestag elections. Furthermore, he develops and tests a proposal for a theoretically sound prognosis approach for predicting votes by the parties in the Bundestag elections.
content.title_en: The forecast of election results : approaches and empirical performance

content.text: Today's partners – tomorrow's competitors? : Strategies, concepts and interactions of television companies on the new moving image market. Pamela Przybylski is a research associate at the Institute of Communication Science at the University of Münster. The German television industry is characterized by the specific character of its audiovisual goods, the associated production conditions and two dominant stakeholder groups: The interaction between the production landscape and the broadcasting oligopoly has become a network. With the development of new digital transmission technologies, these classic value creation processes break open. The author outlines with a focus on the traditional communicators the new moving image market and essential elements of strategic media management. Based on a qualitative survey, it is shown how broadcasters and producers assess the market potential of IPTV, Web TV and Mobile TV, which strategic thrust they follow and which new market players are perceived as competitors and cooperation partners.
content.title_en: Today's Partners – Tomorrow's Competitors? : Strategies, Concepts and Interactions of Television Companies in the New Moving Image Market

content.text: The mercenary system : Military entrepreneurship in the genesis of the international system. Dr. Daniel Robert Kramer is a freelance security analyst and scientific author. For the first time in German language, a sketch of the history of mercenary systems appears from the beginnings of European state formation to the present. A comparison of the commercial companies, which served as spearheads in the submission of non-European peoples, with today's military and security companies directs the view to the continuity of the organization of violence ? the nationalization of the world would not have been possible without the fusion of military and economic entrepreneurship. In maintaining this system military and security companies are increasingly taking on important tasks today.
content.title_en: Mercenary: Military entrepreneurship in the genesis of the international system

content.text: The Biomedicine Convention of the Council of Europe : Human Research — Transplantation Medicine — Genetics — Legal Analysis and Comparative Law. The Biomedicine Convention of the Council of Europe establishes binding international regulations for the protection of human rights in human and embryo research, organ transplantation and gene analysis and therapy. In Germany the Convention is extremely controversial. In order to undermine the constitutionally required and legally guaranteed level of protection, accession is largely rejected. The present paper analyses the Biomedicine Convention in all relevant parts, systematically examines the German legal situation and makes a comprehensive comparison with the Convention. In addition to international legal aspects, constitutional and medical issues as well as legal ethical aspects are discussed in detail. Furthermore, it is explained how a Convention accession to the German legal situation would affect legal protection of legal property in biomedicine -- Central fundamental rights in biomedicine -- European human rights agreements on biomedicine - Biomedicine Convention (BMK) -- Medical research on consent-incapable -- Live organ donation for transplantation purposes -- Predictive genetic testing -- Research on embryos in vitro- gene therapy
content.title_en: The Council of Europe's Biomedicine Convention : Human Research — Transplantation Medicine — Genetics — Legal Analysis and Comparison

content.text: The study is based on the assumption that there are phases and times in the socialisation process of children and young people who are important for their (technical) socialisation. Whether young people are interested in technology depends on various factors that can be described as conditions constellations. The aim of the study is to collect and describe such constellations. The study collects three complex content-related aspects: skills and skills needed for understanding and handling technology, attitudes that influence the view of technology and how to deal with it, and socialisation factors that promote or inhibit the interest in technology (with the emphasis on school and family). With a view to potential intervention points, how technology-relevant skills and attitudes in the socialisation process change; and how to address the socialisation context; and how to address the socialisation context; and how to address the socialisation context.
content.title_en: Ways to technical fascination : socialisation and time of intervention

content.text: Algorithmic Mathematics. With this book we want to present various sub-areas of mathematics from an algorithmic perspective and discuss implementation and runtime aspects. At the same time, we want to present as many aspects of mathematics as possible in a shortened basic education in mathematics in scientific and computer science courses and perhaps encourage a deeper study of one or the other aspect. Our goal is not to train the reader to become a skilled user of the discussed algorithms, but to focus on concrete problems, analysis and solution strategies. In particular, evidence and evidence techniques play a central role. Notation and basic structures -- Elementary counting problems and discrete probabilities -- Graphene -- Trees and matchings -- Numerics and linear algebra -- Nonlinear optimization -- Numerical methods for nonlinear optimization -- Linear optimization -- Suggested solutions to the exercises.
content.title_en: Algorithmic Mathematics

content.text: Management measures against product piracy and industrial espionage. Importance of in-house changes for know-how protection in companies -- Risk efficiency and effectiveness of business protection against product piracy -- Protective measures against product piracy in the functional sector Marketing -- Protective measures against product piracy in the functional sector Logistics -- Sources of illegal know-how drain from industrial companies and strategies against industrial espionage. Product piracy and industrial espionage increasingly threaten the international world economy. Companies can protect themselves, in particular by internal structural changes and targeted management trading. The collection volume presents various perspectives of business measures against illegal effluent of entrepreneurial know-how. The protective measures are considered in terms of their effectiveness, risk and from the perspective of the functional areas of marketing and logistics. Information on defense measures against industrial espionage complete the presentation.
content.title_en: Management measures against product piracy and industrial espionage

content.text: Vehicle acoustics. Basics -- Acoustics of vehicle drive -- Integration into the car -- Integration into the bus -- Integration into the truck. Vehicle acoustics has not only developed significantly in the scientific and metrological approach during the last two decades, but has also become an important criterion for management during decision-making processes during the vehicle development process, as it has a clear influence on the customer's decision-making decision-making. The book addresses beginners in vehicle acoustics in training and practice as well as people who often have to take the acoustic approach into account in their decisions. It provides basics that allow the reader to then enter deeper into the individual specific topics such as simulation, measurement technology, trial and project management.
content.title_en: Vehicle acoustics

content.text: The survey in the context of space, time and sensibility: contributions to a process-oriented theory of survey research. Klappentext: Survey research is still one of the most widely used - tenencovery methods in the social sciences, from which a knowledge win and knowledge progress is expected. Although the methods differ greatly today and the modes diversify, there is still a lack of basic research in this area. The present book is intended to present a further approach which will structure the basic elements of the survey and its embedding in the process-oriented - run of the survey. In particular, space, Ze- and sensitivities aspects and their respective effects are of interest. It will probably require even more intensive research, but also over-convincitation work, in order to bring the survey research from its established and possibly safe way to new methodological perspectives, which nevertheless offer a further approach to truth and reality concepts. Reinhard Bachleitner Martin Weichbold Wolfgang Aschauer Salzburg, January 2010 1 Introduction: The problem and objective of the survey is not a question of the empirical way of using it.
content.title_en: The survey in the context of space, time and sensibility : Contributions to a process-oriented theory of survey research

content.text: Ecological Enlightenment: 25 years of "Ecological Communication" The question why society is slowly approaching an ecological crisis and thus a potential self-hazard is more topical than ever. 25 years ago, Niklas Luhmann presented the study Ecological Communication. It was a systematic attempt to determine the possibilities of modern society to react to ecological problems with the help of a theory of society. From the premise that society is subject to a primacy of functional differentiation, Luhmann's observation follows: functional systems can only produce resonance to ecological problems at the level of their programs, including their specific codes. The authors of this volume take the 25th anniversary of ecological communication as an opportunity to discuss Niklas Luhmann's theses with a view to the current developments in terms of their plausibility. The contributions shed light among other things on the resonance of different functional systems such as economics, law, science, politics and education on ecological problems.
content.title_en: Ecological education : 25 years of ecological communication

content.text: Islamophophobic populism: bans on the building of mosques and minarets by Austrian parliamentary parties. Islam is now a significant position in Western democracies, but is often perceived as a threat rather than an enrichment. Farid Hafez aims to conceptualize the concept of Islamophobia and make it operational for political science by proposing a synthesis of the two concepts Islamophobia and populism. Starting with the discourses of the right-wing parties FPÖ and BZÖ in the Austrian federal states of Vorarlberg and Carinthia, in which a law on the prohibition of building mosques and minarets was discussed, the author examines how this discourse affects other parties, especially the parties of the middle. He examines the extent to which it is adopted, rejected or changed and what reasons for these processes exist. The book is aimed at lecturers and students of political science and social sciences with the focus on migration/Islam as well as socially oriented Islamic scientists.
content.title_en: Islamophober Populism : Bans on the construction of mosques and minarets by Austrian parliamentary parties

content.text: Social Democratic Reform Discourses. In political science research, the power-building role that public discourses play in the enforcement process of political agendas has been increasingly appreciated in recent years. The persuasive power of public reform discourses is now considered to be a central political resource to legitimize reforms, overcome institutional hurdles and involve organized interests. In this book, reform discourses of three socially democratic governments - Great Britain, Sweden and Germany - are being examined in a comparative way, which in the 1990s and 2000s had to carry out social state reforms under pressure from globalization and demographic change. These reforms were about the dismantling of social achievements and the reassessment of the relationship between the market and the state, which seemed to represent a contrast to the traditional programmatic identity and fundamental values of social democracy. Therefore, the three social democratic parties had to try to secure their changed policies through convincing legitimating discourses. How communicated social democrats each had their reform programs communicated? How rhetorically did they link the changes they initiated with their social democratic values system? The comparison of the discourses and the discourses actually performed in terms of discourses reveals the discourses and the discourses.
content.title_en: Social-Democrat Reform Discourses

content.text: Scientific Computing. Applied linear algebra -- A basic pattern of applied mathematics -- marginal value problems -- Fourier series and Fourier integral -- Analytical functions -- Initial value problems -- Large systems -- Optimization and minimum principle. An essential necessity for today's students and readers is to depart from conventional formula-based courses and move to computer-based courses. The aim of this book, which is now finally available in German version, is to present both applied mathematics and engineering mathematics as they actually are used today! This book arose from the course on scientific arithmetic, which has been held at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology for 20 years. The book then tries to merge concepts and algorithms for the reader. The authors begin with the applied linear algebra, an area that many readers have come to miss, but which is an essential tool for scientific arithmetic and its applications. Afterwards they develop the methods of finite differences and finite elements, always with regard to applied mathematics, to make use of this field with numerous knowledge areas, to make use of this book to teach students alike.
content.title_en: Scientific Computing

content.text: Modeling and simulation: With an introduction to ANSYS. Introduction -- Modeling and simulations with finite difference methods -- Grids -- Finite elements method for one-dimensional problems -- Finite elements method for elliptical edge value problems -- Introduction to ANSYS -- ANSYS simulations Project work. The book provides a mathematical understanding of modern simulation methods easily. It enables critical assessment of simulation results. To do so, it is necessary to know the typical sources of error that can occur in the methods used. The methods presented form the basis for almost all common software tools. In addition to the model and method description, the author demonstrates how a variety of problems can be solved in a computer program. For the execution of the simulation on the computer, the worldwide widespread finite element program ANSYS is used.
content.title_en: Modeling and simulation : With an introduction to ANSYS

content.text: Internet economy. The Internet as the cornerstone of the modern information society has created both new digital markets and fundamentally changed existing markets. Although many unsubstantiated business ideas with the burst of the Dotcom bubble have come to an abrupt end, companies such as Amazon, eBay and Google are now market leaders. This book systematically presents the special features of Internet economy. To this end, well-known, classic economic models are applied to the Internet as well as new models. The book reveals the laws of Internet economy, thus explaining the success of established providers and developing recommendations for action for the actors of Internet economy. The results are discussed on the basis of many practical examples. The book is aimed at students, scientists and decision-makers who want to understand and shape the Internet economy. Numerous exercise tasks at the end of each chapter deepen the content. Digital goods -- network goods -- anonymity, price differentiation and consumer rent -- searching and finding -- market savings and competition -- auctions -- trust and reputation.
content.title_en: Internet Economy

content.text: Application-oriented microprocessors: Microcontrollers and digital signal processors. Application-oriented microprocessors, i.e. microprocessors designed for use in a wide range of applications, have simplified or enabled the realization of many modern electronic applications. Application-oriented microprocessors include the microcontrollers, which represent complete microcomputers on a single chip, as well as the digital signal processors, which are designed especially for digital processing of analog signals. The book, which is ideally suited for self-study, provides a detailed presentation of application-oriented microprocessors. Rich imaging and self-contained and autonomous representation support the reader to learn the complex matter comprehensively. Introduction -- Microcontroller -- Digital signal processors -- Mixing forms of microcontrollers and DSPs (DSC) -- The processor core -- The hardware/software interface -- The work storage -- Bus systems -- System control and interface modules -- Examples of digital signal processors.
content.title_en: Application-oriented microprocessors : Microcontrollers and Digital Signal Processors

content.text: Sustainable Logistics: Responses to a global challenge. Logistics and Supply Chain Management will have to adapt to completely new boundary conditions and requirements in the foreseeable future. Based on very ambitious targets for reducing pollutant emissions, the policy will contribute to a significant increase in transport costs through various instruments such as tolls, excise duties and a trade with scarce emission certificates. In the same direction, oil price increases and increasing productivity losses in freight transport, which will have to contend with an increasingly overloaded transport infrastructure, will have to make a strong contribution to maintaining mobility and the environment, and thereby have to reinvent itself in parts. Based on a description of the future boundary conditions, this book will develop adaptation strategies that will enable less pollution-intensive goods to be exchanged and can help maintain mobility as a prerequisite for any work-based economy. In doing so, not only logistical process and network architectures will be examined, but also the overarching marketing strategies and business models that have emerged from the demands of modern logistics. content.text: Java Basic Course for Business Informatics: Understanding the Basics – Understanding Object-Oriented Programming – Getting to Know Advanced Concepts – Business-Oriented Examples. Success and the voices for the first edition confirm that the topic is presented in a balanced and target-group manner. Thus, the second edition of this introduction to programming, which is oriented towards business information technology, is equally suitable for use by JAVA as a textbook for lectures and self-study, without pre-conditions being required. The second edition is improved by new, in-depth explanations and the topicality is obtained by adapting to new Java versions. All the facts are illustrated by vivid practical examples and exercises. More advanced topics in the field of object orientation, algorithms and data structures and basics of programming Distributed applications are also gradually developed and conveyed through numerous illustrations and examples. As in the first edition, each chapter concludes with an exercise section, which is available online and contains informative solutions.
content.title_en: Java Basic Course for Business Informatics: Understanding the Basics – Object-Oriented Programming – Getting to Know Advanced Concepts – Business-Oriented Examples

content.text: Simulation of tribosystems: Basics and applications. To be able to interpret tribosystems at a time and cost-effectively, simulation will be increasingly important in the future. Dirk Bartel explains important theoretical foundations for simulation of lubricated and dry-running tribosystems. Topics such as hydrodynamics and elastohydrodynamics, including cavitation, the influence of rough surfaces on solid state contact, material stress and microhydrodynamics, the calculation of solid state, mixing and liquid friction and temperatures in fluids and friction bodies, as well as lubricant properties of Newton and non-Newtonese fluids will be discussed. In selected application examples, the author shows what progress has been made in the development of the simulation of tribosystems. content.text: Decentralized networked energy management: An approach based on a distributed adaptive real-time multi-agent system. The European energy supply system -- Distributed negotiations in a decentralised agent system -- Decentralized network management -- Distributed learning -- Experimental studies -- Decentralized operational management -- Conclusion and outlook. Existing energy supply systems meet their limits when it comes to the stable and efficient integration of a large number of renewable energy conversion plants. Due to the lack of predictability of renewable energy generation, stable operation of the electrical grid is only possible if the supply fluctuations are compensated with a large amount of fossil-generated (planned) reserve power. Sebastian Lehnhoff presents an approach for a distributed distributed energy management system based on software agents, where reserve power requirements are minimised and existing efficiency potentials are more exploited. He shows that stable operation and the provision of necessary reserve power is possible under distributed control and compliance with strict real-time requirements and can be more favourable than with the current centralised supply.

content.text: Integration motor Sportverein : Results of the model project "spin – sport interkulturell" . The integration of people with a history of immigration is one of the central challenges of Germany. In particular, the association-organized sport is attributed an important integration function. However, the social integration of people with a history of immigration into and through sports clubs is not automatic. Rather, demanding organizational and conceptual arrangements are needed to attract particularly underrepresented population groups with a history of immigration. Against this background, the model project spin - sport interkulturell has been pursuing the goal since February 2007 to support and empower sports clubs to accompany and promote the process of social integration of girls and young women with a history of immigration. In the volume, findings of scientific support and evaluation of spin during the pilot phase are presented in detail and are linked with initial recommendations for action to further develop the integration project.

content.text: What do we know about judges? What are the expectations and requirements of judges? Thorsten Berndt designs a typology of judicial self-conceptions and shows how independence is raised as an essential configuration of meaning over three coherence-building dimensions of judicial self-types: the basic dimension that refers to structures of the judicial organization, the dimension of the legal and methodological relevance that develops in practical working practices, and the dimension of the drive that reveals individual motivations in judicial practice. In addition to showing a broad spectrum of the typology developed in this way, the author also analyses the judicial problem of action in the field of historically grown social expectations. The book is aimed at lecturers and students of social and legal sciences, judges and lay people interested in society's law.

content.text: 20 years of welcome money : 100 marks on time travel – what has become of it?. In the first three weeks after the fall of the Wall alone, the Federal Republic paid 16.4 million GDR citizens 100 marks of welcome money. What could have become of this effort in the past time with clever or less skillful investment tactics? The political and economic influences on the performance were enormous. In this book you can accompany the money through this moving time. Stefan Calefice lived in Berlin in the years immediately after the turn of the year and thus conveys the spirit of this time particularly intense and authentic. He then leads you through the events around the T-actie, the Euro-introduction and the Internet-hype.The authorStefan Calefice is the division manager Portfoliomanagement at the Feri Family Trust GmbH in Bad Homburg.

Business negotiations are increasingly conducted via electronic media. Due to the lack of audiovisual signals, misunderstandings can easily arise between the negotiating partners. Katja Duckek examines the economic importance of communication quality in electronic negotiations. The author shows that the extent of communication at the factual, procedural and relational level significantly influences the negotiation success and derives implications for the management of negotiations as well as for the design of electronic negotiation support.
content.title_en: Economic relevance of communication quality in electronic negotiations

content.text: Enterprise 2.0: Companies between hierarchy and self-organisation. Many social and political interest groups are now also represented on the Internet. Facebook, Google and Wikipedia have increasing user numbers. The term "Enterprise 2.0" stands for the new dynamics in especially economic contexts. They test the classic companies. Older employees meet "Digital Natives". They grew up with the tools of Web 2.0, communicate via SMS and Twitter and collaborate on blogs and wikis. They meet the "Digital Immigrants". Two worlds are colliding, changing the rules of the game and requiring new votes. What challenges arise from the coexistence of both employee types? How are companies to successfully master the challenge? Experts from business and science have shown the underlying phenomena, risks and opportunities in this volume and presented the successful transformation to Enterprise 2.0 in case studies.

Air traffic -- ground handling -- Data description -- Data analysis -- Summary and outlook. Ground handling of an aircraft is crucial for punctuality, stability and economic efficiency of the flight plan. Andreas Schlegel systematically conducts a detailed statistical analysis of the most important ground handling processes in air transport on the basis of the process data collected by Lufthansa at its central Frankfurt/Main hub and identifies relevant factors and causes of delay. The categories of influence and exercise of power as well as trust and mistrust take the place of traditional leadership style concepts. An extensive cross-industry study of executives from various German organizations serves to review the model. The second edition has been reviewed and corrected. Their use is, however, controversially discussed, with the focus on how to measure the success of consulting services and how to overcome the existing obstacles. Against this background, Bärbel Fleischer has examined how success measurements are carried out in company practice in the use of success fees. The book is seen as a contribution to improving the conceptual implementation of flood prevention and to the effective functioning of integrated flood risk management. An ex-post evaluation evaluates the conception, implementation and effectiveness of state measures during the August flood of 2002 in a subsequent scientific and empirical manner. Within the scope of the evaluation, chains of effects are documented and causal relationships between actions, measures and effects are presented. Based on the experience gained in the Free State of Saxony, numerous conclusions on the sustainable improvement of integrated flood risk management can be derived during the ex-post evaluation.

content.text: Value stream design : The path to lean factory. To optimize production, value stream design has been used with increasing success in recent years. This method is unique in its compact visualization of the entire production including the material and information flow. This shows significant improvement potential. The central element of value stream design is the detailed design guidelines. Its application in a mutually building order allows the goal-oriented development of an ideal target state for production. A systematic approach to product family-oriented factory structuring completes the methodology.The present book presents the value stream method carefully and in such detail that it is reliably applicable even in complex production. General considerations on the factory and the objectives of a production complement the representation of value stream design. Examples from practice illustrate their application.

The book addresses clients and service providers in the construction industry and describes the advantages and disadvantages of various project management methods from a business and process-related, construction-based perspective. The project management methods are described from the point of view of the client and the entrepreneur and the industry-specific impact of the customer requirements on the performance offers. For long-term, life cycle-oriented views of construction plants are shown how added value can be generated by incentive systems. The proven presentation has been updated. Supplements to life cycle-oriented project management forms, requirement engineering, generic axiomatic requirement management, return and cost management of construction projects, LC cost drivers of buildings, Net Present Value, economic efficiency analysis for project selection and choice of project management form as well as economic analysis for the evaluation of PPP projects in the investive and non-investive area have been included.

The PDF format, often used only as a digital reproduction of printed content, already has some methods for functional and content enhancement of documents, up to the integration of 3D content. The now additional possibility for integrating the complete functionality of Adobe Flash allows the addition of PDF documents to universal interactive multimedia documents. These are suitable for a variety of different application areas and yet only require the current version of Adobe Reader to be presented. The authors explain the conception, design, production, programming and use of such documents in the present and future. The book describes a variety of concrete, detailed manuals for practice. It is therefore suitable for decision-makers, as well as for conceptualists and programmers or for e-learning professionals alike. content.text: Transparency: Multidisciplinary insights into phenomena and theories of opaqueness. The call for transparency has become louder at the beginning of the 21st century - not least due to crises, terrorism, corruption. Transparency appears to be a remedy, dealing with the complexity of our confusing and opaque world. But is the demand not too transparent? Conversely, is intra-sparence always a reference to a problem or a special resource? Is not personal everyday life increasingly a negotiation between transparency and private withdrawal in a mediated society - with "social media", "glass customers or employees"? Does transparency not always oscillate between surveillance and security - from naked scanners to anti-corruption? The sixth annual volume of Zeppelin University deals with these and many other issues relating to transparency and takes a differentiated location of transparency in different areas of life of economy, culture and politics.
content.title_en: Transparency : Multidisciplinary insights through phenomena and theories of the opaque

content.text: The methods of the system : How to get to the case and how to get behind it? This book reflects the current international state of the still young dialogue between system theory conception and empirical observation. It serves as a reference point for the theoretically critical further development of empirical methods as well as the use of the empirical richness of sociological theory, especially system theory. The questions about the methodologies of system theory, their compatibility with already elaborated methods of empirical social research and parallels with other theories are the focus of the contributions. The thesis of methodology as a bridge between theory and empiricism is common parenthesis and thus as a starting point for research design. René John is a scientific assistant at the Institute of Pedagogical Psychology at Leibniz University Hannover. Anna Henkel is a post-doctoral researcher at Bielefeld University at the Graduated College 'On the Way to the Knowledge Society'. Jana Rückert-John is a scientific assistant at the Institute for Social Sciences of the Agricultural Department at the University of Hohenheim.
content.title_en: The methodology of the system: How to get to the case and how to get behind it?

content.text: The cultural integration of Europe. This collection deals with the various forms of cultural integration and disintegration in Europe. The focus is on the characteristics and mechanisms of these phenomena: Under what social, political, normative and symbolic conditions are integration and disintegration in Europe taking place? What factors are the dynamics of development? What are the limits of integration potential? The interdisciplinary approach of the collection book allows to capture the diversity of political, cultural and social frictional areas in Europe in their complexity and thus contribute to a deeper understanding of the European integration and disintegration processes.
content.title_en: The cultural integration of Europe

content.text: Couples in Change: A qualitative panel study on the dynamics of the course of couple relationships. Dr. Caroline Ruiner is a research assistant at the Faculty of Philosophy and Social Sciences of the University of Augsburg. In the course of the social transformation and individualization process, a creative freedom opens up for the individuals: The normal biography with its inherent expectations and norms of the correct events at the right time? is no longer per se action-conducting - life events and their arrangement become variable and optional. The correct time to complete the training, find a partner, marry and have children is the responsibility of the conceptions and the design of the individuals or are completely at the disposition. For individuals in couple relationships, the coordination of individual ideas and expectations is more necessary than ever in order to enable a common living together. The view on the inner-partner-coordination processes shows that not every ?objective? event has an impact on the couple course. Instead, it depends on their interpretation and construction, i.e. the key to understanding the effect of (the relationship) the couples have been constructed.
content.title_en: Couples in Change : A qualitative panel study on the dynamics of the course of couples relations

content.text: Prekäres Unternehmerfahrt: Uncertainties of self-employed employment and business creation. Start-up of companies and self-employed employment not only open up chances of success, but also bring considerable risks of precariousness. Based on conceptual considerations and recent empirical findings, the volume combines two current but still hardly related social developments. Start-up of companies and self-employed employment not only open up chances of success, but also bring considerable risks of precariousness. Based on conceptual considerations and recent empirical findings, the volume links two current but hardly related social developments: the increasing importance of entrepreneurship and the growing risk of precarization of work. Andrea D. Bührmann is a professor at the Institute of Sociology at the University of Münster. Hans J. Pongratz is currently a representative professor at the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München.

content.text: Interest rate taxation in income and consumption-oriented tax systems: An analysis against the background of the performance principle, European law and decision-neutrality. There has always been a dispute in Germany about whether and, if so, how interest rates should be taxed. In the background, the tax systematic discussion about the alternatives to taxation of income on the one hand and consumption on the other hand always arises. Marion Titgemeyer analyses the tax treatment of national and cross-border interest rates in different tax systems from the point of view of the performance principle, European Community law and the decision-neutrality of taxation. The author develops proposals for reforming German interest rate taxation, which take into account the aspect of tax-indiscriminate behaviour in a structured manner. Basis of interest rate taxation -- interest rate taxation in selected countries -- European legal framework for taxation on interest rate taxation -- interest rate taxation against the background of the performance principle -- interest rate taxation against the background of the requirements of European law -- interest rate taxation against the background of the criterion of tax neutrality of taxation -- proposals for reforming interest rate taxation in Germany -- conclusion remarks and outlook.
content.title_en: Interest rate taxation in income and consumption-oriented tax systems : An analysis against the background of the performance principle, European law and decision-neutrality

content.text: Reactivation management of companies suffering from hardship : Reactivation possibilities within the framework of the insolvency regulations. Initial situation An emergency company -- Reactivation management -- Empirical investigation -- Conclusions. A rehabilitation of companies suffering from hardship can also be carried out under the framework conditions of the insolvency regulations. It is called reactivation management here. Max Liebig compares this form of rehabilitation with the possibilities of a classic/free renovation. It is clear that there is not an optimal form of rehabilitation. Instead, different crisis causes, different constellations of claim groups among the parties and the available legal and business framework conditions must be distinguished in order to decide for which companies a reactivation management is eligible.
content.title_en: Reactivation management of companies suffering from hardship : Remedial measures under the insolvency rules

content.text: Access to human genetic resources of indigenous peoples of Latin America : A stakeholder analysis. Human genetic resources are the subject of important cutting-edge research in the 21st century. The impact of population genetic projects and new insights on humanity is discussed intensively. María Cristina Blohm examines access to human genetic resources of indigenous communities of Latin America. She describes the problem of access and use of human biodata and presents solutions based on the stakeholder approach that take into account the legal regulations, fundamental fundamental rights and fundamental freedoms of humans and the bioethical basic principles for population-related research organisations. Concepts -- The situation of indigenous peoples in Latin America -- Access to human genetic resources -- Examples -- Implementation of the stakeholder approach -- Final considerations.
content.title_en: Access to human genetic resources of indigenous peoples of Latin America : A stakeholder analysis

The special feature of the didactic concept is that each structured and understandable theoretical introduction is visualized and deepened by a variety of examples and tasks. This enables students to learn clearly and independently how to work on the material. In the current 10th edition, a section on the vibrations of continuous systems was added and a large part of the images were replaced by computer graphics. Typographical highlights facilitate the discovery and reading. The numbering of equations, tables and images was adapted to the other volumes.

content.text: Exact algorithms for heavy graphene problems. Basics -- Effort estimation of algorithms -- Graphene -- Logic -- Complexity Theory -- Exact algorithms for graphene -- Fixed parameter algorithms for selected graphene problems -- Exponential time algorithms for dyeing problems -- Exponential time algorithms for TSP and DNP -- Algorithms for special graphene -- Trees and co-graphen -- Tree-wide limited graphene -- Clique-wide restricted graphene. This book deals with serious problems on graphene for which there are probably no efficient algorithms, and presents various methods how to deal with the algorithmic hardness of such problems. On the one hand, one can design efficient algorithms that make use of a suitable tree structure of graphene; on the other hand, fixed parameter algorithms allow an efficient solution when certain graphene parameters are small. Even if these methods are not applicable, the existing exponential selection is easily improved in terms of the current semester assignments and the assignments of difficult subject matter.
content.title_en: Exact algorithms for severe graph problems

Radio Frequency Identification -- Project Module 1 - "Basics-- Project Module 2 - "Application-oriented Development--- Project Module 3 - "Praxistests and Documentation--- In Germany, an average of 950,000 reported accidents occur every year. Many of these accidents could be prevented by the correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PSA). The contributions of the collection volume summarize the development, testing and optimization of suitable instruments for sustainable improvement of occupational safety based on RFID technology. Special focus is on the development of an automatic control of PPE on completeness taking into account the work areas and activities. The RFID instruments described above represent a further testing body at the workplace and sensitize employees for the concerns of occupational safety and health protection.
content.title_en: Industrial safety in construction with RFID : Research report on the project "Safety technology with RFID - Development, testing and optimization of suitable instruments for the sustainable improvement of occupational safety based on RFID"

content.text: Basics of data analysis with R : An application-oriented introduction. This book provides an application-oriented introduction to the basics of data analysis with the free statistical package R. It covers descriptive evaluations as well as inferential statistical analyses. In addition to the most common univariate methods, it takes into account nonparametric and selected multivariate methods. It also covers the many possibilities of creating diagrams and exchanging data with other programs. The statistical procedures are explained in examples and illustrated in many places with diagrams. In addition, manual control calculations are provided to make the results of R understandable step by step. The book is aimed at all those who want to get to know R and use it in specific tasks without having any prior experience with command-controlled programs or programming languages. content.text: Compensation of saturation-related harmonics in the currents of field-oriented controlled synchronous motors : Investigations using the example of a permanent magnet-excited machine with single tooth winding. Machine model based on a magnetic resistance network -- Extension of the basic wave model with an harmonic approach -- Control -- Summary -- Outlook. In the case of permanent magnet-excited synchronous machines with single tooth winding, which are operated with conventional current control procedures in field-oriented coordinates, oscillations in the currents in the overload range, the frequency of which corresponds to six times the electrical rotation frequency, are shown. These oscillations can lead to an exceeding of the permissible current of the inverter when the amplitudes are correspondingly high, which can lead to a safety shutdown or even damage to semiconductor components. Robert Michel examines the causes of oscillations in the machine currents and designs current control methods, with which the amplitudes of the current oscillations are significantly reduced in both stationary and dynamic operation.
content.title_en: Compensation of saturation-related harmonics in the currents of field-oriented controlled synchronous motors : investigations using the example of a permanent magnet-excited machine with single tooth winding

content.text: Repositioning of brands: An agent-based simulation model for predicting the effects of repositioning strategies. Positioning and repositioning decisions within the framework of brand management -- Theoretical foundations and current state of research -- Conception and application of the agent-based model in the fixed telephone market -- Final consideration. The positioning of brands belongs to the "core business" in marketing. Once selected positionings rarely remain unchanged over time, because almost all brands operate in a dynamic market environment. Therefore, repositioning is the order of the day. So far, there are few decision support instruments that can be used for brand repositioning. Christian Feddersen develops an agent-based simulation model, which can be used in conjunction with multivariate methods for the assessment of repositioning strategies.
content.title_en: Repositioning of brands : An agent-based simulation model for forecasting the effects of repositioning strategies

content.text: The use of modern information technologies in automotive product development: productivity potential and system complementarities. The development and diffusion of information and communication technologies (ICT) has profoundly changed product development in recent years. Viktoria Heindorf analyses the complex structure of the application of ICT in automotive development in Japan. It shows cross-links to processes and organizational structures and in particular works out the importance of knowledge structures in the context of digitized development processes. A central result of her analysis lies in the need for so-called T-shaped knowledge structures, which implies a further specialization while increasing knowledge diversification. The author provides innovative design recommendations for personnel development and personnel management. Motivation -- Product development in the automotive industry -- Information technologies - Product productivity potential in the system context -- Complementarity relations in product development - Study on the example of the Japanese automotive industry -- Personnel policy challenges.
content.title_en: The use of modern information technologies in automotive product development: productivity potential and system complementarities

content.text: Antennas and radiation fields : Electromagnetic waves on lines, in free space and their radiation. This textbook and reference work - one of the best basic books on the subject - provides a systematic introduction to the concept world of electromagnetic radiation fields. The antenna technology is presented in a comprehensible way from the field theory basics to practical design suggestions with easy-to-use cooking recipes and fist formulas. In addition to the basic mathematical methods, great importance is attached to the physical interpretation and visualization of the obtained results by means of computer simulations. This clear way of representation of radiation and propagation of electromagnetic waves enables a deeper understanding. In the third edition, the treatment of fractal antennas, horn emitters, helix and dielectric antennas was substantially extended by new numerical results. In addition, addition, additions and improvements were made at many points. This extended edition, with 128 exercise tasks, is largely safe with complete solutions.

content.text: Hydrometry: The theory and practice of flow measurement in open channels. Preface -- Tasks and significance of hydrometry -- Basic concepts -- Measuring water level -- Measuring flow -- Continuous recording of flow -- Data acquisition and remote transmission -- Primary statistical analysis of water level and flow data -- Measuring networks for flow detection -- Organization of hydrological measurement services -- Company directory -- Directory of subjects. Knowledge of the flow of water in a water body (river, channel) and its spatial and temporal variance is an essential basis for the design of water structures and the rational management of the water resource. In order to measure the flow volume per time unit, flow flow, for centuries, traditional methods have been used, but also in recent years increasingly "new" measurement methods, which have become possible due to the increasing use of electronics in measurement and control technology. Building on the physical foundations, the author deals with the possibilities and limits of the individual measurement procedures, in their use in the rough environmental conditions of the measurement of small and measuring systems.
content.title_en: Hydrometry : Theory and practice of flow measurement in open channels

content.text: Car air conditioning : Physical basics and technical implementation. Based on long-standing experimental experiences, elementary physical approaches are used. This allows the connections of car air conditioning to be shown transparently. Typical modes of operation of a car are described in winter and summer. A chapter on climate physiology is also dedicated to this. Detailed examples serve to deepen the read chapters. Mathematically complex calculations and tables are compiled in the annex. Thus, it is possible to look up if necessary. Special topics include, for example, "Air exchange of the body with the environment", "Sun exposure", "Heating up the air on the engine hood", "Heat exchangers", and "testing stations". A compilation of important standards and guidelines facilitates their search. Basics -- Climate physiology -- Air flow through the passenger compartment -- Heat flow through the passenger compartment -- Winter operation -- Summer operation -- Material transport -- Heat transfer -- Cold media circuit -- Comfort increase and energy saving -- Test stands -- Road tests -- Annex A to E.
content.title_en: Car air conditioning : Physical basics and technical implementation

content.text: The experimenter: Neurosciences. Dear EXPERIMENTATOR, this new volume is intended to give the prospective neuroscientist an overview of the questions and methods of neuroscience research. Therefore, we describe well established standard methods and give insights into the current trends and developments that advance modern neuroscience research. The focus of the book is on the explanation of basic mechanisms and experimental principles. It also points to many "small" tricks of laboratory everyday life that can significantly facilitate life for EXPERIMENTATOR. In terms of content, we have focused on the analysis of the vertebrate brain, as it offers the possibility to investigate complex neuronal processes, which are of importance for example for learning, but also for the analysis of neuronal diseases. Methodically, we span the arc of molecular, protein biochemical, cell biological and electrophysiological approaches, about the establishment of transgenic mouse models and their analysis (e.g. in behavioral studies) up to non-invasive imaging methods, which are easy to use in the study of the human brain.
content.title_en: The experimenter: Neuroscience

content.text: Business Engineering Navigator : Design and analysis of business solutions "Business-to-IT". This book presents the methodology of business engineering, i.e. the model and method-based design theory for business solutions at strategy, organizational and IT level in its entirety. Chapter 1 describes the positioning of business engineering (BE) and business engineering navigator (BEN) conceptually. Modelling business solutions, i.e. the subject of BEN, is described in detail in Chapter 2. Chapter 3 is dedicated to modeling itself, i.e. the way of designing business solutions. The longest chapter is the detailed description of the eight BEN components reused in different business models in Chapter 4. While the presentations of the first four chapters are intentionally tool-neutral, Chapter 5 describes the exemplary support of BEN with a modeling tool. A continuous application example illustrates the statements. Necessary and positioning of a business engineering engineering -- business solutions - subject of analysis and design with BEN -- BEN design methodology for business solutions - BEN analysis and tool-support.
content.title_en: Business Engineering Navigator : Design and analysis of business solutions "Business-to-IT"

content.text: Simulation and optimization in production and logistics: Practical guidelines with case examples. The use of simulation-based optimization in production and logistics has high potential. Reports on successful couplings of simulation and optimization are rare. Simulation models are evaluation models that determine results about the dynamic behavior of a system for predefined parameters. Due to the mostly intransparent relationship between the result sizes and the parameters of a simulation model, manual optimization is difficult against the background of increasing process chains and changing system loads. The use of mathematical optimization can help in different functions in cooperation with simulation to achieve better and faster available target values in the sense of task setting. The book introduces simulation-based optimization, shows possible application fields and coupling mechanisms and explains exemplary realizations from practice based on case examples. It addresses the user from the industry, who can check the possibilities and potentials of simulation-based optimization in terms of its tasks and applications. Introduction -- Simulation-based optimization -- Simulation - Optimization - Optimization and target-terms - Interconnection - Optimization-Regulation-Regulation-Regulation-Regulation-Regulation-Regulation-Regulation-Applications.
content.title_en: Simulation and optimization in production and logistics : Practical guide with case studies

content.text: More success through Web Analytics : a guide for marketers and decision-makers. As a marketer, sales expert or decision-maker, you know that you are not allowed to judge Internet strategies from your stomach or to design website layouts to your liking. Instead, you need to rely on the professional use of web analysis and automated optimization. To be successful, you need intelligent analysis of online data that provides information about the behavior of visitors to your websites and shops. In this practical guide you will learn how to perform the complex tasks in web analysis efficiently and successfully. You will be supported in all areas that belong to web analysis: - in the detailed description of all objectives and requirements for web analysis - in the selection of the right tools - in the establishment and application of the tool and - in the analysis of the analysis results from an economic point of view. Use this book so that you can make the right decisions in your company and successfully introduce and use web analysis.
content.title_en: More success through Web Analytics : a guide for marketers and decision-makers

content.text: Descriptive statistics: Practical introduction – With tasks and solutions. This introductory textbook shows the entire process of a statistical study, starting from data collection, processing and analysis of the data to interpretation of the results. The focus is on the application and practical implementation of statistical methods. The author places particular emphasis on a clear, understandable and comprehensible description. To this end, all methods are presented in a clearly structured form, step by step and in detail. Exercise tasks and control questions for all chapters deepen the material. The 8th edition has been revised and supplemented with new examples.

content.text: Real and media product experiences: Analysis and comparison of the effects of experience and cross-media marketing measures. Fundamentals of the effects of real and media product experiences -- Theoretical basics Part 1: Influence of real and media factors on purchasing decisions -- Empirical part 1: Empirical study on the factors affecting purchasing behaviour -- Theoretical basics Part 2: Comparison of the effects of advertising and real product experiences and development of a model for the interaction of media and real product experiences -- Empirical part 2: Studies on the comparison of the effects of advertising and real product experiences -- Implications. Sandra Diehl uses the Diary method to analyze the general influence of media and real factors on purchasing decision behavior. Furthermore, she uses an experimental design to investigate whether and to what extent advertising can shape later product testing or whether advertising can, after a real product experience, still exert an influence on consumer product attitudes. The author conducts extensive strategic and operational recommendations that contribute to optimizing cross-media advertising strategies in combination with real product experiences.
content.title_en: Real and media product experiences : Analysis and comparison of the effects of experience and cross-media marketing measures

content.text: Innovation barriers. The implementation of innovation projects is a major challenge for many companies, because they are often altered, delayed or even prevented by innovation barriers. Based on 186 interviews with project employees and managers in various research-intensive industries, Christoph Mirow shows which innovation barriers can typically occur and how they affect the project. Using a holistic organizational model, he empirically examines how innovation barriers can be influenced by different design options in the structuring of the organization and in project management.
content.title_en: Innovation barriers

content.text: Human Factors in Cockpit : Practice of safe action for pilots. The main task of a traffic pilot is to safely bring his aircraft from A to B. This also economically and comfortably is only second. The knowledge of traffic pilots about optimal accident prevention and the prevention of "human failure" is still capable of improving despite years of efforts. Pilots should know more about when and under which circumstances accidents happen and how they can be reasonably avoided preventively. This is explained in the book in detail. Accident prevention necessarily includes safety-relevant behavior, especially Crew Resource Management (CRM). This would like to support the association Cockpit by first defining the contents of the CRM as completely as possible in the book and then showing how these contents can be transferred from the theory training to the cockpit via the necessary seminars. Accident prevention -- Information reception and processing -- Human error -- Communication -- Stress -- Decision-making -- Leadership and team behavior -- Fatigue and vigilance management -- Recommendations of the Association Cockpit.
content.title_en: Human Factors in the Cockpit : Practice of safe action for pilots

content.text: The Gottlieb Daimler era: New perspectives on the early history of the automobile and its technology. Introduction -- Internal combustion engines – mobile and stationary -- The Gottlieb Daimler era -- Carl Benz and mobility -- Petrol motor cars until 1900. When and by whom was the automobile invented? We believe it to know, but much of it from the period before 1900 remained unknown and untapped. Reinhard Seiffert takes the long-underrated work of Gottlieb Daimler as an opportunity to look back into the beginnings of automobile history. He follows the changes in the culture of memory and the evaluation of individuals and constructions, brands and myths over decades. In doing so, the author focuses on the key function of technology and provides future-oriented insights into the changing lifestyles, increasing environmental awareness and the finiteness of resources.
content.title_en: The Gottlieb Daimler era: New perspectives on the early history of the automobile and its technology

content.text: Controlling and limited cognitive skills: the foundations and applications of a behavioral approach. Controlling ensures the rationality of corporate management. But how exactly can rationality deficits be made tangible within the framework of corporate management? In this work, the contributors choose the method of decreasing the abstraction of Siegwart M. Lindenberg as the basis for analyzing cognitive and motivational rationality bottlenecks. They discuss methodological questions about economic theory as well as concrete applications of such behavioral controlling in the field of investment controlling, information provision and value-oriented reporting. The book is rounded off by an epilogue by Siegwart M. Lindenberg.
content.title_en: Controlling and limited cognitive skills : basics and applications of a behavioral approach

content.text: Creative project management : Promote innovative results with project production. There are many books about project management - this is especially about something completely new, something "never before". The author duo conveys suggestions and methods to master the challenges and uncertainties of a project with imagination and creativity. New here is the approach of creative project culture. For this purpose, methods of project management are linked with the methods of project production developed by the authors. Their credo is: By skillful project structuring, release the necessary creativity, which needs innovative results.
content.title_en: Creative project management : Promote innovative results with project staging

content.text: Innovations in the customer dialogue: Real customer behaviour and real marketing. "Innovations in the customer dialogue is a plea for real marketing, which is based on real customer behaviour. Many marketing concepts are finely thought out, but they aim to be past the market and customers. Being with customers in real dialogue is a claim and a success principle. At the University of St. Gallen, experts from research and practice under the direction of Prof. Dr. Christian Belz with 30 partner companies set themselves the goal of developing relevant innovations for the practice in the customer dialogue. The content - With dialogue marketing more business can be realized in difficult markets - The breakthrough in the dialogue lies between customers and companies. The customer view gains. - Real customer behaviour and real marketing proposes finely thought-out marketing concepts. - Customer information is a strategic resource of companies. - Inbound marketing promotes and uses the initiative of the customer and is full hit marketing. - Added value brings customers to the dialogue for providers of profitable customer behaviour and real marketing.
content.title_en: Innovations in the customer dialogue : Real customer behaviour and real marketing

content.text: Risk-adjusted performance analysis of bond portfolios. Performance analysis in the context of asset management -- Modelling credit risk -- Parameter estimation of the model -- Performance analysis -- Summary and outlook. Measuring and assessing the results achieved is essential for a sound investment decision. The dimensions of return and risk are therefore always to be considered together to avoid misallocation. Jens Daum examines the available instruments for performance analysis of bond and equity portfolios. He combines these with a risk concept based on a no-arbitrage approach to enable risk-adjusted performance analysis for bond portfolios with the developed model. Based on real bond portfolios and with knowledge of the respective shifts, the applicability of the model is shown in an extensive empirical study.
content.title_en: Risk-adjusted performance analysis of bond portfolios

content.text: Intermittent deterministic chaos as a possible explanation for a long memory in financial market data. Long memory in financial market data -- Intermittent deterministic chaos -- Simulation of intermittent deterministic chaos -- Summary and outlook. Empirical capital market research keeps observing a long-term dependency structure, a so-called long memory, in the volatility of stock price yields. This has far-reaching consequences. For example, a long-term memory actually makes rational evaluation of options and the determination of various risk measures more difficult. However, the fact that the relevant standard models cannot adequately describe these dependency structures is far more severe. Karsten Webel first gives an overview of the long-term memory explanations established in econometry and then turns to deterministic processes with intermittent chaos. These processes represent an alternative explanation approach for a long-term memory, which is previously mainly used in physics and computer science, but is almost unknown in econometrics. In this context, four processes with intermittent chaos are highly popular in the application of this application. These processes now provide an alternative explanation for a long-term memory, but are now used mainly in physics and computer science.
content.title_en: Intermittent deterministic chaos as a possible explanation for a long memory in financial market data

content.text: Intelligent Data Interchange (IDI) : Non-interventional business data exchange through knowledge representation and ontological matching. The electronic exchange of structured business documents (Electronic Data Interchange, EDI) is associated with a high implementation and maintenance effort despite the use of standards such as EDIFACT or ANSI X12. Consequently, EDI use is limited to processes with low variability and high evidence volumes. André Köhler develops an architecture for intelligent business data exchange (Intelligent Data Interchange, IDI) which enables companies to exchange structured business documents ad hoc and with unknown partners. Central components of this architecture are ontologies and semantic matching methods used by so-called IDI agents for the interpretation of business documents as well as for the protocol agreement. From EDI to IDI – a paradigm shift -- ontology architecture and language -- ontology content and vocabulary -- ontological matching -- application example -- summary and outlook.
content.title_en: Intelligent Data Interchange (IDI) : Intervention-free business data exchange through knowledge representation and ontological matching

content.text: The frickin math of democracy. The frickin' mathematics of democracy is an explanation and historical introduction to the problems that can arise in a democracy. The majority election and the allocation of seats in a parliament raise mathematical questions, to whose description is no longer needed as arithmetic, but whose solution is surprisingly difficult or even impossible. The so-called Condorcet paradox shows, for example, that a majority election can lead to seemingly absurd results. And how many seats should be assigned to a party in parliament, for example, which received 23.6 percent of the votes? The story begins with the ancient Greeks and Romans and leads through medieval church lords, personalities of the French revolution and the American founding fathers to today's Nobel Prize winners. Both for generally interested readers as well as students of political sciences and economics the book will be of great interest. The Anti-Democrat -- The Letter Writer -- The Mystic -- The Officer -- The Marquis -- The Mathematician -- The Oxforder Professor -- The Founding Fathers -- The Post-Democrats -- The Elite-The Quoplayers -- The Elite-The Journalist
content.title_en: The Fucky Mathematics of Democracy

content.text: Housing renewal : Sustainable optimization of housing stock. Germany is built. The annual new buildings now account for less than one percent of the building stock. However, three quarters of the existing residential buildings are older than 30 years and urgently require modernisation. This work provides a comprehensive overview of the criteria to be observed during a comprehensive renewal in order to find an economically viable, socially compatible and environmentally sound solution. The focus is on multi-family houses. The work is aimed at operators and managers of larger holdings as well as scientifically interested readers in the real estate industry who want to make a critical comparison and systematise their activities. Each chapter offers extensive checklists that can be systematically addressed to upcoming modernisation tasks.

content.text: Statistical Information Technology: Signal and Pattern Recognition, Parameter and Signal Estimation. The 5th edition of the classic statistical information technology is a substantial extension in the field of machine learning. It thus provides an excellent overview of the two important topics of pattern detection/signal processing and machine learning. The authors cover signal detection in noise and pattern recognition as well as parameter and signal estimation. Modern methods such as wavelet transformation or cluster formation with blurred partitions are considered. In addition to classical methods of detection, newer classifiers based on neural networks and kernel-based methods are discussed. The parameter estimation treats Bayes and maximum likelihood approaches as well as adaptive methods. Viennese and Kalman filters are examples of signal estimation. The basics are explained by application examples from practice. Suitable for students and for engineers in practice. 1. Detection and Estimation -- 2. Basic concepts of statistics -- 3. Signal representation by vectors -- 4. Signal and Pattern detection -- 5. Signal estimation systems - 5.

content.text: The discovery of the indivisible: Quantum, Quark and LHC. In the middle of Europe, one of the largest and most complex machines that we humans have ever built has entered into operation: the Large Hadron Collider (LHC for short). With it, a window opens into a new world that contains many secrets: What gives the particles of matter their mass? Are there hidden space dimensions? Does there exist a deep connection between particles with different spins (supersymmetry)? What is the dark matter that permeates our universe? With this book, the reader immerses himself in this wonderful world that we humans have discovered in the modern age: atoms and their substructure of quarks and leptons, the enigmatic quantum mechanics, particles of light, Einstein's tissue of space and time, the four interactions and finally the new world that LHC is currently entering and in which we suspect Higgs particles, supersymmetry and perhaps first signs of string theory. After reading it is clear: We live in an amazing world and finally, the new world that is currently taking a decisive step in the search for its mystery.
content.title_en: The discovery of the indivisible: Quantum, Quark and LHC

content.text: Correlations in extreme situations : An empirical analysis of the German financial market with a focus on irrational market behaviour. Especially in the context of the financial market crisis in 2008, the classic portfolio theory and the mode of action of correlations have once again been criticized. Svend Reuse analyses the behaviour of correlations in extreme situations taking into account irrational market behaviour. Based on the results of an empirical survey conducted by 1,000 German credit institutions on the behaviour of correlations in practice and the handling of asset allocation, the author evaluates market data-based irrationality indices. With their help, he develops his own model for the tactical outperformance of the classic Markowitz approach.
content.title_en: Correlations in extreme situations : An empirical analysis of the German financial market with a focus on irrational market behaviour
