Algebra and discrete mathematics are among the most important mathematical foundations of computer science. Volume 1 of this two-volume textbook is now available in a revised and expanded third edition and introduces comprehensively and vividly into the subject complex. Here, a clear elaboration of solution algorithms, many examples, detailed evidence and a clear optical differentiation of the core material from further information enable rapid access to the material. The extensive collection of exercise tasks not only facilitates an active elaboration of the content, but also shows the most diverse possible applications. content.text: Social Democracy in the Change: Programmatic restructuring in a European Comparison. Dr. Matthias Sachs is a PhD political scientist and works as a consultant at CAIDAO Consultants in Berlin. European Social Democracy in 2010 is already again or still in search of a coherent model, for a promising programmatic core, with which it can help shape the political discourse recognisably. Social-Democrat parties have repeatedly tried to break away from their old models, have thrown away a lot of ideological ballast in the course of their program debates and have seriously and often intensively dealt with the emerging new challenges, in order to find at the end no new and long-term viable ideological foundations. The processes of these program renewals are the subject of this book. It describes the restructuring of the programmatics of German, British and Dutch Social Democracy since the mid-1980s and thus provides an analysis of the ideological development of SPD, Labour Party and PvdA.
content.title_en: Social Democracy in the Change: Programme restructuring in the European Comparison

content.text: The threat situation of European societies has changed over the last decades. Security policy challenges can only be met together: with other states together, but also using very different forces. The interoperability of the armed forces, cooperation with the police and civil-military cooperation have since intensified. What are the status and prospects of the transformation in Germany, Austria and Switzerland? And what future challenges are anticipated? In this volume, experts from the three states provide answers to these questions.
content.title_en: Transformation of security policy : Germany, Austria, Switzerland compared

content.text: Asset management for infrastructure investments - energy and water. Introduction -- Tasks of plant management -- Control functions -- Integration into the corporate organization -- System landscape in asset management. The task of a utility company (electricity, gas, water) is to enable sufficient supply under technical and financial conditions. Under competitive conditions, it is therefore possible to develop new structures and procedures to meet the tasks in a regulated market. On the one hand, the owner expects not only an appropriate interest rate on the capital used, but also a business growth, while the regulator on the other hand aims to provide a reliable and cost-effective supply of the general public. From these different points of view, it is useful to restructure the necessary processes developed in the past and to make them visible organisationally. The book provides an extensive overview of the asset management process, which is implemented at different depths at the time for utility companies.
content.title_en: Asset Management for Infrastructures - Energy and Water

content.text: Structural verification of BPMN models. Business processes usually have to meet requirements of the business level, which must be correctly mapped by the resulting models when modeling the business process. Jens Müller examines requirements that make statements about the necessary nature of the structure of BPMN models with regard to their content importance. Currently used tools for business process modelling do not offer an opportunity to explicitly represent and automatically evaluate business requirements of the category under investigation. This increases the risk of violation of requirements with their increasing number. To solve the described problems, the author presents novel concepts that enable the design of structural-content requirements using a graphical modeling method and to automatically verify business process models in terms of compliance. The application of these concepts is demonstrated by a scenario from the aviation industry.
content.title_en: Structural verification of BPMN models

content.text: RFID for libraries. Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is entering many areas of modern economy slowly and steadily, changing the working processes. Libraries are an example: they are transforming into public spaces with the help of technology, in which visitors can not only use themselves, but also move much more intuitively and quickly within the networked and diverse range of services. RFID technology can therefore provide a comfortable service; theoretically around the clock. Staff are only burdened by routine work and thus get space for new activities in the field of RFID technology. Knowledge about the integration of RFID technology in libraries has multiplied over the last three years. The book describes the technology, planning and financing of the correct library's infrastructure.
content.title_en: RFID for libraries

content.text: Global change and regional development: Adaptation strategies in the Berlin-Brandenburg region. 1 Introduction -- 2 Environmental change and the consequences for the landscape water budget -- 3 Change of land use and its consequences for water resources -- 4 Social change using the example of infrastructure and institutions of general interest -- 5 Synthesis and recommendations for action and orientations for regional adaptation strategies to global change -- 6 directories. What are the consequences of global change for regional development? What consequences do these consequences result from social, economic and political considerations? This volume examines these pressing questions with a view to the Berlin-Brandenburg region. The focus is on the availability, sustainable use and protection of the water resource. The experts of the Global Change – Regional Development Working Group of the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences investigate the various dimensions of global change: The contributions deal with the regional impacts of climate change, with the change of land use and aspects of innovative agricultural economy as well as with the effects of social and spatial structural change on infrastructures.

content.text: Successful business processes through modern commodity management systems : Product overview of market-leading systems and selection process. Trading companies can no longer compete without commodity management systems (WWS) today. Against the background of current competitive conditions, the book describes the requirements for modern WWS and supports in the selection of suitable software systems. Based on the latest and most comprehensive study on WWS, the following questions will be answered: - How to select standardized WWS? - What technological and functional market developments are there? - Which products are available on the market? - What are the characteristics and strengths of the leading solutions? Answering the questions is also interesting for those interested in functional and technical development in order to identify further development potential in their own companies. In this 3rd completely revised edition, over 80 WWS solutions are considered; 42 of them with detailed system profiles and detailed performance data.

System biology examines how the components of a cell or organism form interaction networks and how these networks produce the functions of the cell that correspond to the observable appearance - the phenotype. The present book offers a computer science perspective on system biology with a focus on the management, exchange and integration of the data generated and on modeling with different methods. In doing so, the reader is gradually led from data on the available databases and their integration possibilities to different modelling approaches with different analysis options. The author addresses those who want to obtain a broad, well-founded overview of the field and gives numerous indications of in-depth literature on the individual topics.

The complete electronic integration of logistics processes in heterogeneous system landscapes will become increasingly important in the future. Likewise, the concrete implementation of a SOA concept based on an EAI system using Web Services is currently very much discussed. The main goals of these strategies are the completely media-free exchange of messages as well as a flexible and decoupled execution of enterprise-internal and cross-company business processes. content.text: Signals and Systems: Theory, Simulation, Application: An example-oriented introduction with MATLAB. The book deals with the theory of signals and (linear) systems as well as their applications. After an introduction based on examples from the various application areas, the basic techniques for describing time-continuous linear time-invariant systems and their effect on signals are discussed. The transition to digital signal processing is prepared by the derivation and discussion of the sampling theorem. Subsequently, the methods of system theory for digital signal processing are presented. One focus is on the discussion of the discrete Fourier transformation. Here, in particular, the correlations between DFT/FFT spectra and the spectra of time-continuous signals are provided in the focus. The methods are transmitted to the processing of stochastic signals and thus made usable for practical application. The author describes numerous real examples with real measured data and provides the material as well as the associated MATLAB programs online. The book contains over 150, in many cases MATLAB/Simulink-based exercise tasks, the solutions in a basic and comprehensive set of systems are available for general applications.
content.title_en: Signals and systems: theory, simulation, application : An example-oriented introduction with MATLAB

However, they should be a tool for every physicist, since there is hardly any field of physics in which thermodynamic processes do not play a role anywhere. content.text: Between two disciplines: B. L. van der Waerden and the development of quantum mechanics. Dutch mathematician van der Waerden is known for his "Modern Algebra". However, the focus of this book is on a hitherto largely unexplored area of interest of this versatile scientist: his contributions to the group theory method in quantum mechanics around 1930. The author elaborates on its history, content and effect in detail, and compared with the approaches of Wigner and Weyl, van der Waerden's pragmatic style is revealed. At the same time, the controversy surrounding the use of the group theory method is discussed in its entirety. Not only the complexity of mathematical processes is revealed here, but also its repercussions on developments in "pure" mathematics.
content.title_en: Between two disciplines: B. L. van der Waerden and the development of quantum mechanics

content.text: Monitoring of motivational concepts for young technology professionals (MoMoTech). //No Backcover text for this series// In Germany, many institutions, companies, associations, associations and individual persons are now involved in the promotion of young technology-scientific researchers, especially in the field of extracurricular education, have developed numerous projects and programmes in recent years. The offers range from the promotion of general technology interest to the promotion of talent and the search of young talent for companies. But how effective are these diverse initiatives and projects in view of their intended goals? The academy project "MoMoTech" addresses this question with the methods of empirical social research. In addition to a comprehensive inventory of model projects for the development of technology and the creation of a database (http://www.technik-motivation-discover.de), the promoters and initiators of such projects were surveyed and the project biographies were mapped. Furthermore, 15 selected projects from the "Garagenprojekt" to the large "Techniqueevents" were selected and evaluated in terms of the effectiveness of the target groups. On the basis of these results, the study directs a series of success indicators as well-based and the analysis of the evaluation of the evaluation of the findings.
content.title_en: Monitoring of motivation concepts for young technology (MoMoTech)

content.text: Introduction to quantum computer science: Quantum cryptography, teleportation and quantum computing. Starting from the theory and protocols of quantum cryptography, the achievable service qualities are presented using the current technical possibilities. In an extensive discussion, the achievable safety is elaborated, whereby hitherto little attention is paid to aspects of cryptoanalysis. In the same style, the possibilities of quantum computing are examined, whereby a detailed teaching unit on the design of quantum algorithms and their experimental implementation on classical computers is included. The scalability of quantum computers is critically investigated. As a link between both disciplines, the teleportation is presented, with the help of which one hopes to overcome certain limitations. Extensive practical tasks allow a secure deepening and critical evaluation of the techniques as well as the theoretical simulation of ideas. Conclusion: the use of quantum methods requires higher qualifications of the operators than today's methods and is more critical than is taught so far. 1 Introduction -- 2 quantum mechanical phenomena -- 3 foundations of quantum mechanics - 4 light quantas and encryption - 6 quantum computers.

content.text: Smart Energy: Changing to a sustainable energy system. Preface -- Part A: New business models, transformations and future plans -- Part B: Challenges from the perspective of various actors -- Part C: Energy efficiency, smart metering and intelligent buildings -- Part D: Transformation of networks into smart grids -- Part E: Smart cities and electric mobility. With the events and decisions of 2011, the transformation of our energy system was finally initiated. What prospects do these provide for the companies in the energy sector? Renowned authors from science and practice describe in this book how the change towards more sustainability can succeed. Smart technologies play an important role in this. The challenge for suppliers and technology providers lies in successfully realizing new business models. The authors work in forward-looking projects in this field and report on their progress in the transformation of the energy sector. content.text: Women in the natural sciences: Claims and contradictions. The volume deals with the situation of female scientists in German non-university research, especially in the natural sciences. The contributions of this volume show the clear gender difference in the course of their academic careers. The authors take a look at the research environment of the scientists. The investigations are based on qualitative interviews with experts from the offices of non-university research. The analyses are commented on from the perspective of a research institution and are mirrored with (against) examples from practice.
content.title_en: Women in the natural sciences : claims and contradictions

content.text: Radial centrifugal pumps: Calculation and construction of hydrodynamic components. Introduction -- Flow-technical basics -- Basics for the calculation and construction of hydrodynamic components -- Calculation examples -- Operation of centrifugal pumps -- Formula symbols, head and foot marks -- Bibliography. This practical book provides a sound help in the calculation and construction of hydrodynamic components of radial centrifugal pumps. The author focuses on the core topics of pump hydrodynamics and also addresses the system-specific control behavior of different pump types. It deals with the operating behaviour of pumps in turbine operation and their differences to "real" turbines. For the basic understanding of the very complex connections in pump hydrodynamics, the basic physical laws are first derived and explained in an understandable form. Furthermore, new calculation methods are taught, such as methods for calculating the lower performance, the wheel blade and the entrance cross-section, the various control devices, the disc friction losses and the attainable efficiency.
content.title_en: Radial centrifugal pumps : Calculation and construction of hydrodynamic components

content.text: User Interfaces are the focus of the interest of the client, users and developers of commercial application software. The user interface is contractual acceptance criteria, means of understanding between the requirements and developers as well as acceptance and success criteria for the user. We have found little practical work for the development of user interfaces so far: listing control elements, checklists, advice, bids and prohibitions. User Interface Development practice provides complete UI solutions and dialog page recipes based on specific application cases and requirements. The focus is on creating user interfaces for specific application cases in a specific technology. The reader learns to sketch workflows and dialogue pages using practical examples, design navigation concepts, layout dialog pages and develop the interfaces between logic, design and function.
content.title_en: User Interface Development Practice : Information Structures, Design Patterns, Procedure Patterns

content.text: Informational description and automatic indexing: A textbook and workbook. The book provides knowledge about the modeling of document-related metadata through practical tasks, accompanying theoretical explanations and additional exercises. Examples are image documents and bibliographic data. It provides information on how to build up appropriate databases and provide suitable search environments. It is presented and practically taught how to use knowledge about the structure of data for importing foreign data. The aim is to build databases for the formal and content development and the design of retrieval environments, and for bibliographic data the creation of bibliographical data. As methods of content development, the semantic structuring of topic fields are particularly addressed by the example of the the the thesaurus concept of aspect and the automatic indexing of bibliographic data. The presentation is rounded off by the discussion of references to the construction of relational databases for bibliographic data as well as the background of the character encoding and order questions.
content.title_en: Information development and automatic indexing : a textbook

content.text: Arithmetic and geometrical skills of school beginners: An empirical study with special consideration of patterns and structures. Children have very heterogeneous mathematical skills at the beginning of their school, which require individual diagnosis and support. Therefore, the knowledge about the competences and procedures of the children is indispensable for the planning and implementation of an initial teaching tailored to their abilities. Theresa Deutscher presents the learning levels of school beginners in a comprehensive and detailed way for the basic ideas of arithmetic and geometry. To this end, she conducts clinical individual interviews with 108 children, which she evaluates qualitatively and quantitatively in relation to different student groups. Particularly detailed are the learning levels of the children in the area of patterns and structures and the varied handling of the children with the partial pattern perception, the partial pattern structuring and the pattern application. The author proves that the arithmetic and geometric abilities of the school beginners are in a noteworthy context.
content.title_en: Arithmetic and geometric skills of school beginners : An empirical study with special attention to patterns and structures

content.text: Proportionality and percentage calculation in upper secondary education: Empirical examination and didactic analysis. The curriculum content Proportionality and percentage calculation are not only important in the mathematics teaching of upper secondary education, they also find their applications in many everyday situations. Thomas Hafner examines the development of mathematical competences in these content areas from the 5th to the 10th year. Based on a normative task analysis, he examines solution strategies of pupils. In the context of individual case studies, solution processes and underlying mental models are recorded and analyzed. The basic concept plays the theoretical basis for the interpretation of possible misconceptions. Taking into account the results regarding competence development, solution strategies and misconceptions, as well as the identified deficits and problematic learning processes of pupils, interesting information can be gained for teaching practice.
content.title_en: Proportionality and percentages in upper secondary education : Empirical analysis and didactic analysis

A book for all production managers, production managers, technical managers, masters. The manual Forming and Fine Cutting links in the holistic presentation of material technology and technology in the production of highly demanding and precise end-form-related parts made of steels with higher strength. It thus shows new ways - also through the practical relevance of basic knowledge - for technically and economically optimized process combinations in the design of workpieces, the selection of materials and process design.
content.title_en: Forming and fine cutting : Manual for procedures, steel materials, partial design

content.text: The question of the expert in the court proceedings consists in the mediation of the expert knowledge necessary for the assessment of a concrete case. The evaluation falls within the jurisdiction of the lawyer. It is often difficult for the expert to understand the sometimes complex scientific foundations under the conditions given in foro for the natural layman. Similarly, the lawyer often finds it difficult to take into account the forensic explanations in their importance so comprehensively that their application to the concrete case is possible in all conceivable facets. The present book has set itself the task of presenting the theoretical possibilities of the anthropological examination of the case in terms of the medical profession and the possibility of the diagnosis of the situation in the field of the medical profession.

content.text: Functionalization of thermoplastic fibre composites by hybrid yarns : Adaptive structures through the integration of form memory alloys. By integrating multifunctional components into composite materials, it is possible to realize a new generation of structures and components that have both sensory and actuarial properties and react self-regulating to external influences. Christian Paul is the integration of special FGL hybrid yarns into reinforcement semi-finished products and the utilization of the form memory effect for shaping the functionalized and consolidated composite structure in the focus of his investigations. He develops efficient lightweight constructions with an additional function integrated by a hybrid yarn, such as structural regulation by form memory alloys, with multifunctionality by the integrated component. The cost-effective production of these components by automated manufacturing processes represents an innovative contribution to the development of novel function integrated lightweight structures.
content.title_en: Functionalization of duroplastic fibre composites by hybrid yarns : Adaptive structures by integrating shape memory alloys

The business model of European industrial companies is currently changing from traditional product manufacturers to hybrid bundles of products and accompanying services. In the future, a technically advanced product portfolio will no longer be sufficient to differentiate itself in international competition. Innovative service concepts offer manufacturers the opportunity to build a unique selling point in comparison with their competitors and to safeguard this competitive advantage sustainably. The balanced collection of contributions of this publishing company provides a current overview of successful service innovations and offers companies concrete guidelines to successfully implement them. By integrating high-quality authors from corporate practice, universities and consulting, it is possible in a unique way to show the entire spectrum of innovative B2B services.

content.text: Sensors in science and technology : Functionality and fields of application. Sensors are used for the measurement of physical, chemical and biological quantities. The book provides a comprehensive overview of the physical basics, functions and applications of sensors. It is structured according to the fields of application of sensors and shows their application in a clear way based on typical examples of use. Sensory measures are e.g. mechanical, dynamic, thermal, electrical and magnetic. Furthermore, optical and acoustic sensors are treated in detail in their application in the book. The sensor signals are recorded, processed and converted into control signals for actuators. Such sensor systems are also presented.
content.title_en: Sensors in Science and Technology : Functionality and Applications

content.text: Alternative propulsion systems for automobiles: hybrid systems, fuel cells, alternative energy sources. The updated overview and analysis of processes, drive machines and energy sources that can be combined in complex energy management systems for automobiles are the contents of this book. content.text: Motorcycle Technology - The basics and concepts of engine, drive and chassis. The technology of today's motorcycles becomes more and more complex. High-performance motors and their mechanics, camshaft design, load changes and combustion, digital motor controls, ABS or drive slip control require just as the physical laws for driving stability or also for commuting and other critical driving conditions. Funded but at the same time vivid and understandable, the author addresses experts as well as technology-loving motorcyclists who want to know everything about the basics and the development of modern high-performance motor bikes. Newly incorporated modern measuring methods for stiffness measurement on driving systems and examples of aerodynamic investigations with simulation methods. Current engine new developments with 6-cylinder engines, but also a view of future electric mobility are briefly presented. Around 40 percent of companies are now active in social media to profile their own brand and to engage in greater dialogue with consumers. The quest for more brand loyalty is accompanied by a change in brand communication. This is why consumers increasingly influence the brand and its leadership. The book "Social Branding" provides valuable insights into the new partial discipline of brand management. content.text: Pipeline and apparatus construction : Planning manual for industrial and district heating supply. The book provides theoretical and practical knowledge necessary for the planning and execution of pipelines and supply pipe networks for high pressure steam, hot water, compressed air and cooling water. The author provides both the flow-technical as well as the design principles and all the calculation methods necessary for the pipeline and for the apparatus construction and lists their application in fully calculated examples. The book contains tables with material values and work diagrams to the extent necessary for the understanding of the treated substance and the implementation of calculation examples. Mobile security - what are the dangers? -- e-mail and spam - safe traffic -- biometry - deceptive security -- online banking - enemy reads with -- passwords - what is important -- EC and credit cards. The second, extended edition with many new examples from the technical everyday.

content.text: Sustainable logistics: answers to a global challenge. Management Summary -- Basics -- Strategies and concepts to promote sustainability -- Summary and outlook -- Glossary -- Directory of subject matter. Logistics and supply chain management will have to adapt to completely new boundary conditions and requirements in the foreseeable future. Based on very ambitious targets to reduce pollutant emissions, policy will contribute to a significant increase in transport costs through various instruments such as tolls, excise duties and a trade with scarce emission certificates. In the same direction, oil prices and increasing productivity losses in freight transport, which will have to contend with an increasingly overloaded transport infrastructure, will have to make a strong contribution to maintaining mobility and the environment, and will have to reinvent itself in part. Based on a description of future boundary conditions, this book will develop adaptation strategies that will allow for less pollution-intensive goods exchange and can contribute to maintaining mobility as a prerequisite for any business sector. In this context, not only logistical process and network architectures will be tested, but also the overarching marketing strategies and business models have been updated in the context of the policy framework, and the situation of the new business models.
content.title_en: Sustainable logistics: answers to a global challenge

content.text: The transmission book. Gearbox technology has a significant influence on vehicle consumption, driveability, weight and costs. The relevance of these properties has increased significantly in the recent past, and gearboxes are becoming increasingly important in interaction with the entire drive train or vehicle. Hybrid technology has brought even more life into the world of gearboxes. Degrees of freedom are increasing and a wide range of combinations of gearboxes, combustion engines and electric motors are possible. The transmission book aims to present system and method knowledge about gearbox technology and to learn about functions and interactions. The numerous components and sub-systems are introduced abstractingly, so that a timeless competence is taught. With the knowledge of this book, new gearbox concepts can also be evaluated and developed.
content.title_en: The Gear Book

content.text: Strategic innovations in the hotel industry : A resource-oriented case study analysis of tourist service companies. Services and innovations -- Resources and competences -- Investigation methodology: An exploratory qualitative study -- Case studies. Innovations in the hotel industry pose particular challenges to the management and design of innovation processes. They are due to the constitutive characteristics of services. Elisa Innerhofer examines innovation processes in the hotel industry by linking concepts of service and innovation theory with resource-oriented approaches of strategic management. It shows which resources and competences are innovation-relevant and what role they play in the innovation process.
content.title_en: Strategic innovations in the hotel industry : A resource-oriented case study analysis of tourism service companies

content.text: Electromobility: Hype or revolution?. The growing need for mobility in the population can only be satisfied in the long term by the use of electric small and delivery vehicles for short distances. Mobility providers and customers must be well connected. The gradual market penetration of electric mobility is a major challenge for the automotive industry. Winners are some well-positioned automobile manufacturers and a surprise winner. As the oil reserves of the earth are finally and the oil price is expected to rise in the future, electricity as an alternative fuel is to provide a solution to the problem. The author outlines from the perspective of an insider, which is why a change is indispensable and describes the necessary steps. The finiteness of oil stocks and climate change -- What a future of mobility could look like -- Factor 2: Halving cars with combustion engines Fuel consumption -- Factor 4: Electromobility for short distances -- Factor 5: From individual mobility to collective individual mobility -- Outlook -- Conclusion.
content.title_en: Electromobility : Hype or Revolution?

content.text: Logistic characteristics: Basics, tools and applications. The book describes in a closed form the modeling basis of the Logistic characteristics for production and storage processes as well as their mathematical derivation and calculation on the basis of normal data. This makes the interdependencies of the logistic objectives - short lead time and high adherence to deadlines on the one hand and low stocks and high utilization on the other - as well as their influence possibilities clear. Logistic characteristics are therefore an interesting alternative to simulation for many cases. They often open up hidden potentials in the lead time and the circulation stocks without the need for complex restructuring and investments. The clear structure of basics, tools and numerous application examples from the varied series production make the book a theoretically sound and practical guide to the continuous improvement of the logistical quality of production companies.
content.title_en: Logistic characteristics : Basics, tools and applications

content.text: Services for the energy-efficient city. The promotion and implementation of energy efficiency and climate protection are among the priority tasks of cities and municipalities of all size classes. The results of the competition Energy-efficient city of the Federal Ministry of Education and Research prove that innovative services make a significant contribution to this. The collection presents practical and comprehensively up-to-date implementation concepts from 15 cities and provides an overview of current findings of service research with relevance for the energy-efficient city. The contributions of recognized scientists are aimed at all those who want to develop this interdisciplinary research and action field in a practical and comprehensive manner. The Framing Approach at a Glance -- On the Scientific Status of the Framing Approach -- Partial process theory on the emergence and effect of textual frames in media offerings -- Empirical test of sub-process theory -- Conclusion and outlook Media frames are patterns of statements that occur repeatedly in media discourse products. They are awarded the status of suggesting a certain view on the subject and influence the opinion of recipients. Matthias Potthoff addresses the factors that influence the emergence of media frames. He presents a model that includes factors of influence on the level of persons, organization and country as well as on the basis of events. Finally, the author demonstrates the use of this model by means of an empirical case study on Turkey's accession to the EU.
content.title_en: Media frames and their emergence

This new control approach shows possibilities for controlling cooperations in integrated and social urban development and is a synthesis of existing theoretical approaches and own empirical results. Structural and action-theoretical aspects are integrated and the production of power relations in cooperative political processes are illustrated. With this knowledge selective participation can be effectively processed in cooperations. content.text: Stakeholder Value in Regional Development Processes : A relational perspective. How can added value be generated for stakeholders in regional development processes? Monika Bachinger assumes that regions represent latent network pools from which active networks can be decoupled depending on the problem or topic field. It links basic statements of social capital theory, market-based view and relational view and shows positive effects for the four factors trust, reciprocity, identification and network structure on the development of functional or social-emotional values for stakeholders. The region as latent network pool -- Stakeholders as resource providers in regional thematic networks -- Values as a basis for value generation in networks -- Social capital as a network-based resource and regional core competence -- Satisfaction of the partners in networks -- Triangulation of results of a structural equation analysis based on the partial-least-squares approach and qualitative content analysis.

content.text: Multicriteria award of contracts in combinatorial transport tenders. Transport invitations with combinatorial auctions -- Bicriteria award of contracts under costs and quality aspects -- Exact and metaheuristic pareto optimization procedures. By means of transport invitations shippers decide which transport services should be carried out by which freight forwarders. Tobias Buer presents a model and several solutions for awarding contracts in transport invitations. Both the interdependence of transport services is taken into account and the central decision criteria of cost and quality are also taken into account. The developed exact and metaheuristic solution procedures calculate concrete decision alternatives. For the shipper, the actual trade offs between transport costs and quality are visible and practical decision-making is improved.
content.title_en: Multi-criteria award in combined transport invitations

content.text: Innovative data protection. Main description: The history of data protection shows that while laws are a very important step for the protection of personal data, they are always only the first step. After all, the implementation of data protection standards decides whether everyday practice corresponds to the legislative objectives. In this respect, the ever-increasing automated processing in IT systems puts personal data at particular risk and requires significant protection measures. The most effective protection here are technical and organizational measures that lead to system-immanent protection of personal data. The ideal goal must be to make legally prohibited data processing impossible and to allow only such data collection and processing within the framework of an IT system that complies with the legal standards.
content.title_en: Innovative data protection

content.text: Fascination Wolfsburg 1938 - 2012. Based on four studies covering a period of almost 50 years, history and problems of the Volkswagen city Wolfsburg are illustrated. On the basis of unique empirical materials, an overview of the urban and social problems of a city's new foundation is given. Of particular interest here is the monostructural imprint of the living conditions and the urban development perspectives by the VW plant. Dr. Ulfert Herlyn and Dr. Wulf Ticino were professors of planning-related sociology at the Institute for Free Space Development of the Faculty of Architecture and Landscape at the Leibniz University Hannover. Dr. Annette Harth and Priv.Doz. Dr. Gitta Scheller are research assistants in the Department of Planning and Architecture Sociology at the Institute of Theory and History of Architecture at the Leibniz University Hannover

content.text: The concept of price-oriented quality assessment : A cross-product and cross-cultural causal analysis. General basics for the classification of the topic -- Theoretical conceptual foundations for price-oriented quality assessment -- Current state of empirical research on price-quality relationship -- Development of the study model -- Empirical investigation of price-oriented quality perception -- The concept of price-oriented quality assessment. The subjective perception of the quality of products in purchasing decisions takes on a special significance. However, so far hardly any product- or cross-cultural considerations have been made. Thomas Hofmann examines the importance of the price and other factors affecting the perceived quality by means of the example of different products and in three cultures. He shows that prices are used as quality indicators across the products and cultures considered. In contrast, the importance of emotional or social factors is dependent on product and culture.

content.text: Sociological and empirical work on a new knowledge-sociological approach. The Kommunikative Konstruktivismus as a continuation of social constructivism -- Positioning.- Connections -- Discourse contexts of communicative construction.- Sitative contexts of communicative construction. . The world is not waiting outside to be discovered, but we create it day after day - and especially through communicative action. Therefore, reality changes every day and with it also the social order and norms and values that give meaning to our actions. This is the basic position of the communicative constructivism presented here. The collected contributions try to theoretically justify the approach of communicative constructivism. Secondly, the approach is translated into empirical works that deal with the different topics in different sociological subdisciplinary disciplines (science sociology, migration sociology, media sociology). The third volume includes works on the connections to other disciplines, such as the University of Duisburg's Chair of Communication.
content.title_en: Communicative Constructivism : Theoretical and empirical work on a new knowledge-sociological approach

content.text: IT outsourcing decisions : Analysis of factors of influence and success for outsourcing companies. Outsourcing -- Efficiency, institutional economics -- Legitimacy, institutionalism -- Learning organisation -- Regulation -- Basel II. Companies consider a functioning IT operation as given, because in the event of a failure of IT production lines are still and transactions cannot be carried out. Nevertheless, IT operations usually do not count as their own core competence, so the question arises whether outsourcing is preferable to self-operation. Ralph Pfaller analyses IT outsourcing decisions in their emergence from an economic and institutional perspective, in the change in chosen and successful IT outsourcing approaches and in the context of regulation. The results suggest that there is a coexistence of economic and institutional influences on IT outsourcing decisions.
content.title_en: IT outsourcing decisions : Analysis of factors of influence and success for outsourced companies

content.text: The global configuration of political cultures: a theoretical and empirical analysis. Paradigm of political culture -- Diversity research -- Concept of democracy/e worldwide -- Global configuration -- Unity (cultural globalization), diversity (cultural circles), hybridity (transculturality) Can the global pattern of politically rich culture/s be described as unity, diversity or hybridity? This question fuels the sociological debate about cultural globalization, cultural circles and global mélange as well as the policy-theoretical universalism-relativism controversy. Sophia Schubert establishes a separate research strand in the paradigm of political culture to its conceptually precise and systematic empirical processing: empirical diversity research. The central finding of her analyses is that at present none of the three theoretical positions (unity, diversity, hybridity) alone suffices to interpret the global configuration of political cultures. They are complementary.
content.title_en: Global configuration of political cultures : a theoretical and empirical analysis

content.text: The quality of Participative Journalism on the Web: Building blocks for an Integrative Theoretical Concept and an Explanative Empirical Analysis. Participative Journalism continues to advance about 15 years after the creation of the first weblogs. In view of the increasing prominence of its platforms (e.g. Bildblog, GuttenPlag Wiki, Twitter and Wikileaks), the question arises about the quality of Participative Journalism on the Web with special brisence. Before Sven Engesser addresses this central question, he defines the associated terms, classifies the subject and develops an Integrative Quality Concept based on 30 theoretically derived criteria. Subsequently, he empirically analyzes the quality of over 100 platforms of Participative Journalism from all over the world and explains them using content and organizational factors. The web offers can be summarized into three groups ("Exclusive topic pages), "Local Media Mirrors" and "Commercial game meadows"). Furthermore, the quality criteria reveal interesting interrelations. The work provides an overview of the participation and the participation concept of the current platforms on the basis of quality.
content.title_en: The quality of Participative Journalism on the Web : Building blocks for an Integrative Theoretical Concept and an Explanative Empirical Analysis

content.text: Sustainable urban and transport planning: basic principles and solutions. Starting from the basics of urban planning, this title deals with the special aspect of sustainability in current urban and transport development and the handling of existing urban structures. The topics of demographic change, energy saving, environmental and climate protection are in the focus. The book contains both basic information as an introduction to the topic as well as concrete examples from practice. content.text: Automatisms and architecture; media obsessions technologies. For the first time, buildings and objects are self-controlling. Architecture faces the challenge of developing concepts for built life worlds. This essay examines the emergence and perspectives of the complex contemporary situation based on projects and technomedial theories. Just as mechanization spreads in modern times, automation is now transferred from economic production to the living worlds. There, however, automatic technologies interact with self-active body and cultural techniques. These commonalities are called automatisms. They allow a re-thinking of media and technology and refer to two hitherto unknown origins of modern, postmodern and contemporary architecture. Surprisingly, automatisms conflict with the cardinal virtues of architecture: rational planning of regulated processes, engaged in the influencing sociocultural events and the conscious design of space. Architecture becomes a metaphor for culture before these challenges, because the technological situation provokes many new spatial and sociocultural issues.
content.title_en: Automatisms and Architecture; Media Obsessions Technologies

content.text: Examination Trainer Electrical Engineering : First understand, then exist. This book prepares specifically for an exam before the Bachelor's degree. It contains answers to exam questions, solution strategies for exams and justifications of the essential laws of electrical engineering and electronics. The questions are sorted according to the degree of difficulty. Thus, students can find gaps in their own knowledge and replace them with a deeper understanding.
content.title_en: Test Trainer Electrical Engineering : First understand, then pass

content.text: Local network building as a strategic concept in prevention : Evaluation of a awareness-raising campaign on alcohol consumption in adolescence. Discourse on alcohol consumption in young people -- Intergenerative dialogue -- Social responsibility -- Reconstruction of campaign theory -- Analysis of local networks -- Impact survey among young people. The study examines whether and under what conditions campaigns can be used to develop and strengthen social responsibility for the risks posed by alcohol consumption by local networking in adults. The evaluation of the campaign and its effects is already addressing the question of the organisational management processes of the campaign, is concerned with the identification and analysis of local networks and concludes with an analysis of the prospects and reactions of young people to the campaign. .
content.title_en: Local network building as a strategic approach to prevention: Evaluation of a awareness-raising campaign on alcohol consumption in adolescence

content.text: Recognition and violence in schools: An evidence-based and theory-led intervention study in the practical test. Theoretical basics -- Discussion of empirical findings from the study of violence in schools: Development of the concept hypothesis -- Experimental intervention -- Accepted and rejected research hypotheses. How do school and family recognition conflicts affect the self-concept of pupils, their affiliation to aggressive peer groups and the violence they show in everyday school life? Tilmann Kammler uses an extensive measuring instrument to clarify these questions, which, in addition to parts of existing studies (research group Schulevaluation, PISA and others), also provides new operationalizations. In addition to the interviews of 530 students and the development of structural equation models, the author performs an experimental intervention, in which he assumes that students affected by failure and disintegration develop a positive self-concept through institutional and structural recognition and subsequently show rare violence. The course and consequences of the intervention are comprehensively analysed and documented by a mix of methods.
content.title_en: Recognition and violence in schools: A proof-based and theory-led intervention study in the practical test

content.text: Self-guided current converters at the DC voltage intercircuit: function, modulation and control. Power electronics enables optimal adaptation, conversion and dosing of electrical energy. As these functions are essential for numerous applications, power electronics has a central role in the fields of industry, energy, transport, medicine and communication technology. The worldwide expansion of renewable energy sources and the further development of hybrid and electric vehicles lead to the further increase in the importance of power electronics. This textbook deals with the sub-area of self-guided AC-DC converters as part of inverters with DC voltage intercircuit. Construction, function, modulation and regulation of the widely used two-point current converter are described in detail and intelligibly. This book is primarily aimed at students of universities and technical high and university universities of applied sciences. It can also serve as a reference work for the engineer already active in industry. Preface -- Construction, function and classification of current converters -- Two-stage current inverters with imprinted DC voltage -- Modulation of two-stage current converters -- Control of current inverters with imprinted DC voltage conting.

content.text: Management and marketing in cultural tourism: Basic knowledge – practical examples – checklists. Culture has a boom in tourism: the visit to churches, museums and castles is one of the most popular holiday activities of the German citizens. However, more and more providers are pushing into this market, so that the competition for the cultural tourists will become more and more intensified in the future. What are important trends in cultural tourism? What expectations do visitors have? How can cultural providers successfully assert themselves on the lucrative leisure and tourism market? The book offers up-to-date management know-how – in a compact and understandable form as well as with many practical examples and a checklist "Fit for tourism?" Dr. Albrecht Steinecke is a professor at the Faculty of Cultural Sciences at the University of Paderborn. He has been working on the topic of cultural tourism for many years and has extensive experience in advising tourism destinations (including the development of museum networks and the design of thematic routes).

content.text: Statistics: Introduction for economists and social scientists. More and more business decisions are based on the analysis of economic data. Economists and social scientists are therefore confronted with ever larger amounts of data that need to be arranged and analysed with statistical methods. Therefore, the training in these methods is becoming increasingly important. As many students find statistics difficult due to the mathematical orientation, the authors of this book rely in particular on verbal and easily accessible descriptions of the procedures, in order to arouse interest and fun in statistics also with the less mathematically oriented reader. Numerous practical examples emphasize the importance of statistical methods for the economist. By means of the application-related and comprehensive presentation, the book is particularly suitable for the new bachelor's training in statistics. It covers the substance of a one-year course.

To exploit this potential, Philipp Rode presents a method for the systematic creation of virtual prototypes and their use as virtual stimuli in customer tests in the early stages of the innovation process. The author establishes a model for the analysis, detection and description of product properties in their use context and shows empirically the reliability, validity and practical suitability of the presented method. Information technology in credit institutions -- Individual data processing -- IDP governance - Perspectives and organizational foundations -- Controlled use of IDP applications in the banking sector -- IT system audits. Professional applications for the most important business tasks are subject to a wide range of controls during development and during use. However, a frequently underestimated risk exists in the field of the creation and use of complex task-specific applications, which are developed by users directly at the workplace using end-user tools. Elizaveta Kozlova analyses opportunities and risks of IDP applications in the banking sector and develops a meta-design concept for IDP management in credit institutions. In addition, the author discusses the consequences for the implementation of the legally required economic audits.
content.title_en: Governance of individual data processing: Value-oriented and risk-conscious control of IDP applications in credit institutions

content.text: Generative production with plastics: Concept and construction for selective laser sintering. From the idea to the product -- Generative production processes -- Design rules and solution elements -- Application examples. Generative production processes such as rapid prototyping or rapid manufacturing were developed for prototype construction. These processes offer the possibility of toolless production directly from CAD data. On the other hand, highly complex geometries can be built, which cannot be implemented with any other process. Due to these properties and the ever-increasing quality of the products, generative production processes are increasingly also used for components and small series. This applies especially to selective laser sintering. Therefore, the authors are looking at the generative processes and their possibilities specifically for selective laser sintering of plastics. They present this process and show the rules that must be observed for the design of products. Here, general solution strategies are shown and special solution elements are described. In the application part, implementation examples are presented of existing products. They come from the most diverse areas such as automation, medical technology or consumer goods.
content.title_en: Generative production with plastics : Conception and construction for selective laser sintering

On the (popular)cultural, aesthetic and research-historical location of music video as paradigmatic case of audiovision -- What is a music video? -- How to investigate a music video? -- Computer-supported case analysis. Starting from the music video as a paradigm of audiovisual compositionality, the band is dedicated to fundamentally relevant dimensions of the transcription of video data as well as in particular the specificity of media product analyses. This is a music-centered transcription program for audiovisual media products, which is conceived as a freely accessible web application. content.text: Constructing safety-related products: methods and systematic solutions to the EC Machinery Directive. Safety technology has long become part of the design process. Due to the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EU, numerous European standards and the new Product Safety Act, the designer has to comply with numerous regulations. However, he can also move on to new ways of implementing more advanced safety concepts. The standard work "Construction safety-related products" shows in its 5th edition methods and examples for solving safety-related issues in general mechanical engineering - from practice to practice: it is a didactically constructed compendium of standardised procedures and a collection of new and proven ideas. In systematically structured overviews practical examples for direct constructive safety measures, protective devices and the constructive implementation of ergonomic requirements are offered. In this regard, current technical and normative developments are taken into account. Both experienced designers, project engineers and machine examiners as well as in teaching and training. Here, practical examples and suggestions for own developments are provided. The authors develop a definition of sustainability that they link to the complex areas and processes of Facility Management. Essential impulses and results for this book were developed in the context of recent research (RoSS, Return on Sustainability System), whereby practical key figures for Facility Management were developed in cooperation with companies. In an interview study with 30 fourth graders, the author examines the generalisation processes of students from an epistemological perspective. In the data analysis, she reconstructs conceptual processes into variable concepts and works out linguistic means that the learners use in generalization of mathematical patterns. The problem area Cybersecurity -- Political action opportunities and action restrictions in the problem area Cybersecurity -- Cooperation in international relations -- Power in cyberspace -- Institutions in cyberspace -- Perception in cyberspace. Cyberspace is considered the domain of the social world. Small hackers' groups lead "Cyber Wars," "Cyberdissidents" are "Revolutions" and "virtual communities" transcend political geography. Mischa Hansel relativizes such radical transformation expectations and blames the actual loss of influence of states, above all, their lack of willingness to cooperate. Using cybersecurity as an example, the author applies neo-realist, neo-institutionalist and psychological approaches to the problem of inter-state cooperation in cyberspace.

content.text: Management and Information Technology : A compact presentation. The knowledge in management teaching is constantly increasing - as in other fields of expertise - which also involves specialization, but often hinders networked thinking. Due to the progress in information and communication technology, the need to use the opportunities created by this in almost every part of the business sector in order to be able to survive in competition increases at the same time. The aim of this book is to link the two topics in a compact form, with the focus of the presentation on management teaching and business management teaching.This networking idea is often given too little attention in previously published books. Content Decision - Organization - Personnel - Material - Production - Market - Finance and Accounting Target group Students of business information technology and business administration Practitioners Author Professor Dr. Michael Jacob teaches and researches in the department of business management at the University of Applied Sciences Kaiserslautern and is scientific director at the Institute for Business Management and Business Informatics in Zweibrücken.

content.text: Applied groundwater chemistry, hydrogeology and hydrogeochemical modelling: basics, applications and solutions. The applied groundwater chemistry, the stresses of groundwater with various inorganic and organic substances and their behaviour in aquifers are of interest to practitioners and students in the fields of hydrogeology, water management/hydrology, geosciences and environmental sciences. In addition to the presentation of applied basics of inorganic water chemistry, the organic water chemistry of groundwater pollutants is addressed for the first time in a coherent manner. content.text: Basics in PR and marketing for architects. content.text: Depending on the quantity and combination of food ingredients, food and its ingredients play an essential role in the development and maintenance of our body functions. Functional food ingredients should have demonstrably positive effects on human health, which go beyond those of the normal nutritional effects of food. Students and graduates of the nutritional and food sciences, food chemistry and technology, as well as pharmacy and nutrition medicine are available for the first time a reference work, which shows the principles biomedical effectiveness of food ingredients on body functions in the sense of disease prevention. The organ functions of the body around the intestine, immune system, metabolism, cardiovascular and nervous system are systematically discussed and methods for the detection of disease prevention are examined. The individual food ingredients are structured in a uniform manner and allow a systematic overview of the substance classes and their effectiveness in the sense of the biofunctionality of food. Legal aspects for the assessment "Functional food" in Europe round off this unique reference work. The authors are actively involved in the teaching of this still young academic discipline and represent the university's chairs in Munich.
content.title_en: Biofunctionality of food ingredients

content.text: Future Energy Grid : Migration paths into the Internet of Energy. By 2022 Germany wants to withdraw from nuclear energy and rapidly switch to an energy supply based on renewable energies such as wind or solar energy. These can only be integrated into the electricity system via information and communication technologies (ICT). In a so-called Smart Grid ICT and energy technology merge and ensure sustainable, reliable and affordable electricity. The study describes which migration path to be entered into the Future Energy Grid by 2030. The authors outline the possible developments of the energy system in Germany in three pictorial scenarios and describe the necessary technological steps in the desirable system of a sustainable economic power supply.
content.title_en: Future Energy Grid : Migration Paths to the Energy Internet

content.text: Marketing for LOHAS: Communication concepts for demanding customers. The so-called LOHAS with its "Lifestyle of Health and Sustainability" are purchasing powerful and willing consumers. For most companies it is therefore essential to pay more attention to this growing customer segment and to identify the market opportunities of their products and services. A practical guide with numerous checklists and examples of companies that have already successfully aligned themselves with LOHAS. The content Why LOHAS embody a new lifestyle Methods for target group and consumer type determination LOHAS in the megatrends Key markets, products and services for LOHAS Marketing and Communication concepts for the green lifestyle Sustainability and environmental management systems in the company Success control and future perspectives The author Christiane Köhn-Ladenburger is a specialist in image language and marketing, especially in the field of sustainable business - For the future you have to find yourself in the field of communication for your company.

content.text: The manual for environmental protection and environmental pollution of the German Federal Ministry of Environment and Public Health (Hoftbewerbung) provides a good overview of important questions concerning the protection of the environment. The work combines legal, technological and scientific aspects with environmental issues relating to the protection of our atmosphere. The legal part describes requirements for plant permits, the nature of products and climate protection. In the case of air pollution, the origin, characteristics, cycles in the environment, analytical evidence and sinks in nature are dealt with. Destroying the ozone layer and the upcoming climate changes are the effects to be observed. Numerous graphics show the corresponding developments. The most important procedures for the clean-up of the air are explained. Data and information on the national and global energy consumption illustrate the gigantic challenges for a global energy transition. For the non-specialist, the manual provides an easy-to-understand overview of various topics of air pollution, climate protection and energy issues.
content.title_en: Manual on operational Immission Protection

The author examines the clearly increased vulnerability of the reputation of economic organizations. The causes are sociologically founded, the term reputation is derived from communication science and the logic of reputation building and loss in modern media societies is described on the basis of empirical studies. content.text: International Policy Transfer and National Policy Change: Spread and Effectiveness of the Environmental Action Programme in Central and Eastern Europe. Introduction -- Analytical Concepts and Empirical Experiences -- Research Design -- Empirical Studies -- Result. Can environmental policy innovation be successfully implemented in different national states through organised international policy transfer? And what role do international and national factors play in this transfer process? Ralf Nordbeck answers these questions by investigating the implementation of the international environmental action programme for Central and Eastern Europe in 22 Central and Eastern European countries. The diversity of national adaptation responses ranges from the successful adoption of policy innovation to the refusal of policy transfer. Using a combination of macro-qualitative analysis (fsQCA) and four detailed case studies, the causally relevant conditions are identified that determine the success of a national environmental action programme: the environmental policy innovation will of the actors, the structural innovation capability and the quality of the environmental policy planning process.
content.title_en: International policy transfer and national policy change: the spread and effectiveness of the environmental action programme in Central and Eastern Europe

content.text: Biodiversity and Climate Change: Impacts and Action Options for Nature Conservation in Central Europe. Climate-based foundations – climate change, observations, scenarios -- climate as an environmental and survival factor -- climate change effects today: What changes are already taking place? -- climate change effects tomorrow: What could still come? -- What could our habitats and landscapes look like in the future? An overall overview -- What does biodiversity do for the adaptation of the human society affected by climate change? -- nature conservation as a contribution to climate change -- climate change assessment for nature conservation: synergies, priorities, problems -- action options and requirements -- thanks -- list of references -- employee directory -- glossary. This book provides a comprehensive overview of climate change effects on biodiversity in Central Europe for the first time. Here, the assessment of the observed and predicted impacts of climate change on species and habitats and the derivation of action options under the guideline of early action and risk prevention is a central space. Also, cross-links to human activities such as land and forestry, hunting and fisheries are drawn and the effects on health care and ecosystem services are presented. Special importance is being given to interactions with other elements of the global change.
content.title_en: Biodiversity and climate change : impacts and options for action on nature conservation in Central Europe

content.text: Regression models for the analysis of panel data. The textbook presents basic methods for the analysis of panel data. The authors discuss the different motives for the use of panel data and then derive the appropriate regression method for different variable types, questions and motives. The mechanics and functioning of the various methods are illustrated on the basis of replicable examples, thus the book is also a textbook. In addition to the presentation of central analysis techniques (fixed effects, random effects, hybrid approaches), the authors offer readers concrete decision strategies for the selection of the appropriate method in different analysis situations. content.text: Geometry and billiards. Motivation: Mechanics and optics -- Billiards in circles and squares -- Billiard ball mapping and integral geometry -- Billiards in cone sections and quadrics -- Existence and non-existence of caustics -- Periodic paths -- Billiards in polygons -- Chaotic billiard systems -- Dual billiards -- Bibliography -- Index -- Index -- Supplement to German translation -- Current literature. How does a mass point move in an area at the edge of which it is elastically bounced back? What is the path of a beam of light in an area with ideally reflective edges? Based on these and similar questions, the present book presents correlations between billiards and differential geometry, classical mechanics and geometric optics. In addition, this book looks at the principle of variation in mathematical billiards, the symplectic geometry of light beams, the existence or non-existence of caustics, periodic billiard trajectories and the mechanism for chaos in billiard dynamics.
content.title_en: Geometry and billiards

content.text: Planning, installation and operation of airfields. The new edition of the book describes not only the basics and requirements for planning and scheduling of airfields, but also the legal basis for approval and operation, including the exemption from the duty to operate by the legislator. The tasks of the participating organisations and administrations are presented. The classical classification of airfields is used to illustrate the land side, the terminal area and the air side from an infrastructural and processing point of view. The book also addresses ecologically relevant aspects, such as "green airport" or emissions trading. The book addresses all interested parties in aviation and in particular airport management, trainees and students in aviation-specific disciplines as well as those in the aviation industry and airport employees who need a comprehensive reference work for this field. Abbreviation List -- Basics -- Administrative organization and legal framework -- Planning of airfields -- Structure, elements and installation of airfields -- Operation and operating systems of airfields -- Aviation ecology and environmental protection -- Airfields as elements - Glossary - Literature.

content.text: The prohibition of torture under international law and the "war on terror". Since September 11, 2001, the world has not been as it was before. The fact that the "return of torture" is being spoken of today would have been unimaginable at the very beginning of the new millennium, as well as the talk of a "war on terror". In view of the new threats posed by terrorism, there are voices in politics, society and science that, in exceptional cases, want to approve, legalize or even consider torture to be legal in spite of an absolutely applicable prohibition of torture under international law. The main question posed in this work and affirmatively answered is whether, even in these threatening times, the prohibition of torture must be observed at any time, at any place and under any circumstances. Problem position and course of action of the presentation -- Chapter 1 - The "war on terror" -- Chapter 2 - The prohibition of torture in international law -- Chapter 3 - Legalization of torture? An investigation based on the ticking bomb scenario, taking into account the fight against rebels and terrorists -- Final- Theses - Summary -

Support by an application-oriented mathematics book is advantageous because the mathematics lectures are difficult to synchronize with the requirements of the application subjects. Therefore, the methodological-didactical structure of this textbook follows the principle: as understandable as possible, theoretically as necessary. Great importance is attached to visuality. Numerous coloured illustrations and exercise tasks (with complete solution suggestions) help. The textbook is also suitable as a popular, didactically sophisticated accompanying medium for mathematics lectures - especially when ground adhesion is lost due to the high degree of abstraction. The numerous caricatures are intended to help the readers to maintain a humorous distance during the not always simple work. content.text: Method of edge elements in statics and dynamics. content.text: Environmental management in global value chains: An analysis using the example of operational greenhouse gas accounting. Cumulative emission intensity.- Input-Output-Analysis.- Ecobalance.- Supply Chain -- Management.- Ecoefficiency -- Purchasing power parity. The cumulative emission intensity is a new instrument of operational environmental performance assessment. The introduction of a corresponding key figure system is linked to a starting value problem, to which environmental impact multipliers from the ecologically extended input-output analysis are proposed. Christian Haubach presents cross-country ecologically extended input-output models for the assessment of environmental impacts along global value chains and discusses the need to take into account exchange rates and purchasing power parity. The presented solution of the starting value problem can be used independently of the cumulative emission intensity for the evaluation of operational environmental performance. The content · Basics of the initialisation problem of a system of cumulative emission intensities in the national framework · Initialization problem and procedure for international delivery relationships · Summary of the solutions of the starting value problem The target groups · Lecturers and students of the economic and regional sciences as well as engineers of Heidelberg University of Applied Sciences and Humanities is working at the University of Applied Sciences.

content.text: New energy landscapes – New perspectives of landscape research. Actors, governance and discourses -- Perspectives on the change of landscapes -- Planning scientific approaches. The transformation of the energy economy towards more power generation from renewable energies takes place in physical and material terms in landscapes. It is accompanied by practitioners of spatial and landscape planning, partly with skepticism and partly with positive expectations. The volume examines the consequences of the energy transition on the aesthetic assessment of landscapes, which new constellations of actors have emerged and which conflicts have been encountered around the landscape picture, land use or distribution of power.The consequences of the upheavals towards "new energy landscapes" are addressed for landscape research, but also for spatial planning and governance.The content • Actors, governance and discourses • Perspectives on the change of landscapes • Planning scientific approaches The target groups Social Scientists Landscape and Regional Planners Since 2003 the editor Ludger Gailing has been working as a scientist at the Leibniz Institute for Regional Development and Structural Planning (IRS) in Erknerath.

content.text: Offer management for hybrid IT products: Process and data models for the distribution of customer-specific IT solutions. Providers of IT solutions are in a dilemma: On the one hand, their solutions should be aligned to the individual needs of the respective customer, on the other hand, they are forced to deliver their services at a cost-effective, and thus standardized. Based on identified requirements from literature analyses and 15 expert interviews, Philipp Langer describes a catalogue model consisting of a process and data model. He presents the structure and creation of hybrid product catalogues as well as the complex supply process itself. The content · The framework of hybrid IT products · Literature analysis and expert interviews on the derivation of requirements of hybrid IT products · eSCORE: Catalog and procedure model for the distribution of hybrid IT products The target groups · Lecturers and students of business information technology with the focus Hybrid products, product service combinations, solutions, modularization · Process developer at IT service providers, decision makers at IT service providers, catalog developers The author Dr. Philipp Langer is a PhD student at the University of Munich.
content.title_en: Offer management for hybrid IT products : Process and data models for the distribution of customized IT solutions
