content.text: Global environmental and social standards: Sustainable developments beyond the nation state. This study provides an overview of central international environmental and social standards, at the same time examines how effective they are and how they could be implemented more successfully despite all restrictions. In this context, approaches to a world environmental order and – albeit less clearly – a world social order and thus sustainable developments "beyond the nation state" are identified. In addition to international agreements on environmental and social protection, international economic and trade regulations as well as development policy are also examined to what extent they effectively take into account environmental and social problems. Furthermore, the possible contribution of human rights to sustainable developments is addressed. The content · International environmental and social standards · Environmental and social protection in international economic and trade regulations, in development policy and through human rights · Conditions for more effective international environmental and social standards · Towards a global sustainable legal order? The target groups · Social scientists · Environmental scientists · Management scientists · Practitioners in international organisations and at international environmental and social policy issues as well as worldwide sustainable developments The author Prof. Dr. Erhard Treutner (Scientists) in the University of Applied Sciences and Humanities of Applied Sciences of Cologne is a professor of Law and Social Sciences.
content.title_en: Global environmental and social standards : Sustainable developments beyond the nation state

content.text: Landscape Architecture Theory : Current approaches, perspectives and positions. The contributions of this volume examine the meaning and purpose of the practice of landscape architects, who play a significant role in the design of a habitable world. This practice is integrated into life-world, cultural and social framework conditions. Theory has to take account of this socio-cultural inclusion of practice. Theory has to refer to its scientific theoretic status within the sciences and disciplines in order to avoid unnecessary scientific research. In this respect, landscape architecture theory reflects the conditions of its own success as well as the conditions for successful practice. The contributions of this volume contribute to a better understanding of practice as well as theory for the practice of landscape architecture. The content Current approaches to possibilities and purposes of theoretical reflection and theory mediation in landscape architecture.- Current perspectives of theory formation in landscape architecture.- Current positions on landscape architecture. The target groups of students and lecturers in landscape architecture, urban and spatial planning, social sciences and geography The editor Dr. Karsten Berr is active at the University of Vechta.
content.title_en: Landscape Architecture Theory : Current approaches, perspectives and positions

content.text: Music Listening in the Age Web 2.0 : Theoretical Fundamentals and Empirical Findings. Following up-to-date findings of sociological and social psychological music reception research, the band explains which social functions music listening fulfils today, and what role the new framework conditions play in Web 2.0. Based on representative empirical surveys, musical attitudes and behavioural patterns are illustrated and clearly delimitable types of music listening are characterized, each of which deals with the current possibilities and challenges of digital media morphosis. Particular consideration is given to the question of the importance of primary socialization as a counterweight to musical self-socialization on the Internet. Above all, age, school formation and the size of people's homes are the decisive factors influencing individual musical practice in Austria. The content On the social inequality of music listening New framework conditions in Web 2.0 Current empirical findings on listening to music in Austria Why music? Central tendencies and possible consequences The target groups Students and lecturers of sociology, social and music sciences.

content.text: China's Innovation Strategy in Global Knowledge Economy: Companies, Universities and Regions in the Field of Interdependence of Politics and Autonomy. This editorial volume is dedicated to China's transformation towards a sustainable development path. The focus is on developing a growth strategy based on innovation and knowledge. However, the autonomy of economic and social actors necessary for innovative growth is in contradiction with the government's control. In this conflict area, however, there is a lot and very fast movement. The editorial volume traces these diverse developments and reports on concrete experiences of companies, universities and consultants as well as original research.The content: Innovation and Innovation Policy in China Transformations in the Chinese Higher Education Landscape Concrete approaches and examples of beginning innovation dynamics Findings from research projects and studies Challenges and concepts in the transition from university to business Management of knowledge and innovations in Chinese companies The editors: Prof. Dr. Joachim Freimuth is Professor of General Business Administration and Human Resources Management at the University of Bremen. content.text: Post 2017: Depleting privileges, effectively shaping regulation: Special reports of the Monopoly Commission pursuant to § 44 PostG in conjunction with § 81 para. 3 TKG 1996. In its tenth special report on postal services entitled "Post 2017: Depleting privileges, effectively shaping regulation!" the Monopoly Commission notes little progress in the development of competition in the postal markets due to the continued existence of inconsistent competition conditions. The Monopoly Commission makes proposals for the reduction of the privileges of Deutsche Post AG and for effective regulation of postal markets. The Monopoly Commission examines in detail the exclusive privileges of Deutsche Post AG such as the exemption from VAT from universal services, the shareholdership of the Federal Government, membership in International Post Corporation and the designation as designated universal service provider vis-à-vis the World Post Association. In addition, the Monopoly Commission evaluates extensively the national regulatory framework and the draft regulation on cross-border parcel delivery services of the European Commission.
content.title_en: Post 2017: Depleting privileges, effectively shaping regulation : Special reports of the Monopoly Commission pursuant to § 44 PostG in conjunction with § 81 para. 3 TKG 1996

content.text: The Mathematical Mathematical Analysis of the University of Munich: A Concissian Introduction with MATLAB and Julia. Matrices on the Computer -- Matrix Factorization -- Error Analysis -- Smallest Squares -- Eigenwertprobleme -- Attachments to MATLAB and Julia. This book introduces into algorithmic-numeric thinking based on fundamental problems of linear algebra. The limitation to linear algebra ensures a stronger thematic coherence than is otherwise found in introductory lectures on numerics. The presentation emphasizes the expedientity of matrix partitions compared to a component-wise consideration, which not only pays off in a clearer notation and shorter algorithms, but also leads to significant runtime gains in view of modern computer architectures. The algorithms and accompanying numerical examples are given in the programming environment MATLAB, but also in an appendix also in the forward-looking, freely accessible programming language Julia. The present book is suitable for a two-hour lecture on numerical linear algebra starting from the second semester of the MATL study.

This book explores the question of what is actually sovereignty and what it means in the digital age. It discusses the task of digital sovereignty in times of globalization for Germany and addresses the question of how and why states construct digital sovereignty. In the course of the discussion, a broad spectrum of views and views on the tasks that will be faced by the political leaders, but also by the business community and civil society, coupled with the resulting challenges. Finally, an analysis of the fields of action for potential priorities of the German economy, combined with the question whether the digital politics of Germany (and also the EU) will be influenced by withdrawal and protectionism or whether the Europeans will soon be able to be only consumers, is confined between hardware from Asia and software and Internet services from the USA. content.text: Why States Break Together: A Comparative Study of the Causes of State Collapse. Based on a multi-method study of all empirical cases in the period 1960 to 2007, the authors of this volume develop a model of the causes of state collapse. In 43 case studies of collapses and comparative cases, widespread quantitative indicators of fragile statehood are supplemented by the collection of qualitative factors. The comparison by QCA enables for the first time the examination of many common hypotheses. By supplementing the QCA analyses with process analyses, new risk factors can be identified, known concepts re-defined and effects correlations between factors are revealed. In this way, the book contributes to a better understanding of state collapse and its causes and opens up hitherto unconsidered conceptual and methodological approaches for research. The content of statehood and state collapse. Methodical state of cause research and research design. Explanation factors of state collapse. Operationalization: Concept formation and case selection. content.text: Hoffmann von Fallersleben and the Dutch tongue: correspondence, interrelationships, pictoriality. Hoffmann von Fallersleben undertook his first journey to the Netherlands in 1819. Many of Hoffmann's works testify to his interest in the Dutch language area. His autobiography, his diaries, notes, lectures, correspondence and his newspaper articles can be derived from his findings on his relations with the Netherlands and Belgium. However, neither his relationship nor his Belgium and Netherlands image have been extensively explored to this day. This study aims to reconstruct Hoffmann's relations with the Netherlands and the post-Belgium and the network he built up there, based on his correspondence and the files with his person. Hoffmann describes a diffuse picture of the neighbours, which is characterized by a German-national attitude. It is to be asked whether his positive behaviour and his negative statements were merely ideologically motivated and mainly affected by the fact that he tried to integrate the Netherlands and Belgium into a German state structure, and whether he had been regarded as a cultural mediator, the German archival exchange is now included in the German catalogue.
content.title_en: Hoffmann von Fallersleben and the Land of the Netherlands' tongue : correspondence, relationship lichens, imagery

content.text: Basics of probability calculation and statistics: An introduction for students of computer science, engineering and economics. Descriptive statistics -- probability calculation -- random variables -- closing statistics -- Tables. This book introduces application-oriented statistics into the descriptive and closing statistics, into probability calculation and stochastic modelling and is particularly aimed at students of computer science, engineering and business engineering as well as economics. It is designed as an accompanying text for a one-semester event. The authors present the essential contents and aspects in a short and concise form and therefore deliberately dispense with detailed motivations. Within the framework of the new edition, additions, graphical representations and especially example tasks with detailed solutions were inserted. Thus, the book becomes the ideal companion of every basic lecture in statistics. The authors Erhard Cramer studied mathematics and economics at the University of Aachen. After his habilitation in Oldenburg and activities at the universities of Siegen and Darmstadt, he has been Professor of Applied Stochastik at the Institute of Statistics and Business Mathematics at RWTH Aachen.

Introduction with typical applications -- Basic terms -- Event streams -- Selection strategies for complex events -- Event patterns -- Examples of event processing languages -- Complex Event Processing Engines -- Control-based Complex Event Processing -- Sofware concepts for complex event processing -- Delimitation of CEP -- Predictor logic -- Index. . An important task for IT in the connected world is the machine analysis and processing of information relevant for an application and sent over the network. Complex Event Processing (CEP) allows for the analysis and processing of large amounts of time-related data in almost real time. The basic approach of CEP corresponds to human decision-making in process processes of everyday life and represents an extension of known methods of data analytics such as data mining, statistical analysis or rule-based knowledge processing. content.text: Risk management: Brief instructions Issue 4. The book explains clearly what lies behind the term "risk management". It also provides recommendations for action and instructions. Building projects are accompanied by different risks that can affect the objectives set. In order to achieve the goals defined at the beginning of the project, decisions are to be made regularly. However, a decision can only be taken with great certainty if all dependencies are known. If the project participants are unaware of these dependencies, uncertainties are composed of an uncertainty (wagnis) share and a share of risks. Depending on the impact of the project, the risks can be presented as dangers (negative goal achievement) or as opportunities (positive target deviation). A risk management established in the project helps to significantly minimize the inherent risks. It can optimize the negative deviations in the project processes and balance a middle path between risks and opportunities. content.text: The end of psychotherapy is a successful way of shaping the end of psychotherapy. This book is dedicated to different final situations in psychotherapy. As a reader you will learn about the design principles for ending individual therapy sessions as well as for regular ending of outpatient psychotherapy. Also, you will get valuable suggestions about how to deal with therapy breaks and learn everything important about the special features of ending inpatient treatments as well as closing situations in group therapeutic settings. Even if most psychotherapys fortunately end without major problems, many psychotherapists repeatedly experience rather difficult final situations. This is not surprising, because the therapy ends up in a very close relationship. In particular, if patients have difficulties with leaving therapy or have a problematic binding structure, the solution from the therapy relationship can become a problem. All psychotherapeutic professionals who want to prepare themselves for difficult ending therapies will find in this work a helpful and deepened examination with the therapy end of therapy as well as practice-relevant action impulses.
content.title_en: Successfully shape the end in psychotherapy

content.text: Hamburger Klimabericht - Wissen über Klima, Klima Klima und Imwande in Hamburg und Norddeutschland. This is the second time that the current climate change research situation in the Hamburg metropolitan region and northern Germany has been systematically documented in the context of the KlimaCampus Hamburg. Based on the literature, you can find out to what extent consensus exists regarding climate change in northern Germany. To what extent are developments already measurable, what effects are already evident today and how can the region protect itself against negative consequences of climate change? The more than 70 authors systematically compiled the research results on these questions. The agreement and contradiction of the current knowledge has been elaborated, knowledge gains have been localized compared to the first Hamburg climate report and further existing research needs are shown. All contributions have been subjected to a scientific review process, which has been supervised by a steering committee. The documentation demonstrates comprehensively the effects of already occurring warming in the Hamburg metropolitan region and in northern Germany as well as a rise in sea level at the North and Baltic Sea. With the warming, significant changes in the ecosystem can be seen. These already occurring developments can further strengthen in the future.
content.title_en: Hamburg Climate Report - Knowledge about climate, climate change and impacts in Hamburg and Northern Germany

Against this background, the authors empirically and theoretically address the question of how to design a future-oriented and professional reference framework for inclusive and sustainable city development.

content.text: The importance of housing prices for monetary policy: Conditional effects on residential property and private consumer demand. content.text: Corrected performance of economic equity: new developments for model improvement. Numerous models have been developed and expanded in the past to determine economic performance. Nowadays, consideration of risk is mandatory, among other things. Nevertheless, these models include shortcomings when viewed more closely. And this is precisely what the expansion of the knowledge horizon, i.e. the improvement of the models that have existed so far, requires. The advantages are obvious: only one bank that is able to determine the advantage of a considered business exactly, gains a competitive advantage from this knowledge advantage over the other market participants. With the performance indicators used so far, the dimensionality of the sub-sizes does not match – with consequences for the significance of the characteristic number. This book presents two ways to overcome this model weakness without conflict. Furthermore, the minimum interest rate claim, modelled for the first time, as well as the allocation and trading of economic capital via the internal equity exchange, are considered for the first time. This book is written exclusively for specialists and requires sound knowledge in performance controlling of a bank.
content.title_en: Corrected performance of economic equity: new developments for model improvement

In most cases, textbook examples of the older literature were deliberately taken up, so that the reader has the possibility to compare the results with the conventionally performed evaluation and presentation. content.text: PISA 2015 : a study between continuity and innovation. Every three years, PISA tests the status of the basic education of fifteen-year-old young people in the fields of science, mathematics and reading, and thus examines strengths and weaknesses of education systems in comparison with OECD countries. The central question is the extent to which the participating countries manage to prepare pupils for their further educational and professional paths during compulsory schooling. The national report volume presents the results of PISA 2015, which were achieved by the students in Germany, and sets them in relation to the results in other OECD countries. The focus of the surveys and evaluations is on the natural sciences. PISA 2015 is the sixth survey round of the OECD Programme for International Student Assessment, which also provides the conclusion of the second cycle of the study and the start of computer-based testing. While maintaining essential standards of data collection and evaluation, PISA 2015 has been used to discuss the assessment mode of the computer, a more differentiated scaling model and an extended test design. They take into account changes in the world of learning and life and will improve the statement of the PISA studies on the basis of the continuity of this analysis.
content.title_en: PISA 2015 : a study between continuity and innovation

content.text: The Monopol Commission has issued a special report entitled "Rail 2013: Rapid implementation of reform!", which states that the German markets for passenger and freight transport will continue to be unsatisfactory. It therefore calls for the immediate implementation of the planned reform of the legal framework. The amendment will provide important impetus for a sustainable increase in the attractiveness of the railway sector. The Monopol Commission considers it necessary to introduce incentive regulation, including an ex-ante approval of charges, to adapt the regulations for the use of service facilities, to strengthen the Federal Network Agency and to merge relevant regulations. In addition, the Monopol Commission will again argue for a strict separation of the infrastructure and transport savings of Deutsche Bahn AG's railways. In this regard, the Monopol Commission will present a comprehensive concept for promoting competition on the railway markets.

content.text: Health and well-being in the teacher's profession. Not only teachers themselves have an interest in working life with health, well-being and job satisfaction. In research, the teacher's profession – the burdensome but also the health-enhancing factors – is increasingly being focused on. Numerous empirical findings on the health of teachers have been published. However, in practice, the professional group of teachers is also recognised as a target group and offers are increasingly being developed specifically for the vocational context of school. This book aims to provide a comprehensive overview not only of current theoretical approaches and practical findings on the subject of health in the teacher's profession, but also to meet the complexity of the subject area. The book offers an interface between educational-psychological research and school-psychological counselling practice, and to provide a comprehensive overview of current theoretical approaches and empirical findings as well as specific action options for school practice, and life-careful reflection on the balanced role of work, and more professional professionalism in the field of work, and more suggestions for school-care.

content.text: The German newspaper "Bundeswebsites" (German newspaper "Bundeswebsites") is an experimental tool for the usability and design perception of newspaper websites. Based on the methodological principles of operationalization of constructs, eye-tracking and thinking aloud, the author analyzes the perception of newspaper websites using the methods of factor analysis and observational flow measurement and shows that the behavioral theories and approaches are also transferable to the Internet.The users primarily go to the newspaper website to satisfy the need for information satisfaction and it becomes clear that the user uses a wide range of ways to pursue his goal of satisfying his needs and to fulfill them.The content Scientific and content classification Transmissibility of the findings from previous studies Conceptualization of the investigations Model development and eye-tracking The target groups Lecturers and students of business economics with the emphasis (online) media research/science, (online) advertising research, usability engineering, web design, online marketing.

content.text: Methods of empirical communication research: An introduction. The standard work is an introduction to the essential methods of empirical communication science. It is aimed in particular at students of communication and media science who collect their first experience with empirical methods and is suitable as a detailed accompaniment of introductory lectures and as a practical hand-out for method exercises. Easy understanding, application orientation and a clear structure are the main characteristics of this textbook. For the seventh edition the volume has been updated; a new section on the topic of "Big Data" is used in the chapter on observation, often as a catchword, but also in media and communication science with great potential. The content What are methods, what is Empirie?.- Measuring and counting.- Selection procedure.- Content analysis.- Observation.- Experiment. The target groups Students and teachers of communication science, journalism, journalism and media science The authors and authors Dr. Hans-Bernd Brosius is professor at the Institute of Communication Science and Media Research at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München. Dr. Alexander Haas is also a member of the Board of Directors of the Institute of Applied Psychology.

content.text: Acceptance of ecological product innovations in the automotive sector : Effects of brand love. Isabel Maria Staufer examines how both brand love and the ecological value-holding of a consumer can act as control instruments within a purchasing decision process for product innovations. content.text: Smart City - City of the Future? : Smart City 2.0 as a liveable city and future market. The concept of a liveable smart city emphasizes the relevance of the functional capacity and integrated resilience of future-oriented cities. The progressive digitalization is critically examined and the revolutionised energy sector as the foundation of urban life is recognized. The concept makes the human and the natural environment the starting point of the consideration, resulting in an extended concept of sustainability and an additional product theory. The Smart City 2.0 is an opportunity space for its inhabitants and an attractive future market for innovative products and services, but it presents the actors and product developers with a variety of challenges. The content Challenges of cities Product development for cities Social change in cities Digitalization of urban life Profile of a Smart City 2.0 The target groups Business leaders and decision makers of infrastructure providers, mobility companies and the energy industry Political decision makers, city administrations and city dwellers Product developers and business founders as well as associations and institutions of urban life The author Dr. Chirine Etezadzadeh is a strategy consultant with experience in renowned international corporations. Their focus on the fields of business and development of the future.
content.title_en: Smart City - City of the Future? : Smart City 2.0 as a livable city and future market

content.text: The energy transition: Potentials in energy production: A general introduction. The author describes both traditional power plants and the currently preferred forms of energy generation by wind, solar radiation and geothermal energy. He thus offers a compendium for understanding the current energy discussion. Finally, he describes a view of promising, yet technologically undeveloped processes. content.text: Operational planning in public passenger transport: objectives, methods, concepts. This book provides the reader with a comprehensive insight into all the tasks relevant to the planning, implementation and control of public passenger transport systems (ÖPNV). Special attention is paid to the specific characteristics of transport equipment, as the operation of public passenger transport systems is subject to different boundary conditions and a wide range of interferences. The comparative presentation of the characteristics of the transport modes and their impact on operational planning promotes the understanding of planning tasks. The book "Operational planning in public passenger transport" is a holistic and clearly structured presentation of the individual planning steps in transport companies in their context. Existing methods and solutions are compiled and discussed in a comparative manner. The book closes the existing gap in the literature. It is aimed at offer planners in transport associations, operating planners in transport companies and planning staff in engineering offices. Students of transport sciences find in this book the professional specialisation necessary for the professional tasks. content.text: IT-based cost accounting: basics, instruments, application. Controlling systems can no longer be considered separately from the IT used. This textbook introduces the IT-based cost accounting as a central tool of operational controlling. First, the basics and tasks of cost and revenue accounting and their anchoring in operational accounting are presented. In this context, the author explicitly addresses the question of the provision of information by operational IT systems with reference to SAP software. Subsequently, the sub-areas of operational controlling are explained in detail with their instruments. For the area of overhead cost controlling, the cause principle is shown how the implementation of a cost point-to-be-matched in SAP software runs. This is done by presenting and explaining the corresponding SAP screen masks. The content and tasks of accounting Basics of operational controlling cost accounting Common cost controlling Product cost controlling Operational sales controlling The author Professor Dr. Uwe Szyszka teaches business management teaching at the Fachhochschule Flensburg and is head of the focus on controlling.
content.title_en: IT-based cost accounting : basics, tools, application

This book provides an application-oriented introduction to data analysis with the free statistical environment R. It covers descriptive analyses as comprehensively as inference statistical analyses. Besides classical univariate methods, the book takes into account nonparametric tests, resampling methods and multivariate statistics. In addition, it covers the many possibilities of preparing data and creating diagrams. The statistical methods are now being reviewed using examples and illustrated in many places with diagrams. The book is aimed at all those who would like to get acquainted with R and use in specific tasks without having to pre-experiments with the command of the program.

content.text: The Drktive City: Reflections on the present relationship between mobility and diversity in urban society. Urban Society -- Urban Space -- Diversity and Mobility -- Dynamics of a New Reality -- Inclusive Cities. This book is about the city as an organizational context and as a living system and the impulses of civil society and the population to shape and safeguard inclusion. The invention of inclusion in the sense of a society for all as a regulatory factor for coexistence has always been the prerequisite for urban societies. In the design of this inclusion, new paths have been repeatedly taken, with mobility and diversity always playing a central role. Urban Society however, often struggles to ensure inclusion for all. Using various case studies, it is shown how social inclusion for social, ethnic and cultural minorities and immigrants is continually restricted and turned into exclusion. The text represents the first systematic introduction to the method of sociological constellation analysis. This method is particularly suitable for reconstructing actions and interacting with public persons (speakers, authors, artists, celebrities). It is also of interest to researchers in adjacent disciplines whose studies include the analysis of social contexts, beyond sociology. The volume "Chemistry lessons in terms of diagnostics and promotion" gives impulses, as can be integrated into teaching routines. In this regard, he proposes to understand diagnosis and promotion as a continuous practice of chemistry lessons, in which both aspects always relate to each other. Because it is certain that funding in chemistry is impossible without knowledge of learning potentials and difficulties; a diagnosis of the problems and opportunities, which do not follow appropriate learning opportunities, is not very effective.

content.text: The Böschungen and Baugruben: Safety and economy. This book deals with the problems of the Böschungen and Baugruben - with technical knowledge - and provides help to better control the dangers and thus to avoid damage to the population. Böschungen as inclined earth surfaces occur everywhere. They are processed by humans more or less and thus the condition changes. Thus one should also consider the effects of these changes and gain a certainty about the safety of the Böschungen. Only with this knowledge should changes be carried out to estimate their impact on the humans and the environment. content.text: Digital databases: a media theory in the age of big data. We no longer live only in the information age, but in the era of big data. In this era, the database also stands for the enormous potential for knowledge of information collections as well as for the threatening information excesses of digital media culture. content.text: The book deals with the physical and physiological foundations of technical acoustics, problems of machine and space acoustics as well as acoustic measurement technology. The book presents numerical methods used in technical acoustics, including the standards and guidelines required for daily work in these areas. Broadly speaking, questions of sound formation, air and body sound propagation and noise reduction (e.g. sound absorption, silencer, sound insulation, active noise control) such as those occurring in rail and road traffic are addressed. The contributions have been thoroughly revised and expanded compared to the preliminary edition. The book not only describes the current state of technical acoustics, but also aims to help and guide engineers in dealing with acoustic problems and tasks.

content.text: Marketing Renewable Energies: Basics, Business Models, Case Studies. How to market green electricity or biomethane? What is the right price for renewable energy and how to design the optimal use of social media? What impact does the EEG or electromobility have on green electricity marketing? Does direct sales or is online marketing the key to success? This volume provides answers to these and many other fundamental questions with contributions from leading scientists and renowned practitioners. For the first time, they describe the basics of marketing renewable energies in a structured form, introduce legal and market specificities and introduce new business models. The book is based on current research results, deals with all the important marketing issues for practitioners, provides case studies and concrete recommendations. The content Overview of marketing options of renewable energy consumer preferences Legal framework conditions and their practical effects Opportunities for EE marketing in special customer markets Transfer of marketing concepts between various EE markets and provides recommendations for the elements of marketing mix in the area of EE. The editor Prof. Dr. Carsten Herbes was also active as a member of the board of the German Energy Institute.
content.title_en: Marketing of Renewable Energy : Basics, Business Models, Case Studies

content.text: Constituent democracy: a new beginning or a decline of a political system?. In consolidated democracies, Konstanz is considered a quality criterion for constitutions. Accordingly, the opinion prevails that constitutional changes in established democracies are rather rare phenomena. However, the financial crisis of 2008 had not only financial but also political consequences that were linked to the change of the constitution in many countries. Against this background, the question arises which direction the constitutional changes go: do they actually contribute to the efficiency of democracies or are they rather undesirable decay phenomena that affect the quality of democracies on the contrary? This question is at the heart of the collection. In April 2011, the new Hungarian Basic Law is given special consideration. content.text: The influence of the charging air temperature on the petrol engine: A potential for increasing efficiency and performance of charged engines. Samir Kadunic presents an effective model for the combustion process prediction in the petrol engine and illustrates the advantages that result from the integration of the car air conditioning system into the charging air cooling. A controllable low charge air temperature then allows an outside air temperature independent of the ottomotor combustion. This low charge air temperature has a considerable potential to increase the efficiency and the power density of the charged petrol engine even further. For this it is necessary to decouple the achievable charge air temperature as far as possible from the ambient conditions. The car air conditioning system is available for the charging air cooling as previously unused cold water. With measurements also at the engine test stand, the author was able to show that despite the air conditioning system being switched on, fuel consumption can be reduced and performance can be increased.
content.title_en: Influence of the charge air temperature on the petrol engine : A potential for increasing efficiency and power of charged engines

content.text: Reports on the Resistance Monitoring Study 2010/2011 : Resistance situation in clinically important animal pathogenic bacteria. The use of antibacterial active substances in veterinary medicine is carried out on the one hand for reasons of consumer protection and on the other hand for the preservation of animal health. At the same time, any use of antibiotics leads to the selection of existing resistances, and also the emergence of new resistance mechanisms is encouraged. For these reasons, sustainable management measures must be taken to minimise or avoid the entry of resistant bacteria into the human food chain, especially through food-producing animals. To assess the current resistance situation and development, the collection of valid sensitivity data for animal pathogenic bacteria is necessary. The Federal Office for Consumer Protection and Food Safety (BVL) collects these data within the framework of the National Resistance Monitoring (GERM-Vet) since 2001. These data allow to take coordinating measures and provide decision-making aid for calculable therapy. . 1 Introduction -- 2 Materials and Methods -- 3 Results -- 4 Summary -- 5 Annex -- 6 Tables -- 7 Figures.

content.text: Reading/Law-Letter Promotion for Migrants: Basics, Diagnostics, Methods. Children with a migrant background have a hard time in German schools. Without targeted funding, development delays and sometimes serious problems in reading/writing development arise. The consequences: pupils with a migrant background are classified as learning disabled. They represent almost half of school leavers without adequate reading skills. And far too many of them do not achieve a school degree. The book offers a clearly structured help for practical work and is aimed at educators in the elementary, primary and support school areas as well as at dysthesis therapists. It begins with an analysis of problematic development conditions in families with a migrant background Then diagnostic instruments and their suitability for working with migrant children are examined. Finally, it is about scientifically secured findings about the advantages and disadvantages of individual funding methods. The impact research is described in detail. Readers can decide on this basis which offers are good for bilingual children, which have proved themselves rather moderately effective and which may even be counterproductive.
content.title_en: Reading/Law-Letter Promotion for Migrants' Children : Basics, Diagnostics, Methods

content.text: Bionic Business Management: Employee motivation as a key to innovation, agility and collaboration. This book shows what the principles of evolution have in common with ants and the state of Bhutan. With the "Gross Corporate Happiness" approach, it presents a scientifically sound and practical management model and collects the employee from the cost factor to the most economically important driver for sustainable corporate success in the knowledge society. The work provides answers to the most burning questions of corporate management in the context of globalization and digitalization: How do I motivate my employees correctly? How do I increase the innovation performance of my company? How do I create a culture of cooperation, agility and resilience in times of constant change? Dr. Rüdiger Fox explains how intrinsic motivation in the economic context becomes a business case and thus identifies the organizational framework conditions that, in addition to the satisfaction and the „Flow" that increase the innovation and cooperation capacity of employees. From his practical management experience, the author demonstrates how organizations in complex and dynamic markets become significantly more efficient. The author - The business management department becomes a new business executive director.

content.text: Social Media: Theory and practice of digital sociality. Social media applications are a central driving force of online communication. They organise and strengthen social contacts, enable work, friendship and intimate relationships, provide users with information from all life, social and political fields, support citizens' movements, open new sales and advertising channels for companies and reorganize knowledge. In social communities, blogs, microblogging services, video and music platforms, etc., mediated forms of social communication find a differentiated space for opportunity in different applications and usage practices. In order to approach the relevance of social media, this collection examines three main areas of current social media research with the focus on theoretical perspectives, social media and institution and social media and usage cultures.
content.title_en: Social Media : Theory and practice of digital sociality.

content.text: The Republic in Twilight: On the Metaphoric of Light and Darkness in French Perblicistics 1871-1914. The Republic as a place of lumières: This myth pervades the history of republican consciousness in 19th century France like a red thread. Above all, the oppositional image journalism represented the light nature of the Republic and its struggle against the "dark" powers of reaction in ever new facets. But even with the consolidation of the Third Republic after 1870, the long-awaited "Epoche of Light" did not immediately break open, all the less so since the Republic itself did not always live up to its role as a light carrier. Daniela Kneißl first examines how the metaphors "Light" and "Finsternis" visualized between 1871 and 1914 political, cultural and social conflicts, and underlines the multilayered connections of metaphorical light expectation, technical light progression and factual light neediness. Review text: "Executions and elected approach of investigation. Instead of a large narrative, the discourses make the stories visible in the context of history.
content.title_en: The Republic in Twilight : On the Metaphoric of Light and Darkness in French Visual Journalism 1871-1914

content.text: Basic competences of adults with a migrant background in an international comparison: PIAAC 2012. The migration report on the Programme for the International Assessment of Adult Competences (PIAAC) contrasts the basic competences of the adult population with and without a migrant background in Germany and in an international comparison. In Germany, as in most other countries, people with a migrant background have on average less basic competences than persons with a migrant background. content.text: Key competences: Research literature in libraries and the Internet. How to! From the selection of databases and search engines to the use of suitable search terms and the evaluation of results, to correct citation and the creation of own literature lists of the guide's step by step, the volume demonstrates how to find and process the appropriate literature. Besides printed sources, such as books, magazines and newspapers, free or license-based internet resources are taken into account. For the second edition, the volume has been extensively revised, updated and expanded with chapters on the use of citation databases, discovery services and the handling of open access publications.
content.title_en: Key competences: Researching literature in libraries and the Internet

content.text: Image : an interdisciplinary manual. From the panel image to the film to the 3D image. Images flood us in all areas of society, the handling of digital images is becoming increasingly important. Since the Pictorial or Iconic Turn, the cultural sciences of the topic have also taken on the topic and founded a science of image and image perception. The manual provides a comprehensive overview for the first time, explains basics such as semiotics, phenomenology and iconology, analyses various individual media and subsequent image discourses. A final part illuminates the image theories of different disciplines, and how they understand themselves as image science.
content.title_en: Image : an interdisciplinary manual

content.text: Manual of Cognitive Science. When do mental processes take place? When we are emotional, remember, learn, speak or dream. But cognitive science is not only interested in human information processing, it also investigates cognitive processes in computers or robots. The manual also highlights the models of cognitive systems: e.g. neuronal networks, evolutionary robotics and organic computing; with anthropology, computer science, linguistics, neuroscience, psychology and philosophy, it presents the disciplines of cognitive science.
content.title_en: Manual on Cognitive Science

content.text: City : An interdisciplinary handbook. The phenomenon of the city in the overall exhibition. From architecture to history, geography, political and legal sciences to urban sociology and ethnology: In this handbook all disciplines that deal with the topic of urban research are discussed. An overview chapter illustrates multidisciplinary parallels and differences. In the second part city is presented as a cultural space. It deals with topics such as the image of the city, city as a stage, city as a living world, city and literature, city and religion as well as the memory of the city
content.title_en: City : An interdisciplinary manual

content.text: Luhmann Manual : Life - Work - Effect. In many disciplines controversially discussed, Niklas Luhmann's system theory shapes intellectual debates far beyond the university field. In addition to an insight into Luhmann's biography, the handbook traces the basics of his thinking and various theoretical strands. Among them: Evolution, Communication, Media and Society Theory. In detail, individual works and groups of works are discussed. Further chapters explain central concepts of system theory, such as autopoiesis, code, complexity, system and many more.
content.title_en: Luhmann Manual : Life - Work - Effect

content.text: Methods of literary and cultural analysis of texts : Approaches - Basics - Model analyses. How are texts scientifically interpreted? The textbook presents the usual literary theoretical approaches, such as structuralism, deconstruction, discourse analysis and system theory, in a compact and clear way. The focus of the clearly designed volume is on the application: Detailed sample analyses show how texts and films are analyzed with the various theories and the methods derived from them.
content.title_en: Methods of literary and cultural analysis of text : Approaches - Basics - Model analyses

content.text: Evolution : An interdisciplinary manual. Main scientific theory of modernism. Darwin's theory of evolution not only revolutionized biology, but still influences all areas of knowledge and is still controversially discussed. The handbook provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of debate. It describes the history of evolution theory in detail and addresses its scientific practices, ways of representation and central concepts. It also documents its reception in the sciences and its influence on society and art.
content.title_en: Evolution : An Interdisciplinary Manual

content.text: Metzler Lexicon of Literary Symbols. Pohn, glass, blue, light, dream, circle over 400 articles explain the central meanings of the most important literary symbols of Western literature. Plants, objects, colors, animals, places and states can assume a meaning that transcends concrete pictoriality. Which? Literary examples from antiquity to the present give information. At the same time, the lexicon traces the history of the respective symbols.
content.title_en: Metzler Lexicon of Literary Symbols

content.text: The German law on juvenile justice: A consideration of the appropriateness of existing and the need for new ways of responding to the behaviour of juveniles in criminal cases. The book balances with available empirical data and own surveys the legal consequences of German juvenile justice. It answers with experience-based evidence the question of a possible tightening of the sanctions. The result consists in a plea for a moderate juvenile justice policy, which opposes populist tightening wishes with rational arguments. According to the findings, the population advocates the criminal law special treatment of adolescents and adolescents. The maximum penalties of juvenile justice are considered sufficient, arrests with military drill are rejected. A combination of repressive measures and educational remedies is advocated. Overall, the treatment of the current law with adolescents and adolescents is highly accepted, which may be because the questioning was directed to a population with a high level of education. Using various case examples, practices of investigational detention against adolescents and the expulsion of non-German juveniles are criticized and alternatives are presented.
content.title_en: The Juvenile Criminal Law in Germany: A View of the Appropriateness of Existing and the Need for New Responses to Offensive Conduct of Young People

content.text: The soldering connection is a material-closing connection between materials of unequal composition and the same kind of chemical bond. The process can be used with a large number of different materials and over a large range of temperature. Especially for electronics and electrical engineering, the lowest working temperatures during soldering are well below 200 °C and can also extend over 1000 °C for mechanical engineering parts or vehicles. The authors have compiled in alphabetical order with numerous cross references the entire knowledge about the soldering connection in short definitions, explanations and comments with pictures and tables as a supplement. They thus also lay the foundation for the development of a common language and process control for the production of material connections.
content.title_en: Manual Soldering connections

content.text: The use of technology in care for the elderly: potentials and problems in an empirical perspective. The management of care needs is a major social issue in the present day. In view of growing care needs and scarce human resources, technical innovations promise an increase in efficiency and effectiveness in care. A forced use of technology is intended to improve the quality of life of the care recipients as well as to facilitate the work of the specialists – according to the promises of the product developers.This study shows that the technical potential is mainly tied to operational and personal requirements; and it asks for the first time about the effects of the use of technology on the organization of the facilities and the professional action of the care workers. Four exemplary technology applications – the computer documentation, the leverager, the location of persons and the extra-clinical intensive care – were empirically investigated in the outpatient and inpatient care for the elderly.
content.title_en: Use of technology in the care of the elderly : Potentials and problems in an empirical perspective

content.text: Legal protection against "urban lifestyle"?: problems of noise pollution caused by night-time crowds in urban residential areas. Changing leisure behaviour often harbours conflict potential that can be resolved legally. An example is the evening-time crowds of people in urban squares, which, due to the noise development of several hundred people, have considerable stress effects for the residents. The security authorities are trying to balance interests; however, with a rather moderate success. They usually see intervention measures as referring to the fundamental legal protection of the present persons and the expression of an "urban" feeling of life seen in the collections. Markus Thiel examines the existence of a danger situation and deals with the question whether the present persons can be addressees of traffic-related authorities. Due to the "summation" of the noise contributions, he assigns them as behavioural agents. Finally, the author develops the requirements to a claim of the residents to intervene in traffic-related hearings.
content.title_en: Protection of legal property against "urban lifestyle"?: problems of noise pollution caused by nightly crowds in urban residential areas

content.text: Hull cell for the investigation of galvanic electrolytes : with 17 tables. The Hull cell examination is one of the most important and indispensable analytical techniques at the electroplating companies, regardless of the type of coating. Furthermore, the technique is not replaceable by any other method as such due to its rapid ability to express itself and relatively simple application. This book provides know-how around the Hull cell and should not be lacking in any operation. Contents: The Hull cell and its application in electroplating The stationary Hull cell The Hull cell with rotating cylinder electrode (RZH cell) Hull cell investigations in galvanic operation Studies of electrolytes of tin investigations of nickel electrolytes Investigations of chromium electrolytes Investigations of copper electrolytes Investigations of silver electrolytes Investigations of gold electrolytes Investigations of palladium and palladium alloy electrolytes Keywords
content.title_en: Hull cell for the investigation of galvanic electrolytes : with 17 tables

content.text: Vacuum - Plasma - Technologies : Coating and modification of surfaces. The standard textbook on photovoltaics! With a wide range of exercises for each chapter How do solar cells work? What technologies and concepts exist? How do you plan a complete photovoltaic system? This textbook provides answers to these questions. Basic physical and electrotechnical questions relating to photovoltaics are addressed. The focus is on system technology with information on cell and module interconnection and the grid integration of photovoltaic systems. The book describes the latest measurement methods for solar modules and explains the technical and economic development perspectives of photovoltaic power generation. Focus: • Solar radiation • Fundamentals of semiconductor physics • Structure and mode of action of solar cells • Cell technologies • Solar modules and solar generators • System technology of grid-coupled systems • Solar electricity and its storage • Photovoltaic measurement technology • Planning and operation of photovoltaic systems The website www.lehrbuch-photovoltaik.de offers additional information, software and solutions to the exercises for the book.
content.title_en: Vacuum - Plasma - Technologies : Coating and modification of surfaces

content.text: WorldKnowledge : Development cooperation in the world society. »Development« is inevitably a reflexive communicative process under the conditions of the globalized knowledge society. After realizing that there is no king path towards sustainable development, new ways of cooperation are being developed, in which global and local knowledge are brought into a fruitful relationship. For the experts involved, this means that they primarily act as consultants, mediators and translators. The volume portrays development cooperation from many examples from practice (politic consulting, democracy promotion, good governance, environmental projects, etc.) as an area in which constantly new global-locally anchored world knowledge is produced and communicated.
content.title_en: WorldKnowledge : Development cooperation in the world society

content.text: Revolutions in accessibility: Society, space and transport in transition. The worldwide development of transport and telecommunications has reduced the globe. The volume analyses the consequences of accelerating the transition to space and faster accessibility of any place for society, economy, space, transport and the environment
content.title_en: Revolutions in accessibility: changing society, space and transport

content.text: Suburbanization in Germany : Current trends. The book is the first systematic and summary presentation of the problem of suburbanization in Germany since the 1970s. The suburbanization process in Germany has again experienced a high degree of topicality in the 1990s. New manifestations, causes and actors as well as new urban regional concepts and forms of cooperation are an expression of an increasing profiling of the suburban space. The book deals with the current trends of the suburbanization process in the new and old countries: from a theoretical perspective, with regard to individual aspects, with regard to selected urban regions as well as from a prognostic or action-oriented perspective.
content.title_en: Suburbanization in Germany : Current trends

content.text: Multicultural democracies compared : Institutions as a regulatory of cultural diversity?. Multiculturality has become part of everyday experience in many Western and non-Western societies. Therefore, the question is urgently asked, how the connection between democracy and multiculturalism must be thought today and what new challenges must be overcome by democratic institutions. How much plurality and difference is possible in a democracy? The contributions of this book revolve around this core question. On the one hand, the theoretical prerequisites of the traditional political science institutional and democratic concept are questioned and confronted with the fact of multiculturalism. On the other hand, empirically established Western democracies as well as the transformation societies are analyzed as they institutionally cope with the ethnic and cultural differences within their borders.
content.title_en: Multicultural democracies in comparison : Institutions as a regulatory cultural diversity?

content.text: Space and movement in literature: the literary sciences and the spatial turn. Space is not only a place of action in literary texts, but also a cultural carrier of meaning. The spatial representation is one of the fundamental components of the (fictional) realization of reality. Cultural norms and values hierarchies find a concretely vivid form in literary space; in reverse, literary spaces have a significant part in the negotiation of cultural spatial planning. In this volume, literary space concepts are systematically captured and presented from theoretical, methodological and genre-specific points of view. The volume thus makes a genuine disciplinary contribution to the cross-disciplinary discussion about the spatial turn and focuses on literature as a constitutive component of cultural spatial constructions.
content.title_en: Space and movement in literature : the literature and the spatial turn

content.text: Regional women's networks: Women's political alliances between professional interests and gender policy objectives. The book focuses on the analysis of specific strengths and weaknesses of regional women's networks, defined as regional alliances of different women's and gender policy actors. This study of network structures comprises two objectives: The first focuses on the internal structure, the social network consisting of individual actors. This informal network has a social and supportive effect. The second concerns a consideration of the network as a collective actor, which has common strategies and actively interferes in regional development and political processes on the basis of a feminist understanding of policies.
content.title_en: Regional networks of women: Women's political alliances between professional interests and gender objectives

content.text: Lectures on General Function Theory and Elliptical Functions. The lectures by Adolf Hurwitz on General Function Theory and Elliptical Functions were published in Volume 3 of the basic teachings of the Springer publishing house. The editor Richard Courant was supported by Carl Ludwig Siegel; Courant supplemented the Hurwitz text with a section on Geometric Function Theory. The "Hurwitz-Courant" was immediately a standard work that gave an excellent overview of the Weierstraßsche and Riemannsche function theory. Generations of mathematicians were enthusiastic about the book and, depending on the mood, gave the highest praise to the "Hurwitz" or the "Courant". The present book is a reprint of the Hurwitz lectures; Konrad Knopp said: "So cut off and precise that one is almost too effortlessly and straightly led to the goal.
content.title_en: Lectures on General Function Theory and Elliptical Functions

content.text: Casebook Internet Law : Case Law on Internet Law. Lawyers, students, judges, business lawyers and all those who deal with legal issues on the Internet will be given a reliable collection of decisions with this casebook. The judgments and decisions are selected according to scientific criteria and didactically prepared. Finally, the current decisions on Internet law are available in citable form.
content.title_en: Casebook Internet Law : Case Law on Internet Law

content.text: The discussion about a socio-theoretical recording of social work has been conducted system-theoretically for some time. The volume highlights this debate on whether social work can be adequately determined via inclusion/exclusion or via integration/desintegration. While system theory raises a general claim for explanation, which is developed through the fundamental distinction between inclusion/exclusion, it is in embarrassment if it is to take a position on issues of social inequalities. Although Luhmann has made relevant efforts in his last writings in this regard, the connection between system theory and inequality theory is insufficiently determined. The volume tries to contribute to further clarification here.
content.title_en: Inclusion and exclusion in social work

content.text: Religion, culture and politics in the Near East : The Islamic world in the sign of globalization. Like all world regions, the Near East has also been affected by the processes of homogenization of globalization at the economic, social, political and cultural level. However, no region is so vehemently opposed to these influences as the Islamic world. The present essay collection of Islamic scientists, historians and political scientists offers the reader a complex representation of globalization in the Near East and regional reactions to it. The consequences of globalization on the economic development of the region, its political systems and social structures (gender relations), the cultural discourses (Euro-Islam, human rights, literature), the regional resistance potential (Islamism, terrorism) and the role of the region in world politics are examined.
content.title_en: Religion, Culture and Politics in the Middle East : The Islamic World in the Sign of Globalization

content.text: The theory of stress concentration Precise calculation of strength. "The first two editions of this book, published in 1937 and 1985, are undoubtedly to be counted among the classics of elasticity theory.The mathematically sophisticated book is mainly aimed at theoretically interested engineers and physicists. The numerous, almost manual-like presented solutions can also serve a designer or calculation engineer in many practical cases."
content.title_en: Notch stress theory : Theory of stress concentration Accurate calculation of strength

content.text: Structure and interpretation of computer programs : An introduction to computer science. The translation of the proven introduction to computer science, developed at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), has been successfully used in teaching for years. Step by step, construction and abstraction of data and procedures are presented. From modularization to problem solving with register machines, various programming paradigms are developed and the effective handling of complexity is shown. SCHEME is used as a programming language, a dialect of LISP. All programs run in every SCHEME implementation corresponding to the IEEE standard.
content.title_en: Structure and interpretation of computer programs : A computer science introduction

content.text: Electrical machines and drive technology : basics and operating behaviour. This book deals in compact form with the use of electrical machines in drives with special consideration of modern power funnel technology, and it conveys skills for dimensioning electric motors for typical applications. It is designed as a textbook, each section contains control questions and training tasks with solutions
content.title_en: Electrical machinery and drive technology : Basics and operating behaviour

content.text: Mathematics for engineers and scientists : Vector analysis Probability calculation Mathematical statistics Error and compensation calculation. About the author Dr. Lothar Papula, formerly a lecturer at the University of Frankfurt/M., is now Professor of Mathematics at the University of Applied Sciences Wiesbaden. Mathematics as a tool and aid for engineers and scientists requires a presentation tailored to their needs and applications. Understanding and illustrativeness characterize since the first edition 1983 each volume of the 5-part work. These advantages have long since been recognized by the students. Already more than 500,000 books have accompanied them through the study course. Thus they have acquired a secure foundation for their application-related study with 'DEM PAPULA'. About Volume 3 are dealt with in this third volume: - Vector analysis - Probability calculation - Fundamentals of mathematical statistics - Error and compensation calculation - Tables on probability calculation and statistics - Exercise tasks at the end of the chapter with detailed solutions
content.title_en: Mathematics for engineers and scientists : Vector analysis probability calculation Mathematical statistics Error and compensation calculation

content.text: Technology/Technology Formula Collection : For technical schools and colleges. The Technologie/Technologie work consists of a textbook and a formula collection. It contains the subjects of courses in technical schools and colleges with a focus on metal technology. The formula collection is structured like the textbook and contains the most important equations from the course contents, besides the necessary tables, diagrams and usefully designed extracts from mechanical engineering standards. The teacher will be able to allow the formula collection without any reservations for the written examination work.
content.title_en: Technology/technology Formula collection : For technical schools and colleges
