content.title_en: Project management with Excel: [a practical book with the best tools; project planning: budgets, schedule, dependencies, resources; project realization: how to manage your project to success]

content.text: Vibrations of mechanical drive systems : modeling, calculation, analysis, synthesis. The book presents methods for modeling drive systems such as cranes, rotor systems, thrust crank drives, cutting machines and vibration machines. It contains differential equations, parameter values of pathogens, stiffness and damping as well as results of vibration measurements. Discrete and continuous models are used to calculate the vibration in worm drives using modern software: forced torsion vibrations in vehicle drives, drive strands with asynchronous motors, nonlinear elastomer couplings, self-excited vibrations in pressure machines, resonance flow of rotors, parameter-excited vibrations in mechanisms. Analytical solutions are also given, e.g. for stability conditions Movement sequence of the self-movement optimal positioning movement. Measures for mass and performance compensation, for the influence of self-frequency, for the reduction of vibration excitation, conditions for the self-synchronisation of unbalance pathogens and rules for the design of dynamically favorable drive systems are described.
content.title_en: Vibrations of mechanical drive systems : modeling, calculation, analysis, synthesis

content.text: Warehouse Management: Automation and organization of storage and picking systems. The multitude of networked and time-critical processes in a storage system places high demands on comprehensive, responsive and precise management of the resources used. Today, the key to this is computer-based warehouse management systems (WMS), whose functionality goes far beyond the limited capabilities of previous inventory and storage management systems. This is particularly suitable for the operation of complex warehouse and distribution systems, which are often subject to numerous time, cost and quality requirements as part of a value chain. The book helps to make decisions regarding the warehouse management system in accordance with the system requirements. It is aimed at employees and students who deal with internal logistics, but also at software and system developers who have an overview of the current storage and conveying technology and numerous suggestions for the contemporary design of soft and hardware. The book includes a CD-ROM with the source code of a simple WMS, which is derived from the open source initiative myWMS (see www.myWMS.de). The associated simulation environment enables the use of a WtarMS to operate on a common basis.
content.title_en: Warehouse Management : Automation and organization of storage and picking systems

content.text: Innovation management for technical products. Ideas alone do not lead to success: Product innovation in industry means the conversion of ideas into new, successful products. This implementation can no longer be operated by random means if companies want to survive in the long term. The systematic planning of innovations is therefore a prerequisite for success for the industrial enterprise, but is only rarely operated continuously today. This is mainly because the methods for generating and evaluating innovation approaches are not sufficiently known and only rarely integrated into the innovation process. Methodical approach to innovation planning is therefore the content of this book. The systematic integration of the available methods into a holistic innovation planning is described and demonstrated by examples from practice. InnovationRoadMap, value analysis, TRIZ or portfolio analysis are only some of the keywords that the planning engineer learns and is explained here - put into the correct context - found
content.title_en: Innovation management for technical products

content.text: Successful software licensing : Electronic License Management - From selection to installation. The author describes all phases of a licensing project, shows the way to selecting the right product, highlights possible cost traps and describes in detail which interfaces between product marketing, sales, development, support, logistics and hotline have to be considered. Software manufacturers are mainly addressed who want to introduce electronic licensing of their products for the first time or align current procedures with state-of-the-art. Successful software licensing is not a pure development project, but covers practically all areas of a software manufacturer. For the first time, this book sets out how to successfully set up a licensing project, what difficulties to expect in implementing it and what possibilities electronic software licensing offers at all.
content.title_en: Successful software licensing : Electronic License Management - From selection to installation

content.text: Mathcad in structural design : Electronic worksheets for structural engineering, reinforced concrete construction, steel construction and wood construction. Mathcad - the well-known computer algebra program - is very well suited to make calculations in structural engineering. From simple Mathcad worksheet to professional applications in structural design, the book offers a wide range of immediately applicable Mathcad worksheets. The enclosed CD-ROM contains all worksheets, the Mathcad manual and an immediately applicable Mathcad version
content.title_en: Mathcad in structural design : Electronic worksheets for statics, reinforced concrete construction, steel construction and timber construction

content.text: Energy Saving Regulation : Comment - Proof of Requirements - Examples of Calculation - Special Problems - including changes until April 2003. Coloured organizational charts for proofs and requirements allow a quick entry into the EnEV. The entire regulation text is commented on to guarantee a clear application. For the implementation into practice give calculation examples for two-family, multi-family and office buildings as well as a warehouse assistance. Forms for residential buildings with a window area f< 30% and buildings with low indoor temperatures as well as forms for summer thermal protection proof according to DIN 4108-2:2003-04 help with a non-computer-assisted proof of EnEV
content.title_en: Energy Saving Regulation : Comment - Proof of requirements - Examples of calculations - Special problems - including changes until April 2003

content.text: Lasers : Designs, Beam Guides, Applications. This book is a fundamental introduction to the physics and technology of lasers. It informs about functions, designs and emission properties of lasers, laser types, optical components and beam guide, applications in material processing, medicine, measurement and communication technology as well as holography. In the 6th edition of this successful textbook new developments in diode and solid-state lasers are taken into account and progress in the generation of ultrashort light pulses
content.title_en: Lasers : Designs, Beam Guide, Applications

content.text: Hydraulics for civil engineers. The book describes comprehensively, but easily understandable all practical hydromechanical calculation approaches - from hydrostatics to flow problems. It competently answers the important hydraulic questions. To this end, the computational procedures detailed in numerous calculation examples serve with many illustrations. This makes it particularly valuable for civil engineers in studies and practice. For the second, completely revised edition, the chapter groundwater has been substantially expanded according to its importance. The topic of wave calculation has also been added to meet the current requirements for freeboard measurement.
content.title_en: Hydraulics for civil engineers

content.text: Controlling with SAP R3® : A practical introduction with comprehensive case study and exemplary controlling applications. Within a very short time this book has become a standard work. The advantages: Easy understanding, example orientation and manageable scope of presentation. All components of the controlling module are explained completely and easily. The clearly structured concept leads the reader to a comprehensive understanding based on a case study even without prior knowledge. The connections are explained step by step: From the basics of cost accounting and controlling to the functioning of SAP® software to the application in practical operation
content.title_en: Controlling with SAP R3® : A practical introduction with comprehensive case study and exemplary controlling applications

metadata.authors: Friedl, Gunther; Hilz, Christian; Pedell, Burkhard

content.text: Electrical engineering and electronics : for mechanical engineers and process engineers. Knowledge in the most important fields of electrical engineering is indispensable for every engineer. Starting with electrical and magnetic fields, this textbook leads to the applications of calculation of DC and AC circuits: electronics, electrical machines and drives, electrical energy supply and electrical measurement technology. In addition to a clear presentation of the basics, the focus is on applications. At the expense of the earlier section on field theory, the chapter electronics was greatly expanded and partly redesigned. In particular, the power electronics with its interfaces to the electric drives was considerably deepened, as this field of electronics is becoming increasingly important in the work of the engineer.
content.title_en: Electrical engineering and electronics : for mechanical and process engineers

content.text: Vieweg Taschenlexikon Technik : Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Datentechnik. Referenzwerk für professionellen Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung. The Vieweg Taschenlexikon Technik is a reference work for vocational education and training. It informs pupils, students, skilled workers, masters, technicians and engineers quickly about concepts of technology and their subject contents. It is suitable in teaching for interdisciplinary learning (project method), group work (teamwork) house, study and final work. In the professional practice it offers secure help, e.g. in the drafting of technical reports, in translation and in the preparation of specialist lectures
content.title_en: Vieweg Pocket Lexicon Technology : Mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, data technology. Reference work for vocational education, training and further education

content.text: Real-Time Enterprise : Saving time and costs with accelerated management processes. Real-Time Enterprise (RTE) is a corporate structure that sustainably improves its own action and response speed by continuously accelerating management processes and can react without delay to external and internal changes and thus save time and costs. Prerequisites and framework conditions for this are integrated business processes and information flows along the entire value chain. Ideally, all work processes in a company are optimally coordinated, so that data warehouse, supply chain management, customer relationship management and enterprise resource planning effectively intertwine each other. In this process, the examination of processes and information does not end at the company's borders. Instead, customers and partner companies involved or their processes are transparently integrated and exchange information about all relevant events promptly.
content.title_en: Real-Time Enterprise : Saving time and costs with accelerated management processes

content.text: Vibration analysis in drive technology. The dynamics of drive strands is a research focus of machine and plant engineering in Germany. Many dissertations and habilitations from the last three decades deal with numerical calculation and control of vibrations in rotors and drive strands of various kinds. The book summarizes some of the works, measurements and calculations. It is aimed at calculating engineers, assistants and students, and tries to present the variety of the topic from theory to calculation and numbering to measurement and diagnosis of vibrations using the selected components and examples.
content.title_en: Vibration analysis in drive technology

content.text: Project execution in the construction industry : ways to win-win situation for clients and contractors. The book on project execution methods addresses clients (contractors) and the construction industry (service providers) to examine the advantages and disadvantages of the various project execution forms from the construction industry and process-related, i.e. from the construction company perspective. Here, the advantages of the individual project execution forms from the point of view of the client and the entrepreneur are considered and the industry-specific effects of customer requirements on the service offerings described
content.title_en: Project execution in the construction industry : Ways to win-win situation for clients and contractors

content.text: VDI heat atlas : Calculation sheets for heat transfer. The VDI heat atlas is an indispensable tool for the engineer, who deals with questions concerning heat and material transfer. The plant enables the technically and economically optimal design of process engineering equipment and plants. Since all contributions have been subjected to a comprehensive technical test procedure, the user receives a maximum of certainty that the data, calculation methods and statements correspond to the latest state of knowledge. Due to recent developments and with regard to recognizable trends the 9th edition has been partly restructured. It distinguishes itself against the preliminary edition by the fact that it contains besides numerous updates and additions also many completely rewritten contributions (especially in part L: Print loss calculation). To meet as previously all interested parties, the heat atlas continues to be in book form, as ring book and CD-ROM
content.title_en: VDI heat atlas : Calculation sheets for heat transfer

content.text: Material flow and logistics : Potentials from concept to detail design. In logically building up planning and optimization steps, the book describes the task-oriented selection, the technical and economic evaluation as well as the appropriate and successful use of conveyor and storage systems. Both theoretical basic and practical boundary conditions of the technology and organization are taken into account. Numerous case studies and realized systems show and confirm the pre-conceived procedures and solutions. A central intention of the authors concerns the efficient solution finding with the help of suitable computing methods and computer tools. This ranges from simple methods and computer programs to the application of simulation and appropriate use of the Internet and e-business. Thus, considerable improvement potentials can often be unlocked already with simple means. The book is suitable for the development of the overall subject matter, but also enables the knowledge deepening in the individual of the completed chapters. The great practical proximity makes this solid work a valuable help for the beginner as well as for the experienced, who constantly seeks optimization opportunities.
content.title_en: Material flow and logistics : potentials from concept to detail design

The servers include name, file, transaction, time and security servers. The selection of the presented servers is based on the broadest of the current and frequently used online application programs and the most common usage of the online application program.

content.text: Image data compression : Basics, coding, JPEG, MPEG, Wavelets. This book deals with the general procedures and methods of data compression and specifically addresses their use in systems for image data compression. Using many examples, the algorithms are explained and supported with source code in the programming language C. The modern procedures of wavelet-based compression are devoted to a great deal of attention. The book is suitable as a textbook and also as a reference work.
content.title_en: Image data compression : Basics, coding, JPEG, MPEG, Wavelets

content.text: Diesel engine management. Bosch innovations in diesel injection technology, such as the high-pressure injection systems Unit Injector and Common Rail, have contributed significantly to the diesel boom of recent years in Europe. These systems make the diesel engine quieter, more economical, more powerful and less emission. The present book provides a comprehensive insight into the widespread diesel injection systems and electronics for controlling and controlling the diesel engine. Another focus of this book is the internal engine emission reduction as well as the exhaust gas cleaning (e.g. by particulate filters).
content.title_en: Diesel engine management

content.text: Safety and comfort systems. Safety systems such as ESP or airbag are of paramount importance for the driver. They recognize danger situations independently and trigger complex processes in order to prevent these dangers within the scope of the physical possibilities or to mitigate their effects for the vehicle occupants. Comfort systems facilitate the operation of many functions in the vehicle interior and enable pleasant and fatigue-free driving. The vehicle handlebar can concentrate completely on the actual traffic. Many of these systems were developed by Bosch and brought to series production maturity. With this technical book, the reader receives a comprehensive description of these important components of car technology from the first hand. Numerous detailed drawings and illustrations complement the texts
content.title_en: Safety and comfort systems

content.text: Electrical machines and drives : teaching and workbook. This textbook provides the basics about the operation of electrical machines and drives in an easy to understand form. The material area is easy for those who are concerned with the mathematically simple connections, compressed representation and completely calculated examples. The repetitorium at the end contains comprehension questions and exercises. Therefore, the book is ideally suited for self-study. The new edition has been supplemented by a chapter on servo drives.
content.title_en: Electrical machinery and drives : teaching and workbook

content.text: Massive construction : Design in reinforced concrete construction. DIN 1045-1, which was newly published in summer 2001, changes the calculation methods in solid construction sustainably. Massive construction introduces the basics and design of structural structures, the stability of structures and components and the calculation and dimensioning of special components and thus explains the practical application of DIN 1045-1, edition July 2001. Already in the 3rd edition the topic of reinforced concrete construction is presented in a comprehensible and comprehensible way. The structure in 3 parts ensures the necessary clarity despite the material scope. As in the preliminary editions, the balanced relationship between theoretical foundations and calculation examples facilitates the integration into the extensive problem of steel concrete construction
content.title_en: Solid construction : Design in reinforced concrete construction

content.text: Lasers : Designs, beam guidance, applications. Knowledge of physics and technology of lasers is now part of the basic knowledge of every engineer and scientist. This basic introduction to the designs and properties of lasers, beam guidance and application is intended to lay the widest possible foundation. Modern developments and applications in various areas are taken into account. Numerous tasks with complete solutions serve to consolidate the substance and deepen. In the fourth edition of this successful work, which now appears as a textbook, new development trends are supplemented, especially in solid and diode lasers as well as FELs and X-ray lasers, including the generation of ultrashort light pulses
content.title_en: Lasers : Designs, Beam Guide, Applications

content.text: Aachener Bausexpertentage 2002 : Ceilings and walls made of concrete Practical problems and evaluation questions. Almost all those involved in the construction work have to deal with concrete components. The most important problems and the latest regulations must therefore be of interest to a large group of people. The 28th Aachener Bauexpertentage 2002 was aimed not only at the pronounced concrete specialists, but at all those who deal with the planning, execution and evaluation of construction works. The span of the topics ranged from the handling of cracks in walls, ceilings and industrial floors, the necessary surface design of parking decks, the evaluation of tolerances in the concrete component as well as new regulations on water-impermeable concrete components to damage to tiled concrete and floors on poorly sealed floor panels. In the building sector, in 2002 particularly the debt law reform and its consequences for the assessment of the lack of assessment by the expert were addressed.
content.title_en: Aachener Bausexpertentage 2002 : Ceilings and walls made of concrete Construction practical problems and evaluation questions

content.text: Materials of electrical engineering. The book deals first with the structure of matter, especially crystalline solids. Afterwards a description and physical interpretation of the electrical and magnetic properties of the materials is carried out, especially with regard to applications in passive components and sensors. The treatment of the material processing and testing is limited to the basic knowledge necessary in the course of engineering training. With the complete reprocessing, the 9th edition of the paper "Materials of electrical engineering" is now available again as a modern basic textbook on the current state of the art.
content.title_en: Electrical engineering materials

content.text: Advanced data analysis with SPSS : Statistics and Data Mining. The book describes methods of statistics and data mining, which are offered to SPSS, the most widely used software for statistical data analysis worldwide, in the form of further modules and programs: decision tree analysis (the Answer Tree program), several variants of correspondence analysis, categorical regression and multidimensional scaling (Categories), conjoint analysis (Conjoint), path analysis (Amos), time series analysis (Trends) and exact variants for nonparametric tests and cross-table statistics for small case numbers (Exact Tests). The creation of presentational tables (Tables) and other report possibilities round off the book. The introduction to the procedures is based on appropriate examples, without complicated mathematical redirections.
content.title_en: Advanced data analysis with SPSS : Statistics and Data Mining

content.text: Crane rail beams made of rolled profiles: Evidence and design diagrams. Crane rail beams for crane systems of light and medium-weight operation are usually designed as rolled profiles with flat steel rail without horizontal bandage. To reduce the considerable planning effort, graphic design diagrams are given which simplify design and detection to a comparison of existing and removable loads. The graphic representation allows the evaluation of the design parameters and their optimization. All the safety and suitability for use required in the relevant regulations are recorded in the design diagrams. The diagrams of the 2nd edition now also include the comparative stress proof for the beam's bridge approach, the operational strength proof for beams and welds, and a simple design equation for the welds between rail and support belt. The application in practice has shown that the use of the diagrams and the design and detection equations leads to a significant relief for planners and testers.
content.title_en: Crane rail beams made of rolled profiles : proofs and design diagrams

content.text: Mobile Commerce : Basics and Techniques. M-Commerce (MC) as a new form of e-commerce is created by the convergence of Internet and mobile communications technology. The book provides students and practitioners, especially decision-makers, with structured and practical knowledge from the point of view of the business computer scientist. Both knowledge and methods are taught as well as practical instructions. Technical and business-economic fundamentals are weighted about the same. The spectrum ranges from the technical basics to security aspects and special features of the application design to the consideration of market participants, evaluation of business models and optimization of business processes using mobile technologies. Simple examples and exercises illustrate the conveyed topic
content.title_en: Mobile Commerce : Basics and Techniques

content.text: The manual introduces the exploration of the underground, the examination and evaluation of its material properties and the possible geogenic hazards at the site. It also contains a guide for environmental impact assessment. For the rapid and precise exploration of stress conditions in the underground, a new measurement method is described with the Cereskop: www.ceres-geology.de Geotechnology as an interdisciplinary discipline includes the application of manual and intellectual knowledge in accordance with the legal requirements and adapted to the geographical and geological conditions. The aspect of safety and stability is primarily based on the economic aspect of the choice of suitable construction methods, building materials and construction machinery as well as the cooperation of qualified experts. This concerns reciprocally the planning, investigation, construction, monitoring and use or operation of construction facilities. The manual leads to earth construction, rock construction, road construction, tunnelling, waterworks, landfilling and recultivating techniques and is also suitable for construction engineers.

content.text: Fluid bed spray granulation. The fluid bed spray granulation is a new technology for forming suspensions, solutions and melts. The book provides an overview of all the essential aspects of this technology for the first time. Theory and technology are familiarized in a presentation that is easy to understand and well illustrated for the variously trained interested parties (chemists, engineers, pharmacists, etc.).
content.title_en: Fluid bed spray granulation

content.text: The development of steam generators and combustion plants has made considerable progress over the last decade. To follow the flood of individual publications in brochures, conference reports and journals is hardly possible. For this reason, a summary presentation is indispensable as in this book. Here, the physical contexts and experiences from practice are explained. Thus, the complicated effects can be further developed and grasped in mathematical calculation models. Environmental protection is given a broad scope, as combustion is significantly influenced by ecology. The author places particular emphasis on application-oriented knowledge and thus combines theory and practice effectively. The book addresses engineers in the energy industry and power plant technology. It offers a summary presentation on the latest state of the art and can be used in practice as an excellent reference work.
content.title_en: Steam production

This book deals with the general procedures and methods of data compression and specifically addresses their use in systems for image data compression. The modern procedures of wavelet-based compression are devoted to a great deal of attention. The book is suitable as a textbook and also as a reference work.

content.text: Events and e-commerce: Customer loyalty and brand leadership on the Internet. Companies that want to present themselves as competent partners must offer new and more sophisticated dialogues in the context of high-performance interactive media. In conjunction with network-based communication, event marketing dimensions can develop which offer added value in entertainment, information and active participation. Here, the successful reception and setting of cultural, conceptual and aesthetic standards decides on the market success. The perspectives network-based event marketing are presented here for communication planners, marketing managers, project developers and event managers for the first time. Addressed aspects are among others community building, profiling, clienting, permission marketing, digital branding, one-to-one marketing and customer relationship management. From the content: - media cultural backgrounds: digital economy and event culture, hypermarkets, strategy surfing, events as a sociodesign, meme and designer viren, media management - best practice: Pregnant texts and illustrations inform about the development of groundbreaking projects, task, working methods, background information, and results.
content.title_en: Events and e-commerce : Customer loyalty and brand management on the Internet

content.text: Order processing optimizes according to environmental and cost objectives : OPUS - Organisational models and information systems for an integrated environmental protection. This book provides the necessary foundations for an environmentally oriented optimization of order processing in the areas of design, work preparation, production planning and control, process control, balancing and controlling as well as over-the-counter environmental management. The concepts described in this book are developed in the form of methods, models and prototypes and have been implemented, evaluated and optimized in the context of operational implementation projects in the sectors metal production and processing, machinery and apparatus construction, automotive supplier industry as well as glass processing industry and software development in industrial application areas
content.title_en: Optimising order processing according to environmental and cost objectives : OPUS - Organisational models and information systems for an integrated environmental protection

content.text: Internet & Co. in retail : Strategies, business models, experiences. What significance will e-commerce have in the future? What are the success factors in the conception of an internet presence? Does e-commerce mean a threat or an opportunity for stationary trade? Which business models are conceivable? The authors investigate these and similar questions - all experts from science and/or business practice. They show the central problems and present concrete solutions. With numerous case studies. A book for all business practitioners affected by the developments in e-commerce
content.title_en: Internet & Co. in retail : Strategies, business models, experiences

content.text: Microsystem technology - When does the market breakthrough come? : Miniaturization strategies in the technology competition between the USA, Japan and Germany. Microsystem technology is considered one of the key technologies for securing Germany's location. Market studies have tried to quantify the potential of this technology in recent years, without taking into account company strategies, competing technologies and national specialisation patterns of industry. This book examines the potential of microsystem technology qualitatively from an industrial strategic perspective. Miniaturization continues to follow many individual paths. A cross-sectional market breakthrough is only expected in the medium term. The German technology position is comparatively strong. Exceptions exist in the fields of precision and precision engineering, machine tool construction and biomedicine and genetic engineering, where competitive risks have been identified. Strategic recommendations for action in industry and politics characterize this book.
content.title_en: Microsystem technology - When does the market breakthrough come? : Miniaturization strategies in technology competition between the USA, Japan and Germany

content.text: In-house cooperation based on SAP systems: perspectives for logistics and service management. Through efficient information and communication technologies, inter-company cooperations gain an ever greater weight in corporate strategies. The present book introduces first into the basic methodological requirements and then deals in detail with the use of SAP systems to support cooperation in the logistics chain. The authors examine both classic logistics solutions (including EDI) and modern SAP systems such as SAP APO, SAP LES, SAP BBP, Business Information Warehouse and Internet Applications. The book is rounded off by case studies on the use of the presented SAP systems in corporate practice. The reader can easily understand this book and yet have a deep insight into the topic.
content.title_en: Inter-company cooperation based on SAP systems : Perspectives for logistics and service management

content.text: Business Computing with MS-Office 2003 and Internet : An introduction to practical examples. Business Computing includes those areas of computerization with which a large number of computer users come into contact in the business and training environment. The book introduces into the application programs WORD 2003, EXCEL 2003, ACCESS 2003 and POWERPOINT 2003. It is characterized by the concentration on the essentials. As most users need only a small part of the entire range of services for their work, the book highlights these components in particular. It aims to facilitate orientation by reducing complexity. In appropriate places, the book also provides you with background information that enables even more targeted work with the application programs. For example, in the Powerpoint part there are hints on the general design of presentations. In part about databases, it devotes a whole chapter to the conception of databases.
content.title_en: Business Computing with MS-Office 2003 and Internet : An introduction to practical examples

content.text: From Poland to Germany and back: labour migration and its challenges for Europe. This book deals with labour migration from Poland to Germany after the enlargement of the EU in May 2004. Individual contributions deal with the new legal situation and the related shift of migration flows towards the countries that opened up their labour markets. Furthermore, the authors focus on the different migrant groups and discuss the structure and forms of the new migration as well as the role of migration networks. The focus is on the transnational practices of migrants and their social positioning. Subsequently, the consequences of labour migration in an open European area as well as the challenges of transnational migration for the understanding of social integration in Europe are discussed.
content.title_en: From Poland to Germany and back: labour migration and its challenges for Europe

content.text: In contrast to current readings of Foucault's governmentality, which refer mainly to the logic of economics, this volume highlights the political dimensions of his theory. The analysis of the current security society serves as the starting point for a critical revision of Foucault's typology of power of sovereignty, discipline and government. The contributions outline current aspects of governmentality by problematizing current security concepts and their relationship to migration, gender, bio-security, violence, postcolonial subjectivity and state legitimization. With contributions by Alex Demirovic, Dominique Grisard, Susanne Krasmann, Katherine Lemons, Filippa Lentzos, Katrin Meyer, Sven Opitz, Katharina Pühl, Patricia Purtschert, Nikolas Rose, Yves Winter.
content.title_en: Governmentality and Security : Time Diagnostic Contributions after Foucault

content.text: The information content of option prices. Prices at which stock index options are traded on international futures exchanges are usually systematically different from the implications of the standard model of option valuation developed by Black, Scholes and Merton. To explain this phenomenon known as "smile effect", there are various hypotheses that are discussed in this paper and empirically reviewed using transaction data for the DAX option. Under certain conditions, the extensive data base can be used to obtain information on the price distribution underlying prices and the implicit price process of the base paper. Analysis of these methods is a focus of the work. The study is intended to contribute to a better understanding of the price-determining factors of stock index options overall.
content.title_en: The information content of option prices

content.text: E-Collaboration : Process optimization in the value chain. The rapid development of Internet technologies opens up new possibilities for the communication and cooperation of companies. By overcoming spatial and temporal restrictions, business processes can be extended across location and company boundaries. As a result, the industrial use of the Internet has changed and from electronic business to electronic collaboration (e-collaboration). Originally, the use of the Internet as a sales channel and purchasing platform is being prioritised, so the support of cross-company business processes in development, production and logistics through the Internet is becoming increasingly important. The contributors of this volume deal with central aspects of e-collaboration. The focus is on business process optimization, customer integration, product and service development as well as production and supply. In addition, workflow management systems and computer supported cooperative work are presented as instruments for the realization of e-collaboration.
content.title_en: E-Collaboration : Process optimization in the value chain

content.text: Chaos theory and corporate management: constructions for model-based decision preparation. Managers in companies are often surprised by the consequences of their decisions: the consequences are often unexpected and not desired. The classic approach "decision under uncertainty" explains this with lack of information about exogenous factors. However, there are decisions whose uncertainty is endogenous, i.e. in the complexity of the decision situation, is based on. Since decision-determining mental models leave essential properties of complexity unconsidered and thus uncertainty becomes ignorance, Torsten Büssow reconstructs the phenomenon of complexity mathematically and makes it manageable by means of model-based decision-making preparation. The necessity of using mathematical models for the management of complexity is founded on behavioural and cognitive science and thus extends the system theory of business economics based on verbal and iconic access to the present.
content.title_en: Chaos Theory and Management : Constructions for Model-Based Decision Preparation

content.text: Online market research: Theoretical principles and practical experiences. Renowned experts from science and practice address the dynamic development of this new research branch and highlight its possibilities and limitations. The authors comment on: - the problem of participant recruitment, - legal aspects, - data quality as well as - practical topics and applications of online market research. The spectrum of the contributions covers both quantitative and qualitative market research. For the second edition the work was completely revised and expanded. "Online market research" is aimed at lecturers and students of business economics and social sciences with the focus on empirical market and social research as well as institutional and operational market researchers who want to take advantage of the challenges of the new media and their diverse possibilities. content.text: The era of ecology: a world history. The first world history of ecology. Ecology is the sign of our age. Joachim Radkau's grandiose presentation makes the new era experience its full diversity and global significance. Although it does not ignore the distant origins in the 18th and 19th centuries, it focuses essentially on the last forty years. The book reports on crucial events and experiences such as the Chernobyl reactor disaster as well as on the myth of German "forest extinction" and illuminates the connections with other political and cultural currents. It tells both of spiritual search and outstanding moments as well as institutionalization and bureaucratization. It portrays central initiatives such as Friends of the Earth or Greenpeace and charismatic champions such as Rachel Carson, Petra Kelly and the Chinesin Dai Qing. Joachim Radkau all of all shows what central role and almost mythical potential women in the environmental movement are to have. Radkau writes from inner connection and much of her own experience with the environmental movement, but keeps critical distance from all the movements.
content.title_en: The era of ecology: a world history

content.text: Multi-criteria and fuzzy systems in theory and practice: solutions for decision-making problems with complex target systems. Demanding decision-making problems that are difficult to solve are usually characterized by a complex target system. The differentiated preference structures to be considered here are usually only imperfectly comprehensible. This means that solutions cannot be found by applying simple decision-making principles. The research on the topic of multi-objective decision-making (multi-criteria decision-making) investigates how to take this matter into account. In this traditionally multidisciplinary research area, mathematicians, computer scientists, engineers, natural scientists and economists develop new decision-making concepts. The authors of the contributions of this volume also take account of fuzzy systems from the mathematical-theoretical foundations of (multi-objective) optimization to their implementation in decision-making support systems to the analysis of practical decision-making problems.
content.title_en: Multi-criteria and fuzzy systems in theory and practice : Solutions for decision-making problems with complex target systems

content.text: Optimization of flight plans : Using quantitative methods in air transport. The aircraft has developed into a mass transport medium, while competition among airlines has increased significantly in recent years. In order to strengthen its market position, individual airlines join large alliances with the aim of providing its customers with an attractive offer of non-stop flights and connections. With a high degree of procedures from the Operations Research department, Karsten Leibold develops a model to create the "ideal" flight plan and to select and create meaningful connections. He analyses the development process of a flight plan, derives the essential basic interconnections and develops an appropriate optimization approach. On this basis, he identifies adequate solution procedures and implements them. Finally, the resulting model is tested and evaluated in terms of its practical suitability.

content.text: The business survey for engineers is based on the basics of the development of technical products. Economic decisions on methodical development -- Calculation of product costs for cost-oriented development (one-period calculation) -- Assessment of product development as an investment (multi-period calculation) -- Business decision-making for product development -- With many examples, repetition questions, tasks and solutions. This textbook familiarises students and teachers of all engineering disciplines with the business-related basics and methods relevant to them. Since the development of new products is usually lengthy and associated with high money use, it is becoming increasingly important that engineers systematically deal with decision-making. Otherwise, there is a risk that important things "from the gut" will be decided and essential ideas of the company will be disregarded. Students, teachers and interested practitioners will be informed about how they improve the economic performance of product development or changes in the development method sustainably. In addition to clear examples, questions on repetition and deepening as well as exercise tasks are assigned to each section for the implementation of the product. The second edition has been thoroughly revised and in particular the first business-oriented development program.
content.title_en: Cost-effectiveness calculation for engineers : basics for the development of technical products

content.text: High-risk projects: successfully manage quantum leaps in development. When planning and implementing projects, including particularly risky projects, classical project management is no longer sufficient. Drastically increased risks regarding market acceptance, technology and environment will require situationally adapted management. The result of the analysis is not even more complex planning processes, but the recommendation for more flexible, adaptable organizations and clear processes. "Tents instead of palaces" is the motto
content.title_en: High-Risk Projects : Successfully manage quantum leaps in development

content.text: The trade in the information age: Concepts - Instruments - Implementation. An important challenge for commercial enterprises is always to improve the position as an information specialist, to build up competitive knowledge and to develop existing approaches to business management. The increasing importance of the production factor Information and ways of profiling as an information specialist are at the center of "The trade in the information age". In 26 contributions, renowned authors from science and practice are taking a stand: - Information systems - Customer Relationship Management - Information based use of marketing policy instruments - Micromarketing - Electronic Commerce - Strategies in the Internet - Multichannel systems - New business models - Development perspectives "The trade in the information age" addresses lecturers and students of business administration with the focus on trade and marketing. Managers from the areas of trade and marketing receive a comprehensive overview. Prof. Dr. Dirk Möhlenbruch is Professor of Business Economics, Marketing and Trade at the Martin-Luther-Universität Halle-Wittenberg. Dr. Michaela Hartmann is a scientific assistant of Prof. Dr. Klaus Barth at the Chair of Business Administration, in particular of the University of Business Administration and Sales and Sales of the University of the University of Duisburg.
content.title_en: Trade in the information age : Concepts - Instruments - Implementation

content.text: Neuronal networks in marketing management : Practical introduction to modern data mining. Neuronal networks are among the most important data mining methods. Due to the outstanding importance of the factor "knowledge" in business practice, data mining - especially in marketing questions - is increasingly being used. In "Neuronal networks in marketing management" German-speaking authors provide an overview for the first time: - Fundamentals of data mining with a focus on neuronal networks, - Application fields in marketing management and - Detailed descriptions of the procedure in practical data mining projects The publishers create with the presentation directed to decision makers a fundamental understanding of neuronal networks and their potentials. Interested parties are managers, practitioners and business consultants in the marketing field as well as lecturers and students of business administration with the focus on business information technology and marketing. Frank Buckler is a scientific project assistant at the Chair of Marketing II of the University of Hanover

content.text: Online market research : Theoretical principles and practical experiences. This practical book provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of online market research in Germany. Renowned experts from science and practice in online market research deal with the dynamic development of this new research branch and show its limitations and possibilities. The authors take their stand: - the problem of participant recruitment, - legal aspects and quality assurance as well as - on practical topics and application areas of online market research. The spectrum of the contributions covers both quantitative and qualitative market research. "Online market research" is aimed at lecturers and students of business administration and social sciences with the focus on empirical market and social research as well as institutional and operational market researchers who want to meet the challenges of the new media and use their diverse possibilities.
content.title_en: Online market research : Theoretical foundations and practical experiences

content.text: The ununderstood culture: perspectives of a critical theory of media society. Ununderstood culture is the search for the set-up of a cultural theory of media society - with the aim of renewing a critical communication science. In a time that is as never before characterized by the omnipresentity and abundance of mass media communication, we need a critical understanding of the culture that emerges from it. The book aims to contribute to conceptually and conceptually grasping this media culture. In search of an illumination of our current media society, the text follows historical and current socio-cultural debates.
content.title_en: The Ununderstood Culture: Perspectives of a Critical Theory of Media Society

content.text: Computer-oriented business administration : basics for efficient information management. The use of computer technology is changing increasingly business-related problems and solutions with a far-reaching effect on the structure and market position of companies. At the same time, methods and techniques of business management can also be used for the optimal use of information technology. Both directions of the connection between computer and business administration are dealt with in the book using concrete information and communication techniques such as database use, networking, CASE and dialogue processing. In addition, comprehensive computer-oriented solution concepts such as CIM, commodity management systems or electronic banking are discussed. The main results are classified into a computer-oriented business-oriented business information model and summarized. content.text: Applied data analysis: The Bayes's way. This book offers a systematically structured introduction to applied data analysis, Bayes's statistical models and modern simulation methods with the computer. Starting from the objective of not directly identifying measurable variables and calculating forecasts of future values of uncertain variables, it describes and explains the approaches – from the systematic collection of data to quantification of uncertainty based on probabilities to the application of regression models. With numerous examples from practice and its didactics tested in many courses, the book is ideal for students in applied sciences such as engineering, natural sciences and economics. For the reprinting several chapters have been revised. In addition, a section on hierarchical models was inserted and the book supplemented with a chapter on plausibility of models and hypotheses. The author Prof. Dr. Daniel Bättig is Professor for Applied Statistics and Mathematics at the Department of Technology and Informatics of Bern University of Applied Sciences, Switzerland. As head of the Institute for Risk and Extreme Value Analysis, he has practical experience in analyzing, classifying and modelling data.

content.text: The "guest worker" system: labour migration and its consequences in the Federal Republic of Germany and Western Europe. The Federal Republic of Germany and other Western European industrial states introduced millions of foreign workers from the 1950s to the early 1970s to supplement their national labour markets in times of boom. Numerous bilateral recruitment agreements offered the framework. To date, the consequences of the "guest worker" system are controversially discussed under the heading "integration". The collection offers current results of historical migration research. The conditions and forms of recruitment and their effects for the economy, society and politics are examined as well as aspects of integration at the municipal and national level. This overarching perspective enables new insights into the history of labour migration.
content.title_en: The "guest worker" system: labour migration and its consequences in the Federal Republic of Germany and Western Europe

content.text: Computer experiments: the transformation of science in the age of computers. Since the introduction of computers as a research, experiment and forecasting tool, the sciences have undergone a profound change. Not only the practices and infrastructures of scientific work are changing, but also the logic of research is subject to a fundamental transformation. In addition to theory, experiment and measurement, computer experiments open up a new field of knowledge production and radically change the experimental culture of the natural sciences. Using climate research as an example, the book reconstructs this change of the sciences »from science to computational sciences«.
content.title_en: Computer experiments: on the change of science in the age of computers

content.text: Natural science. The focus of this volume is the relationship between natural science and dialectics. It drafts a sketch of the development of the concept of nature from antiquity to modern times, in order to show the upheaval in the conception of nature as a substance to that as a function. Thus, the principle of natural science experience can be made clear. It is not an empiric description, but rather a determination of movements in nature by measurement and experiment. In both epistemological and thus philosophical foundations are concealed. Natural science itself thinks of its experience in the form of specific dualisms, which understand dialectics as a messtheoretical version of the contradiction that exists as a movement. Thus, the natural science separates itself into a whole.
content.title_en: Science

content.text: The manual correction of solutions to programming tasks is however time-consuming and not always easy. In this – but also in other scenarios – an automated evaluation of the solutions of programming tasks can make a valuable contribution to the improvement of teaching. Moreover, suitable systems enable a presentation of learning progress, keep learners through regularly evaluated practice tasks for continuous cooperation and support teachers through an overview of learning progress and learning hurdles of individual students and the entire group in the planning and orientation of their teaching. This book is aimed at teachers at universities, schools and other training institutions, to university didacticians with reference to programming training and to computer scientists who are engaged in the development or integration of systems for automatic programme evaluation. The objectives of this book are to promote practical relevance and effectiveness in order to provide an automated evaluation of the application of the program in a wider range of automated applications.
content.title_en: Automated evaluation in programming training

content.text: Disability and social work : vocational change - fields of work - competences. People with disabilities have gained in importance as target groups of social work in recent years. In this context, they are no longer understood as "objects of care", but as active designers of their everyday life and life planning. The book first outlines the change of guiding principles and the goals of professional assistance for people with disabilities. It provides detailed information on the areas of social work in disability and highlights the supporting landscape and structural characteristics of disability assistance. It addresses questions of professional qualification, the changed skills requirements and the perspectives of the professionalization of social pedagogical specialists.

content.text: Energy saving - Climate protection, which is calculated. The assessments of the economic evaluation of climate protection measures, in particular to increase energy efficiency, are very contradictory. This book explains the analytical background based on figures and is also understandable for non-economists. The authors conclude that in many areas profitable energy saving potentials are not recognized and implemented. They show that considerable scope for design is available in the pursuit of climate protection targets and prevention against climate damage. By unbundling different levels of discussion and showing the sources for misinterpretations of study results, the book makes an important contribution to the objectification of climate protection discussion.
content.title_en: Energy saving - Climate protection that pays off

content.text: The method of finite elements. The methods of finite elements is a flexible numerical method for the comprehensive calculation of complicated mechanical structures. The book introduces the reader to the theoretical basics of the method, familiarizes him with the properties of this approximation process and deals in detail with the conversion into numerical algorithms and their reliability. Using the example of the rod structures all basic calculation steps are explained in detail. The new edition has been supplemented by a chapter on transfer matrices. The book is addressed to engineers in practice and to students at technical universities and universities of applied sciences. It is also suitable for self-study. Tasks and solutions make the verification of knowledge possible.

content.text: The work is designed as an introductory textbook in particle astrophysics and is aimed at students of physics and astronomy starting with the preliminary diploma. The basics of relativity theory and quantum mechanics are presented in a concise manner before the standard model of particle physics is explained and the connections with today's questions are established from astrophysics and cosmology. Mathematically more elementary than most introductions to particle physics, this book is suitable for a course lecture as well as for self-study. Particular emphasis is placed on pedagogical aspects: in the foreground are visuality, a representation oriented towards the actual thinking process and the balance between theoretical, experimental and interpretative aspects of modern astroparticle physics.
content.title_en: Particle Physics and Cosmology

content.text: Constitution and magnetism. In this monograph, the foundations and latest findings on the constitution of iron and its alloys are documented. Iron is the most important material in technology, especially because of its versatility, and despite its use for thousands of years, it is still a current focal object - especially in the application perspective of modern functional materials. The key to the physical properties of iron lies in its magnetism. It is therefore the aim of this work to link the constitution and magnetism of iron with each other.
content.title_en: Constitution and Magnetism

content.text: Eco-Design. Prof. Dr.-Ing Günter Fleischer was responsible for the development of new technologies and the optimization of process consequences with regard to environmental relief by reducing the material and energy requirements in a semi-finished and a recycling plant during his 15-year industrial practice. Since 1988 he has been researching and teaching at the TU Berlin FB Waste Prevention and Secondary Raw Materials Management. His main activities are the development of product, process and operational strategies for environmental relief by means of holistic approaches. He is an active member of committees of DIN, ISO, SETAC and VDI. This foundation works mainly with product developers and product development managers and scientists, and the result of a three-year intensive research activity by six institutes with the participation of eleven companies in the German economy. The focus is on a methodology that allows the use of all available materials and conceivable material combinations to be made clear in terms of the use of products and the use of waste management systems.
content.title_en: Eco design

content.text: Our lonely Earth. Are we perhaps alone in the universe? To this question the geologist Peter D. Ward and the astrobiologist Donald Brownlee give surprising answers. They contradict the general assumption that higher-developed life exists outside the Earth and is perhaps even widely spread among the billions of stars and galaxies of our universe. In search of life in the universe the authors take the reader on an exciting journey from the hot volcanic sources of the ocean floor to the icy face of Europe, the Jupiter Moon. In doing so, the reader learns that low-developed life is perhaps more widespread than previously assumed, but the emergence of higher-developed life is too complex to take place outside the Earth. A fascinating, refreshingly written book based on the latest state of science. "Astrological science expects us to exceed the limits of conventional biology. Whole planets must be understood as ecological units. When a paleontologist discovers a new life form in a billion-year-old rock of Africa, this is also important for the planet's geologists. Newly discovered trace substances from the sea can only affect our ability to think in terms of time.
content.title_en: Our Lonely Earth

content.text: This book describes the habitat of the sediment for biocenosis as well as the biological and chemical-physical aspects that control the bioavailability of pollutants. Sediments from rivers, estuaries and ports must be removed because they affect shipping and flood discharge. A second focus of the book therefore deals with the role of sediment as a dredging material and the resulting problems of limit value finding, the development of action criteria, targets and classifications for a re-location. Numerous case studies show solutions and evaluation approaches. In the third part of the book, the Scientific Committee on Water sediments in the Water Chemical Society of the DGCh derives recommendations for action and proposes an integrated assessment strategy for sediments that combines biological and ecological characteristics with chemical evaluation criteria. This book is intended to provide support and provide a basis for discussion for all those responsible for the environment in public authorities, industry, water management and universities.
content.title_en: Investigation and evaluation of sediments

content.text: Genetic engineering in agriculture, plant breeding and food production. About 15 years ago genetically modified agricultural animals and plants were first produced. Meanwhile, the first applications have left the research and development stage and are used internationally commercially. Due to the retention of acceptance in the population, regulatory uncertainties and a controversial discussion about ecological and health risks, the commercial use of genetic engineering in the EU remains below expectations. The present book examines the current state of science and technology of genetic engineering in plant and animal breeding, agriculture and forestry as well as food production. It also focuses on the economic aspects, the state of the discussion on opportunities and risks as well as the legal framework conditions.

A chapter on the current topic of single molecules and single molecule spectroscopy has also been added. 133 exercises are completing the book.
content.title_en: Molecular Physics and Quantum Chemistry : Introduction to the Experimental and Theoretical Fundamentals

content.text: Financial Mathematics. Modern financial mathematical methods are closely linked to the theory of stochastic processes. Terms and results of this theory up to stochastic integration are presented in this textbook in their interrelations to financial problems. Based on previous knowledge of probability theory, the reader is taught the essential methods for the analysis and evaluation of financial derivatives and thus a deeper understanding of the practice of financial markets. Newly introduced are practice tasks and further modelling and applications in the financial economy.

content.text: Introduction to probability theory and statistics. This textbook addresses all those who want to penetrate the idea world of stochastics - equipped with basic knowledge of differential and intergrail calculus and linear algebra. Stochastics is the mathematics of chance. It is of utmost importance for the professional practice of mathematicians. In many schools it has found its place. The two main areas of stochastics are probability theory and statistics. In probability theory, random processes are investigated with fixed probability which is assumed to be controlling. This is of theoretical and practical interest. Moreover, probability theory provides the basis for statistics in which conclusions are drawn from observed data about unknown probabilities and about appropriate behaviour. In the seventh edition, besides several detailed changes and improvements to pressure errors, there is a largely rewritten paragraph 9 on timescale analyses of sorting algorithms. The evidence now comes out without the assumption of equal distribution and are simplified at the same time.
content.title_en: Introduction to probability theory and statistics

content.text: Fluid and thermodynamics. Based on a generally understandable, two areas of common concept, a common introduction to fluid and thermodynamics is given. Fluid dynamics includes hydrostatics, hydrodynamics of ideal and viscous fluids, laminar and turbulent pipe flows. In thermodynamics, after the introduction of the terms and the representation of thermal equations, ideal gases are treated by the first and second main propositions, starting with the form of caratheodory valid for adiabates, simple systems, and the balance statement of Clausius Duhem with applications on heat-conducting viscous fluids and canonic equations of state. In gas dynamics, in which the acoustics, the stationary isentropic current thread theory and the shock theory are treated, fluid and thermodynamics are interwoven. The book concludes - as a special feature in the textbook literature - with a chapter on dimension analysis and model theory. In addition to the elaboration of technical questions, it also opens the view for environmental-relevant problems. Many examples from technology and natural science support this view.
content.title_en: Fluid and thermodynamics

content.text: This volume deals with the main characteristics of river basins - small catchment areas and mesoscale catchment areas, drainage dynamics, transport of materials and material discharges, influence of flood events in different spatial scales, leachate rates and a mesoscale landscape analysis. It shows how differentiated questions arise at different scales and can be answered with an adapted range of methods. Furthermore, several contributions explicitly address the requirements of the EU WFD from an environmental economic point of view. Local politicians, spatial and landscape planners, conservation officers as well as lawyers, economists and environmental scientists who are entrusted with the implementation of the EU WFD receive important decision-making aid. The case study collection is of great benefit for practitioners as well as for scientists and students.
content.title_en: Substance and water balance in catchment areas

content.text: Transport processes in process engineering play an outstanding role in process engineering processes that form the basis of product production in various material-changing industries. Their fundamental understanding is therefore an indispensable prerequisite for all those who implement such processes in technical practice. This includes primarily engineers of different disciplines, technical chemists, physicists and biotechnologists. This book includes both the comprehensive presentation of the theoretical and empirical foundations and their application in various technical solutions. In this way, practitioners and students can acquire both expertise and build a solution competence that enables them to analyse and then solve their own specific tasks of everyday work without having to resort to a literature that is now almost inconceivable. Prof. Dr.-Ing. Matthias Kraume studied chemical engineering at the University of Dortmund and received his doctorate there on the subject of "Direct Heat Transition". He then worked at BASF AG as a development engineer and project engineer for nearly 10 years. Since 1994 he has been Professor of Process Engineering at the TU Berlin
content.title_en: Transport operations in process engineering

content.text: Theoretical solid state physics. The book provides an introduction to methods, contents and results of modern solid state physics. It builds on the basic course Theoretical physics, i.e. provided knowledge in classical mechanics, electrodynamics and especially quantum mechanics and statistical physics, as taught in the course in theoretical physics, which is usually taught at all German-speaking universities until the end of the 6th semester. The formalism of the 2nd quantization (set-up representation) is indispensable especially for the treatment of many-particle effects (phonons and electrons in periodic potential, bloch-theorem, hard-tree-focking, electron-phonon interaction) is introduced in the book and used. The content ranges from the classical areas of solid state physics (phonons and electrons in periodic potential, bloch-theorem, hard-tree-focking, electron-phonon interaction) to areas of application such as superconductivity and magnetism, which are currently subject to research (e.g. quantum-hall-effect, high-temperature superconduction). The second edition is supplemented by numerous newly developed and partially numerically-solved exercise tasks.
content.title_en: Theoretical solid state physics

content.text: Atomic and quantum physics. Atomic and quantum physics introduces the results and methods of empirical atomic physics in a careful and easy way, and also conveys the tools of quantum theory and especially the interaction between experiment and theory. In addition to extensive updates, this eighth edition contains new sections on quantum mechanical treatment of the atom in magnetic field and in the electric field. Further, the chapter "Progresses of quantum physics: deeper understanding and new applications" contains detailed explanations on the interlinking of wave functions, the Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen Paradoxon, the Bellian imbalances, the paradox of Schrödinger's cat and the concept of decoherence. The last chapter introduces the fundamentals of quantum theory of chemical binding, which is continued in the second volume of the authors "Molecule Physics and Quantum Chemistry". 167 exercises with complete solutions round off the book and serve to deepen the study.
content.title_en: Atomic and quantum physics

content.text: Internship in Physics. This book offers an ideal introduction to physical internships for students of physics, science, engineering and medicine.

content.text: The book is a summary of 140 outstanding names and keywords of organic chemistry. In an alphabetical overview, the focus is on the graphic description of the reaction mechanisms, and on variants and side reactions. Special emphasis is placed on the presentation of modern application examples. Through its alphabetical structure, the book complements textbooks of organic chemistry for all students with chemistry as main or secondary subject.
content.title_en: Name and Tag Reactions of Organic Chemistry

content.text: The logistics department in the automotive industry is engaged in logistics logistics management in the automotive industry. The second edition of this established factory provides a practical and application-oriented knowledge in logistics management in the automotive industry. In addition to the processes of logistics management already proven in practice, the book also presents application-oriented, scientifically sound concepts, such as the Monte Carlo Simulation. This book describes all logistics-relevant planning and series processes in automotive engineering as a basic work. The main focus is the view of the automotive manufacturer, as it has the highest level of requirements and complexity within the global supply network. This book is structured in line with the standard line-back principle of supply chain management, which is based on the planning stages of logistics, starting from the material preparation at the building site, through the internal logistics stages, up to the delivery processes, and is treated consistently.
content.title_en: Logistics management in the automotive industry : Basics of logistics in automotive manufacturing

content.text: This book of financial mathematical exercises is intended to contribute to the consolidation and deepening of basic financial knowledge and knowledge. It is usable independently, but also an ideal addition to the textbook Introduction to the author's financial mathematics. It is an important learning aid that supports exam preparation, but also suitable for self-study for listeners of basic lectures in economic and financial mathematics. The tasks (first part of the exercise book) are mainly from the textbook Introduction to Financial Mathematics. The second part of the exercise book contains the solutions of the tasks, thus serving as a solution book for the aforementioned textbook at the same time. In addition to the thematically arranged exercises, the book contains numerous test exams. The now available 3rd edition of the exercise book has been carefully corrected and improved in many details. In particular, the fact that the effective interest determination has been carried out for a period of time with a payment of less than one year has been predominantly based on the (international) ISMA method.
content.title_en: Financial Mathematical Exercise Book

content.text: Hydrogeological methods. The second revised and extended edition of hydrogeological methods is based on a thorough revision. This concerns in particular the representation of permeability and transmissivity, storage coefficient and pore space as well as the pumping experiments. The chapter on statistical methods in hydrogeology, which many users have estimated, has not been adopted. For this purpose, modern books adapted to electronic data processing have been available in the literature since 1980. New representations are also available for such hydrogeological methods, which some colleagues and practitioners will miss. New additions are chapters on "hydrogeochemistry for practice", the transport of water content, contamination of groundwater and the rehabilitation of groundwater conductors, groundwater monitoring, well ageing and regeneration as well as groundwater replenishment and balance. Hydrogeological system connections are presented sloppyly and illustrated by many illustrative illustrations. This also applies to the definition and derivation of the most important hydrogeological characteristics. Examples inserted in the text allow the user to follow up the solution route and calculation.
content.title_en: Hydrogeological methods

content.text: Image processing and object recognition : Computer vision in industry and medicine. This book explains how information is automatically extracted from images. The book is used to explain the mathematical foundations of many methods of 2D and 3D image analysis as well as their benefits based on problems from many areas (medicine, industrial image processing, object recognition).The book is suitable for students of computer science, mathematics and engineering sciences as well as for users of industrial image processing.The content - filter design in the frequency room - filter in the space - color image processing - 3D geometry - camera calibration - 3D reconstruction - tensors in image processing - machine learning, characteristics and object recognition - elemental mathematical aids The target groups - students of computer science, mathematics and engineering sciences - practitioners from industrial image processing The authors Dr. Herbert Süße has been working in research and teaching for years and deals with invariants and their application for 2D image analysis at the University of Jena. Dr. Erik Rodner works as a filter area of image recognition - image processing in the field of objects.

content.text: The reduction of the number of traffic accidents and accident victims represents a central challenge, both from the point of view of public health and with regard to economic burdens. The volume therefore brings together research and practical contributions to different aspects of traffic safety communication. The content of target groups.- Traffic safety campaigns.- Processing of messages of traffic safety communication.- Concepts for accident prevention of the future. The target groups - lecturers and students of media and communication science - researchers and specialists for traffic safety and accident prevention The editor Dr. Christoph Klimmt is University Professor of Communication Science at the Institute of Journalism and Communication Research at the Hochschule für Musik, Theater und Medien Hannover. Dr. Marcus Maurer is Professor of Empirical Methods at the Institute for Communication Science of the University of Bielefeld-Schy-Universität in Hamburg.
content.title_en: Traffic Safety Communication : Contributions of empirical research to strategic accident prevention
