content.text: Engineering of process engineering plants : practical manual with checklists and examples. Phase model of plant project processing -- project preparation and basic determination -- preliminary planning -- design planning -- approval planning -- cost determination -- execution planning. Engineering includes the holistic technical planning of a plant. The total engineering costs for plant investments account for approximately 15 to 30 percent of the investment costs. The engineering provides the basis for establishing the investment decision and for establishing the plant economically and purposefully, and for operating it. Thus, the engineering significantly influences the total cost of the project and the cost-effectiveness of later operation. The book structures the entire engineering process using a phase model. It is a practical manual for each person who conducts plant projects and in particular works on engineering. Numerous checklists, templates and practical examples indicate the way to successful plant planning as well as time and cost savings. The book is to be seen in a series with the author's proven practical manuals for commissioning and documentation of process engineering plants.
content.title_en: Engineering of process engineering plants : practical manual with checklists and examples

content.text: Methods of cultural comparative social research: An introduction. Why culture matters -- Methodological debates -- Aims and course of cultural comparative studies -- Selection procedure -- Questionnaire development -- The collection of social contexts -- Analysis possibilities -- Opportunities and limits of cultural comparison. Cultural comparison is becoming increasingly important as a result of globalization and internationalization of many areas of life. However, there is hardly any German-language textbooks on this topic. The aim of this volume is to present a practical introduction to the methods of cultural comparative research. In particular, the possibilities and limits of cultural comparative survey research are addressed. The book provides a solid basis for a critical approach to cultural comparative studies, but it also provides basic knowledge for the own conduct of cultural comparative research. For the second edition, the contents and literature have been updated.
content.title_en: Methods of comparative social research : An introduction

content.text: Service innovations and electromobility: Automotive trade as a holistic solution provider. The contributions of this collection volume show how automotive dealers can become providers of electromobile solutions. This requires the development of new value-added concepts and innovative services in direct cooperation with the customer in the role of an interactive value-added partner. This results in business models that prepare the automotive trade for the profound changes in the value-added chain "mobility". This is complemented by a new concept for a personnel management geared towards this, so that employees can inspire customers for electromobility, and by practical recommendations for the development of a holistic solution offer in the automotive trade in the transition to electromobility. The content New business models, interactive value-added and HR service-performance innovations for electromobility Effective interactive value-added in the electromobility solutions of the automotive trade Personal management in the context of electromobility Automotive trade The automotive trade as a holistic solution provider Practice transfer: Help for the development of a holistic solution offer The target groups Researchers, lecturers and students of business administration with the emphasis on management, services, trades management in the automotive industry Dr. Heif Heif Heif Heif Heif Heib Heibre and Dr.
content.title_en: Service innovations and electromobility : The automotive trade as a holistic solution provider

content.text: The cores, hadrons and elementary particles: A brief introduction. Phenomena of different typical time or length scales are mostly subject to different laws. Introducing them for the respective scale is the aim of this book. It begins with important facts and model concepts about the structure, about decay and about scattering processes of nuclei. It follows the "zoology" of hadrons and the basic facts of Hadronian scattering processes. The third part of the book gives a short introduction to quantum electrodynamics and quantum chromodynamics. content.text: Decentralized coordination of production/maintenance systems: design and analysis of a map-based approach. The economic design of maintenance measures is a relevant topic in the business administration: by improving the system's state, their performance is to be increased. The case of external maintenance service providers is becoming increasingly important in practice. Here, a decentralized coordination of production and maintenance processes is necessary, which is in line with the autonomy of production and maintenance. Michael Kaluzny proposes an approach based on a Kanban-like control system, in which both production and maintenance settings can be made. In this context, the author deals with the condition-oriented maintenance and dynamic sequence planning of maintenance orders. The content Decentralized coordination of information and goods flow Condition-oriented maintenance Dynamic sequencing of maintenance orders The target groups Dozierende and students of economic sciences with the focus on business information technology, engineering and logistics specialist and executives in the fields of engineering, business mathematics and IT as well as logistics The author Michael Kaluzny holds a doctorate at the Technical University of Dortmund and the University of Dortmund as a department of logistics staff.
content.title_en: Decentralized coordination of production/maintenance systems : design and analysis of a map-based approach

content.text: The triad of owner mobilization: Communicative strategies for revitalizing inner-city districts. Urban development under shrinking conditions -- The inner city in the sign of shrinking upheavals -- Revitalization of inner-city districts -- The importance of property owners for urban development -- Property as a determining factor of urban development. Maximilian Vollmer examines how the mobilization of property owners can succeed in difficult situations even in real-estate economic situations. Against the background of heterogeneous ownership structures and increasing overburden on the part of the owners, the author develops measures and instruments for activ and object-oriented mobilization strategies. These support the revitalization of inner-city districts in stagnating or shrinking housing market regions, which are characterized by the congestion of renovation, empty spaces and an increasing number of non-marketable properties. The content of urban development under shrinking conditions The inner-city urbanization in the sign shrinking-related upheavals Revitalization of inner-city districts The importance of property owners for urban development as a determining factor of urban development The target groups Dozende and student of the urban economy is related to urban planning and urban politics as well as well as to the municipal community.
content.title_en: The Triad of Owner Mobilization : Communicative Strategies for Revitalization of Inner Urban Quarters

content.text: Events as instruments of regional marketing: Development of a reference framework for regional-strategic event impact control. In order to achieve positive effects in the event region, comprehensive event impact control is essential. Julia Köhler develops a reference framework that enables a detailed, multidimensional impact analysis of events in regions and links this impact analysis with the fields of action of regional marketing. The suitability of the reference framework checks the author with an empirical analysis. Their results show that the event develops positive effects on the regional economy and the quality of life of the local population. The reference framework provides a tool for regional marketing, which allows a comprehensive analysis of the effects of events, in order to derive appropriate recommendations for action on the optimal design. The content The use of events in the context of regional marketing Development of a reference framework for comprehensive event impact control The target groups Dozierende and students of social and economic sciences with the focus on regional marketing as well as event marketing and management specialist and executives in the field of regional marketing and in the fields of event marketing The author Julia Köhler is a PhD student at the University of Technology and Commercial Communication. The University of Chemnitz.
content.title_en: Events as instruments of regional marketing : Development of a reference framework for regional-strategic event impact control

content.text: Asset Management for Infrastructures - Energy and Water. Introduction -- Tasks of Plant Management -- Control Functions -- Integration into the corporate organization -- System Landscape in Asset Management -- Subject List. The task of a utility company (electricity, gas, water) is to enable sufficient supply under technical and financial conditions. Due to the changes in these boundary conditions since the first edition, it was necessary to revise or add some sections. This includes the addition of the new maintenance standard (DIN VDE 0109), which was issued by the German Electrical Commission (DKE), as well as considerations on how special procedures from the field of Operation Research can be used to optimize maintenance tasks. Moreover, decentralization in the electrical energy supply requires new planning pre-concepts, which are presented in the section "Network Planning in Smart Grid". These also have an impact on asset strategies. It is shown that the working area "Asset Management" is not yet complete due to the changing framework conditions.
content.title_en: Asset Management for Infrastructures - Energy and Water

content.text: Integral planning of building technology: Preserving drinking water quality - Preventive fire protection - Energy efficiency. With increasing complexity of building technology, counterproductive interactions between the trades and systems are increasingly evident in planning processes of public-commercial as well as private construction projects – regardless of size and investment volume. The individual planning goals – such as operational safety and energy efficiency, the preservation of drinking water quality or preventive fire protection – can often only be synchronised with significant additional costs and delays, especially in advanced planning phases. The present technical book provides a basic understanding of integral planning processes and shows how goal conflicts between the trades can be successfully avoided or at least minimized in the early phase of a project concept. Numerous practical examples explain to the specialist engineer potentially risky interfaces. Finally, based on current laws and regulations as well as latest findings from research and teaching, numerous tips are given for everyday planning practice.
content.title_en: Integrated planning of building technology : maintenance of drinking water quality - preventive fire protection - energy efficiency

content.text: Language processing - Basics and methods of speech synthesis and speech recognition. content.text: Energy transition. But fair! : how to make energy future socially sustainable. Do you also have to afford a juicy supplementary payment for electricity and heating costs? Energy becomes more expensive – this hurts especially those who already have to turn every euro twice. Should we therefore again use (meaning cheap) nuclear power? Michael Kopatz shows that it goes beyond flat polemics. He presents measures with which the energy transition can be achieved fairly and socially compatible. The focal point is a national action programme against energy poverty. It includes, among other things, the avoidance of electricity barriers, socially oriented renovation programs for buildings and professional energy consulting in the household. Only if the energy transition is fair and accepted in the population can it succeed. Dr. Michael Kopatz, social scientist with the focus on environmental policy, has been a member of the Wuppertal Institute for Climate, Environment, Energy since 1997. He is currently investigating the extent to which the energy transition is particularly burdened by low-income households and which solutions are available.

In the years 2000 to 2008 the statutory labour market policy of the Federal Government (SGB III) was supplemented from European Social Fund funds (ESF-BA programme). This report provides the IAB with the final information on its results. The findings of the implementation and impact analyses on ESF support for the vocational training of unemployed people, qualification during short-time work in case of a final job loss, support for the establishment of a business from unemployment and the placement of vocational-related German skills to unemployed people with a migrant background are presented.

content.text: The study examines the impact of the governance of international organisations in implementing their educational policy approaches using the concept of lifelong learning. The author examines the reception and implementation of the idea of lifelong learning in models of educational monitoring and education reporting based on three European countries (Germany, Finland, Greece). Although the interpretations of the concept differ in the countries studied due to different cultural traditions, the findings of the study confirm the establishment of lifelong learning as a forward-looking vision and the control potential of international organisations.

content.text: Truth and Usefulness: Self-descriptions of science between autonomy and social relevance. Modern science defines itself as a self-purpose striving for truth, while at the same time it has the practical benefit of new knowledge in mind. David Kaldewey reconstructs the genesis and significance of this double reference by means of historical-sociological semantic analyses. He shows how the two objectives condense in diverse autonomous discourses and practice discourses. The tension between these discourses is shown to be constitutive of the dynamics of modern science from a differentiation-theoretical perspective. Biographical note: David Kaldewey (Dr. phil.) teaches and conducts research at the Forum Internationale Wissenschaft der Universität Bonn. He is called upon to the junior professorship for scientific research and sociological theory and leads the junior research group »Development, Research and Handling of Major Social Problems«.

content.text: Performance : the final stage of ideology. Long description: The term "performance" is omnipresent in politics, economy and society. However, the question of what performance is usually followed by silence. Lars Distelhorst goes to the bottom of this void in his essay and thus is able to practice a profound critique of the "performance society". He shows that every speech about performance leads to an indissoluble contradiction. What lies behind the term "performance" is no less than the emptiness of a society whose center is to be sought in the accumulation movement of capital, while it plays the last maps of ideology. Biographical note: Lars Distelhorst (Dr. phil.) teaches social science at the Hoffbauer vocational academy in Potsdam. His scientific interest is the critical analysis of today's society.
content.title_en: Performance : the final stage of ideology

content.text: The crisis of the boys: Phenomena description and explanatory approaches. Can gender differences be observed for a particular phenomenon area?2. Can these gender differences be explained by other factors besides gender?3. Are there any indications that these gender differences have changed in any way in the past years?

content.text: The Science & Technology Studies are an interdisciplinary and, above all, international research field that deals with the interrelationships between science, technology and society. content.text: Complexity and truth: Science in the field of tension between description, interpretation and distortion. The increasing complexity of modern societies brings with it, in addition to progressive pluralism, degenerate interpretation techniques. In its field, the question arises whether and how the quest for knowledge can be asserted against ideologies, populisms, conceptual disparity, economization, etc. The present metascientific study combines contributions from philosophy, historiography, political science, economics, journalism, and legal science; it illuminates science as a field of tension between description, interpretation and distortion. The increasing complexity of modern societies has not only fostered pluralism but also warned methods of interpretation. In the field of academic research, the question of which the pursuit of knowledge and overcome ideas, populism, one-sided concepts, economics etc. is extreme.
content.title_en: Complexity and Truth : Science in the Field of Interpreting, Interpretation and Distortion

content.text: C# 8 with Visual Studio 2019 : the comprehensive manual. The author also introduces in the updated 8th edition in detail the language basics and basic techniques of programming with C (version 8.0), the development of .NET applications as well as the concepts of WPF. All examples are prepared accordingly for the current development environment "Visual Studio 2019" and are available for download via the publishing homepage. Despite the content and structural revision with some new upper and lower chapters, the scope has remained the same. In the intensified focus are now Entity Framework, EDM designers, 2-D graphics and component tests. For expanded collections recommended and usable alongside J. Kotz: "Visual C 2019"
content.title_en: C# 8 with Visual Studio 2019 : the comprehensive manual

content.text: The current update deals with the database language SQL, which is used in the work with databases. When comparing the table of contents (via DNB-Opac) it is shown that the contents of the book are similar to the pre-press (2017). Chapter 1 has been completely revised, new additions have been made to Chapter 6 "Users, Roles and their Permissions" and Chapter 12 "Change Table Structures", so that this edition has two more chapters. Due to deletions of some sub-chapters, scope and price remain unchanged. Finding in gray stored clue boxes: important tips and important information summarized at the end of each section. In addition, the book's website, all sample databases (MySQL 8.0.16, PostgreSQL 11.2, MS SQL Server 2017) and their installation instructions are provided for download. The author himself goes into the book more closely to the installation of the MySQL database under Windows. The old edition should expire, as this still takes into account the old version MySQL 5.6.
content.title_en: Introduction to SQL

content.text: The Digital Counterrevolution : Online Cultural Struggle of the New Right from 4chan and Tumblr to the Old Right and Trump. Cover -- Content -- Introduction - From Hope to ›Harambe‹ -- Chapter 1 - The Leaderless Digital Counterrevolution -- Chapter 2 - The Politics of Transgression -- Chapter 3 - Gramsci and the Old-Light -- Chapter 4 - Conservative Cultural Struggle of Buchanan to Yiannopoulos -- Chapter 5 - From Tumblr to the Campus Wars: Create scarcity in virtue economy -- Chapter 6 - Entry into the mannosphere -- Chapter 7 - Masses of Normalos -- Conclusion - No more funny: The Cultural Struggle Goes offline
content.title_en: The digital counterrevolution : Online cultural struggles of the New Right from 4chan and Tumblr to the Old Right and Trump

content.text: Discourses that we must lead: The Third Enlightenment. We have an opinion on everything, but hardly any arguments - it is time for a new enlightenment movement! Michael Hampe shows why the Third Enlightenment can only be an educational movement. We need to re-create common cultural projects, from which sense and not only wealth arise, in order to neither fall into violence, cruelty nor illusions as substitutes in our life experience. Such collective projects and the experiences of intensity associated with them arise from educational processes. Hampe is not about elite formation. It is about the acquisition of a collective creativity that gives us the courage and the ability to not only observe the future, but to shape it.
content.title_en: Discourses We Must Have: The Third Enlightenment

content.text: Design principles and design concepts of software technology : Strategies for poorly coupled, correct and stable software. The author is known for his book on object-oriented design and architecture patterns in software technology. In the second edition he sets the focus a little differently. He begins with the modularization of software systems and the concepts for the construction of modules and then comes to design principles for the reduction of complexity. The intended quality objectives for the design are, among other things, the decoupling of software parts, simplicity and comprehensibility, testability and stability. The most important design and architecture patterns are presented afterwards and evaluated with regard to the achieved quality objectives. Didactically well built. "Learning boxes" give a summary and allow a rapid repetition; "Warning boxes" point to typical, often committed errors. All examples are available in the net. All students of computer science are addressed. Interesting alternative to K. Eilebrecht or R.C. Martin. (3)
content.title_en: Design principles and design concepts of software technology : Strategies for weakly coupled, correct and stable software

content.text: Scrum - short & good. The Framework Scrum is an important tool for agile software management. The official reference is the Scrum Guide. - This second edition of the book here is due to the latest updates of this guide. It begins briefly with the development history of Scrum and then comes to the values, mechanics and working methods of Scrum. Practical tips follow with good consideration of maintenance, the development of Scrum teams and the explanation of the agile values and principles underlying Scrum. The book ends with a bibliography and a glossary that explains essential Scrum terms compactly and at the same time refers to further passages in the book. Very helpful is also a website of the book (with many checklists). - The book is suitable both as a short introduction to Scrum and as a reference work for daily work. (2-3)
content.title_en: Scrum - short & good

content.text: This is the first step in the search for clues, such as the concept of "Media Viability" in both media houses and in media development organisations. This analysis focuses on five countries within different world regions: Ecuador, Uganda, and Tunisia. The concept of "Media Viability" can be best promoted in media development organisations and in public institutions. This analysis focuses on five countries within different world regions: Ecuador, Cambodia, and Tunisia. The concept of "Media Viability" is a first step in the search for clues, such as "Media Viability" in media houses and in media development organisations.
content.title_en: Viability of alternative online news media organizations in developing and transformation countries

content.text: For many years, the author has made a name for himself with books on website programming - but also with video training - as a didactically well-assessed author. The considerable scope of this textbook will hopefully not prevent newcomers who want to design websites from reading. They should not follow the advice to start somewhere in the text, but actually study the basic chapter in detail. With this basis on HTML5 and CSS3, you can get to know the 2nd part, HTML much better and will also like to use CSS as formatting aid in part 3. The responsive web design is especially important because of the increasing smartphone usage, because texts and images can be displayed without loss. Tables, forms and graphic design with fonts, their formatting and orientations are also covered in detail. The register could have been a little more detailed, because not always English terms and analogue German text appear (e.g. float : umfliesen; document type : doctype)
content.title_en: HTML & CSS for stupides

content.text: Formful wood : explorative furniture. Design and construct a furniture made of plywood! An experimental study project started by the famous L-leg by architect Alvar Aalto for the Finnish furniture manufacturer Artek asked about the potential and design possibilities of glued and curved wood. In close cooperation with Artek, 28 students of the architecture of ETH Zurich and the object design of the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences not only put the material on their heads, but also questioned the sensual qualities of the object, its construction as an architectural place and sitting as a social event. The band Formful wood. Explorative Furniture presents the surprisingly unknown faces of a known material, illuminates the respective process of creation and reflects the context in various essays. With contributions by Nicolai de Gier, Florian Hauswirth, Sebastian Kraft, Mario Rinke, Christoph Schindler and Alessandro Oreste Tellini
content.title_en: Formful wood : exploratory furniture

content.text: Utopias for realists: the time is ripe for the 15-hour week, open borders and unconditional basic income. Dutch thinker Rutger Bregman says: ?The real problem of our time is not that we are not doing well or that we could get worse in the future. The real problem is that we can't imagine anything better. ? We have to dare to think the impossible, because only in this way we can find solutions to the problems of our time. Bregman makes clear why the unconditional basic income is a real option and to what extent the 15-hour week can be an answer to the digitization of work. ?Alternatively, for Bregman, is no option, even poverty can be abolished, as he shows by the example of a Canadian city. Bregman's visions are inspiring, his energy is inspiring; he shows: utopias can become reality faster than we think. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Utopias for realists: the time is ripe for the 15-hour week, open borders and unconditional basic income

content.text: Step by step to the thesis : split, formulate, format. This guide accompanies its readers in writing Bachelor's, Master's and PhD theses - from the draft structure to the submission. Not only scientific formalia such as the correct quotation and bibliography, but also the use of an appropriate language and even the implementation in the text processing program are explained step by step.
content.title_en: Step by step to the thesis : split, formulate, format

content.text: The time-scale of metallic materials: guide to thermal-mechanical resistance of iron, nickel and cobalt alloys for designers. Permanent heat exposure makes metals wear. When steels or high-temperature alloys are permanently loaded at more than 40% of their melting point, they are completely different from the shelf life data. The mechanical properties are time-dependent and the strength values available in the usual reference plants cannot be used anymore. In industry, metals are used in the high-temperature range. The problem of designers of such plants is to find reliable data for mechanical design. This book provides you with a first remedy. It provides you with: a reference work with time data of 199 Fe base, 77 Ni base and 23 co-base alloys with explanatory information on mechanical properties at high temperatures; methods for determining time-scale data and their interpolation; instructions for occurrence of creep damage to the time-scale; diagnostics and repair possibilities of creep damage; an MS Excel selection tool, which includes a wide range of application data, for the first time, it includes a wide range of time-based data.
content.title_en: Time-Standing behaviour of metallic materials : Guide to thermal-mechanical resistance of iron, nickel and cobalt alloys for designers

content.text: Patent research and the Internet. The book provides new entrants and experienced searchers with ways to successfully search patents. It provides beginners with basic knowledge about patents and database systems, experienced practitioners with solution-oriented and practice-related approaches to research (keywords, classification CPC, CCD and reference-hunting). NEW in the 5th edition: the global file – the one-stop file inspection at the major patent offices of the world; the common patent classification (CPC) is the new classification standard for research; the new espacenet – the improved version of a classic; the impact of machine learning and artificial intelligence on research; the triumph of computer-based translations; new possibilities for free full-text research; the innovations in patent scope (e.g. chemical structure research).
content.title_en: Patent Search and Internet

content.text: RESTful Go APIs: Design and implementation of lightweight hypermedia services. All build APIs. Roughly estimated to consist of 80% of today's developed applications in the core of one or more server-side components that encapsulate business logic and provide them to their clients via a RESTful API. If the REST paradigm is understood, then REST APIs are clear and easy to use. Go is a simple, compiled and highly performant programming language that is excellent for developing REST APIs. Features such as easy learning, a simple and powerful concurrency model, very good HTTP, REST and JSON support, cross-platform capability, simple deployment and highly performant binaries characterize Go. This book is aimed at server-side web developers and introduces the essential aspects of REST development in Go based on an initially simple and complex book-course example. After reading, the reader is able to develop REST APIs in order to be able to use first part of Go's business and to use the Dip to grow in Dip.
content.title_en: RESTful Go APIs : Design and implementation of lightweight Hypermedia Services

content.text: Forgiveness, reconciliation, forgetting: sociological perspectives. The topic of "forgiving" is much discussed in the human and social sciences. It can be seen as a universal, anthropological constant of human coexistence, which links its universality to the flaws of human beings. However, despite its wide range, forgiveness in sociology has been rather little considered. Using numerous historical examples of societies hit by a serious human catastrophe, the contributors highlight the indispensability of this category for social theory and emphasize the hitherto scarcely systematically exploited social-funding potential of forgiveness
content.title_en: Forgive, reconcile, forget : sociological perspectives

content.text: Initial orientation for refugees: a hand-out from the practice of social work. The book offers a theoretical and practical introduction to a special part of social and educational work with refugees. Different concepts, formats and practices of initial orientation are discussed. Based on the results of the scientifically accompanied initial orientation project HO:PE of the Refugee Center Hamburg, best practice approaches for social-space-oriented social work and educational work are presented, which help refugees with goal-oriented and systematic initial orientation. The range of practical approaches covers a range of courses for refugees as well as other formats, e.g. information presentations or training courses for volunteers. Furthermore, readers receive theoretically sound background knowledge on initial orientation and empowerment of refugees as well as on didactic and methodological foundations for educational work. A special focus is also on the empowerment potential of initial orientation, social space activation and social space-oriented social work within the framework of initial orientation.
content.title_en: Initial orientation for refugees: a practical approach to social work

content.text: The WordPress 5 book. Also the 4th edition (3rd edition: 2017) of the title contains step-by-step instructions, starting with the installation of WordPress up to the development of the own website or the blog with WordPress. The comparison to the predecessor shows that the author has streamlined the content in some places and expanded it in others. The structure of the book has remained the same. It is still divided into nine chapters. Contents and illustrations have been adapted to the new system WordPress 5. In addition to the most important innovation, the Gutenberg editor (Chapters 3 & 5), seven new topics have been added in the chapter. The author has produced in addition to the installation of WordPress and FileZilla videos, which he provides (links to this in the book). In addition to this book there is a website with all important links. In addition to the more detailed Peter Müller: "Entry into WordPress 5" (2019) to the inventory supplement or first purchase. In view of the innovations by the project "Gutenberg" the advance requirement to be completed, older editions delete.
content.title_en: The WordPress 5 Book

content.text: High Frequency Technology : Basics of mobile communication technology. Wireless technology enjoys increasing popularity and popularity, especially in the areas of communication, identification and navigation. This textbook provides a clear and understandable insight into the basics of mobile communication technology. The book provides an overview of the concepts, concepts and methods of high frequency technology. The main development tools are presented and current questions and problems are addressed and explained from the practical perspective. The book is aimed at students of electrical, information and communication technology as well as engineers in practice. On the website of the book there are sample solutions and animated 3D simulations: http://www.fh-dortmund.de/gustrau_high Frequency Technology
content.title_en: Radio frequency technology : Basics of mobile communication technology

content.text: Regenerative energy systems: Technology - Calculation - Climate Protection. Regenerative energy systems – the standard work for students and practitioners. In the 10th edition this standard work covers the full range of regenerative energy systems – from solar thermal energy and photovoltaics to wind and hydro power, to geothermal energy and biomass use. It is aimed at students of electrical, energy and environmental technology as well as scientists and engineers in research and industry. The book also addresses developments such as power-to-gas technology and necessary technology paths for a successful complete energy transition. New in this edition are among other things requirements for the implementation of the decisions of the Paris Climate Protection Agreement (including an evaluation of German coal exit plans) as well as current developments in battery storage in photovoltaics and in storage forms in hydroelectric power plants. Numerous calculation examples and graphics illustrate the different technologies and calculation methods. The author's website (www.volker-quaschning.de) provides as one of the largest independent portals on the subject of further information.
content.title_en: Regenerative energy systems : Technology - Calculation - Climate protection

content.text: Simulation of electromagnets with FEMM and Modelica. Electromagnets have been one of the preferred solutions for the realization of movements over short strokes for decades. Therefore, there are a variety of proven analytical and numerical methods available to the engineer for the design of electromagnets. This book provides the basics for the application of electromagnets. The author shows, using the example of a simple electromagnet like a product, how to design, calculate, build and test. It covers all the necessary areas of knowledge: the mathematical and physical basis; the magnetic materials used; the complete working process from the first design to the final measurement; the geometry-based simulation with "Finite Method Magnetics" (FEMM); the equation-based simulation of magnetic networks with "OpenModelica Connection Editor" (OMEdit). For the simulations, free software is used, which allows the reader to re-enact the presented techniques directly on his own computer and thus solve tasks. The book combines all the capabilities required for the design of electromagnets to provide a coherent whole-based understanding of these methods.
content.title_en: Simulation of electromagnets with FEMM and Modelica

Adequate material for Craig Walls to present a new, thoroughly revised edition of its best-selling "Spring in use". In this comprehensive introduction you will find everything you need to know about Spring 5.0. They enter with the basic concepts of Spring and then get to know the framework quickly. The book offers a fun reading and at the same time valuable information that Spring developers cannot miss.
content.title_en: Jumping in action
