content.text: The energy transition in Europe: a vision of progress. Europe needs a new vision of progress. An energy transition has this potential. It can give the "European idea" a forward-looking content. The goal for 2050 is clear: a Europe without fossil and nuclear energy! This is not utopia. Studies, decisions of the EU and some member states prove that this vision is feasible and has many advantages: more jobs, more security of supply, less premature deaths from air pollution, reduction of resource conflicts, falling energy costs. New green key markets for renewable energies and resource efficiency arise. A European energy transition requires an alliance, ideally fueled by the neighbours France and Germany. Many hope to conclude Germany as a driver of nuclear and coal exit. But "revolutionary goals" is not enough: to finally implement them - Germany and Europe are waiting for this book.
content.title_en: The energy transition in Europe: a vision of progress

content.text: The future of information science : does information science have a future? ; Fundamentals and perspectives - offers in teaching - on the front lines of information science. Leading information scientists discuss whether information science needs a new paradigm. They ask themselves how they should adapt their teaching to new challenges in practice, for example the new flood of false and false information, and how students should better introduce them to sophisticated research and source criticism, for example, in conjunction with scientific libraries. Information science research covers a heterogeneous range of topics and comes to important results, e.g. in the areas of smart cities and smart counties, semantic web, information behavior, big data and research infrastructure. These and other areas will determine our future far into our everyday lives. How we manage these challenges, information science opens up new and necessary perspectives for this. (Verlag)
content.title_en: Future of Information Science : Does Information Science have a future? ; Basics and Perspectives - Offers in Teaching - at the fronts of Information Science

content.text: Revolution 1918/19 in Prussia: City routes to the founding of democracy. "Press was only one of 25 countries of the German Republic which emerged in November 1918, but it comprised 60% of its population. This volume examines the revolution 1918/19 with studies on Berlin, Breslau, Frankfurt am Main, Hanover, Cologne, Magdeburg and the Ruhr region. Daily newspapers of the political main directions are used with emphasis on the social democratic and liberal tendencies that dominate in big cities. In addition to the workers and soldiers councils, the view of the election campaigns to the National and Prussian Assembly in January 1919 and little later to the municipal parliaments, which were elected for the first time on the basis of the same voting rights of all at least 20-year-old women and men. Only the revolution 1918/19 led to the founding of democracy; it was also more effectively founded in the urban areas considered in the political conflict fields than the statements of the Weimar Republic which assumed for a long time the end of the period."
content.title_en: Revolution 1918/19 in Prussia : City routes to the founding of democracy

content.text: What is at stake now is my call for peace and freedom. Publisher's info: 30 years after the fall of the Wall: Mikhail Gorbachev on the dangerous disorder of the world. Thirty years after the end of the East-West conflict, peace in the world is once again in danger. The US President announces the disarmament agreement with Russia, Europe is crumbling, China is pushing forward and a wave of nationalization and ideologization is threatening the freedom and self-determination of the peoples. Mikhail Gorbachev, the last great statesman of the 1989 revolution, warns against a war against all in the face of the dangerous world situation. He describes the inability and unwillingness of the current political leaders to work on international solutions. He is dedicated to the great challenges of our time, such as the crisis of democracies and the advance of populists and ideologists, and is committed to dialogue and understanding. Not least, he is dedicated to Germany, to which he, thirty years after the fall of the Wall, is still particularly connected today.
content.title_en: What is at stake now: my call for peace and freedom

content.text: Invisible women: like a world dominated by data, half of the population is ignored. British journalist and active feminist, in thematically structured, German first edition, explains that in almost all scientific data collection, only the male pattern is used as a normal measure, and that the female perspective has been forgotten or considered unnecessary. "Women are highly visible when treated as the subordinate gender, but invisible when it really counts - when it comes to being visible, so to be scientifically captured." The author demonstrates in numerous examples from Europe, USA, Asia for working life, urban and traffic planning, medicine, housing, refugee care etc. that the existential needs of women are completely ignored. In her opinion, the closing of the gender-specific data gap would all benefit. This volume with over 1,000 sources is also suitable for teaching in upper secondary school II. (1 S)
content.title_en: Invisible women: like a data-controlled world, half the population is ignored

content.text: The secret bond between man and nature: amazing insights into the seven senses of man, the heartbeat of the trees and the question of whether plants have a consciousness. How much are we still connected to nature? Peter Wohlleben is convinced: The bond between man and nature is strong and intact until today, even though we are not always aware of this: our blood pressure normalizes in the surroundings of trees, the color green calms us, the forest sharpens our senses, he teaches us to smell, hear, feel and see. Conversely, plants also react positively to human contact. On the basis of recent scientific findings and his own decades of observations, Peter Wohlleben opens our eyes to the hidden interaction of man and nature. He takes us into a wonderful cosmos in which man does not appear as a superior being, but as a part of nature like any plant, every animal. And he makes us aware that it is in our own interest to preserve this valuable good. (Verlagsinfo)
content.title_en: The secret bond between man and nature: amazing insights into the 7 senses of man, the heartbeat of trees and the question of whether plants have consciousness

content.text: Procedures for software architecture : combinable practices in times of Agile and Lean. The practical-oriented technical book is now available in 3rd edition (1st edition: 2013) and offers software developers and architects problem-oriented and combinable procedures as a vision of current architecture projects. Each new edition of the title has been updated and extended by a comprehensive chapter. These chapters deal with the correct application of the procedure patterns as well as the interaction of agile scaling and architecture. The title is suitable for expanded collections and is complementary to the introduction to the software architecture of M. Gharbi as well as the practical-oriented guideline of G. Starke
content.title_en: Procedures for software architecture : combinable practices in times of Agile and Lean

content.text: The only thing that prevents the exercise of the profession from being able to perform the tasks of the profession is the exercise of the profession. This leads to fluctuations that exacerbate the crisis in the health care sector. This resulted in a survey of about 300 nursing professionals who can act according to the values of their professional ethics, are more satisfied with their work and stay in the profession for longer. The author outlines the path that has led to this dilemma in four steps: she looks back on the historical development of the nursing profession, analyses the changes in nursing caused by the economicization, analyses the changes in helping professions and describes the effects on the nursing profession today. In a fifth step, she shows solutions to help people.
content.title_en: Value added : the crisis in the care profession

content.text: Introduction Plastic recycling: economic, ecological and technical aspects of plastic waste recycling. This book shows the true and often underestimated market potential of plastics recycling by highlighting economic, ecological and technical aspects of the topic. It is aimed at both technical and non-technical readers, including decision makers of material suppliers, manufacturers of plastic products, government authorities, teachers and all those who have a general interest in plastic recycling. First, an overview of the waste recycling systems is given. Here, different methods of recycling are considered from an ecological and economic perspective. As recycling of plastic waste is essential from an ecological point of view, common strategies and new approaches are presented to both increase the recycling rate and improve the recycling economically and technically. This includes the analysis of various processing processes and the resulting material properties of recycled plastics. Finally, a global outlook of plastics recycling is given, which considers industrial, transformation, threshold and developing countries differentiated.
content.title_en: Introduction Plastic recycling : economic, ecological and technical aspects of plastic waste recycling

content.text: Identities: the fiction of belonging. As the son of an English woman from the upper class and a Ghanaian who is part of the aristocracy of his country, several identities are pending the professor of philosophy who teaches in New York by his origin. In the USA living as black and gay, this points to further identity features and makes clear that the categories of origin, religion, skin color, class, culture can never be rigid classifications to which people are clearly defined. Such a definition leads to misunderstandings and errors - e.g. when it comes to the fictitious "purity" of the nation. Many ideas about identities need to be reinterpreted and negotiated. - Appiah writes in clear diction, elegantly formulated and documents everything with examples of history and literature. He shows that identities can be lived completely differently beyond the clichés. Although he thus refutes right positions, this is not a disputable script, but a plea for diversity and respect. Encouraging and topical. (2-3)
content.title_en: Identities : the fictions of belonging

content.text: Ringstraße is everywhere: texts about architecture and city 1992-2007. Why do the Austrians gold-plated their architectural monuments even when they fall into dust? Why do the Germans build their automobile temples? And what happens when Ernst Neufert meets Buster Keaton in Graz? Since 1992 the texts of Christian Kühn in the Feuilleton of the daily newspaper "Die Presse", which is considered the leading index of Austrian architectural development, enrich the critical discussion about architecture and urban development. Kühn's texts are aimed above all at curious city and house dwellers who want to get to know and understand architecture as a medium of social change, not only at the specialist audience. Ringstraße is everywhere its best texts from 1992 to 2007: 120 essays that feel the architecture of our time on the tooth.
content.title_en: Ringstraße is everywhere : Texts about architecture and city 1992-2007

content.text: The origin of the Bible: from the first texts to the Holy Scriptures. This book describes the long way from early narratives of ancient Israel to key texts of Jewish monotheism and early Christianity to sacred books of world religions Judaism and Christianity. Anyone who wants to know how such a historical miracle could come should read this biography of the most famous book in the world.[Verlagsseite]
content.title_en: The Origin of the Bible: From the First Texts to the Holy Scriptures

content.text: New dark age: the victory of technology and the end of the future. A Japanese tourist family follows their navigator to the ocean on the coast of Australia, although the road has long since disappeared. The Rangers in the Death Valley in Arizona also know this phenomenon, that non-residents trust technology more than their own senses. They even have a very own term for it: "Death through GPS". But this macabre "automation bias" is only a parable for the situation in which mankind is today. While new technologies are advancing ever faster and more massively to the last corners of our lives, we are less and less able to adapt them to our needs. They have long since become a threat to human life forms. In a rapid Tour de Force, James Bridle, the "Orwell of the 21st century", leads us through the technological dystopia of the present - from climate change and the Internet to the automation of the working world and omnipresent data acquisition. But he shows even more: We have to learn to think differently about a world that has become unpredictable if we want to find ourselves in our "New Dark Age" (Verlag).
content.title_en: New dark age: the victory of technology and the end of the future

content.text: Frankfurt's new old town. It was hardly possible to resurrect the old town bombed by war between the cathedral and the Romans. But today Frankfurter no longer comes out of the wonder. Around the chicken market, now the most beautiful square in the city, a small new world has emerged, which with taverns, shops and even a barber has not only become a magnet of the tourist masses. It is as if Frankfurt in its center has received a soul in addition to a new heart. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Frankfurt's new old town

content.text: We are the climate! : how we can save our planet at breakfast. Climate change is too abstract, so it leaves us cold. Jonathan Safran Foer reminds us of the power and necessity of joint action and gives us many good examples that should serve as an incentive. Foer shows a solution approach that does not require anyone much, but is extremely effective. (publishing)
content.title_en: We are the climate! : how we can save our planet at breakfast

content.text: Sabotaged reality : or: When journalism becomes the doctrine of the faith. Klöckner works in general on "the ruler" [sic], criticises censorship, "closeness to rule", "mental corruption" and social origin of most journalists. As a scaffold the sociologist Foucault, Bourdieu, Luhmann. He has proven his sources, his language is rather demanding. Again and again he calls on the readership to let everything affect itself. Klöckner seems to see everything clearly, and he has a tendency to excite. With examples he takes so-called leading media such as the "mirror" or the "today journal" under the microscope, also brings legitimate criticism. What other than bad style, lack of research or as a product of a lack of time in the fast media business has to do with him, has a system. - His book is to be understood as a contribution to the discussion, in the sense of the diversity of opinion relevant, demand is expected.
content.title_en: Sabotaged Reality : or: When Journalism Becomes the Doctrine of Faith

content.text: Future food: the future of world food. A journalistic journey into the world of food production shows the diverse approaches to how the growing world population can be fed sufficiently today and in the future. Review: A project team led by the FAZ editor (cf. J. Grossarth: "From the land into the mouth", 2016) has looked around the local area how food is produced today and what forward-looking approaches are available or researched for the diet of the growing world population. In the well-readable reports, for example, the life of a small farmer in Zambia is compared to that of a German farmer. The opening of new food (bills, insects, algae) and experiments in Dutch greenhouses as well as in vegetable cultivation in hostile areas (desert, Iceland) are also addressed as problems of climate change (stick substance, monoculture) or eco-farming versus industrial agriculture etc. - Unlike L. Weingärtner: "Handbook World Food" 2011), Grossarth presents no overall concept but leads to journalistic growth in a different way.
content.title_en: Future food : the future of world food

content.text: Urbs: Rome's path to the world metropolis. Publisher's info: How does a small town made up of straw and clay huts become a world city? How does a small village become the centre of a world empire? This biography of the Eternal City tells the vivid and unprecedented history of Rome from the first beginnings of an extraordinary human adventure until the heyday of Augustus. The history of the city of Rome is the history of the conquest of the Mediterranean and the establishment of a world empire. Rome is at the centre of this first globalization of history. Century after century, victory for victory, the Romans wrote the progress of their conquests in the area of their city, which thus became a stone monument in which the Romans could read their history and celebrate a collective identity. The expert Alexandre Grandazzi draws a unique panorama of the early times of Rome from the origins to the death of Augustus, who fundamentally changed the city's politics and face with an epochal construction program for the coming centuries. Taking into account the most important topics, from the environment and topography, to the ethnic composition and material culture, to the history of the city, to the success of Latin, to the city, to the history of the history and the history
content.title_en: Urbs : Rome's Way to the World Metropolis

content.text: The global Green New Deal: why fossil-fired civilization collapses around 2028 - and a bold economic plan can save life on Earth. Around the globe, the mood is falling, and the millennials' protest against a policy that destroys their future is becoming louder and louder. At the same time, the world is sitting on a $100 trillion dollar bubble of investment in fossil fuels in the face of alternative technologies. Future researcher Jeremy Rifkin shows how this constellation creates a unique chance for a Green New Deal. His warning: The economic collapse of our civilization is imminent. Around 2028, the bubble will burst and the world economy will lead to a global operational disruption. What does this mean for us, where the energy transition has long been on the agenda? Will a joint radical break-up in the last minute? (publismatic text)
content.title_en: The Global Green New Deal: Why Fossil-fired civilization collapses around 2028 - and a bold economic plan can save life on Earth

content.text: Democracy: a form of life that is at risk. Liberal democracy has long been taken for granted. Now it is in crisis. It is becoming increasingly clear that democracy is fragile and needs care. It does not exhaust itself in editorials or talk shows, in the corridor to the ballot box or in parliamentary debates. It is not just a form of rule. If we want to be more than clumsy democrats, according to Till van Rahden, we must cultivate the forms of interaction, strengthen the culture of conflict and expand the public spaces that enable us to experience equality as freedom and democratic virtues in everyday life. Democracy is also experienced in the park and in the swimming pool, in the kindergarten and in the playground, in the school and in the family. This book highlights the history of the Federal Republic, which makes its social and cultural conditions clear. Instead of complaining about the decline of democracy, it is important to sharpen our awareness for it. Democracy is nothing less than a form of life.
content.title_en: Democracy: a life-form at risk

content.text: Ghosting: the untracked disappearance of man in the digital age. Movingly, ?Ghosting?-affected people report how silence affects them, as if they had had to deal with a ghost or ghost in the disappeared. Was the other person there at all or was it all just imagination? Clara is left by her friend from one minute to the other. His phone is logged off, his emails come back and she has to find out after weeks that he has planned his disappearance exactly. Who ?gehosted? is going to live on as if this intense relationship and an abrupt separation had never existed. Digitization favors this frightening development. With a lot of empathy Tina Soliman traces the backgrounds that the phenomenon of ghosting is playing off against.
content.title_en: Ghosting: the traceless disappearance of man in the digital age

content.text: Diversity in the classroom: gender and sexual diversity in school and teaching. This teacher's handout focuses on a topical topic. The gender question about male/female/divers is also important in schools. Cultural, social and religious diversity among pupils is well known and there are some literature on inclusion in schools. Here, the professionally experienced author team has compiled everything relating to the topic "Discrimination and sexualised violence in school". Part A deals with basics, theoretical knowledge and legal aspects, part B proposes action strategies for the college, student and school and part C materials, ideas and practical examples for teaching. Also, the anti-discrimination project "School of Diversity" is presented, which is coordinated by Frank G. Pohl. Supplemented to contact points/consultation for help for the students, this volume wants to sharpen the focus on the topic. Other aspects of gender-conscious inclusive education are not known to me. For larger stocks or corresponding users recommended. (3 S)
content.title_en: Diversity in the classroom : gender and sexual diversity in school and teaching

content.text: Plant whispers : how and why plants communicate : a short history of the evolution of plants. Books such as "Thinking animals" (R.D. Precht 2016) or "The secret life of trees" (P. Wohlleben 2015) have been accompanying us for some time in overcoming a purely anthropocentric nature consideration. In this whisper, the graduate biologist and herbal teacher not only listens to the plants, Molenkamp understands herself as a lawyer of plants whose abilities go beyond the processes to be described chemically and physically alone. In doing so, she takes it far out and lets the reader witness the evolutionary process. No textbook, but very instructive, scientifically sounded, but always explained in a layman's way, very pictorial, sometimes daring comparisons to our everyday life without anthropomorphisms or to cross the line to esotericisms; relatively economically illustrated, however, what is recommended in the well-designed text with clever headings, tabular overviews, colour-departed quotations and many good formulations.
content.title_en: Plant whispers : how and why plants communicate : a short history of the evolution of plants

content.text: More justice! : we need a new land order - only then housing will be affordable again. For many years the issue of affordable housing was a shadow that existed until it came to the public again in 2019. The media report in detail, politicians comment, the real estate industry prepares argumentatively, citizens' initiatives demand the expropriation of private carriers or the repatriation of housing into government hands after the privatization waves of the last decades. For many, adequate housing is now unaffordable due to the rising rents. The previous political measures, such as the rent-price brake, prove to be a blunt sword in the fight against the seemingly unstoppable increase in housing. Because for a long time hardly anyone has noticed the actual reason behind the price explosion: the dramatic increase in building land prices. Germany over the last decades, the construction land prices increased by 1900 percent. Only Hans-Jochen Vogel's persistent struggle put the topic back on the agenda. (publishing text)
content.title_en: More justice! : we need a new land order - only then will housing be affordable again

content.text: By Powers and People : 15 short world stories. Handy history book, which briefly reproduces world history. Review: In this new edition, formerly published under the title "Die Nase der Cleopatra" (2011), world history is reproduced in short chapters. Posted by historian and history professor Wolfgang Reinhard, who became known to a broad audience in 2016 with "Die Unterwerfung der Welt: Globalgeschichte der europäischen Expansion" (2016). Reinhard takes up certain events, concepts or persons in his individual chapters and describes the respective events and consequences, partly similar events. - Recommended for new acquisition. May also be used for school-leaving students to prepare for a brief overview of world history. (2 S)
content.title_en: By Powers and People : 15 Short World Stories

content.text: Marriage and the Kingdom of Heaven: Woman and Man in the early Christianity. A presentation of the most ancient experiences of Christians on the subjects of sex and gender roles is a commandment of the hour. It will be admired that in Jesus' knowledge a phase of marriage-criticalness follows. He vehemently opposed discrimination, in his vicinity women are not only responsible for the faith in Easter, but also for the emergence of Christology. His high point reaches the book with the interpretation of the 5th chapter of the Ephesian letter: The frugal and marital love between man and woman is a pattern and template for the relation of the Messiah to his people of God. In his new book Klaus Berger shows cautiously and provocative lines that led from the New Testament to a sexual ethics of the future, and provides building blocks for a biblical sexual morality of the future. The question is whether there is a connection between the faith in the threefold God, who is the God of Abraham, and the retention between man and woman, sexualitat and marriage, but the most important thing is to say the Bible, the fact that the relationship of marriage is increasingly questionable.
content.title_en: Marriage and Kingdom of Heaven : Woman and Man in the Early Christianity

content.text: We want to choose more than just: how we can save democracy. In view of falling voter turnout and the loss of confidence in political leadership, we need to think about other democratic formats. The book is a plea for new forms of democratic participation. Listening, discussing, co-decision. Review: political discontent, falling voter turnout on the one hand, demonstrations and protests in the streets on the other. The representative democracy no longer reaches many people, they turn away because they no longer feel they are heard. The loss of confidence in parties is great. How can these democratic manifestations of decay be stopped. What other possibilities for participation exist? The author pleads for a deliberative democracy, i.e. public discourses, genuine citizen participation in decision-making processes, especially at the municipal level. The author spoke with people in other countries where direct democracy is practised. There is the citizen's meeting in Ireland, the country laws are prepared, the referendums in Switzerland. In Madrid 49 randomly selected citizens consult with municipal decisions. People's decisions are rarely anchored in all German constitutions, but the author's are rarely held.
content.title_en: We want to vote more than just: how we can save democracy

content.text: Smart Factory : Factors of Use - Technology - Products. More than a dozen authors, some of whom are highly skilled, deal with the fourth industrial revolution driven by the increasing digitalization of products and their production. This collection of articles from the series "Modern Production" is divided into five topics: Digitization - Factors of Use - Technology - Processes - Logistics, with the focus on production and logistics. It is about the prerequisites and possibilities for the transition from the classical mode of production to the "Smart Factory". On the one hand, it is not really distinguished what is current and what perspective possibilities - i.e. rather trends, perspectives, summaries. On the other hand, it is meticulously defined, what is to be understood by the skills, skills, knowledge and competence of "human capital". Practitioners, managers, managers and business consultants must look specifically for the approaches relevant to them.
content.title_en: Smart Factory : Factors of use - Technology - Products

content.text: App design. For the second edition of the book here, Semler has brought a co-author on board. Together, they introduce the world of app design. Layout and content have been revised and changed in some parts. For example, the high gloss paper has been omitted. The coloured boxes with explanations of terms are no longer on the edge of the text, but under the respective texts. As some chapters and sub-sections have been added, this edition has about 200 pages more, at the same price. Chapter 4 "User Research" is completely new. "Atomic Design" and "Design-Systeme" are new sections in chapter 8. Illustrations and screenshots have been exchanged as necessary. The recommendation also applies: "Overall, a very conclusive overall view of the relevant aspects with high utility value. [...]" (Ch. Eidloth). Suitable for designers, developers, project managers, marketing experts and customers, but also for all curious smartphone and tablet enthusiasts. In this form, no comparison title is known.
content.title_en: App design

content.text: Microsoft Office 365 : the comprehensive manual. Compared to the preliminary edition (last 2017), this comprehensive manual for system administrators was extended and updated. Wherever the work was well borrowed, the old editions should be replaced
content.title_en: Microsoft Office 365 : the comprehensive manual

content.text: In the past, objects in museum collections have often been treated with biocides for their protection and preservation, which, as we know today, are often harmful to health. Some of these results are highly contaminated objects and workplaces in museums, depots and archives. What impact does this have on employees and visitors? What are the possibilities for safe design of collections? An early and informed education is important in order to enable professional handling of contaminated objects and to protect employees at work in the best possible way. Here, the interdisciplinary author's team sets up for an area for which there has been no specific assistance to handle contaminated cultural property. The target group is equally employers and employees in museum facilities, restorative-conservatory areas and workshops. The publication offers comprehensive insights and supports in building up their own knowledge in order to competently guide the necessary measures and to control their implementation.
content.title_en: Handying to handle contaminated collection material

content.text: Urban development in premodern Europe : observations on continuity and breaks. Observations on permanence and change are at the centre of the sketch on urban development in Western Europe. It tries to reshape long-lasting conditions and clear cuts in a wide temporal and spatial perspective, ranging from the consolidation of the new urban lifestyle in the 12th century to the 19th century, when the political reordering and industrialization changed the ideas of the city. Together and partially re-evaluated, epoch-specific findings of historical research on the medieval and early modern city, comparative studies on regional differences in Western Europe and findings of other disciplines involved in urban research are thus combined and partially re-evaluated.
content.title_en: Urban development in premodern Europe : observations on continuity and breaks

content.text: Manual series / Research Institute Geragogik, Dortmund University of Applied Sciences (ed.); Manual 2: Service structures and supply processes in the district. The manual shows solutions for the maintenance and development of sustainable supply structures in the district. In addition to the description of various instruments and steps for the design of a higher-level supply concept, practical methods are presented and illustrated with examples from the QuartiersNETZ project. These include procedures for the assessment of local structures, the participatory development of a supply concept, for addressing, networking as well as cooperation of different actors and models for the financing of supply structures. The final example is a case study, using which the individual elements of a supply concept are explained in practice.
content.title_en: Manual series / Research Institute Geragogik, University of Applied Sciences Dortmund (ed.); Manual 2: Service structures and supply processes in the district

content.text: Handbook Migration and Success : Psychological and Social Science Aspects. Migration and Success -- Identity Development -- Family -- Gender -- Age -- Education and Work -- Health -- Europe and the World- International Representatives The aim of the book is to work on the topic "Migration and Success" in psychological and social science aspects. Marketing research has shown that this perspective is much more developed in migration research, because often problem descriptions dominate the scientific discourse on migration. This certainly applies not only to psychological research, but psychology is not concerned with migration as a whole and even less with successful migration biographies. The perspectives presented on migration, migration patterns and migration society therefore emphasize the opportunities and successes associated with migration. Among other things, what is to be understood by success, what factors influence it and what it is in for individuals, groups or society. This book therefore takes into account issues such as identity development, family, gender, age, education, work and health and relates to success of migration with an international perspective.
content.title_en: Handbook on Migration and Success : Psychological and Social Science Aspects

content.text: Finite Elements Analysis for Engineers : Basics and practical applications with Z88Aurora. FEA with powerful and freely available software. This book provides understandable explanations of the FEA in theory and practice. The reader receives the full versions of the open source FEA program Z88 V14 and the freeware program Z88Aurora for Windows, UNIX/LINUX and MAC on the downloadsite of the authors. The source code of Z88 V14 allows ambitious users to customize the FEA program individually. Z88Aurora is characterized above all by an intuitive graphical user interface. Further calculation methods such as stationary heat conduction, geometrically nonlinear strength calculations and self-vibration calculations are thus feasible. With the help of over 30 examples, which are also included, the reader can get to know the FEA "live" and re-execute it. The 6th edition is greatly expanded, as the range of the advanced software provides completely new possibilities, which previously did not exist. Thus the user can calculate whole construction groups with all interactions of the stress cases, where previously only Ezel parts were possible for the new structural optimization.
content.title_en: Finite Elements Analysis for Engineers : Basics and Practical Applications with Z88Aurora

content.text: Menges Materialkunde Kunststoffe : Rainer Dahlmann, Edmund Haberstroh, Georg Menges. This book - written in the language of the engineer - conveys the knowledge and understanding of the complex material behavior of the plastics. The essential aspects for the engineer are worked out in order to provide a basis for the development of reliable products as well as of material-compliant construction and processing processes. It is written for students as well as for engineers in practice. Text and construction are characterized by compact representation, but without leaving out essentials. Thus, the work offers an easy to understand entry into the material science of polymer materials. It is intended to help the young generation of engineers to apply plastics successfully and in a sustainable manner. The 7th edition has been completely reworked.
content.title_en: Material science Plastics : Rainer Dahlmann, Edmund Haberstroh, Georg Menges

content.text: The survey of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the population of the Union.
content.title_en: Taxes and rules

content.text: The most important fields of decision of the molded parts engineering are: the material, the tool, the production and the part geometry. These fields and their interweaving are described in relation to the higher quality criterion dimensional stability in the present book by experienced authors. The topics of material and tool are discussed in detail. Furthermore, the topic of tolerance management and the influence of the application and production conditions on the shape partial dimension are explained in detail. The focus of all presentations is now in the second edition, the most up-to-date international standard to which many versions refer. A call to form part developers is the acceptance of a content separation of functional tolerances (construction tolerances) and manufacturing tolerances. Information on the state of the GPS standard is given, whereby the form and position tolerance for plastic molded parts is highlighted in particular. Own experiences of the authors and practical examples are to support the readers in the acquisition of the book content. The second edition contains all information on the cutting-edge international standard and the area of project management.
content.title_en: Plastic Moulding Parts : Tolerances and Moulding Parts

content.text: Shopfloor Management and its digital transformation: the best tools in 45 examples: 116 images and 2 tables. Production is ongoing and always improved: Shopfloor Management has two basic objectives. On the one hand, it is intended to support the achievement of the daily goals and specifications of a production area. On the other hand, it is intended to enable continuous improvement of the processes in order to achieve a described strategic state of production. The Shopfloor Manager has a number of tools available to you in this book: Standards; Key figures; Visual Management and Control Circles; Employee Management; Interface Management. The author briefly describes the structure and importance of each tool and shows over the entire book how these tools actually work in real companies. A special focus is placed on the transformation of analogue to digital. As a shopfloor manager, you should not miss this wealth of experience.
content.title_en: Shopfloor Management and its digital transformation : the best tools in 45 examples : with 116 images and 2 tables

content.text: Energy conversion into power and working machines: piston machines - flow machines - power plants. The task of this tried and tested textbook is to give students of all technical departments a complete and easily understandable treatment of the processes in thermal and hydraulic power and working machines, taking into account the constructive and operational basics and special features. In simplified form, an insight into the physical foundations of heat and flow theory is given. Afterwards, the technical processes in piston and flow machines are explained, with particular emphasis on the comprehensibility and physical correct reproduction of the energy conversion processes. There is no shortage of instructions on the design of the machines as well as those for operation. Power plants are dedicated to several chapters because knowledge of the conversion of conventional and alternative primary energies into usable secondary energy is part of the basic technical training. In the eleventh edition, three new chapters on the use of renewable energies are added.
content.title_en: Energy conversion into power and machinery : piston machines - flow machines - power plants

content.text: Flexible production through digitalization: development of use cases. In the future, it will be flexible with digitised production. Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory and are two terms for the prevailing trend that affects every business in the manufacturing sector: the digitalization of all business sectors. This book deals with the possibilities and effects in production. From current challenges to solutions to concrete use cases, the authors give a comprehensive overview: strategy development, adaptation of value creation processes, IT landscape and production infrastructure; business potentials of digitalization using smart product approach; process integration taking into account relevant IT systems such as ERP, PLM, MES; digital application scenarios such as condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, remote field services; outlook for further improvements from current initiatives, market and technology trends. This book presents practical approaches to the digitization of production. You will learn about available methods, technologies and standards. This will be a valuable guide for all responsible decision makers.
content.title_en: Flexible production through digitalization : Development of use cases

content.text: Practice of heat transfer : Basics - Applications - Exercise tasks : with 778 illustrations, 62 tables, 50 fully calculated examples and 168 exercises with over 300 pages of detailed solutions for download. Practical help for understanding heat transfer. This lecture-accompanying teaching and exercise book guides purposefully through the basics of heat transfer and illustrates these in detail using numerous applications and examples from practice. Parallel to the main text, explanations, graphics and images are presented continuously to explain the topics and overcome mathematical hurdles. Numerous tasks for self-study serve as learning goal control and are suitable for exam preparation. To the content: Basics of heat transfer; Mass and energy balances; Stationary heat conduction; Ribs and needles; Instationary heat conduction; Convection; Heat transferers; Heat radiation; Tasks from various topics. Additional program examples in Microsoft Excel for parameter studies and for deepening the topics as well as solutions of the exercise tasks are available as download.
content.title_en: Practice of heat transfer : Basics - Applications - Exercise tasks : with 778 illustrations, 62 tables, 50 fully calculated examples and 168 exercises with over 300 pages of detailed solutions for download

content.text: Teaching English: Differentiation and Individualisation. Heterogeneity in the classroom is a daily routine and a challenge. English teachers are also asked to take this into account with specially tailored learning arrangements. Maria Eisenmann therefore not only introduces the theories of heterogeneity, differentiation and inclusion, but also presents individualizing methods and learning strategies for the practice of teaching.
content.title_en: Teaching English: Differentiation and Individualisation

content.text: The music school is a new kind of music school, which is no longer called school, because it is not a school in the traditional sense of the word. It is rather an open learning house with a variety of music-related educational offers and practical fields of activity, a house that can be entered at any time and in which you can spend as much time as you like to learn, teach, experiment, play, listen, observe and exchange. Designed as a place where music and music culture of the future can occur, which is neither frozen in museum nor under-wandered commercially, the music school can create an educational space in which all participants can learn both for themselves and from each other. The present book presents this vision and shows ways to implement it into practice.
content.title_en: Inventing music school : ideas for a music school of the future

content.text: Le Corbusier - his international work in the UNESCO World Heritage Site. The book presents for the first time all 17 buildings and ensembles of buildings Le Corbusiers, which have been registered in the UNESCO World Heritage List. A generous picture section presents the buildings individually, together with a statement of the extraordinary universal value. In the text section, experts explain the process of transnational application, the methodical procedure and the speciality of the Corbusier work. A contribution to the IBA CityRegion Stuttgart 2027 establishes the current connection to Stuttgart and the Weissenhofsiedlung. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Le Corbusier - his international work in the UNESCO World Heritage Site

content.text: Stochastik: an introduction with basic principles of measurement theory : including numerous explanatory videos. Review (ekz): The author, well-known for his successful introductory textbooks and his successes in university teaching, provides students of mathematics with a sound introduction to stochastics and the theory of measurement and integration. The deliberately redundant and detailed motivations and explanations as well as numerous examples and tasks (including hints and solutions) are also visually and in terms of content. Examples dealing with more complex or general problems are treated separately, important sentences are taken under the magnifying glass in their own boxes and compiled in terms of terms and formulas on a topic. "Background and Outlook" provided boxes cover compact further topics and summaries round off the presentation. Explanation videos are linked via QR codes. The target group is very useful, also in addition to the more sophisticated classic of A. Klenkeke (2013). The contents are based on large-scale further topics and summaries. Explanation videos are linked to QR codes.
content.title_en: Stochastics: an introduction with basics of measurement theory : including numerous explanatory videos

content.title_en: Urban Development Fund: a new instrument to support sustainable urban development?

content.text: Society and Climate: Developments, upheavals, challenges. This book illustrates the highly complex nature of the relationship between society, science and climate. Climate change requires a multidisciplinary approach that captures the networking of the three systems.It is important to recognise that, on the one hand, the climate influences social, political and economic interactions, but on the other hand, it is itself influenced by social structures, technological practices and energy cultures.This is of particular relevance at a time when climate science is under pressure, both by the general public and by policy makers. Not least, this is why Nico Stehr and Amanda Machin warn of simple assumptions and answers, based on the findings of various disciplines and on numerous examples.
content.title_en: Society and climate: developments, upheavals, challenges

content.text: Access 2019 : the comprehensive manual. The author updated the second edition of the new Access version here (1st edition: 2016). It can be seen that the structure and content of both editions are almost identical. The illustrations also show only small differences (1st edition can continue). The book has 46 pages more (i.e. 10 euros more expensive) by adding the new annex. Here you will find an installation guide for Microsoft SQL Server 2017 and a review of the no longer existing Access Web Apps for SharePoint. In addition to all the important basics of Access (database types, database design, forms & tables, field data types & relationships) the practical application (debt creation, data connections, import & export of data, SharePoint lists) and programming (server databases, SQL, macro & VBA programming, DAO class library, access application programs) are not too short in this work. The workshops available in the book serve to provide deeper practical information. Code examples and sample databases are available on the publisher's website.
content.title_en: Access 2019 : the comprehensive manual

content.text: Context: Sinnstiftung in virtual systems. In the globalized present reality and media reality overlap. Through the interaction of simulation and imagination, new meanings are manifested in constantly changing virtual image worlds. Linking relations are thus increasingly limited to the moment of reception and human space seems to be parzelling itself into ever smaller units of individual experience. A comprehensive systematic approach of this world-exploration, fragmented in constantly changing relations between subject and object, must be redefined in the age of virtuality.This book examines the new structures of the discourse spaces of a mass-medial and globalized society. To this end, a model for the recording of virtual meaningful relationships is presented.In a process-based theory on metacontextualization, the appearance of the media and their meaningful transformation into mental processes using a multi-dimensional structure and practical method-knowledge are combined with a concept of virtual meaningful relationships.
content.title_en: Context : Sinnstiftung in virtual systems

content.text:
Social space High-rise building: Neighbourhood and everyday living in Swiss large-scale residential buildings.

The large-scale residential buildings that fundamentally changed the Swiss settlement landscape during the construction boom of the 1960s and 1970s have become increasingly revocable over the years. But how do the realities of life in this building stock – beyond the widespread clichés – shape themselves?
Eveline Althaus focuses on the neighborhoods of high-rise housing settlements in Switzerland. Using house biographies, she examines social-spatial dynamics and highlights how diversity and difference are experienced and (re-)produced in the residential environment. This opens up new perspectives on how to deal with this built heritage and forms of coexistence in increasingly heterogeneous settings.

About living in high-rises build the construction boom years, the potential of social marginalization and the resilience of neo-borods.
content.title_en: Social room high-rise house : Neighborhood and everyday living in Swiss large residential buildings

content.text: Guide to mistreatment and neglect: information for parents, teachers and other persons in contact. The guide describes the various forms of child abuse and neglect. It explains how children and adolescents can be abused or neglected. Furthermore, possible consequences and indications of mistreatment and neglect as well as the legal framework of child protection are presented. Recommendations for action, which arise from these legal regulations, are formulated and the German assistance system with its various participants, such as psychotherapists, counsellors, medical institutions, youth services and the law enforcement authorities are not so easy to understand. The aim is to encourage adults to be attentive and to pay close attention to the children and young people in their environment, to help them out of the dangerous situation and to provide them with appropriate support, if necessary, in the course of coping with them. (Verlagsinformation)
content.title_en: Guide Mistreatment and neglect : Information for parents, teachers and other persons

content.text: Workbook Stochastics. Workbook Stochastics (Introduction and Basic Principles of Mass Theory). This workbook contains the tasks, hints, solutions and solutions of chapters 2 to 8 of the Stochastics textbook: An introduction with basic principles of Mass Theory. By the disclosure of the solutions, the work is ideally suited for self-study, lecture support and exam preparation. The work comprises 332 exercise tasks, which are roughly divided into comprehension questions, proof tasks and computational tasks.
content.title_en: Workbook Stochastics

content.text: Statistical methods in experimental physics. Statistical methods in experimental physics In physics, data analyses are central to the evaluation of experimental results. This textbook starts with the elementary concepts of statistics, shows the most important probability distributions and explains the data analysis methods for experiments in laboratory internships. Furthermore, concepts of modern scientific data analyses from computer simulation to classification with neural networks are presented.
content.title_en: Statistical methods in experimental physics

content.text: Handbook on Social Work and Digitization. What questions, challenges and upheavals is social work confronted with in the context of social digitalization processes? The handbook covers the omnipresent topic of digitalization for the first time comprehensively with regard to discipline and practice of social work. Different disciplinary perspectives, social developments and discourses, digitised forms of service delivery, digitalization in the context of profession, organization and various fields of action as well as new challenges for and forms of research are illuminated. In each of the more than 50 contributions the current state of knowledge is summarized and its importance for social work is worked out. With perspective on organization, specialists, addressees and forms of delivery possibilities, risks and open questions are discussed. The analyses inform decision-makers as well as specialists and students of social work and other social professions. The e-book is barrier-free.
content.title_en: Handbook on Social Work and Digitalisation

content.text: Two-part and inclusion in the empirical focus: results of the evaluation of the Bremer Schulreform. With the school reform in 2009 Bremen has pursued numerous goals to improve school quality. These include inclusion, the reduction of the influence of social cultural disparities on educational success, the flexibilisation of educational paths, improved funding diagnostics, the expansion of the whole-day school system and quality assurance in the Bremer Schulsystem. To what extent these goals have been achieved, this study is evaluated by an expert group. A wide range of data bases have been used for the study. These included, among others, the individual student history data on educational courses and acquired qualifications, the data of the IQB education trend on the student competences achieved, school managers data from the study on the development of full-day schools (StEG) and school statistics on the selection numbers and student composition at the secondary schools as well as a survey of the school managements of the primary schools and secondary schools conducted at the end of the school year 2016/17. Based on these data, however, the results of the optimization are also shown.
content.title_en: Two-part and inclusion in the empirical focus : Results of the evaluation of the Bremen School Reform

content.text: Dealing with diversity: innovative teaching concepts in teacher education for dealing with heterogeneity and inclusion. Heterogeneity is a theoretical construct that can be perceived as a challenge for teacher education. In the present interdisciplinary volume, highly indebtedactic concepts are presented that aim to address the topics of inclusion and heterogeneity to teachers. Subject-specific didactic and educational science offers are equally described in their appendix and presented in relation to different dimensions. This includes the perspectives from which school and teaching are considered, as well as the question of how the student community can be integrated as a heterogeneous group of learners. In addition, there are indications that innovative teaching projects that deal with complex content can be adequately investigated and evaluated. All of the contributions gathered here are based on innovative teaching projects within the framework of quality offensive teacher education at Münster. This funding programme offers the possibility to systematically develop teacher education in the field of inclusion and heterogeneity.
content.title_en: Dealing with diversity : innovative teaching concepts in teacher education for dealing with heterogeneity and inclusion

content.text: DoProfiL - The Dortmund profile for inclusive teacher education. The focus of DoProfiL, the Dortmund profile for inclusive teacher education, is the inclusion orientation in university teaching and research. Inclusion is related to the breadth of diversity aspects: in particular multilingualism, disability, high-level talent, cultural or social origin, gender. This requires an analysis of technical, didactic, special-educational and educational aspects, but also of their interaction. This book therefore contains closely related and interrelated general and cross-disciplinary perspectives, theories and research findings on inclusion orientation as well as subject-related perspectives, theories and research findings from more than 25 subprojects. Similarly, viewpoints are visible as the processes and structures in university development must be designed in order to implement inclusion orientation in a sustainable manner. Communication structures, change management, further qualification and systematically prepared content structures are just as important as the individual people with their individual dispositions, the teaching staff's perspective and the teaching staff's perspective are made to change the way they are taught in the university.
content.title_en: DoProfil - The Dortmund profile for inclusive teacher education

content.text: Digital sovereignty and education: expert opinions. The digital transformation currently taking place permeates almost all areas of life. The sovereign use of digital media becomes the indispensable basis of all educational processes and the prerequisite for preparing the new generation for changing requirements in the profession and society. In his current expert opinion, the Action Council on Education analyses the specific learning objectives resulting from this development for the respective age levels and the associated educational phases. The concept of digital sovereignty makes it clear that digital education must always include an ethically reflective component. To concreteise these target formulations, the Action Council on Education will then finalize general and educational-phase-specific recommendations for action to policy makers.
content.title_en: Digital sovereignty and education : expert opinions

content.text: Drive the monkeys with the pebbles: impulses for health and satisfaction of teachers. Teachers are exposed to numerous stresses in their everyday working life. Many factors, especially external conditions, are difficult to change. Teachers can learn to deal with stress in a healthy way. In particular, their own thinking patterns, their own attitudes and values are possible starting points. In the examination of personal beliefs and attitudes, health can be positively and sustainably influenced. In this health counsellor, teachers find impulses, which focus on the mediation of self-management strategies – underpinned by humorous images, reflection exercises and experiences from school everyday. From the content: - The ten building blocks of active self-management - pebbles – What is really important to you? - Monkeys – Why do you work so often for others and so rarely for yourself? - Gerte – What drives you? - General Eisenhower – How can you work more effectively?
content.title_en: Drive the monkeys with the pebbles : Impulse for health and satisfaction of teachers

content.text: Cultural-sensitive didactics : an introduction to theory and practice : with online materials. What is characteristic of school and teaching, what is regularly perceived? – Answers to these questions describe school and teaching culture. If one wants to design teaching, this means working on the teaching culture. In this basic work, an approach is presented for the first time, which is devoted to the cultural framework for life and learning in the school comprehensively theoretically and practically, the cultural-sensitive didactics. Teaching is described here as a culture-training professional activity. Teachers receive a sound basis to consciously shape the school and teaching cultural framework and to professionally support the education culture: the book opens the view to understand stable teaching practices, to classify their meaning and to derive consequences for school practice, which lead to the concrete design of teaching. A teaching culture always forms – but not necessarily the one desired from a school-pedagogy perspective. What factors play a role here, which design possibilities teachers have and which quality requirements a teaching culture should satisfy is described in this book.
content.title_en: Cultural sensitive didactics : an introduction to theory and practice : with online materials

content.text: Barcamps & Co. : Peer-to-peer methods for further education. Traditional formats of continuing education are too slow and inflexible to respond adequately to the rapid and unpredictable changes in today's world of work and education. Today's practice needs appropriate formats in which practitioners learn from each other and experts share their experiences with each other. This book provides concrete instructions and tips for self-learning and those who support them. The starting point is the Barcamp format, whose preparation and implementation is described step by step. In the second part of the book, 10 more formats for self-training are presented in compact letters. Numerous tips and tricks, materials and details, templates and checklists support the concrete implementation.
content.title_en: Barcamps & Co. : Peer-to-peer methods for training

content.text: City of the Future - Healthy and Sustainable : Building bridges between disciplines and sectors. Many sectors are involved in the social commitment to promoting, protecting and restoring health in urban life. While social disadvantages are perceived by many sides as important, the attention to ecological sustainability in connection with the topic of health has been much lower. However, it is useful to link these topics as a contribution to a socially just and ecologically sustainable urban culture. Starting from a 'world in transition', the authors develop a concept of sustainable urban health as a concept of knowledge and action. Key principles are a 'view field expansion' also in the direction of future care and sustainability as well as a determined 'bridge building' to overcome barriers that still exist all too often between scientific disciplines and social sectors.
content.title_en: City of the Future - Healthy and Sustainable : Building bridges between disciplines and sectors

content.text: Ambivalents of pedagogical action : Reflections on the care of people with "spiritual disability". Educational action is highly complex and ambivalent. Using the example of a home facility for people with "spiritual disability", Hendrik Trescher shows how diverse the challenges are educationally active in everyday life. He also problems how the 'pedagogical core' of action is constantly threatened by internal and external requirements. He discusses theoretically and practically the consequences of this for both pedagogical actors and their addressees. In addition to the analysis of various document types, including interviews, observations, floor plans and service plans, questions about the further development and transformation of residential facilities - also in the context of an inclusion paradigm - are discussed. This book analyses and discusses the complexity of pedagogical action in the context of inpatient assistance for the disabled in a variety of ways - both theoretically and practically.
content.title_en: Ambivalents of educational action : reflections on the care of people with "mental disabilities"

content.text:
Epistemologies of the surrounding area: on the history, ecology and biopolitics of artificial environments.

The rise of the term »environment« to the description of the present day marks the influence that the reflection on environmental relations and the possibility of the technical design of artificial environments since the middle of the 19th century has gained. In closed artificial worlds such as space stations or artificial ecosystems, the entanglement of the »environment« with the surrounding organisms becomes the subject of a biopolitics that today opens up new spaces in autonomous technologies of environmental control. Florian Sprenger pursues this transformation of ecological environmental knowledge with the aim of better understanding current technologies, making the concept indisputable and working out the biopolitical dimension of every ecology.
content.title_en: Epistemologies of the Surrounding: on the History, Ecology and Biopolitics of Artificial Environments

content.text: Spectacle and opportunity space: Art and the long summer of migration. What happened in 2015 was not a preconditionless, sudden appearance and not a crisis of migration, but a crisis of the European border regime. In addition to the stubborn and resistive movements of migration, this time was characterized by civil engagement and numerous art and cultural productions with, for and about refugees. Nanna Heidenreich asks from the 'long summer of migration' about the relationship between hype and possibility space: When will art become a spectacle with migration? What are aesthetic threshold experiences to the claim of political transformation? In what way are climate change and migration connected, of whose future are we talking about? ... And what color does the sea have?
content.title_en: Spectacle and Possibilities : Art and the Long Summer of Migration

content.text: Migration and adult education. What role does migration experience play in adult and vocational further education? To date, migration was poorly considered in further education research and practice, even though migration-based diversity impacts on learning behavior and requirements. Against this backdrop, the author developed approaches for the profession-based and offer development in adult education with a special focus on the various education requirements of adults with a migration background. The text offers the basic foundation for diversity-conscious further education work for students and practitioners of adult education. What role does migration experience play in adult and further education play? Until recently, it is hardly considered in further education research and practice, although migration-related further education work for students and practitioners develops in a variety of ways in the field of academic education.
content.title_en: Migration and adult education

content.text: Trends in continuing education : DIE Trend Analysis 2014. The third DIE Trend Analysis documents structures, processes and results of continuing education based on data from educational reporting and current findings of educational research. The book bundles the secured, often scattered or difficult-to-access knowledge about continuing education in Germany.In addition, current trends in the fields of supply and participation structures, institutions, personnel and financing are presented.In-house chapters are dedicated to the reporting systems of continuing education, the collection of competence profiles and a systematic view of continuing education research. Thus, trend analysis provides an empirical basis for the assessment and control of future developments in the continuing education landscape.
content.title_en: Trends in continuing education : DIE Trend Analysis 2014

content.text: Theory and practice of competence determination in the company - status quo and development requirements. As actors in vocational education and training, companies are significantly involved and interested in the determination of competences. This volume shows possibilities for making competences and the resulting training requirements transparent. After an overview of the concept of competence, the research status is systematized with regard to the different concepts of competence and the associated analysis and measurement methods. Theory and practice of competence development are linked by model experiments and projects in companies and organizations.
content.title_en: Theory and practice of competence determination in the company - status quo and development requirements

content.text: Aspects of Infiniteness: A Small Tale for Non-Mathematicians. A Book on Infiniteness. Who believes that arithmetic is limited to dry formulas and numbers, will experience a blue miracle with ?Aspects of Infinite IBM A small narrative for non-mathematicians?. This book addresses all readers who want to explore not only logic but also the poetry of infinity. Instead of confusing lay people with cryptic academic jargon, it translates complex facts into easily understandable explanations. Thus, beginners can also learn what surprises the set theory holds. From uncountable sizes and indeterminate questions. The science of mathematical infinity includes numerous problems that are as demanding as exciting. Among others, this includes: the library of Babel, discontinuous continua, innumerable amounts, paradoxes and antinomies. To understand such theoretical approaches in their basics, it does not need to be completed.
content.title_en: Aspects of the Infinite : a small narrative for non-mathematicians

content.text: Windows Server 2019 Automation with PowerShell – the cookbook : practical recipes for automation and administration of administration tasks. PowerShell is an important tool for automation, configuration and management of workflows on Windows Server. The book here is thus a good addition to publications on Windows Server 2019 such as Th. Joos or P. Kloep and a good replacement for the already somewhat older book by P. Monadjemi about PowerShell. The book is addressed to IT experts with considerable previous knowledge and sets access options on a Windows 10 or Windows Server 2019 host with activated hardware virtualization and access to a cloud computing platform. The book is understood as a "cook book" and relies on over 90 practical examples. Didactically well prepared. Helpful in the introduction of the detailed paragraph "Use the book optimally". Many illustrations are shown. For each individual example, how a specific feature of PowerShell works. Complementary notes are highlighted graphically.
content.title_en: Windows Server 2019 Automation with PowerShell – the cookbook : practical recipes for automation and administration of administration tasks

What is education? -- Analysis of educational constellations -- Education – Approaching a concept open to interpretation -- Educational ethics -- Designing educational spaces This volume presents a practical introduction to the socio-semiotic analysis of pedagogical concepts and educational didactics. Based on integrative educational research, David Kergel provides methodology, central terms and methods for socio-semiotic analysis in pedagogical contexts. Building on this, the author develops quality features and implementation strategies for educational didactics for the design of educational spaces. The content What is education? Analysis of educational constellations Education – Approaching a concept open to interpretation Designing educational spaces The target groups Docents and students of educational sciences as well as social work Educationalists, teachers, educational scientists and scientists The author Dr. David Kergel is a scientific employee at the University Center for Teaching and Learning at the University of Lower Rhine

content.text: The integration of vehicle technology, information technology and communication changes the character of the car and driving from the ground up. From the symbol of property and freedom of movement, individuality and privacy, it becomes a component of a complex mobility system and potentially a permanent monitoring object. The contributions analyze challenges, discuss solutions and design design proposals for technology, law and organization of connected driving. The content Basic legal conflicts in the connected vehicle Contract design and fulfilment of responsibility Permission and use powers The car on the Internet and the Internet in the car Safety and data protection Foreign experiences and concepts The target groups Dozierdeen and students of the law, social and cultural sciences as well as the economic and engineering sciences Responsible in companies, administrations and insurance companies, politicians as well as lawyers, journalists and association representatives The editor Univ.-Prof. Dr. Alexander Roßnagel teaches public law, focus on the law of technology and environmental protection. He is director of the Scientific Center for Information Technology-Structure (ITG) at the University of Kassel.
content.title_en: Fundamental rights protection in the smart car : communication, security and data protection in the connected vehicle

content.text: Vision Quantum Internet: Ultrafast and hacker-proof. The future of the Internet can become fantastic! With new quantum technology, hacker-proof information exchange and ultrafast data processing are possible. Albert Einstein's "Quantenspuk" is based on this. It is not a matter of magic, but of a hard-hitting science. This book takes a fascinating journey through the world of our quantum future – from the first "quantum satellites" to the high-security Internet, to the quantum cloud and other, partly futuristic applications. The author guides the reader through basic quantum physics connections, explains the concepts of quantum computers, cryptography, teleportation and establishes their connection to the quantum Internet. Especially the social relevance, technical difficulties and implementation examples are taken under the microscope. The thematically suitable anecdotes loosen the text. With this book you can learn how quantum can revolutionize the Internet in a lively language.

content.text: Legal issues at Open Science : a guide. Digitalisation enables open science (open science) to be explored. This has many aspects, in particular free access to scientific publications and materials (open access), transparent peer review or open source technologies. The Hamburg Open Science programme aims to support open science at the Hamburg research site. The guide, which was developed in this context, aims to make the legal environment tangible. The guide first systematically develops the relevant legal areas. In the second part, legal questions about open science are answered, which come directly from universities and libraries. Thus, a practical preparation and mediation is possible. Authors of the guide are Dr. Till Kreutzer, partner of the law firm iRights.Law, and their scientific assistant Henning Lahmann.
