content.text: Public participation in the grid expansion: Evaluation of the "Planungsdialog Borgholzhausen". The "Planungsdialog Borgholzhausen" illustrates: Early public participation in the planning implementation of projects in the context of the energy transition is worthwhile, but communication does not succeed from today to tomorrow. It is rather the result of hard work, an intensive learning process and demands a corresponding attitude from all involved actors. Above all, the participation of drawn citizens contributed to the success of the participation format. These are the results of the evaluation of the planning dialogue, which the German Institute for Urbanistics 2018 in Borgholzhausen, a North Rhine-Westphalian small town with almost 9,000 inhabitants in the Teutoburg Forest, scientifically accompanied from the beginning. Already in the run-up to the approval process, the dialogue with the citizens was opened in order to promote as a communicative new beginning for a conflict-rich project accepted processes and to develop viable solutions for the grid expansion on site.
content.title_en: Public participation in network expansion: Evaluation of the "Planungsdialog Borgholzhausen"

content.text: Permanent record : my story. At 29 years of age Edward Snowden shocks the world: as a data specialist and secret carrier for NSA and CIA, he reveals that the US government secretly pursues the goal of monitoring every call, every text message and every email. Now Edward Snowden tells his story himself. (publishing)
content.title_en: Permanent record : my story

content.text: Child welfare risk : the implementation of the protection mandate in the youth work of the association. In this book, the focus is on child protection and the prevention of sexualised violence in the youth work of the association. Miriam Gunderoth provides basic knowledge for all those who work in the youth work or are in a lively exchange with this field of activity.The author addresses the specifics of the youth work of the association and explains the legal provisions for this work area. It provides suggestions for the examination with and for the development of association-specific regulations and training concepts and makes clear how an appropriate handling of children and young people can be designed and how employees and volunteers can be sensitized to the topic of prevention of sexualized violence.
content.title_en: Child welfare risk : the implementation of the protection mandate in the youth work

content.text: Atlas of digital architecture : terminology, concepts, methods, tools, examples, phenomena. Digital technology and architecture are inextricably linked. New approaches and methods not only affect the work processes and practice of architects, but also shape the character of architecture. In this comprehensive work, more than twenty university professors and lecturers share their expertise: the Atlas is divided into six parts and offers an overview of the diverse work possibilities with computers in today's architecture such as 3D modelling and CAD; rendering and visualization; scripting, text & code; digital manufacturing and model making; GIS, BIM, simulation and big data & machine learning. The Atlas provides first-hand orientation on the diverse possibilities and professional profiles offered by the digitalization of architecture today.
content.title_en: Atlas of digital architecture : terminology, concepts, methods, tools, examples, phenomena

content.text: Law and morality in environmental protection: [Lecture given on 15 February 1998].Since the end of the First World War, the relationship between law and morality has been particularly interested in the case of collisions – the practical and conceptually correct handling of immoral law.In this study, the question is instead what is the matter of morality and what is the matter of law with regard to environmental protection, as well as inadequate answers to this question in the environmental philosophy and the current environmental policy discussion on deregulation and ownership in environmental protection.The author is Professor of Public Law at Bielefeld University, author of numerous works, among others, on environmental law and legal philosophy, and has been a director of an environmental authority for several years also working in environmental protection.
content.title_en: Law and morality in environmental protection: [Lecture given on 15 February 1998]

content.text: Teaching disorders - prevention and intervention : possibilities and opportunities of resource-oriented pedagogy. Teaching disorders are physically and psychologically burdensome for teachers. Causes are often the behaviour of the pupils. But also the acting of the teachers and a little motivating teaching can be the source. Thomas Klaffke's book shows five essential resources for preventing disorders. The volume also provides a repertoire of actions for low-level measures, for dealing with serious disorders and conflicts in the class as well as for schools in "social focal points". Numerous instruments and practical aids are offered for this purpose, among other things, in the download material.
content.title_en: Disorders in teaching - Prevention and intervention : possibilities and opportunities of resource-oriented education

content.text: Europe visions: Perspectives on Europe before, during and after the crisis. This collection of Humboldt speeches on Europe is a unique testimony to European integration since the Euro crisis. In irregular intervals, the Walter Hallstein Institute for European Constitutional Law of Humboldt University organizes the Humboldt speeches, which now constitute an established forum of European discourse. The speeches presented over the past ten years provide a contemporary insight into these debates. This volume presents the views of European heads of state and government, as well as high-ranking representatives of the executive, judiciary and legislative European member states and institution. The printed speeches are intended to contribute to the scientific and political discourse beyond the boundaries of the field.
content.title_en: Europe visions: perspectives on Europe before, during and after the crisis

content.text: Ghosts of transparency : shadows cast and shadows cast out. In this book, editors from different perspectives deal with architecture and communication: the word "architecture" is used for building and building software. Data and software also transform our cities; however, data alone does not represent information: they must be organized and can be decoded when reading to generate information and communication. The contributions avoid clear separations of the different communication spaces of their disciplines. Instead, they use the resulting wealth of viewpoints and sound meanings. The book therefore pursues an ambitious goal without knowing exactly where to land – a part of the adventure to which the reader is invited.
content.title_en: Ghosts of transparency : shadows cast and shadows cast out

content.text: IP network technology : Internet communication in theory and use. Certain rules are applied to communication between computers, which are called communication protocols. The IP network is referred to as the TCP/IP protocol family that is included in this work. The fourth edition of the work (3rd edition: 2015 was not available for comparison) is available in an updated version. The comparison of the table of contents (via DNB-Opac) shows a comprehensive extension of the content. Part VI "IP mobility and IoT" with three chapters was added completely new. Also new "Security in IP communication" has been given a separate, extensive chapter with chapter two. The scope has increased 326 pages with correspondingly higher price (20 euros more). Also new at the end of each chapter are questions to check the understanding and to highlight the examples with a left-sided bar. This work is suitable as a reference work for practitioners, as a textbook for students and new entrants. Currently the most up-to-date and most comprehensive presentation of the technology of IP networks.
content.title_en: Technology of IP networks : Internet communication in theory and use

content.text: Peter Sloterdijk is one of the most important contemporary philosophers. He has repeatedly stimulated public discussions with his ideas. Peter Trawny, who has already read Sloterdijk as a student, visited the philosopher in May 2019 in a small village in the south of France. The result of this encounter is a conversation among other things about the relationship between philosophy and biography. Sloterdijk explains personal aspects of his thinking, which always claim philosophical significance. In many places the reader hears the echo of a unique country and village; a cheerful atmosphere, which does not avoid serious topics, can be felt everywhere. And thus finally, what philosophy is not only for Sloterdijk becomes clear. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Under the plane tree : a philosophical conversation

content.text: The numeric mathematics program is divided into several chapters: The numeric mathematics program, the numeric mathematics program, the mathematics program, the mathematics program, the physics program, and the computer science program. This two volume textbook is designed for introductory lectures and provides a solid basis for further learning. The text is derived from lecture manuscripts, which the author has been using for about 30 years for his basic lectures in the field of numeric mathematics and scientific arithmetic at the Friedrich Schiller University Jena. The book covers the entire range of numeric mathematics from classical techniques such as Gaussian algorithm and Newtonian procedures to modern algorithms such as cubic spline interpolation, micro-quadrate approximation by means of householder and Givens transformations as well as deflation techniques. The procedures are mathematically accurately described, implemented in MATLAB codes and demonstrated by examples. The MATLAB codes are provided on the publisher's website for download as a basis of the reader's own outstanding exercises and can perform his own exercises.

content.text: Software Engineering Parallel Systems: Basics, Algorithms, Programming. The use of parallel hardware architectures affects all software developers and developers: from supercomputer to embedded system, multi- and many-core systems are now used. The challenges of software engineering are manifold. On the one hand, a stronger understanding of the hardware is necessary (again) . Without scalable partitioning of the software and parallel algorithms, the computing power remains unused. On the other hand, new programming languages are the focus, which enable the execution of parallel instructions. This book considers different aspects in the development of parallel systems and also takes embedded systems into account. It combines theory and practical application and is therefore equally suitable for students and users in practice. By presenting algorithms independently of programming languages, they can be easily adapted for their own application. Many practical projects facilitate self-study and deepen the learning. The content Basics Parallel Systems Algorithms CPU Programming GPU Programming Modern Programming Languages Parallel Projects The target groups Students and Teaching Students in Master Programs of Computer Science and related programs users and software architects in enterprise.
content.title_en: Software Engineering of parallel systems : Basics, algorithms, programming

The work deals with the effects of cannabis as a drug on driving skills.By amending the law on traffic in narcotics, which entered into force in March 2017, cannabis flowers and extracts containing cannabis are also permitted as a medicine, if they originate from cultivation for medical purposes under state control or imports. Patients can be prescribed cannabis under certain conditions since the change of the drug legislation without any exception.These drastic changes are intended to enable patients to live better and more pain-free lives. Nevertheless, the work is also expected to have an impact on other areas of life, especially on driving vehicles in the case of existing cannabis medication. As part of this work, the main questions relating to cannabis medication and driving a car are attempted to be answered.The present work is also aimed at driving licences in Germany and all interested persons.Stefan Schomachers is studying in the municipal administration of the university.
content.title_en: Medicines and driving skills - what effects does cannabis have as a drug? : Presentation of practical relationships and problems

content.text: The EU is unable to cope with its crises in its present form, and therefore it needs profound reforms of the EU. The EU is essentially needed for peace, prosperity in the common internal market, compensation for the relatively small size and power of its member states and the preservation of fundamental principles of Western civilization. A return to the nation-state would be missed. Nevertheless, the well-established nation-state cannot be abandoned because of its advantages compared to the EU. The book proposes, among other things, a redesign of the EU's legal order and the EU treaties, an upgrade of national parliaments, a subordinate role of the European Commission, an appeal court, a modified composition of the European Central Bank and improvements for the Eurozone. If these proposals are implemented in practice, the EU could be better positioned in the future.
content.title_en: Redesign of the European Union

content.text: The Big Data debate: Opportunities and risks of digitally networked society. content.text: The fourth dimension of the business environment: Business life in the workplace of tomorrow. This book is dedicated to the fourth dimension of the digital economy – the world of work – and the fields of tension in which it is moving. In this context, four key areas are examined in the context of scientific analyses and practical business examples: Business 4.0, Leadership 4.0, Employees 4.0 and Organisation 4.0. In all these areas, there are complex areas of tension that need to be explored and sensitized. In the context of Business 4.0, areas of tension can be identified in terms of control and trust as well as the handling of different cultures, while the organization 4.0 also faces challenges for the compatibility of the professional and private life situation and for the handling of agility and flexibility.
content.title_en: The fourth dimension of digitalization: fields of tension in the working world of tomorrow

content.text: Racism-critical political education : Theories - Concepts - Orientations. How does racism develop? What links can be observed between language and racism? Should racialism-critical education not be a cross-sectional task of all educational work? Against the background of new federal political programmes for the prevention of extremism and democracy promotion, not only non-formal political education is faced with new challenges, clarification processes and self-understanding debates. The authors of the volume are dedicated to the multi-layered differentiation of racialism-critical education: besides the topic of anti-Semitism, colonialism as well as sustainability and globalization are also addressed. Racism in the context of populism and right-wing extremism is also addressed. Different institutions are considered in terms of racism (-critic). In addition, media-pedagogy and analytically oriented contributions are found in the volume.
content.title_en: Racism-critical political education : theories - concepts - orientations

content.text: Protection against social engineering: Attack points and defenses in digital economy ecosystems. Economic and cybercrime are a major problem for companies of all sizes. Social engineering techniques are increasingly proving to be particularly critical – coordinated attacks that use both analogue and digital access to access sensitive information or sabotage entrepreneurial processes. How to face the new risk landscape that is emerging in a growing digital economy and an increasingly complex network of dependent infrastructures, this volume highlights with many case studies. A systematic access to an important area of risk management responsibility. And a useful toolbox for building resilient organizations that can defend themselves against such attacks in the short and long term.
content.title_en: Protection against social engineering : Attack points and defenses in digital economy ecosystems

content.text: What is the city society gaining through clean air? : the city worth living: fields of action and opportunities. The complaints of the German Environmental Aid against insufficiently effective air pollution plans have led many of the cities particularly affected by the diesel scandal and the too high nitrogen oxide loads have to impose driving bans and rely on the hardware retrofitting of diesel vehicles and the switch from diesel to electric vehicles. Car traffic is undoubtedly the main source of air pollution and climate and noise protection require a new transport policy. However, as long as the political debate is not focused on bans and omissions, the underlying core of the issue remains unrecognized: clean air is also the key to a city worth living, to environmental justice and health equality and thus to achieve more quality of life. Clean air in the cities does not constitute a sectoral task for traffic planning, but is in the course of an integrated approach to urban development and construction planning, noise reduction planning, landscape and free space planning and the planning of urban infrastructures are discussed in a variety of ways. Climate protection and adaptation, air pollution control, noise reduction and inter-community are addressed in the field of urban planning and urban planning.
content.title_en: What does the city society gain through clean air? : the livable city: fields of action and opportunities

content.text: History of the throwaway society: the downside of consumption. Sooner or later everything is thrown away. In the consumer society, however, useful and new-value products also migrate to the garbage. Such behaviours are the result of a long-term process, which has been created over a period of one and a half centuries. The US was the precursor, the Federal Republic of Germany moved on. It started around the turn of the century with hygiene articles such as toilet paper, monthly bindings, diapers and paper handkerchiefs; after the Second World War, a multitude of other throwaway articles soon came into being: cardboard cups and plastic dishes, nylon stockings and ballpoint pens, razor blades, beverage cans and much more. Wolfgang König shows how the economy and consumers together made the throwaway into routine – and discusses ways to overcome the throwaway society.
content.title_en: History of the throwaway society: the downside of consumption

Big data, quantitative models and in-memory systems are the driving force for this, which form the basis for the redesign of internal control via forward-looking analyses and city-planning. Examples include the automotive, financial, telecommunications and media, logistics and tourism sectors.
content.title_en: Digitization of the company management : process automation, business analytics, big data, SAP S/4HANA, application examples

content.text: Data visualization - basics and practice : how to design meaningful diagrams and graphics. Professional data visualization: how to speak and convince your data. Outstanding basic work on data visualization; memorable and vividly through a variety of good and bad examples; high practical use through tips on diagram types, the use of colors and shapes, etc.; how to access knowledge that is contained in complex data sets? Professional data visualization. Whether data scientist, scientist, analyst or consultant or simply all who need to create technical documents or reports: data visualization has become an indispensable core competence. Claus O. Wilke offers in his basic work a systematic introduction to the principles, methods and concepts of data visualization - and this is very practical and vivid: through solid foundations and countless good and bad examples. content.text: Hello world: what algorithms can and how they change our lives. They are accused of a crime. Who should decide your fate? A human judge or a computer algorithm? You are absolutely certain? You may hesitate? In both cases you should read the book of young mathematician and moderator Hannah Fry, which informs with refreshing directness about algorithms by dealing with people. No dimension of our world in which they have not long been in contact: algorithms, these inconspicuous consequences of instructions that are active on the Internet anyway, but also in every computer program, shape the everyday life of consumption, finance, medicine, police, justice, democracy and even art to an increasing extent. They sort the world for us, open up new options and take decisions from us - quickly, effectively, thoroughly. But they do this frequently without asking us, and they confront new, by no means easy to solve dilemmas. Above all, however, we tend to look at algorithms as a kind of authority, instead of questioning their power. That opens up to us, to be more entertaining, to help us, to make certain algorithms, to make them more open up.
content.title_en: Hello world : what algorithms can and how they change our lives

content.text: The fight against terror in the present and future. In the 1970s terrorist attacks were mostly directed against representatives of the state. Meanwhile, they can meet everyone. In this respect, the book provides insights into a treasure of experiences about how to approach and build such processes. A guide that stimulates independent thinking - with examples of different interventions (workshops, large events, shorter exercises) designed as designs and architectures.
content.title_en: Systemic intervention : Architectures and designs for consultants and change managers

content.text: Agile project management : Agility and Scrum in the classical project environment. Learn how Agile project management works - not only in IT projects! Jörg Preußig explains how agile and classical working methods are combined in a meaningful way, and also addresses the framework conditions in organizations as well as opportunities and risks. Thus, your projects meet the changing requirements and can be successfully implemented and completed!
content.title_en: Agile project management : Agility and Scrum in the classical project environment

content.text: New Management: Success factors for digital transformation. The digital transformation has long been no longer a "wind of change" but a full-blown storm that shakes at the foundations of companies, shakes their business processes and destroys decades of valid success recipes. Rarely have there been so many threats to the established and at the same time so much chance for new things.Marcus Sassenrath presents new approaches that change the way companies work. Using successful control tools and practical incentives, he shows how you establish new, flexible methods in companies.
content.title_en: New Management : Success Factors for Digital Transformation

content.text: Corporate Diplomacy: how professionally designed external relations make a company more successful. Economic risks, regulatory and compliance tsunami, technological disruption: Companies face major challenges. At the same time, the divisions between business, politics and society are becoming deeper and deeper. Wilfried Hoop shows entrepreneurs and managers how they navigate through a volatile, complex and increasingly economic-critical world with the approach of "Corporate Diplomacy" and how they can increase their company success through more targeted cooperation with stakeholders. Interviews with representatives from business and politics include: Josef Ackermann, Roland Berger, Peter Brabeck, Beat Hess, Fred Kindle, Peter Kurer, Edward T. McMullen Jr., Friedrich Merz. For further information: corporation-diplomacy.net
content.title_en: Corporate Diplomacy: how to make a company more successful in professional external relations

content.text: The first part of the book is a short cut, but you would like to change a few details: For example, you want to sew a blouse or make a blouse without a collar. Harumi Maruyama presents in her book over 50 top variants, all based on a basic cut. The cut is included in the book as a multi-size cut, and the author explains in detailed, illustrated step-by-step instructions how to create your own cut patterns. The reader learns how to create new variations through small changes and thus find the way to the perfect blouse or the perfect shirt or top.
content.title_en: Upper-bottom-section variations

content.text: JavaScript : learn to program properly - from the first line of code to the own project. Part 1 of the book introduces in a comprehensible and detailed way the general basics of programming into the language JavaScript (here abbreviated JS) (version JS 2017) - both under the procedural aspect and the object orientation. Paul Fuchs (ID-A 48/19) is recommended among a variety of alternative JS introductions. In part 2, the reader is introduced in the Internet, web and browser technologies in a comprehensible way and, using understandable examples, is enabled to create a Java application in the browser as his own project. Here, the focus is on the interaction of the languages HTML, JS and CSS, on the Document Object Model and the event handling. In part 3, the reader is introduced in node.js (version 10.1), as a JS application area outside of browsers (example: http server for dynamic websites). Further literature on the topic node.js: P. Ackermann. Back to the book by M. Haverbeke: Chapter 22 "Performance" provides guidance on the performance of JS.
content.title_en: JavaScript : learn to program really well - from the first line of code to your own project

content.text: Good economy for tough times: six questions of survival and how we can better solve them. Nobel Prize 2019! Two award-winning economists on failure and responsibility of economists. Inequality, poverty, migration, free trade, economic growth and environmental issues are the problems that dominate the headlines worldwide every day. This is something that is urgently needed for this knowledge and advice from economists. In this book, economists Esther Duflo and Abhijit Banerjee, known for their pioneering work on poverty research, provocatively hold out the mirror to their colleagues: they have slept over catastrophys like the Lehman-Pleite, often misrepresent ideological reservations, and in issues such as the euro, they have been reluctant to speak out inconvenient truths. Duflo and Banerjee illustrate what good economy can instead contribute to solving the urgent world problems. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Good economy for hard times: six questions of survival and how to solve them better

content.text: Alan Turing : Narrative. Nominated for 9 Oscars is the filming of Alan Turing's life and work under the title "The Imitation Game", which currently runs in German cinemas. Bendict Cumberbatch and Keira Knightley are on show in the leading roles. Although the film is not based on this book by Rolf Hochhuth (meeting see BA 9/87), it is based on a biography of Andrew Hodges (not discussed here), but could nevertheless arouse interest in the character "Alan Turing". Libraries can respond to the interest of their readers with this issue.
content.title_en: Alan Turing : Narrative

content.text: Song of bats : novel. The new novel by Olga Tokarczuk is an exciting moral thriller. The quirky narrator Janina Duszejko, village teacher for English and in winter guardian of the houses of summer freshmen on a wind-whipped plateau in the Glatzer Kessel, has two passions: for astrology and for animals. She also struggles with a treacherous suffering, reads and translates with a former student the poems of William Blake and raesoniert about the stars, the people and the meaning of names
content.title_en: Song of bats : Roman

content.text: Web design : the manual for web design. The independent web design designer Martin Hahn presents here the 3rd edition (2nd edition 2017 not shown here) of his manual for web design. The comparison of the table of contents (via DNB Opac) shows that the structure and layout of the book are unchanged. Some chapters for example "Sinus Milieus" in the target group analysis and chapter 16 "Tips, tricks and tools" have been deleted. The chapter "Website Types" is no longer an independent one, but has been integrated in chapter 14 with only a small part. Overall, the book only comes with 14 instead of 16 chapters and thus with 89 pages less. Due to the valuable presentation (four-colour printing) nothing has changed at the price, still the book is expensive. Nevertheless, a successful title, which provides extensive knowledge for beginners and professionals on the subject of web design. The book is well written and clearly structured.
content.title_en: Web design : the manual for web design

content.text: Logic for Computer Scientists. Logic for Computer Scientists is an introductory textbook on logic lecture for the basic and bachelor's degree. The focus is on the high practical relevance and applicability in computer science. The authors cover all relevant classical and modern logic systems. And logical systems are of fundamental importance for every prospective computer scientist, as they provide the theoretical foundation for certain areas of computer science. The authors provide an easy-to-understand introduction to logic as far as this is relevant for modern computer science. Due to several years of teaching experience, the authors know which understanding difficulties can occur with students and therefore strive in a special way for an appealing and generally comprehensible access to logic. Thus, the newly introduced theory is tried out on continuous examples. Many of these examples are held in the style of practice tasks with solutions, so that the reader already takes approaches and solutions for the subsequent exercises. Numerous exercise tasks with short solutions lead to the testing of the learned and are deliberately kept entertaining.
content.title_en: Logic for computer scientists

content.text: Centering : An effective body technique for self-regulation. In this essential you will learn how to achieve more strength, presence, serenity and openness through the body-oriented technique of centering. Learn the physical and psychological language of your body, as well as the triggers and reaction patterns that can get you out of balance. You will learn the effect and benefits of centering with the help of simple stress simulations. Finally you will get hints and practical application possibilities, how to practice the method of centering without any particular effort, integrate and mediate in your everyday life and apply it in training, coaching or psychotherapy. The content Introduction to a body-oriented technique for self-regulation Instructions for training and maintaining centering skill Description of everyday examples, which facilitate the application of centering technology, especially in the professional environment The target groups Students and lecturers in the field of psychology Trainers, moderators, coaches and psychotherapists The author Dr. phil. Manfred Barbarino is a diploma psychologist with over 30 years experience in the fields of aeronautics psychology, project and personnel management has specialized in the field of exercise and management.
content.title_en: Centering : An effective body technique for self-regulation

content.text: More courage! : A new decade has begun. SPD politician, former Prime Minister of Lower Saxony, Federal Environment, Economic and Foreign Affairs Minister, Vice Chancellor and SPD Chairman, who has left active politics, draws the conclusion of his career. (2)
content.title_en: More courage! : A new decade to be set in motion

content.text: The authors of this guide are quite aptly shortening the technical expression phänology. It is about the perception of natural events in connection with the seasons. Especially in times of climate change this approach is shown as important and becomes almost its marker: Does the blossom of fruit trees now in former times, their fruits become mature? The book is divided into three main parts. First, phänology is presented as science, then its observation methods are described and finally (more than 3/4 of the total size) 60 species of plants frequently occurring in Central Europe (mostly trees and woody plants) are treated. In the species chapter, the characteristics of identification are also based on good illustrations of plants and plant parts and ecological aspects, and in addition, the presentation of the development stages plus phänological calendar is also helpfully illustrated. - The title turns to a "wide public" and is widely viewed by all botanically interested parties.
content.title_en: Watching plants in the rhythm of the seasons : the phenological guide

content.text: Let's rock education: what school needs to learn today. 2300 YouTube tutorials - short and minimalist -, with 180 million views, Daniel Jung is the most widely seen math online educator in Europe, one of the most successful German YouTubers in the educational sector (Mathe by Daniel Jung). In his book, the "Rockstar of mathematics" (FAZ) criticizes for an autobiographical chapter that does not save self-lance (T-shirt "Daniel Jung saved my live"), which, in his opinion, is completely outdated cumbersome education system. In times of the 4th Industrial Revolution, he calls for a digital learning revolution, far beyond plans for the digital educational pact, new didactic concepts with a focus on individual learning as well as the comprehensive preparation of children for the challenges of artificial intelligence. His text, which is also a plea for more mathematics enthusiasm, as a basis for future-oriented jobs. In this compilation, no comparison titles (from the author) (from the author).
content.title_en: Let's rock education: what school needs to learn today

content.text: The decayed house of Islam: the religious causes of unfreedom, stagnation and violence. The "house of Islam" has become in many places the house of war, terror, economic stagnation and dictatorship. In its groundbreaking analysis of this desolate situation, the renowned social scientist Ruud Koopmans puts hard facts against Islam-critical all-round judgments and a fashionable self-criticism of the West. He shows how fundamentalism takes Islam into the stranglehold worldwide, and asks which ways lead out of this impasse. More and more Muslims flee from dictatorship and non-muslim countries and migrant groups, such as the Islamic world on the one hand and Muslims in the West on the other hand with regard to democracy, education and economic situation. Ruud Koopmans shows for the first time on a broad empirical basis and through the systematic comparison of Muslim and non-Muslim countries and groups of migrants, as the Islamic world on the other hand and Muslims in the West on the other hand, that the Islam is constantly following. He describes how Islam has been increasingly dominated by fundamentalist tendencies for about the end of the rights of the Muslim population, the Muslim population and the right to fight against the Islam.
content.title_en: The decayed house of Islam : the religious causes of infreedom, stagnation and violence

content.text: Fatum: the climate and the demise of the Roman Empire. Publisher's info: FATUM is the first book to consistently examine and describe the catastrophic role that climate change and epidemics played in the collapse of the Roman Empire. Based on recent scientific findings from the field of climate science and genetics, Kyle Harper tells the story of an inferno in which we recognize, as in a distant mirror, the terrifyingly familiar features of our own world. The fate of the Roman Empire was not decided by emperors, legionaries and barbarians. At least as important were volcanic eruptions, solar cycles, the instability of climate and man-killing viruses and bacteria. Kyle Harper leads his readers from the peak of the 2nd century AD, when the Roman Empire seemed to be an insurmountable power, into the lows of the 7th century, when the empire was embroiled, politically fragmented and materially leached. He describes how the Romans long bravely sought to stand, as environmental changes suppressed the whole of the empire - until the very beginning of the plague-time, the plague-repeasure of the impoverish period, and the fall of the impoverishness of the Roman Empire, had been repeated.
content.title_en: Fatum : the climate and the demise of the Roman Empire

content.text: The fast guide to accessibility design. Quick guide for accessibility projects - "It is a reminder that serves as a checklist for those who design everyday spaces we live in" - This book aims to remind us that we are not alone, and as long as we take this into account, we will design inviting, inclusive and functional spaces. - Accessibility - Public Space - Design Architecture - Interior Architecture - City - Urban Planning - Accessibility - Checklist - Designing everyday spaces - Collection of clues to make cities more accessible - Accessibility
content.title_en: The fast guide to accessibility design

content.text: The new Berlin Castle : from the Stadtschloss to the Humboldt Forum. In recent years, hardly any project has been discussed as much as about the reconstruction of the Berlin City Palace. Day-spiegel photographer Kitty Kleist Heinrich accompanied the building with her camera from the first ground-breaking ceremony. In addition to large-format panoramic views, the images of architectural details and small events impress her humorously commentating on the picture legends. Kitty Kleist-Heinrich's precise photographic view and her dedication to detail make this volume a highly informative and entertaining experience.
content.title_en: The new Berlin Castle : from the Stadtschloss to the Humboldt Forum

content.text: The Moeller is a standard work for the training of electrical engineers at universities and universities of applied sciences. It provides a basis for all electrical engineering – from DC networks to alternating and three-phase current technology to electromagnetic fields. In addition, non-ineary processes and the various electrical control mechanisms including applications in electronic components - from the solar cell to the IGCT - are being treated. The work with the book is supported by its clearly structured structure, a multitude of practical example tasks and the colour printing of many illustrations. The 24th edition was reviewed and corrected as well as by the description of the memristor - field curves - filter circuits and oscillators - non-ineous currents and voltages - electrical power management mechanisms The content of the communication concepts - DC networks - electric potential field - magnetic field - magnetic field - was established by the University of Applied Sciences.
content.title_en: Moeller Basics of Electrical Engineering

content.text: Controlling with SAP®: a practical introduction with comprehensive case study and exemplary applications. Overview of Controlling with SAP -- Continuous case study -- Cost point calculation -- Product calculation and cost carrier calculation -- Conceptual developments of Controlling and its coverage by SAP up to SAP S/4 HANA -- Preparatory activities in Customizing The standard work on Controlling with SAP in eighth edition. The advantages: Easy comprehensibility, a consistent example and high clarity. The clearly structured concept leads the reader to a comprehensive understanding of the widely used SAP software using a case study without prior knowledge. The contexts are explained step by step: From the basics of the cost calculation and controlling to the functioning of the SAP software up to the application in practical operation. In the eighth edition numerous updates were made and the additional possibilities of supporting controlling tasks by SAP S/4 HANA students were demonstrated. The content Overview of Controlling with SAP Friedling's cost calculation and cost bearer calculation and market segment calculation of the Chair of Controlling with regard to the business management and business management.
content.title_en: Controlling with SAP® : a practical introduction with comprehensive case study and exemplary applications

content.text: How machines learn: Artificial intelligence explains intelligible. Do you know what lies behind artificial intelligence and machine learning? This non-fiction book explains to you easily and without complicated formulas the basic methods and procedures of machine learning. Mathematical foreknowledge is not necessary for this. In a short time and informative way Lisa, the protagonist of the book, illustrates these based on everyday situations. A book for all who want to score points with facts in discussions about opportunities and risks of the current development of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Also suitable for pupils! The content ● Basics of artificial intelligence: algorithms, machine learning & co. ● The most important learning methods step by step explained ● Artificial intelligence in society: safety and ethics The editor Kristian Kersting is Professor of Machine Learning at the Department of Computer Science of the Technical University of Darmstadt. Christoph Lampert is Professor at the Institute of Science and Technology (IST Austria). Constantin Rothkopf is founding director of the Center for Cognition Science and Professor at the Technical University of Darmstadt. The contributors From the Study Foundation of the German People supported students from all over Germany – the artificial team of the working group of the machine intelligence – learning.

content.text: Membrane procedures for artificial organs: transport models for the design of extracorporeal processes. Membranes and modules -- material transport models for membranes -- membrane processes for artificial organs Artificial organs are membrane modules that exchange and remove blood content in an extracorporeal cycle. The classical principles of crossflow and countercurrent processes are used. Manfred Raff shows how functional relationships between target sizes and geometric, material and operating parameters are derived for the entire module for the design of such membrane processes from models on the differential membrane element. The equations of results can also be used for technical applications. The content of membranes and modules Substance transport models for membrane processes for artificial organs The target groups Students and lecturers of the fields of process engineering, biotechnology, medicine, environmental and food technology Manufacturers of membranes and modules and users of membrane technologies In his professional life, the author Manfred Raff has been researching the scientific focus membrane technology in the field of membrane technology. content.text: Self-optimization and ambivalence: social appeals and ambivalent receptions. The volume presents theoretical perspectives on the topic of self-optimization as well as empirical examples of ambivalent receptions of appeals of self-optimization. Social constraints for self-compulsion manifest themselves, among other things, in appeals of life-long learning and self-disciplinarity, as they represent self-tracking and lifelogging. This striving for perfection can undermine humanity, but also produce forms of action such as diletting. Empirical analyses can prove that people often ambivalently respond to these constraints, i.e. at the same time optimising and humanity or adapting and self-determination. Sometimes even their own delusion of improvement becomes "decommissioning", i.e. ultimately destruction of the self.
content.title_en: Self-optimization and ambivalence: social appeals and ambivalent receptions

content.text: The geotechnical classification of solid rocks and solid mountains. Despite (and precisely because) a great variety of norms (DIN, ISO, pocket books) prevail in geotechnical classifications, sometimes uncertainties in the correct classification and estimation of solid rocks. In this book specific properties of rocks and mountains are considered, which are suitable for classification because of their quantificability. It is revealed (t.T. surprising) correlations between various physical properties and characteristic values and for the first time quantitatively explained. The book thus pursues two objectives. First, it is intended to lead to a better understanding of (especially physical and thus technical) properties of rocks in the solid mountains. Secondly, it is intended to be a reference work of the usable parameters in the classification and classification of solid rocks and mountains in practice. In their long-standing professional activity the authors have put together unquantified data of measurement data which represent an invaluable value for peers. Here they are now bundled as a technical book and adequately commented on to the subject world. Some approaches are surprised with the unexpected correlation of partially overtifthed physical parameters.
content.title_en: Geotechnical classifications of solid rocks and mountains

content.text: Generation of gene scies: how do we encounter the gene technological revolution?. Preconceptions -- What is genetic information? -- Breeding yesterday to today -- Read genetic material -- Edit genetic material -- Write genetic material -- Gene and society -- Rethink genetics -- And now? We are experiencing a revolution in genetic engineering: with a molecular gene shear, the genetic material in living beings can be changed more specifically than never before. The genetic editing that is possible offers new possibilities in animal and plant breeding – and it is already being applied in humans. Where should we take the journey? Should we treat diseases or better repair them? Does the new genetic technology, combined with modern reproductive biology, lead to designer babies? And: Can we allow a liberalisation of these techniques as civic science (citizen science)? With the availability of genetic shears we face a major responsibility at present: Is it acceptable to use the new genetic technologies – or not to use them for reckless purposes? Where do we draw the border? To interested readers, the author explains the vividly and understandable backgrounds of genetic engineering and the use of genetic engineering.
content.title_en: Generation Gen-Scirculation: How do we encounter the genetic revolution?

The author of the world's best seller On tyranny, the chronicle of a political catastrophe that is coming upon us – the rise of authoritarian regimes in Russia, Europe and the USA. content.text: Future Fridays - why we need the future of the school. The current protest movement "Fridays for Future" shows that school is too much arrested in the past and neglects the topic of the future. Students are left alone with future-threatening topics such as climate change or social inequality. It is no longer enough to convey old knowledge to solve the problems of tomorrow; learning for the future requires new teaching and learning formats. In this book Olaf-Axel Burow calls on students to make designers of their future, to awaken their joy and make them project-oriented team learners. With the future as a first step and the Future Friday as a goal, open, untrained spaces for creative design can be created. Spaces in which the students have the chance to work on projects of the future design themselves. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Future Fridays - why we need the school subject future

content.text: Supporting learning processes digitally: a book of methods for teaching. The author shows how digital media can be used in schools and teaching in a meaningful way. She addresses various didactic approaches, sets out selected methods more precisely, e.g. digital learning counters, digital storytelling and more, and provides information on the implementation possibilities. At the end, it is about the use of digital media as an organizational aid for the planning and implementation of the teaching, the absolutely necessary media education for the pupils and the necessary further development of the teacher's media competence. A well-usable orientation aid and a stimulating and helpful pool of ideas for each teacher; before the essay collection "Schule digital - wie geht?. (2 S)
content.title_en: Digital support for learning processes : a textbook for teaching

content.text: Digitalization - new tasks of the school management. This book gathers current articles on the topic of "Digitalization IBM Education IBM Fake News?". The opening is an article by the school researcher Hans-Günter Rolff about new media and false facts in the knowledge society. Further articles deal with the question of how digitalisation can be used for school evaluation and which instruments are already on the market in this regard. Digital and agile school development are also being discussed, as are the school development award "Good Healthy School"? The fact that digitalisation also raises ethical questions shows the contributions on value education and media orality. Other topics are leadership trades and training interests of school managers. The contributions are based on the congress "Digitalization IBM Education IBM Fake News?" of the German Academy for Educational Executives (DAPF) and have been updated and revised for the book. (Verlagstext)

content.text: Observe and compare globally: sociological analyses of world society. Whether artists' rankings, grain classifications or the recording of forced labour – practices of global observation and comparison are hard to think away from from world-society contexts. But how did such procedures arise? How are comparisons communicated and with what consequences? The contributions of the volume provide detailed insights into the diverse interplay of comparative practices and world society.
content.title_en: Globally monitor and compare: sociological analyses of world society

content.text: Metallography in quality assurance and damage analysis: instructions on metallographic work - methodology and procedure. In this book a brief introduction to material science is given and the influence of production and processing on the structure of the material. The position and removal of the grinding on a component is a decisive step which affects the result of metallographic analysis. Here, it is already necessary to take a targeted approach to reliably detecting manufacturing and operational errors in the component. The assessment of the admissibility of irregularities requires the correct preparation, experience in macroscopic and microscopic assessment and knowledge of the associated standards and guidelines. Numerous documentation and case examples are to provide help in the practical procedure. The characteristic characteristics of different types of faults are explained in connection with an optimized approach or the presentation of alternative methods in preparation. Damage cases represent a particularly difficult task for metallographs/metallographs - thus the success is to be evaluated by the preparation of the investigation, the choice of the closing position and - level of the process. Practical instructions for solving this task are given and explained to the examples. Knowledge gaps in the adjacent fields of metallography and metallography are also used in the production.
content.title_en: Metallography in quality assurance and damage analysis : instructions on metallographic work - methodology and procedure

content.text: Anthropocene: the Age of Man - an Introduction. Ellis is a professor of geology and environmental systems at the University of Maryland and a member of a commission that investigated the introduction of the term Anthropocene as a geological age of the Earth. The term goes back to the Nobel Prize winner P.J. Crutzen: "The Anthropocene". Ellis first explains the previous determination of the Earth Age by stratigraphs, which make the classification of the ages due to fossil finds and rock layers. Meanwhile, the influence of man is evident both in the hydro, bio and the atmosphere. And also the species death, the altered coal and nitrogen cycle change our environment sustainably and justify, according to Ellis' opinion, the renaming of the present age. Overall, a description with detailed registers and literature data that is well understandable for interested laypersons. No current comparison title. The numerous titles corresponding to the same refer predominantly to climate change. Breit recommended.
content.title_en: Anthropocene: the Age of Man - an Introduction

content.text: Visual group theory : a computer-oriented geometric introduction. Beschr.: One can understand groups as algebraic objects, which describe the symmetry of geometric objects. This perspective is in the foreground of the book and thus the book is also about geometry. Groups express symmetry phenomena algebraically, one calculates with reflections, rotations etc., generally with illustrations of spaces. The book can be used during lecture sessions with algebra and group theory lectures. It is also particularly suitable for teacher students, since it presents the material computer-oriented (using the freely available group theory program GAP) with many illustrative examples. For the 2nd edition some parts of the book were presented in more detail. Some contents (for example the classification of finite groups up to order 11) were added and errors corrected.
content.title_en: Illustrative group theory : a computer-oriented geometric introduction

content.text: Bad Science: the dark side of statistics. Increase sensitivity to the misuse of statistical methods. The term "Bad Science" is understood by the authors and editors of this volume as being both sloppy in scientific work, and due to prejudices that have become too one-sided in research, up to falsification of results. The contributions of this collection are based on seminar papers of the "Blockseminar Survey Methodology", which was offered by the Otto-Friedrich University of Bamberg as part of the master's programme Survey Statistics. The authors of the contributions are thus all students who participated in this seminar and have dealt with the problem of "Bad Science" in a thematic way. Due to the great relevance of the topic, the publication of the articles was decided within the scope of this collection volume, so that even more readers can benefit from the findings. In terms of content, a theoretical examination of the p-value is worked out with the size of samples, the approach of p-hacking, the weakness of classical hypothesis tests and the approach of HARKing.
content.title_en: Bad Science : the dark side of statistics

content.text: Project management for engineers for dummies. Well-structured, versatile advisor for engineers from the company practice, who prepare for the acquisition of project tasks: After an overview of project management, the central questions and processes, planning and control tasks, the author presents the project phases in detail and works out their particularities as well as parallel planning processes. He creates the practical relevance by very vivid, extensive examples and practical cases, checklists and exercises. Reading and to the extent rarely found in project management advisors is the chapter on psychology and motivation in projects. Nor is the agile project management, to which the author dedicates his own chapter, too short. The writing style is factual; the contents are well systematized. Reading is quite demanding, because the author also conveys the theoretical contexts and applies them to practice.(2)
content.title_en: Project management for engineers for dummies

content.text: Social Media Marketing for Dummies. No doubt: Social media is the best way to reach your customers, the most authentic, the most personal. What can happen to you better than someone who makes your product personal recommendations on Facebook, for example? However, the complexity of social media marketing is high and the risk of wasting a lot of time and money on social media. This book lowers the hurdle for the beginner into social media marketing and gives you a simple guide to advertise more successfully on the social web. Find your desired customers, define your goals and marketing strategy to match your resources and optimize your work. Become your own influencer! (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Social Media Marketing for Dummies

content.text: Clean Code for Dummies. Clean Code is an important concept for developing programs with as few errors as possible, which can be developed over long periods of time. This topic has already been discussed by R.C. Martin: "Clean architecture" or in the very humorous presentation of U. Post: "Besser coden". The author of the book here works out that this concept requires high craftsmanship in programming; but it shows very well the advantages in the further development of the software and the adaptation to changed operating conditions. Readers with good knowledge in an object-oriented programming language are addressed. The book is well-structured with many hints on stumbling blocks and how to learn from errors. Each chapter ends with a short summary. At the end of the book, the reader finds a list of websites that deepen and complement the contents of the book. (2)
content.title_en: Clean code for dummies

content.text: The craft sector in building planning and environmental law: changed framework conditions, current legal developments and reform proposals. Changed craft structures lead to differentiated land requirements for the various forms of the craft sector. On the other hand, changes in the area and location-related environmental and urban development requirements result in restrictions for the development of sites for craft enterprises. The analysis of the changed framework conditions made by the author makes it clear that in the interest of a sustainable development of the settlement area it is necessary to ensure a sustainable development of the location for craft enterprises not only to align urban planning with the necessary land provision, but also to develop the urban development framework conditions. The results of the monograph should be interesting for all persons involved in urban planning and the development of the craft sector and ultimately also legally for the development of the urban development law.

content.text: Cultural renewal: the contribution of Western philosophy. The author is a professor of philosophy at Humboldt University and wants to shape the self-image of man with his comprehensive view of nature and culture, without degrading other creatures. He addresses the anthropocentric world view in Christianity and Islam. Looking back, the self-liberation of man in culture is not only optimistic, but very far reaching, from biblical perspective to the Gilgamesch epic, described. - Some things might have been more detailed. For example, if Kant's categorical imperative is the subject, an original version of it should be fully quoted. Recommended for anyone interested in culturally. Any special previous knowledge is not required.

content.text: Tourism in criticism : climate-damaging overtourism instead of clean industry?. The dark side of tourism is becoming more and more popular! The travel industry is booming! Glamorous hotels, gigantic cruise ships and long sandy beaches attract more and more tourists from near and far – with negative consequences. Torsten Kirstges addresses this issue: he outlines the economic, socio-cultural and ecological dark side of tourism. He does not ignore phenomena such as overtourism, child prostitution and lack of sustainability. Numerous practical examples make the topic tangible. Knowledge boxes provide a good basis for reading Aha experiences and sensitize for the negative effects of travel. A must-have for all those who are interested in tourism in studies, science or practice. Also for travellers who value sustainable and gentle tourism, this book is an exciting reading.
content.title_en: Tourism in criticism : climate-damaging overtourism instead of clean industry?

content.text: Understanding Diginomics : Economy in the light of digitalization. Computers and robots can no longer be thought out of economics. And: their meaning grows rapidly through artificial intelligence and big data. This also affects our economic thinking, for example, on price formation and productivity. Monopolization tendencies are to be expected as well as labour market and distribution effects. Moreover, digitalization also influences the development of the economy, inflation and in general, the financial situation of the state. The international division of labor is also driven by digitalization. The author addresses the micro- and macroeconomic effects and explains them in an understandable way with the help of economic terminology. Also on opportunities and risks, as well as the effects on industrial policy, is addressed in this context. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Understanding Diginomics : Economy in the Light of Digitization

content.text: Gottfried Semper : Architect and revolutionary. Gottfried Semper (1803-1879) led a life on European stage. Architecture and politics were inseparably connected to him. Sonja Hildebrand followed his moving path of life and for the first time designed a comprehensive picture of his personality. She presented his great monumental buildings in Dresden, Vienna and Zurich and gave a deep insight into the cultural history of the 19th century. Semper was an exceptional figure. Born in Hamburg in 1803 as a factory owner's son, she led him to Göttingen and Paris, Rome and Athens. With the call to Dresden, the professional career began for the 31-year-old, which he later continued brilliantly in Zurich and Vienna. As a convinced Republican, he fought on the barricades in 1849. The prize was years in exile. Today, we especially admire the Semperoper, the Burgtheater in Vienna or the Schwerin Castle.
content.title_en: Gottfried Semper : Architect and revolutionary

content.text: What can we say? : Freedom of opinion in the age of populism. Freedom of the press and of opinion is fought day after day - also in Germany, where it is anchored in the Basic Law. What can we say? How far does freedom of opinion go? Where does tolerance end? These questions have to be answered again and again to a new one. Freedom of opinion is also threatened in democracy. Political populism and threatening communication on the Internet put the fundamental right to the test. (...) Experts from different disciplines clearly describe the dimensions and challenges of freedom of expression. This results in a multifaceted presentation on one of the great topics of our time. (back cover)
content.title_en: What can we say? : Freedom of expression in the age of populism

content.text: Traffic planning for retail locations: a practical guide. Changing retail – challenges and location requirements,- Location analysis -- Determination of traffic volume -- Compatibility testing -- Notes on the design and design of outdoor facilities -- Literature. Good accessibility and traffic compatibility are key prerequisites for successful implementation of retail projects. A comprehensive study within the framework of sound traffic assessments thus decides whether a transport concept is sustainable and economical. This book provides a practical and comprehensive overview of the work steps in the development of retail locations. This is referred, among other things, to relevant central guidelines for the planning phases as well as to experiences from planning practice. It is a reference work for urban and transport planners, architects and all actors involved in the search for locations and the development of retail projects.
content.title_en: Transport planning for retail locations : a practical guide

content.text: This civilization has failed: talks about the climate crisis and the chance of a new beginning. Industrial civilization has no future. It is based on unlimited growth - on a limited planet. The undiminished, ruthless combustion of fossil resources continues to fuel the climate. However, through small-scale reforms and technological innovations, as they are currently on the political agenda, the problem will not be overcome. Rather sooner than later, the thesis that the global capitalist system will end will be destroyed due to the ecological contradictions it itself produces. If humanity does not take completely unexpected radical steps - according to its present state - the collapse of the industrial society as we know it will lead to a disaster. British philosopher Rupert Read and Australian sustainability researcher Samuel Alexander try to look unbelievably into this conversational book of probable development. (publisher text)
content.title_en: This civilization has failed: talks about the climate crisis and the chance of a new beginning

The practical perspective highlights the prerequisites of an effective and responsible management practice.

content.text: Software engineering - compact. Software engineering refers to the use of principles, methods and tools for the development and application of extensive software systems and the operation of these systems. Extensive classics, each published in several editions, are I. Sommerville and St. Kleuker. The book here is initially aimed at beginners and, based on small practical examples, conveys basic knowledge about software engineering. The structure of the book then follows the phase procedure typical of software engineering (planning phase, definition phase, software design phase, ... maintenance phase). Each chapter begins with basics and ends with a summary and a collection of tasks. Many illustrations, graphically highlighted definitions and notes. The solutions of the tasks and a literature directory are found at the end of the book. It provides a good start for first semesters. But also as a current reference work for exam preparation, the book is well applicable. (1)

content.text: The digital narrative: Who writes it and what does it say? This book provides answers to the question of how digitalization affects individuals and people's lives. The connection between digitalization, demography and democracy is discussed as well as the effects of digital transformation on education, employment, work content, forms of work and working time. The book examines who should write along with the digital narrative. It is the scientists of the human sciences and social sciences who need to look behind the scenes of digitalization to explore structures, processes, dangers and opportunities of digitalization for people. It is the computer scientists and technicians, the practitioners in companies and the decision-makers in business and administration who have to make their contribution to the digital narrative. Philosophers are asked to think the digital world from man and thus give the technicians guidelines for a humane design of digital transformation. If the digital transformation is to succeed, then the question must be answered what the systems do with people! Remain the people „Lord in their own home" or become assistants of the digital command givers?
content.title_en: The digital narrative: Who writes it and what does it say?

content.text: Food Marketing: Product innovations, product design, advertising, sales. Marketing for food is a special field, because there is exactly one crucial moment: when the customer is standing on a shelf in the food trade and all competitive products are clearly visible and excellently priced. How can marketing manage to give such a product a character so that the customer decides exactly for this product? Christoph Wegmann shows where the differences in the marketing of food are in comparison to other consumer products, and explains what needs to be taken into account in the marketing of food. He addresses the challenges that arise when marketing food, explains solutions and also addresses ethical issues. He also provides practitioners from the food industry with a clear overview of the various aspects to be considered and the associated action possibilities. The content Basics of the food market Product innovations Product Design Advertising for food distribution routes Ethical challenges The author Prof. Dr. Christoph Wegmann is professor for food marketing at HAW Hamburg. He teaches in the courses of ecotrophology (Bachelor) and in the master food sciences - he has performed numerous basics and product marketing projects - he performs food innovation - heed products - heed products - he markets
content.title_en: Food Marketing : Product innovations, product design, advertising, distribution

content.text: The use, non-benefit and use of social work: theoretical perspectives and empirical findings of subject-oriented research perspectives. With theoretical and empirical contributions to subject-oriented research perspectives – social-pedagogical users research, social-political (non-)use research and addressee research – this book focuses on the question of how such a research perspective is linked to existing scientific discourses of the discipline of social work and whether the empirical analyses provide indications for the profession(-alisation) of social work. By referring to the central categories (non-)benefit and use, the focus is on how social work can be designed, which is oriented towards participation and exploitation and thus is oriented towards emancipatory objectives such as self-determination and participation. Furthermore, it becomes clear which limits and barriers prevent those who use social work as offers (must) have any ‘some practical research' of them. content.text: Legal aspects of genome editing at the human germ line: a comparative legal study. Part I Introduction of natural science and international legal framework -- Part II National regulations -- Part III Comparative study The book contains 19 national reports and a comparative analysis of the legal regulations on the process of genome editing at the human germ line. It is elaborated on the common values that connect the different legal systems and the differences that exist. On this basis, it is examined whether international regulation of the topic is possible and how it could be designed. In addition, it is to be investigated to what extent the regulations of other countries can serve as a model for German legislation.

content.text: Digitalization & Controlling : Technologies, instruments, practical examples. As digitalization increases, controlling is facing a radical change and must face the digital challenges. This ranges from automation and standardization of processes, to shortened periods of data collection and analysis in management reporting, to improvement of planning and budgeting. These disruptive changes also require the controller to take on new roles and acquire new skills and thinking. The authors show the effects of digitalization on the work of the controller and on the controlling processes. They offer you tools, techniques and best practice examples to make controlling sustainable and to take advantage of the opportunities of digital transformation.
content.title_en: Digitization & controlling : technologies, instruments, practical examples

content.text: Retail personality : authentic and successful. What do Parisian chocolatier and sculptor Patrick Roger, the makers of the trendy Oslo fashion label Norwegian Rain, T-Michael and Alexander Helle have in common with Stuttgart-based optician Andreas Kraft? They all believe in the magic and appeal of well-designed shops. More than that – as entrepreneurs they have to make their shops ambassadors of their brand, their philosophy and products. The book is a discovery tour to unusual retail hotspots worldwide. Interesting personalities who make a relevant contribution to the topic of shop design and product presentation are the focus.
content.title_en: Retail personality : authentic and successful

content.text: Collective innocence: the defense of the Shoah in German memory. A critical examination of the way in which the Nazi past is dealt with in Germany. It is shown how the memory of the Nazi era is prevented on a private and social level and has become a victim community. The way in which the Nazi past is dealt with in Germany is often regarded as exemplary (cf. S. Neiman: "From the Germans to learn", 2020). The anti-Semitism and right-wing extremism researcher Samuel Salzborn (born 1977), who teaches at the University of Giessen (cf. "Right-wing sextremism", 2018), however, criticises the local confrontation with National Socialism in his essay. He shows, on the basis of numerous examples from literature, film and politics, that the treatment of the Nazi era primarily involves a guilt and memory defense, a perpetrator-opfer-return and a self-stylization as victims.
content.title_en: Collective innocence : the defense of the Shoah in German memory

content.text: From lean management to digitalization. Economic crises, growing competition and shorter innovation cycles pose major challenges for companies. For this reason, companies need to constantly review their business models and adapt them if necessary. Furthermore, they should streamline their processes, reduce costs and not lose sight of customers. Lean management and the digitalization of production processes and customer relationships are success factors. This practical book shows how you can implement Lean management throughout the company and what design options result from digitalization strategies. In the first part, the authors explain the basics of work organisation and also address the avoidance of errors based on the Toyota production system. From parcel tracking in real time to autonomous robots to individual industrial production, digitalization has arrived in the manufacturing industry. For this reason, the authors in the second part of the book are addressing this major topic. They present the exciting development stages from industry 1.0 to industry 4.0, describe the Internet of Things and present numerous technologies with future potential.
content.title_en: From lean management to digitalization
