content.text: Time in the course of life: a glossary. Contemporary societies function through enormously dynamic time logics and open up a wide range of spaces for action. The transdisciplinary glossary provides insights into the diverse insights and perspectives on the topic of time in the course of life. The individual keywords describe aspects of individual temporality and social time structures in their diversity, sometimes also unpredictable, which determine the rhythm of life and finally the feeling of life. This raises questions about the construction of meaningful time organization and sociocultural constraints between planability and contingency: as an examination of time orders and a socially written time experience, which is related to these time orders and structured by these.
content.title_en: Time in the course of life : a glossary

content.text: Microsoft Teams : the understandable guide. The Corona crisis will probably drag on until 2021, contrary to previous expectations. Thus, group communication programs that enable intensive collaboration of spatially separated groups (e.g. Home Office) gain an ever greater significance. The chat and cloud-based workspace developed by Microsoft plays a major role here "Microsoft Teams", which has been discussed many times, among others by H. Gräfen, R. Withee or P. Kiefer. The book here is seen as a detailed introduction to the use of Microsoft Teams for readers without any special previous knowledge with many examples and practical tips, although special possibilities (which often require different, unfortunately not always free versions of Microsoft Office) are also addressed. The big difference to the above mentioned comparison works is that the use of Microsoft Teams in the educational sector is also extensively addressed (virtual classroom, home schooling) and the interaction with other Microsoft-365 services.
content.title_en: Microsoft Teams : the understandable guide

content.text: Affinity Publisher : the practical introduction. Due to high prices and restrictive licensing policy of Adobe, more and more users are switching to the software clones of Affinity, which are able to imitate the functions, menu structure and "look-and-feel" of Adobe's images. Thus, the Affinity Publisher adapts the DTP program Adobe Indesign. The title deals thoroughly, comprehensively and clearly structured the work with the software and is aimed at users without prior knowledge. Starting with the work surface, through the numerous functions and tools up to useful background knowledge, the topics are explained in detail and understandable. Unfortunately, the practical application is somewhat short: Although individual projects are explained in one chapter (visual card, flyers, display), these are treated on a maximum of five pages. Good: The exercise files can be downloaded via the publisher's website. The continuously colored illustrations explain the text very well. Conclusion: Affinity Publisher with small didactical negligence (2).
content.title_en: Affinity Publisher : the practical introduction

content.text: Computer history(s) : not only for nerds. Jürgen Wolf's present work deals with the milestones of computer development. Starting from the Abakus of Sumerians, through the 19th century punch card system to the game consoles and tablets. The title provides a good and brief overview of the topic. Current techniques and trends are only briefly touched, however, as the focus here is on past development. The text is well understandable for lay people and also helps students to make possible presentations. Within the chapters there are so-called "participants" who invite to try out. This allows the knowledge to be further deepened. All links used in the book can also be downloaded on the publishing website. Martin Burckhardt: "A short history of digitalization", as something more extensive, besides Walter Isaacson: "The innovators", as both titles complement each other well. (2 S)
content.title_en: Computer history(s) : not only for nerds

The work can also be used as a reference work by the existing glossary and index. The predecessor is still usable. (2-3)
content.title_en: Computer networks : basics, functioning, application

content.text: Mobile accessibility of workers. This book deals with the phenomenon of "Mobile accessibility". This can be called a bridge that connects the worker during leisure time with the employment relationship. The intensive delimitation of work in the local and temporal dimension is not regulated by the legislator. The author examines the scope of this delimitation legally permissible. To this end, he embeds "Mobile accessibility" in the dogmatic foundation of European working time law and addresses the practical questions of its implementation. These findings result in recommendations on the reshaping of the legal situation, which relate to both the European legal framework and its national design.
content.title_en: Mobile accessibility of workers

content.text: Sustainable environmental management: Step by step. Understanding and implementing sustainability! Responsible action and sustainability in the production of goods are becoming increasingly important for customers. The topic is therefore becoming increasingly relevant for companies. The book provides the basics of sustainable environmental management and the environmental protection of companies - from guiding principles to practical implementation to the production of environmentally friendly products. A new didactic concept helps to understand: At the beginning, the author addresses the topics of memory and learning and conveys the most important basics of memory training and memorabilia. These make learning with this book an almost playful experience and enable the learning to be quickly translated into long-term memory. This 2nd, revised and extended edition is aimed at students of business administration, business engineering and similar study programmes as well as persons from practice who want to further develop in the field of environmental management.
content.title_en: Sustainable environmental management : step by step

content.text: Climate-Ecologist Malm skillfully links climate change to the Corona crisis. He argues that climate change is an essential threat to human life and that it is at least as high a priority in politics as the Corona crisis. The political, economic and social measures implemented in the world wars and in the current Corona crisis show that a major effort is possible with drastic means in times of crisis. Malm also directly blames climate change and the depletion of humanity in nature for the spread of Coronavirus. Malm wishes that even before nationalization of environmentally harmful industries is prevented and a sustainable economy is prescribed. The text requires the reader to concentrate on a lot of things and is written in a scientific style. The literature list can only be viewed online. content.text: The most important individual issues concerning the explosive and future-relevant climate protection law cover this introduction. In a comprehensive picture that takes all legal levels into account and makes clear to each other. These are the respective priorities: International level: How to proceed to Paris, Katowice and Madrid under international law? Is there a global emissions trading system? Who is responsible for cross-border climate damage? European level: Green Deal and investment plan of the EU Commission for a sustainable Europe. Governance regulation and revised renewable energy directive: Future of the energy transition. Building energy efficiency: EU requirements and national implementation. National level: The climate package 2030: Federal Climate Protection Act, BEHG, tax promotion. Climate law and climate protection claims. Coal exit and structural strengthening law. Diesel driving bans. Basic legal limits of (further) climate protection measures. Compensation and compensation obligations. Because of their concrete influence on climate protection and their sustainable effects on society and law, two other top topics with global impact are given special attention: the digitalisation and the Corona crisis.
content.title_en: Broad lines of climate protection legislation

content.text: Macroplastics in the environment: Consideration of terrestrial and aquatic areas. Simone Lechthaler shows that the entry of macroplastics into the environment, which has already been proven in numerous aquatic and terrestrial areas, is completely conditioned by anthropogenic action and can therefore be completely avoided. Due to the persistence of the material, there is a continuous accumulation of macroplastics in the environment. Preventive measures must therefore be addressed extensively and intensively and also take influence on (environmental) education in order to narrow down the further entry and to prevent as far as possible.The author explains that the interactions between macroplastics and the environment are not yet sufficiently investigated and health consequences for humans are still unclear, but for animals already a health risk exists.The content The life cycle of macroplastics Accumulation of macroplastics in the terrestrial and aquatic environment Problem of macroplastics in the environment Outlook: Current developments and approaches to action The target groups Practically active in the environment, water management and schools are currently working on the topic of environmental sciences, water management and ecology The author of the research group is working on the topic of macroplastics in the environment.

content.text: Beyond Corona: our world after the pandemic - perspectives from science. The Corona pandemic has changed our lives dramatically. We are witnessing a multiple system shock – weaknesses and vulnerabilities have been exposed on many levels. What remains of the crisis and its profound changes? Does it represent a turnaround in times or is it just a dent in long-term trend lines? How will Corona permanently change our life worlds in family, work, school, economy, politics, culture and science? To these questions, 32 renowned scientists from all areas give answers, point-pointed and knowledge-rich. These striking short analyses add to a kaleidoscope and give a clear view of the world after Corona.
content.title_en: Beyond Corona: our world after the pandemic - Perspectives from Science

content.text: Data Analytics and digitalization are considered as key to tackling current business challenges, generally as key to the future. They have long since arrived in everyday business life as a topic – but most companies are still far from systematically exploiting their opportunities. Marcus Albrecht and Tobias Schlüter offer a practical introduction to the world of (big) data analytics, artificial intelligence & co. and convey the necessary tools to successfully implement data analytics projects. - Key topic Data Analytics: Identify potentials, fields of application, application basis and implementation in business processes - Analytics Use cases and develop the appropriate, value-added algorithm - Typical risks and pitfalls and how to handle them in workflow - Analytics Change Management: Create acceptance for data analytics, take employees and correct work sharing People/machines Gain new insights from data and translate them into correct decisions, competitive advances and better company results. Here you can learn how to communicate with the success of the mega-analytical trend.
content.title_en: Data Analytics success model : Use Cases - Analysis strategies - Competition advantages

content.text: Read in the digital age. Digitization changes much, including reading books. Many fear that the dominance of computers and the Internet will lose the world's reading and that the youth will be confused with one of the most important cultural techniques. In fact, no less is read, and the number of new publications is growing year after year. Nevertheless, a lot is changing. The book is about this digital modernisation of the worlds of books and reading. It analyses how and what young and older people read, how publishers and book dealers deal with the digital challenges and what completely new ways of reading digital platforms are taking. The book is a defense of reading and outlines the opportunities of reading when everything becomes digital.
content.title_en: Reading in the digital age

content.text: Cogeneration and aid: consequences of the ECJ ruling of 28 March 2019. In its judgment of 28 March 2019, the ECJ ruled that the EEG 2012 is not an aid. In a detailed analysis based on ten system-relevant criteria, the author demonstrates that this judgment is applicable not only to the EEG but also to the KWKG. Thus, each of these support systems is funded by a transfer, which are based on private law relations and in which the State cannot exercise power or control over the financial resources. These are the replacement of the difference in costs for the operators of CHP plants in the interest of climate protection. In the future, the lack of aid character of the KWKG would not result in a notification procedure.
content.title_en: Cogeneration and aid : consequences of the ECJ ruling of 28.3.2019

content.text: Study paperless: scientifically working in digital times. Paperless work facilitates your studies and ensures clarity Whether you study seminar texts, laboratory reports or housework – anyone who studies uses paper without the end. This is not only bad for the environment, but also for their own work. It is much better to study paperless. Thus, all documents are easily searchable, can be stored without any problems and can be found again. But how does this work? This book shows suitable workflows, hardware and apps to work paperless. Thus, the individual chapters such as students can show how to perform paperless and structured tasks in the study, such as research, material processing, writing texts or creating presentations, better paperless. This book makes the advantages of the digital organization clear.
content.title_en: Study Paperless : Scientific Work in Digital Times

content.text: Interdependence between land use and climate change. Beschr.: This Open Access book presents the first cross-cutting developments in the sectors in Germany until 2030, which cover the largest area - agriculture, forestry, housing and transport - and analyses the interactions between land use and climate change. Based on an action-based discourse on action options to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and adapt to climate change, different land use strategies are developed. The various focal points are discussed, such as climate protection, bioenergy, nature and environmental protection as well as climate adaptation. The possible impacts of the various strategies on food and raw material production, bioenergy, environment and nature as well as socio-economic consequences are analysed using model-based methods. Based on the results, the authors show both how land use in Germany can contribute to climate protection and the conflicts that exist with other societal goals.
content.title_en: Interactions between land use and climate change

content.text: The work is a restructuring law manual for practitioners. Refurbishment by means of insolvency regulations or by means of the "Restructuring Act" which was regulated for the first time at the beginning of 2021. The focus is on the solution of practical questions of the company's continuation and restructuring. In the insolvency law part, creditors' participation, self-administration and insolvency planning procedures as well as all operational steps relevant to the procedure are dealt with. In the restructuring law part, the restructuring plan, the restructuring officer, the liability concept as well as the court-supported restructuring instruments are explained. Advantages at a glanceRefurbishment before and in insolvency in a presentationPraxi information from the restructuring consulting, corporate development and court everyday problem-focused presentation of the current problems of all insolvency-related procedural tools with solution and implementation suggestions. Target group: For restructuring consultants, insolvency administrators, tax consultants, business auditors, creditors and their employees.
content.title_en: Company restructuring and management

content.text: Messunicherungen - Anwendungen : für das Physikalische Praktikum. This book presents the evaluation of measurement data with its uncertainties for the application in the physical internship. For the essential types of measurement tasks, the reader finds a compilation of all the necessary formulas for determining the best value and the combined and extended measurement uncertainty as well as practical hints for the determination of uncertainties according to type B (non-statistical method). Numerous calculated examples provide concrete instructions and demonstrate how the results are incorporated into the internship protocol and how they are discussed. The present compendium is suitable for students in a bachelor's or teacher's program physics as well as for students in natural and engineering courses with secondary subject physics.The content Treatment of measurement data for typical measurement tasks type A (statistical) and type B (non-statistic) evaluation Messunicherheit im Anspraxisproktikum Examples from the physics internship The target groups in a bachelor's or teacher's program physics and in natural and engineering studies of students at universities and in secondary schools have worked on the study of the University of Rostock.
content.title_en: Measurement uncertainties - Applications : for the physical internship

content.text: The study of measurement uncertainty is presented in a concise and vivid manner. In the "Guide to the indication of uncertainty during measurement" (ISO/IEC 98-3:2008), the terminology and methods for the treatment of measurement uncertainty are internationally standardized. On this basis, the reader is taught knowledge of the nature of measurement deviations, of measurement uncertainty and probability distribution, of the combined and extended measurement uncertainty and of compensation calculation. The present compendium is suitable for students in a bachelor's or teacher's degree programme in physics as well as for students in natural and engineering studies with a secondary subject physics. The content of measurement deviations, measurement uncertainty and probability distribution Combined and extended measurement uncertainty Statistical analysis of random measurement deviations (type A evaluation) Compensation calculation Determination of uncertainties according to type B (non-statistical method) The target groups Students in a bachelor's or teacher's degree programme Physics and in natural and engineering degree programmes Teaching staff at universities and in secondary schools of applied sciences The University of Rostock Both have worked on theoretical and theoretical studies in the field of physics.
content.title_en: Measurement uncertainties – Basics : For the physical internship

content.text: Predictive Analytics and Data Mining: an introduction with R. This book provides an easy-to-understand introduction to the topic of data mining and predictive analysis methods. As a method collection, it initially provides a short presentation of the theory for each method and explains the formulas necessary for understanding. It follows an illustration of the procedures with the help of examples developed with the program package R. Finally, a simple possibility is presented, with which the performance values of different methods can be compared with statistical means. To use suitable graphics and confidence intervals. The book does not dispense with theory, however, it presents as little theory as possible, but as much as necessary and is therefore ideally suited for study and self-study. The content Descriptive methods Cluster methods Dimension reduction Predictive methods for classification and regression questions Empirical comparison of the performance of various classification methods The target group Students of Business Informatics, Informatics and Engineering Sciences The author Marlis von der Hude studied mathematics with the focus on statistics at Freie Universität Berlin and subsequently completed his doctorate at Technische Universität Berlin. After several practical activities in the field of business and business administration-reduction of the Bonn.
content.title_en: Predictive Analytics and Data Mining : an introduction with R

content.text: Elemental Basics of Higher Education Mathematics: technical and methodological with online self-tests. This book offers a detailed and vivid introduction to university mathematics with the thematic focus on logic, quantities, relations and functions as well as structure of the number system. Besides the mathematical content, it contains many methodological tips for the search for suitable proof methods, for writing and reading mathematical texts as well as for avoiding errors. Numerous technical and methodological exercises with solution instructions as well as online self-tests for learning control at the end of each chapter complement the work and allow the reader to use the material in a particularly in-depth manner. The book is suitable for students of all teaching offices with mathematics, especially in the first semester, and also for the bachelor's degree course in mathematics as an entry-level course for the first six weeks of study or a preliminary course. The author Dr. Regula Krapf has been working since her doctorate in mathematics in 2017 (Mathematical Logic) at the University of Bonn as a scientific assistant at the Mathematical Institute of Koblenz-Landau University. 1 Logic and Proof Methods -- 2 Quantism Theory - 3 Natural Numbers- 8 Numbers- Relation Theory - 8 - Natural Numbers- Relation - Index - 5 - Index -

content.text: Mobility and communication in modern times. Our current world of life is profoundly shaped by great supraregional mobility and fast communication. The book presents key developments in the history of mobility and communication in modern times and examines their significance in the past and the present. It introduces the working methods, methodology and ways of thinking in historical science.
content.title_en: Mobility and communication in the modern age

content.text: Salafism: the roots of Islamist extremism, using the Friday sermons in a Salafist mosque in Germany. After an overview of the historical development, definition and characteristics of Islamist extremism, the author traces the establishment of the Salafist network in Bavaria, which he researched scientifically in 2016 and 2017. It is shown that the radical religious narrative, by using passages from the sacred texts of Islam (Koran and Sunna), generates both enemy images within Islam and attacks on Christians and Jews. Of course, it is not the aim of the book to demonise Islam and Muslims and to accuse them of terrorism. However, it is important to understand how Salafists provide religious legitimacy for their ideology, in order to set prevention or countermeasures, not least there or there.
content.title_en: Salafism : the roots of Islamist extremism in the example of Friday sermons in a Salafist mosque in Germany

content.text: The art of game design: design and develop better games. Everyone can develop successful games – no technical expertise is required to do so. It shows that the same psychological basic principles that work for board, card and sports games are also key to the development of popular video games. With this book you will learn how to proceed in the process of game design and development to create perfectly thought-out games. Jesse Schell shows how to improve your game step by step by step through a structured method. More than 100 targeted questions and numerous examples from classic and modern games open up new perspectives for you, so that you can find the features that make it successful for your own game. These include, for example, questions such as: What challenges does my game pose to players? Does it promote competition among players? Are they motivated to win? In the book you will learn what matters with a game that meets your players' expectations and is gladly played. At the same time, the author provides you with every amount of inspiration - keep up with the paper and pen to capture your new ideas immediately.
content.title_en: The Art of Game Design : Design and Develop Better Games

content.text: Electromagnetic fields : Theory and application. The university textbook for students of engineering, computer science and physics, which specializes in electromagnetic fields, offers the classical university teaching material on electromagnetism after a refresher of the underlying mathematics (Vektoranalysis), starting from the maxwell equations via electro- and magnetostatic and various degrees of dynamic fields, charge currents, scattering and diffraction of waves in different media up to relativistic processes. The final version is an introduction to numerical simulation (finite-elements and finite-differences method). This 6th edition offers additional extensions (loss performance, radiation) and new chapters (periodic structures, internet animations) adapted to the progressive knowledge (ID-G 51/15) in addition to the previous edition (ID-G 51/15). For solutions to the exercise tasks there is a separate exercise book (here last published ID-G 12/08; 3rd edition in April 2021). - Cf. A.J. Schwab: "Begriffswelt ..." (ID-G 11/19), F. Gustrau (ID) applies more to the simulation theory of the field (ID.

content.text: Colour and Space - Hans-Albrecht Schilling. "On the occasion of the awarding of the Bremen Award for Building Culture to Hans-Albrecht Schilling, the Bremen Centre for Building Culture publishes a commemorative publication in his own honour. Hans-Albrecht Schilling, born in Bremen in 1929, made a name for himself after an education as an artist, especially as a color designer for large housing settlements. Starting from his work as a young designer in the Bremen Vahr from the mid-1950s onwards, he continues to work in the entire federal area. The book gives an classification of his work over the past 70 years and shows numerous examples both in the field of art in construction and in the color design in architecture." (Verlagsinformation)
content.title_en: Colour and space - Hans-Albrecht Schilling

content.text: Echo Spaces of Shock : how the Corona period changes us : Reflections of cultural artists and creatives : an anthology. Covid-19 triggered sound waves that caused a great echo. In 25 contributions cultural artists and creatives record the echo of this time, report on events from politics and society and tell of fears and hopes in their everyday lives in a state of emergency. They measure the shock that hit the cultural sphere during this time and ask themselves how art and culture can be promoted and strengthened in and after the Corona period. The contributions of this anthology were created under the impression of events since the initial restrictions in March until the end of June 2020. (Verlagstext)

content.text: A round table with sharp corners: the diplomatic path to German unity. The two authors – the one then SPIEGEL correspondent, the other diplomat and member of the Bonn negotiating delegation – describe the processes, contradictions and objections and the happy end on the way to German unity "so restless and breathtaking that one does not like to interrupt the reading experience," writes ex-foreign minister Sigmar Gabriel in his preface to the re-edition of the book. Kiessler and Elbe could not only draw on close personal contacts with the key actors of the "two-plus-four" process, but also internal information were therefore accessible to them. In the updated re-edition, the authors took stock of three decades in which the united Germany sought to find its new role. Unity changed more than assumed Germany. Many expectations of the new middle power in the middle of Europe and hopes for a lasting and stable peace order remained unful. The war returned to Europe, to a "strategic partnership" advocated by Henry Kissinger between the US and Russia, the world struggled for a world of disarrayness.
content.title_en: A round table with sharp corners : the diplomatic path to German unity

content.text: The strong welfare state: less is more. Social state means security for all, especially in uncertain times like this. Even for those who think themselves on the safe side. But the belief in the strengths of our welfare state decays, the social basic consensus is endangered. The economist Ronnie Schöb presents a great draft for a modernization that creates new trust. His conviction: We must say goodbye to the interest-led small-minded social policy just as much as to the encrusted structures of a social system that has come into existence. Less bureaucracy, help where help is needed and above all, personal responsibility: Thus the social state becomes firmly established in the future.
content.title_en: The strong welfare state: less is more

content.text: Leadership and digitalization: Challenges for managers in the digital world of work. content.text: How can digital technologies build a more integrated Europe? : exploring digital progress. How can digital technologies promote integration and prosperity in Europe? For decades, digitalisation has been the spearhead of economic, political and social developments. It has become clear that its impact can transform society – digitalization has an impact on all areas of the global economy and radically changes the way in which, for example, financial transactions are conducted, how governments interact with their citizens and people, and people interact with each other. Given the global scale of this digital revolution, the European Union and its Member States want to face the challenges of digitalization and promote its benefits. Initiatives and regulations such as GDPR, SEPA, Horizon 2020 and the Digital Single Market are just some of the ongoing projects at European level. However, it remains clear that further work and commitment in these areas are essential to ensure the development of innovative solutions to the problems arising from the most significant global change since the Industrial Revolution.
content.title_en: How can digital technologies build a more integrated Europe? : exploring digital progress

content.text: From here on, it was different: a political sketch. It was not an intact, healing, secure world into which the Corona pandemic broke. Before that, normality was in crisis. In his clever and thoughtful new book, Robert Habeck explores the reasons for the loss of something natural and designs a policy that is appropriate to the problems of our time. Starting from personal experiences of the last few years, which were marked by successes but also made him a projection surface of hatred, Robert Habeck seeks answers in his new book to the question why the success of liberal democracy threatens to be a failure. Self-critically, he is approaching the blind spots of politics of the past decades and its contradictions. And he designs a policy that no longer only wants to repair, but which does not allow the problems and losses of progress to arise. Because, according to Habeck, if we want to counteract the erosion of democracy, the loss of trust in politics, the loss of Europe, the climate crisis, then we can only do so.
content.title_en: Different from here: a political sketch

content.text: Self-care and protection against own stress for social professions: with online materials. Working with people in precarious situations is mostly intensive, sometimes existentially exhausting and sometimes deeply satisfying. This can pose great professional and personal challenges for professionals. The life stories and emergencies of our clients stir us and the balance between awareness of external and internal life is becoming a shaky situation. When does compassion creation threaten, when secondary traumatization? In this practical book Dima Zito and Ernest Martin shed light on the psychoemotional dynamics that create the everyday stresses of the professionals and they show concrete ways of reducing the stress in simple steps and of achieving more presence like fulfilment. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Self-care and protection against own burdens for social professions : with online materials

content.text: Resilience - the art of resistance : what science says about it. Resilience is the magic word of our time. The special ability of man to cope with crises and difficult living conditions and to step back from this coping is more in demand than ever in our working world, which is characterized by psychological stress. But caution is required. Donya Gilan and Isabella Helmreich give an overview of the history of resilience research, describe their current state and show their possibilities and limits. Omar Hahad and Donya Gilan explore the question of how to secure the cohesion of modern societies in the face of dynamic transformation processes. Basic knowledge on various aspects of resilience. Written by renowned experts. Amazon.de

content.text: JavaScript for impatients : the quick entry into modern JavaScript. The book is recommended for three reasons: 1.) A well-understood introduction. 2.) The "strict mode" - switchable in the program - reports errors in variable processing already at the compile time. Interesting for transitions from other object-oriented languages: The author clearly limits the object model from the class-supported languages such as Java. In the latter case, objects can only exist as instances of a class. In contrast, objects are created and processed in JavaScript independently of the existence of a class. The corresponding class is derived from objects with common properties (2).

content.text: The rest place: a declaration of love. The German rest places have more visitors than the Cologne Cathedral, the Brandenburg Gate and the Oktoberfest. Especially in a motorist nation like ours they are the most important buildings ever. Florian Werner takes these unloved places under the microscope. He talks to truck drivers, bottle collectors and highway police. He meets a rest place operator who loves the noise of the highway, he learns from a botanist how to feed on the plants on the parking lot edge, and he develops a small philosophy of the Sanifair toilet. The result is a loving, funny and very personal homage to a place that is far more fascinating and complex than his reputation.
content.title_en: The Restplace : a declaration of love

content.text: Biodiversity and management of agricultural landscapes: comprehensive action is now important : opinion. Biodiversity in the agricultural landscape has declined sharply in Germany in recent years, even in nature reserves. In their joint statement "Biodiversity and management of agricultural landscapes", the German science academies make recommendations in eight fields of action. They call the protection of biodiversity an urgent and complex challenge. There is a need for a change in society as a whole towards sustainable agriculture. It is important to take into account the economic, political, legal and social framework conditions in agriculture. Therefore, the scientists recommend a systemic approach with diverse, parallel approaches to solutions. The most important point of departure is the subsidy payments under the Common Agricultural Policy of the European Union (CAP). These should be linked more strongly to actual and measurable ecosystem services in the future.
content.title_en: Biodiversity and management of agricultural landscapes : comprehensive action is now important : opinion

content.text: Between cultures: opportunities for integration for migrants. The prerequisite for adequate integration assistance is the knowledge of intercultural differences. People in a cultural area have common features: their personality structure, their habitus, is characterized by joint socialisation processes. A non-European habitus can show serious differences to European – and thus also determine the chances of life in Germany. However, internal patterns are not cast into concrete concrete. Migration is a strong stimulus for personality development – comparable to adolescence. No matter what age, a change of identity into a bicultural dimension will be crucial for social development in the coming decades, for a good life in German culture. Lutz Hieber and Wielant Machleidt will address the background to understanding, discuss practical action skills and promote the knowledge of the basics of intercultural communication.

content.text: 1977: a short history of the present. In 1977, the RAF launched its "Offensive 77", opened the Centre Pompidou in Paris, launched the Apple II in California - and invented the Internet. What do these strange simultaneities mean? Why did Jimmy Carter at the same time speak of the "human rights", spoke black activists of "identity politics", esoterics of the "New Age" and architects of "symbolic forms"? Why simultaneously did punk, disco and hip hop? And why did Michel Foucault say in 1977: "We must start from scratch"? Philipp Sarasin investigates in his book the lines, patterns and similarities that connect these and other events of 1977 - and he tells of how faith in a common general that shaped the modern began to crumble. "The death of Ludwig Erhard, the "Offensive 77- and the invention of the Internet – all events of 1977. Is there a connection? The Swiss historian Philipp Sarasin finds out that all the time is now in the modern age. 2021 The New World is in the New Year's List of Times.
content.title_en: 1977 : a brief history of the present

content.text: Machine learning for time series: Entry into regression, ARIMA and deep learning procedures with Python. Data about processes are recorded in the processing industry, logistics or the financial sector in seconds: the course of a share price, the sales figures of a product, the sensor data of a turbine. Such data not only inform about isolated states; they are like films that trace the course of a process with a series of individual images. Intelligent algorithms can analyze the patterns of these processes, learn them and continue to write them beyond the observation window: states in the future become predictable. The book provides an easy-to-understand introduction to the concepts and practice of time series analysis. It shows how proven and newer learning algorithms work and how to learn with Python and productively use them. A variety of application examples explain the preparation of data, the learning and estimation process step by step. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Machine Learning for Time Series : Entry into regression, ARIMA and deep learning procedures with Python

content.text: The Creativity Code : how artificial intelligence writes, paints and thinks. The omnipresence of the algorithm, which H. Fry and K. Zweig explained to us in the most understandable way possible, is also the entry into the principles of creative AI for the Oxford mathematician. Starting from the three cognitive-scientific modes of creativity (explorative, combinatorial, transformative) he first explains the progress of the latter by means of the working methods of DeepBlue, the chess computer, and DeepMind, the GO computer: He has a self-learning algorithm. Mathematical and analytically oriented, the author examines for us the specific principles, the structure and working methods of self-learning algorithms, in order to then examine their applicability in art. Which rules and algorithms follow music, painting and literature? Which of the creativity modes must be used to create new things? Sometimes it is good, such as Bach imitation or in the poetry, in the narrative literature (still) not. See the experiment of D. Kehlmann. Claimful as Megmal.
content.title_en: The Creativity Code : how artificial intelligence writes, paints and thinks

content.text: Handbook on Learning with Digital Media. Digital media open up opportunities for the in-house differentiated teaching and a new learning culture, but also risks when used uncritically. How can they promote personalized and cooperative learning and learning-effective teaching with heterogeneous groups? This handbook offers concrete impulses for school and teaching development on the current state of the art and scientific research. In particular, the authors address the characteristics of a competence-oriented teaching and investigate how the use of digital media specifically offers itself for this pedagogical concept. Other contributions deal with learning platforms, learning analytics and teaching concepts that provide a hybrid, i.e. mixed use of digital and analog learning settings. The handbook concludes with an overview of digital media in teaching, provides didactic recommendations and brings ideas for practice. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Handbook Learning with Digital Media

content.text: Gentle control? : Deviance, labelling and social work: 1975 and 2020. content.text: World consciousness: Alexander von Humboldt and the unfinished project of another modern age. Hardly any other scientist, writer and scholar of the late 18th and 19th centuries presents such a fascinating challenge for the thinking and action of the beginning of the third millennium as Alexander von Humboldt, the younger of the two Humboldt brothers. This may explain why the natural scientist and natural philosopher, cosmopolitan and cultural theorist, critical intellectual and royal chamberlain, who was admired by his contemporaries, has become more familiar to the public after long decades of forgetting, in which other representatives of national pride seemed more important.
content.title_en: World consciousness : Alexander von Humboldt and the unfinished project of another modern age

content.text: Fatum: the climate and the demise of the Roman Empire. Publisher's info: FATUM is the first book to consistently examine and describe the catastrophic role that climate change and epidemics played in the collapse of the Roman Empire. Based on recent scientific findings from the field of climate science and genetics, Kyle Harper tells the story of an inferno in which we recognize, as in a distant mirror, the terrifyingly familiar features of our own world. The fate of the Roman Empire was not decided by emperors, legionaries and barbarians. At least as important were volcanic eruptions, solar cycles, the instability of climate and man-killing viruses and bacteria. Kyle Harper leads his readers from the peak of the 2nd century AD, when the Roman Empire seemed to be an insurmountable power, into the lows of the 7th century, when the empire was embroiled, politically fragmented and materially leached. He describes how the Romans long bravely sought to stand, as environmental changes suppressed the whole of the empire - until the very beginning of the plague-time, the plague-repeasure of the impoverish period, and the fall of the impoverishness of the Roman Empire, had been repeated.
content.title_en: Fatum : the climate and the demise of the Roman Empire

content.text: Novozän: the coming age of hyperintelligence. Very soon, artificial intelligence will emerge from a new kind of living being: cyborgs, which will be 10,000 times faster than we are. Our life form will appear to them similar to the plant world. But this intelligence will probably not be of the cruel kind we know from the science fiction spectacles from Hollywood. Because it too will depend on the survival of our planet and will have to face the great climate catastrophe that is rolling towards us. Cyborgs could in fact be our last salvation. But that is not all: the great ecological visionary Lovelock has at the age of 100 years cast a glance into our future and written a wise and highly original book in which there is no single boring sentence.
content.title_en: Novocene : the coming age of hyperintelligence

content.text: Undinge : Changes in the world of life. The essay by the German-Korean philosopher (born 1959), who is in the tradition of phenomenology, is Heidegger expert and taught at the Berlin University of the Arts until 2017, is thematically linked to the conservative considerations in "From the Disappearance of Rituals". Since the book "Müdigkeitsgesellschaft" (2010), Han has been considered the most important representative of cultural pessimism. In this minima moralia of the information society, he acknowledges himself as an untimely despiser of technical civilization and delivers an elog to the underlying magic of the analogue world of things. The computerization of reality has radically changed our perception and world relationship: "Not things, but information determine our world of life." Digital informats create Undinge and displace the analog things, whose real presence once formed the "ruhepole of our life". In eight mental images, he provides a critique of the Undinge - including the smartphone (the Unding to itself), the selfie and the AI - the sharp view of our life.
content.title_en: Undinge : Changes in the world of life

content.text: The threatened subject: contributions to the pragmatic transcendental philosophy. The contributions of this collection shed light on the ontological and objectiveistic features of the world view of modern sciences, which make it difficult for man to understand himself as a self-responsible subject. The book focuses on two treatises dealing with the physical, biochemical, genetic and evolutionary theoretical approaches to the reality of life. They are complemented by reflections on the relationship between human subjectivity and artificial intelligence, on the relationships between knowledge and faith, and on the approaches of other philosophers to the world view of modern sciences. The present collection of essays explores the ontological and objectivistic dimensions of the modern scientific world view that make it difficult for people to see themselves as self-determined actors. At the heart of the book are two approaches to the physical, biological, genetic and genetic evolution the question.
content.title_en: The Threatened Subject : Contributions to the Pragmatist Transcendental Philosophy

The leading Dr. Michael Oswald is academic council at the Institute of Political Science of the University of Passau. The menu plays an important role. It is not only the flagship, but also enables the guest to surprise and convince. However, few caterers and hoteliers fully exploit the potential of the card. Wolfgang Fuchs and Natalie Audrey Balch, with the help of Bettina Kaiser and Carla Mayer, convey the possibilities and opportunities of food and beverage cards. The first part of the book provides you with a knowledge base and arranges the map historically, economically and technologically and legally. In the third part you can test your knowledge and consolidate your gastronomic vocabulary through a comprehensive glossary.

content.text: Tourism NOW: Dark Tourism : Travel to places of suffering, terror and death. Auschwitz, Verdun and Chernobyl – such locations of genocide, battles or disasters are recording increasing numbers of visitors worldwide. In his new book Albrecht Steinecke sheds light on this strange phenomenon. He goes into the history of Dark Tourism, among other things, presents different types of "dark" places and explains the travel motives – ranging from memory to sensationalism. Furthermore, he describes the economic effects of memory tourism and shows ways in which destinations can adequately deal with the "dark" cultural heritage. A practical interview also provides deep insights into this tourism segment.
content.title_en: Tourism NOW: Dark Tourism : Traveling to places of suffering, terror and death

Fake is also synonymous with progress and development in the sense of artificiality, virtuality, imagination. In the 21st century, last but not least, digitalization has led to Fake becoming a highly topical and controversial phenomenon in business, politics and society. In this volume, what Fake can be is therefore viewed in an interdisciplinary manner from different perspectives: this includes the historical, literary, intercultural and psychological perspective as well as a political perspective.
content.title_en: Fake : interdisciplinary

An economic, cultural and social history-introducing into landscape science as well as its ecological and economic significance. (Erdmann Steinmetz) "Landscape science can not only be used by specialists, but also by lay people", because landscape is a cultural asset, Köster judges, Professor of Plant Ecology - see "Beautiful Prospects" (BA 7/09) - in its cultural, economic and social history-introducing into a often emotionally occupied subject that extends between natural and spiritual sciences to numerous disciplines. content.text: Food technology: the industrial production of food from agricultural raw materials. Five years after the first edition, a 40-page new edition of this textbook for students of food science subjects is published. The extension has to do with a whole series of new trends that had to be taken up, in terms of Industry 4.0, manufacturing processes, materials, packaging and management methods. The chapter on drinking water is completely new, as well as one on innovative developments for protein supply (e.g. "vegan meat"). The aspects of consumer view and ethics are also included. The update is carried out by all chapters, therefore the first edition should be replaced as far as possible by the present one. The knowledge required for understanding is at Abi basic course level, therefore readers from all fields concerned with the topic "food production" can also benefit from the book from the latest title on the subject, alongside R. Matissek: "Food Chemistry"
content.title_en: Food technology : the industrial production of food from agricultural raw materials

content.text: How do I write diversity? How do I speak gender-appropriate? : a practical manual on gender and language. This practical manual contains information, suggestions and numerous examples of the correct use of gender-inclusive and gender-free language in everyday life, administration, educational institutions and profession. Review (ekz): Since 2006 L. Hornscheidt writes about the topics gender, racism, as well as language and discrimination. Hornscheidt sees itself as a neutrois (a non-binary gender identity) and is committed to a gender-free language change. Since 2018 there is the official 3rd gender entry "divers" alongside "female" and "male". Among these are also people who do not regard themselves as male or female and want to be addressed gender-neutral. How this can be implemented in everyday life, administration, educational institutions or in professional life is explained here in numerous examples. In addition to a gender-free form, a gender-inclusive variant is always offered here.
content.title_en: How do I write diversity? How do I speak gender-appropriate? : a practical manual on gender and language

content.text: God's invisible cubes: physics at the limits of the research. "In this book I want to show how the various boundaries of the world that we can reach have been discovered ... and how they helped shape our image of the world". It is about boundaries in the realm of the ever smaller (building up of matter) and always size (universe). What was the trigger for the Big Bang, why does the finally discovered Higgs boson give the quarks different properties, what is hidden in the quantum lake of virtual particles? Not always is (at least currently) decisive what is physically experimentally feasible; even with mathematical models the question arises of a physical reality behind it: "The solutions of general relativity theory are not necessarily solutions of physics itself". This also applies to quantum theory, since an association of quantum and relativity theory still exists. An exciting and fascinating boundary approach; individual questions always resurface in literature on fundamental research. Here a fairly profound and yet widely understandable summary, often recommended.
content.title_en: God's invisible cubes: physics at the limits of the research

content.text: The author, Professor of Ancient History at the University of Kassel, with a focus on ancient technology history, presents a concise but very informative work on the development of technology in this period. He shows that the origins of ancient technology are mainly to be found in ancient Egypt and the Old East, and then mainly dedicates himself to the development of technology in Greek and Roman culture, divided into the various "areas of application", namely agriculture (at that time, because of the nutritional situation most important), metals, salt, handicrafts, construction technology, transport, infrastructure, communication, mechanics and time measurement, as well as the military technology that often makes war decisions at that time. The connections he points out are fascinating, also his hints on the already then occurring technological consequences, such as the destruction of forests by the enormous wood consumption during metal extraction. Very recommendable and inexpensive! (1)
content.title_en: History of the Ancient Technique

content.text: Objects on the web: scientific collections in digital transformation. Digital documentation of objects and their virtual availability offer enormous opportunities for research, communication and public relations. They also pose a number of questions and challenges to museums and universities: with what goals and tools do we digitize our collections? Which approaches do we want to allow them? What is the relationship between analog and digital objects? The volume gathers positions from theory and practice that deal with the digitization and digitality of scientific collections. The contributors provide insights into current approaches, illuminate future perspectives and ask about the consequences of a digital collection practice. (Source: Verlag)
content.title_en: Objects on the Net : Scientific Collections in Digital Change

content.text: Science fiction for introduction. The genre science fiction as a popular-cultural representation of fictitious technology and imaginary events often forms a reference when it comes to current questions of the future. The narratives make valuable statements about scientific and technological progress, which normalize or critically question current developments. In doing so, the speculative alienation of our world always has metaphorical character as a socio-political comment and reflection on the Conditio humana. Isabella Hermann presents various approaches to definition in science fiction and presents a short genre history up to the recent present. She focuses on genre-typical topics such as intelligent machines and space colonisation, which are currently apparently caught up in reality.

content.text: Billing Management in SAP S/4HANA - Conditional Contract Billing. This book is aimed at all users who want to present future or current bonus processes in SAP S/4HANA and learn how to deal with contract billing. Decision makers and IT managers also get a quick overview of the application possibilities of SAP S/4HANA solution Conditional Contract Billing (CCS/CCM) as a partial function of the billing management. Since SAP ERP 6.0 EHP6, the components agency business (LO-AB) and compensation management (LO-GT-CHB) are summarized in this holistic application. This includes "Sustainable Billing" and "SD-Bonus" were replaced by the new tool in SAP S/4HANA. Using typical application cases, the author duo describes a variety of other billing scenarios in addition to the classic supplier and customer bonus agreements. This includes, among other things, the fees and commission billing, chargeback and bonus buy in the new reporting of the billing industry.
content.title_en: Accounting management in SAP S/4HANA - Conditional contract settlement

content.text: Theology and natural science: to overcome prejudices and to achieve a holistic understanding of reality. Finally, there is a comprehensive presentation of the relationship between theology and natural science. Matthias Haudel discusses the historical developments, the current situation and the future challenges. Furthermore, he unfolds the understanding of the theological creation against the background of the current natural sciences – both in terms of the cosmos and in terms of human beings (e.g. evolution, neuroscience). Haudel understandably sheds light on the theological, philosophical and scientific foundations and their connections as well as the ethical challenges. Furthermore, he presents important dialogue concepts and one-sided reductionist concepts. Thus, overcoming mutual prejudices and the importance of dialogue for the understanding of reality emerges. This concerns the relevance of faith for the whole reality as well as the holistic integration and meaning of natural scientific insights. Accordingly, answers to the existential search for meaningful wholeness of all life-worldly connections can be found.

content.text: Sustainable mobility for all: a plea for more traffic justice. The limits of traffic growth are reached. Climate protection and quality of life are more important than highly-equipped car fleets, which mean loads and mobility disadvantages for millions of people without cars. A radical social-ecological transformation of the transport system is necessary: the development and promotion of the environmental network of public transport, rail, sharing systems, cycling and foot traffic – these are well-known strategic elements, but these are slowed down by the prevailing privilege of the car. The model of the car-friendly city has long since been depleted. Unleased automobiles is increasingly devouring nature and quality of life. The goal must be to secure sustainable mobility, create traffic justice and make half of the car fleet redundant. And the future is already on the road. Many cities are planning a more humanely-friendly mobility: in Paris, Copenhagen, Freiburg and elsewhere. Supported by a more committed transport policy by the federal and EU, the municipal transport movement can become sustainable mobility for all in the city and country. New green business fields and good work for modern mobility services are key to the climate protection measures.

content.text: Classification analyses in the social sciences. This book contains contributions that have been made on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of the workshops on applied classification analysis organised by the editors. The aim of the workshops, which took place at the Landhaus Rothenberge of the Westfälische Wilhelms-Universität Münster, is to combine further developments and newer methods of classification with applications in the social sciences. The classification methods used in the contributions can be assigned to the following areas of analysis methods: cluster analysis, configuration frequency analysis, multiple correspondence analysis, multidimensional scaling, main component analysis, latent class analysis, item-response scaling models and mixed distribution and structural equation models. The processes and their partial further developments – in the form of algorithms converted into R-packages – and their adaptations are used to answer specific topics and questions of the social sciences.
content.title_en: Classification analyses in the social sciences

To what extent does the fictional representation of trans* persons represent its diverse reality, which is characterized by self-determined life plans as well as discrimination and violence? If it is true that series produce models of society and identification, what opportunities and dangers are associated with their dissemination? The authors investigate this question on the basis of selected European series. creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/40/

content.text: What rights does nature need? : Paths out of the extinction of species. One million species are threatened with extinction in the coming years. Again and again the United Nations and governments reaffirm that they want to protect biodiversity. But the political goals are always missed. Can the protection of biodiversity be legally enforced? To this end, the idea of a right to complain for animals and ecosystems has been developed decades ago. NGOs and lawyers are also currently calling for the concept of "nature as a legal entity". Is such a further development of the law possible and can it protect biodiversity? The authors bring together insights from ethics, biology, social sciences and legal sciences: How can one justify rights of nature? How do social ecological examples look like, in which biodiversity and human resource use do not compete with one another? What would be the social consequences if rights of nature were recognized?
content.title_en: What rights does nature need? : Ways out of the extinction of species

content.text: HACCP: the food safety tool. The guarantee of food safety is the basic requirement for the entire supply chain of the food industry. Nevertheless, there are always clear deviations, misunderstandings or uncertainties on this topic. Both in domestic and foreign companies.The specialist book "Questions & Answers HACCP" helps you to clarify the most important questions and build a secure system. Older systems can be examined and improved by the questions raised. Furthermore, you can find some starting points in order to transfer advantages from the HACCP system to other business sectors.The basis for the questions and answers are in particular the "EU Guide HACCP" and the newly published requirement catalogue of the standard "IFS Food Version 7". They are complemented by the valuable experiences that the author has gathered on his career path. The many practical examples that are mentioned on the individual points show you the possibilities for implementing the requirements.

content.text: The Oslo Report : how a German physicist betrayed the secret plans of the Nazis. Eight weeks after the Nazi attack in Poland in 1939, two letters were received at the British Embassy in Oslo. The anonymous author described new German weapons systems and outlined the goals of military research programs of the Wehrmacht. The British secret service feared targeted disinformation. But a young intelligence officer realized that the information was mostly true – and could be used for the benefit of the allies. But who had written the "Oslo Report? To this day, Hans Ferdinand Mayer, the author of the document, is hardly known. He risked everything and escaped the death of the concentration camp. In this book David Rennert traces the breathtaking story of the Oslo Report.
content.title_en: The Oslo Report: how a German physicist betrayed the secret plans of the Nazis

content.text: Threatened books: a history of destruction and preservation of knowledge. "Knowledge is power" is a truism that draws on the more than three thousand years of history of recording and preserving knowledge and information. Richard Ovenden, librarian of the venerable Bodleian Library in Oxford and profound expert in book history, describes in 14 chapters key events in the history of archives and libraries from the time of the Assyrians to the present time of the digital flood of information, which document, on the one hand, the collection and increase of knowledge and information, on the other hand, the power-political, private or lack of interest and neglect-dominated motivations of the attack on this knowledge as well as the forms of information abuse. The individual events are vividly and excitingly written, well researched and extensively documented (on 74 pages). In the final chapter, the author formulates an passionate 5-point Manifesto, "why we will always need libraries and archives". - Timely and thematically comprehensive, a must for any stock, currently without comparison title. In the second part, which forms the focus of this supplement, an overview of the newly created and very dynamic research field "School and Corona" is given, based on over 80 "Steckbriefen" on empirical research projects, which devote themselves to the pandemic-related limitations of school operations, distance learning and its variants combined with attendance instruction, and on the other hand, through an extensive bibliography of publications published on the subject so far. content.text: Buildings that have never been built: failed visions of architecture. The fascinating stories behind visionary buildings that have never been realized. With the beginning of the 20th century, courageous thinkers have set out to rewrite architectural history. The focus of the planning interest is the society of tomorrow, in which nothing is impossible. Many of the bold designs have fallen victim to reality. This does not detract from their genius. This volume tells the fascinating stories behind these projects. As a tribute to the power of vision, the richly illustrated volume presents future concepts of exceptional planners such as Le Corbusier, Kenzo Tange and Zaha Hadid. The factual and pictorial case studies make tangible how wishful memories of the impulses become a change of thought. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Buildings never built: failed visions of architecture

content.text: Doom: the great disasters of the past and some lessons for the future. Corona is not the last catastrophe of humanity, only its youngest. Disasters cannot be predicted. They do not occur in cycles. And yet: If the disaster strikes, we should be better equipped than the Romans at the outbreak of Vesuvius, the people in the Middle Ages at the raging spread of the plague throughout Europe or the Russians at the reactor disaster of Chernobyl. But is that us? Did we not experience everything in the Corona pandemic precisely in imperial arrogance, bureaucratic solidification and deep division? ? ?Doom? looks with the view of the historian and economist at the most diverse disasters in human history. We must learn our lessons from these historical examples so that future disasters do not lead us to ruin. With a current preface of the author for the German edition. (Verlagswerbung)
content.title_en: Doom : the great disasters of the past and some lessons for the future

content.text: Clit : the exciting story of clitoris. Louisa Lorenz tells an exciting story of ignorance, oppression and confusion and shows that it is high time for more sexual self-determination and for the liberation of our lust. A revelation for all who have sex! (publishing information)
content.title_en: Clit : the exciting history of clitoris

content.text: The invention of the continents: a history of the representation of the world. Why is it always on maps north top? Is Turkey part of Europe? Are there seven or five continents, and what is this division based on? Borders and assignments of countries and seas, which seem to us to be natural and intransigable, are in fact the result of historical and geopolitical developments. Christian Grataloup has gone on a search for traces in world maps and atlases from antiquity to today. He shows how different traders, sailors and colonial lords have looked at the world, and why the representation of the earth is not as clear as thought.
content.title_en: The invention of the continents: a history of the representation of the world

content.text: The election is still a day of the day, and the election is still a day of the day. In 2021, the year of the cäsuren is a year of the German Revolution. After 16 years, the German Bundestag elections end the Merkel era, and in a historic decision, the Federal Constitutional Court strengthens the rights of the younger generation. Ecology is now finally at the centre of all future questions: economy, transport, nutrition, but also science, journalism and politics – elementary areas of society must be rethought. Major upheavals are imminent. And it depends much on whether we find common solutions. How much honesty can the conflict between the generations endure? It is high time to look for the conversation. Activist and chief editor, student and family father: Exciting, open and wisely discuss Luisa Neubauer and Bernd Ulrich the fate questions of our days. For those who have been busy with the topic for years, we still have the choice. "One would like to read this book with a pencil in hand, every second word emphasizes and some of the strongest sentences with colorful pencils on posters and carry on the next climate strike. For those who have been busy with the topic, we do not know how to think about the world, how to think about the world.
content.title_en: We still have the choice: a conversation about freedom, ecology and the conflict of generations

content.text: The age of uncertainty: the brilliant and dark years of physics 1895-1945. Klappentext: In the golden age of physics our thinking and the world were revolutionized. Tobias Hürter describes this epoch and the spectacular lifes of the great geniuses of natural science. And he shows how inseparable science and world events are connected. Because we cannot observe the world without changing it. Marie Curie, Planck, Bohr, Heisenberg, Schrödinger and Einstein not only revolutionized physics, but our world, indeed our reality, are reinvented. They were intellectual adventurers, dandys or nerds, who connected deep friendships and bitter enmities. The often crossing paths of life of these heroes of thought offer a rich treasure of great stories. And at the same time their research has triggered an undreamed scientific boost that led to a new world image of physics that is not fully understood until today. But the age of relativity theory and quantum mechanics was also the age of wars and revolutions. Hiraki's discovery of catastrophes and revolutions led the radio-revolution.
content.title_en: The Age of Blurness : the Shining and Dark Years of Physics 1895-1945

content.text: The American historian Daniel R. Headrick has been working on environmental, social and technological history for many years. With this book, he draws an impressive global review of his research, which can be considered a reference work on environmental history. Headrick makes clear that serious interventions in nature and environmental disasters have accompanied and shaped the history of humanity since the beginning. Since the Stone Age, people have exploited the earth. In the mass as the technological capabilities of humanity grew, natural resources have been increasingly reduced and habitats for other species have been systematically destroyed. However, the book also shows how nature has repeatedly thrown mankind back in the form of climate shocks or epidemics. In the Anthropocene, however, the power struggle with nature seems to finally get out of balance, the man-made climate catastrophe inescapable. - The well-readable and facts-saturated book captivates by clarity and objectivity; widely applicable and recommended
content.title_en: Subdue the Earth : the Environmental History of the Anthropocene

content.text: Sociology of value and evaluation. The sociology of value and evaluation has become a relevant research field that has a wide range of references to existing research areas both within sociology and in its neighbouring disciplines. Anne K. Krüger provides a comprehensive introduction to this field, from categorization and classification to valuing and valuing to value plurality, from quantification to ratings, rankings and evaluations to dataficing. By outline the sociology of value and evaluation both in its theoretical foundations and underlining its relevance through various examples from different social areas of life, it provides an analytically prepared insight into the practices of value and evaluation.
content.title_en: Sociology of value and evaluation

content.text: Basics of functional materials for study and practice. Motivating: the practical relevance to modern applications from high-tech industry ensures aha effects and strengthens the perseverance in penetrating the learning material Focused: ideally suited for students of electrical engineering, medical technology and business engineering The new textbook on functional materials offers prospective engineers a motivating introduction to the material science thanks to the detailed presentation of the basics and a strong practical relevance. Helps in the preparation of the exam: chapter summaries and numerous tasks with solutions in the appendix The application-oriented entry into the world of functional materials - modern, understandable, practical.
content.title_en: Basics of functional materials for study and practice

content.text: Archaeological preservation of monuments : Theory - Practice - Professional fields. The archaeological preservation of monuments is by far the largest employer in Germany within the archaeological disciplines and institutions; far more important than museums or universities. It is therefore important to deal with it during your studies. The book describes the history of archaeological preservation of monuments, presents its national and international organizational forms and offers an introduction to the classification of monuments. It thus provides students with a detailed overview of the history, theory and practice of preservation of monuments and also presents study programmes and professional fields.
content.title_en: Archaeological preservation of monuments : Theory - Practice - Professional fields

content.text: LabVIEW for Dummies. You have to deal with LabVIEW unexpectedly? This book helps you to find your way around this graphical programming system. The authors explain the basics of graphical programming and explain what virtual instruments (VIs) are. They introduce you to work in projects with LabVIEW, show you what you should consider when troubleshooting, how to use data types and data structures and much more. Even classic programming is not too short and so you will find yourself in LabVIEW faster than you think.
content.title_en: LabVIEW for Dummies

content.text: Dangerous faith: the radical world of thought of esotericism. Especially in a time of upheaval and change, many people seek support and orientation in esoteric world-explanation models. Horoscopes reveal what will bring their own future. The spiritual healer becomes the leading figure. The esoteric market is booming! Is the belief in invisible forces that are supposed to guide our lives in the right direction just a harmless spin? Or does the esoteric trend bring with it more dangerous risks than it may appear at first glance? "As loosely as this book is written, it turns out to be formidable vademecum against an increasingly shameless scepticism of science that could be expensive for society, especially in the face of crises to be rolled on it." (FAZ). Nominated for the shortlist of the NDR Property Book Prize 2022
content.title_en: Dangerous Faith : the radical thought world of esotericism

content.text: Best of Interior 2021 : the 50 most beautiful residential concepts. As the most important residential design award for interior designers and designers, the new yearbook BEST OF INTERIOR is again published this year. From diverse and outstanding projects, a top-class jury has selected the best 50 private furnishing concepts. Author Ute Laatz portrays the award-winning concepts in detail and presents the ideas, inspirations and, last but not least, the heads behind the innovative implementations and products.
content.title_en: Best of Interior 2021 : the 50 most beautiful residential concepts

content.text: Plastics know-how for additive manufacturing: properties, formulation and applications of thermoplastics. This practical book is aimed at companies that want to integrate thermoplastic-based 3D printing into their manufacturing processes and have to build up know-how in the selection of suitable plastics. It presents the thermoplastics relevant for additive manufacturing and their process specific features as well as diverse application areas. The book is dedicated to the following topics: - functional principle and construction strategy of thermoplastic-based additive manufacturing processes, in particular fused layer modelling (FLM) and selective laser sintering (SLS) - classification and formulation of thermoplastic polymer materials - mechanical, thermal and chemical properties of thermoplastics, which must be taken into account for use in 3D printing - material, design and process specific characteristics of thermoplastics for successful processing - supporting materials, multimaterial processes, fiber-reinforced components - bio-based or degradable thermoplastics, recycling of thermoplastics - recommendations for work and environmental protection as well as product safety Numerous practical examples that make use of the recommended combinations of plastic methods and tools for the use of additive printing.
content.title_en: Plastic knowledge for additive manufacturing : properties, formulation and applications of thermoplastics
