content.text: The electric car – vehicle of the future! Everything about electromobility in a book – technical basics and current backgrounds – was prepared in an appealing and clear manner for all those who are looking for a sound insight into the promising technology of e-mobility. The textbook provides the physical and engineering basics of electric vehicles in comparison to vehicles with combustion engines. Calculation bases and simulations are developed for core statements. The influence of legal requirements and the interlinking to the energy transition are discussed. The overall analysis shows under which boundary conditions electric vehicles make sense and what future development will look like including opportunities and risks. The 5th edition has been completely revised, new sections on autonomous driving and hydrogen have been added. From the content: Overview on the topic of electric vehicles, implementation forms in practice (kw, buses, commercial vehicles, bicycles, etc.), basic motor vehicles drives, construction groups of electrified drivetrains, charging infrastructure, consumption and range, energy generation and storage, environmental balance and market comparisons, mobility concepts and promotion of electric mobility technology in Germany.
content.title_en: Electromobility : Basics and Practice

content.text: Transport without ozone : Consequences for easy mobility in urban regions ; Final report on the donation project "Transport and Ozone". Air pollution by ozone (not the "Ozon hole"!) is only the starting point of this study, which explains traffic problems and countermeasures in urban areas particularly clearly and systematically. The text enriched with numerous data and facts, but not overloaded, is suitable for many readers who are willing to do some training and can serve as a basis for demanding presentations. A title that can be used in the extensive literature on the subject of particularly useful titles, for example, in addition to the thematically broader "Transport collapses" (BA 10/94). A minus point is the simple presentation without back-labelling, which is compensated by "internal values". See also K. Haefner: "Lean Transport" (in this No. 2) (Rolf Rashka)
content.title_en: Transport without ozone : consequences for easy mobility in urban regions ; final report on the donation project "Transport and ozone"

content.text: The wrinkle of the world: how world peace was played out in 1933. An international diplomacy thriller, which plays between February 1932 and October 1933 - historian Paul Jankowski tells the story of the failure of the world community of states, the prehistory of the Second World War. The world ran out of control in the winter of 1932/33. In Germany Hitler seized power, Mussolini rushed to Africa, Japan attacked China and left the League of Nations. In France there were three government changes, the USA under Roosevelt tried to overcome the world economic crisis in its own way. In an enthralling narrative Paul Jankowski describes how the world was finally shaken by national egoism. Everyone fought against anyone who failed the great Geneva disarmament conference grandiosely, the consequences of that failed worldwide came to power. An exciting portrait of world politics in the 1930s - the history of a torn decade that ended in the Second World War. May it also be a mistake to pull parallels: The consequences of that failure are revealed to all today in the world's unreconciliatable and in terms of violence?
content.title_en: The wobble of the world : how world peace was played out in 1933

content.text: More rationality : a guide to better use of the mind. We are constantly wrong - this is shown by the author using the latest research results in cognitive psychology. Meanwhile we also know that people make many logical mistakes in their everyday communication, which can strongly influence the truth content. S. Pinker - professor at Harvard University - not only defends rationality and shows its strengths; he also explains the most important tools for rational thinking and guides the reader through the basics of logic and critical thinking. Thus he describes probability and the role of chance, the relationship between belief and evidence, risk and statistics. After this course in rationality we are prepared to make rational decisions alone and with others much better. Because rationality is still the best tool to take our fate into the hands. As always, the author completes his scientific considerations with an extensive literature directory and register. A book that recommends itself for the field book department in stocks of medium size.
content.title_en: More rationality : a guide to better use of the mind

content.text: Monitoring and consuming: Control, norms and social relationships in digital society. The digitalization of our living worlds is omnipresent and enables the monitoring of our everyday lives in previously unknown forms. But why is there so little resistance to this, although data-protectors are always warning and whistleblowers like Edward Snowden make public the full extent of mass surveillance? Nils Zurawski states that such questions pass by the phenomenon itself, if they do not take the importance of consumption seriously as an elementary social element. He shows what symbolic power technologies have and why digitalization leads to a re-feudalization of life worlds. In this perspective, monitoring becomes part of consumption and has an identity-building effect. The book provides alternatives for other ways to deal with digitalization and new ways to discuss monitoring.
content.title_en: Monitor and consume: Control, standards and social relations in the digital society

content.text: Asked by others: About digital networking, value creation, pathos & identity. Nothing survives without repetition - the essays in this book show that the existing can be changed, it even needs to be changed. The texts undertake critical descriptions of the existing. They deal with the exploitation system of capitalism, the associated oppression and over-stress of the subject and, last but not least, the rejection of identity as a concept that necessarily generates and sustains exclusion Frontmatter -- content -- thank you! -- Introduction: Despite, expending, insurrection & injustice -- interrogated to others. The defensiveness of pluralism -- mediated by confusion. (Digital) networks of consumption and rowned transparency -- More values for whom? Added value by whom? A value for life? -- Excessive subjectivity: submission, insult, responsibility -- The manifestation of differences. Or: What is the question of the "who?" -- List of literatures.
content.title_en: Demanded by others: About digital networking, value creation, pathos & identity

content.text: Education in the digital transformation: the importance for pedagogical staff and for education. The authors are working on the most important research literature of the last 10 years on the respective subject area, thus referring to very current data. This is important, because decision makers in politics and education depend on the evaluation of studies and literature to make well-founded decisions. This is achieved with the present volume in a sound way. – Stefan Düfel, in: lehrbibliothek.de. In the application of digital media and the transfer of knowledge via digital technologies, the pedagogical staff of all educational areas have a key position. The question of the role of pedagogical staff in this process touches on different aspects from the attitude and attitude of teachers towards general developments in the educational fields and measures that are implemented for the education and training of teachers. This question and its sub-topics is examined in this volume by a review format that is oriented towards the process of critical reviews and identifies the most important literature in the field, systematically records the quality of the researched literature and evaluates it in accordance with the respective focus of the question.
content.title_en: Education in digital change: the importance for educational staff and for education and training

content.text: Education, school, digitalisation. This volume bundles over 70 contributions to the topic "Education, school, digitalisation". A central goal is to reflect and critically reflect on the current research status on the diverse aspects, perspectives and questions on digitalisation in the context of school education and teacher education. The topics are programmatic ideas on digitalization and digitality, media concepts and deployment scenarios of digital media as well as questions of their effectiveness. Empirical original works on the use of digital media, examples of good practice, descriptions of planned studies and theoretical contributions to the topic are gathered.
content.title_en: Education, school, digitalization

The chemistry and the technical application of metallic materials, plastics, ceramics and glasses as well as the corrosion of metals and the possibilities of corrosion protection are discussed. The section on glass in particular has been greatly revised. Numerous additions have been made, in particular in the fields of metallic materials and plastics. content.text: The self-driving company: a model of thought for organizations of the future. In this book, an economic-scientific thinking model and a realistic vision of the future are to be presented from the image of the self-driving company. The time of human-controlled linear processes is over: The self-driving company adapts completely automatically to new requirements, constantly learns, never loses focus, does not tire and knows at all times about the state of all organs in its agile organism. It takes routine processes, while the people mainly carry out creative and interpersonal empathic activities. The technical basis for this is already available today. This book presents the vision of the self-driving company in 2035, shows the way there and illustrates it with numerous practical examples. The content The way to the self-driving company functioning of a self-driving company The human being and the self-driving organization The author Florian Schnitzer is management consultant for software and owners and managing directors of the ReqPOOL Group. He advises leading companies in Germany and Austria on the most important topics of digital and computer science in the USA.
content.title_en: The self-driving company: a model of thinking for organizations of the future

content.text: The BIM Institute of Architecture and Engineering: Digital Building Models with NX, 3D Construction, Data Integration, Data Exchange and FE Simulation. The textbook is aimed at students and design and calculation engineers in the practice of structural engineering, who are already working on 3D construction, data integration and simulation in the course of Building Information Modeling (BIM). Using selected practical examples, the fundamentally new methodology of 3D modelling in bridge and engineering is presented step by step and supplemented by e-learning features (videos, files). A cross-cutting project example is used to present the context of the BIM application for a bridge construction plant and briefly explain the theoretical background. Finally, all examples of the latest software generation are being revisited in the context of the new BIM business model.
content.title_en: BIM in bridge and engineering construction : digital construction models with NX, 3D construction, data integration, data exchange and FE simulation

content.text: Digitalization and Artificial Intelligence in Production: Basics and Application. Industry and Society in Digital Transformation -- Basics of Digitalization and Industry 4.0 -- Basics of Artificial Intelligence (AI) -- Ethical Aspects -- Data of Digitalization and AI -- Machine Learning -- Machine Decisions -- Other Tools of Artificial Intelligence -- Attack and Manipulation Security in AI Systems -- Digitalization and AI in Production -- Data-driven Process Analysis -- Quality Management 4.0 -- Robotics -- Success Factors. This textbook describes the basics and application of digitalisation and artificial intelligence in mechanical systems outside of pure IT and data processing. First, it focuses on digital transformation in industry and society and provides basic knowledge on digitalization, industry 4.0 and artificial intelligence. This knowledge forms the basis for an overview and enables a deeper understanding of the topic. The ethical aspects as well as big data and tools as security aspects of AI systems are considered. The focus is on application in industrial production and related topics such as medical technology, robotics and quality management. An examination of the success factors of digitalization and AI in the field of industrial technology.

content.text: The Crown Prince and the Nazis: Hohenzollern's blind spot. "'...if I were elected as the President of the Reich and I made Hitler the Chancellor of the Reich. Then I have the booklet in my hands' - that's how the last German Crown Prince Wilhelm von Prussia dreamed in January 1932. But he was not the only actor on the radical right, who wanted to arrange politically with the mighty rising Nazis at the beginning of the 1930s. Lothar Machtan traces this multitude of informal machinations with sensational source material, without which it is impossible to understand how Hitler's chancellorship could come to Hitler's Reichskanlerschaft on January 30, 1933. The author lets the central actors from ego documents speak directly to us and thus comes as close as possible to the events. A fascinating chamber play of political kunglei, in which the main protagonist appears in ever new roles and yet unlearnably follows a constant: the utopian idea of being able to re-establish with Hitler the overthrow of the Hohenzollern throne." (reverse of the band cover)
content.title_en: The Crown Prince and the Nazis: Hohenzollern's blind spot

content.text: We can also do differently: the world of tomorrow is on the rise. Publisher's info: Humanity is in a tremendous transformation process. The amount of what needs to be tackled, repaired and re-oriented seems to be huge. How do we find compass, creativity and courage to tackle these challenges less than much more? Based on scientific knowledge, Maja Göpel illustrates how we can understand such complex developments and use this knowledge for a better world. Because in history there have been major transformations over and over again. They have been triggered by us humans - so we can also design them. Our window on the future is open as never before. With this attitude, structural change is not an imposition, but an opportunity. It is time that we - each of us, but also society as a whole - allow ourselves to think again, dream and ask a radical question: Who do we want to be?

content.text: Radical universalism: beyond identity. The ideology of identity occupies the entire political spectrum – while the left struggles in categories of race and gender, the right-wing politics operates in the name of the nation. And universalism? Strictly based on an empty shell. Modern liberalism does not protect the duties towards people, but the interests of citizens. With Radical universalism, Omri Boehm delivers more than a reinterpretation – it revolutionizes our fundamental understanding of what universalism actually is. He invokes Kant and his often misunderstood revival of the ethical monotheism of the Jewish prophets. A bold design that opens a way out of the frozen identity debate in its fearlessness.
content.title_en: Radical Universalism: Beyond Identity

content.text: Architecture patterns with Python : Test-Driven Development, Domain-Driven Design and Event-Driven Microservices are practically implemented. Architecture patterns are an important size in software development; they determine the basic organization and interaction between the components of an application.- Literature on this topic has hardly been discussed so far; more detailed mention is made of it at V. Vernon (2017).- The book is addressed to readers who already have experience in semi-complex Python applications. The focus is on an event-driven architecture and here at TDD (Test Driven Development, DDD (Domain Driven Development)) and loosely coupled reactive microservices (interface with complexity across multiple applications or business domains). The book is well-developed didactically. It is divided into two parts, the architecture for domain modelling and the construction of an event-driven architecture. Almost every chapter ends with a summary and thus facilitates a good point-specific entry for the reader.
content.title_en: Architecture Patterns with Python : Test-Driven Development, Domain-Driven Design and Event-Driven Microservices practically implemented

The increasing digitization of the world of work is associated with accelerated structural changes. These are connected with changed qualification profiles and thus new challenges for vocational education and training (VET). Companies, vocational schools and other educational institutions must respond appropriately. The volume focuses on the various demands placed on teachers, learners and educational institutions in vocational education and training and Aims to provide up-to-date results on learning in the digital age. The increasing digitalization of the world of work involves an accelerated structural change, which brings about changing qualification profiles and new challenges for vocational education and training. Businesses, vocational training and other educational institutions must respond to the needs of the learning in the digital age. The increasing digitalisation of the world of work involves an accelerated structural change, and thus brings new challenges to vocational education and training.

content.text: The limits of raw material exploitation: environmental conflicts and ecoterritorial change in Latin America. »For readers from the German-speaking world, Maristella Svampa offers a valuable insight into current Latin American debates on experiences with alternative models and resistance to neo-extractivism.« Monika Streule, analysis & criticism, 19.01.2021 Discussed in: https://pub.uni-bielefeld.de, 26.10.2020 Science & Peace, 4 (2020) The exploitation of raw material and the advance of neo-extractivism in Latin America has taken enormous proportions and profound consequences for man and nature. Maristella Svampa takes on this process and analyzes it comprehensively from a socio-ecological and political perspective. To this end, she works out the historical economic cycles of neo-extractivism since 2003 and proposes for a better understanding of the crisis the concept of commodity consensus. In relation to socio-ecological resistance, she introduces the concept of ecoterritorial change, which focuses on the pioneering role of the indigenous peoples and the rights of the indigenous peoples and the exploitation of the indigenous peoples.
content.title_en: The limits of raw material exploitation: environmental conflicts and ecoterritorial change in Latin America

content.text: In the museum, the participants want to discuss and comment on the content and theses of exhibitions on site, directly link their own thoughts, experiences and experiences to their observations. Despite visitor research, museums have hardly asked how this can be achieved. How can visitors contribute to a guided tour, how much time and space their participation requires, how must information and presentation style change? Answers are provided by the concept of museum moderation, which is described here using practical examples, technical instructions and theoretical backgrounds. With contributions by Bettina Altendorf, Anna Grosskopf, Christine Heiß, Michael Matthes, Sofija Popov-Schloßer, Marion Schröder, Friederike Weis, Georg von Wilcken. »[The publication] Impulse für die Museumpraxis und für die weiter Diskussionen.« Sabina Leßmann, Standbein Spielbein, 3 (2013) Spokes in: Museumsjournal, 1 (2014), Helge Schmidt Mitteilungen, 46 (2014)
content.title_en: Moderators in the museum : Theory and practice of the dialogical guided tour of visitors

content.text: Emojis : The history, present and future of a digital pictorial work. Their history involves media corporations, NGOs and governments as well as private users and social groups. In the conflicting field of rival interests, Emojis is ideologically charged and politicized. Some of them are linked to the hope of a global form of communication, while others fear a language and civilization decline. With a focus on the possibilities and limits of Emojis in local and global contexts, Gala Rebane discusses their future potential as a means of communication. Emojis is no longer to be thought of from everyday digital life. But where and when did the colorful image signs emerge, what explains their global popularity? And is the old dream of a universal world language fulfilled with them?
content.title_en: Emojis : History, present and future of a digital picture writing

content.text: Effective subject lessons: a metaanalytic examination of expertise from 17 school subjects. What quality does the subject lessons have in our schools? Is it effective? Does it achieve its goals? To answer these complex questions, 17 books have been published for the most diverse subjects. The volume "Effective subject lessons" brings together the findings of the books published so far, because for all 17 school subjects the methodological approach was the same: Experts from the subject didactics, from the field of science-practice transfer as well as from school practice were asked by means of the same eight questions after their assessment of the results of the relevant studies and their long-standing professional experience in this metaanalytic examination in order to get the essence out of effective subject lessons in the respective subjects.
content.title_en: Effective technical lessons : a metaanalytic examination of expertise from 17 subjects

content.text: Quality management and error culture: deal with errors with profit. Claudia Brückner is the owner of CBC Consulting. She advises companies on the implementation of process-oriented QM systems and supports them on the way to successful certification or recertification. Numerous publications. Value creation through error management The term "error" is negatively affected in most companies, managers and employees. However, in order to learn from mistakes, improve quality and save costs, a rethink must take place. The goal is a fear-free error culture that creates trust and transparency as well as monetary and non-monetary incentives in the company. This work shows how it works! - Learning from mistakes, saving costs and increasing quality - Connects corporate culture with methods of quality and lean management - With work aids, checklists and guidelines for implementation
content.title_en: Quality management and error culture : managing errors profitably

content.text: The required centre: extreme right and democratic attitudes in Germany 2020/21. The centre was rarely as "demanded" as today. Right-wing extremism, populism, racism are becoming more popular. Every two years, the centre study of the Friedrich Ebert Foundation examines extreme right and democratic attitudes in German society. The current representative survey from December 2020 to spring 2021 shows that the "centre" is required to show its position, to take a position and to strengthen its democracy! In addition, it has the potential. Hatred campaigns, violence, right-wing terror and new right-wing groups have hit the middle in recent years. Now the centre itself is associated with global uncertainties and uncalculable follow-up crises. What does this mean for the democratic orientation of society? The mid-study 2020/21 here recognizes both developments that promote democracy and those that threaten it. The centre itself values right-wing extremism as the greatest threat to democracy, and here lies the opportunity to counter it.
content.title_en: The required center : extreme right and democratic attitudes in Germany 2020/21

content.text: Data Science : Fundamentals, methods and models of statistics. Data Science ranges from big data (e.g. J. Freiknecht: 2018) to data mining (T. A. Runkler: 2015) to artificial intelligence (K. Mainzer: 2019, J. Shane: 2021). Against this background, the choice of titles here arouses false expectations. A little too short is the computer-based implementation, which has become indispensable with programming languages such as R and Python in practical application.

content.text: WONTERRAUM plan : Architecture – Psychology – Social – Society – Culture. Living is a basic human need. Living, the apartment is probably the most important space for people, here it holds up a large part of its time. Due to various influences, the way of living and the demands of the inhabitants constantly change. There is probably no such complex and constantly needing adaptation area as that of living. The apartment is the most private area of living, the narrowest living environment. Living is not limited to the actual dwelling. Also, the residential building, the neighborhood, the closer and further surroundings, and finally the psychological and social characteristics of the inhabitants have a great influence on its well-being. Planning and building of living is more than all other construction tasks, an interdisciplinary matter. Living also contains quite different components: physical, psychological, social, etc. In the present book the most important aspects of the topic of living, which are closely linked to each other, are not always read separately.
content.title_en: Plan WOHNRAUM : Architecture – Psychology – Social – Society – Culture

content.text: The third industrial revolution was initiated with the invention of the memory programmable control system (SPS) in 1968. Now we see that they are also contributing significantly to a highly efficient and successful production in Industry 4.0 as an edge controller during the fourth industrial revolution. The present textbook aims to provide readers with a guide on how to solve typical tasks of factory and process automation with PLCs. The main sections of the book are: • Structure of control systems for Industry 4.0 • Modular PLC programming according to IEC 61131 • Design of interconnection controls • Design of sequence controls • Object oriented PLC programming • Motion Control for the digital factory • Digital engineering of reliable controls • Safety and security in Industry 4.0 • Industrial IoT in process automation. Numerous examples and exercises support readers in learning the described methods and tools. The 5th edition has been completely updated and extended in terms of requirements and use of PLCs in Industry 4.0.
content.title_en: Memory programmable controllers in Industry 4.0 : object-oriented system and program design, motion control, security, industrial IoT

content.text: Introduction to form and position tolerance : geometric product specification for practice. The standard work that describes the toleration of components is over 40 years old. Technical drawings are not yet specified in many cases according to the standard. For example, measurements are sometimes not clear, and in practice many things are not regulated. This simple book for beginners wants to provide a remedy. It focuses on the essential know-how: - the basic concept of specification options - clear definition of two-point dimensions - basic rules for the application of references and tolerances to define the permissible limits - outlook on further descriptions that lead to better technical drawings and help avoid unnecessary, expensive coordination of the required content In addition to the standard contents, the book contains a practical approach to the allocation of tolerances. This is explained to typical practical components and can serve as a template for your own components. Dr. Martin Bohn Head of Tolerance Management of the S-, E-, C-Class, Mercedes Benz AG Head of ISO Working Group on Tolerances and Acceptance Conditions of Plastic Shape Components Committee for the DIN standard identification
content.title_en: Introduction to form and layer tolerance : geometric product specification for practice

content.text: CNC programming in the context of digitalization: from G-code to digital twin. Karl-Heinz Engels, a state-certified mechanical engineering technician. Since 2001 at Siemens AG responsible for the documents in the field of sinumerik for the topics of operating and programming on CNC machines and for the coordination and implementation of trainings worldwide. Eric Engels training as a tool mechanics specialist in mould technology. Currently in the further education as a master craftsman for precision engineering. Professionally active in the planning / implementation in the field of prototypes, and special machine construction for medicine and aerospace technology. CNC programming is experiencing a new edition through the process chain from CAD to CAM to virtual reality. There are new digital tools to create and visualize CNC programs. The book shows from the classical G-code programming the variety of exciting and forward-looking possibilities that open up through digitalization. The book contains: - programming under DIN 66025, - programming with control-identical programming software, - graphical programming, - CNC programming with a CAM system, the use of an ideal toolkit - the teaching chain of CNC is explained to the use of a digital machine.
content.title_en: CNC programming in the context of digitalization : from G-code to digital twin

content.text: Digitalisation in the context of sustainability and climate change. Sustainable business, taking into account economic, environmental and social aspects, is becoming increasingly important in society and politics and thus becoming a fundamental prerequisite for successful corporate management. Opportunities and challenges on the way to possible climate neutrality are opening up, especially through the rapid progress of digitalization. In the 9th congress volume of the series "Sustainability Management for Industries", which deals with the topic "Digitalization in the context of sustainability and climate change", scientists and business representatives provide insights into the topics of digitalization and energy management, approaches to more efficient data processing, alternative energy systems, sustainable development and economy, climate data and climate neutrality, carbon accounting and eco-balance.
content.title_en: Digitalisation in the context of sustainability and climate change

content.text: The material technology internship: Tests. Prof. Dr.-Ing. Frank Hahn has been giving lectures on material technology since 1997; since 2006 at the HS Mittweida. He is co-author of the basic textbook Seidel/Hahn, material technology. Materials technology is one of the basic subjects of many technical study directions. In addition, trainees are familiarized with material technology and material testing in numerous teaching professions. The material technology basics are taught in lectures and are fixed in seminars. Further important components are the internships. Students are to acquire practical skills in material testing, on the one hand, and it is important for them to recognize the causes of the determined properties. The textbook contains the most important internship tests, as they are carried out in this or similar form at many universities: - thermal analysis - tensile testing on metallic materials - metalographic sample preparation and light microscopic method examination of equilibrium-converted steels - thermal treatment - heat treatment of steels - imperative test after Charpy - fatigue and vibration-enhance The objective of the detailed instruction is to facilitate the examination in a detailed manner.

content.text: The systematic way to the right material. Always new products conquer the market. Often associated innovations and further developments are made possible by the choice of materials. The inconspicuous number of construction materials presents the designer with the difficult task of finding the right material for his application. This book shows students and developers a methodology for a systematic search for suitable materials. The focus is on a material pre-selection that must not exclude innovative solutions. After a precise analysis of the design task in view of the required material requirements, the designer selects the most suitable material from all available materials. For this purpose, a large number of information sources are available today, especially material databases. Particularly helpful for the innovative approach are material display images that provide a quick overview of all material main groups. The application of evaluation methods leads to a clear way to a ranking list that orders the materials according to the suitability for the design task. For the materials classified as suitable in this evaluation, Prof. has to prove that the components function reliably with these new materials in the product use. One of the materials decision-making procedures has been comprehensively updated.
content.title_en: Methodology of material selection : the systematic way to the right material

content.text: "And old life blossoms from the ruins" : Reconstruction in architecture and art since 1990. It seems instinctively that a very large number of people have an astonishingly similar sense of city spaces as beautiful or ugly. Very often historical/historic architecture is preferred over modernist new buildings. Again and again it is to be heard that many German cities have a deficit in historical architecture and thus in urban aesthetics. This is the consequence of both the destruction of the Second World War and the modernist urban planning and demolitions of the post-war period. Here the present reconstruction movement starts. It tries to rebuild lost historical buildings. It tries to recover important historical buildings or urban ensembles if necessary also by replicating copies. It wants to heal the cityscapes often torn by wrong plans and create beautiful places (again) . This book is devoted to the German reconstruction movement between 1990 and 2020. Projects of quite different development stories are presented. Often committed citizens initiatives behind the realization, not seldom against resistances from architecture and politics are initiated. However, there are also the structures of private reconstruction, or reconstructions are strongly promoted by the foundations.
content.title_en: "And old life blossoms from the ruins" : Reconstruction in architecture and art since 1990

content.text: Tourism policy. Tourism has been a leading economic sector for decades because of its high contribution to economic performance and employment. Although it is primarily considered an economic phenomenon that causes both ecological and socio-cultural problems, tourism first describes a sovereign, i.e. political task. Nevertheless, tourism policy, which determines the design and development of the tourism industry, does not count as the moving political fundamental themes of a society, but rather rather runs away from public spotlights. This textbook analyses tourism policy as a cross-cutting political task, which in many places is strangled by the political system or vice versa by the various policy areas, and addresses its actors and the environment in which it takes place. In particular, the measures and instruments of the individual sub-areas of tourism policy are focused on different spatial scales and the influence of business decisions by tourism policy. In this context, the focus is mainly on German tourism policy, taking into account international best practices. The content is supported by diverse illustrations, practical examples and excursions and aims at creating a knowledge-based and problem-based approach to tourism policy.
content.title_en: Tourism policy

content.text: Perspectives on diversity in early childhood: research diversity with children. To illuminate and explore different perspectives on diversity in early childhood and ways of researching with children are the impetus and goal of this publication. It refers to knowledge stocks and knowledge references that have developed and established themselves in the context of early childhood and diversity and to give attention to the explanation of different methods and concrete experiences to explore perspectives on diversity with them. One focus is on the description and reflection of research with children. The book is directed on the one hand at students and researchers of educational science and its neighbouring disciplines. It provides an insight into fundamental theoretical frameworks regarding the horizons of childhood, childhood research and diversity and presents methods of research that enable active involvement of children in a concentrated manner. Moreover, it provides professionals of elementary education and organizational management with an impression of methods (-reflexions) and approaches of research with children and can support them in decision-making processes about the participation in research projects.
content.title_en: Perspectives on diversity in early childhood : exploring diversity with children

content.text: Complex Narration - Literature on 2+n-ter level : to a theory of literary complexity. The fact that the literary narrative responds to a rapidly changing, complex reality in an analogous way is a obvious thought. André Steiner asks in this context how complexity manifests itself in the literary text and which methods of analysis can be put into effect by literature studies. In doing so, he proceeds from a still existing research deficit and asks for possible reasons for it. Surprisingly, the methodological tools are already largely available. It only depends on recombining them with insights from complexity research.
content.title_en: Complex Narrating - Literature at 2+n-ter Level : to a theory of literary complexity

content.text: Private data: our traces in the digital world. Each of us leaves traces of data, when surfing, online shopping and in social media. It is the state, the economy, but also criminals who have access to these data or who know how to get them. This fact has great significance for the individual, but also for the democratic society that needs to be understood. Barbara Wiesner presents aspects of the processing of private data, which are rarely known to lay people. In doing so, she is oriented towards quotations from personalities from business, science and politics and encourages to form a separate opinion. Thus, the topic of privacy is illuminated against the background of diverse digital data channels.
content.title_en: Private data : our traces in the digital world

content.text: Gender-specific violence in times of digitalization: forms and intervention strategies. Digital violence occurs not only in public spaces, but also in private relationships - and in combination with domestic and sexualised violence has a significantly gender-specific component. Through information and communication technologies, forms of violence such as doxing, stalking, Hate Speech and online harassment and threats have increased significantly and their effectiveness has been strengthened by the use of the Internet. The contributors of the band provide fundamental interdisciplinary analyses for the handling of these forms of violence and discuss both legal, technical and activist interventions as well as experiences from the consulting practice.
content.title_en: Gender-based violence in times of digitalization : Forms and intervention strategies

content.text: Monitoring and consuming: Control, norms and social relationships in digital society. The digitalization of our living worlds is omnipresent and enables the monitoring of our everyday lives in previously unknown forms. But why is there so little resistance to this, although data-protectors are always warning and whistleblowers like Edward Snowden make public the full extent of mass surveillance? Nils Zurawski states that such questions pass by the phenomenon itself, if they do not take the importance of consumption seriously as an elementary social element. He shows what symbolic power technologies have and why digitalization leads to a re-feudalization of life worlds. In this perspective, monitoring becomes part of consumption and has an identity-building effect. The book provides alternatives for other ways to deal with digitalization and new ways to discuss monitoring.
content.title_en: Monitor and consume: Control, standards and social relations in the digital society

content.text: Digitalization as a distributive force : About the new thing about digital capitalism. Are robots taking work away from us? Anyone who asks this question misunderstands digitalization - it is not an industrial revolution by other means. Sabine Pfeiffer is looking for the real new thing behind digitalization and digital capitalism. In her analysis, she is putting the idea of distributive force aside the Marxian concept of productive force. From platform economics to artificial intelligence, this makes it understandable: it is less and less about the efficient production of values, but rather about their fast, risk-free and permanently secure realization on the markets. In addition to the examination of this dynamic and its consequences, it is also discussed why digitalization as a distributive force threatens to become an ecological destructive force.
content.title_en: Digitalization as a Distributive Power : About the New in Digital Capitalism

content.text: City and planning: a book with texts from 100 years of urban planning. Review: The book contributions were selected and commented on by members of the German Academy for Urban Planning and Regional Planning. The book was edited by Heidede Becker and Johann Jessen at the publishing house DOM publishers in Berlin. The book is published on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Academy in 2022. The selection includes excerpts from classics, newly discovered scientific essays, powerful speeches and influential manifestos, but also newspaper articles, travel reports and even poems. The spectrum of authors ranges from Cornelius Gurlitt to Rudolf Hillebrecht to Thomas Sieverts, from Walter Benjamin to Jane Jacobs to Erika Spiegel. The focus is spread as far as the disciplines represented in the Academy: not only urban and regional planning, but also architecture and landscape architecture, traffic planning, construction and planning law, urban sociology and urban economics.
content.title_en: City and planning : a book with texts from 100 years of urban planning

content.text: The wild city: urban wilderness as an ideal, a service provider and a concept for the design of urban nature. The author of this university textbook is Professor of Urban and Landscape Ecology. "urban wilderness dare!" is the leitmotif of this work, while the parks and outdoor areas of public buildings were once covered with short-run lawns, the aim is now to create "urban wilderness", i.e. the designation of areas for unplanned nature, i.e. for wild animals and plants, in the city. This is important for the preservation of biodiversity and for the experience and observation of nature, especially for children and young people. He advocates the exploration of a "wild-nispotennial", for the renaturalization of river waters/upstanding waters, the decommissioning of railway breaks or the rewildification of parts of parks and for the purpose of providing numerous examples with colour photographs from several parts of the earth. - The work with an extensive literature directory is primarily intended for students and teachers of the subjects of urban and spatial planning, ecology, landscape architecture and conservation, but also actively participates in nature conservation, but some are actively involved in the development.
content.title_en: The wild city : urban wilderness as ideal, performers and concept for the design of urban nature

content.text: Sustainable entrepreneurship : Strategic management using the wine industry as an example. This book teaches entrepreneurs: inside small and medium-sized enterprises and start-ups as well as students with a later work in such companies Management competence for goal-oriented, strategic sustainability management. Here, concrete strategic action and the pursuit of sustainability goals are the main focus. The author wrote a practically and empirically sound book with accompanying attractive visual and virtual support, which increases management competence and anchors target-oriented corporate management as a motivating routine among the actors.
content.title_en: Sustainable entrepreneurship : Strategic management using the wine industry as an example

content.text: Business Mathematics: 77 tasks that bachelor students must master. Jutta Arrenberg presents 77 exams with solutions. The focus is on the matrix calculation as well as equation systems, the limit values and the differentiation of functions with corresponding (partial) derivation, the curve discussion of f(x) as well as f(x,y) and last but not least the extreme points under side conditions with the insertion and the lagrange method. The author explicitly points to frequently made errors in exams, as well as the time spent and the difficulty level per task. All important formulas from school time and studies can also be found in the book. In addition, she reveals how students prepare for the exam properly and gives tips for the exam.
content.title_en: Business Mathematics: 77 Tasks that Bachelor Students Must Do

content.text: Node-RED : the comprehensive manual. Literature about Node-RED, a graphical development tool from IBM, with which use cases with a simple modular principle can be implemented on the Internet of Things (IoT) has been discussed only rarely so far; refer to Erik Bartmann for example: "IoT programming with Node-RED" (2018). The book here is a comprehensive manual, a good replacement for larger libraries, which explains the basics of Node-RED in detail and sets priorities in visual programming, in data processing in maker and IoT projects and especially in house automation. Node-RED relies on nodes (preconfigured function blocks). The aim of the book is to give readers without prior knowledge an overview of Node-RED and to make it clear that Node-RED is a very good assistant in software development and programming in the home office; a focus here is on the development of personal, individual nodes. Interesting are also at the end of the book indications on how Node-RED can be used on mobile devices.
content.title_en: Node-RED : the comprehensive manual

content.text: Conditions of local innovation: on the significance of communicative mechanisms and local narratives. Some cities manage to mobilize innovation potential and respond to challenges such as demographic change, immigration or economic restructuring. However, this book does not address the question: What are conditions for the development of local innovation? Conditions for local innovation are not primarily sought under economic, social or institutional circumstances. Instead, the considerations focus on communicative interactions, through which actors develop a locally anchored understanding or knowledge of these circumstances as well as the resulting constraints and possibilities. With contributions by Max A. Kayser, Panos Koliastasis, Melina Lehning, Georgios Terizakis and Alexia Timotheou. Some cities manage to mobilise innovation potential and respond to challenges search as demographic change, immigration or economic restructuring, while others do not. This book addresses the question: what will the development of the local innovation?
content.title_en: Conditions of local innovation: the importance of communicative mechanisms and local narratives

content.text: Adult education and digitalisation research: Impulse - findings - perspectives. In adult and continuing education practice, digital media are central factors influencing the educational and learning processes of adults, requirements for professionals, changes in organizations and the entire system. This results in new and necessary research perspectives. In the collection volume, digitalization is classified as a research field of adult education science and outlined. For the formation of this field, the editors provide important impulses:in her entry-level contribution. The selection and editing of the following contributions refer to the central research tasks of adult education and digitalisation research: the foundation of adult education practice and theory formation for the scientific examination of the phenomenon of digital. Basic questions of funding, skills, teaching, learning and institutions are discussed from various perspectives.
content.title_en: Adult education research on digitalisation : impulses - findings - perspectives

content.text: The automobiles of the future: more than just electric, digital, autonomous. The automobiles of the future and their drives will be characterized by a great variety of geographical, economic, climatic and ecological conditions, but also by customer requirements. A universal car, uniform, electric, digital and autonomous, has only a limited right to exist. The book describes how modern tablet carriers want to be moved, but also how an automobile develops between acceptance, regulations, safety and connectivity. Functions and structures, design of climate control, lighting and sound, modern bodies, materials and modular vehicle designs are presented easily. The burning topic Alternative Drives is given due attention: The depicted electric motors, fuel cells with hydrogen, batteries, piston engines and compact gas turbines are linked in groups in partly unexpected drive scenarios. Future, climate-neutral fuels for automobiles of the future are listed and evaluated.
content.title_en: Automobiles of the future: more than just electric, digital, autonomous

content.text: The Corona-Pandemic and its consequences: economic, social and psychological effects. Introduction -- Impacts and consequences of the Pandemic -- Close but false answers -- New and sustainable perspectives -- Perspective.- Literature. This book draws preliminary conclusions about the first 12 months of the COVID-19 pandemic in the various countries of the world, which has raised a multitude of questions from a non-medical point of view: From the point of view of the economy, the effects were central, among others the consequences of the lockdown, supply difficulties, broken value chains, rising unemployment and short-time work, economic aid, the monetary and financial policies of central banks and governments as well as the growing debt of many states. At the political and state level, questions arose about the restriction of fundamental rights, about emergency law, about curtailing, about the border closures and protection and for the isolation of particularly endangered population groups. In addition, significant psychological consequences of the Pandemic measures were revealed. Many of these effects also met the populations in the poor countries of the South. When the Corona experiences were reviewed and the consequences of the Medicics are short-en and thus informed by the Snative.
content.title_en: The Corona pandemic and its consequences : economic, social and psychological effects

content.text: Offline!: the collapse of global digital civilization. Many high cultures have been extinguished only a few decades after their greatest power unfolded. It cannot happen to us – or can it? The danger is not pandemic and not climate change. Global digital civilization itself is unstable – that is the author's thesis, which he convincingly elaborates and documents in this book. World trade and world peace are fragile. Our infrastructure is crumbling. Digital products only last a few years. Data is volatile. And above all, the threat of a devastating nuclear war is hovering. Are we still creating it? Difficult, says the author – but not impossible. Excitingly written and comprehensively researched, the book gives conclusive answers to the crucial question: How do we avoid the errors that have so far failed all civilizations? The author Thomas Grüter is a medical scientist, cognition researcher and science author. He writes for Spiegel online, Focus, Spektrum.de and ZEIT history. His numerous books and articles have been translated into several languages.
content.title_en: Offline! : the collapse of global digital civilization

content.text: Multilingual nursing care providers in German nursing homes and the Unforgotten project: Students at the interface of research and society. This open access collection is about the award-winning Unforgotten project, in which students provide linguistic support for immigrants in need of care in the form of regular visits. Germany is considered an immigration country, through which demographic change grows the number of older people and thus also those in need of care, whose first language is not German. At an age, multilingual people can experience linguistic expression difficulties, especially in the later language acquired, which cannot necessarily be met in nursing homes. One consequence of this is an increasing linguistic, cultural and social isolation of these nursing care providers. The contributions are devoted to this group of people and offer insights into a special study project, which is intended to provide visibility at the interface of research and social engagement.
content.title_en: Multilingual caregivers in German nursing homes and the Unforgotten project : Students at the interface of research and society

content.text: Research methods in health promotion and prevention. In order to identify, develop, implement and evaluate suitable interventions as an interface between science and practice, health promotion and prevention require theories, a reliable evidence base, current empirical data, subject-oriented approaches and participatory instruments. In this context, qualitative and quantitative research methods as well as inter- and transdisciplinary perspectives play an important role. This book provides an overview of important research methods in health promotion and prevention. Editors JProf. Dr. Marlen Niederberger is a junior professor of research methods in health promotion and prevention at the Schwäbisch Gmünd School of Education. Dr. Emily Finne is a research assistant at the Faculty of Health Sciences at Bielefeld University. Introduction -- Important study designs -- Qualitative research methods -- Quantitative research methods -- Complex designs -- Mixed-Methods-Research -- Desk Research/Secondary data analyses -- Inter- and transdisciplinary methods -- Research methods in teaching.
content.title_en: Research methods in health promotion and prevention

content.text: Manual Energy Efficiency in the Quarter : Clever Supply, Rebuild, Activate. The handbook "Energy Efficiency in the Quarter" summarizes the results of a research college that has been working on the question of how more resource efficiency can be achieved at the district level over a period of four years. A total of 11 doctoral students at 10 chairs or research institutions have investigated this question in a transdisciplinary research college. The spatial focus of the studies is on selected districts in the Ruhr region, as the Ruhr region has a particular energy policy relevance: In North Rhine-Westphalia, the most energy is converted and used throughout Germany. Technological progress has already radically changed our way of communicating, learning, working and informing us. Learning is the motor of a competitive society and ensures success in the long term. content.text: Energy Transition in Germany: Plural Economic Perspectives. The book addresses the energy transition in Germany from different perspectives. The focus is on applications of various economic approaches (traditional industrial and institutional economic and newer, especially evolutionary-systemic). After a historical outline and a look at the governance challenges, key current aspects of the energy transition are discussed as well as the diverse challenges and potential solutions. On this basis, the focus is on the current phase with sector coupling and an outlook on future phases. Finally, the possibilities and limits of a German pioneering role in the energy transition are discussed. The content Reason and objective of the energy transition as well as current status Traditional and newer economic view Systemic challenges Sector integration and further future phases Reflection on the German pioneering role The target groups Students and teachers of the economic, sustainability and energy sciences Decision-makers and interested parties in companies, municipalities and society The author Prof. Dr. Thomas Göllinger teaches and conducts research on topics of sustainability-oriented innovation and transformation, in particular on evolutionary and systemic explanation and decision-making methods with regard to the application of concepts of energy transition, energy sustainability and energy transition.
content.title_en: Energy transition in Germany : plural economic perspectives

A distillate of nearly a decade of learning and reflection, a collection of hard-worked, practical and relevant insights for the successful use of Scrum, that is this book. It combines this common experience into proven solutions, so-called patterns that will help you improve your work with Scrum, whether you are a beginner or an expert. content.text: The professional product owner : successful Scrum Product Ownership: How the value of a product is maximized over the entire life cycle. The role of Product Owner is more important than ever. It is not just about mechanics, but about taking responsibility into account and focusing on the value as the top priority of everything you do. In this book, two leading experts on successful Scrum Product Ownership show how this works. They learn where the value of a product lies, how it can be measured and maximized over the entire product life cycle. Don McGreal and Ralph Jocham discuss product strategy issues and how vision, value and validation can be combined with a ROI-focused agile product management. They design Scrum Good Practices for managing complexity and continuous value creation and present concrete practices and tools that can help you manage product backlogs and release plans more often. The authors share consistently insightful personal experiences that can highlight obstacles to success, and demonstrate how they can deliver value to you in the process of being able to deliver this product management in a more agile way.

This volume takes a comprehensive look at the phenomenon. Scientists: from different disciplines are concerned, among others, with the influence of artificial intelligence on discrimination and racism, science and advertising. Media, social and cultural science, narrative, science theory and economic science perspectives are in the foreground on AI. With contributions by Nicole Brandstetter, Josephine D'Ippolito, Ralph-Miklas Dobler, Philip Hauser, Martin Hennig, Daniel Jan Ittstein, Gudrun Schiedermeier, Jens Schröter and Alicia Sommerfeld.
content.title_en: Human and Artificial Intelligence: Challenges for Culture, Economy and Society

content.text: They called it work: another history of humanity. Work is the core of our modern societies. But why do we leave so much of our lives to it? And why do we work more and more, even though we produce as much as never before? Does this correspond to our nature? Why do more and more people feel overloaded and burned out? Our stone age ancestors worked far less than we did. They worked to live and not live to work. Yet they were relatively healthy and became older than most people who followed them. First the sedentary rise of man and the increasing division of labor into ever-increasing cities created the basis for our present-day relationship to work, our environment and ourselves. But what was then necessary for survival is far from being very much in our present-day society of abundance. James Suzman delivers an impressive panorama from the Stone Age to the present, and makes us think anew world in which growth ideology no longer sucks out our lives and our planets.
content.title_en: They called it work : another history of humanity

content.text: Digital media economy. In the field of digital media economy, traditional media and platforms are competing and digitised in cooperation (increasingly). The combination of commercial success and cultural value characteristic of media products is particularly challenged. Economization and concentration of power meet ethical issues. From the perspective of communication science, the textbook considers these discrepancies. The textbook brings together central media economic findings and theories on the field of digital media economy. In addition to the organisation of digital media economics, production processes, products, markets and strategies are presented. The volume also deals with media management and constellations of actors in media and journalism.

content.text: Data visualization with Power BI. Literature on data visualization has hardly been discussed so far. A basic work also for general interested parties with many tasks and examples was published by Peter Fischer-Stabel (2018). The book here is aimed at beginners (aspiring data scientists) who want to approach the topic of data visualization and analysis in a practical way, without large extensive theoretical treatises. It is based on Power BI, a simple business analysis service from Microsoft. The didactically well-built book brings many examples. Usage instructions and tips for ease of work are marked throughout the whole book in color. The book begins with a short introduction to Power BI, goes into detail on the big leap from Excel to Power BI and then comes to the many visualization possibilities of Power BI. The focus is on calculations with DAX expressions, with deep analyses with trends, forecasts, clusters and distribution and in the production of maps to global findings.
content.title_en: Data visualization with Power BI

content.text: Telex 827 : the case of Schleyer, the RAF and the Stasi. On 5 September 1977 a command of the left-wing terrorist Red Army faction, the RAF, abducted the employer president Hanns Martin Schleyer in Cologne and murdered his four companions. This act triggered the most severe internal political crisis in the Federal Republic of Germany until then, a six-week-long drama about life and death began. Early on, there was a tangible hint of Schleyer's hiding place: a high-rise building in the Rhenish Erftstadt-Liblar. In this house lived for a while also a couple who worked for the Stasi. Erftstadt, located between the then capital city of Bonn and Cologne, was apparently a kind of hotspot for the spy profi s of the GDR. To be able to react quickly during the search for Schleyer on raids or searches and possible decausings, East Berlin started a voluminous listening action, everything was removed: telephone calls, radio traffic, telex. The protection of the informants had highest priority.
content.title_en: Telex 827 : the Schleyer case, the RAF and the Stasi

content.text: Digitalization and social work: transformations and challenges. Digitalization now embraces all areas of social function and is hardly to be thought out of the life-worldly achievements. Technical artifacts are increasingly networked and form an (invisible) background, with which human actions are implicitly and explicitly interwoven in many ways. The volume takes a critical look at (possible) transformations and challenges that arise for social work in the face of socio-technical change. Here, old questions such as the new contours of social inequality gain. At the same time, new problem constellations such as the substituting of human professional action by big data appear on the question horizon. The contributions gathered in the volume try to bridge the gap between theory and practice and between discipline and profession.
content.title_en: Digitization and Social Work: Transformations and Challenges

content.text: University at a distance: multi-perspective access to digital teaching. Despite massive funding for digitalisation, the teaching of presence is still the standard at German universities. However, due to the physical distancing in the course of the Corona pandemic, it had to be digitized almost completely in the short term. The contributions of the volume offer multi-perspective access to the associated challenges and shed light on how the different actors have implemented and experienced the conversion to digital teaching and learning formats. By combining the different perspectives, the needs and wishes of the individual stakeholder groups can be brought together and better taken into account in the sustainable development of university teaching.
content.title_en: University at a distance: multiperspective access to digital teaching

content.text: Good technology for a good life in old age? : Acceptance, opportunities and challenges of age-appropriate assistance systems. There are long-standing age-appropriate digital assistance systems. However, the extent and speed of their distribution in care facilities as well as in private households are largely unknown. Information on systems actually used, realised sales and market volume are hardly to be found. Although there are many assumptions regarding the obstacles to the introduction of age-appropriate assistance systems, reliable statements are rare here too. The contributions of the volume provide answers based on empirical investigations and theoretical considerations and show how diverse the factors that inhibit or promote the diffusion of age-appropriate assistance systems are.
content.title_en: Good technology for a good life in old age? : Acceptance, opportunities and challenges of age-appropriate assistance systems

content.text: The Institute of Materials and Composites for the Industry of Mechanical Engineering has been developing the new technology for the production of optical fibre systems since the year 2000. The book describes the industrially important processing technologies for carbon fibre reinforced and similar plastics in the field of materials and for hybrid lightweight construction. The technological foundations of the machining processes, the removal processes by means of abrasive water jet and laser beam as well as the basics of chipless separation are presented in a methodical manner. Suitable model approaches are described. The process-dependent processing of fiber reinforced plastics according to the different processes is explained. Special attention is paid to the achievable quality, the limits of use, the expenses for tools and other consumables as well as respective aspects of work and plant protection. content.text: Data-rich medicine and the problem of consent: ethical, legal and social science perspectives. This Open Access book deals with practical questions of data-rich international collaborative research. Data-rich medicine plays an increasingly important role in diagnostics and therapy – especially in view of increasingly efficient algorithmic pattern recognition. With the help of growing data stocks, these algorithms are increasingly able to detect disease symptoms, relate them to other data and thus help either in the search for disease causes or to optimize therapies. Against the background of these developments, the collection combines multidisciplinary perspectives on data-driven medical research with a special view to the question of consent to the secondary use of medical data. In this context, ethical considerations in the areas of patient autonomy and welfare, privacy and data security, as well as responsibility diffusion are raised, as well as concrete legal questions regarding GDPR conformity are discussed. Social science studies on the nature and form of consent and patient behaviour round off the volume.
content.title_en: Data-rich medicine and the problem of consent : ethical, legal and social science perspectives

content.text: Modelling. This textbook from the series "Basics of Physical and Mathematical Geodesy" deals with the essential aspects of geodetic modeling within the framework of physical and mathematical geodesy. The author addresses the three-dimensional modeling and looks at the transformations between different coordinate systems. Two-dimensional modeling is explained by the author on the basis of the illustrations to a sphere, in order to transfer the findings to the case of the rotational ellipsoid which is important in the application. The readers learn about transformation methods between the different illustrations, which, despite the development of modern satellite navigation systems, belong to the basic knowledge of geodetic. The one-dimensional modeling of altitudes is of great importance: the author explains the most important altitude systems, the transformation between the altitude systems and the problem of vertical date determination. The author Prof. (em.) Dr. Karl Heinz Ilk studied measurement systems at the Technical University of Munich. He obtained his doctorate and habilitation with works from the satellite geodesy. After a total of two years of consulting within the framework of the creation of a height and gravity network in Indonesia, he became Professor of the University of Physics of Bonn.

content.text: The minimum wage adjustment and living wage: what can Germany learn from the UK?. According to the minimum wage bill, the minimum wage bill is the minimum wage bill, which is the minimum wage bill, which is the minimum wage bill, which is the minimum wage bill. This rule-binding element has proved to be effective, and although the wage system has been subject to adjustment pressure every two years, the wage bill has not been affected in a sustainable manner. The change in the wage mechanism proposed by the Federal Minister of Labour, which provides for a minimum wage to be applied to the median income, would endanger this success and would be deeply influenced by the wage autonomy.
content.title_en: Minimum wage adjustment and Living Wage : what can Germany learn from France and the UK?

content.text: The irritating nature of society through the lockdown. In the course of the Corona pandemic, a one-sidedness of observation and debate has obviously emerged, which is problematic in the long term. Economic, socialisatory and cultural effects of pandemic politics are thus displaced by discourses that are characterized by dominant infectious logic and occasional compromises with political realities. This lack is countered by contributions from the social sciences. The fight against the Corona pandemic leaves behind a new paradigm for the relationship between state and society. The supposed regulatory state is back – and almost without critical evaluation by media or review by courts. Even an import-approach for the new model was invented: »Lockdown«. Politics has so far eliminated these social science expertises, which are necessary for the contextual consequences of the pandemic fight, many times for the long-term problem. Media have only dealt with them marginally, with the public discourse, with the exception perhaps of education policy, no real meaning. In this way, the social science has emerged from the contextual consequences of the pandemic struggles and the dominant effects of the social politics are characterized by the multi-disciple-disciple and the cultural discourse.
content.title_en: The Society Irritation Through the Lockdown

content.text: The climate of history in the planetary age. From globe to planet! Indian historian Dipesh Chakrabarty is one of the most influential international scientists who have been concerned with the importance of climate change in recent years. Climate change, he argues, fundamentally challenges our traditional ideas of history, modernity and globalization. The task is therefore to put these concepts to the test and to provide the humanities and social sciences with new ideas and concepts at all, so that they can rise to the challenges of the Anthropocene. In his book, Chakrabarty is deeply immersed in history and philosophy and makes bold reflections on how to shape human thought and life in the future. In particular, he explains that we can only achieve a better understanding of both our origins and our future if we are able to look at ourselves from two perspectives at the same time: a global and a planetary, whereby the latter deliberately underscores people. Only in this way can we think in geological periods and gain an appropriate picture of human capacity for action. In view of the imminent natural disasters it is the highest time.
content.title_en: The climate of history in the planetary age

content.text: Free : Growing up at the end of history. Klappentext: Albania 1989: The last Stalinist outpost in Europe, an isolated country that is difficult to visit and even harder to leave. There is a lack economy, secret police and the proletariat. Communism has taken over the place of religion. For ten-year-old Lea Ypi, this country is her home: a place of security, learning, hope and freedom. Everything changes when the wall falls in Berlin and in Tirana Enver Hoxha's statue falls from the pedestal. Now people can choose who they want to dress, worship what they want. But the new time soon shows her unfriendly face: unscrupulous businessmen ruin the economy, the prospect of a better future dissolves into unemployment and mass flight. When the country threatens to sink into chaos and secrets come to light in her family, Lea begins to wonder what it is actually: freedom.
content.title_en: Free : Growing up at the end of history

content.text: The evolution of knowledge: a redefinition of science for the Anthropocene. The evolution of knowledge tells the fascinating history of mankind in sixteen chapters. Using key episodes from the development of science and technology, from the invention of Scripture to the early modern scientific revolution to industrialization and digitalization, Jürgen Renn analyses how knowledge is created and changed, how it has spread globally for millennia and how knowledge economies and the societies in which they are embedded have reciprocal influence. The enormously rich and opulently illustrated book develops a completely new framework for understanding the history of science as part of that cultural evolution that has put its stamp on our planet. The far-reaching look back, which The Evolution of Knowledge dares, therefore also sharpens our gaze on the complex challenges that we are currently facing in the Anthropocene.
content.title_en: Evolution of Knowledge: a Redefinition of Science for the Anthropocene

content.text: In the storms of transformation: two shipyards between socialism and the EU. The gigantic cranes of the shipyards in Gdynia and Pula were until recently the pride of these cities. In Poland 300 meters long ocean giants were created, in Croatia ships on which thousands of sheep could be transported from New Zealand to Europe – including seawater desalination plant. But all the inventiveness and the improvisational talent practiced in socialism did nothing: soon after EU accession the shipyards went bankrupt, also because in Brussels competition law counts more than a globally oriented industrial policy. The team around Ulf Brunnbauer and Philipp Ther dive deep into the everyday life of the two shipyards. The social scientists and historians reconstruct their decline and analyze the great transformation that has shaken Europe since the seventies.
content.title_en: In the storms of transformation: two shipyards between socialism and the EU

content.text: What does orientation mean in life? What can provide guidance in unsightly confusing times? What can confidence open up in crises? What supports people in the midst of personal catastrophes? People who accompany, advise, treat people professionally, encounter such existential questions almost daily. Professional consultants:Inside offer dedicated support and always notice that these questions also trigger important topics for themselves. And so the old-known philosophical considerations, which make a good life, become personal-current development impulses of the companions:inside and treats:inside. Some of these questions, which have become present through clients:inside, take up this book, illuminate it from philosophical-practical and psychological perspectives and thereby open up reflection spaces for one's own encounter, for the determination of location and further debate, supplemented by workshop insights of the author and practical self-coaching suggestions for the readers:inside.
content.title_en: Supporting people in existential crises : self-encounter, orientation and attitude

content.text: Digitalization in Studies and Teaching: Innovative formats, strategies and networks. The open access band addresses the challenges and opportunities of digitalization for students and teachers as well as for support structures and leadership of universities in Germany. The main focus is on the development and implementation of university strategies in the context of regional, national and international networks as well as the promotion of key competences through innovative teaching and learning formats. The volume gathers 33 contributions from experts from the community of the University Forum Digitalization, whose members jointly shape the digital transformation in higher education in a variety of ways. Published by the University Forum Digitalization The University Forum Digitalization (HFD) orchestrates the discourse on higher education in the digital age. As a central source of inspiration, it advises, networks and accompanies actors from universities, politics, business and society. The HFD was founded in 2014 and sees itself as a implementation-oriented think & do tank. It is a joint initiative of the Stifterverband mit dem CHE Centrum für Hochschulentwicklung und der Hochschulrektorenkonferenz (HRK). The HFD is funded by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Digitalization and Research and Research (DKPolic).
