content.text: Neglected children and adolescents are the most frequently neglected victims of child welfare. First work, especially on the subject of child neglect Numerous case presentations and practical assistance measures In contrast to physical and sexual assaults on children, the widespread lack of child care is hardly a focus of public perception. More than 10 percent of all people experience neglect and emotional mistreatment in their childhood. Such experiences in childhood are among the most important risk factors for the occurrence of many mental and physical diseases in later life. The book provides a comprehensive overview of the definition, frequency, causes and consequences of neglect and emotional child abuse. Practical case studies and scientific findings enable a psychoanalytic understanding of the inner world of neglected children. Finally, the book introduces psychoanalytically based principles of successful care and treatment and gives practitioners in medicine, psychology and social education important indications for counselling and therapy.
content.title_en: Neglancy : Care and therapy of emotionally neglected and abused children

content.text: We are used to looking at teaching normatively and intentionally: What does the teacher want? What means does she use and what does she achieve? Who does she not achieve, how can she improve her effect? The manual chooses a different perspective: It observes and describes teaching practices with things and other actors that make a difference in religious instruction. What influence do they have on the teaching process, sometimes with and against the intentions of the teacher? The candle, for example, can trigger much in the welcoming ritual, but sometimes other actors prevent it from being kindled at all. The authors observe religious instruction in this sense from a practice-theoretical perspective. They link insights from the "classical" religious didactics with those from qualitative-empirical educational science. In this way, they open up new, partly surprising insights into the teaching: actors are no longer just the teaching power and the pupils: inside, but everything that makes a difference.
content.title_en: Watching religious education : Practices - Artifacts - Actors

content.text: The West African issue: the causes of flight and what Europe should do. The fight against the causes of flight has become a kind of mantra in Europe since 2015 at the latest. Many politicians: they promise to make a significant reduction in the number of African migrants arriving in the country, also in connection with an ever-increasing surveillance of the EU's external borders. Sociologist and human rights activist Olaf Bernau vehemently contradicts this widespread perspective in his book. He shows why people in West Africa are breaking out - and what the permanent crisis of this region has to do with Europe. Here, the colonial heritage is also discussed in detail. The basic book on the debate about the causes of flight and EU migration policy A detailed look at the most important region of origin of migrants: women from Africa The presentation is based mainly on African voices from Sahel to the Atlantic - how a region in the permanent crisis sinks slavery and colonialism have implications until today. "Sociologist Olaf Bernau explains why Europe cannot stop migration from Africa. And he shows that there is still a lot to be mutual understanding of the two continents."
content.title_en: West Africa focus: the causes of flight and what Europe should do

content.text: A crime without name: Notes on the new dispute over the Holocaust. A genocide like any other? Is it a new historian's dispute? The memory of the Holocaust in Germany is suddenly in criticism. What was just considered a political and social achievement, some now understand as a "catechism" imposed on the Germans and watched over their observance of "high priests". Its true function is to hide other historical crimes and to give the murder of the Jews an exaggerated role in the collective memory of the Germans. This volume counters these theses. Saul Friedländer, Norbert Frei, Sybille Steinbacher and Dan Diner show from different perspectives why the argument of the Holocaust's impeccableness is historically well founded. At the same time they make it clear that the memory, in particular of the colonial crimes, should be given a larger place, without therefore pushing aside the critical confrontation with the Holocaust. Jürgen Habermas opens the volume with a short text "Insert of a Preface".
content.title_en: A crime without names : Notes on the new dispute over the Holocaust

content.text: Historians and the Constitution: a contribution to the history of the Basic Law. The history of the Federal Republic has been significantly influenced by the Federal Constitutional Court's Basic Law and the jurisprudence. However, the accounts of the historians show this only imperfectly. Dieter Grimm, himself a 12 year judge at the Federal Constitutional Court, shows where it would have been helpful to understand the historical development in more detail in the context of the Constitution and the Constitutional Law. His astute book thus contributes to the history of the Basic Law, which has so far been lacking.
content.title_en: The historians and the constitution: a contribution to the history of the Basic Law

content.text: The challenges now arise! : demographic change, climate change, digitalization. On 26 September 2021, the 20th Bundestag was elected. The members of parliament and the new federal government are faced with major challenges. Demography, climate change and digitalization are three key challenges that need to be addressed and tackled sustainably in the new legislative period. These issues are not new, but should be tackled fundamentally new. To this end, framework conditions must be set correctly and the scarce financial resources must be used precisely. In this study, the Kronberg Circle, scientific advisory board of the Stiftung Marktwirtschaft, proposes concrete measures to the new federal government in order to adequately address the challenges with a responsible, forward-looking economic and financial policy. These measures would contribute significantly to putting the financing of today's pension, care and health policies on sustainable and generation-oriented feet, to operate global climate protection effectively and efficiently and to strengthen Germany's competitiveness through an innovation-friendly digitization strategy.
content.title_en: Accepting the challenges now! : demographic change, climate change, digitalization

content.text: acollage : ten years. What is acollage? acollage builds. The architects supervise and accompany their projects from the first planning steps to the finished construction. Who is acollage? Alexandra Merten, Kolja Harms and Gerald Kappelmann founded acollage architektur urbanistik in 2010. acollage is an architecture and urbanistik in Hamburg. For this comprehensive exhibition on the 10th anniversary of the architectural office acollage, the three partners have selected 10 preparatory projects in the fields of architecture, urbanistik and art.
content.title_en: acollage : ten years

content.text: The great experiment: how diversity threatens and enriches democracy. Can democracy function in a diverse society? Political scientist Yascha Mounk shows how this experiment succeeds. He provides the instructions for our plural society. (publishing information)
content.title_en: The great experiment: how diversity threatens and enriches democracy

content.text: The hour of physicists: Einstein, Bohr, Heisenberg and the innermost of the world: 1922-1932. In the 1920s the hour of physicists struck: they set out on their way to the atoms in the innermost of the world. They were forced to completely abandon the familiar world view. Among the pioneers of the new physics were the friends Max Planck and Albert Einstein, who lived in Berlin in the 1920s. They were joined by other exceptional physicists: Niels Bohr, Werner Heisenberg, Wolfgang Pauli, Paul Dirac. Heisenberg in particular acted as an immensely creative head, the unrelentingly crazy physical ideas that came to mind, in many cases, to be torn apart by Pauli mercilessly. The finally elaborated form of science has since been celebrating under the designation "quantum mechanics?" Triumphs. Their clou are not only the electronic devices with their magnificent communication possibilities, which we use today so naturally. Their clou is also a completely changed image of the world behind things: There is only a state of affairs, and there is no more than just a state of affairs in the way of change.
content.title_en: The hour of physicists : Einstein, Bohr, Heisenberg and the innermost of the world : 1922-1932

content.text: Russia as a commodity power: a global energy history. Russia developed into one of the world's leading oil producers, thanks to the construction of a modern oil industry in the Caucasus, and has expanded its position in the Soviet era. The country's industrialization and rise to world power were largely linked to the country's ability to exploit its enormous resource potential. Energy and power are also playing together today. The Putin regime feeds on the billions of yield from the sale of oil, gas and other fossil fuels. In the past hundred years, the development of the Russian energy economy has been paralleled by an ever closer energy interdependence with the world, and in particular with Europe, the most important market for Russian raw materials. This book shows that thinking about energy has influenced the dynamics of East-West relations far more than previous research suggests. It was in the field of trade with oil and gas, where even at the time of the Cold War and the Iron Curtain, where cooperation was possible. The energy history and history of the foreign trade are seen as a central part of Russia's history.
content.title_en: Raw Material Power Russia : a Global Energy History

content.text: Practice Online texts : the guide for websites, blogs, social media and email newsletters. Texts on the Internet are still often oriented towards texts in traditional publication formats. Numerous parameters such as age, reading behaviour, expectations of readers, but also technical framework conditions and possibilities are to be considered. Online texts have to be designed, written and implemented completely differently if the intended message is to be successfully transported. The toolbox shows all the essential aspects that must be observed in online texts. The book offers all online textists a reliable help for the successful work. The author provides both basics and specific information on the different formats. A separate chapter is dedicated to search engine optimization.
content.title_en: Practice Online texts : the guide for websites, blogs, social media and e-mail newsletters

content.text: Crash course Storytelling : Basics and implementations. Marketing expert Werner T. Fuchs will teach you in this crash course what Storytelling is, what principles a good story follows and what needs to be observed in the different locations of use. A story check as well as proven methods and instruments will accompany you in the first steps and support you in the practical implementation - including stumbling blocks, and how to avoid them. The optimal start to the successful storytelling!
content.title_en: Crash Course Storytelling : Basics and Implementations

content.text: Vehicle use in tax law: income tax, wage tax, VAT. All questions relating to vehicle taxation are a permanent topic in tax law. These include individual topics such as taxation of service cars, driving books and the establishment of journeys between home and workplace, but also the use of job bikes. The legislator promotes electric mobility in road traffic and uses additional tax incentives. The author presents all the explanations about the taxation of vehicles according to life-related behaviour and addresses income tax, wage tax and turnover tax issues. The view on the interactions between the tax types allows targeted decisions in the design of each individual situation. With all legal changes, among others, through the law on further tax promotion of electric mobility, the annual tax law 2020, the second Corona tax aid law, jurisprudence and administrative instructions.
content.title_en: Vehicle use in tax legislation : income tax, income tax, VAT

content.text: Systemic process management: Digitize companies - mobilise teams. Digitalisation projects fail too often because the culture in the company does not (yet) harmonize with digital development. Digitalisation means that the cooperation depends above all on roles, rules and processes. In this respect, the analogue aspect of the company, which is characterized by experience, intuition and relationships, is often disregarded. Digitalisation is thus far more than the business-economic design of new processes and their technical roll-out. Therefore, projects for digitalization need not only process management methods, but also methods with which culture can be adapted to the new requirements in teams. In the first part, the book develops the theoretical foundations, especially for anchoring processes in the teams. The second part offers a wealth of methods that can be freely combined in the application. Digital transformation with resonant working relationships. Team mobilization and process modelling: pillars of digitalization. Respectful handling of the corporate culture enables the sustainable development of new processes.
content.title_en: Systemic process management : digitize companies - mobilize teams

content.text: Crash course Self-organization in agile teams: solutions for an appreciative collaboration. Silo thinking, innovation congestion and rigid hierarchical structures leave employees frustrated and resigned. With this crash course you are on the way to a more coherent cooperation in which people not only meet at eye level but also in organizations. With the numerous, innovative workhacks you enable a working environment in which the teams organize themselves, resolve conflicts and problems through reflection and feedback, as well as cooperatively, innovative, flexible and interpersonal action.
content.title_en: Crash Course Self-Organization in Agile Teams : Solutions for an Appreciative Cooperation

content.text: Modern leadership and self-organisation: develop future competences with psychological knowledge. Developing a new working world requires a rethinking of management. Self-management and motivation of employees to develop future competences and self-organisation is a key factor for the future. Based on psychological insights and sound experience in management development, the author shows on the basis of concrete practical examples and challenges how we can develop leadership competences in a targeted manner and support employees and teams in developing key competences for the future.
content.title_en: Modern leadership and self-organisation : develop future competences with psychological knowledge

content.text: The digital transformation changes many areas of work and learning. The central focus of the book is the question of developing skills for young people, which enables them to participate in a future working environment – even if their technological and work organisation features are hardly to be predicted today. The articles look at labour and social policy challenges, possible consequences for the labour market, vocational and vocational training systems, requirements and opportunities for the company's use and competence of employees as well as changes in vocational and school education.
content.title_en: Skills development in the digital world of work : future requirements and vocational learning opportunities

content.text: Made in Washington : what the US has done in the world since 1945. Without the US's protective hand, the world would sink into chaos, it is often said. Bernd Greiner is conducting this thesis in a practical test. What do the world's regions in which Washington has intervened since 1945? The balance sheet is sobering. The United States has waged most wars, they are the frontrunners in the overthrow of disloving, even democratically elected governments, countless people have had to let their lives go, societies have been traumatized and states have been ruined. It is time to discuss the consequences. Because the global challenges of our time will not be able to cope without the US. But under Washington's leadership, it is not enough.
content.title_en: Made in Washington : what the USA has done in the world since 1945

content.text: The great invention: a history of the world in nine mysterious writings. This book tells of the perhaps greatest invention of the world. Without it we would only be a voice. At least four times in world history the writing was reinvented: in Egypt, Mesopotamia, China and Mexico (the Mayan script). Silvia Ferrara combines archaeology, anthropology and neuroscience to visualize the earliest phases of the emergence of script cultures. And she slips into the role of a scientific detective to share her great passion: the decoding of hitherto mysterious writings such as the Cretan hieroglyphics, the signs on the discos of Phaistos or the Rongorongo script of the Easter Island. "The great invention" is a popular scientific pageturner, written in the style of an oral narrative; the representation acts as a rousing stream of thought. But the chosen form also corresponds to Ferrara's thesis, despite its importance, not a biological or historical necessity. Many complex societies do not even have written texts, yet flourishing technologies, and perhaps the text of the future can lead to the future.
content.title_en: The Great Invention : a History of the World in Nine Mysterious Writings

content.text: Professional didactics : Theory and practice of technical didactics Metal and electrical engineering - A textbook and study book. Is professional didactics still up to date? This volume is intended to provide an appropriate answer to this question, in which it presents theoretical controversy and current trends of discipline for discussion. The future of university didactics is also at the heart of this as well as the past of comparatively young scientific discipline. With the concept of education in the centre, the author develops a concept that can be guided by the idea of technological education. He thus provides a vocational pedagogical answer to the dynamics of the occupational fields and activities of metal and electrical engineering developed by the new technologies – and analyses the enculturation of young adults from a technical didactic perspective in relevant educational courses of the system of vocational education.
content.title_en: Professional didactics : Theory and practice of didactics Metal and electrical engineering - A textbook and study book

content.text: The future of foreign politics is feminist: how global crises must be solved. World politics in the 21st century: peace & health, human rights & climate justice for all everywhere No peace without feminism: old, white, Western men still dominate politics as well as theory and practice of international relations. This permanently ignores the needs of women and minorities. The world is full of wars, crises and injustices. Kristina Luz sets up with her "Centre for Feminist Foreign Policy" to change this. The political scientist, activist and entrepreneur thinks peace, human rights and justice together with foreign politics and wants to initiate a paradigm shift: power-gap and military muscle games set her up mediation in peace negotiations, feminist power analyses and climate justice. Real politics is exchanged against utopias, and ambassadors are as many as there are ambassadors. Thus, the conflict between nations can finally be replaced, and everyone will be able to live in greater security and with fewer conflicts. (publisheral)
content.title_en: The future of foreign policy is feminist: how global crises must be resolved

content.text: Intercultural design principles: cultural and social competence for global design. The book offers an innovative and global approach to design education and allows design and culture enthusiasts to learn about the diversity of media design worldwide. Designers: from Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia present themselves in the richly illustrated book with their creative works. Cultural insights are linked to the basics of design, typography and color theory. It shows how diverse design also works in our globalized world and how enriching a culturally sensitive design is. A description of international design workshops inspires the collaboration of interculturally staffed teams. Numerous practical teaching methods promote the development of a sociocultural consciousness that leads to distinguishable design styles and to the appreciation of diversity and commonalities. Textbook, learning app, design education, design study, teaching, teaching, teaching materials, workshop signs - basic elements and basic forms - typo and form - color - intercultural projects - local vs. global - appendix. User note: learning materials such as games, videos, interactive exercises and handouts complement the book.
content.title_en: Intercultural Design Basics : Cultural and Social Competence for Global Design

content.text: Excel + VBA in stochastics: a practical introduction. This illustrative textbook provides practical information on the use of Excel and VBA in the field of stochastics. After an introduction to VBA and an assistance for its application, the mathematical foundations for the fields of stochastics are created. With many examples and associated program code, the readers are to lay a basis for their own tasks, for example to prepare and evaluate empirical data. To this end, the most important Excel functions are applied and some applications in operation research are finally considered. Digital additional material on the author's homepage completes the book and is to support their own creativity. The content: Introduction in VBA actions and procedures Basics Combinatorics Probability Calculation Observations and Measurements Statistical parameters Stochastics in operation research. The target groups: Students in scientific study courses of all disciplines Practitioners and professionals who work with probabilities and statistical data and parameters. The author: Dipl.-Ing. Harald Nahrstedt, former managing director and co-owner of a software house, today is freelance- Software- Asstruator and Computations.
content.title_en: Excel + VBA in stochastics : a practical introduction

content.text: Design patterns with Java: an introduction. A practical description of the software design patterns, as they find mention in the 1994 book "Design Patterns – Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software" by the author group Gamma, Helm, Johnson and Vlissides (also called "Gang of Four", or GoF, i.e. "Viererbande"). All patterns are explained in detail and critically appreciated by examples. Furthermore, design principles of object-oriented programming are described and taken into account. All examples are commented in detail in source code and can be run under Java 16. Some of them are also explained and used by newer features of Java up to and including version 16. The content What are design patterns How to describe them Object-oriented design principles All 23 original design patterns of the "Gang of Four" Design Patterns combine The target group students, apprentices and students of computer science programming beginners after the first steps in Java The author Olaf Musch is an IT engineer, has developed software himself for many years and works today as project manager in the IT area of a large company in Lower Saxony.
content.title_en: Design patterns with Java : an introduction

content.text: Gender-specific violence in times of digitalization: forms and intervention strategies. Digital violence occurs not only in public spaces, but also in private relationships - and in combination with domestic and sexualised violence has a significantly gender-specific component. Through information and communication technologies, forms of violence such as doxing, stalking, Hate Speech and online harassment and threats have increased significantly and their effectiveness has been strengthened by the use of the Internet. The contributors of the band provide fundamental interdisciplinary analyses for the handling of these forms of violence and discuss both legal, technical and activist interventions as well as experiences from the consulting practice.
content.title_en: Gender-based violence in times of digitalization : Forms and intervention strategies

content.text: Work in the digitalized world: practical examples and design solutions from the BMBF funding focus. This open access book includes contributions from 29 joint projects as well as the accompanying collaborative project "TransWork" . Within the funding focus "Work in the digitalized world" of the Federal Ministry of Education and Research, the projects analysed developments in the transformation process of the working world, developed solutions and scientifically accompanied them. The contributions provide insights into the developed findings and concepts of the projects. This can be derived from recommendations for policy and business actors and results in new research impulses for the scientific community.
content.title_en: Work in the digitalized world : Practical examples and design solutions from the BMBF funding focus

content.text: Wikis and Wikipedia understand : an introduction. Hardly any website is called up as often as the encyclopedia »Wikipedia«. It was made possible by the Wiki concept, which invites to participate. But how does a Wiki work and how can it be used for one's own purposes? Wikis and Wikipedia seem impenetrable and inconceivable. A better understanding is important for those who want to create, promote or explore a Wiki. »Understanding Wikis and Wikipedia« is the indispensable companion for one's own access to the topic and conveys background knowledge from the practice and knowledge from the literature in a systematic overview.
content.title_en: Understanding wikis and Wikipedia : an introduction

content.text: New mosque buildings: Institutionalization, meaning and visibility in England and Switzerland. In recent decades, mosque new buildings have been built in Europe. Lucia Stöckli's study of religious studies investigates the history of establishing new mosque buildings in England and Switzerland and sheds light on their importance for Muslims. Based on existing and planned building projects, she works out common structures and national contexts and examines topics such as the development of a multifunctional centre, the role of women in mosque new buildings and the importance of the visibility of these buildings for Muslims.
content.title_en: New mosque buildings : Institutionalization, meaning and visibility in England and Switzerland

content.text: Poor Siechen? : Laufenburg-Siechebifang: An extraordinary insight into the inventory of a late medieval Siechenhaus. In the late Middle Ages the spread of the dreaded leprosy reached its peak. The people affected by the then incurable disease were excluded from healthy society («out of the box») and housed in the Siechenhaus outside the settlements. During excavations on the former power plant meadows in Laufenburg the cellar of such a Siechenhaus appeared in spring 2014. The over 4 300 finds recovered from the cellar represent a broad and well preserved late medieval material spectrum and offer a unique insight into the inventory of a Siechenhaus, a typical urban institution, which is not yet explored from an archaeological point of view.
content.title_en: Poor Siechen? : Laufenburg-Siechebifang: An extraordinary insight into the inventory of a late medieval Siechenhaus

content.text: Abrasiva, grinding and polishing agents of metal processing in history, archaeology and experiment : Contributions to the history of technology Volume 4 (BzT_4). Metals grind and polish in ancient times – old sources and new experiments. Since man can produce his tools and hunting weapons, he has also ground them. After the first materials bones, antlers and wood, the metals later made special demands. Raw casts of jewellery and equipment as well as forged tools and weapons had to be sanded, cut and blades sharpened and surfaces polished for aesthetic reasons. Which abrasives and polishing agents the craftsmen of antiquity used for this purpose is hardly known; the written sources are rare, and archaeological findings are difficult to detect and document. This book summarizes which abrasive materials were available to the early craft, where the raw materials can be found and how the materials are prepared. The ancient authors who mentioned these materials are cited, and with experimental archaeology the author has tested the suitability and efficiency of all abrasives, abrasives and polishing materials.
content.title_en: Abrasiva, Grinding and Polishing Agents of Metal Processing in History, Archaeology and Experiment : Contributions to the History of Technology Volume 4 (BzT_4)

content.text: Energy transition and megatrends : Interactions between global social development and sustainability. The energy transition does not take place socially in the "airless space": it can only take place in the context of other profound processes of social change. Digitization, mobility, urbanization - these and other social major developments are called "megatrends". They are regarded as signposts and social dimensions that must be taken into account when it comes to shaping the future. But what does a development actually make such a megatrend? And what influence do these megatrends have on the energy transition? The contributors of the band discuss the conditions of megatrends as well as the challenges and possibilities that arise in the face of these major developments for the energy transition.
content.title_en: Energy transition and megatrends : Interactions between global social development and sustainability

content.text: New mosque buildings: Institutionalization, meaning and visibility in England and Switzerland. In recent decades, mosque new buildings have been built in Europe. Based on existing and planned building projects, she works out common structures and national contexts and examines topics such as the development of a multifunctional centre, the role of women in mosque new buildings and the importance of the visibility of these buildings for Muslims.
content.title_en: New mosque buildings : Institutionalization, meaning and visibility in England and Switzerland

After a brief discussion of the architecture, the find material is placed in its chronological and functional context. In addition, a shelter, a large slag dump and a platform could possibly be approached as a Köhlerplatz were found in the bamboo jungle of the nearby hamlet Nag Lhakhang.

Were earlier societies actually more integrated, or did there only other conflicts and injustices prevail there? The society, it can be said, consists essentially of inequalities; but dangerous if inequality becomes ever stronger polarization, then a permanent conflict is actually explained to one of our society. What is therefore only media talk, and where real disincentives threaten? content.text: Smyrna in Flames: the sinking of the Ottoman metropolis in 1922 and its consequences for Europe. On the 100th anniversary of the fire disaster of Smyrna (today's Izmir), the once cosmopolitan and multicultural port city on the Turkish west coast, this book appears. Lutz C. Kleveman, journalist and non-fiction author (here last: ID-B 47/11) describes on his trip there this Ottoman multi-ethnic city, in which people from all over the world from different cultures and religions lived relatively tolerantly together. Based on eyewitness reports, the author reconstructs the events of the night of September 13, 1922, when Turkish soldiers set fire in the city and destroyed this unique Ottoman metropolis. Countless people died, waited for their salvation or were forced to move around in the wake. With comments, bibliography and registers. - Kleveman places in it an example of ethnic cleansing of the recent past and draws parallels to the current refugee crisis. His book is a mixture of personally coloured, easy-to-read travel reports and informatively for historical subjects of interest.
content.title_en: Smyrna in flames : the fall of the Ottoman metropolis in 1922 and its consequences for Europe

content.text: Artificial intelligence in research: new opportunities and challenges for science. This book is an open access publication. The long-held dream of artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly reality in our everyday world. This combines high social expectations and concerns regarding a creeping disintegration of humans. Using the research sector as an example, this volume explores the options, development opportunities and risks of AI technologies for the future of the scientific knowledge process and the resulting technical developments. To this end, the state of AI technology and its applications are presented first. Scientific philosophical studies on the question of the applicability of researching humans by AI and expected changes in scientific research are followed. Further sections focus on the consequences for the working world of researchers and the new challenges created by AI for the legal regulation of the field of conflict between scientific freedom and data protection. The volume concludes with recommendations for the responsible actors in science, research policy and society from an interdisciplinary perspective.
content.title_en: Artificial intelligence in research: new opportunities and challenges for science

Thomas Raithel and Niels Weise are investigating the extent of historical continuity in this highly forward-looking department from an institutional, discursive and personal historical perspective. The authors underline the diversity of individual Nazi burdens within a Federal Ministry of Science and Technology, which is strongly influenced by natural and technological sciences, and document the high adaptability and functional capacity of German elites from the Weimar Republic to the Nazi regime and the early Federal Republic.

content.text: Systematic design of body concepts with regard to minimal environmental effects in an early design phase. While conventionally driven vehicles are mainly responsible for the environmental effects in their life cycle, environmental effects in the life cycle of a battery-electrically driven vehicle are shifted into the production phase depending on the energy mix. Therefore, in addition to measures to reduce environmental impacts in the use phase, measures are also needed to optimise the production phase. In addition to battery production, which generates about 46% of greenhouse gas emissions in the production phase, the production of the body also shows a potential for reducing environmental effects with a view to reducing the environmental impact. Therefore, a design methodology is developed that allows body concepts to be designed with regard to minimal environmental effects and to ensure their functionality and feasibility, and taking into account varying life cycle scenarios. Lars Reimer is a specialist consultant in the concept development of an automobile group. Introduction -- Basics for the design of the body -- State of research on the design of the body with regard to minimal environmental effects -- Procedure model for the life cycle design of the body with regard to minimal environmental impacts - Exemplary application of the approach model based on a critical assessment of case study.

content.text: The concept of landscape theory and landscape practice: an introduction from a social constructivist perspective. The book deals with the question of which social conventions we see, interpret and evaluate landscape. In this context, a special focus is placed on the development of landscape understanding in the German language area, in comparison to other linguistic spaces. Starting from a social constructivist perspective, the book examines both different theories on the topic of landscape from social and cultural sciences as well as practical questions on the handling of landscape from the interpretation of the hybridization of urban and rural areas to the energy transition and the integration of the questions of aesthetic construction of landscape into planning processes. In recent years, research on the topic field of landscape has intensified and multiplied considerably. Since the publication of the 2nd edition, this circumstance is taken into account, for example, a more extensive research on the meaning of landscape in games and in and with virtual spaces has been developed. content.text: Psychic growth: Symbolization, metaphor and artistic creation from a psychoanalytic perspective. How does man come to new insights? This book looks at innovative creation from an intrapsychic perspective: What happens in the creative process in the human psyche? What promotes innovative thinking psychodynamically within the creator? The starting point is the question of how inner ideas, representational representations and symbols arise. In this context, the importance of the interpersonal relationship for symbolization processes from a psychoanalytic perspective and from the perspective of infant research is investigated. In addition, important statements by philosophers, artists and poets illuminate the intrapsychic dynamics during symbolization. Illustrating with Fallvignettes, the author discusses symbolization processes in psychoanalytic practice, which illustrates how significant sensual experience for symbolizations is hardly possible: innovative thinking is impossible without sensual perception. The more physically we experience a truly new insight, the more convincing it is.
content.title_en: Psychic growth : Symbolization, metaphor and artistic creation from a psychoanalytic perspective

content.text: Campland : Archaeology of the forced camps of the 20th century in Brandenburg - an introduction. The 20th century is rightly called the century of camps. In the surrounding area of the former imperial capital Berlin, the present-day state of Brandenburg, two concentration camps, three large prisoners of war-steam camps, several hundred outpost camps and even more "civil" forced labor camps and other camps had their place. These often forgotten places to explore their material remains, to preserve them as monuments and (Ge) think places and at the same time to enable new approaches to them, is the task of archaeology for over 25 years. Access to the people imprisoned there enables countless finds: they speak for the now dying generation of contemporary witnesses. They testify both to individual fates and mass crimes in the 20th century: against every attempt to relativize and deny them. The research of the recent past with means of archaeology is presented here for the first time in an exemplary manner for a German federal state.
content.title_en: Campland : Archaeology of the forced camps of the 20th century in Brandenburg - an introduction

content.text: Gashydrates - an introduction to basic research and application. Gashydrates, also called "burning ice", are fascinating, ice-like solids, which are made up of water and gas molecules and are present worldwide on all active and passive continental slopes and in permafrost areas. But their unobtrusive appearance is deceptive: The inclusion compounds can contain considerable amounts of methane gas. Therefore, on the one hand, there is hope for a possible new energy source and on the other hand the concern for a non-underestimation source of climate-damaging methane gas. Gashydrates, the latest research has shown, moreover, offer in many areas of industrial application a very promising alternative to conventional methods. This book gives an introduction to the physico-chemical bases of hydration formation and the structures of gas-hydrate phases. Based on this basic understanding, it explains the natural gas-hydrate deposits and records possible methods of degradation and extraction of methane gas in the field of chemistry research.
content.title_en: Gas hydrates - an introduction to basic research and application

content.text: Internships abroad in teacher education: first findings from the Goethe-Institut's SCHULWÄRTS! research hub. There are many ways to promote the internationalisation of teacher education – one of which is mobility. During the last decade, the demand for an extended teacher training on the part of the educational and research landscape became ever louder. Aspects such as learning an adequate handling of linguistic and cultural diversity are indispensable components of teacher education that it is to be promoted. Numerous studies already constitute valid evidence for the project. But what concrete effect does mobility of students – more precisely the mobility abroad – have on the internationalisation of teacher education? To what extent is it possible and where? What can it and should it contribute at best? Expectations from the teacher training students coincide with the actual yield? And what functions do programs such as SCHULWÄRTS! of the Goethe-Institut fulfil? For the present collection volume, the SCHULWÄRTS! research hub provides current studies on the topic of internationalisation of teacher education from the most diverse disciplines: cultural theory, educational science, educational teaching teaching and teaching methods, empirical research, and teaching methods.
content.title_en: Internships abroad in teacher education: first findings from the Goethe-Institut's SCHULWÄRTS! research hub

content.text: Augmented Reality : Theory and Practice. Augmented Reality as an enrichment of the real world around virtual objects is a typical example of a new technology that has been increasingly discovered by companies in recent years. This book shows students and companies using examples of the possibilities offered by this technology for a wide range of applications. According to the strategy-follows-structure approach, augmented reality enables the conception of new products, the modification or enrichment of existing products and processes, the development of new or the modification and completion of existing business models. In particular, communication can be enriched sensibly by augmented reality. By presenting appropriate examples, students and companies learn best practice approaches. A transfer to their own or corporate needs is possible accordingly. In the new edition, current trends are taken up and illustrated
content.title_en: Augmented Reality : Theory and Practice

content.text: Project management is short & good. Why are so many projects exceeding the planned time and cost framework, since there are project management methods and standards such as IPMA, PMI, Scrum, PRINCE2 or SAFe? More is often too much! Most of the approaches are extensive and assign project managers a variety of roles. Instead of permeating their own project mentally, it often remains when working on process steps and checklists. The authors of ?Project management - short & good? work out the essential aspects and core tasks of project management. Project managers who have this essence in mind can control their project more purposefully and effectively and bring structure, clarity and calm into the processes. The pocket book also examines all phases and essential aspects of project management such as planning, resource and risk management, software quality and documentation. However, it also deals with soft factors such as dealing with difficulties, team and stakeholders. It also examines the interplay of project management and agile working methods. (publishing text)
content.title_en: Project management short & good

content.text: Collective Writing. In contrast to the lone writing as the supposed normal case of modern text production, this volume of the collection for the first time develops a comprehensive systematization and theoretization of collective writing. In theoretical situations and historical case studies, the collection is devoted to writing collectives in a double sense. The contributions shed light on the practices, stagings and hierarchies of different actors: inside, interacting in common, retrospective or conflicting writing contexts. The question is how collective text production takes place, how individual pieces of writing or whole works circulate between different actors: inside, and who is changed by this textual movement as well. The symbolic potential through which collectivity becomes a textual political moment is also taken into account: Who steps out of the writing collective to the public? Who becomes author:in? Who will be forgotten?
content.title_en: Collective writing

content.text: The North Rhine-Westphalian capital of Düsseldorf has undergone a profound change over the past 20 years. Not only have former industrial and military areas been reclaimed as well as livable urban areas. Ground sealings have been broken down, climate-friendly residential areas have been built, public green spaces and paths have been laid out. This has largely overcome the disadvantages of the segmented city body. Due to the departure from the concept of the car-friendly city, Düsseldorf has gained a considerable amount of urbanity. Even today, this makes it tangible what the Green City of Düsseldorf will be with the new inner-city blue green ring. In the architectural guide of Düsseldorf, author Klaus Englert traces the current developments and their traditional lines knowledgeably using the example of over 170 objects - from the baroque garden city to the star architecture of the media harbour and modern residential districts. He outlines the urban change that began at the city's edge, and also takes a look at the buildings of the Stiftung Insel Hombroich in neighbouring Neusss or the Neanderthal Museum in Mettmann.
content.title_en: Architecture Guide Düsseldorf

content.text: The software architecture is documented and communicated: drafts, decisions and solutions are clearly and effectively recorded. content.text: System Process Engineering in Engineering Practice: Control of Processes, Hazards and Purity Criteria. The book deals with the system consideration essential for optimum process engineering processes. This should not only be done for the "pure" process, but also for the entire life cycle of technical plants – from the design of a process to optimization in ongoing operation. It not only depends on normal operation (as often seen in simulations), but also on the start-up and run-off processes, the accident/disruption behaviour of the processes, cleaning processes, safety measures, etc. Suitable analysis and observation methods are presented, which have developed in many years of planning and operating practice. These include risk analyses, time dynamics and reliability methods; their theoretical approach is linked to their practical applicability. Also aspects such as industry 4.0 and process changes in current systems are considered. This is intended to contribute to the engineering training, the technical operational support and project management of the company.

In his book Johannes Drerup traces the drastic effects of measures to combat the Coronapandemic for children and young people and develops an ethically based critique of German Corona policy on this basis. They impress with the immediacy of the descriptions and reports, but also with the insights and reflections of the young authors. They reflect their hopes and fears, their desperation as well as their will to live, the courage and the power they have to counter the deadly threat.

content.text: The "modernism" in architecture can only be said with an awareness of its multi-dimensionality. It was already a worldwide phenomenon in the first third of the 20th century with numerous regional manifestations, which was developed and differentiated in the following period. The migration of architects had a significant part in this. At the same time, the spread of expertise and programmatic positions by magazines, books, exhibitions and travel increased considerably. The contributions of this volume deal with such processes of transfer by example of architects who left Germany in the 1930s. Among them are protagonists of modernism such as Walter Gropius, Erich Mendelsohn and Marcel Breuer, who first worked in the UK and later in the USA, but also Wolfgang Frankl in Italy, Max Cetto in Mexico or Leopold Rother in Colombia. A second focus of the book is on the recent and tense discussion of modernism in post-war Germany. The role of emigrants, from which only a few returned, the approach to concepts of the former avant-garde, the orientation of foreign affairs and not to the hel-repeas of the discourses, the discourses of the modernism are largely known in the history of the discourse.
content.title_en: Branched Modernism : Contributions to 20th Century Architecture

content.text: The Corona Transformation: Crisis Management and Future Perspectives in Business, Culture and Education. Functions applied to forests are becoming increasingly complex in a society that is more differentiated and often lead to increasingly dichotomizing and violent conflicts around forests or forest-related measures. For example, the physical foundations are central to the coverage of existing needs of renewable resources as well as workplace and livelihood for more than a million people in the Forest and Wood Cluster in Germany. content.text: Melioration and migration: Water and society in Central and Eastern Central Europe from the 17th to the middle of the 19th century. Wetlands that are periodically under water, either permanently or through regular floods, have shaped the landscape in pre-industrial Europe. However, bogs, swamps and fractured areas have been the scene of melioration projects since the early modern times. They were intended to expand agricultural land and contribute to the intensification of agriculture as well as to the development of trade and traffic. Meliorations have often been associated with migration and new settlement foundations. In the volume, the term "colony" is therefore examined alongside agrarian expansion and mobility, with its different dimensions of significance such as colonialization, colonization and colonization. The melioration examples from Central and Eastern Central Europe demonstrate the multiple limitations of economic, demographic, ecological and cultural questions and show, in addition to the time-typical belief in progress – especially from today's perspective – instructive shadows of human intervention in nature.
content.title_en: Melioration and migration: Water and society in Central and Eastern Central Europe from the 17th to the mid-19th century

content.text: How we want to live: Compendium on the consequences of digitalisation, networking and artificial intelligence. Folding text: Digitization, networking and artificial intelligence are fundamentally changing our lives! We need to understand and analyse the various developments, how they reinforce each other and affect our "normal", analog life. What are the consequences of the changes for me and for the society in which I live? Digital networking and artificial intelligence are epochal basic innovations that are relapsingly permeating all areas of society and are the engine of a comprehensive, disruptive structural change that will produce numerous new innovations in the coming years. Despite numerous books on the subject, the profound and versatile effects of digitalization are usually only viewed on a cut-off basis, i.e. for individual areas. what is missing is a general picture. The Association of German Scientists (VDW) has therefore been working extensively on the consequences of digitalization since 2016 and has used a study group that presents the present compendium for this purpose. In this we consider the contexts and repercussions of digital innovation in different social areas.
content.title_en: How we want to live: Compendium on the consequences of digitalisation, networking and artificial intelligence

content.text: The story of a Cold War interview project that tried to elicit the hero of quantum physics from the most important scientific revolution of the 20th century. Heller than a thousand suns radiated the new physics at the beginning of the 20th century: researchers such as Niels Bohr, Werner Heisenberg and James Franck revolutionized our understanding of space and time and wrote science history. But only in the middle of the Cold War did this story begin to be written: "Sources for History of Quantum Physics" – under this sober title the memories of all the then still living coryphaes of physics should be gathered together. Thomas S. Kuhn, an unknown historian of science and physicist, developed a new method of reconstruction, which is hardly used in historiography, which is now part of the standard repertoire: the research interview.

content.text: Ergonomics: Fundamentals for the interaction of man, technology and organization. Prof. Dr.-Ing. Martin Schmauder teaches industrial science at the Institute of Technical Logistics and Work Systems at the Technical University of Dresden. Prof. Dr. Birgit Spanner-Ulmer is Director of Production and Technology at the Bayerischer Rundfunk, Munich, and holder of the Chair of Production and Technology in the Media Industry at the Technical University of Munich. In this textbook, seven chapters show how to design work systems economically and humanely. Students and practitioners: In this case, they receive a modern basic training in ergonomics. The book presents basics, methods, methods and case studies as well as recommendations and rules. Numerous practical examples and the consistent four-colour design illustrate the contents. The facts of product and production ergonomics are presented in relation to each other, so that connections become clear. The book is based on a structural scheme of human work. Based on the interaction between man and work equipment as well as the body dimensions, the design of workplace and the working environment are also updated in terms of the context of radiation.
content.title_en: Ergonomics : Basics for the interaction of man, technology and organization

content.text: World disorder: the global crises and illusions of the West. Since the defeat in Afghanistan and Putin's war against Ukraine, the foundations of Western foreign and security policy have been under test. What must change so that we can survive in the new world disorder? After the end of the Cold War, the US and its allies hoped to reshape the international system according to their own ideas. But instead of creating order, chaos was created. The dream of the westernization of the world is dreamed out today. Back there remains a world disorder characterized by multipolarity, block formation and uncertainty, which will determine international politics for a long time. What challenges must we face in Germany and Europe? What means of power are available to us? We need, that is Carlo Masala's central thesis, a realistic view of international relations, which frees itself from illusions, takes into account the geostrategic realities and learns again to read the language of power, but also to speak them.
content.title_en: World Disorder: Global Crisis and the Illusions of the West

content.text: "Along the color line": a journey through Germany in 1936. In 1936, the Afro-American civil rights activist W.E.B. Du Bois travels to Germany for the first time as a critic of racism in the USA. His reports from these months appear here for the first time in German in 1936. In 1936, the Afro-American civil rights activist W.E.B. Du Bois travels to Germany for a period of several months of research into National Socialist Germany. As a sharp critic of racism in his own country, he observes anti-Semitism and the denial of rights of the Jews in the "Third Reich". His weekly reports from these months appear here for the first time in German language. Du Bois reports on the Wagner Festival in Bayreuth and the German Museum in Munich, about German beer stations and the dictatorships of the German population.
content.title_en: "Along the color line" : a trip through Germany 1936

content.text: At the checkout, on the way home, in the restaurant: It is the famous rages that bring even the most respectful mothers or fathers out of balance. With easy-to-use strategies for all typical situations in family life and STOP formula as an emergency aid in case of a rage attack.
content.title_en: Furious attacks : understand, accompany and grow lovingly

content.text: Urwelten : a journey through the extinct ecosystems of Earth's history. Review: In his debut work, paleontologist and evolutionary biologist T. Halliday presents a journey through time from the beginnings of life on our Earth to the present. In an easily understandable way, he takes readers on his journey, across all continents, and gives fascinating impressions of the different ecosystems of Earth's history. His partly poetic observations are best reproduced by the well-known translator H. Kober. Funded scientific theses, archaeological finds and their sites are "to life". From the ice age mammoth steppe in Alaska (Pleistocene) to the Ediacarium in Australia, 16 chapters show how diverse the evolutionary history of the past was, but also how fragile ecosystems have been in the last 500 million years. An epilogue draws conclusions from the past for the present and gives indications of our future evolutionary history.
content.title_en: Premature worlds: a journey through the extinct ecosystems of Earth's history

content.text: Statistics in work organisation. Data is collected in all areas of operational practice by means of measurements, surveys or other experiments. Statistical methods are essential for the illustrative presentation, evaluation and interpretation of these data. This book is intended to provide a basic understanding of statistical methods. The methods described can be used in practice in the following fields: investigation of the properties of subcontracting parts, monitoring quality standards and compliance with quality regulations, process-oriented quality management, time management and planning time for time and cost calculation, use of equipment, personnel and material requirements planning, determination of distribution time shares, production of business statistics. The past has shown that purely theoretical mediation of statistics is not sufficient. In this book, this disadvantage is avoided by understandable contents in conjunction with professional software products and modern teaching methods. For this reason, the book has a download code for a demonstration software, with which all examples and illustrations can be easily understood.
content.title_en: Statistics in the organisation of work

content.text: Memes - Forms and Consequences of an Internet Phenomena. Memes are not only used for entertainment or art, they are also used in politics, in local and international election campaigns or in demonstrations. In their most typical form they are text image structures that are digitally distributed and transformed at viral speed. Joanna Nowotny and Julian Reidy take on this Internet phenomenon from a cultural-scientific perspective. They enter new territory by analyzing individual memes casusistically and systematizing their findings to define this digital form of communication in a definitorial way - in constant relation to other digital phenomena such as trolling. Content -- 1. Introduction: »The multimedia rush does not take place« -- 2. Referenceality: Local memes culture globally networked -- 3. Humour: From pandemems and word jokes, Humor theories and Subversion -- 4. Politics: The ›political‹ meme between activism and sabotage, activity and passivity, ›lefts‹ and ›rights‹ -- 5. content.text: The Basics of the EU Card Business: Characteristics and innovative business models of digital payments and card payments. This second edition of the essentials provides important know-how with the addition of the end-to-end analysis of possible application areas of the card business in companies, as well as the insight into the importance of the card business in the structure and process organization of the European Payment Initiative, as well as their card-driven innovation, thereby helping to clarify current market developments. According to the interdisciplinary character of the essentials, the card business is located at the interface of banks and non-banks, with increasing importance for non-banks. The essentials are aimed at students and interested parties from science and practice alike with their concisely described and graphic content. The content The European Card Business - "The Two-Sied-Market The Card Business - Basis of innovative business models Case Case Study EPI – European Payment Initiative The target groups Dozierende und Studieren der Wirtschaftswissenschaften with the focus on finance, fintech or digital transformation executives and product managers of fintechs, banks and commerce in the fields of business.
content.title_en: Fundamentals of the EU Card Business : Characteristics and innovative business models of digital payments and card payments

content.text: My angry country: a journey through the divided states of America. After ten years as a correspondent in the Middle East and China, Evan Osnos moves back to the USA in 2013. But the country he returns to is hardly recognisable. Equal opportunities, the rule of law, the belief in the power of truth IBM seem to have incorporated the fundamental principles of the oldest democracy in the world. In 2016, Donald Trump is elected president, four years later his supporters storm the capitol. From the united, the divided states of America have become. Evan Osnos has observed these developments over years. He tries to understand and explain why in the rich greenwich on the east coast where he grew up, from moderated conservatives became incarcerated Trump supporters. As in Clarksburg, West Virginia, where he took his first job in a newspaper, the opioid crisis could expand to national catastrophe. And what the causes are for the racism, the violence and inequality in Chicago, where he becomes himself a reputable figure for a journalist. The report of the United States was lost from the year of January to the year of January.
content.title_en: My angry country: a journey through the divided states of America

content.text: Alternative facts: the practice of communicative denial of knowledge. Klappentext: Terminik wie "postfactisch" und "alternative fekte" können Konjunktur. They point out that in many societies a struggle for the reality of reality seems to have flared up. However, sociologist Nils C. Kumkar considers these phenomena from a different perspective: starting from case studies of the conflicts over Corona, climate change and the size of the audience at the inauguration of Donald Trump, he pleads that "alternative facts" should not be understood primarily as set-off pieces of a parallel world, but as discursive fog candles in the context of polarized debates. They do not, according to Kumkar, contribute to the construction of an alternative reality, but as a communicative reality destruction that allows us to continue with better knowledge as before.
content.title_en: Alternative facts : to the practice of communicative denial of knowledge

content.text: Who we are : how we perceive, feel and love : everything you should know about psychology. How does man work? Is there a blueprint for the psyche, a mental framework that all people share? Bestselling author Stefanie Stahl provides fascinating insights into the interplay of perception, consciousness and behavior. She explains easily and well-founded why happiness is our life drug, how subjectively the perception of the world is and how through education and experiences the self-image forms. Exciting protocols from the therapy practice as well as valuable impulses for solving psychological conflicts make this journey into our innermost experience a true experience.
content.title_en: Who we are : how we perceive, feel and love : everything you should know about psychology

content.text: The main tasks of the system management of electrical transmission networks are described in this book. These include grid management, system balance, system security and coordination of electricity trading. The book provides an overview of the structure and structure of transmission networks and their historical development. The integration of national transmission networks into European interconnection systems management and the safety centres is also part of this book. The future development in the field of system management is outlined in the examples of new visualization concepts and curative congestion management. The content Electrical power supply networks Operating management of electrical transmission systems (system management) Network management (network security monitoring, grid status correction, optimization) Compliance with the system balance Innovative grid congestion management European interconnection system management, safety centres Building of switching lines, visualization concepts Electricity trading The target groups of students in the field of energy technology Engineering and users from the field of energy transmission and distribution Computer scientists, physicists and mathematicians with cross-curricular interest in energy supply engineering The German Research Foundation for Energy Management (HWWWWW) was the Head of Research at the University of Wuppertal.
content.title_en: System management : operation of electrical power transmission networks
