The book shows compactly how e-commerce can focus on an ecologically sustainable way of doing things and thus contribute to environmental protection. Because in times when the impact of human trade on nature has become tangible for everyone or at least in the media, e-commerce is confronted with some criticisms. Examples of this are the promotion of unnecessary consumption, the creation of increased traffic and associated CO2 emissions, the disposal of returns or also the generation of large amounts of packaging waste. The author presents approaches and practical recommendations for action to avoid returns and optimize packaging and logistics. Examples from practice convey impulses as companies already act in the sense of environmental sustainability. The content Basics E-commerce Sustainability Approaches of ecological sustainability in e-commerce The author Mark Harwardt is Professor for Commerce, E-Commerce and Marketing uses them for digital management.

content.text: The sport of the military: perspectives from research, teaching and practice. Sports is of great importance for the military in general and for the soldiers in their daily service and in situations of deployment. The role of sport in the armed forces goes far beyond the training of the body. This volume is the first comprehensive work that approaches the subject of sport and military and its dimensions from various disciplines – social sciences and history, as well as medicine, sports science and psychology. The focus is on the connection between sport and military in the 20th century and on the design of this interweaving of relationships in the Bundeswehr. The volume is divided into five sections. First, the fundamental relationships between sport and military are considered from a scientific and practical point of view. The second section focuses on the practice of sport in the military from a sports scientific perspective, the third section on the promotion of top sports. The fourth section provides historical analyses.
content.title_en: The sport of the military : perspectives from research, teaching and practice

content.text: Rescue routes with concept : safe planning and execution in detail : Excerpt from the fire protection atlas. The book provides comprehensive planning bases and practical examples for the planning of rescue routes. The building supervision requirements for fire protection around the topic of rescue routes are compiled in detail and clearly. Numerous illustrations explain the respective requirements easily and in a comprehensible manner and visualized in numerous drawings. Specialist planners, architects, authorities and involved parties receive an overview of basic requirements and protection targets for rescue routes as well as the protection-oriented planning of necessary stairways and necessary corridors
content.title_en: Rescue routes with concept : safe planning and execution in detail : Excerpt from the fire protection atlas

content.text: Small town research: interdisciplinary perspectives. Almost 30 percent of the inhabitants of Germany live in small towns located in bacon belts of metropolitan regions or in peripheral areas. In the rural context, small towns can be important anchors, and elsewhere they serve as residential and holiday resorts. The actors in the local community deal with everyday living together in and the future of small towns in a variety of ways. The contributors of the volume illuminate the heterogeneity of small towns through various case studies with different methodological approaches. In reflections of these approaches, they show the potential of interdisciplinary small town research and take into account topics such as digitalization, mobility and migration.
content.title_en: Small town research : interdisciplinary perspectives

content.text: Life with wolves: affects, feelings and moods in human-wolf relationships. The wolves return to Germany - and with them the conflicts between man and wolf. The affect, atmospheres, feelings and moods that trigger their return play a central role. Thorsten Gieser examines the complex interdependence of nature and society in the Anthropocene via an ethnographic approach. His thesis: The wolves confront us with an affective rewilding and thus initiate a process of rethinking us as a multi-human society. He shows ways to a (peaceful) coexistence, proposes a complex understanding of wolves as affective actors and thus radically re-applys the Wolf-Mensch relationship.
content.title_en: Living with wolves : affects, feelings and moods in human-wolf relationships

This becomes all the more clear when, from a literary and design scientific perspective, the difference between typographical and other, fundamentally nonverbal visual data is observed. The contributors of the volume derive a relationship between literary and art science and its objects, which not least leads to a new attention for the scriptural and typographical materiality and mediality of literature. The topic is the theory of reflection and the practice of the production of a specific book aesthetics.
content.title_en: Book-Aisthesis : Philology and Design Discourse

content.text: Basic knowledge Circular Economy : from the international sustainability concept to political implementation. This book is about aiming for a regenerative system based on planetary boundaries. In addition to the theoretical, conceptual foundations of the Circular Economy, the author analyses the state of development in Germany and the EU. At the same time, he examines the three concepts of the implementation of the Circular Economy: Cradle to Cradle, Blue Economy and Performance Economy. The book is aimed at students of the economic and social sciences as well as the courses of study that include the topic of sustainability.
content.title_en: Basic knowledge Circular Economy : from the international sustainability concept to political implementation

content.text: What does digital sovereignty mean? : Discourses, practices and prerequisites of "individual" and "state sovereignty" in the digital age. Klappentext: The socio-technical relations of digital transformation challenge ideas of the "sovereign state" and the "sovereign subject". In the debates about "digital sovereignty" these challenges are problematized. "Sovereignity" is however a complex concept. It will be the task of the humanities and social sciences to work out differentiated perspectives on "digital sovereignty" in dialogue with the technical sciences and thus to develop orientation knowledge for social self-understanding in the digital age as well as the design of digital transformation. The contributors of the volume face this task and provide impulses from the perspectives of different disciplines of the humanities, social sciences and technology sciences.
content.title_en: What does digital sovereignty mean? : Discourses, practices and prerequisites of "individual" and "state sovereignty" in the digital age

content.text: Hereditary regions: Acquisitions and uses of regional heritage in the Wendland and in the Lausitz region in comparison. Cultural heritage plays a central role in border regions not only in the context of home-building, but also in energy-industrial transformation processes: e.g. in the Wendland as a former "zone border area" and in the Lausitz as a neighbour to Poland since the end of the Second World War. Jenny Hagemann investigates its underlying historical developments and current areas of action in her interdisciplinary study by combining historical comparison, discourse analysis and qualitative interviews. It provides new insights for heritage studies and regional history alike and offers for the first time proposals for the conceptualization of "regional heritage"
content.title_en: Heredity: Acquisitions and uses of regional heritage in the Wendland and Lusatia in comparison

content.text: Optimization of the self : Concepts, representations and practices. Klappentext: From gyms to sleep apps to healing stones - the pursuit of self-optimization has a fixed place in the everyday culture of the present. What is to be understood by the ubiquitous term, however, is controversially discussed. Self-optimization provokes: critics reject it as part of a neoliberal coercion, proponents interpret it as an expression of autonomy. The contributors of the interdisciplinary band differentiate the discourse about self-optimization: they question current valuation patterns, highlight ambiguities and fractures and expose the cultural complexity of the phenomenon.
content.title_en: Optimization of the self : concepts, presentations and practices

content.text: Indigenous Resistance: the resistance of the Bolivian TIPNIS movement. Klappentext: Latin America knows numerous protest movements of its indigenous population. One of the most emblematic cases is the social movement against a prestige project of the Morales government: the construction of a road in the indigenous territory and the National Park Isiboro Sécure (TIPNIS) in the Bolivian Amazon region. With regard to the perspectives of the heterogeneous protest actors Maximilian Held reconstructs this resistance in its complex manifestations. He highlights how problems of weakened indigenous self-government, socio-ecological threats, deficits of the neo-extractive development model and lack of legal implementation are related.
content.title_en: Indigenous Resistance : the resistance of the Bolivian TIPNIS movement

content.text: Religion teaching in the stress of plausibility : interdisciplinary perspectives on current developments and challenges. The fact that religion must be taken into account in school education is largely undisputed - in which form this has to take place, however, is currently increasingly asked and discussed. The contributors of the volume outline current processes of change in religious teaching in Germany, present related challenges and comment on these problem areas from very different scientific perspectives. Representatives from the fields of law, migration education, the media and political education are involved in this interdisciplinary understanding.
content.title_en: Religious instruction in plausibility stress : interdisciplinary perspectives on current developments and challenges

content.text: Protection of violence in refugee shelters : theory, empiria and practice. Collective accommodation of asylum seekers is an important part of refugee policy administrative practice in Germany. With all variance of the type of such collective accommodation, there are always fundamental challenges involved. Because with a central space for dealing with flight and arrival, dangers and conflicts are also concentrated locally. Parallel to the development of concepts for coping with these challenges, the contributors of the volume investigate the realities of life in these institutions.
content.title_en: Protection of violence in refugee shelters : theory, empiria and practice

content.text: Workshop Multihalle - contemporary living experiments. The 'Werkstatt Multihalle' focuses on 'Contemporary Living Experiments' at the interface between 'academic science' and 'democratic urban society' and corresponds to the basic idea of the Multihalle Frei Ottos by focusing on experimental forms of living and by exploring new qualitative habitats. In this workshop, current topics on society, urbanity, living and sustainability are discussed. The focus is on the development of innovative answers to the questions of future urban life.
content.title_en: Workshop Multihalle - contemporary living experiments

content.text: The Western democracies are increasingly challenged by authoritarian populist tendencies. The assumption that democratic learning experiences are irreversible has become questionable. Can a stable trend towards "democratic regression" (snare/snare) be identified? What are the clues on which such a diagnosis can be based, and what are the possible causes? What is added to the concept of regression of the omnipresent speech about the decline of democracy? The special volume provides the first comprehensive discussion of empirical diagnoses, analytical provisions and normative uses of phenomenon and concept of democratic regression.
content.title_en: Diagnosis of Democratic Regression

content.text: Energy storage for the energy transition: Design and operation of storage systems. Understanding the energy transition correctly. Whether driving or standing, on the bracelet, in the pocket, in the car or in the cellar: Storage systems have become an integral part of our lives. By expanding renewable energies and the advent of electromobility, an understanding of the characteristics of these systems becomes increasingly important in the study and profession. The textbook introduces readers to the design of storage systems. It enables us to understand which components are used and what consequences the use of certain storage technologies has for storage tasks. Using examples, it explains what needs to be considered in the conception of a storage system and how meaningful developmental but also investment decisions can be made. Exercise tasks and numerous illustrations help to apply the acquired knowledge in practice. From the content: - System construction and functions of storage systems - Mechanical storage - Thermal storage - Electrical storage - Electrochemical storage - Chemical storage - Load management New in the 3rd edition: - a detailed case example across all chapters (Ladestation für Bussen) - new chapter on energy management - Reghan.
content.title_en: Energy storage for the energy transition : Design and operation of storage systems

content.text: Wind energy Meteorology : Atmosphere physics for wind energy generation. This book provides an introduction to meteorological conditions for wind power generation both on land and at sea, and provides meteorological information for the planning and operation of this important renewable energy source. It includes the derivation of wind laws and descriptions of wind profiles, especially above the logarithmic ground-level layer, and deals with winds over complex terrain and night low-level jets. This updated and expanded second edition contains new chapters dealing with the efficiency of large wind farms and their follow-up and offshore wind energy. This book is a translation of an original English-language edition. The translation was prepared using artificial intelligence (machine translation with DeepL.com). A subsequent manual revision was carried out mainly on the basis of content, so that the book is stylistically different from a conventional translation.
content.title_en: Wind energy Meteorology : Atmosphere physics for wind energy production

content.text: Decoupled working environments: company work organisations and new intermediaries in structural change of post-industrial and virtual work societies. The structures of the industrially shaped work society are significantly changed by the increasing use of automated and digital technologies as well as the expansion of the infrastructure of the Internet. At the same time, an intensive flexibilisation of familiar structures of business-centered forms of employment can be observed. Ina Krause describes individual dynamics at the social meso level and thus contributes to the debate about the sustainable design of the digital and virtual work society in Germany.

content.text: Chronos: a physical journey to the origins of time. Chronos, the personified time, is a mystery, not only for physicists. From Newton to Hamlet, from Einstein to Dalí, it is the protagonist of such fascinating and dizzying speculations. Can we ever stop the unstoppable progress of time? Can the time arrow turn around? Does time actually have its own existence or is it just a huge illusion? The physicist and writer Guido Tonelli tells in a spectacular book the long history of time, its raging birth and bizarre development. Time is an excellent instrument to survive in our environment, but it makes us a dash through the account as soon as we try to understand how the world works outside our small planet. There the regular rhythm of our time deviates from Turbulence, chaotic phenomena and tremendous disasters. We encounter solar systems that have fallen apart by supernova explosions, and galaxies that have been driven by active galactic nuclei, but also to look at the infinite manifestations of our lives. These are the same as the infinite manifestations of our lives. If we listen to the infinite manifestations of the imagination, the same as the infinite manifestations of our lives. If we listen to the infinite, the senses, the infinite, the imagination and the imaginations of the imaginations of the imaginations of the imagination.
content.title_en: Chronos : a physical journey to the origins of the time

content.text: People, gods and machines: an ethics of digitalization. Digitization has undermined our privacy, disintegrating the public into disintegrating partial publics, lowering barriers and softening the boundary between truth and lies. The well-known theologian Wolfgang Huber describes this technical and social development and shows on many illustrative examples how and according to which standards we can shape digitalization self-determined and responsible. The attitudes towards digitalization vary between euphoria and apocalypse: Some expect the creation of a new person who rises up to God himself. Others fear the loss of freedom and human dignity. Wolfgang Huber, on the other hand, takes a realistic look at the technical upheaval. This all too often begins with the language: Are the «social media» really social? Does a car equipped with digital intelligence carry "autonomous" or not more automated? Are algorithms that learn through pattern recognition, therefore "intelligent"? An overboarding language makes us forget that even more powerful computers are only machines that are developed and used by people. In an emergency, one has to pull them the plug into the ethically capable of Wolfgang Huber's use of his principles.
content.title_en: People, Gods and Machines: an Ethics of Digitization

content.text: Viewing map views : Text linguistics, corpus-fragmatics and cultural analysis. The postcard is a success medium of the 20th century. With its two-sidedness of text and image, it has become the icon of modern mass tourism since the post-war period. To combine greetings from a distance with messages about what has been experienced is now one of the everyday rituals of holiday. But what exactly do people write on postcards? Which linguistic-communicative patterns of holiday greetings have proved to be successful and how have they changed over the decades? And is the postcard threatening to die out in the face of competition from electronic successors? The contributors of the volume empirically examine these questions from corpus, text and cultural linguistic points of view.
content.title_en: View to the map : Text linguistics, corpuspragmatics and cultural analysis

content.text: Connective cynicism : Politics and culture in the digital age. Political discourse is threatening, trolls and cross-border jokes are raging in social media. Right-wing populists and questionable influencers consciously use linguistic blurs and ironic intertones to relativize what is said in retrospect. Fabian Schäfer examines the special attention economy and the connectivity of the like and sharing of social media, which stimulate the spread of political and cultural cynicism. With the concept of connective cynicism, he shows how marginal humor is profited and made politics with antidemocratic discourse strategies.
content.title_en: Connective cynicism : Politics and culture in the digital age

content.text: Computer Experiments : On the Change of Science in the Age of Computers. Since the introduction of the computer as a research, experiment and forecasting tool, the sciences have undergone a profound change. Not only the practices and infrastructures of scientific work are changing, but also the logic of research is subject to a fundamental transformation. In addition to theory, experiment and measurement, computer experiments open up a new field of knowledge production and radically change the experimental culture of the natural sciences. Using climate research as an example, the book reconstructs this change of the sciences "from science to computational sciences".
content.title_en: Computer Experiments : The Change of Science in the Age of Computer

content.text: How we want to live: Compendium on the consequences of digitalisation, networking and artificial intelligence. Folding text: Digitization, networking and artificial intelligence are fundamentally changing our lives! We need to understand and analyse the various developments, how they reinforce each other and affect our "normal", analog life. What are the consequences of the changes for me and for the society in which I live? Digital networking and artificial intelligence are epochal basic innovations that are relapsingly permeating all areas of society and are the engine of a comprehensive, disruptive structural change that will produce numerous new innovations in the coming years. Despite numerous books on the subject, the profound and versatile effects of digitalization are usually only viewed on a cut-off basis, i.e. for individual areas. what is missing is a general picture. The Association of German Scientists (VDW) has therefore been working extensively on the consequences of digitalization since 2016 and has used a study group that presents the present compendium for this purpose. In this we consider the contexts and repercussions of digital innovation in different social areas.
content.title_en: How we want to live: Compendium on the consequences of digitalisation, networking and artificial intelligence

content.text: Inscenarios and mobilizations: rights and Islamist actors digitally and analogly. Social media are increasingly a place for the staging and discursive processing of social and political conflicts. Extremely right-wing and Salafist-jihadi actors participate in these conflicts and use them as a platform for propaganda. The volume is dedicated to the question of how mobilization and radicalisation processes unfold in social media and under what conditions they can lead to acts of violence in the real world.
content.title_en: Inscenario and Mobilization: Rights and Islamist Actors digital and analog

content.text: Thinking digital society over again: Opportunities and challenges in everyday and working life from a psychological perspective. The digitalization of work and private life is progressing, the pandemic has accelerated this development. But what does this mean from a psychological perspective? How do the dynamics of conversation and social norms of cooperation change? How can team spirit, motivation, creativity and the positive effects of casual exchange be maintained in digital work structures? What do trends such as AI and social scoring mean for our future and responsible design of interactive systems? The book describes how we can meet the challenges and make the best use of the opportunities offered by digitalization.
content.title_en: Rethinking digital society: Opportunities and challenges in everyday and working life from a psychological perspective

content.text: Diversity in the children's book: how diversity (not) is taught. Books are of great importance for the growing up of children, especially in early and middle childhood. They are important for language and reading development, enable children to explore unknown and fantastic worlds, can be emotional support and serve to impart knowledge. They also always convey social knowledge - ideas of social orders and hierarchies. In this way they are decisively shaping the child's view of the world, of themselves and of others. From a diversity and unequal perspective, this book gathers contributions that examine children's books, but also toys and children's television, as well as how social diversity is represented and negotiated in them. Among other topics discussed are migration, multilingualism, racism, social class, family norms, gender and disability. Furthermore, the importance of diversity in children's media for the growth of children is asked.
content.title_en: Diversity in the children's book : how diversity (not) is conveyed

content.text: City guide design : Shopping, viewing, eating and drinking, relaxing, going out, overnight stay; [more than 500 addresses in Germany, Austria and Switzerland]. Priority 6 German cities (Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich), Vienna and Zurich are tapped as if after design sights. 72 other places with design-relevant objects appear in 3 city alphabets (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). All "proposals" are shown - in a selection, as the authors emphasize, "subjective" and "unfair" - museums, galleries for design objects, buildings, but also hotels, restaurants, shops with corresponding interiors or goods. All "proposals" are illustrated with short description, address and telephone number, in many cases with photos. Target groups are design lovers, whether they are travelling as tourists, study or business travellers. (2) (LK/UL: Kiener)
content.title_en: City Guide Design : Shopping, viewing, eating and drinking, relaxing, going out, staying overnight; [over 500 addresses in Germany, Austria and Switzerland]

content.text: The application application for students and students: a personal guide for education, Gap year, (Duals) study and internships. This guide introduces through all career-relevant application phases, with which pupils, school graduates and students face each other, and specifically addresses the different application situations. In addition to helping for career orientation, various possibilities are discussed, including an internship, Gap year, an apprenticeship or a dual study. Particularly helpful are the author's personal experiences and tips. The right book for all readers who want to apply for the certain something more in support and advice. New in the 2nd edition: The virtual application interview, the creative application and an additional chapter for the application after the study. The content mental preparation Successful vocational orientation General to the application documents General to the application process Application during the school period Application for a Gap year Applications after the school Application during the study Application after the study The author Tamara Schrammel is a mechanical engineer and finance manager at Siemens Healthineers. Pre-Accounting for the application period of success in the field of education and u-Accounting.
content.title_en: The first applications for students and pupils: a personal guide for training, Gap year, (Duales) studies and internships

content.text: MATLAB® meets MicroPython : use with MATLAB® microcontroller. Planning -- Hardware - Construction of the adaptation electronics -- MCU software in MicroPython -- MATLAB. This essential deals with the linking of MicroPython-powered microcontrollers with MATLAB®. Using a practical example, the aspects of the planning, electronic implementation, programming in MicroPython, programming in MATLAB® and the creation of a graphical interface are dealt with.The content requirement of microcontrollers, MCU software and MATLAB. software hardware - Design MCU software in MicroPython MATLAB® software and graphical interface The target groups Students with basic knowledge of programming and career starters Engineers and technicians in industrial practice who plan mechatronic systems The author Armin Rohnen teaches at the University of Applied Sciences, Munich Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Vehicle Engineering, Aircraft Engineering. He specializes in the application of MATLAB® in signal analysis and uses this also in his research on the technical influencing of the taste matter coffee.
content.title_en: MATLAB® meets MicroPython : use with MATLAB® microcontroller

content.text: (Re-)organisation of justification and forms of solidarity: the youth association system and the self-organisation of young people. The topic of solidarity has received much attention in recent years. The contributions of this collection draw in a very different way on material of a three-year research project, which has dealt with the question of solidarity in the field of political representation of the political interests of the self-organisations of young people and the structures of the youth association system. The contributions can be understood in how solidarity and belonging, participation and exclusion as well as democracy, limits of justification and equality are connected.
content.title_en: (Re-)organisation of justification and forms of solidarity : the youth association system and the self-organisation of young people

content.text: Transformative and agile innovation systems: new practices and innovation policy challenges. The patterns of innovation have changed significantly in recent years, as a result of more open innovation strategies of companies, increasing demands for speed and agility of innovation processes, expanding global cooperation and, in particular, the growing importance of digital technologies with new specific requirements. At the same time, the societal and environmental challenges for problem solving through innovation have increased massively. The consequence is that the established innovation system is under pressure to change. Above all, innovation policy must also pursue its strategic goals and socially desired effects of innovation. However, the medium and long-term challenges of this development for the entire innovation system and also for innovation policy have so far only to be anticipated. These questions are critically discussed in this book in an interdisciplinary perspective. The focus is on how the transformation of the innovation system can be promoted and its agility increased.
content.title_en: Transformative and agile innovation systems: new practices and innovation policy challenges

content.text: Social climate: the conflict over the sustainability of the social. The social state has successfully avoided ecology in the decades of ecology. The limits of growth were socially uninteresting for the defenders of the social, jobs were more important than nesting places. The climate crisis has undermined this disinterest. Increasingly, the social sciences appear in the field of sustainability research and social policy women want to protect the climate. The essay "Social climate" searches through the field of social sustainability with the means of a holistic sociology informed by Hegel and Parsons. The proposal is human rights-based guaranteeism, a fourth formation alongside liberalism, socialism and conservatism.
content.title_en: Social climate: the conflict over the sustainability of the social

content.text: Autism, ADHD and tics: Between the norm variant, personality disorder and neuropsychiatric disease. Autism and ADHD experience an unbroken social interest. In DSM-5 and ICD-11 they are introduced together with the tic disorders as developmental disorders to all other mental disorders. But there are also warning voices that they are becoming a fashion diagnosis. Every recognizable personality characteristic is reinterpreted to become a disease. The 3rd edition is extended to include the topic of tic disorders and addresses the following questions: What is normal at all? What is personality? When are symptoms and characteristics become a disease? Autistic symptoms, as well as ADHD properties and tics, can be both an expression of normal development and a neuropsychiatric disease or personality disorder. To understand this can be of great importance for both the affected and their fellow human beings and help to reduce fears and prejudices.
content.title_en: Autism, ADHD and Tics : Between the normal variant, personality disorder and neuropsychiatric disease

content.text: The intertwined nature and culture: Theory formation and research perspectives in the pedagogy of early childhood. A separation of nature and culture was constitutive for modern thinking and thus also early pedagogy over a long period of time. The vulnerability of man and the world in the climate crisis and in the age of the Anthropocene is an engine for exploring alternatives to the natural-culture dichotomy for the theory formation and research of the pedagogy of early childhood. The collected contributions focus on questions about relational determination of nature and culture in the context of early childhood. Questions about anthropological images of the child and its education, on empirical fields of concreteization in pedagogically framed situations as well as political and ethical perspectives for the research and practice of early pedagogy are the focus.
content.title_en: The intertwined nature and culture: Theory education and research perspectives in the pedagogy of early childhood

content.text: Development-oriented education in practice. Development-oriented education is formed as a paradigm that replaces and integrates competence-oriented education. How to shape education in a development-oriented way is what this book is about. Here are examples, concepts, experiences, practical proposals: At the level of education, in different educational levels, subjects and school departments as well as at the level of curriculum and curriculum development and the organization. Here, not only the interrelationships between development orientation and personal personality as well as organizational maturity are illuminated, but also the deep structures of successful practical implementation. More than a proposal for action!
content.title_en: Development-oriented education in practice

content.text: Antisemitism in the context of school: interpretations and practices of teachers and school leaders. Antisemitism as discrimination and violence is part of everyday school life and manifests itself at different levels, from subtle insinuations to obvious actions and attacks. Antisemitism as discrimination and violence phenomenon is part of everyday school life and manifests itself at different levels, from subtle insinuations to attacks in real and virtual spaces. Based on a study conducted in Berlin with group discussions and narrative interviews, (learning) biographical experiences, antisemitism understandings and intervention practices are worked out by teachers: inside and school leaders as well as the challenges they address. The book asks how teachers perceive, classify and respond to antisemitism in school.
content.title_en: Anti-Semitism in the context of school: interpretations and practices of teachers and school leaders

content.text: Environment – Education – Life-course: the connection between individual and social change. Human beings have always had to intervene in nature to survive. However, this has become a problem today. The book describes this development and presents images and narratives with which man has interpreted and shaped his relationship with nature. If the goal of sustainable development is to be achieved, politics and pedagogicalism are equally required. This applies in particular to an understanding of education as life-course competence, if one wants to follow the invitation of Rainer Maria Rilke and Peter Sloterdijk: »You must change your life!«
content.title_en: Environment – Education – Living: the link between individual and social change

content.text: Social space orientation in the day care center. Children's day care centers are important points of contact for families and institutions in the social space beyond the education, education and care of children. In order to successfully complete this function, a social space view is essential. The book explains the theoretical background of social space orientation and supports educational professionals in establishing social space work in the day care center and developing a professional spatial attitude. The book is characterized by a high degree of practical relevance and offers the reader practical information for the implementation of a successful social space work in the day care center. Methods of the development of the social space are presented and the different levels of social space work are considered. In order to get a clear picture of successful social space work, best practice examples are shown.
content.title_en: Social space orientation in the day care centre

content.text: Comprehensive education reform: how a quality-oriented overall system can be developed. Why do most reforms and innovations have so little effect? Research reports show that the impact depends on interaction. Individual reforms usually do not show any effectiveness, even no sustainable ones. The more comprehensively the measures are coordinated, the greater the effectiveness. This is what the term comprehension means. The book presents comprehensively the international experience with educational reforms and innovations at all levels – from the ministry to the classroom. It explains what quality management means and what roles data play. The book also contains several simple tools for analyzing complex development processes.
content.title_en: Comprehensive education reform: how to develop a quality-oriented overall system

content.text: Introduction to form education : Contact and dialogue in pedagogical everyday life. Contact! This is the answer of form education to the challenges of pedagogical action in today's world. Contact means being able to relate to children and young people (and adults) and at the same time respecting their own limits. In this introduction to form education, the theoretical foundations of this important variant of humanistic pedagogy are clearly presented and concrete principles of action formulated regarding current pedagogical challenges (e.g. dealing with "ADHS").
content.title_en: Introduction to the form-pedagogy : Contact and dialogue in the pedagogical everyday life

content.text: The model project "Secure the future early!" (2019-2023) is a test of the city of Gelsenkirchen and the RAG Foundation in close cooperation to make the early education programmes poverty-sensitive and thus to enable each child – regardless of their social origin and financial resources – individual, talent-oriented support as well as social and cultural participation. In the present evaluation report, the central findings of the effectiveness of the model project are analysed and 13 recommendations for poverty-sensitive work in day care facilities with regard to working with children, parents, professionals and in the social area are formulated.
content.title_en: Poverty-sensitive action in the day care centre : Evaluation of the model project "Secure the future early!"

content.text: Global crises in psychotherapy: working in a therapeutically constructive way in difficult times. Well-founded information on possible responses to crises •Concrete therapeutic strategies for a constructive, value-oriented approach to crises •Possible tripping and how to avoid them In times of crisis patients often bring current social issues such as war, pandemic and climate change into therapy. Therapist: inside these people sometimes feel unsettled and avoid these issues. However, it can offer an important opportunity to give room to the current topics. Patient's needs: to be recognized, value-oriented work is made easier and the therapist's own uncertainties are reduced: in dealing with difficult topics. The suggestions can be used independently of school and interference. Numerous examples help in practical implementation. From the content context of global crises and psychopathology • Different reactions to crises • Therapeutic interventions, opportunities and stumbling downs • Engagement of therapists: inside outside the therapy area: working outside the therapy area.
content.title_en: Global crises in psychotherapy : therapeutically constructive working in difficult times

content.text: Education and Digitality: Analyses – Discourses – Perspectives. On the Structure Logic of the Digital: Interdisciplinary Basics -- On the Mediality of the Digital: Media Theoretical and Media Pedagogy Perspectives -- On the Subjectivation in the Digital: Socialization Theoretical Perspectives -- On the Knowledge in the Digital: Knowledge and Education Theoretical Perspectives. With ›Education‹ and ›Digitality‹ an intensely discussed field of tension is marked: On the one hand, the ‹digital backwardness› of school is often lamented, on the other hand, pedagogical skepticism and obstacles cannot be overlooked. On this tension, the contributions of the band are starting to address and ask both the challenges of ‹Education‹ through ‹Digitality› and vice versa for the demands of ‹Digitality› through ‹Education›. However, this makes it necessary to take up ‹Digitalization› not only as (even technical) application problems and didactical challenge, but also to reflect (basic) theory on the challenges of the Ruhr University of Bochum.
content.title_en: Education and Digitality : Analysis – Discourses – Perspectives

content.text: Social cohesion in the crisis: interdisciplinary perspectives on heterogeneity and cohesion of modern societies. Crises exacerbate social problems or make them particularly evident. At the same time, crisis-related cuts in hitherto natural habits raise fundamental questions about living together in modern states and the functioning of social institutions. Against the background of the Corona pandemic, the contributors of the volume shed light on the topic of social cohesion in times of crisis from different disciplines. They not only discuss fundamental social theoretic questions and empirical research results on the topic, but also analyse approaches to solidarity in times of crisis.
content.title_en: Social cohesion in crisis: interdisciplinary perspectives on heterogeneity and cohesion of modern societies

content.text: Mathe-Basics for Data Scientists: Algebra, Statistics and Probability Analysis for Data Analysis. This book is aimed at prospective and advanced data scientists as well as programmers who want to acquire the mathematical basics of Data Science. Particularly well comprehensible through minimal mathematical terminology, practical examples and numerous illustrations. With exercises and solutions to deepen the learned for study and profession To be successful as a Data Scientist, you need to have a solid mathematical basic knowledge. This book provides an easy-to-understand overview of mathematics that you need in Data Science. Thomas Nield will guide you step by step through areas such as infinitesimal calculus, probability, linear algebra, statistics and hypothesis tests and shows you how these maths are used for example in linear and logistical regression and in neuronal networks. In addition, you will get insights into the current state of data science and learn how to use this knowledge for your career as a data scientist. Use them as a mathematical pfith and marimetrics and marimetrics.
content.title_en: Math-Basics for Data Scientists : linear algebra, statistics and probability calculation for data analysis

content.text: Basic knowledge of usability and user experience: Training and further education on the UXQB Certified Professional for Usability and User Experience (CPUX) - Foundation Level (CPUX-F) The basics of the UXQB Certified Professional for Usability and User Experience (CPUX) are the basis for a positive user experience. The knowledge of the project participants about the concepts, process and the necessary process results around "usability and user experience" forms the basis for a high human-centred quality of the project result. The authors provide a thorough introduction and a practical overview of the competence fields "usability and user experience" and their interaction. Numerous examples of design principles, design rules, design patterns, requirements (user needs) and usage requirements (user requirements) explain the methodological basics. In detail, the following topics are addressed: Activities of human-centred design Basic concepts and concepts Plan human-centered design 2. Understanding the usage context and defining new usage requirements.
content.title_en: Basic knowledge Usability and User Experience : Training and further education for the UXQB Certified Professional for Usability and User Experience (CPUX) - Foundation Level (CPUX-F)

content.text: Climate debates in the age of enlightenment: theories and discourses of the 18th century. Already in the 18th century philosophers, physicians and anthropologists asked about the influence of climate on humans: Were differences in physique and skin color effects of climate? Certain the environment human character? And were different forms of state the result of different climates? The focus was also on the question of the autonomy of reason against nature. Bernd Kleinhans gives an overview of the climate debates of this time and traces the basic positions of the discourse. Here, it becomes clear: The question of the relationship of man to its environment is one of the fundamental problems of modernism.
content.title_en: Climate debates in the Age of Enlightenment : Theories and Discourses of the 18th Century

content.text: Printing in the German language (1450-1800) : Technique and craft in printing houses and in the production of books. The volume reveals what we really know about the technique and the craft in printing works when producing books from the period 1450 to about 1800. The subject of the study begins with the beginnings of printing with individual types by Johannes Gutenberg in the middle of the 15th century and closes with the end of the use of the wooden hand press in the early 19th century. The drawing round is 120 sources or source directories, 101 illustrations as well as practical experiments and the prints themselves. Since different customs for printing have been developed in Europe, the focus is on the German language area, but the relevant sources of the other language areas are also taken into account. Christoph Reske now presents a comprehensive print historical presentation for the period mentioned. As he proposes different forms of practice for printing in Europe, he has also specified the solutions used in the German language area and often specifies the relevant sources of the other language areas.
content.title_en: Printing in the German language (1450-1800) : Technique and craft in printing houses and in the production of books

content.text: Climate education - guidelines for all schools and subjects. Climate change and the dramatic extinction of species are the societal challenges of the 21st century. Schools need to prepare children and young people for the global issues of the climate crisis and teach them skills. Gudrun Spahn-Skrotzki makes it clear why climate education is a central topic for schools and in schools. From this, it shows possibilities to implement climate education in school practice: How can climate protection be lived in schools (Whole Institution Approach)? How can climate education be integrated into different classes and in all subjects? Which types of teaching and learning are suitable? Which extracurricular learning places are eligible? With this book, teachers of all levels and subjects receive a practical all-round view of climate change, education for sustainable development (BNE) and practical advice on how to integrate climate education in school everyday life and their teaching practice.
content.title_en: Climate education - Guidelines for all schools and subjects

content.text: Right-wing extremism: detect – reveal – respond. Right-wing extremism is now expressed in many forms. Accordingly, the work against right-wing tendencies demands multi-perspective, grounded and multi-professionally coordinated approaches. This volume offers a cross-section of perspectives from research, university, political education, early-school and social-pedagogical prevention and civic initiatives. It provides a cross-cutting overview of current approaches to explanation and action and is aimed at both experts and citizens.
content.title_en: Right-wing extremism: detect – reveal – answer

content.text: Interdisciplinary climate and environmental projects: Education for Sustainable Development in School. Teachers want to teach their students the skills and knowledge to actively participate in the design of a sustainable society. The handbook contains numerous projects for education for sustainable development (SDO), which can be implemented by teachers: directly in their classrooms – from school gardens to fruit orchards to beekeeping or viticulture. These tried-and-tested projects enable students to experience the effects and adaptation processes of climate change and to transfer them to their own school and living environment. They are supported in understanding the effects of climate change and developing personal options for action. Let us help students:inside:inside: to actively shape a sustainable future.
content.title_en: Cross-curricular climate and environmental projects : Education for Sustainable Development in School

content.text: Crisis is a fear: how teaching can encourage in difficult times. Current crises such as the Corona pandemic, the Ukraine war, rising inflation with all its effects on personal and social circumstances lead to increased anxiety, fears and even depression among children and adolescents. School and teaching are also affected by the emotional effects on pupils: inside. This book works out the essential psychological factors for the stressful life in crises and shows in particular how teachers can:Inside these: In what way do crises trigger fear, worry and depression? What psychological factors play a role? How can these be met in teaching? A possible solution is a common and meaningful orientation towards action through cooperative and democratic action in teaching. By e.g. learning and practicing cooperation, maintaining contradictions and a fair approach to each other, the students experience: within sense, commonness and effectiveness respectively design possibilities, which helps them to counter crises more resiliently or reduce anxiety, anxiety and depression. The pandemic and the Ukraine war are only well-repeated.
content.title_en: Crisis scares: how lessons can encourage in difficult times

content.text: German lessons digital: from the didactic framework to practical implementation: with e-book inside. Bob Blume is addressing German teachers, teachers and secondary school teachers who want to digitally expand their teaching. He builds a bridge between theory and practice: he creates a basic understanding of relevant concepts, arranges didactic-methodical approaches to the use of digital media and presents practical ideas and impulses for a German lesson, in which the digital is a natural part. The readers receive suggestions for tools and are able to implement, adapt and further spin the outlined practice. With his attempt to systematize the digital German lessons regarding the educational plans and strategies of the Kultusministerkonferenz, the book is a gain not only for digital newcomers. From the content - digitality and German lessons - terms, the 4k model of learning, »multi-value« digital media - German lessons digital: framework – competence orientation and digitality, function of digital media in German lessons, possible steps, 10 theses for digitally extended German language teaching, practical language teaching, practical language teaching and digitally extended German courses
content.title_en: German lessons digital : from the didactic framework to practical implementation : with e-book inside

content.text: Handbook on Learning with Digital Media. Digital media open up opportunities for the within-differentiated teaching and a new learning culture, but also risks when used uncritically. How can they promote personalized and cooperative learning and learning-effective teaching with heterogeneous groups? This handbook offers concrete impulses for school and teaching development on the current state of the art and scientific research. In particular, the authors address the characteristics of a competence-oriented teaching and examine how the use of digital media specifically offers itself for this pedagogical concept. Other contributions deal with learning platforms, learning analytics and teaching concepts that provide a hybrid, i.e. mixed use of digital and analog learning settings. The handbook closes with an overview of digital media in teaching, provides didactic recommendations and brings ideas for practice.
content.title_en: Handbook Learning with Digital Media

content.text: The Anti-Mobbing Book : Preventing, recognizing, acting violence at school. Teachers, parents and the pupils themselves can effectively act against bullying. Mustafa Jannan shows in his practical »Anti-Mobbing Book« with a parent book how this can be done. The classic about bullying is now published in the fourth, completely revised edition. From the content: - School violence, bullying, cyber-mobbing - violence prevention and intervention, measures at school level, class level, personal level and against cyber-mobbing - methods, exercises, intervention concepts - working materials
content.title_en: The Anti-Mobbing Book : Violence at School - Prevent, Recognize, Act

content.text: The essence of computer science: what users should know.This extended second edition is aimed at regular users of IT, i.e. professionals, students, and teachers. The book describes the relevant universe of computer science and information technology, from basic principles to social and socio-political significance.New and expanded are topics such as virtual worlds, metaverses, digital twins, and aspects of administration and digitalization. Numerous examples as well as illustrations and graphics are used to present the relevant IT environment of the modern non-specialist. content.text: The art of field work: the beginning of engineering cartography in Central Europe. This volume offers a first comprehensive overall representation of the "genial but also disparate and disparate discovery, development and imagery of Central, Southern and Eastern Europe. As with an eyepiece, it is possible to observe the emergence of a unique and still largely untapped drawing body of enormous scope, in which technical and aesthetic spatial experience keeps its balance. Attention is focused on remarkable personalities, spectacular career paths and outstanding mastery of engineering art, which are experienced and comprehensible from the respective historical contexts.
content.title_en: The Art of Fieldwork : Beginnings of Engineering Cartography in Central Europe

content.text: Give, take, share: Gift economy in the horizon of digitalization. »Open source, file-sharing, crowdfunding, peer production« – the world of digital communication is full of economic practices that are closer to giving and giving than to buying a market. In the horizon of digitalization, an economic science is necessary to reflect possible developments of a globally networked cooperation society, in addition to the paradigm of the respective closed exchange between any person, it also applies the paradigm of the endlessly unfinished gift between connected persons. With contributions by Frank Adloff, Leonhard Dobusch, Michael Hutter, Thomas Macho, Sabine Mainberger, André T. Nemat, Günther Ortmann, Birger P. Priddat, Jasmin Schreyer, Frank Schulz-Nieswandt, Fritz B. Simon, Felix Stalder and Tatjana Thelen.
content.title_en: Giving, taking, sharing : Gift economy in the horizon of digitalization

content.text: Climate crisis and social theory: on the challenges and opportunities of global environmental policy. Both the ever-increasing climate change and the associated global species extinction have come to mind in most politicians. Nevertheless, too little is still being done to effectively address the global ecological crisis. Helmut Willke analyses the failure of global environmental policy from a socio-theoretical perspective. His analysis shows to what extent this failure is due to the fact that the social subsystems "science", "economy" and "politics" each follow their own mutually exclusive sublogics. Only if these partial logics and the related systematic hideout of certain aspects of the ecological catastrophe can global environmental policy succeed.
content.title_en: Climate crisis and social theory: on the challenges and opportunities of global environmental policy

content.text: Practice and uncertainty: the everyday nature of social-ecological crises. Climate change, the extinction of species, global migration movements and increasing political violence are evidence of the multiple crises of the Anthropocene. This crisis-like nature makes uncertainty more than ever a fundamental condition of coexistence and fundamentally questions both existing human-nature relations and our notion of future as linear progress. This book brings together contributions that, from a practical theoretical perspective, deal with the field of tension between competitive futures and uncertainty against the background of the ubiquitous nature of social-ecological crises.
content.title_en: Practice and uncertainty : the everyday nature of social-ecological crises

content.text: Architecture in Germany in the 20th century: History, society, functions. With this book Winfried Nerdinger, renowned and highly distinguished architectural historian, presents a comprehensive overview of architecture in Germany in the 20th century. It is 100 years of influence, from Peter Behrens to Günter Behnisch, from the battle memorial and fagus work to Stalinallee and the new Bundestag – 100 years, in which Germany's urban planning image is shaped. For the first time, architecture and urban planning are presented here in connection with social, economic and technical developments. The focus of this history of architecture in Germany is on the period 1890 to 1990 – from the Empire to the reunification. The upheavals of 1918/19, 1933 and 1945 each change the external conditions, from 1945 onwards, the construction system splits into the occupation zones and after the founding of the Federal Republic and the GDR 1949, the developments in East and West are determined by competition and convergence. With the political unification, the various architectural strands reconnect, the year 1990 therefore constitutes an important gap.
content.title_en: Architecture in Germany in the 20th century : History, Society, Functions

This book, which has been translated into five languages, is of invaluable interest to all those professionals who are concerned with severe mental illness, psychological growth and new developments in psychoanalytic theory and technology.

content.text: The future is a challenge: the relationship between sustainability, democracy and conflict. The key text: Climate change poses enormous challenges to societies around the world. In the term sustainability, a consensus on how to deal with this threat seems to condense. But the supposed unanimity conceals less and less conflicts about what exactly is to be understood by climate protection and sustainable living: how and by whom can this be achieved? And how do these aspirations towards democratic systems behave? 41 contributors approach the narratives, ideas and first manifestations of the future and the implied relationship between democracy, sustainability and conflict.
content.title_en: Future battles : The relationship between sustainability, democracy and conflict

The contributors of the volume accept these questions by understanding ruins as abandoned architectures or urban landscapes in decay: from the 'painting' remains of ancient buildings to abandoned industrial or military areas and abandoned residential buildings to 'new' investment ruins.
content.title_en: Ruins and forgotten places : Materiality in decay - After-uses - Reinterpretations

content.text: Machine learning - Basics and applications : with examples in Python. In this textbook, the basics of machine learning (ML) are explained. The main topics are the mathematical basics, optimization methods and the ML algorithms. The chapters contain example exercises with Python code. In the front chapters, the mathematical basics are presented. The main part deals with the central concepts of machine learning. The book is rounded off by chapters on special applications in different disciplines. The target group are mainly students who want to learn in this field. Engineers can also benefit from this textbook, as a major focus is on the application of ML. Especially the use in in interdisciplinary disciplines such as control technology, image processing and chemistry are shown.

content.text: Contactivity : with new authority, out of prevention. Social fears, prevention behaviour, withdrawal and self-insulation are increasing among children and adolescents. Parents of avoidrs often come to therapy with a feeling of total helplessness. Talks with their child are impossible, motivation attempts fail. Obviously, the school is still running wild, is only on the net and avoids social activities. Less obvious is how much the child has decapitated itself from his own self. Uri Weinblatt's solution for prevention behavior is the restoration of the connection - to himself, to others and to the group. Contact is the most important component to break through prevention patterns and penetrate into affected children and adolescents. In this book, therapists, educators and parents receive numerous practical tips on how to conduct conversations with those affected and help them to participate in social life again, even beyond the computer. The author shows ways to motivate them and give them back a sense of belonging to family and friends.
content.title_en: Contactivity : with new authority out of prevention

content.text: The distanced centre: extreme right and democratic attitudes in Germany 2022/23. The pandemic consequences are not yet overcome, inflation is high, the climate crisis is becoming more and more virulent, as the war of attack on Ukraine and its consequences for security and energy supply are creating further challenges for the "middle". Insecurities and distribution conflicts offer the incipient gateway for antidemocratic positions and extreme right ideologies, as well as for the devaluation of the "others". Democracy, its basic principles, processes and institutions are increasingly viewed with distance from some. At the same time, a democracy-proof "center" goes to a clear distance to the enemies of democracy and wonders whether it can and will bridge this distance. The new FES "center" study 2022/23 illuminates the attitudes and backgrounds that threaten democracy and encourages debate.
content.title_en: The Distanced Center : Right-wing extremes and democratic attitudes in Germany 2022/23

content.text: Turning points: at the transition to the authoritarian century. The international political and economic order and its explanatory models have been shaken by a crisis cascade that has reached its climate with Putin's attack on Ukraine. Against this background, the renowned political scientist Ulrich Menzel identifies the turning points of a world in turmoil. Globalization is demagogified, the USA and China struggle for hegemony. We are experiencing a return of old borders, the anarchy of the state world, of the authoritarian (worldwide and in liberal societies), even of the war in Europe. Are we at the transition from the liberal American to the authoritarian Chinese century? How should Europe position itself, how should Germany position itself in this transition phase?
content.title_en: Turning points : at the transition to the authoritarian century

content.text: In this book, Craig Calhoun, Dilip Parameshwar Gaonkar and Charles Taylor trace the erosion of our democracy from different perspectives. They shed light on how the ruling elites are trying to secure their privileges and how individual freedom became the enemy of equality and solidarity. But they also show ways of possible democratic renewal: on the one hand, it is important to rediscover the idea of the common good and to join republican traditions, on the other hand, social movements such as Black Lives Matter or the Green New Deal could serve as a compass.
content.title_en: The decay of democracy

The possibility of man-made extinction of earthly life in front of the eyes is the subject of this volume of various forms of dealing with one's own temporality: from the pomp of the funeral processions in ancient Rome and the ars moriendi of the Middle Ages to Parisian revolutionary cemeteries, the memory of Hiroshima and the intransigentity of the Holocaust, from the hero death in war over film death and death practices in comparison with culture to the infinite end in computer games and the hope of immortality in cyberspace. This volume invites to an interdisciplinary tour d Horizon to a multi-faceted approach to death and presents research results from the literature and cultural sciences, from theology, philosophy and history, as well as from art, music and media science in a wide spectrum from antiquity to the present.
content.title_en: Types of Death : Dying in Culture and History

content.text: Fire protection in high-rise buildings: practical examples of new buildings and existing buildings. Since the Grenfell-Tower fire in London, the requirements for fire protection in high-rise buildings and the associated regulations are increasingly being addressed by the public in Germany. In order to ensure the protection objectives of fire protection, the construction of high-rise buildings and their operation and conversion require the creation of a specific fire protection concept. There are many and complex requirements for the construction and conversion of high-rise buildings, especially regarding the conditions of use and existing buildings. The practical-oriented foundation works support you in the planning and evaluation of high-rise buildings as well as the conversion of objects in the inventory. The clear representations of all construction supervision requirements provide you with a comprehensive overview of the fire protection planning of high-rise buildings. Based on practical recommendations and sample concepts you will receive direct assistance for the concrete implementation. The technical book summarizes the special features of fire protection requirements by means of typical high-rise buildings. The authors explain these aspects: • Complexity of high-rise buildings requirements and different conditions of use • Component and building material requirements with systems • Rescue path solutions • Consideration of technical protection of fire protection systems for high-rise buildings • High-rise buildings
content.title_en: Fire protection in high-rise buildings : practical examples for new construction and existing buildings

content.text: Digital transformation: transformation through projects. Digitalisation has now covered almost all areas of private life and working life. This book deals with digitalization as a transformation process of society. The focus is on aspects such as - availability of information, - organisation of innovations, - disruptive potential of platforms, - change of business models, - changed working environments and - discrimination by "Big Data". In the second part of the book, the focus is first on digitalization, and on the management of digital transformation. Subsequently, the focus is on projects as temporary forms of organisation. This is followed by a merging of the two thematic fields into part four of this book. Part five then offers case studies, based on which projects and their influence on the management of digital transformation are reflected.
content.title_en: Digital transformation: change through projects

content.text: Variances of cohesion: historical and transregional comparative perspectives. The concept of "social cohesion" is becoming increasingly a guiding principle for both liberal-democratic and authoritarian societies. The contributions of this volume question its use from a historical and global perspective. Using empirical case studies, they make the diversity of concepts and practices of social cohesion visible and thus reveal their contextual dependence and historical embedding. Thus, it becomes possible to explain the current economic cycle of the concept and to counter an unreflected universalization.
content.title_en: Variances of cohesion: historical and transregional comparative perspectives

content.text: The city's administrations and governments are increasingly obsessed with the "image" of their city and plunge into a commercial competition aimed at tourism, investors and real estate markets. The people living in the city become the target of architectural displacement measures. Mickaël Labbé shows how entire population parts are excluded as undesirable by an almost imperceptible architecture of contempt. Surveillance cameras, benches with inclined seating or separating armrests on which one cannot sleep, and other subtle measures in particular make life in the city more difficult for socially marginalized people such as homeless people. Against this tendency Labbé leads the need to reinvent a city that is aimed at all of us. Instead of excluding mechanisms, we need spaces in which we can reconnect our connections more closely. Because a city that is no longer geared towards its communal use, which is only made up of homogeneous ghettos, where we can no longer confront each other with a confrontational and in all diversity, is a re-enactivity that describes a re-enactivities of the re-enactivism, and is a re-enactivities.
content.title_en: Take place : against an architecture of contempt

content.text: Ljubljana: History, architecture and art of the capital of Slovenia. The Slovenian capital Ljubljana is one of the most interesting cities in Europe, historically and architecturally, characterized by a changeable history from antiquity to the present and the geographical location between Italy, Austria and the Balkans.The Roman settlement of Emona became the garrison town of Laibach in the Habsburg Empire under Italian and Austrian influence. Ljubljana was the most north-western provincial capital in the Kingdom of Yugoslavia and later in the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia before it became the capital of Slovenia in 1991. All the epochs of its history were found and found expression in the architecture and art of the city. Italian Baroque, Viennese youth style and socialist modernity are part of a unique ensemble. Slovenia's most famous architect of modernism Joze PleÄnik has shaped the cityscape, hardly less did his student Edvard Ravnikar put his mark on it. The young generation of architects stands on the one hand in their tradition and at the same time takes on the bonds of international modernity.
content.title_en: Ljubljana : History, architecture and art of the capital of Slovenia

content.text: Electrical engineering for mechanical engineering and mechatronics. Electrical engineering is understandable and practical The classic for all those who are looking for a clear introduction to the field of electrical engineering. This textbook aims to remove the fear of electrical engineering from readers. Where possible, a comparison of the electrotechnical phenomena with familiar ones, e.g. from mechanics, is made. In addition to the basics, there are also introductions to applications such as electrical machines and drives, measurement technology, control and control technology, power electronics as well as information and energy transmission. The calculation of electrical circuits is explained with the program LTspice and shown on examples. Particular attention is paid to visuality. Numerous calculation examples with solutions support the reader and help to deepen the learned. On the websites http://www.emaschtronik.de and plus.hanser-fachbuch.de additional information as well as tasks with solutions can be found.

content.text: Radio frequency technology: Basics of mobile communication technology. Radio applications and high frequency circuits are now available in all areas of information technology, from communication technology to radar positioning to medical technology. This textbook provides a clear and understandable insight into the technical and physical basics of high frequency technology with a focus on applications in mobile communication technology. The book is based on mathematical research and supplemented by numerous examples and exercises, and provides an overview of the concepts, concepts and methods of high frequency technology. The main development tools are presented and current questions and problems are addressed and explained from the practical point of view. The book is aimed at students of electrical, information and communication technology as well as engineers and engineers in practice. The 4th edition has been completely revised and now appears in color. The book has been extended to include some topics such as SIW-conducting structures, slit antennas, aperture emitters and the feedback behaviour of radar applications.
content.title_en: Radio frequency technology : Basics of mobile communication technology

content.text: The collection of tasks for measurement and sensor technology. Numerous tasks for measurement and sensor technology in a book This textbook for measurement and sensor technology is ideal for repeating, refreshing, learning and practicing for tests. An introduction to the respective topic follows tasks with increasing difficulty. Due to the strong practical relevance and the explanations, the reader also becomes clear: learning by doing. The book contains the solutions to all tasks, with more complicated questions these are complemented by hints and explanations. The majority of the tasks deal with the measurement basics, process measurement technology, manufacturing measurement technology as well as the field of testing. All relevant non-electric measurement variables (temperature, pressure, level, flow, concentration, force, path, angle, torque, strain) are the subject of the discussion.
content.title_en: Task collection Measurement and Sensor Technology

content.text: The basics of the drive technology are also used as an introductory textbook. The subject area of electrical machines and drives is often perceived as complicated and difficult to understand. In addition, learning a foreign language is like learning it: new terms, symbols, long equations, lots of mathematics, page-wise text – and how to understand all this? This textbook quickly provides a solution. It is aimed at pupils: in initial and further education as well as students:in a bachelor's training course, which enters the field of electrical machines and drives. Equipped with the basic tool of electrical engineering and mathematics, the basic principles of electrical machines and drives are to be taught in a concise and clear manner. The expertise is reduced to the essentials. What is not necessary for understanding the basics is either omitted or marked as deepening expertise. Numerous illustrations support the presentation and convey the most important facts in a more vivid and varied form. After the content of the exercise, the basics of mechanics are further examined with the one and three-phase transformers, synchronous and synchronous machines. The basics of the drive technology are also discussed in terms of the basics of the basics and the basics of the drive technology.
content.title_en: Basics of drive technology : an introductory textbook

content.text: Electronic circuit technology : Basics of analog electronics with tasks and solutions. The author provides knowledge of electronic components and shows their application in analog circuit technology. Detailed explanations based on examples, exercises and simulation examples with the network analyzer PSPICE facilitate access to this complex topic area. Starting from the description of the individual components, the most important circuit principles of analog electronics and the methods of circuit analysis and synthesis are presented. This textbook offers students of electrical engineering a good training and optimal exam preparation in the field of electronic circuit technology. It shows problems and solutions, it provides mathematical tools and thus enables optimal examination preparation. For the new edition, the introduced textbook has been extensively updated. On plus.hanser-fachbuch.de you will find the detailed solutions of the exercise tasks and further additional information.
content.title_en: Electronic circuitry technology : Basics of analog electronics with tasks and solutions

content.text: Programming with MATLAB : programming language, graphical user interfaces, applications. Learning the basic knowledge of programming with MATLAB This textbook provides the most important basics for programming with MATLAB for students of engineering. It starts with the introduction of the elementary principles of data processing and, based on this, provides the basic knowledge of programming with the help of the programming language integrated in MATLAB. Numerous applications deepen the knowledge and introduce it in numerical processes in MATLAB. Where the basic module of MATLAB is no longer sufficient for special problems, the MATLAB toolboxes are referred to for more intensive use, but the installation of which is not necessary for understanding this book. The 7th edition has been completely revised, all examples and applications are aligned to the latest MATLB version R2022b. Extensive additional material can be found online on the book website: www.Stein-Ulrich.de/Matlab and under plus.hanser-fachbuch.de.
content.title_en: Programming with MATLAB : programming language, graphical user interfaces, applications

content.text: Basics of digital technology: elementary components, functions and controls. Through a gradual deepening, extensive examples as well as over 50 tasks with solutions, this book is the ideal companion for the lecture, for independent learning or for preparation for the examination. Other topics are: - Switching network as basic function units of digital circuits via truth tables or switching functions - Flipflop types - sequential circuits - clocked switching circuits - Circuit development with their physical boundary conditions - Hardware questions The third edition has experienced a significant extension: The error detection and correction procedures with parity and CRC testing, an extension of the minimization with KV diagrams for switching networks with switchable inverter at the output (XOR connection), an extension of the application examples to the arithmetical unit (ALU) is available for the support of the simulation with the help of the software.
content.title_en: Basics of digital technology : elementary components, functions and controls
