content.text: Business Analysis and Requirements Engineering : Sustainable improvement of products and processes. We all want lean, effective business processes and optimal IT support. We find a solution for every problem – if we could only agree exactly what our problem is. Understanding problems and formulating requirements that we would like to have differently is the subject of this book. Many different terms are used for this (business analysis, system analysis, requirements engineering, ...) and many job descriptions for the participants. This book shows an integrated approach to handling requirements. It provides you with methods, notations and many pragmatic tips (best practices) that can effectively address requirements between clients and contractors – from discovery techniques to documentation techniques, testing techniques to administrative techniques. The 3rd edition is updated according to the revised teaching plans of the IREB (Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering). content.text: Maintenance and service management : intelligent systems. Maintenance and service management combined and holistically viewed This book introduces the basics of maintenance and service management, introduces the structure in the form of technical systems and deals with their functional processes. The discussions on automation and Industry 4.0 have revolutionarily changed many aspects of maintenance and service, and maintenance and service management networked in an unsuspected way. Aspects of optimal availability of technical systems in use, production and service are systematically considered here. In addition to technical and organizational aspects, requirements of operational and IT security, controlling, law and environmental impact are also integrated. The comprehensively systematically presented knowledge on a new management area is aimed at the learners in the training, the students at universities and universities in the field of business administration and industrial engineering and all practitioners: in the engineering sector. For the re-edition, numerous developments of AI (artificial intelligence) have been incorporated and the developments in standards and laws taken into account. On plus.hanser-fachbuch.de you will find further worksheets for processing this title.
content.title_en: Maintenance and service management : intelligent systems

content.text: Decker Maschinenelemente - Formulan. Decker Maschinenelemente - Formulansammlung is the proven classic for quick help in your studies and engineering everyday life. All relevant formulas for machine elements at a glance. This formulan collection contains all relevant calculations and equations for machine elements that students need in engineering fields at universities, technical universities, vocational academies and technical schools as well as engineers working in practice. The formulan collection is particularly suitable as a working aid in solving test or exercise tasks. The book is a supplement to the long-proven textbook "Decker Maschinenelemente" and "Decker Maschinenelemente - Tasks" and completes the Decker-Gesamtwerk. The important area of strength calculations is completely reworked and explained in more detail in this edition.
content.title_en: Decker Machine Elements - Formulas

content.text: Mechanics and strength teaching. The proven textbook on the most important theoretical foundations Well-founded knowledge of mechanics and strength teaching are indispensable for technicians:inside. This textbook offers students the opportunity to develop theoretical foundations and to check them on the basis of practical tasks. The book takes the form of didactical aspects, which have been gained and tested in many years of teaching practice. No comprehensive mathematical knowledge is required. Multiple support of the readers:inside: - Learning objectives for each section - Questions about learning goal control - Specific practical advice - 266 practical examples of teaching from many areas of technology - recommended work steps as a solution to the tasks - all necessary tables, diagrams and formulas The most important tables, diagrams and formulas are additionally available via plus.hanser-fachbuch.de as a supplement.
content.title_en: Mechanics and strength theory

content.text: Mechanics and Strength Teaching - Tasks. The book of exercises on Karlheinz Kabus' proven standard work This collection of tasks on the standard work "Mechanics and Strength Teaching" has been proven for decades and takes up the examples from the textbook in almost 1200 tasks. It offers excellent support and complements. Numerous illustrations facilitate the understanding of the tasks and an increasing degree of difficulty enables targeted learning at your own pace. The solution section contains the results of the calculations and possible drawing solutions, for tasks where it seemed useful to achieve clear values, the intermediate results and the table values used were also given. In a third part, the book of exercises contains explanations and hints on the solution path of each task, so that also for beginners:in and in practice technicians:inside there is a possibility for rapid induction into the calculation procedures.
content.title_en: Mechanics and Strength Theory - Tasks

content.text: 3D printing for executives: Technology, processes, economy and environmental compatibility of additive manufacturing. 3D printing technologies have taken a firm place wherever customer-specific products are manufactured in small quantities or where short time-to-market processes are required. The potential of additive manufacturing processes is enormous, but they can only best play out their advantages if all requirements are right. This guide is addressed to decision-makers who want to introduce 3D printing in the company and are looking for answers to the following questions: - Technical classification: What is 3D printing? What can be done with it? - Technical procedure: How does 3D printing work? - Ecological evaluation: What are the positive and negative impacts of 3D printing on the environment? - Strategic evaluation: How can the usage of 3D printing be combined with this and how can these be calculated? What are the new business models that follow? - Ecological evaluation: What are the positive and negative effects of 3D printing on the environment?
content.title_en: 3D printing for executives : technology, processes, cost-effectiveness and environmental compatibility of additive manufacturing

content.text: Tasks for applied technical thermodynamics. With numerous practical exercises, this task book is ideally suited for the application and verification of basic knowledge of applied technical thermodynamics as well as for exam preparation. It is aimed at students of engineering sciences, especially energy and environmental technology as well as mechanical engineering. The tasks deal with realistic problems of technical thermodynamics, which often have a direct relation to the energy transition or climate change. The task collection is the ideal supplement to the textbook "Applied technical thermodynamics" (ISBN 978-3-446-47034-7), but can also be used independently of it. The book covers the following topics: - Thermodynamic basics - Homogenous substances, phase transitions and ideal gas mixtures - Moist air - Comparison and circuit processes - Chemical reactions - Heat transfer Within the respective topic the tasks are sorted by difficulty. The chapters start with questions on important concepts (level 1). Then follow tasks, in which the required solution path is unambiguous (level 2). Each chapter is rounded off by complex problem positions, where several paths are often assigned to the target (level 3).
content.title_en: Tasks for applied technical thermodynamics

content.text: Automation 4.0 : Object-oriented development of modular machines for digital production. When is a processing machine fit for Industry 4.0? The fourth industrial revolution poses a number of additional requirements for the design and automation of processing machines. Thus, products and their manufacturing processes are not only more demanding but also more individual. In this textbook, the challenges are analysed and solutions are illustrated by meaningful examples. A focus of the book is the projection of these requirements on well-known design principles. This results in functions that are illustrated by various examples such as the production of photobooks or inmould labelling. This creates a roadmap for the development of a load booklet for the construction of a versatile processing machine. The modular, function and object-oriented design of individual machines and systems is presented as a solution approach for efficiency improvements in the entire life cycle as well as practical examples. A major process for the construction of changeable machines is modularization according to functional units. These diverse requirements are illustrated and worked out step by step. The book is aimed at the development of automation and mecha-technology and engineering.
content.title_en: Automation 4.0 : Object-oriented development of modular machines for digital production

content.text: Optics in engineering and natural sciences: basics and applications. In recent decades optics has become an important driver in the technological development of many fields such as physics, chemistry, medicine, biology and IT technology. Optics are referred to as a "enabling technology", because it has only made innovations possible in many areas. Therefore, knowledge in this field in the academic education in science and technology as well as for many research and development projects is of great importance. This optical book is a compact reference work which explains both the physical basics and the most important fields of application of optics. It was written by experienced university teachers and successful practitioners and is addressed to students and practitioners:in engineering and natural sciences as well as to business engineers who want to acquire knowledge and competences in optical technologies. The book covers two parts, one the physical foundations with many calculated examples and the other the fields of application of optical imaging, imaging technology, equipment processing of sensors and instruments;
content.title_en: Optics in Engineering and Natural Sciences : Basics and Applications

content.text: Journey into the underworld : Insights into life beyond light. The articles of the special edition on the topic "Cave" deal with stalagmites and their importance as a climate archive for the rainfalls of the past, and continue with animals whose habitat are caves as well as with organisms that defy heat and high pressure in the earth.
content.title_en: Journey into the Underworld : Insights into Life beyond Light

content.text: @ichbinsophiescholl : Presentation and discussion of history in social media. What if Sophie Scholl had been active on Instagram? Social media are becoming increasingly popular to mediate history. One of the most recent examples is the Instagram project @ichbinsophiescholl of public service broadcasters SWR and BR, which allowed users to participate in the last 10 months of the life of a remediated Sophie Scholl, played by Luna Wedler. The approach of telling history "at first hand, emotionally and in real time" led to great media attention and reach, but in the course of the project increasingly also to critical discussions with historical representations in social media format. Using one of the most successful products of public history in recent years, the presentation of history in social media is analysed in detail. The volume combines interdisciplinary perspectives from the history, media science, psychology, didactics and historical-political education on the project, its reception and analysis.
content.title_en: @ichbinsophiescholl : Presentation and discussion of history in social media

content.text: Operation Donnerschlag: Imperial anti-insurgency from the air and the "morale bombing" of German cities by the British Royal Air Force 1945. A look at their colonial prehistory gives new answers to the enigmatic motif of British land bombardment of German cities 1945.In the last months of World War II, the British Air Force's tops designed a long mysterious operation plan with the support of Winston Churchill. In the course of Operation Thunderclap, British bomber formations flew concentrated attacks against still undisturbed inner cities and residential areas. Cities such as Dresden, Pforzheim or Würzburg fell into rubble and ashes, tens of thousands were killed. Why were the area bombardments dramatically increased to the last?Lukas Willmy gives new, archive-secured answers to this long unresolved riddle of the Second World War. Rejected to the experiences of the British Royal Air Force as flying "Imperial gendarmerie" in the colonies until recently.
content.title_en: Operation Donnerschlag : Imperial combat of insurrection from the air and the "morale bombing" of German cities by the British Royal Air Force 1945

content.text: First-class freedom between emperor and princely rule: the early modern autonomy city and the Einbeck case. Klappentext: Cities between emperor and prince: A third type of city in the early modern era, considered by the example of Einbeck and the Saxon city federation.For a long time, the early modern era was considered to be a "city-historical view" - a time with only a few new foundations. However, certain types of cities were only formed in this time. For the Holy Roman Empire, a distinction is made between imperial cities and rural cities: the former were directly subject to the emperor, the latter were subject to a state ruler. In the "district" of the first-class northern Germany, a third type of city existed, which the contemporaries called Civitas mixta and for which historical research coined the term "autonomy city" without defining it more precisely. These autonomous cities were not a remnant of the Middle Ages, but established themselves only in the 16th century.
content.title_en: First-class freedom between emperor and princely rule: the early modern city of autonomy and the fall of Einbeck

content.text: Photovoltaic systems in tax law: tax bases for the use of solar energy. Through state support (EEG) and constant improvements in the efficiency of solar systems, this form of energy production is becoming increasingly attractive. In addition to the promotion, the tax benefits are to be used optimally. The work provides a practical guide. The 4th edition takes into account the numerous changes that have occurred in the promotion of a photovoltaic system by the EEG. This also results in a considerable impact on the taxation of a photovoltaic system. In addition, the case law has clarified outstanding issues. The content Current developments in the field of photovoltaics application of the Renewable Energies Act (EEG) Income tax specialities VAT specificities Impact on commercial tax Real estate tax Numerous examples and calculations The author Dipl.-Finwirt (FH) Jürgen K. Wittlinger is property manager in a financial office for corporations in Baden-Württemberg. . . Current developments in the field of photovoltaics -- application of the Renewable Energies Act (EEG) -- income tax specificities -- VAT specificities -- effects on commercial tax -- land acquisition tax -- numerous examples and calculations.
content.title_en: Photovoltaic systems in tax law : tax bases for the use of solar energy

content.text: Analysis of a changeable explains concisely : With logical foundations and cross-links. Basics -- Topological basic concepts -- Convergence -- Steadiness -- Differential calculus -- Integral calculus -- Taylor approximations and power series. This textbook of analysis of a changeable sets a special focus on the most important concepts and contexts. After an introduction of the necessary logical and topological basics, it deals with the terms and phrases of analysis. The author presents in a concise manner, but with many motivations, explanations and hints the canonical contents of an analysis-1 lecture. Central evidence is commented in detail. The textbook is equally suitable as a basis and for accompanying a lecture as well as for self-study. The content Introduction, meaning of electronics Basic knowledge Analog and digital technology Semiconductor technology Electronics in energy engineering Development and manufacturing Micro and nanoelectronics Automotive electronics and embedded system Questions about self-control Computing in electronics Application examples The target groups Business engineers, business economists, business executives, business executives Journalists, editors, PR specialists Computer scientists, natural scientists, engineers of all disciplines Professionals in technical sectors The author Dr. Marco Winzker is professor at the Bonn-Rhein-Sieg University of Applied Sciences and Technology and teaches embedded electronics there. Vice-President Studies, Teaching and Further Education.
content.title_en: Electronics for decision makers : Basic knowledge for business and technology : with tasks and solutions as well as examples of applications

content.text: Corona and the city : Local participation culture in crisis?. The Corona crisis puts urban coexistence to a hard test. Not only social exchange, culture and transport, but also communal democracy is strongly influenced. Who can still speak in the crisis? And how does it change the interaction between administration, politics and civil society? The contributors investigate the impact of the crisis on the municipal participation culture using case studies. They ask with an interdisciplinary view about the municipal crisis management and successful governance structures in the context of multiple crises. Their approach of critical urbanism sees itself as an invitation to reflection, debate and alternative practice.
content.title_en: Corona and the city : Municipal culture of participation in crisis?

content.text: Protests, companies and trade unions: Contributions to East German transformation since 1990. Looking at the unification and transformation process of the 1990s, the question arises whether there were alternatives to the chosen paths. In the search for answers, the path leads to a level that was of identity-building importance for the former GDR labour society: the level of companies, the employees there and their experiences from the time when the economic and social structure in the new countries was radically transformed. How did these processes proceed? What role did trade unions and industrial interest representatives play in this process? How successful were the many protest actions to preserve businesses and jobs? And what significance does this engagement take in the experiences of the affected parties and in the media public? These are the core issues that are addressed in this volume.
content.title_en: Protests, Companies and Trade Unions : Contributions to East German Transformation since 1990

The commentary not only covers the regulations of the GwG, but also includes the GwGMeldV real estate, the 89c and 261 StGB as well as the 154 AO. The commentary takes account of all the case law and all relevant literature. The author's team consists of experienced practitioners: in their field of justice, attorneys and teaching, who are experts. The commentary offers solutions for all the problems in the field of money laundering law. It addresses companies, law firms, notaries, authorities and courts, but also teaching and research, for which it contains important impulses. All legislative innovations including the sanction enforcement law II of 27.12.2022 are incorporated into the field of law enforcement.

content.text: Massive material: monolithic, homogeneous and circular constructions. Driven by climate change, architects are looking for the contemporary expression for permanent massive and homogeneous wall structures made of clay, wood, brick, concrete and recycled materials. Structured according to the specific materials, the book enables direct comparisons, and makes massive building typologies and shape languages visible. Numerous drawings created specifically for the book document the projects. In two essays and interviews with Pepe Marquez and Arno Richter, the strategies and backgrounds for monolithic architectures and massive constructions are discussed. Massive building materials and their contribution to climate protection and sustainability. Analytical representations of varietal and demountable constructions. content.text: Sociological theories of digitalization: an introduction. The sociological theories of digitalization describe and explain the forms of use and the effects of Internet and application systems on individuals, organizations and functional systems of society. Building on empirical analyses of social media, big data and search algorithms in particular, technology sociology, system theory, network theory, rational choice theory, actor network theory, interaction theory as well as theories of social inequality, social movements and media public opinion are applied to the subject area of digitalization. The introductory book presents the most important sociological theories of digitalization and the subject-related analyses of metricization, cultural singularities, power of algorithms and de-networking and shows by means of examples how these theoretical models can be used to analyse digital practices. The functioning and effects of digital media such as Google, Facebook and Twitter and the digital transformation through artificial intelligence (AI) are presented. The content of sociological theories of digitalization Subject-related analyses of digital society Impacts of digitalization on individuals, organisations and society Future of digital sociology The author Prof. Dr. Bernhard Miebach is researching on the organization as a digital researcher.

content.text: Individual action and common good : an interdisciplinary theory of action in the context of freedom, responsibility and artificial intelligence. In the case of conflicts in the private or professional context and in social or military conflicts, there are always certain questions: Why does someone do something like this? What motives and thoughts play a role in this? Could another action have improved or prevented the situation? Gerhard Tulodziecki designs an interdisciplinary theory of action to get closer to answering such questions. In this context, it is also about freedom of decision and responsibility in action - also in view of the increasing use of artificial intelligence. Thus, there are various suggestions for the assessment of action in everyday life, occupation and politics as well as for the reflection of one's own action.
content.title_en: Individual action and common good : an interdisciplinary theory of action in the context of freedom, responsibility and artificial intelligence

content.text: Culture:Wandel : Impulse for a forward-looking cultural practice. What does a just cultural policy in the 21st century look like? How can the cultural infrastructure be kept sustainable and expanded in line with generations and gender? Or otherwise: How can state and non-state actors develop a cultural governance along changing needs? These questions are discussed by the contributors of the volume and design ways of acting and transforming a new cultural understanding. With concrete approaches and practical examples they show new guiding principles of cultural practice or cultural policy, invite to imitate and encourage the development of own concepts.
content.title_en: Culture:Change : Impetus for a forward-looking cultural practice

content.text: Health economics: an introduction. Health policy is on the lips in view of the many challenges facing the German health system. It seems necessary to conduct this discourse from an economic-economic perspective. The main aim of this textbook is to create the essential foundations for this. It first conveys the basic principles of health economics and then provides a deeper, comprehensive insight into the institutions, the control processes and the practical regulations of the health system. The new edition, in which Wilfried Boroch from the FOM University of Applied Sciences Essen is involved for the first time, aims at a greater balance between the theory and practice of health economics. The book is therefore aimed not only at students of the economic and health sciences, but also at medical, nursing and other health-related professions who want to deal with health economics.
content.title_en: Health economics : an introduction

content.text: Investment management: Business basics and implementation with SAP S/4HANA®. Investment decisions determine companies in the long term and therefore decide on the long-term survival on the markets. Misinvestments can be existential for companies. Accordingly, investment decisions are considered management decisions and must therefore be analytically planned, implemented and monitored. This book is addressed to all readers who are concerned with investment management in practice and in universities. It offers direct implementation and decision support with Excel as well as with SAP S/4 HANA. Companies and universities that do not use SAP for investment controlling can also apply the Excel-oriented basic chapter in a fruitful way.
content.title_en: Investment management : business principles and implementation with SAP S/4HANA®

content.text: Microscopic-Botanical Internship : 800 individual presentations. The proven internship book takes you to the hand and shows you: - the correct handling of the light microscope - basics of electron microscopy - important cutting and dyeing techniques - interpretation of tissue sections - drawing of cells and tissues of all topics usually covered in the course. Each single step from preparation to drawing is clearly described in the text and illustrated graphically. The brilliant photos illustrate important building principles and illustrate plant structures as you have not yet seen them. All information on a topic is arranged on two pages - so you do not have to re-learn during the microscopy process. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Microscopic-Botanical Internship : 800 individual presentations

content.text: Integration of foreign workers and their families in comparison with cities: problems, measures, control instruments. The employment of foreign workers is a structural constant of the German economy. In early 1974 the foreign resident population in the Federal Republic and West Berlin grew to 4.1 million. Overall, according to all labour market observations, this limit will no longer be exceeded in the long term. The foreign employees are considered integrated in the economy, while the social integration of foreign citizens is less frequently registered. The present report tries to address these problems from a sociological and practical point of view. Above all, a targeted exchange of experience between industrial cities is to be facilitated. To this end, the foreign-specific measures of 22 cities are systematically evaluated.
content.title_en: Integration of foreign workers and their families in urban comparison: problems, measures, governance instruments

content.text: The many possibilities of modern IT systems bring with them urgent ethical problems. In addition to the obvious question of a morally portable use of information technologies, the aspects of design, manufacture and operation of them are also decisive. The contributors deal with the potential for conflict between technology and ethics by analyzing and discussing case studies close to life. Thus, they provide a practical guide to common reflection on moral commandments and ethical umgamg with IT systems and their possibilities. The volume is thus ideally suited to conveying and learning ethical reflection and action skills in computer science as well as in dealing with IT technologies at all.
content.title_en: Regrettably - case studies on ethical problems of computer science

The book is aimed at doctoral students and advanced students of microbiology, biotechnology and (veterinary) medicine with low to basic knowledge in bioinformatics. content.text: EnEfG : Energy Efficiency Act : Practical Commentary. Energy efficiency is the most important source to meet the growing energy demand in the future, to ensure secure energy supply, to conserve resources and to protect the climate. For the first time, the new Energy Efficiency Act (EnEfG) now formulates concrete goals, measures and instruments for this energy policy-highly prioritized project.A concise introduction and comment on the EnEfG offers you the authors team of Lars Jope and Dr. Julian Asmus Nebel - all important compactly compiled in energy law:- Orientation, main content and fundamental questions of the EnEfG and its development lines- Solution-oriented interpretations for the previously known practical problem-instructive legal materials and relevant guidelines of the Federal Ministry of Economics and Energy (BMWK) and the Federal Office for Energy Efficiency (BfEE), which are directly incorporated into the explanations.

content.text: Development and implementation of funding plans: With work materials for download. Creating and continuing funding plans is now part of the core task of almost every teacher. A good funding plan is the result of a strategy that is individually tailored and cooperatively implemented for the students. This also applies to the increasing number of inclusive school classes, where the funding plan can represent a valuable support for the pedagogical work. What steps should teachers take in the process of funding planning? What quality criteria do you recognise a good funding plan? How can students be competently accompanied with the help of funding plans? The book contains practical answers to these and other questions on funding planning in schools: diagnostics, discussion and cooperation as well as implementation of funding plans into corresponding measures.
content.title_en: Development and implementation of funding plans : With working materials for download

content.text: Urban structural orientation values for soil sealing in residential areas: this paper is a partial result of the research project "Stadtstructural orientation values for soil sealing - natural rainwater management in urban areas". In this work, specific orientation values of soil sealing depending on the type of settlement structure are determined and put to discussion. In terms of comparability of orientation values in East and West Germany, investigations on soil sealing have gained a new significance. The evaluation methods developed so far in West German cities only allow quantitative statements on the degree of sealing. The average sealing values of the structural types derived from the work are suitable for over-consistency sealing estimates. In addition, on the basis of an extended structural classification, sealing degrees and sealing suggestions were derived from 35 Dresdner examples. In addition, conclusions were drawn here on relationships between qualitative assessment methods (ground function number) and urban building criteria depending on the structural type.
content.title_en: Urban structural orientation values for soil sealing in residential areas : this article is a partial result of the research project "City structural orientation values for soil sealing - natural rainwater management in urban areas"

content.text: The ethical evaluation of big data. Under the perspective of big data, basic ethical questions are focused, which arise from the development and application of advanced information technologies. All advanced computer tools are common, that they have to deal with large amounts of data, to analyze them, to process them and to react as independently as possible to the analyses regulating and controlling. The focus is firstly on the connection of a special discourse on advanced information technologies within the technology ethics, secondly on the location of specific problems of action in processes concerning the entire society and the ethical status of the individual, and thirdly on the establishment of metaphysical prerequisites of current attitudes in dealing with analysis devices, which are obtained from large, especially flowing data quantities. The study tries to show the continuity of certain basic ethical conflicts in the information technology discourse. Key topics are among others the dialectics of empowerment and demining in dealing with modern information technologies and, thus, the loss of resistance experiences associated with a loss of reality. The study is considered as a guide and as an input to the assessment of the KIT academic field.
content.title_en: The ethical evaluation of Big Data

content.text: The invention of the wheel : when world history came into play : from the Eurasian steppe to the early high cultures. The invention of the wheel has often been represented. According to the linguistic and cultural scientist H. Haarmann (among others: "History of the Scriptures", ID-A 23/21) it must be written at least in parts. Haarmann places the groundbreaking invention rather in Alteuropa and Eurasia and thus contradicts the usual thesis that all important inventions (use of fire, metal processing, writing) had been created in Mesopotamia. To this end, he uses recent research and finds as well as the hypothesis of a prehistoric "donauvilization" postulated by him earlier. The book then follows in further chapters the traces of the wheel from the steppe into the early high cultures, vividly describes the era of the chariots (2000 BC to about 750 BC) and their symbolism (from the Greek world to the central European "quadriga"). In the concluding chapters, the language is extended to the broad and the language-repeasant, and the language-repeas.
content.title_en: The invention of the wheel : when world history came into being : from the Eurasian steppe to the early high cultures

content.text: The psychology of grief has produced numerous insights in recent years and exposed supposed knowledge as an opinion that has little to do with reality, but much to do with ideas and cultural traditions. The book deals with major topics such as general grief or psychological therapy of complicated or persistent grief. The author takes into account the possible long-term consequences of a loss and shows differentially diagnostically which disorders can be comorbid with grief. The new edition takes into account the current results of research, especially regarding the diagnosis of "constant grief disorder" and the treatment of chronic grief.
content.title_en: Grief and grief management : psychological concepts in change

content.text: The psychology of conspiracy theories: strangely lied to by dark forces. What is a conspiracy theory? Who believes in it and why? What consequences do these result for society, politics, health and social media? The volume considers the phenomenon of conspiracy belief from various psychological perspectives and puts it into an interdisciplinary discourse. Readers thus get an overview of the current research on conspiracy narratives, including the so important contradictions, disagreements and debates.The first part of the volume examines the cognitive foundations of conspiracy theories and the influence of cognitive distortions. The question is examined how a conspiratorial theoretic world picture can arise in the course of life. In addition, the role of conspiracy beliefs in political discourse, social media and in relation to personal health behaviour is discussed. Also, the possibilities and limits of interventions against conspiracy beliefs are addressed. In the second part of the volume these psychological perspectives are brought into productive friction with other subjects.
content.title_en: The psychology of conspiracy theories : strangely lied to by dark forces ...

content.text: Innovation & IT - But how?. Long-term successful companies are characterized by the ability to constantly renew and professional innovation management. Although the topic of innovation in times of digitalization affects every area of a company across functions, IT, digital processes and managers have a decisive role as an innovation driver. All three influence the entrepreneurial success in different ways. However, the question of how to do so is not a general and simple answer.Complex and established infrastructures, lack of willingness to internal and external collaboration, insufficient customer centering or an orientation of action to short-term KPIs are only some central innovation barriers. To meet these challenges, it is necessary to have a broad vision and flexibility.The contributions selected for this volume consider solutions and application examples for the development of digital business models and innovation-oriented corporate strategies.
content.title_en: Innovation & IT - But how?

Introduction to statistics: for basic sociological education and the neighbouring subjects. - The textbook contains all important topics of basic statistical education: from introduction to basic concepts to multivariate analysis. - It provides a clear picture of the current state of social science statistics education. - It contains short portrait tables of the most important multivariate procedures, data sets and data archives. Textbooks with a clear concept: - numerous illustrations and tables illustrate the learning material - definitions and examples facilitate learning - suitable for exam preparation - with further commented references and registers
content.title_en: Sociology Statistics

content.text: The manual deals with the various relationships and interactions between AI and the arts. Procedures and manifestations of artificial intelligence have arrived in the arts as both sujet and as instruments of creative artistic production. Both areas are in line with the manual and, in addition to a history of the representation of AI and AI-related topics in literature, film, theatre, video game, visual art and music, it provides an overview of AI-based processes of artistic production and creativity in different art forms for the first time. This scientifically hardly reflected entry of AI into the arts will significantly change traditional concepts and contexts that determine the discourse of the arts in the near future. Accordingly, the handbook asks among other things about the conditions of authorship, the definition of creativity and originality and new models of interaction between the arts and their recipients.
content.title_en: Manual Artificial Intelligence and the Arts

content.text: Artificial intelligence and labour law. Applications of artificial intelligence (AI) are already being addressed today, although often unnoticed, in private and working life. AI research has taken a rapid development; many experts assume that the fundamental changes are still imminent. What seemed almost unthinkable yesterday may be an integral part of everyday life tomorrow. AI is also becoming increasingly prevalent in companies. AI applications offer employees many opportunities if they only think of relief from physically demanding activities or the protection of workers' health. At the same time, however, the development is associated with significant risks and challenges. With these, the present study deals with and develops solutions based on work law and shows the current legal developments. The two key questions in the book are: What does AI mean for the protection of workers? What challenges do individual labour law and co-determination face?
content.title_en: Artificial intelligence and labour law

content.text: Ruins and forgotten places : Materiality in decay - After-uses - Reinterpretations. Ruins and Lost Places are equally symbols of transience and signs of acts of destruction. Their consideration triggers divergent emotions. What will become of these places? Who determines about it? And how and for what reasons will ruins become the subject of media or artistic conflicts? The contributors of the volume accept these questions by understanding ruins as abandoned architectures or urban landscapes in decay: from the ‹painting› remains of ancient buildings to abandoned industrial or military areas and abandoned residential buildings to ‹new› investment ruins
content.title_en: Ruins and forgotten places : Materiality in decay - After-uses - Reinterpretations

content.text: Corona and the city : Local participation culture in crisis?. The Corona crisis puts urban coexistence to a hard test. Not only social exchange, culture and transport, but also communal democracy is heavily influenced. Who can still speak in the crisis? And how does it change the interaction between administration, politics and civil society? The contributors investigate the impact of the crisis on the municipal participation culture using case studies. They ask with an interdisciplinary view about the municipal crisis management and successful governance structures in the context of multiple crises. Their approach of critical urbanism sees itself as an invitation to reflection, debate and alternative practice.
content.title_en: Corona and the city : Municipal culture of participation in crisis?

content.text: Free will – free choice : A critique of neuroscientific approaches to free will and determinism. Are we really free in our decisions? What influences our will? And is our freedom actually in danger? Uwe Mylatz presents neuroscientific experiments on free will, among others by Benjamin Libet, John-Dylan Haynes, Patrick Haggard and Manfred Eimer respectively Christoph Herrmann. He doubts the great influence on our human image, which is attributed to these experiments by Gerhard Roth, Wolf Singer, Wolfgang Prinz and others. Does their results really undermine the freedom and responsibility of man? Analysis and discussion of their arguments lead him to the questions to what extent determinism and freedom of will are tolerated and whether there are other phenomena that could endanger our freedom. Based on concepts by Sven Walter, Michael Pauen, Daniel Dennett, Peter Bieri and Thomas Goschke, he finally develops a new concept of freedom.
content.title_en: Free Will – Free Choice : A Criticism of Neuroscientific Approaches to Freedom of Will and Determinism

content.text: Lean Empowerment : The consistent continuation of Lean Leadership . The logical chaining and implementation is the success factor for successful companies. In this context, it is important to eliminate the ninth and tenth type of waste and to live Lean with its cultural values as philosophy. Lean Empowerment stands for a responsible implementation of process improvements by the people who are at the center of the work. Here, work in teams and a respectful and valuing approach is central. content.text: Theology and Natural Science : To overcome prejudices and to achieve a holistic understanding of reality. Finally, there is a comprehensive presentation of the relationship between theology and natural science. Matthias Haudel discusses the historical developments, the current situation and the future challenges. Furthermore, he unfolds the understanding of the theological creation against the background of the current natural sciences – both in terms of the cosmos and in terms of human beings (e.g. evolution, neuroscience). Understandably, Haudel sheds light on the theological, philosophical and scientific foundations and their connections as well as the ethical challenges. Furthermore, he presents important dialogue concepts and one-sided reductionist concepts. Thus, overcoming mutual prejudices and the importance of dialogue for the understanding of reality emerges. This concerns the relevance of faith for the whole of reality as well as the holistic integration and meaning of natural science insights. Accordingly, answers to the existential search for meaningful wholeness of all life-worldly connections can be found.
content.title_en: Theology and Science : To overcome prejudice and to achieve a holistic understanding of reality

content.text: Gaia & God : an ecofeminist theology of the healing of the earth. The well-known feminist theologian Rosemary Radford Ruether assumes that myths of the origin of the universe, the earth and humanity profoundly shape our thinking and action. Most myths of creation with which we grew up in the Western Christian patriarchal culture no longer serve as a basis for our world picture as much as the "creation stories" of modern natural sciences. They convey a pattern of relationship of dominance: the monotheistic, male God or man/man/man reigns over nature, about Gaia, the earth. This view has brought us to the edge of the biocide. The ecofeminist theology presented by Rosemary R. Ruether supports the demand for ecological justice and seeks for the basis for ecological spirituality.
content.title_en: Gaia & God : an ecofeminist theology of the healing of the earth

content.text: Digital Humanism is becoming one of the key issues of digitalisation in the economy. On the one hand, ChatGPT is sparking public discussion about AI and is calling for appropriate responses from companies and politics to be able to deal with AI and digital technologies in a responsible manner. On the other hand, the economic fallback of Europe towards Asia and the US in the digital economy makes us aware that in Europe we cannot go either on the US-capitalist, company-centric path or the state-centered, Asian path of digitalization. But what can a European path look like? Digital humanism can provide answers, but is not yet tangible in its design. There are hardly any standards or tried and tested approaches for implementation and few examples of operational practice that can serve as models. Here, this practical book sets out how ideas of digital humanism can be successfully implemented without losing their competitive ability, on the contrary, to stand out from the competition. Examples and approaches of large companies from different sectors as well as new technological or process-based solutions are presented to their leaders, their outstanding views and their views on the topic of how to engage in the digital humanism, their elected and their views.

content.text: AI engineering in production: Whitepaper from Fraunhofer Institutes IOSB and IAIS. To use methods of artificial intelligence (AI) in industrial production IT systems sustainably and operationally, the methodology of AI engineering is required. AI engineering addresses the systematic development and operation of AI-based solutions as part of systems that fulfil complex tasks. The aim is to be able to use the innovation and optimization potential of AI processes in industrial production. The study covers the dimensions for AI engineering applications, outlines the qualitative requirements in development and operation from the user and decision-maker's point of view. Various applications are classified in four levels of autonomy: from AI-based assistance functions to autonomous and adaptive systems. In addition, suitable solution methods are identified. One chapter deals with technical and organizational debts in the use of AI methods. In this context, the AI engineering approach is described in the context of existing models and adaptive systems.

content.text: Philosophy of the wind : Attempt at the unpredictable. The wind is present almost always and everywhere in some form. It surrounds and embraces us from all sides. Nevertheless, we rarely perceive it consciously. Rainer Guldin takes a philosophical look at the phenomenon Wind and shows how closely our physical and emotional attachment to the surrounding weather world is actually. It becomes clear: The wind enables an expansion and reorientation of our perception of the material to the incomprehensible and invisible, to the silence and hardly audible, but always present. Thus an innovative theory of knowledge arises, which appeals not only to philosophers, but also to lay people and researchers of various disciplines.
content.title_en: Philosophy of the Wind : Attempt at the Unpredictable

content.text: The invention of the Federal Republic of Germany: how our basic law came into being. In the summer of 1948, there are big decisions to be made: The Western Allies commission 65 men and women to draft a constitution. Months of passionate discussions begin in which there is a dispute, a trick and a dream. How will it be, the new country? Shortly after a new currency is introduced in the three western zones in the early summer of 1948, the Soviet Union shuts down West Berlin: The city is blocked. The USA decides to supply two million people from the air and send "Rosine bombers", one of which is about to crash. While in Berlin everything is on the brink, the Parliamentary Council meets in Bonn: 61 men and four women who are supposed to write a constitution, including Social Democrats Carlo Schmid, Christian Democrats Konrad Adenauer and Liberal Theodor Heusss. And this is all about everything: How can there be a constitution – without the East Zone? Where should the capital be? And what lessons should be drawn from National Socialism? Sabine Böhne-Di Leo takes us on a daily journey of the world's best interests and the day of the world's best.
content.title_en: The invention of the Federal Republic: how our Basic Law came into being

content.text: Metabolism policy: work, nature and the future of the planet. If we want to understand the ecological crisis, we must understand the world of work. It is the work through which societies carry out their metabolism with nature, according to Karl Marx. Labor policy is therefore always environmental policy - or "metabolic policy". Nature itself plays an active role in this. The further its exploitation is promoted, the more drastic it has a bearing on the world of work. The sociologist shows how productive this perspective is, in a multitude of historical examples: Without mosquitoes, neither rise nor decline of the plantation economy can be understood. The enforcement of the trade unions was made possible, among other things, by the new levers of power that gave the workers the material characteristics of coal to the workers. And the assembly line was also introduced not least because animal cadavers were accumulated in early battle factories due to strikes. If global warming is to be slowed down, this presupposes a transformation of the world of work for Schaupp: we must overcome the logic of expansive exploitation and take the autonomy of nature seriously.
content.title_en: Metabolism policy : work, nature and the future of the planet

The archdiocese of Munich and Freising had a report on sexual abuse in its diocese prepared by the Munich law firm Westphal Spilker Wastl in 2022. Dr. Matthias Losert has examined the 1,893 pages of the report in detail. With precise reasons and great legal expertise, he proves that the Munich abuse report has considerable deficits and that the presumption of innocence has often not been observed. Thus, the author makes an important contribution to a objectification of the debate on sexual abuse in the Catholic Church

content.text: Future assistance systems: analyses of the German Red Cross to maintain everyday systems for crisis management. Crisis and catastrophes are constantly changing – both in perception and in coping with them. Therefore, existing assistance systems should be continuously analysed. Matthias Max and Matthias Schulze show how the German Red Cross has been helping to shape the future aid systems with its competence center »Research and Innovation Transfer« for more than ten years.
content.title_en: Future assistance systems: analyses of the German Red Cross to maintain everyday systems for crisis management

content.text: The tech war : China against the USA - and where remains Europe?. Between the world powers China and the USA a struggle for technological dominance is raging.. It is about artificial intelligence, superchips and computers, new drugs and treatments, self-driving cars and flights to the moon and Mars. But it is also about killer drones or fighting robots. China expert Wolfgang Hirn shows that in many tech areas China has caught up enormously in the past years and is in some cases even leading, and he asks: Can Europe keep up with this duel and possibly regain its technological sovereignty? Conclusion: The beaten third party must finally invest massively in people and capital - otherwise only the viewer role remains
content.title_en: The Tech War : China against the USA - and where is Europe?

content.text: Energy cities. With the detachment of the cities and regions of fossil-nuclear energy sources, the energy-ecological urban conversion is becoming increasingly important. A growing number of actors are committed to the conversion of energy supply to renewable energies as well as to resource-efficient ecological cycles in their living environment. The energy-ecological urban conversion improves the living and environmental conditions in the districts directly, opens up new opportunities of value creation and creates jobs. Cities are converted into energy cities that follow the guiding principles of sustainability, the minimization of energy-ecological footprints and the reduction of land use. The book designs future images of urban conversion for the discourse of the actors. Urban planning, engineering and economic fields of action of the energy-ecological urban conversion including its methodological solutions are described interdisciplinary. This presentation also includes the clarification based on a variety of interesting project examples.
content.title_en: Energy cities

content.text: Information flows, elections and democracy: Festschrift für Rüdiger Schmitt-Beck. This volume is dedicated to the relationship between information, elections and democracy. Looking at Germany, but also other countries, the authors focus on:inside, above all, the citizens, their attitudes, interests and election decisions. content.text: Myth Saxony: Privatisation, communication and state in the 1990s. Saxony did not worsen the transition from the planned to the market economy in the 1990s, but also did not manage better than the other East German states. Saxony's economic rise to the self-appointed class primacy in East Germany was primarily due to Kurt Biedenkopf's image politics and has long been affected. The image of a state government that supposedly had everything under control did not fit in with the political field of forces in which the free state moved towards the federal government and the Treuhandanstalt. Dierk Hoffmann examines the communication and privatization strategies of the state government in Dresden as well as the negotiation process in the privatization of Saxon companies. And he shows how Biedenkopf tried to adapt his neoliberal guiding principles to the transformation process.
content.title_en: Myth Saxony : Privatisation, communication and state in the 1990s

content.text: Europe: the lexicon. What is the difference between the European Council and the Council of Europe? What are the causes of the numerous crises that Europe has mastered – or is still facing? In its 4th, revised and updated edition, the book explains how our new Europe works, what undreamt-of freedoms and opportunities it offers – and why it sometimes doesn't work. The author is clearly analysing the entire spectrum of current topics – from the turbulences around the euro, refugee policy, Brexit and Fridays for Future to the "Green Deal" and the Russian war of aggression against Ukraine. Europe is not an elite project. This tried-and-tested, easy-to-read pocket lexicon invites both beginners and European experts alike to participate, criticize and discuss. Europe is admittedly imperfect, but it is the most amazing thing that we have put on our continent in the last centuries.
content.title_en: Europe : the lexicon

This book examines common topics of higher mathematics almost exclusively on the basis of numerous creative examples. Who is this book aimed at? In addition to technical studies, students of the field of mathematics benefit in a special way because of the exemplary preparation of demanding topics. The author Prof. Dr. Wilhelm Merz has been teaching at the University of Erlangen for over 20 years, mainly in the field of engineering mathematics.
content.title_en: Higher Mathematics in Examples : Analysis and Some Linear Algebra

content.text: Digital competences in political science. What are digital competences for political scientists? And how can teachers contribute to their development? The volume provides impulses for the teaching of digital competences in courses. Based on the distinction between four areas of competence, concrete examples from the teaching illustrate how to constructively address the double challenge of digital transformation: on the one hand, through new digital teaching, learning and work forms and on the other hand, through the contentual examination of the political and social dimensions of digital change.
content.title_en: Digital competences in political science

content.text: Diversity and democracy: societal diversity and the future of linguistic and political education. The contributions gathered in "Diversity and democracy" focus on the future of linguistic and political education in the light of social diversity from an interdisciplinary perspective. It addresses the role of language in political and political education and thus the link between educational practices, political discourses and language processes. In view of rapidly changing framework conditions - for example in terms of dynamics of social, cultural and linguistic diversification, digitization processes as well as prevention and coping with social crises - they provide democracy-pedagogical ideas and development impulses.
content.title_en: Diversity and democracy: societal diversity and the future of linguistic and political education

content.text: Machine learning - Basics and applications : with examples in Python. In this textbook, the basics of machine learning (ML) are explained. The main topics are the mathematical basics, optimization methods and the ML algorithms. The chapters contain example exercises with Python code. In the front chapters, the mathematical basics are presented. The main part deals with the central concepts of machine learning. The book is rounded off by chapters on special applications in different disciplines. The target group are mainly students who want to work in this field. Engineers can also benefit from this textbook because a major focus is on the application of ML. Especially the use in interdisciplinary disciplines such as control technology, image processing and chemistry are shown. From the content linear algebra - probability and statistics - optimization - parametric methods - nonparametric methods - strengthening learning - custer analysis - applications The author Benny Botsch studied mechanical engineering at TU Berlin, has gained knowledge for one of his articles in the field of computer science and has gained a junior staff knowledge in the field of computer science.

content.text: The German Research Center (Kinfraschische Universität) is a philosophical exciter. Art has long been considered the last bastion of the human before artificial intelligence. Since AI-generated images have been auctioned for millions of US dollars and poets' prizes have been awarded to ChatGPT, the question arises: Do we have to be defeated on the terrain of creativity? Even if they do not go through as art, the works of artificial intelligence have an influence on culture, society and economy - the manipulation of purchasing decisions is only a danger.In the example of art Dorothea Winter explores the promises and corruptions of the use of artificial intelligence.Along with the questions What is AI? and What is art? she develops loadable criteria to identify and assess the possibilities of AI's influence. The essay thus provides a stable basis for entering the discourse and to take a position. "In this very readable contribution, Dorothea Winter proposes the great arc of the historical change of the art concept to concrete proposals, as well as the possibilities of today's AI to a democratisation of art."
content.title_en: AI, Art and Kitsch : a philosophical exciter

content.text: Human-robot interaction: an introduction. The role of robots in society is constantly growing and diversifying and involves a variety of questions concerning the relationship between robots and humans. This textbook on human-robot interaction provides a comprehensive overview of the interdisciplinary topics that are of central importance for modern research. Students and researchers from the fields of robotics, artificial intelligence, computer science, electrical engineering, psychology, sociology and design find a concise and understandable guide on the current state of the field: - function, design and performance evaluation of robots - communication modalities such as language, nonverbal communication and the processing of emotions - ethical questions about the use of robots today and in the context of our future society. Numerous examples and colored illustrations illustrate the various subject areas. Discussion questions and relevant literature at the end of the chapter contribute to deepening. From the content: - What is new human-robot interaction? - How a robot works - Design - Interaction in space - Nonverbal interaction - Verbal interaction - How humans perceive robots - Robotic methods - Robotic methods - Robotic methods - Machine applications - The human-robot interaction in the second generation of the human-robot interaction.
content.title_en: Human-robot interaction : an introduction

content.text: Agile democracy: how artificial intelligence enables better politics. Publisher's info: Artificial intelligence has a difficult state in the public. Often heard: either the big data cracks or the machines themselves take over power. As a result, democracy eroded.We have to put AI off our heads and learn to take advantage of its advantages, says Berlin digitalisation and politics expert Juri Schnöller. He tries to take a constructive-progressive perspective. The book offers a wide range of case studies from all over the world, which show how AI can be used with little resources to strengthen democracy. With concrete, practical recommendations, absolutely practical relevance. From municipal politics to the large world stage. The aim, according to the author, is an agile democracy that uses AI's potential, opportunities and tools to improve and improve its resilience. Here, for the first time, is very concrete how this can be implemented.
content.title_en: Agile Democracy: How Artificial Intelligence Allows Better Politics

content.text: Laura Ashley - Designs with color and wallpaper : ideas and techniques for individual living. A little more versatile and classic than the textile band (in this no.) is this guide to the well-known English Deisgn company, which is committed to renowned specialists for the individual furnishing volumes. There are a variety of suggestions for different living and sleeping rooms, kitchens and children's rooms, bathrooms, planks and stairwells. Some is quite simple and spontaneous to rework, others need extensive preliminary work and a lot of time for elaborate techniques such as Craquelé or Découpage, bordering, stamping or floor painting. Good explanatory text with many technical sketches and vivid color photographs. - If necessary in addition to "Color consulting living" (BA 8/94), "Color consulting for the apartment" (BA 10/93) or A. Sloan: "Handbook ..." (BA 1/91). (Rosemarie Scholand)
content.title_en: Laura Ashley - Designing with color and wallpaper : Ideas and techniques for individual living

content.text: Shadow of Mind : Ways to a New Physics of Consciousness. A fictitious dialogue with an intelligent robot illustrates in this book by Penrose why he does not trust machines to give human mental gifts - unless the machines are constructed after a completely new physics. Like 'computer thinking' 'shadow of mind' is a fascinating and much-discussed contribution to the subject of mind and consciousness.
content.title_en: Shadow of the Mind : Ways to a New Physics of Consciousness

content.text: Rainwater use of A - Z : a user manual for the planner, the craftsman and the builder. Informs about legal foundations, authorities, dimensioning, water quality, technical regulations, construction measures, examples etc. (LK/SB: Prawitt) A handout for (aspiring) builders for planning a rainwater use plant. A historical review follows concrete planning aids (legal foundations, authorities, possible uses, dimensioning, water quality, technical regulations); finally, the author presents concrete (undertaken by the company) examples with regard to construction measures, plant technology and components and describes exemplary actions of individual municipalities and countries. A helpful, from the point of view of the company certainly not ineligible manual. Similar titles: "Use rainwater" (BA 10/93), H. J. Pütz (BA 9/92), "Praxis councilor rainwater use" (BA 12/91); construction instructions contain the titles of W. Brew (BA 8/89) and K.-H. Also suitable as a bad (BA/B/B/H) 11.
content.title_en: Rainwater use from A - Z : a user manual for the planner, the craftsman and the builder

content.text: Political science methods : basic outline for studies and research. This textbook enters new territory in a double sense: First, there is no similarly comprehensive and current introductory book in the political science methods in Germany, and secondly, the material is presented in a new conception. In the first part, the methodological foundations are systematically discussed, then five chapters from the workshop of research follow: Scientists show here individual methods - survey research, document analysis, content analysis, expert interviews and aggregate data analysis - in the practical application based on their own works. The textbook is committed to the guiding principle of "critical-empirical policy research", it combines pragmatic quantitative and qualitative empirical methods in a vivid manner.
content.title_en: Political science methods : basic outline for studies and research

content.text: The Islamic Garden : Architecture, Nature, Landscape. Petruccioli, who has made a name for himself as an expert in the field of Islamic and Italian architecture, gathers in this book a good dozen essays by different authors. Among themed ("The Garden in Islamic Painting", "The Garden as an Oasis") such as regional aspects (Gardens in Palermo, Algiers or Samarkand) a multifaceted picture of the cultural history of the Islamic Garden emerges, which extends far beyond one-sided ideas, for example, from the fairy tales of a thousand and one night. Despite the sometimes sophisticated writing method, this opus, which is beautifully designed in terms of printing and visual appearance, is not only reserved for historians, but also highly recommended to readers interested in cultural history. Unfortunately, there is no local, personal and factual register. (3)
content.title_en: The Islamic Garden : Architecture, Nature, Landscape

content.text: Death: a book of the last things. Death does not touch us, Epicurus wrote, but it is equally certain that it does not let us go. To banish the horrors of the end, every time has staged, hidden, exaggerated, bagatellized death in its own way. Today, when a new thought about death and our dealings with dying people has begun, the present anthology reminds us of historical perspectives and gives us evidence as to how each one can incorporate death into life in his own way.
content.title_en: Death : a book of the last things

content.text: Resilience and resilience promotion through the life span. The topic of resilience and the promotion of protection factors has gained increasing importance in human and health sciences in recent years & in conjunction with the paradigm shift from deficit to resource orientation and from pathogenesis to salutogenesis & an increasing importance. Resilience and resilience promotion not only refers to certain age areas, but is a cross-cutting topic across the entire life span. In this book, the resilience concept is therefore specifically related to different stages of development: the importance of resilience and corresponding funding opportunities are presented for early and later childhood, adolescence, adult and high age. Students and practitioners receive numerous theoretical and practical indications on how resilience promotion can be designed in the different phases of life. New fields, such as family resilience and - new in the 3rd edition - resilience promotion of students, are also presented.
content.title_en: Resilience and resilience promotion over the lifespan

content.text: Living for the elderly and disabled: Guide to planning, building and financing. The practical guide informs about the need-oriented redesign of the house and apartment. (Gisela Jonas) A clear guide for owners, tenants and landlords who want to build, prepare and redesign their house or flat in a way that is suitable for living and needs-oriented or barrier-free. The range of topics ranges from the removal of structural and technical obstacles, the equipment with equipment adapted to demand to the equipment and tools in the sanitary sector. To each chapter a checklist as planning aid. Finally information on the promotion and financing of construction measures as well as on consulting services, contact addresses, products and manufacturers. Keyword list. For architects and construction engineers, large libraries should provide the standard work "Barrier-free construction for the disabled and elderly" (Koch, 3rd, completely revised edition 1994). (1) (Gisela Jonas)
content.title_en: Housing for the elderly and disabled : Guide to planning, building and financing

content.text: Reading in the age of artificial intelligence: about the change of a cultural technique. We are facing a cultural upheaval in cultural technology Reading that began with the invention of writing and led to digitalization via book printing: With the »language models« of the learning artificial intelligence, people suddenly encounter inhuman machine readers who can receive all texts and process them into new texts. They read texts as binaryly coded information streams and do not understand the written, but learn a probable word combination - from which unexpected things can happen. Florian Rötzer dares to read and answers the question whether AI is only revolutionizing the cultural technique of reading by the new influences.
content.title_en: Reading in the age of artificial intelligence: about the change of a cultural technique

content.text: Digital author:innenschaft : Practices and policies of literary self-presentation. In the digital age, authors:inside the literary public focus in a new way: if they want to be successful, they must also perform (self). The contributors:inside the works and manifestations ask about the functions and forms of auctorial performance in weblogs, social media and on other digital stages, which experienced a boom in the course of the Covid pandemic. In addition to the economic contexts, they are particularly interested in the political dimension of digital self-presentation and thus cover a new complexity of modern writers:
content.title_en: Digital Author:Internalness : Practices and policies of self-presentation

content.text: Landscape - Performance - Participation : rural spaces in cultural education and artistic practice. Landscapes and cultural education are interwoven in a multi-layered way. The contributors from art and science illuminate these relationships and open up interdisciplinary perspectives on how cultural education conceptualises, explores and potentially changes landscapes as social, aesthetic and physical-tactical spaces. The focus is on fundamental questions concerning the relationship between city and country, as well as art and nature, but also on a contemporary understanding of cultural education.
content.title_en: Landscape - Performance - Participation : Rural spaces in cultural education and artistic practice

content.text: Digitalisation of counterpower : union conflict and industrial struggle today. German trade unions are heavily affected by the effects of the digitalisation of the working world. Their organisational and assertive capacity is strained as well as their claim to the widest possible representation of wage-dependent employees and workers. Against this background, the contributors discuss the theoretical possibilities and practical experiences with the digitalisation of counterpower from a trade union-activist and social science perspective. These include forms of industrial struggle in the digital sector and new, transnational, resistant practices on the Internet or in the digital infrastructure of companies and corporations.
content.title_en: Digitalisation of counterpower : union conflict and industrial struggle today

content.text: CityParts: new practices of communal use of urban spaces. Practices of sharing are complex negotiation processes, but they are an opportunity to design cities alternatively: Can the schoolyard be used by the neighborhood in the evening? Does the house community have an interest in a common garden or event room? Open is what promotes such solidarity sharing and which architectural interventions facilitate the division of public space. Based on empirical studies in three German cities and a practice laboratory, the authors formulate proposals for conditions, potentials and limits of sharing - thus providing important ideas for politics, administration, science and housing companies.
content.title_en: TownShare : new practices of communal use of urban spaces

content.text: Code & prejudice : about artificial intelligence, racism and anti-Semitism. Our future life is to be revolutionized by artificial intelligence. But who benefits from the efficiency gained and for whom does artificial intelligence become a real danger? What consequences will there be for democracy and open, diverse society? And will AI also be of benefit to those who are now affected by discrimination, anti-human violence and social exclusion?These and other questions are addressed by the contributors of the fourth volume of the Edition Bildungsstätte Anne Frank. In the individual texts they deal, among others, with (racist) algorithms, anti-Semitic deep fakes or digital filters and beauty ideals, but also with the possibilities of a "good" AI in the fight against inequality and for democracy.
content.title_en: Code & Prejudice : about artificial intelligence, racism and anti-Semitism

Based on the basic mathematical lectures, canonical topics from the fields of data science and machine learning are taken through. Here, rigorous evidence and a systematic understanding of the underlying ideas are the main focus. The text is rounded off by 121 teaching-proven tasks. Treated topics include: neighbors, linear and logistic regression, clustering, best-suited subspaces, main component analysis, dimensionality reduction, collaborative filtering, perceptron, support vector machines and neural networks
content.title_en: Mathematical Introduction to Data Science

content.text: The volume presents in 26 articles researches on German and European princely courts and their international connections, comparative perspectives on different countries in the Holy Roman Empire, scholars and education in courtyards and cities as well as on the history of universities and schools. Chronologically, the range extends from the Middle Ages to the 20th century with a focus on the early modern era (1500-1800). The contributions offer many new, partly surprising, insights that enrich the research done so far in these fields with interesting aspects.

These are potentials for individual and common learning that can be developed directly during work, driven by simple routines and tricks.
content.title_en: Team Toppings : 21 learning hacks for agile work

content.text: Successful digital transformation in the small and medium-sized industrial sector: a guide guide for executives. Digital transformation as an individual business journey Digital transformation is in fact affecting all organisations. This does not pose the question of whether a company has to deal with digitalization, but in which areas digitalization is to be promoted as strongly. This book aims to show that there is no "one best way", but that digital transformation is an individual business journey. In this context, the journey is not only about identifying and introducing supposedly correct technologies, but that critical engagement with its own business model is just as important as intensive consideration of customer needs, ability to work agilely or also the competence to think and act in networks. These beliefs form the core of this book. In doing so, the authors focus on the topic of digital transformation from the perspective of the management of medium-sized companies in the form of a fictional history. The guiding principle is the journey of the managers of a medium-sized company into Silicon Valley. These are intended to serve as the basis for clearing up the myths and legends of U.S.-American companies and to show which aspects are relevant for the digital transformation for medium-sized companies.
content.title_en: Successful digital transformation in the industrial medium-sized enterprises: a guide for managers

content.text: Electrical energy storage systems: [Basics, examples, tasks]. "What do I have to do to integrate storage technology X into my system Y to make it work?" This book presents tools for the first time to find answers to this question in a structured way. The recipe for designing electrical storage systems consists of three steps: 1. Collecting requirements for the energy storage system – presented in this book as user stories. This makes it clear who wants to do what for. 2. Determine power distribution in the energy storage system – for this purpose, the power flows are modelled in a power flow diagram. They can be adapted for each technical realization. 3. Create system design and compare with the requirements. The tools shown in the book help to reduce the number of possibilities. Margin conditions such as price, efficiency, product strategy, market access are taken into account in the design of the electrical storage system. Very many application examples, exercise tasks and solutions provide excellent support to implement the method described in the book. From the content: - Use of energy storage systems - General description of energy storage systems - Introduction to power electronics - Mechanical storage - Electrical storage - Storage - Storage systems Electrochemical storage systems
content.title_en: Electrical energy storage systems : [Basics, examples, tasks]
