content.text: Death and taboo in the pandemic : Cultural economic lessons from the Covid-19 policy. Crises shake social thinking about life and death. In the Covid-19 pandemic, the individuality of the human being was protected by the taboo of collective death. The virus forced politics to take sides for the elderly in the balance between health and freedom protection. Ernst Mohr provides a cultural economic autopsy of the Covid-19 policy with lessons for the future. He focuses on the self-protective host organism human and develops a crisis rationality that justifies existential crises. Thus, a concissive view of an event that will not have been the last of its kind - and a plea for a future pandemic policy without taboos
content.title_en: Death and taboo in the pandemic : Cultural economic lessons from Covid-19 policy

content.text: Homo destructor : a human-environment history : from the origin of man to the destruction of the world. Given the size of today's environmental destruction, the question arises: Is man a homo destructor that destroys his environment always and everywhere? The opus magnum of the well-known geographer and apen researcher Werner Bätzing gives an answer to this in the form of a broad history of our relationship to nature, which goes back to the origin of homo sapiens. In order to prevent the imminent destruction of the man-influenced world, according to Bätzing's thesis, it is necessary that we take a step back and take more into account the experiences of the pre-modern society in dealing with nature and the environment. To survive, man intervened and changed it very early in the nature found. But he has always tried to shape these changes in such a way that his own basis of life remained for the next generations. Only with the modern natural sciences, with enlightenment, industrial revolution and market economy, does man take a thought and action by means that natural and environment is used in the short term, without its preservation and its effects, and ultimately destroys the environment.
content.title_en: Homo destructor : a human-environment history : from the origin of man to the destruction of the world

content.text: The struggle for the Internet: such as Wikipedia, Mastodon and Co., challenge the tech giants. More freedom and more democracy were the great promises of the Internet. But now power is concentrated on a few tech giants. The network itself offers a solution to preserve its original promise of freedom: the non-commercial digital counterworld. Among them are the online encyclopedia Wikipedia, the Twitter alternative mastodon, the browser Firefox or the Messenger Signal. It is up to us to how strong we make the digital challengers. In elaborately researched, as informative as well as entertainingly written portraits Stefan Mey presents the protagonists, goals, strategies and business models of the digital counterworld. There is much more of them than we usually think. They are the digital counterparts of Greenpeace, Attac or Amnesty International and form the digital civil society. To make the Internet better, fairer and freer, one does not need to study computer science, not to start a startup and also not to be a hacker. Is this the beginning of a small revolution?
content.title_en: The fight for the Internet: such as Wikipedia, Mastodon and Co. challenge the tech giants

content.text: The Turkish authorities, Günter Seufert and Christopher Kubaseck, describe how the Republic is being repolished authoritarianly, and in doing so, they have not been afraid of any conflict: confrontations within NATO and with the EU are mounting, Turkish military operations in more and more countries, minorities are being suppressed and oppositionists are being persecuted. "Old Turkey" is a past, but, as the book impressively shows, the "New Turkey" has not yet found a way out of its many crises. On 29 October 1923, Atatürk declared the Turkish Republic. The new state wrote itself modernised and secularized on the flags and oriented itself culturally and politically on the West. The military provided for the observance of this course, if necessary by putting it. Around the turn of the millennium, Turkey was calling for the Turkish Republic. But under Erdogan there can be no more talk of it. The book shows how Ataürk's repressed Turkey is being repressed by the opposition, and the opposition is soon to be repressed by the South.
content.title_en: Farewell to Ataturk : the crises and conflicts of the new Turkey

content.text: In the present analysis, the analysis of the relationship between inflation and income distribution shows that a profit-price spiral is not detectable in the economy as a whole. The functional income distribution has remained almost unchanged in 2022. The empirical analysis of the Phillips curve for Germany from 2015 to 2023 also shows that inflation expectations are key indicators for explaining inflation trends.
content.title_en: Macroeconomic analysis of wage-price spirals: risks of second-round effects in the current high inflation phase

content.text: Project management and digital humanities : to intelligently shape the cooperation. The framework conditions for projects in digital humanities can be challenging: On the one hand, the innovation expectations of participating institutions and sponsors are unremitting. On the other hand, the coordination of interdisciplinary, complex large-scale projects as well as the development of research infrastructure and services require a professionalization of project management. The contributors give insights into different practices and gather views from the specialist community. This is the first step in bringing the field of activity into the German-speaking specialist discourse - and show methodological approaches to a further development of science management through theoretical reflections.
content.title_en: Project management and digital humanities : to shape the cooperation wisely

content.text: Digital learning technologies: from mystification to reflected design of EdTech. Digital educational technologies (EdTech) arouse high expectations and are part of various promises in terms of individualization, relief or self-guided learning. But what does EdTech mean and what consequences do these results for education? Based on this question on the reflected design of school digitization, the contributors bring together research and practical approaches from Germany for the first time to critically question EdTech's typical promises. Instead of general euphoria or rejection, they plead for a differentiated picture - and thus provide inspiration for all those who are looking for concrete approaches to a conscious use of EdTech.
content.title_en: Digital learning technologies: from mystification to reflected design by EdTech

content.text: Transport and tourism: An introduction to case studies. Tourism and mobility are inextricably linked. First and foremost, one might think of the arrival and departure to the holiday destination. But also for activities on site, means of transport and transport infrastructures are of crucial importance. They can even, for example, be an essential part of the trip, e.g. on cruises or multi-day bicycle tours, or, as for example, imposing bridge structures or steam trains, are considered as an attraction. Numerous examples and 40 case studies based on own experiences illustrate the topics taken up and are intended to awaken the reader's spirit of discovery to pursue interesting ideas and developments in reality.
content.title_en: Transport and Tourism : An Introduction with Case Studies

content.text: Digital collections: Requirements for digitalised cultural heritage. How can digital access to collections of visual cultural heritage be made possible to the public? This question concerns many museums, archives and libraries, but there are no surveys to be carried out that could help the public. On behalf of the Foundation for Art, Culture and History (SKKG) in Winterthur, Sonja Gasser is dedicated to this vacancy and analyses in a survey the requirements for digital representation of collections. The results provide orientation and inspiration for museums and other cultural institutions – for example, in developing or expanding a digital offer and matching digital collections to the needs of the beneficiaries.
content.title_en: Digital Collections : Requirements for the Digitalised Heritage

content.text: The term "discipline" is not used in the context of the social discourse, but in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse. The term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse, the term "discipline" is used in the context of the social discourse.
content.title_en: Basic social concepts: a glossary of public speech

content.text: Find time for the untamed life. From morning to evening, our life is tacted: every single moment is captured, optimized or taken as an economic resource – and that destroys us. Jenny Odell, the author of the New York Times bestseller "Doing nothing", explores in your sharp new book what false ideas shape our modern capitalist time understanding and what a more human, freer life could look like far away from it. What to do if time seems to be too scarce? To answer this seemingly simple question, Odell plunges deeply into the history of humanity. She reconstructs how it could come to the division of the day into 24 equal, exchangeable time units. It leads us to the emergence of the "time is money" mentality at the flowing bands of the taylorist factory. And it troubles the marketing of the untamed time as easily consumed leisure experience in yoga and mindfulness retreats. In doing so, Odell untapped the capitalist and the loyalestial roots of our life is not connected to the untamed and untamed life.
content.title_en: Find time: beyond the cycled life

content.text: The crossing of the impossible: hope in times of climate catastrophe. The ecological and political catastrophes of our present explain the climate of fear in which we live. How can we not despair or untidyly resign ourselves in the face of this increasing tension? French philosopher Corine Pelluchon shows in her new book a small philosophy of hope that places particular emphasis on the amazing power of our vulnerability. It shows that the possibility of a collapse of our civilization offers the chance for a change that opens up a common horizon of hope. Hope arises without one having searched for it, when one sets aside all illusions and superiority fantasies and learns to look at our reality with a new look. In her philosophical essay Corine Pelluchon argues that the still lacking social will to change our way of life is not due to a lack of shared convictions but to a lack of hope. In this we must not confuse hope with optimism, which conceals the seriousness of the situation. Even with very gloomy prospects, the possibility of finding another future – to reciprobate hope in it, but to recognize the lack of truth.
content.title_en: Crossing the Impossible: Hope in the Times of the Climate Disaster

content.text: Dialectics of emancipation: sexuality and gender in modern education. The key questions of this book are, on the one hand, historical: How did a broad liberation option emerge from repressed sexuality and how a morally repulsive marginal theme of society came to the centre of modern education? Finally, what was - and is - the price of this centering? Educational concepts and their dynamics, which are not linear but often broken, are examined. On the other hand, the current discussion should be addressed: How could a broad political movement be turned into a philosophy that opted for the dissolution of the traditional order of the sexes, actually a new youth movement that has managed to become a mega-theme in public debates in a few years' time?
content.title_en: Dialectics of Emancipation: Sexuality and Gender in Modern Education

content.text: The new childhood education: opportunities, risks, misguided paths. Despite educational reforms over the last 20 years with the aim of improving educational level and equal opportunities in the day care center, the success of the new childhood education remains. Is it only lacking in kindergarten places and staff or is it the new conceptual orientation of content itself that is of little use or perhaps even harmful? Eight guiding concepts of the new childhood education - quality of kindergarten, academics, professional attitude, competence orientation, self-education, resource orientation, participation and diversity - are examined for opportunities, but also for shortcomings in the scientific justification or educational implementation.
content.title_en: The new childhood education : opportunities, risks, misguided paths

content.text: Electrical drive technology. This textbook provides a comprehensive overview of the structure and operation of electric drives. It shows how drives can be optimized in terms of productivity, costs, space and energy efficiency. Numerous images and exercises illustrate the learning material and serve to deepen knowledge. In order to facilitate entry into this complex field of expertise, the main focus is on the requirements for electric drives and their main differentiation features at the beginning of the book. The tasks of individual components such as motor, mechanical transmission elements or position measuring instruments are described, basic relationships are elaborated and important concepts are explained on the topic of product information. In the main part, common motors are explained in drives of production machines, such as direct current, step, synchronous and asynchronous motors. In the sub-area of servo drive technology, basic connections are presented. For the new edition, the textbook has been updated and extended to include energy efficiency topics. The practical and easy-to-understand structure enables readers to acquire knowledge in the field of electrical drive technology or to acquire it.
content.title_en: Electrical propulsion

content.text: Technical problems are solved with C/C : from analysis to documentation. Based on concrete examples from the technical-scientific and mathematical field, this textbook provides programming and documentation techniques with C/C++. Based on a well-understood and well-founded introduction to the work with C/C++, it is possible to step by step to professional software development. The problems are arranged according to increasing difficulty level - from simple applications such as the reaction of resistors to complex questions from the switching algebra. Pre-knowledge is not required. They solve problems such as the conversion of temperature systems or the programming of a own functional plotter. The examples are implemented with Microsoft Visual C++, which is available free of charge. On plus.hanser-fachbuch.de you will find the code examples presented in the book for download. For the new edition, the well-introduced textbook has been updated and supplemented with other examples. The well-intelligent introduction and the many technical examples make this textbook the ideal companion for students:inside and bachelor students.
content.title_en: Solve technical problems with C/C : from analysis to documentation

content.text: The new heating system: efficient, sustainable, resource-efficient - current standards and trends in heat production and hot water production. Which heating technology should be chosen if the heating system in the house needs to be renewed or should be? Which fuel is economically and future-proof at the same time, and which technology is considered the best, most economical and environmentally compatible if a new building or an energy-renovated old building is to be equipped with a heating system? These are the central questions that move home owners, building families, planners and craftsmen. This is discussed in detail in this book. Marion Schulz and Hubert Westkämper describe in detail and with great expertise the construction, planning corner values and areas of application of modern heating technologies and compare the costs, environmental impact and cost-effectiveness of the most important systems. They also provide hints on the decisive details of modern, energy-saving system technology including hot water preparation and ventilation technology.
content.title_en: The new heating system: efficient, sustainable, resource-efficient - current standards and trends in heat generation and water heating

content.text: Digitalization and artificial intelligence in production: Basics and applications. This textbook describes the basics and applications of digitalisation and artificial intelligence in mechanical systems outside of pure IT and data processing. The book deals first with the digital transformation in industry and society and provides basic knowledge on digitalization, Industry 4.0 and artificial intelligence. This knowledge forms the basis for an overview and enables a deeper understanding of the topic. The focus in the second part is on industrial production and related topics such as medical technology, robotics technology and quality management.In the new edition additional chapters on technical and organizational challenges as well as process models for the use of AI in production were added. In addition, each chapter ends with transfer questions. The book addresses students of engineering as well as teachers and learners in commercial education as all those who wish to enter digitalisation and AI with a focus on industrial production.
content.title_en: Digitalization and artificial intelligence in production : Basics and application

content.text: Next Generation Internet: the fusion of reality and virtuality in the metaverse. The development of the Internet, especially the WWW, is currently reaching its limits - both technically and socio-culturally and economically. As a solution, a new Internet is promised, which is to overcome the boundaries of the real and virtual world and merge reality and digitality - the metaverse. Technical, semantic and organizational details closely interlock in this. But what does this mean when you look at it more closely? What technical and technological challenges must be overcome in order to achieve such a fusion? Which economic possibilities open up and which ones may be banned? How can an open and usable metaverse be created? And how can it be avoided that even in this new metaverse few large providers prevail over their proprietary ideas? For these questions, this book should show answers
content.title_en: Next Generation Internet : the fusion of reality and virtuality in the metaverse

content.text: IT governance: The key success factor for digital transformation. Digital transformation significantly increases the influence of information technology on company success. This also increases the requirements for the IT management system in companies. Here is the simple wisdom: An unsuitable management system usually brings with it worse decisions. How you determine in a goal-oriented manner who should influence in the company as well as on IT-relevant decisions, Christopher Rentrop shows you with a lot of overview: - Basic goals and success factors of IT-governance - Design elements of IT-governance: structures and processes, decision-making rights, relational mechanisms, etc. - COBIT as framework of IT-governance - Specific decision-making domains, fields of action and responsibilities - Management, further development and measurement of success of IT-governance A concise orientation aid that guides you step by step towards an organizationally-compliant design of the IT management system.
content.title_en: IT Governance : Central success factor for digital transformation

content.text: When you're talking about the multi-sensory brain learning from head to foot: basics and practice of python programming. What? Everything that's relevant: from the Python basics, to the handling of complex data structures, JSON, web technologies such as temperating and web scraping to Python's library Panda for data analysis and much more. How? With the brain-friendly from head to foot didactics: a playful and visually stimulating knowledge transfer around a swimming coach that exchanges clipboard and stopwatch for an automatically updated web app with data connection who? All those who want to learn Python correctly and first programming skills with you want to program Python professionally without having to hack through any boring instructions and manuals? With "Python from head to foot" this works out: Quickly understand the complete data structures and functions and write runable Python code. They develop your own web application and make it ready to the cloud.
content.title_en: PythonTM from head to toe : basics and practice of python programming

In this Playbook Eric Horster presents more than 30 innovation methods for workshops to improve customer experience. He explains approaches such as service design and design thinking and explains the role of innovations in this context. All innovation methods are presented in a uniform format, which always includes a step-by-step guide and illustrations by Liane Eckl. The methods are complemented by kick-offs, warm-ups, voting and feedback methods. With templates for method combination in half- and full-day workshops as well as instructions for a multi-day training on innovation coach (train-the-trainer). content.text: Urban mixes: Urban development and urban planning as a relational field of action. Contemporary urban planning concepts presuppose the urban mix as a basic principle and recognize a challenging but necessary practice in it. However, it is controversial in the implementation and often remains unmatched or surprisingly different in the result. The contributors critically deal with aspects of urban mix and the associated role of architecture and planning. They shed light on contradictions and challenges and cite examples of new perspectives and qualities of urban life, for their meaningfulness, success or failure. Their analyses provide the basis for current and future collaborative planning and construction
content.title_en: Urban Mixtures : Urban Design and Urban Planning as a relational field of action

content.text: With AI to passionate education : a manifesto : with e-book inside. ChatGPT has begun the future of the school. Digital assistants revolutionize teaching and learning through the use of artificial intelligence. The handing out of routine activities to the new tools opens up a space for teachers and learners who can finally devote themselves to the actual goal of education, namely the discovery and promotion of talents or inclinations. In this way, AI – unlike many people think – leads a long-due farewell to the depersonalizing, factory-like assembly line learning of the industrial age and makes it possible for us to discover our inner vocation and follow it. "Do what you do with passion in life," the Nobel Prize winner for Chemistry, Benjamin List, recommends us. And more: "It must not feel like hard work. "How this can be implemented in the school of the future, Olaf-Axel Burow shows in this book. His analysis leads to a "manifesto for passionate education", which calls for a radical realignment of school and education by means of a creative restriction of digital learning.
content.title_en: With AI to passionate education : a manifesto : with e-book inside

content.text: Future-oriented sustainable urban development: a transdisciplinary study using the example of an inner-city quarter. Inner-city districts have high potential in the sense of a sustainable "city of short distances". They are densely built and functionally mixed. Everything is close together. Cars are hardly necessary. The Darmstadt city of Mollerstadt is such an inner-city quarter with potential – but it also brings with it a number of challenges. On the public hand, it is the reorganising of the stationary traffic and the public spaces: thus it can also influence the crisis of the retail and the city centre. Most areas are in private or commercial hands: their construction must be energetically upgraded and the energy supply must be converted to renewable energies. Free areas must be sealed and greened. The implementation of sustainable development here is essentially the responsibility of the owners – for which this must be interesting. Within the framework of the project "s:ne System Innovation für Nachhaltige Entwicklung" these topics have been comprehensively analyzed and discussed.
content.title_en: Sustainable urban development: a transdisciplinary study using the example of an inner-city district

content.text: Climate protection and sustainability in tourism: Developments and implementation strategies. The green transformation in tourism is now reflected in many different topics and projects: Whether in landscape protection, in discussions about local resilience limits and working perspectives or in the key topic of climate change. While direct concerns already create diverse adaptation strategies, it looks different in the case of mitigation strategies: here tourism often becomes a dilemma between victim and perpetrator roles. How strengthened climate protection and sustainable development can succeed, the contributions of this volume shed light on current market analyses, case studies and best practice examples. - Climate protection at destination level and how credible emission accounting and detouring paths could look at destination level - Tourist behaviour in the context of sustainable development - Role of communication for more sustainability and the activities of tour operators - Further development of tourism supply with a view to sustainability An exciting overview of current developments and strategies from tourism research and practice.
content.title_en: Climate protection and sustainability in tourism : Developments and implementation strategies

content.text: Authentication and authorization in IT: Basics and concepts. - the basics of authentication and authorization explained - presented using practical applications - explained the useful solutions - described effective combinations and decision-making methods - needed to have no to a few previous knowledge - your exclusive advantage: E-Book inside when buying the printed book The book basically describes various methods of authentication and authorization in the context of operational information systems. Starting point is the problem that data and information, data flows and information flows must be protected both in the local as well as in the network. To this end, the book identifies several areas and protective measures as to be combined and how they can be implemented on the basis of existing technologies. Potential implementation patterns are also described. You will learn how to protect data, especially within the framework of the GDPR and the ever-increasing distribution on the basis of cloud-native architectures. Thus, it is no longer sufficient to implement a simple user login, but must be implemented at a wide range of levels depending on the criticality more or less extensive and very finely meshed security mechanisms.
content.title_en: Authentication and authorization in IT : Basics and concepts

content.text: Nature Conservation Biology. 1. Textbook, comprehensive and up-to-date, on a sub-area of environmental sciences that is gaining much attention. It includes theoretical foundations, key research results and selected projects from practice: Subject of nature conservation biology, danger and value of biological diversity (see the outstanding title "The Value of Diversity" by E. O. Wilson, BA 1/96), conservation, planning and management of protected areas, international conventions and financing in this respect. Extensive list of literature and German and international environmental organizations and information sources in the annex. For students, but also for practitioners a treasure trove. (3) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: Nature Conservation Biology

content.text: In times of multiple crises such as the climate and biodiversity crisis, the war of attack by Russia against Ukraine, the consequences of the COVID-19 pandemic, inflation and energy crisis, children and young people report a marked higher psychological burden. With regard to school, a highly stressed education system with a flagrant shortage of personnel is added. The new, crisis-like and uncertain normality meets the school, which must deal with it as a significant social institution as well as as as a concrete social place. The book highlights what social crises are and how they affect the school and the people in the school. An individual stress model is presented and from this derived possible strategies of coping and action for teachers, pupils and other participants. The topic of resilience is in focus to make pupils, teachers and schools as a system more crisis-proof in the long term; especially with regard to the major social-ecological crises, the challenge for school everyday life is to prioritize the existing burdens appropriately. Finally, the role of the school teachers is to guide the future as a role model for the school teachers.
content.title_en: Dealing with social crises in everyday school life

content.text: Forests on the move: a journey through a hundred years of forest and climate change. Climate change has long since arrived in the forest and the damage cannot be overlooked. In most cases, our forests will hardly stand up to the new climate. So what can we do? The proposals for adaptation range from the principle of continuing traditional forestry practices to the requirement to leave the field entirely to nature. But what is the right path?Christian Kölling bundles the results of twenty years of research and practice in this book and recommends a middle way: If the new climate moves from the south - then the forests should also move from south to north. The greater the adaptation problems, the faster we must enrich the forests with the trees that fit into the new climate. This opens up a hopeful prospect for our forest and climate future. Christian Kölling invites us to a time journey to the forest of the future - to make the forest of the present wisely.
content.title_en: Forests on the move: a journey through a hundred years of forest and climate

content.text: The De and Stationary Low Voltage Direct Current Grids: Structures – Switching – Dimensioning – Protection. Not only small devices such as televisions and PCs work with DC current, but also data centers and production systems increasingly use it. Since devices and systems are currently powered with AC current, however, a prior transformation is required, which is accompanied by energy losses. The increasing use of renewable energy sources such as solar energy, which generate direct current, ensures that DC current is increasingly declared as the power supply of the future. This basic work introduces in the construction, design and operation of mobile and stationary low voltage direct current networks. The book focuses on automotive on on-board networks and building networks. In particular, the influence of the operating voltage is addressed. The book primarily applies to students of automation and electrical engineering, but is also suitable for practitioners: to assist in the introduction of DC current networks. The book also addresses the situation of a low voltage direct current grid from reason to plan. They learn all the necessary equipment and its functions – from the selection of the voltage source to the voltage switch and the voltage circuit.

content.text: Public service broadcasting (ÖRR) is rightly criticised for its fundamental reform of public service broadcasting. With technological progress and a wide range of media from public and private broadcasters, the Internet, various streaming services and social media, the recipients have changed their usage behaviour considerably. Moreover, the normative justification and social acceptance of the ÖRR, which is criticised for cost-intensive expenditures and an overly unbalanced and sometimes distorted reporting, is diminishing. The Kronberger Kreis, scientific advisory board of the Foundation Market Economy, shows that a fundamental reform of the ÖRR is necessary to ensure that it can adequately fulfil its mission. Based on an analysis of the reforms under the 3rd and 4th Media Change State Treaty, the Kronberger Kreis develops eight concrete reform steps to strengthen the governance of the ÖRR. content.text: Natural architecture: looking for a natural architecture. David Pearson, English architect, was on the way with the camera to find projects that have implemented his basic conceptions of natural architecture - "ecology, health and mental awareness". The result is an impressive documentation of the world's efforts to design buildings that are in harmony with nature, which are impressively captivated by the beauty of the images. Among other things, these include the buildings of the "organic" architecture of the American F. L. Wright and the Dutchman T. Alberts, but also the unique forms of design of Hungary I. Makovecz. The volume, testimony of a "soft architecture", can be recommended to many libraries. Addresses, bibliography of English-language literature, register, glossary. (2)

content.text: The ecological dimension of urban-Umland-Verkehrs / [Ed.: Institut für Ökologische Raumentwicklung e.V.]; [1.] Part: Quality of operation of urban suburban communities. The quality of operation of public transport is to be examined here as a measure of the supply of public transport services and as an indicator of ecological conditions. The analysis of the impact of land use, transport and ecological situation is a prerequisite for the effective use of the control instrument Land Use Planning and other instruments. The focus of the study is on the relationships between the structure of urban suburban communities and the quality of operation of public transport in these municipalities. The aim is to determine structural determinants with a significant influence on the level of public transport supply and the description of municipal structures with typical service quality. The development of the quality of service is spatially differentiated. A noticeable deterioration of quality could be demonstrated, for example, by the proximity of roads with important regional development function.
content.title_en: The ecological dimension of urban-environment transport / [ed.: Institut für Ökologische Raumentwicklung e.V.] ; [1.] Part: Quality of service Public transport of urban surrounding communities

An introductory text dealing with the basics of energy-saving construction follows the most important planning rules and then assessment criteria for building materials and constructions. content.text: Civicism and faith: contours of the urban Reformation. The specific nature and weight of the urban Reformation against the background of the specific forms of life and piety of the late medieval bourgeoisie in the example of Nuremberg. Is there a specific profile of urban mentality, piety and theology in the late Middle Ages and Reformation? What was the particular part of the cities in the course of the Reformation in the Holy Roman Empire between 1521 and 1555? How do the forces of piety reform and the Reformation of faith combine with the values and norms of urban coexistence and to what extent do they transcend the framework of a bourgeois religion? These are the questions that are being addressed in this book, which attempts to bridge the history of theology and social history. It combines the form of a broad overview with the in-depth analysis of the example of a council writer (Lazarus Spengler) and a craftsman (Hans Sachs) in Nuremberg.
content.title_en: Civility and Faith : Contours of the Urban Reformation

content.text: Biblical Encyclopedia / ed. by Walter Dietrich and Wolfgang Stegemann; vol. 2: The Origin of Israel in the 12th and 11th centuries BC. According to the biblical picture of Israel's history, the pre-state period is divided into two sections: the conquest and distribution of the country (Book of Joshua) and the self-assertion in the conquered country against the various enemies (Judge Book). The description of both epochs is largely fictitious, because the traditions recorded in these books were only developed during the reign of the king. Only with the basic stock of the Deboral Song in Judge 5 is an au- ntic text from the pre-state period. Accordingly, ten tribes settled in the country in the 11th century and asserted themselves against the claim of power of the Canaanites. According to archaeological results, some Canaanite cities continued to exist in the 11th century; however, the country was largely densely populated by a new population in small villages, whereby the material culture of the Canaanites was taken over.
content.title_en: Biblical Encyclopedia / ed. by Walter Dietrich and Wolfgang Stegemann; Vol. 2: The Origin of Israel in the 12th and 11th centuries BC.

content.text: The city in Germany : current development and problems; [social, political and cultural life]. The change of German (large) cities is taking place rapidly and has a profound effect (globalization processes, changes in the population and production structure, the labour market and the welfare state). Other topics of this very readable collection (authors mostly sociologists) are ecological urban conversion (in eastern Germany), poverty in the big city, urban culture, new governance models and municipal financial crisis, the commercialized city and its aesthetics. Important part of urban sociology, based on new investigations and current data. (LK/F: Lüdtke)

content.text: Violence in the media - Violence in reality: societal contexts and pedagogical action. Media violence is only understood from the context of real violence. This topic is considered in this study from an explicitly pedagogical perspective. The book aims to theoretically fund pedagogical action and describes practical models for dealing with media violence.
content.title_en: Violence in the media - violence in reality: societal contexts and educational action

content.text: Experiments on the developmental biology of plants : phytohormones. Hormones play a coordinating role in the development of plants. The 20 experiments collected here deal mainly with their influence on growth, germination and foliage fall. Synthetic phytohormonal derivatives as "weed-killing agents" are also treated, but on the margins. The experiments are particularly suitable for upper secondary school and can be carried out as both teacher and pupil experiments. Furthermore, they can be understood theoretically by their exemplary results protocols and their understandable interpretation. In practical terms, a clear presentation of the general principles and a detailed description of the individual phythohormon groups is provided, so that a clear and new research results are thus available in an important field of plant physiology. (2 S) (LK/SH: Enderle)
content.title_en: Experiments on the developmental biology of plants : Phytohormones

content.text: Marine science : Introduction to the geography and biology of the oceans ; 13 tables. The oceans and seas of the earth cover 70% of the area of the biosphere and contain 95% of its water. Following the formation and operating forces, the formation, shape and characteristics of the seas and the organisms living in them are described. The effect of the water on living beings, soil and coastal form, as well as radiation conditions and production can be classified and arranged the most important habitats of the sea. These habitats are the main part of this book. The final part deals with the vital issues of the use and pollution of the seas. (MOD)

content.text: In the magic circle. Rez.: Hunchback and ugly, the I-narrator, a sorcerer who has healing powers and is asked by the tribe as midwife and physician. An outsider - with the devils in league? Suspected of being a witch, the villagers deliver her and her daughter Asa to the stake. To save Asa, the hunchback promises herself to be the evil one and survives. 9 years later she lives in the forest, until Hansel and Gretel find her in the woods and she finds her end, well known in the oven. Death is redemption, liberating from the curse that burdened her. Again (see BA 3/95) fairytale-phantastic, cleverly told novel by the author. The possible prehistory of the witch in the Grimm fairy tale? At any rate exciting, background, vibrating of mysterious-knister tension. - Highly recommended for lovers of fairy tales, fantastic. (IK: Fantasy) To save her daughter from being retired to being sent away by the devil.
content.title_en: In the Magic Circle

content.text: The Involvement of the Other : Studies on Political Theory. Collection with new and partly unpublished moral philosophical and political theoretical essays written by Habermas since 1992. In these studies he once again pleads for an open pluralistic society, which is constituted by the idea of avoiding discrimination and the idea of the "involvement of the other"; he defends his discurstheoretical program in discussion with John Rawls; he problematicates the concept of the nation and the supposed right to self-determination; he deals with the enforcement of human rights and with Kant's idea of "Eternal Peace"; finally he refers to the internal connection between the state of law and democracy. A book worth reading that can convey intelligent insights both socially philosophically and critically to the reader. (3) (Dieter Altmeyer)
content.title_en: The Involvement of the Other : Studies on Political Theory

content.text: The school of the future: from the educational institution to the learning workshop. Who knows earlier titles of this author (lastly "school report": BA 4/95, "The Art of Education": BA 5/96), will find many things known here: for example the emphasis on the school's educational mission, the rediscovery of the class teacher principle, the described trend towards a school system that is essentially two-part (secondary schools/gymnasiums). Struck outlines the future school as a "learning workshop", in which the teacher - through the computer is relieved of the pure knowledge transfer - becomes a friendly "learning consultant" of his pupils, who, if necessary, also has parental and therapist functions. The question remains whether school and educators are not overburdened with this (see H. Giesecke: BA 6/96). A not too brilliantly written book, full of tapeworm sets and repetitions, dedicated and generally understandable (with literature directory, register), thought for all those who want to speak with the topic. (2 S) (Erich. H. Sausssett.
content.title_en: The School of the Future : from the Institute to the Learning Workshop

content.text: Regional development in Northern Germany: functions and hinterland connections of the ports to the North and Baltic Sea. Initially, functions and development of the German seaports to the North and Baltic Sea are systematically presented. Against this background, the requirements of infrastructure expansion in the hinterland connections of the German ports to the North and Baltic Sea are then addressed. The following article is dedicated to the overseas ports of the North Range of Hamburg via the Bremen ports to Rotterdam and Antwerp. The statements focus on container handling in overseas traffic. Furthermore, the Baltic Sea ports are the focus. Based on quantitative scenarios of future trade flows in the Baltic Sea region, the consequences for the traffic flows and for the future functional division of the ports of the southern Baltic Sea are discussed. Furthermore, the regions in which the port locations lie are also brought into focus. Finally, relevant questions are at the center of the view of spatial planning and country planning.
content.title_en: Regional development in Northern Germany : functions and hinterland connection of ports to the North and Baltic Sea

content.text: The speed of escape: essay. In a time when everyone is thinking about freedom of expression and the political role of the media in society, it is imperative to ask about the individual's freedom of perception and the threat of it, which is the industrialization of seeing and hearing, the optical and acoustic pollution. Virilio brings together all the motives of his thinking in this essay and transfers them into a political-moral manifesto.
content.title_en: Escape Speed : Essay

content.text: Environmental biotechnology: basics, applications and perspectives. The author, with his publication, is not so much interested in specialists but rather interested in other sectors, especially in the economy. In view of the matter, he describes possibilities, technology and selected areas of application of modern environmental biotechnology, whose aim is the protection and restoration of the environment (i.e. the removal of pollutants). Apparently this branch of biotechnology has developed into an export hit. Unlike the (traditional) chemical-physical processes, the biotechnical cleaning, remediation and recycling processes are also more cost-effective. The conclusion is an annex with contact addresses, information sources, databases and Internet addresses. No comparable title on the market. The not entirely cheap title is also to be desired in public libraries. (2) (Leo Prawitt)
content.title_en: Environmental Biotechnology : Basics, Applications and Perspectives

content.text: Hemp: the practical book. According to the basic stock titles "The rediscovery of the hemp ..." (BA 4/95) and F. Waskow (BA 4/96) and the entertaining Schlenker by Katja Behrens (BA 11/96) it is primarily about the practical use of the plant. Sagunski and Lichtner as employees of the HanfHaus Hamburg and the ecologically committed journalist Hembd promote the use as a remedy, for nutrition, in cosmetics and as a raw material for textiles, building materials etc. Extensively the legal situation is discussed. The graphically appealing, clearly designed book, which does not spare the cultural historical background, advertises very skillfully, but also with thought, for the plant in the trend. Informatively also for pupils from secondary school I. Cf. also R. Robinson (in this No.). (2) (Reinhild Khan)

content.text: The Information Society: Opportunities for a New Quality of Life at the beginning of the third millennium. The author tries to explore the real look of a society shaped by the Internet, teleworking and cyberspace and the economic changes that result from it. He deals in detail with the key technology of the future, the Internet. He shows the structure of the Internet, e-mail systems and online services and deals with topics such as electronic publishing, online business, teleworking, electronic banking and legal and security aspects of a digital society. He discusses the blessing and curse of technological progress, social aspects of an information society and attempts under the provocative title "Work - no thanks" to a reassessment of the importance of work. A well-understood book that provides ideas and relativises the emerging theories that have so far been circulating under the heading "Cybersociety". (2) (Christiane Greul)
content.title_en: The Information Society: Opportunities for a New Quality of Life at the beginning of the third millennium

content.text: The words of the words of the word: Anticitates from literature and media. At the latest since the publication of Georg Buchmann's "Winged Words" (1864) a collection of quotations has been included in the book cabinet of the "Bildungsbürger". However, old and familiar quotations have always been modified and parodiumed. In this book, the linguistic and literary scholar Wolfgang Mieder has collected more than 2000 "Anticitates" from literature, press and advertising. Goethe's "Over all Summits is Ruh" for example, he records no less than 38 variants. The linguistic plays are often witty, humorous and amusing, sometimes provocative or obscene.
content.title_en: Transverse words : Antiquotes from literature and media

content.text: External assignment of tasks of technical services in universities. HIS was asked to examine the topic of external assignment of technical services and tasks with a nationwide inventory in order to provide relevant materials to universities and scientific authorities as guidance aids. Not only the extent of the already done in universities of technical services to third parties should be determined, but above all examples of successful dissipation should be documented with the aim of providing appropriate solutions for different tasks and deriving award criteria and assessment aids. The study also aims to establish the basis for new concepts of building management in universities. Structure: 1. Introduction 2. Reference framework for the analysis of tasks of technical services in universities - Definitions and demarcations 3. Building management in universities 4. Practice of external assignment in universities 5. Case examples for external assignments 6. Recommendations for practice 7. Conclusions. - Annex (including survey form) (HoF/Text adopted)

His case contains a variety of practical and methodological tools for investigations, surveys, evaluations, evaluations and data systems. After an opinion on the controversial terms "practical knowledge", and "scientific knowledge", the author introduces the prospective researchers into the planning of research projects and gives them the opportunity to avoid the most common mistakes and errors of beginners. The description of the individual methods and techniques contains a whole range of proven methods and aids that minimize the effort and enable a systematic, optimal evaluation.

content.text: The author of this workbook is the specialist seminar leader for addiction prevention in Berlin and representatives of the form education, which aims instead at deterrent drug information to a holistic personal approach, creativity and emotionally experienceable learning content. The main part is 99 educational games and exercises for children, adolescents and adults, which are intended to promote self-experience, interaction and reflection and to be realized with simple means such as paper and scribe, glue and clay. As addressees are called school, hort, church, leisure facilities and youth education places. As practical help (with a list of literature) besides the more basic book of D. Bäuerle (BA 5/96) and the titles mentioned there. (2 S) (Irmgard Andrae)
content.title_en: Addiction prevention in practice : a workbook for school and youth work ; 99 exercises and suggestions

content.text: Interaction of color : Foundation of a didactic of seeing. Some of the protagonists of classical modernism, especially from the Bauhaus, left behind theoretical writings as a sum of their reflections on visual art, alongside J. Itten (last BA 5/85), Kandinsky and Klee, Josef Albers, whose first edition of "Interaction of Color" appeared in 1961 (not discussed here). Albers' work is the color theory, more precisely the theory of color perception, but does not give up the philosophical foundation that is frequently found in comparable works. Rather, he is concerned with a practical training especially of the become artist, certainly also of the interested in art. The aim of learning is to recognize the relativity of the perception of colors in the context of other colors and to make them usable in the creative process. (3) (Volker Pirsich)
content.title_en: Interaction of color : Foundation of a didactic of seeing

content.text: Coming out: Lesbians and gays from all over the world. The life stories of 10 young homosexuals, gays like lesbians, from Ukraine, Croatia, South Africa, Morocco, China, Indonesia, Iran, Israel, Panama and Uruguay, compiled here by Lutz van Dijk (see also "A Fulfilled Life - Nevertheless", BA 3/93), prove their oppressive coming-out experiences especially in those countries, of which it is known that homosexuality is still being suppressed or even persecuted in a special way. The documentation, supported by Amnesty internationally, also shows how a negative social environment can mobilize forces to emancipate from it and fight for its own gay identity. That there is not only "far behind in Turkey" homosexual discrimination, but also in the allegedly tolerant Germany, the editor points out this by means of many examples. A plea against intolerance and discrimination. (2) (Uwe-F. Obsen)
content.title_en: Coming out : Lesbians and gays from all over the world

content.text: 20th century cutlery : from silver bars to throwaway articles. After a brief historical overview of the development of table-sitters and the necessary devices - supporting or replacing fingers - the book addresses the two opposing tendencies of modernism; the return to artisanal forms, a line from John Ruskin to Art Deco and Art Nouveau, and the trend towards industrial modern design, for example the company WMF and the Danish house Georg Jensen. Overviewable, easy to understand, illustrated with many photos, with table of shapes, short monographs, literature notes (not much) and addresses of museums. A contribution to the understanding of the everyday culture of the 20th century, which is not only addressed to collectors. (2) (Irmgard Andrae)
content.title_en: 20th century cutlery : from silver to disposable

content.text: Nature conservation through organic farming. The authors point out that organic farming is the only form of agriculture that preserves resources and thus the basis of life for future generations. The policy of the Federal Government and the European Union is then examined to what extent commitments made at the Rio Summit have been respected. However, positive political approaches, for example, are also reported in Switzerland. Last but not least, the need for increased cooperation between nature conservation and organic farming is pointed out. A valid and inexpensive basis for discussion for farmers and conservationists. (3) (Hans-Ulrich Struck)
content.title_en: Nature conservation through organic farming

content.text: The author (most recently "Europäische Salons", BA 2/93) has again addressed a woman-specific theme in her latest book - the diary of creative women from the 18th-20th century. For a long time, the diary was the only way for women to express themselves in writing, and many women used it. In the individual chapters of the book, the various forms of the diary are now described (e.g. travel, artist, contemporary diary). These forms are assigned to famous diary writers (from Madame de Stael to Virginia Woolf to Simone Weil) and describe in detail the life and work of these women. A very interesting book, which is certainly important for reading, but which is mainly suitable for larger collections due to the special topic. (3) (Elke Jinschek)
content.title_en: Eavesdropping life: Women's diaries from three centuries

content.text: Myth Internet. The volume gathers contributions from authors who approach the phenomenon of the new web world from various perspectives of philosophical, economic, political and cultural questions. In the sense of critical introduction and follow-up, the contributions are directed towards all those who want to understand the present better.
content.title_en: Myth Internet

content.text: Total digital: the world between 0 and 1 or the future of communication. The much-invited information society takes on concrete features. The author of this book describes here what the new world will look like between "multimedia" and "Internet". The book is the concrete analysis of the enormous leap in history since the invention of book printing. It is no longer about the technical development of computers, but about the radical change of our entire life. How we will communicate with each other determines how we will think, learn, work and let ourselves be entertained in the future - in short: how we will live.
content.title_en: Total digital: the world between 0 and 1 or the future of communication

content.text: Dachauer Diary: the records of the prisoner 24814. "... ich muss, muss es tare", notes the author (1906-1991) who is hardly known in Germany in the foreword to his "Dachauer Diarys", which were created and saved under danger of life in the concentration camp Dachau from 1942 to 1945. This book is followed by the publishing house, which is published here for the first time completely and unabated. Kupfer-Koberwitz, an unusually compassionate and sensitive as art-loving person, was in custody for a total of 4 years and 9 months. In his diary he records the camp reality, but also reacts to the outside world and reveals his inner life. All impressions go "deep through his heart". A preserved, "unadulterated time document", supplemented by the "Dachauer Dictionary", testimonies of fellow prisoners, poems, explanations and a preface by B. Distel. (2) (Marianne Jonzeck)
content.title_en: Dachau Diaries : the records of the prisoner 24814

content.text: Ways to healthy building : residential physiology, building materials, construction constructions, standards and prices. The third edition of 1989 was presented (BA 2/90); compared with it this edition is a strongly changed, extended and technically updated edition; also a lot of experience has been incorporated from practice. It is also pleasing to note the extended excursion range on special topics such as "unwanted house dwellers". The new edition of this very well-used book should be purchased in any case, even if the preliminary editions can be used. (2) (LK/SB: Prawitt)
content.title_en: Paths to healthy construction : residential physiology, building materials, construction structures, standards and prices

content.text: The focus is on the many and often difficult to understand processes of institutional change in Central and Eastern Europe. But institutional change is not only taking place where it is particularly striking. European integration also brings fundamental institutional changes, the direction and extent of which are not easy to estimate; the same applies to the Third World and not least to international institutional arrangements such as the United Nations. Thus, we are confronted with a variety of heterogeneous processes, ranging from revolutionary breaks to almost inconceivable but not least serious changes in "slip-in institutional change". The volume provides information on the causes, course and trends of these processes and answers the following questions: Which are the decisive factors in the different forms of institutional change? Are there comparable patterns, perhaps even commonalities, and how is it each ordered by the continuities in change? The contributions make it clear in a comparative perspective which forms of institutional change characterize our societies at the end of the 20th century and how the social sciences understand them.
content.title_en: Institutional change

content.text: The medieval profane stone building of Westphalia in the European context. It is not a finished work, but an important chapter of a planned book on the Bürgerhaus in East Westphalia, on which Josef Schepers worked until shortly before his death.
content.title_en: The medieval profane stone building of Westphalia in the European context

content.text: Whose fault? : from the historian's dispute to the Goldhagen controversy. Starting from the conviction that the controversy over Goldhagen's theses on German anti-Semitism and its consequences (BA 10/96) was less scientific than more questions of our political culture, which shaped the debate about the Nazi past, the Berlin-based FU-Neuhistorician examines in 4 discourses totalitarianism theories, the supposedly tragic geopolitical middle situation of Germany, the question of war guilt and the modernism effect of National Socialism. The author, who was well proven by similar works on "fascism theories" (BA 2/90), "European Fascism" (BA 10/83) and "controversies around Hitler" (BA 3/87), can put the Goldhagen controversy into the continuity of the "historic dispute" that had now reached a new phase. Very useful discussion introduction. (3) (Friedrich Andrae)
content.title_en: Whose fault? : from the historian's dispute to the Goldhagen controversy

content.text: Plastic recycling : Basics - Procedures - Practical examples. Material and energetic processes for the reprocessing of plastics in a collection volume with textbook character. Extensive and detailed structure, with little pre-knowledge (the introductory section provides basic information on the technology of plastics). Thorough technical presentation for students and practitioners. Can be used alongside A. Jungbauer (ID 18/95), before W. Michaeli (ID 34/93, limited from material processes). Important for larger specialist collections (the topic is still in demand). (3) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Plastic recycling : Basics - Process - Practical examples

content.text: World Culture and World Society : Aspects of Global Change : to commemorate Horst Reimann (1929-1994). The increasing density of global direct and indirect interactions has stimulated sociologists and other scientists to reflect and analyse the complex and sometimes contradictory processes associated with it. So far, cultural globalization has meant the diffusion of modern culture, which has emerged in Europe and developed in North America, of fundamental values such as rationality and individuality, but also of understanding science and popular culture. However, on closer examination, processes such as transformation and recombination, contradiction and resistance in the rest of the world and self-reflection such as self-correction in the "first world". At the same time, it becomes clear that the major problems of the future are "world problems" which can only be contained or possibly even solved through a global consensus, the core of a "world culture", and the construction of globally accepted institutions, the representatives of a "world society".
content.title_en: World Culture and Society : Aspects of Global Change : in memory of Horst Reimann (1929-1994)

content.text: Public security in the cultural conflict: the development of the municipal police in multicultural society. The study shows that the immediate workloads can only be assessed in connection with the changes in the urban and democratisation processes in the police themselves. Xenophobic tendencies are part of a dissatisfaction syndrome that includes aspects of urban perception and the assessment of occupation, working climate and police work tasks. Central developments of urban modernity encounter widespread, sometimes aggressive rejection.
content.title_en: Public security in the cultural conflict: to develop the municipal police in multicultural society

content.text: Designing in the mechanical engineering sector : from the design specification to the construction template. Textbook for engineers, which wants to build a bridge from the theoretical construction process to the technical application. Introduces clearly and vividly into the topic and brings numerous examples and tabular overviews. The focus is on methodological learning steps, CAD is discussed in the final section. Appears more practice-oriented than G. Pahl (in this no.), narrower and easier in the approach than G. Koller (ID 11/95). - Suitable as an entry course. (2) (Alfred Pleuß)
content.title_en: Construction in the mechanical engineering sector : from the design specification to the construction template

content.text: The aim of a research project was to find out how children calculate. Children, parents, teachers and students were involved in this work under highly indebted leadership. The result here shows that children are different from ourselves and assume it. Many examples document and critically analyse the different nature of the mathematical thinking of children. The aim of this volume is to teach primary school teachers in education and in the profession how they can study and then understand the thinking of pupils themselves in class. An informative book for a better understanding of the often unusual computational paths, especially of school beginners. (3 S) (Georg Friedrich Dahm)
content.title_en: How Children Count

Then the speed adjustment on the different types of drives is explained with the help of principle diagrams, demonstration examples etc.. In addition, commercial aspects (selection criteria, energy saving, operating costs, maintenance, legislation on EMC etc.) are discussed. The book offers engineers and technicians who have to choose, use, maintain, maintain, maintain, a good overview, students an introduction. Most closely comparable to W. Böhm (last 3rd edition: E-ID 35/89; 4th edition 1996); still on the subject, but more general or demanding: "Modern power funnel drives" by P. F. Brosch (last version BA 6/98), H. O. Seinsch (ID 20/93 and the titles mentioned there). (2) (Rita Weinheimer-Hartmann)

content.text: Trustee of the Reich: Switzerland and the fortunes of the Nazi victims; a search for traces. Only the pressure of the USA initiated by a senator caused the Swiss government to exert pressure on Helvetic bank bosses to make a hesitant confession of the fortunes of Nazi victims; but the stone had its start in an article in the Zurich Sunday newspaper of March 5, 1995 (apart from the thematically differently tending, now revised "Rubgold" by W. Rings, BA 4/86). Balzli did not let it go with the impulse, but further calculated in archives of Switzerland, USA and Germany: His carefully worked, liquidly written report on the search for traces of the fortunes of the Holocaust victims, without aiming for completeness, is oriented towards selected but typical examples of the dark ways in which dirty businesses of Nazi-workers with Helvetic bankers with honorable value were carried out at the expense of Nazi victims. This title is widely recommended to the current subject. (2) (Friedrich Andrae)
content.title_en: Trustees of the Reich : Switzerland and the fortunes of the Nazi victims ; a search for traces

content.text: The USA: economic and social geography and problems. From the foreword: The two authors deal in this book mainly with basic principles and problems of spatial relations of economic and social relations in the USA, which influence the typical new world economic and lifestyle that has spread to large parts of the rest of the world. Historical development, especially the development of the space and the valorization of the various regions, is used insofar as it is the cause of certain contemporary phenomena. Particularly those topics are addressed which increasingly gain global significance and open up essential insights into tasks and conflicts that must be mastered by internal and external policies. With this concept, the authors deliberately refrain from exhaustiveness in favour of the in-depth consideration of individual topics and issues, which are also seen from various aspects. The alternatives shown in the text as well as the work material presented in maps, statistics and diagrams are derived from experiences in teaching practice and provide good foundations for technical and integrated teaching as well as for further investigations and discussions.
content.title_en: The USA : economic and social geography and problems

content.text: The King of Greenland: an artist novel. Rez.: The Cologne author ("Ich, Wolkenstein": BA 9/87; "Clara Schumann, Piano": BA 8/96) is particularly successful with his literary biographies. A museum technician who leads a highly bourgeois and rather boring life dreams of Greenland (who he met in the war as a ship chef) and of a kind of artistic staging of the Greenlandic polar light above the night Cologne. Kühn contrasts in his narrative a soberly documented everyday Cologne world with rather impressionistic passages in which Greenland is at the centre. Despite the delicate love story with which Kühn seeks to link both narrative strands, the novel seems to me to be not convincing, and above all the bone-dry description style of most passages seems to be tiresome. From central libraries it is possible to create a museum technician whose bourgeois life begins to bore him with the distant Greenland, which he has known as a ship chef in war, and who has experienced the artistic staging of Cologne over the night.
content.title_en: The King of Greenland : an artist's novel

content.text: The Marshall Plan : History and the Future. An informative, easy-to-understand overview of the history of the Marshall Plan and its future, given in various contributions and interviews by representatives of business and politics, historians and journalists. Graphs, photos and a comprehensive bibliography complete the very successful introduction to an important chapter of German post-war history. (3) (LK/HD: Eberle)
content.title_en: The Marshall Plan : History and the future

content.text: His and Schein : Reflections on chemistry. Artificial fibres, special waste, exhaust catalyst, Seveso-Gift, healing effects of a drug or fatal side effect? What is characteristic of chemistry: success reports or scandal reports? Nobel Prize winner Roald Hoffmann teaches us to see both faces of chemistry and to bridge the gap between art, economy, culture and philosophy. The apparent unity and the supposed contradictions of chemistry are the central theme of the attractively illustrated book.
content.title_en: His and Schein : Reflections on Chemistry

content.text: In search of historical building materials: a manual and guide. The very useful address book lists all (36) dealers affiliated to the "Entrepreneurenverband Historische Baustoffe e.V.", who have specialized in the purchase and sale or restoration of historical building materials, components and building parts. They view historical building materials as cultural assets and preserve them from a "disposal" on landfills. The short descriptions contain interesting facts about the company: history, priorities, objectives, offers (also craft and advisory type), address etc. An overview map, literature directory and a schematic overview of the dealers round off the volume. The book goes beyond a pure address book; it also represents a kind of plea for the preservation and reuse of historical building materials in the sense of a style and professional renovation. (2) (Leo Prawitt) Address book and directory of traders specializing in the distribution and restoration of historical building materials, components and building parts. (Leo Prawitt)
content.title_en: In search of historical building materials : a manual and guide

content.text: Education and Europe: the EU support measures. The volume provides an overview of EU activities in the field of education with many addresses. It also presents the education systems of the EU Member States in a concise and clear form. Structure: A. Introduction. - B. Programmes, actions, internships (I. Socrates II. LEONARDO III. Structural Funds IV. Education and training outside the programmes I-III V. Internships VI. Research VII. Continuing vocational training VIII. Cooperation with third countries). - C. Education systems in the EU (I. The education systems of the EU Member States compared II. Statistical development of student numbers III. Recognition of vocational, university and school qualifications, correlations of vocational qualifications). - D. Institutions. - E. Annex (including index of keywords) (HoF/Text taken over)
content.title_en: Education and Europe: EU support measures

Updated compared to the 8th edition 1987 (BA 9/88) and extended by almost 10 pages. An exchange of expenditures is useful. (2 S) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: The arc welding machine : Guide to training and practice

content.title_en: Experimental Physics textbook : for use in academic lectures and self-study / by L. Bergmann and Cl. Schaefer ; Vol. 7: Earth and Planets : [50 tables]

content.text: Women of this world. The gorgeous, expressive photos are above all those that impress with this lushly equipped high-gloss picture/text book. In addition, the women from 20 countries of the world are presented through interviews, in which they express themselves relatively scarcely to the questions about their everyday life, their living conditions, worries and desires. Information about the respective country and impressions of the authors round off the picture a little more. Even if the texts do not go too deep, the large-format volume offers a kaleidoscope of different female life forms and invites you to see and treat. (2) (Reinhild Khan)
content.title_en: Women of the World

content.text: Development. "Development" - an all-world word. Much can be developed and developed - in nature, in technology, medicine, history, in politics, the economy etc. etc. - And in the so-called developing countries?! In analogy to Darwinian evolutionary theory, in any case, it is tacitly assumed that development takes place purposefully from a level considered to be low to a higher level. Here Reinhart Kößler begins with his critical considerations. His main focus is on the catching-up development. Her problem is based on the inequality in world society and its dynamics - currently concentrated in the crisis of the hegemonic development model. This refers to the many questions about the social strategies that hide behind the term "development": they concern the concept of the future, the possible overcoming of industrialization and modernity as well as the re-relationship of "development" to the "first world".
content.title_en: Development

content.text: The authors give an insight into the technical foundations, construction, construction and operational use of overwater warships built on shipyards of Blohm + Voss in Hamburg, Kiel and Emden. The overview covers the so-called "dreadnoughts" and battleships of the two world wars, including the description of the modern MEKO design concept for corvettes and frigates. This is illustrated by the example of Fregates Class 123 and 124. The contents in detail: naval ship construction in Hamburg, Kiel and Emden; overwater combat ships in the present time; the MEKO design concept; MEKO ships in the seven world seas; new frigate for the German Navy; on board the Fregate Class 123; development of the frigates in class 124; with MEKO frigates, MEKO corvettes and MEKO-OPVs in the 21st century; future by cooperation. In addition, a list of the Navy + Vohms has been built since 1892.
content.title_en: Guardians of the Seas : History and Future of German Naval Shipbuilding

content.text: DC technology : basics and examples. The textbook for students or repetitory for engineers in practice comprises scarcely and yet exactly (like a lecture script) the absolute basic knowledge. It contains many calculated examples, but nevertheless the "collection of tasks ..." of M. Vömel (ID 14/95), could be a good addition. Compared to R. Unbehauen (ID 3/95), P. Gilles (ID 23/93) H. Clausert (ID 28/92), W. Weissgerber (ID 6/91) - see also the older titles mentioned in these discussions - is hardly new to expect. (3) (Rita Weinheimer-Hartmann)

content.text: "The city will be in the landscape and the landscape in the city": Band city and band structure as guiding principles of modern urban planning. If today there is talk of urban design, then, blinded by the guiding principle of Gartenstadt, the guiding principle of Bandstadt will be forgotten. It was central to modern urban planning of the machine age: the period from the turn of the century to the beginning of the seventies. It offered a uncompromising alternative, as it broke thoroughly with the over-generated structure of the city. The band city in its many variations and structures aimed at overcoming all the traditional city forms; it was turned towards technical progress and social change, it should be "the new city" for the "new man". Its forerunners were organizers of the industrial mass society, they stood left and right, in the camp of socialism and nationalism; and in between them, of course, in the reform bourgeoisie and social democracy. - From the far over 100 well-known band city concepts between 1882 and 1970, the publishers from America, German and English, they could cast out the original light- on Russia and the hypotheses, they could document the original text in the city- and the city-be-be-be-belong-belong-beanitook-beanit.

content.text: Methods of text analysis : Guide and overview. This textbook achieves two objectives: on the one hand it provides an introduction to the approach to scientific analysis of spoken or written texts. On the other hand, a total of 15 methods and procedures from linguistics and sociology are presented and discussed. The presentation takes place according to a uniform structure and thus enables a direct comparison. Extensive commented references to literature facilitate the in-depth access to the subject. This creates the most comprehensive overview of social science methods of text analysis at present.

content.text: The only world power : America's strategy of supremacy. Carter's former security adviser, currently Professor of Foreign Policy, wants to secure the global domination of the USA, which is necessary for stability in the world. Eurasia is of central importance. He analyses the relationship with America's partners Europe and Japan as well as the possible and desirable development of Russia, the "Eurasian Balkans" (consisting of 8 successor states of the Soviet Union and Afghanistan) and China. Based on the findings he designs an American "geostrategy" for Eurasia. The book provides information about the countries concerned and about an influential foreign policy direction of the USA; with 23 maps, 5 tables, factual and personal registers. (2) (Joachim Renkhoff) Analysis of the American "geostrategy" for the preservation of the American supremacy in the world. (Joachim Renkhoff)
content.title_en: The only world power : America's strategy of supremacy
