content.text: The newspaper: a multimedium : Text design - a design concept for text, image and graphics. As a new and holistic design theory for newspapers - this is the term "text design". The two authors (deputy editor-in-chief and professor of media science) are concerned with the integration of the otherwise often separated information channels text, images and graphics, with the aim of creating a user-friendly "operator interface" and to satisfy journalistic demands on the content equally. To this end, they raise the traditional separation between textians and layouters and offer hints on portioning and arranging information, on the use of the headlines, on the preparation, on the writing of texts and on the use of photos and graphics. With further suggestions on a changed editorial management, on the design of an online newspaper, with checklists, glossary and literature notes. An exciting and compactly designed supplement. (3) (Ulrike Knipping)
content.title_en: Die Zeitung: a multimedium : Text design - a design concept for text, image and graphics

content.text: The "KoKoSS" manual - continuous and cooperative self-qualification and self-organization. The structures of initial vocational training as a learning organisation are transferable into all areas in which competent teamwork is required. However, in order to initiate and implement development processes of this kind, an ideal and initiative "start investment" is required. "Learning and working in a team" according to the method KoKoSS cannot be simply prescribed, but must be developed and implemented together in a process supported by all involved. To provide handouts and experiences is the aim of this manual. The publication is aimed at personnel and organizational developers in enterprises, managers of vocational training institutions, such as training workshops, vocational training works, vocational promotion centres, inter-company training centres, etc., trainers and vocational school teachers with the aim of an inclusive vocational training and school educators with the goal of internal reform.
content.title_en: Manual "KoKoSS" - continuous and cooperative self-qualification and self-organization

content.text: Introduction of quality management systems : practical guide with integrated environmental management. The book provides practical and clear information on the requirements of international quality management standards and environmental management standards for a company and how they are met.The reader is enabled with this practical guide to build both a certified quality management system and a gradual integrated quality management system and environmental management system.The book contains numerous procedures, checklists and forms tested in practice, an integrated sample manual and a CD-ROM for training purposes. It thus provides the basis for the independent creation of a management system. (MOD)
content.title_en: Introduction of quality management systems : practical guide with integrated environmental management

content.text: Journal essay databases Theology : a critical comparison between journal content service Theology and Religion Database taking into account other databases. The present paper and the underlying questions result from the experiences of a study-accompanying internship at SUB Göttingen in summer 1996 and the library practice at the Theological University Library Friedensau. The focus of the work is on comparing two bibliographic databases for theological and religious literature and scenarios for future possibilities of the production of journal content databases. The aim of the work is to provide suggestions for taking note of what has been done so far, to review the current practice of bibliographic work in the field of theological journal content databases and to develop concepts of future cooperation.
content.title_en: Journal essay databases Theology : a critical comparison between journal content service Theology and Religion Database taking into account other databases

content.text: The secrets of the children's drawings: how can we understand them?. The experienced Waldorf educator Inger Brochmann explains the essential phases in the development of children's drawings by means of over a hundred examples and interprets the secrets underlying them. It is evident that the drawings are related to the physical development of the child. Also drawings that have been created after the experience of pain and illness or treatment of therapy become understandable. An important help with which children's drawings can be read and understood. (Klappentext) Suggestions for the interpretation of children's drawings from an anthroposophical point of view. Based on Rudolf Steiner's views on the development of the child in the first seven years of life, the author interprets about 100 drawings from which pain and joy can be read. With partly coloured illustrations in the text, black-and-white photographs of "created" children and literature notes. The children's drawings are not seen as "individual artistic ability of the child" which would be promoted, but as "expression of a collective mental development", which can only be observed. For anthroposophical photos of "created" children and literature.
content.title_en: The Secrets of Child Drawings: How can we understand them?

content.text: The failed merger Berlin-Brandenburg : regional policy framework and consequences. The volume includes papers and statements presented at the meeting of the Academy's regional working group in Berlin in October 1996. This dealt with the failure of the planned merger between the Länder of Berlin and Brandenburg. In the individual contributions, the possible consequences of the failure for regional development and spatial planning are analysed from different perspectives and ways of solving the worsening coordination and cooperation problems between the two countries are discussed.
content.title_en: The failed merger Berlin-Brandenburg : regional policy framework and consequences

content.text: Determination of land use changes using satellite image data - Methodical investigations using the example of the city-relocation regions Dresden and Leipzig. In order to correspond to the necessary timeliness of settlement area mapping, satellite remote sensing is an innovative method of surveying with the possibility of highly up-to-date data collection. In the study, three methods of land use mapping (Change Detection Methods) were used decisively for a study room and compared with the efficiency and processing effort. The focus is on the detection of new building and building areas. If only a mapping of new settlement areas is to be carried out, a visual comparison of a current and a correspondingly older recording with a delineation of new settlement areas on the basis of a logical search is the simplest, safest and most cost-effective method. If the result is that land use qualifications covering the area are available, the superposition of several images of the individual classification with subsequent adaptive filtering allows the mapping of the change areas.
content.title_en: Determination of land use changes by satellite image data - Methodical studies using the example of the city-circumstances regions Dresden and Leipzig

content.text: The living dead and the dead God : Death and Beyond Concepts in the Philippines. This book confronts the reader with existential border experiences in the field of death, death and beyond conceptions in the context of Filipino religion and culture. They put him in the middle of an event that initially seems mysterious to him, but whose attentive interpretation leads him to surprising insights. The analysis traces the hidden meaning of attitudes and behaviours that seem strange, strange or even repugnant to the Western reader, but which he learns to understand by exposing himself to their differentness and alienity as comprehensible expressions of a subterranean fabric of meaning.
content.title_en: The Living Dead and the Dead God : Death and Beyond Concepts in the Philippines

content.text: Nature and person in the ethical dispute. The possibilities of man to intervene in nature are currently increasing to a limited extent, and at the same time the knowledge of the consequences of such action grows. Both moments point out that nature is not only the opposite and the other for man, but that it is itself a natural thing. It can gain or lose its own form in the form of life, i.e. through action, its own form and its at the same time abandoned form. Insofar as this action is equally rational and individual, it also proves to be a personal activity. The authors of the bond investigate this connection between nature and person in the context of current philosophical research.
content.title_en: Nature and Person in the Ethical Dispute

content.text: Science and religion: the reconciliation of wisdom and knowledge. Science - as Wilber's starting point in this book - is one of the most profound methods developed by man to discover truth, while religion is the only great force for creating meaning and value. But these two enormous forces, which are of such central importance to the fate of humanity, are bitterly opposed in the modern world. Both sides tend to deny each other the existential significance for human life. Loss of meaning and value in a world dominated by technology, on the one hand, and fundamentalist tendencies and sects in the field of religion on the other, are only some of the fatal consequences of this ubiquitous separation between natural science and religion. To overcome the cultural crisis resulting from this disintegration is one of the great tasks of mankind at the threshold of the 3rd millennium. In this disintegrating book Ken Wilber shows how an integration of science and religion, which is acceptable to both sides, is to be accomplished. To this end, it is not only possible to clearly recognize the possibilities and limits of science, but only to understand the truth of the spirit of the spirit of the universal religion.
content.title_en: Science and Religion : Reconciliation of Wisdom and Knowledge

content.text: Coffee, cheese, caries ... : Biochemistry in everyday life. This collection of articles is the result of a one-week compact seminar in which 26 students of chemistry, biochemistry, human biology, medicine and physics took part together with 3 lecturers. The aim of the seminar was to develop and present science in a cross-disciplinary manner. To this end, facts from daily life were examined in a scientific way and on biochemical processes. The selection of topics was arbitrary and followed the interests of the participants. The topic spectrum is therefore broad: beer, wine and sparkling wine, tea, coffee, caffeine, tobacco, smoking, hemp, drugs, meat, fruit and vegetables, spices, milk, cheese, dental and oral care, skin care products, detergents, hair, natural fibres, wastewater technology. Despite all efforts to understand the natural sciences, basic knowledge is required to make reading fun. (2) (Uta Nieper)

content.text: Atlas of the Fish in the Schleswig-Holstein Wadden Sea. Within the framework of a research project "Ecosystem Research Schleswig-Holsteinisches Wadden Sea" supported by the UN, the fishing biologists R. Vorberg and P. Breckling have prepared a detailed inventory of the wadden fish. 63 species of fish are systematically presented in this fish atlas, their way of life and reproduction are described, their occurrence regionally and Europe-wide mapped and their place in the ecosystem of the Wadden Sea, the threat status on the one hand and the importance for the North Sea fisheries on the other documented. Detailed drawings of single specimens, mostly young fish, illustrate the scientifically accurate representation.

content.text: Lexicon of Eco-Irrities: surprising facts about energy, genetic engineering, health, climate, ozone, forests and many other environmental topics. "The waste mountain grows", "The forest dies", "Wale and elephants die out", "We are heading towards a climate catastrophe". Behind such headlines is often a conglomerate of contradictory and questionable figures, from assumptions and estimates, missing measurements and unknown connections, which have to do with faith rather than with knowledge when looking at them. Dirk Maxeiner and Michael Miersch crack the disaster consensus, report doubts and let scientists speak, which are usually flat rolled by the Kassandra cartel. They plead for a new beginning in eco-movement and environmental policy. Instead of maintaining frozen world images, they recommend cheerful enlightenment and a constructive culture of change. They bring to the table sound figures and facts, which allow a much more differentiated picture of the situation of the planet.
content.title_en: Lexicon of Eco-Irrities: surprising facts about energy, genetic engineering, health, climate, ozone, forest and many other environmental topics

The various stations in the Buddha's life are brought in connection with the present places of pilgrimage in India and illustrated by (not very attractive) black and white photographs that the author made on a trip to India. content.text: What can and should be the effect of education? : Possibilities and limits of educational influence. Klappentext: The question of what can be the effect of education has been investigated by the author with a system-theoretical approach, which understands education as a communicative process for the purpose of the exchange of information between educators and educand. The processing of the communications is described with assumptions from the late work of Piaget and neurobiology on the development of humans through learning. The work, following Dilthey, highlights the normativity of a general educational goal, but from which the historical relativity of the respective desired competences can be clearly distinguished. In this sense, some positions in the history of education are examined exemplarily and the current German educational theory is critically questioned. But also the analytical empirical education theory must allow on this basis modifications of its view of causality in the educational process.
content.title_en: What can and should education do? : Possibilities and limits of educational influence

The volume impressively shows an elegant, classically simple variant of architecture that refuses to play. In the appendix works directory and bibliography. content.text: The fall of the Wall: the unintentional self-resolution of the SED state. The fall of the Berlin Wall on the night of 9 to 10 November 1989 marked the end of the GDR and formed the starting point for the state unity of Germany. At the same time, it acted as a fanal for the revolutions in Central and Eastern Europe and accelerated the collapse of the Soviet empire and the Soviet Union. Was the fall of the Wall a coincidence? Neither the SED nor the Ministry of State Security had planned this opening of the border, at least; the governments in East and West were inconceivable. Embedded in the historical context, the author examines the events of 9 November 1989. Based on numerous interviews with witnesses of time and directly involved parties, and on the evaluation of extensive document material, the author reconstructs the fall of the Wall in all details. He examines the decision-making process in the party and state apparatus of the GDR and deciphers the interrelation of individual acts on 9 November. The exciting presentation and the extensive document and extended interview section allow the reader to participate in the fall of the Wall as a central, symbolic event of German history of world-historical significance.
content.title_en: The Fall of the Wall : the unintentional self-dissolution of the SED state

content.text: Five after twelve: the global crash and the future of life. The social and ecological megatrends will lead to a global crash. content.title_en: Five after twelve : the global crash and the future of life

content.text: The series of classes for classes 3 and 4 is designed to provide children with knowledge in a seemingly banal but indeed highly interesting part of their everyday experience. They are interested in historical, technical, ecological, economic, medical and sociological aspects of laundry care in an exciting way. In a learning circle with thirty optional learning stations, they can gain valuable insights from this field of experience through independent experimentation, examination, presentation and playing. The series of classes is curriculum-oriented, thoroughly tested and practically prepared in school practice. A synopsis shows that this topic is provided in the curricula of almost all federal states. For each learning station, learning objectives are formulated, the required materials are listed, station assignments and research questionnaires are presented ready for copying.
content.title_en: Station work: Discovering, testing, experience : Example of laundry care earlier and today

content.text: Dictionary of Biology : English - German, German - English. With about 50000 terms of classical and modern life sciences this dictionary is about 12000 entries less extensive than O. I. Tschibissova's "Dictionary Biology. English-German" (1996; not presented in the discussion service). However, it offers both linguistic approaches (following in orthography and definitions of American spelling). Generic and species names of plants and animals are expressly excluded, in contrast to Tschibisowa. Here as there is worked with the concept of the thematic concept collection (clusters). Besides the more special specialist dictionary (environment, biotechnology, zoology etc.) Cole should be available where students, scientists and translators belong to the users. (3 A) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: Dictionary of Biology : English - German, German - English

content.text: Construction and living with wood: successful planning and wood processing for new construction, construction and renovation. In the series "Bau-Rat für den Bau-Start" (Blottner, 1998) and "Das Buch vom gesunde Wohnen" (BA 8/98) nine other books on the topic of building have already been published. This book contains no descriptions of houses with basic plan and prices but gives many tips and tricks on what to look for when dealing with wood. The book not only conveys much worth knowing about wood, how to handle craftsmen, how to procure raw material, but gives clear and understandable instructions for the homemaker, illustrated with many pictures (e.g., how to install a front door, bathroom and kitchen in a wooden house, how to lay floorings ...). Interesting is this book not only for the housebuilder but for all those who work with wood in any way. Just like the others from this series recommended. (1) (Elke Reher)
content.title_en: Construction and living with wood : successful planning and wood processing for new construction, extension and renovation

content.text: How children learn to speak: child development and the linguisticity of the human being. W. Butzkamm, a well-known language teacher (see ID 45/89), and his son as co-author give a very comprehensive overview of the main development steps in language acquisition in connection with the social development of the child up to preschool time. They also inform about the language acquisition of disabled children and discuss problems of school foreign language acquisition and teaching. In a small "pedagogy for parents" they give suggestions and advice on the promotion of language acquisition. A work that has been tried through many language examples and illustrative ways of presenting it in a way but in a first line as a book for pedagogically active people. - In addition to G. Szagun (last ID 33/91) and B. Reimann (BA 2/94) recommended for parents, complementing the counsellor of L. Clark (BA 9/95). (3 S) (Reinhold Heckmann)
content.title_en: How children learn to speak: child development and the linguisticity of man

content.text: The body symbolism of the Bible. Christianity is generally considered to be an enemy of the body and spiritualized. The authors show that the body and its organs have symbolic meaning in the Bible by means of numerous examples of texts and images. In this way, an exciting and vivid cultural history of our body is created. Dr. theol. Silvia Schroer is professor of the Old Testament and biblical environment at the University of Bern
content.title_en: The Body Symbolism of the Bible

content.text: Controlling in the hospitality industry : Focus points - practical examples. 2 major chapters "What is controlling?" and "What is controlling?" examine by means of examples and training units, which tasks a controller has, which tools he needs and which working techniques he must master. What concrete possibilities and solutions for personnel, cost, appointment, product, marketing, financial, investment and communication controlling especially in the gastronomic practice exist? A practical book for trainees and specialists in gastronomy and hospitality, students, teachers and managers of this field. A meaningful addition to "Business Economics for the hospitality industry" (BA 12/96) and H. Meisl (BA 3/94). (2) (Ingrid Bischoff)
content.title_en: Controlling in the hospitality industry : Focus points - practical examples

content.text: When all the ropes are broken: children and adolescents between education, therapy and punishment. The authors of this essay collection work in institutions of youth assistance or the youth psychiatry. They show which social and family conditions lead to the dissuasion and exclusion of children and young people and how negative experiences are repeated through false institutional intervention. Individual cases are presented and analysed, meaningful possibilities for assistance and model experiments presented. In 2 essays, the focus is on the subject-political considerations for the further development of youth assistance. The book is addressed to all those who work with children and young people, especially in the area of youth assistance, and would like to invite to the inter-institutional discussion. (3) (LK/W: Scharmann)
content.title_en: When all ropes tear : children and adolescents between education, therapy and punishment

content.text: Human and nature in the world religions: the foundations of a religious ecology. The question of the relationship between man and nature is one of the most pressing problems of our time. But at the center of the Holy Scriptures of the world religions are man and the question of his salvation and not ecological questions. Nevertheless, they always present man in relation to his environment. The present book shows that and how the relationship between man and nature is grasped in the traditions and teachings of the various major religions. On the basis of the respective beliefs and the ethics associated with them, perspectives and paths open up for a responsible approach to nature. With a view beyond the religious boundaries, the basic understanding for a dialogue of religions on the preservation of creation and thus the possibility of a general religious ecology arises.
content.title_en: Humanity and Nature in World Religions : Foundations of a Religious Ecology

content.text: How thinking arises in the head. The book provides insight into user's mental structures and the structure of the brain. The human mental abilities are explained.
content.title_en: How Thinking Is Made in the Head

content.text: We are interfering : ideas for a common future. They have fought against dictatorship and for a decent future. And they are interfering today, taking the challenges of the future on the background of their experience. What are their criteria for a political civilization that can survive freedom, human rights and dignity of the citizen - in view of the social, economic and ecological problems? An exciting book, especially in a period of paralysis and upheaval.
content.title_en: We get involved : ideas for a common future

content.text: New wooden architecture. Wood has been discovered internationally by architects as a building material again. An introductory chapter provides an overview of ecological consequences and technological developments of wood architecture. Subsequently, the author (architecture critic in England) documents 31 international, realized projects (4 from Germany) by famous or unknown architects in 5 chapters with different focuses (new aesthetics, special constructive possibilities, green buildings, houses in conjunction with nature, regional architecture). Each project is presented with a short text and presented in detail with location plans, drawings, colour and detail photographs. The book conveys the high technical and aesthetic status of the current international wood architecture, offers students new ideas for possible projects. Unfortunately, for public libraries the price is expensive, but for presentation, equipment and content is justified. (3) (LK/KA: Nibbrig)
content.title_en: New wooden architecture

content.text: Habitats: the great guide for ecological construction and living. The author is the editor-in-chief of the magazine "ÖKO-HAUS/ÖKO-TEST" and presents here in a large-format and heavy-weight (2.2 kg!) volume a comprehensive inventory on the topic of ecological construction. Introductory aspects such as solar construction, biologically healthy construction, energy-saving construction or sustainable construction in connection with future urban development are discussed. Subsequently the range of topics of rough construction, interior construction, pro and contra of individual building materials, house technology (inclusive compost toilet, rainwater use), apartment equipment up to ecological pest destruction and meaningful gardening equipment. Numerous indoor and outdoor photos show realized projects, detailed drawings explain structural connections. An address directory with consulting institutes and a literature directory serve for further help. The book offers a wealth of suggestions and solutions, which are so concentrated and compressed rarely found, is very understandable and before all ersteins warmest in the topic (1).
content.title_en: Habitats : the great guide for ecological construction and living

content.text: Media culture. Vilém Flusser is considered a "media philosopher" (taz). His philosophy of the new media, however euphoric it sometimes occurs, is based on the accounting for the segment of media that we usually think is the media par excellence: the mass media. In the exciting and excited process of the merging of telecommunications and digital technologies, Flusser saw the opportunity to escape television culture. The networking of society through the new media ultimately means a change in the cultural process, a "catastrophe of bourgeois culture", which, of course, also opens up possibilities for a new imagination: "There is nothing new before the catastrophe, only after it."
content.title_en: Media culture

content.text: Cathedrals of the leisure society : Short holidays in adventure worlds ; trends, backgrounds, effects. The collection of 18 contributions was created from a conference in 1994, which dealt in a wide sense with artificial holiday worlds, as they become more and more popular especially as destinations for day trips and short breaks. Ideally, offers are meant, which offer on a limited area both high-quality accommodation as well as special experience quality. Besides concrete descriptions of "Center-Parks", "Euro-Disney", "Damp 2000" among others, theoretical fundamental considerations, investigations about ecological compatibility, future perspectives among others. The most famous author is Hamburg leisure researcher Horst W. Opaschowski, otherwise planners, tourism experts, among others, readers with social science backgrounds are offered a partly with figures and data, rich material collection, the induction and the ability to critical assessment required. - For accordingly expanded stocks. (3) (Rolf Rashka)
content.title_en: Cathedrals of the leisure society : Short break in adventure worlds ; trends, backgrounds, effects

content.text: Successfully experiment with Nitinol Mini Robots : Memorymetal Muscles in practical use. The not unknown author for books describing the production, monitoring, control and regulation of mini robots (ID 24/98) deals in his latest book with the construction and control of robots with the Memorymetal Nitinol. The special feature of this nickel-titanium alloy is that it pulls together by current flow or by heating up to 8%. If the current flow stops or cools the material, it reaches its original length again. Robot beetles can move around, for example, by changing lengths without mechanical components. After the author approaches the properties, advantages and disadvantages of Nitinol, the construction of Nitinol beetles, including control, is explained step by step. Finally, some Nitinol robot examples are presented, e.g. after the author approaches the properties, advantages and disadvantages of Nitinol, and the art object "Gregor" (seen from a beginner as well as a reference point).
content.title_en: Successful experimenting with Nitinol Mini Robots : Memory Metal Muscles in practical use

content.text: Rain novel. When the Hamburg writer Leon finds his dream house on the edge of an East German bog, everything seems ready for a happy idyll. But the moor and the morass of human relations are treacherous. Just as the snail plague attacks the garden and the incessant rain the foundations of the house, so indifference and coldness penetrate Leon and his marriage. A rushed dog and the erotic confusion around the austere Kay and her never-sat fat sister Isadoa accelerate the decay...
content.title_en: Rainy novel

content.text: Prussia : Art and architecture. Klappentext: Prussia is generally associated with state-raeson and military rule. This one-sided view to loosen and open the view for the artistic readings of Brandenburg-Prussia takes place. The presentation takes the arc from the Middle Ages to classicist Berlin and shows the art creation in its international references. The broad overview opens up the whole range of art in Prussia, but focuses on architecture and garden art - the names range from Schlüter to Knobelsdorff to Schinkel, Prince Pückler-Muskau and Lenne. Reich illustrated with historical and new photographs, inspired the work to journeys of discovery along Spree and Havel.
content.title_en: Prussia : Art and architecture

content.text: Structure, study offer and areas of music colleges: planning materials. With this report, differentiated inventories and specific quantitative and qualitative planning aids are available for the music colleges. The aim of the survey was to provide a compressed overview of the structure, the range of studies and the area supply of music colleges in Germany, which includes as much as possible all institutions. Furthermore, it was intended to provide insights into specific areas of use and equipment requirements necessary for understanding these universities and for the implementation and evaluation of individual planning. The material should not only take into account requirements of a lavish planning at an early stage, but also provide comparative information and detailed information for the planning of individual typical areas of music colleges. Structure: PART A. KURZPORTRAETS. - PART B. GENERAL SUPERVISION 1. Tasks and University Access 2. Structure and study offer 3. Students and staff 4. Area inventory. - PART C. BAUBEZOGENE MATERIA AND PLANNING HINTS 1. Materials for individual areas of use (including ensemble rooms, exercise rooms, chamber music rooms, office rooms, etc.)
content.title_en: Structure, study offer and areas of music colleges : planning materials

content.text: Foreign worlds: the conflicting interpretation of the GDR by SED reformers and citizens' movement in the 1980s. Although they had to struggle with the same problems in the GDR and had quite similar experiences, their conclusions were completely different: while the SED reformers wanted to improve socialism and use its institutions for it, the civil rights activists refused to form the structures of power and created a morally oriented counter-public in the church-related area. An understanding between these two worlds hardly took place. The authors investigated the family and social imprints of the participants in a variety of detailed interviews and worked out the highly different collective identities and the central "codes" of the respective discourse communities.
content.title_en: Foreign worlds: the conflicting interpretation of the GDR by SED reformers and citizens' movement in the 1980s

content.text: Saturday: about the emergence and change of a modern time institution. As is obvious to most people, the weekend begins on Saturday at the latest. But as a result of the progressive flexibilization of working and operating hours, Saturday is increasingly becoming a normal working day. This raises the question of its everyday practical meaning, but also of its symbolic value in a world that is still modernizing. This collection examines the origins and career of the time institution 'free Saturday' since the 1950s, by looking at a variety of facets and aspects: Cultural and economic, sociological and labour-political, legal and collective bargaining aspects are also discussed, as are religious questions and the comparison with countries that have other traditions. The comprehensive inventory results in an attempt to determine the location: Is Saturday still free?
content.title_en: Saturday : about the emergence and change of a modern institution of time

content.text: The history of the German National Socialist Party, which is divided into eight major themes, is particularly suitable for students, and possibly even for more advanced school needs. It provides a concise presentation of the most important political facts and a research history on National Socialism. The historical controversy, such as the historian's dispute or the Goldhagen controversy, is put into the political context of their time and critically analysed. In the first chapter, the Berlin historian, who has emerged from numerous publications on the subject (see BA 3/98, ID 23/97), examines the different interpretations of the Nazi state. The analysis of selected policy areas (social and economic policy, youth policy, church struggle and resistance, etc.), which are each structured according to "facts" and "controversies", is followed by a well-used list of literature and registers of authors and persons. The footnotes are - less easy to read - placed between chapters. (3) (Engeldrecht Boversen)
content.title_en: Controversial Past : Facts and Controversies on National Socialism

content.text: The ironic nation of the Sociology as a time diagnosis. At the moment of farewell one realizes in a painful way what one has lost. The old Federal Republic is today the subject of many declarations of love. The small practical state of the Bonn Republic is celebrated as a civil mixture of efficiency and modesty. How was that possible? Still lacks a term for this provisional long-term, which has suddenly become history. Under the title of the ironic nation, the band gives an answer to the question of the origins of the old and new Federal Republic. Compared to the GDR, it is clear how irony and tragedy of the Germans spread in the post-war period. There, with antifascist emphase, a counterstate was founded, here with post-fascist integration awareness continued. But at last, the historical demolition company in the West proved to be more promising than the folk-own upstart project in the East. The band gathers sociological descriptions from the unification and turn of the nineties. It is about the distance between the old and the new Länder, about the emergence of a youth movement from right and the sudden outbreaks of the sociology also the rest of the general civilization.
content.title_en: The ironic nation : Sociology as a time diagnosis

content.text: The author is a psychologist with a master degree in Aikido. The philosophy of this humane martial arts, which he combines as a "path of harmony between man and universe", is based on the concept of his educational experience with children and young people: to experience nature with all senses simultaneously leads to the deepening of the inner perceptive capacity. In addition to the projects mentioned in the title, playfully incorporated movements of the aikido, gravity exercises, natural meditations and others - In addition to titles such as G. Kaiser, translator, author (last BA 7/95; 8/97) and "Internet stroller" (see BA 2/97), presents here both the sum of his PC experiences and a computer guide specifically for the "homme de lettre". He first makes some general (very apt) comments on the occupation with computerism, then he reports on his personal experiences with "mouse and machine" since the PC middle age (beginning 12 years ago), before he enters into practical information on hard- and software, especially on text processing (especially MS-Word). content.text: Calling - the direct way to the new job : Tips, tricks and training for the optimal telephone strategy. Calling is an effective application tool and contributes to the success of an application to a large extent. However, only if you master the right technology. This means: being able to listen actively; asking the right questions; developing a clever approach to advance to the "target person"; showing a diplomatic conversation and a favorable self-presentation. For all this there are hints and examples (e.g. for question types, for the oral short presentation, for dealing with gossip). Furthermore, suggestions for formulation and structuring aids for telephone calls are offered from the various occasions - before or after a personal conversation, as a thank you for an invitation, after an announcement or as an initiative application. 3 reviews, some advice for the use of the technology (fax, answering machine, mobile phone, e-mail) round off the matter. Very useful hints, which have been "treated" in other counsellors. (2) (Ulrike Knipping)
content.title_en: Calling - the direct way to the new job : Tips, tricks and training for the optimal telephone strategy

"It is certain that for every architect of museum construction today something meant the cathedral as before" concludes the famous exhibition designer H. Szeemann in his critical introduction to the development and consequences of the museum boom. In this volume are illustrated some outstanding new openings and museum extensions and explained (among others Guggenheim Bilbao, MOMA New York, Tate Gallery London, Getty Center Los Angeles), the architects are asked about the planning, intention and execution of their buildings. Can be used as "New Museums" (ID 3/91), where buildings and projects of the 80s were presented. (3) (LK/HL: Ittekkot)

content.text: The transformation of the welfare state: views of parties and welfare associations on the modernization of the state. Society is changing into a service-providing information society. The economy, with the help of electronic data processing and digitized communication, exceeds the boundaries of the nation state. In view of this, the state must modernize itself. The welfare state, the institutional pacification of the conflict between capital and labour in the industrial society, needs to adapt to the conditions of globalization. However, a 'remodelling' in society and politics is fiercely controversial. The author gives a theoretical introduction to this and lets municipal factions of the Bundestag parties and business leaders of large welfare associations speak with their views on the modernization of society, state and welfare state.
content.title_en: The transformation of the welfare state : views of parties and welfare associations on the modernisation of the state

content.text: The most modern diesel technology: TDI; the development of direct injection. Diesel engines are important drives for motor vehicles. For a few years, technical developments have been taking place in the passenger car sector, which have led to higher performance, lower fuel consumption and improved environmental properties. These include charging (e.g. with a turbocharger), direct injection and the "Common Rail" process. After historical review, current engines and models are presented. Bosch is the market leader in injection pumps and its products are almost exclusively used. The focus is on the TDI models of Audi and VW. Other companies, such as BMW and Opel (which, here unmentioned, had a model with "Comprex" charging on offer a few years ago), are only marginally mentioned. The rarely critical, often enthusiastical, factual book reads easily and reports the state of the diesel technology.
content.title_en: Modern diesel technology : TDI ; the development of direct injection

content.text: The young man: an African childhood. The South African author tells us of his difficult childhood in Cape Town in the 1940/50s: from the mother whose love crushes him, from the father he rejects and from the parental farm on which he feels most comfortable. "He has two mothers. He has born two times: from a woman born and from the farm. Two mothers and no father." This is how dissociated the South African author (lastly "The Master of Petersburg", BA 3/97) describes his own childhood. Through the unlucky father, a lawyer, the family often has to change residence in the 1940s/50s. Coetzee sees himself as an introverted, thoughtful boy who appreciates the love of his courageous mother, but at the same time feels burdened by it. He rejects the father, he keeps away from his younger brother as much as from the fellow students. Only on the farm, which belongs to the father's family, he feels comfortable. Intrusive, sober and yet poetically written portrait of a difficult childhood.
content.title_en: The boy : an African childhood

content.text: The media's speed of modernization is a constant phenomenon of a flickering time: the speed of the media. The use of mobile phones, faxes and the Internet makes our lives more beautiful, faster and more pleasant. The connection to the place and time is exchanged for the connection to the worldwide data network. The possibilities to create time with the media are quite diverse: media not only serve the acceleration of life, but also the extension of time: where during the day time time is successfully "spared" and processes are accelerated by telephone and fax, it is "deadly beaten" on long television evenings or in front of the computer. The question of time sovereignty is similarly ambiguous: if everyone wants to be and must be accessible everywhere and at all times, media abstinence becomes the increasingly frequently used time privilege. Beyond cultural-pessimist larmoyance, the authors ask how the media's push for modernization is related to the imminent ecological and social renewal of our society.
content.title_en: Flickering times : the pace of the media

content.text: The world is as we think it : to the cultural critique of the media society ; analyses and essays 1980 - 1999. Klappentext: Between the possibilities to know and the opportunities to understand, the gap is growing. This is one of the central and worrying paradoxes of the modern communication society. Under the intensified conditions of multimedia information acceleration with the simultaneous scarcity and absorption of time, the question of meaning not only remains, but becomes a survival problem: Which media-mediated and updated knowledge is existential, which fleeting and exchangeable? What possibilities exist to make communication about the world understandable from journalistic news? These are some of the questions that "The world is how we think it" raises and seeks to answer.
content.title_en: The world is what we think it is: on the cultural criticism of media society; analyses and essays 1980 - 1999

content.text: The intellectual foundation of the Federal Republic: an impact story of the Frankfurt School. The authors assume that among all intellectual groups, none of the political-cultural self-images of the Federal Republic of Germany has influenced more than the "Frankfurter Schule" (Horkheimer, Adorno, Marcuse, Habermas etc.). From this approach, the collection offers an analysis of its impact story. After preliminary essays on the development of critical theory in the 1920s and the situation in exile, the emphasis on the content of the Frankfurt School's establishment in the Federal Republic and the effects it had on the intellectual coping with National Socialism is precisely elaborated. For example, the Institute Policy of Horkheimer, the relationship to the mass media, the role played by the Frankfurt School in the student movement, its educational concepts and effects are an essential contribution to the elaboration of the political and cultural history of the Federal Republic, which is of great importance to the Frankfurt School without facing it uncritically. (3) (Gerhard König-Kurowski)

content.text: The overall economic importance of trade fairs and exhibitions in Germany. A key aim of the study was to determine which primary effects are derived from the organisation of trade fairs and exhibitions in Germany and to derive from the overall economic turnover and/or production and employment effects which can be attributed to them. Furthermore, the study also covered fundamental considerations on the range of trade fairs and exhibitions in the context of increasing globalization and the assessment as a marketing instrument for companies. The calculation of secondary and tertiary effects was carried out by the German Institute for Economic Research using input-output calculations based on the data obtained by FfH Berlin and the ifo Institute.
content.title_en: The economic importance of trade fairs and exhibitions in Germany

content.text: The basic outline of the regional and regional planning. Starting from a presentation of the historical roots, the spatial structure of the starting point and the legal framework for spatial planning in Germany, the tasks of the regional and regional planning are explained. European and cross-border planning tasks are particularly important. Sections on the performance of these tasks by the institutions of regional and regional planning and the legally binding instruments available to them are followed. In the discussion of the factors relevant for the implementation of the planning, a special focus was given to new cooperative procedures (moderation, mediation) and management-oriented planning approaches. The actors of the planning, their organization at the various planning levels as well as the training of the spatial planners were dedicated to a separate chapter. The volume concludes with an outlook on the future design of the German regional and regional planning.

content.text: Controlling and marketing in scientific libraries : (COMBI); Development of a practical marketing strategy for university libraries using the example of the University Libraries Düsseldorf and Magdeburg / hrsg. by Elisabeth Niggemann ... ; Vol. 2: Interim results and working materials 2 : the management of electronic document delivery - a central challenge for libraries. This volume 2 presents the interim results of the extended project "Marketing and controlling in scientific libraries" in the University Libraries Magdeburg and Düsseldorf under the aspect of the introduction and use of electronic document delivery. The focus is on the document delivery services SUBITO and JASON. In Magdeburg a strategy is developed to introduce SUBITO using benchmarking to optimize its own marketing by comparing with competing companies. In Düsseldorf, the aim is to examine the extent to which cost transparency for the university library can be achieved with the help of process cost accounting. Using the use of medical journals, the problem of access versus ownership is discussed in order to underpin the advantages of electronic document delivery. Finally, the establishment of a service center for telephone user consultation is described.
content.title_en: Controlling and marketing in scientific libraries : (COMBI); Development of a practical marketing strategy for university libraries using the example of the University Libraries Düsseldorf and Magdeburg / ed. by Elisabeth Niggemann ... ; Vol. 2: Interim results and working materials 2 : the management of electronic document delivery - a central challenge for libraries

(BA 10/79), or very rare. The modified doctoral thesis by U. Poschartt (BA 3/98) for example is mainly devoted to the relationship "disk jockey and pop culture". After the first rainwater usage systems were designed in the "Do it yourself-fast-track procedure", one has learned from errors and now approaches planning and construction with experience and knowledge. The book first explains the calculation of catch area and cistern, describes the house water system and the professional laying of the pipes. Then 3 usage systems are presented: a simple one with extended comfort and analog control unit and one with digital control unit. In the annex are described individual works, named reference addresses, map board layouts and regulations and listed supports. Thus the experienced home-worker can build his plant himself or inform himself before he commissioned a company. The volume "Collect rainwater and use" (BA 2/97) is kept simpler. content.text: Now I learn shell programming: [the effective handling of the Linux/Unix command line; for Bash and Korn shell]. UNIX and Linux are already often operated under a graphical user interface. However, working from the command line allows faster, more flexible and more effective problem solving. As already known from the DOS world with batch programming, individual commands can be combined to command line programs, called UNIXworld scripts, and thus give possibilities for automation of workflows. As a shell, i.e. as an interface that accepts input from the user and converts it into actions via operating system or programs, the authors choose bash (bourne-again shell). In practice-oriented presentation, based on many examples, they develop the basics of shell programming, i.e. the creation of scripts. Focuses are on queries and loops, functions, processes and signals, when time-controlled starting scripts and when handling errors. Many tips and tricks. Tasks with Linux programming are assumed for Linux users's basic skills.
content.title_en: Now I learn shell programming: [the effective handling of the Linux/Unix command line; for Bash and Korn shell]

content.text: Brick architecture in the villages of the Mark Brandenburg : barns, storage rooms, stables, pigeons, walls and gate pillars ; an inventory. The brick buildings in the villages of the Mark Brandenburg are monuments that characterise the cultural landscape of this space in a unique way. They are part of a cultural heritage that must be recalled back to the consciousness of the Brandenburger and Berlin population. These profane buildings, which were built mainly in the Gründerzeit, show a perfect connection between functionality and aesthetics. The diversity of their brick decoration elements, including friezes, cornices, gable arches, windows and other ornaments, is remarkable. The original symbols of the buildings, which represent protective, help and petition functions, are an expression of the faith and the treasure of the peasant population.
content.title_en: Brick architecture in villages of the Mark Brandenburg : barns, storage rooms, stables, pigeons, walls and gate pillars ; an inventory

content.text: Further education on the Internet. R. Merk is active in the field of continuing education (see "Paedagogues make themselves independent", ID 42/97). His new book is aimed at Internet newcomers who are also active in this field. After a fundamental introduction to the possibilities of the Internet (technical preconditions, computer possibilities) follows an introduction of relevant databases (including library catalogues). Using the example of some search terms, results are presented. Homepages of educational institutions and the search possibilities for seminars and providers of telelearning as well as chat forums are presented. A glossary explains the most important technical terms around the Internet. (3 A) (LK/W: Scharmann)

content.text: Quantums are different: the hidden unity of the world. In addition to relativity theory, quantum theory is one of the most significant theories of the 20th century. The author, Professor of Physics Didactics, first explains their history, and then (without formulas) it describes its most important characteristics, discusses the relationships between classical physics and quantum physics and finally discusses the relationship between natural and human sciences on the basis of quantum theory. In holistic thinking, he notes that, and especially here (e.g., an atom) the whole is more than the sum of the parts and that through the "determination of possibilities" a meaningful compromise can be found between predeterminedness and freedom. Thus, he brings new accents into the discussion of physics and philosophy (see H. Preuß, ID 9/98). (2) (Michael Mücke)
content.title_en: Quantums are different : the hidden unity of the world

content.text: Migration and tradition formation. The view of tradition is in the movement after the end of the Cold War, the new constitution of Europe and universal globalization less a view of preserved or surviving, but a sudden realization of the "necessity of the constant tradition of the accumulated cultural goods" and thus also of the possibility for a "new" access of new cultural leaders (in the sense of Karl Mannheim). This requires not only the continuous change of generations and the rise and descent of new social groups, which shaped the process of tradition at all times, but above all the processes of migration that have been ongoing and changing since the Second World War. - I. The dialectic of Jewish tradition formation after the Holocaust II. Tradition formation and ethnicity in modern labour migration III. Transformation processes of traditionality in the global periphery

content.text: Wool and silk with natural substances color: bright colours without toxic additives. Apart from the very personal, strongly esoteric introduction to the author's motivation to dye with natural substances, and the importance of the colours, this is a well-founded guide for the dyeing of wool and silk with vegetable colours and cochenille. The complete absence of toxic chemical additives when applying the pickling and development baths, which even the old masters in natural dyeing, E. Bächi-Nussbaumer and L. Nencki, in some cases considered necessary, counters the strong natural connection of the hobby dyes, but increases the time expenditure and makes colour and durability even less predictable. Otherwise, the large, detailed collection of recipes offers a wide range of colours, which however, no corresponding pictorial color scales are compared, as they are illustrated in the not so completely chemical-free, but altogether comparable "colors with natural colours" of D. Berger (BA 11/98) but also a sample of vegetable sources and yarns.

content.text: Red Hat Linux for Dummies: against daily frustration with Linux. [Red Hat Linux is installed in a snap; X-Windows interface and command line dominate; start with Linux on the Internet]. Linus is a UNIX clone that is practically free of charge and can be run on IBM compatible, among other things. Linux is also gaining ever greater importance in the private sector and is becoming a competitor for Windows. Linux is spread in the form of distributions that contain large-scale utilities and application software besides the kernel - the core operating system. This introductory book describes the Red Hat Linux 5.2 distribution (which is included in the book on CD-ROM), but can also be used for other distributions with limitations. In a loose, humorous manner (many cartoons) the author introduces a UNIX/Linux expert of the first hour, into working with Linux. Focuses are in the installation, the graphical user interface, shells, file management, the use in the network, the Internet access, the utilities and troubleshooting. Goodly highlighted various possibilities of a customized configuration.
content.title_en: Red Hat Linux for Dummies : against the daily frustration with Linux. [Install Red Hat Linux in no time; dominate X-Windows interface and command line; start with Linux on the Internet]

content.text: "The social garden": the green manifesto. Lepercht Migge presented this publication with a new edition of the programmatic paper "German Inner Colonization - Sachgrundlagen des Besiedlungswesen" (German Inner Colonization - Sachgrundlagen des Besiedlungswesen), which he first published in 1926 in the series of German Garden City Society. At the beginning of this interim review during the construction period in the mid-1920s, Migge once again presented the "Green Manifesto", the critical disputation which he had spread after the end of World War I. In this report, he calls for a new conception of garden culture. His "Social Garden" is a productive garden that secures the existence of the city's citizen through self-help. Migge places it at the centre of a new settlement policy: the development of the city's edge combines housing, labour procurement, waste management, food supply and urban ecology from the beginning of the century.
content.title_en: "The social garden" : the green manifesto

They evaluated mainly archival material of the cities of Eckernförde, Flensburg and Husum. Their research results are generally valid for Schleswig-Holstein. content.text: The transformation process of the large chemical industry in Saxony-Anhalt. Results of the research project to investigate the overall process of conversion of the large chemical industry in the urban triangle of Bitterfeld, Halle, Leuna from the plan economic combination structure to market-economy conditions. The developments are considered both at the level of the combined or the enterprises as well as at the level of the industry with regard to the national and the world market situation. The economic conditions, the opportunities and restrictions that characterise the situation of the chemical industry are treated as well as the industrial policy of the Treuhandanstalt, the market and production policy of the company's managements as well as the labour policy and its consequences for the qualification, employment volume, research potential and the regulation of interests within the framework of the industrial relations. The study covers the period 1989 to 1992 and spatially the southern industrial area of Saxony-Anhalt with a limitation to the four former large combined or production locations Leuna, Buna, Bitterfeld and Filmfabrik Wolfen.

content.text: Technized communication. Publishing info: That people understand themselves face to face is not only the evolutionary primary form of communication, it is still the subjectively most important form for us today, which is the prototypical conception of what communication is (and how it should be) to a considerable extent. Against this background, one can call an understanding face to face (face to face) as elementary communication. In the course of social development, however, the possibilities of elementary communication in different directions and aspects are expanded. We would like to address these forms of expansion with the keyword 'technization of communication'. Essential constituents of this technology are secondary symbol systems (e.g. writing systems), technical apparatuses (e.g. printing machine, telephone, radio and television) and conservatory storages (e.g. books, tapes, diskettes). They play a role in the various forms of technologicalized communication in different combinations and with varying weight. Was social communication initially nothing but the system of elementary communication, they have become increasingly complex in the way of the existing forms.
content.title_en: Technical communication

content.text: Introduction to phylogenetics and systematics : 27 tables. Since the fundamental work of Willi Hennig from the 1950s, the systematics have experienced a renaissance. Today, they are again regarded as a serious discipline that leads to verifiable statements and in their methodology meets the demands of scientific research. This book conveys principles that allow biologists and those interested in systematics to deal with the historical connection of the diversity of organisms. The authors present the phylogenetic questions based on numerous examples from the animal and plant kingdom and address the pros and cons of hypotheses and their probability assessment. In addition, suggestions for discussion and guidance for practical work are given. The volume is ideally suited to promoting phylogenetic-systematic work and evolutionary biology at universities and advanced school courses.

content.text: Right-wing extremism and xenophobia: concepts, positions, fields of practice. Since the election successes of right-wing parties in Western Europe and the breaking up of juvenile right-wing extreme violence, the political public and social sciences have been heavily discussing causes and countermeasures. However, the sometimes hectic efforts to find appropriate analyses and alternative actions are often insufficient, because important concepts are used in a vague manner and structural contexts are underestimated or not seen. This volume provides an overview of the unconscious debate by presenting and discussing the central concepts and problems. The author's thesis is: Modern right-wing extremism draws its political dynamics primarily from the meeting of increasing social inequality, antidemocratic orientations/trends/trends and an ethnization of social relations resulting from unprocessed migration.
