content.text: Specialized dictionary for aerospace. Short reference work for laymen with information on technology, transport, space travel, including biographical entries. Includes approximately 2500 keywords and provides easy to understand, concise definitions. Can be used alongside H. Schliephake (BA 7/85) and the more detailed "Lexikon der Luftfahrt" (BA 8/92). As a handy, not too thorough compendium for loan and for presence stocks. (2 A) (LK/N: Pleuß) Short reference work with approx. 2500 keywords on technology, transport, space travel and important personalities. (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Technical Dictionary Aerospace

content.text: Sara and Simón: an endless story. Sara Méndez must flee Uruguay in 1973 and continue to fight the regime from Argentina. When she is abducted by a command of the intelligence service, she must leave behind her newborn son Simon. Only years later she finds out about him.
content.title_en: Sara and Simón : an endless story

content.text: Scissors, stone, paper : Sophie's story. Larkin lives with his family on a small tourist island. One day he finds a basket with the whimpering 1 year old finder Sophie...
content.title_en: Scissors, stone, paper : Sophie's story

content.text: The changes from the 'city in socialism' to the 'city in capitalism' and the problems associated with it are the subject of this volume. The contributions deal with the spatial and social changes that have taken place in terms of the external appearance, organization of the city, the urban structure and the social composition of quarters: changes in everyday organisation, changes in usage structures, new forms of social segregation, urban development and suburbanisation, restitution of private property in real estate and privatization of new housing, changes in neighbourhoods and residential environments, development of housing quality and rents, new citizens' initiatives, the future of flat building settlements and urban renewal. Thus, "city development in eastern Germany" offers a first overall picture of the new living and living conditions in the East German cities.
content.title_en: Urban development in East Germany : social and spatial trends

content.text: The plate: industrialized housing in the GDR. Klappentext: This book deals with the industrialization of housing in the GDR. The "plate" as its main product and its urban development are outstanding symbols of an urban policy with which the social conditions in the GDR should be remodelled in a structural-spatial way - unfortunately without the long-term success hoped for. It was the peculiar mixture of scientific belief, political and economic centralization and tons ideology, which led, in association with the neglect of the old building substance in the GDR, to the collapse of the state from a housing policy perspective. Starting from a socio-technical historical representation of the industrialization of construction, the author analyses the specific processes and results of urban development in the GDR. An outlook on the future of the East German large settlements under the new social conditions completes the work.
content.title_en: The record: industrialized housing in the GDR

content.text: Theory and Numerics of Elliptical Differential Equations : with examples and exercises. A textbook stressing a uniform treatment of theory and numerics for mathematicians, physicists and engineers in study and practice.
content.title_en: Theory and Numerics of Elliptical Differential Equations : with examples and exercises

content.text: Cybersociety : Myth and reality of the information society. Klappentext: Telearbeit, Teleshopping, Telebanking, Interactive television - virtual worlds are already increasingly determining our everyday life. How does this development affect social relations, working environments, leisure and consumer behaviour? Achim Bühl is based on literary and filmic Since Fiction and the utopias and horror images designed there. After an overview of the technical foundations of virtual worlds, he examines the state and perspectives of this megatechnology by means of important applications: military and space, construction and design, production and service, medicine, psychology and psychiatry, education and entertainment. The book comprehensively reviews the social consequences and technological consequences of virtualization and makes myth and reality of the information society understandable.
content.title_en: Cybersociety: Myth and reality of the information society

content.text: Algebra der Computerarchitekturen. Klappentext: Architektur ist Planen und Bauen. The plan of a computer architecture is accordingly algebraic; its concrete structure and behaviour have the same - ordered algebraic - structure. The book deals with this structural equality and is thus an introduction to algebraic system theory. On the Internet there are test chapters available. The author discusses - based on his experience from 50 years of computer development - all essential computer architectures and programming methods as applications of this theory and sets standards for their critical evaluation. The structure in chapters such as construction forms, construction rules, flexible construction, plan and execution deliberately emphasizes the analogy to the building system and thus shows with what right computer architecture is ever spoken of. The book addresses scientists and practitioners who want to fundamentally inform themselves about the method theory of computer design. Since it requires little prior knowledge and is systematically built up, it can also be well read by advanced students of computer science and mathematics. Dr. rer. nat. Wolfgang Everling is professor at the Institute for Computer Science, Department Calcology and Calcology, at the University of Friedrich-Wil-Wil.
content.title_en: Algebra of computer architectures

content.text: After 2000 years of Christian proclamation, the churches, forgotten and exhausted, stand on the ruins of their old power. Stupidly before the challenges of the high-tech society, they have made themselves superfluous. They could be as important as never before. Reimer Gronemeyer shows that and how the church could become an avant-garde in its decline to its original ideas: heretical, heretical, ascetic. A disputation against and for the church.
content.title_en: What more church?

content.text: The EC Eco-Audit-Regulation: with eco-controlling to the certified environmental management system. Twenty experts, among them a graduate biologist or engineer, have developed the compendium, specifically to show in all details the advantages that a certification can have (base: EC Regulation No. 1836/93 - printed in the annex). Their objectives are not only the environmental relief, but also of course the competitive advantages. To date, 5500 companies in Germany have participated in the process, which attests objectives and measures of an active environmental-oriented management system at all operational levels in the course of an "environmental audit" at all levels. How the company can simultaneously operate quality assurance according to DIN/ISO 9000 (in addition to this also Gerd F. Kamiske's "Quality Management" (ID 37/93), is also explained in an understandable and practical manner (checklists, case studies). If the volume is required, the volume is a good addition to Volker Stahlmann (ID 51/94) and Erika Schulz "Environment controlling ..." (ID 37/93). (3) (Angela E. Kardung)
content.title_en: The EC Eco-Audit Regulation : with eco-controlling to the certified environmental management system

content.text: Historical gardens in Schleswig-Holstein. The book documents about 100 historical gardens in Schleswig-Holstein in a local alphabetic sequence. The beginnings of the local garden art are in the 16th century; the investigation ranges from the Renaissance gardens of the time to the reform garden movement at the beginning of this century. Examples are residence and mansion gardens, town and villa gardens of the bourgeoisie, spa facilities and city parks; their original shape is hardly recognizable today. The documentation includes the design ideas of the respective epoch, the historical development, botanical features and an inventory of the present state. Extensive annex with directory of garden gesalter, plant names, technical expressions etc. Important publication on a previously little-educated topic; result of a five-year research project of more than 30 scientists at Kiel University. Despite the price wider acquisition desirable.
content.title_en: Historical gardens in Schleswig-Holstein

content.text: Agriculture East counter-Treuhandmodel. Luft, professor and agricultural expert in the former GDR, is committed to ensuring that East German agricultural structures are not further destroyed with their large-scale agriculture and their forms of community economy. They are quite competitive and profitable, the management of the former LPGs has been denounced as an old team in advance, while he does not deny that fraud has occurred in some villages as part of the re- and re-establishment. He supports the description of the transformation process and his proposals for new cooperations, market and product strategies with meaningful figures and also refers to the discussion in specialist publications - in this respect, the narrow study requires special interest. West German farmers will not share all points of view. (2) (Elke Günther)
content.title_en: Agriculture East versus Trust Model

content.text: The Labyrinthic: about the idea of the hidden, mysterious, difficult in the history of architecture. Jan Pieper: "The Labyrinthic. About the idea of the hidden, mysterious, difficult in the history of architecture". ed. by Heinrich Klotz. Vieweg Verlag, Braunschweig/Wiesbaden 1987. 290 pp., née, 98,- DM
content.title_en: The Labyrinthic: about the idea of the hidden, mysterious, difficult in the history of architecture

content.text: Social work on the elderly: pedagogical approaches and the design of lifestyles in old age. This book develops discussion bases and perspectives that arise from the demands of a modern and pluralized age phase for social work on the elderly.
content.title_en: Social work for the elderly: pedagogical approaches and the design of lifestyles in old age

content.text: Recommendations on doctoral education and the promotion of young university teachers. These include the opinions of the Research Council of 1994 on the continuation of the Research Training Group programme and its recommendations on doctoral training from 1995 and on the promotion of young university teachers from 1996 as a comprehensive concept. In this context, the report documents the university's achieved performance in the international perspective and highlights structural, organisational and qualitative weaknesses which need to be resolved decisively. The statistical annex contains 15 tables with differentiated data on professors (proportion of Habilitation, by subject group and university), Habilitation by subject group (1976-1995, proportion of women), Habilitation frequency by subject group and university, average age of Habilitation (1970-1995, subject groups), gender distribution, doctoral and post-doctoral qualifications of the former GDR and new Länder, Young Talents scholarships by subject area (1991-1994), proportion of women in academic staff at universities (1986, 1987, 1991, university type) and the stock of professors up to 2020 (temporary, differentiated by subject group). (F/text)
content.title_en: Recommendations on doctoral training and support for young university teachers

content.text: Baroque: German architecture 1600 - 1760. By Hansmann (born 40), specialist for baroque architecture and garden art, he appeared in Europe in 1978, among others, "Baukunst des Barocks" (BA 12/78, 295). In his latest work, he examines baroque architecture in Germany, in relation to Italian and French "original images". As in the above work, he shows important examples of sacred, domination, urban and residential architecture in the "wide range of building tasks and solutions". He is concerned with "the essence of a building as holistic as possible" in "form, function and meaning content" and with bringing Baroque architecture to the attention of antiquity and Renaissance, which "with all its meaning for the intoxicating and excessive" preserves the legality of measure and number. With numerous black and white illustrations, basic plans and bibliographic apparatus. (2 S) (Christa Chatrath)
content.title_en: Baroque : German architecture 1600 - 1760

content.text: The Cross: History and Meaning. Baudler, professor of theology in Aachen, has written a cultural, symbolic and religious history of the Cross. The richly illustrated book leads to the sacrificial cross through the archaeological finds of "Jägerkreuz" and "Mother's Cross". In the second part of the book, the religious-historical-symbolic and theological content of the crucifixion of Jesus as well as the depictions of the crucifix in Christianity are discussed. Impressive is the abundance of the presented material and the factual-precise argumentation of the author as well as the excellent literary list. In contrast to Wilhelm Ziehr: "Das Kreuz" (BA 5/97), which is more artistically oriented and works with colored images, Baudler goes into the theological and/or religious historical backgrounds. Depending on the orientation, both books on this current topic ("Kruzifix-Beschluss" of the BVG) are widely recommended. (2) (Alfred Sobel)
content.title_en: The Cross : History and Meaning

content.text: Andreas Schlüter : Architect and sculptor of the Prussian Baroque. In 1937, the architect and sculptor Schlüter, whose most famous building was the destroyed Berlin Castle, published this title on Schlüter's Berlin years. The well-understood, albeit very baroque-pathetic text, is now a departure from the numerous expressive black and white illustrations that show historical photographs of some irretrievably lost buildings and sculptures. The art historian H. Börsch-Supan wrote a clever, differentiated post-word to this new print, in which he points to the time-bound nature of the first publication, highlights the importance of Schlüter's work and calls for a new, schlüter's complete monograph. (3) (LK/HL: Ittekkot)
content.title_en: Andreas Schlüter : Builder and sculptor of the Prussian Baroque

content.text: Street Social Work and Youth Violence : Experiences and Conclusions from Model Projects in Schleswig-Holstein. The book on three model projects, which Wurr/Dittrich accompanied over the period of three years, contains some surprising insights, such as the dialogue between street social work and police, the recruitment of street workers and the sponsorship of street work projects.
content.title_en: Street social work and youth violence : experiences and conclusions from model projects in Schleswig-Holstein

content.text: Consent to Creation: a contribution to the ethical judgement in relation to genetic engineering and its application to microorganisms, plants and animals. A contribution to the ethical judgment in relation to genetic engineering and its application to microorganisms, plants and animals, presented by a working group of the Evangelical Church in Germany
content.title_en: Consent to Creation: a contribution to ethical judgement in relation to genetic engineering and its application to microorganisms, plants and animals

content.text: Mathematics at the Technical University and the Technical University Berlin 1770 - 1988. The brochure tries to give an overview of the scientific activity of mathematicians who worked at the Technical University of Berlin and its predecessor institutions, the Berg-, the Bau und der Gewerbeakademie, from 1770 to 1987. These academies were training places, which for a long time did not expect any research from their teachers due to this activity. The teaching activity was carried out by the department. Structure: I. Mathematics at the Bergakademie (1770-1916) II. Mathematics at the Bauakademie (1799-1879) III. Mathematics at the Gewerbeakademie (1821-1879) IV. Mathematics at the Technische Hochschule V. The mathematicians at the TH/TU Berlin and the Berlin Mathematical Society VI. Directory of mathematicians who worked at the Berg-, Bau- or Gewerbeakademie, the Technische Hochschule or Technische Universität or are VII. Table VIII. List of doctoral, postgraduate and private lecturers for mathematical fields.
content.title_en: Mathematics at the Technical University and the Technical University Berlin 1770 - 1988

content.text: Environmental indicators : Planning, control and control parameters for environmental management. In five chapters this book provides information on the state of development, the performance possibilities and the performance limits of operational environmental indicators. First, the indicators are shown in their mapping and steering function within the framework of controlling. The second chapter deals with the fundamental linking of the objectives of sustainable economic management with the environmental indicators management. Chapters three to five then show the state of development of the work with indicators in three important sectors: industry, trade and banks. Chapters three to five are written in a continuous application-related manner. The book addresses students and lecturers of universities as well as the practitioner.
content.title_en: Environmental indicators : planning, control and control parameters for environmentally-oriented management

content.text: The 1950s: Home - Faith - Glory; the style of a decade. This rich text book is good for a surprise: The authors succeed in rehabilitating a decade: the 1950s are not only sweet kitsch and post-war provisional, they are also (!) searching for stylistic clarity, formal rigour and the separation of National Socialist power-through-joy aesthetics. The authors prove this with excursions into the world of film and fashion, architecture and design, photography and theatre. Best researched texts without false dogmatism, a skilful selection of images and excellent printing make the volume an important document over a decade that they had thought was all the essentials said. (See H. Karassek: "Go West", BA 11/96 - a time portrait with autobiographical features, and the classic on the subject: "The Puntity of the Republic", ID 4/79/94, 154). (2) (Bettina Scheurer)
content.title_en: The 1950s : Home - Faith - Glory; the style of a decade

content.text: Holiday camps of course! : practical ecology in school and youth recreation. Camp days offer a unique opportunity to realize exciting projects with young people and to also pay attention to environmentally friendly lifestyles.
content.title_en: Holiday camp of course! : practical ecology in school and youth recreation

content.text: World exhibitions. World exhibitions manifest themselves primarily through their built architecture, and thus this exhibition volume is a walk through 150 years of architectural history. Every exhibition from London 1851 to Seville 1992 (lookout for Hanover) is characterized by data, but above all with rich pictorial material. The architectural and art historian shows ephemeral prestige objects (mostly exhibition pavilions), which were often spectacular and innovative, evaluates, weighted and explains contexts. A little knowledge of art history does not harm reading. Nothing like it. (2) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: World exhibitions

content.text: Dynamics of marine sands : a manual for practical applications. The movement of sand and gravel in coastal waters, in the estuary of rivers is the subject of practical studies for the engineering sector. The book provides an introduction to processes of sedimentation and hydromechanics.
content.title_en: Dynamics of marine sands : a manual for practical applications

content.text: Toxicological Lexicon on Environmental Chemical Law : (ChemG, GefStoffV and ChemVerbotsV). The author of well-known works of analytical chemistry (last: BA 12/94 and ID 44/95) provides an important tool for every practitioner and apprentice in professional groups who have contact with chemical substances. In addition to recommending toxicological textbooks and specialist books. The importance of the most important toxicological terms and elementary connections are explained by reference to legislation and practical relevance. Toxicologically important parts of chemical and hazardous material law (e.g. chemical law, hazardous substance regulation, chemical prohibition regulation) are also quoted literally. (2 S) (LK/B: Müller)
content.title_en: Toxicological Lexicon on Environmental Chemical Law : (ChemG, GefStoffV and ChemVerbotsV)

content.text: The "New Social Movements" (70s and 80s) were the "New Social Movements" such as the Women's, Peace and the Environmental Movement, while in recent years they were more anti-foreign violence and extreme right-wing uprisings that attracted public attention. What can we say about these forms of movement, and what socio-scientific explanations are there? This volume tries to give answers. Renowned authors examine the New Social Movements and the Right-wing Extremism in various ways. This systematic coupling of theory and empiricism conveys the state of knowledge of German and international theories of social protest, and on the other hand, the volume provides a theoretical presentation of the two most influential types of movement of the last decades in Germany.
content.title_en: Paradigms of movement research : emergence and development of new social movements and right-wing extremism

content.text: Environmental protection in building permit procedure. The building permit procedure is of great importance for the enforcement of environmental protection requirements during construction. In the light of the amendments to the building and construction side law in all federal states in recent years, the report first examines the current regulatory status and the handling practice of construction and environmental regulations. The practical analysis focuses on case studies in five cities and a district. The main focus of the report is the presentation of the process process in terms of its importance for environmental protection as well as the presentation of the technical and technical bases and the handling practice. Recommendations for the effective integration of environmental protection into the building permit procedure as well as the coordination and coordination of all parties in connection with the effective implementation of the administrative implementation round off the report.
content.title_en: Environmental protection in the building permit procedure

content.text: Modern English for mechanical engineers : an entertaining training book. The well-known specialist author offers a training book to expand the language and technical knowledge. Turns mainly to students and practitioners of machine and plant engineering, besides also to specialist translators and contains reading pieces (with vocabulary), detailed drawings on machines, pronunciation aids, a dictionary of words in the appendix. An audio CD with further learning units, exercises and aids for pronunciation. Unlike "Engineering English" (see G. Moellerke: ID 31/91, 2nd edition 1996) the volume contains no explanations about grammar, thus is no language guide. It requires linguistic prior knowledge, but informs briefly, also thanks to the scattered caricatures and vignettes. Thus, it appears more widely applicable than the above mentioned title. (2) (Alfred Pleuß)
content.title_en: Modern English for mechanical engineers : an entertaining training book

content.text: New ways of the day after tomorrow: ecological utopias since the 1970s. As a result of the general attention given to the results of the Club of Rome (Meadows: "Borders of Growth": BA 293, 121) at the beginning of the 1970s and with social and political movements, ecological utopias (here, in this context, Ernest Callenbach's "Ecotopia" was at the centre of the project, perhaps already maculated in many libraries, but still on the market: 3rd edition 1995, and: in English school reading), as a counterpoint to linear belief in progress. Idler analyses the ecological utopias and the social and discursive environment of the time. - In conjunction with Callenbach, already useful for medium-sized stocks. (2) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: New ways to the day after tomorrow : ecological utopias since the 1970s

content.text: Electronic distance and direction measurement. Compared to the last edition discussed here (ID 29/91) updated with regard to the technical developments, especially in the sections on calibration procedures, direction measurement, measuring systems and energy supply. content.text: The language of colours: changing the meaning of colour in visual art. This volume is the continuation of Gage's successful "cultural history of color" (ID 21/95) and contains mainly earlier published journal and book contributions or lectures by the author on the subject. In the 21 chapters, Gage addresses the different scientific, philosophical and art-scientific aspects of colour perception, in particular the connection between colour and the linguistic expression for colours and the culturally historical change of colour concepts and color assignments as well as the color theories and their practical conquest by the artists. It is fascinating how the author directs new perspectives in each chapter on the seemingly old and omnipresent phenomenon of color and thus this sophisticated book will find readers in the wake of the previous volume. It is also applicable where M. Bruns "Das Pädtel Farbe" (ID 27/97) is located. (3) (Irene Ittekkot)
content.title_en: The language of colours: changing the meaning of colour in visual art

content.text: Steel Fibre. Elementary introduction to steel production and application, taking into account the materials science and design. Based on the issue of A.-K. Bolbrinker (Verlag Stahleisen, 1989, not discussed here), updated (data; standardization) and extended by 30 pages. Contains numerous photos, drawings and tables and addresses a wide user group (trainers, skilled workers, possibly interested lay people). A current comparative title is not known. (2 S) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Steel Fibre

The "Harenberg-Landenlexikon" (BA 3/99) and the "Landenlexikon" by Bertelsmann (BA 5/99) follow the new edition of the "Diercke-Landenlexikon", whose first edition dates from 1983 (BA 1/84). Each country contribution begins with the statistical overview box "State and Land", which follows the fixed headings of the natural space, history, population, economy, culture and "seeable cities and landscapes". content.text: The book describes 20 gardens of artists, mainly painters from Rubens to Nolde, but also sculptors, architects, etc. Not only gardens that served as a source of inspiration for artists, but also sculpture gardens such as those of Henry Moore. Other gardens, in turn, express the artist's personality. The gardens are documented by photographs, often compared to the artist's corresponding images. The text describes the life and work of the artist and his special relationship with the garden. While V. Russell (BA 11/96) focuses on the design and history of the garden of Claude Monet, this volume focuses on the artist's personality - including Monet - and his relationship with nature and the garden. Both art lovers and garden lovers will enjoy the book. (2) (Burchard Bulling)
content.title_en: Artists and their gardens

content.text: System theory and sport. The newer sociological system theory has been one of the few expanding paradigms in the social and human sciences for some time now. Through its ability to observe and describe social phenomena with the help of a differentiated theoretical instrument, it can provide orientation and overview in a highly complex society. If sport was still one of those social areas that were outside the analytical interest at the beginning of the system-theoretical reflection work, this abstinence is no longer durable due to the enormous growth of size and the unsurprising importance of sport. Today it is clear that modern society as a whole can only be understood if this field of person- and body-oriented this sideness is taken seriously in the same way as economics, politics or law and theoretically put into the concept.
content.title_en: System Theory and Sport

content.text: From the history of the divisions: Roman. Jörn returns to the places of his childhood in rural Mark Brandenburg in the summer of 1996, and descends deeper and deeper into his memories: the separation from his parents, overshadowed by the war and postwar needs Jörn returns to the places of his childhood in rural Mark Brandenburg in the summer of 1996, and descends deeper and deeper into his memories: the separation from his parents, overshadowed by the war and post-war needs.
content.title_en: From the History of Separations : Roman

content.text: The theory of constructivism is the theory of the physical outside world (environment). The theory of constructivism is the theory of the observation of a self-observing society, that is, a second order theory. This theory has different forms; it seems promising in particular to the systemic constructivism which Niklas Luhmann has founded. This is reported - including all sources, predecessors and currents. The report is an introduction to the philosophy of constructivist science. The theory of constructivism: Introduction, Reality, Metaphysics and Ontology, Constructivism: What is Const.?, Constr. in Art, Deconstruction - The World as Text, Cultural Architecture - The World as Space, The Problem of the Beginning, The Constructivist Theory, Origins of the Knowledgeful Constr., Enlightenment Theoretical Aspects of the Constr., Newer Currents of the Constr., The Theory of the Constr., The Theory of the Constr.
content.title_en: Knowledge - Constructivism - System Theory : Introduction to the philosophy of Constructivist Science
Water supply : Standards / ed.: DIN, German Institute for Standardization ; 3: Pipe network and accessories

content.text: The lexicon of food mycology: with 20 tables. Not only are molded foods not only a little appetizing, they also represent a significant economic and health problem. The most famous are the highly toxic aflatoxins, which also have a carcinogenic effect. The consequences of such spoiled foods can be devastating; in 1960 hundreds of thousands of farm animals such as turkeys or trout died from aflatoxin contaminated feed. Besides these food spoilers there are also various types of moulds that are used in food production. In the case of wine and beer, bread and baked goods, yoghurt etc., one would not want to do without the beneficial effect of yeasts, in the case of cheese on noble mould. In addition to the most important useful and harmful moulds, whose biology, toxins, occurrence and use, are also explained the basic terms of mycology and food technology (about 1200 key words). (Source: www.buchkatalog.de 10.07.2009)
content.title_en: Lexicon of Food Mycology : with 20 tables

content.text: Old sites in urban regions of Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia. Questions of revitalization potentials and problems of industrial old sites are important elements of the management of regional and urban development in the urban regions of Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia. Based on case studies, this volume provides approaches, experiences and results that have been achieved in the revitalization of old industrial sites in these countries. Methodological notes and the discussion of suitable instruments of location development and the use of location management methods complement this analysis.
content.title_en: Old locations in urban regions of Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia

content.text: Women in the city: Challenge of Modernism?. The terms "Gretchen", "Girl" and "Garçonne" from the introductory article refer to 3 opposing types from the 1920s and 1930s. On the one hand, young women were attracted to the city life because they thought they could be self-employed and emancipated there, on the other hand, reality often proved exploitative and threatening for body and soul. Positive and negative aspects in the women's life of the time, prejudices and cliche roles are clearly documented. (3) (LK/HH: Reimers)
content.title_en: Women in the Big City: Challenge of Modernism?

content.text: A house made of wood: planning, building, living. A thematically broad-based help for interested parties in the construction of a wooden house, which (aspiring) builders can also serve as a guide for discussions with architects and builders. It contains chapters on fundamental considerations about building, wood construction, short descriptions of wood construction in other parts of the world, but also very practical chapters in which planning, costs, correspondence with authorities, ecology, and of course the numerous technical questions, from excavation to materials, house technology, fire and sound protection, insulation, walls, doors, windows, roof to the living room and garden design are treated; even Feng Shui is not spared. The fact that much necessarily only needs to be treated in a very cursory manner is understood. The addition of more specific literature will be inevitable. Above all, interested parties who are in front of/against wood construction can be a good decision-making aid. - Widerly applicable as the titles of B. content.text: Combinatorial methods in chemistry and biology. Verlagsinfo: Combinatorial synthesis plays a major role in pharmaceutical research, for example: In drug search, it is important to produce as many molecules as possible as quickly as possible and to investigate their effectiveness. Combinatorial methods now enable the synthesis of many different molecules by combining a wide variety of building blocks. The most diverse substances - up to millions of similar molecules - can be represented automatically. By subsequent screenings on biological activity, one can rationally search for new drugs. From the content: * Peptid libraries * Non-peptide libraries * Chemical libraries * Combinatorial methods with molecular biological techniques * Analysis of libraries
content.title_en: Combinatorial methods in chemistry and biology

content.text: Life history and religion. Thomas Ruster, born 1955; Professor of Systematic Theology at the Faculty of Human Knowledge and Theology at the University of Dortmund.
content.title_en: Life Story and Religion

content.text: The discussion about genetic engineering as one of the most controversial technologies of the present day is increasingly leaving the narrow circle of scientists and is shifting more and more into the public. In a careful study by the Academy of Technology Assessment in Baden-Württemberg, experts from various disciplines have examined attitudes - fears like positive expectations - in various aspects and analysed in detail the formation of opinion by the media. - For the ongoing and further increasing knowledge of relevance for and resistance debate important for larger stocks. (3) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: Genetic engineering in public : perception and evaluation of a controversial technology

content.text: The art of thinking connected to one another: ideas and tools for a new approach to complexity. In view of an increasingly complex world, the inadequacy of conventional thinking becomes aware. What is hardly developed is a sense of the interrelationships that connect the things of the world. Every intervention in complex structures has highly complex consequences. Perfectly planned, the interactions that it triggers can lead to chaos. Nor does the enormous amount of information that can be accessed prevent this: more information rarely means better information. Frederic Vester and his team of the Study Group on Biology and Environment can look back on decades of experience in dealing with complex problems and situations. He summarizes these experiences in this handbook, which addresses politicians and managers as well as lay people. His central message is: The art of connected thinking is an essential extension.
content.title_en: The art of thinking connected: ideas and tools for a new approach to complexity

content.text: Private housing modernization in urban renewal areas of East German cities. Private housing modernization in urban renewal areas of East Germany is still facing considerable difficulties in the foreseeable future. The problematic economic development, the uncertainty about future transfers and subsidies of the federal and state states and finally the saturated housing market act as obstacles to a necessary revitalisation of the inner cities. The study contains a presentation of the conditions relevant to modernization in the East German cities as well as the guidelines, conditions and perspectives of the funding practice. Furthermore, the experiences of the main target group private housing modernization - the private house owner - are presented and corresponding practical suggestions for improvement for the modernization process developed. The study is based on the following work steps: expert surveys on local and interurban level, group discussions with house owners, a supplementary written presence survey of the participants at the group discussions as well as a brief survey on the importance of the private house owners in urban refurbishment areas of East German cities.
content.title_en: Private housing modernization in urban renewal areas of East German cities

content.text: Lavater's mask : Roman. In his new novel "Lavaters Mask" Jens Sparschuh tells the story of a writer who - also for him somewhat surprising - gets to Lavater, Goethe's friend-enemy and founder of physiognomy, makes the most absurd experiences in his research on the masquerades of life and almost loses his face.
content.title_en: Lavaters Mask : Roman

content.text: Organization and decision. Organizational formation requires a recognition rule that allows to determine which actions and aspects they have to be considered as decisions of the organization. This rule of knowledge is first and foremost a membership rule. It determines who is considered a member of the system and in which roles this membership can be exercised. By selecting personnel and defining roles, the organization is distinguished and differentiated against the surrounding other social. - Organizational theory: The classical constructions - Organization as an autopoietic system - Membership and motives - The paradox of decision-making - Time relations - Uncertainty absorption - Decision-making programs - Personnel - The organization of the organization - Structural change - Technology - Organization and society - Self-description - Rationality - Theory and practice
content.title_en: Organisation and decision

content.text: The city of Geschichte is the city of Geschichte, the history of the city from the Middle Ages to the present. With the aim of raising understanding for the historically grown city, Kiesow, chairman of the German Foundation Monument Protection, describes the development of the city from the Middle Ages to the present. The clearly structured, vivid and expert text, which is equipped with numerous coloured illustrations and plans and floor plans, documents on selected examples, whose geographical focus is the central and eastern German parts of the country, essential areas such as fortifications, market squares and churches as well as cuts by population growth, industrialization and the "bausünden" of the postwar period. The work, which is inexpensive in terms of its good equipment, with literature notes and local registers, is interesting and recommendable in terms of culture, economic and social history. (2) (Erdmann Steinmetz) The author has devoted himself to the area monument city and thus to the construction art of the early Middle Ages to the present day. In his comparative representation, he takes the city as an integral organization, which is subject to continuous development.
content.title_en: Gesamtkunstwerk - the city : to the history of the city from the Middle Ages to the present

content.text: The history of navigation. An extremely vivid and vivid presentation on the subject. It describes to a wide reader circle the different methods of determining position and direction from the beginnings of antiquity to the present day and includes other cultural circles. The diction is already almost salopp for a book from the publishing house Koehler, but makes the area easily digestible in itself mathematically sobering. Too bad that no information on further literature can be found. The very appealing illustration with exhibits from the Tamm collection is to be emphasized. An ideal entry title. More substantial and focused on the time since the 1970s is Gerald Kistner (BA 11/94). (1) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: The history of navigation

content.text: Intelligence between man and machine: from brain research to artificial intelligence; guide book to the New Radio College "The Future of Thinking". Without computers, modern brain research could not have developed, and vice versa, the performance of computers has always been measured by the brain's abilities - some even see a model for special mental abilities of humans in the computer. But how is the metaphor of computers as an "electron brain"? And vice versa: Does the human brain - at least a bit - work like a computer? 30 catchy contributions by renowned scientists such as Michel Jouvet, Stanislaw Lem or Oliver Sacks point a way from brain research through robotics and so-called artificial intelligence to visions of life in digital worlds.
content.title_en: Intelligence between man and machine : from brain research to artificial intelligence ; Companion book to the Neuer Funkkolleg "The Future of Thinking"

content.text: The new virtual MIDI/Audio technology: this makes your PC a professional music studio. It is already possible to produce an almost professional CD in the home studio. However, this includes a necessary technique and a considerable knowledge of the correct application. The author wants to convey this necessary knowledge. He first explains the technology and the setup of a studio, then to respond to the use of the special hard- and software as well as the microphones. Here also repeatedly experienced musicians and producers speak. The book takes into account both the Apple system and the PC with Windows. The attached CD-ROM contains demo versions as well as free and shareware for Mac and PC. Comparable titles on the subject are H. Zander (ID 13/98) and H. Hofmüller (BA 7/98), the latter being suitable as an introduction, while the present volume also takes into account the latest technology. - For expanded stocks. (3) (Burchard Bulling)
content.title_en: The new virtual MIDI/Audio technology : this makes your PC a professional music studio

content.text: Faith in Freedom / Eugen Drewermann, Religion and Science ; Vol. 3: ... and it happened this way : modern biology and the question of God. This is the 2nd volume (the 1st part "The Sixth Day - The Origin of Man and the Question of God" was not indicated in the meeting service) in which Drewermann combines the history of life on earth and the question of God. According to Drewermann, modern biology shows that the development of life requires no Creator to explain. Even if the question of God can no longer be asked about nature, the author continues to ask the question of God from the existence of man himself. Drewermann's merit is to have brought biology and theology back into conversation. It is to be criticized that he writes too out of the ordinary (almost 1000 pages) and does not engage with theologians working in this field. With a detailed register. For beginners Drewermanns certainly a must, but otherwise only for experts interested in biology and theology. (3) (Alfred Sobel)
content.title_en: Faith in Freedom / Eugen Drewermann, Religion and Science ; Vol. 3: ... and it happened this way : modern biology and the question of God

content.text: The architectural critic (see BA 4/99) not only examines and describes individual skyscrapers (here J. Dupré: Wolkenskratzer; BA 1/98), but also analyses the development of high-rise cities on different continents: America with New York and Chicago, Europe with Paris, London, Berlin, Frankfurt and Moscow, as well as today's boom cities in East Asia. His main focus is on the different social conditions that contributed to the growth of high-rise cities and the spatial relationships between high-rise buildings and cities. The text is generally understandable and is well complemented by photos, city plans and overviews of the development of heights. With local and personal registers and extensive literature list. (1) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: Centuries of high-rise buildings : high-rise building and city in the 20th century

content.text: Intercommunal cooperation : planning action across borders. The volume deals with selected case studies of intercommunal cooperation in Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia. It provides an overview and a problem presentation on the important area of intercommunal cooperation in urban-Umland regions and presents city networks and city associations as new instruments of spatial planning for the implementation of regional development concepts. Furthermore, regional action programmes are discussed as an essential part of the process of regionalization of structural policy and the experiences with the regional planning instruments are evaluated.
content.title_en: Inter-Communal cooperation: planning across borders

content.text: On 29 October 1998, the Italian wood carrier PALLAS stranded south-west of Amrum. The burning wreck lost about 60 tonnes of heavy oil in the next few weeks and caused the largest oil spill on the German coast (circa 16000 animals) so that the research and technology centre was prompted to investigate the following questions: a) Is the sinking of oil on the sediment surface near the beaching site? b) Does the bacterioplankton in the vicinity of Amrum cause changes due to the oil accident? c) Is it possible for the biological degradation of the oil spilled due to the nutrient salt demand and oxygen requirements of the degradation process to be expected to occur in the winter cotton sea? d) What biological degradation rates for heavy oil are possible in the winter in the North Frisian Wadden Sea? e) What changes for the Bactioplankton community and the degradation process are expected in the Waddymeal?
content.title_en: Studies on the impact of the Pallas-Havarie on the bacterio- and phytoplankton community of the Wadden Sea

content.text: Latin for biologists and physicians : Learning - Understanding - Teachings. Since the Doctor is still not accepted after spelling reform and 22nd Duden edition, all prospective academics without Latinum are well advised if they adopt a few basic rules of word formation and form teaching. Such a minimum equipment promises the Tübingen author and course leader with the present mini textbook to prospective biologists and physicians who invest a "quick time". Despite the examples from the mentioned departments, this ribbon should help with limitations even beyond the natural scientific audience to expose buried knowledge or create first foundations. Moreover, it is written so legible - sometimes entertaining - that it can be worked through well in a piece of knowledge. - Price-effective offer, which should already make medium libraries their customers. (2) (Olaf Kaptein)
content.title_en: Latin for biologists and physicians : Learning - Understanding - Teaching

content.text: Metaphor, allegory, symbol. Metaphor, allegory and symbol are central concepts of literary science. Gerhard Kurz's presentation is also a contribution to discussion and an introduction. The exemplary analyses aim to clarify the scientific use of the three concepts and to distinguish them from each other. All important facts are explained and developed using examples from different literatures and different times.
content.title_en: Metaphor, allegory, symbol

content.text: Violence and xenophobia - youth educational exits: five model projects in the Hessian youth action programme against violence, xenophobia and right-wing extremism; workshop report. Violence among young people in public, xenophobic slogans and deeds as well as an increasing acceptance of extreme right-wing ideas are a worrying alarm signal, to which five model projects in Hesse responded by showing exemplary ways out of the entanglement of randals and no-future feelings. The projects selected by an independent jury reached different target groups: "right" boys, marginal cliques of different nationalities, difficult school classes, girls threatened by violence and young women, perpetrators and victims. Special attention was paid to the gender-specific differences in both the active participation in violence, the implicit profit in co-crime and the different levels of violence suffered by girls and boys.
content.title_en: Violence and Xenophobia - Youth Education Outcomes : five pilot projects in the Hessian youth action programme against violence, xenophobia and right-wing extremism ; workshop report

content.text: Regional planning in the East German Länder: basics, experiences, further development. Against the background of the specific starting conditions and the creation of a functional spatial planning in the East German Länder, it was useful to compare the work done here so far in a synopsis and to examine whether and to what extent these experiences can provide impulses for the further development of spatial planning, especially at the regional level as a whole and for other countries. With this volume, the starting conditions, the development and state of regional planning as well as the legal foundations of regional planning and development are presented in a comparative manner and subjected to a forward-looking assessment in the East German Länder.
content.title_en: Regional planning in the East German countries : basics, experiences, further development

content.text: Darwin's dangerous heirs: biology beyond egoistic genes. Review: The author is turning in this book against a direction prevailing in biology, represented above all by R. Dawkins (last BA 12/94) and D. C. Dennett (ID 5/98), which assigns to the genes an absolutely dominant and determinating meaning for all organisms including humans. Problems of individuals can neither be attributed to genes nor to social problems alone. Rose argues against such reductionist views, which are unremittingly simplified and too one-sided in terms of complicated life relationships. He accuses this "ultra-darwinism" that his hypotheses were based on little convincing empirical evidence, that living beings could not be reduced to passive victims of genetic and selective processes. In his view, the complex organism, which can actively shape its own fates, is not the one that can be seen as an intelligent, objectively competent and argumentative representation (2).
content.title_en: Darwin's Dangerous Heirs: Biology Beyond the Egoist Genes

content.text: Evaluation of psychological intervention measures : Standards and criteria: a manual. What should be evaluated in the field of psychological intervention? What expectations can one approach this task? What criteria are there for the various psychological sub-areas? How can it be examined whether individual measures bring benefits in practical application? The discussion about quality assurance is reflected in the psychological field, especially in diagnostics. However, the fundamental question of criteria to which intervention measures must meet has remained largely unaffected. In this work quality and effectiveness criteria are developed.
content.title_en: Evaluation of psychological intervention measures : standards and criteria: a manual

content.text: Decorative art - 70s : a source book. The publication (a reprint) on architecture and design of the 1970s brings a selection of highlights from the English design yearbooks of the magazine "The Studio Magazine" (see "Decorative Art - 60s": ID 40/00). The content has shifted towards the preliminary volume in favour of architecture and interior design. The two editors introduce with a contribution into the architecture and design development of the 70s decade. In the main part the objects are arranged chronologically according to genres and therein. The architectural examples and the designer objects are all described (in English) with indication of the architect, designer or client. The illustrations are often small-format and poorly reproduced. The book is developed by an index of designers/architects. (3) (LK/K: Weber)
content.title_en: Decorative art - 70s : a source book

content.text: Solar world economy: Strategy for ecological modernity. With the award of the alternative Nobel Prize to Hermann Scheer, it can be assumed that publications from his pen will receive an increased attention value. After reading the latest book, it must be said: Right! Scheer is able to formulate exciting, with compelling logic, professionally savvy and yet understandable and to tie the reader to a topic that will become the highest priority for most in a future that can still be experienced: the finiteness of fossil resources, the environmental problem through their unbridled consumption and the possibilities for re-directing this development through the use of solar technologies, which in turn oppose the economic interests and power cartels of multinational energy suppliers. - Should no library be missing! (1) (H.-Joachim Sommer)
content.title_en: Solar world economy : Strategy for ecological modernity

content.text: Poverty in the Federal Republic: on the theory and practice of an over-burdened term. Based on the fact that in one of the richest countries (Germany) there is a constant complaint about the increasing poverty, the Dortmund professor presents facts and considerations about various manifestations of poverty, about its measurability, about indicators and about social assistance. He does not hesitate to take up many points of contention such as the relationship between income and wealth, the hidden income, the proportion of necessary expenditures, the often different care within multi-person households, difficult data collection and control. His remarks about real poverty and poverty as a political combat concept are also challenged. Apart from definitions, there are no overlaps with Udo Neumann: "structure and dynamics of poverty" (Lambertus, 1999). Also highly recommended for upper secondary school II. (2 S) (Elke Günther) Walter Krämer sheds light on the theoretical and practical handling of the term "armut" in Germany. He encounters contradictions and one of his assessments after arbitrary use of the term. He examines what poverty in our country means and provides facts and figures that fill the vague term with a form of war.
content.title_en: Poverty in the Federal Republic : on the theory and practice of an overburdened concept

content.text: Measurement of costs and benefits of access to the European Union for selected countries in Central and Eastern Europe. As regards the economic and political integration of Hungary, the Czech Republic, Poland and Slovenia within the European Economic and Monetary Union, some questions remain unanswered, in particular on the assessment of the regional and structural funds. For the accession countries mentioned above, the key statement of this contribution, the current long-term cost-benefit analyses are not appropriate, as they allow insufficient statements on the effectiveness of the regional structural measures in question.
content.title_en: Measurement of costs and benefits of access to the European Union for selected countries in Central and Eastern Europe

content.text: Roland Weber - the art of the garden: landscape gardens, parks and courtyards. The landscape architect and co-founder of the office Weber/Klein/Maas WKM Roland Weber (1909-1997) has created more than 800 gardens in about 50 years. His famous gardens show the art to a large extent to highlight the natural beauty in an artificial facility. - Complemented by 10 projects of the office Weber/Klein/Maas WKM landscape architects, the publication presents the gardens, parks and courtyards Webers and its partners, which were active not only in Germany but also in Holland, Austria, Switzerland, Italy, France and the USA.
content.title_en: Roland Weber - the art of the garden : landscape gardens, parks and courtyards

content.text: The detailed scientific study, which was developed from a research project at the German Youth Institute, is likely to become a mandatory reading for specialists in the field of prevention and therapy. The strategies are analysed by perpetrators in the case of intra-family abuse (which are hardly different from those in the case of extra-family abuse). The conclusions also serve to develop concepts for effective prevention work as well as quality assurance of counselling work with child victims of sexual violence and perpetrator therapy. (3) (Heidrun Küster)
content.title_en: Perpetrator strategies and prevention: sexual abuse of girls within family and family-like structures

content.text: The fourth episode of Freiewerk RELIGION »Experience Symbols – Understanding Symbols« introduces the students to the independent development of symbols by means of a basic course: »The language of images: Understanding symbols«. Using the symbols WEG / BAUM / DOOR / LIGHT, they can independently implement and test the knowledge and skills they have developed. They learn about various symbolic interpretation possibilities and learn how different dimensions of reality, especially the religious-spiritual ones, can be opened up in this way. A rich range of songs, poems, stories, pictures, objects, Bible words, mandalas, aids to becoming quiet, etc. supports this learning and experience process.
content.title_en: Experience Symbols - Understanding Symbols

content.text: Wolfsburg: City at the turning point : a third sociological study. Klappentext: A city in Germany is the third time a sociological study is being conducted. In a new city such as Wolfsburg, various aspects of urban development can be identified as modelled. In addition to a brief recapitulation of previous research results, the focus of this third study is on two classic and current thematic blocks for the city. On the one hand, it deals with forms of social integration, a core topic in the current debate about social pluralization processes; on the other hand, new forms of cooperation between the VW plant and the city are being discussed, which go far beyond what is currently discussed under 'public-private partnership'.
content.title_en: Wolfsburg: City at the turning point : a third sociological study

content.text: The library of the future: text and writing in the times of the Internet. Someone goes to the library. He finds the house he knows like no other, closes the door, takes off the shoes, bootes the computer, quickly feeds the cat, and already the library opens up before him, the largest in the world, the universal library. Because it is everywhere, even in his home. Libraries made of stone and glass have become superfluous. The new, the omnipresent library is made of electric current. Will there soon be no libraries in which reader breaths, no bookshops in which the novities lie out in colored splendor? Will all this be of yesterday's time because you get every reading experience by mouse click on the screen? No, so it will not come - and Dieter E. Room explains in his new book why the print media must remain and become a reality. And yet - the so-called information age has begun, and its medium is the connected computer. Who uses it to read and write, but should understand what it can even be expected, but what the user looks like a new machine and what the opportunity of the future informs.
content.title_en: The Library of the Future : Text and Writing in the Times of the Internet

content.text: The bibliographical atlas of Tübinger is based on the Tuebinger Atlas of the Near East (TAVO). Folding text: Maps are compiled in this scientific bibliographic atlas, which have so far been available only individually. They are published for the first time in a bound edition and at a reasonable price, which makes this material accessible to a wider audience. On a total of 29 large-format map sheets (extended 72 x 49.3 cm each) the historical geography of the biblical countries is documented with unique precision and completeness. The map sheets are a targeted selection of the original maps relevant to Bible studies from the large historical-geographical work of Tübinger Atlas of the Near East. Individuals have been revised and supplemented for the bibliographic atlas, a map on the archaeology and history of Sinai has been re-created and is published for the first time. The registers, especially for the bibliographic atlas, open up the rich inventory of historical places and place names recorded in the atlas. The register section is available separately and can be easily used, even if the maps have been expanded.
content.title_en: Tübingen Bible Atlas : based on the Tübingen Atlas of the Near East (TAVO)

content.text: Amok - Children of the Cold : about the roots of anger and hatred. Following on from his much discussed book "Youth and Violence" (together with Reimer Gronemeyer, BA 11/93), Eisenberg, Dr. rer. soc. and prison psychologist in adult execution, deals with a "new dimension of violence": - the amok courses. He describes them as a consequence of a social "progress" that also sustainably transforms the "inner conditions". The radical economic and social changes of the last years - the "amus of capital" - have been suppressed in the psychological constitution of the younger generation and released a potential of unbounded anger and undirected hatred, which had previously been firmly integrated within clearly structured life courses. Wide space occupies in Eisenberg's argumentation the phenomenon of "Borderline syndrome", whose better understanding could open up the opportunity to gain an understanding of the current violence phenomenon. No easy reading, but certainly a book that is discussed and critically reviewed. (2)
content.title_en: Amok - Children of the cold : about the roots of anger and hatred

content.text: Russia : a decade after the Soviet information dictatorship ; failure of freedom of information and democracy, breaks up the state unity ?. Against the background of the overcome Soviet information dictatorship, this work should point out some major deficits in the area of media and information economy in today's Russia . The freedom of the press initiated by Gorbachev has not yet been fully established in some regions of Russia . In recent years the situation in some regions has even worsened, because the media are often dependent on authoritarian regional administrations . This development also has a negative effect on further democratization in Russia .
content.title_en: Russia : a decade after the Soviet information dictatorship ; failure to provide information and democracy, is the state breaking up?

content.text: The magical channels: "Understanding Media". With wit and subtle analysis, a much discussed study of the media theory of the learned literary scholar and visionary of the media age, which became the founder of modern media science in the 1960s. (I. Müller-Boysen)
content.title_en: The Magical Channels : "Understanding Media"

content.text: The present volume asks about the learning and education opportunities offered by the Internet. It is devoted to new social-sational phenomena and basically discusses the dimensions that need to be considered when speaking about the educational value of the Internet.
content.title_en: The educational value of the Internet

content.text: HTML - short & good. This comprehensive HTML reference provides a quick-to-access overview of all HTML tags and their most important attributes. It takes into account the W3C specification HTML 4.0 as well as the extensions of Netscape Navigator and Internet Explorer. The alphabetical list HTML tags contains explanations for each day about the meaning and use of the tag and its attributes as well as information on whether it is supported by the standard HTML 4.0 and by the four most important Web clients -Netscape Navigator, Internet Explorer, WebTV and Opera3. Furthermore, there is an overview of the tags according to their functionality, an overview of how tags are grouped into web page elements, as well as tables for color values and character entities.
content.title_en: HTML - short & good

content.text: Introduction to the geological sciences : 187 drawings, 55 formulas, 33 tables. Review: Inter-subject introduction to geology, mineralogy, petrology, geochemistry and geophysics of the earth, based on lectures of the Freie Universität Berlin. Broadly speaking, the basics and working directions of the geological sciences are taken into account as well as chapters on exogenous and endogenous processes. Other topics are the evolution of the solar system and the structure of the earth's body. Finally, global geological structures and their formation according to the theory of plate tectonics are presented. Further literature, cross references and info boxes facilitate the understanding of interdisciplinary relationships. - For beginners, secondary students of one of the disciplines mentioned as well as readers interested in geological phenomena and theories. (3 S) (LK/MH: Lieske)
content.title_en: Introduction to the geological sciences : 187 drawings, 55 formulas, 33 tables

content.text: Plant Systematics : Introduction to systematic botany ; Basic principles of the plant system. Popular short university textbook for beginners and advanced students with botany as a minor. Provides the basics of systematic botany and gives an overview of the groups of the natural system of plants with their related relationships. Currently, the modern methods of molecular biology lead to new findings, reliable findings are taken into account in this 7th edition and have led to corresponding corrections and extensions compared to the preliminary edition (BA 10/93). Replace pre-presses. Necessary only for student use. Goes far beyond the substance of the gymnasial upper level. (3) (LK/SH: Enderle)
content.title_en: Plant Systematics : Introduction to systematic botany ; Basic principles of the plant system

content.text: Trade- oriented cross-reference dictionary for engineers and architects. Bilingual reference work, structured according to specialist sections (glass, concrete, iron etc.), but also according to pre-silbs (be-, double-, de-,) with over 22000 technical terms from the building technology and related areas (trades, trades, etc.). Contains a main alphabet (German-English) with translations according to the above criteria. Systematic assignment aids or image aids (diagrams etc.) are not available, there are also further references missing. Turns to a wide reader group and is moderate in price. Can not replace the comprehensive, conventionally designed dictionaries (H.-D. Junge: ID 9/93 or "Längenscheidts Fachwortenbuch Bauwesen", ID 12/98), but - also due to the individual structure and topic position - usefully complement. (3 A) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Trade- oriented cross-reference dictionary for engineers and architects

content.text: The current study guide of the DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service) is dedicated to Latin America as a more exotic goal for those interested in studying abroad. Like all the helpers of the publishing series, the comprehensive guide provides comprehensive basic information on the university system, application, job opportunities, tuition fees, housing search, everyday life etc., provides a detailed list of addresses for important contact points in Germany and abroad and also provides information on further information sources. It thus closes a gap as information on study opportunities in the countries of Latin America is not yet widely available. In the series so far, study guides have been published for the following countries: Great Britain/Ireland (BA 4/00 and in this No.), France (BA 1/00), Spain/Portugal (BA 9/99), Belgium/Netherlands/Luxembourg (BA 10/99), USA/Canada (BA 4/00), Austria/Switzerland (BA 10/00), Northern Europe (BA 12/02), South-East Europe (BA 10/03) and Australia/ New Zealand (BA 2/04).
content.title_en: Latin America Study Guide

content.text: To increase the attractiveness of the engineering studies : experiences and perspectives from a project. In the first chapter of the study an introduction to current literature on engineering studies is outlined as background for the study's own empirical approach and the socio-economic approach. The following four chapters provide information about the various research steps within the scope of this study: the survey on the interest of students in engineering studies, the measures to supplement the application and practical relevance of teaching in the study, together with the biographical surveys of students, the survey of graduates of the study and the survey of students of basic studies. The final chapter highlights key questions and empirical findings, but also the yield of the socio-economic perspective for the interpretation of the findings. (HoF/Text taken over/St.)
content.title_en: To increase the attractiveness of engineering studies : experience and perspectives from a project

content.text: Atlas flat roofs : usable surfaces. This volume in the series of proven construction satellites shows the construction physics, the material and manufacturing technology as well as the constructive conditions for the "flat roof" on the state of today's technical development. It highlights the importance of the flat roof, also in connection with other roof shapes, in view of ecological requirements and additional uses and documents its indispensability for new construction tasks of the future as well as innovative architectural expressions. History and present, supporting structure, solid, wood, steel structures, heat, fire, moisture protection, materials, layer construction, the ventilated roof, the claimed roof, roof edge, pipe breaks, etc., details of built examples, detailed registers.
content.title_en: Atlas flat roofs : usable areas

content.text: With the Macintosh on the Internet. Since modem and software manufacturers, online services and Internet providers are mainly oriented to Windows clients, there are sometimes problems with the use of Apple PCs on the user side. In the introduction of literature on the Apple operating system MacOS, the Internet is treated (see e.g. T. Maschke: BA 11/99), but special problem solving cannot be discussed in this way. This gap closes the author by "tapping" modem purchase, Internet access and provider choice on Apple-specific problems. In particular, the presentation of dial-in procedures and computer configurations for the well-known online services is helpful. In addition, Apple users find information on security issues, email administration, Internet search, chat, FTP and web programming (HTML). The CD-ROM contains browser software and some useful tools (including databases, coding and packaging programs, viewer for graphics and film).
content.title_en: With the Macintosh on the Internet

content.text: Symbols of Judaism. Text book on objects of daily use in the Jewish household, at Shabbat in the synagogue, for ritual customs and other things
content.title_en: Symbols of Judaism

content.text: Willenbrock : Roman. Bernd Willenbrock, former engineer in a GDR company, runs a used car trade in Berlin. He is a sympathetic man of the best age. His life runs in orderly fashion. Marriage with a boutique owner works without problems. The wife gets nothing from his meetings with attractive customers. But then the security of bourgeois existence begins to break away - first imperceptibly and then incalculably. Several times from his business parking lot cars disappear, without the the thefts can be clarified. When Willenbrock himself becomes the victim of a brutal assault, his security need is shaken. The experience of defenselessness changes his relationship with the legal state. Had he always despised weapons lovers, he now gets a revolver with the help of a Russian customer. A time bomb begins to tick.
content.title_en: Willenbrock : Roman

content.text: Krupp : the rise of an industrial empire. "Hart wie Kruppstahl" - the company has even entered into the proverbial vocabulary. Lothar Gall, from the first ranks of German historians (lastly: "The company's railway from the beginning to the first world war: biographies of entrepreneurs, market situation, company development, company constitution, social benefits, working world, interdependence with the armaments sector and politics, etc.). A round piece of industrialization that makes clear that the motto "waxing at all costs" with all its risks does not apply only to Internet companies since the latest, but was already Usus. Many illustrations, maps, statements and a register of property and persons evaluate the book completely. (3) (Jürgen Plieninger)
content.title_en: Krupp : the rise of an industrial empire

content.text: Water: the global crisis around blue gold. "We consume water, spill it, poison it, waste it and change it constantly, indifferent to the consequences of the natural water cycle - too many people, too little water, water in the wrong places and in the wrong quantities", the Canadian author points out. For years he has researched the world's water crisis areas on site. His knowledgeable, accurate analysis (water resources, water policy, presented in regional examples), which plausibly links the causes and effects, is in contrast to J. Wallacher's scientific study "Lifebase Water" (ID 8/00) accessible to a wide reader circle, because de Villiers understands captivatingly to write! Like S. Postel "Die letzte Oase" (BA 12/93): (1) (Helga Lüdtke)
content.title_en: Water : the global blue gold crisis
