content.text: Beautiful dangerous light : studies on a cultural phenomenon. "When physicists, philosophers, artists, architects or others speak of light, they speak of various things: speed of light, knowledge, color or illumination. When seen from the angle of aesthetics into light as in this book, almost everything happens. 'Lighting, illuminating, illuminating' leads us through this past 20th century - materially and symbolically."
content.title_en: Beautiful dangerous light : Studies on a cultural phenomenon

content.text: The Wüstenrot Foundation documents its 3rd competition of 1998, this time on the topic of "revitalization and conversion of buildings". Projects from residential buildings, agricultural or military buildings to commercial facilities of all kinds, which were renovated, renovated or repaired after 01.01.1993, were taken into account. The first 100 pages are followed by a sketch of the history of building conversions, as well as an overview of current European projects. Subsequently, various articles by experts deal with possible networking of the topic with monument maintenance, urban planning, economy and ecology. The last 100 pages present the award-winning projects with pictures and plans, among the shorter examples presented are the city libraries Landau and Berlin-Mitte. An interesting title for architects, city planners, but also for interested citizens on a booming topic in the building sector. The large-format, well-equipped volume is also a real price bargain. (2) (Elke Nibbrig)
content.title_en: Re-uses in the inventory : new uses for old buildings

content.text: Langenscheidt's specialist dictionary Kompakt Biologie : English - German/German - English. M. Eichhorn has selected 40000 entries from the extensive (st) but also most expensive specialist dictionary Biology ("Langenscheidt's specialist dictionary Biology", German-English, 1999; English-German, 2nd edition 1999; both ID 42/99) (after my translation this refers to both languages). Without plant and animal names, with subject details and short explanations. This selected vocabulary is aimed at students, but also at other occasional users. As a compact dictionary it may be possible to borrow one of the more detailed titles (see above, E. Launert, ID 20/98 or Th. Cole: ID 3/99) in the presence. (3) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: Langenscheidts Specialist Dictionary Compact Biology : English - German - English

content.text: Cyberkids: empirical research into the effects of video games. The increasing reports about violent youths and increasing demands for the banning of PC games with violent content have prompted A. Bühl (see also "Cybersociety", ID 39/96; "The Virtual Society", ID 14/98) to publish 3 empirical studies on the controversial effects of computer games on children and adolescents. The effects of PC games on 6-11-year-old children, adolescents from 11-18 years and gender-specific preferences in the game selection were investigated. It is evident that the consequences are less serious than suspected. Almost all investigated children are more important to joint ventures with friends than computer games, they often only use them when they are bored. Girls favor jump-and-run games and the intellectual challenge of adventure and strategy games, while boys prefer action- and combat-oriented games. The demand for further research and a sound media-pedagogical education in schools decide on the interesting book.(3) (Christian Kaufhold)
content.title_en: Cyberkids : empirical investigations of the effects of video games

content.text: Renovation with the sun : Solar energy use in the old building. In times of high energy prices, it seems appropriate to employ energy supply systems, which lead to dependence on price fluctuations of fossil energy carriers. If new buildings are often already invested in renewable energy generation, there is still a wide field of activity for real estate owners and architects in old buildings, to whose order the authors point out numerous possible applications of solar energy. Part 1 of the book lists the technical possibilities of solar energy in the building sector, with the authors going far beyond the use of solar panels and photovoltaic systems. Part 2 describes the use of the previously explained techniques using examples from the single and multi-family building and industrial and commercial buildings. A greater dissemination of this book seems to be desirable given the need to use new resource-saving techniques in the building of buildings and in particular in the renovation of old buildings. (2) (H.-Joachim Sommer)
content.title_en: Renovation with the sun : Solar energy use in the old building

content.text: Transport in the city and region: guiding principles, concepts and instruments. This volume attempts to shed light on the current possibilities for transport policy and spatial planning, to stop the erosion trend with new concepts, guiding principles and instruments and to transform the urban change process into sustainable development. Therefore, the guiding principle is to preserve mobility through less transport. Because the transport sector can only replace outdated forms of transport with less burdensome ones, the solutions to manage traffic growth outside transport are therefore important. Therefore, planning as a framework for private self-organization is so important. Thus, land use planning, location selection, macrologistics, telecommunications and not least mobility education are the focus of the volume.
content.title_en: Transport in the city and region : guiding principles, concepts and instruments

content.text: Addiction prevention in kindergarten: this is how you help children to become strong. In this book, behavioral biologist G. Haug-Schnabel, known for her numerous advisors on education issues (see last BA 10/98), and educator B. Schmid-Steinbrunner, describe 3 main areas of early addiction prevention: the promotion of childish "I-Strength", the conscious use of the game and the creation of offers in which children can experience and get to know themselves. A successful addiction prevention should provide the child with knowledge so that it can feel competent and strong in order to be able to act or say "no" for good reasons. It is about strengthening their own decision-making ability and avoiding dependence. This important book for committed educators combines theoretical considerations and practical suggestions and thus complements "The AddictionGamebook" by A. Robra (BA 9/99) and the CD-ROM "Round um das Spiel (ID 39/97). (2) (Elke Spar)
content.title_en: Addiction prevention in kindergarten: how to help children become strong

content.text: What is Gothic? : an analysis of the Gothic churches in France, England and Germany 1140 - 1350. What is Gothic architecture? This first volume of the new architectural historical series answers a wide range of questions and problems that arise when looking at the impressive Gothic cathedrals in France, Germany and England between 1140 and 1350. A differentiated consideration is necessary for an appropriate assessment of the buildings during this period; Günther Binding presents this impressively.
content.title_en: What is Gothic? : an analysis of Gothic churches in France, England and Germany 1140 - 1350

content.text: The book describes the history of the almost 800 women who qualified for the profession of the doctor in Germany until 1918 and pursues their life paths from the Empire to the end of the Second World War. As daughters of a society that only provided for the profession of wife and mother for bourgeois women, they initially formed a disappearing minority. They were outsiders and at the same time protagonists of emancipation, who managed to establish themselves in the contradictions of professional and female roles. In 1933 this generation broke apart. Many of the early doctors became victims of the Nazi system, some of them co-inflicted women, and the others arranged themselves. The first part of the book presents the path of the first German generation of doctors in several chronologically coordinated essays through five decades of the 20th century, touching aspects of women's and gender research, social, status and educational history, and the history of emigration and the history of the Nazi regime. The second part summarizes in a tabular form the most important social, educational and professional data of the early medical profession.
content.title_en: Doctors from the Empire : CVs of a generation

content.text: Compendium of Media Design for Digital and Print Media. Folding text: This compendium provides a comprehensive introduction to the complex field of modern media production. It deals easily with the technical and design fundamentals from the conception, planning and calculation of media products to their production routes and processes. The compendium and the independent, complementary workshop (ISBN 3-540-66420-3) are particularly suitable for self-study for apprentices and students of the relevant media professions and for teaching preparation for teachers, lecturers and trainers. At the same time it is an excellent manual for practice. In addition, the work offers interesting information and work aids for all those who are concerned with the design and production of digital and print media products.
content.title_en: Compendium of Media Design for Digital and Print Media

content.text: Children from families with alcohol problems: developmental risks and opportunities. In the co-dependence debate, the correlations between behavioural abnormalities and clinical disorders in children and adolescents as well as in later adulthood and the origin of a family with alcohol problems are a well-known topic; the psychologist Zobel in his study (probably dissertation) scientifically examines these clinical attributions (Woititz; Wegscheider; Lambrou; Black). From these results, the author derives a model for overcoming dependence by professional helpers. - Especially for those who are involved in therapy, counselling and aftercare. (3) (LK/HB: Obsen)
content.title_en: Children from families with alcohol problems : development risks and opportunities

content.text: Methods of training : didactic tools for trainers. Theorists and practitioners of vocational education and training present 12 methods for action-oriented learning in training. The use-oriented methods of contributions to methods and active learning are framed. Differences are made in methods for job-oriented learning (e.g. junior company), for learning in groups (e.g. intercultural simulation games) and creativity methods (e.g. mind mapping). Incentive for the practical work of trainers and trainers. (3) (LK/W: Scharmann)
content.title_en: Methods of training : didactic tools for trainers

content.text: Decorative art - 30s [&] 40s : a source book. This volume continues the reprints from the decorative art yearbooks with the 30s and 40s decade of the 20th century (see "Decorative art - 60s", ID 40/00). After the collapse of the world economy and its effects of the Second World War, new design forms developed using new materials (e.g. Bakelite and other plastics). The volume is structured according to genres: architecture, interiors and furniture, metal works, ceramics and glass, lamps, textiles. The objects are mainly depicted in black and white and are provided with short descriptions (in English). The architectural examples are explained in more detail by floor plans. The given annual figures refer to the publication in the yearbooks. The volume is developed by an index of designers, architects and manufacturers. Stilhistoric overview of international architecture and design of the 30s and 40s (streamlining, organic design).
content.title_en: Decorative art - 30s [&] 40s : a source book

content.text: Society without canopy: on the lability of structural structures of order. The essays gathered in this volume follow the program of a »hermeneutic sociology of knowledge«. They show how symbols, myths and rites are also in the present essential elements of our constructions of reality, which help us to find our way around the world - but which we must also repeatedly control, criticize and »deconstruct«. The essays and essays gathered in this volume are divided into two blocks, one of which is to contain more of a sociological topic, the other is to contain rather "general sociology".
content.title_en: Society without canopy: on the lability of structural structures

content.text: Sinnkohlen : a deconstructive reading of Niklas Luhmann's system theory. Since the mid-eighties, the place of the debate between critical theory and system theory has been that between system theory and deconstructivism. The concept of the political is of central importance in these debates. While a general concept of the political is proposed by deconstructivist side, system theory can only think politics within the political system. The irritation caused by this opposition forms the starting point for a reconceptualization of the political as a policy of deparadoxification. It is about forms of the political that are made possible by the internal paradoxes of a system.
content.title_en: Sinnkohlen : a deconstructive reading of Niklas Luhmann's system theory

content.text: Drawings for tilers: basics and practical examples; with 11 tables. The author has already written numerous textbooks for (aspiring) tilers, but also for carpenters and roofers (e.g. ID 35/96; BA 2/97). The present textbook is aimed at both trainees and practitioners who can be useful in managing everyday business tasks. Both the basics (e.g. drawing equipment, work equipment, geometrical basic constructions, projection theory) and the technical drawing (e.g. laying plans, value drawings, arches, circular sections, stairs, swimming pools) are presented. Also the use of CAD software is covered. Besides numerous drawings, photos are also included that illustrate individual facts. - A large-format, graphic textbook that can be useful for homeworkers or builders (reading the plans). - More comprehensive than the only comparable title of H. Braunreiter (BA 7/98). (2 S) (Leo Prawitt)
content.title_en: Technical drawing for tilers : basics and practical examples ; with 11 tables

content.text: I, Oskar Schindler : personal records, letters and documents ; with numerous facsimile documents. Numerous lively and exciting letters of Oskar Schindler, who during World War II saved over 1300 Jews from safe death, were discovered in a loft in 1999. The Schindler-Witwe, Emilie, complained against their publication as a series in the "Stuttgarter Zeitung". In book form they were now published and commented by the journalist Rosenberg, a close confidant of the Schindler-Witwe and co-author of her biography (BA 6/98). The correspondence, which only began with the end of the war (especially correspondence with friends, but also Jewish organizations, lawyers, etc.) illuminates Schindler's struggle for a nine-year career in Argentina and Germany, his personal honours, his close connections with Israel, his disappointments. Also, there are many details about his actions during the war period, as he saved "his" Jews by bribes of high-ranking SS-men. An impressive time-historical document (Mweis-Jühss-Jüs-Jüs-Jüs-Jüs-Jüs-Jüs-Jü-Jüs-Jü-Jü-Jü-Jü-Jü-Jü-Jü-Jü-Jü-Jü-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-Ju-
content.title_en: I, Oskar Schindler : the personal records, letters and documents ; with numerous facsimile documents

content.text: Crisis prevention: Prevention is better than cure. "Crisis prevention" is currently the preferred means that the peace research of politics recommends or also admonish politicians in peace research. As in medicine or criminalistics, the idea is obvious to everyone, but practice is more complicated. It is therefore good that Matthies explains this topic. The Hamburg political professor has made himself a good name for many years as author and editor of books that explain newer tendencies in research about war and peace accessible (see V. Matthies, BA 7/95; "The successful peace", BA 2/98). The new book is worthy of this series. The first part gives an overview of the concept of crisis prevention, about early warning, about possible actors, instruments and fields of action and about conditions of success and success measurements. The second part compiles materials, especially excerpts from scientific analyses and policy recommendations, diagrams, etc. The book is thus also well available at schools, secondary level II. (2 S) (Stephan Nitz)
content.title_en: Crisis prevention: prevention is better than healing

content.text: 100 tips & tricks for pinboard and flipchart. Hardly any seminars without flipchart and pinboard, without moderator case with pins, cards, needles and headline clouds. With the 100 tips and tricks in this book your flipcharts and pinboards will wake up to new life. Your participants will be thrilled! Pinboard and flipchart are the most popular "tools" for seminars, workshops, presentations and meetings. But writing and pinning is not all you can do with these ingeniously simple media. Let yourself be surprised by original ideas: thread trick, pop cloud, pinboard lamp, changing litfasssäule, card jogging, traffic light feedback, drawer pinboard, fast clusters and much more. Become more professional in drawing, writing, mind mapping, moderating. Try the learning psychological tips to capture the attention of your participants, make learning easier and secure what you learn playfully.
content.title_en: 100 Tips & Tricks for Pinboard and Flipchart

content.text: Drinker and lover: An attempt on dependency. The 81-year-old, born in Tunis as the son of a Berber and a Jewish father, French literary scholar and sociologist Memmi, whose "racism" book is one of his more well-known in this country (see last BA 2/93), analyses in this volume the topos of dependence in its many manifestations: from the alcoholic to the physician/patient or the human/animal relationship and the parent-child relationship to the individual's dependence on his ethnic group. He reveals "costs and benefits of dependence", deepens the topic by using the example of erotic dependence with the help of 3 film analyses (including "scenes of marriage" by I. Bergmann and "in the realm of the senses" by Oshima), finally in several essays on the nature of dependence in the context of cross-referential problems (e.g. autonomy and freedom, morality, cultural identity) to advance to a philosophy of dependence. With the term pair of dependency/purchance, he proposes a bridge to his former pair of dominance/subjugation.
content.title_en: Drinkers and lovers : Trying to be dependent

content.text: Home - a place of peace and relaxation as a counterpart to the hectic everyday life of the profession in a fast-paced time. Natural harmony and balance and the simplicity of art and design characterize the living world of Asian houses. The influence on the Western living world is documented here. Zen style is deliberately limited to things that are aesthetically or functionally essential. The facilities are minimalistic and well arranged and pleasant for eye and touch. The slogan "Less is more", coined at the beginning of the 20th century by Mies van der Rohe, characterizes this far-eastern living trend, which seeks to enter our apartments after Feng Shui (adapted to Western climate and lifestyle) . Solid, thread-bound volume, with meaningful photos, which should be offered alongside "Asia: Living ideas from the Far East" (BA 8/00) initially in larger stocks. In the extent Zen really becomes a residential trend here, remains to be seen. (3) (LK/EF: Leer)
content.title_en: Housing and Zen

content.text: The beautiful appearance of art and its shadows : [Festschrift für Rolf Peter Janz zum 60. Geburtstag]. The appearance is deceptive. But is it not also the medium of truth? Isn't appearance essential to the being? Do we know anything at all other than the appearance of appearances? Isn't everything we believe to be a phenomenon produced by ourselves? Nowhere does the ambivalence of appearance become as concise as in the beautiful appearance of art, which has ever been suspected of being a deceptive appearance, but has been praised as an appearance of truth and autonomous sphere of human freedom. In a broad historical panorama, ranging from the beginnings of medieval book poetry to the true crime stories of the present, the contributions of the Festschrift on the 60th birthday of Rolf Peter Janz unfold this ambivalence.
content.title_en: The beautiful appearance of art and its shadows : [Festschrift for Rolf Peter Janz on his 60th birthday]

content.text: Routledge Langenscheidt's specialist dictionary compact construction: English-German/German-English. According to the publisher, the shortened compact edition contains 10000 keywords in English and German with 16000 translations each. Terms from all areas of construction (construction technology, construction, building technology, environmental issues, etc.) are selected, which are relevant for a basic vocabulary. A short appendix contains conversion tables for frequent sizes and units in the construction industry. Target group are workers on construction sites, apprentices, construction managers - for students, engineers, translators as first starters. The large "Langenscheidts specialist dictionary construction" (ID 12/98) costs 178,00 DM. Comparably compact, almost 30,00 DM more expensive is K. Magdlung (ID 52/98). (2 A) (LK/KA: Nibbrig)
content.title_en: Routledge Langenscheidts Specialist Dictionary compact construction : English-German/German-English

content.text: Genetic engineering in plants : Opportunities and risks. Folding text: Are genetically modified plants a future perspective? Do they solve the nutritional problems of humanity? The authors provide an overview of the opportunities and risks of plant genetic engineering at the moment and competently. Based on basic methods of genetic engineering, modern methods for the production and identification of transgenic plants as well as application examples up to release experiments and commercialization are presented. Boxing with background information, excursions to interesting details, core statements at the end of the chapter, WWW addresses and an extensive glossary round off the text. Here you get factual information as an answer to burning questions.
content.title_en: Genetic engineering in plants : opportunities and risks

content.text: The case of Madrid: Roman. "The Fall of Madrid": This is a special day. The day when Franco dies. José Ricart becomes 75 years old. His daughter-in-law Olga prepares a feast for him. On which the secret police shoots an old communist worker. The day when, in a crowded bus passing Franco's residence, people suddenly start singing from their necks: Adieu from the heart! Rafael Chirbes succeeds in a great feat: he tells a single day in the life of the Ricard family and designs a grand family epic over three generations, in which Spain's departure into a new era is reflected.
content.title_en: The case of Madrid : Roman

(ID 30/99) and as standard work Günter Wöhe: "Grundzugungen der Buchnung ..." (last BA 9/00). Cracks offers a reduced entry into the principles and the technique of accounting starting from the preparation of the balance sheet on the treatment of VAT and selected accounting topics up to the annual accounts. The exercises included (with solutions) are difficult, they require a very exact work. The extracts from the legal texts also contain the volume that is really recommended for students. (3) (Joachim Bahler)

content.text: After the exit: Future course for renewable energies. One of the prerequisites underlying the scenario developed by the authors, the ratification of the Kyoto climate change targets, has already been sacrificed on the political altar. Therefore, it seems all the more important to give the reader an easy-to-read comprehensive guide on how to achieve the goal of reducing greenhouse gas emissions in the shortest possible time. This is impressively achieved by the authors' team with the present work, which was produced on the basis of the results of the study "Climate protection by using renewable energy" on behalf of the Federal Ministry of the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety. Unfortunately, the factor of transport is given too little space and importance. Even if the material would have been more easily consumed by the somewhat more frequent use of graphics, a broad use of the book can be recommended. (2) (H.-Joachim Sommer)
content.title_en: After the exit: Future course for renewable energies

content.text: CliXX Java 3D : the basic course. Interactive dynamic three-dimensional representations gain an ever greater importance on the Internet, especially in e-commerce. The authors present Java 3D as a platform-independent programming interface (API) and extension of Java. They introduce the development of interactive 3D graphics applications and animations using Java 3D. The reader requires experience with Java and basic knowledge in 3D graphics. The versions are based on the operating systems Windows and Linux. The presentation is designed as a multimedia course; the CD-ROM is the main work, the book gives explanations. The course is built up in independent teaching modules, which are based on 3D applets (also on CD-ROM). The source code of this applet can be easily modified and adapted to its own needs. The focus is on the installation and configuration of Java 3D and the design and construction of Java 3D programs. The topics of illumination of scenes and background design are also well taken into account. Tasks with sample solutions. (2) (Klaus Barckow)
content.title_en: CliXX Java 3D : the basic course

content.text: Of grass-halms and high-rise buildings: [mechanical creations in nature and technology]. The author compares technical systems created by man with the diverse constructions that nature produces. He explains that apart from common physical laws and similar building principles, there are fundamental differences that arise from the own dynamics of life. Nature provides models and suggestions, but it cannot be transferred as a copy, as a blueprint directly to human techniques. Nature works and invents in fundamentally different ways. At the same time, the author refutes the widespread idea that the creations of nature are perfect and unsurpassed. A factual book on biomechanics, which is well understandable for readers with biological and physical basic knowledge, recommended as a supplement to the titles of Nachtigall (BA 4/88, BA 12/98) and Mattheck (ID 14/97). (2) (Helmut Köhne)
content.title_en: Of grass stalks and skyscrapers : [mechanical creations in nature and technology]

content.text: 116 times Lübeck : Monument protection, renovation, new architecture ; 25 years of dealing with a city monument. Lübeck has neglected its old town for a long time, yes: forgotten. But from 1975 to today much has happened to regain the heart of the old Hanseatic city. 116 times Lübeck - this is a tour of 116 case examples from the preservation of monuments, the renovation and the new architecture. There is, despite some criticism, abundant praise and recognition. But can we be satisfied with what has been done so far? - - More quality is not only a question of money. A somewhat changed awareness of the concerns of the old town could make wonders. Perhaps this book can help us to keep going uphill with the old town.
content.title_en: 116 times Lübeck : Monument protection, renovation, new architecture ; 25 years of dealing with a city monument

content.text: Mies van der Rohe : Vision and Reality ; from Concert Hall to the New National Gallery ; Development of an idea. White, urban planner and architect, worked at Mies van der Rohe in 1963/64. His illustrated book traces the development of freely spanned, single-storey universal spaces in Mies Oeuvre. This reduction to the elements of floor panel, supports, roof and glass shell that are important for the construction was made possible by modern building materials and corresponded to the spirit of the time. Many of the buildings presented in text and image remained merely projects; in detail, the completed New National Gallery in Berlin is discussed. Records of conversations from the time in Chicago convey the personal proximity of the author; interesting are Mies' statements on the closure of the Bauhaus in Dessau. Of rather artistic value are the many greatly enlarged photos. With a brief biography. According to David Spaeth (BA 9/94), which enables the entry into life and work. (3) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: Mies van der Rohe : Vision and Reality ; from Concert Hall to the New National Gallery ; Development of an Idea

content.text: Studying for the global labour market: international degree programmes and degrees at German universities. New courses have been established at numerous German universities for several years, which aim to train for the future international labour market. Their characteristics: internationally recognised degrees or an integrated study abroad, high foreign language content and orientation of the study content to the labour market. Approximately 350 of these courses present the present study guide of the author team known by numerous relevant advisors for students. Sorted by subject groups, the most important information such as admission requirements, study priorities and occupational fields of application are presented tabulated - with mention of the partner universities, WWW and postal addresses of the universities and the relevant contact persons. (2 A,S) (LK/W: Thorn)
content.title_en: Studying for the global labour market: international degree programmes and degrees at German universities

content.text: About Germany: the Federal Republic in German history. Gerhard A. Ritter shows the different traditions the two German states followed after the end of the war and how different the fundamental processes of transformation in the state, economy and society were. He explores the extent of the Americanization of the Federal Republic and the Sovietization of the GDR and shows how the different orientation patterns made it difficult to create an internal unity after 1989.
content.title_en: About Germany : the Federal Republic of Germany in German history

content.text: Autonomous living : Reflections on freedom and equality. In this book, in a critical distinction to the approaches of Rawls, Dworkin and Habermas, an autonomous conception of political liberalism is developed which understands the production of social equality as a means of securing freedom. - 1. Freedom and equality: Two fundamental values and their meanings 2. Distributive equality - An ideal and its parameters 3. Weights of freedom and equality 4. Freedom, liberalism and perfectionism 5. Freedom and equality from the perspective of feminist political theory
content.title_en: Autonomous living : Reflections on freedom and equality

content.text: Bertolt Brecht : his life in pictures and texts. The picture chronicle, which was first published in 1978 by the Insel-Verlag (BA 7/78.391) and for the 90th birthday of Brecht in 1998 as an island-pocket book (BA 6/88), is now available as a large-format Suhrkamp-pocket book. The opulent picture volume shows in pictures (black-white) and texts chronologically life and work by Bertolt Brecht (died 1956). Preface: Memories of Max Frisch to the man named Brecht. Essay by W. Hecht on B. Brecht. (1 S) (LK/H: Haldenwanger)
content.title_en: Bertolt Brecht : his life in pictures and texts

content.text: The aim of this ARL working group was to develop proposals for the scope of action of regional planning and other actors in the regional area, in the light of the amendment of the Spatial Planning Act, to establish sustainable development as a new spatial guiding principle, and to use quality objectives, objectives and indicators to improve the operational scope of regional planning. Furthermore, it was important to clarify the contribution that regional planning can make to sustainable development. Regional planning is predestined for the implementation of sustainable development. It has all the different concerns in a region, as far as they are spatially effective, to weigh up with each other and among each other. The three sustainability dimensions require specific implementation: while the ecological and partly economic dimension can be operationalised in sub-areas, the social dimension requires operationalization approaches that go beyond current regional planning practice and beyond its field of responsibility.
content.title_en: Sustainability principle in regional planning : Operationalisation

content.text: Climate makes history : Human history as an image of climate development. "Climate is a crucial environmental factor for our survival" - a thesis of geologist and climate researcher (here last: "The last days of dinosaurs", BA 4/90), which is unlikely to find any contradiction today. From early history to the last "little ice age" between the 14th and 17th century, Hsü examines the backgrounds of migrations and conquests, addresses questions of race and linguistic development, deals with Darwin and the theory of evolution, as mentioned above, and discusses possible consequences of the "greenhouse effect". Because of the abundance of problems and the personal nature of the presentation, which puts the emphasis on the history of China, the core question is sometimes pushed to the edge. Nevertheless, the work offers many suggestions for those who are seriously interested in the topic. (2) (Erdmann Steinmetz)
content.title_en: Climate makes history : Human history as an image of climate development

content.text: The future from debris: reconstruction and urban development in Schleswig-Holstein after the Second World War. The cities of Lübeck and Kiel were heavily destroyed, like Hamburg during the Second World War. In Lübeck, the old town, the shipyards and residential areas were hit above all in the shipyards and in Kiel. The housing of the numerous refugees exacerbated the urban development situation even where little of the building material had been lost, such as in Husum. The volume of 10 contributions by experts deals with the resulting urban planning questions: reconstruction according to historical model or urban conversion according to modern ideas; how to cope with the housing shortage; what priorities were set for the design of the public space. The principles underlying Damas still largely determine the architectural appearance of Schleswig-Holstein cities. (I. Hanewald)
content.title_en: Future from debris : Reconstruction and urban development in Schleswig-Holstein after the Second World War

Design design - Design process - Design process - Method - Design method - Ergonomics - Golden cut - Proportion - Action analysis - Presentation - Collage - Future - Product design - Product design - Teaching - Method - Teaching method - Teaching
content.title_en: Design : to the practice of design : an introduction

content.text: Differentiation of A - Z : practical guidance for secondary schools. After theoretical considerations, Master explains possibilities for differentiation in daily teaching by means of short examination exercises and examples. Stimulating material for teachers in upper secondary school I and II, even more practical than the titles of M. Bönsch (BA 4/96, ID 35/00). (2 S) (LK/DU: Heckmann)
content.title_en: Differentiation between A - Z : a practical guide for secondary schools

content.text: The magic of Baroque and Rococo. "Even today, the magic of an art that raised artisticism to its own end is the expression of beautiful appearance," says the folding text of this book, which spreads 43 highlights of baroque architecture and garden art in the German-speaking world to the most magnificent. Text writer is the Baroque specialist W. Hansmann, photographer F. Monheim, and this author's team has already succeeded in several thematically comparable volumes (among others "Baroque Garden Paradises" BA 10/96 and "Balthasar Neumann", ID 13/99). Again, highlights of Baroque and Rococo architecture such as the Wieskirche, Fourteen Saints, the residence in Würzburg, Sanssouci Castle and the Zwinger in Dresden are photographed and explained in a well-founded way, whereby the author does not go into picture band-accompanying prose, but found out the form, function, origin and meaning of the buildings and gardens, so that there is nothing to be seen except at the price, which is quite appropriate for himself, but makes the beautiful Batork/Bockmann more affordable.
content.title_en: Magic of the Baroque and Rococo

content.text: Bus systems in automation and process technology : Basics and systems of industrial communication. The book still offers a very good overview. In addition to improvements, updates, small extensions, the main changes in the chapter on bus systems performed (many are replaced by new examples) and also in the useful "data sheets" (tabular list of the most important information on bus systems in uniform form). Since no comparable current compilation is known, this edition should supplement the 1st and 2nd, if not replace it. (3) (LK/W: Weinheimer-Hartmann)
content.title_en: Bus systems in automation and process technology : Basics and systems of industrial communication

content.text: Aggression and stress : relief and relaxation by reducing massive forms of aggression. Massive aggressions of mentally disabled people with some autistic symptoms can be subject to different conditions and have different functions. The author examines stress-aggression interactions using the example of a home with school.
content.title_en: Aggression and stress : relief and relaxation by reducing massive forms of aggression

content.text: The world unleashed: how globalization changes our lives. Anthony Giddens held the Reith Lectures in 1999 - broadcast by the BBC and thus turning to a large audience. He spoke about his subject, globalization. In their turn, our world has unleashed itself. Everyone, in every place of the earth, whether poor or rich, is exposed to its consequences. The risks it carries for the individual are increasing to an unknown extent. Globalisation requires changes in our understanding of democracy, sets new demands on families and, according to Giddens, demands a cosmopolitan attitude so that the world does not sink into the chaos of fundamentalism, various forms of play. - I. Globalisation II. Risk III. Tradition IV. Family V. Democracy
content.title_en: Unleashed world: how globalization changes our lives

content.text: Regional land use plan : legal framework and recommendations for implementation. The amendment to the Regional Land Use Act, which entered into force on 1.1.1998, opened the possibility, under certain conditions, of a plan simultaneously assuming the function of a regional plan and a common land use plan. This new plan type is called a regional land use plan (RFP). The working group of the ARL shows the possibilities resulting from § 9 paragraph 6 ROG for the restructuring of the German planning system, sets out the organisational and legal issues associated with this framework regulation; explains planning-methodical questions resulting from the design of the new plan type "Regional Land Use Plan", and gives recommendations to the countries on the possibilities of a federal implementation.

content.text: Professional Internet research: for scientists and online professionals. This practical guide will show you the most profitable online resources and most efficient research techniques, which you can use quickly and safely for any topic, to keep an eye on the data highway clogged with abundant information waste. To this end, the most important general German and international (meta) search services and web catalogs are precisely portrayed using concrete research examples and the best special search aids, such as online library catalogs, encyclopaedias and specialized information sources, are presented. The practical main part of the book is complemented by a constructive discussion of the opportunities and risks of learning on the web. content.text: The project was funded by the German Research Foundation under the priority programme "Technological Change and Regional Development in Europe" (Phase III) under the title "Telematics-based Regional Networks (TRN) and their impact on regional development in Europe". The volume presents the results of the research project for the identification and evaluation of telematically based regional networks (TRN) in Germany and Europe. TRN can be understood as a reaction to socio-economic change and as organisational concepts of economic cooperation relations. Their participants - small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) - cooperate with each other via different communication channels, which are wholly or partly based on the new information and communication technologies. Based on a detailed literature and document analysis, the current research status is presented. The economic, political and technological framework conditions and prerequisites in the EU for the construction and use of such networks are elaborated. Special attention is focused on the relevance of TRN for the competitiveness of SMEs and for regional development. In the empirical part, the regional networks in the European Union are identified by the pre-selection of the enterprise's marketing industry, the new potential of the industry and the enterprise's business.

One of the surprising findings of the investigation is: We aesthetically judge when we know nothing; in our explanations and causes ascribements of danger potentials lurk; with better information grows the anbivalence, also decision-making inability; the violence as an example of a false connection of spirit and organization.
content.title_en: The stupidity of the information society: Social psychology of orientation

content.text: Humboldt : Travel novelles. Four travel novels - prose texts, picture-text-image-stories and the combination of both: via ferratas in the Montblanc, where the overtaking for sprinters seems impossible and the tides of nature are tempting. The base camp in Quadâne, in Mauritania, where it has not rained for fifteen years and as a compass in the sky the cross of the south appears to point the way at night. Ulm Münster, whose ascent one needs a camouflage cap, otherwise comes the fire department. And Humboldt, about which Günter Herburger writes in his preface: "At the end of his life he was in Siberia, again inspiring to discover so much new that is close to us, because, he said, who does not appreciate hybrides, can become at home, the most famous place, only misanthropic and fall false judgments."
content.title_en: Humboldt : Travel novelles

content.text: Sociology of nutrition. Just as in the "Sociology of Food" by E. Barlösius (see this no.), this entertaining and diverse presentation is not only sociologically interested. Although more attention is paid to social structural change, socialization, drive structure, power and violence, fast food and gene food, but also similar structure and cultural historical orientation. Some passages are much more sociological than in Barlösius with the corresponding specialist terms. Both titles deserve a recommendation, complement each other in an ideal way, in the present, somewhat more comprehensive work a subject register helps with the development. (2) (LK/H: Günther)
content.title_en: Sociology of nutrition

content.text: The collection of essays deals critically with the previous school measures to prevent alcohol abuse among young people, also provides information on alcohol prevention in extracurricular educational areas, such as kindergarten and family, and shows which measures are taken in some European countries to prevent alcohol. - Complementary to "sight and drug prevention in parents' homes and schools" (BA 7/94) and to D. Bäuerle (BA 5/96). (3 S) (LK/DU: Heckmann)
content.title_en: Alcohol prevention in education and teaching

content.text: Geopolitics : to the ideology critique of political spatial concepts. The political spatial concepts of modernism served in the age of nation states and imperialism, especially the legitimization of national borderlines in the run-up to the First World War, but they also influenced the spatial construction of the nation states that emerged from the colonies. At the level of the global or large-scale concepts, the ideological and propagandistic preparation of the territorial objectives of expansion, their scientific preparation and accompaniment and their political-administrative implementation were the main focus. Moreover, the regulation of territorial interests balance between the imperialist powers, for which spatial images (influence spheres) formed an important legitimization basis.
content.title_en: Geopolitics : to the ideology criticism of political spatial concepts

content.text: The author, detective and computer expert, presents a compact paper with information directly from the practice on all important aspects of the protection of minors in the PC area - focusing on online communication in the title. Some general remarks follow 3 main chapters: dangers through the Internet, protection of various types and useful advice for teachers and parents (and also librarians!); the conclusion is a reference to Internet offers for children and young people, a short conclusion, a glossary with commendable detailed explanations and a concise list of literature. R. Richard has not only succeeded in being as complete as possible, he has also been able to provide all relevant information clearly and intelligibly in the texts despite the shortness of the individual subsections. An important book - current and critical, as the subtitle promises - that libraries (repeated as contact points for obtaining the necessary media competence) for the loan, presence and/or the hand hold is highly recommended. (1) (Roland Schwarz) The protection of minors offers the most useful aspects of the protection of minors's privacy and the Internet.
content.title_en: Protection of minors on the Internet: a current and critical guide for teachers and parents

content.text: In the laboratory of the physics history: to investigate historical experimental practice. The trend of the public understatement of science? acquire an original opinion by saying that people do not only their own history but also their own natural science. This is the aim of a small research group in the physics department of the Carl von Ossietzky University. For more than fifteen years, she has been exploring the history of experimentation and experimentation with a unique method: to imitate historical experiments with the most original copies. What theoretical basis does this 'replication method' have? What can one learn from its application? To reflect the demand for public understanding of science is more, and to show that man does not make his own history.
content.title_en: In the Laboratory of Physics History : to investigate historical experimental practice

content.text: IBM and the Holocaust: the involvement of the world corporation in the crimes of the Nazis. Klappentext: The Nazi extermination campaign against the Jews required smooth logistics. The core of the murderous wheelwork were the punch card systems and Hollerith machines provided by the American company IBM and the German subsidiary Dehomag. Edwin Black shows how deeply IBM was involved in the Nazi crimes to secure its monopoly and make millions of transactions.
content.title_en: IBM and the Holocaust: the involvement of the world corporation in the crimes of the Nazis

content.text: Design of buildings: a guide for students. The author teaches construction and design at the Wismar University and misses practical instructions on design of buildings in the standard works. His guide for students of architecture and civil engineering tries to convey the "crafted" joining of parts to a building in addition to the knowledge of facts. In 5 thematic blocks he deals with the trained perception and classification of building types, work organization and structuring in the planning phase, object conditions and requirements for the construction, the modeling of constructive solutions and checklists for building control. Understandably written, compressed in the type of study scripts, with many small-format SW photos and drawings. In case of appropriate specialist reading good addition to the standard works "construction theory" by M. Mittag (BA 9/00), "high-construction construction" by H. Schmitt (ID 34/01) and "construction theory" (Band 1: ID 12/98, Volume 2: ID 39/98). (3) (Elke Nibbrig)
content.title_en: Constructive building design: a guide for students

content.text: Java and XML. Java and XML are both powerful technologies, because of their platform independence, but together they form the ideal solution for developing web-based applications. Java can develop portable code, generate ,it XML portable data. Their common features such as expandability, reusability and global language support (Unicode) make them so effective in their interaction. The book deals with: a) the basics of XML b) the use of SAX APIs and DOM APIs to parse XML c) the development of new document types with DTDs and XML schema d) the writing of programs that generate XML data e) the conversion of XML to different other formats with XSL/T f) the programming of applications with XML RPC g) the use of frameworks such as Apache Cocoon h) the use of XML as a configuration language i) the programming of business-to-business applications with XML j) the development of information channels with RSS and dynamic content with XSP. (MOD)
content.title_en: Java and XML

content.text: Paris: Art metropolis and cultural city. From the same author as the comparablely equipped volume "Versailles" (BA 7/97) this heavy-weight title on art history from Paris from the beginning to La Defense. In the large sections of antiquity/medium ages, modern times and modernism, the detailed text explains the city's cultural heritage and investigates the geographical, economic, social and historical conditions under which the cosmopolitan metropolis was created. Those who do not want to work through the whole profound text can enjoy the rich, almost inconceivable pictorial material. With maps, short biographies, registers. The inexpensive volume can be used in addition to more handy Paris art guides (such as Droste-Hennings, DuMont; BA 11/00). (2) (LK/HL: Ittekkot)
content.title_en: Paris : City of Art and Culture

content.text: Fathers : the importance of the father for the psychological development of the child. Fathers educate differently! This book breaks with the traditional idea that the mother is responsible for the first months and years of life of the toddler alone, and emphasizes the need for an intensive relationship between fathers and their children from the beginning. There are many reasons to focus more intensively on the role that fathers play in raising their children today: the dissolution of traditional role patterns, combined with the increasing professional activity of mothers, the pluralization of life forms and a new self-understanding of men. Paradoxically, this is not true that psychology, psychoanalysis and binding research over half a century, as it goes without saying, were based on the fact that fathers play only a marginal role in the development of a child - a prejudice with which the author of this book thoroughly cleans up even on the basis of his own scientific investigations and beyond that fathers (and mothers!) give many useful tips.
content.title_en: Fathers : the importance of the father for the psychological development of the child

content.text: Castles, lands, places. The mythical places that have been found in the Middle Ages have a magical effect on the imagination of the people. These include such imaginary places as paradise, hell, the heavenly Jerusalem or Walhalla, but also real places such as Aachen and the city castle Alhambra, the Chinese Wall and the Marienburg, such as Mecca and Rome. There are also certain types of places with fixed meaning and function such as the monastery and cathedral, the tree garden or the abandoned. And finally, there are the fictional places of literature and art such as King Arthur's Camelot, the Gralsburg or the Minnegrotte or the "non-place" Utopia, which have all legendary and legendary reputation. To some of these places such as the Schlaraffenland or Schilda you can only get there with the help of imagination, but to others you could actually travel and can still visit them today, such as the pilgrimage destination Santiago di Compostela, the Wartburg or the pseudo-middle-sized fairytale castle Neuschwan and many other places are accessible in the band.
content.title_en: Castles, Countries, Places

content.text: Review: Baumgartner and Payr want to show how a scientific thesis in the study, starting with the first idea for the work until its publication, should be worked out step by step and systematically. The question of how the Internet can be integrated into this process and which help can provide modern information resources is always addressed, but is not as far in the foreground of the presentation as the book title suggests. A guide, which is structured with numerous diagrams, tables and lists, which is directed in the first line to students of the social, economic and humanities sciences. On the subject see also the general guide by M. Stolpmann (BA 5/97). (2) (Reinhold Heckmann) Guide on the use of the Internet and modern information tools for scientific work. (Reinhold Heckmann)
content.title_en: Studying and researching with the Internet

content.text: Problems of urban development and municipal policy 2000 : Results of a panel survey with municipal urban development planners. In 2000 the German Institute for Urban Studies repeated its annual city survey on the current problems of urban development and municipal policy for the 22nd time. The aim of the survey series is to gain an insight into the structure of municipal problems and to observe the changes in this "municipal agenda". The panel deliberately focuses on the problem view of urban development planners, which is typically cross-resort and forward-looking. A supplementary question explores "successful problem solutions" that deserve to be considered in comparison with cities. Materials and documents are incorporated into the Difu databases ORLIS and DEMOS.
content.title_en: Urban development and local policy problems 2000 : Results of a panel survey of municipal urban development planners

content.text: Basic course on statistics in the social sciences: an easy to understand, application-oriented introduction to the necessary statistical knowledge for social science. The book is intended for social scientists who want to gain the basic knowledge necessary for them in a course of the scope of a semester. It conveys to its readers "statistical literacy" so that they can read - output tables from statistical programs, - classify statistical statements in scientific publications, - statistically criticise opinion polls, - describe own datasets with the statistical basic methods. It works with little mathematics, many graphics and original output of the statistical program SPSS. - What is statistics?, social science data collection, scale levels, frequencies, location parameters, scatters, normal distribution and other theoretical distributions, probabilities, confidence intervals, nominal scaled correlation measurements, ordinal scaled correlation measurements, correlation and regression.
content.title_en: Basic course on statistics in the social sciences : an easy to understand, application-oriented introduction to the necessary statistical knowledge for social science

content.text: Excel for Controllers : effective and pragmatic Excel. In the first part of the book, extensive application possibilities of Excel are presented and hints, tricks and ready-made solutions are offered, which support a controller especially in the commercial area (accounting) in the daily work. The second part is business oriented. In addition to the presentation of various financial mathematical functions, the acquisition of existing data and their analysis are discussed. Other main topics are: cost accounting, planning and simulation, creation of graphics and sample templates, scenario manager, solver and pivot table, balance analysis, movement calculation and procedures of investment accounting. Part 3 provides an insight into the automation possibilities with VBA, the uniform programming language of the Office 97 program package. In a slight manner, the non-programming of the office programming is facilitated. In addition to the version Excel 97, the previous version Excel 5.0 and Excel 95 is also taken into account.
content.title_en: Excel for Controllers : Effective and pragmatic use Excel

content.text: The discovery of the shadow: the fascinating career of a mysterious phenomenon. The fact that the earth is round, Venus shines out of itself and Robert Peary never reached the North Pole, this knowledge owes humanity one of the most natural and at the same time mysterious phenomena on this earth: the shadow. Roberto Casati traces this phenomenon and presents as cleverly as entertaining all the confusion and discoveries that have been triggered by shadows.
content.title_en: The discovery of the shadow: the fascinating career of a mysterious phenomenon

content.text: The book provides the necessary tools for the design of "wild" areas for children and young people. The author is committed to the positive effects of these areas of experience on their users. The necessary steps are described in detail, from financing to plant management, through to care measures. The main part of the book is covered by the so-called planning elements such as plants, paths and places, structural elements (walls, wells), water (pond, watercourse) etc. Detailed instructions for practical work and detailed descriptions of suitable wild and useful plants as well as numerous references to further literature are very helpful. An indispensable book for the planning and implementation of natural outdoor areas for children. (2) (Georg Braun)
content.title_en: Courage to the wilderness : nature-oriented design of outdoor areas at kindergartens of public playgrounds and schoolyards ; practical assistance

content.text: From mobile phone, fiber optic and Internet: this is how modern communication works. Communication technology comes to us at every step in our daily lives. But we usually don't think much about the technical requirements. The book introduces us in an easily understandable way to the function of technical systems for signal processing and signal transmission. It starts with the definition of the term information and signal transformation and leads the reader to the modern news networks. A short view of the possibilities of future developments decides the band, which addresses those who want to know more about the theoretical foundations of communication technology from professional or general interest. Who is interested in the practice of this technology, should be pointed out H.-J. Geist (BA 12/01). (2) (Burchard Bulling) Information and signaling, signal transformation, source coding, transmission paths, connections in space, communication networks: How does information and communication work? (Burchard Bulling)
content.title_en: From mobile phone, fiber optic and Internet: this is how modern communication works

content.text: Living with the Bauhaus. Klappentext: Tom Wolfe describes the unprecedented triumph of a once revolutionary idea and sets the barren, impersonal and highly abstract style of Bauhaus architecture in contradiction to American civilization and its needs for representativeness, demonstration of power and wealth. Wolfe wants to challenge with his polemic essay, written with wit - adequately translated by Harry Rowohlt.
content.title_en: Living with the Bauhaus
Powder metallurgy : metal powders, sintered metals, carbides ; standards

content.text: The German energy policy between climate protection and liberalisation: spatial perspectives of change. The study analyses the current reforms of German energy policy in the context of the institutionalisation of climate policy, the long-term expiry of nuclear energy use and the liberalisation of energy markets. It examines the overall effects of the reforms for the spatial structures of the energy supply and energy services industry as well as for spatial development.
content.title_en: German energy policy between climate protection and liberalisation: spatial perspectives of change

content.text: ... and in the future the knowledge society? : the handling of knowledge in the decision-making process. Knowledge and information have become central elements in the preservation of competitiveness, both for the individual and for a company. Without knowledge and information, the increasingly fast-growing decision-making cycles cannot be successfully mastered. The St. Gall Center for Future Research sheds light on the many aspects of this topic.
content.title_en: ... and in the future the knowledge society? : the handling of knowledge in the decision-making process

content.text: Now I'm learning TCP/IP: [under Windows 98, ME and 2000 to get to know and install; start without prior knowledge!]. The book provides an introduction to TCP/IP and related protocols. After basic knowledge is taught, the author shows how to independently network small and large networks, especially Microsoft networks, with TCP/IP. A little knowledge of the hardware is helpful. Furthermore, advanced techniques for subnets, routing, DHCP, WINS and DNS servers are explained. In manageable learning units there are both repeat questions and a summary. The book is sufficient and usefully illustrated. However, a short-cut directory and a conceptual overview would have done well. Unfortunately, a CD-ROM with meaningful and freely available free and shareware or at least link tips for the Internet is missing. It is useful for people who need to build, know or maintain a small network. (2) (Rainer Burghausen)
content.title_en: Now I'm learning TCP/IP: [under Windows 98, ME and 2000 get to know and install ; start without any prior knowledge!]

content.text: Symbols in kindergarten - understand and design : a practical book for the religious early education of the 3-7 year olds. This practical book for kindergarten shows how educators can sensitize the perception of children. In conversations, with the help of stories and pictures, through songs, games and other activities light and tree, path and seed, stones, water and air are experienced in their symbolic meaning. A wealth of ideas brings new impetus for working with children.
content.title_en: Symbols in kindergarten - understand and design : a practical book for the religious early education of the 3 - 7 year olds

content.text: The authors' team Wenninger/Ownerstetter (both are graduate psychologists) provides many practical tips for speakers and moderators. Numerous illustrations loosen up the well-readable text. Detailed index, extensive bibliography. 1. Choice, however, remains J. Seifert (BA 2/02). (2) (Sigrid Liedmann)
content.title_en: To illustrate content : Guide to Presenting and Moderating

content.text: Bioinformatics : a guide for natural scientists; [databases, online tools, websites, glossary]. Bioinformatics is concerned with the processing of complex biochemical and molecular-biological data, in particular with the large amount of data in genomic sequence analysis (see also H. H. Rashidi in this No.). These data are collected, structured and evaluated to gain new insights into, for example, structures and functions of genes and their products, proteins. The book explains the basics, methods and the essential applications of this new scientific discipline, it provides an overview of national and international databases and describes forms of research on online tools and related software. A compressed introductory guide for natural scientists and physicians who are engaged in studies or occupationally with sequential analytical methods. Just as the title of Rashidi for larger libraries with expanded and differentiated natural science stocks. (3) (Helmut Köhne)
content.title_en: Bioinformatics : a guide for scientists; [databases, online tools, websites, glossary]

content.text: Planspiel zur Umführung der EIA in der Bauleitplanung : Statement of planners to the draft law. Urban projects can have a significant adverse impact on the environment. In order to take sufficient account of environmental damage in large and generally significantly polluting projects, the law on environmental impact assessment (UVPG) is amended and provisions on the EIA are included in the BauGB in the development planning. Thus, the Federal Government meets EU requirements and brings the municipal development planning to a standard laid down by European law. The Federal Ministry of Building commissioned difu to carry out a practical test of the regulations from the legislative project concerning municipal development planning. The results are documented. In addition, the volume provides important indications for the interpretation of the new legislation and illustrates its practical handling by means of examples.
content.title_en: Plan game for the implementation of the EIA in the planning of the building: Statement of the planners on the draft law

content.text: The Darß-Zingster Bodden : a study. The report describes the ecological status of this coastal landscape. One focus is on poor water quality and the lack of integrated coastal zone management. Targets are defined to increase e.g. water quality. The importance of this landscape in the context of complex and complex ecosystems in the Baltic Sea is underlined.
content.title_en: The Darß-Zingster Bodden : a study

The integration of Central and Eastern European States (CEECs) into the European Union has different perspectives depending on whether they are considered from the point of view of the current Union countries, the CEECs or the regions located at the interface where the borders will fall. In this second volume, the results of the study on EU-East Enlargement are presented specifically on the basis of subprojects.
content.title_en: EU-East Enlargement and German Border Regions / Jürgen Riedel (Project Coordinator) ; 2: Subprojects

content.text: Registry Guide : Windows 2000, Windows NT4 ; [over 100 registry keys]. The book offers a comprehensive and up to now unique update of registry entries to Windows versions NT 4 and Windows 2000 and thus closes a gap in knowledge of the registry and its documentation. It not only shows the structure of the registry, but also presents the differences in the two operating systems and thus facilitates the handling of the migration to Windows 2000 and beyond. It helps not only to change the operating system, but also supports the technical measures that guarantee the operational security and availability of the Windows servers. A crucial additional benefit to the book is the CD-ROM: The RegCheck tool, as a database and expert system, facilitates the documentation, commenting and archiving of any number of registry entries for the corresponding system with a superior and conscious attitude to set up the management of large Windows networks.
content.title_en: Registry Guide : Windows 2000, Windows NT4; [more than 100 registry keys]

content.text: The collection includes 50 examples of modern, innovative and spectacular staircases, mostly designed in the 1990s by well-known architects such as R. Rogers, T. Ando, I. M. Pei. The very high-quality photographs show the interiors of stairs, including the staircases in the entrance hall of the Louvre under the glass pyramid. The construction of the stairs is illustrated in a very colourful way and explained on several pages. An introductory text gives a brief overview of the history, function and symbolism of the staircase. The target group of the noble-designed band are fewer builders looking for practical solutions (for this purpose, "New Stairs" BA 9/00) than architects, interior architects and architects interested in architecture. (3) (LK/HL: Ittekkot)
content.title_en: Staircases

content.text: The genetic controversy : Basic positions : the speech of Johannes Rau. This collection of contributions to the controversial discussion about genetic engineering is, like "biopolitics" (in this no.), mainly concerned with research on embryos and preimplantation diagnostics. In the complex debate, the reader is tried to give an overview of the various positions and arguments. In contrast to the above title, the critical and warning evaluation of the new biotechnologys prevails in this volume, and he also considers and discusses the far-reaching effects on society, which can become creepingly more visible (e.g. how does the handling of sick, disabled or old people change? How is human dignity defined?). Easier accessible than the above title. Both books belong to the stock of public libraries due to the brisancy of the subject. (2) (LK/SB: Nieper)
content.title_en: The Gene Controversy : Basic Positions : with the speech by Johannes Rau

content.text: Building business - Basics : Project participants, project planning, project process. Practical textbook for students of civil engineering and architecture at universities and universities. Relevant basics are provided for construction project process, business management, process planning and quality assurance. Understandably formulated, also suitable for self-study. With numerous diagrams, tables, examples for performance lists, sample calculations. On the topic of project management, reference is made to P. Greiner: "Building business - project management" (ID 12/03 - in KA quite requested) in the same series. No direct comparison title. Libraries with corresponding specialist audiences are recommended. (3)
content.title_en: Construction business - Basics : Project participants, project planning, project process

content.text: E-Learning : to make the revolution of learning profitable. Experts expect that vocational education and training courses that rely on electronic learning methods will increase significantly in the coming years. The volume provides an overview of the current state of scientific discussion, including methodological and didactical issues, addresses key aspects that business companies should take into account when using e-learning offerings, and provides examples and experiences from the practice of "electronic supported learning". Like the compilation of S. Seufert (ID 10/01) a special title for training managers in business and administration, course managers and other professionals. (3) (Reinhold Heckmann)
content.title_en: E-Learning: Making the most of the revolution of learning

content.text: The aim of the CD-ROM is to provide a better understanding of the work situation and the situation in the workplace, and to provide a better understanding of the situation in the workplace.
content.title_en: Working without end : new employment relations and trade union labour policy; [with a CD-ROM of IG-Metall]

content.text: The Court House and Paradise Garden: Architecture and life forms in the Islamic world. To adequately assess the problems of the Islamic world today, it is important to sharpen the understanding of the traditional patterns of thought and behaviour of Islamic culture, which act as subterranean forces up to the present day and have found a particularly well-feasible precipitate in architecture and art. The present book, the sum of a more than 25-year-old, critically sympathetic examination of Islamic architecture and life culture, provides an instruction on such deeper understanding. Stefano Bianca describes here the archetypical basic forms of Islamic architecture: the house, the palace, the garden, the mosque and the bathroom, as well as the public buildings, the tombs, the markets and the variety of commercial buildings. He explains how they are structured, how they were used and how they are combined into unique city structures. Moreover, the author uses literary and philosophical sources to illuminate the spiritual conditions of Islamic art, which finds one of their highlights in ornamental architectural decoration. Beyond the external style features, a holistic panorama art is created.
content.title_en: Hofhaus und Paradiesgarten : Architecture and life forms in the Islamic world

content.text: Theological, heretic, saint: small lexicon of persons on church history. This lexicon provides concise and vivid information in about 1000 articles about saints and mystics, heretics and cult founders, popes and politicians, Christian kings and emperors as well as the most important Catholic and Protestant theologians. The history of Christian churches and sects is as diverse as the people who shaped them. Those who wanted to get an overview of the most important persons in church history so far, were dependent on several volumes of encyclopaedias or a multitude of specialized reference works. This lexicon provides for the first time in a volume scarce and reliable information about the life and work of the great figures of Christianity from the Apostles to the present. Literature under the articles enable the targeted deepening. An indispensable reference work not only for theologists of all denominations, but also for historians and art historians as well as all readers interested in cultural history. The lexicon is supplemented by the two reference works Kleines Lexikon der Kirchengeschichte von Manfred Heim (1998) and Mönchtum, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden, Orden,
content.title_en: Theologians, Heretics, Saints : small personal encyclopedia on church history
