content.text: Publicity and counter-publicity on the Internet: political potentials of media development. The authors analyse the complex functional interactions between conventional and new media as well as the resulting constitutional conditions of politics in the digital age. Starting from the question whether public is fragmented by media development, the reality content of current visions is concerned, namely the efficient networking of alternative discourse flows and the development of direct democratic politics on the basis of Internet communication. The dialectical relationship between information technology and the public is clearly evident: the Internet always constitutes counter-publicity; however, there is the risk of increasing reciprocal penetration of state and society. Opponential publicity therefore means more than protest movement on the Internet. It refers to a new way of dealing with critical public opinion.
content.title_en: Publicity and Counter-publicity on the Internet : Political Potentials of Media Development

content.text: The German-Polish manual of planning concepts. The completely revised German-Polish manual of planning concepts makes an important contribution to the mutual understanding of spatial planning in the partner countries and for cross-border and transnational cooperation in Europe. Against the background of the EU enlargement and intensive Baltic Sea cooperation, it is constantly increasing at all levels in Central and Eastern Europe. The glossary with explanations on the most important planning concepts has been preceded by introductory chapters on state and administrative structure and planning systems in the countries concerned. A comparison of planning systems facilitates the comparison of both countries. Illustrations of plan maps of the different planning levels illustrate the explanations. A translation of Polish and German technical terms into English facilitates transnational communication.
content.title_en: German-Polish manual of planning terms

content.text: The author demonstrates the possibilities of a procedure of renovation that preserves the character of the house. He strongly recommends the use of historical materials (e.g. for a breathable wall structure: "cement is like caries") and the use of traditional methods of craftsmanship. All steps should also be coordinated with the monument authority. The chapters are oriented towards the special problem areas of the houses, from the basement (if any) over floor, foundation base, timber structure, inflated areas, thermal insulation, plaster, roof chair and roof up to the painting and painting work. The materials are the main focus; in addition, each chapter concludes with "What you should avoid", the cost question is always kept in mind. - A recommended, fundamental guide, especially suitable for non-professionals (also in other regions of Germany), currently in this concept without any conflict. (2) (Leo Prawitt)
content.title_en: Restore half-timbered houses - renovate - modernize : materials and procedures for permanent repair

content.text: Attempts to be told about the fraud: religion, writing, image, gender. Anyone who deepens into the ambitious, slightly eccentric book about the fraud will soon be caught up in fraud. The highly educated, highly-read professor of cultural studies at Humboldt University in Berlin has packed too much into her work and has linked too many topics - gender, media, the relationship between Jewish and Christian tradition, "crazy interpreters and false readings" - so it is difficult to recognize the red thread she has designed, deciphering a subliminal discourse that is based on the thought of progress in the West. Despite understandable language and interesting passages, the volume is almost unreadable. - Not recommended for public libraries. (Ursula Homann)
content.title_en: Attempts at the vertigo : religion, writing, image, sex

content.text: "The application must be rejected": 14 pretexts against compensation of forced laborers; a German scandal story 1945 - 2000. On 30 May 2001 the German Bundestag found that legal certainty for German companies was given to lawsuits of former forced laborers for compensation in the USA. The author of this narrow pocket book, jurist and time historian (born 1939), doubted that this also means that the matter itself is out of the world: He lists 14 pretexts, among which companies, offices and politicians, assisted by legal doctrine and jurisdiction, rejected and further reject applications for compensation. Scandally, not only the behaviour of the Federal Republic and the German economy since 1998, but the whole history of refusal to pay since the end of the war was a single scandal - a well-founded view. Especially since recently an intensified investigation of forced labour under Nazi rule (such as J. Schulte, in this No.) revealed new facts, structures and connections. (2) (Friedrich Andrae)
content.title_en: "The application must be rejected" : 14 pretexts against compensation for forced laborers; a German scandal story 1945 - 2000

content.text: Learning knowledge management : a guide to the design of workshops and self-learning. Knowledge management is the conscious and systematic handling of knowledge and the targeted use of knowledge in organizations. The aim of this book is to provide an introduction to knowledge management concepts and to promote the application of knowledge management methods. "Learning organisation", "guideline" and "company culture" are considered topics. The book is suitable for self-learning, but also as a material collection for workshops. Clear, practical. Target group: adult education staff, employees responsible for company organization (also in the field of municipal training). (3) (Ute Scharmann)
content.title_en: Learning knowledge management : a guide to the design of workshops and self-learning

content.text: Asylum policy on the wrong track : national and European responses to the globalisation of refugee flows. This book provides a coherent rationalistic analysis of the asylum policy of the OECD world. The authors analyse numerous measures and show the extent to which the risk of discrimination for refugees in a growing Europe is high.
content.title_en: Asylum policy on the wrong track : national and European responses to the globalisation of refugee flows

content.text: The orbits of the Sun: the birth of planets, volcanoes on Venus, the moons of Jupiter, The Kuiper belt. Here are summarized again more recent results of the exploration of the solar system (as of 1999): the origin of planets, solar physics, solar wind and its effects on the Earth (physically and meterologically), Mercury, the least explored planet (a Mercury mission is planned for 2009), the moons of Jupiter, especially Europe, the Kuiper belt between Neptune and Pluto, a ring of ice and dust, where numerous smaller objects have been discovered in recent years, the Oort cloud (the source of most comets) and gravitational interactions, especially of the outer planets, which play a greater role than was recently assumed. Current addition to the literature on the solar system, much image material. Widely recommended. (2) (Rolf Becker) An attractive compilation of articles on the topics "The Birth of Planets", "The Moons of Venus" (The Moon of Jupiter).
content.title_en: The satellites of the Sun : the birth of the planets, volcanoes on Venus, Moons of Jupiter, The Kuiper Belt

content.text: www.revolution.de : the culture of the New Economy. "Happy boys and girls sit in front of their computers, have fun together and work among equals in the productive collective" - so founders, employees, investors and politicians liked to imagine the "new economy". After not even half a decade, the decline occurred when investors wanted to see the dotcoms' turnover and profits. While R. Hickel (in this list) describes the economic background of the collapse, the two "field researchers of the New Economy" (cover) examine the culture of the industry. They thoroughly clear up the myth of the "new" of the New Economy: Flat hierarchies and (conceived) self-determination of creative employees have already existed in the alternative enterprises of the 70s and advertising agencies of the 80s; the negative side effects in the Internet economy are however far more pronounced: self-exploitation of employees, ironization of their own person and social isolation. - Excellently researched, sober representation of German conditions. (3) (Michael Reisser)
content.title_en: www.revolution.de : the culture of the New Economy

content.text: The post-war Holocaust images in contemporary art and architecture. What the Shoah-born generation of artists knows about the Holocaust, which she did not know herself, originates from the memories and traditions of the victims, the survivors: historical consciousness, the past from second hand. The Anglist and Judaist of the University of Massachusetts in Amherst, member of the expert panel for the Berlin Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe, has already dealt with the subject on several occasions from different, art-theoretical approaches: "Describe the Holocaust" (ID 21/92), "Mahnmale des Holocaust" (ID 17/94), "Forms of Remembrance" (ID 12/98). The new book is also not a thematic overview of contemporary art, but rather a discussion of selected artistic positions of memory after Auschwitz: among others Spiegelman's Maus-Comics, Levinthal's photo series on Hitler's "Mein Kampf", Attis Sites Unseen to Liebeskind's Museumbau and the Berlin memorial problem. Special, but important. (3) (Friedrich)
content.title_en: After-images of the Holocaust in contemporary art and architecture

content.text: Time-frequency transformations for radar imaging and signal analysis. The contents of the book deal with the application of time-frequency transformation in the aspect of radar signal processing. In detail, the authors refer to the signature extraction of radar targets as they are used in the automatic target detection. One-dimensional distance profiles as well as two-dimensional radar images are considered. Techniques of extraction of signature properties of radar targets are described by means of multiple scattering processes and taking into account their movement in space.
content.title_en: Time-frequency transformations for radar imaging and signal analysis

content.text: Internet in primary school : media-educational and didactical basics. Wöckel discusses what the Internet actually is and gives a lecture on the results of the Rhineland-Palatinate model experiment on computer use at primary schools. He tries to lay down general pedagogical-didactic principles, then comes to the specifics of the Internet use in primary school and finally shows in brief individual examples from the teaching practice. Mainly theory-oriented. - For students of primary school education and for primary school teachers. (3 S) (Reinhold Heckmann)
content.title_en: Internet in primary school : basics of media education and didactics

content.text: Landscape aesthetics : about the essence, meaning and handling of landscape beauty. The mechanistic world view, which determines our perception of landscape and is perceived by sensitive observers as pathological, needs an ecological perspective as well as an aesthetic perspective to change: today, the contrasts between culture and nature, between mind and body, and between subject and object seem too crass. Symptomatic for this state are the numerous ecological problems that could only arise due to the disregard of the aesthetic basis of life. Landscape aesthetics, in addition to philosophical aesthetics, are a young topic. The author gives an overview of the tendencies in landscape aesthetics, stimulates improvements and strengthens the awareness of landscape beauty. He challenges previous thinking habits and values and pleads for less arrogance in dealing with landscape, wholeness and integration.
content.title_en: Landscape aesthetics : about the nature, meaning and handling of landscape beauty

content.text: The risk spiral: what remains of the New Economy?. The Bremen economics professor (as editor: "Do we need another economy?", BA 1/02) is a member of the "Working Group Alternative Economic Policy" and representative of a holistic economic theory, which - in contrast to neoliberalism - explicitly includes social policy and ecology. Hickel takes stock of the failure of many companies in e-business. By the market adjustment, more economic core data were now counted. He emphasizes in particular that Germany and Europe were not "posted" by the USA, but that many traditional industries were able to successfully adapt the e-commerce concept. Although the IT industry will play a more important role in the future, there can be no question of the need for a comprehensive realignment of entire economies. The "ideological fiction" of a new economy is ultimately only a way forward for the "extension of the economic principle to all areas of life".
content.title_en: The risk spiral: what remains of the New Economy?

content.text: The individual wooden house: from the idea to the optimal solution. In detail, construction and construction of a low-energy house were described and photographed - according to the wishes and ideas of a trained carpenter and graduate designer designed by an architect - health-friendly wooden house in current wooden frame construction, not cellared, with a desk roof and with wood and glass as clearly dominant materials in construction and design. Further data: 120 sqm usable area, high central living space with gallery and bridge, and construction and planning costs of 510000 DM (without land). The numerous photos show the construction progress and the works of the craftsmen step by step, vividly and comprehensible, supplemented by explanatory descriptions and some drawings. Whoever bears the thought of building a similar house, receives excellent visual material here as decision-making aid or for planning. Of course, the local building regulations must be considered as a priority. - Certainly no must for libraries, but a very interesting offer for potential builders. (3) (Leo Prawitt)
content.title_en: The individual wooden house : from the idea to the optimal solution

content.text: The preservation of monuments is often seen as a patronage or an intervention in the "freedom of construction". It is overlooked that the political mandate behind the conservation laws is to protect historical evidence and to preserve it for the coming generations. For the roof brick industry, the preservation of monuments is an important pillar, as about 20% of the turnover is achieved there. In the old roof area, a total of 60% of all sales are achieved. For the construction trade, the handling of monuments is rather a niche. However, if qualified, this can lead to a sales segment that is quite lucrative. In this brochure, the main aspects of the preservation of monuments are explained, roofing materials and heritage-related techniques, historical brick covers and details are described.
content.title_en: Brick roof and preservation

content.text: Algorithmics. The "teaching of algorithms" is broad here. It leads from concepts of logic, such as the predictability of functions or the concept of completeness, to the analysis of program and data structures to known mathematical calculation methods. The author is more concerned with understanding the background, the study of complexity and efficiency, than with the provision of procedural recipes. A detailed initial chapter deals with basic pincipia at a quite abstract level. The following sections, which present algorithms from various fields in pascal-like block structures, are however largely independent of this. The reader should have programming experience and be familiar with elementary stochastics. The contentful text can be recommended to interested parties in theoretical computer science, especially students of this subject. (3) (Wolfgang Grolz)
content.title_en: Algorithmics

content.text: Manual of natural dyes : occurrence, use, proof. The focus of this manual is a comprehensive, systematic presentation of the methods and tools for the analysis of natural dyes (prevention, proof). Chemists receive an excellent tool for the determination and detection of the various natural dyes, e.g. on old textiles. The history of the use of natural dyes from the prehistoric period is therefore another focus. The focus is on chemists, botanists and textile specialists, but also on interested parties from archaeology, ethnography and art history. A future standard work, which is probably only suitable for large stocks. (3) (LK/SB: Prawitt)
content.title_en: Manual of natural dyes : occurrence, use, detection

content.text: The competition of the victims: Genocide, identity and recognition. The Belgian author (born 1958) of the excellently translated book (original edition 1997 before N. Finkelstein and P. Novick, both BA 5/01), philosopher and sociologist, was a long time associate of the Fondation Auschwitz in Brussels, is currently working with research assignment at the University of Louvain and has published many individual topics in the vicinity of this book. It should be remembered that he is a serious expert in Holocaust, Auschwitz and Jewish extermination, because Chaumont here discusses the ever-controversial topic of the historical singularity of the Shoa, asks questions, seeks answers and gives. "If the Shoa was unique, what place will remain for the suffering of the others?" Such questioning may be wrong if it comes from outside Jewish perspective. But whoever, like this author, takes up the debate with such seriousness, has a right to be heard and taken note of it. Extensive bibliography. No easy reading, but important. (3) (Friedrich Andrae)
content.title_en: The competition of the victims: genocide, identity and recognition

content.text: AfricaImages : Studies on racism in Germany. The subject of "racism in Germany" is dealt with in this volume using African images that are circulating in everyday life. The authors assume that right-wing extremism is only part of the general racism (language, politics, media) firmly anchored in the German federal society, whose roots are to be sought in colonialism. The book is based on events of the faculty at the seminar for African Studies of Humboldt University (Berlin). Scientists, lawyers, politicians and cultural workers are spoken, and controversial opinions are presented. Part 1 is reserved for the historical and ideological treatment of racism, the second part is designed by cultural professionals who present and explain the African images in their respective metiers. The third part is devoted to politics, foreign, development and internal politics. Acribisch is searching for examples from the African quarter in Berlin via song texts and school books to the ethnopornography of the 19th century. Unique in abundance. (3) (LK/HD: Eberle)
content.title_en: AfricaPictures : Studies on racism in Germany

content.text: Sustainable consumption: Research and practice in dialogue. Buyers and users of goods are crucial for the realization of ecological, social and economic sustainable development. Renowned authors present innovative concepts and answer the question of how "sustainable consumption" can be determined in terms of content and implemented in everyday life.
content.title_en: Sustainable consumption: Research and practice in dialogue

content.text: Model turbines in self-construction : technical basics and construction practice. In this series the author published a book on the self-construction of a steel turbine (see BA 10/92) Since then he has been one of the pioneers for this fascinating type of propulsion in flight model construction. In addition to complete kits and finished parts, there are now also ready-to-use (and quite expensive) turbines to buy. The engines have become more efficient and reliable and are used more frequently in model flight. Schreckling gives an introduction to the technical basics and the necessary accessories for model jet turbines in this book. In the main part he describes clearly the assembly of a kit turbine and the own construction of two model turbines. With detailed piece lists, construction drawings and photos. In addition to the older title of T. Kamps ("model jet engines", ID 29/95) highly recommended for experienced, committed model builders. (2) (Günter Pflaum)
content.title_en: Model turbines in self-construction : technical basics and construction practice

content.text: The main works of ethnology. Klappentext: The ethnological interest in culturally different works is probably as old as human culture itself. A teaching and research subject at the universities was not made until the late 19th century. The emphasis in the selection of the main works presented here lies on the ethnology of the late 19th and 20th century with classics that found far beyond the narrower limits of the subject. In this new volume of the Hauptwerk series, renowned representatives of the subject inform in scarce, generally understandable articles about 104 key works of ethnology. The reader receives information about the conditions of origin, content and impact of the works, their significance in the history of ethnology as well as about the most important issues and research contributions.
content.title_en: Main works of ethnology

content.text: The Karl Drais, a professor and technical historian of Ulm, wrote a standard work on everyday use with the "Bicycle Book" (lastly BA 3/97), which unfortunately never re-issued. But the subject of two-wheeled vehicles does not seem to let go of it, as this biography of the often-sad democrat and ingenious treadmill inventor Drais (1785-1851) shows. But this work, richly illustrated with faksimile historical documents and illustrations, is even more - a story of the roots of modern individual traffic that began with the wheel. Lessing works with amazing thoroughness and leaves many other literature on traffic history fleeting and superficial. His fascinating book requires readers with long breath and considerable historical interest, which will be found in large libraries. There as a truly extraordinary addition highly recommended. (3) Lessing's ultimate Drais biography is at the same time an extremely entertaining book on the history of mobility in all its facets. Quickungen, patent claw, parallel developments, backgrounds and private disasters were the same for the first time in the history of the automobile.
content.title_en: Automotiveity : Karl Drais and the incredible beginnings

content.text: Paperback Chemical Substances : Elements - Anorganika - Organics - Natural Substances - Polymers. In this new edition (most recently BA 5/93) of the chemical lexicon, published in new design, you get fast all-round information about about 1200 substances (chemical elements, inorganic and organic compounds, natural substances and polymers). These are more than 300 compounds than in the preliminary edition. Thus, current developments (e.g. prions, BSE, fullerone, Viagra) are taken into account. In addition to the descriptions of the substances (appearance form, occurrences, synthesis, properties, analysis, historical, toxicology) important practical references and inter-subject relationships are presented. Very detailed register, whereby one could have omitted an additional list of the substances, since they already find a good mention in the subject-word list, visually well removed. The preliminary edition should soon expire. Useful for information stocks starting from medium libraries! (2 A,S) (LK/MD: Hörning)
content.title_en: Paperback Chemicals : Elements - Anorganics - Organics - Naturals - Polymers

content.text: Klausurtraining Statik : 100 Tasks for the basic and advanced studies. Compact task collection for civil engineering students in the 1st to 4th semester for practicing and deepening of static basic knowledge. Systematically divided into 9 topics such as rod works, statically defined specialized works, frames and arched structures. Each chapter consists of short text explanations, detailed and illustrated tasks with solution paths and exercise tasks with solution instructions. Good addition to textbooks such as "Practical Structural Statistics" (Volume 1: BA 9/94; Volume 2: BA 8/98; Volume 3: BA 10/97), F. Bochmann: (3 volumes: ID 31/01) or G. Lohmeyer (Volume 1: BA 4/97; Volume 2: ID 39/01). (3) (LK/KA: Nibbrig)
content.title_en: Examination Training Statics : 100 Tasks for the Basic and Advanced Studies

content.text: Essays and speeches. Niklas Luhmann, founder of system theory, is considered one of the most important sociologists of the 20th century. This volume traces his career by means of selected, sometimes unknown, writings. Oliver Jahraus' extensive post-word gives a good overview of Luhmann's work and is excellently suited as an introduction to the complete work.
content.title_en: Articles and speeches

content.text: Departure in the Church : Instructions for a future-proof Christianity. Healful-provokatively written, with explanatory examples and summary theses, the book by Michael N. Ebertz offers concrete impulses and trend-setting perspectives for a future-proof Church. A start to think, a basis for discussion and discussion for women and men who care about the future of the Church.
content.title_en: Departure in the Church : Instigation for a future-proof Christianity

content.text: Packaging innovative. The commercial packaging of products is not only intended to address customers and to arouse their needs, but also to provide product-related information in addition to the protective function. The richly illustrated publication shows which solutions (also unusual) are possible. The author, an expert in packaging design, works for the English company Automatic, which specializes in printing and packaging solutions. Based on 50 case studies, the author shows interesting packaging solutions with different equipment elements for different products. Each example is shown on a double page and is described with his manufacturing process, specifying the designer, customer and the materials used. With technical dictionary of packaging materials and manufacturing processes. In the annex several templates that can be used as a template for three-dimensional packaging. No history of packaging design, but an aid for professionals/designers in the packaging industry. (3) (LK/K: Weber)
content.title_en: Packaging innovative

content.text: Global agenda: Communication and globalization. Globalization is on the agenda of the media and is at the same time the main feature of a comprehensive transformation process of our world. Network communication offers new opportunities, but also new challenges, e.g. in the form of a digital two-class society (Digital Divide), an enormous acceleration and the associated decision-making pressure. In the global information society forms of cultural understanding, processes of information and knowledge management and the role of the media are re-explored.
content.title_en: The global agenda : Communication and globalisation

content.text: The gravel garden : gardening on dry site. Chatto, British garden expert (see "In the green realm of perennials", BA 10/92), began to build a garden in the 1990s, which was entirely oriented towards the specific conditions of her home Essex. The soil: gravel and sand; the climate: extremely dry and windy. She therefore began to care for "dry artists", such as lily and ornamental lurk charters, clematis, agaven. Following the seasons, she describes, accompanied by magnificent photos, growing and flourishing (sometimes also not flourishing) of her plants. Although not everyone like the author has more than 3000 square meters of garden - and even her "small" gravel garden has the size of a tennis court - the title is not suitable for lovers and visitors of beautiful gardens alone. There is enough preparation and advice for the native, stony front garden. Inform about dry-resistant plants - even if short comprehensive garden manuals like "The large garden manual" (BA 6/01).
content.title_en: The gravel garden : gardening on dry site

content.text: Waste and marble columns : Sanitation in Roman antiquity. How was Roman culture: unusually hygiene conscious? "the purest nation in the world", in history "only standing there" in its cleanliness need? Or is the opposite right: has Rome neglected hygiene? Rome as a "dirty, foul-smelling place", unhealthy to human contempt? The author asks to the literary, epigraphic and archaeological tradition questions like: Was there a Roman garbage collection? Where were the waste of the places, manors and caste? Only the answer of such questions allow a sound judgment.
content.title_en: Waste and marble columns : Sanitation in Roman Antiquity

content.text: Fire fighting : structural installations, facilities, organisational fire protection. Contains: DIN 55394-1:2000 [Prenorm] ; DIN 55394-2:2000 ; DIN EN ISO 10012:2001 [Manuscript] ; DIN EN ISO 14024:2001
content.title_en: Fire fighting : structural installations, facilities, organisational fire protection

content.text: The PostScript & PDF-Bible. PostScript and PDF in comparison. Differences and similarities of the programs developed by Adobe. The Portable Document Format (PDF) as universal file format for the exchange of digital documents from one PC to the other. All operating systems, OS2, Windows etc., can recognize and edit the existing format. PostScript for the exchange and later output on paper or film. Mostly to control different devices for the generation of a graphic output. Different operating systems can be used. The program is mostly used in laser printers or for the exposure device, the films for offset printing are generated. PDF files are usually converted to PostScript files before output on a printer.
content.title_en: The PostScript & PDF Bible

content.text: Schleusen und Wehre : Technik und Geschichte. Uhlemann is a traffic engineer and worked for decades at the waterway administration; he already wrote "The History of Shiplifts" (DSV-Verlag, 1999). Here he begins to discuss the development of waterways, in order to then devote himself to fixed and mobile defences and lifts. In the second main part he deals with locks with their gates, filling and emptying facilities as well as facilities for water saving. The historical development and technical description of the different forms around the world keep the balance. Reich illustrated with historical and contemporary photos and technical drawings. Local and personal registers round off the work for professionals and interested lay people. (2) (Martini Paulini)
content.title_en: Locks and Weirs : Technology and History

content.text: The whims of chance: scientific discoveries of Archimedes to this day. Chance is not a reliable size. And yet it is important in science. One only thinks of Archimedes, who (the tradition) discovered in the bathtub the physical law on the hydrostatic buoyancy forces when he - by chance - noticed that his body was displaced in the tub water. His discovery helped him solve a task that King Hieron II had put to him. This story - whether true or not - shows how chance can help a researcher achieve an an anvised goal. However, there are also cases in which chance helps to a not planned discovery - or even harms the researcher. A total of 35 "incident stories" from the time of Archimedes to today, divided into the departments of archaeology, anthropology, biology, medicine, pharmacology, chemistry and physics, are presented in this volume by the author, professor of human biology and genetics, such as the discovery of the X-ray or the development of the antibiotic.
content.title_en: The whims of chance : scientific discoveries of Archimedes to the present day

content.text: Urban-Umland problems and development of large-scale retailing in the countries of Central and South-East Europe. The European Working Group for the Central European and South-East European Area of the ARL presents a collection of lectures which shed light on the question of suburbanisation and the different framework conditions from the point of view of the countries Germany, Austria, Slovak and Czech Republic and Hungary. Using the example of retailing, the influence of large-scale projects on the space and thus on suburbanization processes is presented and the question of new, effective control possibilities is addressed.
content.title_en: Urban-Umland problems and development of large-scale retailing in the countries of Central and South-East Europe

content.text: Atlas on the history of Islam. Large-format alto-las volume on the history of Islam, i.e. the religion per se and "also the history of the world shaped by this religion" (preface) from the 7th century to the present. Spatial references and developments are far better represented in maps, temporal contexts in graphic representations than in many words. An excellent addition to the boards are the respective texts, scarce and compact, which convey basic facts and background knowledge. Through good structure, table of contents and various registers the volume is well accessible. The only small, really to be neglected wormwood drop: the maps are not titled. A competitionless volume, which optimally prepares an incredible wealth of information, appealing and carefully designed, in short: worth its price. (1 A, S) (Elisabeth Mair-Gummermann)
content.title_en: Atlas on the history of Islam

content.text: Gold-plated and silver-plated: new trends and techniques for decorative living. This book can certainly be seen as the ultimate highlight in the field of decorative living, because the material is as noble as the material used, and the appearance and effect of the metallic shiny or gently shimmering walls, floors, furniture and accessories. After an introduction to the work area and the artistic criteria, the author leads 20 large and small projects, first of all on the underlying idea, listing the required material and tools, specifying the preparatory work and finally the subsequent work gradually in the image and text. This follows with basic material and tools, for the production of glue and polish, as well as a summary description of the technology of genuine gold-plated as well as the numerous other, less elaborate and less affordable methods of achieving metallic effects. On this basis, own projects are possible.
content.title_en: Gold plating and silver plating : new trends and techniques for decorative living

content.text: The microstructure of the export boom. This paper uses secret individual data from official surveys in Lower Saxony industrial companies to take a look behind the scenes of the export boom. Here, a marked heterogeneity of export dynamics between companies within a main group, technology class and size class is shown. Neither the size of the company nor the industry nor the wage cost development have a statistically significant connection with the probability that a company belongs to the category of export-upper...
content.title_en: The microstructure of the export boom

content.text: Buildings for children: a guide to kindergarten planning. The legal claim to a kindergarten place leads to an increased interest among planners and authorities in the construction of day-care facilities for children. The authors are architects and present here a generally understandable and vivid book with basics and facts. The first part deals after a short demolition of the toddler's education the structural foundations, technical aspects, educational concepts (e.g. Montessori, Waldorf, Reggio) and architectural interpretations, interior design and material selection, cost calculations and cost-saving constructions. In the second part 38 examples show the variety of possible solutions, divided by buildings until 1992 (budgery crisis through reunification) and after 1992, documented in detail with photos, drawings, floor plans, key figures. The guide is equally recommended for architects, planners, educators, educators and parents. For ecological design and furnishing of kindergartens see E. Lutz (BA 8/96) and K. Blessing (BA 9/01). No current basic comparison title is known. (2)
content.title_en: Buildings for children : a guide to kindergarten planning

content.text: The moving classroom : a project shows effect ; results and suggestions for practice. The authors report on their primary school project "Leichter lernen durch Bewegung". They use suggestions and findings of moto-pedagogy and the Edu-Kinestetik and try to facilitate and support cognitive learning, which dominates teaching. In the second part, reports from application practice and examples of moving games to promote writing and arithmetic. - For primary school teachers, supplemented by M. Scholl (BA 2/99), S. Meixner (BA 11/96) and F. Decker (BA 11/97). (3 S) (Reinhold Heckmann)
content.title_en: The moving classroom : a project shows effect ; results and suggestions for practice

content.text: The expert's report: legal basis, questions, structure, rationalization. The book offers a comprehensive introduction to the complex expert report topic and makes it easier for the beginner to create and evaluate expert reports. Experienced experts can provide numerous suggestions on how to shape their expert reports even more rationally and with a high degree of persuasiveness in the future. With this second, revised and supplemented edition not only psychologists, but also experts from other disciplines receive practical information on the following topics: legal status of experts and expert expertise, appropriate expert report structure, design of expert reports - form and content, basic requirements for expert reports and quality criteria, avoidance of frequently occurring expert reports and errors, rational handling of expert reports, billing of expert reports.
content.title_en: Expert opinion: legal basis, questions, structure, rationalization

content.text: The book is dedicated to the well-known architect and urban planner Hardt-Walthorr Hämer, who has devoted himself to all his tasks during his 80 years of life with great commitment and proverbial power, as an architect or planner, as a remediator and IBA director in Berlin, as a university teacher or Bauhaus director in Dessau, as a human being and a interfering citizen. Hemer was always led by the "city in the head" especially the man in his so complicated relationship to the built architecture a concern. Five authors, among them Manfred Sack and Susanne Kippenberger, draw a convincing portrait of this great lateral thinker of the recent German architectural history
content.title_en: City in the head : Hardt-Waltherr Hämer

content.text: The area of Lower Saxony is covered by the study on the basis of the construction of an integrated property, building and building management of the State of Lower Saxony. Structure: 1. Introduction (1.1 contract - 1.2 initial situation. - 1.3 Methodological requirements. - 1.4 implementation). - 2. Cross-university design structure and central requirements (2.1 formation of planning units. - 2.2 initial size study places. - 2.3 study place distribution profiles. - 2.4 subject-specific area targets. - 2.5 scope of third-party funding research). - 3. area requirements (3.1 assessment procedures. - 3.2 area requirements of technical facilities (area basic equipment for teaching and research, capacity ineffective facilities, area additions of third-party funding research, other supplements of technical facilities). - 3.3 area requirements of library system. - 3.4 area requirements of central and other facilities including university administration). - 4. Summary and re-use of the area requirements (4.1 total area requirements of higher education institutions. - 4.2 determination of accommodation budgets - new approaches to property management. - 4.3 differentiation to control models of land use on site). - Literature directory. - Annex A. Installations. - Annex B.
content.title_en: The areas of Lower Saxony universities: Investigation on the occasion of the construction of an integrated property, construction and building management of the state of Lower Saxony

content.text: The cell : Atlas of Ultrastructure. Folding text: The book, now published in the third revised edition, describes the submicroscopic morphology of the cell organelle after an introduction to the apparatusive foundations of electron microscopy, which follows an explanation of the entire cell system by means of selected cell forms. Pathological aspects are also taken into account. The focus of the presentation is the electron microscopy image, which is partly supplemented by schemas. Colour plates and text illustrations facilitate the presentation of the three-dimensional organization of the cell. Each chapter is accompanied by a detailed literature list. The book is primarily aimed at students in basic and specialized studies of all bioscientific disciplines and medicine, but also particularly at teachers and pupils of the Gymnasial upper level.
content.title_en: The cell : Atlas of the ultrastructure
Aluminium : Standards / ed.: DIN, German Institute for Standardization ; 2: Bars, pipes, profiles, wires, raw material

content.text: The environmental design is the focus of the project: the reduction of waste products, energy and material consumption in the production of products, as well as their environmental compatibility. The author, an English university teacher, has compiled a collection of materials with information, household items, building materials, etc., which he believes can help to avoid environmental damage. Introducing eco-design strategies, he describes how manufacturers/designers can avoid environmental damage. Thematically structured according to everyday objects, working environment and materials, 600 products are then described in a catalogue. For each product, there is information about the designer/manufacturer, material, awards with eco-prices. A source part contains addresses of designers/manufacturers, institutions, glossary, bibliography with Internet addresses. A practical manual also for environmentally conscious consumers. (2) (LK/K: Weber) Recycling Sports Office Usage Material Transport Mobility Seat furniture Material Everyday object Materials Household appliances Eco-design Ecodesign
content.title_en: Handbook on ecological design : furniture, objects, equipment, materials, addresses

content.text: Media City: urban clusters and global centres of cultural production. The "Media City" is termed cultural and media centres on a wide range of geographic scales - it includes local clusters of cultural production in urban areas, up to the cultural metropolises of the global urban system. Today, the media economy can be considered as "lead industry" and pioneers of socio-economic structural changes by creating institutional forms of creative production, the division of labour between companies and spatial organizational relations, as well as the cross- and cross-market marketing of new products in ever shorter cycles, which will shape many branches of social work in the future. In selected large cities, urban clusters of cultural production form together, which draw their dynamics from the interplay of knowledge- and design-intensive branches of activity in urban areas. The cultural economy is also shaped by globalization processes, whereby global media corporations and their global network of subsidiaries and subsidiaries combine the urban clusters of cultural production, and commercially exploit the trends or lifestyle elements that are found in leading media cities.
content.title_en: Media City : Urban Clusters and Global Centers of Cultural Production

content.text: Science and wisdom : to the conversation between natural science and theology. Jürgen Moltmann's theology has always inspired the "Book of Nature". This volume gathers the most important contributions of the Tübingen systematicist to the scientific-theological dialogue and points them out: Moltmann places wisdom as the ethics of knowledge in the common center. Thus, he shows that the theological world perception is important for the natural sciences and that the scientific findings are enriching for theology. - Respect instead of appropriation. Wisdom as the ethics of knowledge.
content.title_en: Science and Wisdom : to the conversation between science and theology

content.text: Architectures of the moment: Space-images and image-spaces of urban modernity in literature, art and architecture of the 20th century. Is the technical city of the 20th century determined above all by the dominance of vision and visibility, by the hegemony of spatial-time orders? Are their uniform spaces speaking to us alone in the visual vocabulary of functional neutrality, while participatory, involved experiences of the next environment disappear? What are their identity as a place, their concrete and symbolic constructions of space, their social and cultural memory? Or has it become the everywhere identical, uniformly equipped transit space, the non-place of an overmodernity? The author addresses such questions by returning to the beginnings of urban modernity in the 20th century, to the epochs of 1910, and directing them to the visual arts, literature, architecture and cultural theory since early Italian futurism.
content.title_en: Architectures of the Moment : Space-Pictures and Image-Rooms of an Urban Modernism in Literature, Art and Architecture of the 20th Century

content.text: Light and lighting : Basics and applications of lighting technology. Publisher's text: The textbook describes the basics of lighting technology: physiological and physical prerequisites for light perception, light generation, use of light as lighting, light-technical building materials and the technical realization of indoor and outdoor lighting.Editor's text: The textbook describes the basics of lighting technology: physiological and physical prerequisites for light perception, light generation, use of light as lighting, light-technical building materials as well as the technical realization of indoor and outdoor lighting.
content.title_en: Light and lighting : basics and applications of lighting technology

content.text: Basic principles of Internet law : e-commerce, domains, copyright. The work focuses on the current and important legal problems of the Internet in connection with modern information and communication technologies, such as trademark and copyright, advertising and contract law issues. Structure, cases and examples as well as schemes and graphical overviews illustrate the context. For students of the departments of law and economics, companies, lawyers, judges.
content.title_en: Basic Internet law: e-commerce, domains, copyright

content.text: Art of the Middle Ages: an introduction; from the beginnings of Christian "art" to the end of the Middle Ages. Klappentext: In the 1980s, the question of whether art history was at the end of the century had been raised, has not only proved to be viable, but has revealed an enormous potential for rapid development. A kind of process of globalization regarding the material involved and the duplication of methodological approaches make it difficult for students and art lovers beyond the university to orient themselves in the abundance of the offer. This book therefore deliberately lays red threads through the visual media architecture, sculpture, painting, etc., which were applied between the 1st century AD and the transition from Romanesque to Gothic in Europe and in the countries bordering the Mediterranean south and east. It shows artistic connections, but at the same time understands the individual works as voices in a comprehensive discourse.
content.title_en: Medieval Art : an Introduction ; from the beginnings of Christian "art" to the end of the Middle Ages

content.text: The authors, historians and experts in the history of the building industry with practical experience (Großmann: BA 4/99), are fascinated by buildings made of wooden skeleton and ephemeral clay and which grow up to 750 years old. The development of the construction history of the timber structure from the beginning to the present day is discussed with the essential characteristics of the individual epochs. Further chapters describe the subject-relevant materials wood, clay, stone, technical terms and explain the historical construction of the walls, ceilings and facades. Finally, the authors enter into timber houses in the present, provide tips on conservation, restoration, reconstruction and warning of errors. With numerous, also historical black-and-white photos, glossary, addresses of museums and institutions. The book, which is clearly written, is a good guide for professionals, for trade houses or potential buyers, but also worth reading in the interest of historical construction art and handicraft work. (2)
content.title_en: Half-timber as historical construction : a guide and guide

content.text: Manual of foundational damage : recognition and repair. The research of the building ground as an important component of a construction project is a relatively young science. Wrong assessment of the building ground conditions and resulting, partly significant liability risks, have made it necessary to prioritise the classification of the ground conditions, the methodology of the construction ground exploration and the calculation of the type of foundation. For the builder it is important that only sufficient and regular construction ground investigation offers him the desired planning security, cost safety and damage freedom. The book informs about the procedures of the building ground and building analysis, repair procedures of foundations and the damage elimination by press-in techniques. Numerous examples from the practice document renovation services on historical buildings, supporting walls and bridges. TOC:History of construction.- Ground.- Founding types.- Special effects on the foundation system.- Building ground and building analysis.- Renovation methods.- Areas of use for damage elimination by press-ining technology.- Building practice examples.- Construction management and quality assurance.- Standards and regulations.- Information from manufacturers, service providers and professional associations.-
content.title_en: Manual of Founding Damages : Detecting and Repairing

content.text: Sustainable development in Germany : to make the future sustainable. In this future study of the Federal Environment Agency, a continuation of "Sustainable Germany" (BA 1/98), different environmental-relevant fields are linked according to the concept of sustainability: energy use, climate protection, food production, mobility, tourism, industry, natural resources. A separate chapter deals with the policy of sustainability. Clear, greatly expanded. Extensive literature. Also useful for pupils of secondary school level II. (2 S) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: Sustainable development in Germany: making the future sustainable

content.text: The Weimar Republic. The series, conceived as study literature, is a work of scientific debate on core topics of historical studies. The volume offers a brief overview of the epoch in its introduction, and then in the main part in 8 sections, develops major controversy in research. These include debates on the role of the workers' movement, the importance of the economic crisis, the voters of the NSDAP, the end of the Republic, etc. The conclusion of the book, which is written in legible form, is a critical balance of the research status. Register of subjects and persons. No footnotes, instead, references to the detailed, structured list of literature. According to E. Kolb from the series "Oldenbourg-Grundriss der Geschichte" (lastly BA 1/01) can be used primarily in the university field. (3) (Engelbrecht Boese)
content.title_en: The Weimar Republic

content.text: Introduction to social psychology. A problem-oriented introduction to the questions of social psychology. -- To answer, we address social impression formation and social memory, prejudices towards social groups and gender roles. How does aggression and helpfulness relate to our values and attitudes? What does violence, which is shown in the mass media, cause? -- Further focus: close relationships (physical attractiveness, love and dissolution of relationships), processes in groups that refer to performance, conformity and decisions. -- With a presentation of the research methods of social psychology and its application in law, in business and in the environment. -- "This introduction to social psychology pursues the goal of presenting important and interesting topics while at the same time promoting methodological awareness of errors and traps in social science studies. Moreover, there is a focus on questions that are important for educational psychology, such as self-fulfilling predictions, change of attitudes, trust and solidarity. The logic of the organization of the text is that four basic chapters (the formulation of social psychology, the formation of social psychology, and the formation of social opinion, the formation of social opinion, and the formation of social opinion).
content.title_en: Introduction to Social Psychology

content.text: Clinical psychology and Internet: Potentials for clinical practice, intervention, psychotherapy and research. The Internet has become an almost everyday communication and information medium in recent years. After analysing the effects and influences that the Internet has as a tool and as a medium on clinical psychology, this volume presents the importance of the Internet as an information medium. For this purpose, relevant Internet resources for behavioural medicine, children's and youth psychiatry and psychoanalysis are presented. Contributions to online consultation, psychotherapy and self-help make it clear that the Internet can be used as a communication medium to support certain components of a clinical-psychological intervention process. Internet addiction, sex on the net, suicidality on the Internet: The use of the Internet as a communication tool has direct consequences and interactions in relation to human experience, behavior and perception; accordingly, various clinical-psychological aspects of Internet communication are addressed. Finally, the Internet can facilitate and support the research process. In the latter part of the volume special research aspects are discussed, e.g. data collection in the network or the external presentation of clinics on the Internet.
content.title_en: Clinical Psychology and Internet : Potentials for Clinical Practice, Intervention, Psychotherapy and Research

content.text: The historian who teaches in Hanover and Berlin deals with the 20th century as the "century of dictatorships" and speaks and analyses the different research approaches, the rise, design and the overcoming of dictatorial systems. The core topic is the question whether the comparison of dictatorships from a historical and political perspective is meaningful or even necessary, in a methodological way feasible and acceptable on a moral level. The study provides a concise overview of comparative dictatorship research and its various approaches "totalitarianism", "political religion" and "modern dictatorship", whereby the controversial theses are clearly elaborated and also treated with special questions. Like the entire series, the title is conceived as study literature. The aim is to facilitate students' preparation for teaching events and examinations. Therefore, in the first line for large libraries in university locations. (3) (Gerhard König-Kurowski)
content.title_en: Dictatorships compared

content.text: Visual C++ 6: [the mitp standard work for professional programming with Visual C++ 6; database access with OLE DB; MFC libraries; professional use with DLLs]. The author is known for his introduction to Visual J++6 (ID 18/99). In a similar way he now presents a work on the competing language Visual C++6. The basics of programming are treated with Visul C++, i.e. the creation of demanding Windows applications. The book deals with almost the same material as R. Nanko (BA 10/00), but is much more detailed at the same price. Clear layout; each chapter deals with a completed topic and ends with at least one detailed sample program. The source code is only used for those parts that illustrate the basic concepts of the respective example. The complete code can be found on the accompanying CD-ROM. The examples can be used, at least in sections, well as building blocks for own applications. The focus is on the error handling, the use of the Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), the database access and the database application and the use of the Internet.
content.title_en: Visual C++ 6: [the mitp standard work for professional programming with Visual C++ 6; database access with OLE DB; MFC libraries; professional use with DLLs]

content.text: Small manual of measurements, numbers, weights and time calculation. Compact reference work on measurement and the various measurements in history and present. It begins with a very interesting overview of the measurement process and the measurement systems used (about 1/4 of the book) and then presents in detail the international unit system SI, which is widely used today (with examples and tables). A chapter on numbers and number systems and one on control of measurements and measurement (e.g. calibration), an extensive collection of old units (by epochs and regions or states), tables on material properties (chemical elements and compounds) and standardised dimensions (e.g. paper formats, clothing sizes). Finally, a time table on metrology and a literature directory. Compared to the licence edition of 1996 (Bechtermünz; BA 8/97) only slightly changed. Still highly recommended and very inexpensive. (1 A) (LK/SB: Nieper) Compact reference work on measurement and measurement systems and units used in history and present. (L/SB: Nieper)
content.title_en: Small manual of measurements, numbers, weights and the time calculation

content.text: Wood components properly protected : durable wooden buildings by constructive wood protection. In this book, the author shows numerous possibilities to protect wood structures by purely constructive measures and to completely dispense with chemical active substances. He presents the physical and anatomical properties of the wood and explains the consequences of this for the constructive wood protection. He explains in detail the different demands, for example wood protection with permanent earth and water contact, direct weather stress and internal installation with high room air humidity. For each application he informs about the suitable wood type. Numerous construction drawings and illustrations illustrate the text...
content.title_en: Wood components properly protected : durable wooden buildings by structural wood protection

content.text: Islam and Germany: Muslims in Germany. Those who expect a presentation of Muslim life in Germany, information about the everyday life of 3.3 million Muslims, will be disappointed. Tibi is primarily concerned with bringing a cultural-historical and religious-scientific treatise to the reader, which is at the core of his thesis that only the liberal, European-thinking Muslim has his place here. Urgent and missionary as always an appeal to not allow too much tolerance and multicultural romanticism to be exercised, in order not to destroy the foundations of democratic civil society. All this would certainly convince more if Tibi did not devalue every different position as "blue-eyed" and uninformed. The plus points of the book - well-founded intellectual and religious-historical statements - offer nothing new compared to his previous publications. Therefore, at least for large focus libraries. (3) (Daniela Neuenfeld-Zvolsky)
content.title_en: Islam and Germany : Muslims in Germany

content.text: The large passenger ships of the world : illustrated register of all 750 passenger ships of the world from BRZ 10 000. Reference work on large passenger ships of the world. Provides a chronological sequence (after years of construction) with technical data, short descriptions, photos. Has been extended compared to the 3rd edition of 1991 (ID 3/92) by numerous new entries and updated in the data. In the Annex a list of withdrawn and under construction ships. A register of the ship names closes the information-rich volume. Important documentation for larger stocks (the old edition should be replaced). (3) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: The big passenger ships of the world : illustrated register of all 750 passenger ships of the world from BRZ 10 000

content.text: Modelled use of gas vehicles: Final report August 2001. Within the framework of the "Investment Programme for the Reduction of Environmental Pollution" of the Federal Government, the use of gas vehicles was tested as model projects. In three model regions this project was supported/translated from 1997: City of Augsburg, Wernigerode district, Bad Harzburg and Usedom island, later on Hanover. In the model regions the original target was significantly exceeded (Wernigerode: forecast 95 vehicles/result 406; Bad Harzburg: 93/252). An even greater success is the broad impact that could be achieved via the model project, which ultimately led to modern, competitive and environmentally friendly natural gas vehicles being pushed into the market and further funding programmes being launched today throughout Germany.
content.title_en: Modelled use of gas vehicles : Final report August 2001

content.text: PONS technical dictionary Environment : English - German. The note "1. Aufl." is a bit misleading. In fact, Peter H. Collin had already published a "PONS technical dictionary Environment: English-German, German-English" (BA 4/92), also with Klett. In essence, Kohlschmitt's complete new development is an English-German "dictionary", i.e. a dictionary (with short explanations, but not consistent). Includes about 18000 English keywords with over 21000 German equivalents from the field of environmental protection and related fields. Suitable especially for translators. Amazingly few overlaps with "Langenscheidt's technical dictionary Compact Ecology: English-German German German-English" (in this no.). (3 A) (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: PONS Specialist Dictionary Environment : English - German

content.text: After us the future: the global conflict for justice and ecology. Review: Sachs, co-worker at the renowned Wuppertal Institute, (co-)author, among others of "Zukunftsfähigkeits Deutschland" (BA 4/96) and "Der Planet als Patient" (BA 4/95), takes into consideration in 8 essays (obviously different time of origin) the topic of a future world society under the conditions of an increasingly globalized economy and politics on the one hand and the global conflicts (ecology, climate, population etc.) on the other. The environmental summits of Rio (1992) and Johannesburg (2002) play a not insignificant role as well as the guiding principle "justice", in addition to that of "sustainability". Unfortunately, mainly English-language titles are mentioned, of which a German translation has long been available in detail. In addition to J. Trittin: "Welt Um Welt" (BA 11/02) from medium library. (2) (Helga Lüdtke)
content.title_en: After us the future: the global conflict for justice and ecology

content.text: The school is reinvented: Systemic-constructivist approaches to school and pedagogy. The editor of this essay collection is Professor of School Pedagogy and Systemic Therapist. In the contributions of the book, a different view of school and school reality is attempted on the background of systemic thinking. The degree of abstraction of the contributions is sometimes very high. Due to the fact that the book is already in 4th edition (previous editions were not presented) and that the 2nd school congress on the topic is already planned, the title is displayed here. (3) (LK/W: Scharmann)
content.title_en: Re-inventing the school: Systemic-constructivist approaches to school and pedagogy

content.text: The editors, professors at the University of Bremen, are giving a good insight into a world that is not publicly visible, but which makes globalization possible. It is a realistic description of facets of today's maritime shipping, not a historical presentation. International experts provide information on technical, legal, political and social conditions of transports via sea, such as the structural development of shipping and port operations, the importance of billy flags, safety and environmental protection and their control, working and living conditions of seafarers. The target group is primarily to be sought in shipping circles, but the text is not easy to understand. - The book fills a gap. (2) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: Maritime shipping in the face of globalisation

content.text: Mobile networks: basics, services and protocols; 19 tables. An introduction to mobile services with GSM, GPRS and UMTS for students. Many sections are also understandable and important for laypeople (Martin A. Lobeck) In Germany alone, there are currently more than 50 million mobile subscribers in the 4 D and E networks, all of which are operated according to GSM standard (GSM = Global System for Mobile Communications). In addition, the new Internet services with parcel switching (GPRS technology) and the future UMTS multimedia services with higher bandwidth. How all these services work and on which physical foundations they are based, describes the author - FH professor in Zweibrücken - especially for computer science students, but also for other interested parties who want to gain insight into this fast-developing and previously well-recorded technology. Perhaps they only read the short introductory chapter, which briefly describes the current and upcoming services and evaluates the use for certain purposes. Here, one should not only think about the omnipresent mobile phone, but also about the wireless DECT telephones, wireless network network (WiFi) - the local network system.
content.title_en: Mobile networks : basics, services and protocols : 19 tables

content.text: Religion and culture in Germany 1400 - 1800. Robert W. Scribner (1941-1998) was one of the most stimulating and innovative social historians of the German Reformation and the early modern era in Europe. This volume offers an overview of the central topics, approaches and results of his research in a representative selection of texts. The focus is on Scribner's work on forms of folk culture and popular faith in the late Middle Ages and the Reformation period, in which he deals mainly with the manifold forms of reciprocal penetration of practices of popular piety and reformatory beliefs. Scribner was particularly interested in the tension between theology and popular religion as well as the conflicts between religious officials and community members in everyday life. Scribner developed a completely different approach to popular piety in his late essays, in which he strongly influenced the influence of the Reformation on sensual forms of perception and the importance of images for popular beliefs and culture. Scribner's writings have been published here for the first time in the religion, culture and language history of the Reformation.
content.title_en: Religion and Culture in Germany 1400 - 1800

content.text: MediaTerrorWar: the new war paradigm of the 21st century. Not proven peace researchers and experts in arms and security policy, but mainly publicists, journalists, and "specialists" representatives of philosophy, literature and art science express themselves here in 21 essays on the supposedly new war patterns of this century. The reason for the terrorist attack of 11.9.01 and the worldwide terror fight is the focus of the contributions is the various roles that the traditional and new media play and play for the terror fight and the terrorists new types. The changes in the relationship between state and society is another focus. All contributions come from the online magazine "Telepolis". Non-founded scientific research results are presented by the 10 authors, but essays that reflect moods and/or can be understood as a thought-provoking for further investigations. A stringent editorial treatment with source and literature references could have significantly increased the value for interested readers. (3)
content.title_en: MediaTerrorWar : the new war paradigm of the 21st century

An outlook takes up perspectives and trends, keyword: party as event agency, media careers of politicians in the fun society, among others with registers of subjects and persons and many references to literature. content.text: The study and practice manual is a comprehensive textbook for students of civil engineering and for practitioners in the construction industry. It is systematically structured by sub-assemblies (natural stones, binders, concrete, wood, glass etc.) and is accessible through a differentiated table of contents and a keyword register. Compared to the 12th edition 1994 (ID 39/94), it is continuously revised, expanded and updated to the latest state of the art in building materials production, application and standardization, taking into account harmonised EU standards by the end of 2002. In particular, the chapters concrete, glass and joint sealants have been extensively revised. The preliminary edition should be used soon, even earlier editions have to be deleted. According to H. Schäffler (BA 5/00) and W. Hiese (BA 7/02), which are more intended for professional training.

content.text: Violence in the media - Violence in reality: societal contexts and pedagogical action. Media violence is only understood from the context of real violence. This topic is considered in this study from an explicitly pedagogical perspective. The book aims to theoretically fund pedagogical action and describes practical models for dealing with media violence.
content.title_en: Violence in the media - violence in reality: societal contexts and educational action

This book, richly illustrated with many photos, provides inspiration for imaginative, imaginative, colorful and child-friendly gardening. content.text: Rolling Home : Seafarers' customs, Shanties and the fascination of the great sailors. The authors associated with sailing and Shanty represent the work songs of sailors on large sailors in their social-historical context. To this end, the maritime tradition is described first, in order to then discuss the history, functions, species and variations of Shanties and also to consider the relationship to folk songs. A chapter is devoted to the maritime song stuff today. With extensive and meaningful appendix, appealing illustrations as well as notes and texts. On the CD there are 12 work songs sung by Shanty-Chor Cuxhaven, which make the development of the song type clear. Good addition to Lore Haack-Vörsmann (BA 10/02). The work for the many of the fascination of great sailors of Erlagen fills a gap. (2) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: Rolling Home : Seafaring customs, Shanties and the fascination of the great sailors

content.text: CBT and WBT practice book : design, develop, design; [with CD-ROM]. The terms "CBT" and "WBT" stand for "Computer Based Training" or "Web Based Training". The author presents the characteristics of these methods in several examples (unfortunately not on the enclosed CD, nor on web links) compared to traditional media; for which purpose they are particularly suitable and which models exist for knowledge transfer. In a second part it is about the practice: program structures, construction of tasks, use and effect of multimedia, visual design, performance features of various technical platforms (CD-ROM, Intranet, Internet), different author software. On the accompanying CD-ROM an interactive learning game of Daimler-Chrysler AG, which is used in management training. A workshop in the third part of the book leads step-by-step through its creation and serves as an example and inspiration for own projects. Practice-oriented title for users, rather theoretically Andrea Back (ID 28/02), as a general overview of Beate Bruns (ID 31/02) or "Information" (ID 31/02) and "Information (3).
content.title_en: CBT and WBT: design, develop, design; [with CD-ROM]
