This is still one of the most important titles on the European installation bus, a frequently used automated building control system, in addition to which there are also some other ones, which are also available in several books. Compared to the preliminary editions (BA 1/96, 9/98) a lot has been changed: in the case of system components, the elimination of a larger annex "Documentation of the sample plant", the addition of the chapter "Visualization" and 100 audit questions with answers. Where the preliminary edition is well used, it should be supplemented with at least this. (2)
content.title_en: EIB plans and installs : Planning and commissioning of installations in building systems technology

content.text: The author - architect with many years of experience in the repair of historic wooden buildings - with his large-format book addresses owners of timber-framed houses, architects, engineers, conservationists, craftsmen. The first part of the book provides general information on the special features of timber-framed houses, construction details, defects and defects in historical wooden constructions, work sequences on a construction site with historical buildings. The main part contains a collection of 100 work sheets with drawings on repair examples of wood connections, bases, floors, ceilings, roof structures and many more. With an extensive, colored picture part, also on detail problems and a useful annex, among others with a service list for timber-framed repair. According to the standard work of M. Gerner (BA 9/94) and the basic guideline of W. Lenze (BA 4/02) a detailed practical manual. Particularly important in regions with many timber-framed houses. (3) (Elke Nibbrig)
content.title_en: The work of the trade union is carried out in a practical manual, details, suggestions

content.text: Amok : the course of masculinity. Unlike the socio-political analyses of the amok run by G. Eisenbert (BA 11/00, ID 39/02), this book provides the historical film of the amok run describes its origin in the Malay cultural circle, its historical development worldwide and especially in the 20th century. On the other hand, the author tries to show the various forms of conflict and causes of the phenomenon by means of his own content analysis of newspaper reports on amok runs from the years 1994 to 2000. - Rather for specialists (publisher for police science) than for the general public. (3) (LK/HB: Obsen)
content.title_en: Amok : the course of manhood

content.text: SAP APO System Administration : Basic knowledge for effective system management ; [Preparation for certification ; On CD: Roadmaps for APO introduction and maintenance]. This book is addressed to all R/3 system administrators who now also want to operate APO systems. New tasks and tools are being assigned to the administrator. This book will help you to learn the differences in architecture and operation of R/3 and APO systems. It will provide you with the necessary basic knowledge on all relevant topics and help you to learn the effective handling of APO-specific tools. For example, you will learn all the things you need to know about liveCache, COM routines, data exchange, optimizers and much more. The practical experience background and the solution suggestions on this basis guarantee its high use value. The book is suitable for preparing for certification to the APO-based consultant.
content.title_en: SAP APO System Administration : Basic knowledge for effective system management; [Preparation for certification; On CD: Roadmaps for APO implementation and maintenance]

content.text: The garden of the artist: 33 portraits. The garden as a magnificent background for sculptures and other works, as an opportunity to create art in and with nature or as an object of fantasy: the team of authors (see above "Women and their gardens", not discussed here) has combined in an impressive and gentle way the various perspectives of the portrayed artists on the subject garden in a beautifully photographed picture book. It is also clear that the respective life story has influence on the garden design and the partly changed relationship with the own art (design). The result is a large-format work for lovers of interesting and unusual gardens and fans of aesthetically shaped (garden) art works. Certainly for most libraries a costly pleasure; where the above mentioned previous volume was well borrowed and who can afford it - buy! (3) (Kristina Kroll)
content.title_en: The Garden of the Artist : 33 Portraits

content.text: The central-location concept is considered one of the main conceptual pillars of German regional and regional planning. In recent years, however, criticism of the traditional form of central-location policy has increased. The relevant resolutions of the Ministerial Conference on Spatial Planning are increasingly less in line with current problems and a contemporary understanding of spatial planning. The practice of applying the central-location concept in the federal states reveals great differences. In coordination with the Ministerial Conference on Spatial Planning, the ARL has therefore established the ad hoc working group "Continuing the Central-Location Concept", which has dealt with the arguments pro and contra central-location concept and, above all, possible approaches to its further development. The results are presented in this volume. In a first part, the scientific knowledge of the central-location concept is summarized. The second part contains concrete recommendations for a contemporary development of the concept and identifies open questions for research.
content.title_en: Further development of the central-local concept

content.text: Perfect motorcycle tuning: optics and technology. The book by Vielschreiber Gaßebner is a follow-up to "Edelbikes - perfect built" (BA 9/98) and gives valuable information to motorcyclists with ambitions for tuning. The head of the magazine "PS - Das Sport-Motorrad Magazin" has already dedicated himself to tuning in young years. Well informed, often entertaining, are shown with meaningful pictures, bikes, which visually and technically surpass the series products. Essentially, 3 machines (on Honda and Triumph basis) are presented. Main topics are planning, chassis construction, engine tuning, engine electrics, production of plastic parts, optical tuning, galvanic metal finishing and questions of approval. In the appendix are among others addresses of the specialists and literature notes. Specialists, which also come to the attention here, are tuners, like the Swiss Fritz W. Egli and engine specialist Roland Eckert, who have rank and name in the motorcycle scene. Even if the number of private "Tuners" keeps in touch, learn a lot of interesting and interesting information.
content.title_en: Perfect motorcycle tuning : optics and technology

content.text: Applied turbulence modelling in marine waters. This book provides an overview of statistical turbulence modelling with applications in oceanography and lakes. It shows how these models can be derived from Navier-Stokes equations, and how gradual simplifications lead to models that can be used with numerical simulations for realistic solutions. Options for considering additional effects such as surface waves breaking and longmuir circulation are dealt with. Relevant methods for numerical discretization of turbulence models are presented. Results of one-dimensional simulations are shown for various oceanic and freshwater studies. For the integration of these turbulence models in the three-dimensional models, some selected results are given.
content.title_en: Applied turbulence modeling in marine waters
Construction / Publisher: DIN Deutsches Institut für Normung e.V. ; 4: Sound insulation : Requirements, proofs, calculation methods and building acoustic tests ; Standards

content.text: Behavioural training for school beginners : Training manual with CD. A behavioral training for school beginners for the development of social and emotional skills is presented. As an early training program it is intended to reduce problematic behaviors, such as aggressive and hyperactive behavior of the students, to build up an appropriate social behavior and develop a positive class climate. The manual contains a detailed presentation of the individual training hours including the used image material, the CD short radio plays and a song for use in the training context. For the hand of the student an additional work booklet is offered (ISBN 3-506-13605-4). - A manual for primary school teachers and school psychologists. (3 S) (Reinhold Heckmann)
content.title_en: Behavioural training for beginners : Training manual with CD

content.text: The passive house : Building for the future. A passive house is the most consistent concept for reducing energy consumption during construction by not using independent heating and the optimal use of existing passive heat. The present volume contains the thesis of a civil engineer with the evaluation of a passive house double half from a technical and economic point of view, as well as three reports by architects with very different realized projects in the southern German area: the construction of the 1st Bavarian passive house in own performance, the conversion of a building from the 18th century to a house in passive construction in comparison to 4 further projects and a single family house on a difficult building plot. All articles are well understandable, with numerous photos (somewhat grainy and pale), construction drawings, tables, calculations and company advertising as a conclusion. For interested builders an inexpensive alternative title to the first information according to D. Pregizer (in this No.), which deals with the construction technical foundations in detail and explains on a realized project. (2)
content.title_en: Passive house : Building for the future

content.text: Video editing on Windows PC. A currently available PC is sufficient for digital video editing - many devices have already built video connection cards. The authors proceed in clear steps: first, the necessary hardware is considered (necessary performance, upgrade options, camera types), then important basic rules for turning and cutting films and importing videos into the PC are discussed. The actual editing and editing is presented using the example of the three most well-known software products: an extensive chapter per program. Importance and function of the DivX codec, the work with DVDs and video CDs round off the title. The explanations are catchy, easy to understand and understandable, the technical topics are described precisely, the CD contains test versions of the software and game material, only the illustrations are sometimes somewhat outdated. Conclusion: round, coherent title, which adequately weights individual subject areas and presents the topic for beginners well understandable. The software selection is more practical than with H. Wacker: "Video editing on PC" (ID 31/02). (1) (Ulrich Wesser) Well understandable presentation of the digital video editing on PC, already for beginners.
content.title_en: Video editing on Windows PC

content.text: The Federal Republic of Germany. Klappentext: If today the "old Federal Republic" is attested a relative success story, this does not mean that fundamental choices such as the West-bound or the East-politics were not fiercely controversial in the contemporary debate or have not been controversially discussed in research or are still in part still being discussed. Bernd Stöver presents the central research controversy in a balanced and problem-oriented way and outlines the deteriorating research and development perspectives. In view of the almost inconceivable research literature on the history of the Federal Republic, he thus offers an excellent and indispensable orientation aid.
content.title_en: The Federal Republic of Germany

content.text: The consumerist manifesto. Has world history recently been pushed twice and produced in concise, myth-forming events and images, namely the fall of the Berlin Wall and September 11, 2001 foreclosures that change everything? But if one marks the end of the belief in the linearity of progress, the second appears to be the superimposed embodiment of mass-effective, fundamentalist anti-Americanism, which uses Islam. Basically, according to Bolz (see also BA ID 27/01), secular world society faces the "people of faith", who claim to be taken seriously. Luhmann's supercode of inclusion and exclusion (R. Stichweh: "World Society", ID 13/01) applies. And consumerism? Against terror, no weapons help, but the commodity world promises always new things! It only helps to infect societies with the ideology of market citizenship, market peace and democracy compatible consumption capitalism, also observed as a discipline of discipline.
content.title_en: The Consumerist Manifesto

content.text: Introduction to computer science : object-oriented with Java ; with 4 tables. Revised 2nd edition of the introduction to computer science, which is based on lectures at the University of Tübingen (see BA 2/01). Now we also discuss the hardware and software architecture of a computer, especially a PC system. The introduction to algorithms and algorithmic language constructs has undergone a restructuring (also program verification according to Floyd - loop variants). The new classes in Java 2 (SDK 1.4) are discussed as far as the programs of the book are concerned. However, an exchange of the 1st edition is not necessary. Unfortunately, no solutions are available for the exercises. For this purpose, there are on the website for the book for each chapter slides for lecturers. Since the book deals with broad sections of computer science, it is still recommended as an introduction to the further development. (2) (Shl)
content.title_en: Introduction to computer science : object-oriented with Java ; with 4 tables

content.text: Differentiation of urban life. In this volume, concepts of differentiation are systematically related to urban everyday life and urban structures for the first time and are related to each other. It is examined how, under Annanhme, a functional differentiation of society can be conceived of as a structuring formation of urban spaces. Furthermore, how hierarchical and stratificational forms of differentiation (in this case, gender) enter into an alliance with urban spaces.
content.title_en: Differentiation of urban

content.text: History of the ancient biography: from Isocrates to the Historia Augusta. From antiquity, a wealth of biographical literature has been handed down to us. Holger Sonnabend examines their literary contexts, but also puts the often neglected historical source value into the foreground: The ancient biography conveys diverse insights into the life, thinking and action of ancient personalities. This volume presents from the beginnings of the 5th century BC to the late antiquity all relevant representatives of the genre in detail with their works and in their historical context and offers for the first time a comprehensive comprehensive presentation of the ancient biography.
content.title_en: History of the Ancient Biography : from Isocrates to the Historia Augusta

content.text: Light design for interiors and gardens. Publisher's text: Light effects determine whether you feel comfortable in a room or not. Used correctly, this often neglected design element offers a versatile interior and exterior equipment that can be used to highlight amazing effects from dramatic to romantic or spectacular accessories. "Light design" presents the various possibilities of lighting design with diverse light sources and lighting bodies, thus opening the view to a new dimension of interior design. Using the interiors of well-known designers such as Nicky Haslam and Christian Liaigre, the renowned architect Sally Storey explains the different effects of natural and artificial light and the effective play with light and shadow, reflection and projection. Inspiring photos show the original use of patterns, colors and light sources and stimulates own experiments. The book presents a rich kaleidoscope of creative ideas and original proposals that perfectly preserve the balance between functionality and aesthetics. AUTOR: Architect Sally Storey worked with John Cullen, one of the most successful lighting designers in the UK. Under her direction, the team held presentations on the theme of light in Asia and the UK.
content.title_en: Light design for interiors and gardens

content.text: The foreign as a social type : classical sociological texts to a current phenomenon. With globalization international migration has dramatically increased. The world has become a planet of nomads. Wherever one looks, there are strangers. Sociology has categories with which one can understand the social situation of the foreigners typologically and understand the social logic of their integration. This introduction gathers the most important texts of the classics of sociology. The introduction of the editors systematizes these texts and develops a typology of possible forms of being foreign.
content.title_en: The Stranger as a Social Type : Classical Sociological Texts on a Current Phenomena

content.text: Refurbishing of the roof and wall ceilings. An increasingly important topic of the old building renovation and preservation of monuments is the preservation and restoration of old roof and wall ceilings. In the renovation and renovation after 1945, regional typical materials, colours and structures of the roofs were given little attention. The competent author provides understandable knowledge and background for affected house owners, architects, roofers and monument keepers, who strive for a style and professional renovation. Structured in soft coverings with straw materials (straw, reet, reeds) or wood (shining, planks) and hard coverings from natural stones (stone, slate) or historic roof tiles (monk/nonne, hollow pan, beaver tail, etc.) materials, deck techniques, lifespan, causes of damage and professional repair possibilities are treated with numerous, informative drawings and black and white photos. Provides good basic knowledge for W. Bender: "Dachziegel als historisches Baumaterial" (BA 11/99).
content.title_en: Roof renovation : restoration of historic roof and wall ceilings

content.text: Sound protection, thermal protection, moisture protection, fire protection : manual for interior fittings. The practical manual contains basic and specialist construction physics for interior fittings. Can be used for practitioners, students, trainees and further training. Compared to the 4th edition 1990 (ID 5/92) updated with national and European standards, especially revised with regard to thermal protection and the new energy saving regulation and extended with regard to ecological construction. Low energy houses. Older editions have to be replaced. No comparison title known. Current, general textbooks on building physics, which also cover the building envelopes, are "Lehrbuch der Bauphysik" (ID 10/03) and G. Lohmeyer (BA 6/02). (3)
content.title_en: Sound protection, thermal protection, moisture protection, fire protection : manual for interior fittings

content.text: PostgreSQL : Basics - Practice - Application development with PHP. PostgreSQL is a free open source database system that meets the SQL92 standard. The author is addressed to website developers, database developers and database administrators. For less experienced users, there is an introduction to the basics and theory of databases. In detailed chapters, the powerful functionality of PostgreSQL is explained (including functions, sequences, queries, transactions). The content is understandable and presented in clear steps. Using a continuous example project, the reader is introduced to the creation of dynamic websites with PHP. In addition to the interface to PHP, this database system can also be accessed by means of other procedural programming languages (such as C, Perl, Python, Java). So, if you are familiar with such a language, you can easily create dynamic websites withPostgreSQL and PHP.
content.title_en: PostgreSQL : Basics - Practice - Application development with PHP

content.text: The two authors (from Rautenstrauch here last: "Integration Engineering", ID 23/93) present a remarkable book here - the reader should not be deceived by the title. In a competent and understandable way all topics relevant to information technology are presented here. The target groups mentioned in the title are never lost sight of and in some places also addressed specifically. This does not disturb non-economists when reading. Rarely can such a compact introduction to computer science be found at a reasonable price: from bits and bytes, different database systems to operational application systems suffices. Despite all the looseness, the volume always seems serious and never trivial. It is highly recommended. (2) (Torsten Stenneken)
content.title_en: Computer science for economists and computer scientists

content.text: Duden - Sentence and Correction : Editing, processing, designing. This completely re-designed practical manual describes step by step how a manuscript becomes a template for a sentence - an indispensable help for all who create, process and design texts professionally.
content.title_en: Duden - Set and correction : edit, process, design

content.text: Stairs : Design and construction. Publisher's text: Stairs reveal much about the design concept, the constructive effort and the material understanding of the respective architect. Despite the ever increasing offer of ready-to-use components on the construction market, the staircase adapted to the individual building situation remains a key quality feature of good architecture. This book provides a sound and up-to-date overview of the state of the art and hints on new production methods for working on detail. After an introductory essay on the development, the basics of staircase construction are presented: the essential planning aspects in relation to the supporting structure, joining techniques, rule details as well as the constructive possibilities of the basic building materials wood, steel and concrete. Current examples from Germany and abroad, structured and comprehensively documented by usage types, provide valuable suggestions for practice.
content.title_en: Stairs : Design and construction

content.text: Reaction mechanisms: organic reactions, stereochemistry, modern synthesis methods. Updated and extended by almost 300 pages of the 1996 first published university textbook (ID 12/97). "Der Brückner" - 1998 awarded the book prize of the fund of the chemical industry - has already developed into a standard reading for students in the field of organic chemistry, basic and main studies, despite its relatively short age. The more extensive this second edition is mainly achieved by expanding the part of the main study program. Read-friendly design through different coloured border stripes; one can thus see at a glance whether it is basic or main study knowledge. New also the extensive compilation of overview articles to each chapter. For chemistry students with the desired degree degree but also for teaching students. (3) (LK/MD: Hörning)
content.title_en: Reaction mechanisms : organic reactions, stereochemistry, modern synthesis methods

content.text: Virtual worlds - real violence. That violence is part of human life and belongs to the dark sides of our psyche seems to be one of the anthropological constants. Historically, messages mediated by the media have also become stimulants of real violence and therefore the discussion about the media effect is one that begins already in antiquity. The 19 contributions taken from the online magazine Telepolis (www.telepolis.de) were initiated by the bloodshed of Erfurt and the related debate about violence-glorifying computer games. They span the arc in a quality and demanding way, but further: The effect of media is complex. It is about the interactivity of computer games as a special way of inclusion, around the dwindling boundary between game and reality-related military simulation or the violence that media exert when they investigate the private life of people. The band continues a topic that was e.g. H.-B. Brosius (ID 19/95), T. Döbler (ID/B.Munseler) or T.
content.title_en: Virtual Worlds - Real Violence

content.text: Avatars: digital speakers for business and marketing. Computer interfaces are facing a technical revolution. "Avatare", intelligent software programs, will communicate with users in natural language, will accompany them in the search for information and products on the Internet, advise them and facilitate everyday tasks. Although initial approaches are already available in this technology, their chances for e-business, marketing and advertising are hardly taken into account. A gap that this book seeks to reduce by an interdisciplinary approach. How is the development status of natural language computer systems? Where are their possibilities and limits? How can companies benefit from these trends? For this, along with scientists, companies, business consultants and practitioners from selected projects, are also discussed.
content.title_en: Avatars : Digital Spokesman for Business and Marketing

content.text: Spice drugs: a manual of spices, herbs, spice mixtures and their essential oils. Like the spice, the roast, the popular is aware of. And besides, spices are healthy, e.g. because they promote digestion, stimulate the circulation or simply provide a physical feeling of well-being. The author leads the reader into the fascinating world of spices. From the stinking asant to devilishly sharp chillies and precious saffron to the fragrant cinnamon, he describes 300 plants and the spices derived from them from a natural scientific perspective. He presents 84 spice drugs in detail and focuses among other things on their cultivation, extraction, ingredients, properties, vigour and use in kitchen and medicine. The readers are inspired by the variety of spices and their applications - with the most comprehensive work that has been written about them in German language so far.
content.title_en: Spice Drugs : a manual of spices, herbs, mixtures and their essential oils

content.text: Introduction to System Theory. Luhmann (died 1998), who continued to study sociology, noted a systemic crisis of sociology, tried to clarify and simplify and caused a stir in 1984 with his first main work "Social Systems" (ID 46/84) - which has since been repeatedly published. In 1991/92 he had followed his lecture "Introduction to System Theory". He obviously never planned it in book form, it existed until now only on 14 sound cassettes. In linguistically slightly revised and with some notes it is now finally presented as a book. Luhmann's versatile, unorthodox approach with interesting accent shifts since 1984 will be very welcomed by sociologists. The editor also contributes a register, which however is somewhat lean. Important addition to Peter Fuchs' introduction (ID 40/92). (3) (Elke Günther)
content.title_en: Introduction to System Theory

content.text: Basic knowledge of the educational system, teaching concepts and techniques / ed. by Manfred Bönsch and Astrid Kaiser; vol. 5: Learning with multimedia and the Internet. The use of the diverse possibilities of multimedia and the Internet for learning depends significantly on the learning conditions and the learning organisation. This hypothesis encourages the introduction to learning with multimedia and the Internet for the active design of media and their use in the learning process. Various schulpractical scenarios for the current and future conceivable use of multimedia and the Internet also stimulate discussion about school development. The questions raised by media educational tasks about the planning and implementation of the learning processes are addressed, e.g.: How do `new` media change the teaching process? Which framework conditions are to be considered? How do we learn with media? What forms of differentiation with media are possible and necessary? How can one organize joint learning with knowledge management? What possibilities exist to learn on the Internet? What pedagogical perspectives open up different equipment concepts? Following the claim of mediation between theory and practice, numerous media teaching courses are given to all areas of instructional teaching and teaching.
content.title_en: Basic knowledge Pedagogy, teaching concepts and techniques / ed. by Manfred Bönsch and Astrid Kaiser ; Vol. 5: Learning with multimedia and Internet

content.text: PHP - a practical introduction. PHP was also the most popular technology in addition to ASP last year to create dynamic websites, especially with database connection. O'Reilly takes this development into account and now publishes the now already 4th (German-speaking) book on the topic. This is a strongly example-oriented introduction for HTML-acquired and rather self-employed readers. Because with the help of a larger project the most important elements and functionalities of PHP are discussed gradually and immediately applied. The concrete solution is before the underlying theory. This concept is especially good for those who want to acquire the technology quickly or only get to know certain aspects in order to implement them immediately in their own projects. As a structured introduction the book is less to be used, also because references are missing. Very pleasant loose language style. Code examples can be loaded from the Internet. Use best in addition to more extensive introductions (e.g. MacCarty: BA 7/02) and/or manuals (e.g. J. Krause: BA 11/01). (2) (Christian Eidoth)
content.title_en: PHP - a practical introduction

content.text: Ways and terraces: plan and create. This guide addresses garden owners who want to find design ideas for paths and terraces and want to implement them themselves.... Using illustrative examples, the expert laying in sand and mortar is explained step by step. With many photos and drawings, it is attractively designed. Recommended. This guide addresses garden owners who want to look for design ideas for paths and terraces and want to implement them themselves. First, the planning phase is presented, in which aspects such as location, size and shape, perspectives, path guides, paths, dining places in the countryside and many more are considered and practical tips given. The main chapter deals in detail with the covering materials granite, porphyry, basalt, diabas, marble, sandstone, concrete work stone, paving clinker, tiles, wood, pebbles, bark mulch and straw with their different properties such as resistance against frost-tau-change, pressure resistance, abrasion resistance, surface finish, color and shape. Using illustrative examples, a step for step was then the professionally laying of sand in the order of the table and the table of seats is also recommended.
content.title_en: Ways and terraces : plan and create

content.text: The knitwear has long had problems to free oneself from the image of bieder housewives or the like. In recent years, international designers have rediscovered the advantages of the knitwear. This has to do with a return to old craftsmanship, on the one hand, and with novel processing techniques that open up new design and application possibilities. The lush picture book is largely oriented towards the products of individual designers and follows how knit classics are reinterpreted, how individual designers advance to unconventional new lands and finally look like border crossings in the direction of art. Again and again the author is not content with mere picture series. New techniques and materials are explained in detail. Rounding off, the book contains a comprehensive attachment that makes the book a reference work for design enthusiasts. (3) (Bettina Scheurer)
content.title_en: Fashion Knitted

content.text: The practical textbook for students, civil engineers, architects and construction technicians is one of the standard works for the topic of reinforced concrete and was fundamentally revised, extended in content and brought to the latest state of the art and standardization after 10 years (last edition 5th 1994: BA 5/95). The requirements for concrete and concrete steel, definition and calculation of the components, construction and construction are addressed. The conclusion is a comprehensive, calculated example for a 3-storey business building. The older editions have to be replaced. G. König (ID 11/99) deals only with the design according to Eurocode 2. Before the two-volume textbooks of O. Wommelsdorff (Volume 1 last ID 3/03, Volume 2 last ID 50/03) and A. Goris (Volume 1: ID 37/02, Volume 2: ID 40/03). (2)
content.title_en: Reinforced concrete construction : design, construction, design

content.text: Introduction to waste management: with 95 panels and numerous examples. Compact textbook on modern waste management for students at universities, universities and practitioners. Compared to the 2nd edition 2000 (BA 9/00) updated for data and numerical material, new regulations (e.g. deposit of municipal waste), treatment procedures (e.g. mechanical-biological pretreatment) and extended by 1 page with Internet addresses. The preliminary edition may continue, if good use is required, a purchase of the new edition is desirable. (3) (LK/KA: Nibbrig)
content.title_en: Introduction to waste management: with 95 panels and numerous examples

content.text: The group of companies in the concentration survey of official statistics: the collection of capital links between enterprises and of competitively relevant cooperations. The study is a revised version of the "investigation of improved concentration recording" and deals with the preparation of data from official statistics on enterprise concentration. The aim of the study is to substantially improve the empirical capacity of official business and concentration statistics, to minimize the necessary use of public resources and not to burden the economy by additional surveys.
content.title_en: The group of companies in the concentration survey of official statistics : recording of capital interdependence between enterprises and of competitively relevant cooperations

content.text: Examination questions Pastry chef, pastry chef : the entire specialist in question and answer for all examinations. Collection of questions and answers to the specialist in the pastry trade. Is less than a task book for exam preparation than a repetition course in question and answer (are directly between each other) and complements the two-volume specialist "The Young Pastry Doctor" (see E. Schild, last BA 1/96). A little rather poor in form: Table of contents without page details, text without colored highlights. The book thus looks somewhat dry in the presentation. The volume by J. Loderbauer: "Conditor, pastry chef: exam knowledge..." (Handwerk und Technik, 1999, not displayed here) is more comprehensive, attractive and should be preferred despite the higher price. If required. (2 S)
content.title_en: Audit questions Pastry chef : the entire specialist in question and answer for all examinations

content.text: Typo & Design: [Basics of typography; screen design and typography for the web; font in context: content, layout and medium]. Word processing, layout programs and web editors offer a variety of possibilities. However, lay people often lack basic knowledge in the production of handbills, association newspapers or brochures in the page design, optical structuring of text and the correct use of fonts. For these users, the author has summarized essential rules on typography and layout in chapter manner: page structure, font selection, text elements, colors and illustrations/photos. Cursorically treated are print pre-press, web design and font management. With many examples that clearly elaborate the "serving" function of font and layout. Good addition to D. Graefen (BA 11/01) or K. Bauer (BA 1/03), which address the same target group and prepare the technical manufacturing process in the prepress stage. C.D. Khazaeli (here last ID 14/02) applies to professionals and goes more to implementing with the help of relevant DTP programs.
content.title_en: Typo & Design : [Basics of typography; Screen design and typography for the Web; Font in context: content, layout and medium]

content.text: The first edition was published in 1936 and was subsequently revised and supplemented by the author. The new edition is unchanged compared to the DuMont edition of 1983 and is based on the revised edition of 1957. Pevsner has been extensively involved in architecture and handicrafts and examines in his book the fall in style and the development of a new style from the mid-19th century to the beginning of the 20th century. He goes into the reform movements that originated from England and in their succession Germany and Austria took over the leadership. At the work of Morris, van de Velde, Behrens, Wagner, Gropius and others, he shows how they helped to become universal in their work the "New Style". The change of style is illustrated in text and image (black-white illustrations) in handicrafts, painting and architecture. In the appendix apparatus of notes, time table, afterword, register. (3)
content.title_en: Pioneers of modern design : from Morris to Gropius

content.text: Examination book Koch, Köchin : action-oriented ; for preparation for the intermediate and final exams. Examination book for exam preparation with tasks on technology, mathematics, economic and social studies, is oriented according to tasks types (open answers, multiple choice, situation-oriented tasks), within the task groups by subject areas. Action-oriented goal direction with special consideration of the social competence. Reworking of "Examination book Koch, Köchin" (1996, not discussed, should be replaced); is differently designed from the thematically comparable volume of H. Grüner (BA 1/03). Both works can complement each other. (2 S) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Cook, cook : action-oriented ; in preparation for the intermediate and final exams

content.text: War and peace in modern times: from Westphalian peace to the Second World War. Public debates on the Iraq war have promoted a fundamental interest in war and peace. History and peace research have been intensively addressing the topic for 10 years with its fundamental questions. Here, a historian gives an excellent insight into the problems, conveys important basic knowledge and describes briefly and flushly the research status with the persistently controversial positions. He makes clear that the military and war history has long since emancipated and has become an integral part of both general history and peace research. Wolfrum divides his "orientation assistance" into 7 topics (including peace concept, state and war, military and society, total war, new wars), which are dealt with in their historical dimensions from 1648 (Western Peace) to today. The reference to the current debate is always established. The well-readable title, designed for students and candidates for examination, is also suitable for students and interested citizens.
content.title_en: War and peace in modern times : from the Westphalian Peace to the Second World War

content.text: The large cathedrals, monasteries and pilgrimage sites of Europe. The large-format illustrated book shows the most important churches, monasteries and pilgrimage sites of Europe. In addition to the numerous coloured illustrations, the layouts, the brief description of the architectural features, the historical background and the development of the history of piety are presented. The buildings and/or places are divided by countries. Compared to "churches and monasteries in Europe" (in this no.), the descriptions are shorter and more general, but much more buildings and sites are presented. Therefore I would prefer this book. With glossary and local register. Overall a short, general description of the architectural development of the Christian buildings. (2)
content.title_en: The great cathedrals, monasteries and pilgrimage sites of Europe

content.text: The large Ravensburger Nature Game Book: over 190 games for children. Games in the wild or in the urban environment: contemplative play inspirations as well as wild, exciting and daring ideas. Short instructions that can be implemented spontaneously, and information about the number of players, required time, material and whether a game leader is needed. (LK/WÜ: Saathoff) The well-known author of game books (last: "The Great Ravensburg Game Book", BA 6/01) has compiled a lot of games here in the wild or in the urban environment. The book offers contemplative play inspirations, as well as movement-intensive, wild, exciting and daring ideas. The instructions are short, can be spontaneously implemented and contain as pictograms information about the number of players, required time, material and about whether a game leader is needed. A separate register in the annex, ordered by number of players, allows a quick overview and gives special promotion areas. The volume is a real "Hingucker", it is highly stable (1Hingucker) and is highly recommended for all libraries.
content.title_en: The great Ravensburger Nature Gamebook : over 190 games for children

content.text: What is Baroque? : Architecture and Urban Design of Europe 1580 - 1770. The scientific assistant at the Institute of Art History of the University of Cologne deals with the formal structure of sacred and profane buildings in their historical framework, places well-known buildings in relation to currents in science, art and art theory, and also deepens individual aspects such as column order and mathematical foundations of baroque architecture. Countless photos, historical illustrations and floor plans additionally illustrate the said. Hoppe addresses the topic in a disciplined manner closely, scientifically and yet generally understandable and deeper than Wilfried Hansmann (BA 1/98). Christian Nörber-Schulz' two-volume work in the "World History of Architecture" (BA 12/86) can remain in existence, where still available, further as reference titles. (2)
content.title_en: What is Baroque? : Architecture and Urban Design of Europe 1580 - 1770

content.text: France : [Geographie, Geschichte, Wirtschaft, Politik]. Review: The completely revised edition of the standard work, published in 1997, describes the important political position of France in European history. Many changes within and outside Europe were triggered here or influenced by French thought. After an overview of history and the natural space, the population, settlement and economic structures characterized by centuries-long centralism as well as the political significance of France are elaborated on the basis of updated data and latest scientific research and knowledge. The generally understandable presentation and modern equipment with newly designed colour maps, color photos and tables as well as short 'views' of the political structure, the party, trade union and educational system enable every French person interested in systematically to grasp the individual characteristics of our neighbouring country.
content.title_en: France : [Geography, History, Economy, Politics]

content.text: Concepts of Internet technology. This qualification unit (QE) provides basic knowledge about the functioning of the Internet. Its development history and concepts are examined as well as the elementary processes in data communication. You learn how the Internet basically works (Internet protocol, IP), on the basis of which network technologies the current Internet is built up and how an IP network is operated. You will also learn which protocols are used in today's Internet-dominating applications and how they work. In this context, security on the Internet is also addressed. Using an example that runs through the entire course, the various components of the Internet are related to its everyday use and to each other.
content.title_en: Concepts of Internet technology

content.text: Art at construction: the Federal Projects in Berlin. The volume documents all the works of art created in the framework of the Kunst-am-Bau concept in the buildings of the Federal Government, the Federal Council and the Federal Presidential Office as well as a representative cross-section of the works in the Bundestag buildings. Each work of art is presented with photographs, brief explanations and biographical information about the artist. It also informs about the graphic collections created in the Federal Ministries.
content.title_en: Art at construction : the federal projects in Berlin

content.text: The cities open to the heavens: speeches and reflections on the reconstruction of the underwent and the return of the New Building 1948/49. The early contributions of the magazine "Baukunst und Werkform" give an unconcealed picture of the first fundamental architectural discussion after the Second World War. The volume contains texts of almost all important protagonists of the reconstruction: Otto Bartning, Hugo Häring, Hans Scharoun, Fritz Schumacher, Rudolf Schwarz, Egon Eiermann, Rudolf Steinbach, Emil Steffann, Ludwig Neundörfer, Robert Vorhoelzer. From today's perspective, the authentic image represents a deeply moving immediacy towards the scenes of the European city-beings that were destroyed for all time, to which even Le Corbusier, in his Charte d'Athènes (Bauwelt Grundste, vol. 56), was able to address a soul.
content.title_en: The cities open to the sky : speeches and reflections on the reconstruction of the lost and the return of the New Building 1948/49

content.text: Labyrinths & mazes. More than 100 historical and modern labyrinths and mazes in Europe are presented in large-format colour panels taken from an airship, showing the variety of motifs and artistic expressiveness of this landscape architecture. Labyrinths as paths "to themselves" and mazes as symbols of adventure and danger are analyzed under cultural, religious and psychological aspects, with the reference to maze and internet not lacking. The temporal framework ranges from mythical origins to modern amusement parks. The predominant expressive colour panels are complemented by hints of origin, form and material. Differently designed as "secret of labyrinth" (BA 12/98) and more easily accessible than "labyrinth" (ID 44/99), the work is recommended at a price that is quite reasonable to the beautiful equipment. (2) (Erdmann Steinmetz)
content.title_en: Labyrinths & mazes

content.text: Duden - Set and correction : Materials. Guidelines and standards on typesetting, touch letters, correction marks, fonts, alphabet and special characters. (Chapp) As an extract from the detailed manual "Duden [Set and correction]" mainly in table form Guidelines and standards on typesetting, touch letters, correction marks, fonts, alphabet and special characters and replaces the Duden pocketbook "Set and correction instructions" (BA 1/87). Should be in the information stock from medium-sized libraries. (2 A) (Chapp)
content.title_en: Duden - Set and correction : Materials

content.text: Gartenlust - Lustgarten : the most beautiful historical gardens in Germany : official guide to the palace administrations in Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Berlin-Brandenburg, Dessau-Wörlitz, Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saxony, Thuringia. Note International Hölderlin Bibliography: pp. 137-143: The Garden Kingdom of Dessau-Wörlitz; p. 144f.: Luisium [each with colour photographs] By the German palace authorities jointly published guide to historical gardens in Germany, which are under state supervision. Geographically subdivided into federal states, with a focus on southern and eastern Germany, over 90 gardens and parks are pre-ordered. Each federal state is introduced with its gardens by a short text, followed by a selection of examples of magnificent gardens, many of which are conceived as a complete artwork. They are portrayed with history and garden architecture, with indication of address, opening hours, tourist information and addresses of the garden facilities not included. Numerous beautiful colour photographs and maps illustrated the texts.
content.title_en: Garden Love - Lustgarten : the most beautiful historical gardens in Germany : official guide to the palace administrations in Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Berlin-Brandenburg, Dessau-Wörlitz, Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saxony, Thuringia

content.text: Internet-Discourse: Basic questions of spatial planning on a medium level : Documentation of a pilot project of the ARL in cooperation with the University of Karlsruhe. The volume documents the Internet-Discourses of the ARL on the future orientation of spatial planning on a "medium level" and its partial discourses on infrastructure and spatial development on the example of the Upper Rhine, on the region as a field of action of regional spatial development policy and on the draft consultation of the Baden-Württemberg regional development plan. It reflects in two respects the experimental character of the pilot project. On the one hand it contains the contributions to the "Discourse on the Discourse", which deals with the possibilities of using the Internet as a means of work in the field of spatial-related research as well as the methodological and technical requirements for an internet-based discussion. On the other hand it includes a wide range of articles on questions and suggestions for action on the future tasks and instruments of spatial planning, especially at regional level.
content.title_en: Internet-Discourse: Basic questions of spatial planning at medium level : Documentation of a pilot project of the ARL in cooperation with the University of Karlsruhe

content.text: Basic course UNIX/Linux: the novel media book: textbook and interactive software in one. This work is a symbiosis of book and interactive learning module on CD-ROM (for use on PC or workstation); it is aimed at beginners, who do not require any special prior knowledge. Basic operating system functions of UNIX/Linux are provided, which are necessary for effective work with applications such as text systems, spreadsheets, database systems and Internet services. The focus is on system characteristics, file systems, shells, control structures, command procedures, the C-Shell and the work on the net. The book largely leans on W. Brecht (BA 1/94). Each chapter follows with practice tasks and comprehension questions (with solutions and answers in the appendix) and a reference to the sections of CD-ROM, which should be worked through interactively for better understanding. The didactically well-prepared CD-ROM promotes the motivation to always verify that the book content has been really understood. Also for the computer science lessons of the secondary school II.
content.title_en: Basic course UNIX/Linux : the new media book: textbook and interactive software in one

content.text: The paper trade : [Tradition, techniques and projects]. After a short historical introduction, the characteristics of paper, materials and tools, techniques of paper production and the fibre raw materials are treated. At the end of the volume are 9 projects, which enable the implementation of the aspects of paper creation discussed in the previous chapters in step-by-step instructions. The treatment of manual paper production naturally includes smaller machines such as Dutch and hand stirrs. The individual work processes are often shown on historical instruments and illustrated by numerous photos. In addition, there are also self-construction suggestions or hints on the use of household appliances, which enable the establishment of a cheap hobby workshop for paper production. The present book is more detailed than purely hobby advice like T. Hartel: "Paper Creators" (BA 3/00), it also brings more basic manual knowledge. The paper production and use of paper provides a broad overview of the overall paper production and use of the material book "Paper" (DuMont; BA 6/02). (2)
content.title_en: The paper trade : [Tradition, techniques and projects]

content.text: In 1994, the volume "Aviation professions" (BA 10/94) was published by the same, well-known author (e.g. "European international airports", BA 11/95). The current list of addresses of aviation authorities alone, flight schools, etc., makes exchange essential. Systematic descriptions of training routes, activities, prerequisites, basic information about flight operations and German airlines enable a comprehensive overview of occupations from glider sail pilots to aircraft mechanics (and - of course - supposed "dream occupations" such as scheduled flight captain or stewardess). A list of technical terms and a very helpful source list complement the volume, which actually has serious competition only in the professional image "flight pilots" (BA 4/02). - Already for medium libraries of interest. (2 A) (Edgar Schichtl) Systematic descriptions of training systems, activities, prerequisites, basic information about flight operations and German aviation companies enable a comprehensive overview of occupations from glider sail pilots to aircraft mechanics. (Edgar Schichtl)
content.title_en: Occupations in aviation

content.text: Tat-Orte : Gemeinden im Ökologische Competition : [Themenheft] / ein Projekt der Deutschen Bundesstiftung Umwelt in Kooperation mit dem Deutschen Institut für Urbanistik: Umweltschutz durch Kooperation : Ansätze für den ruraler Raum ; Themenheft. This issue is about environmental protection through cooperation. To improve the environmental situation many different people and groups can contribute and achieve more. The publication is intended to prove this. To this end, the basics for the preparation and implementation of cooperations are presented, paths are shown, but also obstacles are explained and practices of cooperation are explained. Afterwards, potential approaches for successful cooperations for selected fields of action of environmental protection are presented. Selected practical examples document realised cooperations in rural communities.
content.title_en: Tat-Orte : Municipalities in ecological competition : [Topics] / a project of the German Federal Foundation for the Environment in cooperation with the German Institute for Urban Studies: Environmental protection through cooperation : Approaches for rural areas ; Topic

content.text: C/C++ : from the basics to professional programming. C++ as an extension of C is one of the market leading object-oriented programming languages. The author, based on teaching experience at the FH Gelsenkirchen, addresses readers without any prior knowledge and gives a detailed introduction to C++. On the other hand, since he represents important basics and concepts of computer science and directly links to programming, the book is also an introduction to the basics of computer science and programming languages. The book is divided into textbook and reference sections. In the textbook sections the material of a particular sub-area is taught and applied directly by means of concrete programming examples. In the reference sections, the results of the textbook sections, as far as they concern the programming language C/C++, are summarized and supplemented by missing detailed information. Notements and exercises at the end of each chapter. On CD-ROM, a variant of the gcc compiler, which allows immediate completion of the substance and experimentation on the own computer. (2) (Klaus Barckow)
content.title_en: C/C++ : from the basics to professional programming

content.text: Java in a nutshell : English edition for Java 1.4. David Flanagan's Java in a Nutshell has quickly become an indispensable reference work for Java programmers. The updated and extended reissue of the bestseller covers Java 1.4 and offers a compact, well-structured introduction to the Java programming language and its most important APIs. The following are discussed in detail:The syntax of the programming language - the object-oriented features of Java - the Java 2 platform and the most important Java APIs - the Java development tools, which are delivered with the Java SDK from Sun.
content.title_en: Java in a nutshell : German edition for Java 1.4

content.text: Baroque and Rococo : [Architecture, painting, sculpture]. This volume resembles the large-format title "Die Kunst des Barock" (BA 4/98, out of print): the same editor, the same photographer and partly identical pictorial material, and also similarities in structure and concept. The text writer was also involved in the pocket volume. The introduction is still partly printed from this book. The format and scope are significantly reduced here, but there is no shortened version of the large volume, but a separate title with its own text (see also "Romanik" in this no.). The book gives an overview of architecture, sculpture and painting of the Baroque and Rococo, divided within these large chapters by regions. In the appendix, glossary, bibliography and person and place register. Cheap title with very good illustrations. Anyone who owns the large volume does not necessarily have to offer it, but it is more handy and loan-friendly in terms of price/covering "The art of the Baroque" remains uncontroubleduous, but this book is also inexpensive and widely usable (2).
content.title_en: Baroque and Rococo : [Architecture, painting, sculpture]

content.text: Freud and Leonardo : a critique of psychoanalytic art interpretation. Further information Content: Sigmund Freud's "founding document" of psychoanalytic interpretation of visual art is critically reread here. Clemenz shows in his appreciation of Freud's essay that Freud has tried to present an exemplary case story that claimed not only to understand biography retrospectively, but also prospectively explain it. Manfred Clemenz explains the deeper reasons why Freud's plans had to fail to understand and to do justice to Leonardo da Vinci. At the same time, he gives an outlook and provides criteria for an adequate psychoanalytic art interpretation.
content.title_en: Freud and Leonardo : a review of psychoanalytic art interpretation

content.text: What is Baroque? : Architecture and Urban Design of Europe 1580-1770. The scientific assistant at the Institute of Art History of the University of Cologne deals with the formal structure of sacred and profane buildings in their historical framework, places well-known buildings in relation to currents in science, art and art theory, and also deepens individual aspects such as column order and mathematical foundations of baroque architecture. Countless photos, historical illustrations and floor plans also illustrate what is said. Hoppe deals with the subject in a disciplined manner closely, scientifically and yet generally understandable and deeper than Wilfried Hansmann (BA 1/98). Christian Nörber-Schulz's two-volume work in the "World History of Architecture" (BA 12/86) can remain in existence, where still available, further as a reference title. (2)
content.title_en: What is Baroque? : Architecture and Urban Design of Europe 1580-1770

content.text: The art of the beds: imaginative garden design with fragrance, colours and shapes. Were the title "Garten-Glück" (BA 7/02) still covered all topics relating to garden design, the author places only the bed as a functional element in the foreground. The function and location and style of the beds are decisive for a harmonious effect and the shape of the beds. Colours, shapes and flowering times, as well as silhouettes and textures, offer a wealth of design possibilities, which only come to the fore from a certain garden size. The detailed text is supplemented by beautiful photos and the service part of the annex explaining necessary basic knowledge (ground preparation, optical construction, planting, care, winter protection). The plant tables in text and appendix could have been quieter and more detailed, so one must study the explanatory texts to the photos, one wants to "rebuild" one or the other beds. Here other titles are certainly practical; however, in the great demand for the topic an attractive addition. (2) (Kristina Kroll)
content.title_en: The art of beds : imaginative garden design with fragrance, colours and shapes

content.text: The world of colours of plastics: Colours and preparations: properties, processing, quality assurance. Introduction to the dyeing of plastics, dyes and pigments. Provides concise descriptions of conventional and modern induction processes, in pigment preparations and their quality assurance as well as in the processing of dyed plastics. In addition, references to the colour formulation, to standards and further literature. Brings a clear introduction to a complex topic and is suitable for practitioners, in some ways also for apprentices. Elementary and scarcer than the specialist of J. Kremer (ID 34/01). Possible for a wide range of users. (2)
content.title_en: The world of colours of plastics: colouring agents and preparations: properties, processing, quality assurance

content.text: Nelson, the captain and I. Dog and cat together on board a ship? That can't go well! In fact, it's over with the calm on the Chinese sea, when dog Finn and captain Husen rescue a ship-wrecked cat from the waves, who imagines himself as a seacat Nelson and permanently disturbs the trusting togetherness. From Finn's perspective, this very unpleasant acquaintance with a gerdy cat, who has been driving to the sea for a long time, will be told from his eyes. He spins his sailor's yarn in a laconic way and you can hardly think of the revenge plans he leads against the cutter. Of course, everything comes differently in the end and it looks quite after the beginning of a wonderful friendship between dog and cat. On picturesque pictures in unusual colors, K. Gehrmann tells her adventure on the high sea. Quiet scenes and dramatic sequences, which use simultaneous representations to make even more gripping, alternate. Both from the story and from the design a sophisticated, special picture book, which can only be expressly recommended.
content.title_en: Nelson, the captain and I

content.text: Manual of Competence Measurement : recognize, understand and evaluate competences in company, educational and psychological practice. First-time presentation of the procedures of competence measurement. Well-intelligible and clearly structured manual. In this manual - for the first time on a European scale - the entire spectrum of procedures of competence measurement and characterization is presented on the basis of numerous examples. The authors describe numerous procedures used in company and educational practice. In a comparative outlook the reference to methods as applied in modern psychological diagnostics, personnel selection and work analysis methods is established. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Manual of Competence Measurement : recognize, understand and evaluate skills in company, educational and psychological practice

content.text: Heidegger Manual : Life - Work - Effect. According to the "Nietzsche Manual" (ID 44/00) and the "Kant Manual" (ID 5/03) from the same publisher and in the same format, a manual on Martin Heidegger (1889-1976). In independent scientific articles, almost 50 renowned scholars and experts from different countries and from various points of view deal with his thinking on a high level. In the first part, they present an analysis and interpretation of Heidegger's most important writings in chronological order. In the second part, they examine the context of his philosophy, his influence on contemporary thinkers and his subsequent reception at home and abroad. The conclusion is a detailed chronicle with the most important biographical data on life and work of Heidegger. In the appendix, a literature directory, a register of persons and a register of subjects. - As a complete commentary on the writings of Heidegger and as an orientation aid in studying his philosophy. (3) (Dieter Altmeyer) Note Internationale Hölderlin Bibliography: Hölderlin passim, s. Personenregister. - S. 515-Hidehard Die Heide-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu-Meu
content.title_en: Heidegger Manual : Life - Work - Effect

content.text: Wood construction : Basics, design aids ; with 121 tables ; [according to the new DIN 1052!]. The author teaches wood construction and structural engineering at the FH Augsburg. In the present textbook he provides the basics of the design of wooden components and compounds on the basis of the completely newly edited DIN 1052. Among other things, construction material properties, load-bearing evidence, connection possibilities, types of dowels, roofs. With numerous illustrations, sketches and practical example calculations in each chapter (see solution volume in this no.). In the annex a compilation of the most important tables as calculation aid. The CD-ROM contains the demo version of an Excel measurement software of the author. The target group are besides construction engineers and structural engineering planners also carpenters and master pupils. Can be used before the introduced, e.g. textbook by G. Werner (Volume 1: ID 38/04; Volume 2: BA 6/93), which is clearly expensive and in addition to the current DIN 1052 also the old DIN 1052 (1988), as well as the Eurocode 5. (3)
content.title_en: Wood construction : Basics, design aids ; with 121 tables ; [according to the new DIN 1052!]

content.text: Paperback of Environmental Technology: with 59 tables. A multi-disciplinary presentation on environmental technology and environmental protection with introductory information on basic scientific concepts, environmental law, limit values, and others as well as environmental technologies on drinking water treatment, wastewater treatment, waste-related pollution treatment, emission reduction, etc. (Elke Nibbrig) The compact paperback provides a multi-disciplinary presentation on environmental technology and environmental protection. In the first half of the book, introductory information on basic scientific concepts, environmental law, limit values, environmental management and basic information on water, air pollution, soil pollution, waste problem. The second half treats environmental technologies on drinking water treatment, waste water purification, waste-related pollution treatment, exhaust gas purification, emission reduction, noise protection, regenerative energies etc. By means of a clear table of contents, an extensive index of keywords and literature information well as reference work and by the understandable, practice-oriented presentation well suited for examination preparation. Widely applicable for students of natural sciences, engineering at universities and universities, but also for students at vocational academies, technical schools. Vor I. Rözel/Witung (ID) for Environmental Technology (D.
content.title_en: Paperback of environmental technology : with 59 tables

content.text: Database programming with MySQL 4 & PHP: [the methodical and detailed introduction; over 350 pages of beginner know-how]. SQL is a standardized database language, which has been implemented in database programs in different completeness. MySQL is a free database program, which uses only little system resources and is very fast due to a rather spartan interface. MySQL is used together with the script language PHP and the web server Apache for interactive web presences.
content.title_en: Database programming with MySQL 4 & PHP : [the methodical and detailed introduction ; over 350 pages of beginner know-how]

content.text: The successful engineer: principles and practical examples that are not taught during his studies. Guide to career planning for engineers with hints and examples for use in companies, as well as a general introduction to business administration. The author, former industrial engineer and managing director, gives practical tips on basic and individual questions of corporate management as well as examples of project work, investment calculation, production control, etc. Clearly structured, easy-to-read compilation with calculation examples and checklists. Applys to young engineers in practice, but also to (becoming) managers. Elementary, more practice-oriented than the collection volume "structural change and career planning" (ID 52/98). - Already for medium-sized specialist stocks. (2)
content.title_en: The successful engineer: principles and practical examples that are not taught during the course of studies

content.text: Textiles: the world of modern textiles. The journalist, who has specialized in design and art, has discovered textile science as a field of research. Textile fabrics, their creation, designs and development history are the subject of her research, which she presents in this high-quality text image band. She describes the cultivation and extraction of natural fibres (wool, silk, cotton, linen), their use in history and present, but also the discovery and processing of synthetic fibres, which enable the production of "wovens with spectacular surface effects". Insights into the production of traditional textile companies and contemporary textile designers round off the ribbon. Can be used in libraries with expanded textile specialist stocks and/or textile schools on site. Complementing the standard work for the training of Alfons Hofer: "Fabrics" (BA 5/00). (3)
content.title_en: Fabrics : the world of modern textiles

content.text: Natural colour manual: [natural colours produce and apply: recipes, painting techniques, creative room design]. The attractively illustrated manual provides detailed and vivid information on the production of natural colours and their application in the living area using various techniques. (Beate Fischer) Visually and very appealing in terms of content, which provides detailed information on the production of natural colours and their application in the living area. After an introduction to the history and an overview of the individual components of the colour follow the recipes, ranging from the wall colour on a quark basis, the lime-dish, the oil and beer glaze to the floor and furniture wax. Wide space takes the detailed instructions for the color design of walls, floors, furniture and objects of all kinds. The individual techniques (roll, sponge, wipe, wrap, stupe and lasur technology, stenciling and patinating) are clearly described and supplemented with meaningful pictorial material. With reference sources and keyword in the appendix. Also in addition to "Natural colours" (BA 6/02) and "Decorative color design for living spaces" (BA 12/patinating) very strongly in view of the ecological situation of the books.
content.title_en: Natural Color Manual : [make and apply natural colours: recipes, painting techniques, creative interior design]

content.text: Information Retrieval : Search models and data mining procedures for text collections and the web. The content search for text documents - the Information Retrieval - played out until a few years ago mainly in libraries and archives. The WWW is increasingly also confronting individuals and companies with this task.This book conveys the basic models and methods of information retrieval, describes current developments - especially in the field of web search - and places them in a theoretical context.Introductory classical approaches such as hierarchical classifications, boolean search, the vector space model and evaluation methods for search procedures explained. It follows an introduction to methods of data mining, which can serve to support the search. Subsequently, different retrieval models and concrete systems are presented.In a separate focus the book is devoted to the WWW and treats from the perspective of information retrieval the web-signing languages of companies XML and HTML, metadata systems such as Dublin Core as as well as the description language RDF.
