content.title_en: Information Retrieval : Search models and data mining methods for text collections and the web

content.text: Plant oils : Cultivation & processing of common oil plants ; Production of special and spice oils. In the course of healthy nutrition, vegetable oils have also found a whole new attention in terms of their importance for the human organism. However, the present practical book is primarily suitable for agricultural use, as it focuses on European oil plants (botany, cultivation and harvesting), the extraction of plant oils and their further processing and chemical composition (fatty acid content). Only in the chapter application and recipes suitable proposals for health applications, cosmetics and soap or cooking recipes are found. However, this can be found in many other books more detailed, so that the present title is only recommended for libraries in which the agricultural aspect is primarily required. Additional information provides address lists, literature notes and Internet addresses; the printed legal framework unfortunately only refers to the legal situation in Austria. (3)
content.title_en: Plant oils : Cultivation & processing of common oil plants ; production of special and spice oils

content.text: Places of the Late Modernism : Guide through railway stations, shopping malls, Disneyland Paris. On the way to the Late Modern City - Places and Non-Places - Order, Culture and Power - Approaches to Non-Places - The "Old Railway Station" as an experience portal - The "New Railway Station" as a hybrid form - Panoptism as a service - The shopping mall as a condensation of the world - Strewn by the CentrO - The Mall as a space of freedom - Archetypes of the Disney Continent - Group image with Mickey - Disneyland as a cult site - Places of the Late Modernism
content.title_en: Late Modern Sites : Guide to Stations, shopping malls, Disneyland Paris

content.text: A comprehensive study with important results for educators, primary school teachers and psychologists. (3 S) A comprehensive study with important results for teachers, primary school teachers and psychologists.
content.title_en: Torture spirits and their victims : bullying among children - and how to deal with them

content.text: Heat: Roman. Berlin, a few years after the turn of the year, a large kitchen in Kreuzberg, which supplies its customers with packed food in the West and East. Here, between huge pots and pans, we meet the assistant chef Simon DeLoo, a former cameraman who has torn the death of his partner from all contexts and who now takes food out in the >>turned Berlin<< . On his tours he meets Lucilla, a young urban tramp from Poland, and believes to see the silhouette of his former wife again. He provides her with their clothes, leaves her the empty apartment - but she tears his illusion-spinning, unravels, and only in her homeland, in the hotly fluttering landscape of the Pomeranian lake plate, he sees her truly: her face, in which there is >> something brighter than intelligence<< , her body, which confuses him. >> Suddenly he felt clearly what had prepared the whole life in him, as a distant tone, his vibration, the molecules are true until she adopts a green tip text (a stone text).
content.title_en: Heat : Roman

content.text: PC hardware superbibel : the complete reference work. Reissue of the voluminous, comprehensive hardware guide. Compared to the last 12th edition presented here, there are numerous differences: Although a large part of the topics (chapter) remained the same, some were changed, 3 sections are no longer available in printed form (see below). In terms of content, much has been revised, remodeled or (partly considerably) extended, some things have been rewritten and of course everything is up to date. The attached CD-ROM contains no more the previously offered 90 minutes video with step-by-step instructions, but current tables with hard disk parameters, BIOS error codes, a (here it is probably not useful) database with 398 PC hardware manufacturers in the USA and the chapter "Printer/Scanner" and "Local Networks" printed in the 2001 edition, which is also recommended in the book (Ro) (Ro) (German version).
content.title_en: PC hardware superbible : the complete reference work

content.text: The future of the space: Perspectives for the city, region, culture, landscape. From the content: Michael Braum: Is less more? Urban planning and urban planning under changed signs - Dietrich Fürst: Upgrade of the region as a level of social self-control - Heiko Geiling: The city in the region - Problems of social integration in Hanover - Carl-Hans Hauptmeyer: The future from the past. City, region, culture and landscape from the perspective of regional history - Jörg Knieling: Urban regional development through major projects, festivalization and new guiding images. Planning strategies in the metropolitan region Hamburg - Hansjörg Küster: The city in the landscape: The example of Hanover - Axel Priebs: Regional consensus strategies on the example of the retail concept of the Greater Hanover - Dietmar Scholich: Area consumption - without public interest? - Hille von Seggern: Design of urban landscape. Or: to qualify urban landscape. Example Wastewater - Jürgen Weber: The location in the region: Municipal development and regional planning - Hans Hermann Wöbse: About the culture of dealing with landscape in the region Barbara - Zibell Region - The future of the region of the city.
content.title_en: The future of the space : perspectives for the city, region, culture, landscape

content.text: Image knowledge: the visuality of natural phenomena. Pictures address the viewer in their own way, not only in art. The author, a renowned art historian who teaches at Oxford, is concerned here with images from the field of natural sciences. Based on his (not strictly) chronologically ordered essays, which have been published in the journal "Nature" since 1998 and now (with changes) are summarized into a book, one goes through a veritable gallery, reading and grappling, in which the arc spans from Leonardo's drawings to M. S. Merian's insect and plant paintings to the representations of attractors, but at the same time also shown by, for example, "Brunelleschi's viewpoint". It is also an essay by the mathematician Ian Stewart that shows many interesting parallels with their visual products. Kemp's work creates a fascinating connection between art and science, and the selected examples and the pictorial material are meaningful and impressive.
content.title_en: Image knowledge : the visuality of scientific phenomena

content.text: The TÜV-Book car trailer : purchase, construction, testing and operation. Purchase, construction and operation of caravan and transport trailers. Provides information on approval and safety technology and is addressed to professionals and skilled laymen. Has been updated in the regulations (also in EC directives) compared to the 5th edition (BA 11/97), but not in the literature data, which are still dusted. The preliminary edition can still be used, older expenditures should be replaced. (2)
content.title_en: The TÜV-Book Car Trailer : Purchase, Construction, Testing and Operation

metadata.authors: Lauffs, Dieter; Miedel, Hans; Spitzer, Gerhard

content.text: Violence in school and education : Causes - Basic forms of prevention and intervention. The two authors try to summarize the main theoretical and research approaches about violence in childhood and youth in a pedagogical-anthropological overall draft. This overall draft provides the basis for their concept of the 12 basic forms of violence prevention for education and teaching. A theoretically well-founded, but also practice-oriented concept in a slightly revised and updated edition (the first edition published in 1999 was not displayed here). For educators and education politicians who want more than recipes for the next day. (3 S)
content.title_en: Violence in school and education : Causes - basic forms of prevention and intervention

content.text: Sports, health and public health. The book deals with the interrelationships between sports, health and public health. It deals mainly with three questions: What effects does physical activity have on private and public health? What psychological and structural determinants depends on the extent of sports and exercise behaviour? And with what interventions can the level of physical and sporting activity in the population be increased? For the practice of sports and health promotion it is of central importance to know which factors are decisive for participation in sports. Because only then intervention measures can be used purposefully and efficiently. Against the background of the current research status four principles of theory-led sports promotion are presented in this volume.
content.title_en: Sports, Health and Public Health

content.text: Electronics & Model Train / Jürgen Köhler ; 1: Basics. An introduction to the basics of electrical engineering. As in a physics school book, electrical sizes and laws are first defined; in the main part, all components (such as transistors, diodes, relays, electric motors) that can be used for model railway electrics are described in their mechanical and electrical properties. The numerous, partly complicated calculation formulas may be indispensable for engineers, for the target group of model railway fans they are just as incomprehensible as useless. The practical reference to model railway hobby is hardly recognizable at least in this 1st volume (of planned 4 volumes). Generally, instructions on the self-construction of electronic circuits in this hobby are hardly noticed. Therefore, a purchase is not recommended. Standard titles in the field of model railway electrics/electronics remain: A. VonHeede/F. Löser: "Modellbahn-Elektrotechnik", BA 3/86 (Reprint 1996, not displayed here).
content.title_en: Electronics & Model Train / Jürgen Köhler ; 1: Basics

content.text: Netze - Protokolle -Specifications : the basics for successful practice. The rich volume offers both the theoretical foundations of the networked computer world and useful information for the practitioner. The common network architectures and access methods and hardware components (cables, hubs, routers, switches, etc.) are presented in detail and intelligible. The following explanation of the protocols takes more than half of the volume, whereby the TCP/IP family takes the lion's share, but also routing protocols and the DNS (Domain Name System, which assigns the correct IP address to the email or web addresses) are explained up to all the details of the data fields. At the end of the book you will find an overview of some diagnostic programs, a (unfortunately unnecessarily bloated) list of the "Well Know Ports" 1-1023 and some other tables.
content.title_en: Networks - Protocols - Specifications : the basis for successful practice

content.text: In 2001, the German Wolfgang Ketterle, together with two American colleagues, received the Nobel Prize for Physics for the Bose-Einstein Condensation. This topic and other new developments in physics are dedicated to this work by the young physicist Morsch, who will take into account research results until 2002. He begins with the history of the atomic hypothesis in ancient Greece and the research of the structure of light and atoms, then makes a big leap and continues to explore the development of lasers, the discovery of laser cooling, which leads precisely in the Bose-Einstein condensate to the basic state of atoms, as well as the construction of atomic clocks and the stopping of a light beam. The last chapters are dedicated to technical applications, in particular the further miniaturization of chips and the production of extremely powerful quantum computers. Morsch understands it, among other things, by using analogies from everyday life, to illustrate the latest developments to the interested laypersons in an important field of physics.
content.title_en: Light and matter : a physical relationship history

content.text: Civil society and economy - the new role of companies. The late and restrained attention that has been given to the topic of "civil society and economy" in Germany so far does not correspond to its socio-political significance. On the contrary: the more social institutions lose their ties and the more tendencies towards a fragmented and increasingly polarised society emerge, the more fundamental the demands on the institutions, organizations and groups of this society change. The contributions reflect the socio-political dimensions of entrepreneurial action in the context of the current discussion about civil society. They present numerous examples of new civic engagement of companies in Germany. The municipal level as a place of social innovation is given special attention. The contributions contained in this volume were presented in part at a conference on "civil society and economy - the new role of companies" - this conference took place in November 2001, it was organized by the German Institute for Urban Studies, Berlin, together with the Department of Education Sciences of the Martin-Luther-Universität Halle-Wittenberg.
content.title_en: Civil society and business - the new role of businesses

content.text: Image direction : Architecture between retrodesign and event culture. Klappentext: The competition between traditionalists and modernists for the power of definition over the built space has developed into the motor of image formation in the site competition of urban centers. Neomodern and neo-traditionalism support the simulation of a long-globalized, yet locally staged urban culture. Architecture is the role of becoming the central medium for "identification" and tourist attraction.Werner Sewing's historical and sociological essays on the architectural discussion between second modernism and neo-traditionalism as well as on the sociology of architecture as a profession are complemented by fundamental essays on the "Berlin Architecture Dispute" of the nineties.
content.title_en: Image direction : Architecture between retro design and event culture

content.text: Model configuration of the North Sea/Baltic Sea model: 40-year NCEP integration. A regional ice model/ocean model was developed to determine spatial and temporal variability in the North Sea and Baltic Sea region. This model has been used to perform a hindcast calculation over 40 years of simulation time with consistent advance. The hindcast period covers the period 1958 - 1997. Chapter 2 of this report describes the model configuration in detail. Chapter 3 is dedicated to model validation, here are comparisons between model results and observation data. From model data (daily mean values) monthly mean values of the transport field in the water were determined for the model area climatological (Chapter 4). Chapter 5 contains maximum values of the speeds for each grid point, based also on the daily mean values, and in Chapter 6 monthly mean values of transports are presented by the cuts Orkney - western edge Norwegian channel, Norwegian channel and English channel.
content.title_en: Model configuration of the North Sea/Baltic Sea model : 40-year NCEP integration

content.text: World images - Human images : Natural science and theology in dialogue. Are theology and Christian faith really incompatible and in constant contradiction with the natural sciences? Are there really a controversy and a centuries-old conflict between the world images of natural science and the Church? This theme book Religion offers methods and perspectives for a successful and appropriate dialogue between natural science and theology for work in schools and communities, using the example of the two areas of cosmology (e.g. Big Bang and matter) as well as anthropology (e.g. genetic engineering and human dignity).
content.title_en: Worldviews - Human Images : Natural Science and Theology in Dialogue

content.text: Construction technology: Examination book Civil engineering. According to "Hochbau" (BA 4/00), "Bauzeichnung" (BA 10/02) and "Dachdeckung" (BA 1/03) the title for the examination preparation for civil engineering specialists follows here. Series-standard structure according to basic education, intermediate examination, final examination, additional learning field tasks, economic and social studies and an extensive solution part. Again, the free space for entries is problematic. Good addition to the publishing book series for construction professions, as well as the specialist customers of D. Richter (BA 11/98) and "Subdivisions of construction - civil engineering" (technology: BA 4/99; technical mathematics: BA 9/00; technical drawing: BA 11/01). (2 S) (LK/KA: Nibbrig)
content.title_en: Construction technology: Examination book Civil engineering

content.text: What do you understand by love? : Ideals and conflicts from early romanticism to today. The author aims with her study on the change of the understanding of love since the 18th century at the condition of the ideal of love and thus provides suggestions to see the personal love relationship from a new perspective and possibly to change it
content.title_en: What do you mean by love? : Ideals and conflicts from early romanticism to today

content.text: Generation Emotion : the future of feelings and how they guide us; instruction for the 21st century. Ankovich reports on neurological research results on the human brain, the emergence of our consciousness and the central role of feelings. He describes how feelings arise in us and how much they influence our thinking and action. At the end, he reports on how we can learn to address and influence our feelings. An impressive reading, more vivid and easier to understand than J. LeDoux (ID 23/98) and A. R. Damasio (ID 51/00). (2) Ankovich reports on neurological research results on the human brain, the origin of our consciousness and the central role of feelings. He describes how feelings arise in us and to what extent they influence our thinking and action. At the end, he describes numerous indications that we can learn to address and influence our feelings. An impressive reading, more vivid and easier to understand than J. LeDoux (ID 23/98) and A. R. Damasio (ID 51/00 (2)).
content.title_en: Generation Emotion : the future of feelings and how they guide us ; Instructions for use for the 21st century

content.text: Oracle, Java, XML : Integration in Oracle9i ; [Architecture Approaches for Practice]. Additional information Content: Java and XML are now standard in enterprise projects. Oracle9i's high degree of dissemination also makes it a standard for e-business applications. Its robust integration of Java and XML makes it all the more attractive for highly scalable IT systems. Oracle's database system is often combined with development tools and application servers from other manufacturers. This book takes this into account by focusing on the impressive Java and XML capabilities of Oracle's database, regardless of the manufacturer and technology. It deals with various possible architecture approaches, Java "within" and "outside" of the database, and much more. It is based on database version 9i Release 2, which introduces promising new features, especially in XML integration. However, users of other versions will also be able to use this book, as numerous tools and functions are also available in older Oracle versions.
content.title_en: Oracle, Java, XML : Integration into Oracle9i ; [Architecture Approaches for Practice]

content.text: The politicians. Review: Allenthalben is fraught with electoral fatigue and political ardor, politicians and politics in general are very poorly regarded. The committed SPD politician Scheer (among others "Solar World Economy" BA 4/00), president of Eurosolar and winner of the Alternative Nobel Prize, examines the conditions of action under which politics is made. He analyses the social state and to what extent globalization and other interests leave the representatives of the people still independence and their own scope for action. He does not save with criticism at his own stand, but often lets himself be too detailed about globalization and WTO, which "dilutes" the book a little. Nevertheless, one notices: H. Scheer is a politician with body and soul in the most perceptible and positive sense of the word, wants to encourage him to participate actively in politics or otherwise influence himself. Politicians' analyses of other, i.e. CDU-side, by the way, there have already been already once by E. Ackermann ("Politicianer", BA 3/97). (2)
content.title_en: The politicians

content.text: XSLT 2.0 : the comprehensive manual; [Basics, Application, Reference; Commented reference of all elements and functions of XSLT 2.0 and XPath 2.0; installation and application of Saxon 7]. XSL transformations (XSLT) have become the preferred technique for all types of XML transformations. You can convert XML files into HTML, but also into any other file formats such as PDF or image files. The book provides a comprehensive and well-founded introduction to the transformation of XML files using XSLT. The language elements and instructions of XSLT in version 2.0 as well as the elements and functions of the path description language XPath are described.
content.title_en: XSLT 2.0 : the comprehensive manual ; [Basics, application, reference ; commented reference of all elements and functions of XSLT 2.0 and XPath 2.0 ; installation and application of Saxon 7]

content.text: Online shopping and urban development: trends, impacts, strategies. The volume summarises the results of the workshops and the final event of the project "Online shopping and services - Municipal spaces for action". It contains updated and compressed contributions as well as action-oriented overviews of the four previous publications in the Difu series of materials and the position paper "Online shopping and services. Positions and strategies". The first is a thematic summary of the project results, which was already included in the position paper. After three fundamental contributions on demarcations, interactions and trends, on the impact of online shopping and services on economy, urban and spatial development, and on the strategic options for action that arise for the municipalities, the results of the first four workshops are compressed. Finally, the "Essenz" of the final event of the project is prepared. The results of an internal "future workshop" are contained in the summary statements of all chapters. Overviews of the relevant literature and relevant links are published in the volume.
content.title_en: Online shopping and urban development : trends, impacts, strategies

content.text: The Church's decision-makers need reliable information to understand the mobile communications technology and to assess the risks involved. Only in this way will they be able to make informed decisions. The present handout can help to make internal church opinion-forming and decision-making processes transparent and open to results and to give particular emphasis to the aspects of preventive health protection and peace of the congregation. However, this writing is also a contribution of the churches to the social political debate about the possible risks of mobile communications. Experience with the use of mobile communications technology, especially with regard to its effects on humans and animals, is only available for a comparatively short period of time. In the field of tension between economic interests on the one hand and the fears of many people on the other hand, the precautionary idea must therefore be given a high priority. For this reason, the church environmental representatives are committed to the greatest possible care in dealing with the new technology. - Many church towers are attractive locations for mobile operators. The rents, however, are welcome in times of short church funding for building maintenance.
content.title_en: Mobile communications on the church tower ? : Information and decision-making aids for parishes

content.text: Basics : architectural basic elements and their dynamics. Importance and effect of architectural basic elements and their function in the formation of space (spatial feeling, effect in space, spatial effect); visual perception, arrangement, point, line, surface, space; architecture, natural and constructed objects; two-dimensional (2d, 2 dimensional), three-dimensional (3d, 3 dimensional)
content.title_en: Basics : architectural elements and their dynamics

content.text: Building technology : Examination knowledge for bricklayers. Collection of tasks in DIN-A4 format for preparation for intermediate and final exams for bricklayers / level II and construction specialists / level I. With introductory tips on learning techniques. The questions on the facts of the respective learning fields and complex tasks on cross-learning problems are systematically arranged according to basic and technical level. Two-columned with questions and solutions side by side, the solutions can be covered with the cover flaps. Good addition to existing specialists such as "Basic knowledge of construction technology" (Stam; BA 1/02), "Learning fields construction technology Maurer - Fachständen" (Stam; BA 1/02), "Learning field construction technology - basic level" (Handwerk + Technik; last BA 7/02), "Learning field construction technology - Fachständer Maurer" (Handwerk + Technik; BA 2/01).
content.title_en: Construction technology : Examination knowledge for bricklayers

content.text: Didactic design: a guide to the development of hypermedia learning systems with web didactics. This book offers a theoretically sound and at the same time practical introduction to web didactics: step by step, from didactic planning to the realization of individual screen pages to quality assurance, the development of media-oriented and didactically sound learning environments is described. The preparation of receptive, interactive and cooperative knowledge follows the models of web didactics, which range from discovery, problem-oriented to theory-led learning.
content.title_en: Didactic design: a guide to the development of hypermedia learning systems with web didactics

content.text: Hegel Manual: Life, Work, School. According to the manuals for Nietzsche (ID 44/00), for Kant (ID 5/03) and for Heidegger (ID 37/03), here is a corresponding publication from the same publishing house on the main representative of German idealism, G. W. F. Hegel (1770-1831). In this paper, Bochum philosophy professor W. Jaeschke outlines the life stations of Hegel from school to study and teaching as a professor. In the main part, he first presents Hegel's work in chronological order from the first manuscripts to his last writings; then he analyses the Heidelberger and Berliner lectures in which Hegel anticipated his philosophical "system". In the third part, he examines the early phase of the history of Hegel's philosophy until the division of his school. In the appendix, he analyses a time table, an extensive list of literature, a register of subjects and a register of persons. - A sound, both historical and systematic overview of life, work and effect of this philosopher.
content.title_en: Hegel Manual : Life, Work, School

content.text: The fact that the demographic factor can also be discussed without emotion is demonstrated by the scientific assistant at the Federal Institute for Population Research (born 1945). Her interpretation does not culminate in disaster reports, if the "gifty old people" (cf. Bernd Klöckner, born 1966, BA 11/03) continue to burden the future of youth. Roloff uses the statistical evidence to differentiate analyses of the existing and future age structure not only for the factors of retirement and health, but also for the school and working world. Her conclusion: A new self-confidence of the old people, based on a more positive group image, would be necessary to assess the assumption of voluntary activities in the social field and in politics, privately or in committees not as a time-drain for the last long life phase. This presupposes a generation-wide change in thinking. Unconditionably, however, besides Klöckner, please be careful that the modest small band is not lost in any way in addition to the provocative hardcover Klöckners! (2)
content.title_en: Demographic factor

content.text: For years, sports scientists, physicians and sports associations have been complaining about an increasing lack of movement among children. No longer is there any more movement and sport in the children's daily life, but the television, playstation or visit to McDonald. And the few remaining movers among the children are still out of their room for play, exercise and sports. The author questions this pessimistic view of a predominantly unmoving childhood. As methodical access, the complex and therefore only rarely, perhaps too rarely used recording of the everyday time budget of children is chosen. The generally common thesis of childish movement deficits is not confirmed. On the contrary, movement and sports prove to be the racers among the everyday activities of children. Whoever identifies the movement potential of today's children as deficient, thus generally poses a problem thesis for the life organization of current childhood. However, this insight only opens up when movement in the concert of the everyday areas of activity is analysed and not isolated to be viewed as a matter of consideration. Regardless of the use of the child's context of exercise, the use of the children's everyday life in general context allows the use of the children's living spaces.
content.title_en: Thousand days of children: sports and exercise in everyday life of children

content.text: The author of various garden books (most recently "Erlebnisgartenn für Kinder", BA 2/03) shows here how gardens can be redesigned or remodeled so that they can be handled well by seniors or physically less mobile garden owners. It provides examples of successful replanning of family gardens to seniors and gives tips for the design of paths, places, ponds. Of course, the indications for planting are not missing either: whether perennials or vegetables from the high beds, whether herbal corner or spalier fruit, these questions are also dealt with here - at least in a transparent manner. Furthermore, the book contains hints for köperspänendes Arbeiten im Garten und suitable garden equipment. Practically, so far only guide for the target group. (2
content.title_en: Designing gardens for seniors easy care

content.text: Places in Europe. This illustrated book shows mainly in panoramic photos over 30 places from 11 (Western) European countries and explains architecture and history of the respective place. Places as identity-giving places create space for encounter. The most important places are presented pictorially and culturally historical (Petersplatz, Piazza del Popolo, Trafalgar Square ...) - besides there are also unknown things to discover: e.g. the Campo San Maurizio in Venice. Photowise, the viewing angles and pans are up to 200 degrees. The photos are in very good quality. To the history of panoramic photography, a short section is found. 2 very detailed registers open the work. It offers clearly more than a pure coffeetable or gift book - altogether something for the far-travelled cultural traveler for follow-up. Not cheap, therefore for more expanded stocks, but because of the abundance of information also for special collection areas art. (3) (LK/OS: Lohe)
content.title_en: European places

content.text: The David principle: Power and powerlessness of the little ones. From splendor, strength and future of the little ones. Twelve reports from the unique world of the self-employed, from the bacteria and the Chancellor to the tennis artist and the writers. All the big ones in business and trade want to become even bigger, preferably "market leaders". Because of the "synergy effects", they say. And when they shrink, they supposedly reflect on their "core competence". The salt of the eaten up competitors makes them at most thirstier, not wiser. The little ones laugh. They know the habits of the big ones better than themselves. In this pocket book twelve experts of the matter of different metiers freely expound their experiences: reports of the survival of the little ones. Texts by Hermann Beil, Hans Magnus Enzensberger, Steffi Graf, Hans-Olaf Henkel, Felix Huby, Dirk Maxeiner / Michael Miersch, Rezzo Hose, Holger Schnitgerhans, Gerhard Schröder, Klaus Wagenbach, Martin Walser and Wendelin Wiedeking.
content.title_en: The David Principle : Power and Powerlessness of the Little Ones

content.text: How we live: nature, architecture, residential culture. Wide-scale publication on global architecture, interior design, residential culture and residential styles. The two authors have explored the living and living worlds of the population around the globe and present the result in the book, which contains over 1100 illustrations. In countless thematical examples, they show living and living in rooms, ranging from simple to traditional furnishings to interior design with chic interiors, in addition to the special features of the interior in their own 4 walls, and show further details such as courtyards, passages, doors, etc. The book is rounded off with a chapter on the living environment of people with some market and street scenes. The coloured illustrations, briefly commented, are provided with cross references to similar things. With a local and non-profit register. A book on global architecture and residential design, which is endowed with rich pictorial material. The various residential styles offer suggestions for every taste. (3) (LK/K: Weber)
content.title_en: How we live : nature, architecture, home culture

content.text: The bus driver. Benjamin drives every morning with the school bus into the city. The bus driver stinks, is disgusting and very unfriendly to her passengers, the "little bastards", as she says. One day Benjamin sleeps the stop at the school and is awakened only in the depot by the gruesome driver. Now he has to spend the whole day with her. Skeptically he pursues all her ways, first silently, then questioning. They drive to the sea, then to an old man for whom she cooks, so that he does not have to go to the old age home. They empty fish chests and go to a pub. Finally they pick up the "all little bastards" from the school again. Quite gradually she begins to tell of herself and her life, becomes human and even smiles at farewell. Much space take in the coarse black drawings, which represent events and thoughts drastic and hard in childish manner. A remarkable, special book that certainly needs to be explained and recommended. For youth-joy libraries. - the bus driver misses his stop.
content.title_en: The bus driver

content.text: Designing with SolidWorks. Publisher's text: This book is both an introduction to the virtual 3D construction - MCAD - and an introduction to the SolidWorks program package.
content.title_en: Constructing with SolidWorks

content.text: Finishing : grafting and oculation. Apart from the cover completely unchanged 5th edition of a title published for the first time in 1994. "Founded guide for advanced small gardeners who want to acquire the necessary equipment for the finishing of tree fruit. With numerous photos illustrating the measures and illustrated step-by-step instructions. Comparable to P. Klock's "Element made easy" (BA 1/89), which was published a good 2 years ago in the attractive, newly-boxed guide series "blv-Garten plus" in a new version (BA 8/01) and is more appealing in the design than the present volume similar to the information content. (2) (LK/MS: Flick)
content.title_en: Finishing : grafting and oculating

content.text: Small art history for carpenters. The relevant trade school leader (BA 10/83, 61) has revised his classic (not discussed here) in the 10th edition in such a way that it is equivalent to a new edition. New are above all the inclusion of Muslim art and the summary representation of postmodernism and deconstructivism. However, in character he remains a guide through the history of style from antiquity to today, which makes clear with scarce treatises and sufficient pencil drawings of furniture, buildings and ornamental details connections between furniture culture and general style developments as well as the cultural, economic and social environment of the epochs. The focus is on the 20th century, also the various undercurrents of the last years and decades are considered. For carpenters, students and teachers at vocational and technical schools. Replace pre-conditions as possible. (2) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: Small art history for carpenters

content.text: The garden: a cultural history. The garden expert P. Hobhouse, well-known far beyond the borders of England, has created a technically well-founded work with this book on the cultural history of the garden. From the early gardens of Mesopotamia to the gardens of today, the author leads through 5000 years of garden design. The book brings together art historical readers the most important garden styles of the world. In addition to historical facts and contexts, it also conveys background knowledge, e.g. through person descriptions of influential garden experts. Numerous photos and drawings illustrate the demanding text. An opulent standard work, which is suitable for both looking up and making a mockery. The purchase can be recommended to any medium and larger library, especially since nothing comparable is on the market. (2) (Georg Braun)
content.title_en: The garden : a cultural history

content.text: The railway to Sylt: the history of the Hindenburgdamm and the Niebüll - Westerland/Sylt railway line. The Hindenburgdamm, inaugurated in 1927, is the focus of this comprehensive presentation of the railway traffic to Westerland. The author spans the arch from the prehistory of the marsh railway in the mid-19th century to the recent present and has diligently used various archives and collected a large wealth of material. With the numerous, partly colored illustrations, the book written in liquid style is quite something for railway friends. For them and on site it is highly recommended. (S. Gülck)
content.title_en: The railway to Sylt : the history of the Hindenburgdamm and the Niebüll - Westerland/Sylt railway

content.text: The basics of organic chemistry. Review: In terms of volume, extended by 25 pages, but not the same as in the preliminary edition (BA 4/90 - was not available for comparison), this university textbook of organic chemistry takes into account topics from biochemistry, pharmacy and food chemistry in an increasing way. 2-colour presentation of chemical formulas for the clarification of reaction sequences. Much more than 500 tasks (also highlighted in color) - solutions at the end of each chapter. Suitable for students at universities and universities of applied sciences with major and secondary subject chemistry as an introductory textbook and exercise book - also good for self-study and exam preparation. (3) (LK/MD: Hönning)
content.title_en: Basic principles of organic chemistry

content.text: The nutritional lie: How the food industry is making us understand. The science journalist cites numerous evidence that industrially produced foods can be a factor in our mental performance and can be responsible for brain diseases such as Alzheimer's or Parkinson's. (Uwe-F. Obsen) The relevant "pre-loaded" science journalist Grimm (see BA 2/03; 7/02; 10/02) adds a new, threatening dimension to the topic of "un-healthy nutrition": the influence of nutrition on brain chemistry and thus on our behaviour, our psyche and our health. In the pointed mixture of case descriptions and scientific expertise Grimm has a great burden of proof; (brain) diseases such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ADHS, childish autism, ALS or depression are associated with the quality of our diet. On the one hand, industrial food production has deprived the food of valuable nutrients, on the other hand, additives (including color and preservatives) are incorporated into the food of the author's direct question.
content.title_en: The food lie: How the food industry is killing us

content.text: Energy-efficient old buildings : by renovating to a low-energy house ; an information package. Publisher's text: Residential buildings are very durable. Already houses that were built 15 years ago are old buildings in the sense of energy efficiency. By renovating the building envelope and using effective technology, the heat demand of old buildings can be reduced by up to 70% and at the same time the comfort of living can be increased.
content.title_en: Energy efficient old buildings : through renovation to the low energy house ; an information package

content.text: Art therapy and autonomy : from the action of one's own creative power in psychological border situations. The book describes the specific possibilities of art therapy to strengthen mentally ill people in their autonomy striving. In this context, autonomy development and illness are first considered in a general social context, whereby illness and crises are regarded as an expression of autonomy. Through a resource-oriented approach of art therapy, concentrated on the ability to act and imagination, autonomous efforts can be supported. Art therapy is presented in various psychiatric settings and symbolisation processes are described in detail using numerous designs. The author addresses in particular the spiritual dimension of psychological border situations, which has not been discussed so far, and illustrates these by means of examples of images.
content.title_en: Art therapy and autonomy : from the action of one's own creative power in psychological border situations

content.text: Check Point Next Generation AI: [the standard work for Fire-Wall-1/VPN-1]. The author explains in detail the setup and administration of the leading Firewall Check Point Next Generation with Application Intelligence. He describes the basic components of the software and its extensions and gives instructions for installation on the operating systems Sun Solaris, Windows and Linux. Other topics are the formulation of the rule sets for access permits and their logical implementation in practice and the establishment of a Virtual Private Network.
content.title_en: Check Point Next Generation AI : [the standard work for Fire-Wall-1/VPN-1]

content.text: The green room: [the garden as a modern living space]. Urban gardens are subject to very different requirements than the normal house garden in small towns and rural areas. In addition, a new urban garden style has developed in the international metropolises by merging garden styles of different cultures and under the requirement of functionality. From this point of view, contemporary design designs for gardens in urban surroundings and gardens with a living space character are compiled here. There are excellent examples of designed interior and backyards, front gardens, winter gardens, minimalist gardens and above all roof gardens. Also the garden's equipment with furniture, colors, water plays and lighting effects is not too short. 123 predominantly impressive color photos give this rich garden architecture guide the appropriate outer frame. Especially libraries in larger cities are recommended. (2) (Hans-Ulrich Struck)
content.title_en: The green room : [the garden as a modern living room]

content.text: Wooden decks in the garden : 15 projects are explained step by step. Wood decks are defined as pavements, seats, platforms, terraces and wooden bridges. After an introduction to the material, the tools and the planning, the basic and special working techniques are described. 15 working instructions for the most diverse constructions from the simple plank path to the pretty shore terrace follow. Each instruction is provided with a tool and material list. In addition, a full-page photo of the finished work, a complete view of all parts and photos of individual work steps. The large-format pictures facilitate the reconstruction also for less experienced DIY enthusiasts. The book has the same layout and equipment as "Building with fresh wood" (BA 11/02) from the same authors. (2
content.title_en: Wooden decks in the garden : 15 projects explained step by step

content.text: World Risk Society: in search of lost security. After 20 years, after many studies on "reflexive modernization", the overarching theorem, the now famous Munich sociologist takes up the concept of risk society ("organized uncertainty") again, this time with the claim to consider it globally, to include both the facticity of risks as future dangers as well as the different cultural handling with them and to consider them as universal critical social theory (also in criticism of a nationally-born and conceptually narrow-minded sociology). 3 important risk conflicts are identified by the author: ecological (not only atomic), global financial crises and terrorist attacks, although they are completely different from each other and are to be answered. Therefore, there is a lack of an examination of the international resonance to the risk concept, of empirical differentiations and plausible proposals for action on the demand for a global, preventive real policy. Nevertheless, certainly temporarily wide discussion for insiders. (2)
content.title_en: World Risk Society: in search of lost security

content.text: Key works of gender research. Klappentext: The volume gathers summaries and analyses of 19 key texts of gender research, written by leading representatives of the area. Extensive references and further literature are named. In this way, the content and personnel of this volume are familiarised with a comprehensive, interdisciplinary research area.
content.title_en: Key works of gender research

content.text: This time, culture is not a text! Do we gain a new look at cultural history if we do not merely look at a culture in the perspective of its language, texts, works and monuments, but examine its cultural techniques? Cultural techniques here understood as those everyday practices in which, as in written arithmetic, the symbolic and the technical are so closely confused that our knowledge assumes the form of a technologically capable skill? Does an innovative perspective arise for the history of science as soon as we take into account the interaction of writing, image and number? Today, the computer integrates the phenomenal media of such diverse kinds as writing, image, music and language, and precisely because binary alphabet allows them to be coded as numbers. This binary transcribing of various media is indeed new. But at the same time, it raises the question whether and if so: to what extent cultural and scientific upheavals received their impulses, precisely from transformations, not only between the different systems of representation, but also between semiotic and machinel.
content.title_en: Figure, font, number

Economic trends and trends in research - Structures of lobbying in the FRG and the USA compared - European interest groups - Regulation of lobbying activities by political addressees in the FRG and EU compared - Actors and strategies of lobbying at the EU level - Asymmetries of social intermediation - Lobbying for general interests. To the vacance of family policy negotiation systems - The change of lobbying strategies of environmental associations: NGOs at international level With contributions by: M.P.C.M. van Schendelen - Martin Sebaldt - Miroslaw Matjya - Katharina Ahrens - Irina Michalowitz - Thomas von Winter - Irene Gerlach - Ingo Take
content.title_en: Lobbying : Structures, actors, strategies

content.text: The German-Dutch Manual of Planning Terms adds another volume to the series "Planning Terms in Europe" initiated and published by the ARL and developed with numerous partners in the participating countries. The manuals make an important contribution to the mutual understanding of spatial planning in the partner countries and to the ever-increasing cross-border and transnational cooperation in Europe at all levels. The glossary with explanations on the most important planning terms has been preceded by introductory chapters on state and administrative structure as well as planning systems in Germany and the Netherlands. Plan maps of the various planning levels illustrate the presentations.
content.title_en: German-Dutch Manual of Planning Terms

content.text: Networks under Windows. The big book "Networks under Windows" is the revision of the title of the same name (BA 10/00). For the target group network planners and administrators this title is a good guide for daily work. It maintains a balanced balance between introduction, practice instruction and compendium. The general introduction to network technology and network planning is quite scarce, but the troubleshooting is very detailed. Subsequently the relevant aspects (hardware, installation, maintenance, detailed troubleshooting) are explained in practical and understandable terms. Nevertheless, there is no lack of the necessary depth of the presentation. Also, the conversions of Windows 95, 98 and NT 4 to Windows 2000/2003/XP are taken into account. The book is pleasing because of its uncomplicated language. It fills the gap between entry-level titles on the one hand and heavy-weight expert titles on the other hand. Unfortunately no CD- supplement with meaningful and freely available tools. Replaces the above mentioned book. (2) (Rainer Burghausen)
content.title_en: Networks under Windows

content.text: The book is not only accessible to specialists. It is aimed at students, but also at users from industry. Computer graphics is constantly gaining in importance with the progress in software and hardware development. The book is divided into 17 teaching units, each divided into learning objectives, requirements, text, glossary, contexts and exercises. Additional visualization through many exercises; many tabular overviews. Well documented program examples. The exercises are of particular importance; in addition to sample solutions (on accompanying CD-ROM) time and learning objectives are also given. The basics cover two- and three-dimensional basic concepts, but also basics from physics and medicine (properties of light, physiology of visual perceptions). Programming takes place in different languages, based on graphic libraries. In the applications numerous tools (demoversions on accompanying CD-ROM) are discussed. Extensive annotated literature data. (3)
content.title_en: Textbook of graphic programming : basics, programming, application

content.text: Sokulturische und antirassistische Bildungsarbeit: Projektwärten und theoreticale Beiträge. This volume links two discourses that have so far run side by side with each other: The educational discussion about juvenile right-wing extremism is for the first time related to the debate about intercultural and antiracist pedagogy. Practitioners from the new federal states discuss with renowned scientists about the appropriateness of intercultural and antiracist educational concepts in relation to right-wing extremism, xenophobia and violence. An enormous tension between theoretical reflection and practical experiments becomes visible. - Rudolf Leiprecht: Antiracist approaches in (social) pedagogy fields of work, Albert Scherr: Interracist pedagogy - (k)a reasonable reaction to right-wing extremism, Annita Kalpaka: Stolpersteine und Gemeins in der intercultural und antiracistische Bildungsarbeit, Wolfram Stender: Erziehung zur Tolerung zur Tolerung?
content.title_en: Intercultural and antiracist educational work : project experiences and theoretical contributions

content.text: The book deals with the problems of television and radio reception with many technical details and the main European satellite systems, and then on the other special satellite systems. The annex contains tables, addresses and abbreviations. In addition to discussing technical questions, the reader also receives practical information for the establishment of a reception system. G. E. Thaller (BA 10/00) reports on spy satellites, which have been excluded here. (2)
content.title_en: Manual Satellite Channels

content.text: Klastic sediments : facies and sequence stratigraphy. A modern textbook of sedimentology has long been missing on the German market. The author describes in detail facies models and case studies and thus makes the sedimentological analysis of clastic deposits understandable. A detailed chapter is dedicated to sequence stratigraphy. Richly explained drawings and photos help to open the access to this wide field of geological practice. To facilitate the entry into international literature, the English equivalents are given for important technical terms.
content.title_en: Klastic sediments : facies and sequence stratigraphy

content.text: Systematic Zoology. Well-established university textbook (preliminary edition see A. Remane: ID 45/97). The new edition has been revised and supplemented by about 50 pages. New findings, especially from the fields of morphology, molecular biology, paleontology and the systematics have been incorporated. For example, the development of the animals in the course of the Earth's history is now particularly important, electron microscopic photos of microorganisms have been taken and the systematics have been supplemented in several places by new subclasses and orders. The diversity of species and habitats is taken into account in the further development of the "Artenkäschen" and "Lifespace-Tables". Clear, clear structure of the enormous quantity of material. For students indispensable. Possible for higher-level performance courses (premature construction plans, but difficult to understand without zoological dictionary for laypersons). The 5th edition can expire, all previous editions have to be replaced.
content.title_en: Systematic Zoology

content.text: Visual Basic .NET with method: Software develop with the .NET class library - basics, Windows, ADO.NET, ASP.NET, Webservices and Remoting. In the course of the introduction of the new .NET development environment, Microsoft has developed the proven language Visual Basic 6 into the fully object-oriented language Visual Basic .NET. Introductions for beginners in Visual Basic .NET are S. Fellner (BA 9/03) or P. Monadjemi (BA 4/03). The present book goes beyond these introductions. Based on over 300 examples, it provides comprehensive application knowledge, with a focus on working with the .NET class libraries. Also, database accesses with ADO.NET - although not as detailed as with S. Fellner (ID 20/03)-, the use and synchronization of threads and data transfer in networks are treated. Good consideration is also given to web applications and remoting (use of programs distributed in the network). The examples consist of annotized listings and the associated screen output. The literature directory is scarcely helpful in the case of the online version.
content.title_en: Visual Basic .NET with Method : Develop software with the .NET class library - Basics, Windows, ADO.NET, ASP.NET, Webservices and Remoting

content.text: Examples of timber construction: sample solutions, formula collection, design tables; with 98 examples and detailed sample solutions; [according to the new DIN 1052]. The volume contains the 98 examples from the textbook of the same name (see in this no.) with detailed, calculated solutions, as well as a compilation of the most important design rules as "collection of formulas" and again the table annex from the textbook. Good addition to the textbook for training and exam preparation. For students of civil engineering, structural engineering, carpenters and master students of the carpenter's trade. (3)
content.title_en: Wood construction examples : sample solutions, formula collection, design tables ; with 98 examples and detailed sample solutions ; [according to the new DIN 1052]

content.text: Brake manual : Basics, components, systems, driving dynamics. Manual on braking systems in (power) vehicles taking into account technical and human requirements. Also applies to special applications (in aircraft, racing cars, commercial vehicles) and points to regulations and test methods. Processing and continuation of "Bremsen Manual" (Alfred Teves GmbH, Autohaus-Verlag, 1993). Is now working in a company-neutral manner, compact in the information. If applied to specialists (engineers, workshop personnel), is more detailed than "Brems systems for motor vehicles", BA 7/95), higher in the approach than "Conventional and electronic braking systems" (BA 6/03). - Important for large specialist stocks. (3)
content.title_en: Brake manual : Basics, components, systems, driving dynamics

content.text: Neuro-Fuzzy systems: from the basics of artificial neural networks for coupling with fuzzy systems; [with online service to the book]. Books on fuzzy logic, blurred logic, and their importance for control and control processes have been presented recently with K. Michels (ID 10/03) and J. Börcsök (ID 31/00). Neuronal networks treat R. Callan (ID 32/03) and - as one of several topics - G. Görz (BA 2/04). Both areas together deal with the collection volume "Neuro+Fuzzy", where differences and similarities of both areas are highlighted and examples of solving real problems are brought based on a link between both areas (ID 36/95 - should still remain in existence). In this book, the authors first present detailed neuronal networks and, somewhat scarcer, fuzzy systems as tools for modeling expert behaviour (how do experts anticipate complex problems?) and then show that neuro-fuzzy systems provide the learning capability of neural networks at the same time provide a transparently structured and transparently structured set of reading.
content.title_en: Neuro-Fuzzy systems : from the basics of artificial neural networks to coupling with fuzzy systems ; [with online service to book]

content.title_en: Island 34 : Roman

content.text: Status report : Area and measure pools. Area pools are a relatively new tool in the context of the implementation of the legal consequences of the intervention scheme. Many cities have begun to develop concepts for compensation areas and procedures for activating these areas. A number of counties also take up the new possibilities and offer the local communities the mediation and development of compensation areas as a service. Area pools are built on a regional scale in cooperation with municipalities and in some cases other interested parties. Land societies, farmers' associations, nature conservation foundations check partly whether they develop their own area pools and offer compensation-based areas as services, or have already developed corresponding business fields. The report gives the impression of a very diverse practice, which is confirmed by a closer look at objectives, tasks and organisational structures. The report is based on the results of a status conference on behalf of the German Federal Foundation for the Environment on 16 and 17 September 2002, on extensive preliminary work as well as on evaluations of publications and other available materials.
content.title_en: Status report : Area and action pools

content.text: Brick: an architectural history - from the beginning to the present. The term brick is used to quickly connect the North German brick Gothic (here is the reference "Middle Age Brick Architecture", BA 4/96). The text/billbook is available in a spatial and temporal way. Hardly an aspect that is not considered: individual chapters inform about buildings for various purposes from all regions of the earth, essays present the individual epochs in a profound and clear manner, excursions lead to brick production, construction technology and cultural history. The high-quality photos complement the text well, so that both art historical contexts and details of the buildings become clear. With glossary and bibliography. Nothing comparable. (1) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: Brick : an architectural history - from the beginning to the present

content.text: The land quality target concept of Lower Saxony / Lower Saxony's State Office for Ecology; Part 1: soil erosion and soil sealing. Soil erosion is becoming increasingly a danger for Lower Saxony's soils. As the agricultural land use, especially arable crops, has intensified, the erosion risks have increased over the last 50 years (e.g. by increasing the uniformly managed cropfalls without water or wind-braking structures or by increasing the cultivation of erosion-prone series crops such as corn, sugar beet, potatoes). Depending on the plant-usable greenness of a soil, the soil quality target concept derives from the risk levels of soil fertility and assigns protection measures to the soil quality target concept. In terms of wind erosion risk, tolerable field lengths are recommended depending on the levels of soil erosion and the level of protection of the degraded fruit species.
content.title_en: Lower Saxony / Lower Saxony State Office for Ecology; Part 1: Soil erosion and soil sealing

content.text: Marketing in the backwind: Solutions in recession and upswing. Even in the growth phases of an industry, the revenues and revenues of individual companies can break down. Difficulties are of course part of the business; even more so in the backwind. Managers are looking for ways to tackle the crises properly. Many companies are also able to do so. Only these messages are often not heard as the failures. The empirical study 2003 <Marketing in the backwind> records what moves companies in difficult times and which marketing actors put them in this particular situation. The focus is on budgeting as well as on concrete marketing measures. The authors differ in survival, optimization and future programs. Case studies and practice statements provide concrete impulses for marketing in difficult times. Selected questions about the current recession: 1. Does the fall in 2002/2003 differ from previous collapses? Do and do we need other solutions? 2.How do high-conjuncture and recession marketing differ? 3.Where do short-term and long-term orientation in marketing become more difficult? Where do the current recession and innovation orientation differ? 4.What are the prerequisites and measures for corporate or savings conjunctures in 2004? Which are the business sectors of the business?
content.title_en: Marketing in the headwind : solutions in recession and recovery

content.text: Langenscheidt Routledge Specialist Dictionary compact Technology English : English-German, German-English. News reference book with technical terms and translations from all major technical disciplines. Based on the expensive large specialist dictionaries (e.g. "Langenscheidts Specialist Dictionary Technology...", 2 volumes: BA 11/02) and was extended by almost 50 pages (approx. 2500 entries, especially in the areas of computer science, telecommunications, environmental technology etc.), with general terms and with conventional specialist fields. Still widely applicable (the old edition can be used, should be supplemented as possible with this new edition. (1 A) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Langenscheidt Routledge Specialist Dictionary compact technology English : English-German, German-English

content.text: Databases compact. According to the high importance of database systems in business and administration, the topic is one of the classic areas of training in computer science courses. In order to take account of current developments, the authors present a revised edition, whereby the changes compared to the preliminary edition (BA 10/01) are limited to the topics SQL standardization and XML developments. Otherwise, structure and content remained unchanged, so that an exchange of the preliminary edition is not necessary. Due to the "didactically well structured presentation" and the compact processing of a quite complex topic, the book finds great acceptance in Bremen. Target groups are in the first line major and secondary students in the computer science course, but the book also recommended for other interested persons for self-study. In addition to A. G. Taylor (BA 10/01) and F. D. Rolland (BA 8/03) (2).
content.title_en: Databases compact

content.text: When monsters become lively: simple experiments from biology. The editors M. Keil and P. B. Kremer, as well as the authors, are designated didactics specialists who want to seduce experimenting. 20 experiments with a high knowledge value, which are easy to perform, are gathered together in this volume with explanations of background, implementation and observation. For each experiment literature data, (color or micro) photos, schemas. Especially to biology teachers and pupils of upper secondary school I and II, we turn to "Hobby biologists" in Chr. Wendel: "Biological basic experiments S I" (1. Botanic; BA 5 /02) and H. Kopeszki: "Biological experiments" (BA 7/00), but the latter also - as the present volume - to "Hobby biologists". Very well applied already in middle city and school libraries. (2 S) (LK/F: Lüdtke) Experiments with a high knowledge value are easily performed with explanations about background, implementation and observation. (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: When monsters get lively: simple experiments from biology

content.text: From tax chaos to simple taxation: the guide through the tax debate. Anyone who is not tired of the subject of "tax" today or simply yearns for an uncomplicated tax rule - and who does not - will take advantage of Rose's explanation of a simple model that has emerged within a group of scientists, tax practitioners and companies in Heidelberg and has successfully passed his practical test of rebuilding Croatia. After taking stock and investigating the causes, where the political abuse and disregard of the economic impact of taxes on the name are mentioned, Rose presents the new guiding principle, namely the rejection of annual tax burdens and the conversion to a life-time-appropriate taxation, in which capital formation is taxed only once, thus "simple". Rose describes the positive effects on unemployment, pensions, economic recovery on the basis of practical examples of workers, companies and pensioners. The title from the publishing group Handelsblatt offers insight and information, sometimes even in an entertaining way. (2) (Sigrid Schuster-Schmah)
content.title_en: From tax chaos to simple taxation: the guide through the tax debate

content.text: Practical introduction to ABAP objects: [correct programming according to SAP standards]. Beginners who are looking for an efficient, up-to-date and practical introduction to SAP programming will find the ideal companion in this book. They will be gradually introduced to all relevant programming methods: In addition to the procedural language elements, you will also learn to master the object-oriented of the current ABAP releases (4.6 to 6.20). Numerous instructions, screenshots and solution tips on everyday programming tasks make this beginner book a practical ABAP workshop
content.title_en: Practical introduction to ABAP Objects : [correct programming according to SAP standards]

content.text: Thermodynamics of the motor vehicle: with 7 tables. Thermodynamics is a key pillar of engineering sciences, but often also - due to its complexity and scope as well as phenomenological approach - a challenge for engineers. The aim of the book is to offer a mental workshop for research, development or numerical simulation of various vehicle modules by means of a methodological chain of theoretical foundations, their mathematical representation, the fields of application in automotive technology and many specific exercises and examples. TOC:Basics of technical thermodynamics.- Ideal gases - Thermodynamic properties.- The second main principle of thermodynamics.- Application of the main sets of thermodynamics in energy conversions.- The steam.- Gas-steam-gemische.- Combustion.- Grunlagen der Hemübervermittlung.- Heat transfer (Convection).- Heat radiation.- Thermodynamic processes in machines and plants.- Measurement of thermodynamic quantities.-
content.title_en: Thermodynamics of the motor vehicle : with 7 tables

content.text: Control technology: mathematical basics, design methods, examples. This textbook introduces the theory of linear dynamic multi-size systems. The behavior of these systems under the influence of deterministic and stochastic signals is analyzed in the time and frequency range. Classical and modern methods of controller design, time-continuous and digital controllers, suboptimal observers and Kalman-Bucy filters are the subject of the book. The sixth edition has been revised and extended especially in the field of classical regulation. Tasks with solutions to the respective chapters serve students and practitioners for the training of the learned and for self-control. TOC:Introduction.- Analysis of linear time-invariant systems in the frequency range.- Treatment of simple control problems in the frequency range.- Analysis of linear systems in the time range.- Design of controllers with linear state-reduction.- Design of controllers with linear output feedback.- System considerations for measuring and setting.- Description of random processes in the time range.- Analysis of stochastic linear systems in the time range.- Description of stationary random processes in the frequency range.
content.title_en: Control technology : mathematical foundations, design methods, examples

content.text: Applied statistics: an introduction to the SAS programme examples. The book closes the gap between statistics taught at universities and statistical methods used in industry and public administrations. Numerous concrete practical problems are used to introduce and illustrate the possibilities for applying statistical methods, with solutions always being indicated using SAS. Particular importance is attached to the practical presentation and deepening of the learned through exercises. An appendix compiles the basics of SAS so that prior knowledge about SAS is not required. The datasets and SAS programmes used can be downloaded freely at: http://statistic.mathematics.uni- wuerzburg.de/falk/sas-diskette
content.title_en: Applied statistics : an introduction with examples of the programme in SAS

content.text: Genetic engineering in plants: Opportunities and risks; with 14 tables. Genetically modified plants in all mouths? Plant genetic engineering is developing rapidly. Transgenic plants are growing on millions of hectares of arable land worldwide. The authors give an up-to-date and competent overview of the opportunities and risks of plant genetic engineering. In doing so, you answer burningly discussed questions such as * harmful genetically modified food to humans? * Solve transgenic plants the nutritional problems of humanity? * Are genetically produced plants ecologically more valuable through herbicides or insect resistance? Basic methods of genetic engineering, modern methods for the production and identification of transgenic plants as well as application examples are presented in an understandable manner. The book provides factual information and thus contributes to the partly emotional and polemically guided discussion on the topic rationally. Mouth on and competently discussed! Reading this book provides you with the basis. TOC:Introduction.- Basic methods of genetic engineering.- Production, detection and stability of transgenic plants.- New properties of transgenic plants.- Release and commercial use of the plant genetic technology to the future.
content.title_en: Genetic engineering in plants : opportunities and risks ; with 14 tables

content.text: Media Society Ancient? : Information and Communication from Ancient Egypt to Byzantium ; lecture series on the topic of "Media Society Ancient?". Modern media, information technologies and forms of communication mark a change in the life and thinking of modern societies that is almost to be qualified as a cultural revolution and which also raises questions about antiquity, which can undoubtedly claim special attention as a central element of European and western cultural identity. The individual contributions draw from four millennia of human history, from Pharaonic Egypt to the Byzantine Empire. A rich range of sources shows, as already then through mass communication, but also secrecy and encryption of messages, through the production of public, but also through manipulation and counterfeiting, through the ideological monologue of the rulers, but also through criticism and subversion, complex and contradictory forms of cultural communication were alive.
content.title_en: Media Society Ancient? : Information and Communication from Ancient Egypt to Byzantium ; lecture series on ancient science at the Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences

content.text: Wood pests: wood-destructing fungi and insects on timber; avoid, recognize, combat; a reference work for interested builders, builders, house managers, architects, engineers, conservationists, builders, carpenters, and experts in wood conservation. Extensive illustrated sample collection of timber types, wood-degrading fungi, animals and wood-destructive marine animals. Compared to the first edition 1999 (ID 36/99 - can be used) continuously updated, extended by a chapter on wood protection and image material. The author has many years of experience in wood protection and old building renovation, works as an expert for building damage and uses this reference work in the first line to builders, monument keepers, wood professionals, but also builders. Recommended for a wide range of professional readers in parallel to the somewhat more expensive title of H.-P. Sutter (ID 10/03). In B. Leiße (BA 6/03) and the understandable guide by P. Weissenfeld (BA 7/01) the wood protection is the foreground (KbKA) (B.
content.title_en: Wood pests : wood-destructive mushrooms and insects on timber; avoid, recognize, combat; a reference work for interested builders, developers, house managers, architects, engineers, conservationists, builders, carpenters, carpenters, experts and experts in wood protection

content.text: Online addiction: when chatting and e-mailing become a coercion. On the subject of Internet addiction, only 2 titles have already been dusted up via the meeting service, especially since they have been running out of the Anglo-American space: D. N. Greenfield's "Suchetrape Internet" (BA 4/01) and K. S. Young's "Caught in the Net" (ID 21/99). G. Farke, even a certain time online-dependent and after her exit founder of the association "Help for self-help for online addicts", draws from her experience. Her information on the manifestations, reasons and causes as well as the summary of scientific expert findings and tips on exiting are always integrated into a variety of mails and chat posts that were directed to her online (http://www.onlinesucht.de). Special focus here is on the excessive communication dependence via chat, mail or in forums the online sex addiction as well as the search-like behavior of the participants to internet auctions. With special chapters on how to deal with the work.
content.title_en: Online-Sustain : when chatting and e-mailing become a coercion

content.text: Designs from Romanesque to present: an image manual. The proven small manual (3rd edition: BA 3/87), which is often borrowed, conveys knowledge of architectural history, lets the reader see style features and explains the basic vocabulary of historical and contemporary designs, with special attention to architectural details and ornaments mainly in German-speaking areas. The basic design with a good 500 available drawings has not changed, but fortunately the content has been updated; only the literature list has been carefully supplemented with new titles. With useful factual and local registers. An exchange of the editions is not mandatory, because the 3rd edition can still provide good services with the length of the period covered. No substitute for the basic stock construction style customer "dtv-Atlas zur Baukunst" by Werner Müller (BA 11/97; 12th edition 2002). (2) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: Designs from Romanesque to present: an image guide

content.text: Maps and the Internet. Articles by more than thirty authors from different countries give an overview of current research in the field of cartography on the Internet. The Internet allows maps to be made accessible to a large number of users, including interaction and animation. Weather maps or maps for traffic can be updated at intervals of a few minutes. In response to the fundamental changes in distribution and use of maps, the International Cartographic Association (ICA) established the Commission on Maps and the Internet in Ottawa in August 1999 (http://maps.unomaha.edu/ica/). This Commission has the task of promoting international cartographic research and solving problems arising from scientific work with maps and their use on the Internet. The book has four main topics: 1) Introduction and current topics 2) Technical development 3) Applications and user questions 4) Theoretical development.
content.title_en: Maps and the Internet

content.text: Pocketbook Calculator Networks and Internet : with 105 tables. The pocketbook provides a broad, systematic overview of key topics such as infrastructure, transmission and mediation procedures, protocols, services and applications. Other topics are planning computer networks, standards and network management. The Internet is given special attention in all matters, it is completely new in the 2nd edition.
content.title_en: Paperback Networks and Internet : with 105 tables
