Also this new edition (2nd edition: BA 3/00, was not available for direct comparison) continues to pursue the goal of "translating students of business administration the basic computer tools for the study and later career". For this edition the author team was expanded and the contents of the book were updated. All chapters have updates. Since this presentation is based on the use of Windows XP, the special attention is focused on adapting the work steps, the problem solving approaches and the illustrations under the new operating system. Furthermore, there were extensions in the chapters spreadsheet calculation with Excel and information activities on the Internet. The programs Word, Excel, Access and PowerPoint as well as the topic Internet are treated. Unfortunately, the tasks covered remain without resolution. Even if this is an introduction to well-known application programs, this compact presentation is more likely to be compared with the student clientele. (2)
content.title_en: Business Computing with MS-Office 2003 and Internet : an introduction to practical examples

content.text: From the OFFENSIV Act on "Activating Social Assistance" : a concept for the reform of labour market and social policy as a contribution to more employment and growth; study on behalf of the Hessian State Chancellery. The present study by the Ifo Institute for Economic Research analyses four different concepts for reforms of labour market and social policy in Germany, which were introduced by various sides in the course of 2002 into the political discussion. The aim is to develop an overall concept for reforms on this basis, which can reverse the unbroken trend of rising structural unemployment and create new employment opportunities for social benefit recipients, especially those of low-skilled workers who are particularly affected by unemployment.
content.title_en: From the OFFENSIV Act on "Activating Social Assistance": a concept for reforming labour market and social policy as a contribution to more employment and growth; study on behalf of the Hessian State Chancellery

content.text: Material science for roofing, wall and sealing technology : Fachbuch für die Aus- und Weiterbildung im Dachdeckerhandwerk ; mit zahlreichen Tablen. Praxis-oriented textbook for the education and training in roofing trade. Provides a detailed, richly illustrated insight into the origin, production, properties and application possibilities of the individual materials such as stone and clay, mortar and concrete building materials, building metals, wood, bituminous building materials, plastics, insulation materials. Compared to the 9th edition 1995 (BA 7/96 - was not available for direct comparison) extended, brought to the latest state of the art and updated regarding changes in standards and regulations. In addition to roofing masters, construction experts, architects and master craftsmen are also addressed, who are looking for help in the classification and application of the materials. Replace pre-press as possible. Good addition to "Dach, Wall and Sealing Technology" (BA 2/99) from the same publishing house. (2) (LK/KA: Nibbrei)
content.title_en: Materials science for roofing, walling and sealing technology : book for training and further training in roofing trades ; with numerous tables

content.text: Autumn in primary school. The compilation is a substantially reworked and extended version of "Autumn in primary school" (1st edition 1991, 8th edition 1997, not shown here). Eibl and their co-authors offer a collection of differentiatedly elaborated materials on autumnal topics (weather, plants in autumn, harvest time, animals in autumn) for use in primary school lessons. With copyable templates, instructions for games, craft instructions, poems and stories and more. Stimulating and helpful for cross-curricular use; for all primary school teachers. (2 S)
content.title_en: Autumn in primary school

content.text: Trend barometer Technology : visionary products, new materials, factories of the future. Compendium for the "Year of Technology" (2004) with over 100 selected examples of information and communication technology, energy and environmental technology, but also on health, companies and others. The authors are proposals for solutions on topics (e.g. driving assistance systems, screens for rolling up) which are in discussion but not yet ready for practical implementation. The authors are experts from research and practice (Siemens AG, Fraunhofer Institute etc.). Clearly structured and well illustrated, with references to innovation level, market relevance, practical meaning. A direct, similarly widely applicable title is not known. (2)
content.title_en: Trend barometer technology : visionary products, new materials, factories of the future

content.text: Cultural dimensions of medicine : Ethnology - Medical Anthropology. Modern medicine still draws on self-image and practical significance from the natural scientific dimensions of health and disease. In contrast, cultural dimensions of medicine are developed from the perspective of ethnomedicine and medical ethnology. This publication provides an up-to-date overview of the basics of these areas. In 12 chapters, which are largely independent of each other, topics, approaches and important literature are presented. The first section is dedicated to the discussion of locations and methods. Thus, the strong change of concepts and research areas in ethnomedicine and medical ethnology itself is taken into account. In the second section, the key concepts of "biomedicine", "illness" and "body" are presented and a change of views in medicine is shown. Disease, for example, is not only a biological event. Its cultural dimensions take shape when the experience of illness, "healthiness", shifts into focus and their character as a cultural construct. The consideration of the cultural dimensions of medicine has led to a strong differentiated view of a variety of problems. In the second half of the book, the social dimensions are defined by the social boundaries, and the fields of medicine is very much related.
content.title_en: Cultural Dimensions of Medicine : Ethnology - Medical Anthropology

content.text: Production-technical research in Germany: 1933 - 1945. In the years between 1934 and 1941 all the production-technical chairs in Germany were re-occupied. What was the decisive factor in the new occupation, professional qualification or political skill? How far went the political influence of the party and state, how much the chairs in their teaching and research activities were exposed to the transformation of the universities in the National Socialist sense? The work of Günter Spur and his employees answered these questions by meticulous reconstruction of the appeal procedures. The involved persons, in particular the newly appointed and emeritus professors, are presented in detail. The research focuses of the technical universities in Berlin, Aachen, Braunschweig, Breslau, Danzig, Dresden, Hannover, Stuttgart and Munich are documented. All the dissertations and habilitation papers in the field of production technology that have been produced during these years are listed. Thus, the book is an irreplaceable find for all those interested in these important years of recent technology history. Living witnesses are less and less and less, therefore the book is also suitable to learn more about their own university at this time.
content.title_en: Production Technical Research in Germany : 1933 - 1945

content.text: Design and calculation : textbook for engineers in mechanical engineering. Informs about a sub-area of the design process in a textbook for students at universities of applied sciences and designers in practice. Brings numerous examples of exercises taking into account computer-supported processes (CAD) as well as information on the documentation of products. Is supplemented by numerous tabular overviews and by a list of important standards and guidelines. Can be used alongside H. Hintzen (BA 5/01), which is more tailored to students. (3)
content.title_en: Design and calculation : textbook for engineers in mechanical engineering

content.text: Professional software development with PHP 5 : Object orientation - Design pattern - Modeling - Advanced database programming. In the third quarter of 2003, PHP overcomes the technical limitations of the object model, including the lack of private attributes and methods as well as problems with object references. With the new language characteristics and the Script Running Machine SRM (the first application server for PHP), the PHP platform opens up to other technologies. The book describes experienced PHP developers the way into the new, object-oriented PHP 5 world. Programmers who have worked with object-oriented programming languages such as C++ or Java learn how to implement the familiar concepts and design patterns with PHP here.
content.title_en: Professional software development with PHP 5 : Object orientation - Design pattern - Modelling - Advanced database programming

content.text: Development of Linux drivers : Device drivers for kernel 2.6 are introduced systematically. Drivers under Linux are easy and fast to implement compared to other operating systems. This book describes the basic concepts for this and illustrates with numerous, easy to understand and functional code examples. The device driver (and Linux) newcomer finds a sound introduction to the topic here as well as numerous recyclable code fragments, which make it easier to create first own programs. Furthermore, the work is explicitly aimed at professionals. Thanks to detailed description of the internal kernel functions, the book is also suitable for this target group as a reference work. Also discussed is the programming of specific drivers (USB and network drivers) as well as the changes from kernel version 2.4 to version 2.6 (preemption in the kernel, elimination of task queues ...)
content.title_en: Developing Linux Drivers : Device Drivers for Kernel 2.6 introduced systematically

content.text: Nanotechnology : A journey into the realm of dwarfs. Easily readable introduction to nanotechnology and its (possible) application in medicine, science, electronics and other technical sub-disciplines. The research area is considered particularly promising; the author, chemist and science journalist describes opportunities and problems, illuminates broad effects like estimated market volumes. Is hand-made worked as W. Fahrner (ID 7/04), easier accessible than M. Beckmann (ID 6/03) , more detailed but sparsely illustrated than the brochure "Nanotechnology" (BA 10/02). Can be used as a comprehensible, application-oriented overview for a broad audience. Not cheap. (2) (Alfred Pleuß)
content.title_en: Nanotechnology : A journey into the realm of dwarfs

content.text: Open source software : an economic and technical analysis ; with 6 tables. The book provides for the first time an economic and technical analysis of an increasingly important model of software development and licensing. There is an overview of the German software market, then presents the various manifestations of Open Source Software (OSS), examines the technical aspects of the creation and use of OSS and analyses the motivation of both private and business OSS to develop and use. In particular, the competitive and business dimensions of this rapidly expanding approach are discussed. Based on this, the economic impact of OSS on the German software industry and the economic policy aspects of OSS are examined. TOC:Introduction.- Inventory of the software industry.- Definition and examples of OSS.- Technical aspects of the development and use of OSS.- Economic aspects of the development and use of OSS.- Impacts on the software industry.- Annex
content.title_en: Open source software : an economic and technical analysis ; with 6 tables

Task collection for technical mechanics in a clear topic setting with the help of common mathematics programs. Brings detailed descriptions of the solution paths and - in addition - exercises for deepening in a final section (solutions on the Internet), to introduce the applied software. Can be used as an alternative to H. D. Motz (ID 16/02) to older representations. (3)

Introduction; Basics of climate policy; The institutional basis; State of climate research; IPCC's state of play reports; The empirical basis; The role of economic instruments; The environmental economic background; Flexible instruments in the Kyoto Protocol; Emissions trading at European level; Implementation into national law; Summary; Literature; Brief presentation / Abstract
content.title_en: Climate policy and emissions trading: the economy in the climate protection sector

content.text: The standard work on the design of floor plans in residential buildings is available in an updated, papered special edition (preliminary editions not shown here). Introducing a brief overview of the development of the floor plan, the role of the development and the different architectural approaches of the 60s and 80s. The main part contains international floor plan examples in the scale 1:200, divided by floor and flat construction, as well as systematically arranged according to corner houses, building gaps, residential towers, double houses, terraced houses etc. For each project there are additional small-format photos and short information about the type of construction, year of construction, financing, housing number, housing sizes, architect etc. Target group are students of architecture and civil engineering, architects, but also private builders. Valuable addition to the classical design textbooks of E. Neufert (last BA 9/00), H. Schmitt (last ID 34/01) or P. Neufert (BA 4/04).
content.title_en: Building and construction

content.text: Digital differential protection : Basics and application. Differential protection is a fast, selective protection, which is used in many variants in electrical machines, transformers, collection rails and lines. This book first conveys the general principles of differential protection in analog and digital technology. Based on this, it describes the different types of differential protection and uses it in practice on the basis of examples. Likewise textbook as standard work, the book deals with all topics that need to be considered when planning, projecting and applying differential protection. It is addressed to students and engineers who want to work in differential protection, but also to experienced users who are looking for entry into digital technology. It also serves as a reference work to solve special application questions.
content.title_en: Digital differential protection : Basics and application

content.text: Integrated Knowledge Management Systems : Architecture and practical application ; with101 illustrations and 26 tables. How do you actually build Knowledge Management Systems (WMS)? How do you integrate them in organizations and between them? Based on extensive practical experience and the evaluation of relevant theories, this book presents a comprehensive architecture (a "construction plan") for WMS. This architecture shows how components and functions of such systems can be derived from strategy and processes and integrated with each other in a targeted manner. A procedure model, a measurement system, an organizational model and representations for cultural anchoring provide sound support for the implementation of WMS. Extensive practical cases and numerous illustrations illustrate problems and solutions in implementation and application. In the future, possibilities of inter-company integration of WMS are highlighted. TOC:Introduction.- Practical cases: drivers and challenges for knowledge management systems.- Basics.- Proposal of an architecture for integrated knowledge management systems.- Dimensions of the integration of knowledge management systems.- Practical cases: Solutions, results and insights.- Summary and outlook.- Annex.- Online sources.-
content.title_en: Integrated Knowledge Management Systems : Architecture and practical application ; with101 illustrations and 26 tables

content.text: Service-oriented IT management : ITIL best practices and case studies. Companies are once again focusing more on the cost effectiveness of their IT departments. No longer the technology, but costs and customer satisfaction are in the foreground. The transformation from a technology-oriented IT department to a customer-oriented IT service provider with an efficient design of internal IT management processes can only be ensured by a service-oriented IT management. This topic approaches the book from two pages: In addition to a structured description of best practices ? based on the IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) ? experiences from the practice on the topic of service-oriented IT management are provided in the form of case studies. TOC:Introduction.- Basics.- ITIL processes.- ITIL in practice.- Annex.- Glossary
content.title_en: Service-oriented IT management : ITIL best practices and case studies

content.text: John Dewey's logic of investigation for the discovery of the political in modern societies. At the beginning of the 20th century, the American pragmatist John Dewey (1859-1952) conceived a new public model against the background of the problematic social conditions of industrial modernism. In search of a way out of the misidentifications of either economic or statist (de) regulation and the unilateral ideologies of either communitization or socialization of the great society, he developed the hypothesis that the political must always be rediscovered in an intercommunicative investigation process between lay and expert cultures.
content.title_en: John Dewey's logic of investigation for the discovery of the political in modern societies

content.text: Now I learn CAD: the easy introduction to designing with AutoCAD/AutoCAD LT; [the complete starter kit: AutoCAD-LT trial version and all sample drawings on two CDs; start without prior knowledge]. Entry course in CAD with numerous exercises (no more solutions) and test questions for self-control. Brings understandable, well-structured instructions with numerous examples. New edition in alignment with the current version AutoCAD 2004 (normal and compact version). The CD-ROMs contain on one hand exercises examples with executed drawings, on the other hand a 30-day freeze version of AutoCAD LT 2004. Has been streamlined compared to the prepress (BA 7/02) (smaller font image, command list taken out in the annex), on the other hand, supplemented according to the new program version (sentence, hatching, tool palettes, extended functions, etc.). Construction and structure remain the same. Purchase of this edition is desirable, but not necessarily necessary if the 2002 edition is available (the 2000 edition, see BA 6/00, should be widely used).
content.title_en: Now I learn CAD : the easy way to start designing with AutoCAD/AutoCAD LT ; [the complete starter kit: AutoCAD-LT trial version and all sample drawings on two CDs ; start without prior knowledge]

content.text: Resilience : Promote the resilience of children in day care facilities. Resilience refers to the ability to deal with difficult situations in life (also: stress resistance). The aim of resilience research is to determine factors and conditions that influence the psychological stability of children. The book presents theoretical approaches and research results on the area of resilience and the concepts and programs for pedagogical practice based on them. Particular emphasis is placed on early childhood education in day care facilities. In this predominantly theory-oriented book, the topic of resilience is presented for the first time in summary. As the topic becomes increasingly important for pedagogical practice, a basic work is thus available. (3) (Ute Scharmann)
content.title_en: Resilience : Promoting child resistance in day care facilities

content.text: The story of the Golden Ratio: Ascension and Fall of the Divine Proportion. Albert van der Schoot takes the reader on a fascinating journey through the long history of the Golden Ratio: the path runs through philosophy and mathematics, from architecture to biology and psychology. The discoveries are amazing: unlike the usual ones, the divine proportion did not have an outstanding place in antiquity. Nor did it play the prominent role in the Renaissance, which has long been attributed to it. - So when did the Golden Ratio get its sort of >holy status? The author shows that it was the Romantics who first placed the Golden Ratio on a podium. In the face of the threatening gap between nature and culture, they saw in the geometric relation a bridge that connected nature, art and psychology. With his impressive book van der Schoot, van der Schoot has written an important chapter on the mythology of art and science completely new.
content.title_en: The History of the Golden Ratio : Ascension and Fall of the Divine Proportion

content.text: Data modeling and database design: a comparison of current methods. The author considers all established methods of data modeling, from semantic data modeling (ERM), to the specific data modeling (ERM), to the specification of SERM (Structured ERM) and to the concreteization of SAP company models as SAP SERM, to the relational data modeling that leads to the concrete database design. Furthermore, object-oriented data modeling, as developed in the UML (Unified Modeling Language), is presented. A special feature of the presentation is that it also addresses data modeling for business processes (?process-oriented data modeling). This modeling technique, which is required and used by practice, has been largely ignored by database theory. TOC:Introduction.- Tools.- Modelling.- SQL.-ity Relationship Modeling.- SERM - Structured entity relationship models after Sinz.- Business processes and their modelling by event-controlled process chains.- The environment - Databases in the business information environment - Database modeling.
content.title_en: Data modelling and database design : a comparison of current methods

content.text: Normating, Trading, Inscenating : Christianity as a book religion. Christianity is a religion of the book and the writing through its roots in Judaism and through the early writing process. Andreas Holzem and a group of first-class historians and church historians show how the Bible and its accompanying texts influenced culture and religious practice and how, in turn, the normalization process of religious writings depended on historical factors.
content.title_en: Normating, Trading, Stageing : Christianity as Book Religion

content.text: The metallurgy of the material: iron materials - non-ferrous metal materials. In this third edition, substantial new topics were expanded in practice. First of all, these are additional indications of phase transformations (martensit formation and transformations in the liquid and solid state).The versions on corrosion damage to welded structures (especially those consisting of "corrosion-resistant" materials) have increased considerably.The handling of the often abstract theories of corrosion chemistry (electrochemistry) is facilitated and can thus be applied specifically to corrosion problems. At the request of many readers a number of tasks have been taken up, which can be used to control the understanding of the read. These "examples" mentioned tasks (or their solutions) are therefore so helpful, because they point to mostly not obvious connections. At the chapter ends, the interested reader therefore finds tasks, of which part with the material shown is resolvable, but another part is thought of complementing and continuing the material and gives indications of further studies and information. content.text: Distributed systems: Basics and basic technologies. Distributed systems are the basis for a wide range of applications in the working environment as well as in the private life of most people. Currently, the integration of mobile technologies expands the application fields, but also the structure and properties of distributed systems. The present book presents the basics of distributed systems from the perspective of computer networks and distributed processing. The focus is on a compact presentation of the basic concepts and technologies as well as the extended view of distributed systems resulting from current developments. The diverse aspects are explained and presented in practice based on an application field that is consistently used throughout the book. Together with her co-authors she now presents a book on system administration which represents the basics of system management for Linux including working in networks. The reader is provided with basic knowledge in Linux. The book deals with the market leading SUSE Linux, but can - with very few limitations - also be used for other Linux distributions. Preferably working with a graphical user interface. However, it also takes into account the direct command input via terminal, which is often faster and even indispensable in some tasks (e.g. creating a larger number of new users). Well-responsible, practical representation with many illustrations and tables; glossary; references; numerous further literature information (including journal articles and Internet addresses).

A focus is on the various areas of the European Alps and the mountains of the European countries of travel. Among other things, the situation and landscape, geology, climate, vegetation, land use and tourism are treated. Fascinating landscape and plant photographs, geological overview maps, climate diagrams, representations of vegetation zones as well as text boxes with important keywords and clues complement the text. Knowledge in botany and geosciences is of benefit. The book can be very useful for travel preparation, but it is also an important basis for global questions such as water resources, biodiversity and climate change.

content.text: Food shortage and protest: Expensive unrest in France and Prussia in 1846/47. Famines have been the trigger for social protests since the times of ancient Rome, which in part resulted in socially relevant changes. The author examines such protests, their course, their social carriers and their effects on politics and society in a comparative analysis (France/Prussia) for the years 1846/47. This time was marked by hunger unrest throughout Europe, which often resulted in violent actions. Since the previous research has often focused on individual factors, a very ambivalent picture of these events is to be found. Therefore, in his work, the author tried to investigate and explain the conditions of the unrest as comprehensively as possible, so that the events become actually understandable. Likewise, the state countermeasures, which all too often exhausted in pure repression, are examined in a comparative analysis of France/Prussia.
content.title_en: Food shortage and protest : Excessive unrest in France and Prussia in 1846/47

content.text: The Brut : Roman. Th.D., awarded the Dt.Krimi Prize for her best-selling novel "The Brain Queen", presents her new novel a masterpiece of suspense and subtle horror. Th.D., awarded the Dt.Krimi Prize for her best-selling novel "The Brain Queen", presents her new novel a masterpiece of suspense and subtle horror
content.title_en: The Brut : Roman

content.text: Whose water belongs to? "Whose water belongs to?" seeks the agreement of the viewer through a phenomenological approach to the water that an element that is constantly in the river, evades every claim to property, whether politically or economically. From an economic, ecological, cultural, social, ethical and aesthetic point of view, complex questions are raised in the context of drinking water supply, waste water disposal, food production, climate and discussed in dedicated image sequences and dense texts and fact folders.
content.title_en: Who owns the water?

content.text: Environmental History : an Introduction. Historiography has attached little importance to the changes in the environment by humans until the last decades of the 20th century. Only then - also in response to the increasing environmental problems - the subject of environmental history has developed. The study book offers for the first time an interdisciplinary overview of the state of research of this discipline and an introduction to its topics and methods
content.title_en: Environmental History : an Introduction

content.text: The recollection of both dictatorships of the 20th century is part of the democratic self-image in united Germany. The multi-faceted memories of these chapters of German history sharpen the awareness of freedom, law and democracy. Enlightenment about the two dictatorships that had animosity against democracy and the rule of law in common are the core of democratic consensus and memory culture. Memorial sites, places and signs as well as museums and documentation centres present the authentic places of persecution in East and West Germany, but also of opposition and resistance. They are signs of the recognition and moral rehabilitation of those who had to pay civil courage with suppression, imprisonment or death or even without their own intervention became victims of persecution. The memorials in public space are places of quiet, individual and common remembrance.
content.title_en: Places of Remembrance : Memorial Signs, Memorials and Museums on the Dictatorship in SBZ and GDR

content.text: The city of architects: Anatomy of self-destruction. While most architects leave the dramatic transformation of city and urban life far uncommented, their international stars are treated as brilliant creators in the glaring economic cycle of media-reformed architectural events. Against this background, the volume focuses on the relationship between architect and city in the theoretical and technical debates of the past decades. With a view to the current challenges that the profession should face, the essay advocates a radically new reading of this relationship. (http://www.baufachinformation.de/literatur.jsp?bu=2005129005961)
content.title_en: The City of Architects : Anatomy of Self-Deassembly

content.text: The end of work and its future: new concepts for the 21st century. If the industrial technology available today were to be used in Germany, nine million jobs would be lost and unemployment would rise to 38%. The progressive process of automation and job destruction in industrial production will not be stopped. Whether the enormous social conflicts that arise from the division of society into rich and poor, the disappearance of all social security systems and the structures of the distribution of wealth, can be avoided, this is the question to which Jeremy Rifkin is devoted here with impressive technological and economic competence and remarkable social imagination.
content.title_en: The end of work and its future: new concepts for the 21st century

content.text: The future of the world economy. Proposals for a transformation of globalization and differentiated explanations of world economic contexts and requirements. (Elke Günther) The internationally recognized American economist compares the construction of a global economy with the tower building of Babel, because globalization has many different consequences for different people and regions - that is very well explained. Arguments of opponents and advocates, especially those of the US Americans, are discussed, besides their economic policy activities, the economic situation of the population and their special consumption behavior, Thurov does not save with criticism. As in "The Future of Capitalism" (ID 23/96), he impresses with his knowledge of many countries and their economic development. He is also appreciative failure to the World Bank and now also the European Central Bank. He explains the necessity and further development of the 3rd industrial revolution and mentions proposals for a transformation of globalization. Liquidly written, differentiated explanations of economic contexts. (2) (Elke Günther)
content.title_en: The future of the world economy

content.text: The Harvard concept: the classic of negotiation technology. For more than 20 years, the method of substantive negotiation, known as Harvard concept, has been considered the most effective of all negotiation techniques: instead of running previously defined positions, the partners strive to achieve a fair balance of interests, which will bring the best possible result to both sides.
content.title_en: The Harvard concept: the classic of negotiation technology

content.text: AboutLife Knowledge / Ottmar Ette ; [1]: The task of philology. Thanks to fascinating models of understanding and impressive research results, which are increasingly searching for areas of everyday life and securing the future, the life sciences were proclaimed to the sciences of life par excellence. The riddle of life now seemed to be decipherable: as a accountable and ultimately predictable chain, as code. However, in the traditional humanities one begins to understand that the human body can no longer be researched from a historical perspective and otherwise be left to medical-natural research as "nature", but that new forms of inter- and transdisciplinary cooperation are urgently required. The Potsdam novelist Ottmar Ette asks and analyses the concept of life knowledge in science and literature and in the form of various constructs and discourse formations. Life and pleasure, body and knowledge, play forms of literary writing and writing are intended to enter into the construction of scientific objects and at the same time to change their scientific subjects.
content.title_en: AboutLife Knowledge / Ottmar Ette ; [1]: The Task of Philology

content.text: Chassis technology for cars: basics, concepts, processes and trends. Short introduction to components, systems and processes of the chassis (lenking, brake, wheel guidance, etc.) for passenger cars in simple, well illustrated descriptions for trainees and technically interested lay people. Focuses on future developments (pre-looking chassis) and complements the older, more thematically specific presentation of the author from the same series (ID 7/98). Suitable as a first overview before or alongside the detailed expert of J. Reimpell (BA 8/00). (2)
content.title_en: Chassis technology for passenger cars: basics, concepts, processes and trends

content.text: The author has been able to show how the IT project can be assessed in a professional manner and how it can be managed. The spectrum ranges from internal mediation to mediation proceedings to judicial dispute. With tried-and-tested regulatory proposals and checklists as well as clear case studies, the author helps to avoid and deal with conflict and crisis situations - for 15 years now publicly appointed and sworn IT experts - and helps to prevent and deal with IT projects: mastering risks and eliminating mischief. Many IT projects exceed time, costs or resources - or they fail altogether. Rarely, however, projects are suddenly cancelled. This book shows the characteristics of imminent conflicts and mismatches at an early stage.
content.title_en: Saving IT Projects : Mastering Risks and Eliminating Scatters

content.text: Software technology in C and C++: the compendium; modular, object-oriented and generic programming; ISO-C90, ISO-C99, ISO-C++98, MS-C++.NET; [all program examples on CD-ROM]. The globally standardized languages C and C++ are presented in a very detailed and common way in this textbook. Already in the 4th edition (1st edition: ID 47/99) the authors (from the 3rd edition together with Hartmut Helmke) updated and extended their work. Completely new additions are a chapter on C++.NET. In addition, the chapter on "Automatics in Software Technology" is used as the basis of the standard ISO-C99. The 3rd chapter "The Language C++ and its Software Techniques" has been restructured and numerous exercises have been added. In order to avoid any increase in the already luxuriant volume of the book, the chapter on "Automatics in Software Technology" is now available on the accompanying CD-ROM. There are also all program texts used in the book and the solutions to the exercise tasks. The book is used for computer science students as well as well as well as for professional programming.
content.title_en: Software technology in C and C++ : the compendium ; modular, object-oriented and generic programming ; ISO-C90, ISO-C99, ISO-C++98, MS-C++.NET ; [all program examples on CD-ROM]

content.text: Energy-saving building: from European standardisation to the Energy Saving Ordinance. Textbook for civil engineers and students of the fields of construction and architecture to implement the Energy Saving Ordinance EnEV, which has been in force since 2002, and corresponding thermal protection certificates. Topics are the application of European and national heat protection standards, the implementation of the Low Energy House Standard for individual components and detailed constructions, energy-saving building technology in relation to the EnEV as well as a documented example for the calculation method for the Energy Demand Certificate of EnEV. Compactly formulated, with numerous tables, graphics, sample calculations, construction drawings and extensive literature. No direct comparison title known.
content.title_en: Energy saving construction: from European standardisation to the Energy Saving Regulation

content.text: Constructing with UNIGRAPHICS NX2 : solids, assemblies and drawings. UNIGRAPHICS is one of the world's leading CAE systems. The new UNIGRAPHICS NX is currently being created from the fusion with IDEAS. The book describes in detail the essential functionalities of this new system for general engineering applications. The basis for this is the German version of UNIGRAPHICS NX2. First, the most important terms and functions of the user interface are explained. The focus is on the volume construction with the creation of 3D models using basic bodies, form elements, sketches and operations. The commands are explained in detail by means of examples. Tips for a useful way of working are added to the presentation. After the individual parts are discussed on the assemblies. In addition to the instructions for the construction and manipulation of assemblies, the functions for the exchange of information between parts, the handling of piece lists and simple movement simulations are described.
content.title_en: Design with UNIGRAPHICS NX2 : solids, assemblies and drawings

content.text: The book by the renowned author Günter Mader provides basic knowledge for planning and execution of the design of open spaces: from small house gardens to the surroundings of larger building structures to the multi-layered structures of the city's green. Introducing the basics of the design, the individual design elements and the available materials are presented. The typical design process is also documented. Excellent colour illustrations as well as tables, graphics and drawings support the presentation. Examples of successful open space designs from history and present date from Belgium, Denmark, Germany, England, France, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Austria, Portugal, Sweden, Switzerland and Spain.
content.title_en: Open space planning : gardens, green areas, urban landscapes

content.text: Strong children defend themselves: prevention against violence; child safety training. Making children strong and self-confident is the aim of the book, which is oriented towards child safety training, which Holger Schumacher offers for children and their parents (WO-DE security training). It is about prevention of (sexual) violence of adults, but also about the handling of violence between children among themselves. Manipulation attempts by perpetrators, encouragement to say no, taking serious care of the child's feelings are topics that the book conveys. "Children's sides" represent conflict scenes and are intended to give rise to discussions with the children. Widely space takes the presentation of the courses of the WO-DE security training (photos with explanations of the exercises and their objectives), which gives the book a bit of the character of an advertising brochure. Not uninteresting, but if sufficient literature on the topic of violence and abuse prevention is available (e.g. "Valitation prevention in youth work and school", BA 5/03) no "muss". (2)
content.title_en: Strong children resist: prevention against violence; child safety training

content.text: Competencies and learning cultures: to the historical reconstruction of modern educational semantics. Responsible for the need for continuous learning is the fact that economic and political structures as well as social and cultural practices are subject to continuous change. Against the background of these rapid changes, which humans are constantly exposed to in their environment, it is important to make a historical contribution to the semantic clarification of fundamental concepts such as competence, competence development, self-organisation and learning culture. In this volume, Hermann Veith tries to reconstruct the meaning of concepts in their historical context in a time frame from the Reformation epoch to the present day, in order to provide an impetus for the formulation of modern educational theory concepts. Apart from the creation of contextual references between the non-explicit concepts: - development of historical and systematic questions on the connotations of the concepts of competence, competence development, self-organisation and learning culture - presentation of the change of the educational theory of guiding semantics in the course of modernization - summary of the research results under historical and systematic perspectives
content.title_en: Skills and learning cultures : to the historical reconstruction of modern educational semantics

content.text: Plastics joining : basics, processes, application ; with 31 tables. This work deals with the basics of joining techniques for plastics, i.e. welding, bonding and mechanical joining (screwing, riveting, snap joints). It conveys the various joining methods, their technology and process technology, their fields of application as well as the associated machine and apparatus construction. The most important physical properties of plastics, the topics adhesion, heat transfer and flow technology are scientifically presented.
content.title_en: Plastics joining : basics, procedures, application ; with 31 tables

content.text: Design and design in mechanical engineering : Components - assemblies - machines. Textbook of engineering engineering for students at universities and universities of applied sciences. Focuss on the design of components - assemblies - machines. Brings calculated examples and exercises and complements the teaching material with numerous illustrations and photos. Appears somewhat more theoretical and higher in the approach than the entry course of F. Steinwender (BA 11/97), simpler and less detailed than R. Koller (ID 52/98); both are no longer entirely up-to-date by the guidelines. In this respect, this new publication is worth considering at least for larger stocks. (3)
content.title_en: Design and Design in Mechanical Engineering : Components - Components - Machines

The textbook is used for the introduction into the basic areas of electrical engineering. The 5th edition, which is newly edited, brings a series of updates and additions oriented towards the "framework agreements on specialist schools of the conference of cultural ministers" and the study plans of the universities. Practical and cross-chapter tasks deepen the learning content. New topics are: Superposition law on network circuits, internal circuits for passive four poles as well as a consideration of location curves
content.title_en: Basics and components of electrical engineering : with numerous tables, examples, exercises and test tasks

Part W - Materials, Connection technology, Environmental technology. Part BU - Operation and its environment, Annex.
content.title_en: Electrical engineering: tables, formulae, standard application

content.text: The laboratory of poetry: chemistry and poetry at Friedrich Schlegel. Chemical images can be found everywhere in early romantics - especially in their theoretical head Friedrich Schlegel. Poetry, as it is read repeatedly, "melts", "mixes", "saturit", "oxydirt". The central thesis of this book is that chemistry at Schlegel is not only a supplier of pretty metaphors, but that it itself maintains as a guiding model of the early romantic project. The fact that the conception of modern poetry is chemically lacking is connected with the confusion in which chemistry is located around 1800. It strikes a balancing act between mathematical formalization and alchemistic materiality, between mechanism and organism, between combinatorics and election relations. Of all these (scientificly unsustainable) intermediate positions make it the most effective allegory of the early romantic program. Their ehrgeiz lies in the fact that the word-teleological description of the work of art inherited from aesthetics and of choice is to be replaced with a description, which shows our attention to the abstract, experimental fragmentary, existing model of poetry.
content.title_en: The Laboratory of Poetry : Chemistry and Poetics by Friedrich Schlegel

content.text: Borders worldwide: zones, lines, walls in historical comparison. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, the term "border abolition" has been used in all places, as well as integration and freedom of movement as an expression of a growing global village. The multiplication and acceleration of capital, goods and migration flows is considered an indicator. It seems that borders of the past have been formed. However, when you look closer, old and new barriers are coming into your eye. Although there is no more Iron Curtain and no Berlin Wall, "Schengen" and the fortification line between the US and Mexico borders within the central areas of peripheral areas. In addition, walls exist between districts of different religious and ethnic groups from Belfast via Ustí/Labem to Jerusalem. For the isolation of Palestinians in the occupied areas, a modernized variant of the "Iron Curtain" is being completed by Israel. New borders are emerging through new state foundations from Estonia to Moldova. Zones, lines, marks and walls have not disappeared from the map.
content.title_en: World borders : zones, lines, walls in historical comparison

content.text: From Absinth to Zabaione: how food and drinks came to her name and other curious stories. "Nothing is known," says the authors, who try to explain the origin of the names of food such as tapas or pumpernickel, bismarckhering or sour cucumber. Of course, this is not always valid, but it is grateful to note that, for example, it is finally correctly explained that the Kaiserschmarrn of Kaser, the cheesemaker on the mountain pasture, originates. Nevertheless, many things are told by Franz Joseph and his Sissi. And so the whole style of the book, almost exuberant, but clever and entertaining, is told anecdotes. Thus, rather curious stories, as the subtitle promises, than a rebuttal work; not to be confused with "From Aal to Zabaione" from the dtv publishing house, a somewhat unfortunate namelikeness. Besides Ch. Gutknecht: "Pustekuchen" (in this BA02).
content.title_en: From Absinth to Zabaione : how food and drinks came to her name and other curious stories

Basic knowledge has been published and closes the gap between the specialist for electrical engineering at vocational schools and the mathematical-physical basics of electrical engineering in university literature. Publisher's text: This proven book on electrical engineering is so far under the title: Electrical engineering for technical schools. Basic knowledge has been published and closes the gap between the specialist for electrical engineering at vocational schools and the mathematical-physical basics of electrical engineering in university literature.
content.title_en: Electrical engineering : Basics

content.text: The impact of the enlargement of the EU east on the economy and the labour market in Saxony: expert opinion on behalf of the Saxon State Ministry of Economic Affairs and Labour. Saxony is particularly affected by the enlargement of the EU east. It is the only German federal state bordering two candidate countries. Poland and the Czech Republic, with about 570 km of border to the candidate countries, has the longest border. The Saxon State Ministry of Economic Affairs and Labour has therefore commissioned an analysis of the impact of the enlargement of the EU east on the economy and the labour market in Saxony. The empirical study should identify the strengths and weaknesses of the location Saxony, analyse the competitiveness of the Saxon economy in relation to the candidate countries and derive response strategies of Saxon economic policy and the Saxon companies. As a result, the study underlines the urgency of the reform needs in the German social state and in the regulations of the German labour market. More flexibilisation in working hours and in wage structures is also a prerequisite for strengthening the profitability of Saxon companies and the expansion of their funding areas. Without improving the financing possibilities, the companies will not have the opportunity to face the expansion of the challenge of the EU.
content.title_en: Impact of EU enlargement on the economy and labour market in Saxony : Expert report on behalf of the Saxon State Ministry of Economic Affairs and Labour

content.text: Europe: social rather than neoliberal. The small volume, whose authors Attac are connected, begins with a critical review of the political-economic development of Europe, examines the economic and social conditions and the consequences of the EU enlargement for Eastern Europe. In relations with the USA they see potential conflicts as a result of currency competition, disputes on questions of military competence or in the approach of new alliances (China, Russia). Their proposals are directed against a Europe of two speeds, demand institutional ("democracy deficit") changes and favor a domestically oriented strategy. - To the critical addition possible. (3) (Herbert Lindenlaub)
content.title_en: Europe: prefer social rather than neoliberal

content.text: Dot.City: relational urbanism and new media. We have long used mobile phones, ATMs or the Internet as something common in our everyday urban life. Basically, life does not seem to have become different. Or have we become immeasurably accustomed to the existence of the invisible? How can new digital possibilities be used creatively for the designer? The IV. International Bauhaus Center for Advanced Study in the Humanities "Dot.City" has shown strategies for the use of digital media that integrate the unpredictable and unplanned into the city. The book shows the medialization of urban life as a global phenomenon and describes the consequences that result from it for the design of the city's living space.
content.title_en: Dot.City : relational urbanism and new media

For comparison only the 1st edition of 1987 was available. Compared to this continuously revised and improved by an attractive design from the outside. The older editions should be replaced. Important reference work to "Die große GU-Nührwert-Kalorien-Tall" (last BA 11/03). (2 A)
content.title_en: The small Souci-specialist-Kraut : Food table for practice

content.text: Emissions trading: economic principles, legal regulations and technical solutions for climate protection. From 2005 emissions trading will be used as a climate protection instrument throughout Europe. Trade with limited allowances for CO2 emissions will implement the global political idea of counteracting climate change with market-based methods. The reduction of greenhouse gas emissions by technical measures will therefore take place where this is economically most advantageous. However, the introduction of emissions trading is characterised by a large number of complex, inter-linked economic, legal and technical issues discussed in this book by experts. These include the actual extent of climate change, conflicts of interest in the legislation and allocation of emission rights, consequences for strategic decisions of affected companies, CO2 reduction technologies and the vision of an emission-free energy economy. content.title_en: Emissions trading : economic principles, legal regulations and technical solutions for climate protection

content.text: The World of Consumption. Every year, the Worldwatch Institute in Washington, DC published an environmental inventory in collaboration with the Heinrich Böll Foundation and Germanwatch (see last issue of 2003: BA 7/03). This year's focus is on consumption with its diverse facets: among others consumption (criticism), computer, paper, water productivity, consciously eating, flying, large buyers and the attempt to redefinition what constitutes "good life". Furthermore, it is indispensable for public libraries because of the current data and the current environmental processes and debates. (1, A, S) (LK/F: Lüdtke) Every year, the environmental inventory published by the renowned Worldwatch Institute in Washington, D.C., in cooperation with the Heinrich Böll Foundation and Germanwatch. (LK/F: Lüdtke)
content.title_en: The world of consumption

content.text: Life in addition to the welfare society: Families in precarious situations. The book deals with families on the edge of poverty. What are their living conditions, how did they get into this situation and how can another slip-off be prevented? Despite the extensive reporting on poverty in Germany, there is hardly any information about poverty-related living conditions, i.e. about risk situations between poverty and relative prosperity. The study "Families in precarious situations" of the German Youth Institute, funded by the Federal Ministry of Family Affairs, now sheds some light on this grey area of the research landscape. The results show two poverty-related, precarious living conditions, clearly distinguished from the social aid recipients and also clearly distinguishable among themselves. The living conditions of these two different population groups, their human skills and their social integration are described as well as their individual strategies and their assessment of their own situation.
content.title_en: Life beside the prosperity society : families in precarious situations

content.text: Chemical Reactors : Design and Simulation. Publisher's info: The chemical reactor is the centre of every chemical process in which chemical implementations are carried out under the best possible technical conditions. Our book deals with the basics of chemical reaction technology and explains all the necessary equations of design based on the material and heat balance, taking into account the stoichiometry and kinetics of reactions. Each chapter contains completely calculated examples and exercises for which solutions are given and the solution path is commented. More complex tasks are solved using numerical methods with the computer. content.text: Precarious balances: flexible working hours between company regulation and individual requirements. The current working time discussion is dominated by those actors in business and politics who, in order to reduce costs, demand an extension of working hours and greater market-oriented flexibility. The voices who argue for a further reduction in working time and an increase in the time sovereignty of employees are currently of little importance. At the same time, issues of reconciling work and life have gained importance not only as a problem of working mothers but as an object of corporate personnel policy as a whole. Therefore, such forms of flexibility are at the centre of the discussion, which allow for the balancing of different time interests, such as the establishment of time accounts, which allow flexible multi-work, on the one hand, and the use of saved time for personal needs without extending working time in general. This study provides insights into the organisation of working time of companies in different sectors and into the time-trading of employees between company requirements and private interests. It examines, in particular, the conditions that both company sides would need to develop for a successful balance of work and life.
content.title_en: Precarious balances : flexible working hours between company regulation and individual requirements

content.text: Macroeconomic impact of the EU eastward enlargement. This paper presents empirical work on the macroeconomic impact of the EU eastward enlargement following a theoretical overview of the integration of economic areas. Due to the four constituent fundamental freedoms of the European Union, the accession countries will see changes in the commodity and factor markets, which have an asymmetric impact on the individual economies. While the Central and Eastern European countries achieve high welfare gains, the positive effects for the current EU member countries are low.

content.text: Perspective 2050: Economics of demographic change. Germany faces far-reaching demographic challenges more than other advanced industrial states. The age pyramid is shaken from two sides: by low birth rates and rising life expectancy. In 2050, there will be as many people in Germany aged over 80 years as people under 20 years old, and the population will decline from 83 to about 72 million. The fact that this phenomenon will cause problems for an ageing and then shrinking population has shown that the welfare systems financed by the Umlage (social security) system, especially the statutory pension and health insurance system. However, the macroeconomic structural change that is triggered by demographic trends has not been studied and needs more attention. In addition to an inventory of the demographic situation in 13 analysis chapters, the present book shows the effects of an ageing and shrinking population on the individual policy areas, which can be expected to be seen today. The economic policy conclusions derived from this are summarized in a final reform agenda. The Institute of the German Economic Policy Strategy and Cologne's policy agenda is intended to provide a comprehensive overview of the economic policy challenges and the relevance of the current economic situation.
content.title_en: 2050 perspective : economics of demographic change

content.text: Maria Teresa Parpagliolo Shephard (1903 - 1974) was a prominent contributor to the development of garden culture in Italy in the 20th century. Maria Teresa Parpagliolo Shephard (Parpagliolo) is one of the few women of her generation in Europe and America who have been active in the highly male-dominated field of garden and landscape architecture. Through a critical examination of Parpagliolo's works and their production conditions, her creative process is examined and her importance for the development of garden culture is assessed on the theoretical, practical and institutional level in Italy. The contextualization of her works also contributes to the understanding of the present and present situation in Italian landscape architecture. Parpagliolo's curriculum and her career as garden and landscape architect are reconstructed. As a result, the work shows that Parpagliolo can be considered a pioneer in several ways: as a woman in the profession and as a garden and landscape architect in Italy. Her importance for the development of garden culture in Italy lies less in the quality of her individual works than in her impulses for the emergence of a more conscious mind for garden architecture, in the context of garden architecture and in the wider garden architecture.
content.title_en: Maria Teresa Parpagliolo Shephard (1903 - 1974) : a contribution to the development of garden culture in Italy in the 20th century

content.text: The experimenter: Microarrays. Microarrays is a collective name for modern molecular biological investigation systems that allow parallel analysis of several thousand samples in a small amount of biological sample material. DNA microarrays are increasingly used in genome analysis, diagnostics and in investigations in differential gene expression. The development of protein microarrays promises an even faster on-site analysis of samples, as they do not require the often necessary amplification of genetic material and subsequent hybridization and allow direct protein detection. This book is dedicated to the topic of microarray with understandable explanations and a clear presentation of the instruments and biochips available at the moment. The different requirements for DNA and protein chips are listed in individual chapters. The reader receives detailed information to establish or expand his own microarray laboratory if necessary. Furthermore, the current patent situation is discussed and a comprehensive list of literature and companies is attached.
content.title_en: The experimenter: Microarrays

content.text: Information criminal law and legal information technology. It is a cross-sectional matter, which includes to a considerable extent also criminal law problems in addition to civil and public law issues. This volume is dedicated to information criminal law. Problems with fundamental relevance as well as questions of "hacking" or "file sharing" and "outsourcing" of data are dealt with. The collection volume is supplemented by contributions from legal information technology to "e-learning" and to typical problems in the operation of a faculty network.

content.text: The former terrorist expert of the Clinton and Bush administration reports on developments from the Gulf War to the Iraq War and on the failures and possibilities in the anti-terrorist struggle to break down the terrorist network that has now been able to re-organize. (Barbara Riedl) The author was a security expert for 30 years under four presidents and, lastly, a senior terrorist expert before he resigned from his office in 2003. For years, he had been in vain warning of the dangers of al-Qaeda, and indeed traces of fundamentalist-Islamic movements can be traced back over 20 years. Even after 9/11, Iraq was always in the foreground for the Bush administration. However, the war only strengthened his back with the al-Qaeda register, especially since the friendly Sauds regarding al-Qaeda had to be more closely monitored as long as they were not themselves threatened (see C. Unger, BA 8/04). Clarke has been very concerned with some of the financial problems in the U.S. Radio's security system. In addition, Johnson has to be remedied by the fact, in this case, the U.
content.title_en: Against all enemies : the insider report on America's war on terror

content.text: 213 hacks for Google, Amazon and eBay: [use the new APIs; with .Net, PHP, Flash, JavaScript, AppleScript, XML; for users, programmers and sales professionals; partner programs 3 in 1 effectively]. The title deals with the three major e-commerce sites: the best search engine on the web, the largest auction house and the most successful book dealer. This book offers 212 hacks, tricks and programs that allow you to access the data or base applications of the popular sites. Whether from business interests or simply to spice up your own site - here you will find the appropriate code nippets to use the big three for yourself.
content.title_en: 213 Hacks for Google, Amazon and eBay: [use the new APIs; use it effectively with .Net, PHP, Flash, JavaScript, AppleScript, XML; for users, programmers and sales professionals; use partner programs 3 in 1]

content.text: The important American social scientist (see "The End of History", BA 7/92; "The Great Awakening", BA 1/01) is looking into the question of why weak or failed states could become the heart of international conflicts and the basis for terrorists after the end of the Cold War. Based on broad socio-scientific and economic findings, the author shows that the weakness is due to the lack or non-functioning of institutions at the level of the nation states. The role of institutions in the development of statehood is to be regarded as central. The task of politics, especially of the American and European, in the coming decades must therefore be to build statehood in underdeveloped and thus crisis-prone regions. The differing views of the USA and Europe in relation to the legitimacy of international decisions are to be overcome. The book offers new standards for practice and theory of international politics. It should gain strong attention. (2) (Klaus Kohlfeld)
content.title_en: Building States: the New Challenge of International Politics

content.text: Practical book compassion : social learning in schools; internship and teaching in secondary schools I and II. The practical book Compassion is a compendium of social learning in schools. The aim of the project is to develop socially committed attitudes such as solidarity, communication and cooperation with people who, for whatever reasons, are dependent on the help of others. To this end, the pupils go to a social institution for two weeks during the school year, while they are visited by their teachers both at the place of the internship and are informed and reflectively accompanied in the field of technical instruction. This close connection of social real experience and teaching, experience and reflection is decisive for the pedagogically new to the Compassion project and for its sustainable effect. The present book answers in detail to a side council, which is always called the main obstacle to the introduction and anchoring of social projects at schools: the question of concrete implementation. It shows copyable plans and aids for the organization of the project and documents selected teaching series for the different subjects at all the upper secondary schools I and II.
content.title_en: Practical book compassion : social learning in schools; practical training and teaching in secondary schools I and II

The book describes wireless networking of PC, Internet connections and printers, because Wireless LAN (wireless networks) is becoming more and more interesting for home use. This quick-initiation on 150 highly illustrated pages leads in fact quickly and easily through the installation, setup and configuration. Likewise, the security and also the troubleshooting is briefly dealt with. The book is clearly written about the content, language style and structure and well understandable. However, other books have already described this fact (Christian Peter: BA 11/03 or Thomas Köhre: BA 6/03). There the reader sometimes finds something more content.
