content.text: The dance around the golden calf: the ecological colonialism of Europe. Currently, 15.7 million cattle, 23.7 million pigs, 2.5 million sheep and 600,000 horses are kept in Germany alone. This means that on every square kilometre of the agricultural area on average 250 ungulates live - that is about two and a half times as much as in the Serengeti, the richest region of the earth in wildlife. This means, the evolutionary biologist Josef Reichholf (see last BA 3/03) claims that the livestock populations in Germany, Europe and America are considerably higher than the soils can feed and cope ecologically. The consequences: Agriculture consumes enormous amounts of energy, plant protection and mineral and organic fertilizers. The extreme fertilization promotes a few animal and plant species and replaces all others. And to meet the need for feed, the tropical rain forests are cut down - with devastating effects on the animal and plant world and on the global climate. - Reichhol's heretical theses are empirically well documented. An ecological classic, which should be found in every library. (2)
content.title_en: The Dance for the Golden Calf : the Ecocolonialism of Europe

content.text: Service Robotic Visions. The very well-made non-fiction book addresses all those who have a certain interest in the current developments in service robotics. Here, the most diverse fields of application of robotics are presented: household (cleaning equipment, safety tasks), maintenance technology (telemanipulated inspection systems), research (underwater or space robotics), health care (neurosurgery) etc. In addition to the fields of application and the concrete developments, the authors also repeatedly focus on general problems of robotics such as system reliability, standards and artificial intelligence. - A reading book for many readers who want to get a dignified overview of robotics technology. Here, they get factual information that is entertaining enough even without science fiction inserts.
content.title_en: Service Robot Visions

metadata.authors: Wegener, Kai; Schraft, Rolf Dieter; Hägele, Martin

content.text: Gender training has been a long way off in Germany since gender mainstreaming as a gender policy strategy has become a thriving market, and gender training has become a (self-)critical discussion. The foundation of the Gender Training Network has been a sign of a long-standing exchange of demands on the heterogenic gender training field and a further development in dialogue. The volume documents these discussions and helps to further formulate quality. Guest authors have been asked to contribute: authors from the South who have been involved in the debate as gender trainers for a long time, and authors from the spectrum of critical male research broaden the perspective of how and in what ways the socially-driven gender relations can be changed through training. The Gender Training Network is a nationwide association of gender trainers, which has existed since 1997. Its roots lie in the international women's movements and feminist research. The trainers organized in the network regularly exchange information on the content and methods of gender training and current developments in women's and gender research. The network's employees offer gender training for a wide range of institutions and trainers in male groups.
content.title_en: Moving gender relations : experience with gender training

content.text: Who spoke the first word? : the origin of language and writing. The origin of language and writing is one of the most exciting questions in cultural history. Current research results draw a partly completely new picture of the development of human communication
content.title_en: Who spoke the first word? : the origin of language and writing

content.text: E-Learning: Ensure quality and user acceptance: Contributions to planning, implementation and evaluation of multimedia and network-based applications. Contributions to planning, implementation and evaluation of multimedia and network-based applications The present volume combines previous experiences on the use of e-learning, which were collected by the authors in selected projects. They focus on two questions: First: How is e-learning understood and replaced in companies as a task of organisational development? - The tension between learning and work within an organisation and instruments of a deliberate approach between both types of activities are presented here. Second: How can the quality of e-learning and, therefore, its user acceptance be ensured? - Content suitable to address, its media didactic preparation, the personal support of the learners, the maintenance of the technical infrastructure and content, the qualification of the involved educational staff and the embedding in the company/learning culture are only some of the criteria that the authors believe must be fulfilled for the successful use of new media in vocational education and training.
content.title_en: E-Learning: ensuring quality and user acceptance: contributions to planning, implementation and evaluation of multimedia and network-based applications

content.text: The urban series house of the city is divided into the following categories: The urban series house of the city history and the history of the city history. The large-format, beautifully designed volume presents the result of a research project of the Desert Red Foundation and systematically shows the development history of the urban series house of the city history from antiquity to the present. The first part deals with a critical examination of central concepts of urban living and various urban strategies. The second part offers a historical panorama of the European series house of the city history from antiquity to the early bourgeois and classicist city to the modern metropolis - with beautiful architectural drawings of the facades, as well as detailed floor plans. The third part discusses the history of the urban series house of the Roman Empire to the modern city history. Finally, theses for today's dealings with urban series houses and a new culture of living in the city. For equipment, presentation and content, a very inexpensive title is given. For students, architects and city planners, but also for interest in urban series history of the city history of the city history of the city history of the city history begins.
content.title_en: The Townhouse : History and Typology

content.text: Public commemoration: German cultures of remembrance since the Weimar Republic. The NDR commented on the German reactions to the attacks of September 11, 2001. Public commemoration is always aimed at the creation of an imaginary community in the form of a "we". At the same time, the practices of commemoration - the laying down of wreaths, minutes of silence, reading names of the dead, the taking away of earth from places of mass death - are an expression of religious and national traditions, whether they are commemorations of warrior monuments or places of former concentration camps, in the GDR, the FRG or in reunited Germany. Insa Eschebach examines public commemoration practices in the 20th century and interprets them as forms of sacralization such as the trivialization of violent death.
content.title_en: Public commemoration : German cultures of remembrance since the Weimar Republic

content.text: At a time of hell: the crisis of Israeli society. Warshavsky describes the rapid pace of repression and violence of the occupation of Israel: the destruction of democratic fundamental rights, the questioning of all democratic norms in everyday life, the perverse habit of violence and death. He denounces the verbal threat of media and politicians, the influence of the state of war on school, university and culture. Warshavsky diagnoses the decline of the rule of law and of society, which is associated with "preventing self-defense". Unproportional violence in the army and civil life results in the rapid drifting of the political class to the right. Why is the euphoria of the Oslo treaties so quickly vanished? How did the Palestinian fellow citizens become internal enemies? Will Israel become a fundamentalist state that is bulging against the wall of hatred and, in the alliance with the US, to the "extermination of terrorism" to a catastrophe? After its autobiography 'On the border', current texts of this controversial Israeli author are now available.
content.title_en: At a Time of Hell: the Crisis of Israeli Society

content.text: Software Ergonomy : Recommendations for programming and selecting software. Contains: DIN 66272:1994 ; DIN EN 29241-2:1993 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-1:2002 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-10:1996 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-11:1999 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-12:2000 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-13:2000 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-14:2000 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-15:1999 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-16:2000 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-17:2000 ; DIN EN ISO 9241-8:1998 ; DIN EN ISO 13407:2000 ; DIN EN ISO 14915-1:2003 ; DIN EN ISO 14915-2:2003 ; DIN EN ISO 14915-3:2003 ; DIN ISO IEC 12119:1995 ; ISO IEC 18035:2003 ; ISO IEC 18036:2003 ; ISO TC 16071:2003 ; ISO TR 16982:2002
content.title_en: Software Ergonomy : Recommendations for programming and selecting software

content.text: It is different! : Alternatives to social dismantling. A large coalition of capital representatives and party politicians is about to overthrow the social order of the Federal Republic with distributed roles. The red-green federal government gives the door opener - CDU/CSU and FDP only need to complete the started. The authors take apart the legends, which are to legitimize the social dismantling. They inform about backgrounds, methods and consequences of this democratically unlegitimized system change in the care of old age, the health insurance funds, in the employment (lose) administration, in the wage policy, in the public goods and services. They show that with all this not natural laws prevail - it is different! They present social and labour market policy alternatives and their conditions in another economic and tax policy. But a change of policy cannot be expected from above; can only reach him in their perspectives convincing social movement.
content.title_en: It's different! : Alternatives to Social Disassembly

content.text: The visual has always accompanied the war and conflict events. Images are often attributed an instrumental role. They are assumed to have stoked, supported and extended war in the form of visual war propaganda. At the same time, however, image communication is not to be forgotten from pacifism. This book deals with visual war coverage before, during and after wars, with the emphasis on the present - especially the Iraq war - and it provides answers to numerous questions: Which reporting patterns and routines are evident? What proof power do images possess? How has the function of images changed in the confrontation with war? How are the propaganda apparatus of the warring parties structured and what significance do the image media have within the bellicistic strategies? Can there be a communication and media ethics in the context of wars? What dangers and fascinations arise from the images of horror? Overall, the volume provides a broad overview of functions, structures and effects of image communication in crises, conflicts and especially contexts of war?
content.title_en: War visions : Image communication and war

content.text: The disappearance of the industrial age buildings: life cycles of industrial building stocks and methods of transdisciplinary research. In this research study on the life cycles of industrial building stocks, instruments are developed that allow to analyse, describe and perhaps predict long-term developments. In the investigations, not only the actual industrial buildings were included, but - as far as possible - the entire construction and infrastructure stock of the industrial age. Because only this comprehensive perspective could be gained an idea of how the observed acceleration phenomena can affect, also an idea of the dangers that these processes trigger
content.title_en: The disappearance of industrial age buildings : life cycles of industrial buildings and methods of transdisciplinary research

content.text: Work disorders: causes, self-help, rehabilitation training. Who doesn't know? A mountain of work is on the desk, but you can't get rid of it. Lack of the necessary skills? Are the tasks not clearly formulated? Prevent diseases at work? Are there worries or social problems at work? Or is it simply too much? This book helps help. Work occupies a wide space in our lives. Many mental and physical diseases as well as life crises are accompanied by serious disorders in work life, are even often directly linked to them. The book provides a differentiated analysis of the causes of work disorders in adults - it offers on the basis of cognitive behavioral therapy: 1. a description of the forms, causes and special problems of work disorders, 2. the modules of effective self-help as well as instructions on self-observation and practical exercises, 3. work material for the therapeutic practice and 4. a rehabilitation training for persons who had been retired from work life due to illness or other circumstances.
content.title_en: Work disorders : causes, self-help, rehabilitation training

content.text: Social market economy. It is not possible to expect pure basic knowledge about the market economy from the university studies politics, but this problem-oriented introduction with reference to the current socio-economic situation is suitable for performance courses. There are 5 clearly structured contributions by economists, some with further literature and comments, about development, regulatory variants, previous and still necessary reforms, about the relationship to the EU, about influences and reactions to eastward enlargement and globalization. Some authors think that the market economy needs to be reinterpreted, but extreme positions are not represented here. Disputes could be excellent about whether the term "social market economy" still has its justification for further reforms. There is hardly any new literature on the subject in our holdings; recommendation. (2) (Elke Günther) Development, variants and reforms up to the current problems in economy and society. (Elke Günther)
content.title_en: Social market economy

Publisher text: This book provides you with the basics of the creation of PCBs with Eagle, taking into account the three main modules: Layout editor, Schematic editor and Autorouter
content.title_en: PCB design with EAGLE : [from task to finished PCB; own component libraries, autorouter and ULPs ; with freeware version on CD]

content.text: Architecture, Power, Memory : Statements 1984 to 2004. The research on the history and architecture of National Socialism is a focal point in the work of the internationally renowned architectural historian Winfried Nerdinger. On his 60th birthday twelve of the most concise, partly unpublished contributions to the relationship between architecture and power in Germany, Italy and the Soviet Union are gathered. His pointed statements cover topics such as modernism in National Socialism, the international classicism of the 1930s, architecture in Stalinism and fascism, or the "memoir on a flame of austerity" in Germany.
content.title_en: Architecture, Power, Memory : Opinions 1984 to 2004

content.text: Video DVDs are created and copied with Nero 6 : [perfect 1:1 copies with Nero Recode 2 ; the PC as video recorder: create direct recording on DVD ; professional menus with NeroVision Express; Special: edit and optimize disks created with the "living room DVD recorder" in Nero]. The author Dominik Reuscher has already addressed in his title "CDs & DVDs burn with Nero 6" (BA 11/03) the numerous possibilities of how to create with Nero 6 video DVDs and CDs. With this title this area is presented in more detail and more detail, the important external program parts of Nero (such as the tool Nero Recode) are dealt with in particular detail. The layout is detailed, the explanations are competent, profound and understandable, the topics are always appropriately weighted. Concrete practice-relevant tasks (e.g. creating a DVD menu, playing old video recordings) are discussed in detail, the explanations are very well-regarded - the subject matter is highly relevantly discussed.
content.title_en: Create and copy video DVDs with Nero 6 : [perfect 1:1 copies with Nero Recode 2 ; the PC as video recorder: Direct recording on DVD ; create professional menus with NeroVision Express; Special: re-edit and optimize windows created with the "living room DVD recorder" in Nero]

content.text: Show me the future : engineering and design by Werner Sobek. Werner Sobek is an engineer. A gifted engineer, a specialist in light structures that uses materials where other concrete would be poured, the glass floats, where others would frame it in steel. He is also an architect and he has built with some of the most important architects - Helmut Jahn, Christoph Ingenhoven, Dominique Perrault, Hans Hollein, to name a few. Werner Sobek's work combines his extraordinary skills as an engineer with his talent as an architect. His vision of the designed environment is focused on the minimal use of resources, on sustainability, on the maximum use of daylight - always respecting the environment. His works are graceful and elegant; they are characterized by the highest quality of design and at the same time preserve a human dimension.
content.title_en: Show me the future : engineering and design by Werner Sobek

content.text: The postcolonial Africa: Politics - Economy - Society. In the preface of the exemplary technical book, the editors of the series ask the two crucial questions: "Africa, a marginalized continent shaken by civil wars, which is increasingly forgotten in the process of economic globalization? Or do the states of Africa have development potentials that are likely to lead to a better economic and democratic future?" The African experts at the University of Hamburg try to answer this in depth and plausibly, especially with selected country examples. The authors succeed in correcting common clichés and atattesting to independence to the continent, almost 50 years after the "dismissal" of most states, a semi-positive prognosis. The basis of this textbook, incidentally, formed a course at the distance university Hagen; target group are students and probably also students of the gymnasial upper level. Very extensive bibliography.
content.title_en: Postcolonial Africa : Politics - Economy - Society

content.text: Quantitative planning: basics, case studies, solutions. Ideal combination of practical planning and model-based theory. The successful textbook connects all sub-areas of model-based planning from decision theory, operation research, investment theory and corporate planning. Quantitative planning is thus explained as a uniform process with many different facets. PC applications for the solution of linear programs, the metaheuristics or natural anarchy procedures and the simulation are deepened.
content.title_en: Quantitative planning: basics, case studies, solutions

content.text: The ancient Troy: virtual tour through the most important epochs of the settlement history. The introduction to the history of Tonia and possible preparation for a visit to the excavations on site was presented here last B. Brandau "Troia" (BA 8/04; there false area indication on page 26). The reconstructions used there were from the same project, which is also used for this DVD-ROM and allows various virtual tours through the Troia II, VI and VIII as well as the modern excavation site. The guided tours as well as the in-depth, thematically accessible reading texts are also concentrated on the selected periods of the city's history. The multimedia possibilities go far beyond what is required in "Troia 3,000 Years of History in the Model" (BA 8/01). As an addition, the complete Ilias text is found in the translation of J. H. Voss, which is equipped with a full text search and can also be called in pdf format. - Good multimedia introduction to history and the archaeological research stand, which focuses on essential periods. For the broad circle of the Tonia-interested and for students (1.
content.title_en: Ancient Troy : virtual tour of the most important epochs of the settlement history

content.text: Strategy maps: the path from intangible values to material success. The trend continues. Strategy maps can be used even more effectively to implement the Balanced Scorecard system. How does it work? Strategy maps develop cause-effect chains. They reveal which strategic decisions lead to what measurable results. Strategy maps are based on a simple philosophy: you can only implement what you can measure. You can only measure what you can describe. In practice, Strategy maps help to communicate in a comprehensible way. Strategy maps draw up the schedule according to which the targets are to be implemented. They provide ideal support because intangible assets such as human, information and organizational capital have to be integrated into the strategy. The concept of success authors Kaplan and Norton is a milestone for strategic corporate governance.
content.title_en: Strategy maps : the path from intangible values to material success

content.text: Challenges and opportunities through global accounting standards: capital market-oriented accounting and integrated corporate governance. Changed accounting. How can companies adapt to IFRSs optimally? What accounting challenges must be mastered in terms of occupational retirement or corporate governance? The conference volume reflects the current discussion
content.title_en: Challenges and opportunities through global accounting standards: capital market-oriented accounting and integrated corporate governance

content.text: The basics of robotics: Tips and tricks for self-building. Vehicles that move independently or as if controlled by ghosts' hands are unusually fascinating to many viewers. Often this involves the desire to construct such vehicles themselves and thus build their own robots. Self-building of any robot vehicle is not so easy. Without minimum knowledge in this field, failures are programmed. Frustration, usually combined with unnecessary costs, are the consequence and often lead to the quick end of the new hobby. The book promotes understanding of mechanical and electronic basics. It presents simple and functional systems that stimulate your own imagination and inspire further creative experiments through a fast-growing success experience. The book describes in addition to complete construction proposals also a whole set of modular components for drive, transportation, sensor technology and power supply. The described modules can then be combined completely freely in own models and thus guarantee a maximum of design possibilities.
content.title_en: Basics of robotics : Tips and tricks for self-building

content.text: Latin America and Europe: on the way to a common educational and cultural space?. This book reflects the results of the first efforts to create a common educational space of the European Union with Latin America. The editors have decided to ask for contributions from an internationally recognized collegue, which, in addition to the technical and administrative aspects, also reflect personal perspectives and experiences. In this way, the volume offers far more than a technical interim review of negotiations. Rather, it intervenes in the communicative area of intercultural relations and sheds light on the importance of individual and collective interests and feelings, which can hardly be overestimated in the context of integration processes, especially in the cultural-academic area. As the focus is on education, experiences and perspectives of Latin American students in Europe and European students in Latin America are presented. Their contributions are mixed with the views of distinguished scientists such as Michiel Baud, Hans-Albert Steger, Martina Kaller from Europe, Gustavo Esteva, Jorge Brovetto or Franklin Trein from Latin America.
content.title_en: Latin America and Europe: towards a common education and culture area?

content.text: The Bilderatlas im Wechsel der Künste und Medien. What is an image? This question has been at the centre of controversial debates at the intersections of disciplines such as art science, media aesthetics and film theory for some time now, but has now expanded to the study of the iconicity of scenic modes of representation, the visuality of writing and, last but not least, imaging methods in science and technology. The pictorial turn inevitably leads to the question of the systematisticity of image-based cultural knowledge, of forms of its arrangement and archiving in a time of alphanumerically supported recording systems and databases. The Bilderatlas Mnemosyne von Aby Warburg, created in the first third of the 20th century, is the starting point for the authors of this volume, who come from different disciplines of knowledge and yet together on the way to analysis possibilities our often visualized culture.
content.title_en: The Art Atlas in the Change of Arts and Media

content.text: Service-oriented architectures with Web Services : Concepts - Standards - Practice. The book is written for all those who want to critically question the web services technology. The authors convey the foundation on which Web Services are built. This provides decision-makers and users with the knowledge to participate in the design of their company's IT landscape regardless of fashion trends and manufacturer specifications. The authors first present the overarching concept of a service-oriented architecture (SOA) and then discuss the most popular implementation at the moment, the web services. After the introduction of the three cornerstones (SOAP, WSDL and UDDI) of a web service-based SOA scenario, security aspects (WS-Security) are discussed and solution strategies are presented. Further, the process of merging (orchestriating) Web Services into complex super services with the help of BPEL is rounded off by the scenario of the outlook of Apache.
content.title_en: Service-oriented architectures with web services : Concepts - Standards - Practice

content.text: Minerals and rocks : properties, formation, investigation. The book is an understandable introduction to the basics of mineralogy and petrology. It presents the most important minerals and rocks and enables their determination. It introduces in mineralogical concepts as well as in the processes of rock formation and alteration and presents the most important optical and analytical methods in an overview
content.title_en: Minerals and rocks : properties, formation, investigation

content.text: Databases: Basics and XML Technologies. This book deals with relational databases as tools for reliable and user-friendly processing of a structured set of permanent data. The two main areas are the query language SQL (Structured Query Language) and - in terms of applications on the Internet - XML (Extensible Markup Language) as the basis for electronic data exchange. The focus is on first semesters of computer science. The book goes beyond the introduction of P. Monadjemi (BA 5/05). It differs in the objective of H.-E. Erbs (BA 2/04), where relational databases are also treated object-oriented and object-related databases, but applications on the Internet are somewhat short. The SQL standard is discussed in detail, in particular the concepts newly developed in SQL: 1999 and SQL: 2003 are explained in detail. XML presents XPath, XML Schema and XQuery.
content.title_en: Databases : Basics and XML Technologies

content.text: The open-minded city: public space in China from Anting to Zhuhai. All contributions are published in German and Chinese. With contributions by Yongjie Cai (Shanghai), Chong Liu (Qingdao), Dieter Hassenpflug (Weimar), Zhiqiang Wu (Shanghai), Zhang Guanzeng (Shanghai), Zhang Lingling (Harbin)
content.title_en: The open-minded city : public space in China from Anting to Zhuhai

content.text: Rock determination in the terrain. With simple methods and few tools, it is possible to determine rock in the terrain. Most important are probably accurate observations and a magnifying glass. But of course, one must also know the stone-forming minerals and understand the petrographic laws and classifications of rocks. This book explains the most important working methods for successful petrographic field work and indicates what tools and tools are needed. It presents the most important stone-forming minerals and explains the characteristics that can actually be observed in the rock. All important rocks are described in a concise and uniform manner. It is made clear what they actually are recognized for. The author points to unconventional approaches from practice that can help in determining them. He indicates which rocks cannot be distinguished without a microscope and shows how to take the most meaningful samples for the laboratory examination without destroying the often sensitive conclusions. However, the rock analysis is not limited to the determination and designation of the rocks. It also covers the conditions of their formation and the geological history of the site.
content.title_en: Rock determination in terrain

content.text: Ancient architecture and architectural ornamentation: basic forms and basic concepts. The volume provides a systematic overview of the most important ancient (Greek-Roman) architectural ornaments and layouts, as well as their guiding forms and variants in temporal development. The descriptions and excerpts from ancient texts in translation are compared with images, which were made according to original templates for the volume. An index of all technical terms in six languages (gr./lat., german, engl., french, ital.) enables the user of the compendium to quickly orientate themselves.
content.title_en: Ancient architecture and architectural ornamentation : basic forms and basic concepts

content.text: Landscape forms: our Earth in transformation - the shaping forces on the trail. First, the geological foundations are explained. Afterwards, the formation and transformation of landscape forms and the interaction of forces acting from the inside (crust movement, magmatism, earthquakes) and outside (water, wind, meteorites, man) are presented. Excellently illustrated. (Ingrid Rall-Haiß) The geoscientist and media professional H. Frater has skillfully brought the content of the interactive CD-ROM of the same name (BA 7/01) into book form. The entire content has been revised, expanded, updated and restructured. The first chapters of this popular science book deal with the foundations (e.g., construction of the earth, plate tectonics, cycle of rocks, climate zones). In the further chapters, the emergence and transformation of the diverse landscape forms and the interaction of forces from the earth's interior (crust movement, magmatism, earthquakes) and the forces of water, ice, wind, meteorites and, the interventions of the human being presented in the landscape are presented. Using examples from all over the world, the various maps are also presented in a comprehensible manner.
content.title_en: Landscape forms: our Earth in the course of change - the shaping forces on the trail

content.text: Algorithmic graph theory. Each system consisting of discrete states or objects between them can be modeled as graph. Many applications require efficient algorithms for processing such groups. This textbook is an introduction to algorithmic graph theory. Its focus is on algorithms as a practical application of graph theory. The algorithms are presented in a compact form in a programming language-related notation that makes it easy to transfer into a specific programming language such as C or Pascal. Most of the 75 algorithms treated have been implemented and tested in the presented form in the course of lectures. Their practical relevance is demonstrated in many applications from areas such as compiler construction, artificial intelligence, operating systems, computer networks, Worls Wide Web and Operations Research. Nine chapters cover the most important sub-areas of algorithmic graph theory. The book contains around 250 exercise tasks in various degrees of difficulty, from basic studies to higher semesters. The detailed solutions to this are contained in an annex.
content.title_en: Algorithmic Graph Theory

content.text: Stochastik : Introduction to probability theory and statistics. Review: The first edition of this textbook was published in 2002 and was very well received by the market. The text provides an introduction to probability theory and statistics for students of mathematics (diploma or teaching post) from the 3rd semester onwards as well as for natural scientists who want to understand stochastik from its mathematical side. The two sub-areas probability theory and statistics are placed in two separate parts on an equal footing. In contrast to many other introductory textbooks, there is no separation into discrete and general models, but rather a moderate generality is sought from the beginning. Concepts from the theory of measure are not completely excluded, but are introduced and motivated as far as necessary. The book holds the middle between the rather elementary Stochastik textbooks and the further texts on probability theory and mathematical statistics. It leads in many points further than the elementary literature, but still preserves the introductory character and therefore dispenses with in-depth methods which would require the full treatment of the measurement theory. The theoretical results are motivated by the use of the multiplicity of the booklock and the study of the subject.
content.title_en: Stochastics : Introduction to probability theory and statistics

content.text: The lifeboats of the DGzRS from 1865 - 2004. The development can be impressively illustrated with figures: Ten years after its foundation, the DGzRS already maintained 91 stations on the North and Baltic Sea coasts and had rescued 870 people from distress. In 1890 it operated 111 rescue stations and had more than 1,000 volunteer rescue men. 48.979 supporting members also support the rescue work, 1942 with 173,000 sponsors the highest level was reached.

content.text: The State on the wire : Electronic Government and the future of public administration - an introduction. What can and should the State do in the future? This question can only be answered appropriately today if one takes into account the potential that information and communication technology has: for a different way of working and communicating, for a qualitatively better and more efficient production of public services, for better plans and decisions, for a renewed democracy. The aim of this volume is to show the opportunities of information technology in view of the upcoming transformation of the State. It therefore sets itself apart from a close understanding of e-government, which is oriented on the Internet and the still common forms of "online" communication. In a systematic overview, the author examines both the potential of information technology and the way in which administrative work is done. In this introduction, he links the changes in state modernisation, which have already gained momentum under the labels "New Public Management" and "Public Governance", with the design opportunities of the gradual computerization of the State and Administration.
content.title_en: The State on the Wire : Electronic Government and the Future of Public Administration - an Introduction

content.text: Sustainable mobility is one of the most problematic areas of activity. A large part of the population feels burdened by noise emissions from transport; considerable amounts of fossil fuels are consumed for transport on the ground and in the air; transport infrastructure uses enormous areas - these and many other health, environmental and social problems illustrate the difficulties. At the same time, no one can and does without mobility, economic prosperity and many jobs are directly linked to the transport sector, so the pressure for action is great. This book examines the status quo and possible development paths of the mobility and transport activity field within the framework of the Helmholtz Community's inclusive sustainability concept. On a very broad, up-to-date data basis, the authors provide a structured inventory of the many facets and aspects directly and indirectly related to mobility, an analysis of the sustainability deficits and estimates of future development under various political-social, economic and technical conditions.
content.title_en: Sustainable mobility integrative

content.text: Hamburg U-Bahn & S-Bahn Album : all the Hansestadt's fast train stations in color. The Berlin-based author Robert Schwandl presents the two fast train networks in this 144-page book. In a work illustrated with over 400 colour photographs, he particularly addresses the history of the development and the peculiarities of the individual lines and stations. At the same time, one also finds a short description of the vehicles currently in use. In the annex there is a detailed network plan, which makes the texts (German/English) easier to understand for people who do not know these cities. The Hamburg Hochbahn was opened already in 1912 and thus belongs to the oldest underground trains in Europe. It has been expanded over the decades and today has a length of 100 km. The various historical periods are reflected in the design of the stations. Not least through the high-rail line at the port the underground station is also one of the tourist attractions of the Hansestadt. In addition to the underground, the Hamburg S-Bahn has also proven itself to be an efficient inner-city transport system.

content.text: The state and death. Death marks a limit, the other side of which we do not know. Therefore, it is an original religious question. The state, however, claims the right to decide on life and death. With the abolition of the death penalty (Art. 102 GG), the Federal Republic has not waived this claim, but has suspended its assertion. This work investigates the question whether the claim is justified. Basically, death is something normal for the state. All people die. As an organization of politics, however, the state can consolidate the danger of death without regard to the state of the body so that the individual can no longer avoid it. Religiously, this authority is no longer to be justified since the decoupling of religion and politics. The use of life in police, fire and paramedical services is justified by the special tasks. Moreover, a sacrificial death is recognized when it serves the protection of his own offspring, family or house. However, a right of the state to dispose of life and death results from his task of issuing universally binding norms. For the fulfilment of this task, the state needs power. Physically force must be subjected to violence.
content.title_en: State and death

content.text: Diversity is a concept of public law. The author examines the question of whether there is a legal concept of diversity in public law as a counterweight to the established, often schematicised concept of public law equality, perhaps even as its barrier. From diverse manifestations of diversity in various areas of law - such as opinion and media diversity, party diversity, cultural and economic diversity, federal diversity in the state, regionalism as a "developmental diversity" - she develops basic orientations for a general concept of diversity: diversity can become a legal requirement for state bodies, diversity may lead to the diversity of organisations or institutions leading to a variety of material decisions, and finally this material-legal diversity in the field of fundamental law can develop. Thus, the author contributes to the fact that diversity becomes a legal concept of public law, but above all as a legal value. (Source: Verlag).

content.text: What is a natural law? The book is a systematically structured study of a central and controversial subject of both modern metaphysics and philosophy of science, namely the nature of natural laws. D.M. Armstrong works out a largely new point of view in detail, whereby natural laws are relations between properties and universals. This theory goes hand in hand with a realistic representation of the universals, and thus follows the natural science realism that the author has already developed in earlier publications. It begins with a detailed critique of the orthodox and skeptical view, which, based on David Hume, claims that natural laws are merely a regularity of the correspondence between property instances. Starting from this criticism, Armstrong develops a final judgment against this position. He continues with the systematic presentation of his own theory, which he defends against the most obvious objections and rounds off this and his theory of universals with an integration of functional and statistical (probably) laws. The treatment of the subject is refreshingly precise and vivid. Armstrong with this book in its appearance, a persistent debate of philosophical law in the context of its philosophical history.
content.title_en: What is a natural law?
