content.text: Management of innovation and risk : Successfully manage quantum leaps in development; with 13 tables. When planning and implementing projects, especially of very risky projects, classical project management is no longer sufficient. Risks regarding market acceptance, technology and environment have increased dramatically and require situationally adapted management. The result of the analysis cannot be even more complex planning processes, but rather the recommendation of more flexible, adaptable organizations and clear processes. "Tents instead of palaces" is the motto
content.title_en: Management of innovation and risk : successfully manage quantum leaps in development; with 13 tables

content.text: Barrier-free web design: practical guide for web design and graphical program interfaces. The book refers to the standards of BITV (Internet, Accessibility, Barrier-free web design) which were legally prescribed in 2002 and presents a wealth of illustrated design and programming examples. It provides technical basics and work tools for the practical implementation of the legal standards and is primarily aimed at web designers, developers and computer scientists, but also at designers and editors. Readers are provided with knowledge of the field of web design: Html, CSS and PC. The book is based on a variety of training events and consultations of authors, which were carried out, among other things, by partners of the Action Alliance for Accessibility Information Technology (AbI). The book serves readers as a basic or reference work as well as a practical manual. It is also provided by an accompanying CD practical help. Several of the authors are involved in the Action Alliance for Accessibility Information Technology. Based on different trainings, they offer advice on the creation and testing of Internet pages, training, information services and tools to the disabled web design.
content.title_en: Barrier-free web design : Practical manual for web design and graphical program interfaces

content.text: Object-oriented testing and testing automation in practice: Concepts, techniques and procedures. Object-oriented software with its specific sources of error has increased the challenges to software development. How can quality programs be efficiently written? The answer to this is a modern, test-driven design. But how can a minimum number of test cases be achieved that cover a maximum of the error possibilities? How can meaningful test data be found? How can already be tested automatically within the software development? The book presents in a pragmatic way classical and modern test theories and procedures. Here, solutions for technical, analytical and methodological problems as well as for testing object-oriented software are shown. Also, organizational factors and test strategies are addressed. The implementation in practice can be enhanced by means of concrete examples for JUnit, CppUnit and NUnit. Further, it is shown how the use of test samples can facilitate the testing of object-oriented software. As in connection with object orientation the UML as a modeling language is increasingly being addressed, an exemplary is presented how to the UML diagrams are used in the context of a test-based application of a test-based application.
content.title_en: Object-oriented testing and testing automation in practice : concepts, techniques and procedures

content.text: The book makes the connection between technology and mathematics visible, i.e. mathematical applications are presented in a practical manner as a computational solution of technological problems. The topics of technical mathematics required by the curricula are developed and linked to structural questions. With the help of many exercises, students can consolidate the learned and thus acquire a job-wide basic education. Publisher's text: The book makes the connection between technology and mathematics recognizable, i.e. mathematical applications are presented in a practical manner as a computational solution of technological problems. The topics of technical mathematics required by the curricula are developed and linked with constructional questions. With the help of many exercises, students can consolidate the learned and thus acquire a career-wide basic education
content.title_en: Mathematics Construction - Basic knowledge

content.text: The current reform of unemployment insurance: Benchmarking Germany. The statutory unemployment insurance is increasingly considered to be too expensive, hostile to incentives and unfair. The present study shows possible currently discussed reform paths. Among them are an experience rating that makes the employer's contribution dependent on dismissal behaviour, a wage insurance for the long-term unemployed, in order to make the admission of a lower paid job by state subsidies more attractive, and the introduction of individual insurance accounts to strengthen self-sufficiency. The core of the study is an integrated reform proposal for the redesign of unemployment insurance. Its main element is the introduction of flexible voting rates, which can better take account of individual reemployment opportunities, the possibilities for self-sufficiency and personal risk preparedness. The necessary balance between the solidarity idea and the ownership remains in mind. Such a reform would reduce the costs of the existing system by more than half
content.title_en: Reform of unemployment insurance : Benchmarking Germany up to date

content.text: Linux/Unix system programming. This title is clearly aimed at the pro. The 3rd updated edition looks behind the scenes of Linux/UNIX. New is the addition of the chapters Network and Thread Programming. This makes the classic swells up to over 1,280 pages. In thematically arranged groups the readers learn how to access system calls in UNIX. Also taken into account are all common implementations (SVR4, BSD, Linux) and standards (POSIX, XPG). Very many examples, annotated bibliography. Exercises, often with solution sketches. Good access via detailed table of contents. Libraries with well-developed computer equipment should not miss a procurement; replace the preliminary edition. (3)
content.title_en: Linux/Unix system programming

content.text: Logistics of the Future - Logistics for the future. Future Research Vision Management Development of Distribution Structures and Processes Models for World-Class Logistics European Logistics Networks Electronic Shopping
content.title_en: Logistics of the Future - Logistics for the future

content.text: Flow and transport in porous media and fractured rock : from classic methods to modern approaches. Two different ways of modeling are presented. The first way is based on classical flow and transport equations, called 'continuum models'. The second way is based on modern methods from statistical physics of disordered matter, i.e. 'discrete models'. The book is ideal for doctoral students, for chemistry, petrochemical, construction and environmental engineers, geologists, physicists and all scientists who are concerned with porous media.
content.title_en: Flow and transport in porous media and frescoed rock : from classic methods to modern approaches

content.text: Examination book for roofers : Technology, technical mathematics, technical drawing and project tasks in question. Tasks for exam preparation for apprentices in roofing trades. Covers the contents of all 3 years of training and contains a systematich structured questionnaire from building materials science, construction operations, roof types, among others, including technology, technical mathematics and (very short) technical drawing. Has been updated compared to the 1st edition 1998 (BA 11/99) (taking into account current regulations, conversion to euro, new spelling), so that an exchange is recommended (preliminary use soon). (2 S) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Examination book for roofers : technology, technical mathematics, technical drawing and project tasks in question and answer

content.text: Helicopter flight mechanics: Technology, the flight dynamic system Helicopter flight stability, controllability. As an integrated part of the transport and aviation system, the helicopter is today neither in civilian nor in military areas. Its flight technical characteristics are based on flight mechanics, which is described in this practical book comprehensively. As the costs and flight characteristics are determined to a large extent at a very early stage of development, an early introduction of requirements and regulations to be met is extremely important. The author supports this by addressing with his decades of experience both the engineers involved in the research and the production of helicopters as well as the procurement and use workers in the Bundeswehr, police, air rescue, civil aviation etc. TOC:Evolution of helicopters.- Helicopter missions and market.- Essential components of helicopters.- Basic principles of performance accounting.- The stroke movement of rotor blades.- The tilt motion of rotor blades.- The higher frequency rotor blade vibrations.- Design of helicopters.- Design of the general forecast.- Helicopter.- System of helicopters.- The general forecast.- The observation.
content.title_en: Helicopter flight mechanics : technology, flight dynamic system helicopters, flight stability, controllability

content.text: The technical knowledge of windows, doors, facades and glass structures, which go far beyond the contents of conventional technology books. Simply explained, so that also professional and trainees profit from it. Material technology (focusing on glass, plastic and aluminium). Technology around windows, doors, facades and glass buildings. Basics of building physics, simple static pre-measurements, narrowing-saving regulations. and many more. Teaching of specialist knowledge, practical examples and work (flow) plans for workshop production and assembly. Background knowledge in building physics, statics, fire protection. Regulations and calculation procedures
content.title_en: Window, door and facade technology

content.text: Basic course on mobile communication systems: from UMTS, GSM and GRPS to Wireless LAN and Bluetooth Piconets. The book deals with the different systems of mobile communication. From GSM, GPRS and UMTS to Wireless LAN and Bluetooth, the individual possibilities for mobile communication are dealt with here. Each of the individual systems is dedicated to a chapter which at the end contains a small collection of tasks to check the knowledge learned. The individual chapters go beyond the normal introduction and offer more than a rough overview of the individual systems due to their depth of detail. The well-read book is accessible through a keyword directory. Deeper reading recommends the literature directory. Also on the Internet there is a dedicated website. In this book a solid basic knowledge is taught, which can be built on with further literature. As a user, theoreticians and practitioners are equally considered. (3) (Dirk Reinartz)
content.title_en: Basic course mobile communication systems : from UMTS, GSM and GRPS to Wireless LAN and Bluetooth Piconets

content.text: Theory and policy of unregenerable natural resources. From the summary: This book presents economic theories and political economic options for action that deal with the use of non-regenerable natural resources: The supply-oriented pension approach mainly takes into account distribution aspects of international commodity trade; the demand-oriented policy is based on the findings of conventional, non-regenerable demand theory; and the thermodynamics, presented as an alternative approach, describes the restrictions to which all earthly and thus all economic activities are subject; but their application to non-regenerable natural resources can only be considered as a first attempt, since the required regulatory consequences do not seem feasible. These three concepts can not give an answer to the question of how the stocks of non-regenerable natural resources should be used in the course of time.
content.title_en: Theory and policy of unregenerable natural resources

content.text: Paper textiles: History - Materials - Experiments. Can paper be textile? Yes, it can! Paper has been used textile for a thousand years, is experiencing a real boom today and seems to be a trendsetting material for the textile industry. In this book, the author is looking for traces in the past: to Japan, where the first paper dresses were made over a thousand years ago and where the most beautiful and noblest Shifu fabrics from twisted paper strips in 1700 even replaced silk as luxury material, or to Europe and the USA, where paper textiles played an important role in everyday life, especially in times of distress. Paper textiles shows how the paper threads are made and what special features it is necessary to consider when processing paper into textiles. With many application examples in various textile techniques, the author introduces objects by many textile professionals to the practical design with paper yarns. They explain how a knitted top, a hammered bag, a braided basket, a tied decoration object, or a woven scarf are created by means of a fascinating portrait of a contemporary artist.
content.title_en: Paper textiles : History - Materials - Experiments

content.text: University - History - City : Festschrift für Helmut Böhme. Helmut Böhme, who worked for decades in the university service at the Technical University Darmstadt at the Institute of History and in the field of architecture, was honored as its president (from 1971 to 1995) and has significantly shaped and shaped TUD. Helmut Böhme, who left the university after 35 years at the end of the summer semester 2004, was a creative and inspiring historian as well as an innovative and visionary university director. The contributions of this volume recall on the one hand his political interests in higher education. They cover a wide range from the economic and social history of the early modern era to the becoming and passing of the European city until the debate about the outbreak of the First World War. Helmut Böhme worked for 35 years at the Technical University Darmstadt and retired from the university service at the end of the summer semester 2004. On this occasion, employees, students and friends wrote this Festschrift, which consists of personal memories and scientific contributions.
content.title_en: University - History - City : Festschrift für Helmut Böhme

content.text: Introduction to Limnology. This proven short textbook of freshwater science describes the system properties of the water and describes the relationships between the climatic, geological and physico-chemical factors as well as the material balance and aquatic animal and plant communities. An extensive chapter is dedicated to the applied Limnology and its current problems (water treatment, water pollution and water therapy, river expansion and flood risk, water acidification, ecotoxicology)
content.title_en: Introduction to Limnology

content.text: Inorganic chemistry in focus II. Whether it is the main group, organometal, coordination, solid state chemistry or materials sciences, all these research areas can be summed up under the umbrella of inorganic chemistry. To ensure that every scientist can obtain an overview of the many subdisciplines, an international team of authors presents the research highlights
content.title_en: Inorganic chemistry in focus II

content.text: Theoretical Physics / Florian Scheck ; 2: Non-relativist Quantum Theory : from Hydrogen Atom to the Multiparticle Systems ; with 51 exercises with solution instructions and exemplary, complete solutions. Theoretical Physics 2. Non-relativist Quantum Theory is the second of five volumes to Professor Scheck's Theoretical Physics.The Theoretical Physics cycle includes:Volume 1: Mechanics. From Newtonian Laws to Deterministic ChaosBand 2: Non-relativist Quantum Theory. From Hydrogen Atom to the Multiparticle Systems.Volume 3: Classical Field Theory. From Electrodynamics to the EichtheoriesBand 4: Quantized Fields. From Symmetries to Quantum Electrodynamics.Volume 5: Statistical Theory of Heat. From Thermodynamics to Quantum Statistics.The textbook represents a modern theoretical physics in stringent representation. Tasks and complete solutions help in the development of the material. TOC: Quant mechanics of a particle.- Scattering of particles at potentials.- The principles of quantum theory.- Symmetries in quantum physics I.- Non- Relativativeist Disorder Calculation.- Identary Particles.
content.title_en: Theoretical Physics / Florian Scheck ; 2: Non-relativist Quantum Theory : from Hydrogen atom to the multiparticle systems ; with 51 exercises with solution instructions and exemplary, complete solutions

content.text: The Turkey debate in Europe : a comparison. With contributions by: Angelos Giannakopoulos, Konstadinos Maras, Martin Große Hüttmann, Ahmet Island, Galatasaray, Panos Kazakos, Othon Anastasakis, Claire Demesmay, Eddy Fougier, Francesca Arato, Sylvia Kritzinger, Franz Steinbauer, Wendy Asbeek Brusse, Dirk Rochtus, Enrique Banús Irusta, Fredrik Langdal, Sebastian Plociennik, Emil Souleimanov,Tibor Dömötörfi
content.title_en: The Turkey debate in Europe : a comparison

content.text: Introduction to manufacturing technology : with 10 tables. Introductory textbook for engineering students on manufacturing processes for metallic and non-metallic materials. (LK/N: Pleuß) Introductory textbook for engineering students on manufacturing processes for metallic and non-metallic materials. Has been extended to about 10 pages compared to the 5th edition 2002 (BA 6/03) (cleaning production, rapid prototyping) and updated. A purchase of this edition is desirable (1.-3. copy, 4. and 5. edition consume). (2) (LK/N: Pleuß)
content.title_en: Introduction to manufacturing technology : with 10 tables

content.text: Diercke, Germany in maps. Classified: first maps and text sections for Germany as a whole, then for the individual federal states. Each of these major chapters consists of a political map (print error in the Sachsen-Anhalt map, where the "B" is listed as a car identification mark for the district of Börde!), maps on history, physical maps and maps on (anthropo-)geographical topics as well as text sections with basics on history and (anthropo-) geography with references to the corresponding maps. For Germany additionally a satellite map, for the federal states additional statistics, city map sections under special aspects, plans/ground plans. The Atlas, also opened by an extensive register, is ideally suited both to inform and to work with it due to the abundance of figures and facts that maps and texts can be drawn from.
content.title_en: Diercke, Germany in Maps

content.text: Methods of empirical social research. This teaching work, which begins at the beginning of the studies, strives in many different ways and in some new ways for the methodical bridge between empirical social research and sociological theory. It not only presents methods and facts, but explains them intelligibly. This alone points far beyond the existing textbook literature. In the meantime, a bestseller may be spoken of. The seventh edition has been substantially revised and supplemented. In all chapters there are new details and further developments of older techniques; almost no page remained unchanged.
content.title_en: Methods of empirical social research

content.text: Large-scale projects in the field test : sustainable settlement development through large-scale projects?. Large-scale projects and mega-events have been used worldwide for decades to promote urban-regional changes. In the discussion on the ground, the economic advantages are usually emphasized either unilaterally or the negative social and ecological effects. Are from the point of view of a city and regional development committed to sustainability then to support or reject large-scale projects? The present book offers a differentiated case-by-case assessment by investigating two examples, the new Messe Stuttgart and the Eden Project in Cornwall (GB). On this basis, conclusions for the general handling of large-scale projects and mega-events are presented.
content.title_en: Large-scale projects in the field test : sustainable settlement development through large-scale projects?

content.text: Steamers, diesel and turbines: the world of ship engineers. Richly illustrated documentation of the 200-year development history of ship operations and the professional development of the ship engineer. 31 authors, all themselves "standing" ship engineers, describe in this standard work the technology on board and the heavy responsibility of their profession - from the first commercial steamships to the modern ships of today
content.title_en: Steamers, diesel and turbines: the world of ship engineers

content.text: New weapons technologies for the fight against international terrorism: ideas, patent applications, projects by a security expert. Invisible fast boats, which cannot be explained by radar or binoculars at night or even by day, march into an enemy port, undetected control the supply routes of terrorists. UN airstorm soldiers move 3,000 km to the field with their flying "Blue Peacemaker" gun tank, where they can end conflicts within hours. They carry a battle helmet whose sensors can discover every hidden opponent even in the densest jungle. Above our nuclear power plants millions of cross-beam laser beams form an impenetrable laser shield that makes a terrorist attack impossible. These are some of the ideas, projects and patents of Hamburg security expert Hans Krech for the asymmetrical fight against international terrorism.
content.title_en: New weapons technologies for the fight against international terrorism : ideas, patent applications, security expert projects

content.text: Low-fire: attractive colours and effects with raku, smoke and capsule fire. In Japan, only the goods produced by the Raku family for tea-cermony, which is not reduced after the fire, are still referred to as raku; in contrast, Western Raku artists are still taking new experimental paths. Apart from the relevant chapters in Bernd Pfannkuche's "Handbuch der Keramikflannöfen" (revised reprint ID 49/00), nothing more detailed has appeared on the subject since C.Tyler's weighty volume "Modernes Raku" (1975). If there was also much to be learned about the roots and spiritual dimension of Japanese Raku, this aspect is only briefly stripped here. The American authors and participating artists use very different methods of burning and reducing. In addition to basic information, vividly illustrated step-by-step instructions on exemplary vessels show the self-building of diverse, individually developed oven types for raku, smoke and capsule fire, glaze and other decor techniques, as well as the brand and reeditoratory techniques.
content.title_en: Low fire : sexy colors and effects with raku, smoke and capsule fire

content.text: Tomcat 5 : [incl. Tomcat 5.5 ; Installation, configuration and safe operation ; Jasper2, valves, servlet filters, JNDI and JDBC ; Loggen, Administration, Performance Tuning]. Everyone who uses Sun's reference implementation for JavaServer Pages or JavaServlet will find the ideal working basis here. You will get a complete overview of Tomcat architecture - with all the new features in version 5. From installation to realm implementation and the connection of databases, you will find everything you need to develop professional web applications.
content.title_en: Tomcat 5 : [incl. Tomcat 5.5 ; Installation, configuration and safe operation ; Jasper2, valves, servlet filters, JNDI and JDBC ; Logging, Administration, Performance Tuning]

content.text: Plastics: Structure, properties, processing, applications of thermoplastics, thermoplasts and elastomers. Basic introduction to plastics, their properties and applications. A slightly extended version compared to the 5th edition 1997 (BA 3/98) and especially updated in the standards (translation from DIN to Euro standard). An exchange of the issues is recommended. Further widely applicable for trainees and practitioners (see also the CD-ROM "Plastic Science", BA 5/04). (2)
content.title_en: Plastics: Structure, properties, processing, applications of thermoplastics, thermoplasts and elastomers

content.text: 1000 chairs. A richly illustrated overview of nearly 2 centuries (19th and 20th century international seating design. The two authors have selected around 1000 examples, which were designed by renowned dissigers and architects. With a contribution on the variety of chairs, the authors introduce the topic. The main part, chronologically designed, each adds the seating furniture (chairs, armchairs) in small-format illustrations on one side. In addition, the design year, material and manufacturer with production period are referred to as the multilingual version, the design year, and the manufacturer. In addition, there is a short characterization of the model. In some cases, the examples are shown in connection with apartment furniture. In the appendix short biographies of the designers, manufacturer's directory, museum list, bibliography and person register. The book offers numerous models of seating furniture, which are lifted out of the mass of seating furniture by design and production. (Ex. 2000 for DM 39,95)
content.title_en: 1000 chairs

content.text: Why your child needs movement : promote optimal development - from the very beginning. Children need a lot of movement for their development. They also need a variety of suggestions from the environment and perception experiences, especially through music, and also a healthy diet. Goddard (see also ID 41/98) explains her thoughts on this in detail and makes suggestions to support these demands. A not always clear and often little grippy presentation, examples of student work from an English reading and spelling test and further references to the situation in Great Britain certainly do not provide for special visuality among German parents and educators. - Only in addition to the numerous advisors for the promotion of child development. (3) (Reinhold Heckmann)
content.title_en: Why your child needs movement : promote optimal development - from the very beginning

content.text: Light and time. It is not a matter of course that light and time have something to do with each other. If light is experienced more than timeless, the day than an everywhere in which we usually rise unquestionably. Nevertheless, one suspects that there is a mysterious connection, the subject matter challenges. The reader of this book will find it no different from the authors who, as writers, have approached the question of the connection between light and time.
content.title_en: Light and Time

content.text: Algorithms : from problem to program. What is an algorithm? - Numerical Algorithms - Partiality in N - Priority systems in Q - Iterations in Q - Nonnumerical Algorithms - Search processes - Sorting processes
content.title_en: Algorithms : from problem to program

content.text: Cold hearts: how television shapes our character. We live in times of a creeping change in the culture of emotions. Television is the most powerful supplier of social messages and role models that ever existed, and becomes a secret educator of a new social character. Shame limits are sinking, public and private emotional representations have a boom. Individuals change and this has consequences for the entire society. The daily TV program with its talk shows, news, soap operas reveals it: Everywhere a new guiding type takes shape. Its emotional world is characterized by continuous desire for excitement, superficiality and theatrical staging, in which feelings are merely depicted but not really felt. In a subtle examination, the backgrounds are illuminated, in front of which television sets the new model of normality into scene. And it is shown the fatal consequences, which this media-modulated social type has for politics, working life, and indeed in the intimate branches of the family. Winterhoff-Spurk calls to mind the causes of social change and appeals to the educators, finally something of television.
content.title_en: Cold Hearts: how television shapes our character

content.text: Beyond the genes: Proteins - key to understanding life. Proteins are among the preferred biomolecules of modern molecular genetic research. The author explains in detail their importance for all life processes, describes the processes of their synthesis and outlines characteristic structural characteristics. The focus is on the diverse tasks and functions of proteins as well as their outstanding position for application-oriented gene technology basic research, especially in the fields of medicine and pharmacy. A solid, clearly structured non-fiction book in which the elementary basic principles of protein chemistry are taught in an understandable manner. The attractive typographic design and the informative illustrations focused on essentials, which contribute to a better understanding of complex biological relationships. (2) (Helmut Köhne)
content.title_en: Beyond the genes : Proteins - key to understanding life

content.text: Polymer chemistry compact : Basics - structure of macromolecules - technically important polymers and reactive systems ; with 17 tables. Especially for polymer chemistry applies: Fast changes and innovations are omnipresent and new findings have to be recorded in ever more extensive publications and special documentation. Inevitably the clarity is lost, so that the reader easily loses in details and special knowledge. This textbook, however, conveys in brief the essential aspects of the chemistry of large molecules. Basic concepts and structural property relationships are dealt with as well as technically important monomers, polymers, polymer families and reactiv systems. A short overview of additives and stabilizers as well as of production methods rounds off this volume. Thus, for the student a textbook is available, the advanced one serves as preparation for the diploma and doctoral examination, the professional beginner in the industry offers it in clear form a possibility of a quick entry into the polymer chemistry
content.title_en: Polymer chemistry compact : basics - structure of macromolecules - technically important polymers and reactive systems ; with 17 tables

content.text: PHP & MySQL : Step by step to the database-supported website. This introduction to dynamic website development with PHP and MySQL appears in the second edition, and the IT industry can already understand this fact as a clear indication of quality. It is therefore not surprising that on relevant websites for the first edition of this title you can find predominantly benevolent reviews and reading reviews. This can only be followed by the fact that the structure and preparation of the material can convince in every respect. The beginner learns from all the necessary techniques just as much as he needs for the start. In addition, a clear and understandable diction that facilitates the handling of the complex matter is added. In the new edition, versions PHP 5 and MySQL 4 are taken into account, however, the object-oriented features are not addressed. But at least one chapter for structured programming can now be found at the end of the book. For the (not quite low) price you get comparable hardcover volumes such as E. Hirte (BA 11/04). (2)
content.title_en: PHP & MySQL : Step by step to the database-based website

content.text: "A place to which one likes to go": the Holocaust memorial and the German history policy after 1989. The history of the Berlin Holocaust memorial, its place in the German history policy in connection with the great discourses on the central themes of the past management. (Friedrich Andrae) There were many distortions, loud and unworthy discussions about the memorial to the memory of the Jews of Europe murdered by the Nazis. In May 2005, the Holocaust memorial, realized according to the design of Peter Eisenman, will be open to the public: Whether the memorial will really be a place "to which one likes to go", will prove itself. The political scientists Leggewie (born 1950) and Meyer (born 1968), both individually concerned with the scientific topics of memory policy and history policy, represent the history of the memorial from the idea of invitations and drafts to the realization in a wide range of contexts. The keywords of past consideration, historian's dispute, topography of terror, military exposition or gold-stones, are not presented here for the perpetrators, and the future is not very much analyzed.
content.title_en: "A place to go": the Holocaust Memorial and the German history policy after 1989

content.text: Introduction to Java: [incl. Java Professional Book on CD; up-to-date on JDK 5; for beginners and Java newcomers; with many examples and commented solutions; understand, apply and look up]. The publisher has also published a book on the new Java 5 (JDK 1.5), which only highlights the innovations of this now current version (F. Esser: BA 1/05). This book is a comprehensive introduction for beginners, which explains in detail the work with the new Java version 5, starting with simple basics and object orientation up to the new language concepts Generics, concurrent programming and Enums. Good didactical structure. For each chapter an introduction and a summary. The language elements are explained based on about 100 smaller sample programs. Development tools and environments are presented only in selection (including Eclipse, JBuilder, NetBeans, Together). For additional information, the author refers to his website. Very helpful are 8 larger carefully documented projects on different areas of Java programming, which can be used as a template for self-experimentation.
content.title_en: Introduction to Java : [incl. Java Professional Book on CD ; current to JDK 5 ; for beginners and newbies ; with many examples and commented solutions ; understand, apply and look up]

content.text: The path to the right house: [individual building with knowledge and intuition]. The author (engineer and architect) has been building detached brick houses away from the fashion for years and offers here a holistic guide to house planning, which addresses building owners and architects, but also to medical practitioners and psychologists. Introducing it is about emotional aspects such as intuition, taste, well-being, feeling of space, energy, quality of life as an invitation to the builders to obtain clarity about their own wishes and ideas for their house - regardless of high gloss brochures. Subsequently, the author deals in detail with individual building materials, healthy building materials, problematic insulation materials, heating and house technology, financing and goes in detail on the good design of the individual house components. The book is very understandable and fluently written, illustrated with meaningful photos and with numerous drawings, computational examples and tables for the clarification of building physics aspects. For thoughtful, critical building owners recommended as a foundation reading like "single correct building: foundations" (BA 7/99). (2)
content.title_en: The way to the right house : [individually build with knowledge and intuition]

content.text: Synagogue - Church - Mosque : Experience cult spaces and discover religions. Architecture and interior design of cult spaces, ceremonies and rituals of monotheistic religions! with inspirations and materials for exploring and getting to know interreligious.
content.title_en: Synagogue - Church - Mosque : Experience cult spaces and discover religions

content.text: Audio circuitry : understand - design - build. The revised reprint (see BA 9/94) takes into account the technical development of recent years, but it is not very extensive in terms of basics and circuitry technology. Therefore, the previous edition does not necessarily have to be replaced. It is pleasing to note the new index of keywords that has been added, which makes it easier to work with the book. In the meantime, the book by G. Haas (BA 12/96) has been published as a comparative title, which particularly takes into account the measurement technology. (2)
content.title_en: Audio circuitry : understand - design - build

content.text: Execute IT training successfully : didactic concepts and participatory methods for trainers, trainers, teachers and quality managers. Efficient working with a new software requires good training. This book provides IT trainers with the necessary basic knowledge: methods, ways, procedures that have proven themselves independently of the respective software. Building blocks on the computer? Puzzle-laying in the seminar room? Setting up a network with software modules? - These and many other surprising possibilities present the authors to optimize IT training. They address the framework conditions, discuss course structure, learning and teaching methods as well as error management. Information and practice phases can be arranged in a meaningful way so that participants can benefit optimally and implement what they have learned into practice. In addition, handling disorders and conflicts - often a key point in training - is illustrated in detail by numerous examples.
content.title_en: Successfully carry out IT trainings : didactic concepts and participatory methods for trainers, trainers, teachers and quality managers

content.text: Learning is painful: to the theory of negative knowledge and the practice of error culture. Learning from mistakes and errors is not pleasant for anyone, but it leads to people understanding a thing better afterwards, doing something wrong no more, not allowing an experienced injustice. The book is about this so-called "negative" knowledge and how it can be used in school and family (defect culture). But that people change when learning and that they do both make mistakes and commit errors is a matter of course. It contains the fact that this wrong is a decisive contribution both for the sustainability and the safety of knowledge. Through the wrong to come to the right thing is often a laborious and emotionally difficult way. The volume is meant for practitioners (defect culture in school), but it is also of interest in pedagogical-psychologically (building up negative knowledge). Special aspects are the emotional reaction to errors, the effect of shame on the further learning process and biographies of people who report on learning processes that were often very painful in action. There are also some errors and errors discussed as well as the moral reaction to error.
content.title_en: Learning is painful : to the theory of negative knowledge and to the practice of error culture

All corrosion and corrosion protection problems, which occur or occur at the various construction and materials on buildings, are covered. Furthermore, the correlations between corrosion and corrosion protection and the ecology of natural materials and the use of materials are described. Of course, the existing regulations and regulations are considered.

content.text: Hans-Josef Wagner is concerned with the foundation of a structural interdisciplinary theory of socialization. In the first volume, Sociality and Reciprocity, the fundamentals of socialization in natural history are considered in particular. In the second volume, Crisis and Socialization, the process of socialization in human ontogenesis is the central topic. The starting points of Wagner's work are in particular the structural anthropology of Claude Lévi-Strauss, the anthropological communication theory of George Herbert Mead, the language theory of Noam Chomsky, the genetic structuralism of Ulrich Oevermann (closely connected to Wagner), the theories of Freud, Piaget and Bourdieu, and the more recent findings of neurosciences (neuronales Unkonscientes, Spiegel-Neuronen). The synthesis of these concepts leads to a new - integral - theory of socialization and education processes of the subject. The perspective of the social-division of Wagner is based on the social-division of the social-division and the social-division of the social-division of the social-division.
content.title_en: Structural Theory of Socialization / Hans-Josef Wagner ; 2: Crisis and Socialization

content.text: The informative universe: the new world picture of physics. This work is about information, and more about the physical, theoretical aspect. While information is understood as the meaning of any form of message, physics is about the symbols with which a message is transmitted and then in information technology about the storage, transmission, representation and processing of such symbols. This book is about this. Baeyer is also less about a historical representation than about a precise explanation of the information concept and its smallest unit, up to the 1992 created "Quibit", the term for quantum unit of information. Baeyer, professor of physics in the USA and author of the non-fiction book ("The Atom in the Trap", BA 9/96) has once again succeeded in a well-readable and very informative work, which can be recommended to all, who deal in some form with information processing, not least because it also allows a look into the future of this exponentially growing area. (1 S)
content.title_en: The informative universe: the new world view of physics

content.text: The manual for physical and chemical age determination. Review: Mebus Geyh provides an overview of all methods of numerical age determination. His standard work on age determination is re-published here and brought to the current state of science. No other work reports so comprehensively and at the same time tightly structured about all chemical and physical dating methods. As a textbook, it offers the student an introduction to geochronology, as a reference work it allows a fast and targeted method choice for practical work. The coloured application mirror enables environmental and geoscientists, archaeologists, paleoclimatologists and botanists to select the method for them according to the type and quantity of his samples, the accuracy and other aspects needed without further research.
content.title_en: Manual of physical and chemical age determination

content.text: Places of Modernism : Worlds of Experience of the 19th and 20th centuries. Klappentext: What do cinema, force room and airplane, bunkers, newspaper editorial staff and apartment have in common? They are all places where everyday experiences are condensed in the narrowest space - experiences that many people of the late 19th and 20th centuries share and which still shape our world of life. Technology, mobility and communication stand for progress; experiences of isolation, but also autonomy and individualization for its consequences.
content.title_en: Places of Modernism : Worlds of Experience of the 19th and 20th centuries

A second part goes to the bottom of the secrets of the engine and chassis. Here everything you need to know about modern two-wheelers is shown in a comprehensive and clear way. A technical manual as you can't wish for it to be more experienced, now in an updated and revised re-edition.
content.title_en: Pure motorcycle technology : function - construction - suspension

Or not rather known planets and not peaceful? For example, the Earth. From the first flight into orbit through the first space walk to the moon landing from the beginning, there were inconsistencies in the conquest of the universe. They lead to the trace of a huge deception maneuver: Under the cover of civilian space travel military apparatuses are fattened and secretly stationed weapons. Aim of the mobilization in space: world domination. In the crosshairs: the Earth and each of us. Bestselling author Gerhard Wisnewski traces the true intentions of the powers and victorious powers in space and designs a frighteningly realistic scenario about the terror from orbit

content.text: The dialogue between the citizens of Germany and Poland is the social level of the German-Polish neighbourhood. A characteristic of German-Polish relations both before and after the change of system in 1989/90 is the quality of non-state contacts. Approaches of a "socialization of foreign policy" existed before the turn of the year, although the People's Republic of Poland, like the GDR, tried to secure the foreign policy monopoly of the ruling parties of unity and were therefore not interested in democratizing bilateral relations. The diverse cultural and charitable initiatives of the German-Polish societies also played a significant role in improving the perception of Germans in Poland. They laid an important basis for the improvement of German-Polish relations after the turn of the year. With the collapse of the Eastern Bloc and the unification of Germany, the German-Polish societies got new impetus. New societies were created, especially in the New Länder, and the individual associations formed themselves in the course of the relocation of the government seat to Berlin to a federal association.
content.title_en: Citizens' dialogue: the social level of the German-Polish neighbourhood

content.text: The web - the construction of the unabomber. The worldwide networking of computers, institutions, people is long since reality. In his film The Net, which was awarded at the >European media art festival < in 2004, Lutz Dammbeck has traced the origins of this development. Since the 1940s cybernetics, multimedia art, LSD trials and system theory designed the fascinating vision of an open, global and networked world society. One of the most famous opponents of this technological society is the so-called unabomber, which from 1978 to 1995 shattered the USA by a series of bomb attacks on renowned scientists. Dammbeck has revealed impressive documents about the development of cybernetics and military defense strategies. He has conducted interviews with the protagonists of the cyber elite: the publisher John Brockman, the computer scientist Stewart Brand and David Gelerter, the physicist Heinz von Foerster and others. He has published these voices with letters of the highly gifted former Harvard mathematical professor Ted Kaczynski, who was arrested in 1996 as an alleged impomber to the German book.
content.title_en: The net - the construction of the unabomber

content.text: The Arctic Climate Report : the effects of warming. The Arctic Council, to which the nations Canada, Finland, Denmark/Greenland/Faroeer, Norway, Russia, Sweden and the USA belong, has presented an extensive scientific study on the consequences of Arctic warming with alarming results. This study (ACIA - Arctic Climate Impact Assessment) was prepared by some 300 researchers from eight Arctic countries and documented in a 1,500 page final report. This report is a summary of the key results of this study and addresses the public and policy makers - in an international study on the changes of Arctic ecosystems through global warming, which is well illustrated and clearly prepared for the interested layman. The author of this novel architectural history shows in which context and ideal environment new developments have become an integral part of architecture and are still becoming today. Over 100 selected and commented case studies illustrate where new developments have been researched and tested. Six chapters address the most important problems facing architects and engineers, construction schools and research institutes and structure them as a teaching and manual with a wealth of illustrations.

content.text: Tropical architecture : sustainable and humane building in Africa, Latin America and South-East Asia. This far-sighted study examines the great challenge of tropical architecture, which takes account of the changing climate, economy and limited resources. The tropics, about 40% of the earth's surface, cover both very humid rain forests and extremely dry desert regions. The architecture is correspondingly diverse. The author examines this by comparing the native constructions with those of the colonial period to examples of modern buildings of great architects. Supported by impressive imagery, the influence of the > imported < architecture on the traditional construction, whether in Africa, Asia or in Central and South America, is illustrated by the influence of the > imported < architecture on the traditional construction.
content.title_en: Tropical architecture : sustainable and humane building in Africa, Latin America and South-East Asia

content.text: The architecture of the new Berlin. Nowhere in Europe has so much been built in the last 15 years, nowhere has such deep wounds been closed. Today Berlin is the example of combining modern architecture with the framework conditions of traditional urban development. In this book, the long-standing Senate Building Director Hans Stimmann explains the urban planning and represents the development that led to the new image of the city. Berlin architectural critic Martin Kieren comments on the state of architecture of this city. Precise photos of Erik-Jan Ouwerkerk, who has been living in Berlin since 1988 accompany and illustrate vocals and kierens's examination of the new Berlin.
content.title_en: The architecture of the new Berlin

content.text: Technology Notes : Autobiographical insights into everyday experiences (1965 - 1999). From the unusual perspective of a humanist, the records collected here take into account the "technicity" of our culture. But why is technology considered at the same time when it comes to everyday descriptions? Under technology, any form of objects of use or skills is understood, so one finds that since the earliest times human being and the use of technology belong together indissolubly. Without the practices, objects, devices and spaces surrounding people, everyday life and culture cannot be adequately described. Precisely because the "technic notes" have not been purposefully defined, but have been created as spontaneous experiential descriptions and experience protocols, they are particularly convincingly documenting the technical perseverance of our everyday life. Thus, this volume is a valuable source for cultural science technology research as well as for popular studies of city life and travel culture. In a reflective and at the same time fascinating way, the autobiographic sketches on the other hand reflect a contemporary portrait of the last decades of the 20th century.
content.title_en: Technology Notes : Autobiographical Insights into Everyday Experiences (1965 - 1999)

content.text: Symbol and truthfulness: Reformbaukunst in Dresden. Dresden played an important role in the German art and architecture landscape at the beginning of the 20th century. The period marked by upheaval brought about new approaches to restoring the unity of architecture, art and life. Using the example of the Dresden architectural event between 1900 and the First World War, the term "reform building art" which has not been firmly established in the history of architecture or art is discussed. Due to the problematic assignment of the buildings, which are now mostly listed as monuments, to the Art Nouveau style, which has led to uncertainties among those interested in architecture, a clear distinction between time-parallel styles is also given as well as a elaboration of the various manifestations of this "reform building style" itself. An object catalogue, which is linked to districts, is intended to visit the numerous less well-known testimonies of the Hellerau by Heinrich Tessenow or the work of the city building council Hans Erlwein, is introduced in the various directions of reform building art.
content.title_en: Symbol and Truthfulness : Reform Building in Dresden

content.text: In atmospheric and aesthetic images, Tuscan landscape and contemporary art enter into dialogue and reveal magical places with extraordinary garden designs. Tuscany has always exercised a special attraction to artists from a wide range of countries of origin, and has been chosen by many as a place to live and work because of its simple lifestyle in harmony with nature, mild climate and rich cultural heritage. Each of them refers to the Tuscan landscape in its own way in its own environment and art. Special importance is attached to garden design: some create thoughtful gardens, others create areas beyond the so-called garden art, which seem to be more accidental than the search for perfection. Mario Ciampi captured the magic of 25 gardens of contemporary artists in his extraordinary photographs. Mariella Sgaravatti has researched the background for the creation and design of the gardens in personal conversations with the artists. She has discovered links between the artworks and the Tuscan landscape and collected many unusual suggestions for the installation of gardens. All afternoons you want to lose yourself in these images, to enjoy the easy and knowledgeable text book, but very much.
content.title_en: Artist gardens in Tuscany

content.text: Software requirements. Not a few software projects do not achieve their goals, since already in their initial phase requirements for the software have not been thoroughly analysed and documented. Often it is neglected that software development has as much to do with communication as with actual development work. At this point, this classic of software development literature starts, in which convincingly is presented, why the survey, compilation and management of software requirements is essential for successful projects and with which tried and tested means these tasks can be dramatically improved with the practice described in the book. Karl Wiegers shows how requirements analysts, project managers, but also all programmers and designers who have to implement requirements of customers, productivity, schedule fidelity, customer satisfaction and maintenance and support costs can be drastically improved with the practice described in the book. - Realistic expectations for functionality and quality set - integrate business rules into application development - use application cases to define user requirements - identify unspoke and changing requirements and manage - reduce revisions and thus save costs - produce better software

content.text: The Prince as a gardener: Hermann von Pückler-Muskau and his parks in Muskau, Babelsberg and Branitz. The author is an art historian and deals in particular with landscape design in East German countries. He has already written a book on "Das Dessau-Wörlitzer Gartenreich" (ID 23/93 and 34/00). The present book deals with the Prince Hermann von Pückler-Muskau (1785-1871). It begins with the prince's childhood and his little successful education. Many escapades drew his way of life. However, for posterity he was an important landscape designer and garden architect, which also puts the emphasis on this book. Numerous historical and contemporary illustrations show the beauty of the parks in Muskau, Babelsberg and Branitz. A biography of the Prince is also found at H. Ohff (BA 12/91) and a retrospective of his garden art in "Der Parkschöpfer Pückler-Muskau" (ID 10/96). (2) (Burchard Bulling)

content.text: The open house: for a new architecture. Can a building really be without any relationship to the place where it stands? Can architecture express itself freely of all social, geographical and cultural influences, without running the risk of being arbitrary and interchangeable and losing in substantial quality? The publication "The Open House" is dedicated to these questions of high social and political topicality. It sensitizes for a world knowledge based on all architecture and asks how to correspond to the basic human need for a unity of architecture and nature. Starting from the traditional Japanese house and the classical Western modernism, the author finds criteria that can also be applied to contemporary architecture. On buildings by Rem Koolhaas, Herzog & de Meuron, Peter Zumthor, Katsuyo Sejima, Ryue Nishizawa and many others, these are explained exemplary. This approach to the only intellectual, intuitive and subjectively experienced qualities of architecture gives diverse suggestions for own realizations.
content.title_en: The open house : for a new architecture

content.text: The lesser evil: political morality in an age of terror. Should we fight terror, murder with murder and torture with torture? Should we sacrifice civil liberties in order to maintain public security? Michael Ignatieff, left-liberal intellectual and advocate of the Iraq war, presents in this book a theoretical justification for his political positions: In view of the danger of devastating terrorist attacks, the "liberal hawk" advocates the thesis that a political ethics must constantly weigh up which "smaller evils" are to be justified in order to prevent "greater evils". This means specifically allowing the question under which circumstances the abolition of fundamental rights, harsher interrogation methods (excluding torture) and preventative wars are acceptable. Ignatieff argues for the search for a middle way: one must find the balance between freedom and security, between the preservation of the fundamental rights of individuals and the protection of the social majority. At the same time, Ignatieff points out that this balancing act always carries the risk of self-harming democracy, which must consciously counteract it.
content.title_en: The lesser evil: political morality in an age of terror

content.text: The dictation of the clock: time forms, time conflicts, time perspectives. The statement about time, which has dominated everyday life and science, is: time is measurable. Barbara Adam shows, however, that this is an incorrect, because a narrow picture of people's dealings with time prevails. Her extensive empirical studies prove that the individual is more inventive and (partly) playful with the time budget than was previously assumed. In numerous extensive discussions with individuals from all walks of life and age groups, it has been shown that the disciplinary dimension of time - time pressure, routine activities, calendrical subdivisions, lack of time and aging - is compensated by counter-strategies. Barbara Adam describes the means and ways that individuals find and invent time for social interactions, time for the body (for illness as well as healing), the environment, time for learning, but also for leisure and luxury. Thus, the author's thesis of dealing with time, the typical double meaning of all the individual's dimensions, is forced to proceed against the compulsion of the individual, but at the same time, he is forced to create his own time budget.

content.text: Modern instruments of real estate controlling ; [1]: DCF valuation and key performance systems in real estate controlling. The developed process gives capital investors and experts an efficient instrument for the appropriate, return-oriented assessment of real estate. The second part of the book presents a holistic solution for the optimization of operating costs. Complex key performance systems serve as the basis of the edv-based benchmarking, which - in this area - can be expanded to an automated portfolio management. content.text: The gender of politics. In this volume, countries on three continents - Finland, Mozambique, Austria, Portugal and the USA - are confronted with each other. In this volume, the authors ask how "gender" is important in the different societies, both as a social affiliation and as a category of discrimination. While it is confirmed that "gender" has a central function in all the societies studied in social differentiation and hierarchization, it is true that gender is important and effects in the different countries, in the different social groups and geographical regions that they cover. While in Finland, for example, the distinction between men and women is the central pointer in society, in the USA, the weight of ethnic and social belonging is of particular importance. In Portugal, it is, in turn, participation in certain social milieus, which is perhaps essential for determining the scope of a person's action as a gender-related factor.

Guide for planners and practitioners with current regulations and guidelines for fire protection-compliant electrical installations Electrical installations are important components of buildings and constructional installations that have to meet the requirements of current building law. Employees in the construction industry, electrical planners and electrical installers therefore bear the responsibility for the maintenance and guarantee of safety operations in buildings to a large extent. All current regulations on preventive fire protection of electrical installations are comprehensively treated. Problems, which are sometimes permanent part of operational practice, are made transparent and treated in such detail that they contribute to a high degree of practical problem-solving. The author, publicist and innovative filmmaker ("September wheat") at the beginning repets the well-known "computer plagues" (e.g. exponentially increasing computing performance for the actually always same tasks), in order to then develop a new model for the storage of data. This goes away from a tree structure and to a polylogical order in the form of relations. This can be done under the keyword Pile system here and as a project on the web. The then obvious question, whether such computers approach the AI and better simulate human actions and decisions will be impossible and will never be overrepeasible.

content.text: Forced migration in Europe: a scientific and political debate on the expulsion of Germans from the East. The recent migration of refugees, displaced persons and forced migration in the 20th century have become a major topic in Germany and its neighbouring European countries. The focus of the discussion is on the expulsion of more than twelve million Germans during and after the Second World War. The contributions of this volume attempt to place this serious process in historical contexts, to relate it to other forced migration processes such as the Holocaust. At the same time, it is discussed how to deal with the expulsion in the German and European culture of memory.

content.text: Environmental assessment in building management planning. The obligation to carry out an environmental assessment in the preparation of building management plans, including the obligation to draw up an environmental report as part of the foundation of the building management plan, was introduced by the EAG Bau on July 20, 2004. Cities and municipalities must adapt their procedures and the content of the statement of reasons for an environmental report accordingly and implement a number of other innovations. This work assistance is intended to help with this. The aim is to provide practical recommendations for the implementation of the legal requirements beyond the legal comments. Among other things, there are hints and examples for the drafting of the environmental report, for the summary statement, for the process design, for the relevant protective goods and finally for monitoring.
content.title_en: Environmental assessment in building planning

content.text: The top ten of the most beautiful physical experiments. What the title does not immediately suggest is a very distinct physics history book. An example collection of historical physics experiments that have one thing in common - to be classic-beautiful like the free fall of Galileo Galilei, Foucault's pendulum, Eratosthenes's measurement of the Earth's circumference or the spectral dissection of sunlight by Isaac Newton. Thus, the historical span runs through about 2,200 years of physics history. The latest of the experiments described here, the attempt by the Tübingen physicist Claus Jönsson to interfer with electrons at the double fission, dates back to 1959 and was chosen by the English physical society "Physics World" as the most beautiful physical experiment of all time. So this book is not so much about the instructions for carrying out physical experiments, but about the mediation of fascination and the transmission of interesting details from the biographies of the physicists concerned. Could be somewhat richer illustrated. Nevertheless, highly recommended for physics teachers, students and interested lay people. (2 S)
content.title_en: The top ten of the most beautiful physical experiments

content.text: Another war: the UN sanctions regime in Iraq. As an Iraq expert who coordinated the program "Oil for Food" as a UN employee in Baghdad from 1998 to 2000, Hans-C. Graf Sponeck analyses both this intervention and the sanctions imposed in this context, as well as the political strategy of the dictatorship in Iraq, and provides an equally knowledgeable and lucid critique. The book focuses on the question of how the economic sanctions have affected everyday life in Iraq. Who really benefited from the program? What role did the Security Council and in it play the individual Member States? And there were and are alternatives to the UN's Iraq policy? In answering these questions, Graf Sponeck resortes to previously unpublished internal UN documents. Based on this material and after evaluating numerous discussions with Iraqi politicians (including Saddam Hussein), UN decision makers (such as Secretary General Kofi Annan), members of the UN Security Council and, especially with the Iraqi population affected locally, the author is able to draw a detailed picture of the sanctions policy and its consequences as well as the domestic political situation.
content.title_en: Another war: the UN sanctions regime in Iraq

content.text: The intelligent failure: the human-tech dilemma. The Kaiserslautern professor of mechanical engineering and process engineering is known for his criticism of the lack of ease of use of many technology products. His entertainingly written and easy-to-read book on the human-machine interface deals with the large range of complex devices of daily use or of the domestic and directly used technology such as the computer or the car. The author describes in the first part the typical problems, in the second the causes of technological overload and paints in the third a future scenario. His criticism is directed towards those who design the devices more according to their functionalities than their ease of use. Only 15% of the customers are "innovators" and "early adopters", who want to beat around with the child cranes and the often cryptic manuals of the latest generation of devices, the remaining 85% are looking for technology that is suitable for everyday use and easy to use. And especially this quality of "usability" is the thing that is hard to use. - In addition to the more academic titles on the subject. (3)

content.text: The education of man: what the natural sciences know about us. Fischer sees the book as a continuation of his "Other Education" (BA 4/02). If this work was designed as the scientific supplement to the Schwanitzian "Education" canon (BA 1/00) and dealt with the "external sciences", with the laws outside the human body, Fischer is concerned with the question: "What image have modern natural sciences designed by man?" about the "inner sciences". The author understands the education of man in the ambiguousness of the term: the special position of man can be adequately represented only in the complementarity of biological development (how does man enter the world) and the appropriation of knowledge, for him synonymous with free will (how does the world enter man). The design, which is picked up with scientific history, philosophical and knowledge from molecular and neurobiology, refuses to be assigned to the one exact assignment, as it needs to the other the access of a reader who wants to have answered Kant's question "What is man modern?" (3).
content.title_en: The education of man: what the natural sciences know about us

content.text: Working methods of human geography. A survey among students of the diploma geography at the Technical University of Munich showed that seminars that impart methodological knowledge are of the highest priority for later professional practice. How and where do I obtain data for a research work? Which data are relevant for research? What are the differences between qualitative and quantitative methods of examination? How does statistics work? How can results be presented? A basic work for students in basic studies, very well suited for self-study. (3)

The antisemitism accusation is a political means of fighting, which has decided dozens of political battles over the past two decades. Most of the figures who could not be proved to be an antisemitism or even a mere attitude are inferior. Thus the impression arose that the antisemitism accusation is applicable even without a solid basis: its effect is devastating, and more than that it is important in the political struggle. Arne Hoffmann, Belfort-Bax-prize winner for exemplary scientific authorship, goes after the basic principles of the antisemitism debates in Germany. He analyses why Jürgen Möllemann and Martin Hohmann had no chance to defy the antisemitism accusation once raised against them. Hoffmann does not, however, restrict himself to prominent personalities such as Martin Walser, Roland Koch or Norbert Blüm, who had to defend themselves against their skin because they were accused of antisemitism; from the cases of "Hans Lezündecker" the "Beibahlt" is "ther "Gebührung" of the "Hon" of the "Honhalbehmann.

content.text: Future of livestock farming: expert opinions of the Scientific Advisory Council on Agricultural Policy, Sustainable Land Management and Rural Development at the Federal Ministry of Consumer Protection, Food and Agriculture. Farm animal farming in Germany is confronted with developments at the global and European level as well as with changes in the framework conditions at the regional and local level. Conflicts occur in the conflicting field of different interests, especially in the areas of animal, environmental and consumer protection. The possibilities for resolving the target conflicts are narrowly limited, simple solutions are not generally available. Therefore, it is often useful to implement policy measures gradually and to use the experience gained in this process successively to re-calibrate the path taken. Moreover, it is advisable to try out some measures only in individual regions and to undergo careful scientific support. Against the background of the special location situation in Germany, focusing on a single guiding principle is not advisable; instead, it is likely that it will require even more differentiation and diversification of animal production in order to remain competitive both against the co-concurrent and to use the proximity to the domestic market as a source of advantages.
content.title_en: Future of livestock farming : expert opinion of the Scientific Advisory Council on Agricultural Policy, Sustainable Land Management and Rural Development at the Federal Ministry for Consumer Protection, Food and Agriculture

content.text: New ways to combat domestic violence: proactive counselling centres in Lower Saxony and their cooperation with police and justice. In recent years, institutional treatment of domestic violence has changed significantly in Germany. In 2002, the Law on the Protection of Violence came into force, in many places new police action strategies have been implemented, local networks have been created, new intervention concepts for victims have been tested. Pro-active counselling centres represent such a new form of support: they are informed by the police about domestic violence operations, offer the injured people advice and inform about the legal possibilities. content.text: Data report Mecklenburg-Vorpommern : Information and data as the basis for an efficiency and effectiveness analysis of the university system. Study periods, switching behaviour and study success or decline are important factors in the context of an assessment of the effectiveness and efficiency of a university system in addition to cost sizes, monetary and personnel equipment and capacity utilization. The report first gives the most important results on study behaviour (I.). Subsequently, the central findings on the accommodation related to study places in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern are summarized in connection with the current utilization and the current graduates - both sizes which are significantly influenced by the student behaviour (II.). Afterwards, the evaluation of these study places are presented in monetary terms and at what costs per student and per graduate this leads (III.). Finally, an overall overview is reflected on how the university expenditure of the country in relation to the economic power, the number of inhabitants, the eligible students, the new students and students (IV.). (HoF/Text überständer)
content.title_en: Datareport Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania : Information and data as the basis for an efficiency and efficiency analysis of the university system

content.text: OpenOffice programming: Automate office applications with Basic. The author is known for his various books on the development of applications with Basic dialects based on programs from Office packages (e.g. BA 11/01 - VBA and Word 2002). In this book he deals in detail with the automation of continuously recurring processes and processes in OpenOffice programs using the integrated Basic development environment. The focus is on the explanation of the theory and philosophy of the Basic IDE and the interfaces through which access and control is made in applications. The reader gets to know very well the dialogues with their differentiated possibilities with which user inputs are intercepted. The individual programs Calc, Writer, Draw, Impress and Base are taken into account. The book concludes with several large practical application examples, which can be easily modified for own needs. Among other things, one form manager for managing large form collections, a tool for quick access to letters in a large archive, but also an organigram assistant. (2)

Computer science is highlighted as a science of abstraction. General methods for solving practical problems are provided. Thus, the importance of computer science for professional practice is well highlighted. The focus is on modelling, abstract data types, algorithms as well as ancillary and distributed programming. Basic concepts are realized by means of the object-oriented language Java. Connections between the large areas of computer science are clearly elaborated. Clearly highlighted definitions and tabular overviews. The authors attach great importance to a performance control. Thus, each chapter ends with a section "What do you know now?". The book is well suited for exam preparation. The compact index contains only test-relevant terms. Who can specify the definition and use of each keyword has actually learned enough. content.text: Social integration as a challenge for local and regional actors. Social integration as a balance between interests, as a way to deal with conflicts and as a social practice of mutual recognition has become more difficult. Various socio-political crisis phenomena indicate that social interests and rights must be renegotiated with the change of social structures and relationships. With regard to the urban region and from the perspective of individual actors from urban and spatial planning, architecture and social and political science, this volume provides current analyses of the crisis of social integration. The contributions of the annual lecture series of the Competence Center for Spatial Research and Regional Development in the Hanover region from the summer semester 2004 are documented.

content.text: The crisis and future of the welfare state. Political science research with basic knowledge of structure and tasks as well as a look at the prehistory since 1870/71. The era of Kohl 1982-1998 and the era Schröder 1998-2005 are broken down and compared in detail with all the arguments and counterarguments of the time. Thus, the early influence of neoliberal tendencies since the mid-1970s, when recession and globalization did not have to hold up to the foundation of the welfare state dismantling, is documented. The Cologne scientist, known for numerous social science research projects (lastly "Kinderarmut in Ost und Westdeutschland", BA 5/05) and as an advocate of a citizen insurance, analyses the social policy, its "reconstruction" and future perspectives, the role of the media, parties, interest groups, the extensive literature and compiles a catalogue of different alternative models.
