content.title_en: Regional planning in the urban-environment area

content.text: The author is known for his experimental instructions "Chemical Cabinet Pieces" (BA 3/95) and "Chemie en miniature" (BA 5/99), which are particularly distinguished by the holistic approach of the chemical experiment described in each case under historical, philosophical, scientific and aesthetic aspects. Also in this volume the chemistry enthusiast (but also the one who still has to be enthusiastic!) comes at his expense with each of the more than 80 experiments. And this already during the reading. Some of the experiments can be carried out without great difficulty at home. For example "Rottled peppermint tea", "Red wine as colour indicator", "electricity from the beer can" or "Münchhausen - the flying styrofoam ball". Very richly illustrated with thoroughly coloured, mostly very effective photos. For chemistry teachers, lecturers, students and interested lay people. (2 S)
content.title_en: Highlights of chemical experimentation

content.text: Concepts of biology. The German-American Ernst Mayr, who died recently at the age of 100, is considered one of the most important biologists of the 20th century. His attempt to unite Darwin's theory of evolution with Mendel's genetics was groundbreaking. He first proved that new species often arise from spatially isolated populations. And he introduced the definition of the concept of biological species, which should later become more widespread: a species is every population whose members form a reproductive community. Mayr was also a great systematicist, and his essential achievement as a science theorist consisted in showing that the research objects of biology are fundamentally different from those of physics and chemistry. - The 12 common-minded and linguistically brilliant essays gathered in this book are very suitable as an introduction to Mayr's thinking. For readers who want to familiarize themselves with the theoretical foundations of modern biology and the central insights of Darwin's evolutionary theory. (2) (Frankf)
content.title_en: Concepts of biology

content.text: Networks for dummies: [Set up and administer networks; perfect security in the network; for Windows, Novell, Linux and Mac OS]. Setting up and administering networks nowadays belongs to the everyday work of the computer manager, whether in small business or in large companies. In the well-known Dummies series, the author provides help and basic knowledge on this topic. Two years ago the predecessor band (BA 9/03) appeared, which is now being resubmitted in a significantly revised version. The author focuses his presentation entirely on the network theme. The chapters Website creation and web server operation are completely omitted, for this the network operating systems get increased attention. Wireless LAN, client configuration, DHCP and security aspects are dealt with sufficiently for entry. Also cables, adapters and other network accessories get more attention. The initially loose language design increasingly differs a sober and emphasized objective style. Private users who want to network their domestic PCs are not addressed here. The predecessor band should run out, older issues are ready to be deleted. Besides Axel Schemberg (BA 9/04) and Klaus Dembowski (B/05).
content.title_en: Networks for Dummies : [Set up and administer networks ; perfect security in the network ; for Windows, Novell, Linux and Mac OS]

content.text: Myth Net: Communication beyond space and time?. From the futurists to the Internet. The "network" is omnipresent, and not only in the form of the Internet. According to a popular utopia, the network is supposed to lift space and time and, instead of the cities sinking into chaos, it is supposed to become a new home or a universal key for the world. This book shows that such expectations overburden the concept. It puts it in the context of programming such as futurism, which already declared the death of space and time a century ago, and explains what they fail to do: that technology, because it is always realized in space and time, can never lift it up, but merely restructures it. Rainer Fischbach illuminates the metaphor that today surrounds the term "network", as well as the hopes that from it are to be linked to a knowledge society, in the net and market melt together. From the technological and economic structural determinants of network-like infrastructures of traffic and communication, he directs the prognosis that the spatial, but also the social counter-sets are not explained in the opposite.
content.title_en: Myth Net : Communication beyond space and time?

content.text: Social policy in Germany: historical development and international comparison. A comparative analysis of German social policy from the founding of the German Reich to the situation in united Germany; with a presentation of the effects of social policy in the sense of a cost-benefit analysis. (LK/WIT: von Grote) New edition of the textbook on social policy from the authorship of the Heidelberg political scientist (last BA 8/98). Part 1 deals with the historical development in Germany from the beginning of Bismarck's social legislation to a well-founded presentation of the measures of the red-green coalition. Part 2 deals with the historical development and current position of state social policy in the international comparison. Part 3 deals with the social effects of social policy. Statistical data are available at 2005 and the list of literature was also extended until 2005. (2)
content.title_en: Social policy in Germany : historical development and international comparison
Optical production : standards

content.text: Room signs : Architecture and communication design. Orientation system, guidance system - signposts to culture: museums, exhibitions and antiquities. Orientation in the masses: airports, fairs and stadiums. Corporate design for society. Inforamtion in public space.
content.title_en: Room signs : Architecture and communication design

content.text: Natura 2000 in Germany. This CD-ROM gives a comprehensive overview of the contribution to the European Natura 2000 network and the implementation of the European Union's nature conservation guidelines for the first time.
content.title_en: Natura 2000 in Germany

content.text: Management of area-related integrative district development: approaches in Copenhagen and Vienna compared to the implementation of the programme "Social City" in German cities. In many European countries - as in Germany in the framework of the federal-state programme "Social City" - procedures of integrative district development are used. The necessary innovative management and organisational forms in particular of the cities of Copenhagen and Vienna seem to be comparable at first glance with approaches in German programme areas. However, in detail there are also differences which - beyond country-specific specificities - interesting "irritation areas" for the discussion about the further development of the "Social City" give. The volume contains the results of document analyses as well as above all expert interviews, which were conducted at the beginning of 2005 with actors of the district development in Copenhagen and Vienna at the administrative level, on site and in the intermediate area. Thus, a detailed, quite critical picture of the implementation of integrative district development in the two cities could be drawn.
content.title_en: Management of territorially-related integrative urban development : approaches in Copenhagen and Vienna compared to the implementation of the "Social City" programme in German cities

content.text: Joomla! : Websites are organized and designed with the Open Source CMS. Joomla! is a content management system based on PHP. It is a split of the open source project Mambo, from which the developer team has distanced itself from internal querels. Therefore, in large parts the functionality corresponds to that of Mambo in the current version. The further development of the system is currently difficult to estimate, because it is not clear how large the amount of supporting users and developers will be. The version Joomla! 1.0 was released only in September 2005. It could be that Mambo is completely replaced by Joomla - or even not. Courageous people get a useful introduction to the topic with the book. Less courageous people can still wait a bit and observe how the market is developing. In addition, one must always bear in mind that in the open source area alone, besides Mambo/Joomla, a large number of other competitors are seeking market shares (the most common one is currently type03).
content.title_en: Joomla! : Organize and design websites with the Open Source CMS

content.text: Synergetics in Psychology : Understanding and shaping self-organization. The book offers a comprehensive presentation of synergetics, i.e. the science of complex self-organizing systems, in psychology. The volume not only presents the theoretical foundations of self-organization in a comprehensive way, but also numerous empirical research results. Moreover, the latest scientific findings of neuroscience and psychology are integrated, with a broad spectrum of psychological basic functions such as motorism and perception, over memory, decision processes, personality and self, psychoneuroimmunology, psychotherapy, dyadical and group interactions, up to management and organizational development. Philosophical questions and science and/or epistemological problems are also discussed. Furthermore, numerous methods of nonlinear time series analysis are introduced. - A didactic special feature is the enclosed DVD, which contains visual material such as film sections, computer simulations and color graphics. The volume is the product of creative cooperation between a world renowned theoretical physicist, who is also the founder of synergetics, with a psychological researcher and system theoretician. The book provides the 21st century of fascination and the cross-generation of psychology.
content.title_en: Synergetics in Psychology : Understanding and Designing Self-Organization

content.text: Cultural history of climate : from the ice age to global warming. After a brief introduction to the development of climate in the history of the earth to the occurrence of the
content.title_en: Cultural history of the climate : from the ice age to global warming

content.text: The author provides a comprehensive overview of the various categories of electrically driven models from many years of experience. He demonstrates in an exemplary way where energy losses occur in the drive chain from battery to propeller (or impeller) and how they can be minimized. Where deeper penetration into the material is indicated, the author does not sting with explanatory graphics and images. A versatile guide, equally interesting for the newcomer as well as for already advanced electro-flyers Verlagstext: The author provides a comprehensive overview of the various ranges of electrically driven models from long-term experience. He demonstrates in an exemplary way where energy losses occur in the drive chain from battery to propeller (or impeller) and how they can be minimized. Where deeper penetration into matter is indicated, the author does not stinge with explanatory graphics and images. A versatile guide, equally interesting for the newcomer as well as for advanced electric flyers.
content.title_en: Electric Flight Guide

content.text: There you can fall for a paradise: the garden landscapes of Prince Pückler. Klappentext: An opulent picture book about the incomparable garden creations of the world's bummler Prince Pückler. Prince Hermann von Pückler-Muskau (1785 to 1871) was one of the most dazzling people of his time. He became world famous with his castle parks Branitz, Muskau and Babelsberg, which are now UNESCO cultural heritage and on which he worked for almost 30 years: entire villages disappeared, rivers were diverted, mountains were thrown up - a landscape full of contrasts and surprises emerged. Matthias Körner roams through Pückler's parks, shows unusual views of botanical art pieces. Thomas Kläber's brilliant photographs complement this volume, which is an ideal guide for all lovers of garden art.
content.title_en: There you can fall on a paradise : the garden landscapes of Prince Pückler

content.text: History of the engineer: a profession in six millennia. A successful and comprehensive overview of the history of the engineering profession from the early high cultures to today. Both the fields of activity and the social position of the engineer and his attitude to contemporary events and politics are examined in a differentiated way. (Heidi Debschütz) The technological development of a civilization has always influenced the course of its history in a significant way, and thus the profession of the engineer has a certain key role in world history. In this book, published for the 150th anniversary of the VDI, the history of the engineering profession is comprehensively and differentiated by renowned representatives of the history of technology, from the early high cultures to today. The division is chronological in itself, but splits itself where it is important (e.g. in the illumination of the German and French engineering industry in contrast to the British-American from 1750-1945), and even on the German-German differences after the Second World War.
content.title_en: History of the engineer: a profession in six millennia

content.text: The "Baulaien" (private builder and real estate owner as well as administrators and professional groups who have to deal with the topic without any training in the construction field) is very clearly designed lexicon on the subject of construction. The definitions are kept intelligible accordingly. Many entries are additionally illustrated by pictures (mostly photos, some with graphic markings) which unfortunately have a somewhat colour-stitched colour. Since the title is hardly addressed to legal regulations and standards, a relatively long life is predicted. Before all technical reference works (e.g. "Baulexikon", BA 3/01). (1 A)
content.title_en: Construction Lexicon

content.text: The instructions refer to the following topics: lighting equipment for locomotives and wagons, track-set signal, turnout and signal control, installation of video cameras in model vehicles. To facilitate the reproduction of the circuits, the circuit layouts are printed in the appendix. The many pages of extensive criticism of existing control systems of the different manufacturers are exhausting and the argumentation for a "compatible control system" according to the author's ideas is as unnecessary as it is unrealistic. The construction instructions themselves pass by the needs of the model railway hobby and can only be realized by model railroads who have appropriated their electronic skills. In short: for a special target group for the inventory supplement. (3)
content.title_en: Vehicle electronics in model

content.text: Basic course Programming with Visual Basic : the basics of programming - simple, understandable and with easy to understand examples; [with online service to the book]. Visual Basic is an easy to learn programming language, which is mainly used for applications of the Microsoft platform. The presented language constructs apply to VB 6.0 and VB.NET as well as to VBA. No longer is the version "Visual Basic 2005" published last November included. The present introduction with its well-intelligible examples, is suitable not only for the university area but also for students in the Computer Science course. With this new edition (1st edition: BA 11/03) an editorial revision of all chapters is accompanied by a complete revision of the chapter. In addition to some minor addition, the chapter of "event-oriented programming" has been completely revised and significantly extended. In addition, additional exercise tasks have been added for all chapters, the solutions of which can be retrieved on the Internet. The legibility of the screenshots, which are now being enlarged, has been improved.
content.title_en: Basic course Programming with Visual Basic : the basics of programming - simple, understandable and with easy to understand examples ; [with online service to the book]

content.text: Quantitative research : a practical course. All prospective social scientists need basic knowledge and practice-oriented practice in the methods of quantitative social research. This application-oriented textbook introduces the necessary steps into the basic questions of empirical social research and explains the research process at all stages of its development. The focus is on social science practice, the analysis and translation of data with SPSS. - Basic problems empirical social research - Phases of the research process - From the research question to data collection - The survey as dominant survey method - Data preparation with SPSS - Data evaluation with SPSS
content.title_en: Quantitative research : a practical course

content.text: Consummatus: [Roman]. In her second novel, the author, born in 1954, who is the recipient of the Ingeborg Bachmann Prize 1998, sends her protagonists to the realm of the dead, who make themselves known to him as invisible companions of the human being. (Ronald Schneider) After two experimental stories and a surprisingly conventionally told novel ("Montgomery": BA 6/03), the 1954-born author, who is the recipient of the Ingeborg Bachmann Prize 1998, presents a daring and ambitious narrative construction. The novel describes a day in the life of a school teacher from Stuttgart who has been over 50 years old, but who, in a café, with many drinks, and on a long walk, recapitulates his life and keeps his dialogue with "his dead". Years ago, he had lost the great love of his life and was following her - like Orpheus - into the realm of the dead, but without being able to lead her life again. And since then, the dead are his companions and invisible dialogue partners, who have not yet been able to understand the mythical things that are spoken by him.
content.title_en: Consummatus : [Roman]

content.text: Openings: from design to execution. The authors (last BA 6/02) deal with the building element window with its constructive and design peculiarities. Introducing the history of the window and its associated glass production since the Middle Ages, as well as the structural and technical requirements of the window construction. The main part offers an example collection with window openings in solid houses and in elemental facades. Examples of designs are shown in single-family and multi-family houses, office buildings, a school, a boarding school or a library in Spain - mainly new buildings, but also solutions for extensions or renovations are included. Each project is presented with text, constructive drawings, exterior and interior photographs. Previously without direct comparison titles. Cf. on the topic window and others by M. Schrader: "Window, glass and fittings as historical building material" (BA 9/01), "Window, door, facade technology" (Europa-Verlag, BA 3/04), A. Wagner "Bactiv ..." (BA/01) (3).
content.title_en: Openings : from design to execution

content.text: The Depron book : Models, construction tips, flying. The foam Depron, which is used primarily as insulation material, is also excellent for the construction of light flight models. Schulte has already shown in his book "Remotely controlled flight models made of light foam" (BA 11/04) how to build model aircraft with "Depron". Here the reader learns everything he needs to know about the material Depron and its correct processing for the construction of own flight models. Extensive descriptions of the construction techniques for hull, wings and control unit are given. Tips for installing remote control, chassis and drive. A short overview is also given of 3 modular models from Depron. In the annex there are construction instructions with short construction plans for the construction of 5 own constructions. Due to the growing importance of Depron as a building material for flight models, it is recommended everywhere. (1)
content.title_en: The Depron Book : Models, Building Tips, Flying

content.text: DATA BECKER's practical manual of astronomy with the PC: [Guides for the top astronomy programs; professional recording and editing of sun, planets and deep sky photos]. For amateur astronomers there are numerous programs that help to prepare and evaluate observations, to remotely control telescopes from the PC, to create astro photos by means of built-in webcam or digital reflex camera, to optimize them or to create animations from them. The author, versed amateur astronomer, presents the most important programs (all available as freeware on the Internet, as a commercial example Photoshop Elements) with numerous illustrations and screenshots in detail. To take real advantage of the book, one should be familiar with telescope and PC, experience in hardware based is also helpful. Comparable titles are few, as data collection should be referred to Antonius Schrode (BA 7/02) or Redshift (version 5: BA 4/04; 5.1 without significant innovations: BA 6/05), as program compilations Bernd Müller (BA 5/96) or Frank P. Thielen (BA 11/97), very useful for the last hobby, but very useful for the last hobby.
content.title_en: DATA BECKER's Practical Guide to Astronomy with the PC: [Instructions for the Top Astronomy Programs; Professionally Record and Edit Solar, Planet and Deep Sky Photos]

content.text: Houses and courtyards in Lübeck : historical, archaeological and architectural contributions to the history of the Hanseatic city in the late Middle Ages and in the early modern era / for the Office for the Conservation of Monuments of the Hanseatic City of Lübeck ed. by Rolf Hammel-Kiesow ; Vol. 7: The municipal brewing industry and its buildings from the Middle Ages to the early modern era : Studies on the development, equipment and topography of the brew houses in the Hanseatic City of Lübeck. In some 180, some brew houses still preserved today, brewing was brewed in Lübeck for inner-city consumption and especially for export beer. Based on archival sources and structural historical findings, the author succeeds in a complete reassessment of the Lübeck brewing industry, which has been underestimated in its importance so far.
content.title_en: Houses and courtyards in Lübeck : historical, archaeological and architectural contributions to the history of the Hanseatic city in the late Middle Ages and early modern times / for the Office for the Conservation of Monuments of the Hanseatic City of Lübeck ed. by Rolf Hammel-Kiesow ; Vol. 7: The municipal brewing industry and its buildings from the Middle Ages to the early modern era : Investigations on the development, equipment and topography of the brewhouses in the Hanseatic City of Lübeck

content.text: PIC microcontroller programming. Books on the use of microcontrollers, e.g. for measuring, controlling and rules, have been published in large numbers by Franzis Verlag (last W. Trampert: ID 44/04; D. Kohtz: ID 4/03). However, these books are mostly aimed at committed practitioners and require considerable prior knowledge. The present book offers an interesting alternative. It deliberately addresses beginners and sets the basis for a variant of Basic when programming. In particular, the interaction of hardware and software is to be interpreted. The examples are the generally available board iL-TROLL-TB (reference sources in the annex) as well as the preprogrammed component iL-TROLL. Further software can be downloaded from the Internet. The simple examples can be easily varied for own purposes. Likewise, a simple transmission to any microcontroller is possible. The structure of the examples is accompanied by several function tests, which convey an additional security feeling. - The authors agree to answer readers' requests via email at any time. (2).
content.title_en: PIC microcontroller programming

content.text: In the age of online research, too, a practical introduction to archive work is indispensable, and it is necessary to find specific sources in a targeted and quick manner. In addition to an overview of the German archive landscape, this volume contains a comprehensive guide for practical work in the archive including case studies. It offers in particular those concrete help that have little or no experience in dealing with archives. The introduction to archive use gives a historical overview of the emergence of the German archive landscape, which is characterized by heterogeneity, before the practical main part is devoted entirely to the work in the archive. Preparation for the archive visit, order systems and research strategies, which are illustrated in case studies, dealing with archive materials, legal questions, source science and questions of conservation are some of the topics covered. References to career perspectives, a glossary and useful Internet addresses round the book. The guide addresses both to any potential archive user and especially as an "archiv Praktic companion" to students and career entrants of various intellectual and historical disciplines. In addition to the "greyed" article in the "English" article on archive.
content.title_en: Introduction to modern archive work

content.text: Introduction to the New Testament contemporary history. Bernd Kollmann explains the historical background of the New Testament, without which a deeper understanding of the Bible is not possible. Political and social relations (also the relationship between the sexes) are as much a topic as the religious and philosophical schools of the five centuries around Christ's birth. An indispensable book for students and interested lay people.
content.title_en: Introduction to the New Testament Contemporary History

content.text: Energy Saving Regulation Step by step : Residential buildings, non-residential buildings, explanations, examples, Excel calculation sheets. The new European Buildings Directive requires an "proof of the energy performance" of buildings, which is largely covered by EnEV in Germany. However, the Directive goes beyond this and also requires an energy certificate to be issued when selling or renting. This also requires energy certificates to be drawn up for existing buildings. The new European Buildings Directive requires an "proof of the energy efficiency" of buildings, which is largely covered by EnEV in Germany. However, the Directive goes beyond this and also requires an energy certificate to be issued when selling or renting.
content.title_en: Energy Saving Regulation Step by step : Residential buildings, non-residential buildings, explanations, examples, Excel calculation sheets

content.text: The industrial heritage of Lower Austria: History - Technology - Architecture. Lower Austria houses one of the oldest industrial landscapes in Europe and has a rich industrial heritage. This is the task of industrial archaeology, which deals with the remains of the industrial age and tries to reconstruct the multi-faceted industrial society from the traces and the legacy of industrial activity. Since the emerging transformation from the industrial to communication society, industrial cultural research has gained a special place in the context of historiography. As a basic area of responsibility for industrial archaeology and industrial monument preservation, inventory captures the material remains that, as documents of the industrial age, provide an understanding of its current production processes and working conditions. This publication is the result of a comprehensive inventory of industrial buildings and traffic facilities in the province of Lower Austria. Introducing the development of industrial monument maintenance in Austria is outlined, the history and method of industrial archaeology is told in the catalogue conceived as a manual, which contains about 1,000 objects of the industrial heritage from A (like Absberg) to Zwetch, a comprehensive glossary is presented in the context of the history of the production mill and the history of the history of the history of the history of the history of the industry.
content.title_en: The Industrial Heritage of Lower Austria : History - Technology - Architecture

content.text: The environmental status is measured using the indicators soil sealing and green volume. In continuation of the research line "Spatial performance and ecological quality" methodological approaches for the protection and development of urban ecological quality have been investigated. The empirical studies were carried out in the 116 circular cities on the basis of an object model "City" which includes both two-dimensional (sealed open area, green and water area) and three-dimensional elements (vegetation and buildings). The focus is on the impact relationships between land use structures, green area shares and area-specific green volume. Furthermore, the typical ecological performance properties, the structural location values of the cities and the resulting strategic orientation values in the field of land use are interesting for the city-specific urban area level of the core city and city-specific urban quality. The results are stochastic models of the area-specific green volume for the spatial area area of the urban area of the city.
content.title_en: Impact of urban use structures on green areas and green volumes

content.text: Hydropolis: Water and the city of modern times. Stiff waste water in urban underground or crystal clear water in the local bath - a functioning wastewater disposal is just as indispensable in the modern city as a good water supply. The use of water since the 19th century investigates here among others geographers, sociologists, medical and environmental historians. They describe the changes in social and spatial structures in the cities as well as the political regulations of water use. Whether shrinking East German cities, major cities such as Berlin or megacities like Lagos and Jakarta: The handling of water proves to be the key to the understanding of modern city culture. With contributions by Matthias Bernt, Jürgen Büschenfeld, Elisabeth Heidenreich, Detlev Ipsen, Ulrich Koppitz, Shahrooz Mohajeri, Engelbert Schramm, Eric Swyngedouw, Heinrich Tepasse and Karin Winklhöfer.
content.title_en: Hydropolis : Water and the city of modernism

content.text: Liquifications: Ways and detours from the welfare state to the cultural society. The experts of change live and work in science and art. We would have badly needed their contributions at a time when the outlines of the knowledge society are only beginning to emerge, in which our country faces many problems of change, for example on the labour market. But the boundaries between politics and culture are frozen. Adrienne Goehler challenges: Let us liquefy them so that more movement comes into change!
content.title_en: Liquidation: Paths and detours from the welfare state to the cultural society

content.text: Database development in IT professions: a practical introduction with MS Access and MySQL; [with online service to the book]. Database systems play an important role in managing larger data volumes. The author gives a practical introduction in this book for trainees in IT professions. But also for students of the upper level with the subject area computer science the book is well applicable. The focus is on the presentation of basic concepts, basic contexts and concepts, not so much on the creation of complex databases. Thus, in the theoretical part, explanations about query languages are deliberately kept scarce. All exercises and examples refer to Microsoft Access 2002 for Windows and MySQL 5.0.18, based on a Linux operating system (distribution: Fedora 5.0). A large detailed example is the school administration of a professional upper level. On this example, numerous exercises are then put on (member management in the sports club, customer database of a car house, ...).
content.title_en: Database development in IT professions : a practical introduction with MS Access and MySQL ; [with online service to book]

content.text: Balnea : The history of the architecture of the bath. The Enlightenment produced a new type of building: the bath house. After the low level of body care in the 17th century, bathing was rediscovered in standing and flowing water. For the changed conception of hygiene based on new medical findings and for a more conscious body culture, buildings were designed in which the bath was celebrated. Bathing ships, designs for bath houses and the sea baths on the North and Baltic Seas that emerged in the 18th century offered the architects the opportunity to train completely new types of space and construction. - Around the mid-19th century, these luxury baths reserved for the wealthy strata followed the public washing and bathing facilities for the poor urban population. For the first time, BALNEA presents these and other architectural aspects of the bath in summary form of a summary. - - BALNEA appears as a companion publication to the exhibition of the same name, which in a unique way illustrates important stations of the bath architecture of the 17th to early 20th century, with models and historical material.
content.title_en: Balnea : architectural history of the bath

content.text: Basic course on statistics in the social sciences : an easy to understand, application-oriented introduction to the social science necessary statistical knowledge. This successful textbook is intended for social scientists who want to gain the basic knowledge necessary for them in a course of the scope of a semester. It covers: - uni- and bivariate distribution parameters - detailed correlation measures for nominal, ordinary and interval-scaled variable-normal, chi2-, and binomial distribution - inference statistics so far that confidence intervals and significance of correlations can be calculated. It works with: - economical handling of exact mathematical formulations - many graphics, tables and interpretations of original output of the statistics program SPSS - many examples from the nationwide representative scientific survey ALLBUS
content.title_en: Basic course on statistics in the social sciences : an easy to understand, application-oriented introduction to the necessary statistical knowledge for social science

content.text: Report 2005 Transnational cooperation. The report presents the activities and networks in the five cooperation areas with German participation (Alpine, CADSES, North Sea, North-West Europe, Baltic Sea region). It also contains intensive cross-cooperation cross-area comparisons and proposes possible improvements to transnational cooperation in a future funding period. The report thus provides for the first time a comprehensive assessment of the results of transnational cooperation on spatial development in the framework of INTERREG IIIB (source: Verlag).
content.title_en: Report 2005 Transnational cooperation

content.text: Statistics with Excel for practitioners : Prepare and present statistics. Practically oriented entry-level book for statisticians with basic Excel knowledge, which shows how to create and present statistical evaluations with the powerful spreadsheet program Excel. (Simone Roth) Every day we are confronted with statistics, whether in work, study or private. The well-known computer book author H.-D. Radke wants to explain the topic of statistics with his new book in such a way that one does not need to understand advanced mathematics knowledge. Target group are practitioners who have to do with numbers in companies, and trainees, to whom he mainly wants to show how to create statistical evaluations with the powerful spreadsheet program Excel and then present them. In 8 chapters the following topics are dealt with in a comprehensible way: statistical investigations, determination of statistical measures, basics of probability calculation, probability distributions, samples, trends, presentation and application of statistics in operation. The well-explained, comprehensible practical examples are mainly chosen from the field of operational statistics. In the appendix, there is also a formula collection and a glossary for the use of the basics of statistics.
content.title_en: Statistics with Excel for practitioners : Prepare and present statistics

content.text: Anti-Semitism as a political weapon: Israel, America and the abuse of history. The author, Professor of Political Theory in Chicago, is known for his sharp criticism of Israeli politics against the Palestinians and the treatment of the Holocaust, cf. "The Holocaust Industry" (BA 5/01) and "The Conflict between Israel and the Palestinians" (BA 12/02). His new book reveals in part 1 how the accusation of anti-Semitism is used to de-avoue critics of Israel, mostly in the USA, but also in Europe. Part 2 is a detailed discussion with A. Dershowitz' "Plädoyer für Israel" (ID 22/05), who sought to expose all accusations against Israel as prejudices. Its undifferentiated, important sources ignore views especially on the human rights question (folder and similar) Finkelstein convincingly refutes with investigation results of Amnesty International and B'Tselem, an Israeli human rights organization that has existed since Intifada 1989. With an impressive preface by Felicia Langer, Finkel has to present the alternative, which has to pay a counter price.
content.title_en: Anti-Semitism as a political weapon : Israel, America and the abuse of history

Has been extended and revised by about 60 pages and 130 entries compared to the first edition 2000 (BA 9/00); the literature information has apparently remained unchanged. The work is initially also usable for technically interested laypersons. The old edition can be used up, should be supplemented with this new edition. (2 A)

The individual learning fields each include comprehensive, practical project tasks. Topics of the subject levels include: covering a steep roof, finishing a flat roof, performing metal coverings. Waiting and repairing a roof etc. The contents of technology, technical mathematics and technical drawing are taught together. Overviewally, 2-column and colored with numerous photos and illustrations, chapter summaries and exercise tasks (without solutions). With annex to overarching topics such as recycling, construction physics, work safety. As the training contents of the construction occupations in the basic level are broadly identical, the learning fields 1, 3-6 are from "Lernfeld Bautechnik - Basic level" (included BA 7/02).
content.title_en: Learning Field Construction Technology - Basic and advanced level roofing : with many examples, project-related and action-oriented tasks ...

The tasks are formulated in practice, which is also expressed in the drawing presentation of the constructive situation and the addition of tasks by information available in practice on the solution of the tasks.

Also on radio certificates, but does not replace a test book, offers the general technical foundations. Is supplemented by a glossary, (less enclosed) maps about coastal radio stations, a German-English vocabulary and others. Overall a very rich, by the structure not very clear compilation, which replaces the meanwhile outdated manual of R. Brannolte (BA 10/92). (3)

content.text: Google's challenge: for a European library. Dispute for a European, non-commercial alternative to "Google book search", which highlights the overwhelming influence of American publishers and culture and also highlights the librarian aspects. (Olaf Kaptein) Jeanneney, president of the French National Library, is about the company of the well-known search engine, which is now under the name Google book search ("book search" on the German site), digitizing 15,000,000 printed books and putting all copyright-no longer protected titles on the net for free. With all sympathy for such a cultural act, he fears the increasing predominance of English at the expense of all other European languages in addition to the Google effect (the most visited pages bring the greatest advertising revenues) the preference for American culture, the overpowerful influence of American publishers, the US-American dominance of published research results and last, but not least the increasing predominance of English at the expense of all other European languages. This dispute for a European, non-commercial alternative, which also raises the library aspects, has the positive tendency to a cultural-political essay.
content.title_en: Google's challenge : for a European library

content.text: Computer game addicts? : Advice and help. More cautious and differentiated than with W. Bergmann (BA 1/07) the findings about the prematurely diagnosed use of relevant offers as computer or internet game addiction. The experts of the Interdisciplinary Addiction Research Group Berlin provide professional and parents in specialist departments and measures a picture of the causes, effects and intervention possibilities of excessive computer games (where the question of the content or quality of the games is subordinate here). The authors bring developmental psychological findings and consider computer game addiction, similar to other substance-unbound addiction forms, as a behavioural addiction with corresponding fault images. Here they emphasize that flat-rateizations (e.g. the assumed connection between excessive computer use and increased willingness to use violence) undermine existing positive aspects of computer games, e.g. as creative incentive to work.
content.title_en: Computer game addict? : Advice and help

content.text: The Eclipse codebook: 182 tips, tricks and solutions for Eclipse-specific problems. Eclipse is a development platform developed by IBM and is highly adaptable by a special plugin architecture. Eclipse is particularly important for programming Java applications. The author is known for its introductions to working with Eclipse (last ID 49/05 - Eclipse 3.1 and Java 5). The present book is a good addition to this. It offers solutions in the form of about 180 templates for frequently occurring programming questions. The templates can be used as building blocks in your own programming and easily modified for your own needs. It is also important that the author not only treats the use of Eclipse as a pure development tool. Also the use of the Eclipse platform as a program framework and workflow environment for your own plugins and so-called RCP applications (RCP = Rich Client Platform) is discussed in detail. Good knowledge in Java 5 is required by the reader. On accompanying CD all templates of the book as well as Eclipse 3.1 for Windows and OS 3.1 for Windows.
content.title_en: The Eclipse Codebook : 182 Tips, Tricks and Solutions for Eclipse-specific Problems

content.text: The change of war: from symmetry to asymmetry. Herfried Münkler describes the change from the classical war between states to new forms of war, in which sub-state actors have become the challengers of the former war monopolist state. With this change not only the security political arrangements have changed, but also the international regulations relating to the classical war of states have lost power. Instead, a confrontation of concepts of the >just war < with those of >holy war < has taken place.
content.title_en: The Change of War : From Symmetry to Asymmetry

This will only be possible if the alternatives to petrol and diesel can be provided in sufficient quantities, which is in question. Based on the current level of knowledge about chemical properties, technical potential and the resulting cost structures, the analysis allows an assessment of the suitability of alternative fuels and drive concepts.

content.text: Football, fashion, flat screens: the latest generation of plastics. The author is a chemist and science journalist. In this book the author of the latest generation of plastics is devoted to. It is really amazing that there is no further, extremely popular scientific literature about this highly exciting area, since the topic has a very close connection to normal everyday life. Such headlines as "With special foils against vandalism in transport", "Fest like steel, but six times lighter" or "Textiles with built-in cosmetic case" arouse curiosity. The black and white illustrations are however not consistently of good quality and expressiveness. Recommended for interested lay people. content.text: The secret media revolution: how weblogs, wikis and free software are changing the world. Media means power. Can the Internet Bertelsmann, Time Warner and Rupert Murdoch become dangerous? Large companies are also trying to capitalize the new media, but other rules of the game apply in the global, decentralized communication network.On the basis of free software, which can be changed and copied by everyone free of charge, completely new media forms are emerging. Millions of online posters called "Weblogs" complement the classical media landscape with independent voices. First experiments with clever financing models show that on this basis true journalism is possible. At the same time thousands of volunteers work on open knowledge databases such as the gigantic encyclopedia Wikipedia. A convergence of wikis and weblogs is emerging. Massive online collaboration in the fields of news, knowledge, art and culture seems inevitable or already takes place. The revolutionary potential of the Internet, which was exaggerated, then mocked, takes on contours. This book captures the current state of development, ventures a careful look into the future and provides the necessary basic knowledge for direct participation of the media world.
content.title_en: The Secret Media Revolution: How Weblogs, Wikis and Free Software Change the World

content.text: The modern city: sociological considerations on urban planning. The book is a classic of German urban sociology. Based on the criticism of conservative urban critique, Hans-Paul Bahrdt develops the basics of his theory on the polarization of public and private life as the basis for a sociological concept of city. Based on this he develops a critique of the industrial city of the 1960s up to ideas on urbanization of the city. His intellectual theoretical statements have not only influenced the social science debate on urban life, but have also had a major influence on urban planning and urban planners in recent decades.

content.text: The district of North Rhine-Westphalia has an unusually rich and diverse stock of historical housing and workers' settlements, which are characteristic as testimonies for historical living and living forms, have monument value and are mostly integrated components of mines, production sites and similar workplaces. The Rhineland has with the workers' settlement in Oberhausen-Eisenheim the oldest preserved workers' settlement in Germany, a before the middle of the 19th century from simply lined brick buildings on scarcely space arranged, which set equally bourgeois as well as political sign. Also in the North Rhine-Westphalian monument protection law of 1980 settlements and the objects important for the development of the labor and production relations are explicitly mentioned as worthy of preservation. Already earlier, since 1971, the Rhine Office for the maintenance of monuments has been dealing with the problems of the district of Rhineland. Today, the settlement of the district of Rhineland is a firmly established area of preservation of the Rhine as a place of occupation.

content.text: Foreign direct investment and regional industrial clusters in Central and Eastern Europe. In recent years, the economies in the new EU accession countries have developed into a sought-after investment goal. Although only about 5-6 % of German direct investment flows to Central and Eastern Europe, the book shows that this region remains interesting even after the accession of 8 countries to the EU in 2004. From a business perspective, investments in this economic area are successful because taxes, labour costs, working hours, the investment climate and the legal framework offer attractive conditions. Direct investment has improved the technological level of these countries. This makes it possible for the companies based there to serve not only domestic markets but also the world market. The volume illustrates that foreign direct investment is not a homogeneous entity. They take place in different practical forms (Greenfield investment, Merger & Acquisition). In this respect, different effects of direct investment have their origin in different forms. For the inflow of direct investment, regional industry is a  even more decisive factor.
content.title_en: Foreign direct investment and regional industrial clusters in Central and Eastern Europe

content.text: The enlargement of the European Union, which took place on 1 May 2004, is considered a milestone in the process of overcoming the division of Europe and a significant step towards the political-institutional and economic integration of the countries of Europe. For the development of the European Union's eastern regions, the enlargement of the East brings new challenges at various levels of policy in cross-border contexts as well as new development conditions for the regions at the borders of the "old" EU and the new EU member states, as well as for regions in the "inner" of the old and new member states. With regard to the regional development in East Germany, which is characterized by structural weakness, labour market crisis and population migration outside the few growth islands, the enlargement of the EU east in recent years was considered primarily an additional risk factor of development, while the chances for regional development in East Germany were mostly neglected. These new development opportunities are, however, the focus of this volume of analysis. The focus of the work is on the areas of economy and the labour market, agricultural structures and rural areas, the cooperation in the region-related planning and in the new traffic-related countries.
content.title_en: Opportunities for EU enlargement to the East for East Germany

content.text: The Journey of the Beagle : Diary with explorations of the natural history and geology of the countries visited on the journey of HMS Beagle under the command of Captain Fitz Roy, RN. On 27 December 1831 Charles Darwin set out from England to the world round-up with the H.M.S. Beagle. Without the firelanders and the finches on Galapagos Darwin could not have developed his theory of the origin of the species. Darwin's account of his journey with the Beagle is not only the most important travel book of world literature, but also the adventurous chronicle of the wandering years of a young man who traveled the world to change it. The story of the birth of modern biology, brilliantly written with an introduction by Daniel Kehlmann. (2)
content.title_en: The Journey of the Beagle : Diary with explorations of the natural history and geology of the countries visited on the journey of HMS Beagle under the command of Captain Fitz Roy, RN.

A demand that is increasingly being made to web designers and developers is the barrier-free design of a website. The understandable guide has been divided into two main areas. In the 1st one explains what barriers exist and who they hinder, what accessibility means on the web and with what measures can be improved. After that, the user enters directly into the practical project: the analysis of the shortcomings of a specific website and the comprehensive conception and implementation of its barrier-free relaunch. Among other things, detailed description, which must be observed at the code and content level, the respective test possibilities and detailed explanation of the problematic use of PDF and Flash for this purpose. The book is not an introduction for beginners, but is not directed exclusively at web specialists. (2)
content.title_en: Barrier-free web design : make attractive websites accessible ; [takes into account detailed BITV ; real workshop from analysis to relaunch ; on the web: authentic practice project in the prior/after state]

content.text: Le Corbusier / Pierre Jeanneret : Semi-detached house in the Weißenhof settlement Stuttgart ; the history of a renovation. The double house, which Le Corbusier designed together with his cousin Pierre Jeanneret in 1927 for the Weißenhof settlement created in the context of the exhibition "Die Wohnung" is one of the outstanding architectural certificates of classical modernism. With the building, Le Corbusier implemented the objectives of his new architectural program: variable floor plans, high-rise of the ground floor by means of supports, roof terraces, continuous window bands and a free façade design. However, just after its construction and then again in the mid-1980s, the building was rebuilt and "modernized", whereby parts of the original were irrevocably lost. The aim of the measures carried out in the years 2003 to 2005 for the repair and restoration of the double house was to make the "Le Corbusier architecture" clear again and to regain the original architectural proportions and floating effect of the house. The present book describes the history of the house, presents the results of the building archaeological and architectural studies and informs about the individual measures for the renovation of the double house, now the opening house, since 1927, the exhibition of all visitors.
content.title_en: Le Corbusier / Pierre Jeanneret : Semi-detached house in the Weißenhofsiedlung Stuttgart ; the history of a repair

The present large-format book is a successful mix of project examples and practical information on the topic of conversion measures on existing buildings. It deals with reasons for conversions, conversions within the house, extensions and extension buildings, handling of the monument protection, characteristics and defects of building epochs, technical details of individual construction measures, preservation of building substance, improvement of thermal insulation, role of the builder, construction costs etc. The example projects are documented in detail with texts, interior and exterior, "before" and "after" photos and floor plan drawings, whereby the text information is in the foreground. The target group is all real estate owners who want to use an older house or an older apartment in a contemporary way or think about buying a used property. Recommendable next to O. Rau (BA 3/05), G. In the appendix, literary sources for the read, name register and a glossary are found. Only the design of the volume is not convincing. The cover illustration seems childlike and unhelpful. content.text: The threat: Roman. Since leaving his newspaper, where he had to answer the cultural pages, Loose has dedicated himself to his own writing projects: unfortunately without the hoped-for success. His wife Sabine has meanwhile taken over his post at the newspaper and earns the money. As he does, the books he has firmly planned are simply not finished. The invitation comes from a certain professor Maurer, whose career he had significantly promoted by the publication of some articles. Loose wants to cancel, but a newspaper article under the heading of the faits divers holds him back. There is the talk of a secret-swept forest, in which recently unexplainable things occurred, accumulated suicides. From this message he is magically attracted. He decides to accept the invitation and to take the journey, because this forest is located right next to the hotel, in which the botanical society will meet. content.text: Galileo's fingers: the ten great ideas of natural science. The author is otherwise more familiar to us through his chemistry-university textbooks, especially on physical chemistry (here last BA 8/02 and ID 24/02). However, it is not the first time that he writes for a wider audience. Thus, the well-known British scientist imaginatively and stimulatingly explains the periodic table in the example of a kingdom ("In the realm of elements", BA 7/00). The fact that only one finger has been preserved from Galileo's body brought Atkins to the idea for the title of his latest book. It is supposed to be a symbol of the finiteness of human existence in contrast to the intransigence of human knowledge. The author embarks on a journey with the reader through the "10 great ideas". He spans a bow by bringing the most important findings from physics, astronomy, chemistry, biology and mathematics into a context of evolution, DNA, energy, entropy, atom, symmetry, quantum, cosmology, space time and arithmetic. One little comparable to B/04-B.
content.title_en: Galileo's Finger: the Ten Great Ideas of Science

content.text: The future is a realistic view of the possibilities of the 21st century. The title of the book "Take a grip on the future" deliberately counter-acts the reform-trists that are currently prevailing in Germany, the ideology of the supposedly inevitable narrow buckle of the belt and the departure from a supposedly closed episode of the promises of happiness and welfare state illusions. Helmut Klages, one of the leading researchers on questions of change of values, makes it clear in this book that one can only see the real possible reality under the condition that one thinks exactly in the opposite direction, i.e. from a wealth of previously unimagined opportunities, which does not avert the boundary line between utopia and reality principle, but emphatically postpones, so that the departure into unforeseeablely expanded spaces of life-making can become the motto. The prerequisite, however, is the willingness to take action that is directed towards a goal- and situation-consciously based on the available potentials.
content.title_en: Take the future forward! : a realistic view of the possibilities of the 21st century

There are many books with tips on how to bring your own website far forward in the results of internet search engines. However, as the operators of the "search engines" do not disclose the methods of their placement (ranking), the result of strategies is uncertain, but often successful. Thus, the authors offer a good overview of well-known game rules and procedures of the big operators like Google. They also give very reasonable advice and warnings, even for smaller search engines. The volume is printed in relatively small but well-readable fonts and thus more informational than comparable ribbons (page numbers are completely unusable in this book sector for comparison). The registration with the large operators and link exchange with webrings and owners of other - as well known - websites are described in their own chapters, also mentions the offer of bonus games etc.

Well suited for self-study. - Sensual addition to the textbook of M. Reuter (ID 29/04). content.text: Large-format volume, which has developed into a standard structure on support systems since its first publication in 1967 (not presented here). Engraving difference to conventional textbooks: theory and calculations are largely omitted. The different types of support structures are presented in a basic classification. Their mechanisms, the structural design possibilities, the relationship between support structure and design are taught by detailed drawings. Target groups are architectural students, but also for students of civil engineering. Recommended for libraries with corresponding specialist audiences besides P. Kuff (ID 34/01) and conventional textbooks on support structure and structural statics, e.g. J. Stöffler (ID 14/03), G.C.O. Lohmeyer (last ID 4/03, ID 39/01) or F. Krauss (last ID 16/04/04). (3)

content.text: Challenge China: how the Chinese rise changes our lives. Klappentext: Every second camera sold worldwide, every third air conditioning system and every fourth TV comes from the middle. Whether shopping or refueling: the consequences of China's economic rise will be enormous and directly noticeable. And that's just the beginning: the People's Republic is on its way to a world power, first economically, then politically and militarily. In Europe, the USA and Japan, de-industrialization and thus mass unemployment as well as pollution will continue to advance. Prices on world markets, whether for oil or other raw materials, will explode. Whether consumers, workers or managers, we will all be more affected by the Chinese economic boom than we have been in the past.
content.title_en: Challenge China: how the Chinese rise changes our lives

content.text: The planet of slums. Mike Davis states in this ambitious and disturbing book a >>Copernican turn < < human settlement history. Because never before did the proportion of urban population exceed the proportion of those living in the country and never before did a tremendous number of over a billion people have been forced to survive in poverty, in the dirt of the garbage dumps, without (clean) water, without toilets, without any kind of health or social care. The megaslums of the south are an expression of a highly unequal and unstable urban world. Here the social fronts of globalization clash in a radical way. Davis traces the global formation of the informal settlements apostrophe in the 1960s as 'slums of hope' - from the 'big bang' of urban poverty in the course of the debt decade of the 1970s and 1980s to the present-day megaslums of Sadr City or Cape Flats. From the over-exploiting barricadas in Lima to the garbage, industrializing and decoupled in urbanization.
content.title_en: Planet of the slums

Therefore, this work is particularly suitable for students, doctoral students, professors and practitioners. The rules have not yet been laid down and have been compiled by the authors. It is highly recommended for libraries with student customers. (2)
content.title_en: Citation fib for lawyers

content.text: In this extensive book, musicologist K. Miehling underlines his thesis that violence music (pop, rock, rap, jazz, hiphop, heavy metal ...) is partly responsible for the increasing violence in our society. He supports this view with extensive and many quotations from song lyrics, musicians and music makers as well as music consumers. He gives detailed evidence on topics such as violence, sex, anarchy, hedonism, fraud, drugs or satanism. Further chapters cover "The Violence Music in Our Society" or "The Instrumentalization of Violence Music". The band also serves as a guide. Thus, legal and regulation texts on the topic of music noise are cited. In the appendix, a historical overview of the topic, a glossary, address list, a detailed literature directory and a register in which hardly a well-known pop group is missing. This expensive volume deals with a certainly neglected topic, whether "toral music" is to be essentially responsible for increased criminal behaviour, is more than worthy of discussion. (3) (L/S/S.)
content.title_en: Violence Music - Music violence : popular music and the consequences

content.text: The egoistic gene. A cost-effective paperback edition of the book, which was heavily discussed at the time of its publication (BA 11/78, 397), which presented the way of thinking in sociobiology to a broad audience. On the 2nd completed and revised reprint (BA 12/94), K. Bock wrote: "The ... edition should be part of the stock of any good public library.
content.title_en: The selfish gene

content.text: 10 golden rules for good ventilation, climate and comfort. The starting point of this collection was a symposium on indoor climate and comfort research. In their contributions, 10 well-known authors explain the essential foundations for optimal comfort and room air conditions in offices and other rooms. Among other things, room temperatures, perceived air quality, air flows, minimization of odours, psychological aspects of window opening by users, outdoor air intake, system conception, maintenance and inspection hygiene are addressed. A wide range of experts from planners, architects, building technicians, service staff, plant manufacturers - but also builders and affected office staff can get a compact entry into the current ventilation, air conditioning and comfort technology. With numerous illustrations, diagrams, tables as well as references to norms, guidelines and further literature. No direct comparison title. "Window ventilation and room climate" (ID 15/07) is broader and more comprehensive, H.-J. Moriske (BA 5/07) addresses indoor climate and health problems.
content.title_en: 10 golden rules for good ventilation, climate and comfort

content.text: Monasteries and Pencils in Schleswig-Holstein: 1200 years of history, architecture and art. The book of pictures and reference documents illuminates the cultural history of the local monasteries and pens, which were for a long time intellectual, cultural and economic centers of the region. Several architectural guides with a national reference are already available from the author, including a narrower (construction) history of the monasteries and pens in Itzehoe, Preetz, Schleswig and Uetersen. His new, well-developed and richly illustrated, large-format volume justifies the high price by the much more detailed presentation and the good equipment.
content.title_en: Monasteries and Pencils in Schleswig-Holstein : 1200 years of history, architecture and art

content.text: Automotive design and technology : Design, functionality, technology. Collection of contributions to the technology of industrial design in passenger cars in a specialist for engineers, students and sales professionals. Unlike "Automobil Design" (ID 2/06), no picture documentation or sample collection, but a basic, technology-oriented overview with an introductory section on history. Generous printed, with numerous, mostly small-format color illustrations. In the appendix glossary and a list of image examples. Solidly worked, with numerous further references, sometimes a bit smooth in the formulations. Wide range of topics, with examples on Daimler-Benz, Chrysler, Opel and others. More detailed than "The drive to design" (ID 8/99). Not cheap. (3)
content.title_en: Automotive Design and Technology : Design, Functionality, Technology

content.text: Pro/ENGINEER Wildfire 3.0 for beginners - short and concise : Basics with exercises. Short introduction to basic CAD program Pro/Engineer Wildfire, which is aimed at 3-dimensional applications. Treats the program version 3.0 and is therefore more up-to-date than the workbook of P. Wyndorps (ID 29/04). Contains detailed examples of exercises (project tasks) with control questions and solutions and addresses students and engineers without any special knowledge. - For a wide professional reader group. (2)
content.title_en: Pro/ENGINEER Wildfire 3.0 for beginners - short and flush : Basics with exercises

content.text: Gender Geography : Gender and space as social constructions. Today, gender is also established in geography as an analysis category. Therefore, in this introductory volume of the series "Social Geography Compact" the essential theoretical foundations, the relevant methods and the most important research fields and research results are presented. Here, the focus is not on biological gender (Sex) but on gender, the social gender, which is produced as a category discursive and in everyday practice. A gender-related geography is devoted to the spatial aspects of gender roles and gender relations, describes and analyses the scope for action and restrictions through the constructs "femaleness" and "maleness" and discusses possibilities to change these often restrictive concepts. Many empirical examples provide an insight into German-speaking and international gender research in geography.
content.title_en: Gender Geography : Gender and Space as Social Constructions

content.text: Motorcycle technology: basics and concepts of engine, drive and chassis; with 21 tables. Publisher's text: The technology of today's motorcycles is highly complex and is in no way inferior to the technology of the automobile. Antidive, ABS, catalyst or low-cross-section/wide tires require explanations that are not yet summarized in any technical book. However, you do not have to be a car master or have studied mechanical engineering to understand the book. The author addresses experts and technical motorcyclists who want to know more than the operating instructions give. For this edition, the new mass compensation system of the BMW F800 as well as the air-spring damping system and the new ABS systems have been supplemented. The current additions to technical accessories for conversions for technical improvements and optimization of the own machine complete the innovations.
content.title_en: Motorcycle technology : basics and concepts of engine, drive and chassis ; with 21 tables

content.text: Methods of empirical social research. The "Atteslander" is the basic work for the introduction to the methods of empirical social research. The 11th edition is extended by new contents and also takes into account new electronic survey methods, e.g. surveys via the Internet. The bibliography is updated. A didactically well prepared textbook and workbook for students of all social science subjects as well as for teachers and practitioners.
content.title_en: Methods of empirical social research

content.text: Violence: descriptions, analyses, prevention. Despite all hopes, today's society is not non-violent. Rather, new forms of violence occur alongside the previous ones, others seem to disappear or experience a change of form. In order to cope with the complexity of one of the most difficult social phenomena, the contributions to current, future-relevant or previously neglected problem fields follow a specific rhythm of case study, analysis of the contexts and causes as well as subsequent comment. Based on this, prevention approaches to the prevention of violence are presented. With this connection from scientific knowledge and practical prevention work, the volume makes a new and further contribution to the understanding and limitation of violence.
content.title_en: Violence : descriptions, analyses, prevention

content.text: Model Flight ABC : Basics, Aerodynamics & Tips. This book deals with the basic principles of flying and aerodynamics. Why does an aircraft fly at all? How do model aircraft behave under different air and wind conditions? How does the control of a flight model work? What effects do different wing profiles have on flight characteristics? What is the character of a model with high flight stability? What is the significance of the propeller? These and similar questions are discussed by Martin Simons in this book and explained in a very simple and vivid way. With a great many drawings. The author published a roughly twice as comprehensive, basic title on the topic of "Aerodynamics flight model" (not discussed here) in the same publishing house a good 10 years ago. For all model makers who want to understand how a model aircraft flies and which functions the individual components fulfil, highly recommended. Only the price seems to be somewhat high in terms of the simple equipment (broschürt, only black and white illustrations). (1)
content.title_en: Model Flight ABC : Basics, Aerodynamics & Tips

content.text: The city is attacked by critical texts on the conception, planning and effect of integrated and non-integrated shopping centers in central locations. Publishing info: It is frightening. News about new urban shopping centres in planning or under construction soon come through the gazettes. In some cities, historical city plans are without hesitation destroyed, monuments are removed and the desertification of traditional shopping areas taken into consideration to make room for new shopping centers. Although there has been no growth in retail for years, further sales areas are constantly being created. It seems that these transformations are to be realized at any price, even if the loss of a city culture grown over the centuries is connected with this. In this volume, renowned architectural critics, urban sociologists, city planners, geographers, consultants, brokers and operators of shopping centers from a wide range of perspectives deal with this topic.
content.title_en: Attack on the City : critical texts for the conception, planning and effect of integrated and non-integrated shopping centers in central locations

content.text: Postfossil mobility: Signpost for the post- Peak Oil period. We are at the beginning of an epochal transformation from fossil transport to post-fossil mobility. This transition is inevitable and is now on the way. The book tells the story of this transition and describes 7 guiding plans that determine post-fossil mobility: energy efficiency, renewable energies, more efficient spatial and settlement structures with a new balance of proximity and distance, mobility opportunities for all (sustainability principle of generality), physical mobility for health and well-being, more mobility through the combination of digital services and transport, attractive and emotionally appealing design of post-fossil mobility in a self-affirming process.
content.title_en: Postfossil mobility: Signpost for the post- Peak Oil period

content.text: Introduction to the computer-based analysis of qualitative data: [lecture book]. The use of QDA software promises more efficiency and transparency of the analysis. This book provides an overview of these new working techniques, discusses the underlying methodological concepts (including the Grounded Theory and Qualitative Content Analysis) and gives practical guidance on implementation. The social-scientific analysis of qualitative data, the text and content analysis can be carried out very effectively with the support of computer programs. The use of QDA software promises more efficiency and transparency of the analysis. This book provides an overview of these new working techniques, discusses the underlying methodological concepts (including the Grounded Theory and Qualitative Content Analysis) and provides practical guidance on implementation
content.title_en: Introduction to computerized analysis of qualitative data : [lecture book]

content.text: Borders in Schleswig-Holstein's and Denmark's history. Klappentext: In 21 articles, the authors shed light on the topic of "borders" in a wide variety of ways: the temporal range ranges from the Bronze Age to the late 20th century and also thematically, there are various approaches. This ranges from political borders to scenic and economic borders to mental borders or taboos, from perception of borders to their meaning or drawing to crossing borders. Thus, this volume contains articles on constitutional and political boundaries to crossing travel or post-mortem photography.
content.title_en: Borders in the history of Schleswig-Holstein and Denmark

Information and literature research on the Internet. Personal material documentation.III Preparation of written scientific papers. Elements of written work. Creating the manuscript with a text processing program. Layout and typographical design.IV Proof of performance. Seminar protocol. Lecture (Seminar lecture) and presentation. Klausur. Hausarbeit, Abschlussarbeit. Muster Seiten.

content.text: Proseminar Geschichte: Mittelalter. Verlagsinfo: Das Standardwerk jetzt in der 3rd Auflage! The newly edited and updated "Proseminar Middle Ages" introduces the methods and working methods of historical science. The book presents contents and tasks of the subject, explains the character of typical types of representation and above all sources and brings to the attention of the handling of these materials, describes the historical method and the work of the source in its individual steps, introduces the most important auxiliary sciences, discusses the variety of possible question approaches and the problems of historical interpretation and provides sufficient bibliographical references to the usual work tools, integrated into the individual sections. The illustrations, graphics and sample texts facilitate the understanding of complex matter for the first time students.
content.title_en: Proseminar History: Middle Ages

content.text: The crisis and future of the welfare state. Hardly anyone denies that the welfare state is in a deep crisis, but is it also the crisis of the welfare state, or is it only the main cause of a development whose causes lie elsewhere? This book makes clear what issues and controversy are at stake in the discussion. His author establishes links between the development of the world market, demographic change and the strategies of influential groups of society and sheds light on the background to the various "reconstruction" concepts. The central part of the volume is a critical balance of red-green social policy, which is compared with that of the Kohl governments. Finally, the author discusses alternatives to social policy in Germany that have not been considered yet and takes a first look at the grand coalition.
content.title_en: Crisis and future of the welfare state
