content.text: The German North Sea coast is one of the most affected regions: whether and when adaptation measures are needed to rise sea levels are therefore an increasingly important question. The results of the explicitly interdisciplinary project Climate Change and Preventive Risk and Coast Management on the German North Sea Coast (KRIM) offer orientation and action knowledge for coastal protection in Germany, but also for dealing with climate impacts overall. The authors from oceanography, coastal protection, ecology, economics and sociology analyse the consequences of climate change on the basis of a climate scenario for the year 2050 and develop action options from it. The technical, economic and societal consequences of an implementation are discussed from the perspective of integrated risk management and, in conclusion, demand a national strategy for adaptation to climate change. The book thus lays a sound basis for the societal discourse on climate change and coastal protection.
content.title_en: Country below? : Climate change, coastal protection and risk management in North West Germany: the 2050 perspective

content.text: The Google Copy Paste Syndrome: like web plagiarism, it endangers education and knowledge. If about thirty percent of students admit that they are using text claps from the Internet, then something is running out of control. The currently rampant copy/paste mentality threatens the entire scientific text culture. A fundamental change in cultural technology is emerging: from their own idea and formulation to the "transversion of the brain" and the text editing of already existing segments in the web. "Text culture without brain" is the first German-language non-fiction book dedicated to copy/paste syndrome and the consequences of the Google Wikipedia knowledge monopoly.The author critically observes the rise of reality and the progressive exodus of the mind from text production. He asks how media science reacts to this problem - if anything -.A (text) culture without brain does not only provide a boost to net plagiarism: cyber-response or "Weblish", chat- and SMS-contaminated awareness, create a psychological-aidive, a new media-aiding, a new media-aiding, a new-aid-aid-aid-aid-aid-aid-aid-aiding.
content.title_en: The Google Copy Paste Syndrome : How to endanger web plagiarism education and knowledge

content.text: Colour and light: a new interior design. Colour and light as key elements of the interior design, which can be used originally and innovatively, are the idea behind the present picture book. Interior designers and painter Johannes Klinger deals with the importance of these two elements and presents proposals for their very different use in private living spaces, in architecture, in business spaces and offices. Many of these productions have the character of a complete art work - some seem to be in need of getting used to. From the approach artistically as "design with light" (ID 43/94) or residential element color (BA 11/05). For trainees and professionals in the industry, but also as a pool of ideas for courageous "renovation willing" and builders. Recommended where the similarly innovative title for wall design by Wolfgang Raith (ID 11/07) is used. (3)
content.title_en: Color and light : a new interior design

content.text: The author is a scientific director at the Federal Environment Agency, which has been overwhelming for several years with requests for mold, fogging (black, soot-like dust deposits in apartments) and other interior problems. Since man is staying in enclosed rooms (apartment, office, car) for about 80-90% of the day, the interior is essential for health. The main point of discussion in case of mold infestations or similar damage is the cause: are there structural defects or is the room user responsible? The title gives a scientifically sound overview of the numerous possibilities of indoor contamination, about the anchoring of health aspects in building law, shows residential hygiene damage cases with the causes and in a practical part addresses structural requirements and user behaviour. With numerous tips for practical implementations, applicable also for public buildings and offices. Compact and practical in the first line for construction professionals, but also helpful for the space users. In these topics, without comparison (2).
content.title_en: Mould, fogging and other interior problems : can we still live and work "healthy" in the future?

content.text: The spatial implications of the demographic change / Academy of Spatial Research and Regional Planning are summarized in the summary of the regional policy guidelines for the regional policy guidelines. Part 8: Demographic change in selected regional types of North Rhine-Westphalia: Challenges and opportunities for regional policy. The long-term decline and the continuous ageing of the population as well as international and interregional migration also trigger a profound social and demographic change in North Rhine-Westphalia. Especially in the aspect of sustainable spatial development, there is a comprehensive need for adaptation and reorganization of the settlement, supply and infrastructure. Demographic and structural change affects the individual regions in North Rhine-Westphalia to varying degrees. A special need for adaptation arises for the areas affected by economic structural change for decades. But the other regional working community North Rhine-Westphalia has also set up a working group on the consequences of sociodemographic change. As a result of international migration and related heterogenization processes, the regional policy guidelines for the regional policy guidelines are particularly relevant to the regional policy guidelines.
content.title_en: Spatial consequences of demographic change / Akademie für Raumforschung und Landesplanung ; Part 8: Demographic change in selected regional types of North Rhine-Westphalia : Challenges and opportunities for regional politics

content.text: Net IT : Professional qualifications Network technologies. This book is a teaching and learning tool for all technical and commercial training occupations, which deal with network and telecommunications technology. It builds on the basic knowledge taught in the book "T@ke IT" (BA1/02). CD-ROM supplement with programs and tools on the topic (which are not described in the book). Many practical examples. Just like "T@ke IT" this book is also written in a comprehensible manner, divided into clear learning fields and well structured. Tips are highlighted in color. The book is well suited as a deepening application especially in IT professions, but not as an entry book. Therefore only suitable for a limited target group. (2)
content.title_en: Net IT : Professional qualifications Network technologies

content.text: Probability and statistics: for engineering students at universities of applied sciences; with 93 examples and 71 tasks. This introduction to statistics from the series "Mathematics-Students" is primarily aimed at engineering students at universities of applied sciences and can be read in the first semester. The most important methods for the evaluation, interpretation and presentation of one-dimensional and two-dimensional data material are presented. The statistical part is divided into descriptive and closing statistics. In the descriptive statistics, large data volumes are tried to be described by few meaningful parameters, in the closing, however, to draw conclusions on much larger basic aggregates based on samples. In addition to the derivation of terms and methods, particular emphasis is placed on their correct interpretation and application. The knowledge required for the closing statistics from the probability calculation covers a separate chapter. The book corresponds to a one-semester lecture with four hours of weeks and contains numerous examples and tasks with solutions in the appendix.
content.title_en: Probability and statistics : for engineering students at universities of applied sciences; with 93 examples and 71 tasks

content.text: Pfusch am Bau / Dieter Ansorge ; Vol. 5: Building repair and modernization. Rez.: Building renovation measures cannot be compared with new construction measures, since builders, planners and executive craftsmen constantly have to expect surprises from the old building substance. This is often the reason for subsequent conflicts due to quality defects, not complied with construction regulations and/or cost overruns. In the present volume of the series "Pfusch am Bau" the expert author and construction expert (see BA 2/07; BA 2/06; BA 3/05) deals with the problems of building modernization due to poor construction designs, unsuitable modern building materials, conflicts between old building material with modern standards and regulations, incompetent monument maintenance and others. Due to numerous damage cases, poor planning and execution details are documented with numerous photos and construction drawings and compared with a lack-free execution. Recommended as a guide and guide for potential building agents and real estate buyers, construction planners, experts, craftsmen besides H. Aschen04.
content.title_en: Pfusch am Bau / Dieter Ansorge ; Vol. 5: Building repair and modernization

content.text: PHP 5 and MySQL 5 the cookbook : recipes, solutions, best practices ; [object-oriented programming, graphics, security, configuration ; date and time, MySQL-5 features, mysqli, RSS feeds ; Ajax with PHP]. "cookbooks" in the IT field are usually collections of common use cases, tasks and problems with their solutions. This type of book does not systematically introduce itself into a topic but is integrated according to the topics covered. It is therefore particularly suitable as a supplement to introductions and manuals. Since PHP and MySQL are very often used together in practice, it is useful to offer a collection of recipes for both topics. In this case, these are initially treated separately: first PHP is treated with topics such as data types, date and time, files and directories, forms, graphics, security etc., then the most common stumbling blocks of MySQL are presented as well. Topics are e.g. phpMyAdmin, user management, data structures, data query, data retrieval, and data retrieval are well understandable, and end-of-time are also common.
content.title_en: PHP 5 and MySQL 5 the cookbook : recipes, solutions, best practices ; [object-oriented programming, graphics, security, configuration ; date and time, MySQL 5 features, mysqli, RSS feeds ; Ajax with PHP]

content.text: 300 new professional circuits : application circuits for practice, laboratory and study. After the 10 volumes of the "Professional Circuit Technology" (last BA 2/04) a further volume is now followed under similar title. It is similar and is again a treasure trove for experienced hobbyists. Besides the above 10 volumes also on CD-ROM (ID 7/98) there are some extensive circuit collections in the Elektor publishing house, last "309 circuits" (BA 8/06; see also the volumes mentioned there from the "300 series"). Libraries, which also have need, can of course also acquire this volume as a supplement. (3)
content.title_en: 300 new professional circuits : application circuits for practice, laboratory and study

content.text: Energy security: the new survey of the world. Climate policy can only function globally as an "external environmental policy" or "internal energy policy" (introduction to Müller-Kraenner/Chr. Knospe: "Climate policy", ID 48/96). In continuation of this approach, energy security means external energy policy. And thus energy questions gain a central role in world politics. Müller-Kraenner, biologist and for years working in international environmental policy bodies, can, in order to become clear and concrete, dispense with tables and largely with figures. Instead, he focuses on a dense description of the close interdependencies of economic (outside)political, social and ecological problems, which vary greatly depending on the region and respective political interests. His credo: Only through joint action can Europe in future act as a strong partner of the energy superpowers (e.g. Russia) in external energy policy.
content.title_en: Energy security: the new survey of the world

content.text: They were raised in faith in the "master race" and had to learn that they were not "heard of" in truth. They had to suffer bitterly as children of occupation soldiers or had to deny their origin. They were taken away from their parents and formed in orphanages or in "reliable" families in the sense of the respective regime. Only after the fall of the dictatorships did many people manifest their divided existence, in which the characteristic opposites of our history are reflected. Historian Peter Hartl describes exemplary life processes and makes illustrative facts illustrative.
content.title_en: Lying, cheating and rearranged : Children's fate from the 20th century

content.text: Habitats: in search of contemporary living. With the changes in society, the coexistence of classic and new family structures, increasing average age, increasing cultural mixing, controversial mobility needs, new patterns of behaviour and increasingly extreme purchasing power differences, the requirements for living change. The housing concepts of the past are largely no longer in line with this.The fact that this publication is also different, is shown by the authors' three-stage qualitative analysis in cooperation with the University of Zurich's social research office. It finds organizational forms and architectural solutions functioning model cases for a living that meets changed needs. Interestingly, the examples shown here are largely derived from the help for self-help. They were built by initiator-thinking individuals, spontaneously founded interest groups and innovative cooperatives. What may appear today as an exotic case on the outskirts of the housing market can become standard tomorrow or at least gain veritable quantitative significance.
content.title_en: Habitats : looking for contemporary living

content.text: Vesuvius: The history of a mountain. One of the best connoisseurs of the Gulf of Naples has written the fascinating cultural history of a mountain that has spread fear and terror for centuries and at the same time exerts an irresistible attraction. Among the 500 active volcanoes of the earth, Vesuvius has a unique human history. It begins with the outbreak of the year 79 AD, which buried Pompeii and Herculaneum. Since then, the >>Majestic criminal<< (Gerhart Hauptmann) has brought people to ponder the dark side of nature. Vesuvius is the birthplace of modern volcanology. And it is the most visited mountain in the world. Since its reawakening in 1631, it has been the destination of the Grand Tour. Tired and tormented countless travelers have been tormented to give themselves to the fiery crater sublime feelings or to hold a kesse picnic. Then, Funiculì Funiculà, the many-sung cable car. And finally, the mass traffic in bus and car. Since 1944, the volcano is settled in the midst of the volcano.
content.title_en: The Vesuvius : History of a mountain

Wilhelm II was a reactionary and modernist in one who arrested tradition and past and at the same time closed to the future. Innovations such as electricity, automobiles, railways, radio and aircraft, though not always immediately and not always equally, aroused his interest, not to mention his enthusiasm for new developments for the navy. The practice is not so easy! But there will also be readers who want to find out in principle how they already have more specific in Barbara Eder: "Plant oil as fuel" (BA 2/05), Alfons Berning: "New energy from the farm" (ID 16/04) or Friedemann Zacharias: "Gas engines" (ID 27/01). Garden and landscape architect H. Braun first outlines design possibilities of formal and freely designed gardens, then presents individual design elements such as floor coverings for paths and terraces, stairs, walls, fences, pergolas and protective roofs in detail. He also deals in detail with the installation of meadow and lawn, molded wood and hedges, water in the garden, planters, garden furniture and lighting. More than 400 colour photographs and planning drawings show extremely successful examples of gardens of different types and sizes as well as public parks and green areas. Some, but not all work steps are explained. To do so, it should be used on home-friendly titles such as: "The Great House and Garden Book" (BA 6/03), P. Wirth (BA 6/04) or P. Mair (BA 3/05). As an example collection of successful garden architecture very well suited. (2)

content.text: The playground book : Paths to dream islands of childhood; with practical instructions and many examples. Ideas-rich design examples for adventurous and creative playgrounds. With many colour photographs and drawings. (Rosemarie Scholand) Playgrounds should be varied, adventurous and creative places that appeal to all senses. Many attractive colour photos, funny illustrations and explanatory texts show an enormous variety of naturally designed play areas in the city and rural areas, in the forest and open terrain, on publicly designated playgrounds and break courtyards. The volume is used in its vivid form to design objects as natural playgrounds for children and parents, to educational staff in various facilities and sponsors. Besides some practical construction instructions, it also contains many tips, including the house garden with asthills, ballancier tracks, wells, natural trampoline, pastures etc. With detailed service appendix. Understandable textbook with practical example calculations on basic components, planning and design of a heating system taking into account energy and environmental aspects. The new regulations of the energy saving regulation, the calculation of the annual primary energy demand, the heating load calculation and so on. content.text: Future is possible: Ways out of the climate chaos. Review: Shaping the future" (ID 5/06) had the creation of a "World Future Council" (WFC) and its agenda on the content, an NGO at the highest level. Here is the first major publication of the World Future Council, a volume of 8 contributions by international authors that make it clear that trying to control climate change cannot be enough to radically reduce CO2 emissions. Rather, in order to effectively address the "climate chaos", important social and economic problems of the global environment - e.g. how do we produce and consume? - must be completely re-addressed and politically shaped. The first 8 topics (of planned 24) are concerned, among other things, with renewable energy, the creation of viable and sustainable cities, a fundamentally new vision for world trade. Together with the volumes of the 12-part series "Forum für Verantwortung" (cf. "Use the Earth Right" or M. Latif: "Let's Break the Climate out of the Time?", both BA 4/07) for a wider audience.
content.title_en: Future is possible : Ways out of the climate chaos

content.text: ECO houses: attractive houses with low maintenance costs. Publisher's text: Building cheaply is popular but what about the maintenance costs of the finished house? This book presents attractive single-family houses, which are also economically long-term thanks to durable materials and constructions, intelligent planning or economical house technology. In addition to manageable follow-up costs, the designs from Germany, Austria and Switzerland offer sophisticated and interesting architecture: The range ranges from down-to-earth to extravagant, from conventional single-family houses to the spacious villa to energy-sufficient small house. Building owners and planners are thus given numerous suggestions for sustainably cost-effective construction. Residential houses that are characterized by convincing architecture and remain sustainable cost-effectively presented all projects through quality architectural photos from inside and outside as well as meaningful texts floor plans and all important cost information.
content.title_en: ECO houses : attractive houses with low maintenance costs

content.text: The book gives a sovereign overview of the urban development and planning history of the European city from antiquity to the post-war period. The development of the city is placed in the respective socio-political, economic and social context. Why did certain forms of the city floor plan with a specific street, building and parcel structure arise? How did the urban functions of living, working or public life spread? Why did a particular picture of the city arise? The urban structure and the planning processes that produce it are presented in close connection with the development of the urban planning instruments such as planning, building regulations or the right to expropriation.
content.title_en: Urban planning history : [an introduction]

content.text: Facade design with colour: from design to execution. Large-format book on the topic of good facade design through colour and surface design in the urban context. Typical colours of important styles, color planning and colour use in urban construction are treated, basic methods of facade design for historical and modern buildings, presentation and application techniques. With extensive application examples, checklist, glossary, further literature. Target group are architects, painters, restorers, city planners, color designers and builders. Despite the high book price recommended for larger libraries. No current comparative title known. C. Darmstadt: "Facade design with colour" (ID 49/91) deals only with citizen houses of historism and the Art Nouveau. H. Krewinkel (ID 23/86) addresses craftsmen on the topic of interaction between architecture and color. (3)
content.title_en: Facade design with colour : from design to execution

content.text: What is the human being's epiphany?: the discovery of the nature of the mind. KNO: What does neuroscience really have to say and what does not. The advances of science seem to shake our world and self-image again and again. Were it in the past centuries the teachings of Copernicus, Darwin or Freud, who were responsible for fundamental >> ills < < of man, so today it is the findings of neuroscience that put our human self-image into question. But what is it really about these debates? Are the participants of the current debate about the consciousness and free will that some brain researchers want to deny us, not a fundamental misunderstanding? Michael Pauen tells the exciting story of a century old pseudo-conflict and shows that the findings of neuroscience do not threaten us, but quite the contrary, the understanding of central human abilities improve. Why the current brain research does not force us to make new human images past, refutation of the myths of >> impeaching < of human self-image through results of scientific research, and ways of an allegedly unsolvable thing between the neuroscience and what really does not seem to say the human science.
content.title_en: What is man? : the discovery of the nature of the mind

content.text: The rural life of the farmer is not profitable - as a result, unused farmhouses, barns, storage houses are empty and decayed for years. The benefits of rural heritage in terms of building history are shown in this text-picture-volume on 17 unusual projects in D, AU, CH. The range of use (housing house, cultural house, municipal center, theatre, holiday home, etc.) is as large as the range of conservation requirements for monuments, emphasis on regional characteristics, radical nurturing and innovative additions to former farms, flour stores, stables or business buildings. Each project is presented in detail with detailed state descriptions, structural details and materials, special solutions for fire protection, wall protection, etc., exterior/indoor security, as well as pre-/after photos, basic drawings for farmers.
content.title_en: Country life : Living and working in old farmhouses

content.text: Nervous Zone: Politics and Journalism in the Berlin Republic. The book provides a thorough analysis of political journalism in today's Federal Republic. The basic thesis: Journalistic culture has suffered serious damage in recent years through a "neo-conservative turnaround". Civic journalists such as Christiansen, Dieckmann, Jörges, Schirrmacher and others had taken leadership positions and replaced solid research with polarizing campaign journalism. Especially in the example of the red-green federal government, Lutz Hachmeister describes the dazzling interrelationships between media and politics. His conclusion: Journalists who cry out with the powerful and do not fulfil their mission to critically illuminate society and politics have failed to fulfil their profession. The author himself is a renowned journalist and media researcher, was director of the Adolf Grimme Institute and today heads the Institute for Media and Communication Policy in Berlin. A similarly differentiated but more up-to-date representation such as T. Meyer (ID 17/00), A. Dörner (ID 37/01) or L. Rolke (ID 10/04) is only useful for larger stocks.
content.title_en: Nervous Zone : Politics and Journalism in the Berlin Republic

When Mike one day jumps after his ball, which falls into a garbage basket, his way leads straight into the underworld. There he meets 4 fantasy beings, which are composed of the most incredible waste. Balloon, a creature of old balls, hopes for Mike's help to finish the constant dispute of white (old-time) and green (young) alligators. J. Federspiel uses the legends of the alligators of New York, combines this with fantasy beings, which very much remind Alice in Wonderland, and makes a wonderful story of it for reading. On the Internet there is the possibility to download the audio book for free. The clearly drawn, colorful images stimulate the imagination and make in combination with text and MP3 this adorable illustrated book to an area of the stock of reading. The text is very comprehensive and mysteriously suited to a picture book, therefore only for children in the middle of the day.

content.text: The mobility of man: beyond paths, railways and borders. The author, who interprets the mobility of man as its basic need to cross borders and extend beyond himself, illuminates the subject in a variety of ways. First, he outlines the anthropology of mobility from the early history of humanity. His chapter on the sociology of mobility describes the modern mobility scenario of society, which is increasingly globalizing. A large part of the book is inevitably devoted to transport, the various means of transport, the factor infrastructure and various traffic flow concepts. The chapter on the futurology of mobility deals with the "cosmic" mobility of man, i.e. space travel, and its perspectives. In the appendix, Adolf Rabenseifner, from the idea and conception of the book, presents various "mobility-relevant" companies (and at the same time involved in the development of the book) and their performance spectrum (e.g. on high-performance engines, development and production of vehicles, tunnel construction). Interesting and very forward-looking. (2)
content.title_en: Human mobility: beyond paths, railways and borders

content.text: The fall of the Roman Empire and the end of civilization. What became of the Roman Empire? New findings of archaeologists speak for a violent, abrupt end. They shake the thesis of many historians who assume a continuous transition from the Roman period to the Middle Ages. What became of the Roman Empire? New findings of archaeologists speak for a violent, abrupt end. They shake the thesis of many historians who assume a continuous transition from the Roman period to the Middle Ages.
content.title_en: The Fall of the Roman Empire and the End of Civilization

content.text: Product liability for quality managers in food companies. * When is there a defective food?* On what basis must be held liable?* How can the risk of damages for the company be reduced for the person responsible? Especially responsible persons in the quality sector are confronted with questions about product liability, warranty and guarantee time and again. "Product liability for quality managers in food companies" gives easily understandable answers to the most important questions and thus paves the way for the production of safe food. Food business operators are obliged to place only safe food on the market. A number of behavioural requirements and measures are derived from this. Many questions arise to the responsible persons: When is a defective food available? On what basis must be held liable? What possibilities exist to reduce damage risks? The brochure "Product liability for quality managers in food companies" gives you easily understandable answers to the most urgent questions – so you are ahead of time! Callback actions on the basis of defective food products in the sense of product liability are always proven to be accompanied by significant financial damage – to mention the image damage.
content.title_en: Product liability for quality managers in food companies

content.text: Seats : Concepts of brilliant garden architecture. Whether terrace, loggia, veranda or sitting place in the front garden - in the outdoor refuges near the house are the central theme of this opulent text/picture book in landscape format. It shows successful designs of international garden designers, which have strong references to the house in style, material and colour and at the same time take up influences of the garden. Distinctly divided into seats at the house, in the garden, on the water, on variable heights and at the garden borders, the sophisticated book shows an impressive wealth of stylistically safe ideas. The layout is very clear with an example of each double side - a full-page photo on the right, on the left the corresponding text. Just looking at the aesthetic and artistically great photos of 4 renowned garden photographers is a true pleasure and feast for the eyes. However, these are mainly extremely exclusive design ideas that blow the framework of an average house garden.
content.title_en: Seats : Concepts of brilliant garden architecture

content.text: Media landscape Germany. The German media landscape is on the move. Whether newspapers, magazines, radio or television - consumers use the media in Germany differently than before. This is influenced above all by the progressive digitization. The Internet affects the readers of newspapers. It can use the network with articles of its choice or even becomes an "weblogger" itself. It is also increasingly difficult to inspire young people for the classical media. Accompanying offers of radio and television on the Internet like the "Podcasting" gain in importance. Above all the recent changes of the media landscape, in newspapers, magazines, radio, television and in the online area (book, film, comics missing) by digitization and the Internet the journalist and jurist in this attractively and clearly arranged overview distinguishes clearly, with photos, sidemarginalia, register, link collection, after, not without the respective developments since 1945, scarcely depicting themselves. Additional chapters devote themselves to popular television formats, news agencies and press agencies, the news and the journalists. Thus - in cooperation with the Bavarian regional headquarters for political education work - as an informative panorama, primarily from a topical research and a pre-r-textual.
content.title_en: Media Landscape Germany

content.text: How long does the resource last? : from the handling of the blue gold. Mauser, Prof. for Geography (University of Munich), continues the series "Forum for Responsibility" (cf. H.-J. Wagner: "What are the energies of the 21st century?" and St. Rahmstorf: "How threatened are the oceans", in this no.) with the ever more public discussion topic of water. It is obliged to take an interdiciplinary view when it represents the global water resources, their distribution and consumption. In the data-rich, current text, which is supplemented by maps, diagrams, tables and single (badly reproduced) black and white photos, each chapter concludes with a summary. Central to the understanding of the remarks are the explanations on "blue water" (visible water flows), "green water" (invisible flow of water vapor from the earth's surface to the atmosphere by evaporation) and "virtual water" (water imprint of goods and services). Unfortunately, these terms are also missing in the glossary (Recommendsends) in the context of the "Far" (Recommends).
content.title_en: How long does the resource last? : from dealing with the blue gold

content.text: What if? : Future images of the information society. Since the Renaissance, technology and science have opened the door to the future and to utopian designs for Western societies and their people. However, the momentum of progress that has been set in motion has now become ambivalent and, above all, in social utopias, has been overlaid by fears or doubts. Technological progress is no longer a utopian necessity, but an expected and economically necessary necessity. This has fundamentally changed the relationship of people to the future, especially in the process of moving towards the information or knowledge society.
content.title_en: What if? : Future images of the information society

content.text: Microcontrollers and microprocessors: 41 tables. With this textbook, the authors introduce students to the world of microcontrollers and microprocessors. content.text: Spatial consequences of demographic change / Academy for Spatial Research and Regional Planning; Part 9: Conversion of cities and regions in north-eastern Germany: The need for action and prospects for action. In eastern Germany, demographic change has taken on a particular dimension, to which political and planning needs to be reacted, so that the affected cities and regions can cope with the necessary restructuring process. In the countries of eastern Germany, however, declining regions in the population are located alongside regions with increasing population numbers and economically prosperous ones, as well as with significant problems in structural change. Spatial approaches and problem-solving solutions are therefore to be given priority over general and general concepts. The two Landesarbeitsgemeinschaften in eastern Germany have therefore addressed this topic in a coordinated manner. The "Reconstruction of Cities and Regions" AG of the LAG Berlin/Brandenburg/Mecklenburg-Vorpommern dealt with the rural areas that shape the area and the Berlin Metropolregion. The contributions elaborated and reproduced here have therefore been addressed in a coordinated manner, long-term and forward-oriented, the regional-specific problems in the restructuring process, the strategies taken and the consequences of the strategies for the implementation of these strategies and the concrete strategies and the impact-based strategies.
content.title_en: Spatial consequences of demographic change / Academy for Spatial Research and Planning ; Part 9: Conversion of cities and regions in north-eastern Germany : Action needs and perspectives

content.text: The Federal Government has also set itself the goal of reducing bureaucratic burdens and of creating a standards control board to help reduce bureaucracy costs. This is understood as such, which is the case for natural or legal persons when they comply with their obligations to inform authorities as a result of legislation. However, in order to reduce bureaucracy costs and assess the effectiveness of appropriate measures, it is necessary to measure them first - and that is anything but simple. What is to be included in the bureaucracy costs, at what times and by what methods they are to be determined is controversial. This book describes two competing measurement models, compares them with regard to their benefits, the implementation opportunities and risks and outlines possibilities of modification and further development. It arranges the current discussion on bureaucracy cost measurement in the broader context of bureaucracy reduction and state modernization, asks whether the expectations associated with bureaucracy cost measurement are realistic, and makes its own proposals.
content.title_en: Measuring bureaucracy costs - but how? : Methods, intentions and options

content.text: The new Energy Economy Act of 1998 and its amendment in 2005 fundamentally changed the structures and systems of electricity and gas supply in the Federal Republic of Germany. The established territorial monopolies of the major energy suppliers were broken down. This attempted to establish competition in the production, distribution and pricing of energy markets. Further legal regulations were added, especially in the environmental sector, which further promoted this restructuring. Basic framework conditions were thus set up. This liberalisation and deregulation will continue to lead to serious changes in the spatial structure of the energy economy, which will allow a new need for regional and supraregional coordination. Especially in the context of sustainable regional development, the integration of energy policy guidelines and objectives at the level of regions and municipalities will be of particular importance. With this volume, the aspects of these spatial effects will be investigated and will try to answer the question of a further need for spatial planning control in the energy sector (source: ARL).
content.title_en: Change in electricity supply and spatial policy

content.text: Dissocial behaviour of children and adolescents: manifestations, development, prevention and intervention. Dissocial behavioural problems such as oppositional, aggressive, delinquent and criminal behaviour are widespread among children and adolescents. They cause considerable costs in our society, whether on the part of potential victims, either due to material damage or due to the care problems in family, school and other institutions of our social system. The volume deals with the various manifestations, their developmental psychological and clinical foundations as well as the possibilities of prevention and treatment of these behavioral problems. In addition to preliminary questions on description and diagnosis of dissocial behavior, a summary of developmental psychopathological research on risk and protection factors is a first focus of the book. A second focus is on the presentation of various prevention and intervention approaches. Here, especially programs of social skills promotion for children, parental programs for training educational skills as well as multimodal prevention concepts and treatment measures for juvenile offenders are presented and discussed.
content.title_en: Dissocial behaviour of children and adolescents : manifestations, development, prevention and intervention

content.text: The lecture book deals with the design and programming of microprocessor systems. It takes account of the basics of computer technology and machine programming, the complex relationships of system construction, bus systems and interface techniques, and describes the functioning of input/output devices and background storage. The material selection is based on common processors of the PC world. The work, which is intended for students of electrical engineering and computer science, also enables users to develop the appropriate system structures, select the appropriate system components and design the associated software themselves. The book continues the success of its predecessors and takes into account the changed tasks of its predecessors. In addition to extensive corrections, the chapters on serial interfaces and via serial buses were restructured and extended. This book deals with the design and programming of computer systems based on microprocessors. The main topics are: CISC and RISC principles of today's scalar and superscale processors, structures of bus and bus systems, and of single-processor and multi-processor systems with special consideration of the PCI bus, optimization of memory access in relation to the memory management of the user's interfaces and computing systems.

content.text: Layout synthesis of electronic circuits - Basic algorithms for design automation. The author succeeds in striking the bridge between the world of algorithms, i.e. the 'inner life' of modern design systems, and their application. For each of the essential steps in layout synthesis, a problem description and the idea of terms and optimization objectives are first presented in clear chapters. Afterwards, he is addressed the most significant algorithms underlying the corresponding design tools. Numerous examples and tasks with solutions are used to increase visuality. For each chapter, an extensive slide set is available via the Internet. Jens Lienig studied electron technology at TU Dresden and received his doctorate there in 1991. content.text: Machine tools 2 : Design and calculation. This volume 2 focuses on the design, design, calculation and optimization of the static, dynamic and thermal behavior of the elements and assemblies of machine tools. In detail, the design of the frames, frame components, joining points and the installation and foundation of machine tools are dealt with. The design and calculation of guides and bearings is another focus, taking into account the aspects of high-speed machining. In detail, the design of main drives is also addressed. In addition to the modern machine design and the necessary additional equipment, the electrical design is addressed. Current topics, such as the coupled calculation of structural dynamics and drive control of the feed axes with the help of flexible multi-body simulation, have been supplemented in this completely revised eighth edition.

content.text: Technical Combustion: Combustion Technology, Combustion Modelling, Emissions: 65 tables. content.text: Machine tooling 4 : Automation of machines and systems. The compendium machine tooling systems comprises five volumes, which illuminate and bundle the increasingly complex matter of machine tooling. This volume 4 aims to explain the possible control concepts including their programming techniques for the various application areas in detail. In particular, the memory programmable control (SPS) as well as the numerical control (NC) are discussed in detail. These two types of control are mainly used in machine tooling machines and robots. A special role in highly dynamic feed drives is played by the adapted guide size generation for axle movements. The deviations in the dimensions of the workpiece must be small despite high speeds and accelerations. content.text: Late texts on the constitution of time (1929 - 1934) : the C manuscripts. This volume contains research manuscripts by Edmund Husserl on the problem of the period 1929-1934. The publication of the C manuscripts documents the final phase of Husserl's analyses of all stages of the constitution of time, which began in 1904/05 with the lectures on the phenomenology of inner time consciousness (Husserliana vol. X) and continued in 1917/18 with the Bern manuscripts (Husserliana vol. XXXIII). In the C manuscripts the historical constitution of time is examined, starting from the field of experience of the concrete living present. In particular, Husserl strives to clarify the transition from the extensive and constantly lively present of the experiencing subject to the objective, jointly constituted time.
content.title_en: Late texts on the constitution of time (1929 - 1934) : the C manuscripts

content.text: Agricultural landscapes: Sustainability and conservation on low-yield sites. In large areas of Central Europe, farming on low-yield sites is cost-covering only with public funding. Starting from a historical examination, this book examines perspectives of extensive, multifunctional farming, nature conservation and recreational fitness integrated into its target bundle. content.text: News from the knowledge society: Analyses on the change of science. More knowledge also leads to more uncertainty. What does this mean for our everyday life - and what for the development of science?The volume is the result of the work of a research group, which is established under the title "Science in the Transition - On the Way to the Knowledge Society" at the Institute for Science and Technology Research (IWT) of Bielefeld University and was funded by the Volkswagen Foundation within the program "Key Topics of the Humanities".The research group was composed of the members of the IWT, the scientific philosopher Martin Carrier, the technology sociologist Wolfgang Krohn, the physicist Günter Küppers and the science sociologist Peter Weingart, as well as the philosopher Paul Hoyningen-Huene of the University of Hanover. The employees were the philosophers Kirsten Endres, Jörg Kellermann and Michael Stöltzner, the mathematician Johannes Lenhard, and the sociologists Ralf Herbold and Holger Schwechheimer. One of the concerns of the research group was given to the general public to convey the results of the study of the wider interest in the knowledge society.
content.title_en: News from the knowledge society : Analyses on the change of science

content.text: The compatibility of family and work in an international comparison: between paradigm and practice. A factual study by the Bertelsmann Foundation on the question of the better compatibility of work and parental work especially for women. (LK/GÖ: Vetter) How can the social policy framework conditions in Germany for the participation of women be improved in particular? This study was developed within the framework of the project "Balance of Family and Working Life", initiated by the Bertelsmann Foundation and the Federal Ministry of Family Affairs (BMSFSJ), which examines family policy instruments, social and labour market policy regulations and possibilities for childcare (current topic "criticels"). In this context, European and international comparisons are used again and again. Numerous tables illustrate the data collected. In sum, the fact-rich but easy-to-read study supports the recognition that has become established in politics: not only tax relief and more transfer services than sufficient and high-quality childcare facilities are the key to a successful reconciliation of family and work. Ways of the current topic not only recommended for expanded social science stocks. (2)
content.title_en: Reconciliation of family and work in an international comparison : between paradigm and practice

content.text: Hundred maps that changed the world. Maps are among the oldest forms of human communication. This unique collection of extraordinary maps gives the reader an impressive picture of the development of cartography. Whether prehistoric rock drawings, Agrippa's map of the Roman Empire or an overview of the British Empire - maps have always had an influence on human civilization history. "Hundred maps that changed the world" gives an impression of the effect of maps on our development up to the present world. This exclusive illustrated book describes the 100 most influential maps and their political, scientific and religious connections in detail.
content.title_en: Hundred cards that changed the world

content.text: Children make circuses: [a guide and idea giver for the construction and implementation of children's circus projects for schools and clubs as well as other institutions and free groups using the example of the Hamburg circus Willibald]. Whether children's circuses or varieties event - in this book you will find suggestions for the areas acrobatics, juggling, clowning and magic. Much may be too elaborate for everyday life, but in all areas you start at the very beginning, so that the entry into these fascinating topics is really possible for every layman and is therefore also of great interest for the desperate mother, who is looking for new ideas for the child's birthday! Using the example of the Hamburg children's circus Willibald a complete circus project is presented, which in all details from the financing of the possible program design to tips for a successful presentation in comprehensible partial steps, illustrated with helpful schema drawings and colorful stimulating photo material, to lead to a successful financing of the children's circus project.
content.title_en: Children make circus : [a guide and inspiration for the development and implementation of children's circus projects for schools and associations as well as other institutions and free groups using the example of the Hamburg circus Willibald]

content.text: What else does our Earth tolerate? : Ways into sustainability. In the "Forum for Responsibility" (a total of 12 volumes until the end of 2007, including on water, energy, world population, oceans, transformation of the economy; see also Latif and Schmidt-Bleek in this no.) well-known scientists present research results on the respective focus and try to prepare facts such as thinking models in a comprehensible way to enable judgment and responsible action. Like a red thread, the topic sustainability runs through the series. J. Jäger (Sustainable Europe Research Institute/Vienna) provides an inventory of global change here, describes the current and future resource consumption and carries out visions of a sustainable future as well as paths into sustainability. Well structured, supported by tables and diagrams. Important terms are explained and highlighted in detail (e.g. ecological backpack, global environment), moreover, there is a glossary and literature advice. In addition to F. Luks: "Sustainability" (BA 12/02) and A. Grunwald: "Sustainability" (BA 8/06) widely recommended for school libraries.
content.title_en: What else does our Earth tolerate? : Ways into sustainability

content.text: Significant lime trees: 400 tree giants in Germany. The lime tree is one of the oldest and most impressive trees in Europe, with a trunk circumference of more than 15 metres depending on its type and can grow more than 1000 years old. 400 well-known and less known tree giants in Germany are portrayed in this book - dance lindens, court lindens, village lindens and memorial trees - with interesting background information and many atmospheric colour photos. Each lime tree has a detailed cross-section of its unique history as well as the legends and myths that surround it. In addition, detailed geographical, ecological and forestry information and facts are provided and the topic of tree care is illuminated. Many of our linden trees are threatened today. Michel Brunner draws attention to their importance with this picture-text-band and thus makes an important contribution to the protection and preservation of the linden trees in Europe.
content.title_en: Major lime trees : 400 tree giants of Germany

content.text: Climate in transition - Earth in danger. No one seriously disputes global climate change anymore, because the consequences are obvious: extreme heat waves, massive floods, cyclones, melting poles and glaciers. The present volume documents the often catastrophic side effects of climate change in numerous large-format color photographs from all over the world and is thus a stirring warning to action. The texts also strongly exhort to rethink. Widely recommended. (2) Global climate change is no longer seriously contested by anyone, because the consequences are obvious: extreme heat waves, massive floods, whirlwinds, melting poles and glaciers. The present volume documents the often catastrophic side effects of climate change in numerous large-format color photographs from all over the world and is thus a disturbing reminder to action. The texts also strongly exhort to rethink. Widely recommended. (2)
content.title_en: Climate in Change - Earth in Danger

In addition, however, in numerous chapters - the structure of the text is identical to the previous one - corrections and new information found (e.g. Pharming, AJAX, hidden files etc.). Given the good comprehensibility, the text is particularly suitable for computer newcomers, but the large range of topics ensures that advanced users feel addressed. Everyday tips and a clever selection of software on the attached CD-ROM complete the positive impression. In addition, the statement by Martin Lobeck is worth: "One useful user, one of the first-time users, one of the first-time users.

content.text: Ambivalences of death : Reality of dying and death theories today. Publisher's info: Death cannot be displaced, denied away, tamed or peaced. It remains the great scandal or the great promise. He has always been one of the most important themes of philosophy, today he is pushing with power into interdisciplinary discussions through the many techniques of death avoidance and delay. Such interdisciplinary exchange is documented here. Do we experience the era of euthanasia? What significance do the hospice movement and the changes in the culture of burial have? What happens to death in the age of life technologies? Experts from different fields describe the reactions of a medicamentalized and faithless society to death, the literary and political reactions, the administration and rape of death. With contributions by Petra Gehring, Reimer Gronemeyer, Marc Rölli, Christian Grüny, Werner Fuchs-Heinritz, Andreas Hetzel, Ludger Fittkau, Martin Schnell and Stefan Dreßke.
content.title_en: Ambivalents of Death : Reality of Death and Death Theory Today

content.text: Culture and development: four regions of the world in comparison. As an infinite history that requires a high degree of frustration tolerance, the authors describe the subject of culture and development. It is highly prone to abuse, subject to intellectual fashions and characterized by the drilling of thin boards. Even at the conceptual level " 160 cultural concepts could be identified in the early 1990s " there is a great indeterminateness, followed by methodological-theoretical and metatheoretical difficulties. Nevertheless, the editors dared to take up this difficult area and to put together contributions by ethnologists, religious scientists, geographers, political scientists, lawyers, philosophers and economists. They state that today above all the question must be answered which development possibilities a culture allows, and not whether cultures can probably influence the development capacity of a country. The example of China clearly shows that cultures allow a higher degree of economic change than previously believed. From the researcher's perspective, the systematic examination of the relations between culture, economics and politics remains a deteriority.
content.title_en: Culture and development: four regions of the world compared

content.text: We experience more than we understand: Quantum Physics and Life Questions. This work is a special edition of the paperback book published under the same title as Herder-Spektrum Volume 4847 in 2001. It essentially includes the commented and partly shortened reproduction of several conversations between philosopher Oesterreicher and physicist Dürr. Dürr "is a personality that combines deep insights into quantum physics with the strong commitment of a political actor in personal union". In the discussions, the focus is on the philosophical and ethical implications of quantum physics, especially the indeterminacy, the openness that has its causes in vibrations, and the finding that ultimately everything is connected to everything. Thus, Dürr says, for example, "Quantum mechanics opens a door to the underlying openness of the world." Overall, a work worth reading for all who are willing to face their responsibility for nature and society. Six years after the first appearance, the work is still topical, perhaps more important than ever. (2)
content.title_en: We experience more than we understand: Quantum Physics and Life Questions

content.text: Photovoltaics: Electricity from sunlight for grid and island installations. Comprehensive standard work of a Swiss professor who deals with all aspects of solar energy generation. Especially suitable for theoretically interested readers, but also for builders and practitioners (Rolf Raschka) In specialist books, such as Hans-Joachim Geist: "Photovoltaics plants" (BA 12/07) or especially Falk Antony: "Photovoltaics for professionals" (ID 7/06), basic knowledge is also taught, but it is mainly used for practical implementation. The Swiss professor now complements this literature with a comprehensive, systematic textbook, which is partly suitable for builders and practitioners, but mainly for theoretically interested readers up to students. Häberlin's decades of research is reflected in detailed information, which includes, for example, accurate analyses of the economic viability of individual plants. Sometimes it refers to the special situation in Switzerland, but which does not bother much. The work, which is equipped with small photos, numerous tables, diagrams and examples, is relatively inexpensive for the scope, but contains some of its stocks.
content.title_en: Photovoltaic : Electricity from sunlight for grid and island systems

content.text: Power folly: like a mediocre elite of leaders, we are destroyed. A furious continuation of the "reform lie" (BA 10/04), which seeks to prove the failure of economy, politics, science and journalism with a series of recent reforms and austerity measures. Much of what is prescribed in Germany from above is annoying, unjust and incomprehensible to the average citizen. Müller, who has long been involved in the elite leaders, in a clever way strengthens our displeasure, illustrating deception, inconsistency and abuse of power through texts and statistics - not by secret documents, for example. It could be defamatory that he accuses the makers of being gentle, sometimes enriching themselves, of making the population afraid of each other, of cuncing among themselves, of influencing the media. Some of these things may indicate bitterness. After all, he has rejected the originally planned thrifty title "dumbly or corrupt". Everything in all but his - now becoming a "mirrage" bestseller - call, the network of medium-minded attention to the elite, (2) to look at the fingering.
content.title_en: Power Delusion: How a mediocre leader beats us

content.text: Blockhouse construction : traditional techniques from Sweden. The loghouse construction has a long tradition in Sweden. The author leads courses on loghouse construction in Sweden and describes in this book the ancient method. After a brief explanation of the different types of houses, the suitable tree trunks are presented and the corner connections are described as the basis of the house construction. After the necessary tools follow the individual work steps, which are explained step by step with numerous photos and large drawings. There are many, from experience, tips, such as the insulations from moss or the roof ornament, which should protect against evil spirits. No easy work is such a construction and in Germany you will rarely find a suitable place and the necessary material. Homeworkers who want to build a small, romantic wooden house for their children should stick to D. Stiles (ID 51/05, BA 2/06, 1/06). (3) (Burchard Bulling)
content.title_en: Blockhouse construction : traditional techniques from Sweden

content.text: The relationship between city and country has changed over the years: a network structure with a wide range of functional relationships has replaced a hierarchical relationship. Inter-communal cooperation and regional governance play an increasingly important role in addressing the challenges arising from globalisation and economic structural change. The present study characterizes and analyses the most important urban and surrounding processes in East and West Germany over the last few years. It presents different forms of inter-communal and regional cooperation and discusses the various instruments and models used here, including in relation to cross-border cooperation. In particular, the temporal course of the paradigm shift from hierarchical control with linear planning processes to cooperative, participatory planning and control processes is elaborated. Building on the current state of research on urban and surrounding processes and intercommunal cooperation, the study leads to open questions in various research fields.
content.title_en: Urban-Umland processes and inter-municipal cooperation : state of play and perspectives of research

content.text: Elites and Power in Europe : an international comparison. Publisher's info: In his new book, which is based on comprehensive, current research, Michael Hartmann shows who Europe's elites are and who has a significant influence on European politics and economy. In addition to the three major EU countries Germany, France and the UK, he looks at the elites from Italy, Spain, Austria, the Netherlands, Scandinavia, Switzerland and many others, including Eastern European countries. His result is that national recruitment and promotion patterns prevail. At best, there are approaches to alignment at European level. The greatest contrast exists between the three major EU powers with relatively closed elites, one thinks only of the exclusive British elite forges Oxford and Cambridge on the one hand and the Scandinavian countries on the other hand: There are the best chances of rising into the world of the powerful.
content.title_en: Elites and Power in Europe: an International Comparison

content.text: History in memory: from individual experience to public staging. Aleida Assmann describes in her new book how history is remembered, experienced sensibly and represented in media productions in Germany. In this context, she spans an impressive arc from experience, generation and family memory to the historical backdrop of architecture, to exhibitions, media stagings and reproductions of history. A "must" for all who want to understand on which basis German history consciousness is reorganized at the beginning of the 21st century. - We live in a history-forsaken time, in which memory has become an individual duty and public task. However, the "new historism" of the 21st century is clearly different from that of the 19th century. Different approaches to the past have been replaced by a national master narrative. History awareness has become more diverse and contradictory in itself. In the search for identity, one's own life and family history has gained importance, similar to the local history, which is discovered as an economic and tourist location factor. History is not only present in family novels, but also in the reconstruction of buildings and films, and in the reconstruction of the history.
content.title_en: History in memory : from individual experience to public staging

content.text: The author, Professor of Ancient History at the University of Kassel, with a focus on ancient history of technology, presents a concise but very informative work on the development of technology in this period. He shows that the origins of ancient technology are mainly to be found in ancient Egypt and the Old East, and then mainly dedicates himself to the development of technology in Greek and Roman culture, divided according to the various "areas of application", namely agriculture (at that time, because of the nutritional situation most important), metals, salt, handicrafts, construction technology, transport, infrastructure, communication, mechanics and time measurement, as well as the military technology that often makes war at that time. The fascinating connections he points out are also interesting his references to the already then occurring technological consequences, such as the destruction of forests by the enormous wood consumption during metal production. Highly recommended and inexpensive! (1) The author describes the origins of ancient technology in Egypt and the Ancient Orient as well as the technical developments in Greece and Rome - from agriculture to mining to construction and time measurement.
content.title_en: History of the Ancient Technique

content.text: 24 hours: how the global economy works. A common thread is snapshots of decisions made in all parts of the world within 24 hours. This demonstrates interlocking and dynamic global economy with predominantly positive but also negative socio-economic and political impacts. Altman is an economist and writes for well-known Anglo-American press organisations, lives in New York, Hong Kong and Buenos Aires. His topics are the latest developments in China, Brazil, Syria, East Timor, South Africa and Vietnam, corporate activities and financial transactions. He investigates whether a poor country can quickly become rich, whether the US really determines the global rules of play, criticizes the role of the European Central Bank and the exploitation of resources and people. He tries to loosen the matter by turning on the ground as involved wire educators with his own experiences, but the well-founded reports make many backgrounds visible anyway - even without this didactic "art grab". (2)
content.title_en: 24 hours : how the global economy works

content.text: The German title says less than the original title, which speaks of the "spirit of Japan in our gardens". This corresponds to the author's intention, which, by means of examples from Japan and Europe, wants to make the Japanese "garden soul" clear. It is to be transferred to Western conditions, but not copied. The magic of these gardens is reflected in beautiful, mostly large-format photographs. Also the quiet narrative of the now deceased author, who was a profound expert in Japanese landscape architecture, contributes to the enjoyable mockery in this book, although the translation sometimes seems not quite successful. In addition to the characteristics of the Japanese garden, such as the play with light and shadow or the integration into the surrounding landscape, one finds in this book very concrete instructions for the installation of such gardens. For this purpose particularly suitable plants, mainly trees and shrubs, are presented in portraits. A book, which certainly not only inspires friends of Japanese garden culture. Especially recommended for larger books. (2) Based on examples from Japan and Europe, the author illustrates the mood of Japanese gardens and garden instructions, is transferred to Braun's own garden.
content.title_en: Gardens in Japan style

content.text: The end of privacy: the way to the surveillance society. Review: The author is an economist and has been Federal Commissioner for Data Protection for about four years. He has been working on this topic for almost 20 years and initially also offers a brief review of developments in Germany. But then he describes quite compactly and yet well legible, what is already possible in electronic surveillance or will be available tomorrow. He also describes very clearly that the legislator is not able to consider future technical developments in regulations and laws. General fundamental rights could and should be enshrined in the Basic Law, which did not happen for the right to data protection. Currently there is an unspeakable variety of provisions, so that "affected persons only perceive their rights imperfectly". Naturally, the constantly reworded demands of Interior Minister Schäuble for online search ("Federal Trojan") are discussed. A little sarcastically, the author Stasi-Chef Mielke quotes: "To be safe, one must know everything". - The consciousness-expanding reading of the book is worthwhile for everyone! (1 S)
content.title_en: The end of privacy: the way to the surveillance society

content.text: Forests that we kill: about forest destruction, climate change and human insanity. The author describes the proportion of the destruction of rain forests in the climate catastrophe. (Hans-Ulrich Struck) E. Grundmann is a primate researcher and president of the French Jane Goodall Institute. She has become known in France through her commitment to protecting apes in Asia and Africa. This commitment has ultimately also resulted in this book on the worldwide destruction of forests. The author criticizes states like the USA and China, which are feeding their growing hunger for raw materials at the expense of poorer countries. She denounces the multinational corporations, which destroy the last untouched ecosystems ecosystems of Africa, Asia and Latin America in search of soil resources. We consumers, who buy uncritically furniture from tropical wood, grilled coal and cheap paper, contribute to the destruction of rain forests. The climate catastrophe is thus preprogrammed and outlined by emission rights trading, as in the Kyoto Protocol. We also see a glimmer of hope in the examples of individual countries that have been unresolved. (The World Food Crisis) (2).
content.title_en: Forests that we kill : about forest destruction, climate change and human irrational

content.text: Watt: Living space between land and sea; [National Park Wadden Sea]. This book - a completely new adaptation of the well-known title "Wadden" with new texts and new image material - makes the fascinating ecosystem Watt with its highly specialized plants and animals come alive. At the same time it is a plea for the effective protection of this highly sensitive habitat.The best way to get to know Watt is by experiencing it in the truest sense of the word. The wondrous world of sea, watt and beach opens up to the one who wants to experience and discover with all senses. Thus, this book shows all the great and small wonders, which often can only be discovered at second glance. (Source: buchhandel.de 28.09.2007) Every year many thousand people visit the Wadden Sea National Parks along the North Sea coast. The authors, scientific staff and professors of the Universtity Osnabrück, want to change the meaning of these species as overcities and overcities.
content.title_en: Watt : Habitat between land and sea; [National Park Wadden Sea]

Contains in the information section graphical overviews and graphs, thereby underlining the Atlas character of the work. Modern infant research has developed experimental methods that enable us to get answers to the above questions. It asks the infant questions he can speak - not verbally, of course, but rather through his eyes or movements, especially through his sucking behaviour. Daniel Stern manages to think into the inner world of the infant and to describe it vividly to us. This has resulted in this differentiated and provocative book. Hertzog (BA 5/02 - not quite up-to-date). content.text: The Lords of the Land: Israel and the Settler Movement since 1967. The Israeli historian (BA 2/04) and former press spokesman T. Kolleks describe the history and ideology of the settlers movement "Gush Emunim" (Block of Faith) that arose after the 6-day war in 1967 and their influence on politics and society. The 1st part chronically deals with the internal political struggle for the formation of settlements in the occupied territories and the behaviour of politics and their personalities (Rabin, Peres, Begin, Sharon ...) to this day. The 2nd part examines the historical and religious-ideological foundations of the movement (word: "Arab-free Greater Israel"). The authors establish a complicity of parts of the military and security organs, of the hesitant enforcement of the law against the settlers with simultaneous unequal treatment of the Arab population. History and ideology of the settler movement Gush Emunium and their influence on Israeli politics and society. (Herbert Lindenlaub)
content.title_en: The Lords of the Country : Israel and the Settler Movement since 1967
