The Bielefeld Working Group 8 Social Work/Social Education has set clear markers in the German-speaking and international debate on social work in the last four decades. The driving force behind this development was and is Hans-Uwe Otto. In this volume, whose co-authors, on the occasion of his retirement, have for the first time gathered for a comprehensive overview of these 'Bielefelder Forschungspräktiven' on social work. The eight central research and thematic fields, which were ordered by Bielefelder AG or with their participation in the last decades, form part of the volume. The common point of reference of all the contributions gathered here is the connection between social work and society: social work as a professional authority can only be realized in its social context and thus in explicitly social policy positioning.
content.title_en: Social work in society

content.text: WordPress 2.x compact: [creating and maintaining your own weblog can be so easy; so you can master the entry]. WordPress is a program package that gives the numerous weblog writers a relatively convenient, free way to publish their thoughts, ideas and failures not only on the net, but also provides many functions to give the whole a professional paint, an aesthetically appealing design. However, the new blogger should have some previous knowledge, while the technical requirements are safe with most providers of a web server (e.g. a MySQL database). The first author has joined Mosmann as co-author for this new edition, which mainly takes care of technical details of the program. Lamprecht briefly devotes himself to the installation, but in detail the use and modification of "themes" for designing the blog design, e.g. "Kubrick". Additional programs for spam fights are also well explained. Because of the increasing blogger number (actively around 30,000) more demand is to be expected than with the first installment of the BA08/BOSID (for example, the first installment of the BA08/Brug).
content.title_en: WordPress 2.x compact : [creating and maintaining your own weblog can be so easy ; so master the entry]

content.text: The special didactic hamster model is aimed at beginners without any prior knowledge and introduces them into the basic concepts of programming. "A virtual hamster is controlled by a virtual landscape and has to do certain tasks. The hamster model is oriented towards the language concepts of Java. ... The hamster simulator can be obtained free of charge via the Internet." (K. Barckow for the first edition: BA 2/00) The very understandable presentation with numerous examples and exercises has been extended since the first edition and improved in the equipment. Various adaptations to current guidelines and the correction of also content errors make an exchange of the book suitable for students and for self-study advisable. (2 S)
content.title_en: Programming learning to play with the Java Hamster model

content.text: Küttner piston machines: [piston pumps, piston compressors, combustion engines]; with 40 tables and numerous exercises and examples with solutions. Well-known textbook on piston machines (pumps, compressors, combustion engines)with emphasis on basic laws. Contains numerous examples and was rewritten by a collective of university teachers after the death of the original author and adapted especially in terms of energy efficiency and environmental compatibility new developments. A purchase of this edition (standard work for engineering training) is useful, the old edition should be exchanged. (3)
content.title_en: Küttner piston machines: [piston pumps, piston compressors, combustion engines]; with 40 tables and numerous exercises and examples with solutions

content.text: Process automation : from field device to automation solution. Publisher's text: This book provides the basics and provides an overview of the big topic of process automation. In this context, emphasis is placed on a clearly understandable and vivid way of presentation, supplemented by many images.
content.title_en: Process automation : from field device to automation solution

content.text: Architecture of knowledge : Educational spaces in the information age. Universities and schools have developed over the centuries with the media technology of book printing and the resulting cultural techniques of reading and writing. Similarly, new spaces of knowledge transfer and knowledge generation will emerge in the age of multimedia and digital web media. Physical and virtual architectures constitute educational spaces that increasingly show relationships to one another and in places enter symbiosis. This development will not only influence the methodology and curriculum, but in particular will change the structure of communication spaces and the organization of educational institutions. In a historical span from the wedding of the industrial age to the information age, twenty-three information units illuminate the manifold correlations between the development of communication technology, the formation of theory and the organisation of the educational space.
content.title_en: Architecture of Knowledge : Educational Spaces in the Information Age

content.text: Basic course on software engineering with UML: the pragmatic way to successful software projects. The Unified Modelling Language (UML) is an extremely important tool in software development. A work on the subject already published in several editions is P. Forbrig (ID 10/07). However, the work is aimed at advanced users and sets the focus on the UML tools OCL (Object Constraint Language) and Rational Rose. The present practical book is more general and also due to the repetition questions and exercises for each chapter suitable for beginners. In the reader, e.g. first semesters of computer science and business informatics, only some basic knowledge in the principles of object-oriented programming is expected. The author wants to show how to develop using UML software, which fully corresponds to the customer's wishes. The path leads here from the requirements of modeling and implementation to the later maintenance of the software created. The importance of continuous communication between customers and developers and the resulting possibilities of optimization (2) is well elaborated.
content.title_en: Basic course Software Engineering with UML : the pragmatic way to successful software projects

content.text: Common differential equations : an introduction from the perspective of dynamic systems. The book provides a compact and fundamental introduction to the theory of ordinary differential equations from the perspective of dynamic systems in the scope of a single-semester lecture. Beyond the discussion of the basic solution theory and the theory of linear systems, analytical and numerical solution methods, basic concepts of the theory of dynamic systems, stability, branches and Hamilton systems are discussed. The material is illustrated and deepened in detail by means of examples, exercises and computer experiments. The book is particularly suitable for the bachelor's degree program ..., both during the lecture course of the module "Common differential equation equations" for students in the 3rd semester as well as for self-study. (3)
content.title_en: Common differential equations : an introduction from the perspective of dynamic systems

content.text: Technical drawing : learn and practice independently and effectively; with 59 tables; [with current standardization and over 300 exercises]. Publisher's text: This textbook summarises the most important rules of technical drawing vividly, effectively and with new standardization. The reader receives precise information to read and prepare technical drawings. Many exercises enable the preparation of the material in self-study.
content.title_en: Technical drawing : learn independently and practice effectively ; with 59 tables ; [with current standardisation and over 300 exercises]

content.text: Shell script programming: [sh, ksh, bash, csh and tcsh; awk; the 100 most important UNIX tools; graphics with gnuplot; system administration and proactive system management]. UNIX shell is an interface for communication between the user and the UNIX kernel (operating system core). It also offers the possibility to accept orders with the help of scripts, which are intended for coordination, automation or simplification of processes. Therefore, shell script programming belongs to the working environment of the system administrator. The first 5 chapters describe commands, techniques and concepts and 130 UNIX tools. The tool awk is particularly taken into account, which is already in the 3rd edition (previous ones not displayed). It consists of a basic and one application part. The first 5 chapters describe commands, techniques and concepts and 130 UNIX tools. The following 3 chapters offer application-related descriptions as well as a good description of the scripts.
content.title_en: Shell script programming : [sh, ksh, bash, csh and tcsh ; awk ; the 100 most important UNIX tools ; graphics with gnuplot ; system administration and proactive system management]

content.text: Comment on immigration law : Residence law and free movement of persons law/EU. The immigration law already introduced a fundamental amendment to the immigration law as of 1 January 2005. The amendments have already been in force for over two and a half years. In summer 2007 the legislator again adopted extensive legislative amendments by the law on residence and asylum law of the European Union. Already the immigration law caused a fundamental amendment to the immigration law as of 1 January 2005. The amendments have already been in force for over two and a half years. The legislator again adopted extensive legislative amendments in summer 2007 by the law on the implementation of residence and asylum law directives of the European Union.
content.title_en: Comment on the immigration law : Residence law and free movement law/EU

content.text: Better PHP programming : Manual of professional PHP techniques; [Design Patterns, PHPUnit, XDebug, Debugging, Security, Errorhandling, Zend Studio, Zend PDT, Frameworks, MVC architecture, Performance optimization and much more]. The far more than kilo-weight volume illuminates the script language PHP very popular with web programmers very intensively with all facets. Möhrke is addressed to professional web developers, but not with hints that are also valuable for ambitious Internet users, e.g. to various character sets and their conversion or the use of csv files, which are often offered when downloading tables on the web. Since the author always offers detailed comments, they are also founded and propagated a good programming style, also experienced programmers receive thought-provoking advice. As with good textbooks usual, this work has also increased from circulation to circulation (from the 1st to the 3rd edition each by around 15%) and many suggestions are included. The pre-releases were not discussed here (the PHP is not yet discussed here).
content.title_en: Better PHP programming : Manual of professional PHP techniques ; [Design Patterns, PHPUnit, XDebug, Debugging, Security, Errorhandling, Zend Studio, Zend PDT, Frameworks, MVC architecture, Performance optimization and much more]

content.text: The new insurance contract law. The fundamental reform of the insurance contract law (VVG) will enter into force on 1 January 2008. The amendment will change the VVG in essential areas and completely recast it, which is why the consultants and representatives of insurers and policyholders must adapt to a completely new legal situation. The fundamental reform of the insurance contract law (VVG) will enter into force on 1 January 2008. The amendment will change the VVG in essential areas and completely recast it, which is why the consultants and representatives of insurers and policyholders must likewise adapt to a completely new legal situation.
content.title_en: The new insurance contract law

content.text: PISA 2006 - School achievements in international comparison: natural science competences for the world of tomorrow. "PISA 2006: natural science competences for the world of tomorrow" presents the results of the latest PISA survey, which focused on basic science education and also evaluated knowledge in mathematics and reading skills. The results are presented in two volumes: The first provides an analysis of the results, the second volume (available only in English and French) contains the underlying data (source: publishing book). How well are students prepared for life? This question is the basis for the OECD's PISA survey, which identifies and analyses student achievements in an international comparison. The OECD has been monitoring the key areas of reading competence, mathematics, natural sciences and problem solving since 2000 every three years: reading literacy, and thus countries can continuously monitor their development of educational outcomes and draw conclusions on educational policy decisions. PISA has set new standards for international educational comparisons, and has been used to provide a comprehensive overview of the political relevance. This volume reports how the participating countries have cut off their reading skills in the third wave.
content.title_en: PISA 2006 - School achievements in an international comparison: science competences for the world of tomorrow

content.text: Major cities of tomorrow: international strategies for urban conversion. Large cities are today laboratories of a tough social structural change. They are forced to rebuild cities in order to compete in global economic competition. They try to strengthen their centres, make public space more attractive and develop new forms of urban housing to attract creative classes. In many big cities there is a boom in urban development.The present book of the Schinkel Centre for Architecture, Urban Research and Monuments of the Technical University Berlin presents international experiences with urban conversion strategies from Barcelona to Tokyo as an example. (Barcelona, Birmingham/Manchester, Chicago, Genoa, London, Lyon, Moscow, Paris, Prague, Rio de Janeiro, Tokyo, Turin.)
content.title_en: Large cities of tomorrow : international strategies for urban conversion

content.text: Basic principles of IT law: the right of data processing and online services. Presentation of information and communication law, with special attention to the telemedia on the Internet. With numerous cases from the case law and the economic practice
content.title_en: Basic principles of IT law: the right to data processing and online services

content.text: The energy pass: [for landlords, administrators and owners; step-by-step instructions for the optimal energy pass; how to improve the energy efficiency of your property; on CD-ROM: sample energy certificates, sample letters, laws; with calculator to the energy characteristic].One of the first real estate guide on this hot topic.With detailed information on the new energy pass for buildings.In addition, practical tips and case examples for calculating the energy requirement.The book offers both the legal foundations and concrete instructions for action for landlords on the procedure of the energy pass.CONTENT Everything about the implementation of the EU directive 2006 The new energy saving regulation (EnEV) 2006 - what do I have to consider? The building energy pass: What calculations are used? What do the calculated energy values say? Who is entitled to issue an energy pass? What costs do landlords have to me? What obligations do buyers have? How can I avoid disadvantages that could arise from the identification?
content.title_en: The Energy Certificate : [for landlords, administrators and owners ; step-by-step instructions for the optimal energy certificate ; how to improve the energy efficiency of your property ; on CD-ROM: sample energy certificates, sample letters, laws; with calculator to the energy characteristic]

content.text: Gardening in urban planning: history and challenges. Under the title "Gardening in urban planning. History and challenges" it raises the question of the importance of gardening, or more commonly expressed, of landscape architecture for the structure and attractiveness of our cities. - - The history of the European city is also a history of urban gardening. Even in the Renaissance, private gardens, squares and promenades have shaped the cities. In the Baroque period, entire cities were created according to the pattern of a garden, in the 19th century the milled ramparts offered starting points for parks and promenades. With industrialization, you were created under built urban quarters. During this period, dedicated social reformers had the first folk parks built. - - Since then, private and public gardens and parks have become more and more important elements of urban planning. Only in the second half of the 20th century this aesthetic dimension was increasingly lost, functional and legal aspects of nature were brought to the fore.
content.title_en: Gardening in urban planning : History and challenges

content.text: Digital hardware/software systems : Synthesis and optimization. This textbook introduces methods for the systematic design of embedded systems. These systems are embedded in a technical context and are specialized for optimum reasons in terms of their tasks, capabilities, interfaces and areas of application, which generally requires the implementation of cooperating hardware and software components. Important areas of application are automotive and consumer electronics as well as communication and medical technology. All methods are described in a uniform notation for hardware and software, with the essential content ranging from modeling to code generation. Due to the increasing importance of embedded systems, this book provides essential knowledge for students of computer science, electrical engineering, information technology and mechatronics and is also a valuable reference and reference work for researchers as well as developers of embedded systems.
content.title_en: Digital hardware/software systems : Synthesis and optimization

content.text: Theoretical Physics 4 : Quantized Fields From Symmetries to Quantum Electrodynamics. This volume begins with a deeper analysis of symmetries in quantum physics. It deals with quantum field theory of scalar fields, Eichbosons and fermions - mainly in canonical quantization - and their applications to important electromagnetic and weak processes. The method of Feynman graphs is illustrated by many examples of quantum electrodynamics and weak interaction, which are carried out up to the observables (scatter cross sections or decay probabilities). The principle of regularization and renormization is described as well as the physical significance of the most important radiation corrections. The book contains both elaborated examples and exercises, which are provided with solutions or clues. New in the 2nd edition are two sections on path integral method in quantum mechanics and field theory. The book concludes with life data and historical notes on some of the founders of quantum mechanics and quantum field theory.
content.title_en: Theoretical Physics 4 : Quantized Fields From Symmetries to Quantum Electrodynamics

content.text: Manual Theories and methods of spatial and environmental planning. Planning methods are gaining increasing importance in spatial and environmental planning. Despite all the shortcomings, they have the advantage of transparency of planning calculations. Methodical approach highlights the need for decision making more clearly and makes it easier to design consensus processes due to the given >> communication ability< < . This is a key insight gained from previous moderation and mediation processes.
content.title_en: Manual Theories and Methods of Spatial and Environmental Planning

content.text: Right for software and web developers: [contracts, insurances, taxes; entry into self-employment; checklists and model contracts]. This guide provides tools for software and web developers who are looking for the way into self-employment. What legal form is the right one? What does a business plan look like? What is there to be observed in copyright and patent law? How do I protect my services? Not least, questions about tax law. With this updated edition (last 2nd edition ID 8/07) Otto adapts the text to the latest legal situation. In concrete terms, the sections on warning (in copyright), e-mail signature as well as deadlines and old charges in tax law new passages are found. Also parts of the new telemedia law and the current case law on open source licenses (keyword GPL 3.0) have been incorporated. Unfortunately, in the language still very strongly influenced by the jurist German. Since the legal questions on software development are emphasized much more strongly, it is recommended, also the title "Right for graphic and web developers" (Uwe Koch and D. Otto: To be replaced by the new edition of the new edition of the new edition of the new version of the new version of the new version of the new version of the new version of the new version of the new version of the new.
content.title_en: Law for software and web developers : [contracts, insurance, taxes ; entry into self-employment ; checklists and model contracts]

content.text: The metropolitan regions in the northwestern part of Germany have been included in the metropolitan region since the mid-1990s by the Hamburg Ministerial Conference on Spatial Planning. What are the prerequisites for the three metropolitan regions? What are the special qualities of the metropolitan regions? And finally: What realistic possibilities of cooperation in the northwestern part of Germany extending beyond these metropolitan regions can be identified? The band first discuss the general framework conditions of the ongoing German discussion on metropolitan regions, then evaluate the fields of action and strategy approaches of the existing large-scale cooperation and finally develop concrete recommendations for action for a content-oriented policy of the metropolitan regions in northwestern Germany. While the metropolitan region of Hamburg has been one of the German metropolitan regions of European importance since the mid-1990s, the areas of Hanover-Braunschweig-Göttingen and Bremen-Oldenburg have been able to identify the possibilities for the metropolitan regions of Northwestern part of Germany?
content.title_en: Metropolregionen und Raumentwicklung / Academy for Spatial Research and Planning ; Part 1: Metropolregionen in Nordwestdeutschland

content.text: Closeness and distance: a field of tension between pedagogical professionalism. The book develops a multifaceted dialogue of these subdisciplines on three levels. In addition to the presentation of the respective strengths of the disciplinary approaches to the tension between proximity and distance, it offers historical and social science discussions on professionalism in the field of tension between social and psychosexual questions and, finally, studies on pedagogical fields of work, which show why the often arduous balancing of this tension is indispensable. The book thus introduces pedagogical action, based on the dialogue of the subdisciplines, into systematic basic questions.
content.title_en: Closeness and distance : a field of tension of pedagogical professionalism

content.text: Energy from biomass : an overview of raw materials and processes. Publisher's text: After biomass plays an ever greater role as an energy source, it is important to know the advantages and disadvantages of the different raw materials and processes for their energy use.The book provides an easy-to-understand overview of processes at various stages of development with hints for further research.The book provides an easy-to-understand overview of processes at different stages of development with hints for further research.
content.title_en: Energy from biomass : an overview of raw materials and processes

content.text: The sound of the pyramids: Plato and the Cheopspyramide - the unravelled wonder of the world; with a folding panel and a CD. With the pyramids the Egyptians created buildings of world renaissance. Why their sight always fascinates us again remained hidden. We only realized that the corner of the pyramids of the embankments are all harmoniously. The search for the reason for this amazing phenomenon led the philosopher Friedrich Wilhelm Korff into the ancient music theory. The secret of the number 5040, which Plato declared the logistical basis of his ideal state, had remained hidden until now even the classical philologists. Korff discovered that this number is in truth a pyramid number. It contains the complete set of dimensions of the Cheopspyramide in verifiable cub lengths. Thanks to its archaeological spookiness and the mathematically exact derivatives Korff succeeds of proof that the inclination angles of all pyramids are formed from musical intervals. Since one cannot hear the sight of the pyramids, the puzzle is solved when one says in the figurative sense of the ancient pyramids, the mythical systems are not known in the ancient.
content.title_en: The sound of the pyramids : Plato and the Cheopspyramide - the unravelled wonder of the world ; with a folding board and a CD

content.text: Statistics with Microsoft Excel. The author teaches practical statistics in companies and universities and has designed these from suggestions derived from this book. The 17 chapters are structured according to application purposes and deal with the following topics, among others, using examples from different industries: e.g. Pareto diagrams using the example of manufacturing errors or Beveridge curves using the example of vacancy and unemployment rate, residuums using the example of patient statistics, normal distribution using the example of blood sugar content or mean values using the BMI coefficient. Von Schweitzer has already published 1 title on the subject of 2003 (BA 7/03), without Excel and statistics knowledge, one should not take the book at hand. Numerous tables and graphics (in black and white), solid and unadorned appearance. Glossary would have been helpful, unlocking code in the e-learning area for libraries poorly suited. Target groups are practitioners from all sectors with previous knowledge, but then find them very precisely to the right statistics.
content.title_en: Statistics with Microsoft Excel

content.text: Basics of the construction firm / Fritz Berner; Bernd Kochendörfer; Rainer Schach ; 2: Construction company planning. Project start/contract assignment - Determination of the contract - Concepts of the construction company planning - Project organization - Process planning - Calculation of the process comparison - Formwork planning - Work safety - Construction site planning and construction site logistics - Work calculation - Resource deployment
content.title_en: Basics of the construction firm / Fritz Berner; Bernd Kochendorfer; Rainer Schach ; 2: Construction company planning

content.text: Gender Research and Natural Sciences : Introduction to a complex interplay. This book closes a gap between gender research and the natural sciences. It offers a systematic introduction for students of the natural sciences who want to learn about gender research and for students of the social and cultural sciences who want to learn about gender research in the natural sciences. It is aimed at an interdisciplinary readership and can be used as teaching material for gender studies. The first part provides a clear example of a start in gender-perspective analyses of biology, chemistry, mathematics and physics. The second part explains central theories and concepts of gender research that are needed for the analysis of the natural sciences disciplines.
content.title_en: Gender and natural sciences: Introduction to a complex interplay

content.text: Management of IT projects : From planning to implementation. It is always surprising how rarely the procedures and methods of project management are consistently used. Many problem-ridden projects speak a clear language here. Knowledge of project management and its application possibilities are indispensable for IT managers and IT developers. In this book the most important methods and methods of project management are presented. The practical relevance is established by the extensive practical knowledge of the authors in the management of IT projects and results in concrete recommendations for action for the implementation of IT projects.
content.title_en: Management of IT projects : From planning to implementation

content.text: Productivity and efficiency analysis : The nonparametric approach. Microeconomically sound introduction: It shows how to get to know productive efficiency without prior knowledge of the production function. The authors present the approach of nonparametric frontier function analysis and expand it over various steps. These steps include the analysis of various forms of variable scale returns and the determination of the most productive enterprise size.
content.title_en: Productivity and efficiency analysis : the nonparametric approach

content.text: Parasites of fish fillets: appearance, biology, food safety. In food hygiene, the assessment of pathological changes in the body muscles of fishes has been relatively subordinated to the microbial spoilage and contamination with pathogenic pathogens and environmental chemicals. This book lists the fish species of the world whose body muscles can be altered pathologically. Most of these are parasites. A number of these parasites can lead to diseases in humans after consumption. Food business operators and the staff of the control and hygiene authorities must know the appearance in the fillet in order to distinguish it from similar deviations differentially diagnosically. According to the relevant questions of food law, the traffic concept, the anatomy and physiology and the general pathology of fish musculature, the book focuses on the parasitic causes of muscle changes. These are mainly ordered according to the classification of the parasite categories involved. Explanations of the investigation methods, their efficiency and measures to avoid a health risk close the book. A bilingual glossary, as well as registers of additional handling of fish species, the fish file names and the fish file names.
content.title_en: Parasites of fish fillet : appearance, biology, food safety

content.text: Learning to program: A basic introduction to Java. The aim of this book is to systematically teach basic programming knowledge. The object-oriented language Java is used in the new version Java 6. The classic programming concepts, such as conditional instructions, loops and recursion, are gradually and thoroughly introduced by the growing demands of the problems considered. Further topics are: objects and (generic) classes, data structures, important algorithms for searching and sorting, simple numerical applications and elementary graph traversing. Modularization concepts and methods of incidental programming by means of threads, exception handling, input and output as well as graphical user interfaces complete the book.
content.title_en: Learning to program : A basic introduction to Java

content.text: Mathematics for Computer Scientists : Volume 2: Analysis and Statistics. Precisely, yet vividly and well comprehensible: Numerous examples explain the mathematical basics and their application in computer science. Historical backgrounds and perspectives on adjacent topics loosen up the book. Control questions at the end of each chapter test the understanding, clear out misunderstandings and avoid typical errors. Numerous exercises with complete solution and further training tasks help to consolidate the learned and implement the practical relevant. The 2nd edition is again very suitable for self-study. Plus: the computer algebra system Mathematica visualizes the teaching material.
content.title_en: Mathematics for Computer Science: Volume 2: Analysis and Statistics

content.text: Poisson geometry and deformation quantization : an introduction. First as a textbook, with detailed evidence and over 100 tasks with solution instructions. The author develops the basics on the topic starting from physical questions. The Poisson geometry provides the framework for geometric mechanics and represents a generalization of symplectic geometry. This is important for mechanical systems with symmetries and their phase spatial reduction. For the desired quantization, the geometrical facts are algebraic interpreted and formulated accordingly. Building on this, the deformation quantization provides the framework for the quantization of Poisson mannities.
content.title_en: Poisson geometry and deformation quantization : an introduction

content.text: Stochastic integration and time series modelling: an introduction with applications from financing and econometrics. Stochastic integral calculus and time series modelling play a crucial role for economists in the modelling of financial markets and for the statistical inference of instationary time series. The elementary and at the same time rigorous introduction looks at both areas. Readers thus learn about the modern methods of mathematical finance theory and time series econometrics. At the end of each chapter, over 100 problems and exercise tasks together with complete solution, which contain further technical details and evidence. Plus: illustrative examples and as few mathematical derivations as possible.
content.title_en: Stochastic integration and time series modelling: an introduction to applications from financing and econometrics

content.text: The struggle for the Second World: empires and influence in the new world order. Within a few years the geopolitical fabric of the 21st century has changed dramatically. New constellations are suddenly conceivable or already reality. In addition to the defiant superpower USA, two other global players are preparing to assert their interests and influence in shaping the future world order: the European Union and China. The focus of these very different empires" new styles is mainly on the states of the Second World - that large but surprisingly underestimated group of countries in which the prosperity of the First World is impacting on the misery of the Third World. According to Parag Khanna, the strategic and economic importance of these states in Eastern Europe, Central Asia, Latin America, the Middle East and East Asia is hardly to be overestimated. The way they respond to the challenges of globalization and the avenues of the three empires" will be decisive for the future world order. Parag Khanna's impressions, his view of the great interrelations as for detail and his radical new perspective will make his indispensable, the way of becoming a globalized and the way forward of crisis, and the way of understanding the challenges that are always present.
content.title_en: The Battle for the Second World : Imperience and Influence in the New World Order

content.text: Everything feels: man, nature and the revolution of life sciences. The author develops a biology of feeling, according to which all living beings are connected by the power of feeling. His natural philosophy stands in the field of tension between subjective natural experience and objective modern scientific facts. (Helmut Köhne) The author opposes a prevailing understanding of nature, which is determined by the idea that organisms are controlled by genes like automats and functioned like machines. He tries to design a biology of feeling, according to which all living beings are connected by the power of feeling. From this world view, the necessary ethical consequence for him is to save the environment in order to protect the souls of humans. Weber develops a natural philosophy in the field of tension between subjective natural experience, natural aesthetics and natural mysticism on the one hand, and modern, objective natural scientific facts on the other. A book in the first line for larger libraries with expanded biological stocks. (3) (Helmut Köhne)
content.title_en: Everything feels : Humanity, Nature and the Revolution of the Life Sciences

content.text: The excluded: the end of the dream of a just society. Our society is facing a deep division. This book makes clear why we must say goodbye to the dream of a just society. More and more people are excluded from the blessings of prosperity and have no hope of changing anything. Lifecycles, which were considered to be solid, are becoming slurred because jobs, which were certainly believed to be broken. Unskilled auxiliary workers can be as well as highly qualified scientists. Heinz Bude, one of the best connoisseurs of German society, for the first time designs a comprehensive picture of those rugged conditions that will increasingly shape our society in the future. Now is the time to discuss how we want to live in the future.
content.title_en: The excluded: the end of the dream of a just society

content.text: Ajax Security : secure Web 2.0 applications. Web applications with AJAX are en vogue and are spreading increasingly. However, with popularity and dissemination level, the risk of possible attacks is also increasing. AJAX applications are not necessarily more vulnerable than conventional web applications in terms of security, but of course the security aspect is central to every serious developer. The book summarizes the most important security issues in a compact form. It describes different attack techniques divided into "attacks on web applications", "attacks on HTTP" and "attacks on TCP/IP". Furthermore, the topic is: Cross-site scripting, web services, mashups, JSON and others. The potential for danger is briefly presented, in order to show prevention and solution strategies afterwards. Without too much theoretical ballast, the programmer is pointed to the potential vulnerabilities of his application and can thus quickly take countermeasures.
content.title_en: Ajax Security : secure Web 2.0 applications

content.text: Practical guide Building cleaning : Expertise compact. Short, compact guide for practice on treatment products, occupational safety, floor coverings, cleaning methods for beginners and professionals in the building cleaning trade. Also deals with personnel management and addresses special features in cleaning in the healthcare sector; provides clear, attractively illustrated information. Is scarcer, to this end higher in the approach than "technical knowledge building cleaning" (BA 9/05, more for Azubi). The author is an expert in the matter and has presented in the self-publishing the "special book building cleaning" (3rd edition: 2003, not displayed here). Unfortunately without material register. Otherwise, well usable for the addressed user group. (2) (LK/N: Pleuß) Publisher's text: This brochure provides an overview of the current cleaning technologies, cleaning chemistry, materials, basic hygiene, work and environmental protection as well as the most important legal requirements for cleaning. The user can always obtain a quick overview of the possibilities of cleaning, moreover, the practical proximity of the texts of the object management can serve as a daily work aid.
content.title_en: Practical Guide to cleaning buildings : expertise compact

content.text: Sociology of imitation and desire : Materials on Gabriel Tarde. Publisher's info: Franzose Gabriel Tarde (1843-1904) was one of the most important and original sociologists of his time, but was largely forgotten in the 20th century. This collection presents Tarde not only as a classic that was neglected, but also shows the great potential of his sociology of difference for the current sociological theory formation. The international and interdisciplinary contributions deal in particular with the role of imitation and the desire streams for the functioning of society and culture. This is the connection of the volume to the newly developing Tarde discussion in the context of poststructuralism, network theories and aesthetics.
content.title_en: Sociology of imitation and desire : Materials to Gabriel Tarde

content.text: Monitoring in spatial planning : Examples of approaches to monitoring environmental impacts during plan implementation from Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland. The present ARL work material is focused on approaches to monitoring environmental impacts during plan implementation on examples from Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland. Following a systematic presentation of the subject matter, objectives and requirements of monitoring, requirements for planning practice are formulated. Two findings are of crucial importance: firstly, that "implementation" is always a priority in subsequent administrative action, and secondly, that the prerequisite for taking monitoring measures is always the assumption of a demonstrable causality between observable environmental changes and plan setting. Based on this, possible approaches for monitoring in the countries under consideration are presented and assessed in terms of their degree of relevance for spatial overall planning. Finally, initial considerations on the integration of monitoring approaches into evaluation concepts are outlined as the basis of plan development.
content.title_en: Monitoring in spatial planning: Examples of approaches to monitoring environmental impacts in the implementation of plans from Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland

content.text: The end of the drawer: the power of the new digital disorder. Whether we walk, shop or entertain - we constantly divide the living beings and things that surround us into different categories: trees and flowers, dairy products and vegetables, sympathetic people and unsympathetic. So we create order and find ourselves in the world as in a library - everything has its place. This order is going to be shaken, says David Weinberger. Our thinking in fixed categories does not continue to lead us in the long term, we must learn to deal with chaos, disorder and blur. Only in this way can we understand why projects like Wikipedia work, why YouTube, Flickr and iTunes are so popular and successful. That's no less than a revolution: because at once experts lose their power, social networks become increasingly influential, customers and citizens decide themselves because they know best what they want. Everyone is concerned about exactly the information he needs and brings it into the order that best benefits him. A fascinating panorama of the digital world from one of the most profiled internet thinkers.
content.title_en: The end of the drawer: the power of the new digital disorder

content.text: Home for people with dementia: current developments in nursing home construction - examples and experience of use. Introducing demographic factors, the paradigm shift in nursing home construction, modern intervention and housing concepts for demented people as well as integrated construction and operational planning are described. In the main part, 18 selected nursing facilities in Germany, Switzerland, Denmark and Finland are presented in detail with plan types, room offer, interior design, care and care concept, positive and negative usage experiences and colour photographs. The actual target group are architects, planners and builders of nursing facilities, however, through the insight into modern therapy concepts and current nursing home developments for dementia patients the title is more applicable. Recommended before "Drawing satellites Living in Age" (ID-G 34/10). (3) (LK/KA: Nibrig) The architect Nieg shows in large-scale care facilities in Germany, and in large-scale care facilities.

content.text: Power and powerlessness in the class: what makes teachers strong. Power is frowned upon in social-pedagogical professions, but power relations shape the everyday life of the school. What lies in the power of the teachers and where does this end? Some teachers feel deprived of their responsibility for difficult conditions in school. Is a democratic coexistence of students and teachers viable? This book helps to develop a new understanding of roles by presenting everyday (ear) power situations and offering action possibilities.

In a sport such as golf, which requires considerable space, the landscape integration is particularly important taking into account the natural conditions in connection with a high level of landscape design. content.text: What is the story of the world? How politics and media jump around with climate research. More and more shrillly warn the headlines and reports of an imminent climate catastrophe. Fear reports, simplified blame assignments and emotional charge characterize the reporting, and politicians of all parties seize the opportunity to set themselves up as a protection force for the world climate and demand victims from the citizen - whereby the control of success can only happen in the distant future. As always when it comes to saving humanity, neither delay nor contradiction is tolerated. There are words that one does not use, truths that one does not speak, and questions that one should not ask. The debate has reached a point where scientists and journalists use a spiral of silence. No one dares to contradict each other any more. Fear is a good instrument of domination, but a bad guide. Dirk Maxeiner wants to take the fear and put it into the position of his readers, to make an independent picture of the events in our environment and society. What climate changes can actually be measured and observed? Is there new findings that hide the dramatic sense of the catastrophe? What is the story of the story? What is the story of the story of the story?
content.title_en: Hurrah, we save the world! : how politics and media jump around with climate research

They lead to economic and social catastrophes in the affected regions, civil wars and huge refugee flows. And this happens precisely where the living conditions are disastrous anyway. The research professor for social psychology (Uni Witten/Herdecke) is not concerned with "wars" in the conventional sense. The author known for books on the perpetrators of the Holocaust ("Opa was not a Nazi", ID 34/02, "Käter", BA 11/05) deals here with the consequences of climate warming in general and the consequences that society and its economic and political elites derive from it. Interstate wars about natural resources do not exist until now, but civil wars, unstable states and enormous population migrations are limited. Pessimistically, he states that "... even when it comes to survival, cultural, social and symbolic factors often play a greater role (play) than the ecological self-preserving, "the historical catastrophe" and "the global crisis" is "extended."

Today, the invasive digitization of science and society requires a revision of this category, as life itself makes itself a new agent. Nature, body and life have now received a power of their own through which the classical mantra class, gender, ethnicity - obviously generates itself as an artificial and artistic position, as politically usable or as a commercial position.

content.text: Climate Report international. Just before the UN Climate Conference in Bali, the Konrad Adenauer Foundation publishes the Climate Report International. More than 50 KAS staff from abroad report on how climate change is perceived in Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America. The report provides an overview of the impacts of climate change and how climate change is handled in individual countries. The reports are based on five key questions: How is climate change discourse in the country of deployment going? What are the consequences of climate change as acute problems? What reactions have been made to the report by Sir Nicolas Stern and the IPCC? How does politics deal with the issue? Who are the actors? All foreign staff are experienced experts in the political environment in their countries of deployment. Each individual can give an accurate assessment of the importance of climate protection measures beyond the solemn declarations in international conferences in the context of day-to-day political activities. In this respect, the Climate Report serves to provide information on perception and national concerns in the field of climate change and climate protection.

Increasing energy prices and the necessary carbon dioxide reduction make the question of an economical and sensible house technology system for water heating and heating increasingly meaningful. The author is an architect for wooden houses in different energy standards and offers here a factual and numerical comparison of current gas, heat pump and wood heating in a newly built EFH or EFH old buildings of the 60s, 70s and 80s. The basis for calculation are the standards and characteristic values of the current EnEV as well as the intensified funding guidelines of the KfW. Numerous tables, diagrams and comparative representations offer architects, planners and interested builders a good comparison of energy values, investment and consumption costs. With a comparison of 17 built single and row houses and the actually incurred investment and consumption costs. Recommended according to the practical advisors on modern heating technology of Bo Hanus (BA 1/08), H. Westkämper (BA 4/08), J. Brück (BA) 608).
content.title_en: Which heating does the house need? : Heating and ventilation systems compared

content.text: The cultural history of the climate: from the ice age to global warming. The catchphrase of climate change makes us forget that the climate itself has a long history. Knowing it is more than just a prerequisite for understanding and evaluating upcoming climatic changes. The climate of past epochs has rather shaped our way of life and our culture: construction, water and agriculture, food and clothing, even social crises can be traced back directly or indirectly to the influences of the climate. The historian Wolfgang Behringer combines secure climate facts and a broad historical range of sources to a thrilling journey through the climate history of Europe. The book is also well read beyond the scientific sciences.
content.title_en: Cultural history of the climate : from the ice age to global warming

content.text: Mobile Cities: Dynamics of global urban and transport development. For the first time in human history, the majority of the world's population no longer lives in the countryside but in the cities. Global urbanization is accompanied by a rapid social and spatial mobilization of entire societies. While urban and transport development in the developed countries has reached a certain level of saturation, it is progressing with a tremendous dynamic in other world regions. If these countries do the same as the Western model, negative effects on the global scale are to be expected. Therefore, the question is whether there are also examples of alternative development paths that allow sustainable urban and transport development. Because all the indications are that conventional concepts of urban and transport technology, as developed over a hundred years ago in Europe, are not appropriate in view of the limited resources and the ecological consequences today. The primary concern of this study is to present an inventory of the global urban and transport development for the first time in order to take a look at the extent of global challenges. In this context, a proposal is finally made in which direction the future can be considered in order to address the problems.
content.title_en: Mobile Cities : Dynamics of global urban and transport development

Optical and spectroscopic methods for process analysis are very fast, measure contactless and thus non-destructive. With little effort, a 100% control during quality testing is possible. content.text: The social space analysis has become an integral part of social work. In numerous institutions and projects, social space analysis and participation methods are used and implemented in practice. These qualitative methods have been developed in the context of a social space concept development especially in open child and youth work and are increasingly used in other areas of social work, including social space-oriented youth assistance planning. The book provides theoretical foundations and presents current methods for different fields of social work: from child and youth work to day care facilities, regional working communities of youth assistance, opening up school to seniors. Specific methods for large groups or social reporting are presented. The relationship between virtual and real (social) spaces is discussed and methods are described which use virtual spaces. Specific methods and projects are presented on the special social space conditions of rural areas. - The book provides theoretical foundations and presents current methods for different fields of social work: from child and youth work to day care facilities, regional working spaces of youth assistance, the social space for the elderly and the practical working groups.
content.title_en: Social Area Methodbook

Therefore, it is a worthy company of the author to have compiled the most important points compactly, with the help of which the loading time of websites can be accelerated - partly considerably. The "14 rules" deal with very different aspects such as HTTP requests, compression, stylesheets, DNS lookups, JavaScripts, redirects or AJAX. After the introduction of the problem fields these are illustrated afterwards with a performance analysis of large and well-known websites like AOL or Wikipedia. As an addressee addressed can feel above all professional web developers. Deeper knowledge in CSS, JavaScript, AJAX and especially in TCP and HTTP are required. Also for these persons the tips are probably only partially relevant, because there are really large websites with high access rates in the foreground. The book is very well done and of high use, also because similar titles are missing. (3)
content.title_en: High-Performance Websites : [14 professional rules to optimize your website]

content.text: Urban prayers: new religious movements in the global city. In recent decades, social organizational forms in the poverty districts of the big cities have changed dramatically. Where formerly left-secular movements had great influence, religious actors have dominated urban everyday life. In the international debates on urban social movements, the focus is almost exclusively on groups that follow more classical ideas of mobilization and organization. Religiously shaped movements or religious communities generally do not correspond to this image. On the other hand, the public presence of new religious communities, which are now unsurpassable in the cities as political actors and which even frequently take on replacement roles in the global south, is rarely investigated scientifically or politically discussed. This volume explores the relevance of new religious movements for current urban conflicts and transformations in different cities and in the global context. It contains a cross-section of texts and conversations from research collaborations in Africa, Asia, Latin America and Europe on the relationship between city, religion and politics, which cast as precise a view on the phenomenon "Urban Prayers".
content.title_en: Urban prayers : new religious movements in the global city

content.text: Clusters: the new stage of capitalism. "Cluster" literally means "Haufen". In the new management theory, the term for the aggregation of innovative enterprises is a strategic core. Silicon Valley was an early example of clusters of this kind. Out of these cores strategies of organization, capitalist command and globalization are developed. Cluster is the new key concept, with which the orientation of the people and regions to the innovation and productivity needs of the capitalist command is to be achieved. This booklet deals with the regional cluster strategies of the model example Wolfsburg. The authors trace the strategies of this postmodern access to the population of the region. At its core are the Hartz programs, but the impoverishment policy is only one of their strands. Overall, they aim at the total capture of the subjective resources of the region, to self-activation under constant control. "Cluster" policies solve the old social strategies and reorganize them on a new level.
content.title_en: Cluster : the new stage of capitalism

content.text: Meteorology and climatology: An introduction. The book is an introduction to the fascinating world of weather and climate. Particular emphasis is placed on an understandable presentation. The numerous illustrations, which have been extended by around 20 in this edition, also contribute to this. After the treatment of the physical foundations of the atmosphere, the chapters that deal with the (synoptic) weather phenomena and the weather forecast follow.The general circulation then represents the link between the short-term weather and the long-term climate behaviour.The chapters on climate change and the city climate round off the book.In contrast to the 4th edition, the statements on the weather-determining long waves in the atmosphere, the behaviour of hurricanes (including the New Orleans hurricane Katrina) and the weather forecast models are substantially expanded. In relation to the diverse climate aspects, substantial extensions to the climate system of the earth as a whole, to the climate zones and climate classifications as well as to global, hemispheric and central European climate change are also addressed.
content.title_en: Meteorology and climatology : An introduction

content.text: The authors of the book "Colour - Communication in Space". Publisher's info: Colours are part of our environment, both natural and human. They convey messages of all kinds and fulfil so different functions: they inform, arrange, warn. They also serve to fulfill aesthetic motifs, influence the statement, effect and acceptance of objects and spaces. As different reactions to colours are possible, however, generally valid colour concepts can be established in design questions, which meet the expectations of the different user groups. This book offers a guide based on a wide range of scientific findings and serves as a qualified consulting basis for the architectural student as well as the specialist. The three editors, Dr. B. Rodeck, Prof. G. Meerwein and F. H. Mahnke, are long-standing lecturers at the Salzburg seminars on color and environment of the IACC.
content.title_en: Color - Communication in space

content.text: Living Systems: Innovative materials and technologies for landscape architecture. Living Systems represents a variety of novel material technologies for landscape architecture. The projects and materials are created in close collaboration between designers, engineers, scientists and ecologists. In a combination of practical representation and theoretical background technologies focus on topics such as growth, flow, metabolism, climate and weather phenomena. The presentation connects the materials and technologies according to their functions, processes and properties. Detailed drawings and construction-relevant photos illustrate the 36 international projects and 23 material examples. The complex systems include vertical growth structures, prevention from flooding, rainwater leaching plants and minimization of soil erosion. Example projects include West8 (Netherlands), GROSS.MAX (Great Britain), Weiss-Manfredi Architects (USA), Kathryn Gustafson (USA) and Vogt Landschaftsarchitekten (Switzerland). The use of innovative new materials is an important trend in landscape architecture to day. These words of substance.
content.title_en: Living Systems : Innovative materials and technologies for landscape architecture

content.text: Political strategy: A basic idea. Everyone is talking about strategy, but hardly anyone asks what is behind it. This book finally provides political strategy analysis a foundation from which it can be further developed. The addressees are practical politics and political science. In-depth and with references to practical-empirical examples, the three central building blocks of the entire strategy making are developed: strategy capability, strategy formation, strategic control. This is followed by case studies on strategic politics in the history of the Federal Republic of Germany, which illustrate the systematic connections and at the same time demonstrate the far-reaching potential of strategy analysis.

content.text: Integration in Germany: between assimilation and multiculturalism. Parties, associations, media, locals and immigrants: all are for integration. However, the consensus on integration policy in Germany is limited to the fact that everyone uses the concept of integration, although they often mean very different things. This introduction to integration sociology presents the most important concepts, positions and concepts and for the first time systematically answers the question of what integration can or should be. The basic questions are: Do immigrants have to adapt to the host society at all? If yes, how and how far? The starting point is the realization that societies depend on the integration of their members. The integration of immigrants is therefore only a special case of general integration. This results in a two-level model. In structurally functional integration, however, locals and immigrants do not differ. While the locals are naturally integrated into the existing culture, immigrants are asked what model of cultural-identificatory integration should apply: Assimilation, accultuation and various forms of multiculturalism are available to us.
content.title_en: Integration in Germany : between assimilation and multiculturalism

content.text: Atlas of World Entanglements: a book of graphs on poverty, prosperity and the future in the One World. Wherever a reflection on global development is to be initiated, the Atlas of World Entanglements is indispensable. Graphs, each supplemented by explanations and ideas for mediation, provide excellent material for teaching. The fact that one in five people live in poverty or that around 100 species of animals and plants are eradicated every day, suggests that we have not yet really understood many "world entanglements". The book of graphs refers to these connections. Poverty, population development, living standards in the North and South, but also economic trends in world trade and investment or the unequal environmental consumption are among the global developments that are taken up here. The graphs are seen as materials for teaching (Sek. I/II), adult education and community work. They are complemented by one text page explanations and didactic suggestions.
content.title_en: Atlas of World Entanglements: a chartbook on poverty, prosperity and the future in the One World

content.text: Since the 11th century, new cities have been created from settlements around castles and monasteries. More and more serfs from the surrounding area settle in these places. They were usually unrecoverable for their landlords. The right-wing usage arose: A serf in a city could no longer be demanded back by its landlord after year and day. So city air released in the truest sense of the word. Jörg Schwarz draws a vivid picture of the medieval city. Who lived there? What social groups existed there? Who ruled and what role did the bourgeoisie play in it? Who was one of the outsiders? What did the city do for its inhabitants and where were its problems? The city of Cologne is a prime example in the depiction, but the view also goes back and forth to other cities and beyond the German borders of the town.
content.title_en: City air frees up : Living in the medieval city

The treatises on population, natural space, agriculture, trade and industry, tourism and settlement structures are documented with numerous graphics, tables and maps. The most recent data of the statistics are mainly from the 1990s. In the appendix a comprehensive literature list, registers, a country overview in figures and facts and a picture block with small color photographs. No comparison title is known. The rich in material country studies for pupils of secondary school and students is suitable. (2 S) Folding text: For many Greece is synonymous with sun, recreation and classical excavation sites. These aspects may not be missing in any geographical country science, but they shorten the multi-faceted and multi-layered image of this country. The volume therefore has the goal to a deeper understanding of the rooms, structures and classical sites and archaeological sites. These aspects are treated to natural in any geographical history, and in the past.
content.title_en: Greece : Spatial change in the south of the Balkan Peninsula; 70 maps and illustrations; 39 tables and 74 tables; in the annex a coloured part of the picture with comments

content.text: Turkey. Series introduced in the meantime; this volume looks particularly at the problems of agriculture, agglomerations and water supply, urban growth and rural exodus, mass tourism and nature and environmental protection, guest workers and their reintegration problems etc. An important book for pupils of secondary school and students, which, with extensive literature list and numerous tables, should be available alongside the numerous travel guides at least in big city libraries. (2) (LK/WIT: Schwab)
content.title_en: Turkey

content.text: All Mathematics : from Pythagoras to the CD Player. Publisher's text: Mathematics is in demand everywhere in the applications, because it is often the only means to analyze and understand practical problems. In the 3rd edition now available for the year of mathematics 2008, the spectrum of topics covered has been expanded by new contributions. One can now find out about mathematics in the climate of global change, the Poincare presumption, an extraordinary view into infinity and surprising insights about chance. Also in the contributions already contained in the previous editions there are numerous updates. The editors wish readers again many exciting hours in discovering the different facets of mathematics.
content.title_en: All Mathematics : from Pythagoras to CD Player

content.text: The European Union, following the Treaty of Lisbon. The Treaty of Lisbon marks a new stage in the process of European integration. Based on the draft Constitution of the Convention on the Future of the European Union, the Treaty of Lisbon will be the new legal basis for the Union for the coming years. The authors of this volume provide a comprehensive and systematic overview of the new Treaty work. They will examine the reform of the institutions and changes in individual policy areas and analyse opportunities for further development of the EU.
content.title_en: The European Union under the Treaty of Lisbon

content.text: The company Babylon: how globalization threatens the soul. The globalization and the accompanying change of social structures also changes the human psyche, Winterhoff-Spurk (see last ID 5/05). Using Pieter Breughel's 1563 painting "The Tower of Babylon" he describes the social change processes in transition situations in a very detailed manner and shows how people react mentally. They get scared, feel threatened and become receptive to groups and leaders who promise them commitment and justice. Winterhoff-Spurk warns of this economic and mental situation and calls on the economic and economic elites to see the signs and to react correctly. A sound analysis from a psychological point of view, highly interesting and continuing for all interested parties, not only for decision makers in business and politics. (2) The first psychological consideration of globalization and its effect on the individual. The author uses Peter Breughel's famous painting "The Tower of Babylon" to show how people react psychologically to social changes. At that time an unguided transformation process led to the misery of social unrest and of long-term economic war.
content.title_en: Business Babylon: how globalization threatens the soul

content.text: Generation Internet: The digital natives: how they live, what they think, how they work. The change that the digital revolution has triggered is not only in sophisticated search engines and new business models. The growing gap between those born in the sign of the zodiac "Internet" and those who do not.The children of a new generation who cannot imagine life without Google are now of age. They are the first "digital natives" whose media habits profoundly change our economy, our culture, even our family life.The changes that have been visible so far are only the tip of the iceberg.How does this globally connected generation of "Digital Natives" live? How do they differ from previous generations? How do they deal with information? Do they safeguard their privacy? What does identity mean for young people who have online profiles and avatars? How do companies have to communicate with them? What opportunities and risks arise for society? Based on current research results, this book of internet expert John Palfrey and Urs Gasser characterizes the portrait of a digitally born generation, and want to know the future.
content.title_en: Generation Internet: the digital natives: how they live, what they think, how they work

content.title_en: The formula for enjoyment : culinary physics

content.text: The demographic future of Europe: how the regions change. How does the good "old" Europe develop? In many places, the number of children is low and more and more people are getting into retirement age. Social systems are facing great challenges everywhere. Old and new member states of the European Union want to benefit from EU enlargement. Cheap production is moving to the east, but the most earned is still in the innovation centres in the north and the west. At the same time, half of Europe has been following the migration process - always the jobs. One thing is certain. The Europe of 2030 will look completely different from the continent of today.All 27 EU countries and important non-EU countries such as Iceland, Norway and Switzerland are analysed and evaluated using a statistical indicator system in their demographic and economic development. In addition, the other European nations will find a separate view.General chapters analyse how the different countries react to the changes and what can be learned from them. How Iceland or Italy, France or Bulgaria deal with their migrants, how they reform their education system, what they start with empty regions and what family policies they operate.
content.title_en: The demographic future of Europe: how regions change

content.text: The abolition of species: Roman. The age we know has long since fallen asleep. Where once Europe was, there are only three labyrinthine cities that have grown more than they were built. The world belongs to the animals. Fish argue about sodomy, theologians with hawk heads search in archives for testimonies of humanity, and Cyrus Golden, the lion, directs the state of the three cities. As an overpowering opponent threatens the new society, he sends the wolf Dimitri as diplomats to seek an ally in the former North America. The night trip over the ocean and into the deep tunnels of natural history teaches the wolf Riskantes about war, art and politics and leads him to the edge of his world, where he recognizes "why did happen to the people what happened to them".
content.title_en: The Abolition of Species : Roman

content.text: In the context of the religious discourse, the religious discourse in France and Germany is closely linked to the modern self-image of European societies. Recently, they have been the subject of passionate controversy. The dissolution of religious milieus, the individualization of religious faith, and above all the migration-related pluralization of the religious field, present a series of new challenges to democratic communities. This volume, which presents the results of a multi-annual Franco-German research cooperation, examines from a sociological perspective the relationship between religion and politics in national and post-national constellations. The prerequisite for this joint work was an understanding of whether and to what extent the classical sociological discourses on religion are influenced by the historical course of state and nation formation in the late 19th century. This question is precisely the first part of the volume. Starting from a conceptual consideration of "secularization" and "laicity", these concepts of religion are examined under the terms of Émile Durkheim, Max Weber and Georg Simmel, and on the cultural struggles, these concepts of the German religious discourse are still validly discussed in the context of the German religious discourse.
content.title_en: Controversies of Religion in France and Germany

content.text: To Iraq and Afghanistan: what comes when the Western troops go?. Western troop associations will not remain permanently in the crisis regions, according to Dyer is only a matter of time. The Canadian political scientist and historian is an Middle East expert and has been working since the 1970s as a journalist for press, radio and television; his columns on international politics appear worldwide in over 175 newspapers. He analyses the current situation in the Middle East and puts the region in a precise way, explaining the protagonists and their motives, whether they are the complex tribal relations in Afghanistan, the clashes between Shiites and Sunnis in the Iak or the political forces in Israel, Syria or Lebanon, which have an impact on stability and peace far beyond their borders. The loss of image of the West in the face of a disastrous retraction and the right of peoples to self-determination legitimize the region itself to take its fate into account.
content.title_en: To Iraq and Afghanistan: what happens when the Western troops leave?

content.text: The journalist Keller focuses on this little-known aspect of the use of corpses, which has a much larger dimension than organ transplantation or the trade in organs. In the case of tissue donation, body parts are separated from the body in order to prepare the heart valves, bones, tendons, skin parts in different ways, which are then implanted into other people. This also means, however, that during cosmetic operations, body tissue from the muscles of the thigh ends ends up in the lips, nose or penis of another person. The author documents the "market of possibilities" in the tissue industry, its commercialization and its scandals (e.g. criminal body trade or G. von Hagen's "body worlds"), gives an overview of the industry actors in Germany and analyses the sold-out legal dimension, the ethical standards neglected. The conclusion of the committed and well-founded report: The dead human body must not be "scapped" at every price.
content.title_en: Excavated: the human body as a raw material

content.text: Real estate crisis in the United States: historical comparison and implications for economic development. The noticeable slowdown in the economy in the United States due to the real estate market crisis is expected to continue until 2009. A comparison with the trends of historical real estate market downturns in 15 developed countries and an analysis based on a vector-author-egressive model can be expected to continue the housing recession probably until mid-2009. For total economic production, all results indicate that the development is expected to be weak, especially in the first half of 2008, but that there is a significant decline in production in both quarters is not mandatory. Over the entire real estate market downturn, the economic situation is likely to be less affected by the strong development during the past summer half-year than the average of the historical crises. This is not least due to the very low real interest rate level.
content.title_en: Real estate crisis in the United States : historical comparison and implications for the economic cycle

content.text: I will be here in the sunshine and in the shadow : novel. We are in the middle of a dog-year-old world war. Fascist Germany is fighting against the Soviet Republic of Switzerland, which was founded in 1917 by the revolutionary Lenin. The hero is a black political commissioner who is after a counterrevolutionary. A geopolitical fantasy novel in the sound of the First World War. - SWR Best List October 2008
content.title_en: I'll be here in the sunshine and in the shadows : Roman

content.text: Digital working techniques for humanities and cultural sciences. The book provides knowledge and skills for advanced students, lecturers and researchers in the humanities in dealing with new media, open access and digital publishing practices. It focuses on rights and obligations in dealing with digital texts and images, addresses the different situations in the German-speaking countries and provides further literature and sources on these topics.
content.title_en: Digital working techniques for humanities and cultural sciences
