content.text: Political participation: Introduction to dialogue-oriented instruments of political and social participation. Political and social participation is an interdisciplinary cross-cutting topic. The aim of this volume is therefore to present an introductory and textbook which is suitable for political science, sociological and educational discussion and teaching, which exemplifies modern instruments of political and social discussion. In this context, a bow is drawn from representative democracy, which designs the citizen as an information subject, to discursive interactively designed procedures that correspond more closely to models of deliberative politics and a democracy based on a comunitarist and civil society.
content.title_en: Political participation: introduction to dialogue-oriented instruments of political and social participation

content.text: Handbook on Conflict and Violence Education : Procedures for School and Youth Aid. The authors present pedagogical approaches and concepts for dealing with conflicts and violence in youth aid and school. In addition, essays on overarching questions and references to international perspectives The authors present pedagogical approaches and concepts for dealing with conflicts and violence in youth aid and school.
content.title_en: Handbook on conflict and violence education : Procedures for school and youth assistance

content.text: Food goes through the stomach: the small nutrition teaching. Our digestive organs do hard work every day to disassemble the different foods into their nutrients. The booklet describes the organs involved, their tasks and the processes that are taking place. In addition, the brochure explains the structure and function of proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals. Also the importance of the fiber and the way the absorbed fluid are described. An additional chapter answers particularly frequently asked questions, in which e.g. the most favorable eating times, heartburn or the effect of laxatives are discussed. A real basic work that communicates the complex processes of digestion entertainingly and easily understandable (source: aid).
content.title_en: Eating goes through the stomach : the small nutrition teaching

content.text: Theories and methods of history. Basic introduction to theory, method and history of history, designed for bachelor students.
content.title_en: Theories and methods of historical science

content.text: Basic course on data communication : TCP/IP-based communication: basics, concepts and standards. Works on data communication have not been discussed for a long time (notably: F. Kauffels: ID 12/97, no longer current). The author of the present book P. Mandl is known for a similar book on operating systems (BA 6/08). The book on data communication here is addressed to first semesters of (economic) computer science. Also for self-study the book is well suited. Practical presentation, the current communication systems and protocols (TCP, UDP, IP, IPv6, DHCP, ARP, DNS, http, ...) are discussed in detail. One focus is on higher communication layers. But also technical bases of networks and the basic concepts of mobile communication are well considered. Many demonstrators and examples. At the end of each chapter exercise tasks (with solutions in the appendix). On a separate website well-prepared slides to the individual chapters.
content.title_en: Basic course on data communication : TCP/IP-based communication: basics, concepts and standards

content.text: 50 wellness houses : living with all senses. Who doesn't dream of a perfect house to feel good? This book helps to make reality out of the longing. 50 mostly unpublished flagship projects point the way to their own dream house and fascinating living ambience. Detailed portraits of newly built, converted or at the highest level designed single family houses are illustrated in high-quality photographs and detailed plans and presented in text based presentation - whether living rooms with fabulous views and air for breathing through, kitchens for cooking and well-being, baths with wellness experience in their own four walls or bedrooms for a thousand and one night ... So exciting and relaxing can feel good architecture be! Basic information about architecture and interior design - for all senses and tastes atmospheric projects from Germany, Austria, Spain and Switzerland Funded descriptions and detailed plans
content.title_en: 50 wellness houses : living with all senses

content.text: The maid : Roman. Lynn Zapatek is a maid, an extremely thorough one. Gradually she develops a personal relationship with the things she finds, to pieces of paper, books, whatever. She sniffs the foreign clothes. She puts them on...But then she doesn't get out of the room fast enough, she crawls under the bed
content.title_en: The maid : Roman

content.text: Networking in the health sector : Competition and cooperation. Networking is one of the orientation points in the reform of the health sector. Competition and cooperation are being redesigned between service providers in hospital associations, franchise systems, medical and nursing networks, integrated care structures, and systems of managed care and corporate health management. Many of these networking concepts are still being tested, but there are already initial practical experiences.The volume discusses fundamental problems and paradoxes of networking in the health sector.
content.title_en: Networking in the health sector : competition and cooperation

content.text: Manual Dialogue of Religions : Christian sources on religious theology and interreligious dialogue. Interreligious dialogue is becoming increasingly urgent in a world in which the faithful of different religions come together more closely. To be able to properly enter into the encounter, it is important to deal with the foundations of interreligious understanding and to raise awareness of dialogue. The theology of religions, which has been developed in Christian theology for many decades, has produced many basic texts. In this volume are classical texts by Ernst Troeltsch, Karl Barth; Hendrik Kraemer, Paul Tillich, Wolfhart Pannenberg and others, but also difficult to access texts by Asian theologians such as Francis DSa and Aloysius Pieris. Likewise, the dialogue rules of Leonard Swidler and the dialogue interpretations of Raimon Panikkar as well as relevant church documents from the 2nd Vatican Council and the Ecumenical Council of Churches are documented as a basis for the study of religions. They are introduced in a general problem-oriented overview and are provided with short presentations.
content.title_en: Manual Dialogue of Religions : Christian Sources on Religion Theology and Interreligious Dialogue

content.text: The German Warplace: Stalin's war plans against the West. Review: The controversial, hardly degraded Furor, Polish-born historian (most recently ID 40/00) presents an ambitious scientific study that wants to break open a taboo: this is likely to provoke discussions. Musial, who could evaluate unknown materials from Russian archives, does not warm up the controversial thesis in his well-readable book, which led Hitler to wage a preventive war against Soviet Russia (cf. V. Suvorov, BA 10/95, W. Post, ID 10/96). However, the Soviet leadership under Stalin has since the 1920s set in motion a gigantic armament in order to lead a war of aggression against Western Europe with a view to world revolution. The author, who recently initiated an anti-Stalinist campaign against the sociologist Zygmunt Bauman, places the brutal industrialization policy of Stalin as well as the terror of the 1930s in this context of war preparations with historical pre-conceptions.
content.title_en: Battleground Germany : Stalin's war plans against the West

content.text: Hamburg - Parks and squares of a city worth living : Landscape architecture at a glance. The green side of the inviting city of Hamburg presents in an unusual format: This architectural guide on landscape planning shows the most interesting open spaces of the last five years and gives a view of the development of the green metropolis by the water. 60 projects, selected by an independent jury, are presented with photos, texts and locations. Places, parks and promenades, urban green and public space invite with exceptional variety to relax and leisure in the middle of the city. Discover Hamburg's livable page sixty times new. The practical pocket format is always available, the connections with bus and train lead you directly to the destination.
content.title_en: Hamburg - Parks and squares of a livable city : Landscape architecture at a glance

content.text: Almost at the bottom: how to get satisfied with food tablets in Germany. The new poverty has produced a large social movement since the 1990s, namely the "panel movement" with about 800 food tablets in Germany. The sociology professor worked for a year in the daily practice and describes observed, experienced and requested things with customers and helpers. He brings a liquid social reportage in exchange with research from sociological distance about the formation of the tablets, organizational forms, about the throwaway society, which produces 20-40 % food for the garbage and now gives a part of it as questionable symbiosis between supermarkets and tablets. Keeping away a wealth of reflections on the social function, on the composition and motivation of the helpers, the use of arms, which can save at most on food. Selke also poses important questions, e.g. whether tables may be the problem for a social state in the future. With meaningful black and white photos. Special recommendation! (2)
content.title_en: Almost at the bottom: how to get satisfied in Germany by the help of food tablets

content.text: Emotional competence in children. Emotionally competent children can express and regulate their own feelings, recognize and understand the feelings of others and behave empathically and pro-socially in dealing with others. The revised and expanded edition of this book describes from a developmental psychological point of view the education of this central basic competence in the first six years of life and shows references to social behavior, school success and well-being of children. Both temperamental and family influences on emotional development in childhood are discussed and risk factors are referred. The volume describes in detail age-specific procedures of diagnosis of emotional skills in infants, preschool and school children and presents preventive training programs for the promotion of social emotional competence. These include parental programs to promote responsive educational behaviour, training programs to promote social-emotional competence of preschool and primary school children and specific interventions to promote emotional skills in children with special risks.
content.title_en: Emotional competence in children

content.text: Gender inequality in a system-theoretical perspective. The consequence with which Niklas Luhmann spelled out his theory of functional differentiation seems to conflict with the empirically proven research results on gender inequality. However, the fact that one of the most advanced, universally conceived social theories should not allow access to questions of gender inequality has mostly been postulated and not systematically proven. The present contributions explore whether and how gender difference in the context of observation, communication and functional differentiation acts as a distinction that makes a difference.
content.title_en: Gender inequality in a system-theoretical perspective

content.text: Mathematical Modeling. This textbook provides a vivid and vivid introduction to mathematical modelling of phenomena from the natural and engineering sciences. The reader learns to understand and derive mathematical models, and at the same time finds a wealth of important examples for abstract concepts discussed in mathematics studies. Methods from linear algebra, analysis and the theory of ordinary and partial differential equations are used or carefully introduced. Application examples from the fields of electrical networks, chemical reaction kinetics, population dynamics, flow dynamics, elasticity theory and crystal growth are discussed in detail. The volume of the book is suitable for up to two four-hour lectures for students of mathematics and engineering or natural sciences from the fourth semester onwards.
content.title_en: Mathematical modelling

content.text: Physics of particle accelerators and ion optics. The physics of particle accelerators introduces the various accelerator types and their components, and then elaborates on the ion optics with magnetic elements and electrostatic lenses. Another focus is the orbital dynamics of the circle accelerators, whereby both aspects of transversal and longitudinal path dynamics are thoroughly addressed. Methods for injection and extraction as well as beam cooling complete the book. Numerous calculated examples in the text and exercise tasks with solutions serve to deepen. The book is an introduction and a technical book for all those who have to do with particle accelerators.
content.title_en: Physics of particle accelerators and ion optics

content.text: Technical mechanics - Strength theory : textbook with practical examples, exams and solutions. Deformable bodies - Stresses of real components - Stresses, distortions and material law - Thermal elongations and heat stresses - statically determined and undetermined rod systems - Bend of beams - Intersections and their effects - Normal stresses - Surface inertia moments - Bar deformation - Slip bending - Push stresses - Torsion of structures - Levels Voltage and distortion state - Main normal and main thrust stresses - Strength hypotheses - Stability problems - Strength and stability proofs
content.title_en: Technical mechanics - Strength teaching : textbook with practical examples, exam tasks and solutions

content.text: The book "Political Science" is a collection of numerous political science works that are hardly manageable even for the educated political scientist. The key works are intended to help in orientation. From the rich collection of political science literature, the volume extracts those that reflect the development of political science in particular. The exciting journey through political science leads from Plato's political philosophy to the current veto approach of Georg Tsebelis.
content.title_en: Key works of political science

content.text: Questionnaire : a workbook. This book is a "practice book" in the truest sense of the word. It is intended to help researchers who want to use social science surveys in their empirical research. It is intended to provide help in the development of their questionnaires, in concrete and detailed terms. The book simulates questionnaire consultation, as the author has done for many years at the Center for Surveys, Methods and Analysis (ZUMA) in Mannheim, very practical and written in such a way that readers can work with it when developing a questionnaire, with many examples of how to do something wrong and how to do it right. After a short introduction to the cognitive psychology and communicative foundations of the survey, a variety of methodological aspects of a questionnaire are worked out, from types of questions, types of scales and the formulation of questionnaire questions to a good cover page, to survey aids and to the layout of questionnaires, all illustrated by examples from survey practice.
content.title_en: Questionnaire : A workbook

content.text: The basics of his boundary layer meteorology: Introduction to the physics of the atmospheric boundary layer and to micrometeorology. The lowest part of the earth's atmosphere is called atmospheric boundary layer. Here most living beings (human, animal, plant world) live, therefore it is of particular importance. The book carefully explains the physical processes in the atmospheric boundary layer and sets another focus on the interactions between atmosphere, soil and vegetation (micrometeorology or microclimateology). This book is aimed at students and lecturers of meteorology as well as geographers, soil scientists and plant oecologists. Prof. Dr. Helmut Kraus, born in 1930, has worked on various sub-areas of meteorology, so the physics of the atmospheric boundary layer, the Alpine Meteorology (1963: scientific expedition to the area of Mt. Everest), the Tropical Meteorology (1972-1974: Professor at the GARP Atlantic Tropical Experiment), Mesometeorology (including experimental investigations of sea wind circulation) and the University of Bonn.
content.title_en: Basics of boundary layer meteorology : Introduction to the physics of the atmospheric boundary layer and to micrometeorology

content.text: The environmental assessment of the regional planning is therefore necessary for the implementation of § 7 para. 5 to 10 ROG. The objective of environmental planning in the context of the environmental assessment of certain plans and programmes is by no means new for the German planning practice, but the contents of the directive also give rise to increased requirements for the procedures of spatial planning. Meanwhile, the first experiences of the planning practice with the environmental assessment in the regional planning are available. These are partly very different due to the specifics of the individual regions and the respective planning mandate - a single correct way of carrying out the environmental assessment can and will not exist. The work assistance "environmental assessment in the regional planning" presents possible approaches as well as experiences of the planning practice in the implementation of the individual environmental assessment steps. These are illustrated by examples of selected regional planning bodies. The work assistance should give suggestions and assistance in the implementation of the environmental assessment in the context of regional planning. The previous experiences show that the environmental assessment is well-established in the existing planning procedures and that the existing planning procedures are still well-regarded in the context of the implementation of the regional planning.
content.title_en: Environmental assessment in regional planning : Helping to implement § 7 para. 5 to 10 ROG

content.text: Introduction to mathematical logic : a textbook. Publisher's text: This comprehensive textbook was written for students and lecturers of mathematics and computer science, and because of the detailed presentation of Gödel's Incompleteness Statements also for students of Philosophical Logic.
content.title_en: Introduction to mathematical logic : a textbook

content.text: Elementary Numerics for Technicians : Data Analysis and Modeling - Programming with C and Graphic Programming with GNUPLOT. Practical introduction to computer-based methods of applied mathematics. Textbook for students at technical and technical schools as well as for beginners of engineering sciences. If knowledge of the programming language C and higher mathematics is prioritised, then it is also in some cases appropriate for students at vocational schools and technical gymnasiums. If first the mathematical basics are dealt with, then the classical approximation procedure is applied, introduces mathematical applications in physics, finally areas of mathematical modeling. Provides manageable learning sections, is supplemented by tables and graphical overviews. In the appendix extensive exercises with suggestions for solutions. Overall, a more understandable, yet not simple course, more widely applicable than G. Bärwolf (ID 4/07). (3 S)
content.title_en: Elementary Numerics for Technicians : Data Analysis and Modeling - Programming with C and Graphic Programming with GNUPLOT

content.text: Tables in Germany: Aspects of a social movement between food redistribution and poverty intervention. Stefan Selke, who is already working on the movement of food tablets in the social report "Almost at the bottom" (BA 1/09), is also responsible for this volume as editor. The world of food tablets is examined in various aspects, from sociological, (social)political and political science, nutritional and historical perspective. Case studies provide a heterogeneous picture of different cities. The ambivalent role of the table movement is clearly illustrated, which offers on the one hand strategies for coping with poverty, but on the other hand also strengthens these and reminds of poor feeding, folk kitchens and almsgiving. (3)
content.title_en: Tables in Germany: Aspects of a Social Movement between Food Distribution and Poverty Intervention

content.text: Measurement uncertainty and data evaluation. Basic concepts of measurement -- Basic principles of measurement data evaluation -- Measurement uncertainty -- Measurement data evaluation for several measurement sizes involved -- Balance evaluation -- Bayesian theory of measurement uncertainty -- Basic principles of probability calculation and statistics -- Basic principles of matrix calculation -- Important methods -- Additional calculations -- Calculation programs for measurement data evaluation
content.title_en: Measurement uncertainty and data analysis
Paper, paperboard and fibre material : 2 DIN 53120-1 to 58953-7 : Standards and standard drafts

content.text: Technical Vibration Teaching : with 72 tasks and 40 examples. Publisher's text: This textbook on vibration theory and machine dynamics reliably conveys the theoretical contexts and builds the bridge to application to problems in practice with many vivid examples. The new edition has been updated and revised in many places to make the book even more understandable.
content.title_en: Technical Vibration Theory : with 72 tasks and 40 examples

content.text: Games programming for PC, mobile phone and PDA: programming platform-independently with PPL. Multimedia-enabled mobile devices such as mobile phones, SmartPhones or Pocket PCs are currently a difficult trend, computer game programmers for such devices are in high demand in the rapidly growing market. This title describes the programming of computer games using the so-called PPL (Pocket Programming Language), whose products are running on any Windows-based platform (precaution - subtitles not quite correct). First, the installation and operation of the PPL is discussed in detail, after which some smaller games of different genres are created, partly facilitated by the use of prefabricated modules. The systematic design ensures a light orientation, the enclosed CD contains the source code and the running games of all examples and the full version of the software used. However, the title places high demands on the reader: For complete understanding, comprehensive theoretical prior knowledge is indispensable. Conclusion: specialized title on the programming of computer games for mobile devices. (3)
content.title_en: Games programming for PC, mobile phone and PDA : programming platform independent with PPL

content.text: Social inequality and care : Contributions to social science oriented nursing research. Social inequalities in the context of care care represent a growing challenge for social and health policy. The contributions of applied nursing research illustrate from a scientific and practical perspective how serious resource differences influence the quality of care. This applies to the design of care arrangements, the effectiveness and efficiency of the care services provided and the function of care care care in the reproduction of social-related health inequalities. The volume offers far-reaching theoretical and practical perspectives on the topic of care and social inequality from the hand of profiled specialist representatives and provides empirical findings on the subject of a systematic discussion for the first time.
content.title_en: Social inequality and care : Contributions to social science oriented nursing research

content.text: Survey research: Challenges and limits. Klappentext: In recent decades, many innovations have been made in survey research. Web-based surveys and telephone surveys are now just as natural as international comparative surveys. Mobile phones and videos are increasingly used as techniques. This special volume deals with these innovations, describes them and examines the question of how they affect the quality of the results and what challenges and limits arise in the future. This special issue of the ÖZS is the first comprehensive survey of surveys in German-speaking countries.
content.title_en: Survey research : challenges and limits

Heat protection : Standards / ed.: DIN German Institute for Standardization, Building / ed.: DIN, German Institute for Standardization ; 24: Energy requirements and degrees of use of heating systems in buildings and standard heating load

content.text: Construction / ed.: DIN, German Institute for Standardization, Heat Protection ; 24: Building planning, Heat Protection, Heat Requirements : Standards. Contains: DIN V 4108-6 [rectification 1] ; DIN V 4108-6 ; DIN V 4701-10 ; DIN V 4701-10, Supplement 1 [Side 1] ; DIN V 4701-10/A1 ; DIN V 4701-12 ; DIN V 4701-12, Correction 1 [rectification 1] ; DIN EN 15265 ; DIN EN ISO 13790
content.title_en: Construction / ed.: DIN, German Institute for Standardization, Heat Protection ; 24: Building Design, Heat Protection, Heat Demand : Standards

content.text: In Bonn, the 9th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity took place in May 2008. The reason for the editors of the yearbook is to focus on the topic of biodiversity in 2009. The 12 main contributions illustrate how essential biological diversity is for an intact nature and for securing all the basis of life. It is crucial for the vitality and evolution of all life forms on Earth. If habitats of plants and animals become smaller or disappear completely, important building blocks and ecosystems can collapse completely. Human beings benefit from the greatest possible bio- and geodiversity: food, building materials, energy sources, drugs are just a few of many examples of the product diversity that we all use.
content.title_en: Praise of diversity

content.text: Mathematics : Textbook for Science Studies / Albert Fetzer; Heiner Fränkel. With the help of Dietrich Feldmann ... ; 1st edition: This successful introductory textbook is now published in this edition. It is characterized by an exact and vivid presentation. The teaching material is clearly structured and well structured. Mathematical formal evidence is largely omitted, however, the derivation of important connections is presented. The material is illustrated by a wealth of examples and illustrations, and numerous tasks with solutions to each section facilitate self-study. A book for students of engineering science at technical universities and universities of applied sciences.
content.title_en: Mathematics : Textbook for Science Studies / Albert Fetzer; Heiner Fränkel. With contribution by Dietrich Feldmann ... ; 1

content.text: The new revised and expanded "Guide for ventilation and air conditioning systems" is primarily aimed at engineers and planners, technical personnel in sales, purchasing, service, maintenance, facility management, students and graduates. The first chapter shows the thermodynamic processes, the second chapter gives an overview of the components of a full air conditioning system. The re-issue was supplemented in the third chapter with useful control schemes from practice, the standards and VDI guidelines have been updated. The current energy situation has been taken into account by fundamentally revising the chapters "Regulations for fans" and "Heat recovery".
content.title_en: Guide to ventilation and air conditioning systems : basic thermodynamics components ; components of a full air conditioning system ; standards and regulations

content.text: Cutting and packaging optimization : Problem formulations, modelling techniques, solution methods. The terms arrangement, packaging and cutting problems include a variety of theoretical and practical problems. Although very different formulations are used, there are often very close relationships between them, so that methods for solving cutting problems can also be used to solve arrangement and packaging problems and vice versa. In the context of this book, mainly arrangement, packaging and cutting problems are considered, where an optimization component is important. The aim is to provide an introduction to this topic by addressing some basic cutting and packaging problems, their problem formulations, modelling techniques and approaches to solution methods.
content.title_en: Cutting and packaging optimization : problem setting, modelling techniques, solution methods

content.text: Alternative Energietechnik. Verlagstext: The main content of this book is, in addition to technically important interpretation and safety criteria for conventional, nuclear and regenerative energy systems, the recognition, assessment and consideration of the repercussions caused by the human economy, the fundamental problem of the non-quantifiable nature of environmental decision-making criteria and ways out of this dilemma. In addition, socio-political aspects are brought into play, which lead self-organizing from the Darwinian economy to a humane economic process, which is currently fully exploiting the ecological minimal principle. The clear presentation of the facts with the help of simple mathematical models requires only elementary knowledge of mathematics and relevant disciplines. Numerous tasks are attached to the deepening and exercise with the indication of the solution.
content.title_en: Alternative energy technology

content.text: The netbook with Windows: [Internet everywhere, office in the pocket, pleasure at any time]. The newly created, now rapidly expanded segment of the netbooks has apparently been a good thing for the well-known computer author Born, because he has not only proved himself as a specialist of the first hour - for the EeePC of Asus, the 1st of its kind - (see the comprehensive guide, discussed in BA 5/08), now he has followed literature on the "small, sympathetic, cheap" machines, which are now also to be found in the portfolio of Acer, One, MSI Wind/Medion, HP, Dell and Lenovo. This volume focuses on the devices with a specially adapted, slim version of Windows XP (in January 2009 also a title on Linux netbooks should appear), presents hardware and operating system, deals with applications, Internet capabilities, multimedia functions and finally with upgrades and expansions. Although he always refers to earlier works (here are especially the chapters on OpenOffice), the compilation is tailor-made and his didactical skills are recommended to the same.
content.title_en: The Netbook with Windows : [Internet everywhere, office in the pocket, pleasure anytime]

content.text: Inkscape : Design vector graphics for PC, MAC and Linux. Inkscape for Windows, Linux and Mac is an opensource vector graphics program, thus a counterpart or supplement to Gimp, which serves as pixel graphics program especially for image editing. Inkscape is currently available in version 0.46, i.e. it is still in development, but it does not expect much. The book presents the program and its surface with many images and screenshots quite thoroughly (experimental material on the book website) and shows what possibilities the program offers now, even if the comparison with illustrator, freehand or CorelDraw is still somewhat high-key. Inkscape allows, for example, the work with various forms, paths, texts, transparency effects, transformations, color gradients, patterns and groups, node editing, layers, complex path and text operations, bitmaptracing, XML editing. On the Internet, however, numerous tutorials, help texts and sample collections, printed material are hardly found. Experience shows that the corresponding books are very often borrowed from a wide range of books (2).
content.title_en: Inkscape : Design vector graphics for PC, MAC and Linux

content.text: User-oriented search engines / Edited by Dirk Lewandowski ; [1]: Manual Internet search engines : User-oriented in science and practice. This manual focuses on user orientation. Renowned authors from science and practice deal in 16 chapters with web search machines, which are the pioneers in changing user behaviour. The behavior learned from Google and Co. is transferred to other search systems: the website search, the intranet search and the search in special search machines and specialized databases. For all providers of information systems it is becoming increasingly important to know the workings of search engines on the one hand, and to be familiar with the behavior of your users on the other hand. On the side of the scientists, the book offers readable review articles on relevant topics, on the basis of which a strategy for individual search solutions can be developed. As a third practitioner, the experts are interested in informing the community of the most important topics.
content.title_en: Manual Internet Search Engines / Edited by Dirk Lewandowski ; [1]: Manual Internet Search Engines : User Orientation in Science and Practice

content.text: Leonardo dreischreiheit / Mario Taddei; Edoardo Zanon; Domenico Laurenza ; [1]: Using computer graphics to track the ingenious inventor. Leonardo's sketches and drawings, which have been handed down to us in many manuscripts, have always provided a source of conjecture about the technical inventions of this Renaissance man. Models built after the drawings enrich the museums, and many "tech adventurers" have tried to realize the apparatuses designed 500 years ago to put them into practice. A less materially complex method of approaching the designs of the genius from Vinci has been tried by the authors of this volume. Using the most modern computer graphics techniques, they have converted 32 designs into very vivid representations that allow an understanding of the structure and function. Among them are known inventions such as the air screw or the tank wagon. The drawing, which Leonardo already used as an important technical communication instrument in crack form, cutting image, etc., finds in these 3-D images, explosion representations and detailed analyses of their target group.
content.title_en: Leonardo three-dimensional / Mario Taddei; Edoardo Zanon; Domenico Laurenza ; [1]: Using computer graphics to track down the ingenious inventor

content.text: Our inner clock : use natural rhythms and avoid non-stop stress. Human beings have an inner clock that never remains uninvolved when we reorganize our lives. If external rhythms change, it only irritates them for a short time. In the long term, it adapts as soon as the external conditions are stable again. However, if we repeatedly ignore them, then we can get sick. This book gathers much that the chronobiologists have found out until today. There is advice on how to use this knowledge in everyday life to stay healthy.
content.title_en: Our inner clock : use natural rhythms and avoid non-stop loading

content.text: Eclipse for C/C++ programmers: Manual for Eclipse C/C++ Development Tools (CDT). The integrated development environment Eclipse is known in particular in connection with Java programming. Good introductions are here M. Seeboerger-Weichselbaum (BA 12/08) and B. Daum (ID 19/08). The possibility to use Eclipse also in programming with C/C++ is mentioned only marginally in these works. The present book shows how Eclipse with the C/C++ development tools (CDT) also brings simplifications for C/C++ applications. It starts with detailed instructions on installation and configuration (both under Windows and Linux). Using a practical example, all the functions of the development environment that are important for the daily work are demonstrated and explained. It is important to highlight the fact that error determination and error handling are discussed in great detail. The book applies to readers with C/C++ experiences; knowledge in Eclipse is not required. However, the existing tools are also clearly identified with these problems.
content.title_en: Eclipse for C/C++ programmers : Manual on Eclipse C/C++ Development Tools (CDT)

content.text: New biological atlas: Ecology for Schleswig-Holstein and Hamburg. This large-scale, scale-setting work from a cast (see correspondingly for Baden-Württemberg "Naturverlebnis Baden-Württemberg", BA 4/98) documents the current situation of biology and ecology in Schl.-H. (climate, geological conditions, over 2000 plant and animal species, the most important ecosystem types, nature conservation, Wadden Sea National Park, more than 200 particularly protected areas of the region). The author (Uni Kiel) has incorporated a lot of new ecological knowledge, also critically examines the current environmental policy. Approximately 600 high-quality color photos, graphics, diagrams, 80 maps. Successor of the "Biological Atlas Schleswig-Holstein" (1980). In North German libraries already recommended especially for medium-sized stocks.
content.title_en: New biological atlas : Ecology for Schleswig-Holstein and Hamburg

content.text: Algae, jellyfish, water flea : the world of plankton. Friends of nature, lakes and seas, this book offers an insight into the often microscopic world of plankton. Numerous drawings and colour boards give an impression of the beauty and variety of forms of many planktons. Examples from many waters of the earth show how plankton plays an important role in the food chain and how it influences the material cycles in the water and even the atmosphere. Finally, the plankton's reaction to water acidification and overfertilization is shown and explains the potential for danger of poison algae.
content.title_en: Algae, jellyfish, water flea : the world of plankton

content.text: The two authors, who presented a "maritime tour for Shiplover through Germany" with "Nostalgia on the Water" (BA 1/01), have developed an even more useful guide to German maritime museums, museums with shipping departments, museum ports, museum and traditional ships on the coast and inland. The most important museums in neighbouring German countries are also listed. Opening hours, entrance prices, contact details and information about events can be found as well as a short outline of the main areas of collection and the history of the vehicle. The facilities are listed in a local alphabetic way and can be located by a map. A handy and appealing guide with photos. (2) (Martin Paulini)
content.title_en: Maritime museums : Museum and traditional ships

content.text: Sensing Space : Technologies for architectures of the future. Intelligent and interactive architecture, networking, portraits of spatial experiments, prototypes and installations from different areas (home, living, public space, public, interactive architecture); smart home, sensors, microcomputers, open source principle, configurable architecture, networking of virtual and physical spaces, remote home (Science Museum London, 2003), robotic furniture, smart textiles, intelligent textile technology (Poetic Textiles), thermosensitive surfaces, facade installation, media façade (e.g. emotionalcities.com, corpora in Si(gh)te), installations (e.g. wind to light), communicate with architecture
content.title_en: Sensing Space : Technologies for Architectures of the Future

content.text: In order to solve open realistic questions, reality must be simplified, the necessary values must be appreciated or measured to achieve a response. In pupils, these tasks promote the establishment of a connection between mathematics and everyday life, as well as creativity and independent work. Modelling tasks offer rich learning opportunities that enable students with different mathematical skills to search for solutions at their level. In order to solve open realistic questions, reality must be simplified, necessary sizes must be appreciated or measured to achieve an answer. In students, these tasks promote the establishment of a connection between mathematics and everyday life, as well as creativity and independent work. Modelling tasks offer rich learning opportunities that enable students with different mathematical skills to search for solutions at their level.
content.title_en: Further developing mathematics lessons : tasks for mathematical modelling ; practical experience ; for classes 1 to 4

content.text: Case study on the effect of the compensation allowance in the district of Vogelsberg (Hessen). The aim of this case study in the district of Vogelsberg in Hesse is to investigate in depth the impact of the compensation allowance on different areas of agriculture and rural areas in a "typical" less favoured area. To this end, existing statistics, relevant literature and the data of the test farm network were evaluated and surveys were carried out with farmers and experts. Based on a written survey of consultants from structurally similar districts, the transferability of the case study results was verified and all results were then discussed at a workshop with the expert officers responsible for the compensation allowance of the Federal Government and the German Federal Government. The result of this case study was that at the time of the study the compensation allowance objectives were achieved in the fall region as a whole. In terms of the design of the compensation allowance, it was possible that the disadvantage in the fall region would result from the stonyness of the soil and the low soil quality. It is therefore proposed to take these criteria into account more closely when setting the premium level or to take into account individual areas more closely.
content.title_en: Case study on the effect of the compensation allowance in the district of Vogelsberg (Hessen)

content.text: Development perspectives of rural areas / Academy for Spatial Research and Regional Planning ; Part 1: Objectives and strategies of a current policy for peripheral rural areas in Bavaria. The tasks of spatial planning policy still include the creation of equivalent living conditions and thus the promotion of structurally weak regions. Recently, there has been an emphasis on promoting growth poles or priority locations. Against the background of diverse structures, development processes and problem situations in individual regions, generally offered models for regional development in peripheral, structurally weak rural areas only conditional perspectives open up - a regional differentiation is inevitable. The present study of the working group "Objectives and strategies of a current policy for rural areas in Bavaria" of the Bavarian regional working community of the Academy for Spatial Research and Regional Planning therefore deals with peripheral rural areas in Bavaria, not only in the German-Czech border area, in order to analyse developments and to offer solutions to problems as far as possible.
content.title_en: Development perspectives of rural areas / Academy for Spatial Research and Regional Planning ; Part 1: Objectives and strategies of a current policy for peripheral rural areas in Bavaria

content.text: Welding technology / DIN German Institute for Standardization ; 7: Welding technology manufacturing, welding connections : Standards. Contains: DIN 2559-2 ; DIN 2559-3 ; DIN 2559-4 ; DIN EN 1011-1 ; DIN EN 1011-2 ; DIN EN 1011-3 ; DIN EN 1011-3 ; DIN EN 1011-3 ; DIN EN 1011-3 ; DIN EN 1011-3 ; DIN EN 1011-3 ; DIN EN 1011-3 ; DIN EN 1011-3 ; DIN EN 1701-1 ; DIN EN ISO 5817-rectification 1 [correction 1] ; DIN EN ISO 6520-1 ; DIN EN ISO 6947 ; DIN EN ISO 9692-1 ; DIN EN ISO 9692-2 ; DIN EN ISO 9692-3 ; DIN EN ISO 9692-4 ; DIN EN ISO 10042 ; DIN EN ISO 13916 ; DIN EN ISO 13920
content.title_en: Welding Technology / DIN German Institute for Standardization ; 7: Welding Technical Manufacturing, Welding Connections : Standards

content.text: Energy certificates (2) understand the technical, cost, consequences. Guide to understanding the thermal property valuation of new and old buildings. In addition to building physics explanations on the building envelope, the individual pages of the energy certificates for residential and non-residential buildings are explained. (Elke Nibbrig) The new energy certificates are not always easy to understand for the layman. The author is an expert in structural heat and moisture protection and offers here a guide to understanding the thermal property valuation for buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords of new and old buildings. In the first half of the book, very clear construction physical properties of the building envelope, climatic temperature differences and their effects on uninsulated or insulated exterior walls, floor ceilings, thermal bridges are explained. The second half contains detailed explanations on texts and terms on the individual pages of the energy certificates for residential and non-residential buildings - each for the demand-oriented and consumption-oriented calculation - as well as exemplary filled sample pages. Finally, the author briefly deals with the effects on the purchase or rental of real estates, meaningful investments on thermal insulation and calculations of KFhard 1 B.
content.title_en: Understanding energy certificates : technology, costs, consequences

content.text: Data analysis with SPSS for advanced users : a workbook. The book offers an understandable and application-oriented introduction to the advanced work with SPSS, the most important software in the field of empirical social research. Illustrative examples from the social sciences and comprehensive additional material on the homepage of the book round off the dictactic concept of the book.
content.title_en: Data analysis with SPSS for advanced users : a workbook

content.text: Descriptive statistics and modern data analysis: A computer-based introduction with Excel, SPSS and STATA. This textbook introduces practical into the basics, techniques and application possibilities of descriptive statistics. It addresses the descriptive basic methods of univariate and bivariate methods, which are applied to business examples using computer-based calculations. The contents range from the collection and scaling, presentation and univariate analysis of quantitative data, to the analysis of bivariate relationships. This covers all important aspects of a course for descriptive statistics. The use of mathematical representations and derivations is largely dispensed with in favour of an 'intuitive' approach. The textbook shows the efficient application of descriptive methods on the computer programs Excel, SPSS and STATA and thus trains the competence of the readers to calculate and interpret results independently with the computer.
content.title_en: Descriptive statistics and modern data analysis : A computer-based introduction with Excel, SPSS and STATA

content.text: Thinking left over : Politics for the majority. Sigmar Gabriel talks to Tacheles: He describes clearly what is left today and what is not. Because the question of left or right actually means nothing more than: In which society do we want to live? End the egg dance around the political center in Germany. Our country and the political coordinates are in motion. But what does that mean? And what does this new comrade trend mean for the oldest of the German parties: the SPD? (Source: Piper-Verlag / Internet). Sigmar Gabriel talks to Tacheles: He describes clearly what is left today and what is not. Because the question of left or right actually means nothing else than: In which society do we want to live?
content.title_en: Thinking Left New : Politics for the Majority

content.text: The political systems of Western Europe. Updated Neuaufl. of the collection (see BA 5/03), which in about 20 articles and overview articles breaks down the most important data and facts on the West European states. The main topics are usually the constitution, head of state, parliament, government/administration, legislation, electoral system, parties, associations, media, political culture, justice, politics at the municipal, regional, European and international level, respectively, by means of references and Internet addresses. As before, a standard work, can be used as a textbook and study book as well as as as as a means of information. The collection "Democracies in Europe" (ID 14/03) was also aimed at the integration process within the European Union. The collection "Constitutions of the EU Member States" (BA 10/05) and the collection "The political systems of Eastern Europe" (currently 3rd edition 2008, here last edition 1st edition: BA 12/02).
content.title_en: The political systems of Western Europe

content.text: Mathematics in medieval Islam. This book contains episodes from the mathematics of medieval Islam, which had a great influence on the development of mathematics. The author describes the topic in its historical context and refers to Arabic texts. Among the areas covered are the discovery of decimal fractures, geometry, plane and spherical trigonometry, algebra and the approximation solutions of equations. Furthermore, a number of applications of these areas in the society of Islam, such as in the tax system, in the case of inheritance, in the calculation of prayer times and the geometry of ornaments are presented. The book is of great interest for mathematics historians as well as for mathematics students. The presentation is easily accessible to anyone with mathematics knowledge of a secondary school. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Mathematics in medieval Islam

content.text: Human Capital: How Knowledge Determines Our Life. What impact do education and learning have on our societies and economies? How can inequalities in education be eliminated? And how can we ensure that each individual receives the type of learning opportunity in all phases of life that can bring him the greatest benefit and enable him to fully develop his human capital? This report uses the unique resources of the OECD to answer some of these fundamental questions. Based on research and analysis from the 30 OECD Member States, the increasing importance of human capital for individuals and for society in managing social and economic change is explained. Furthermore, it examines the extent to which countries succeed or fail in supporting people's lives by providing education and training. - What importance do schools and universities have? How can inequalities in education be eliminated? Keeley explains the concept of human capital, which includes knowledge, qualifications, competences and other characteristics, as a solution to economic and societal challenges?
content.title_en: Human capital: how knowledge determines our lives

content.text: Challenge Diversity - rural spaces in structural and political change. Rural spaces are not currently among the most discussed objects of spatial research. The discussion about rural spaces is also complicated by a problem of definition and demarcation. Both functional and economic sectoral, as well as social-structural and lifestyle-specific criteria, the areas of urban and rural areas clearly separated in the pre-modern era have become a wide transitional area. Rural spaces can be defined most frequently today. Despite the increasing elimination of the differences between city and country, however, this stereotype dichotomous distinction dominates political discourse and EU funding programmes. The stereotype perception of rural spaces also prevents these from being seen as individual spaces with different and specific combinations of weaknesses and strengths. However, such an individualized approach is a prerequisite for generating promising concepts for the development of rural spaces.
content.title_en: Challenge diversity - rural areas in structural and policy change

content.text: Heating with the heat pump: Made easy, money and anger saved. The author already has a practical title for the house supply with alternative energies (BA 2/09). Here he provides very vivid information in the well-known "Do-it!" series about heating systems with heat pumps. Heat pumps use air, groundwater or geothermal heat to supply the buildings with heat and need electricity as drive energy. Introducing it is about economic efficiency and ecology of heat pumps, their meaningful use in new or old buildings and operating costs comparisons with other heating systems. In the main part are explained different types of heat pumps, the planning of such a heating system and work steps during installation and commissioning. Finally, the connection to solar heat, technical innovations, optimal control and error sources are treated. With very vivid illustrations, numerous color photos, checklists and additional information boxes with practical tips. Widely usable advisor as decision aid per or contra heat pump for builders and remediation willing house owners. Recommended before Michael Baumann: "Heim Pumpen" (BINE, BA 8/07).
content.title_en: Heating with the heat pump : Made easy, money and trouble saved

content.text: The large book of ideas garden and terrace: 256 pages full of ideas and practical tips - from modern to classic. The text/picture book in landscape format presents 119 (!) examples of different possibilities of garden design. The clear layout with an example of each double side, - on the right a full-page photo, on the left the corresponding text - invites you to browse through. The presented ideas are very different. Sometimes they are individual garden elements, such as a charming bench with a suitable frame or a decorative paving surface, then particularly attractively designed areas of extensive garden facilities. The excellent photos are complemented by detailed descriptions as well as practical tips for the realization in the own (?) garden. However, many of the examples shown blow the framework of an average house garden. A large part of the often very artistic contributions comes from the well-known English garden exhibition "Chelsea Flower Show". Just looking at the opulent color images is a pleasure. A sophisticated book with a seemingly endless selection of ideas for garden design. (2)
content.title_en: The large Idea Book Garden and Terrace : 256 pages full of ideas and practical tips - from modern to classic

content.text: The website manual: Programming and Design; [currently for PHP 5.3, Flash CS4, Dreamweaver CS4, Internet Explorer 8, ASP.NET 3.5, Silverlight 2]. The authors, who are well known and well-known, have already spoken word-richly about various web topics. Now they apparently wanted to present their accumulated knowledge compactly and have (almost) everything that is needed for website design and programming in a thick and heavy manual: from the basics HTML and CSS, to the design (with Photohop and Flash) to programming (PHP, ASP, AJAX) and much more, which belongs to a web project (search engine optimization, content management systems, accessibility, legal issues etc.). Sometimes this actually works together from different sources and for some topics one needs anyway own monographs, but: the price-side ratio is exceptionally favorable, the quality is very good and the exterior is very appealing. Perhaps less as a manual in the actual sense (for that it is not too suitable for a detailed overview), but for some current techniques (1).
content.title_en: Website Manual : Programming and Design ; [currently available for PHP 5.3, Flash CS4, Dreamweaver CS4, Internet Explorer 8, ASP.NET 3.5, Silverlight 2]

content.text: Adobe Photoshop CS4 : Pixel Perfection from Retouch to Assembly. The professional Photoshop image editing program offers many new features in the new version CS4 which the author describes within the new edition (a revision of the pre-release: BA 1/08). Since Adobe no longer delivers printed manuals, this compendium is probably the most complete German-language introduction, work and reference work for CS4. With over 1,000 pages very comprehensive, yet clear, very practical, huge keyword directory. The differences to the previous version and many valuable and practical hints can be found in the appendix. On the DVD supplement: 800 pictures and work examples, over 50 actions, a trial version of Photoshop CS4 Extended as well as about 3 hours excerpts from video trainings of the publisher. Conclusion: A successful and clearly designed manual (no textbook!), well suited for ambitious beginners but also as a reference work for advanced users. For beginners and advanced users still suitable. As a compendium without alternative. (1)
content.title_en: Adobe Photoshop CS4 : Pixel Perfection from Retouch to Assembly

content.text: The development of safe ties is an important foundation for the physical, psychological and social development of a child. It can be promoted, delayed or prevented by a variety of ways within the family and also within society. The contributors to this bond address the questions of how a child can experience security through experiences in his family, in the nursery, in school and in other social groups within society, such as in case of attachment insecurity or anxiety mental disorders such as depression, addiction, psychosomatic disorders, learning disorders, behavioural problems, speech development disorders, and binding disorders, dissociality and violence, such as mental disorders and disorders by prevention, counselling and psychotherapy can be prevented or treated.
content.title_en: Ways to secure ties in family and society: prevention, support, counselling and psychotherapy

content.text: Expertise Refrigeration technology : an introduction to training and further education with tasks and solutions. Introductory textbook in basic refrigeration technology with exercises and solutions. Basic course for trainees and technicians in continuing education. Has been extended by about 40 pages compared to the 3rd edition 2002 (BA 3/03) (new tasks, more detailed solutions) and updated in data and guidelines. The old edition can be used up, should be supplemented with this new edition. (2 S)
content.title_en: Expertise Refrigeration technology : an introduction to training and further training with tasks and solutions

content.text: Tourism Marketing : Market-oriented management in the micro- and macro-sector of tourism industry. Verl.Beschr./Neuauf.: This work gives a comprehensive presentation of the foundations of an independent
content.title_en: Tourism Marketing : Market-oriented management in the micro- and macro-sector of the tourism industry

content.text: Young, successful, Turkish: a slightly different portrait of migrants in Germany. Homicides of honour, underground battles, hate preachers the press is full of negatives. The large mass of well-integrated fellow citizens is invisible except for a few exceptions. But there are many. Many have arrived long ago. Erkan Arikan and Murat Ham present successful Turkish fellow citizens who work in all conceivable fields: in politics and media, business and sports, science and art. Some names are already big, others are still there. And they all contribute to a new, positive picture of the third generation of Turks in Germany. Arikan and Ham want to make courage on the one hand, on the other hand, to reduce the fears of contact because there is still much to be done.
content.title_en: Young, successful, Turkish: a slightly different portrait of migrants in Germany

content.text: Now I am learning Java 7 : complete starter kit for successful starter programming; [no previous knowledge required, from the basics to database programming, with complete software equipment on book DVD]. As with their series processor for Java 6 (BA 5/07; still usable), the two authors have not completely reworked their proven beginner instruction even with the release of Java 7 but have kept the existing structure unchanged and updated the contents only slightly, partly considerably. The innovations of Java 7 are not explicitly displayed. The most likely is the new, modern layout, with hints on the side edge and more striking infoboxes. The book DVD provides necessary setup files for Java 7 and Eclipse as well as the practice examples to the book. The library-friendly low price, which should allow for the replacement of any existing predecessors to older Java versions (BA 3/05, 10/01, 1/98) is left behind. With numerous alternative titles, the last mentioned title of F.A. ID is addressed to a bit more than a previous one.
content.title_en: Now I learn Java 7 : complete starter kit for successful starter programming ; [no previous knowledge required, from basics to database programming, with complete software equipment on book DVD]

content.text: Tree landscapes: The benefits and aesthetics of trees in the open landscape. Trees as a defining element in the cultural landscape and the cultural history of tree use in agriculture are the themes of this book. (Hans-Ulrich Struck) In the intensively used agricultural landscape, woody plants often have no place. In this context, it is often overlooked what diverse functions they have fulfilled in the past and what benefits we get from their disappearance. This book deals with the cultural history of tree use in agriculture. It is not wood use that is in the foreground, but the use of fruit as fruit or for oil production, the bark for cork production, the branches for baskets and broom binding or the leaves for animal feeding. Whole landscapes (think only of scattered orchards, cork oak forests, olive groves) have been shaped in this way. Many examples of pictures from Germany and other European countries show trees as a defining element of the respective cultural landscape. Short informative texts convey information about the location and about the current use and aesthetics of trees in the open landscape. (3) No comparison title.
content.title_en: Tree landscapes : Use and aesthetics of trees in the open landscape

content.text: The book presents all the mathematical foundations that are of particular interest to physics. The focus is on vector analysis in order to obtain an understanding of classical field theory and linear algebra as a preparation for quantum theory. The textbook takes the fear of mathematics and enables the reader to use the concepts of physics creatively for his own studies as well as for future teaching planning in the teaching profession. Important statements are presented as formulas as well as verbally formulated, interesting connections facilitate understanding. The use of writing methods, which are common in physical literature, facilitates the recognition of structures. The book also contains tasks with solutions and/or solution tips and hints on the use of computer algebra systems (Mathematica).
content.title_en: Mathematical foundations for the physics teaching programme

content.text: Müller hoch Drei: Roman. Shortly before his 14th birthday Paul's parents explain that they no longer want to be present, since they want to intensively maintain their partner relationship. Paul inherits house, garden, many admonishing glue sheets, hidden cash and an untrained dog. For grief there is no time left, because he must at the same time learn that he is not a crown prince but "only" a trip. His 2 sisters were released to various families for adoption. Within a week Paul collects his sisters, lets the dog dress, overtakes a windy television producer and returns to his home richer in experience and 2 sisters. Spinnen delivers with his 2nd children's book (see "Belgian Giants", BA 9/00) an entertaining road movie, which can surprise with lively turns and absurd ins and at the same time describes puberty changes original. The fresh cover of Sabine Wilharm does the rest to guarantee visual curiosity. Recommendable children's literature on a high linguistic level, in which two eye-catching parents can still be re-committed to his 14th birthday and can's unspeakable.
content.title_en: Müller hoch Drei : Roman

content.text: Crafts, guilds and trades: Middle Ages and Renaissance. Overview work that covers the development and social organization of craft from the 11th to the late 18th century, taking into account the history of economics and technology throughout Europe. Illustratedly written, partly supplemented by illustrations and tabular lists. Scientific orientation, but without any precise evidence in footnotes, but with an "apparat" in the form of a bibliography and register. The author is emeritus Mediaevist (most recently "because they love freedom so much ...", ID 6/93), which summarizes one of his main areas of work here. Wide coverage of the period and geographical space, therefore without direct correspondence with other publications. The content is accessible to interested lay people. (3) (Jürgen Plieeninger) Throughout Europe, the development of craft from the 11th to the 18th century is treated in a vivid way in connection with economic and technical history. (Jürgen Plieninger)
content.title_en: Crafts, guilds and trades : Middle Ages and Renaissance

(Hans-Dieter Kübler) More than a dedicated argument writing: a guide to rethinking. How do we deal with the electronic media? Susanne Gaschke eliminates the nonsense that the media world is almost natural and every critic of yesterday. Media are products in a market, it is about a lot of money. The talk of the >> new viewing habits < < >>Youth today< is marketing poetry of the manufacturers. How, however, is intensive, uncritical media use of people? The child's dad signals sovereignty - but really usefully the devices can only be used, who has learning competence.

content.text: Stress food : with nutrition and stress management from the burnout trap. The nutrition scientist and cookbook author Ingrid Kiefer explains how stress arises and affects the body, how stress is dealt with with with relaxation methods such as breathing exercises, autogenic training, meditation and time management. The focus is on nutrition and stress, here jaws show the typical eating behaviour of the stress-hungry and stress-eating eaters and the effects of the stress-related nutrient deficiency and stress-related wrong nutrition. Whoever takes the right foods, vitamins and minerals in a suitable combination, sufficient quantity and at the right time, can prevent and counteract stress. With questionnaires to determine the stress level and the individual stress factors, exercise instructions for relaxation methods and concrete behavior tips. With 20 recipes from breakfast to dinner. Recommendable entry title in a pleasant layout, more compact than M. Sulzberger, which offers more recipes and additional information on dietary supplements. (2)
content.title_en: Stress food : with nutrition and stress management from the burnout trap

Mr. W. has an invitation in the post one day: On a panel discussion of unknown underground poets he should give information about his work, about the oppression in the GDR and about his experiences as an enemy of the state. content.text: Straight staircases: construction, design, examples. According to "wood stairs" (BA 6/02) and "steel stairs" (not shown here), the authors are concerned here with the design and construction of straight staircases, regardless of the material produced. Introducing the most important basics for construction, impact sound protection and aspects of safety are explained. The main part shows 23 examples, divided by stairs in public spaces and stairs in private houses - each with concise texts, photos, floor plans and construction drawings. The compact volume from the "Baudetail" series is aimed at students, architects, builders and can also inspire builders. Recommended in front of the expensive technical books of W. Mann: "Treppen und Geländer aus Stahl, Holz, Stein ..." (ID 6/05) and W. Diehl: "Scala - modern stair construction" (ID 39/02). For homeworkers see "Plan and build stairs themselves" (BA 8/02).

Chladni was the first to have thin glass plates sprinkled with fine sand to swing, whereby the sand became characteristic figures, the "Chladnic sound figures". H. Jenny, the doctor, was passionately experimenting and painting, continued these experiments. He worked with various powders, pastes and liquids and used sound to put them into vibrations. There are, among other things, figurative elements and currents, emptyings and upswings, reliefs and clumps. For H. Jenny, who is connected to the founder of Anthroposophy, Rudolf Steiner, sound is even "the creative law". Although the work is an extraordinary rendition of two kinds of images, mücha and clumps. For H. Jenny, who is connected with the founder of Anthroposophy, Rudolf Steiner, sound is even "the creative law". For example, the work is an extraordinary rendition of two kinds of sound.

After the 12th edition (2006, not discussed here) structure and content were fundamentally restructured and supplemented, this edition contains further clarifications and several smaller extensions in the various chapters. The table of contents was further detailed in some places. The literature and detailed material index were updated. The textbook and reference book is preferably addressed to non-mathematicians, e.g. practitioners in technology and science, engineers, physicians as well as students and scientists in these areas. The 12th edition can expire, older editions must be replaced. (3) (LK/GÖ: Vetter)
content.title_en: Applied statistics : Method collection with R

content.text: The reformed public budget: state of national reforms and international reform trends. For some years, the budget reforms have been in full swing, especially at the local level, less in the federal states and not yet at the federal level. If there is broad agreement in the direction, there are still some contradictory views on - also important - details; the reforms are also in the conflict between national and international developments in accounting. The script describes the state of reform, characterizes and problems the approaches and wants to contribute to converged solutions. (Source: Backtext / Publishing Association).
content.title_en: The reformed public budget: state of the art of national reforms and international reform trends

From the content: To the beginnings and history of the marked tomb (Reiner Sörries, Kassel) - Tombyard culture and garden art around 1800 (Sascha Winter, Heidelberg) - The figurative tombyard from the Baroque to the Second World War (Sylvina Zander, Lübeck) - Tombforms in the 19th century (Barbara Leisner, Lutzhorn/Schleswig-Holstein) - The effects of industrialization on the graveyard culture (Gerold Eppler, Kassel) - Aschengrabmäler and ashlagen der moderne Feuerbesstattung (Norbert Fischer, Hamburg) - Reformgrabmarks of the early 20th century (Helmut Schoenfeld, Hamburg) - The typing of the graveyards of the graveyards of the graveyard of the graveyard of the German community of the German community of the German community of the German community of the German community of the German community of the German community of the German community of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German city of the German capital. the German capital. the German capital. the German capital.

content.text: The tactics and procedures of the NPD are now diverse and complex. Skilled and with preference for the younger, the most diverse areas of the population are infiltrated. The journalist P. Gensing, who was awarded the Grimme Online Award in 2008, meticulously analysed the internal composition of the NPD, describing the ideology and the various strategies of the right, which - not a small part of which is financed by taxpayers' money - were ruthlessly and cleverly using the possibilities of the system to eliminate this. Police, politics and justice would be helpless to watch. Informatively and objectively, but also with a certain amount of rhetorically skillfully used irony, which makes the book particularly easy to read. Further information on P. Gensing's website NPD-blog.info. Similar to C. Ruf and O. Sundermeyer: "In der NPD" (BA 5/09), there further literature. Countermeasures, which are addressed in the last chapter, must be responsive and flexible to the heterogeneity of the party.
content.title_en: Attack from the right : the strategies of the neo-Nazis - and what to do about it
