content.text: The time of society: on the way to a sociological theory of time, a new edition with a contribution "present". One can observe modern society from a factual point of view - and encounter the differentiation of functions. One can look at it from a social point of view - and encounters stratification, collectivities and distribution structures. One can also examine it from a spatial dimension - and then encounters reciprocal observational relations of places and perspectives. In this 'modern classic' of system theory, modern society is knocked down in terms of its temporal order and dynamics. One then encounters the simultaneity of all the aforementioned dimensions: the simultaneity of functions, layers, collectivities and spaces and the problem of its synchronisation. In addition to a socio-theoretical elaboration of a sociological theory of time, a draft of a social theory of time is presented in this study.
content.title_en: The time of society: on the way to a sociological theory of time reprint with a contribution "Presence"

content.text: Computer science research in Germany. The development of computer science research in Germany in the period from the 'first DV programme' to the 'IT research 2006' funding programme is explained in detail. The focus of the first phase is the national research programme Computer science. The focus of the 1980s is on the broad structure of artificial intelligence in Germany and the software production environments. In the third phase of the 1990s, language processing and software engineering are the main focus, along with new research areas such as neuroinformatics and bioinformatics. In the new century, human-technology interaction is the main topic. The book provides an overview of 40 years of computer science research in Germany for the first time. The authors lead through four thematically delimitable development phases. The focus of the first block (70s) is the supraregional research programme Computer science. The focus of the 1980s is on the development of artificial intelligence and software production environments in the foreground of the 21st century. The focus is on the language and software processing in the third phase.
content.title_en: Computer science research in Germany

content.text: The basics of suspension, suspension, damping, drive and steering are presented in this book. The engine is not too short. The main measures for increasing performance are shown and the special features of individual components are pointed out in this book. Structural details such as quick-release fasteners, crossbars, drive shafts or wing profiles are presented with all design criteria. Cross links to the car illustrate the differences in technology and the performance achieved. The transfer to the currently competing Formular racer is derived from the technology of the racing cars in formula series and touring car sports. FH-Prof. Dipl.-Ing. Michael Trzesniowski has gained practical experience in various fields as a designer in the automotive sector for many years. He teaches the subjects of design teaching and CAx at the FH Joanneum in Graz at the degree programme in Automotive Engineering. He is the founder of the Formula Student Racing Team at FH Joanneum in Graz and is considered one of the fathers of the success of this team.
content.title_en: Racing car technology : Basics, construction, components, systems

content.text: Inorganic structural chemistry. The textbook for students of chemistry presents important aspects and relationships of structures of inorganic-chemical compounds.The structural characteristics of molecular compounds as well as solids are treated and explained in vivid examples. As far as possible, these structures are explained by simple and catchy theories (Gillespie-Nyholm theory, ligand field theory, ion radial relations, Pauling rules, (8-N) rule, etc.), but they are also discussed with modern binding theory. Important solid structures are repeatedly viewed, each time from a different point of view. Relationships between structure and physical properties are worked out.All errors that have become known to date have been corrected.
content.title_en: Inorganic structural chemistry

content.text: Brands on the way: success strategies for brands in tourism. Everything you need to know about successful brand building in tourismTourism is considered one of the "most beautiful industries in the world" . And it is a billion market with large growth rates. But the times when the profits automatically bubbled, are over. The market is in a state of transition: companies merge or are taken over, the demand in the middle price segment breaks away, customers demand long ago more than the classic package tour. Those who want to assert themselves as providers of tourist services here need a clear and systematic brand strategy. The authors Nicholas Adjouri, experienced brand consultant, and Tobias Büttner, in the management of a tour operator, combine sound branding know-how and long-standing tourism expertise. In "Trademarks on the way to travel , they look behind the scenes of the industry and show how successful brand management in tourism succeeds. They learn what brands generally characterized themselves in tourism and what makes them unique, like branding and expanding - from analysis of the strategy to implementation.
content.title_en: Brands on the road : Success strategies for brands in tourism

content.text: Flower beds are beautiful: simply imitate: plant examples for small gardens. The author (Staudengärtner and landscape architect) already has a book in the same size and similar equipment (see "Gartenplanen für Einsteiger", BA 5/08). This is about the planning and design of flower beds in the different seasons. 30 exemplary beds, designed for different locations, show attractive, coordinated flowering plant ensembles made of hardy wood, shrubs and onion plants. On each double page there is a floor plan in which the plants are marked graphically and colourwise different to the different varieties and species. In addition, in a perspective drawing the beds are shown in an ingrown state. Infused photos highlight the whole flower splendor of the beds. The text refers to the special features of the plants. An inspiring and practical guide, unfortunately in spiral binding.
content.title_en: Design flowerbeds beautiful : simply imitate: plant examples for small gardens

content.text: The car crisis. The book of a publicist describes a wide arc, begins with the current structural crisis of the car industry, then catches up and brings the history of traffic innovations and the development of the automobile to describe and discuss future scenarios. Parts 2 and 3 are those that are not found elsewhere in intensity, part 1 could become obsolete due to its valuations. The story brushed against the line (for example, that the electric car had good chances for a long time), the future with its contingencies well brought to the point - all in all a substantial book on the framework conditions of the crisis of a German key industry. (2) Starting from the automotive crisis in 2009, the author critically describes the history of the automotive industry and discusses future scenarios of traffic development. (Jürgen Plieninger)
content.title_en: The Car Crisis

content.text: Symbols of Life - Symbols of Faith : Book of Religion and Catechesis / Elsbeth Bihler ; Vol. 1: Light - Fire. An important source of a sustainable faith are symbols in which significantly something of the reality of God and his relationship with people appears. The book series Symbols of Life Symbols of Faith gives practical inspiration for the holistic development of symbols that we encounter in daily life. Volume 1 deals in a completely new chapter with the symbols of light (and darkness), sun, moon, stars, rainbow, sky, cloud, wind and fire. Stories and texts, songs, dance and music, design ideas, silence exercises and games and actions offer children, youth and adults concrete possibilities to rediscover these symbols and experience them with all their senses. With versatile keyword register (displayed by publishing)
content.title_en: Symbols of Life - Symbols of Faith : Book of Religion and Catechesis / Elsbeth Bihler ; Vol. 1: Light - Fire

content.text: The authors present a comprehensive introduction to the analysis in a well-understood and understandable way. From elementary algebra to complex formal problems, the focus is placed on the economic aspects of mathematics. Here, the complete material, which is covered in introductory mathematics courses, is particularly distinguished by the mathematical rigour and reliability of this book.
content.title_en: Mathematics for economists : basic knowledge with practical relevance

content.text: Complex numbers and plane geometry. The book combines algebra, number theory and geometry with mathematical aspects. Complex numbers are not only a suitable means of solving equations in mathematics and mathematically solving problems from physics and technology. They serve as vectors in the plane as well as as as rotational stretching to illustrate geometric objects. This book introduces the arithmetic of complex numbers and deals with their role in solving equations as well as in the geometry of the plane. It also addresses references to the historical development of central mathematical results. Exercise tasks with solutions to each chapter and an appendix to calculating complex numbers and conforming illustrations in MAPLE complete the textbook. (3)
content.title_en: Complex numbers and flat geometry

content.text: Foreigners in the foreign world: professional and social integration of immigrants in historical review. What is the situation of migrants in Germany? Do they remain strangers forever or become equal and accepted members of society? The book examines the influx of foreign fellow citizens and pursues their integration into society and the labour market until the end of the 20th century. After the large refugee flows at the end of the Second World War, a further wave of migration to Germany with the first guest workers is swarming with the mid-fifties, followed by political refugees and asylum seekers in the 70s. Günter Kühn describes attempts to integrate migrants into society and presents funding offers that support professional qualification. A special focus is placed on language mediation, in conjunction with vocational training measures.
content.title_en: Foreigners in the foreign world : professional and social integration of immigrants in historical review

content.text: Violence in schools: pedagogical responses to a social crisis. A recent analysis of the manifestations and causes of violence among pupils, together with proposals for educational measures and programmes.
content.title_en: Violence in schools: educational responses to a social crisis

content.text: Geology of the Alps. Bern geology professor Adrian Pfiffner, whose expertise has been gained during the construction of the new Gotthard Base Tunnel, has taken as the basis for this comprehensive textbook on the geology of the Alps, his revised and supplemented lecture script. After the first discussion of the plate tectonic framework of Europe, the older mountains and the young alpine mountain ranges in Europe, the rock associations of the crystalline base mountains as well as various sediment sequences, the tectonic construction and the tectonic development as well as the recent geological history of the Alps are discussed. With numerous maps, profiles, development plans and a bibliography. No register. Two-column printing. For students with major or secondary subject earth sciences and geological interested persons with prior knowledge. (3)
content.title_en: Geology of the Alps

content.text: Practice: Wooden facades: material, planning, execution. Pre-hanging facades made of wood were revived in conjunction with wooden frame buildings by the eco-building movement of the 1980s in Germany and are now one of the most modern, cost-effective and sustainable forms of weather protection on buildings. The author (last BA 7/08) is a specialist in energy-saving construction, wood construction, solar architecture and offers here the first practical manual on wooden facades. Well understandable and detailed are constructional physical demands, suitable facade woods and materials for the substructure, different types of construction, construction of connections and transitions (corners, windows, roof etc.), surface treatment (natural greying, colored glazes), facades made of wood composite materials, as well as planning, self-construction and renovation of wooden facades. Very vividly explained by numerous color photographs and construction drawings. With addresses and references to standards, literature. Without comparison title. Recommended for wood house owners for general information and for technically-versed wooden construction fans as do-it-yourself counsellor. (2)
content.title_en: Practice: wooden facades : material, planning, execution

content.text: Quality management for engineers: with 186 tables and a CD-ROM, including "Quality Management Manual", glossary, numerous tools and functions. CD-ROM contains: Audit checklist for the QM according to ISO 9001:2008; Questionlist according to ISO 9004 for self-assessment; Audit checklist for environmental management; Program for selection of test equipment; Program for monitoring of test equipment and management of test equipment; Calculation programs for statistical methods of the QM; Extensive training documents (PowerPoint); Program for computer-supported QM
content.title_en: Quality management for engineers : with 186 tables and a CD-ROM, including "Quality Management Manual", glossary, numerous tools and functions

content.text: Religion and global development: the influence of religions on social, political and economic development. A critical-reflective consideration of the influence of religious factors on political, economic and social development as well as on development cooperation Religions are decisive forces for social development. They promote human development but can also hinder it. Thus, the Arab Human Development Report of the United Nations of 2003 comes to a critical judgment on the role of religion in the Arab area. European development policy is based on our secular state order. By focusing on state systems it is inclined to understand religion as a pure belief system. But religions are the origin of world images and social orders. They have a decisive influence on the economic and sociocultural development of societies; moreover, they affect the behavioural mentalities of citizens. Religion and development - risk or opportunity? Renowned experts from science and practice discuss development-relevant factors of the different religions.
content.title_en: Religion and global development: the influence of religions on social, political and economic development

content.text: No panic about thermodynamics! : Success and fun in the classic "dickboard drill" of the engineering studies. Publisher's text: Thermodynamics is the most important basic discipline in engineering science, besides mechanics and mathematics. It embodies, among other things, the ?warm? and ?soft? mechanical engineering, which steams, bubbling and hissing. With the help of thermodynamics, the Perpetuum Mobile (as a good idea at least) can be easily swept away from the table! Thermodynamics is the basis of energy technology and heat teaching. The subject is just as feared by almost all students due to its theoretical-mathematical approaches of observation as the mechanics! The thermodynamics are also descriptions of everyday observations, which can be quite simple and funny in some cases, if you have found the access first time.This textbook is entertainingly written and contains many general examples, it is beautifully illustrated with cartoons by Oliver Romberg.The 3rd edition was revised and extended in the chapters on fundamental equations, efficiency/performance figures, airflows and the effect.
content.title_en: Don't panic about thermodynamics! : Success and fun in the classic "dickboard drill" of the engineering studies

content.text: The following are the main points of consideration: development, review and evaluation of services: proven and new ways of primary and secondary education. Starting from the question of the meaning of school performance requirements and critical illumination of the measurement quality of school performance reviews, all practical questions are addressed, starting with the planning and design of examinations, questions of evaluation and grading, and the subsequent self-critical analysis of whole examinations and individual tasks. The practice of oral tests and the review of holistic performances is also taken into account. Starting with the question of the meaning of school performance requirements and the critical illumination of the measurement quality of school performance reviews, all practical questions are addressed, starting with the planning and design of examinations, questions of evaluation and grading, and up to the subsequent self-critical analysis of whole examinations and individual tasks.
content.title_en: Development, review and evaluation of services: proven and new ways of achieving primary and secondary education

content.text: The European Commission as a learning organisation? : the implementation of the principle of environmental integration in selected Directorates-General of the European Commission. The European Commission is a key player in the European Union. It is confronted with increasingly extensive and changing tasks to which the European Commission must respond. This book examines, using the example of the implementation of the principle of environmental integration within the European Commission, the extent to which it is able to learn in the context of changing environmental requirements. This is based on a systematic study of approaches to organisational learning, which is used to guide empirical research into the following areas:
content.title_en: The European Commission as a learning organisation?: the implementation of the principle of environmental integration in selected Directorates-General of the European Commission

content.text: The clinical view in the social work : system theory approaches to a theory of reflection of the help system. The focus of this book is a cultural-scientific reformulation of Luhmann's system theory in the context of social work. Against the background of the criticism of the attempts to establish a system theory foundation of discipline, the symbolically generalized communication media of love and power and their transformation are analyzed in the context of the genesis of the help system. This results in a previously neglected empirical connection of the system theory access to social work and a further element is created to develop the theoretical perspectives of the social work.
content.title_en: The clinical view in social work : system theory approaches to a reflection theory of the aid system

content.text: The architect, the cook and the good taste. Cooking and building have always been one of the basic activities of man: both originate from usefulness, but at the same time include a cultural, as well as aesthetic-sensory moment. The book seeks the amazing parallels and also the deeply rooted relationships between the art of building and cooking. Petra Hagen Hodgson is a freelance architectural critic, correspondent for work, building+ and author of numerous contributions to architecture and urban planning in magazines and books. Rolf Toyka is head of the Academy of Architects and Town Planning in Hesse.
content.title_en: The architect, the chef and the good taste

content.text: Central marketing aspects in the Public Health Care : Word-of-Mouth (WoM) as a communication tool and the acceptance of the extended tariff choice. With the support of the Techniker Krankenkasse, the University of Applied Sciences Kiel investigates the emergence and effect of WoM in the choice and change of the health insurance. The second study focuses on the acceptance and attractiveness of voting rates from the point of view of health insurance companies and insured persons.
content.title_en: Central marketing aspects in the Public Health Care : Word-of-Mouth (WoM) as a communication tool and the acceptance of the extended tariff choice

content.text: Fire does not burn : Roman. A novel about the gentle growth of East and West and a chronicle of erotic desire
content.title_en: Fire does not burn : Roman

content.text: Modern operating systems. Standard work for university use. The textbook presents concepts needed to understand modern operating systems. (LK/HB: Isigkeit) This standard work for university use has been fundamentally revised. Both in structuring (new chapter classification), and in terms of content (new emphasis) the output differs significantly from its predecessor (ID 44/02). The powerful compendium of the renowned scientist, which has expanded to its extent by about 200 pages, takes on feedback and suggestions from scientific practice and, on the other hand, addresses current developments of recent years. Among other things, an introduction to the programming language C including C runtime model was re-introduced and instead of Windows 2000 there is a representation to Vista. The UNIX/Linux chapter has been revised and completely switched to Linux. Newly introduced also a chapter on Symbian OS, an operating system that is widely used in smartphones. Multicore systems and virtualization technology are now also taken into account. In addition, outdated material has been removed and replaced by current texts. (3) An exchange of the expenses is necessary.
content.title_en: Modern operating systems

content.text: Methods-Lexikon for the social sciences. The book provides a comprehensive and urgently needed lexical overview of the methods of empirical social research. Methods in the social sciences usually systematically introduce the topic in the form of a manual or textbook, which is why a lexical dictionary is a good supplement from the outset! Empirical social research, qualitative and quantitative methods as well as statistics are treated. The topic area is wide-ranging with 2,000 keywords and numerous references inside and outside the articles. The concise articles are often supplemented by tables, graphic representations and formulas. Longer articles cover the methods of the individual social sciences. Literature information is not included. The work produced by more than 100 contributors is suitable for the actual social sciences (sociology, political science, educational science) as well as for sciences with larger intersections with the social sciences (such as ethnology, geography, history, communication and media sciences). A very good addition to the collections of introductions to the empirical social sciences! (3 A)
content.title_en: Methodical Lexicon for the Social Sciences

content.text: We Gutkrieger : why the Bundeswehr will fail abroad. Behind the polemic title lies a factual analysis of the already normal and expanding foreign operations of the Bundeswehr since the 1990s. The political scientist and proven expert for peace and military politics hides moral categories for the time being and investigates the questions whether the previous operations could fulfill the goals formulated by the responsible politicians themselves and whether they could do so in the future. For both the answer is "no"; because the military means are completely inadequate. He criticizes supporters and opponents of the operations for avoiding professional analyses of the military possibilities and prefer to strive for moral categories. Chauvistré goes into detail in a second step about the consequences for international politics, internal politics and for the social climate. He pleads for the ultimately much more effective means of diplomacy and other civilian "foreign operations".
content.title_en: We Gutkrieger : why the Bundeswehr will fail abroad

content.text: Object-oriented programming: the comprehensive manual; [object-oriented programming explained intelligibly; from principles to design to implementation; practical examples in UML, Java, C#, C++, JavaScript, Ruby, Python and PHP]. The comprehensive basic and practical book on application possibilities of object orientation in software development, which primarily applies to computer science students and software developers with relevant prior knowledge, was only slightly revised in this new edition, so that the preliminary edition (ID 46/06, then under the title "Praxisbuch Objectorientierung") does not have to be replaced. However, an almost 50 page practical example, in which the development of a modern web application with PHP 5 is presented, is also dealt with. In detail, the basics of object-oriented programming, polymorphy and inheritance, persistence procedure, modules and architecture and aspect-oriented programming, comprehensive topics such as UML and design patterns are included. In case of good use of the predecessor in advanced computer systems are additionally recommended. Represents a good alternative to the didactically designed B. McLaughlin (ID 33/07) Balzers scarcely updated.
content.title_en: Object-oriented programming : the comprehensive manual ; [object-oriented programming explained intelligibly ; from the principles to the design to the implementation ; practical examples in UML, Java, C#, C++, JavaScript, Ruby, Python and PHP]

content.text: Basics of Statistics / by Jochen Schwarze ; Vol. 2: Probability calculation and inductive statistics. Publisher's text: The two-volume basics of statistics provide you with the basic statistical knowledge you need to pass your exams and to apply them afterwards in your profession. The author repeatedly establishes the connection of the theoretical teaching material to concrete economic questions, which makes the teaching work particularly clear.
content.title_en: Basics of Statistics / of Jochen Schwarze ; Vol. 2: Probability calculation and inductive statistics

content.text: The health care system in an international comparison : Health system comparison and European health policy. This book provides an overview of the structures of the health care system in an international comparison. The overview is supplemented by case studies on the health systems of some countries, which are used repeatedly in Germany in the course of reforms. Furthermore, the increasingly important health policy at European level and its influence on the German health system is explained. With many current hints and tips, the book also offers important support for further research for both students and teachers and practitioners.
content.title_en: International comparison of health systems: comparison of health systems and European health policy

content.text: Structures of the European Administrative Network : Results of a German-Spanish research group. The increasing integration of national and Community administrative bodies in the European Union through various forms of vertical and horizontal links is currently at the heart of European administrative law. In Germany, this development, which leads to an erosion of the traditional emphasis on the separation between Community (direct) and Member State (indirect) implementation of Community law, is described by the concept of the European Administrative Network. However, this discussion is not limited to Germany, but is conducted throughout Europe under very different terms and problem priorities. (Source: Verlag / Internet).
content.title_en: Structures of the European Administrative Network : Results of a German-Spanish Research Group

content.text: The right of the arcades to be used after the federalism reform: to interpret Article 74 (1) No. 11 GG and to reconcile restrictions on commercial gambling operations based on it with Article 12 (1) GG. The book deals with the legislative competence for the law of the arcades, which has passed over to the countries with the federalism reform I of 1 September 2006. It shows, on the basis of the history of the creation of this new country jurisdiction, that it refers only to regulations which were previously under § 33 i GewO matter of the federal government, and thus opposes attempts to extend them to the entire arcade system to include a concern of the countries with which they could not penetrate already in the federalism commission. In the second part, the book deals with demands, in the interest of a so-called coherence of protection rules to combat gambling addiction, also to provide for similar computer-based access controls for game halls as required for game banks. The author examines these proposals on the basis of professional freedom of play halls operators and concludes that they are therefore disproportionate with the exception of a light balance of the customer (G.
content.title_en: The right of the arcades after the federalism reform: to interpret Article 74(1) No. 11 GG and to reconcile restrictions on the commercial operation of games with Article 12(1) GG

content.text: A planet before overheating: intelligent policy against a destabilized climate. The 2009 volume shows which technologies, behaviours, institutions and agreements are needed to avert the upcoming climate catastrophe. (LK/F: Themelidis) The yearbook "Zur Lage der Welt" ("... 2008", BA 6/08) is more indispensable than ever, because climate change is and remains the greatest challenge of mankind. The 2009 volume shows which technologies, behaviors, institutions and agreements are needed to avert the upcoming climate catastrophe. - Can be used everywhere. (1 A,S) (LK/F: Themelidis)
content.title_en: A planet before overheating: intelligent policy against a destabilised climate

content.text: FortPlants : Botany + Breeding + Biotechnology ; [what you always wanted to know about sex in plants]. KNO: Mostly belong to sex two: man and woman. In plant gender research there are many plants, both of which are at the same time (hermaphrodite), others, which can not decide and sometimes are male and sometimes female, and the mushrooms can have many sexes. And then the man comes into play with his desires. He makes purely female rye or purely male asparagus for commercial reasons. He lets chaste virgins miss the goal of their life, because they only give good hop aroma if they are not satisfied. And finally, he completely rejects some plants the gender and breeds them to clones, pure identical twins, which can only have sex once in life. And to have full control over the plant sex, he uses modern methods of cell and tissue culture and gene technology.
content.title_en: FortPlants : Botany + Breeding + Biotechnology ; [what you always wanted to know about sex in plants]

content.text: The question of what the system theory provides for the analysis of socialization and subject formation, however, leads to a new area which is still hardly underdeveloped. The volume investigates this question and tries to bring proven structural genetic socialization theories into contact with system theoretic perspectives. The juxtaposition of subject-centered and sociological explanatory approaches to socialization, which can be found in the socialization theories, can be resolved if the system theory takes account of the independent organization of subjective and social processes. The studies deal with processes of development and socialization as well as methodological and methodological questions. Thus, they put a theory of self-socialization at the centre of interest under changed conditions of social differentiation.
content.title_en: Interactionist Constructivism : to System Theory of Socialization

content.text: Smart Materials in Architecture, Interior Architecture and Design. The application of smart materials in architecture is an innovative, dynamic field in which research, development and application in construction are fluidly merged. Smart Materials with their reversible alternating properties react to stimuli such as light, temperature and electric field. They change in form, colour, viscosity, etc. One of the most fascinating developments is form memory alloys or phase change materials. For example, they can develop self-acting kinetic facades or wallpapers that change colour and patterns depending on temperature and light. The book introduces the development of these materials as well as their context in architecture, design and art. The materials make it possible, for example, to develop smart materials respond to voice and switch over again and again.
content.title_en: Smart materials in architecture, interior design and design

content.text: Excel + VBA for mechanical engineers : Learning to program and solve problems ; with 43 tables. Many prospective engineers and technicians work with the MS Office package nowadays and use the EXCEL program for simple calculations and calculations. But this also provides them with a very good tool for creating their own programs. This book gives a short introduction to EXCEL+VBA and shows on several program examples from the technology how they can use this tool meaningfully and use it. The reader learns to solve the programming and problem situations independently. It is thus a helpful guide through a large part of the mechanical engineering study. Newly included chapters on manufacturing and gear technology as well as technical documentation.
content.title_en: Excel + VBA for mechanical engineers : Learning to program and solve problems ; with 43 tables

content.text: Design with wood, stone and metal: modern architecture in the garden. According to "Das große Ideenbuch - Garten und Terrasse" (BA 8/06) and "Moderne Gartengestaltung" (BA 2/08) here another attractive text picture volume in this publishing house. Landscape format and layout with an example of each double page have remained the same as the dominance of the large-format, impressive color photos. The book is a continuation of the above title. Also this time it is about selected examples of modern garden design. The focus this time is on the use of wood, stone and metal. International garden designers show their partly rather unusual ideas in garden rooms. The author of the book, herself garden architect, gives besides a description of the impressive pictures, professional tips for the implementation of the presented ideas in the personal garden planning. For garden lovers and garden designers this book is an idea foundation of modern garden design! Libraries, in which the first two picture volumes found sufficient audience, will probably also acquire this volume. (2)
content.title_en: Design with wood, stone and metal : modern architecture in the garden

content.text: Sexual self-determination as a human right. Gender identity and sexual self-determination are becoming increasingly visible as topics in the human rights discourse, but still encounter contradiction and resistance. Experiences of international human rights organisations demonstrate that numerous rights of people who do not comply with the gender or sexual norm or who live in same-sex partnerships are being violated worldwide. Nevertheless, the practice of international institutions for the protection of human rights at the European level and at the United Nations shows which human rights standards have developed to this day. The collection volume deals with both the human rights foundations of sexual self-determination rights and the perspectives of different groups affected.
content.title_en: Sexual self-determination as a human right

content.text: The Cyclops: the cultural history of the telescope. A popular scientific sketch of the history of the telescope - from the beginning of star observations to today and beyond - written by one of the most famous German authors on the subject of astronomy. (Heidi Debschütz) KNO: When Galileo Galilei first directed the telescope, which was invented in 1609, a world picture collapsed. Today a large telescope surrounds our Earth and gigantic telescopes continuously gather information from the vastness of the universe. The cultural history of the telescope is dotted with coincidences, amusing anecdotes and great efforts of outstanding scientists and technicians of all countries. The book tells exciting and entertaining about the historical rise of the "cyclops" and reveals essential insights that we owe to the artificial giant eyes. The Cyclops is directed to a wide reader circle, which includes both the friends of astronomy, but also historically and culturally interested readers. The success story of the telescope - of coincidences, recursions and errors - is told briefly, with anecdotes, but nevertheless, aspires to completeness.
content.title_en: The Cyclop : the cultural history of the telescope

content.text: City(t)raume - Everyday Spaces? : Youth cultures between planned and lived urbanity. The book examines the appropriation of public spaces by children and young people using the example of a new and remodelling area in Zurich. In this context, crises and opportunities of public space are addressed against the background of an interdisciplinary urban-architectural and cultural-scientific oriented approach: At which interfaces do public urban spaces have conflicts or opportunities for development for communication processes between generations? With what measures can these be influenced or promoted?
content.title_en: City(s) Dreams - Everyday Spaces? : Youth Cultures between Planed and Lived Urbanity

content.text: Test questions and answers for the automotive technician trade. Includes over 2,000 test questions (just below) on automotive technology in systematic breakdown by component, component, plant and auxiliary material. With sketches and diagrams, without index and further literature. Has been extended by about 40 pages (new tasks) compared to the first edition (BA 10/01) and updated in the regulations. The old edition can be used, should be supplemented with this edition. (2 S)
content.title_en: Questions and answers for the motor vehicle technician trade

content.text: The ethically acceptable animal test: criteria and limits. Experiments on animals are considered as a necessary evil in large populations. Although their moral problems are recognized by most people, few would like to completely renounce animal tests. However, until an indiscriminate animal test ban is desired, the differentiation between ethically unacceptable and such, considered to be legally feasible experimental projects is a permanent task for ethics. The inclusion of animal welfare among the state objectives of the Federal Republic of Germany in 2002 has increased the normative need for clarification. Since then animal test applications can be rejected on the basis of lack of reliability or ethical non-reliability, although the freedom of research has the status of a fundamental right. The basic law amendment has re-enacted a number of ethical-normative conflicts, which in turn have been evoked massive moral-philosophical reflection and clarification requirements. This publication has been created with the aim of examining the suitability of the proposed animal test projects, ethical criteria and practical considerations to activate the injustice of each individual case.
content.title_en: The ethically acceptable animal test: criteria and limits

content.text: Time-players: Productions of the temporal at Bergson, Deleuze and Lynch. If time is released from the narrow form of linear time, events no longer follow each other and effects no longer follow on causes - then the clarity of the event deviates from a game of possibilities. This idea characterizes both the thinking of Henri Bergson and Gilles Deleuze as well as the film creation of David Lynch. Using the example of this thinking, Kerstin Volland depicts the theory, method and method of film analysis. From a media pedagogical point of view, she shows how time in film manifests itself exclusively through subjective experience.
content.title_en: Timer : Productions of the Temporale at Bergson, Deleuze and Lynch

content.text: The Tower of Babel - Myth or Reality? : Tower Buildings Compared to the Bible. There are remarkable clues for the historical reliability of the prehistory of the Bible. They are examined in an exemplary way by the story of the Tower Building of Babel. Comparisons with extra-biblical parallels lead to astonishing results that underpin the credibility of the biblical tradition.
content.title_en: The Tower of Babel - Myth or Reality? : Tower Buildings Compared to the Bible

content.text: Megacities: Risk living spaces with future. IWorldwide there are already more than 20 megacities: cities where at least ten million people live. Most of them are in developing and emerging economies and are constantly growing. The huge population explosion brings serious social and ecological problems. The inhabitants of the partly illegal settlements and overcrowded slums lack the most necessary water, sanitation and electricity. The speed with which urban spaces expand and become dense is hardly to be controlled. The energy and resource hunger overburdens the infrastructure and exceeds the supply capacities. Millions of cars and mopeds clogge the roads and the smog from traffic endangers the health. The authors of political ecology114 describe life in megacities and the causes for their emergence and attraction. They name the problems and discuss how the agglomerations can improve the living conditions of their inhabitants.
content.title_en: Megacities : Risk spaces with future

content.text: Introduction to PHP 5.3 and MySQL 5.1: [suitable for beginners; introduction to web programming; graphics, PDF, flash applications and email; object orientation explained intelligibly]. PHP is very often used to develop dynamic Internet applications, accompanied by the database system MySQL. This book, designed for beginners, takes into account the further development of the software and is now based on versions PHP 5.3 and MySQL 5.1. In fact, the effects for the target group are rather small. All presented examples can also be implemented with the previous version and both the structuring of the learning material and the majority of the text present themselves unchanged compared to the last displayed edition (BA 1/07). In addition to the few additions (e.g. a short introduction to SQLite3), the installation of the XAMPP package (composition of free software) which is completely on the attached DVD is now explained in the appendix. For inventory update, in addition to the further usable pre-press and before the titles of Michael Kofler (BA 1/09) and Luke Welling (BA Thi09/BA) the advanced version (B/B/B/B/B/) or the advanced version.
content.title_en: Entry into PHP 5.3 and MySQL 5.1: [suitable for beginners; introduction to web programming; graphics, PDF, flash applications and e-mail; object orientation explained intelligibly]

content.text: The traffic jam is not a traffic problem. The car is not actually a driving, but a standing equipment. Either it is in a parking lot or in a traffic jam. And the traffic jam is again a consequence of the wrong parking space organization. One speaks of freedom through the car and overlooks that one has already been put into the "car trap". As long as the car is not at least as far away from all human activities as the stop of an attractive, regularly trafficting public transport, there is no escape from this trap. Only by another structure, in which the settlements are not occupied and controlled by cars, but only when people again dominate the technical transport system, can the prerequisite for human development be created.
content.title_en: Stand-by vehicles: traffic is not a problem

content.text: Digital signal processing with MATLAB : Basic course with 16 detailed tests; with 67 tables. The book introduces the basics and applications of digital signal processing through practical exercises on the PC. 16 tests are offered, consisting of an introduction, a preparation part with tasks and a test part with MATLAB exercises. To the tasks and MATLAB exercises there is a detailed solution part at the end of the book.A PC with the program package MATLAB with the signal processing toolbox is provided.More than 80 programs and data sets are available free of charge on the homepage of the Vieweg publishing house, www.vieweg.de.In the 3rd edition the experiences gained in an internship with students in the 6th semester of the University of Applied Sciences Fulda are incorporated. In particular, the tools offered by MATLAB are: Window Design and Analysis Tool, Filter Viewer Tool and Filter Design and Analysis Tool are increasingly involved, so that the learned can be transferred directly into practice.
content.title_en: Digital signal processing with MATLAB : basic course with 16 detailed tests; with 67 tables

content.text: Google Maps : Use and expand web maps. Anyone who uses the Internet at all will find maps of Google Maps, either as a mere map or as satellite photos. You can easily change the scale and move the viewed section. In this volume, the authors first offer a short and easy-to-understand introduction to the basics of cartography, before they show how private individuals or associations can easily enrich Google maps with informative and appealing additional information, whether it be clear markings of hiking trails, information on tourist attractions or locations of rare plants. One can then see that the basic chapter was helpful if one wants to show a bicycle tour, but the paths of the bike map do not exactly match Google Maps and need to be changed due to other projections. Each step to this, but also for the inclusion of the Google Maps API and JavaScript is described in detail and in detail, with legal hurdles (whether license-free). Also suitable for real estate sellers. (1 S)
content.title_en: Google Maps : Use and expand web maps

content.text: AutoCAD 2010 LT 2010 : the practical reference. Editing and continuation of W. Sommer: "AutoCAD 2009, LT 2009" (BA 4/09) with a compact description of the commands and program options. Repetitive course and reference work for a wide user group in addition to the comprehensive compendium of the author (BA 11/09), after the entry course of J. Ridder (BA 11/09), besides the training course "AutoCAD 2010" (DVD-ROM, BA 10/09). Quick overview of the frequent look-up, which is eligible for own ownership but can also be offered in libraries. The old edition can be used. (2)
content.title_en: AutoCAD 2010 LT 2010 : the practical reference

content.text: New management of universities: an interim assessment. In recent years, the discussion about new control instruments has also expanded to the field of universities. Following the study reforms, the internal modernization and the reorganization of the external relations of universities are now at the center of the university modernization. Higher education autonomy, university councils, global budgets, target agreements, performance-oriented funding as well as the professionalization of management structures are the main points of discussion. The main objectives of the modernization efforts are the redefinition of the relationship between university and state, the introduction of more competition between universities and the reorganization of management structures. In this volume, experts identified in the field take a first look at the modernization efforts in universities. They also sharpen their attention by means of a comparative perspective on different paths that the countries are taking in the federal system of the Federal Republic of Germany and on international developments and influences. Not least, they ask for lessons that can be drawn from the reforms of the municipal administrations for university modernization.
content.title_en: New governance of higher education institutions: an interim assessment

content.text: Media mix in citizen participation: the integration of online elements into participation processes at local level. At the local level, there has been a wealth of legally anchored but informal forms of public participation, but rarely used to a significant extent. When the Internet opened up new possibilities for communication in the mid-1990s, electronic democracy became not only a catchword for new visions, but also the subject of state support programmes in many countries, so that traditional online-based forms of participation were added to the traditional forms of participation. Since a participation process usually uses several communication channels and means, a media mix in citizen participation can be spoken of. Based on selected participation projects, this volume examines whether and how new forms of participation can be combined via the Internet with the usual practices and thus better achieve the participation objectives. The presentation introduces in basic terms of 'e-participation' and media communication, discusses the planning of media participation in participation processes and their effects, and illustrates the way in which many practical examples are used.
content.title_en: Media mix in citizen participation: the integration of online elements into participation procedures at local level

content.text: Sigfried Giedion and photography: Pictures of Modernism. Sigfried Giedion (1888-1968) was one of the most important Swiss art historians of the 20th century and at the same time one of the protagonists of international architectural modernism. He organized and curated numerous exhibitions, worked in teaching and established worldwide networks - but above all he acted as a publicist. - He gave at least as much attention to his own photography as to the precise use of images in his publications, which he designed to the very detail of his own, as well as to the written word. To his friend Walter Gropius he wrote in 1930: "I am usually photographing myself not only for the purpose of possessing the material, but above all for the purpose of having it as little as possible words to hang on it." - Sigfried Giedion's diverse pictorial strategies have remained largely unnoticed by research until now. The publication first sheds light on his approaches and provides a historical contribution to the current debate on images and media.
content.title_en: Sigfried Giedion and Photography : Picture productions of Modernism

content.text: Practical principles Biostatistics and SAS : descriptive statistics, situation tests, tests for frequencies, correlation, regression ; application in SAS. Publisher's text: This book is primarily aimed at students/doctoral students of medical or related courses who wish to carry out experimental empirical work. Also for the interested practitioner the script is equally useful. The execution of the basic statistical procedures is carried out using the statistics software SAS® a program which is used worldwide in many research institutions and industries for various purposes, in particular data analysis. All versions are carried out and tested with the SAS® version 9.1.
content.title_en: Practical principles Biostatistics and SAS : descriptive statistics, situation tests, frequency tests, correlation, regression ; application in SAS

content.text: The world is changing: sustainable bioenergy and land use. Given the great opportunities and risks and complexity, bioenergy has quickly become a challenging political regulatory and design task, which can only be solved through global cooperation and international framework. The central message of the WBGU is that the sustainable potential of bioenergy that exists worldwide should be exploited as long as sustainability risks can be excluded, in particular food security and the goals of nature and climate protection.
content.title_en: World in transition : sustainable bioenergy and land use

content.text: The book provides basic technical and design knowledge on the topic of plan and presentation. The project-related presentation in the new building and inventory, which requires a targeted, scale-based selection of information, is conveyed with concrete examples from architectural history and present. Thus, the reader learns that in the age of CAD historical examples of architectural representation are still inspiring and instructive.
content.title_en: Architecture and plan presentation

content.text: Ferdinand Graf Zeppelin: the aviation pioneer and his company. The aviation historian treats important employees like Hugo Eckener beyond the biography of the Count (1838-1917) and the widely branched corporate network that extends to the present day. (Rolf Raschka) There are many books about the Count, who was rooted in the society of the Empire (1838-1917). Thus, in the airship anniversary year 2000, the recommended Christopher Chant: "Zeppelin" and Hans G. Knäusel: "Der Zeppelin" (BA 9/00, 12/00), but also older titles like Hans von Schiller (ID 36/88) were published. The aviation historian Provan ("Big Lift", BA 9/98) expands the field of view beyond a scarce biography to important employees like Hugo Eckener (cf. D. Botting: "The Great Zeppelin", ID 44/02) and the branched company fleet ("Big Lift", BA 9/98) to the extent that the aircraft was also produced in a very large number of aircrafts and a number of experiments.
content.title_en: Ferdinand Graf Zeppelin : the aviation pioneer and his company

content.text: Focus: Political spatial types: the power of public structures and spatial structures in the 20th century. For years, the topic of "space" has been a business activity in social and art sciences. However, the individual studies to date have rarely focused on one problem: While it is assumed that specific social and political contexts affect the design and political power of individual spatial creations - but can not even basic forms of space be themselves carriers of meaning alone from their structure? Can they generate political meaning? Has this connection of historical and spatial structures inscribed itself into collective memory? Can basic forms of the built space, for example, direct gaze, control movement or prevent, move to the centre or point to the periphery, generate political significance? And how does this convey itself? - These questions appear relevant, since space is an essential condition as well as a result of action. In this volume they are critically discussed.
content.title_en: Focus: Political spatial types : the power of public structures in the 20th century

content.text: The hatred of the West: how the poor peoples defend themselves against the economic world war. As most recently in "The Empire of Shame" (BA 2/06), J. Ziegler describes the mechanisms of exploitation of the poor peoples of the South based on structural violence by organs of the "rob-capitalism" of the West. However, the hatred that strikes this one has Ziegler, according to more profound reasons, and is located in the traumatic violations of slavery and colonialism - an injustice that demands reparation and reparation, but is arrogantly ignored by the West. In Bolivia's politics under indigenous President Evo Morales, Ziegler sees the hopeful example of an independent path for the poor - in the blatant contrast to the catastrophic exploitation situation in Nigeria. Together with the geographer, Trier, he has identified and analysed statistical data for 15 large cities between 1990 and 2005, thus linking poor and ethnic minorities and their spatial distribution. The authors consistently avoid the untapped concept of "getting". The theoretical part mentions the causes of segregation, the disadvantage on the labour and housing market with many references to other studies and research approaches. The thematic maps for each city document the proportion of foreigners per district. content.text: Water - sustainable uses: innovative examples from the fields of water, water, wastewater. The growing world population with ever-increasing migratory pressure, the increasing industrial production and the more intensive agriculture require massive efforts, especially in times of climate change, to sustainable use and distribution of water. German engineers, small and medium-sized companies, scientists and operators have a special responsibility here, because they are leading the development of plants for wastewater treatment and water extraction. In the past years, in the field of in-house, process-integrated environmental protection processes have been developed, which are economically and energy efficient, are able to cope with less water or serve the water cycle management. The concerns of a sustainable water management correspond to the guiding principle of the German Federal Environmental Foundation. This book presents over 100 DBU funding projects and scholarships from the fields of drinking and groundwater, water protection, water use and circulation, wastewater purification and communication. They show how this guiding principle is introduced in practice.

content.text: The perception and acceptance of large protected areas. Large protected areas fulfil a central function for modern nature conservation. At the same time, they are increasingly regarded as instruments of regional development and are often considered as model areas for sustainable development. This also increases the challenges of planning large protected areas. For a long time, these were usually enforced 'from above', without sufficient communication among the affected parties. This explains a variety of acceptance deficits, which represent a significant mortgage for the implementation of corresponding planning. <dt.>
content.title_en: Perception and acceptance of large protected areas

content.title_en: Safety and Risk : on the Dealing with Hazard in the 21st Century

content.text: New man and collective identity in the communication society. The sociology of contemporary society increasingly recognizes the importance of collective identities and corrects classical theory of modernization. It recognizes that morality is not capable of regulating much, because it is based on conflict. Sociological research is increasingly showing us that we cannot escape the collective feelings. It also demonstrates the wisdom of self-control of social systems in relation to their state over-control. Sociological enlightenment contributes to the insight that even the geno-optimized New Man cannot escape the elementary processes of social life and collective identities. The contributions also shed light on the limits of communication that are produced by the communication society itself. The volume is dedicated to the commemoration of Karl Otto Hondrich (1937-2007), whose sociology makes us aware of the fact that in the age of globalization and hybridization the dominance of local, regional and ethnic worlds of origin cannot be overlooked.
content.title_en: New human and collective identity in the communication society

content.text: Social change, space and mobility: empirical studies on the subjectivation of transport demand. The demand for transport by households has changed considerably in recent decades. This applies equally to private motorization and the use of transport as to the lengths of the journey, the spaces for action and time structures. On the one hand, spatial developments have contributed to these changes, such as the suburbanization and regional deconcentration of households and enterprises. On the other hand, social change is closely linked to transport development in many ways.

content.text: Rights of disposal in urban conversion: patterns of action and control instruments in old buildings. In shrinking cities with high vacancy and decay tendencies, the urban conversion becomes a real experiment due to lack of theoretical foundations and previous experiences in many places. Bertram Schiffers analyses the interactions between the real estate market and state intervention using theoretical concepts of the New Institution Economics. House ownership consists of a bundle of rights of disposal with their respective own framework conditions. This includes the right of use of tenants, the right of construction and change of the homeowners and the right of interest of banks.

A well-written and vividly illustrated popular scientific presentation of the landscape forms of the Earth, with the collaboration of the well-known ZDF science presenter Karsten Schwanke. content.text: Structural change in European dairy farming : results of a regionally differentiated survey. The competitive pressure in European dairy farming is increasing due to the progressive liberalisation of the EU dairy market. Existing agricultural economic research methods are only limited in their ability to make robust assessments of regional competitiveness and future relocations within Europe. The aim of this work is to create an exploratory approach to the questioning of a supplementary contribution to such a forecast. The survey approach was developed within the European Dairy Farmers' and agri benchmark' networks and used in European dairy farms. An unrepresentative selection of these farms forms the basis for the regionally differentiated analysis available. The planning and expectations of the farmers surveyed provide both indications of regional developments in milk production as well as of individual production developments and management strategies. Finally, the survey approach is assessed as to its suitability as a sustainable analysis tool and proposals for future development are presented (source: author).
content.title_en: Structural change in European dairy farming : results of a regionally differentiated survey

Oestreich (Statistics, BA 3/09), J. Strybny (Stromungsmechanik, BA 1/07) is now another volume with an introduction to a mathematically oriented, as difficult, basic subject. The authors introduce basic concepts (model formation, control circuit, state room, etc.) and bring everyday examples and step-by-step instructions about laws and applications. Loose, sometimes somewhat intentional witty writing, which is supplemented by cartoons and which want to suggest a bridge to more thorough textbooks with higher mathematics content. Repetitive questions and exercise tasks (with solutions) increase the visibility of the theory and the volume of active. The subject is called "Plephir" (Dict. 11).
content.title_en: Don't panic about control technology! : Success and fun in the mystery subject of engineering studies

content.text: Stress and Burn-out Prevention : Manual for executives, works councils and occupational physicians. Stress and burn-out can affect all occupational groups, whether technicians in call-ready, managers, nurses, drivers or employees of call-centers. Not only for the individual, but also for companies can have dramatic consequences of declining performance and productivity of the workforce. Thus stress prevention is all the more important in the company. This book aims to contribute to this with checklists, tips and experience reports on successful stress prevention programs of different companies.
content.title_en: Stress and Burn-out Prevention : Manual for Managers, Works Councils and Occupational Medicines

content.text: Process engineering and construction operation in basic and special foundation construction : Building ground - building pits - building ground improvement - pile foundations - groundwater conservation : with 176 tables. Geotechnical processes - practical The planner experiences in this compact technical book all economic and operational conditions for basic and special foundation construction with current technical reference. The authors take into account the connections between choice, dimensioning and calculation of processes that are subject to dependence on soil, water and structure as well as construction concerns. In addition, the book contains recommendations for the phase of construction preparation for the service description in order to meet the requirements for a clear and exhausting service description (VOB/A par. 9 No. 1). Important information on construction processes, equipment selection as well as performance and cost calculation are another part of the content. Thus, the practical manual and teaching work is a competent companion when it comes to project development until acceptance!
content.title_en: Process engineering and construction operations in basic and special foundation construction : land - pits - improvement of the building ground - pile foundations - groundwater management : with 176 tables

content.text: Media - Event - Religion : the mediatization of the religious. Religion and religiousness have become a theme in the media and everyday life in recent years: Not only that the media reports about a "new religiousness". Likewise, individualized religion has become more visible in the everyday life of young people and young adults and is shaped by media-mediated content and its appropriation. But what is the relationship between the current religious change and the media? How concrete is media-mediated religiousness lived in the everyday world? And how do traditional churches deal with it? The volume treats these questions as an exemplary media event in Germany and Italy on the basis of the Catholic World Youth Day 2005.
content.title_en: Media - Event - Religion : the mediatization of the religious

content.text: Online communication : Basics, fields of practice and methods. In 7 chapters, the authors first define what online communication is, in which forms and forums it takes place and discuss online communication as multimodal sign trading. They then discuss the topic of identity and social relations, political communication on the net as well as the conditions and effects of online communication for economic relations (PR, advertising). Finally, they examine how online communication can be investigated and which methods online research uses. The content is well supported by graphs and screenshots. Each chapter ends with repetition and discussion questions and further references. With glossary and extensive bibliography. The title is aimed at lecturers and students of communication and media studies and can be offered at corresponding university locations.
content.title_en: Online communication : basics, practice fields and methods

content.text: On the hunt in the underground: the ideal entry into the fascinating world of deep drilling technology; [with high-tech looking for oil, gas and geothermal energy]. Despite the increasing importance of regenerative energies, the majority of energy production continues to be via fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, etc.). Demand is rising despite declining deposits. All the more, efforts are being made to reach further sites through special methods (low drilling, etc.). The author, Professor of Drilling Technology at the TU Freiberg and a specialist in matter, first brings a general introduction to oil and gas drilling technology, a listing of the sites before detailed information about drilling facilities, processes and tools of deep drilling follows. The not simple topic is provided in an understandable way and illustrated by illustrations and practical examples. An outlook on future reserves of raw materials concludes the reading volume, which is supplemented by further literature and a glossary. On the subject are only older illustrations (e.g. "Ear gas in industry", ID 6/96 or "Mineral oil school", ID 18/96), the material is not intended for the other.

content.text: Basic knowledge of machine elements. Compact course on the design and strength of machine elements in a textbook for students who treat the topic in a minor subject (automation technology, mechatronics, etc.). Based on the two-volume course of the author (cf. H. Hinzen: ID 34/07, 3/09) and dispenses with complex computational descriptions. Clearly structured, with practice tasks after each main section (solutions on the Internet) as well as further literature and standard references. Can be used alongside B. content.text: Empirical social research: models and methods of standardized data collection and data evaluation. The introduction to standardized empirical social research in the twelfth edition is practical in application. Its structure follows the real research process. The basic scientific theoretical and methodological questions are not treated as an end in themselves, but as their relevance for research practice and illustrated by social science examples. The text does not require prior knowledge and is particularly oriented towards the needs of "new entrants". For "repeaters" and practitioners, the footnotes provide continuous hints on the subject of deepening. In addition, the perspective of qualitative-interpretative social research is also illuminated for each chapter in short annotations.
content.title_en: Empirical Social Research : Models and Methods of Standardised Data Collection and Data Evaluation

If used well up to now, it is worth in principle an exchange of the preliminary editions (at least until including the 11th), however the work is quite expensive and the here now new topics are certainly already covered by individual volumes. (3)
content.title_en: Semiconductor circuitry

content.text: Help between generations: a European comparison. Everyday help between generations is of great importance for individuals, families and society – and its relevance is even increasing with demographic ageing. The study examines the following questions for eleven European countries based on the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE): Who helps whom to what extent? In what circumstances are intergenerational help in the family performed? What influence do the state, market and culture have on private support between parents and adult children? How can existing potentials be used efficiently?
content.title_en: Generational assistance: a European comparison

content.text: Methods of marketing research: Basics and practical examples. Gerhard Raab, Alexander and Fritz Unger provide a comprehensive insight into the relevant methods of marketing research. The focus is on general methods, data analysis based on modern evaluation programs and practical marketing research. The authors also focus on aspects of international marketing research. Statistical analysis methods take a broad range of areas, but all chapters are understandable without extensive prior knowledge. The second edition includes the current state of knowledge from research and practice.
content.title_en: Methods of marketing research : basics and practical examples

The focus of the picture text band are the individual examples: 9 children/youth rooms in newly built or converted single family houses, 4 examples for a relatively inexpensive new/redesign in own direction and 6 theme rooms à la "prinzessinenzimmer" or "underwater room" - each designed by a designer company at the cost of 10,000 Euro to 15,000 Euro per measurement. content.text: Child delinquence: Law violations of criminal offenders and their consequences. Child delinquence is an issue that is increasingly discussed in the broad media. Sometimes, however, little scientificly sound standards are used here - not to mention some daring conclusions on the causes and the possibilities for intervention. Those who want to know more about it should read this book. The results of the Marburg long-term study on child delinquence are published here in summary. For almost 30 years this study was carried out in and around Marburg; it is unique in its kind. Besides the presentation of the results on the delinquence of criminal offenders, the authors also want to show the importance of earlier legal violations for the later legal development, in order to derive from them aspects for prevention and intervention measures. (Source: Text Verlagseinband / Verlag) Child delinquence is an issue that is increasingly discussed in the broad media. (Ronald Schneider) There are no serious criminals that bring us from now on to the 83-year-old Siegfried Lenz. Small naive fraudsters, people with heart and mind like the self-teller Clemens, a university professor who helped some students, after they had shared the bed with each other, through exams and then had to go to prison for four years. Clemens' cell neighbour Hannes got caught by the way he had armed with a police cell on the roads of failure to collect fines; then there is the corrupt football arbitrator Mumpert or the marriage dizzy Bolzahn. content.text: Linux command reference : Shell commands from a2ps to zypper. Linux specialist Kofler describes in this reference all important Linux commands for managing the file system, for starting and ending processes, for editing text files and for processing other administrative tasks. Commands for bash programming are also taken into account. All commands are displayed in alphabetical order, each together with the most important options. A very clear, user-friendly and distributive-independent compilation, which can be useful for both beginners and users familiar with the Linux system. Can be used in addition to the more extensive reference by Ute Hertzog (BA 2/08). For professional users, the title of Helmut Herold (ID 8/07) is available. (2)

content.text: Apocalypse no! : how human livelihoods really develop. Review: It is still often claimed that the planet Earth's situation is deteriorating day by day. Non-renewable resources, it is said, would be running out of time to keep the world's population growing unstoppably without food production keeping pace, that there would have been a dramatic rise in temperature worldwide and that the ecological catastrophe would be imminent. Of such apocalyptic forecasts, Danish statistician Lomborg does not hold anything. Based on a tremendous amount of data, he tries to prove that humanity has never been as good as today and that the expected further economic growth will enable it to get under control of all ecological crises. Lomborg can show that many doomsday forecasts are based on distorted perceptions and misinterpretations. What he himself does with the data material is often no less questionable. Nevertheless, the book is a one-sided but pioneering contribution to the ecological debate. It is also easily accessible and surprisingly inexpensive. (2) (Frank) The amount of data is not available to prove that the amount of data is not available to the Danish population.
content.title_en: Apocalypse no! : how human livelihoods really develop

content.text: Men - the weak sex and his brain. The renowned biologist, brain researcher and author (lastly BA 8/09) has already dealt with recent findings of brain research on several occasions. If one follows Hüther, these show that the human brain, that is also that of the man, is far more changeable and adaptable in its inner structure and organization than previously assumed (ID 28/01). Now he deals with the biological foundations of the male sex and describes then the process of man-behavior, from procreation and birth to puberty, to paternity, career and retirement from the profession. In doing so, he goes far beyond the referencing of findings of biology and brain research. Rather, he tries to make clear that the man can dissolve him restrictive behavior patterns in the brain - for example the idea of having to make career - and that he can develop the potentials that are put into him by his male nature (the male man's brain can also describe the behavioural pattern) (the male man's brain can also be clearly replaced).

content.text: The main steps and processes for the planning and execution of automation projects in the field of process engineering are described in this textbook, whereby both continuous and event-discrete processes are considered. Starting from the general construction of an automation plant, the development and content of the essential project documents, control and control design as well as basics for the project planning of the auxiliary energy supply are explained. Presentations for the supply creation and calculation of automation projects complete the topic.
content.title_en: Projecting of automation systems : an effective and clear introduction

content.text: Basics of vehicle mechatronics : a practical introduction for engineers, physicists and computer scientists. This textbook provides the necessary foundations for an understanding of the controls and regulations used in modern vehicles. Starting from the system structure, the individual components such as sensors and actuators are presented and subsequently discussed their interaction in simple controls and regulations. The interfaces relevant to the vehicle technician are in the foreground, less the physical principle of the sensors or the details of the electronic signal processing. Important systems such as ESP and future electronic braking systems are presented and discussed in detail, especially the role of patent specifications as the latest state of the art.
content.title_en: Basics of vehicle mechatronics: a practical introduction for engineers, physicists and computer scientists

In increasing complexity constructions are treated from the requirements of the customer to the production-oriented workshop drawings. Alternative solutions are presented and their advantages and disadvantages evaluated. The calculation of the machine elements is consistently carried out in the textbook Roloff/Matek machine elements. Due to the didactic concept, this book can be used well for self-study. content.text: The power of Africa: why the continent is not yet lost. While other countries that once belonged to the "Third World" have gained prosperity in recent decades, the majority of the states of Africa seem to fall further behind despite Western development aid. With much empathy for the affected, Rupert Neudeck analyses the background to the present situation, reports of his own experiences and calls for another Africa policy, which relies on initiative from below instead of "development" from above. Africa has much that we need in Europe as relief and compensation: oil and important raw materials in abundance, a beautiful nature, good agricultural products that are not yet contaminated by chemicals and much sun and wind for alternative energies. And it has many people who are ambitious and want to improve their situation. But the continent is also burdened by the legacy of colonialism and slavery and by the mismanagement of most African governments in the last 50 years. The absence of responsible political elites is for Rupert Neudeck the most important cause of African misery and also the Western development policy. The founder of CAP ANAMUR knows the problems of humanitarian aid since the past years, but the crisis of Africa's colonialism has not been abunk.
content.title_en: The power of Africa: why the continent is not yet lost
