Bastian Sick has made it happen: In an entertaining way, he has sensitized a million audience to linguistic phenomena. Decidedly, he fights his fight against the decay of the German language and, wherever he weathers a violation of grammar, mercilessly dissociates alleged errors. However, not all of his contributions stand up to a critical question. In "Sick of Sick?" Berlin-based linguist André Meinter shows in which points the well-known grammar pope is not quite right. In a similar entertaining way as in the "onion fish" in this book, it becomes clear how much more complicated or sometimes how much easier the German language is than Bastian Sick wants to believe.

content.text: International law and international politics. (people's) law, national and international law can secure peace, paradoxically but also cause war and conflict. This depends on whether it is appropriate to "social relations" or not. If social relations change, but not law, an outdated law can even lead to conflicts and disputes. Against this background, this important study examines the history and present of international law. (Source: Text Verlagseinband / Verlag)
content.title_en: International law and international politics

content.text: In his new novel Rainer Merkel tells scenes of an extinguishing love. A man has to go to the airport. He has to hurry, but his memories stop him. Here in New York he met his long-time girlfriend again. One last time. In ever new runs his thoughts circle around the center of the catastrophe. He remembers the dramatic events of the last months. A journey through California, which ends in the middle of the desert in a nameless hotel. In memory this night appears grim and overexposed, and the search for truth becomes a sexual confession, a confession without a listener, a monologue without an audience. Shortly before his return flight he suddenly realizes that there would have been a possibility of salvation. "What remains of the nights that one spends together? I have to calculate back. Night after night. In a systematic memory work, and when one goes through everything again, perhaps the decisive moment, the moment, the moment, the moment, after which I already seek all the time, is found."
content.title_en: Light years away : Roman

content.text: The labyrinthic: the idea of the hidden, mysterious, difficult in the history of architecture. The labyrinthic is an architectural quality that rarely reaches the realm of theory and history of architecture. Amazing, for there exists an entire world of the hidden, enigmatic and difficult, which eludes conceptual access, but which is just as lastingly shaped and important to us as those we see through. In his work, which was first published in 1987, which has long been out of print and now re-accessible, Jan Pieper repeatedly draws on testimonies of the labyrinthic from foreign cultures, in which the anthropological foundations of the labyrinthic often gain sharper contours than in the familiar phenomena of his own culture. His historical, theoretical and culturally comparable investigations take their origin from the chiffren-like labyrinth figure. But the focus is on the variety of labyrinthic ideas, which always resonate in architectural interpretations, gestures and associations of the significant building. Jan Pieper's wonderful work in the sense of word opens up the ideas and the expressions of the conscious order of the architecturally enigage.
content.title_en: The Labyrinthic: about the idea of the hidden, mysterious, difficult in the history of architecture

content.text: Automation of regenerative heat and cooling supply of buildings : components, systems, plant examples. It is highly likely that both the regenerative heat and cooling generation and automation will develop into central topics of sustainable energy use in the future.This textbook provides a compact overview of regenerative systems for heat and cooling generation. Integration and automation schemes provide a quick overview. The basics for the control behavior of systems for regenerative energy use are also presented. Practical examples show clearly standard solutions for the integration of regenerative energy sources.
content.title_en: Automation of regenerative heating and cooling supply of buildings : components, systems, plant examples

content.text: Offices. "Collection: Offices show the most exciting architectural designs, from single offices to large-scale offices, to office landscapes and business clubs, from small units consisting of two rooms to high-rise buildings with over 100 floors."-
content.title_en: Offices

content.text: The planning game intercommunal traffic development planning in the Munich region: documentation. In densely populated urban regions, where traffic movements are concentrated strongly on one or more centres, traffic integration is particularly intensive and at the same time particularly associated with undesirable side effects. Traffic development planning is an appropriate means of coping with these challenges conceptually. However, this requires close cooperation of all those involved, which is rather rare due to the intensive and complex process design at intercommunal level. In order to approach this new task in a first step, Munich and neighbouring municipalities have agreed to test a cooperative planning process within the framework of a non-binding planning game. The aim was to test planning and coordination processes within the framework of an intercommunal traffic development planning in cooperation with a newly developed regional traffic simulation model. As a result, it was possible to demonstrate that a joint development of objectives, measures and scenarios of traffic development planning by the city centre and surrounding communities is possible in the planning workshop.
content.title_en: Intermunicipal traffic development planning in the Munich region : Documentation

content.text: The concept of free space protection and free space development through spatial planning: the balance sheet, current challenges and methodological and instrumental perspectives. The spatial planning of free space protection has developed over the past 20 to 30 years from conservation conservation to multifunctional resource management. Today, regional and regional planning has an extremely differentiated toolbox for regional free space protection, whose effectiveness and relevance is beyond question. However, new challenges are visible for the future due to the foreseeable shortage of landscape resources that raise questions of further development of free space protection. Above all, the expansive area claims of biomass production and other regenerative energies as well as nature conservation with its conception of regional and supraregional habitat composite systems. Moreover, the use of land for settlement and transport purposes also keeps at a high level, which further increases the use conflict potential on the remaining free space areas. Against this background, this collection group pursues two objectives. One of the three East German federal states, Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia, is discussing the objective of the regional and regional planning with the aim of presenting regional planning strategies and instruments for the effectiveness of this free space protection.
content.title_en: Free space protection and development through spatial planning : assessment, current challenges and methodological and instrumental perspectives

content.title_en: Food safety : management systems, food machines

content.text: A society in the process of departure: the Federal Republic of Germany in the sixties. Inspired by the sociology of Norbert Elias and his studies of social processes, Hermann Korte writes about the period between the years of reconstruction under Konrad Adenauer and the technocrat-economic consolidation under Helmut Schmidt. His thesis is that the sixties were a period of social change that had a share not only of the so-called '68 movement, but also of large sections of the population.
content.title_en: A society on the rise : the Federal Republic of Germany in the 1960s

content.text: (LK/KA: Nibbrig) Barrier-free construction is defined by the authors as "building for all", as integrative construction for people with and without restrictions. Demographic developments and new legislation such as the Equalization of Disabled Persons Act or the new DIN 18040 "Barrier-free construction" require the general accessibility of buildings and surroundings. The title is addressed to technical planners, architects, interested builders and provides practical basic information on the subject. After an introduction to history, definitions and social development, the main requirements of planning (operational elements, development, stepless accessibility, etc.) are addressed, specific requirements are structured typologically (living, living in old age, public space, working spaces, etc.) and examples of execution. With many basic plans, cross-sections, diagrams, colour photographs, Burbrian/Birthies (Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies) for "Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Birthies/Bilings.Birthies/Birthies/Bilings.Bilings.Biling.Birthies/Birthies/Bilds.Birthies,Birthies,Bild.Bilds,Bilds,Bilds,Bilds,Bilds,Bilings,Birthies,Birthies,Bilds,Biling,Birthies,Bilds,Birth,Birth,Bilds,Bilds,Bild,Bilds,Bilds,Bilds,Bilds,
content.title_en: Barrier-free construction : basics, planning, examples

content.text: Regional economic effects of tourism in German national parks. Description of the editor: National parks primarily pursue conservation objectives. Traditionally they also play a role as destinations of natural tourism. Tourism is a source of many effects, which can be clearly quantified in the economic area at least in part. The present volume therefore tries first, using five case examples, to determine the importance of tourism in national parks in Germany for the respective regional economy. Furthermore, it is estimated by a projection how the situation for national parks is presented throughout Germany. The results show that the tourism associated with national parks makes a considerable economic contribution to the regional economy. This shows, on the one hand, that landscape-related tourism is to be given a greater weight in the regional policy opinion-forming process. On the other hand, the results of the present study provide an important basis for creating a higher acceptance for the local national parks, both in the population and among political and economic decision-makers.
content.title_en: Regional economic effects of tourism in German national parks

content.text: Time management with Microsoft Office Outlook : the time under control with the most used office software ; strategies, tips and techniques (versions 2000 - 2007) ; with additional video lessons on the web. Clearly structured, understandable instructions. Slightly extended reprint should replace previous (BA 2/06), as it explicitly explains the innovations in Outlook 2007. (2) (LK/E: Kardung) Fachbuch für optimal Tages- und Terminplanung, effektöglichhandlung mit E-Mailen und Aufgabenlisten. (LK/E: Kardung)
content.title_en: Time management with Microsoft Office Outlook : time in control with the most used office software ; strategies, tips and techniques (versions 2000 - 2007) ; with additional video lessons on the web

content.text: The invention of the art of measurement: applied mathematics in ancient Greece. A highly interesting treatise on the measurement methods and measuring instruments of antiquity. The engineer and geodeticist Dieter Lelgemann, emeritus professor of astronomical and physical geodesy at the TU Berlin, begins with the beginnings of the measurement art and the natural sciences (Thales of Milet, Anaxismandros, Eleaten and Pythagorean, Aristarchos, Archimedes, Klaudios Ptolemaios ...) and with the resulting reconstruction of the methods. Further, it goes on with the length and angle masses and their connection. A separate chapter is dedicated to the map of Eratosthenes, the last chapter deals with the heliocentric hypothesis of Aristarchos. It is clear that the Greeks' measurement art is mostly oriented to rational methods and deeply practical questions and that the level of their mathematical, mechanical and practical knowledge was much higher then than was initially thought. Fascinating but very academically and demanding (3).
content.title_en: The invention of measuring art : applied mathematics in ancient Greece

content.text: In the legal literature in the German language area, but also within Austria, references and abbreviations are still given differently. The guide is intended to simplify the handling of the basic citific to a large extent. Building on the practice, the national legislation and those of European law are taken into account, as well as the case law as well as the online sources. Numerous examples illustrate the application of the citific to individual cases, and the possibility of illustrating and dissolving doubt cases. The reduction to the essential elements gives the user clear orientation points for coherent handling and thus allows easy access to the cited sources. An innovative instrument for legal science work and the handling of the multitude of relevant material.
content.title_en: leg cit : Guide to legal citation

content.text: Formal models of software development: model checking, verification, analysis and simulation. Software must work to be accepted by customers. But how can one ensure that the control of a spaceship, a pacemaker or a stock management function correctly? In addition to the classic test approaches, formal models are playing an increasingly central role in proof of correctness. A model allows to analyze and simulate any sequential or distributed system. By defining accuracy requirements precisely, one can even verify that the requirements are met. This book presents different formal models with their application possibilities and tools. In doing so, the application of the models is deliberately the focus and not the theory behind them.
content.title_en: Formal models of software development : Model-Checking, Verification, Analysis and Simulation

content.text: Mathematics for engineers : Basics, applications in Maple and C++. The completely revised and greatly extended edition is excellent for self-study. Mathematical basics are very vivid and easy to understand. The author does not use comprehensive evidence. A large number of calculated examples and a comprehensive collection of tasks with solutions allow students to consolidate the material and prepare themselves optimally for the examination. Numerous application examples from technical fields make the use of mathematics transparent in practice. The CD contains: all MAPLE sample files, programs in C++, the powerful C++ compiler OpenWATCOM with graphical development environment, the free C++ compiler Dev-C++, the FEM program SANFEX with examples, freeware mathematics programs and text editors
content.title_en: Mathematics for engineers : Basics, applications in Maple and C++

content.text: "This is above all trivial!": Tips and tricks for formulating mathematical thoughts. What you always wanted to know about the art of formulating mathematical texts, but never dared to ask: What does 'trivial', 'well-defined', 'Korollar', 'unambiguous', 'o. B. d. A.', ...? What are good terms? How to organize a proof? This book helps students of mathematics with many examples and concrete advices in formulating mathematical exercises, seminar papers and exams.
content.title_en: "This is above all trivial!" : Tips and tricks for formulating mathematical thoughts

content.text: Network economics case studies. Networks play a central role in many economic sectors. Important services such as water, electricity, gas, transport, telecommunications and post are brought to consumers via network infrastructures. The application of network economics concepts to concrete issues requires an integrated approach, in which the analysis of entrepreneurial strategies and competition policy objectives are closely linked. This approach is illustrated by eight case studies from the fields of telecommunications, rail and air transport as well as energy supply. The book facilitates access to day-to-day discussions and contributes to a sound assessment of sectoral developments.
content.title_en: Case studies on the network economy

content.text: River Altwasser : Ecology and Remediation. In Central Europe, floodplains are ecosystems threatened by disappearance. Therefore, in recent years, measures have been implemented mainly on the Elbe for revitalization. However, these measures have often been carried out without a thorough scientific preparation and follow-up. This book presents a mission-oriented remediation strategy based on a detailed description of the genesis and ecology of waste water and explains these on the basis of examples. In addition to the ecological and technical aspects, legal and financial aspects are also dealt with.
content.title_en: River Altwasser : Ecology and rehabilitation

content.text: Creation beyond control: how technology uses us. Technological progress is ever faster and unstoppable. Even today we can hardly understand the technology that surrounds us every day. Karl Olsberg, as an expert, asks the right questions: Are we the masters of this development? Are we condemned to be enslaved by our creation in the foreseeable future? He impressively proves: The genesis of technology also follows the evolutionary principle of all life. Quickly, a tremendous thought arises: man as a stirrup holder on the way to the rule of machines. The obsessiveness of Olsberg's representation is captivating and frightening at the same time. Understandably, he sums up theories from Charles Darwin to Richard Dawkins, from Alan Turing, Ray Kurzweil, Stephen J. Gould and many others, and consistently thinks it into the stirring scenario of a future life. Olsberg, however, is no technical enemy, he merely warns of the naivety and self-evaluation of people. At the same time, he shows how we are responsible for our future and our children's acting out of control.
content.title_en: Creation Out of Control: How Technology Uses Us

content.text: Derrida : [Key theses, key concepts, time table, commented bibliography]. Publishing info: Jacques Derrida was always concerned with an ambiguity of meaning, a meaning as mine, saying, wanting to say, which goes beyond a writing of meaning. Each language is thus marked by an inextricable overboard of meaning in an inexhaustible reading. The introduction summarizes the different aspects of metaphysics, language philosophy, psychoanalysis, poetics, aesthetics, media theory, ethics and politics in a comprehensive picture of the thinker Derrida.
content.title_en: Derrida : [Key theses, key concepts, time table, commented Bibliography]

content.text: Where do the richest Germans live? Where is the most invested? Which region has the highest unemployment, which most patent applications? Where in Germany is the best childcare? Where do most foreigners live? Where do most of the foreigners live, from which countries do they come? Which counties have the highest proportion of children? Where does the sun shine the longest? And are the people there actually the happiest? The "Business Atlas Germany" provides answers to these and many other questions. In eight chapters, from work and consumption to resources and innovation to demography and education, all important and up-to-date information about the country and its citizens are bundled in the form of more than 150 four-coloured maps and graphics and broken down by regions. Detlef Gürtler, economist and business consultant, comments on each map in an entertaining and amazing way. The standard work for all those who are informed about economic ties and want to compare "their" region with other regions – or simply like to deepen themselves in maps and discover new things.
content.title_en: Economic Atlas of Germany

content.text: We are not stupid! : The entrepreneurial university. 200 years ago it was founded by illustrious minds like Wilhelm von Humboldt and Friedrich Schleiermacher: the German university idea. And it was a racer, an example, a success model worldwide. Before and after 1900, pilgrims to Germany, who wanted to experience a modern teaching and research university. The much praised US elite universities - today acted as an unmatched model - were designed after German blueprints. With this model is now concluded. Under the pretext of dismissing the universities in freedom and autonomy, the state decrees to them a rabid business fitness program. Precisely and with a keen view, Clemens Knobloch subordinates the Bologna process to an in-depth, biting criticism and comes to the conclusion: In a knowledge society that deserves this name, the university has not to obey the requirements of the economy, which its interest gladly expresses for the general - because it promises the one job and the other profit. As an institution of scientific truth-searching, the university must, on the contrary, make its own autonomous demands on the economy.
content.title_en: We are not stupid! : The entrepreneurial university

content.text: Pipeline systems : Standards on graphic symbols. Contains: DIN 1986-100:2008 ; DIN 2403:2007 ; DIN 2429-1:1988 ; DIN 19227-1:1993 ; DIN 19227-2:1991 ; DIN 28401:2008 ; DIN EN 806-1:2001 ; DIN EN 1861:1998 ; DIN EN 2429-2:1988 ; DIN EN 12792:2004 [rectification 1] ; DIN EN 12792:2004 ; DIN EN ISO 10628:2001 ; DIN ISO 1219-1:2007 ; DIN ISO 1219-2:1996 ; DIN ISO 6412-1:1991 ; DIN ISO 6412-2:1991 ; DIN ISO 6412-3:1994 ; E DIN EN ISO 81714-1:2008 [design]
content.title_en: Pipeline systems : standards on graphic symbols

content.text: Things we said today: Roman. Brisekow, a village in Vorpommern. When the old wife Hanske dies, her daughter Ingrid and her family from Ireland come to the funeral. Ingrid had left Brisekow many years ago in flight. The visit changed many things in the village, raised old and new questions just for the families Ploetz and Wachlowski. The villagers begin to talk about their current life and their entanglements from then. Brisekov was always a small world, narrow, remote and today also threatened by decay.
content.title_en: Things We Said Today : Roman

content.text: Optimization of material flows in municipalities - using the example of gas discharge lamps. Since the entry into force of the Electrical and Electronic Equipment Act, the public-law disposal carriers (örE) bear responsibility for the collection of gas discharge lamps (GEL), e.g. energy saving lamps, from households. However, the total return rate of GEL in Germany amounts to less than 40 percent of the income, the return from households is estimated to be even lower. Due to the so-called "glue lamp ban" initiated by the EU Commission, it is also assumed that the rise in the income of GEL from households is significant. GEL contain mercury which is harmful to the environment and health, therefore there is a particular public interest in increasing the return rate. The question arises which measures the local authorities can increase the return of GEL. Within the scope of a study carried out by the German Institute for Urban Studies, measures to optimise the GEL return were identified and implemented in individual areas of investigation. By implementing the measures there, the volume already achieved recursive increases.
content.title_en: Optimization of material flows in municipalities - using the example of gas discharge lamps

content.text: Small bike technology : competent, compact, easy to understand. Publisher's text: The current state of the art in a compact form with a wealth of facts and backgrounds
content.title_en: Small bike technology : competent, compact, easy to understand

content.text: The new gardener: Design with plants for gardens of the 21st century. Again an impressive text-image-band of the well-known designer duo (lastly "The New Garden", BA 7/08). Similar in structure and layout also here basic thoughts of the authors, individually and in conversation. Decisive for the planning is the question: complete redesign of the garden or only change? In both cases the clear designation of the objective, the structure and the colors, the design with materials, the location of the garden and the influence of the seasons is important. Practical tips, plant directory and detailed register complete the volume, which presents international examples of perfectly designed formal and natural gardens, which come strictly, cool, lush, playful, skillfully wildly or enchanted. Each in its way a pleasure for the eye. Besides "Design with plants" (BA 7/09) and "Garden seduction" (BA 6/09) for a reader circle, which wants more than just a few flowers in the garden. Unfortunately not cheap, but worth its price. (2) (Ingrid bishop) formally arranges for pleasures, luxuriably.
content.title_en: The new gardening : Design with plants for gardens of the 21st century

content.text: Royston Maldoom : Community Dance - Everyone can dance; the practical book. British choreographer and dance teacher Royston Maldoom, not least known from the successful feature film "Rhythm Is It!?" (2004), represents the philosophy that every person can dance, regardless of origin, age, gender or physical personality. His community dance projects, such as those with street children from Addis Ababa, Hamburger welfare recipients or Berlin pupils, demonstrate in a very impressive way how much the desire to dance can change a whole life and give it a new meaning. This book presents Maldoom's approach step by step and helps interested choreographers, dance teachers and teachers to master the entry into the world of community dance, whether artistic or educational.
content.title_en: Royston Maldoom : Community Dance - Everyone can dance ; the practical book

content.text: The concept of the »Knowledge Society« is extremely successful and has found its way into political, economic, scientific and mass media discourses. This textbook provides an overview of the central theories and the most important topics of current popular time diagnosis. It addresses students and experts in the fields of humanities and social sciences. With contributions from renowned experts, the book enables a comprehensive understanding of social transformation processes of the present and offers a systematic orientation and interdisciplinary connection points as well as a critical analysis of the explanatory power of diagnosis.
content.title_en: Knowledge Society Manual : Theories, Topics and Problems

content.text: The work's starting point is generalized depictions of migrants and their cultures of origin, usually described as backward, with which social inequalities are legitimized, among other things, as well as the assumption that so-called parallel societies are formed in public. Migrants from different cultures of origin have taken photographs for the work. So-called photo interviews were conducted to their pictures, in which the photographers explain their own images. The central focus of the work is an exemplary photo, which is called "expression".
content.title_en: Identity formations of older migrants: photography as a means of expression and source of knowledge

content.text: Atom: the history of the nuclear age. Science journalist Stephanie Cooke, who has known the Metier for over 30 years and who has also had the appropriate internal vision as a member of numerous bodies, overcomes the challenge of a history of almost 70 years of nuclear energy research and use with detailed knowledge, thought out and with a proper portion of skepticism. The final storage question for radioactive nuclear waste is still not solved worldwide, tens of thousands of nuclear warheads still threaten humanity and not a single nuclear power plant anywhere on the globe corresponds to the usual safety requirements. The stereotyped formula of the supposedly clean bridge technology in the fight against climate change speaks the word of a nuclear renaissance and serves only to upgrade so many states with fisssile, weapons-capable material. This book should be explained to the mandatory reading of all functionaries in politics, military and energy economics, then certainly many decisions are made differently. Well written, with exemplary apparatus of note. Suitable for the gymnasial upper level. (2 S) (Claudia Niebel) Atomzeitschieführt von Geschichtigeszeitschieuden von Robert Othien.
content.title_en: Atom : the history of the nuclear age

content.text: We all stay! : Gentrification - urban conflicts for appreciation and displacement. Gentrification, the valorization of previously inexpensive residential areas, has developed into a constant companion of urban changes and stands for the neoliberal version of capitalist urbanization. Renovated houses and new commercial uses not only represent a change of the city, but above all for rising housing costs, the displacement of economically disadvantaged and the enforcement of new social structures in the affected districts. Worldwide these real estate appreciation strategies trigger protests and resistance of the previous residents. We stay all! The right to stay is a central requirement of many urban initiatives. International examples are also used to illustrate the backgrounds and effects of urban appreciation dynamics, as well as the strategies of urban movements and anti-gentrification mobilizations.
content.title_en: We all stay! : Gentrification - urban conflicts for upgrading and displacement

content.text: As mathematicians tick: ingenious minds - their world of thought and their greatest insights. Whoever lets himself be tempted by the title to expect Burleskes is mistaken. With occasional reviews up to the antiquity, the author, a recognized scientist, conveys a rich but generally understandable insight into the thinking and methods of mathematics of the last century, from the logical fundamental discussions to the structural considerations to newly created disciplines. In a colorful subject he brings together biographical, often vividly through the personal reference, very little formulae, philosophical illuminations and again and again essential mathematical thoughts. One can be contemplating one's joy in the beauty of mathematics and at the same time share the ridicule about the elite walk of many of its actors. The reader looks at the working researcher's day-to-day business over the shoulders and feels his emotions. If one does not agree with individual statements, this is only an additional stimulus. Highly recommended for all diverse interested parties. (3)
content.title_en: How mathematicians tick : ingenious minds - their world of thought and their greatest findings

content.text: Style history of art : a holistic method. Style is an expression of social change and thus symbol of historical, social, cultural, artistic and intellectual content. Franz Neckenig brings history, society, culture and art together in a holistic method
content.title_en: Style History of Art : a holistic method

content.text: Architecture. Forgotten: Jewish architects in Graz. "Five Graz buildings from the period 1910 to 1934 represent the starting point for the view of forgetting as cultural practice in the field of architecture. The authors identify a field of tension between everyday processes of superstructure, functional change and spatial reconception as well as violent interventions such as political recoding and destruction. Using the example of employment office, outdoor swimming pool, Jewish ceremonial hall, children's home and suburban settlement, multi-layered dimensions of forgetting are exposed: random, intentional, private, public, non-told, invisible. The brackets that hold the four arch-kitects and builders together are not made up of their Jewish origin or identity, but only of the National Socialist history of persecution as an aspect of forgetting."--back cover
content.title_en: Architecture. Forgotten : Jewish architects in Graz

content.text: Violence in school. How does violence develop in school? And what is a successful prevention? International empirical research on aggression and violence has made important contributions to these central questions of school practice. It shows that violence has many causes: violence potential is carried into school from the outside by family, milieu and media. But violence is also caused by the school itself. Personal factors - from teacher behaviour to bullying by classmates - are worse than structural and organizational. Aggressive arousal and harmful behaviours often arise without intention - nobody wants to harm others specifically, and yet the envy, greed after recognition, the elbow mentality, flourishes. Students, teachers and parents are asked to develop a peaceful style of dealing with each other. With the application of a few anti-violence programs, it is not done: the whole school life is a peaceful transformation.
content.title_en: Violence in school

content.text: Architects' services - Construction contract - Construction management - Project management. The textbook deals with the basics of the construction contract and the construction management. These topics are increasingly playing a role in the new architectural courses and are of vital importance for professional beginners, because they are primarily concerned with construction management and organization. Warranty, deadlines, acceptances, remuneration are treated as well as questions of project organization, errors and complications, security and quality assurance.The present UTB complements the volumes Architects' services – costs and law (UTB 8353) and tendering and award (UTB 8400).The three books together offer a complete overview of the spectrum of architectural services.
content.title_en: Architect services - Construction contract - Construction management - Project management

content.text: Border Sociology: the political structuring of space. Territorial borders and their effects are not only an important topic of social science research recently. Nevertheless, sociology remains a fundamental question of both the origin and the effect of borders and border draw. The present volume responds to this deficit and answers the question of the specific significance of borders for sociology on the basis of both classical sociological theoretical approaches and recent theoretical considerations and empirical studies. The contributions deal with the emergence, function and change of state borders and with the factors that cause the transformation of state borders and their meaning and finally with the question of the social consequences of borders. The volume aims to identify a new sociological topic area and introduce it into border sociology. Professor Dr. Georg Vobruba and Dr. Monika Eigmüller work at the Institute for Sociology at Leipzig University.
content.title_en: Border Sociology : the Political Structuring of Space

content.text: Innovations for journalism. Anyone who wants to be successful in the media world of tomorrow as a journalist must be able to use the possibilities of the Internet as well as new concepts of media management in a sovereign manner. This textbook provides prospective journalists, but also interested practitioners with a comprehensive and up-to-date overview of how innovations in editorial practice sustainably change journalism: What new tasks do journalists have to cope with in newsrooms? How do trendsetters in the media area address their target groups? And what new opportunities arise from computer-assisted reporting (CAR)? Based on international case studies and selected studies, the band analyses how innovations will shape journalism in the future. Dr. Susanne Fengler is Professor of International Journalism at the Technical University of Dortmund and Scientific Director of the Erich-Brost Institute for Journalism in Europe. Dr. Sonja Kretzschmar is a research associate at the Institute for Communication Science at the Westfälische Wilhelms-Universität Münster.
content.title_en: Innovations for journalism

content.text: The empathetic civilization: ways to a global consciousness. Presentation of developmental psychology, biological, technological history, social, economic and other scientific works, only and solely to support the thesis that empathy (appendage) is designed in man and the primates and leads to a more global and ecological consciousness. The content presented can be better understood in specific specialist books, the thesis is merely illustrated, not proven, since Rifkin (lastly "The European Dream", BA 11/04) does not even care about the counter-concepts of egoism, competition and conflict. Who is surprised if the utopia on which the thesis is directed includes only 7 pages? (Jürgen Plieninger) Rifkin's thesis of a fundamentally existing approach to human beings is countering the global dangers of modern civilization and tries to prove this by means of the paper on scientific works in the fields of psychology, history and technology. (Jürgen Plieninger)
content.title_en: Empathic Civilization: Ways to a Global Consciousness

content.text: At the end of the fairy tale hour, how industry took over LOHAS and lifestyle ecos. In the past, social events and revolts shaped a generation. This changed at the latest in the 1990s: the adolescents no longer took their identity from collective protest experiences, but from the consumption of brands. Therefore, the public desire no longer aims at a better world, but at better products. Social movements have become mere style communities. The most important of these is that of Lohas. They believe that they can combine hedonism and morality, egoism and social change: in the political act of the right shopping. No wonder that more and more people become Lohas.
content.title_en: End of the fairy tale hour: how the industry acquired LOHAS and lifestyle eco

content.text: Common Wealth: the end of property. In the current crisis, the social discomfort of capitalism is growing. Many people are now asking for a more humane alternative to living together. A society beyond maxims such as profit, competition and ownership - is that possible? Michael Hardt and Antonio Negri, authors of the bestseller "Empire", develop a provocatively optimistic social design in their new great work. This is no longer based on the neoliberal contrast of private property and public property, but on the idea of the common. Resources such as water, air and plants and intangible goods such as knowledge and information belong to us all. If we share them, the path becomes free for a more just society where everyone can participate. In the dispute over the political profile of the 21st century, the authors offer a central counterweight to all those who want to make us aware that the current political and economic form is the only possible.
content.title_en: Common Wealth : the end of property

content.text: The gardens and parks in Lower Saxony. Lower Saxony is one of the regions in which the European garden art of the last centuries can be relived in many plants in a particularly vivid way. In the ensembles of the large residences, for example, in Braunschweig, Celle, Wolfenbüttel, Oldenburg and world-famous in Hanover-Herrenhausen; in the rather smaller refuges, the summer seats, hunting lodges; or in the extremely numerous country estates of the established aristocracy. Jens Beck, a proven expert on the subject, and Karl Johaengges, a multi-award-winning photographer, have embarked on a long journey through small and large paradises. Have supposedly seen something new in a surprising way and at the same time look at places that have not been or hardly noticed so far: the large cemeteries for example with their old tree holdings, the official, parish and monastery gardens, which sometimes have Mediterranean-like cures, gardens of manufacturers and artists, or even the latest creations, such as in the car town of Wolfsburg or on the Expo site in Hanover.
content.title_en: Gardens and parks in Lower Saxony

While the former President of the Wuppertal Institute for Climate, Environment and Energy offered a concentrated introduction to "Renewable Energies" (BA 12/07), he now expands his perspective on the global problems of energy supply in the coming decades. content.text: The author examines this question at various levels - the political class, the military elite and civil society.- The use of the German armed forces in Afghanistan is becoming increasingly critical. According to author Klaus Naumann, he is exemplary of the structural problems of German security and defence policy: "In the case of Afghanistan, claims and reality, goal formulation and implementation, concepts of action and government practice are becoming increasingly different." The response to new requirements to the German armed forces often involves improvising and without any recognizable strategy. Naumann's analysis does not limit himself to identifying deficits on the political, military and social levels. He also shows how the conditions for a realignment of the security and defence policy in Germany could look like.
content.title_en: The need for military policy

content.text: Computer architecture : Modeling, development and verification with Verilog. Main description: The book is based on the idea that the design of digital circuits is ideally done using a hardware description language. This allows the reader to immediately understand the theoretical content conveyed, but also shows how these concepts can be realized using the Verilog hardware description language. Verilog's necessary designs are also presented, allowing the reader to immediately understand the theoretical content conveyed. The book begins with the description of a simple RISC processor. Subsequently, the hardware aspects of the required computing systems and sequential circuits are presented and modeled with Verilog before a complete CPU is designed. Finally, a description of the initially presented RISC processor is presented at gate level. The following chapters deal with more complex computer systems. CISC processors and more powerful assemblers such as JAVA bytecode and microassembler for the interpretation of the computer commands of the CISC machine are presented and modeled with Verilog. The required constructs of Veri Log are introduced to the Recilog in the book75.

Main description: This book deals with the conceptual, constructive and design questions of the realization of user- and application-oriented interactive computer systems. Building on the volume of software ergonomics, which deals with theories, models and criteria of interactive systems analytically, this second one now takes up the basics and deals with concepts, architectures and building blocks that are essential for the construction of multimedia interactive systems. Interaction design models and forms the basis of a subsequent implementation. It is a task for computer scientists and designers due to its abstraction of certain technologies. This creates a productive connection that translates the conceivable into the feasible. Interaction design builds the difficult bridge from analysis to implementation without defining the implementation. The difficult aspect of aesthetics is not excluded, but is considered from the basic human potential for synaesthetic perception, regardless of design schools and design styles.

content.text: Luhmann-Lektüren. How hardly any other intellectual of the 20th century has moved the minds, excited, provoked, surprised, irritated, in short: he was always an exceptional source of intellectual energy and is this 10 years after his death even today. Four also outstanding intellectuals have approached the work and the person Niklas Luhmann in Freiburg lectures. Peter Sloterdijk considers Luhmann's innocentism under the heading: ?The Advocate of the Devil?, Dirk Baecker considers ?Niklas Luhmann and the Managers?, Peter Fuchs examines the ?metapher of the system? and Hans-Ulrich Gumbrecht shows Luhmann as the master of the anti-intuitive aphorism and his relationship to Alteuropa
content.title_en: Luhmann readings

content.text: Environmentally-friendly life cycles: Environmentally-oriented business processes are being aligned; a guide to ecological lifecycle management. Climate change is becoming more reality than feared, natural resources are dwindling at a rapid pace, and infectious diseases are increasing worldwide. Environmental protection is no longer a trend, but a global societal challenge – and thus a competitive advantage for ambitious companies. Products with a future need to be socially and ecologically compatible. Small and medium-sized companies in particular can react more flexibly and concretely to changing wishes of the national and international market. Lifecycle management helps them: The concept of business management structures the life cycle of a product from its development and market maturity to its disappearance from the market. This will achieve quality standards faster, costs manageable and production times optimized. Ecological lifecycle management is a particularly innovative variant. This further development aligns the business processes of a company along the product life cycle ecologically, protects resources and energy, thus often even reduces costs, while the market value of the company and its products vis-à-vis competitors increases noticeably. Carolin Sültmann offers a practical guide to the implementation of ecological lifecycle management in the company.
content.title_en: Environmentally-friendly life cycles : ecologically oriented business processes; a guide to ecological lifecycle management

content.text: Key works of constructivism. It is the central assumption of all constructivist approaches that we are caught in recognizing that access to an absolute truth is impossible, must be impossible. In this book, starting from precursors and central reference theories of philosophy history, the various theoretical strands of constructivism are described, which originate from the natural sciences, the humanities and the social sciences. The spectrum ranges from the classics of philosophy history to the philosophy of language and sociology of knowledge to the theory of autopoiesis and modern brain research. In compact, easy-to-read articles, written by leading experts from Germany and abroad, the key works of constructivism and the possibilities of research and practice-related application are presented in different disciplines and fields of work (including media and literature, education, psychology, organizational consulting, social work).
content.title_en: Key Works of Constructivism

Unzicker proves to be a critical thinker here, who many of the newer theories on space and time, dark matter and dark energy, to string theory, to the Big Bang, to cosmic background radiation and to multiverses. Although we have extraordinary possibilities of observation today, many problems are easily reversed in the field of theory. So he ununderstandably enters a formula for reading of the basic physics.
content.title_en: From Big Bang to Big Bang: the absurd hunt for the world formula

content.text: The political economy of the EU decision-making process: models and applications. This book uses policy-based theories to investigate the decision-making process within the European Union. The relevance and methodology of different theories are explained in the analysis of the EU's political system, and the prognosis of the hypotheses derived from these theories is empirically examined. The book provides an insight into the EU legislative process and the internal decision-making structures of the European Commission, the Council of Ministers, the European Parliament and the European Central Bank. The book uses policy-based theories to examine the decision-making process within the European Union. The book explains the relevance and methodology of different theories in analysing the EU's political system, and empirically examines the prognosis of the hypotheses derived from these theories. content.text: Introduction to computer-based analysis of qualitative data. The social-scientific analysis of qualitative data, the text and content analysis can be carried out very effectively with the support of computer programs. The use of QDA software promises more efficiency and transparency of analysis. This book provides an overview of these new working techniques, discusses the underlying methodological concepts (including the Grounded Theory and Qualitative Content Analysis) and provides practical guidance on implementation.

content.text: CSR Education : Corporate Social Responsibility as an educational task in school, university and further education. The collection volume 'CSR Education' shows a selection of different practical examples in addition to a theoretical discussion on this topic. This is the aim of raising awareness of such initiatives and promoting the debate on CSR Education in various fields of application. The collection volume is not limited to one level of education, but combines different educational institutions and levels. It is divided into three major educational areas: school, university and further education. In this way, an interinstitutional insight as well as an exchange of experience across the own educational area is possible. The area of school comprises general education schools and vocational schools, the area of university includes universities and colleges of applied sciences, business schools and other academic institutions. The chapter on continuing education deals with CSR in continuing vocational training, personnel and organizational development.
content.title_en: CSR Education : Corporate Social Responsibility as an educational task in school, university and further education

content.text: Precautionary principle and fear of risk: For the perception of the risk of mobile communications. New technologies, whose risk potentials are still in the dark, often trigger fears and fears. Is the precautionary principle suitable for dealing with this? This book deals with this question. Based on empirical research, it is shown that preventive risk management must reject all ideological longings. Only evidence-based information and communication strategies provide a viable approach to avoid fatal errors. Prof. Dr. Peter Wiedemann works at Forschungszentrum Jülich on problems of risk assessment and risk communication of new technologies. New technologies, whose risk potentials are still in the dark, often trigger fears and fears. Is the precautionary principle suitable for dealing with these issues? This book deals with this question. Based on empirical research, it is shown that preventive risk management must reject all ideological longings.
content.title_en: Precautionary principle and risk fears : The perception of mobile communications

For the housing typology, the authors have developed new, systematic representations of the most innovative types. In the individual volumes the application and transformation possibilities of a particular residential construction form are developed. The first volume deals with the types of the courtyard house, which use the courtyard as an intimate exterior space of living. A presentation of the courtyard as a city building stone follows a comprehensive range of types: clusters, net, carpet, hofriette, terraces etc. The second volume deals with the types of the terraced house, a particularly widely used residential form. The cross-disciplinary discussion of the principle series - series as urban building block, linear space and corner solutions, etc. - follows the systematic representation of the different types. content.text: Europe - quo vadis? : selected problem areas of European integration policy. This volume examines selected problem areas of European integration policy: In addition to the political and institutional perspectives of the European Union between deepening and enlargement, the volume deals with the global economic crisis and the perspectives of European economic and social policy. Further chapters deal with the dimensions and perspectives of mobility, in particular labour and flight migration, as well as the current challenges of European right-wing populism and right-wing extremism.

content.text: Renewable (alternative) energies : real future of energy supply, including nuclear energy. The limits of the individual energy sources (fossil, regenerative and nuclear) are discussed on the basis of comprehensible, reliable sources (with indication).

content.text: Migration and integration research in the discussion: Biography, language and education as central reference points. Immigration leaves its traces in the structure of the population: The resulting social heterogeneity - the diversity of languages, religions and cultures - also poses new challenges to the social sciences. The volume approaches the topics of migration and integration from an interdisciplinary perspective. The contributions from political science, sociology, pedagogy and linguistics group around the central social science categories biography, language and education. The eleven authors of this volume present results of qualitative and quantitative studies, many of which are based on their own empirical surveys. Other contributions systematize already existing empirical studies and proceed secondary-analytically. The perspectives of the actors are taken into account in the essays as well as the framework conditions leading to exclusion and discrimination.
content.title_en: Migration and Integration Research in the Discussion : Biography, Language and Education as Central Points of Reference

content.text: More courage to start over. The worst seems to have been endured in the economic and financial crisis. After crisis management, the new federal government is now facing fundamental challenges in important areas of economic policy. To address these challenges, medium to long-term strategies are needed, which must be designed in line with the market. In this study, the Kronberg Circle shows solutions for four areas where there is a particularly urgent need for reform: strengthening banking and financial supervision, the tax system (with regard to income and compensation taxes), the health care system (with regard to health allowances in statutory health insurance and retirement provisions in private health insurance) and the promotion of renewable energies. In summary, the Kronberger Circle recommends: More courage to start over!
content.title_en: More courage to start over

His long-standing work as a translator and author for O-Reilly Verlag (among other things on Java and other enterprise computing technologies) supports him in the field of German language and to combine her professional and technical interests.

The author (company and PR advisor) deals with the "ear close to the customer" and never superficially the current platforms - 2 years ago would probably have been still second life, who remembers? - all the more important: The author is at the height of the time, writes comprehensible and comprehensible social media and social networks revolutionizing media and marketing. With the survey of the PR leaders, the new public relations and the business executives have to apply the new PR tools of communication.
content.title_en: Social Media Relations : Guide to successful PR strategies and public relations in Web 2.0

content.text: The impact of Health Check and the EU Economic Programme on the rural development programmes of the German Länder. As a result of the Health Check of the Common Agricultural Policy and the European Economic Recovery Programme, the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development (EAFRD) has been increased to take appropriate measures to respond to the new challenges (climate change, renewable energies, water management, biodiversity, restructuring of the dairy sector). This report analyses the changes that the German Länder made in 2009 in their rural development programmes. The analysis shows the great difference between the formal allocation of these additional funds to measures according to the priorities of Health Check and the actual distribution of funds in the programmes. The total shift from free resources to other measures leads to a strengthening of measures that primarily support income from agricultural holdings and are hardly linked to demanding conditions of additional environmental services in agriculture (source: Verlag).
content.title_en: Impact of Health Check and EU Economic Programme on the rural development programmes of the German Länder

content.text: Welfare states in comparison : Social security in Europe: Organization, financing, benefits and problems ; [lecture]. The Tübingen University teacher presents his compendium for the comparison of the Western European welfare states now in the scope significantly extended in 3rd edition with the status of autumn 2009 (last ID 24/96). The basis of the first edition of 1996 was a research project initiated by the Hans-Böckler-Stiftung. The revised text follows again the clear and streamlined structure in 4 large sections, namely: Methodology and introduction, presentation of country profiles, international comparison of the classical fields of action of social security and current problems and solution models. Finally an outlook with conclusions for Germany. Refined research results, new literature and many new links make according to the preface necessary a revision, which should be offered in larger stocks. New addition is a section on education policy. Unfortunately, J. Plieninger on the 1st edition, "written in social science jargon", which restricts the target group. M.E. nevertheless well understandable, in no way sociologically quast. (3)
content.title_en: Welfare States in comparison : Social protection in Europe: organisation, financing, benefits and problems ; [lecture]

content.text: Success strategies in health tourism : Analysis to the expectations and satisfaction of guests. The citizens' participation in medical prevention will continue to grow with regard to the German health system and the increasing life expectancy. This opens up new market opportunities for you as a provider in tourism. But how can you use them in practice? And how do guests imagine their health holiday at all? Answers give you Monika Rulle, Wolfgang Hoffmann and Karin Kraft with this book: - You will get to know the needs of health tourists: travel motives, expectations, willingness to pay ... ; - You will get many suggestions for the development of innovative offers: spa tourism, medical wellness ... ; - You will learn how to reduce seasonal dependencies with the help of health tourism. The book contains the results of the first comprehensive study on health tourism! Know-how, with which you generate growth and avoid misinvestments safely!
content.title_en: Success strategies in health tourism : Analysis to the expectations and satisfaction of guests

content.text: Globally fair: fighting climate change, enabling development; a report by the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research and the Institute for Social Policy Munich. Current literature on the threats to climate change and the topic of "poverty/development" fills many shelves. Both problems are rightly seen together here, because they are the policy areas that are at the heart of our world's sustainability. This study is about how poverty reduction and climate protection can be combined in an overall concept. Because while countries that have contributed least to climate change depend on strong economic growth for their development, this tends to lead to higher emissions, as can be seen from the example of industrialisation and prosperity of the rich countries. In this field of tension of the goals of climate protection and development, the concept of a global deal is outlined here, with key points for a two-objectives-oriented policy. The important but very theoretically argumenting study is a contribution to the discussion in larger specialized stocks. (3)
content.title_en: Globally fair: fighting climate change, enabling development; a report from the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research and the Institute for Social Policy Munich

content.text: Living Rhine-Auen : Nature, culture and life on the northern Upper Rhine. The meadows on the Rhine with their unique fauna and flora are described. Also their important role in flood protection on the northern Upper Rhine.
content.title_en: Living Rhine-Auen : Nature, Culture and Life on the Northern Upper Rhine

content.text: Luck: the perspective of economics. Luck research is no longer a topic "only" among philosophers, psychologists and neurobiologists. Economists are also concerned today with the question of what makes us people really happy and expand the standard economy in a revolutionary way with their research work. Especially in today's crisis-ridden times, their analyses and conclusions for opinion makers and decision-makers from the economy, politics, administration and for the interested layman are of great interest. Bruno S. Frey conducts research on topics that the economists rarely deal with: politics, family, art and happiness. He often comes to astonishing results and deep insights into the human constitution. According to the "Handelsblatt Economien-Ranking VWL 2008" Bruno S. Frey takes the first place; he is the most research-strongest economist in the German-speaking world with his life work. (Source: www.buchkatalog.de 26.03.2010)
content.title_en: Happiness : the view of economics

content.text: Shell programming: [the comprehensive manual; introduction, practice, reference; Bourne, Korn and Bourne-Again shell (Bash)]; including grep, sed and awk, GUIs with Tcl/Tk; CD-ROM with openbooks for Linux and C]. A minor revision of the comprehensive manual for ambitious users (for the first time the 2nd edition: ID 21/08 was displayed here), which also refers to possibilities under MacOS and Windows. Script programming on the command line is one of the basic capabilities of an administrator of UNIX/Linux systems. The basic teaching and reference work with numerous practical examples focuses on the standards Bourne, Korn and Bourne-Again shell and offers users with Linux basic knowledge of a competent overall overview of shell programming, which also covers the help components grep, sed and awk. The changes are - also compared to the initial edition 2005 - only marginally so that the title of the first edition can be recommended by ABA (in addition to the extensive version of the AID).
content.title_en: Shell programming : [the comprehensive manual ; introduction, practice, reference ; Bourne, grain and Bourne-Again shell (Bash) ; incl. grep, sed and awk, GUIs with Tcl/Tk ; CD-ROM with openbooks to Linux and C]

content.text: Guide Heating : with stored solar energy and heat pump technology ; a guide for cost-effective and environmentally conscious heating in new and old buildings ; [Heating without oil and gas]. Publisher: The RATGEBER HEIZEN is the first book exclusively for building families and home owners. The authors deliberately refrained from complicated, technical descriptions or physical explanations. They do not want to give construction or planning instructions, but to show how to reduce the consumption costs by up to 50 percent and at the same time relieve the environment
content.title_en: Guide Heating : with solar energy stored and heat pump technology ; a guide for cost-effective and environmentally conscious heating in new and old buildings ; [Heating without oil and gas]

content.text: Climate shock: causes, effects, forecasts. What is really about global warming? What will happen when the polar caps melt? Will we have to fight with floods and natural disasters or enjoy Mediterranean temperatures in Central Europe? Climate shock provides all current knowledge on climate and climate change for the first time competently and comprehensively. The presentation ranges from the history of climate in prehistoric and historical times to current climate research, its methods, possibilities and limits, and even short and medium-term and realistic future scenarios for the people in the affected countries. Visually, many graphics, graphs and maps convey the latest state of the art research. Climate shock is an excellently researched and profound compendium and reference work that mediates between the existing positions by showing the state of knowledge of our time and by explaining the great problems of the future in an understandable way.
content.title_en: Climate shock : causes, effects, forecasts

content.text: Design, design and implement web pages; over 9 hours of web design know-how and effective Photoshop tricks from the web expert; DVD-ROM for Windows and Mac. Hellwig succeeds in a very good connection between theory and practice: first formal construction of web pages and navigation, controlled adaptation to different screen sizes and user interfaces (PC, mobile devices often without mouse and keyboard), possibility of later changes. Then: Web typography, implementation of a design using HTML and CSS, special techniques in Photoshop (text effects, button patterns, animations etc.), suitable file formats, image compression and loading times, generation of standardized and optimized codes for export (Photoshop also provides only suboptimal results in the current version), hints on supporting tools and web pages. On the subject of last: Nils Manuel Mora (ID-B 3/11) and "Power Workshops Webdesign mit Photoshop" (BA 9/10) - for comparison. For users with knowledge of Photoshop, also HTML and CSS. Example files, Photoshop test version finished on the topic of the user interface.
content.title_en: Web design with Photoshop : Website design, design and implement; over 9 hours web design know-how and effective Photoshop tricks from the web expert; DVD-ROM for Windows and Mac

content.text: Green new deal, sufficiency or ecosocialism? : Concepts for social paths from the eco-crisis. Green New Deal or eco-socialism, subsistence or sufficiency? The approaches for the social ecological transformation of society are as numerous as different. The book presents the most important ones and offers an orientation aid in the jungle of discourses
content.title_en: Green new deal, sufficiency or ecosocialism? : Concepts for social ways out of the eco-crisis

content.text: Allergen Management : Solutions for food production ; Practical Guide. Brief overview: The second edition of the practical guide Allergen Management is here. In the practical and easy to understand work all important information on allergen themes are compiled. The focus is on the numerous examples from practice. In addition to a short presentation of the scientific background, you will receive an updated, clear list of the legal framework conditions. (Source: www.behrs.de 20.04.2011)
content.title_en: Allergen management : approaches to food production ; practical guide

content.text: Urbanization, architecture : the 20th century. A compendium illustrated with numerous pictures on the history of architecture and urbanization in the 20th century. Essays on styles, buildings, gardens and parks. The work offers an exciting documentation on the interaction between man, time and architecture.
content.title_en: Urbanization, architecture : the 20th century

content.text: The social structure of Germany in an international comparison. The social structures of European countries are presented in detail empirically and interpreted and compared with a uniform modernisation-theoretical grid.
content.title_en: The social structure of Germany in an international comparison

content.text: Science & Technology: the illustrated history of the world; [the fascinating history of sciences - from the invention of the wheel to nanotechnology]. Review: A thick, well illustrated overview of the history of scientific progress (mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, geosciences, astronomy, medicine) from the early days to the present day. The breakdown takes place chronologically and divides the described period into the epochs of the beginnings of science, renaissance and enlightenment, industrial revolution, atomic age (1890-1970) and information ages. Within the chapters, mostly on double pages, individual topics such as the periodic system, chaos theory, rocket drives, breakthroughs such as the moon landing or persons such as Newton, Aristotle, etc. Interesting are the boxes "earlier" and "laters", which briefly inform about the previous history/further development of a described topic. Further research life, "breakthroughs" (e.g. the experiments of Pawlow), inventions or practical examples are described in addition to the flow text in text boxes. In the appendix, important data, formulas and tables are also available in German.
content.title_en: Science & Technology : the illustrated history of the world; [the fascinating history of science - from the invention of the wheel to nanotechnology]

content.text: Food product for beginners. How are milk, meat and eggs assembled? How healthy is fish? What are functional foods? The textbook provides comprehensive answers to these and other questions. It covers the entire area of food of plant and animal origin and is divided into product groups. The authors focus in particular on the composition of food as well as the assessment from a nutritional, health and toxicological point of view. With many illustrations and the latest data from the National Food Study.
content.title_en: Food goods customer for beginners

content.text: Treasures of the Earth: the fascinating world of raw materials. Non-fiction book on the origin, occurrence, structure of the deposits, extraction and exploitation of raw materials. (Olaf Kaptein) Origin, occurrence, structure of the deposits, mining and exploitation of raw materials are the subject of this non-fiction book, which is equipped with layer diagrams, infographics, photos and maps. The chapters of the book were roughly broken down by energy suppliers, metals, salts, etc. Neither the most important raw material for life on earth, water, nor the former geology professor passes over rare metals such as tantalum or valuable minerals such as diamonds. But this title is particularly important for the library due to its extensive contributions to coal, petroleum, iron ore, and mineral water, which often give topics for school orders. So far, there has been a real gap in the newer generally understandable material literature that can be closed with this volume. Therefore, despite the price, it is highly recommended. (1 S) (Olaf Kaptein)
content.title_en: Treasures of the Earth : the fascinating world of raw materials
