content.text: The Ultras: Football fans and football cultures in Germany. With the Ultras a new fan culture has established itself in football. Also in the media it appears more and more. However, with negative headlines about violence or other rule-injury. Jonas Gabler draws a different picture of this movement. He explains its typical characteristics: The new form to support the respective team; the intensive group life; the special rules and codes; the commitment against the progressive commercialization of football. Gabler also shows the positive effect of the Ultras in Germany when pushing right-wing extremist and racist actions back into the stadiums. In relation to violence, his verdict is not so clear. He proves the ambivalent relationship of the Ultras to the use of violence and shows that this problem has become increasingly acute. However, can the countermeasures of the associations and the police expect improvement? Thus he refers to another characteristic of the ultra movement: their organized protest against repression
content.title_en: The Ultras : Football fans and football cultures in Germany

content.text: Basic course on statistics for politicalologists and sociologists. This textbook is aimed at students in the basic course on political science, sociology and neighbouring disciplines. The basics of empirical social research, descriptive and closing statistics are explained in a comprehensible way using numerous examples. Tables, illustrations and cross references as well as a detailed register underline the textbook character. In addition, the authors offer further materials and information through online support. This introduction has been revised for the 5th edition. Uwe Gehring is a political scientist and IT consultant. Cornelia Weins is a sociologist at the University of Trier.
content.title_en: Basic course Statistics for political and sociologists

content.text: Motorcycle technology: basics and concepts of motor, drive and chassis. The technology of today's motorcycles is becoming increasingly complex. Mass balancing, digital engine controls, catalyst, ABS or drive slip control require explanations as well as the physical laws that lead to commuting or kick-back in the chassis area. However, you don't have to be a car master or have studied mechanical engineering to understand the book. Well-founded, nevertheless easily understandable, the author addresses experts as well as technology-loving motorcyclists who want to know more than the operating instructions give or are explained in motorcycle magazines. A section on board nets and electronics has been included and latest developments in chassis control systems integrated. The additions to technical accessories for conversions to the technical improvement and optimization of their own machine as well as more and updated image material complete the innovations. The content: complete vehicle - engine and drive - chassis - body and overall design - individualization - future technology - glossary. The target groups: technicians and engineers with working area motorcycle, students of vehicle technology, participants in master courses motorcyclists, technical drivers The author of the department of motorcycle engineering today has the subject of the engineering.
content.title_en: Motorcycle technology : Basics and concepts of engine, drive and chassis

content.text: Programming of natural analog methods: Soft computing and related methods. This book deals with the programming techniques required for the implementation of so-called natural analogue methods. These are cell-automated, Boolean networks, evolutionary algorithms, simulated Annealing, fuzzy methods and neural networks. The volume is a supplement to the book Modeling complexity by natural analogue methods because of its concentration on programming techniques. No special programming knowledge is required, but only knowledge of one of the languages that are commonly used today, such as JAVA or C#. The instructions for programming are written in a pseudocode that is understandable to beginners and does not require any specific language. After a successful reading, readers are able to program the models themselves.
content.title_en: Programming of natural analog methods : Soft computing and related methods

metadata.authors: Klüver, Jürgen; Klüver, Christina; Schmidt, Jörn

content.text: Repetitorium Bachelor Mathematics : for the preparation for module exams in the basic mathematical education. The book is aimed at all Bachelor students and teacher-bachelor students with subject mathematics, who want to check, refresh and supplement the material of the most important basic lectures by questions and given answers. Here, special emphasis is placed on conceptual formations, contexts and examples. More than 300 completely solved exam tasks enable additionally a targeted preparation for written module exams/classifications.
content.title_en: Repetitorium Bachelor Mathematics : for preparation for module exams in the basic mathematical education

content.text: The large manual of strategy tools : tools for successful corporate management; [benchmarking, mapping, life cycle analysis, segmentation, scenario technology and others]. New edition of this manual provides an overview of the most important tools necessary for the strategy of a company or individual business units for the business practitioner.
content.title_en: The Great Handbook of Strategy Instruments : Tools for Successful Management ; [Benchmarking, Mapping, Life Cycle Analysis, Segmentation, Scenario Technology and Others]

content.text: The book provides basic knowledge on cell biology using the example of plant cell. The scope and level of presentation are based on the Bachelor's degree programme in biology. Basic principles of cell biological structures and functions are explained, (Helmut Köhne) The book provides basic knowledge on cell biology using the example of plant cell. The scope and level of presentation are based on the Bachelor's degree programme in biology. The basic principles of cell biological structures and functions are explained, in particular the building blocks of the cell, cell components, cell division and transport processes and important metabolic processes. The special features of plant versus animal cell are highlighted. The appealing didactic concept with summary texts at the beginning of the chapters, border column texts with concise note phrases and colour highlighted text boxes. In addition, the book contains many detailed, visually impressive and informative illustrations that provide a good help to understand the complex contexts.
content.title_en: Cell biology of plants
Operational textiles and dressing materials : standards

content.text: Nature Guide Geology : Schleswig-Holstein and South Jutland; geological sights and interesting sites for fossils and rocks. Schleswig-Holstein and the adjacent areas of South Jutland have many geologically interesting information to offer. On beaches, in gravel, clay and limestone pits you can find special rocks and fossils. This book gives with numerous photos and drawings an overview of the most important geological sights and sites, their construction, their formation and the rocks and raw materials occurring there. Besides geological highlights such as Lägerdorf, Lieth, Groß Pampau, Gram or Helgoland you can find in this nature guide many more exciting excursion destinations. (Verlagstext) The book combines every amount of geological background knowledge, abundant visual material with pictures of finds and places and can also be used as a guide to geological sights and collectible sites. The latter however, because of the picture band format to Frank Rudolph's "beach stones" and similar. - everywhere recommended. (S. Gülck)
content.title_en: Nature guide Geology : Schleswig-Holstein and South Jutland ; geological sights and interesting sites for fossils and rocks

content.text: Garden art and garden heritage conservation in Saxony-Anhalt. Saxony-Anhalt is rich in unique traces of the past. Historical gardens allow us to explore history and art in a mere walk through. Generations meet in them, they are a place of recreation. Gardens are also sensitive natural spaces and cultural assets. This book is dedicated to garden art and garden heritage conservation in Saxony-Anhalt. It is presented, assigned to the five historical areas, examples of garden art from four centuries. These include not only the gardens and parks that are successfully marketed and particularly attractive through the monument conservation-tourist project "Gartenträume". Also little known parks and traces of lost garden art are presented as representative of Saxony-Anhalt's rich heritage.
content.title_en: Garden art and heritage conservation in Sachsen-Anhalt

content.text: Language skills in country comparison. Content: In this volume Language skills in country comparison are reported on the first country comparison of the Institute for Quality Development in Education (IQB). The country comparisons of the IQB replace the PISA supplementary studies (PISA-E), in which the countries of the Federal Republic of Germany were also compared with the levels of competence of their pupils. While in PISA the fifteen-year-olds represent the target population, the IQB examines pupils of the ninth grade. In this report, in addition to the focus of the examination of the levels of competence in the subjects German and first foreign language (English/French) also takes into account social and cultural conditions. The focus of the study is on the competences listening, reading and orthography in the subject German and listening comprehension as well as reading comprehension in the first foreign language. The surveys on the country comparison were conducted in 2008 (French) and 2009 (German and English) as well as the results of the school's study on quality development in education (IQB) is an independent scientific institution of the countries and has the task to further develop the educational standards and to make them more comparable. The study standards of the standards of the study are defined in the study.
content.title_en: Language skills in comparison with countries

content.text: The Internet is a very interesting tool for young people, and the Internet is a very interesting tool for young people to understand and understand. The Internet is a very useful tool for young people, but the most important is the communication via images. Flickr, YouTube, myspace and Facebook are the central platforms for young people to stage themselves and exchange ideas with others. Communication and presentation work visually through image networks, especially via online videos and "photo sharing". The authors analyse these social networking sites on the Web 2.0. They develop methods that are tailored to the special characteristics of the new media and show why the term "private" no longer fits the information shared here. Rather, the web is about creating a picture of themselves and thus presenting itself in fashion, gender or music. The basic research presented in this book provides for the first time an instrumentarium with which this youthful network culture can be captured, and gives surprising and insightful insights into the youth cultures on the web.
content.title_en: Flicking youth - flashing pictures : Web cultures in the Web 2.0

content.text: Facebook applications: [program Facebook applications, create fan pages, use open source tools]. The Facebook communication and advertising platform supports the development of individual applications (apps) with a variety of interfaces (APIs) and development tools (SDKs). Web developers with JavaScript and PHP knowledge receive approaches to how their own applications can be integrated into the interface or how external websites can be integrated. The necessary knowledge of the interfaces (especially Graph API, Open Graph Protocol, REST-API, FQL, XFBML) provides comparatively detailed documentation when introducing the Facebook platform in detail. Practical programming work is presented in 2 continuous application examples (MP3 player, Karaoke program) and extensive listings. Otherwise, only A. Wussow (BA 9/10) is available on the topic, but it is not quite up to date in some details. Where this is well used, the present volume is certainly also welcome for professional web programmers, but for the large number of Facebook users (3).
content.title_en: Programming Facebook applications: [Programming Facebook applications, creating fan pages, using open source tools]

content.text: Manual Library 2.0. Library 2.0 is an institution that applies the principles of Web 2.0 such as openness, re-use, collaboration and interaction in the overall organization. Libraries extend service offerings and workflows to the possibilities of Web 2.0 technologies. This changes the professional image and self-image of librarians. The collection provides a complete overview of the topic Library 2.0 and the current state of developments from a technological, sociological, information theory and practice-oriented perspective.
content.title_en: Library 2.0 Manual

content.text: Carbon fibres and their composites: production processes, applications and market development. Introduction to the production and development of carbon fibres and their application in composites used for space projects, wind turbines, sports equipment, etc. Update and continuation of U. Rosenbaum from the same series (BA 8/94) with references to the application and market development of the material. An outlook on future trends and a list of abbreviations complete the clearly written volume, which is suitable for apprentices and technically interested laypersons. (2)
content.title_en: Carbon fibres and their composites : manufacturing processes, applications and market development

content.text: The consequences of National Socialism on the perpetrators' side have so far only been examined in a incomplete way. Jan Lohl closes these gaps in his comprehensive analysis. The study examines the intergenerational consequences of National Socialism on the "perpetrator side" and its political relevance: Starting from a conceptual extension of the "inability to mourn" (Alexander & Margarete Mitscherlich), the traces of affective integration into the Nazi community are systematically traced over three generations. New is the realization that the National Socialist collective narcissism is traded and which mechanisms become effective. On this basis, the evidence that Nazi sentimental hermitages in the grand generation are a docking point for those paranoid ideologies mediated in right-wing extremist groups is not only to be explained, but is itself an anti-nationalist and anti-nationalist factor.
content.title_en: Emotional inheritance and right-wing extremism : a social psychological study on the history of the generations of National Socialism

content.text: Business process integration with SAP: case studies for managing value creation processes along the supply chain. A case study will be conducted to explain business process management using SAP technologies. Conceptual and technical principles (in particular, introduction to the SAP XI and SAP Business Workflows integration platform) will be preceded by the case study. The book's case study will focus on determining the environmental impact of products and thus address a problem that arises in the context of different business processes and industries: to meet the customer-specific need for information on the environmental impact of a product, production details will be collected along the value chain from raw material extraction to distribution. Based on the data obtained, the consumer will be informed about the origin of the raw materials processed and the production processes used. The necessary processes will be designed and implemented using the product-related carbon footprint (PCF). The author will use SAP technologies to demonstrate how business processes can be automated and optimized. The potentials for use will be explained by a case study, which will focus on the environmental impact of products: based on data that are collected along the supply chain, the modelling of the raw materials and the product chain.
content.title_en: Business process integration with SAP : Case studies for managing value creation processes along the supply chain

content.text: Neuronal networks for forecasting and disposition in retail. Artificial neural networks offer a considerable potential for improving sales forecasting and product disposition in a trading company. Sven F. Crone offers a sound analysis of the basics of sales forecasting, commodity disposition and the process class of the neural networks. Using asymmetrical target functions of decision-making costs, he expands them to a simultaneous approach to forecasting of cost-minimal commodity stocks, which is suitable for robust practical use. The research work has been awarded the Science Prizes of the University of Hamburg 2008 and the Gesellschaft für Operations Research (GOR) 2009. Sven F. Crone offers a sound analysis of the basics of forecasting, disposition and the process class of the neural networks, and shows new ways of their application by example. Dr. Sven F. Crone received his doctorate from Prof. Dr. h. c. Preßmar at the Institute of Business Informatics at the University of Hamburg and is currently Assistant Professor in Management Science at Lancaster University and Deputy Director of Lancaster Centre for Forecasting in England.
content.title_en: Neuronal networks for prognosis and disposition in trade

content.text: Communication and Crisis: How decision makers define reality. Who are the decision-makers and opinion-formers in companies, science and politics and how do their world views develop? How are "realities" made by them and how can they influence this dialogue? Scientists provide basics of communication and the latest research results. Practitioners present tools, tactics and techniques that illustrate the process of opinion-forming and influence of decision-makers. Successful opinion-formers explain in current examples the power of communication and the possible influence on opinions and world images.
content.title_en: Communication and Crisis: How Decision-makers Define Reality

content.text: Chemistry of the climate system. Klappentext: Climate change is one of the biggest challenges of the modern world. Air chemistry in the context of the climate system is the focus of this integrative manual. The problem-oriented approach to explaining atmospheric processes includes a presentation of the chemical evolution on which the assessment of the state of the climate system and possible factors of influence and change are based. Chemical interactions of the atmosphere with the biosphere and hydrosphere are presented in the sense of a multiphase chemistry. From the perspective of chemical climatology, the book offers solutions for unwanted changes in the climate system that can be caused by chemistry but also solved.
content.title_en: Chemistry of the climate system

content.text: Planning for the space between integration and fragmentation: [Ringle lecture 2009]. In the face of serious societal challenges, for example in the context of demographic changes, climate change or the energy crisis, the demands on the space change. Overlaying and competing usage requirements arise. Here spatial planning comes into play. It tries to coordinate the different interests of use and protection goods or to reconcile them as far as possible. It is at the side of the technical planning, which in turn has its own powers to fulfil its tasks and often has a tension with the over-disciplinary coordination task of spatial planning. Therefore, the question arises as to how a timely and appropriate implementation of the coordination task of spatial planning can be designed. Does the current and future challenges give rise to new requirements for the coordination of spatial planning? What should and could coordination look like in the future, so that the technical planning does not see it as a precaution but as a support of its tasks?
content.title_en: Planning for the space between integration and fragmentation : [Lecture 2009]

content.text: Spatial planning: Challenges of the German institutional system. The political and administrative foundations of spatial planning are the focus of this book. It is not intended as a textbook, but it is endeavouring to systematically classify all aspects of the spatial planning system, which make it understandable and understandable how spatial and regional planning works in Germany.
content.title_en: Spatial planning: challenges of the German institutional system

content.text: The market economy of the 21st century. The chief economist of UNCTAD breaks with established doctrines, opposes neoliberalism and economic policy failure and outlines reform principles
content.title_en: The market economy of the 21st century

content.text: Characteristics of discrete material mixtures. Re-use or recycling of waste products, packaging and waste materials is often only useful if they are present in homogeneous object types or material fractions. This requires either a collection of objects that is pure in variety by the waste producers and collecting plants or a sorting of waste mixtures after the collection. Although many return systems provide for a separate collection of certain waste mixtures or even individual waste fractions, this pre-sorting in households is usually not sufficient. Operational sorting processes are then used to divide waste mixtures into different fractions or to evaluate negative readings of disturbing objects. The aim of this work report is to characterize the mixing of waste mixtures more closely. This is used to characterize the quality of the sorting process input and thus to describe a significant influence on the process design and its value effects. To this end, the effects of six characteristics characterising the mixing are discussed using a simple example. From this five indicators are then mathematically defined, the mixing and as a numerical value within a range of 0 indicators are discussed.
content.title_en: Characteristics for the characterisation of discrete mixtures

content.text: Urban future manifestos. Summary: Architects, urban planners, artists, designers, political activists and many others feel the obligation to respond to the current inevitable challenges of an urban environment. The present collection of manifestos offers interdisciplinary approaches to the topic of urban development, growth and migration, economy, politics, gender and nature. The contributors present their respective processes and forward-looking approaches to thinking in the face of urbanism.
content.title_en: Urban future manifestos

content.text: The town of Adelebsen, located on the edge of the Solling in southern Lower Saxony, can look back on more than 300 years of Jewish life. In the 19th century, due to the high proportion of Jewish inhabitants, it was even called Klein Jerusalem. Today, only a few traces are still visible in the village picture. Like most of the dead-sacred Jewish communities in Germany (230 in Lower Saxony alone) only the cemetery survived. To open up this so-called house of life as a historical source and to make it accessible as a place of remembrance is the aim of this documentation, a piece of unfinished and necessary mourning work.
content.title_en: In the steep slope : the Jewish cemetery in Adelebsen : memory of a destroyed community

content.text: Graphene and network optimization. 'All roads lead to Rome!' But which is the best way to find my Navi the way at all? And what about a round trip through Europe's capital cities? These questions form only a small part of the topics of this book. Based on many practical situations, the concepts of graphene theory and network optimization are introduced and the problems raised are solved with the help of algorithms. The book is aimed at students of mathematics and computer science in the first semesters as well as interested practitioners. It contains a variety of application examples as well as important algorithms relevant in practice with the proof of their optimumity. Special mathematical prior knowledge is not required: All terms and methods are introduced in an understandable manner. The knowledge thus acquired can be deepened and verified using numerous exercises and their solutions.
content.title_en: Graph and network optimization

content.text: Introduction to waste management : with 131 tables. The textbook and technical book was completely revised for the fourth edition and adapted with a new conceptual orientation to current developments. With the help of competent experts and experts working in the field of waste management and research, the book was significantly expanded. New chapters are for example 'waste management planning and concepts', 'environmental management and operational waste management', 'substance flow management' and 'ecobalances/ecoefficiency'. At the end of each chapter the reader finds numerous control and exercise questions. Further contents are a comprehensive glossary with explanations of the technical terms and supplementary tables.
content.title_en: Introduction to waste management : with 131 tables

content.text: Simple and economical parking space management: a case study in Berlin. Parking in many municipalities is still a very conflict-laden and partly over-stretched permanent topic in the political debate, where the factual argumentation and scientific foundation are neglected. In this regard, lack of space, park search, accident risk and the disadvantages for residents and visitors provide sufficient reasons for managing the parking space efficiently. How typical implementation obstacles can be removed in parking space management and which innovative measures and instruments are useful, was examined in the context of the funding initiative Mobility 21 of the Federal Ministry of Transport, Building and Urban Development (BMVBS) on the example of Berlin. The volume contains the summary final report with the recommendations for action for municipalities, federal and rural communities as well as the sub-reports "Plan games for the preparation and implementation of parking space management in the Berlin districts Pankow and Treptow-Köpenick", "Economic parking space management" and "Easy parking".
content.title_en: Simple and economical parking space management : a case study in Berlin

content.text: Optical radiation safety and lasers / ed.: DIN Deutsches Institut für Normung e.V.; VDE Verband der Elektrotechnik Elektronik Informationstechnik e.V.; 1: Standards with basic character, limit values and design instructions; Standards with specifications for protective devices and precautions. Contains: DIN EN 207:2010 ; DIN EN 208:2010 ; DIN EN 12254:2010 ; DIN EN 60825-1:2008 [Supplement 1] ; DIN EN 60825-1:2008 [Regulation 1] ; DIN EN 60825-1:2008 [VDE 0837-1] ; DIN EN 60825-1:2009 [Regulation 2] ; DIN EN 62471:2009 [VDE 0837-471] ; DIN EN ISO 11553-1:2009
content.title_en: Optical radiation safety and lasers / ed.: DIN Deutsches Institut für Normung e.V.; VDE Verband der Elektrotechnik Elektronik Informationstechnik e.V.; 1: Standards with basic character, limit values and design instructions; standards with specifications for protective devices and precautions

content.text: Optical radiation safety and lasers / ed.: DIN Deutsches Institut für Normung e.V., VDE Verband der Elektrotechnik Elektronik Informationstechnik e.V.; 2: Application-specific standards : aids, explanations, checklists. Contains: DIN 26912:1999 ; DIN EN 60601-2-22:1996 [VDE 0750-2-22] ; DIN EN 60601-2-22:1997 [VDE 0750-2-22, Corrigendum 1] ; DIN EN 60601-2-22:2005 [VDE 0750-2-22, Draft] ; DIN EN 60601-2-22:2007 [VDE 0750-2-22, Supplement 1] ; DIN EN 60825-12:2004 ; DIN EN 60825-2:2007 [VDE 0837-2] ; DIN EN 60825-2:2008 [Side 1] ; DIN EN 60825:2006 [Side 10] ; DIN EN 60825:2006 [Side 14] ; DIN EN 61040:1993 [VDE 0835] ; DIN EN ISO 11145:2008 ; DIN EN ISO 11553-2:2009 ; DIN EN EN EN 11554:2008 :
content.title_en: Optical radiation safety and lasers / ed.: DIN Deutsches Institut für Normung e.V., VDE Verband der Elektrotechnik Elektronik Informationstechnik e.V. ; 2: Application-specific standards : Help, explanations, checklists

content.text: Creativity meets the city: the relationship between art, culture and urban development within the framework of IBA Hamburg. The International Building Exhibition IBA Hamburg aims to initiate a structurally effective and sustainable approach to art, culture and creativity. With the project "Creative Quartier Elbinsel" the IBA opens up possibilities for the development and strengthening of permanent artistic and creative structures. This book describes the individual projects initiated in 2008 to 2010, but also shows problems in their development. In reflective contributions Adrienne Göhler, Martin Heller, Klaus R. Kunzmann and many other experts question the theoretical and strategic orientation of the IBA concept in relation to its structural effectiveness and place it in relation to comparable formats in Germany and abroad.
content.title_en: Creativity meets city: the relationship between art, culture and urban development within the framework of IBA Hamburg

content.text: Nuclear waste - where to go with it?. While G. Rosenkranz: "Myths of atomic power" (BA 7/10) offered a concentrated introduction and contained a detailed overview of "Smoke of atomic power" (BA 8/10), the Munich physics professor focuses mainly on the disposal of civilian and military nuclear waste. He considers this problem to be more urgent than the actual reactor safety, but which should not be neglected because of the danger of terrorist attacks and human failure. The relatively understandable, internationally oriented analysis concludes that enormous efforts must be made to eliminate the problems. The associated astronomical costs refute the market from economic nuclear power. Especially for students, the basic sections on nuclear power technology are suitable. In addition, the focus is on Chernobyl, other incidents and alternative energies. A simple, particularly substantial work, which is recommended libraries of medium size according to the above-mentioned literature. With graphics, tables, extensive literature directory. (2 S) (Rolf Raschka) Thorough analysis of the dangers of nuclear energy with the emphasis on nuclear waste.
content.title_en: Nuclear waste - where to with it?

content.text: Ubuntu Server : Installation, configuration, administration, security. The Linux version Ubuntu can also be used for server use. Kofler, who has been a skilled specialist in Linux for several years, describes in this revision of his predecessor title (ID 33/09) everything necessary for the setup and operation of a Ubuntu server. The basis for the description is version 10.04 (an LTS version, equipped with a longer-term update support). The text has updates at many points. A chapter on server virtualization with the module KVM has been added. The chapter on authentication server Kerberos is dropped, however. The structure and appearance remained largely unchanged. For larger computer stocks. The predecessor can be used further, but supplemented with the new edition. (3)
content.title_en: Ubuntu Server : Installation, Configuration, Administration, Security

content.text: Matrices and Lie groups: a geometric introduction. Lie groups are indispensable in mathematics and its applications today. The corresponding basics should therefore be known to every mathematician and (theoretical) physicist. The present work now provides an introduction to the theory of Lie groups for students of these subjects (Bachelor and Teacher's Office). Only the knowledge that is taught at German universities during the first year of study is required. The distance between the beginner literature and the weighty works on Lie groups that have existed so far in German literature is thus bridged for the first time and the foundation for deeper employment is laid by the teaching of the basic facts and concepts. Thus, the work cannot replace more comprehensive textbooks on Lie groups. Contains numerous tasks with selected solutions or solution instructions. Also suitable for self-study. As a preparation for or addition to Joachim Hilgert (ID 6/92) very useful. For stocks with corresponding target groups priority to wide, otherwise complementary. (3)
content.title_en: Matrices and Lie groups : a geometric introduction

content.text: Introduction to SQL : understand, use, look up ; [with practical examples, tasks and exercises ; SQL syntax by MySQL, MS Access, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, Base, Oracle, DB, SQLite and Firebird ; including reference card with SQL syntax ; CD-ROM perfect for self-study: exercise software, SQL-Teacher]. The author couple has updated its introduction to SQL after a short time (the 3rd edition: BA 1/10, still up-to-date) which is best suited for beginners without previous knowledge. The 2nd edition (BA 10/07) is still usable, but should be supplemented by the new edition as possible. The 1st edition (BA 8/04) is to be exchanged. To update the "dummy" title of A. Taylor (BA 5/07), if necessary also A. Beaulieu (O'Reilly, 2009; not discussed here) (2).
content.title_en: Introduction to SQL : understand, use, look up ; [with practical examples, tasks and exercises ; SQL syntax of MySQL, MS Access, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, Base, Oracle, DB, SQLite and Firebird ; incl. reference card with SQL syntax ; CD-ROM perfect for self-study: exercise software, SQL-Teacher]

content.text: The book of mathematics: [in four volumes] / by Uwe Storch and Hartmut Wiebe; Vol. 3: Analysis of several variable - integration theory. The work is the third volume of a four volume textbook of mathematics (Vol. 1: "Analysis of a Variable", ID 22/03; Vol. 2: "Lineare Algebra", BA 10/99; Vol. 4: "Analysis on Manifacies ...", ID 27/01, d.Red.), which contains the material for the mathematical preexamen. It is addressed to students of mathematics, computer science, physics and geophysics and deals with analysis in several variable. The focus is on differential calculus in finite-dimensional numerical spaces and the (Lebesgue) integral calculus on the basis of mass theory. In addition, an introduction to topology, function theory and stochastics is given. Numerous examples, especially from physics, and extensive task material complete the presentation. (3)
content.title_en: Textbook of Mathematics : [in four volumes] / by Uwe Storch and Hartmut Wiebe ; Vol. 3: Analysis of several variable - integration theory

content.text: The book of the Luxembourg representative at the WTO and the UN is important because it clearly and with great expertise names the political and structural causes of hunger in the countries of the South. It is courageous because it blames the world economic policy dominated by the Western industrial nations for the catastrophic food situation. In the 1980s the neoliberal economic model became the dominant doctrine. The economies of the developing countries have since been exposed to global competition - and especially their dumping prices in agricultural exports - without protection. Jean Feyder, with his convincing analysis, has been unreservedly criticizing the policy of the West, combined with a vehemently positive appeal to rethink. Very recommended! (2)
content.title_en: Death hunger: who benefits from the misery of poor countries?

content.text: Weblog with WordPress 3: [so you can make more of your blog]. This easy-to-understand introduction to the blog software offers beginners the necessary know-how for starting with a blog. Consideration also find security issues and the management of several blogs. (LK/HB: Isigkeit) With the free-of-charge web software WordPress it is also possible for Internet users without programming experience to build their own attractively opened web blog. Frankemölle presented 2 years ago their first introduction on this topic, which based on WordPress 2.5 (BA 8/08; can expire). Meanwhile, further versions were published, which are incorporated into this updated and extended (just 100 pages more) edition as the version 3.0 published in June. Regarding presentation and construction everything remained the same. In terms of comprehensibility there is still nothing to criticize and the black-white illustrations are mostly of good quality. Keeping in mind is also a login with read access to the project blog to the book. Widely usable, as not only newer is mentioned in the adjunctition. (Bonchi) The adjunct.
content.title_en: Weblog with WordPress 3: [so make more of your weblog]

content.text: University privatisation and academic freedom: beyond the market and state: universities in world society. Neoliberal reformers want to push the state back in higher education. Teachers and learners should become market participants, the specialized training becomes a service. However: If the civil law system gains in effectiveness, academic freedom can also expand despite market-economy constraints. Which of the two alternatives actually prevails in higher education is the subject of this comparative study of higher education in Germany, the USA, Romania and Chile. It addresses all those interested in higher education.
content.title_en: University privatisation and academic freedom: beyond the market and state: universities in the world society

content.text: The Unix-Shell practice course: [become a command line virtuoso, treats Bourne-Shell, Korn-Shell, bash & TC-Shell, with tasks and solutions]. Introduction to working with the most well-known Unix shells. The meaning of a command line oriented work - also in the age of graphical surfaces - is particularly elaborated. (Klaus Barckow) A UNIX shell is an interface between the user and the UNIX-kernel (operating system). It is a command line interpreter. A shell can also be used as a script language for the automation of workflows. A comprehensive manual on shell script programming is P. Ditchen (ID-G 18/08). An introduction for beginners is R. Krienke (BA 1/07). The author of this book introduces readers to working with the most common shells (bash, grain, Bourne- and TC-Shell) in the command line. Prerequisites are hardly required; however, knowledge in a higher programming language (z.B.) The use of the command line of the command is also useful for the use of the command.
content.title_en: Practice course Unix-Shell : [be treated to command line virtuoso, Bourne-Shell, grain-Shell, bash & TC-Shell, with tasks and solutions]

content.text: Encyclopedia of German History / ed. by Lothar Gall ... ; Vol. 49: Die industrielle Revolution in Deutschland. Verlagsinfo: Since the first edition of the volume, numerous recent studies on the industrial revolution have been published in Germany. Various research approaches testify that the interest in industrialization and the associated emergence of modern economy is still great. That is why Hans-Werner Hahn has brought his standard work up to date.
content.title_en: Encyclopedia of German History / ed. by Lothar Gall ... ; Vol. 49: The Industrial Revolution in Germany

content.text: Topology and Functional Analysis : Basics of abstract analysis with applications. Main description: The elementary introduction to general topology, Lebesgue integration theory and functional analysis in uniform presentation based on the Real Analysis and Linear Algebra. With application among others to differential and integral equations, optimization and numerical methods. Starting from well-known concepts such as metrics, convergence, vector space, scalar product, topological spaces, in particular complete pseudometric and compact topological spaces with their fundamental properties are treated. Following a classical representation of the Lebesgue integration, five principles of linear functional analysis, the Banach-Hahn-Mazur separation sets as well as studies on extreme points, duality and Hilbertraum operators follow. Through over 150 examples and 428 tasks with complete solution suggestions, the book is also suitable as a companion text for lectures and exercises as well as for self-study.
content.title_en: Topology and Functional Analysis : Basics of Abstract Analysis with Applications

content.text: Higher Mathematics for Engineers 2 : Task Collection ; with more than 150 fully solved tasks. Main description: Mathematics learns by means of fully solved tasks? The present two-volume task collection shows that this is primarily aimed at students of engineering sciences from the second year of study. In addition, students of natural sciences and mathematics also find a wealth of examples. More than 150 fully solved tasks help the lecture material to understand and serve the preparation for exams and examinations. The most important definitions and sentences required to solve the tasks make the book largely independent of a textbook. This second volume of the collection includes tasks to create nonlinear equations, to Laplace and Fourier transformations, to distributions, to calculate variations and to ordinary and partial differential equations.
content.title_en: Higher Mathematics for Engineers 2 : Task Collection ; with more than 150 fully solved tasks

content.text: Tasks for engineering mathematics : Differential equations, numerics, Fourier and Laplace theory ; with Mathematica and Maple examples. Main description: A workbook with the character of a reference work. For the central areas of engineering mathematics: Differential equations, numerical and system theory methods - with numerous practice examples and exams and detailed solutions. For easy orientation, the required definitions and sentences are given in short form.
content.title_en: Tasks for engineering mathematics : Differential equations, numerics, Fourier and Laplace theory ; with Mathematica and Maple examples

content.text: Mathematical methods of signal processing. Review rate. A quota from a review of the product: "A wonderful book I have been waiting for for a long time." (Prof. Dr. W. Treimer, Technische Fachhochschule Berlin) Main description: Since signals are described by functions and consequences, the signal processing places high demands on mathematics. Therefore, this book not only contains a description of the classical discrete and continuous transformations of signal processing as well as wavelet transformation, but also an overview of mathematical theory with the essential topics from the basic area. In addition, calculations with Matlab and Maple are included and explained for practice. The only modern presentation of mathematical methods for signal processing. The aim of this book is to bridge the gap between mathematics and applications and the use of modern software. In this context, the classical discrete and continuous transformations of signal processing are presented together with wavelet transformation. The provision of mathematical tools of function theory, distributions and Hilbert spaces ensures a rigorous and uniform structure of the theory.
content.title_en: Mathematical methods of signal processing

content.text: Algorithmic Graph Theory. Main description: Every system consisting of discrete states or objects and relationships between them can be modeled as graph. Many applications require efficient algorithms for processing such systems. The focus of this introduction to algorithmic graph theory lies in the practical application of algorithms within computer science. The algorithms are presented in a compact form in a programming language-related notation that makes it easy to transfer to an object-oriented programming language such as Java or C#. The practical relevance of the algorithms is demonstrated in many applications from areas such as compiler construction, artificial intelligence, operating systems, computer networks, world wide web, analysis of social networks and operations research. Nine chapters cover the most important sub-areas of algorithmic graph theory. The book contains about 300 exercise tasks in various degrees of difficulty, for the bachelor's and master's studies. The detailed solutions are contained in an annex. Review quota. A quote from a review of the product: "The representation is characterized by clarity and insight. The book contains about the University of Berlin's high-level teaching.
content.title_en: Algorithmic Graph Theory

content.text: West Germany in the OEEC : Integration, Crisis, probation 1947 - 1961. Main description: The integration of West Germany into the European-Atlantic Community was by no means as smooth as it might seem in retrospect. Because the Organization for European Economic Cooperation (OEEC) was the first international organisation in which the Germans were able to cooperate on an equal footing after the Second World War, their example shows the economic, political and psychological problems in integration particularly well: the debate about the future role of the country in the European economic fabric, the adaptation to new forms of foreign policy, the handling of the "hypothetics of the past". The book examines in detail the individual stages of the integration process and illustrates how the Federal Republic became a respected member of the OEEC from the "sorgekind".
content.title_en: West Germany in the OEEC : Integration, crisis, probation 1947 - 1961

content.text: Geometric group theory : a start with the computer ; basic knowledge for study and mathematics instruction. This book is about group theory. Groups can be considered as algebraic objects that describe the symmetry of geometric objects. This perspective is in the foreground of the book and thus the book is also about geometry. Groups express symmetry phenomena algebraically, one expects reflections, rotations etc., generally with illustrations of spaces on itself. The book can be used during lecture sessions with algebra and group theory lectures. It is also particularly suitable for teacher students, as it presents the material computer-oriented (using the freely available group theory program CAP) with many illustrative examples. For the second edition some parts of the book were presented in more detail. Some contents (for example the classification of finite groups up to order 11) were added and errors corrected.
content.title_en: Geometric group theory : an introduction to the computer ; basic knowledge for studies and mathematics lessons

content.text: Practical hydrology: Basics and exercises. Textbook on the basics and mathematical and physical-based methods of engineering hydrology - a sub-area of hydrology - in which the main focus is on the determination of data for water economics, hydrological and ecological planning. (LK/KA: Nibbrig) Textbook on the basics and mathematical and physical-based methods of engineering hydrology - a sub-area of hydrology - in which the determination of data for water economics, hydrological and ecological planning is the main focus. At the level of a basic lecture, the measurement of basic data, calculation and measurement of evaporation, precipitation-flow models, evaluation of data series, etc. Compact presentation with numerous practical examples and training tasks (with solutions) on the basis of real data. For students and practitioners of water economics oriented disciplines of construction engineering or environmental sciences. No comparison title. (3) (LK/KA: Nibbrig)
content.title_en: Practical Hydrology : Basics and Exercises

content.text: Glass for supporting components. Due to architectural trends, the use of glass in supporting components is becoming more and more common. This is supported by the development of ever more powerful construction glass products. The book is therefore intended to provide the reader with information and skills that he needs to design and measure bearing glass components. It is aimed at engineers and architects in work and studies who want to use construction glass not only for windows and non-supporting facade glazing, but also by incorporating glass into the supporting structure to achieve greater transparency and light flooding in the building.
content.title_en: Glass for load-bearing components

content.text: Renovating old buildings - saving energy. Residential buildings are very durable. But even houses built 15 years ago are old buildings in the sense of energy efficiency. By energy-efficient renovation of the building envelope and the use of effective building technology, the heat demand of old buildings can be reduced by up to 70% and at the same time the living comfort increased. This book introduces the architectural, building physics and technical foundations of modernization. Typical weak points are analyzed and suitable renovation measures presented. The legal standard forms the lower limit of the possibilities. Thus, the book offers a wealth of suggestions to make real energy saving houses from old buildings.
content.title_en: Renovating old buildings - saving energy

content.text: Adobe Premiere Pro CS5 : the practical book with numerous workshops; [step by step to the perfect film; with exercise film on DVD]. The innovations of the version CS5 of Adobes (semi-)professional software for video productions are more "under the hood" (now pure 64-bit application, use of the computing power of graphics cards). For the user has done quite little at the surface. Accordingly, the author has revised the reissue (see BA 8/09) of his workshop book only slightly: after a short introduction of Premiere Pro follow the individual workshops, somewhat streamlined and in changed order. The few new functions are marked in the text. Classes convey the handling and possibilities of Premiere Pro again intelligible and step by step on an example film which is attached to the DVD (unfortunately again the film from the preliminary edition). The illustrations and screenshots are black-white but easy to recognize. Test versions are also included. Furthermore, an understandable and thorough title, well suited for beginners and advanced users. Where the direct pre-press is available, however, can be omitted only for a higher price of EUR 5.
content.title_en: Adobe Premiere Pro CS5 : the practical book with numerous workshops ; [Step by step to the perfect film ; with exercise film on DVD]

content.text: With Lightroom develop: from vision to perfection. Three images are the ones that make up a photo: the image you imagine, the image you take and the image you then develop. This book is about the 3rd step, not about the entire workflow from import, image management, printing or web presentation. It is also not a book about tips and tricks, even though they are to be found. This is about recognizing the vision to an image and giving it expression with the developing module in Lightroom. Even if the beginning is somewhat text-heavy - but this text contains the author's philosophy and thus the most important part of the book. David DuChemin shows how he edits his images and makes them what he saw and felt at the moment of the recording, i.e., a picture so to work on, so to express his vision. In the 1st part it is mainly about the mindset of the author and about Lightroom itself. Only in the 2nd part it is about the concrete development with Lightroom. A somehow different book, but it is good for the right!
content.title_en: Develop with Lightroom : from vision to perfection

content.text: Prescription book school integration : on the way to an inclusive school. The school integration of children and young people with disabilities is demanded by numerous sides. However, the practical implementation shows that this involves major challenges for schools and teachers. How can funding diagnostics and funding planning be designed easily and effectively? What needs to be taken into account in order to develop an inclusive school? The authors show practical orientations on how the teaching can be designed so that it meets the needs of as many students as possible. Numerous excourses of successful examples of inclusive teaching from different countries are also presented.
content.title_en: Prescription book school integration : on the way to an inclusive school

content.text: Protection for overload and short circuit in electrical systems: Explanations of the new DIN VDE 0100-430:2010-10 and DIN VDE 0298-4:2003-08. "The book deals mainly with the current load capacity of cables and cables"... and their ..."protection against overload and short circuit" (see the discussion on the 1st edition: ID 5/00; still under H. Nienhaus), i.e. it explains and comments on the relevant standards based on numerous application examples. In the 2nd edition of 2006 the DIN VDE 0298-4: 2003-08 were re-established, in the 3rd edition now also the DIN VDE 0100-430: 2010-10. Thus all preliminary editions must be replaced, if there is any demand in public libraries because the circle of users (planners and installers of plants, i.e. [future] engineers, technicians, master technicians and specialists in maintenance and testing) should not be too large. (3) (LK/W: Weinheimer-Hartmann) The relevant standards are explained and commented on on on the basis of numerous application examples; for planners and installers, thus for technicians and technicians (Win the type of maintenance and technicians, as well as well as well as well as well as well as for technicians for technical specialists and short circuitists and short circuitists in electrical systems.
content.title_en: Protection for overload and short circuit in electrical systems : Explanatory notes to the new DIN VDE 0100-430:2010-10 and DIN VDE 0298-4:2003-08

content.text: The Internet trap: what we unknowingly disclose about us online and how we can safely use the World Wide Web for us. On the Internet I am anonymous, I can do and let what I want to know about me. These two statements illustrate the range of ideas that have been set in the minds of users when it comes to the questions of the digital egos in the online age. 30 million people use social networks on the Internet alone in Germany. But hardly anyone knows the backgrounds and contexts of the Web 2.0 world, beyond recurring press releases about data claping, cyberstalking, identity theft and online mobbing. Here are just some examples of the possible side effects of an overly careless handling of the Internet. Thomas R. Köhler Internet entrepreneurs of the first hour shows that in the online age digital identity is not a debatting field for theoreticians, but something about every user. The Internet trap provides a look behind the scenes of the web economy. Concrete tips and recommendations for dealing with the Internet's own data wear out in the internet, but rather help to avoid the risks of being over-regarded here.
content.title_en: The Internet Trap : what we unknowingly reveal about us online and how we can safely use the World Wide Web for us

content.text: Atlas of the Real World : you have never seen the Earth like this. This Atlas shows you the world you've never seen before. The book combines the results of the latest digital cartography with concise analyses of the facts presented in the maps. Open the Atlas anywhere and you'll surely learn about our world you haven't yet known.
content.title_en: Atlas of the Real World : You've never seen the Earth like this

content.text: Specific Landscapes : HutterReimann + Cejka Landscape Architects. What is the specificity of a place? And how can the hidden potentials of a place, a landscape be made visible? For ten years, hutterreimann + cejka landscape architects have been designing public spaces such as parks, squares, garden shows and playgrounds, but also residential areas, private gardens and representative facilities in the private sector. Their unconventional solutions mark the love for detail, but also the courage to "great gesture" without fear of polarizing. In the interplay of the living and the new, of reflection and pictorial poetry, specific landscapes emerge in this way. This book presents in numerous photographs, plans and drawings as well as accompanying essays the unconventional solutions of landscape architects in their entire range.
content.title_en: Specific Landscapes : HutterReimann + Cejka Landscape Architects

content.text: The Photoshop Elements 9 manual. The manual explains in detail how to manage, edit and present digital image material with Photoshop Elements. With sample data, demo versions for Windows/Mac and plug-ins on DVD. (LK/MZ: Steiner) The new edition of the heavy weight manual for version 9 of the image processing software has added another 180 pages - at the same price (see BA 5/10). The author describes very detailed and uncomplicated the complete workflows of image processing with Elements. As in the preliminary edition, 5 exercises on standard tasks are presented for heating up, before then in now 34 chapters practically every feature of the software, but also theoretical foundations are explained. The whole is illustrated in color throughout, for each topic smaller workshops are found. Compared to the predecessor, the structure has been revised, the content is now finer structured - good for targeted revisit. The few innovations of Elements 9 have been considered. Conclusion: A highly recommended and didactically well-made manual for all users who have already worked with Elements and now want to exploit all design possibilities. The content is offered qualitatively with the help of a Wolf.
content.title_en: The Photoshop Elements 9 Manual

content.text: Molecular biological methods in food analysis: basic methods and applications. Molecular biological methods have been used for a long time in the analysis of food, seeds and feed. The spectrum ranges from the detection of genetically modified and allergenic ingredients to the differentiation of animal species in meat products to the determination of pathogenic germs and mycotoxin-forming fungi. The book provides the necessary molecular biological techniques and the necessary background knowledge in a very practical way. One focus is the polymerase chain reaction (PCR), including real-time PCR and quality assurance.
content.title_en: Molecular biological methods in food analysis : basic methods and applications

content.text: The theory of ordinary differential equations and dynamic systems plays a central role in the modelling of real time-dependent processes. This makes it part of the basic university education of mathematicians, physicists, computer scientists and engineers. The volume provides a contemporary presentation of the theory, with a focus on dynamics. To demonstrate the performance of the theory, examples take up a lot of space. New applications in biology, chemistry and physics are dealt with in detail in modelling and analysis. As a lecture-accompanying reading, the book has succeeded in providing detailed explanations of the mathematical methods. However, the particular examples described in detail are those that are best read before the theory. The solution is so detailed that no questions remain open. This book is therefore highly recommended for students of physics and mathematics. Mathematics Association RHO e.V.
content.title_en: Common differential equations and dynamic systems

content.text: Hopes and Desperation in the City of Salzburg 1938/39 : Prehistory - Facts - Consequences. Why the History of National Socialism Does Not Go Away : Reflections of an Ancient Historian / Ernst Hanisch -- In the sign of the founding of a festival, general suffrage and economic crisis : the City of Salzburg in the interwar period / Robert Hoffmann -- Bombs, Böller, Propaganda : the rise of the Nazi Party in Salzburg 1918-1938 / Oskar Dohle -- Militant Nazi activists with a base of retreat : Salzburger bei der Österreichischen Legion / Hans Schafranek -- "double rule", Nazi power-attack and "connection" : from Berchtesgaden agreement to the annexation of the people vote / Peter F. Kramml -- "A People---Ein Reich--Ein Führer" : audiovisual documents for 1938 in Salzburg / Johannes Hofinger -- Mobilization, social promises, control, persecution : mechanisms of the Nazi rule in the phase of its stabilisation, 1938/1939, and the participation of the population / Ingrid Bauer
content.title_en: Hopes and Despair in the City of Salzburg 1938/39 : History - Facts - Consequences

content.text: Information resources : a handbook for librarians and information specialists. This volume provides information specialists with a current introduction to the use of information resources. In addition to the theoretical basics, about 400 general and specialist information resources are selected and their contents, functions and meaning are described. This provides a basic knowledge on information resources that can be used directly in practice. The only introduction of this kind in the German-speaking area. Classical works for introduction to bibliography are no longer up-to-date.
content.title_en: Information resources : a handbook for librarians and information specialists

content.text: Lifeworlds and life paths in the mountain towns of Oberharz: everyday life and social conditions of the mountain people in the 19th century. The Oberharz rose since the late 16th century to one of the centers of early modern silver mining in Central Europe, but its heyday had passed at the beginning of the 19th century. Demand and promotion of further ores and metals created a temporary boost for the Harz mountain and metal industry. However, in competition with new areas that were rising worldwide, the Oberharz had poor conditions like most sites of old European ore mining. Around 1900, a time of general economic and social dynamics, the old Montan region was considered a emergency area. The author traces selected questions of social and everyday history in the Oberharz mining area and, above all, also with the help of microhistoric case studies, provides insights into traditionally mountain-männische social environment.
content.title_en: Lifeworlds and life paths in the mountain towns of Oberharz: everyday life and social conditions of the mountain people in the 19th century

content.text: Higher Analysis - Function Theory and Common Differential Equations : A Compact Course. Main description: Mathematics students have always sought a compact representation of function theory and differential equations. Both for the diploma and for the higher teaching office belong to the examination material: here is the ideal repetitorium with which the examination preparation becomes a success. A valuable companion of lectures the book is by its abundance of complete and very elegant proofs even of difficult sentences.
content.title_en: Higher Analysis - Function Theory and Common Differential Equations : A Compact Course

content.text: Renovation of the house: repair - modernize - energy saving - conversions ; ecological building practice ; with guidance for self-help. Guide to the proper repair, modernization and maintenance of old building substance taking into account health-friendly building materials and ecological building techniques. (LK/KA: Nibbrig) Practical guide for home owners for appropriate repair, modernization and maintenance of old building substance taking into account health-friendly building materials and ecological construction techniques. Compared to the 10th edition 2008 (BA 4/09) legal changes in thermal insulation, energy efficiency, building materials and building law were taken into account. The chapters on heat protection and heat supply, house technology and ventilation, heating technology were re-incorporated. 2 smaller chapters on sanitary and electrical installation were added, all cost data were updated with 2010 status. The preliminary requirement can be used, but should be supplemented by the new edition. Recommended next to "Vom Altbau zum lowenergie- und Passivehaus" (with BA 4/10) from the same publishing house with emphasis on energy-technical renovation. (Kbrig/KA)
content.title_en: Renovation of houses : repair - modernize - energy saving - conversions ; ecological construction practice ; with guidance to self-help

content.text: Beauty on every table : ceramic used around 1930; the Budden Siege Collection at the Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg. Since 1997, the Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg has owned the Tillmann Budden Siege Ceramic Collection, an exceptionally large collection of ceramic used from the period around 1930. It comprises approximately 1200 objects and is thus one of the most extensive collections on this topic.
content.title_en: Beauty on every table : ceramic used around 1930 ; the Budden Siege Collection at the Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg

content.text: The way in which buildings and memorial sites of the 20th century are handled is one of the major challenges of the preservation of monuments. Not only can most of the buildings, places and ensembles in question not be subsumed to the usual expectations of beauty that are directed to historical buildings, but also the value of monuments of trace-based, fragmentary or symbolic places of memory is often still to be theoretically justified. The professorship for monument studies and applied building research at TU Dresden has been paying particular attention to these questions in research and teaching for several years. The contributions gathered in this volume testify to this.
content.title_en: Denk_MALE of the 20th century : Buildings - Relics - places of remembrance ; Challenges for the preservation of monuments

content.text: Labour market policy with the European Social Fund : Supplement to the SGB III from ESF funds; implementation and effects. In the years 2000 to 2008 the statutory labour market policy of the Federal Government (SGB III) was supplemented by funds from the European Social Fund (ESF-BA programme). This report provides the IAB with the final information on its results. The findings of the implementation analyses and impact analyses on ESF support for the further training of unemployed people, qualification during short-time work in the event of a final loss of work, support for the establishment of a business from unemployment and the placement of vocational German skills to unemployed people with a migrant background are presented.
content.title_en: Labour market policy with the European Social Fund : Supplement to the SGB III from ESF resources ; implementation and effects

content.text: Box, portfolio, book cover: the basics of book binding for all who appreciate this craft: for teachers, professionals and lovers. Publisher's text: Franz Zeier, who himself has developed the craftsmanship at the level of art, gives to all those who want to learn the profession of bookbinding or to pursue it as a leisure activity a textbook in hand that leaves no wishes open in his clarity and systematics. It is the professional conclusion of a true master. He introduces step by step into the artisanal techniques of bookbinding. He has placed great emphasis on the initial reasons of bookbinding, e.g. on the handling of tools, on the treatment of the material paper or on the manifold problems of life. Besides the various versions of boxes, folders, ceiling covers he also deals with the photo book, the passport-partout and the adhesive binding altogether 123 objects are represented.
content.title_en: Box, portfolio, book cover : the basics of bookbinding for all who appreciate this craft: for teachers, professionals and lovers

content.text: Material flow analysis of the German biofuel sector for 2007. This report analyses the material flows of the German biofuel sector for 2007. Numerous statistics were evaluated to make percentage statements on how much raw materials flowed into biofuel production and other energy uses compared to the food and feed sectors. In addition, it is shown which by-products are produced and, if possible, their quantities quantified. Trade statistics have determined the imported raw materials quantities. Due to gaps in data availability, the traded biofuel volumes have been shown as net imports (consumption minus domestic production), which can lead to deviations in terms of the actual imported and exported biofuel quantities (source: Verlag).
content.title_en: Material flow analysis of the German biofuel sector for 2007

content.text: Welfare states in comparison : Social protection in Europe: Organization, financing, benefits and problems. A text on the problem: How does the welfare state work in different countries, with which problems and perspectives? Different cases, fields and problems of social segregation are examined, whereby a close connection of scientific analysis with political-practical aspects is pursued. This third edition has been extensively updated and extended. Dr. Josef Schmid, Professor of Political Science at the University of Tübingen.
content.title_en: Welfare States in comparison : Social protection in Europe: organisation, financing, benefits and problems

content.text: Statistics and Thermodynamics : an introduction for Bachelor and Master. Starting from the quantum mechanics of a microscopic system that is known to be used as the basis for the first part (Bachelor), the statistics of a macroscopic system are treated. From this, the fundamental sentences and properties of classical thermodynamics are derived, making their postulates very transparent. Thermodynamics is then applied to important and practical systems. In the second part (Master) the various ensembles are discussed and quantum statistics are built up. It is applied to modern and current systems including the microwave background radiation of the universe and the recent investigations of Bose-Einstein condensation. A brief insight into irreversible processes and fluctuations finishes this deliberately didactically written book.
content.title_en: Statistics and thermodynamics : an introduction for Bachelor and Master

content.text: Manual Library 2.0. Library 2.0 is an institution that applies the principles of Web 2.0 such as openness, reuse (reuse), collaboration and interaction in the overall organization. Libraries extend service and workflows to the possibilities of Web 2.0 technologies. This changes the professional image and self-image of librarians. The collection provides a complete overview of the topic Library 2.0 and the current state of developments from a technological, sociological, information theory and practice-oriented perspective.
content.title_en: Library 2.0 Manual

content.text: The German monument and the national idea in the 19th century. The origin of the national idea and its development in the 19th century in relation to the monument building, especially the national monument, are the focus of the present work. - - Consider the early monuments after the battle of the peoples, among others the Kreuzberg monument, the Berlin Victory Column, the numerous monuments for Kaiser Wilhelm and Bismarck as well as the Battle Monument of the Peoples near Leipzig. - By focusing on few important monuments of the phases of the 19th century decisive for the national movement and the analysis of their historical, social, military and, last but not least, artistic environment, three central questions are clarified: - - How does the monument develop in comparison to national idea and history and what parallels exist? What changes do the monument art experience over the course of the century? How and with what purpose is the monument politically instrumentalized and with what success this measure achieved? - - This work was recognized by the Departmental Council of the University of Koblenz (FB 2: Philology / Cultural Sciences) as an outstanding scientific achievement.
content.title_en: The German monument and the national idea in the 19th century

content.text: Psychology - the exercise book : the exam training for the Zimbardo. The textbook by Philip G. (2) (LK/DU: Heckmann) An exercise book with comprehension questions, multiple-choise questions and correct-false questions, each with solutions, based on the text of the textbook "Psychology" by Philip G. Zimbardo. (LK/DU: Heckmann.)

Applies to students of the fields of material engineering, mechanical engineering and manufacturing technology and can also be used during lecture sessions. At the same time also suitable for engineers in industry with corresponding previous knowledge for self-study. With further literature. Content and chapter structure of the new edition have been greatly revised, the text has been re-assembled, as well as the illustrations, which are now increasingly supplemented by black and white photos. The edition has been corrected and the standards have been updated. The somewhat enlarged format has improved clarity and readability, the price has remained the same. content.text: The Hamburg U- and S-Bahn network: a history in route plans from 1842 to today. Hamburg's local transport network fascinates visitors and residents alike. In 1842, a railway connected the Elbmetropole with Bergedorf. The second largest city in Germany has had an electric city railway since 1906 and an underground railway since 1912. The network has been continuously expanded over the decades. Currently, the new U-Bahn line U 4, which will connect the port city, is being developed. This book describes in detail the local transport of the Hanseatic city and its history.
content.title_en: The Hamburg U- and S-Bahn network: a history in route plans from 1842 to today

content.text: Motors : People, myths and engines of automobile history. A richly illustrated compendium, which presents in 1,400 short biographies outstanding inventors, designers, talented technicians, entrepreneurs, merchants, racing and record drivers, etc., which earned themselves the development of the automobile. Selected personalities, who wrote automobile history in the 19th and 20th century, were selected. Thanks to the lexicographic order of the person names and the 5-part index, it is easy to find out who, when, what has done. Very informative and comprehensive reference work, which should not be missing in any larger inventory for vehicle construction, especially since nothing comparable is known. In addition to individual biographies (e.g. about "Gottlieb Daimler", BA 11/00; "Maybach", ID-G 29/00 or "Karl Benz", ID-G 30/01) in expanded collections or already from medium libraries to cover the topic.
content.title_en: Motors : People, Myths and Motors of the History of the Automobile

content.text: Is it possible to get sick and broke? : The German health system. Are our health insurance companies really broke? Can we soon not afford to become ill? That our health system is not a charity event, but a powerful industry, we have long understood. But who benefits here? And why do we pay more and more as an insured person? Hartmut Reiners, one of the most experienced health economists, now rushes to the aid of the confused patient and in this critical introduction reveals the myths of our health system step by step. In the end you will finally understand what the health care specialists at Anne Will, Maybrit Illner or Frank Plasberg actually argue about. What is wrong in our health system and how it could really be reformed shows one of the leading health economists in Germany.
content.title_en: Sick and broke? : The German health system

content.text: The big book of self-sufficiency: [using renewable energies, growing fruit and vegetables, collecting wild plants, keeping farm animals, making cheese, wine-celling, feeding, cooking and smoking, natural remedies and more]. Father and son cultivate a farm in Cornwall and strive to provide a universal self-sufficiency through renewable energies, organic cultivation of fruit and vegetables, keeping farm animals, own production of food, etc. They pass on their knowledge with detailed, practical advice and construction instructions, which are illustrated by attractive photos and drawings. These include special techniques such as drying and dörren (see "Drying and dörren with the sun", BA 10/10). A register and a really useful literature directory complete the work revised for German conditions, which also provides useful information to city dwellers. The authors are in the tradition of the classic John Seymour (The new book of life on the countryside, lastly BA 4/10), which seems more old-fashioned. Alan Bridgewater offers a detailed "Lust is offered everywhere" (Bridge is also offered for self-service life and equipment).
content.title_en: The big book of self-sufficiency: [use renewable energies, grow fruit and vegetables, collect wild plants, keep farm animals, make cheese, wine grow, put in, boil and smoke, natural remedies and more]

content.text: 3 Colonialism in Oceania. The discovery of the island states of Oceania by Europeans began in the 16th century, in the 18th and 19th centuries, mainly Spaniards, French, German, American and British colonial rulers divided the states among themselves, the 20th century (not least as a result of the world wars) the period of decolonization. In specialized books on colonization (here most recently: W. Reinhard, BA 7/08) Oceania was long neglected. The professor of anthropology deals in the 3rd volume of his compendium on the subject of scientific research (and for an academic readership) with colonialism in general and from a European perspective as well as with the colonial activities of the master countries and the effects of their often irreversible, destructive administrations. With maps of all islands, black and white photographs, 10 time tables, various lists, extensive literature list (from English and German).
content.title_en: Cultural History of Oceania / Hermann Mückler ; Vol. 3: Colonialism in Oceania
