content.text: Finite Elements Models of statics and strength theory : 101 cases of application for modeling. The practical application of the finite elements method is bound to the operation of FE software systems in more demanding tasks. And there is the need to prepare real components to realistic FE models. The modeling thus comes to the center of the problem-solving. This practical book, after a short introduction to the finite elements method, conveys the processes for modeling in general form. Therefore, there is no dependence on a specific FEM program. The focus is on modeling on structures with one and several basic elements, modeling on components with different types of stress, application of different element types, verification of FE results with classical calculation approaches.
content.title_en: Finite Elements Models of statics and strength theory : 101 Use cases for modeling

content.text: The political science study on the structure and tasks of the welfare state with a focus on the recent development since the government of Kohl. (LK/WIT: Grote) The Cologne political scientist Butterwegge has become known through various publications on (children) poverty and welfare state development. This basic, but at the same time quite demanding work, written for a student and scientific audience (here last edition, BA 11/05, was not available for comparison) was continued until 2011. The presentation is minute and now also covers the period of the Grand Coalition as well as the CDU/CSU-FDP coalition. The main background debates (Sarrazin, Sloterdijk, Westerwelle) and the whole thinking towards neoliberal modernization are also covered in the last section. Despite necessary previous knowledge: (2) (LK/WIT: Grote)

content.text: Recommendations for the planning, installation and maintenance of irrigation systems in vegetation areas : from the work of the RWA "Irrigation/Irrigation". In the irrigation of golf courses and sports facilities, the water-saving automatic irrigation has been state of the art for many years, but not in the garden area or in public or semi-public green. But here, too, the trend towards professional irrigation systems has been increasing for years, as the irrigation technology, which enables a more even and thus more economical distribution of water on the area, has been considerably further developed in recent years. (Source: www.fll.de 28.03.2011)
content.title_en: Recommendations for the planning, installation and maintenance of irrigation systems in vegetation areas : from the work of the RWA "Irrigation/Irrigation"

content.text: Multiculture 2.0 : Welcome to the immigration country Germany. The immigration country Germany has been promoting for years - and partly to this day - the guiding principle of a homogeneous German society, in which immigrants perceived as outsiders have to integrate. In the meantime, about 20% of the population has become obsolete with a migration background and the idea of clear cultural attributions. According to the many renowned authors of this volume, unilateral integration demands for immigrants lead today into a dead end, because migration has changed German society as a whole and it is time to face this reality. In addition to an inventory of the German migration debate and comparative analyses with other immigration societies, this exciting book opens up a wealth of approaches and perspectives for thinking and action, which serve as a guide for a different coexistence in cultural diversity and can inspire public discussion immensely.
content.title_en: Multiculture 2.0 : Welcome to the Immigration Country Germany

The second part is about the land garden practice: well-known and forgotten vegetables are presented, flowers that heal, edible flowers and unscrewed plants, a garden for children, old pet breeds, flowers and bees, building with pastures and hazelnuts - a wealth of topics that a land garden offers, are placed in the scene, the gardeners are known as the gardeners, the gardeners are also known as the gardeners, the gardeners are able to find many of the gardeners.

content.text: The cosmic back stairs: the exploration of the sky from Aristotle to Stephen Hawking. The author is a historian of science and has already written numerous books, e.g. "In the beginning was the double helix" (BA 5/03). Here he deals with the history of astronomy: from antiquity to our time the time frame from which he has chosen the "helix researchers", whose life and work he describes, stretches. It begins with Aristotle and continues from Aristarch to Copernicus, Galileo Galilei, Newton, Bessel, Einstein and Hubble to Stephen Hawking. Interestingly, two people are also present, who are actually known as poets and philosophers, namely Dante Alighieri and Kant. Out of the collection of life pictures, the astronomy history of Asia, South America, India, Persia and the Islamic world was left out of course. The author has succeeded in presenting the biographies in a larger and more cultural context, so that the history of Asia, South America, Persia and the Islamic world is a pleasantly fascinating one.
content.title_en: The cosmic back stairs : the exploration of the sky from Aristotle to Stephen Hawking

content.text: Urban development concepts for commercial spaces: the example of the state capital Potsdam; a workshop report. Urban development concepts that represent the inventory, demand and measures for the development of commercial spaces on a urban level can contribute to the successful use of commercial spaces. For politics and administration they create the strategic basis for comprehensive commercial space management; compared with land owners and real estate industry they are an important communication tool. The publication proposes building blocks for the development of commercial space-related urban development concepts and illustrates these using the example of the state capital Potsdam. This includes, for example, the typing of different area requirements and location qualities in the demand forecast and inventory survey. New methodological approaches to forecast the business space requirements and for the consideration of the fiscal consequences of different strategies of commercial space development are presented in depth.
content.title_en: Urban development concepts for commercial spaces : the example of the state capital Potsdam ; a workshop report

content.text: The Church crisis : how does Christianity survive?. The book on the Church crisis. The proportion of the non-denominationals in the population increases. Church bond and Christian faith decline dramatically. The situation has further intensified, especially for the Roman Catholic Church: the cover-up of paedophile practices of clerics or the handling of the Pius brothers, who reject the essential results of the Second Vatican Council, makes clear: Behind current conflicts there are serious structural and perceptual problems. A strategy of centralist unification has caused the increasing loss of credibility. How will it go on? The view of a great religious sociologist: Nächternes Denken über die Zukunft des Christianiens.
content.title_en: Church Crisis : How does Christianity survive?

content.text: The enemy is in the East: Hitler's secret plans for a war against the Soviet Union in 1939. The attack on the Soviet Union on 22 June 1941 is considered in historiography as the last phase of Hitler's step plan for the conquest of "living space in the East". The renowned military historian Rolf-Dieter Müller denies this view in his latest book. Based on previously widely ignored sources, he can show that Hitler has been concerned with the possibility of an early intervention war against the USSR since his entry into power in 1933. For this he and the Wehrmacht initially put on negotiations with Poland and also considered an alliance with Japan. In September 1939, after the beginning of World War II, a direct military clash with the Red Army was conceivable. The Wehrmacht did not shy away from him. The view of the prehistory shows: There was neither a step plan for the east expansion, nor was the "Barbarossa company" a preventive war, as some publicists think.
content.title_en: The enemy stands in the East: Hitler's secret plans for a war against the Soviet Union in 1939

content.text: Inside WikiLeaks: my time at the world's most dangerous website. The revelations of WikiLeaks keep the world in mind. content.text: The floods set limits to the following: Schleswig-Holstein's coastal protection; West Coast and Elbe / Robert Stadelmann. Edited by the Schleswig-Holstein Heimatbund and the Minister of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Areas of the Land Schleswig-Holstein; Volume 2: Dithmarschen and Elbe/Elbmarschen, Islands of Trischen and Helgoland. Never in a comparable period was so much done in coastal protection as in the second half of the 20th century. The latest findings from research and new technical possibilities found their way into enormous coastal protection projects. The unique standard work on coastal protection includes the complete documentation of all land protection ponds on the Schleswig-Holstein West Coast. The present second volume covers all landslides from the Eider to the Elbe Marches to the Geesthacht/Lauenburg area as well as the islands of Trischen and Helgoland. From North to South, the individual dikes including other coastal protection structures such as barrier works, screens, banners, etc. are recorded in their prehistory, origin and development to the present status. The work examines the various aspects of coastal protection and the various aspects of the maquidial and the various aspects of the conflict.

The professor of experimental physics and football fan is known by his "shaked, not touched" (BA 1/09) in which he communicates physical facts on the basis of James Bond films. In 2006 he was present in the media with his victory formula for the football World Cup and here he also shows scientifically seriously, but always with a wink of the eye, how physical aspects affect many areas of the football game. Some are known from his own school days, some will over-examine the understanding of most fans. Besides mechanics it is also a lot about probability and statistics. content.text: Is the Church still to be saved?. What is the suffering of the Catholic Church? The 83-year-old, probably most famous church critic, Hans Küng, once again speaks and analyses his church, which is still characterized by a Roman, medieval system of rule. Sexual abuse of the clergy, anti-women and mistrust of the Evangelian Christians lead to church departures time and again. In the center of the crisis Küng sees Pope Joseph Ratzinger personally, who has missed the chance to renew the Catholic Church so far. The title is already in 18th place in the Spiegel bestseller list and should be present in well-sorted religious holdings. (Cornelia Jetter) The emeritus professor for ecumenical theology and president of the Weltethos Foundation shows how the institution Church is sick and how it can save itself from the crisis. (Cornelia Jetter)
content.title_en: Is the church still to be saved?

content.text: The biological nature of man, according to the physician/brain researcher, has been for years (BA 12/06; 12/08; 4/10), designed for cooperation and social understanding, not for aggression and violence. Aggression is neither an urge (S. Freud) nor an instinct (K. Lorenz), but a behavior controlled by the brain, which reacts like fear and flight to threats from the outside world. Just as to physical pain, the brain reacts to emotional pain: anyone who humiliates, marginalizes or disregards people exceeds their limit of pain. This is the background of Bauer's neurobiologically sound theory of aggression in the individual and in society, developed in clear language and by reference to everyday situations. If aggression has a stabilizing function afterwards, it is necessary to prevent it from turning into uncontrolled violence. For "the everyday violence" care, education and education are the most important factors of prevention; for those of "global violence", characteristics of "robotial capitalism" today, the author holds rather diffuse interventions. (2)
content.title_en: Pain limit : from the origin of everyday and global violence

content.text: On the Internet: Internet crime scene - Protect children from sexual violence. The author, active in the educational and counselling institution "Innocence in Danger", presents a guide for parents, educational professionals and other caregivers, which addresses an aspect of sexual violence on the Internet which has been neglected in the relevant literature: cyber grooming, sexual contact initiation with minors on the web, with the aim of committing crimes such as child pornographic recordings or sexual abuse on them, often also to meet with them in real life and abuse them. The author describes, based on serious sources, the entire complex: extent of cyber grooming; activities of children and adolescents on the web; forms and dissemination of sexualised violence on the web; psychology of the perpetrators, victims and environment; prevention measures in parental home and school, including addresses. - basic stock next to S. zu Guttenberg (BA 11/10) and the many advisors on the spread of child pornographic material on the Internet, such as R. Richard/B. Hilken (B.Hilken) 6/10).
content.title_en: On the Internet : Internet crime scene - Protect children from sexual violence

content.text: The book series "Fördern lernen ; Intervention" (here last R. Stein: ID-G 52/12) is primarily aimed at teachers or pedagogical specialists and describes educational support programmes and instructions for action in the respective educational field of action. Stephan Ellinger (here last ID-G 10/11) describes first what social disadvantage is, how it can be promoted by extra-school pedagogical staff and finally addresses school support in the case of social discrimination. Has similar topics like his book "Risk Children in the Full-Day School" (ID-G 37/07), however, does not only address all-day schools here. For the "normal" reader of a public library rather not suitable, therefore only recommended to a limited extent. Rather, it is aimed at libraries that focus on pedagogical literature or school libraries that have pedagogical literature in the programme for the teachers. (3 S)

content.text: Germany's most beautiful private gardens: green paradises open their garden gates. With "Dreamy private gardens" (BA 8/07) and "New dreamlike private gardens" (BA 11/09), the authors offered exclusive insights into 33 private garden paradises throughout Germany, which can also be visited regularly on the day of the "Open Garden Gates". The present volume presents the most beautiful ones again - supplemented by some new gardens - with detailed texts on the history of the creation, plant selection and design ideas as well as many personal stories and of course the beautiful photos.
content.title_en: Germany's most beautiful private gardens : green paradises open their garden gates

content.text: The introduction of the professor at Hildesheim University aims to provide students with a first access to sociology. Typical problems of the subject are presented in 5 chapters: the classification of sociology as a teaching of society, selected basic concepts such as social action, fields of concept such as socialization, inequality or culture and conceptual pairs such as community and society, capital and labour. Standard in series (see also Hartmut Rosa: "Sociological Theories", BA 2/08) is the clear didactic structure with graphics, definitions, summaries, learning control questions, further literature information and registers. In addition to the numerous introductions to sociology such as A. Nassehi (BA 6/08), A. Eder (BA 9/08), "Gesellschaft gespeichn" (BA 2/09) and, most recently, the more theoretical O. Dimbath (ID-A 34/11).

content.text: Introduction to Romance Linguistics : French, Italian, Spanish. Introduction to Romance Linguistics for Students. The author's team speaks in the preface of an "all-in-one introduction", as not only chapters on linguistic basic topics such as phonetics/phonology, morphology, semantics, syntax, pragmatics and historical development of the Romance languages would have found their place, but also chapters on literary studies, literature research and cititudialism. Following each of the 9 chapters there are exercises (solutions to this on the publisher's website) and literature indications. Definitions and terminology are highlighted for a quick search in the text. With this volume, libraries can instead be hired to introduce the various Romance languages of this cross-language work.

content.text: Biographical individual aid : Methods and working techniques. This textbook sensitises to the importance of "biographical case understanding" in individual aid and introduces concrete methods and working techniques of a reconstructively sound individual aid. Here the authors link two methodological strands of development in social work with each other: the development of individual aid based on the classic three-step and the development of a qualitative-reconstructive paradigm of case work. The linking of the two methodological strands takes place using case stories from different fields of individual aid, which were collected with the method of narrative-biographical interview.
content.title_en: Biographical individual aid : methods and working techniques

content.text: Carted national history : History atlases in international comparison ; 1860 - 1960. History atlases have shaped the history image of generations of pupils. Sylvia Schraut compares atlases from Germany, Austria, Great Britain and the USA and examines their view of world history. She refers to the intentions of editors and publishers, the respective school systems and the state of history as well as the influence of current political events and the spirit of the time. It is clear that the nationalist atlases concepts of the late 19th century have strongly influenced the history atlases until the 1960s. (Source: Text Verlagseinband / Verlag)
content.title_en: Mapped national history : International comparison of atlases of history ; 1860 - 1960

content.text: A brief introduction to system theory: a textbook and a textbook. System theory is very abstract; students of electrical, communication technology and computer science often lose the thread and thus the motivation to deal with this technique which is obligatory for their studies. This compendium summarizes the most important material (based on a one-semester lecture) concisely and intelligibly, of course with the unavoidable mathematical descriptions, but not too theoretically and without unnecessary derivations and evidence. There are certainly already some books on the subject, which are still usable, because the theory is hardly outdated. If not, and if students use the library, this should not be acquired as a matter of priority, but rather as a relatively inexpensive title. (3)
content.title_en: A brief introduction to system theory : textbook

content.text: Photo book Garden design : 400 ideas for every garden. Extensive illustrated manual on garden design with the inclusion of landscape architectural principles. Garden and landscape architect H. Braun first outlines design possibilities of formal and freely designed gardens, then presents individual design elements such as floor coverings for paths and terraces, stairs, walls, fences, pergolas and protective roofs in detail. He also deals in detail with the installation of meadow and lawn, molded wood and cut hedges, water in the garden, plant vessel, garden furniture and lighting. More than 400 colour photographs and planning drawings show extremely successful examples of gardens of different types and sizes as well as public parks and green areas. Some, but not all work steps are explained. To do this, it is necessary to use home-friendly titles such as: "The large house and garden book" (BA 6/03), P. Wirth (BA 6/04) or P. Mair (BA 3/05).

content.text: The water is a call to our vigilance. In the face of increasing flood hazards, the aim is to develop an appropriate planning and architectural competence and to put creativity into the work, because "Hochwasserschutz ist Baukultur". The Rheinkolleg chose the method of the competition as an instrument to document practical examples of high-water-conscious action. With 59 entries to the 3rd International Rhineland-Palatinate Prize of the Rheinkolleg 2008, a project spectrum from the entire Rhine basin was revealed. - The present catalogue wants to be idea-makers, fundus and work-help for planning tasks on rivers. The discussions with the projects of the catalogue and their pilot character may inspire the quality of the river landscape on the doorstep. Selected interview partners and guest contributions point to the range and topicality of the topic. "Hold water" means to awaken development potential, develop structures and new life forms that are geared towards living with the flood.
content.title_en: Remembering the Water

content.text: Elements of the New Economic Geography. The most important question of the theory of space economy is: What are the causes of the emergence, the existence and the changes of spatial economic structures? Undoubtedly, agglomerations are among the most striking structures that cannot be traced back to natural causes. The New Economic Geography answers the question of the reasons for its existence from a microeconomic total model that takes into account different regions and production sectors, heterogeneous goods and different transport costs. The present book has three objectives: First, this new paradigm is put into a dogma historical context with traditional theory of space economy and trade theory. Furthermore, the basic model of the approach is described in detail and then critically discussed. Finally, some possibilities for expansion are identified, which are able to remove some previously mentioned criticisms regarding the basic model.
content.title_en: Elements of the New Economic Geography

content.text: iPhone tips with iOS 4: [Secrets about the iPhone!]. The author already had a recommended user book for the iPad (BA 10/10), now he expands the already extensive literature on the current iPhone 4 (and his operating system iOS4). However, he does not provide a basic introduction to the device and its operation, but mainly restricts itself to topics for advanced owners of the Apple smartphone, who are already familiar with the functions and now want to get the optimum with regard to operation, configuration, media management and playback and to search for fast solutions with typical Apple errors. Eye-friendly large print, continuously colored screenshots should arrive well with all readers. As the only title to the iPhone 4 not sufficient content, but in addition to the comparable D. customer (BA 12/10) surely a welcome addition of entry titles like M. Krimmer, H. Dorsch (both BA 12/10) or S. Kelby (ID 4/11). (2)
content.title_en: iPhone tips with iOS 4 : [Secrets around the iPhone!]

content.text: Basic course Functional Analysis. Publisher's text: This book contains the basics of functional analysis developed in the first third of the 20th century.Based on concrete questions of analysis, you will learn about methods for investigating linear operators between Hilbert and Banach spaces and apply them to Fourier series, linear integral and differential equations and quantum mechanics.The book is excellently suited as a companion reading for an introductory lecture on functional analysis and also for self-study.It is very detailed and easy to understand, the concepts and results are illustrated by numerous examples and illustrations. Using many exercises you can test your understanding of the substance, using other methods to develop it independently.
content.title_en: Basic course Functional analysis

content.text: Algorithms and data structures. Standard work for the design and analysis of algorithms and data structures (most recently ID-G 32/02) was revised by the authors, but a complete revision was omitted. Therefore, a large part of the text remains unchanged. The increase in the volume of the book is based on a newly inserted chapter with further algorithm design techniques and on smaller sections, especially in the chapter on geometric algorithms. The extensive literature list remained unchanged. Students of computer science are addressed in basic and main studies. The predecessor is still applicable, but should be supplemented with the new edition. In addition to G. Saake (ID-G 8/06) and the introductory work of H.W. Lang (ID-G 5/07). (3)
content.title_en: Algorithms and data structures

content.text: Dynamic media: [Multimedia: Bild - Audio - Video - Animation]. Due to the continuous expansion of the Internet, digital dynamic media have become increasingly widely distributed. The title covers the topic of "Dynamic media" at different levels: In addition to the technical basics of the different types of non-text media (audio, image, video, 2- and 3-dimensional animation), their production (and suitable tools) is also discussed, besides didactically meaningful fields of application are described in different information contexts. The title, which is built as a textbook, is explicitly addressed to students from the fields of computer science, media information technology, web design. The descriptions are not to be understood - also in the field of practice - as concrete instructions, much more necessary steps are identified, put into a meaningful order and assigned to a functional area. Many illustrations, a literature list and an extensive glossary support the text. Conclusion: Theory-oriented textbook on basics, production, use and didactic added value of digital dynamic media. (2)
content.title_en: Dynamic media : [Multimedia: Image - Audio - Video - Animation]

content.text: The majority of the damage to the building is due to design defects and insufficient training, as the author (a civil engineer, an expert for building damage) has already pointed out several times in the "Phusch am Bau" series (last BA 9/08). After an introduction to regulations and guidelines for sealing ground-touched components, the author presents 38 damage cases of faultyly designed or executed seals on residential and commercial buildings, administrative and purpose buildings from his expert work and explains the necessary renovation measures as well as the costs for the damage elimination. With numerous colour photographs and detailed construction drawings for the faulty actual condition and for a lack-free target condition. Finally general instructions for avoiding building plaster. The advisor applies to construction planners, experts, craftsmen, jurists etc., but is also well understandable for builders or house buyers. "Lufsky - Baustufsicht von Baustichtung" (No. 46) is suitable for professionals.
content.title_en: Pfusch am Bau / Dieter Ansorge ; Vol. 1: Building sealing against moisture from the outside and inside

content.text: Measurement and integration theory. Measurement and integration theory is an indispensable tool for many areas of mathematics, such as functional analysis, real analysis or probability theory. It should therefore be taught in mathematics education in the second year of study. In this script a concise but complete representation of the most important techniques, results and examples is given, whereby a special emphasis is placed on the concepts relevant to probability theory. This includes in particular a detailed treatment of the Lebesgue measure integral, but also of the Riemann integral concept, which is of fundamental importance for stochastic analysis.
content.title_en: Measurement and integration theory

content.text: Simultaneous inconsistencies: An introduction to complexity research. The book provides insights that have been gained in recent years in disciplines such as cybernetics, system, game and network theory, as well as in the rapidly growing research field of simulation of complex systems, and are discussed under titles such as complexity research or theory of complex systems. The range of topics ranges from simpler developments such as the basis for predator-beute systems, to the basics of chaos theory, the theory of cellular machines, game and network theory, to methods of artificial learning, the theory of artificial neural networks, and the conception of self-referentiality and autopoiesis of complex systems. At the same time, the book tries to associate the Anglo-American research tradition, such as with the Santa Fe Institute, the activities of Bob Axelrod in Michigan, the efforts of Joshua Epstein at the Brookings Institution, and the investigations of Steven Strogatz and Duncan Watts, with the German systemtheoretic discussion following Niklas Luhmann.
content.title_en: Simultaneous incompatibilities : An introduction to complexity research

content.text: Places of diversity: formats, arrangements and stagings. "This collection of texts is presented as a contribution to an interdisciplinary and internationally comparative clarification of the term diversity, which is used today inflationaryly. The book is presented to scientists who research different disciplines (sociology, ethnology, psychology, education, political science, philosophy, etc.) on this topic. The book also addresses the topic of action theory and practice-oriented suggestions for experts who are involved in the design or practical work as consultants, multipliers, lecturers and trainers in administrations, authorities, educational institutions, social services, in companies and in the media programs for the reflected consideration of diversity."
content.title_en: Places of diversity : formats, arrangements and stagings

content.text: As a rule: technology and tactics at meetings, meetings and discussions. Bodies, commissions and assemblies influence our lives: In parliaments and party assemblies not only are debated - here decisions that affect everyone directly. But not only in the 'great' politics, but also in everyday life committees - e.g. city council, school conference, association meeting, owner meeting - have more influence on our lives than is often known. And not always the decision-making processes run as we wish. This book reduces the information advantage that the 'old tacticians' have ahead of you. It emerged from practice for practice: intended for all those who - whether as participants or as leaders - have to prove themselves in committees, meetings and meetings. Dr. Hermann Meier, managing director, member or chairman in committees of business and politics.
content.title_en: Rules of Procedure : Technique and tactics at meetings, meetings and discussions

content.text: Excursion into the unthinkable. "Algorithms and digital information processes are omnipresent - they nest in the smallest objects and penetrate all areas of life. The digital codes, these "understandings" (flusser), which are invisible and in the exact sense of the word "incomprehensible", were initially also considered in art as the epitome of the intangible. With their help, the resistance of the material was to be overcome and the old physical world replaced by a new virtual one, which allows the artistic idea to be realized without distortion. Whoever, as an artist, engages in the inner structures of the computer and, for example, programs himself or solders boards, for him, the abstract algorithms and digital codes transform into real artistic material. The works gathered in code and material are characterized by the fact that codes, algorithms and digital information processes are not only used for the implementation of an artistic idea, but also the inner structures of the digital machines themselves are examined."
content.title_en: Excursions into the Undingliche

content.text: Career and career planner IT und Wirtschaft 2010/2011 : For students and university graduates Industry trends - Application tips - Top employers. content.text: InDesign automates: no fear of scripting, GREP & Co. Products such as smaller brochures, the classic print prepress, Web2Print solutions are worthwhile when they are always recurring tasks (formatting, awards, corrections, etc.), even in large amounts of data such as catalogs, technical documentation or book production as well as all kinds of periodicals. The author ("instead of clicking ten times, prefer to program") presents solutions based on GREP, then uses JavaScript to program, which is used by Adobe ESTK (ExtendScript Toolkit). Practice-oriented automation examples with GREP and other scripting recipes follow, to end still workflow with Word files and the generation of EPUB files for electronic books. Many examples are referenced with web addresses, and many other sources are also referred to on the web. Currently no comparable title, or nearer to Katharina Frerichs (ID-G 33/09). A very useful and helpful title for professional users should be offered in larger collections (3).

This book is intended to facilitate searching for packages or specific commands for the creation of bibliographies. It will be shown in detail which possibilities arise. In order to have an overview of which package with which commands seems useful for your own needs, this compilation is very helpful.
content.title_en: Bibliography with LaTeX

content.text: Dr. Helene Darges-Sonnemann : successful pediatrician and entangled in Nazi crimes. Critical examination of the actions of the pediatrician Helene Sondermann, who was born in Flensburg in 1911, who during the early 40s was instrumental in the killing of children at the Children's Hospital Hamburg-Rothenburgsort and was able to continue her professional career unchecked. (S. Gülck)
content.title_en: Dr. Helene Darges-Sonnemann : successful pediatrician and involvement in Nazi crimes

content.text: The rule and exception: essays on building, planning and similar things. Building is full of rules without which this sophisticated way of playing human action would not work. But there are also habits that require critical questions: Why do we still spend time wastefully dealing with our resources, although we know it better? Why do we use arbitrary, new reconstructions to do nostalgia instead of saving what is actually present in monument-valued substance? Wolfgang Pehnt's essays (*1931 in Kassel) target architecture from various points of view, focus on thematic contexts, current tasks and historical phenomena, from which lessons could often be drawn for today. From individual aspects, this book gives an image of the past and present building as it is in the author's head - and an architectural history in revealing episodes.
content.title_en: The rule and the exception : essays on building, planning and the like

content.text: The trend back to the city marks a change in our everyday needs. Living in urban districts with a small mix of living and a diverse working environment becomes a serious alternative to the green meadow as well as to the exclusive and large-format downtown projects of the developers.
content.title_en: The everyday suitability of our cities : Interactions between urban planning and daily action

content.text: Pfusch am Bau / Dieter Ansorge; Vol. 7: Schallschutz. In the "Phusch am Bau" series, the expert and author of the building has already shown on several occasions how planning defects and insufficient training can lead to serious construction damage (most recently ID-G 19/11). This volume deals with the sickening effect of noise, outdated noise protection standards in construction, the difficult proof of sound insulation defects, building acoustics as well as effective measures against air and kick noise, noise from building systems and external noise. The detailed case examples are single-family houses, a renovated town villa, a factory building or larger residential facilities with problems caused by poorly designed or executed sound protection on stairs, ceilings, walls, exhaust ducts and integrated garages. Series available with numerous colour photos, as well as detailed construction drawings on the faulty condition of the building.
content.title_en: Pfusch am Bau / Dieter Ansorge ; Vol. 7: Sound insulation

content.text: The "Loud Light" is on the list of proposals for the most bizarre book title in 2011, but also under what the two journalists bring to light is a few bizarre things. It is about the energy saving lamp, which will finally turn off the light bulb after almost 130 years by decree without parliamentary hurdles, by virtue of the EU regulation 244/2009. However, this future will not remain uncritical, for example the NRD consumer and business magazine "Markt", which suspects that energy saving lamps release toxic substances to the room air during the operation, and the present round-up of this modern type of gas discharge lamp. The authors have extensively researched and show economic, health, social and quality of life effects of this luminescent, which are at least worth considering. In this case, hardly any argument can exist per compact fluorescent lamp before the authors. Even if one does not necessarily like to join them, the title is a profit for enlightened consumers. (Of) The energy saving lamp is examined in terms of quality of life.
content.title_en: Lying light : the dark sides of the energy saving lamp

content.text: Technical information in antiquity. Cech, who has been habilitated for montan and industrial archaeology, presents a comprehensively illustrated non-fiction book, which covers the history of ancient technology. After a very short overview of the main sources and an introductory overview of the basics (energy resources, natural science knowledge, measurement technology) the outstanding technical skills and the results of their application are presented: construction technology (approx. 110 pages), agricultural engineering, shipbuilding, mining and metallurgy, war technology (together 70 pages). An extensive annex on masses and weights, computational and construction techniques, data on water supply as well as the usual source evidence and a register conclude the well-equipped volume. This volume can close the gap between more scientific demands sufficient and already no longer baptistic representations (e.g. H. Schneider: "Introduction to the ancient history of technology", ID 37/92) and popular overviews (e.g. very inexpensive Helmut Schneider: "History of ancient technology", BA 12/07).
content.title_en: Technique in antiquity

content.text: Geothermal energy: Energy from the interior of the earth. Geothermal energy has the advantage of continuously delivering power compared to other alternative energies. Subsequent factors are high development costs, lack of geological findings and possible earthquakes. Up to now, only a few power plants are working in Germany, much more are planned. Private use is widespread (cf. R. Hoffmann: "Heizen mit der Heizpumpe", BA 3/09). Apart from the more special P. Loose: "Earth Heat Use" (ID-G 12/07), there is hardly any new literature. Therefore, the systematic, in addition to deep and shallow geothermal energy, environmental balances, the earthquake risk and some power plants dealing with large libraries are recommended. The target group includes students, engineers and geologically pre-formed readers. Unfortunately, the summaries of the individual chapters are not as exemplary as the introduction. Geothermal energy is treated in comprehensive representations of alternative energies, most recently in "Energies der Zukunft" (ID-A 14/12) and J. Winterhagen (ID-A 11/12).
content.title_en: Geothermal energy : Energy from the Earth's interior

content.text: User-oriented demand planning: Process quality for sustainable buildings. Have we got what we ordered? - a natural question when a product is delivered or a restaurant visit. What is normal in other areas of life, namely the quality and quality of a product, is handled surprisingly casually in large real estate projects. Although the area of a building is defined at the beginning of a project and meticulously pursued, the actual functionality, quality and thus the performance of a building is often described insufficiently. Companies then move into buildings that look good but do not fit them - and what they do -. Demand planning is all too often confused with the creation of a room and area list. This early phase is crucial for the process and product quality and ultimately for the sustainability of the building. It offers you the possibility of optimization and saving as no other of the subsequent planning phases. The book User-oriented demand planning is aimed at builders, users, planners, facility managers and project managers who are involved in creating a demand planning. It provides you with theoretical and practical knowledge, in order not to define the quantity in a comprehensive way, but to ensure that the quality of the project is ordered and to ensure that it is fully.
content.title_en: User-oriented needs planning : Process quality for sustainable buildings

content.text: The IT service industry has been in a state of crisis for five years with shrinking project sizes and falling prices. This book deals with how this crisis can be overcome by its own strength. Service and sales managers not only in the IT industry are being sensitized that the profitable future of service companies does not depend on their size, but on their service design and engineering strength: in the future, not just the largest companies will have the greatest success, but the companies that have the most top forces in terms of service distribution, project management and technology. These paths from the crisis are described by a practitioner as concrete recommendations for action in the individual business sectors, such as sales, product development, personnel and management.
content.title_en: Leading IT service companies : successfully shaping the future

content.text: Descriptive statistics : Practical introduction With tasks and solutions. This introductory textbook shows the entire process of a statistical study, starting from data collection, processing and analysis of the data to interpretation of the results, and focuses on the application and practical implementation of statistical methods. The author places particular emphasis on a clear, understandable and comprehensible description. To this end, all methods are presented in a clearly structured form, step by step and in detail. Exercise tasks and control questions for all chapters deepen the material. For the 9th edition, all practical examples have been updated or replaced by current case studies.
content.title_en: Descriptive statistics : Practical introduction with tasks and solutions

content.text: Chroma Design Architecture & Art in Color. "Designers and architects have to decide on colours every day. But how do you find the groundbreaking inspiration? The right color? How do other designers or artists deal with the theme? Under the title "Chroma", the Greek word for color, the present picture book provides answers to these questions and makes clear that color is not just decoration, but also one of the central problems of creative work. In doing so, "Chroma" relies on the sensual experience of color, inspired and seduced with extraordinary projects from industrial products to color field painting. The book presents both the works of younger designers such as Stefan Diez and Arik Levy as well as the famous artists such as Ellsworth Kelly. All works are large-format and in a kind of color gradient assigned to the chapters monochromatic", "multichromatic" and "achromatic". The spectrum includes all conceivable tones and combinations, from luminous, colorful over subtle color compositions to black and white contrasts. Another chapter analyses the work with outstanding artists, and the artist's work on colour break, and the artist's background.
content.title_en: Chroma Design Architecture & Art in Color

content.text: Do not panic about the tax consultant exam: how to pass the tax consultant exam safely. The tax consultant exam is particularly feared because of the numerous and complex audit contents. This book shows you how to pass the difficult tax consultant exam - in writing and orally - objectively confident. The memory and learning training tailored to you helps you to keep the extremely extensive expertise for the exam easily available. Thus you learn from technical examples, your memory ability up and expand, to read technical texts faster and how to keep your oral lecture completely free.
content.title_en: Don't panic about the tax consultant exam: How to pass the tax consultant exam safely

content.text: Data and information quality: On the way to Information Excellence. The first German book on data and information quality in the second, updated and extended edition. Scientifically based and written by practitioners, the current state of research and practical application is presented, in the important facets of this important topic. A must for all IT professionals. The content: Information quality ? Fundamentals ? Methods ? Techniques ? Tools ? Organization ? Practical examples ? Outlook The target group: - Corporate management and IT managers, e.g. in banks and insurance - Teachers and researchers - Data specialists The editors: Prof. Dr. Knut Hildebrand, University teacher at Weihenstephan-Triesdorf University of Applied Sciences, research focus master data quality, member of the Gesellschaft für Informations- und Datenqualität e.V. (DGIQ) Dr. Marcus Gebauer, Head of Department Information Technology Hannover Rück AG, founding member and chairman of the board of the German Society for Information and Data Quality e.V. (DGIQ) Prof. Dr.-Ing. Holger Hinrich for Research at the University of Applied Sciences and Sciences and Humanities.
content.title_en: Data and information quality : Towards information excellence

content.text: Generational education. Generational education is currently a major research topic within scientific education. In the cross- and longitudinal section, the term has numerous connections to central questions of educational research. In this volume, renowned educators write about generation in pedagogical contexts, generational relationships and intergenerative education, generation and social change, and generations in further education, thus opening up a new discourse. Dr. Thomas Eckert is a professor at the Institute of Pedagogy at the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München. PD Dr. Aiga von Hippel is a research associate at the Institute of Pedagogy at the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München. Dr. Manuel Pietraß is a professor of educational science with a focus on media education at the University of the Bundeswehr München. Dr. Bernhard Schmidt represents the professorship for further education and media at the TU Braunschweig. Generational education is currently opening a new research topic within scientific education.
content.title_en: Generational education

content.text: Medial migrants: Mediatization and the communicative networking of the diaspora. Media and migration is a hotly discussed topic. But how important are media for migrants really? What has changed with the establishment of the Internet, mobile phone and social web? What importance do media have for the communitization of the diasporas? These are questions that are dealt with in the study 'Medial migrants'. A multi-layered analysis shows that the communicative networking of migrants across the various media is very different depending on whether they are more origin, ethno or world-oriented. Thus, the study shows that one must think 'integration through media' differently than has happened so far.
content.title_en: Medial migrants : Mediatization and the communicative networking of the diaspora

content.text: Emotional interaction design: gestures and facial expressions of interactive systems. Multitouch interfaces and instrument-based input techniques à la Wii controllers determine the handling of digital devices today and in the future, embedded in multimodal and multisensory environments. Interaction between humans and technology is considered in this book as an interplay between gestures and facial expressions - and also on the side of the system. For the success of a fault-free, safe and satisfactory interface operation, a transparent gesture control and an adequate feedback behavior of the system are an indispensable prerequisite. Current examples from consumer electronics and research provide suggestions for own projects. With the sequence and interaction diagrams developed by the author, interaction designers and application developers can solve the problem of how gestures can be defined from the functional requirements and can be coupled with a coherent system feedback to create a positive user experience (user experience).
content.title_en: Emotional interaction design : gestures and facial expressions of interactive systems

content.text: Sicily in the mirror of ancient testimonies : a cultural historical travel companion. Publisher's info: Traveling to Sicily also means traveling to one of the origins of our Western culture. In Sicily, the wealth of Greek culture unfolds: temples and theatres testify to the power and splendor of the ancient cities, the Villa Casale in Piazza Armerina is an impressive testimony to the refined civilization of the Roman Late Age with its magnificent mosaics
content.title_en: Sicily in the mirror of ancient testimonies : a cultural historical travel companion

content.text: Oversexed and underfucked! This certainly pointedly formulated and provocative diagnosis of the present state of 'sexual desire' assumes that the pleasure of the sexes has largely disappeared from each other today and that the supposed, essentially media-borne, oversexualization has a significant part to play in it. And it implies that 'we' all know (want) what good sex is. Along with these guidelines, the present work of the social construction of lust goes to the bottom. It analyses the ideas of 'successful sexuality' from the point of view of science as well as the recipe knowledge of successful sex counselors from 1950 to today. The sexual scripts 'reconstructed' from these sources (Dornröschen-Skript, Ken&Barbie-Skript, Adam&Eva-Skript and I&I-Skript) point to the fact that from the representation of sexual intercourse as a drama, rather than 'spraying' I describe a 'spraying' as a 'spraying' rather as a 'spraying'.
content.title_en: Oversexed and underfucked : about the social construction of lust

content.text: Oldenburg places of remembrance: from the castle to the hell of the north, from Count Anton Günther to Horst Janssen. At first glance, Grünkabel and Pinkel, Count Anton Günther and the Carl von Ossietzky University Oldenburg do not have much in common. For the Oldenburgers, these three things are inseparably part of their city and the associated memories. The "Oldenburg places of remembrance" studied in this volume are not only places in the material sense, but they represent "long-lived, generations-extended crystallization points of collective memory and identity" (Francois / Schulze). What has its fixed place in the memory budget of Oldenburg? Who was interested in directing the memories in a certain direction or letting things get forgotten? All these questions are examined by the following essays.
content.title_en: Oldenburg places of remembrance : from the castle to the hell of the north, from Count Anton Günther to Horst Janssen

content.text: Vinland: the voyages of discovery of Vikings from Iceland to Greenland and America; Erik der Rote, Bjarni Herjulfsson, Leif Eriksson and Thorfinn Karlsefni. In contemporary complaints, Vikings are described as terrible and inhuman beings, but most were primarily seafaring traders and farmers. Looking for new livelihoods, they came from Scandinavia's coasts to Iceland to Greenland and wanted to settle there as farmers and traders, which they also tried on the North American coast. With the excavation of a base camp of Vikings on Newfoundland, the early medieval sources and sagas of Erik dem Roten, Leif dem Glücklichen und and other explorers are again at the center of scientific and journalistic treatises. In a comparative critical view of the font sources around Vinland and taking into account recent archaeological findings, North European historian Jörg-Peter Findisen outlines the current state of knowledge about the voyages of Icelanders and Greenlanders to North America. (Verlagstext) (S.)
content.title_en: Vinland : the Vikings' voyages from Iceland to Greenland and America; Erik der Rote, Bjarni Herjulfsson, Leif Eriksson and Thorfinn Karlsefni

content.text: Bacula : Backup strategies and solutions in the network; [Bacula Appliance on DVD]. Bacula is an open source solution running in the background, which can also backup and restore data in heterogeneous networks. It is important for companies of any size. Bacula is referred to as one of the 3 most known open source backup utilities on the Internet. The book here is the first book on Bacula at all. The author organizes annual Bacula conferences, which are of great importance for the Bacula community. The book is addressed in the first line of system administrators. The book begins with the components of Bacula and their collaboration. In particular, it is pointed out to the Catalog, a database system about the backups performed. It follows explanations about installation and the different adjustments by means of adapted configuration. Then, the practical work with Bacula is explained using many case examples. The experimental testing of Bacula is facilitated by a pre-installed Bacula system that is fully operational on the DVD.
content.title_en: Bacula : Backup strategies and solutions in the network; [Bacula Appliance on DVD]

content.text: Diercke - Learning with GIS : from WebGIS to Desktop GIS. Learning with GIS is becoming increasingly important in current geography lessons. Overall concepts for teaching GIS skills are, however, still rare. The book "Diercke - Learning with GIS" is intended to contribute to the promotion of GIS skills in geography lessons, which are taught using the example of concrete teaching examples. The book is based on an overall concept for the introduction of GIS skills developed by the author for schools in Rhineland-Palatinate and tested in teaching and teacher training events. It tries to make it as easy as possible for teachers as well as for students.
content.title_en: Diercke - Learn with GIS : from WebGIS to Desktop GIS

content.text: The author of this book is first-line students of computer science at universities and software developers in practice. He wants to make it clear that software development is a largely standardized, methodological development process. In his book he deals in detail with the individual steps of software development and sets out proven design and architecture patterns for each step, which can be used as building blocks. Running examples allow a good examination of the extent to which these patterns can be used for own projects. A special focus is on testing finished projects. The book hardly addresses more specific questions such as designing user interfaces or dialogue techniques. Didactically very well designed: "learning boxes" allow a targeted repetition of the material; "warning boxes" provide hints to avoid typical serious beginner mistakes. Many simpler exercise tasks at the end of the individual chapters. - Well applicable in addition to the comprehensive basic work of T. Posch (ID-G 25/11). (3)
content.title_en: Methods and Architectures of Software Technology

content.text: Halal : Integration into QM systems. Halal food regulations for various food groups and additives - Halal certification - Halal logos - Haram Analysis and Critical Control Points (HraCCP) - Halal production - using the example of milk and meat products - Avoid cross-contamination - Training of employees.

"It is a compact textbook for students or a repetitorium for engineers in practice - intelligible written and yet accurate. As far as from the discussion on the 1st edition (ID-G 52/05), which is now a new edition. Highly revised and extended by 175 pages (last BA 1/02). Used as a learning material for the preparation for the Master's Test in the automotive engineering trade, is very practical and equipped with numerous schematics, sketches and schematic illustrations. Here the basics of automotive electrical/electronics, digital technology and control and control technology are taught according to the master's regulations (2001) and the ZDK (Central Association of the German automotive trade). The new edition takes into account the rapid development in electronics and microelectronics and should replace the preliminary editions.
content.title_en: The safe way to master test in the automotive trade / Technical Academy of the Automotive Industry (TAK): Electrical, Electronic

content.text: User's manual Guest : Enthuse guests, sell them in a clever way. Title mainly for professionals in the area of gastronomy/hotels, who conveys the pyschological background knowledge for working with guests and customers
content.title_en: User's guide Guest : Enthuse guests, sell them in a clever way

content.text: Transport policy: An interdisciplinary introduction. The special feature of transport policy is that it is placed in many other social fields with the cross-sectional theme of transport and is influenced by them. Accordingly, this volume brings together experts from various disciplines, each of which devotes itself to different dimensions of transport. The aim is to present the complex structure of the effect of transport and to convey a feeling for the possibilities and limits of transport policy. The scientific transport policy is a domain of economic sciences. So far, an introduction to the transport policy field has been lacking, which is an interdisciplinary approach and can also be used by non-specialists and students of neighbouring disciplines without prior knowledge. The volume offers a general introduction to scientific transport policy, which is a cross-disciplinary approach and in particular offers students.
content.title_en: Transport policy: An interdisciplinary introduction

content.text: Alternative energy technology. The main content of this book is, in addition to technically important interpretation and safety criteria for conventional, nuclear and regenerative energy systems, the recognition, assessment and consideration of the repercussions caused by the human economy, the fundamental problem of the non-quantifiable nature of environmental decision criteria and ways out of this dilemma. In addition, socio-political aspects are brought into play, which lead self-organizing from the Darwinian economy to a humane economic process, which is currently fully exploiting the ecological minimal principle. The clear presentation of the facts with the help of simple mathematical models requires only elementary knowledge of mathematics and the relevant disciplines. Numerous tasks are attached to the deepening and exercise with the indication of the way of solution.
content.title_en: Alternative energy technology

content.text: University Inventor Law : A handbook for science and practice. With the abolition of the university teacher privilege in 2002, new tasks are being carried out on German universities. Research results must now be examined for their usability, patent applications made and payment-effective customers found. Furthermore, completely new questions arise regarding the freedom of teaching and research, the recruitment of third-party funds and the cooperation with non-university research institutions as well as the industry. The present handbook wants to answer the mentioned questions in the field of conflict of public service law, university law on the one hand, and the law of intellectual property on the other. The work is aimed at the practice in universities, but also in industry and legal advice.
content.title_en: University Inventor Law : A Handbook for Science and Practice

content.text: The urban spaces are both transit and contact spaces. Differences are being met, life plans are being negotiated, global developments are being interpreted locally in a variety of ways and transferred into urban everyday life. The city is not only a background or stage for such processes, but also a generator and catalyst of mobility. The contributions of this volume show this mobile diversity and the social and political handling of it from different perspectives. Dr. Wolf-Dietrich Bukow is Professor of Education and Cultural Sociology and Managing Director of the Research Centre for Intercultural Studies (FiSt) at the Faculty of Human Sciences of the University of Cologne. Dr. Gerda Heck is a fellow in the research project 'Global Prayers. Redemption and Liberation in the City', which is being led by Viadrina University Frankfurt/Oder together with the HKW (Berlin) and metroZones e.V. (Berlin). She is also a member of the Research Center for Intercultural Studies (FiSt). Dr. Erika Schulze is a student at the University of Applied Sciences at the University of Cologne and the University of Applied Sciences and Humanities is an unresolved member of the Faculty of Applied Sciences.

content.text: Oversexed and underfucked: About the social construction of lust. Oversexed and underfucked! content.text: The theory of reality is based on the prerequisites of all knowledge and opinions. This also applies to our ideas about the current events that the media report on. However, the assumption is mostly wrong that the media only report on events that happen independently of their coverage. In fact, many events that the media report on are a consequence of their previous coverage, and others would not happen if the actors did not expect the media to report on them. Also, the assumption that the media report on a series of similar events because they are currently increasing is often wrong, because the media report on similar events more frequently after key events, even if they do not happen more frequently than before. The relationship between reality, representation, perception and behaviour is complex for the above mentioned and a number of other reasons, but follows recognisable rules. In this volume, theoretical and empirical studies show how and why the mass media contribute to the construction of social reality and what can be concluded for practice.
content.title_en: Realism constructions

content.text: The Wiesbaden program: Johannes Otzen and the history of a type of church between 1891 and 1930. The Protestant church building of the second half of the 19th century was governed by the Eisenach Regulativ. It wanted to lead the people to the right worship by means of an architecture that preserved the "dignity of the traditional". - - The "Wiesbadener Program" of 1891 represented the counter-strike to this regulatory, for whose first architectural formation Johannes Otzen was responsible. He placed the quality of hearing and seeing at the centre of his efforts and assigned church music the place that was just to its importance. Thus, he proclaimed a modern understanding of the function against the purposefulness of historism as an affective one. - - - Despite liturgical differences between Lutherans and Reformed people, a large number of churches were built up by 1918 according to the Wiesbaden program. - - This book orders the buildings that were built into typological rows and describes the sustainable effect that Otzen's spatial creation had on the architectural history.
content.title_en: The Wiesbadener Program : Johannes Otzen and the history of a church building type between 1891 and 1930

Busse: "Die Ernährungsdiktatur", BA 8/10, exciting analysis and consumer appeal, and - as tireless critic of neoliberalism - Jean Ziegler: "We let them starve" (ID-A 49/12). The philosopher H. Lemke, who teaches in Lüneburg and Salzburg, shares the criticism of these and other authors of the structures and consequences of industrial food production on the one hand and the consumer behaviour that corresponds to the strategies of food companies on the other. He is concerned with the realization of gastrosophy (political philosophy of food), that food is political. Given the complex global and individual consequences of our eating behaviour, social change and a new ethical eating culture must be goals which he sees as a result of a multitude of movements "from below". Capitalistically, in its philosophical deepening above and above title, very understandable and well readable. (2)

content.text: The house: Roman. Forts. von "Das Zimmer". Andreas, who had been raised in Bad Nauheim with his grandmother, has now to move to his parents' new house in Friedberg. "Problem-Andreas", who has hardly spoken as a toddler, is here completely retreating into his own world. Breakfast in the bright kitchen is a horror to him, the first day in kindergarten is also the last and the school is a single path of suffering... (Connie Haag) The self-poverty hero bears the kindergarten only one day, then he remains traumatized at home. But this home is no longer long, because the parents build. content.text: The desert or paradise: from the renaturation of threatened landscapes to aqua culture and biotope construction to urban gardening. S. Holzer, self-proclaimed "Agrar-Rebell" with Bergbergernhof in Salzburger Land, spreads his convictions and his practice on the management form permaculture multifaceted (see his experiences on herbal healing "Wo ein Wille, da ein Weg", ID-G 16/06). The concept of permaculture aims at the creation of self-regulating, sustainably functioning natural cycles. Holzer is the focus of this work on renaturation (natural water management) and biotope construction (forest). The topics of world nutrition/self-sufficiency, urban gardening and biotope-friendly family animal husbandry also have their place. The richly illustrated volume contains thoughtful practice tips for gardeners, farmers and land owners. The continuous self-marketing (training courses, projects) in word and image are indicated by the G.
content.title_en: Desert or Paradise: from the renaturation of threatened landscapes to aqua culture and biotope construction to urban gardening

content.title_en: Niklas Luhmann on the introduction

content.text: The Islamic Year : Times and festivals. Those who want to understand a foreign religion or culture should first familiarize themselves with their festivals and their conceptions of time. This applies in a special way to Islam, whose calendar differs greatly from ours. This book introduces in general-clearly in the Islamic lunar calendar, the meaning of the individual months and days of the week as well as the annual census. It describes the most important festivals such as the Sacrifice Festival or the Iranian New Year, the pilgrimage to Mecca and the fasting month Ramadan. Annemarie Schimmel masterfully understands how to draw from the rich treasure of her personal experiences in many areas of the Islamic world and at the same time to tell the history of the festivals by using scarcely known source material.
content.title_en: The Islamic Year : Times and festivals

content.text: Places, paths, visions : Current approaches to tourism geography. Travel as a cultural practice is a reflection of social conditions. If a society changes, its travel behaviour changes. Against this background, the first decade of the 21st century was characterized by numerous developments that pose great challenges to tourism and tourism research alike. In this volume, selected tourist trends and their spatial implications are traced, with supply and demand-side analyses, the motives, experiences and action options examined and future perspectives explored. The contributions illustrate that established destinations and leisure offers are exposed to enormous pressure for innovation due to changes in tourism demand, but for emerging target areas they offer the opportunity to position themselves on the market.
content.title_en: Places, paths, visions : Current approaches to tourism geography

content.text: Our technical staff: 350 monuments and testimonies of German technical culture. Sorted by federal states, around 350 mostly historical technical monuments, museums or testimonies of German technical culture are presented here. (LK/SH: Preisler) Sorted by federal states, around 350, mostly historical technical monuments, museums or testimonies of German technical culture are presented here. The spectrum is diverse: large and spectacular such as mines, lifts or canals, but also small locations such as a garden dwarf or a harmonica museum, Norddeich radio, a water-screw wheel etc. are listed; the time frame ranges from the early days to the present day. Some monuments, such as the old Elbe tunnel or the Westfalenhalle 1 are used to this day or serve as a framework for cultural events. A wealth of different sights and yet understandable completeness should not be expected. The scope of the entries ranges from half a page to the double page with a full page picture, but always with at least one coloured illustration and the inscription of the address and homepage. With a local register and overview map. In this range no comparison is possible.
content.title_en: Our technician : 350 monuments and testimonies of German technology culture

content.text: The survey of the population of the rural districts in Germany 1995 to 2008. This report provides a comparison of the structure and development of the employment between different types of districts for the years 1995 to 2008. The focus is on disparities between rural and non-rural districts. It can be seen, among other things, that in the old Länder the most sparsely populated rural districts could not keep pace with the increase in employment in the rest of the counties. In the new Länder, the number of employed persons has decreased in most of the county types; only in the core cities of the agglomeration areas and in rural districts in urban areas the growth rate is positive. The summary of selected recent research contributions on regional disparities in employment development shows that a large number of factors can be blamed for development differences. The main role seems to play in this process, which can usually be only difficult to take into account in empirical estimates.
content.title_en: Employment in rural districts in Germany 1995 to 2008

content.text: The church, which has been occupied by every village, every city for almost two thousand years, is in danger of being put to rest as a result of demographic change. Will we in the future have to pass by a church that has been used to the library, sports hall or restaurant in search of a consecrated church in order to find a church? - Teachers and students at the HAWK in Holzminden have been dealing with the topic of church and change for many years, here in particular with the question of the extended use of churches. What chance of a re-dedicated place of storage for urns is represented in the publication of the church as a final resting place? Columns in churches and chapels and reflected in the context of the change of Sepulcral culture. - Columbaria, also called burial churches, grave churches or urn churches, need a philosophy that is aligned with the house of God, which can clearly be distinguished from urban models. To this end, 18 columbaria, usually in urban parishes, is presented as an individual concept for the church of the church.
content.title_en: Churches as a final resting place? : Columbaria in churches and chapels

content.title_en: Microbiological methods: an introduction to basic working techniques

content.text: This volume for Bachelor students offers a new look at the function and didactics of grammar in German lessons. Grammar is considered here as a traditional, not modernized field of knowledge, which leads to problems in teaching and the frustration of learners and teachers. In 14 chapters or learning units the grammatical models and terms are discussed, the tripartite traps are shown in school everyday life and better suitable understanding and mediation paths are developed. The focus is on a functional understanding of language and grammar based on experiences in foreign language lessons. Each learning unit ends with several exercises and literature recommendations. Even for non-Germanists interesting, as provided with convincing examples, but also demanding. No comparison title known.
