content.text: Basic knowledge Electrical engineering : DC, AC and AC. Klappentext: This textbook and exercise book is the basis of electrical networks of DC and AC technology in an easy to understand but accurate form. The compactness of the book and the didactic structure of the material, which gradually leads the reader from the simplest DC circuits to complicated AC circuits and finally to three-phase systems, are to be emphasized. More than 280 illustrations facilitate the understanding of the electrical engineering context. Many very detailed and explanatory examples give certainty when calculating networks. The 3rd edition is revised and further improved by the implementation of numerous reader requests and suggestions. In addition, the 3rd edition contains a new section of the section "Driving Current Systems". In addition, the book offers tasks with detailed solutions on the Internet as an online service on the publishing homepage www.viewegteubner.de.
content.title_en: Basic knowledge Electrical engineering : DC, AC and AC

content.text: Applied statistics with R : An introduction for economists and social scientists. The aim of this textbook is to enable the reader to evaluate data in a meaningful way as quickly as possible. The focus is on topics for which there is a demand, especially in business practice. Reiner Hellbrück shows how data can be collected online, how the raw data obtained in this way can be processed with a spreadsheet program and then evaluated and graphically processed by the use of the statistics program R. Control questions and concrete tasks with solutions strengthen the acquired knowledge. The second edition takes into account in particular the importance of measurement and the topic of co-integration. In addition, the author has added another possibility for installing additional packages in Unix systems.
content.title_en: Applied statistics with R : An introduction for economists and social scientists

content.text: Visible concrete shanks : Expert classification, defect removal, concrete repair and concrete cosmetics. Visible concrete - or visible concrete? Planning and execution errors are presented on approx. 90 examples. The appearance and cause of damage are analysed. Afterwards these planning and execution errors are described from the expert's point of view and classified with good respect. From a competent professional point of view, the author gives valuable information on the prevention of exposed concrete shanks.
content.title_en: Visible concrete shanks : Expert classification, defect removal, concrete repair and concrete cosmetics

content.text: Touristization of spaces: Cultural studies and sociological studies on the construction of spaces. Tourism spaces do not exist in themselves. Only the equipment with tourist infrastructure and its use makes spaces become tourist spaces. As tourist spaces they gain a symbolic charge, by which self- and world conditions can be read, which are already found in other social areas and are now projected on spaces. Tourismification is therefore a spatialization of the ideas and structures associated with self- and world relations. Dr. Karlheinz Wöhler is professor in the Institute of Urban and Cultural Space Research at Leuphana University Lüneburg Tourism spaces do not exist in themselves. Only the equipment with tourist infrastructure and its use makes spaces become tourist spaces. As tourist spaces they gain a symbolic charge, by means of which self- and world relations can be read, which can already be found in other social areas and are now projected on spaces.
content.title_en: Touristification of spaces : Cultural and sociological studies on the construction of spaces

content.text: The parties after the 2009 Bundestag election. With the 2009 Bundestag election, the German party system has been changing type for the first time since the German Federal Republic existed. If it has been part of the type of party systems with two-party dominance, it is now a pluralistic system. In addition, in the first year after the election, dramatic changes in the political mood have taken place, which mainly concern the smaller parties. The book provides a systematic inventory of these developments. In individual chapters on all relevant parties and a series of cross-sectional analyses, the following questions are addressed: Are the Greens developing into a People's Party? How does the FDP deal with its fall after the Bundestag election? Are the People's Groups at the end? Are there new coalition options in the party system? How do the parties choose their candidates for Bundestag elections and what election strategies do they apply?
content.title_en: The parties after the 2009 Bundestag election

content.text: The handbook of social science data analysis provides a comprehensive presentation of multivariate analysis methods in over 40 chapters. The handbook focuses on data analysis, regression analysis methods for cross- and distance-section data as well as scaling methods. It also deals with OLS, logistic and robust regression, structural equation models, multi-level, panel, event data and time series analysis, MDS and rapid models. In addition, many newer methods are presented, such as multiple imputation, boat traps, analysis of latent classes and propensity score matching. Each chapter begins with a generally understandable introduction. It follows a presentation of the mathematical-statistical bases. Finally, each procedure is presented using a social science example. The contributions end with hints of typical application errors and an commented literature recommendation.
content.title_en: Manual of social science data analysis

content.text: Questionnaire: a workbook. This book is a 'practice book' in the truest sense of the word. It is intended to help researchers who want to use social science surveys in their empirical research. It is intended to provide help in the development of their questionnaires, in concrete and detailed terms. The book simulates questionnaire advice, as the author has done for many years at the Center for Surveys, Methods and Analysis (ZUMA) in Mannheim, very practical and written in such a way that readers can work with it when developing a questionnaire, with many examples of how to do something wrong and how to do it right. After a short introduction to the cognitive psychology and communicative foundations of the survey, a variety of methodological aspects of a questionnaire are worked out, from types of questions, types of scales and the formulation of questionnaire questions to a good cover page, to survey aids and to the layout of questionnaires, all illustrated by examples from the survey practice. Rolf Porst is a scientific employee at GESIS - Leibniz Institute for Social Sciences in Mannheim and there, where his focus on data collection in the field of empirical research is now on the topic of project research.
content.title_en: Questionnaire : A workbook

content.text: Guide for construction experts : Legal basis ; expert opinions ; liability. The book answers all important questions about the function of a construction expert, such as the work in court, the preparation of an expert opinion, the questions of remuneration and liability. The 3rd edition has been revised and takes into account the current case law.
content.title_en: Guide to construction experts : legal basis ; opinions ; liability

content.text: Operational controlling based on IT-based cost accounting. The contents of the textbook are operational controlling using the classical cost accounting tool. First, the basics and tasks of operational controlling and its anchoring in operational accounting are presented. In this context, the author explicitly addresses the question of information supply and embedding in operational IT systems with reference to SAP software. Subsequently, the sub-areas of operational controlling are explained in detail with their instruments. In the area of general cost controlling, the reference to IT-technical implementation with the SAP software is constantly established by the formulation of necessary requirements and the integration of appropriate screen masks.
content.title_en: Operational controlling based on IT-based cost accounting

content.text: Event Communities : the Fusion Festival and its visitors. The book analyses the social community of visitors to a Techno Event: the Fusion Festival. The festival visit as a cultural practice shows what things and actions the participants attach importance to. In this context, the distinction between everyday life and common actions are decisive for the extraordinary experience. Community(s) are not constituted during the festival by shared interests, but by common actions and common feelings. Due to this fragile basis, some communities decay as quickly as they emerged.
content.title_en: Event Communities : the Fusion Festival and its Visitors

content.text: The small black: young people's car dreams as a challenge for future management. Small, fast, cheap, the desire car of the young generation. Important accessories: a powerful music system. The preferred colour: black. Sure: environmental compatibility also plays a role - but only if the car does not become more expensive. These are only some results from 363 surveys and 30 deep interviews with young people and young adults about their mobility and especially about the car of the future. But even these results represent a considerable irritation for the strategic future management - they are extremely conventional and provide little impulses. But that is only at first glance irritating. Because the young people simply turn the matter around: they expect innovative technological solutions from the companies, which guarantee them a problem-free individual mobility tomorrow too. Thus the car companies will have to play a far more active role in the placement of innovations in the customer's consciousness than before. The success, as the study shows, will depend to a great extent on how these innovations fit into conventional everyday life.
content.title_en: The Little Black : Young People's Car Dreams as a Challenge for Future Management

content.text: Online opinion leaders in the fashion market: The influence of Web 2.0 on purchasing decisions. The authors show that buying decisions in the fashion sector are influenced by other users in discussion forums, whereby the degree of influenceability is correlated in particular with the strength of orientation to other people and the frequency of asking for advice. Gesa Ahrens, Master of Arts (BWL, FH Kiel) and advertising clerk currently works as a trainee in marketing sales. Dr. Matthias Dressler is Professor of Marketing and Management at the Department of Economics at Kiel University of Applied Sciences. Do online opinion leaders influence the purchasing decisions of other internet users in the fashion market? The authors consult 402 participants in selected discussion forums about their purchasing habits. They prove that buying decisions in the fashion sector are influenced by other users in discussion forums, whereby the degree of influenceability is correlated in particular with the strength of orientation to other people and the frequency of asking for advice. The trust in the advisor is particularly high when this is assessed by opinion seekers as a similar to their own attitudes and values.
content.title_en: Online opinion leader in the fashion market : The influence of Web 2.0 on purchasing decisions

content.text: Elements of international media studies: An introduction to innovative concepts. content.text: The contribution of universities to the development of a region as a "knowledge region". The study of knowledge-based effects of universities on their region is based on a comprehensive literature evaluation and two case studies. Methodically, such effects can be only poorly understood - case studies (with a high proportion of hermeneutic interpretation) and econometric studies (with a narrow variable basis) dominate. While Anglo-Saxon research is primarily interested in the contribution of universities to "regional innovation systems" and in "entrepreneurial university" (patent production, spin-off generation), German studies focus on knowledge transfer and university contribution to regional development. Restrictions are primarily due to the insufficient incentives for university members, in the conflict between scientific reputation requirements and business confidentiality requirements, and in part also to the lack of university autonomy as well as to the still insufficient receptiveness and partly also to the ability of regional economies. In general, the state of research is still unsatisfactory.

On the other hand, it is the systematic attempt to reduce obstructive structures in education, especially in the context of inclusive education. At the interface between the standardisation of child development and the establishment of an inclusive education system for all children, the critical analysis of Dana-Kristin Marks begins. content.text: 25 years of the METEOR research vessel and its history. Folding text: The German research vessel METEOR celebrates its 25th anniversary in 2011. Despite its age, METEOR is one of the most powerful ships in Germany and in use worldwide thanks to continuous modernizations. Almost everyone knows one of the many fascinating documentations about marine research from television. FS METEOR is often there, because on it multidisciplinary expeditions are carried out on all world seas. Reason enough for the editors and 24 well-known authors from the different disciplines of marine science and seafaring to look behind the scenes and present the ship and its history. The contributions show the whole spectrum of modern scientific methods at sea. This ranges from standard instruments of marine research, which have been used for several hundred years, to the modern marine bottom drill and autonomous diving robots. Furthermore, an insight into the laboratory work and the everyday life of the seaman is taught on board of scientists and crew in wind and weather. In addition, the construction and history of the METEOR FS is shown with rare historical recordings and plans. The captain is interested in the development of the sea ship.
content.title_en: 25 years of FS METEOR : a research vessel and its history

content.text: War machines: robots in military use. Robots have long since proved indispensable for the main forces in the fighting in Afghanistan and Iraq. However, in 20 years the first of them could autonomously decide on the use of deadly weapons. This would complete a development that took its starting point in the First World War: the war machines would have been completely emancipated by man. "Hans Arthur Marsiske compiles in this volume very carefully selected, versatile texts, such as a conversation with Rafael Capurro about the photo from the situation room of the White House on the occasion of the attack on Osama bin Laden... The present volume sheds light on the topic from the perspective of social and natural scientists, philosophers and writers. He shows how necessary it is to bring the uncontrolled dynamics of the new arms race into public political discussion.

content.text: Secret space projects since 1957. Everything is presented in a short, competent manner with numerous pictures, illustrations and technical details, unfortunately without documentation of the sources. Further extensions are planned. content.text: The Russian is one who loves birch: Roman. Masha is young and idiosyncratic, she is Azerbaijani, Jewish, and if necessary also Turkish and French. As an immigrant she had to experience languagelessness early in Germany. Now she speaks five languages fluently and a few more as "like the ballerman tourists German". She is planning her career at the UN when her friend Elias becomes seriously ill. She is in despair of fleeing to Israel and is finally caught up with her own past. With perfect balance between tragedy and comedy and with a remarkable sense of the essential Olga Grjasnowa tells the story of a generation that knows no borders but has no home. Masha is a self-willed, multi-lingual woman, Jüdin, Russian, Azerbaijani and German, with a trauma caused during the political unrest around Bergkarabakh. She never talks about this, nor does she talk about her beloved friend Elias, who in Frankfurt after a sensitive operation on his football injury, can't die with a heartbeat of his own roots.
content.title_en: The Russian is one who loves birch : Roman

content.text: White magic: the era of paper. You can print and write on it, you can tear it, bend it and fold it: paper is a magical substance that, like no other, contributed to the development of the modern world. As change and paper money, it was indispensable for the economy. As a stationery it became the scene of the modern soul, as newspaper to the scene of politics. Lothar Müller tells how the paper from China came from Egypt to Europe and became the basic material of modern civilization. His crown witness is the literature of Rabelais and Grimmelshausen, from James Joyce to Paul Valéry. We believe to know the "Gutenberg age". But we understand it better when we discover his background world: the era of paper. "One would like to praise much of this book, the current debates about losses and gains in the terrain gain of the screens - keyword E-Book - with a solid counterpoint. But perhaps this is what we understand better when we discover his background world: the era of paper. "One would like to praise the authors of this book, the fact that the book was not used to be used for the history of China."
content.title_en: White magic : the epoch of paper

content.text: The I-illusion: how consciousness and free will arise. Brain research has declared the free will of man an illusion. Renowned neuroscientist Michael Gazzaniga explains why the "I" is a fairy tale that the brain tells itself. And he describes how freedom and consciousness nevertheless arise: not in the individual brain, but in the coexistence of brains. It is language, culture and morality that let us reach consciousness and our "self". With the "I-illusion", Gazzaniga creates a deep understanding of how we function. A passionate plea, not to draw premature conclusions from the findings of brain research - and an important contribution to the debate about guilt and responsibility in the light of neuroscience.
content.title_en: The I-illusion : how consciousness and free will arise

People become manipulated idiots of their data tracks. With countless examples, quotations, references to (presumably) scientific studies, the author outlines these developments from a diverse, sometimes tiresome repeating perspective. In the end, he can only counter to them transparency, fairness, education and appeals to the responsibility of the corporations. (2)

content.text: What are men good for anyway? : How cultures profit from exploiting men. The US social psychologist does not out-proceed - as the title might suggest - as a further gender warrior, but rather with his highly-serious analysis of the differences between the sexes takes a mediating, culture-specifically based position. Men are neither naturally superior to women nor had they conspired against women - the causes of the difference were rather based on fundamental preferences and dislikes, and for these differences there are good reasons, and both genders profited from it. His thesis: Our culture uses men and uses them according to a kind of cost-benefit calculation. In the course of human history, among other things, the division of labor became the close social relations necessary for survival, core quality of women, replaced by male characteristics, such as competitive spirit and risk-taking. This made men useful for a culture and always brought them certain privileges, on the other hand, in view of their eligibility also showed their - an important contribution to the gender debate. (2)
content.title_en: What are men good for anyway? : How cultures benefit from exploiting men

content.text: The upcoming revolt. In Europe, too, a revolt will occur over a short period of time. For fewer and fewer people in Europe still feel obliged to the majority society. They live in countercultures in the long term. With such a development, the social contract between generations, the different strata and milieus can no longer stand. Solidarity becomes a foreign word. The consequences are easily predictable: rising crime, urban decay through the emergence of slums, ethnic-religious conflicts and gang wars, political radicalization and thus the end of the political and social consensus. Europe is revealed to decay. "Michael Ley has presented with his book a provocative analysis of the situation of Europe at the beginning of the 21st century. Despite his unilateral criticism of the 1968s, which this movement represents every contribution to social progress, and the fatal tendency to follow the racist and anti-Islamic arguments of Sarrazin & Co. in his critique of multiculturalism, the book of Ley remains - at least at the level of its state descriptions - to be read - and to be repulsive.

content.text: In order to escape the overpowering reality, people invent images and myths, metaphysical and cultural systems, because they provide orientation, even if their »truth« can hardly be proved. Guided by this consideration, philosopher Hans Blumenberg was interested in certain metaphors that, as »regulative ideas«, provide a framework for thinking without completely defining it. Metaphors, he believed, form the background of the history of ideas. Since 1978, he has been interested in a book of his own about the three »water metaphors«: sources, streams and icebergs, to which he attached central importance. He collected extensive materials and evidence in his paper boxes, and in his indulgence found a text that was almost ready for printing, which was published here for the first time. Using numerous examples – from the pre-socracists to the current texts – he still uses the phrase "the phrase of the flower mountain" as a new metaphor, literally life-necessary. "Although the editors have emphasized that Blumenberg has practically been put together in a form of expression, the phrase of the phrase "the phrase of the flower mountain is still present".
content.title_en: Sources, currents, icebergs

content.text: Solar heating: heating with the sun. Thermal solar systems are used to heat water and to support heating, especially in individual houses, but also larger buildings. Significant progress has been made in plant technology, so that solar heating can be used reliably and environmentally friendly when carefully planned. Compared to photovoltaics, there is relatively little literature (cf. Frank Späte: ID-A 51/11, B. Hanus: "Thermic ...", ID-G 46/09, U. Stamp: "Thermic ...", BA 10/07, A. Themessl: BA 3/07), which is surpassed by Oberzig. content.text: How are landscapes made?: social science perspectives on the constitution of cultural landscapes. How we deal with the landscapes in which we live depends decisively on how they are communicated and which images and ideas circulate about them. In this volume, everyday landscape constructions are illuminated as well as planning landscape understandings, landscape concepts in wind energy discourses and cultural land-based action spaces.
content.title_en: How are landscapes made?: social science perspectives on the constitution of cultural landscapes

content.text: Theater as a time machine : the performative practice of reenactment ; theatre and cultural perspectives. The theatre is a time machine through which present and past relate to each other. However, since the turn of the millennium, a performative practice has been increasingly encountered in the arts that re-positions the theatre as a time machine: reenactments re-enact history instead of portraying it. They re-enact the past instead of updating it – and make up for the performance that it never wanted to be: theatre. Starting from an interdisciplinary inventory, the band initiates the theatre and cultural scientific discussion of participatory historical repetition in the intersection of art and media culture. Jens Roselt (Prof. Dr.) is Professor of Theory and Practice of Theatre at Hildesheim University. Ulf Otto (Dr. phil.) is a research associate at the Institute for Media and Theatre at Hildesheim University.
content.title_en: Theatre as a time machine : the performative practice of reenactment ; theatre and cultural perspectives

content.text: Introduction to wind energy technology: with 27 tables and numerous examples and exercises. Under the umbrella of the research community Wind energy of the Schleswig-Holstein universities, 10 renowned authors have developed an introductory presentation of wind energy technology. The 11 chapters convey the modern state of the art. After a historical outline and insight into the energy-political international significance of wind energy, the following topics are aerodynamics and sheet design, rotor blades, drive train concepts (the rotating parts in the machine house), tower and foundation, generator systems, control and regulation, grid integration and offshore wind energy. The text of the university textbook accompanies numerous illustrations, diagrams and formulas. Each chapter ends with literature references. Tasks with increasing difficulty stimulate to check the level of knowledge. The book has the potential for a standard work and should be provided in libraries at university locations (machinery, electrical engineering). Well-suitable according to Horst Crome (ID-A 50/12), besides "wind power plants" (ID-G 33/11), Siegfried Heier (ID 4/10). (3) (LK/HB: Isity) Introduction to the offshore wind energy technology.
content.title_en: Introduction to wind energy technology : with 27 tables and numerous examples and exercises

content.text: Fault lines: Distortions; why they still threaten the global economy and what to do now. The financial crisis has long since become a global threat to the financial system through the currency crisis. Although the acute fires of the global financial structure seem to be under control again and again, it continues to bubble under the surface. This is precisely where Raghuram Rajan, one of the most prominent economists of our time, sets out why the fundamental economic imbalances between nations continue to threaten the global economy. But what consequences do these differences in economic regions have, what role does a disproportionate export orientation like Germany, Japan or China play? And how can the actors of a completely out-of-control financial system be steered back into orderly paths? Sure: The world economy will not come to rest so quickly. So how can the future be shaped? What painful and possibly unpopular reforms are necessary? And in which direction must the first steps lead to a long path towards the recovery of financial markets? The answers Rajan makes conclusively and thus shows that he belongs to the most important new economy?
content.title_en: Fault lines : faults ; why they still threaten the world economy and what to do now

content.text: Subjective cartography : examples and social spatial practice. The map is generally considered an "objective" medium of spatial representation. All the contributions of the volume deal with the reasons for this mythical transfiguration and the dependence of map production on perspectives and interests. The discussion of intentions, wishes, economic and political calculations that direct the reading of the map at a concealed level leads to a plea for reflexive methods in dealing with the medium. <dt.>

content.text: The "Total War": Münster's citizens move to the countryside. Between 1943 and 1945, several hundred thousand temporary homes were created for the urban population, who were deprived of their homes by the bombing war, in the German Reich at short notice. Many of these emergency homes exist to this day, however, have been changed. In this publication, the formal conditions, technical necessities and the room for manoeuvre of the builders are examined, with a socially differentiated view of the living conditions of bombed citizens at the end of the Second World War.
content.title_en: Help homes for bombers : coping with the everyday in the "Total War" : Münster's citizens move to the country

content.text: Project Mars: Human Dream and Vision. Current state of Mars research and space technology, plans and roadmaps for future missions and pleas for manned space travel as a significant cultural achievement. (Rolf Becker-Friedrich) New edition of Jesco by Puttkamer (BA 9/96/11/97). Besides some new image material, numerous updates are found, basic texts have remained. The ISS is now in operation, the Spaceshuttle has ceased its service, progress has been made, e.g. in energy, communication and material technology, not least in the exploration of Mars itself. Old plans have been rejected, there are new road maps, the author is currently expecting a manned expedition about 2030 to 2035. Unchanged are the astronautic problems, in the drive technology there is no way in the medium to long term to significantly reduce the expedition time; despite "Mars 500" there are no reliable statements about the measured stays in space or an appropriate reliability of technical systems. To conclude, a public audience is not held to be a good example of the last term of the term of the term of the term of the term of the space travel.
content.title_en: Project Mars : Human Dream and Vision

content.text: The data eaters: how Internet companies and state integrate our personal data and how we get control of it back. It is simple, inviting and practical: Most of us dive into the virtual worlds of social networks, communities and forums every day. We order and book online, upload and download. Without a doubt, the digital revolution has brought us a lot of advantages and opportunities. But this development has dark sides. Every digital action leaves data behind. They allow themselves to be merged the more, the better, to individual profiles and provide such deep insights into the interests, habits and desires of a person - ideal for the global advertising industry, which deserves billions with such voluntary or involuntary data traces. But even state bodies increasingly and with a wide variety of motives use personal information. Where, why and for whom are we transparent? And what can we do, and what must we do about it? - There is hardly any activity left behind by no data traces. But there remains a diffuse sense of being delivered. The book deals with how we can better understand the digital world's destiny and what we need to do about it.
content.title_en: The data eaters: how Internet companies and state incorporate our personal data and how we regain control of it

content.text: Business administration for architects and civil engineers : successful management in the planning office. Amazon:It is not enough to be technically perfect for successful management of a planning office. Architects and engineers in managerial positions must also assume responsibility for the economic success of projects. To this end, it is essential that they know the business connections and can use methods and tools for controlling. This book provides the basic knowledge of the business administration and enables the planner to create the appropriate framework conditions for his company, to measure and manage profitability and thus ensure the long-term financial success of his office.
content.title_en: Business administration for architects and civil engineers : successful management in the planning office

content.text: Photovoltaics : how sun becomes electricity. How does photovoltaic work? What types of solar cells exist? How economical are photovoltaic systems? What is the future development? The compact book provides a sound orientation knowledge about the functioning, application and limits of photovoltaics. It is suitable for a quick introduction to the problem and enables the classification of different technologies and plant variants. The authors explain clearly the most important characteristics of solar radiation and convey the principle functioning of a solar cell. They address the significant differences between today's and future technologies of solar cells. And they treat the cost-effectiveness of different plant concepts.
content.title_en: Photovoltaic : how sun becomes electricity

The book provides comprehensive support for the most diverse communication situations between employees and customers in a library: initial interview, information interview, training and conflict situations, complaints and customer orientation. Basic work on the professionalization of librarians in the field of didactics/instructional design. (S.Preisler) Increasingly practice libraries Teaching tasks in the field of information literacy. After a brief introduction to the essential theoretical foundations of teaching and learning, in addition to a guide for the conception of events, concrete teaching strategies, methods and possibilities of integrating e-learning into the design of guided tours and training courses in the library context are presented. content.text: Lost among 100 friends: how we are mentally abated in the digital world. The American psychologist who teaches at MIT presents here, according to "The Wish Machine" (BA 3/85) and "Life in the Net" (ID-G 14/98), the final volume of her trilogy on the development of digital culture. Her presentation first deals with the relationship between human robots ("new friends in loneliness"), then the phenomenon of complete networking ("new loneliness among friends") that is now everywhere. As usual from the predecessors, Turkle offers very deep insights into matter, its reports and conclusions, leading to 15 years of research and interviews with hundreds of people. Her convincing credo: one can, indeed, let oneself be involved in the possibilities created by the new technologies, but without responsible handling it "one (one) in dependence, passivity and danger of socially and mentally abending". An important, very extensive, with many information and clever thoughts - but also a long breath-requiring study, at the same time a plea for a person to be (re-enhanged).
content.title_en: Lost among 100 friends : how we are mentally amortizing in the digital world

content.text: Cloud computing for companies: technical, economic, legal and organisational aspects. Cloud computing is a shift of computing power and storage space to any data center on the Internet. Hardware and software are also often no longer held on site. Cloud computing is becoming increasingly important, with particular emphasis on the (consumed) cost advantage. - A good general introduction is given by M. Krimmer (ID-A 34/11). Presentations, which also cover many interesting topics for companies, are "Cloud Migration" (ID-G 3/12) and M. Meir-Huber (ID-B 5/11). The authors of this book deliberately address small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). They also rely on investigations conducted for the IHK North Westphalia and on interviews with SMEs. The focus is on technical, business, organizational and legal aspects. Very well also issues of information security in the cloud are addressed. The book ends with a summary reference and an outlook on future developments. SMEs receive valuable decision aids and checklists as well as statements of actions. (Cluckow, GMB) Business and Business.
content.title_en: Cloud computing for companies: technical, economic, legal and organisational aspects

content.text: In her new book Angelika Overath returns to the lost Atlantis of childhood, the youth. She tells of promise and shame, of paternal football rituals, of the irritation of first sexuality under cherry trees and the shy gestures hoped for friendship. "Fließende Land" is also a book about being on the way. Angelika Overath takes us to the lagoons of Tahitis or to the wide beach of the North Sea island of Vlieland; to the herengracht of Amsterdam, where Jewish children were hidden from German occupiers, or to a museum in London, before the flickering of van Gogh's South French chair. "Angelika Overath is above all a reporter; her texts appear mostly in the "New Zurich Newspaper." But are these things reports or rather a descriptive prose, which balances on the narrow ridge between facts and fiction, because here an art will becomes visible, the reality is not necessarily a matter of hospitality, but rather a matter of how to express itself on the pages of the reporters.
content.title_en: Flowing Land : Stories of Writing and Travel

content.text: How to strengthen a child: a manual for daycare and family. How do we do justice to different children, for example, girls, boys, children with a migrant background, highly gifted children? How can we strengthen children in important transition phases, for example when we move from kindergarten to primary school? What to do when children get into difficult situations very early on? How can we support children who have lost a family member or those who grow up in separate/divorce families? Can we protect children from drugs or sexual abuse? These and many other questions - many scientifically and elementary pedagogically well-founded answers for daycare and family!
content.title_en: How to strengthen a child: a manual for daycare and family

content.text: Methods of empirical human geography. The present, comprehensively revised and extended reissue of the book focuses in its practical examples on both the classical methods of observation and quantitative and qualitative surveys as well as the increasingly established discursanalytic methods. These methods are used in many sub-disciplines of human geography in research and teaching. Students, who represent one of the main target groups of this book, use the methods presented both in university courses and in their final papers.
content.title_en: Methods of empirical human geography

content.text: The Anne Frank Diary: a source of historical learning in teaching and study. Hardly any document from the Second World War is now receiving comparable public attention as the Anne Frank diary. Little is known that the million-fold sold edition is the result of an edition process that began with the author's revision - "the" Anne Frank diary did not exist. Why this was so, and which conclusions about the perspectives of the "back home residents" can be drawn from the Anne Frank records historically is the subject of this book. It is asked what the contemporaries could know about the day's events and how they assessed it, what they put their hopes on. The core concern of the book is to perceive the diary from the perspective of historical science. From the historical and didactic analysis of the Anne Frank records twelve text excerpts are discussed more intensively, which are recommended for the development of the topic of National Socialism and the Second World War in historical education and teacher education.
content.title_en: The Anne Frank Diary : a source of historical learning in teaching and study

content.text: Apps with HTML5 and CSS3: for iPad, iPhone and Android; [geodata, videos, audio, graphics, motion sensors, etc.; working with jQuery Mobile, Sencha Touch, PhoneGap; including development of tablet magazines]. content.text: Use of wind energy. Those who need a current overview of wind energy plants and wind farms as planners, investors, students or members of a citizens' initiative will receive a wealth of information with this work, which covers virtually all basic knowledge. Among other things, the technical background, the conception, the expansion and the economic and ecological balance sheet are dealt with. Simple technical prior knowledge is sufficient for understanding. Not only has much changed since the preliminary edition (BA 3/08), the book itself has also been overhauled and made larger and more appealing in format and layout. Data, facts and literature data are updated, black and white images have been replaced by colored ones. Can be used before the more detailed titles "Introduction to wind energy technology" (ID-G 6/13) and "Wind power plants" (ID-G 33/11), as the first entry is for example H. Crome (ID-A 50/12). Suitable for medium stocks for first-generation purposes; older editions should be replaced by the present ones. (2) (LK/LEV: Junker) Information about technology, planning, operation, economy and future developments of wind energy.
content.title_en: Use of wind energy

content.text: Mobile Web from head to foot: [develop mobile websites & web apps]. This book shows how to create mobile websites and apps using common web technologies. Modern approaches such as responsive web design and smart technologies such as WURFL, HTML5, jQuery Mobile and PhoneGap are used. (Christian Eidoth) Mobile access to the Internet is constantly increasing. However, the literature on the subject is not yet exhaustive, at least as far as mobile web and web apps are concerned (lastly: F. Franke: ID-B 34/12). Mobile Internet is the website variants that are optimized to the needs of mobile access. Web apps are small applications that run in mobile devices' browsers, which also means that they are not operational-dependent applications that are more commonly known in the public mind. The book connects both topics, which you can't do. Treated to responsive web design, heterogeneous environment, device support, binge of devices, and binge of the usual, in the case of the usual, in the wild.

Guide to the training regulations, the examination procedure (with sample tasks and solution instructions) and the evaluation of the examination performance. Review (EC): Unchanged update (only cover update) of the title "100% success in the practical exam" published in 2005 by Goerke. "No usual task book for exam preparation, but a guide to the training regulations, the examination procedure (with sample tasks and solution instructions), for the evaluation of the examination performance. content.text: Everything has its time, only I have no: ways into a new time culture. As in his earlier books, time researcher Geissler thinks about the phenomenon of time, divides the history of time into 3 sections and shows ways out of the "time trap"
content.title_en: Everything has its time, only I have no : Ways into a new time culture

content.text: Guide to barrier-free housing: from theory to practice. Basic, broad and practice-oriented guide on accessibility in housing, which takes into account the needs of a wide range of people. Compared to the first edition (BA 5/05), revised, expanded, on the current state of technical development (e.g. use of RFID for acoustic orientation systems) and updated with regard to the new edition DIN 18040 for public housing. The preliminary edition should be replaced. Recommended before Dagmar Everding: "Handbuch Barrier-free Building" (ID-B 44/11), Isabella Skiba: "Basics barrier-free planning" (BA 11/09) and the sample collection "Barrier-free housing" (Blottner; BA 6/08). The vocational school textbook for the 3-year training as roofer or roofer is oriented towards the nationwide framework curriculum, takes into account the regulations of the German roofer trades and mediates the learning fields 1-19. Clear and colored design, 2-column, with terms and definitions in margin columns, numerous practical examples, exercises, construction drawings, detailed photos, pictures, internet addresses and further literature. content.text: iPhone & iPad games develop : from the game idea to the first app ; [fast start to app development ; with app certification tips]. The title describes the framework conditions and technology of programming apps for Apple's iPhone and iPad and is designed for users with experience in application programming. (Ulrich Wesser) Due to the ever increasing popularity of Apple's iPhone and iPad, some users come to the idea of switching from the user side to the producer side and programming and offering games or programs - so-called apps - themselves. The title describes the way there and starts with the description of the registration as Apple's developer and the (chargeable) access to Apple's iOS Developer Program. Afterwards, the description of the development environment Xcode and the programming of a first small game project follows. The title is clearly addressed to users who already have programming experience, the explanations are partly scarcely available. (A little more detailed is the programming of hardware-specific possibilities (location sensors, control by wishy) followed by the description of a first small game project. The title is not applicable to users who already have programming experience in the application, but to the application of the application for the application.
content.title_en: iPhone & iPad games develop : from the game idea to the first app ; [fast start to app development ; with tips on app certification]

content.text: "You can do well German!": why I no longer want to be grateful that I can live here, and tolerance does not help. Since T. Sarrazin's controversial bestseller, the integration debate in Germany has been completely unfurled. It would be high time to finally abandon the – not only verbal separation – between Germans and "Germans with a migrant background". Because Germany has long since had its ethnically mixed society and we should finally learn to understand this as an opportunity and enrichment to shape our common country together. The young author and journalist (last of all "Lieber Mischa", ID-A 13/11) tells here very personally, refreshingly open and honest from many of her own experiences of the life of a "Migrantenkind", poses critical, provocative or ironic questions, demands passionately for all immigrants to listen to and participate, but also to be interested and to contribute. Rhetorically brilliant, very catchy to read. Many other, current and individual contributions to the topic (including I. Boro: "Die gestürkte Republik BA/B11", 1 /08", "S.
content.title_en: "You can speak German well!": why I don't want to be grateful anymore that I can live here and that tolerance doesn't help

content.text: Multisensual Corporate Communications : Successful brand building through the approach of all senses. In her guide for specialists and executives, Andrea Haug shows how companies can showcase vision, hearing, keys, taste and smell across all senses. The advantage: they attract attention, remain in lasting memory and can sometimes also direct the behavior of their target group.
content.title_en: Multisensual Corporate Communications : Successful Brand Building by Addressing All Senses

content.text: Nerd Attack! : a history of the digital world from C64 to Twitter and Facebook. The web is changing private and public communication. How are culture and society affected by it? What are the elements of the web culture? The book describes a journey to the locations of the digital revolution, to programmers, hackers and simple users who have changed the world. - You can actually write them already, the history of the digital world. Light years seem past when privileged clever minds solemnly served the first wall cabinet-sized computers, as concepts such as mouse pad, floppy, modem and browser still seemed to come from a code for initiates. From the roots of the digital revolution in cellars and garages to the omnipresence of information, entertainment, exchange and data debris on the Internet and the social networks, Christian Stöcker travels through the fascinating-disturbing world of computer-based communication. He stumbles into the back rooms of applications and animations and presents their protagists: programmers and Bastlers, hackers and crackers. His travel report is critical and informative, not to understand anything else that is too much to be read online.
content.title_en: Nerd Attack! : a history of the digital world from C64 to Twitter and Facebook

content.text: Flood protection and preservation : case studies and recommendations for practice. Flood protection represents a balance in which different factors must be taken into account. The authors deal in this context with the concerns of the monument protection. Their results are presented in the form of numerous case studies, assessments and recommendations and thus facilitate the detection of listed solutions
content.title_en: Flood protection and preservation : case studies and recommendations for practice

content.text: The book enemies: about fire and water, gas and heat, dust and neglect, ignorance and narrow-mindedness. In this bibliophile classic, the English printer William Blades (1824-1890) makes known the biggest enemies of the book. For whether a fire disaster or spring cleaning, books are constantly threatened by all sides! The (IDo) attacks(IDk) range from historical-significant to entertaining-squirly. In his introduction, Hektor Haarkötter lets the life of this obsessed as well as curious man and the history of the book villains revue pass. In the Anglo-Saxon language space, "The book enemies?" have long been a classic. Now they are available in German translation.
content.title_en: The book enemies : about fire and water, gas and heat, dust and neglect, ignorance and narrowness

content.text: Photo Finish! : perfect images with Photoshop, Elements & Co. ; [Step by step to extraordinary pictures ; over 30 workshops for perfect photo styling ; fascinating picture looks for portrait, architecture, product photography and much more]. Tilo Gockel impressively shows how to get the best out of just half-way ordinary photos simply but effectively. content.text: Practical manual SAP Query Reporting : [Step by step with SAP Query for concrete evaluation; optimal reports for all business processes; suitable for all SAP components; with 100 immediately applicable queries]. The author presents the most important SAP database tables and their connections, so that you can directly create queries in SAP ERP (SD, MM, PP, FI, CO etc.). Using screenshots and step-by-step instructions you will learn all important query features: Drill-down functions, rankings, statistics etc. The relevant SAP transactions are explained in detail. Many practical examples also help you to provide reliable and with little time effort the desired data from SAP ERP - including 100 immediately applicable queries.
content.title_en: Practical manual SAP Query Reporting : [Step by step with SAP Query for concrete evaluation ; optimal reports for all business processes ; suitable for all SAP components ; with 100 immediately applicable queries]

content.text: Smart City concrete: a future workshop in Germany between idea and practice; evaluation of T-City Friedrichshafen. Scientifically based, the authors make a concrete contribution to the debate on smart cities. They present a public-private partnership between Deutsche Telekom and the city of Friedrichshafen, where over five years of concrete work on a smart city was carried out. The project's aim was to improve the quality of life of citizens, increase the location quality of companies and increase the networking in the city society as a whole. The volume shows the effects and benefits of the project (Urbanity Living. A book collection of the Frankfurt Book Fair 2013)
content.title_en: Smart City concrete: a future workshop in Germany between idea and practice; evaluation of T-City Friedrichshafen

content.text: Tool - Thinking tool : manual intelligence and transmediality of creative processes. Hand, brain and tool - a complex interaction. This volume, initiated from the architectural practice, investigates from the perspective of various disciplines of knowledge to what extent human manual intelligence promotes creative processes. Does a contradiction between instrumental action and intuitive work exist in times of programmed environments? The contributions from art, design, architecture, cultural and cognitive science explore this question and enter into an interdisciplinary dialogue about the technique of design.
content.title_en: Tool - Thinking tool : manual intelligence and transmediality of creative processes

content.text: Suburban spaces as cultural landscapes. To think of suburban spaces as cultural landscapes is still a provocation in the German research tradition. This perspective is, however, increasingly found in international spatial research. In addition, such thinking is also required in some European documents on spatial development. In this sense, the 3rd guiding principle "preserving resources, shaping cultural landscapes" of the German spatial planning from 2006 understands all spaces as cultural landscapes, i.e. also the suburban ones, and sees such a cultural landscape understanding as an important qualitative complement to traditional spatial development policy. This volume aims to show that the cultural landscape view can actually contribute to structuring a new perception of suburban spaces, because it helps to reveal ecological, aesthetic, cultural and life-world qualities also in these spaces, although they are sometimes denied. This means an extension of the previously more functional perspective of spatial planning on this hybrid spatial type and can be used as a starting point for adequate forms of cooperative regional development policy, as illustrated by examples.
content.title_en: Suburban spaces as cultural landscapes

content.text: International Principles and Guidelines for the Conservation of Monuments. International Principles and Guidelines on the Reservation of Historic Buildings and Monuments : 22 Documents 1889 - 2008. 22 documents 1889-2008. - - This publication contains the idea that the international principles and guidelines for the preservation of monuments, which are only partially available in German, are to be published as a common trilingual work of the German National Committees. It contains 22 groundbreaking papers from the years 1889 to 2009 in German, English and French. The publication is the first volume of a new international series on the maintenance of monuments.
content.title_en: International principles and guidelines for the preservation of monuments

content.text: OECD environmental outlook to 2050: [the consequences of inaction]. How will economic and social developments affect the environment by 2050? What measures are needed to address the most important environmental challenges and what consequences do we have to expect in the event of political inaction? The environmental outlook provides analyses of economic and environmental trends. The projections focus on four areas that will determine the future of our planet: climate change, biodiversity, water, and environment and health.
content.title_en: OECD environmental outlook to 2050 : [the consequences of action]

content.text: Lightroom 4 : the big training; basics, photo workflow, practical tips. Detailed video training for managing, optimizing, converting and issuing digital photo material with Lightroom 4. With training material and a complete sample project - from image import to output. (LK/MZ: Steiner) In this video2Brain basic course for the new version of Lightroom (see T. Bredenfeld: BA 11/10) 2 new trainers are now presenting the application of the software. Version 4 has some interesting innovations to offer: In addition to 2 new modules, the development module was revised, the menu guidance was optimized. The new features are presented in the course and explained in the corresponding chapters. Target group of the training are demanding beginners who are looking for a thorough introduction to the efficient management, optimization, conversion and output of digital photo material. Basic knowledge for image processing and the corresponding terminology should be available. Very helpful: In the bonus chapter a complete project from import to output is worked through. The DVD is commonly available, exercise material is included. As Adobe has greatly reduced the prices for Lightroom, this program should be recommended for users.

content.text: Scott Kelby's Lightroom 4 for digital photography: recipe for success for photographers. The well-known author has been supporting Adobe's Raw Photo Workflow software since version 1 and has now released a revised and updated edition of his recommended entry-level title to version 4 (pre-release: ID-A 8/11). In a typically loose style Kelby explains step by step the management, editing and output of digital image material with Lightroom, always aligned with the usual workflow. Compared to the predecessor, the topic of image editing has been greatly expanded, new are chapters for working with videos and the photo book module. Also innovations such as the map module or softproof have not been forgotten. Example photos and more can be found on the website for the book. A completely successful book about Lightroom, with which every beginner should get along well. Especially the exemplary project from shooting to the edition is very helpful. Since the operation of Lightroom 4 has changed a lot of things, this new edition should complement the predecessor. Very recommended, besides the very good title of Lightroom (ID-A 4) is the basic version of the Digital Room (ID-A 38M) (in German version of the Basics and the Basics of the Library).

(Elke Nibbrig) Can a book about book shelves - "old fashioned" printed on paper - be inspired in times of increasing sales figures at e-book readers? Yes - and this square-handle book has its origin on the Internet. Since 2007 the British journalist and professional blogger Alex Johnson runs the blog "Bookshelf", where book shelves and book furniture of designers are at the center of attention. All important renewable, plant building materials from fiber and dye plants are treated with the corresponding physical and chemical principles. The authors explain in addition to numerous common and possible raw material plants, also comprehensive physical and chemical aspects for crafts, industry and construction planning, resource and environmental protection, pollutants from construction products. content.text: Transnational history. National borders no longer shape the world of experience of Europeans. This tendency towards transnationality also loses much of their naturalness in the direction of national history and its borders. Instead of the self-contained events on German, French or British, less often on European history, students are confronted with offers that either look at regions or point beyond the national framework. Transnational history is a demanding approach that places high demands on the historian's self-reflection. Margrit Pernau's introduction to transnational history provides assistance here and beats Schneisen through the theoretical offer that has become rather confusing. Basic course New history• Compact presentation of complex theories• Detailed explanation of problems• with many illustrative examples
content.title_en: Transnational history

content.text: Practice fields of applied ethics: ethical orientation in medicine, politics, technology and economics. The individual's desire to align his own behavior with certain ethical standards, as well as requirements of individual actors and decision-makers, requires a professional discourse on morality. This should go beyond the discussion in philosophical ethics or Christian social doctrine and include the respective fields of science such as medicine, technology or economics. Morally correct behavior needs more than codified norms and general instructions for action. The application of general rules in complex situations of action – whether in clinical everyday life in the limitation of therapy, whether in political decisions about the level of greenhouse gas reductions – requires specific knowledge and special skills. In this volume, the results of two workshops of the AG "Ethics in Practice" of the Junge Akademie (Berlin) are summarized, in which the different approach of the different ethics was attempted to be supplemented by a common moral and cognitive concept and thus wide parts of the applied ethics are brought closer to practice. The path of the Aristotelian Phronesis concept leads to the attempt to learn the concept of judgment for different ethics, to make it fruitful in practice the fields of ethics, in particular, to apply the fields of ethics.
content.title_en: Practice fields of applied ethics : ethical orientation in medicine, politics, technology and economics

content.text: Cities and Places: Expeditions into the literary landscape. Joseph Roth's relations with his Galician hometowns Brody and Lemberg -- Joseph Roth in exile: Ostend as a possible source of inspiration for The History of the 1002nd Night. -- Joseph Roth between Paris and Amsterdam -- Hort der Freiheit, Sinenbabel und Tummelplatz von Exoten. content.title_en: Cities and Places : Expeditions into the literary landscape

content.text: Electrical and magnetic fields : A practical introduction. In this compact textbook, the electric and magnetic fields are presented in such a way that they are also accessible to the more practical students. The pictures, which are particularly illustrated on the basis of modern numerical methods, as well as the numerous calculated examples are to be highlighted. The author is a specialist in magnetic technology and allows her great practical experience to be incorporated into the deepening of this area. Therefore, the work is also interesting for many engineers from industry and engineering offices as well as for students of all bachelor's degree programmes at universities and universities. The book has an attractive modern layout with excellent illustrations, an annex on the application of numerical methods in the calculation of magnetic fields and numerous new calculated examples with practical relevance. It is now available in 3rd edition and is supplemented by tasks with detailed solutions on the Internet.
content.title_en: Electrical and magnetic fields : A practical introduction

content.text: Biochemical and physiological experiments with plants : for study and teaching in biology. In this book Professor Aloysius Wild, head of the technical didactics seminar Plant Physiological experiments in the school, together with Volker Schmitt, publishes the practical experiences of numerous generations of students. This biological work book deals with biochemical and plant physiological experiments for biology studies and for school lessons. All experiments are described with many useful details for implementation and are always embedded in a theoretical preparation and a subsequent evaluation phase. In addition, safety and disposal instructions are given.The book is addressed to both teachers (Schwerpunkt Gymnasium, Sec. II) and to students of biological subjects and students with a particular interest in biological experiments. When selecting the experiments, the following aspects were taken into account: The experiment must be robust accordingly, so that even in the case of a small or missing experimental exercise a very high probability of success is given; the test result must have a clearly recognizable effect; the equipment, materials and chemicals used must be taken into account the average equipment of a school.
content.title_en: Biochemical and physiological experiments with plants : for study and teaching in biology

content.text: Algorithms for engineers : Technical realization with Excel and VBA ; with 65 tables. Programming means knowing the solution method of a problem and applying it in a targeted manner. This requires the classification of a problem, which requires a little mathematics, and the exemplary implementation. The author has compiled particularly instructive examples in close proximity to the application and has shown the way to solving programming tasks - comprehensible for every engineer - using Microsoft Excel and Visual Basic for Application. The book is the result of decades of teaching and practical experience of the author, who has specialized in problem solving in the engineering field.
content.title_en: Algorithms for engineers : Technical realization with Excel and VBA ; with 65 tables

content.text: Mathcad in structural design : Electronic worksheets for structural engineering, reinforced concrete construction, steel construction and wood construction. From simple Mathcad worksheet to professional applications in structural design, the book offers a wide range of immediately applicable Mathcad worksheets. The enclosed CD-ROM contains all worksheets, the Mathcad manual and an immediately applicable, time-limited Mathcad version.

content.text: Adhesive - successful and error-free : Craftsman, practitioner, training, industry. This book provides the basics for a successful application of the life. All necessary information for users in the industrial, artisanal or private sector is taught in practice and with a large lack of scientific depth of presentation. Thus it is also suitable for adhesive training. Since a special emphasis was placed on easy comprehensibility, it is also useful for all interested DIY enthusiasts. content.text: Mathematics for Computer Science: a practical textbook. This book contains in a volume the mathematics material needed for the computer science study in application-oriented Bachelor's degree programmes. The material selection and the detailed presentation of the material originate from the author's long-standing teaching experience in computer science courses at the University of Applied Sciences Landshut. This means: · You find again and again concrete applications from computer science, so you can recognize the usefulness of mathematics for your subject area. · You learn not only the mathematical basics of technical applications as in the mathematics books for engineers, but also the mathematical thinking that provides a basis for understanding computer science. · It is not as much theory as in books for mathematics studies, evidence is then guided if you can learn from it, not for the sake of proof. Mathematics is initially a necessary evil for many students. The book shows by the detailed motivation of the results, by many examples, by the continuous display of cross references between mathematics and computer science and also by an occasional outlook on the world of 'right' mathematics, but rather the description of the subject matter is completely reworked.

content.text: Sensors for process and factory automation : Function - execution - application ; with 35 tables. The book, which is expanded in content and well-recorded in practice, provides a comprehensive overview of the physical basics, functions and applications of sensors in process and factory automation. It is structured according to the fields of tasks of sensors and shows their mode of operation and application in many typical applications. This includes cases of use in robotics. For important technical terms of sensors the English translation is given. 250 specialist terminology of sensor technology are explained in a lexical collection. A list of search terms is intended to support the reader in Internet searches.

content.text: Distributed systems: Basics and basic technologies. Distributed systems form the backbone of many industrial applications. With the integration of mobile networks and mobile devices, they are experiencing an intensive development in recent times. Fields of application such as office automation, production control and WWW are expanded and supplemented by new ones. The present book presents the basics of distributed systems from the perspective of computer networks and distributed processing. The focus is on a compact presentation of basic concepts and technologies. The basic principles are always rounded off by the discussion of current developments, for example in the field of service-oriented architectures. The presentation is based on a consistently used field of application, the examples are oriented to common standards and technologies such as Java, EJB or Web Services. Both students and practitioners are to be taught basic knowledge with close reference to concrete application. The new edition has been continuously updated and extended, especially in the field of service-storiented architectures, AJAX and cloud computing. In the second edition more exercise tasks with solutions have been included.
content.title_en: Distributed systems : Basics and basic technologies

content.text: The crisis of the boys in education and education: discursive construction of gender and masculinity. Educational childhood and gender research have shown that the media discussion about boys as 'new worry children' and 'education loser' greatly shortens the actual situation of boys. In addition to the question of 'rightness' of such images, however, it is also necessary to ask about their productivity. In this study, the discursive construction of a crisis of the boys in the print media between 1999 and 2009 is linguistically and visually reconstructed and analyzed. It is evident that pedagogical actors - parents, teachers and educators - are described as problem-causing and as 'bad parents' and 'bad educators' come into focus. Above all, however, the study shows how these orders of gender and masculinity reproduce about these issues. Dr. Susann Fegter is a scientific employee in the Department of Education Sciences, Institute of Social Pedagogy and Adult Education of Goethe University, Frankfurt on Main Educational childhood and gender research have shown that the media discussion about boys as 'new education' is strongly analyzed by 'child'.
content.title_en: The crisis of boys in education : discursive construction of sex and masculinity

content.text: Material technology: Materials - Properties - Testing - Application. This book aims to enable prospective technicians, students of technical disciplines at universities of applied sciences and vocational academies as well as participants in advanced training courses to study material-technical foundations according to a proven didactic concept. In an easy-to-learn form, the chemical and physical foundations of metallic and non-metallic materials (their structure), the derived properties and their testing as well as the processing and the application possibilities of the materials are discussed. Material groups, individual materials and methods for finishing and determining properties are presented exemplarily. The link between structure and properties and their possible influence (heat treatment, finishing, etc.) is made clear in the foreground. In addition to important construction materials, including composite materials, the topic of corrosion and corrosion protection is addressed in metallic materials. Many examples deepen and consolidate the learned. Learning-oriented tests, which are added to each chapter, serve to verify the acquired knowledge. At the end, the solutions of all exercises and tests are compiled. Mr Seidel has taught many years of material technology at the vocational academy in Glauchau.
content.title_en: Materials technology : Materials - Properties - Testing - Application

content.text: Multicore software: Basics, architecture and implementation in C/C++, Java and C#. Modern processors contain several parallel processor cores. Compared to conventional CPUs, higher computing power of such multicore processors can only be used by parallel software. This leads to significant changes in software development, with parallelism from design to implementation playing a crucial role. The book provides a solid basic knowledge about software development in the multicore age and serves as reference work for daily work. The first part covers the basics and covers the essential aspects of parallel systems, from synchronization mechanisms to design patterns for parallelization of programs. In addition, various forms of parallelism are described, typical pitfalls are shown in programming multicore computers and methods for solving typical problems are presented. The second part provides a compact and structured guide for the productive development in the programming languages C/C++, Java and C #. Using examples, the concepts and techniques discussed in the first part are explained. Finally, the authors do not give an overview of less widely used programming but get a good understanding of the existing programming language.

content.text: The study shows the multifaceted impact of this gap on the political communication of the citizens and draws conclusions for future action.- "What do the citizens do with the Internet?", Martin Emmer, Gerhard Vowe and Jens Wolling ask. During the period 2002 to 2009, large sections of the German population opened up the Internet for themselves. In a broad empirical study of this process of development, they analysed how the appropriation of the Internet had an impact on the political communication of the beneficiaries within this period. Three questions were at the heart of the interest: How do citizens use the Internet for their political communication? How does their political communication change in this process overall? How can these changes be explained? The authors examined information behaviour such as reading political websites as interpersonal online communication and political participation activities on the network.

content.text: The book provides an introduction to the systematics of methodological action in social work. The systematics include basic ethical and legal issues, important concepts of action (e.g. empowerment, case management, social ecology), central interaction media (consultation-co-advisory support-maintenance), specific methods and procedures of situation analysis (such as person-in-environment system, network analysis, genogram work), situation intervention (such as client-centred conversation, thematic interaction, motivational interviewing) and reflection on professional action (self-evaluation, supervision) as well as the development of a competence profile for social work professionals. content.text: Life between houses. Danish architect Jan Gehl, one of the world's most famous urban planners, explains in his book Life between houses the fundamental importance of sensitive spatial planning for a good coexistence in our cities. Jan Gehl mentions decisive cornerstones for improving the quality of life. In the lens of his observations, the human being whose basic needs should determine the design of public spaces. And in contrast to architecture, which is subject to changing fashions and currents as well as our lives, these criteria remain surprisingly constant. The book, which appeared for the first time in Danish over 40 years ago and has now been translated into more than 50 languages, has lost nothing of its topicality. Rather, it still provides basic and surprising proposals for a decisive improvement in the quality of life in our world. This classic urban planning appears for the first time in German language.
content.title_en: Living between houses

content.text: Adaptation to climate change through spatial planning Basics, strategies, instruments. Climate change, which is mainly caused by anthropogenic factors, is no longer sustainable, so that our social and economic systems have to adapt to its consequences. This particularly concerns spatial planning, but can nevertheless make an important contribution to the area provision and coordination of specialist planning. Adaptation to climate change through spatial planning requires an interdisciplinary approach. In order to carry out concrete projects at regional level, it is not only necessary to prepare climate projections that are appropriate to scale, but also to prepare their results specifically for planning disciplines. For this transfer from climate and climate impact research to planning sciences, little knowledge and experience is available at present. The present report is a "work-place report" of the Leibniz project "Adaptation to climate change through spatial planning - fundamentals, strategies, instruments" (KLIMAPAKT), which describes the results of the scientific studies carried out during the three-year project period.
content.title_en: Adaptation to climate change through spatial planning Basics, strategies, instruments

content.text: Staff in social management: latest developments in research, teaching and practice. The focus was on qualification, personnel selection and development, personnel management and stakeholder participation. The contributions offered orientation and action support to scientists and students as well as practitioners of social work. Dr. Herbert Bassarak has been a professor of social work and social education at the University of Nuremberg since 1985. Dr. Sebastian Noll has been a consultant to the Advisory Group for Association Management (B'VM) in Stuttgart since 2008. content.text: Villa Garten Landschaft : City and country in Florentine Tuscany as an aesthetic and political space. In the 14th and 15th century, many city citizens of Florence spent several months in the countryside. The close exchange between city and country led to a changed perception of the space and the development of perspective spatial concepts. The villa in the Florentine countryside formed a retreat for the mercantile middle class of shopkeepers and cloth producers, notaries or bankers. Its ideal type illustrates complex lines of development in the humanities and social history: the guiding idea of the Tuscan Renaissance, life and work, created an ever unstable balance between humanistic ideal and economic interests. The political and economic appropriation and education of the urban cultural landscape of the contado influenced the perception of nature. Beyond an art history as a history of domination, the Florentine families' estates - alongside those of the Medici - and anonymous architectures are presented in this book.
content.title_en: Villa Garden Landscape : City and Countryside in Florentine Tuscany as an aesthetic and political space
