In the 3rd, updated edition the economic efficiency of the systems is in focus even more, there is an update and supplement in the chapter Control and the new grid connection conditions for photovoltaics are presented. On the basis of an online survey of financial tests there are new invoices for purchase and operation.
content.title_en: Photovoltaic : Solar power from the roof

content.text: Sweets made from garden and nature: delicacies made by themselves. Why not make sweets yourself? Although the sweets made by yourself are not really much healthier, they also contain sugar, fat or chocolate. But they are made without chemical additives and from natural ingredients, which makes them very different from the products of the confectionery shelf in the supermarket. Nevertheless, things like marshmallows, raspberry mussels, quince lollipops, almond masonry with chocolate banana filling, fruity chocolate kisses or strawberry raspberry brew powder are created. At the beginning of the book there is a detailed introduction to needed equipment and accessories as well as to ingredients and basic techniques such as candy making. Otherwise, this title is divided into 4 categories: "Nusses, seeds and almonds", "Fruchtiges", "Blüten- und Kräutdelikates" and "Feines Küssung". Some recipes are quite easy to follow, but most are quite demanding and need some time. Comparison titles are: "Gifts from my garden" (A. 12)

content.text: Designing urn graves beautiful: with plant ideas for the whole year. Using 15 concrete examples, the author describes the interplay of grave signs and design, permanent planting and alternating beds. With plant portraits of slow growing and compact plants that are particularly suitable for urn graves
content.title_en: Designing urn graves beautiful : with plant ideas for the whole year

content.text: Taste the Waste : Recipes and ideas for food rescuers; [the cookbook on the bestseller Die Essensvermöger]. After the movie "Taste the Waste" (IN 15/12) and the book on the film by S. Kreutzberger: "Die Essensvermöger" (ID-A 38/11), the topic of scandalous food destruction of up to 50% of the products is on the current agenda. Not only business and politics, but also every individual consumer is called for rethinking and action. An alternative scene has already developed, which propagates and practices a conscious handling of food. People, for example, who live from discarded food from containers or implement common cooking, sharing and gifting of leftovers and other ideas of waste prevention. The "rebels at the stove", whose ideas and recipes are presented in this accompanying cookbook to the film, are not only activists from the alternative scene, but also top chefs. The creative, appealing layout - contrary to the usual cookbook image - corresponds to the test-exciting of the list of recommendations and library offerings.
content.title_en: Taste the Waste : Recipes and ideas for food savers ; [the cookbook for best sellers The food destroyers]

content.text: The historical guide to the working class movement in Berlin. This historical guide, in six chapters, provides information in chronological order from the revolutionary beginnings of 1848 to the present day on sites of the social democratic workers' movement in Berlin. After each introductory short essay, individual historical places are presented in their former and present meaning or use. Portraits of important personalities of the workers' movement complement the local entries. Furthermore, the book is informed about trade unions, associations and associations of the workers' cultural movement, about modern settlements and last resting places. Many historical and current pictures and numerous maps allow the discovery of the described places. The volume is published for the 150th anniversary of the Social Democracy (see the "Beck Wissen" volume by B. Faulenbach, in this no.), for which there will be numerous events in spring 2013. (3)
content.title_en: Workers' Movement in Berlin : the historical guide

content.text: Buying for the waste dump: the principle of planned obsolescence. A product that does not break is the nightmare of capitalism. It gives trade bad sales. Consumption, however, is the engine of our economic system. And so we throw away and buy new, instead of repairing it, especially today is often cheaper. Since the light bulb cartel of the 1920s, many products do not last as long as they could: Firewires burn early, laser printers set the work on chip-controlled orders, and every three years a new computer must be produced, since the old with the latest operating system can not keep any more pace. Behind this is system: "Planned obsolescence" means the principle that the deliberate reduction of life span from the beginning. Thanks to cheap production and wasteful use of raw materials, it has become the cornerstone of the overflow societies and their fetish economic growth.
content.title_en: Buying for the garbage dump : the principle of planned obsolescence

These very heterogeneous, but well developed initiatives and grassroots projects through registers and glossary are described in a uniform scheme (including Internet addresses) and in the form of refreshing, encouraging "stories of success". These are examples of what is already taking place in the field of environmental protection, consumption, nutrition, construction, energy and elsewhere. And these initiatives are all more important than to argue at international conferences without following the "world rescue". The last third deals with the "high point of mobility" with a fact-rich (but only Germany considering) "atlas of present mobility" and with imaginative descriptions of possible mobility developments until 2030 and 2050. The 20 authors (including 11 men), recognized experts in matters of the future, give many suggestions for reflection and making. (2) (Siegfried Lörcher) This future salmanach is a kaleidoscope (72) "the topic of mobility", on the other hand, "the topic of mobility today", "the topic of mobility".
content.title_en: Mobility priority

content.text: Die in Mexico: Reports from the inside of the drug war. Describes very drastically and in extremely shocking details the terrible drug war in Mexico and demands of the USA to end the restrictive drug policy, legalize drugs and thus to free the Mexican state from the spiral of violence. (Joachim Bahler) Gibler lives since 2006 in Mexico and reports since then in various media from the country - so far primarily for the American market. This 1st translated text describes very drastically and in extremely shocking details the terrible drug war in Mexico, which since 2006 has cost the lives of more than 50,000 people and the resulting corruption and the decay of the state. The abundance of detailed described crimes of both the drug cartels and the state organs almost hides the fact that Gibler has led to the escalation, the effects e.g. on journalism very clearly analyzed and named. His conclusion from this situation is a demand to the USA to end the prohibition policy, to legalize the drugs and thus to deprive the drug cartels and thus the Mexican state of its place. (Auffs) is more important to free the abuse.
content.title_en: Die in Mexico : Reports from the Inside of the Drug War

content.text: Thanks for the life: Roman. Toto is a miracle. An orphan without a clear gender. Too fat, too big, begotten in a suff. The father already cut off before birth, the mother soon afterwards. And yet Toto remains untouched. Born in the cold summer of 1966, he walks through the GDR as if there were everything else: goodness, innocence, love. Why, he asks, do the people make this life even more terrible than it already is? Toto goes to the West, where capitalism destroys what socialism has caused to rot. Only two things make him hope - the reunion with Kasimir and his only talent: singing. Toto leads to Paris. A furious, shrill novel by a great author about the only thing in life counts. "Sibylle Berg sends in her novel "Many thanks for the life of a hermaphrodite through German history." The story of Toto is a irritating, fascinating inventory of the grey , "FAZ". He returns to the top of the list of socialism in September 2012!
content.title_en: Thanks for life : Roman

content.text: The environmental assessment of biogas plants is based on the ecological assessment of the crop yield. [...] A motivation for this study is in particular the consideration of the low-saxon conditions in the ecological assessment. The biogas plant systems in the different regions of Lower Saxony differ primarily from one another by the available or used substrate types. While in the arable region of South Lower Saxony no economic fertiliser is available as a substrate, the utilization of manure from resident livestock farms does not pose a problem for the plants in the processing and mixed region. The plant from the dairy livestock region is characterized by the fact that grass silage is used as a substrate from the grassland that predominates in the region. The availability of alternative energy crops in this region is lower, as the arable areas for the cultivation of livestock feed are proven. The choice of the substrates used has a significant influence on the results of the ecological assessment. This effect is particularly evident in the case of the substrate fertilisers and grass silage. The use of economic fertilisers has a twofold positive effect on the ecological assessment. For the purpose of the use of the crop crops, the use of the crop is not allocated to the crop crops.
content.title_en: Life cycle assessment of biogas plants : taking into account the low Saxon conditions

content.text: Niedersächsisches Gaststättengesetz (NGastG) : Commentary with explanations on the Niedersächsisches Non-smoking Protection Act. By the Niedersächsische Gaststättengesetz (NGastG) which entered into force on 1 January 2012, the state legislature has made use of its legislative competence and replaced the old Bundesgaststättengesetz (Bundesgaststättengesetz) which has been extended to date.
content.title_en: Niedersächsisches Gaststättengesetz (NGastG) : Commentary with explanations on the Niedersächsisches Non-Smokerschutzgesetz (Lower Saxony Non-Smoker Protection Act)

content.text: Medialization: the medialization of the human being. The exponential growth of mediality leads to a reversal of the relations between the concrete-real and virtual living conditions of the human being. The medialization of the human being is a new phase of development, whose effects are much discussed, but are still far from sufficiently estimated. Not the central places of the countries, cities and villages, but the media platforms and forums form the middle of the cohabitation. On the Internet, everyone can soon be connected to each other. It makes the appearance that the old human dream should be realized here to separate itself from the temporal and geographical conditions of earthly existence, by creating a largely intangible basis of existence. This exciting development on the one hand can lead to a pathological dependence on the Internet and its derivatives. The book puts the individual and collective dimensions of medial dependence into a larger context. From various media-scientific perspectives, answers to the question are sought, which moves the human being, if he shifts his emotional-spiritual existence as far as possible to a virtual level. Numerous examples show that the digitally-involvedness of the Bertva brings a profoundly changing age.
content.title_en: Medialization : from the media dependence of the human being

content.text: Future in the South: how the Mediterranean Union can revive Europe. "The crisis of the South, which is also a midlife crisis of the entire EU, must become the starting point for a fundamental reform that promotes the enlargement and deepening of the Union in a new Euro-Mediterranean region network." Against the prevailing fatality of failure, political and cultural scientist Claus Leggewie sets a realistic counter-project: a new vision of Europe around the Mediterranean. A newly written EU has the potential to develop alternatives for energy supply and financial markets, to establish itself as a peacemaker in the Middle East and, last but not least, to offer a modest democratic model for the states that have to choose between secular and Islamist governments after the Arab revolution.
content.title_en: Future in the South: how the Mediterranean Union can revive Europe

content.text: Gardening with perennials: from Foerster to New German Style. Perennials are no longer to be thought away from the garden. That this was not always the case and how the path of perennials developed into the gardens, describes the studied gardening engineer and trained journalist Masha Schacht in her new book (cf. "A garden full of roses", ID-G 12/11, and "Terraces and seats", ID-B 18/12). A brief historical review at the beginning covers the period before 1900 to 1950. Below, the author presents the development and meaning of perennials through portraits of numerous important plant breeders, gardeners and garden designers by Karl Foerster, Richard Hansen and Beth Chatto, who initiated the use of perennials after the natural areas of life, via Piet Oudolf, Gabriella Pape, Wolfgang Oehme and others until the establishment of the New German Garden Style (Cassian Schmidt, Petra Pelz, Stefan Körner). An interesting book for passer gardeners with numerous photos of beautiful gardening facilities and beds, which is expensive but worth the gardening of the gardeners; the numerous stands and gardens.
content.title_en: Garden design with perennials : from Foerster to New German Style

content.text: Cheese made from sheep's, goat's and cow's milk. Book for cheese preparation for private individuals and farm shop operators. The author, himself dairy master, provides the basics of the feeding process for the marketing of dairy products. In detail, besides basic knowledge on milk processing and cheese production, variable basic recipes and legal regulations are offered.
content.title_en: Cheese made from sheep's, goats' and cows' milk

content.text: Space for education : Aesthetics and architecture of learning and living places. An interdisciplinary collection on the perception, appropriation and design of spaces: He presents conceptual, theoretical and empirical approaches to the intersections between architecture and urban planning, pedagogic and psychology, as well as art and music, and focuses on the connection between living and learning places, as well as spatial ideals and educational utopias.
content.title_en: Space for education : Aesthetics and architecture of learning and living places

content.text: Search engine optimization: step by step to optimal ranking; improve your Google ranking by linking, on-page optimization, editorial SEO and much more; DVD-ROM for Windows, Mac and Linux. Many video trainings are about special programs whose functions are intensively considered and conveyed. This is different with the Galileo DVD for search engine optimization (SEO), which is rightly addressed by Trainer Kubitz as Google optimization. Readers, seers and listeners are mainly experiencing a talk of almost 7 hours on the topic, in many places well illustrated. In this way, some topics are also dealt with, which are rarely found in books on SEO technology. However, many current examples from the Internet and especially at Google are also shown. The application of the mostly free Google tools is also explained. Thus, the small entrepreneur also learns what he could do better with his web presence. The whole topic can and should also interest every Google user. He learns that and how he is manipulated, that for him but often leads to better search results. But also - Abbeck is recommended for small libraries.
content.title_en: Search engine optimization: step by step to optimal ranking; improve your Google ranking by link building, onpage optimization, editorial SEO and much more; DVD-ROM for Windows, Mac and Linux

content.text: Urban everyday life: the paradox of differentiation and homogenisation in urban districts. The trends in everyday life in terms of flexibility are currently reflected in the urban-political paradox of leading differences as urban qualities and actually generating homogenisation: times of everyday life are less and less standardised and the places of everyday activities seem more often to be individually identifiable. In urban districts, flexibilization is a central cause of conflicts that are exacerbated, especially with the urban-political goal, to support everyday forms of creatives in urban spaces. Anne Vogelpohl conceptualises the social connection between everyday life and urban districts along the terms Henri Lefebvre's space, everyday life and rhythms and evaluates them along his understanding of urbanization.
content.title_en: Urban everyday life: the paradox of differentiation and homogenization in urban districts

content.text: The author, Professor of Ancient History at the University of Kassel, with a focus on ancient technology history, presents a concise but very informative work on the development of technology in this period. He shows that the origins of ancient technology are mainly to be found in ancient Egypt and the Old East, and then mainly dedicates himself to the development of technology in Greek and Roman culture, divided into the various "areas of application", namely agriculture (at that time, because of the nutritional situation most important), metals, salt, handicrafts, construction technology, transport, infrastructure, communication, mechanics and time measurement, as well as the military technology that often makes war decisions at that time. The connections he points out are fascinating, also his hints on the already then occurring technological consequences, such as the destruction of forests by the enormous wood consumption during metal extraction. Very recommendable and inexpensive! (1)
content.title_en: History of the Ancient Technique

content.text: Time belongs to us : Resistance to the regime of acceleration. Hengsbach (born 1937), Jesuit and emeritus professor of Christian social ethics, is still active as Attac adviser and lecturer for system criticism, distributive justice and more humane living conditions. This book reads like an update of "The Perspective of Reform" (BA 2/05), when he accuses the financial markets of having triggered acceleration and destructive dynamics in all areas, which continues to be a serious burden on privacy, family and community life. He also analyses in detail financial, debt crisis, political decisions and their consequences. With excursions in philosophy and history, he demands a lot from the reader, but helps with the respective sum of the 5 major chapters, 4 of which he calls "building stones". A very challenging chapter deals with the subject of "time". Finally, there are suggestions for a decelerated life - as the book title seems to promise - and the reference to a growing number of time-rebels. (3)
content.title_en: Time belongs to us : Resistance to the regime of acceleration

content.text: Artificial intelligence: a modern approach. "Artificial intelligence" is a sub-area of computer science that is developing very quickly. S. Russell's book is considered a standard work and is already available in the 3rd edition (previous editions are not discussed). The new edition is thoroughly revised. The introductory chapter on machine learning is completely new. The web search and information extraction as well as techniques for learning from very large data volumes are now treated very well. Microelectronic devices and robots as well as learning based on neural networks are also taken into consideration. The book aims to present concepts of artificial intelligence. The teaching material is well understandable on the basis of the many examples. These examples are consistently derived from the basic idea of an intelligent agent who uses perceptions from his environment to react. The students of the basic study are addressed in the first line; each of the 27 chapters offers material for a lecture week. Introductions also offer U. Lämmel (BA 2/09, already suitable for secondary-levels II) and W. Ertel (BA 12/09). (3)
content.title_en: Artificial intelligence : a modern approach

content.text: Regional distribution of regionally-effective financial state aid in the context of regional economic development. The report describes the regional distribution of regionally-relevant regionally-relevant regionally-effective financial state aid in the period 1995 to 2008. The study units are the federal states and the rural and non-rural settlement structural circle types in the old and new federal states. Ten areas of support are described, with particular reference to the measures for the development of rural areas. In addition to the description of regional differences in the use of funding, regional differences in other potential explanatory variables for regional economic growth are described. There are marked regional differences in the intensity of support and the relative importance of the individual areas of support as well as other hard and soft location factors at all levels of the study.
content.title_en: Regional distribution of regional financial support in the context of regional economic development

content.text: Sustainable urban and transport planning: basics and solutions. Based on the basics of urban planning, this book deals with the special aspect of sustainability in current urban and transport development and the handling of existing urban structures. The topics of demographic change, energy saving, environmental and climate protection are the focus. It contains both basic information as an introduction to the topic as well as concrete examples from the practice.
content.title_en: Sustainable urban and transport planning: basics and solutions

content.text: Is technology the future of human nature? 36 Essays. Science and technology are not an end in itself, they are intended to provide benefits. But where does it lead us when technology literally comes to life? Is technology perhaps the future of human nature? With this question, the Forschungszentrum Karlsruhe (the present Karlsruhe Institute of Technology) – one of the great natural and engineering research centres in Europe – came to the public in the spring of 2006. An essay competition in the tradition of academic prize-giving in the Enlightenment turned to the younger generation of scientists, who are preparing to assume responsibility in research, teaching and business. However, what does the provocative speech of optimising mean at all? Whether antidepressive or plastic surgery, whether gene therapy or nanorobots, is to be improved, yes, optimized, to the point of impermeability? What does the provocative speech of optimizing mean? Are the possibilities of gene conversion – for example, in the interaction of brain research, nano-complete, and the use of bio-complenity – of the concept of bio-biography and information technology?
content.title_en: Is technology the future of human nature? : 36 Essays

content.text: Mindfulness : a Buddhist concept conquers science. The concept of mindfulness is 2500 years old and comes from Buddhism. Now it conquers the sciences: Psychologists, neuroscientists and physicians have been able to prove that mindfulness meditations have a positive effect on a wide variety of diseases and stresses. But also in education and other social sciences, attention is met with a positive response. For the first time, international experts from natural, social and human sciences as well as representatives of Buddhism clarify how mindfulness can change science and society. The Dalai Lama has also contributed to the project.
content.title_en: Mindfulness : a Buddhist concept conquers science

content.text: Legal ex machina : Formalization of the right on the Internet of services. Software is increasingly gaining influence on human interactions and thus increasingly becomes a tension between law and society. Problems arise in particular because software design without any democratic legitimation deeply intervenes in many areas of life without taking into account the legal framework. From the point of view of the software developer this usually happens from ignorance of the legal framework. The present contribution to legal information technology therefore provides the conception and implementation of a productive system to support the development of legally compliant software, which also allows a runtime control. The approach is based on a technical implementation of the legal subsuming as far as possible and is complemented by a large complexity reduction of the normative issues. As a scenario, the development of the "Internet of services" is to serve as a comprehensive ecosystem, in which services are tradable, for example, via market places on the Internet.
content.title_en: Legal ex machina : formalisation of the law on the Internet of services

content.text: The IT Security Manager : current practical knowledge for IT Security Manager and IT Security Officer in companies and authorities. Benefit from the authors' experience. This book provides you with the current and reliable practical knowledge on IT security management. The structure and content of the work have already proven themselves in the training of IT Security Officers. Based on fundamental considerations about the security process in the company, topics such as ISO 27001 and IT basic protection are treated as clearly and intelligibly as theory and practice of security policies and security concepts, vulnerability analysis and assessment. Enriched with many practical examples, you will learn everything you need to know about security measures: for the areas of organization, personnel, infrastructure and technology up to the implementation of awareness campaigns in your company. The third edition has been updated and expanded with new topics.
content.title_en: The IT Security Manager : Current practical knowledge for IT Security Manager and IT Security Officer in companies and authorities

content.text: In the turning circle of chaos: climate change and the new geography of violence. The American professor and journalist describes the meeting of climate change with the economic and political problems in emerging states and the so-called "3rd world". (Helmut Lange) The title is the region of the earth between the two turning circles of cancer and Capricorn. Here are the most states of the so-called "3rd world" which are first and most severely affected by climate change. The American professor received his doctorate at the London School of Economics and writes for the "The Washington Post" and "New York Times". He examines the meeting of desertification, acidification of the seas and rising sea level with the political and economic problems in Africa, Asia and Latin America, which lead to catastrophic developments. Tribal feuds, civil wars, refugee movements and the dissolution of states are accelerated and the state leaderships develop hardly more than military countermeasures. Nevertheless, Parenti also sees hope for effective countermeasures which he presents in the closing chapter. With his comprehensive view, he stands in a series with H. Welzer broad: "Bactus/Bactus" (Backs/Backs).
content.title_en: In the turning circle of chaos: climate change and the new geography of violence

content.text: Proper heating and ventilation in apartments. Proper heating and ventilation in apartments, especially in new buildings and renovated, newly insulated houses, is indispensable. Improved thermal insulation and airtightness can quickly lead to unpleasant moisture damage if wrong behaviour is carried out. Mould formation is the most famous symptom here. This brochure, now in the 5th edition, shows how such ""housing damage"" and unnecessary conflicts between builders and tenants can be avoided on the one hand and builders and architects or craftsmen on the other side. (publisher information)
content.title_en: Real heating and ventilation in apartments

content.text: Introduction to scientific work: including e-learning, web research, digital presentation, etc. Through the progressive digitalisation and development of the Internet, the framework conditions for organised and institutionalised, but also informal learning processes have changed considerably. What does this mean for scientific work? The volume takes up these developments in depth and thoroughly and places them in the context of the requirements for a high-quality degree programme. (Verlag)
content.title_en: Introduction to scientific work: including e-learning, web research, digital presentation, etc.

content.text: Structural change and climate change: how climate policy changes the economy and the working world; a study. To reduce climate change, greenhouse gases in the industrialised countries must be drastically reduced by the middle of the century. This involves strengthening economic structural change. The present study combines knowledge about climate change in Germany's economy and working world. It is clear that the level of information is limited. Although sectors that are particularly burdened by avoidance costs or benefit from additional demand can be identified, due to a large number of complex effects, the employment effects can only be covered by great uncertainties: significant job gains and losses of individual sectors result in a rather low net gain in employment for the whole economy. The additional induced intersectoral structural change in employment should be left behind intra-sectoral adaptation requirements. Skill requirements will tend to increase, but completely new skills are not required. Necessary additional qualifications can usually be acquired through further training.
content.title_en: Structural change and climate change : how climate policy changes economy and working world ; a study

content.text: PPS in automotive engineering : Production program planning and control of vehicles and aggregates. This textbook describes the processes and methods of production program planning and control in automotive engineering in detail and practical terms for the first time. Theoretical principles are the definitions of varied products and complex production and dispatch structures with the help of quantity and interval algebra, for which understandable definition schemes are developed. The practical applications based on these are explained by numerous examples.
content.title_en: PPS in automotive construction : Production programme planning and control of vehicles and aggregates

content.text: Games develop for iPhone and iPad: programming, graphics, sound and special effects. "Casual games" is the most popular computer game genre at the moment: graphically not very sophisticated games that can be learned quickly, require only a simple pattern of action by the player and are played especially on mobile devices (smartphones or tablets). The author describes in detail and deeply the complete development of such a casual game from planning to programming for Apple's iOS (i.e. for iPad and iPhone), to offering the finished game in Apple's own AppStore. As examples, 12 games with different game motifs are used for this purpose. Open source products such as Blender or Gimp are used for design and animation. Target groups are professional users with prior knowledge of game or app programming and experience with the programming language Objective-C. In addition: Berlin photos by Marek Pozniak with his blackbox camera. Dieter Hoffmann-Axthelm, urban planner, architectural critic, essayist, born in 1940 and raised in Berlin. Studied theology, philosophy and history; in the 90s cooperation at the plan plant in downtown Berlin, accompanied for decades building and becoming in Berlin with a critical view. "We get a bit of city planning explained how this developed, sometimes city planning is another word for misplanning. Beautiful example: the former Kranzler-Eck, Ku'Damm Ecke Joachimsthaler. There were opportunities for charm and beauty between the city tour - Berlin not used as a critical example.

content.text: Technical standardization and intellectual property. Technical standardization not only permeates the business life, but also private everyday life. Against this background, the author is dedicated to the interaction of standardization, intellectual property law and antitrust law on the basis of Austrian and European legal situation. This closes a gap in Austrian legal literature. Practically and legally founded questions such as the consequences of non-disclosure of property rights in the standardization process or lack of IP compliance are examined. Univ.-Ass. Dr. Clemens Appl was born in Vienna in 1982. He passed the diploma and maturation examination with distinction in 2001 at the Technical Gewerbemuseum Wien in the Higher Department of Business Engineering. Clemens Appl has since since worked as a university assistant at the Department of Information and Intellectual Property Law of the Vienna University of Economics and Business University of Vienna. Clemens Appl has been a freelancer in October 2002 at the Faculty of Law of the University of Vienna and has completed his degree in legal science and in 2006.
content.title_en: Technical standardisation and intellectual property

His brother Matìas died just now, who had long lost his revolutionary enthusiasm but had found a new task in alternative agriculture. Around them, family members, friends and helpers, who give a sobering picture of today's Spain, are corrupt, egocentric and incapable of meeting the ethical and ecological challenges of the time. content.text: Introduction to regular expressions : Understanding regular expressions step by step. Regular expressions allow sample comparisons and allow to search and replace strings. This is important for complex word processing problems, but also for effective and fast program creation. A still highly recommended manual is J. Friedl (ID 8/10). Many examples are found in the "cookbook" of J. Goyvaerts (ID 10/08), which also addresses the implementation of regular expressions in different programming languages. In this book the author addresses beginners without any prior knowledge. He relies on a variety of examples, which then derive general rules. Several (mostly free) tools are used. This procedure is already very clear with the first example, the discovery of a US-American telephone number. Focus is on various search techniques, e.g. lookarounds (identification of text that precedes or follows a given text directly), reverse reference or finding Unicode characters. Many useful attachments, e.g. a reference to regular expressions (2).

content.text: The future of the Kulturforum: The song of the island of objects. "The Kulturforum has remained a testimony to the division of the city two decades after the fall of the Berlin Wall. The quarter between Potsdamer Platz and Landwehrkanal - with Hans Scharouns Philharmonie and Ludwig Mies van der Rohes Neuer Nationalgalerie location of two icons of German post-war architecture - is like an urban-planning area. For over half a century, the former most important home of Berlin's citizens has been a painful wound that cannot cure the cultural buildings with their world-significant art collections and musical performances. The debate about the future of the Kulturforum has now occupied more than two generations of city builders, architects and politicians in the most diverse political constellations. With this book, Hans Stimmann, long-standing Senate Building Director and in this Funktiion, also himself, is taking part in the cultural forum, in the ongoing discussion about a transformation of the place. Town-building designs by six well-known architects underline the call for a necessary change.
content.title_en: Future of the Cultural Forum : Singing to the Island of Objects

content.text: Children of mentally ill parents: Identify and treat developmental risks. Biographical note: Dr. med. Angela Plass, University Hospital Hamburg-Eppendorf. -- Dr. rer. nat. Silke Wiegand-Grefe is head of the prevention project »Children of mentally ill parents« at the University Hospital Hamburg Eppendorf (UKE). According to current estimates, about 3 million children in Germany grow up with a mentally ill parent. This is a difficult situation for the children: they cannot understand the behavior of their parents, they lack the necessary care, they get into conflicts of loyalty or are excluded from the family. It is therefore not surprising that 60 percent of these children themselves develop a mental disorder. Here it is important to deal early with the problems and problems of children of mentally ill parents. The authors explain where the dangers lie for affected children and how they can be counteracted. They pay particular attention to the individual differences between the children and the special relationship with their parents. Dr. med. Angela Plasss, University Hospital Hamburg-Eppendorf.
content.title_en: Children of mentally ill parents : Identifying and treating developmental risks

content.text: Statistics for the social sciences: basics, methods, applications. This completely revised re-edited textbook provides an application-oriented introduction to social science statistics and provides in an understandable form the basics of statistical data analysis. In the presentation of statistical analysis methods, the application requirements and interpretation possibilities are highlighted. In addition, the relationship to the underlying general logic of statistical reasoning is also shown. Readers can thus easily identify common features and differences between different analysis methods, which helps to select the most appropriate method in their own applications. content.text: The book examines the inclusion of persons in the globalized functional systems of modern society. It is about the "performance roles" in which someone assumes activities and obligations that are constitutive for a social sphere of action. Secondly, the multiplicity of "public roles" is analysed, which are available alternatively when the focus of a person's activity is elsewhere. Also through these audience roles, the person can intervene in the events of the systems. Third, "exclusion" is the subject of discussion, i.e. the possibility of non-consideration and exclusion of persons from social systems. A sociologically central question is whether in Modern Exclusion always leads to a re-inclusion in another social place. These three strands are linked to the book, which is now in second edition, with considerations about migration, the theory of world society and the forms of inequality in society.
content.title_en: Inclusion and exclusion : Studies on social theory

content.text: New self-employed people in European comparison: structure, dynamics and social security. In the 1970s, an increase in self-employment, the so-called "Renaissance of self-employment" was introduced across Europe. This volume highlights this trend according to various economic, structural and social criteria in the country comparison (Germany, the Netherlands, Italy, Sweden and the United Kingdom). One result of the country comparison is that the boom of self-employment has included a large number of people who do not have the profile of the traditional self-employed (small business operators, professions, small business enterprises and secret professions). The "new self-employed" often establish in the service sector small, micro or solo enterprises, often without or only with small assets. In particular, solo self-employment is characterized by high mobility and frequent status changes. These developments are linked with new demands on social security for the responsible actors and institutions. This volume shows by the example of central insurance sectors, whether and in what form the national state-guarant systems are set on these challenges.
content.title_en: New self-employed in European comparison : structure, dynamics and social security

content.text: Parent participation and violence prevention in municipal educational and educational landscapes: Models and instruments for practice. How is the interaction of youth assistance, school, young people and especially parents promoted? How is the topic of violence prevention integrated into the development of the system and how can cooperation be achieved by all professional and non-professional actors, especially parents? The authors focus on parental participation and violence prevention as key and cross-cutting topics for the design of educational and educational landscapes within the framework of a practical research project. They present "good practice", in particular models and instruments that can be used in educational and educational landscapes.
content.title_en: Parent participation and violence prevention in municipal education and education landscapes : models and tools for practice

content.text: Confidential strangers: Acceptance in the promotion of integration of migrants in Japan and Germany. Conflicts of integration form part of the everyday world of experience of individuals in today's societies. This study, which is based on the Japanese-German comparison, therefore examines how they can achieve acceptance as constructive handling of these conflicts. It sets out interview statements in relation to structures of migration and integration policy control at the national and local level. In this context, a surprising small influence of political control was shown. Rather, the respondents constructed subjectively defined "confidential strangers to whom they restricted their acceptance. The subjective character of this exclusivity refers in the perspective to the potential of biographical diversity for promoting social inclusion.
content.title_en: Confident strangers : Acceptance in the integration promotion of migrants in Japan and Germany

content.text: We are the state! : why people are not enough. All state power goes from the people but it never returns to it. That has always been a problem. Since politicians have given so much of the power they have given to globally operating economic and financial giants, the state itself is part of the problem. It is just as in crisis as the banks. Because with power it is like with money: it does not disappear, but only changes the owner. And the new owners do not give it back. That is why politics does not solve the permanent crisis either.
content.title_en: We are the state! : why people are not enough

Surprisingly, under the same title, a garden book by John Brookes has already been published by the same publisher (BA 12/05), which focuses on planning and designing gardens. The newly published work with contributions by various British authors is a comprehensive manual for hobby gardeners. It contains all garden-relevant topics, from garden design to the right choice of plants, the resulting care work to frequently occurring problems. An extra chapter is dedicated to the garden with portraits of numerous fruit and vegetable species. In the abundance of topics, of course, much can only be dealt with scarcely and superficially. Nevertheless, both beginners and advanced gardeners will gladly take advantage of this reference work and browse it. Over 1,000 colored photos and illustrations and the many practical tips and suggestions make it extremely attractive. An "allrounder" that can be used in any library. (2)
content.title_en: The new garden school : plan, plant, maintain, harvest

There are no uniform standards for energy plus, zero energy or efficiency houses. All buildings that they generate in the total amount of energy in the annual average are shown. The architect Bettina Rühm (last ID-B 7/12) presents a broad range of currently discussed concepts in the large-format text-image-band with 20 projects from Germany, Austria and Switzerland. After an introduction to the topic, among others to the building framework and energy standards, residential buildings and commercial buildings, both new buildings and sanitized buildings with different construction concepts and heating energy systems are discussed. There is information on planning and living space for the building owners, among others, about the building materials and architectural drawings.

content.text: The world has changed: people are increasingly producing their own food; buses, cyclists and pedestrians dominate cities; fossil fuels are on the move; environmental technologies are booming worldwide. Yet, this world is still a vision, but there are increasing signs of change everywhere. The book shows how this path can be pursued Our world has changed: people are increasingly producing their own food; in cities buses, cyclists and pedestrians dominate; the fossil fuels are on the move; the environmental technologies are booming worldwide. Still, this world is a vision, but everywhere there are increasing signs of change. The book shows how this path can be pursued. For all areas of our existence - mobility, housing, energy, nutrition, work - best practice examples are shown that make a desire for a different future.
content.title_en: Future Report: How Green Change Works

content.text: The analysis of the English economist and professor of sustainable development at the University of Surrey suggests that we should at least review our convictions. Review (ekz): Wealth and economic growth - both seem inseparably linked in our thinking. This is demonstrated by the ongoing debates in the face of the global economic crisis. Tim Jackson, English economist and professor of sustainable development at the University of Surrey, encourages us to decouple growth and prosperity in industrial nations. His analysis and his ideas call into question firm convictions. In the forewords to the new edition, the respective authors - Jürgen Trittin, chairman of the Bundestag faction of Alliance 90/Die Grünen, Uwe Schneidewind, President of the Wuppertal Institute for Climate, Environment, Energy and Barbara Unmüi-g, board of the Heinrich Böll Foundation - point to the German Bundestag's "Growth, prosperity, sustainability" Enquete Commission, whose results are expected for this year. The book is not easily accessible and must be read with interest and expertise. Since the author takes a counterposition to the common view, the title should be widely offered.
content.title_en: Prosperity without growth : life and economies in a finite world

content.text: The construction site of the future: the great transformation of economy and society. Human beings are driving the planet at a high speed at its limits of resilience. It is clear that we must come to climate-friendly lifestyles and a post-fossil way of economy. There is no longer much time for this major transformation. It is good that some have already begun: companies maximize the satisfaction of their employees instead of their profits. Neighbours are building their vegetables together in urban gardens and municipalities are taking energy supply into their own hands.The radical transformation will not be based solely on technological solutions. Rather, it is about actively shaping the transition as a profound cultural process. This will not be easy, but it is worth it: In the culture of the rich, breathe nature and people. The oekom association aims to promote communication on ecology and sustainability - between the disciplines as well as between science, politics, economics and society. For this, the association for ecological communication (oekom) e.V. contributes to the necessary insights and helps in practice.
content.title_en: Construction site Future : the great transformation of economy and society

content.text: Germany 2030: how we live in the future. Updated new edition (ID 49/08) of this important "future reports on scientific basis" of the well-known futurologist. In contrast to previous editions, the study now focuses on keywords such as growth, prosperity and quality of life. Social and ecological future markets as well as individual networks represent thus the most important future potentials of our society. Accordingly, the original text 3 new chapters were put forward. Otherwise, the structure of the book with the main topics of work, consumption, environment, media, sports, experience, vacation, living, culture, education, social, values, generational contract and prevention remained essentially the same. The basis are again (mainly in Germany) opinion surveys and the author's literature study, documented by numerous sources. The many individual information are presented in the text as well as in over 130 graphics and are also extensively illustrated by a detailed factual register. Where the predecessor editions were used, should also be offered in this new edition. (3) (LK/GÖ: Vetter) Updated new edition of the book. How will our world be changed until 2030? How can we actively explain these futures?
content.title_en: Germany 2030: how we live in the future

Müller-Boysen) The "New practical book Fairytale" of the author living on Sylt (librarian, trained fairytale narrator) supplements the first volume (BA 06/01) with 50 new fairytales in its own narrative version. Like Band eins a good introduction to the genre Fairytale and an appropriate idea book for the pedagogical-literary work with fairytales in family, kindergarten, school and old-age work. (I. Müller-Boysen)
content.title_en: New practical book Fairytale

content.text: Deception in strategic communication: A communication science analysis. Can PR managers lie? Are they primarily committed to truthfulness or loyalty to their client? These questions are the subject of intense debates in the field of strategic communication. Kerstin Thummes develops a definition of deception based on communication science and a basis for evaluation, through which deception can be systematized based on its motives and functions. Based on this, the boundaries of harmful and the need for protective deception in market communication and PR are analyzed. As a result, the absolute claim to truthfulness of PR managers proves to be unfulfilled. Rather, it shows that public relations can only achieve its legitimization goal if it succeeds in establishing certain necessary deceptions with protective functions as part of the role of PR.
content.title_en: Deception in strategic communication : A communication science analysis

content.text: The practical manual Event Management is a reference book for all those who plan and organize events in their company. The author shows how to plan, organize and manage business events efficiently and budget-consciously - from the field service meeting to the trade fair presentation, the press conference to the virtual meeting. Numerous checklists and sample templates complement the practical tips. A book that provides valuable services to assistants every day. New in the 3rd edition: Social Media in Event Management, the planning of virtual meetings, event marketing and much more. From the content: Success factors for the perfect organization - event types - Corner points for the optimal preparation - Milestones defined - Events from A to Z- Small Knigge for hosts - Pleiden, Pech and Pannen mastered confidently - Follow-up and success control - Numerous checklists. The author Irmtraud Schmitt is an entrepreneur, speaker and trainer. She can return to almost 25 years of experience in the field of Management-Assistant and Event Management in Heidelberg.
content.title_en: Practical manual Event Management : the A-Z of the perfect event organization ; with numerous checklists and sample templates

All important changes to technology and standards have been taken into account.With over 300 standards, guidelines and references, it is the textbook and reference work with recognized highest useful value of the optimal support in new presentation. "This book belongs to the standard literature for architects and engineers, which deals with the technical development of buildings." content.text: Radiation measurement and dosimetry. Radiation measurement and dosimetry"Radio sources and dosimetry" is part of a textbook series on radiation physics and radiation protection. The first part deals with the physical foundations of radiation detectors and radiation measurement. The second part describes the concepts and procedures of clinical dosimetry. The third section explains in detail the dose distributions of clinically applied radiation types. The fourth part presents further measurement tasks of radiation physics including the measurement systems for imaging with X-ray radiation. In addition to the basic explanations, this volume contains numerous tables and graphics on technical and medical radiology in the current text, which can be very helpful in practical work and 199 exercise tasks with solutions for deepening the contents. content.title_en: Radiation measurement and dosimetry

content.text: Introduction to urban ecology: Basic principles of the urban human-environment system. What is urban ecology? What do we know about nature in the city and how can cities be ecologically integrated? What role do climate, water balance and soil play in urban spaces? Which plants and animals have adapted particularly well to urban life? How do city dwellers willfully or unintentionally intervene in natural interactions? What importance does urban planning have and with what challenges of global change increasingly need to deal with cities? These and other basic questions of the urban human-environment system are explained in detail and vividly by the author. Merksatzätze in der Randsplite summarize the most important contents and insights concisely, numerous illustrations and tables illustrate the facts and facilitate understanding. A reference system with extensive literature and keyword list enables further deepening and quick finding of information.
content.title_en: Introduction to urban ecology : Basic principles of the urban human-environment system

content.text: Applied developmental psychology of childhood : Accompanying, supporting and supporting in family, day care and primary school. Empirical developmental psychology findings are transferred in this volume to the application in families, day care and primary schools. The starting points are the biopsychosocial development model, the concept of protection and risk factors as well as empirical findings on development-promoting environmental conditions. Various programs are presented and their reference to professional action in pedagogical everyday life is examined. The areas of developmental psychology, pedagogical psychology, clinical child psychology and health science are taken into account.
content.title_en: Applied developmental psychology of childhood : Accompanying, supporting and supporting in family, day care and primary school

content.text: Shamland: poverty among us. We live in one of the richest countries in the world, but every sixth person has to get along with less than the minimum of existence. Rarely do people talk about the poor, never with them. Sociologist Stefan Selke travelled through Germany for several years to talk to poor people about their situation. He meets the single parent, who is happy when her child gets sick before a school trip because it saves you a few euros. Or the craftsman, who gets after a professional accident Hartz IV and packs in supplies at the feeding of the poor so that he does not have to starve on the weekend.
content.title_en: Shamland: the poverty among us

content.text: "This is simply our story" : Life paths of the "second generation" after National Socialism. Study by social scientists of the Alice-Salomon-Hochschule Berlin, which gives a profound insight into the complex chaining of the consequences of the Nazi regime and the resulting traditions of the descendants of victims, perpetrators and followers born after 1945
content.title_en: "This is simply our story" : Life paths of the "second generation" after National Socialism

content.text: Youth today: between pressure for performance and virtual freedom. In view of the rapidly changing world of life, this volume deals with some of the challenges that youths today face. Stress, burnout, depression and phobias, up to increasing suicide rates among students, are just some of the symptoms that are triggered not least by reforms such as G8 and Pisa. The contributions show whether and how psychotherapists, teachers and others can support today's youth with professional means.
content.title_en: Youth Today : Between Performance Pressure and Virtual Freedom

content.title_en: The New and its Enemies: how ideas are prevented and how they prevail

content.text: Literature for the school: a work lexicon on German teaching. The work lexicon on German-language literature is primarily aimed at students of German studies with the aim of teaching German and teaching German. The editors, two renowned university professors, want to make their readers aware of the "wideness and diversity" of German literature in more than 500 individual articles. However, since the text selection was based on an evaluation of 100 reading lists of secondary schools, the focus here is inevitably on the literature of the 20th century and above all on contemporary literature. The 870-page volume is alphabetically divided into authors and works or groups of works and offers in the individual articles, written by academic experts, a compact but thoroughly legible overview of content, authoring, contextual references and interpretative aspects. Since literary didactic considerations and references only occupy a scarce space, this literary lexicon is suitable as a first information for the texts already well for pupils of secondary school II.
content.title_en: Literature for the school : a work encyclopedia on German lessons

content.text: Beyond citizen participation: urban development as a joint task? : analyses and concepts. Civic participation and urban development - a topic with a long history, a topic that currently enjoys special attention. Reason enough to put it to the test and ask: Are the old concepts and concepts of participation still suitable? Are the demands for more participation in the right direction? And: How does all this come about on the ground? Does the everyday life of citizen participation change? What new developments can be observed?
content.title_en: Beyond citizen participation: urban development as a common task? : analyses and concepts

content.text: Recommendations for planning, construction and maintenance of gabions : from the work of the RWA "gabions". Background and content of the rules: gabions are a popular and frequently used design element in the free country and in the settlement area, which are used in particular in gardening and landscaping for a variety of purposes. The past experience has shown that in the case of non-professional planning and execution of gabions there can be long-term defects and damages. In practice, however, there have not been uniform requirements for planning, construction and maintenance of gabions for the various fields of use of gardening and landscaping. The present rules deal with the typical plannerical tasks of gardening and landscape architect and the execution of gardening and landscaping. In future, it is intended to contribute to avoiding defects and damages due to planning and execution errors in gabion constructions. Under interdisciplinary participation of many professional associations and experts in the FLL regulation committee as well as consulting individuals from science and practice, a normative recommendation has been created that establishes the reference to the respective field of application and reflects the state of technology.
content.title_en: Recommendations for planning, construction and maintenance of gabions : from the work of RWA "Gabions"

content.text: Deserts : Origin, characteristics, habitat ; 26 tables. In "deserts" many people think first of the Sahara or other deserts in Africa. The fact that the term "desert" covers a very wide range of types is shown by the emeritus geography professor and desert expert Blümel in this comprehensive textbook. In the first half it characterizes the different desert types, such as deserts, savannas, coastal deserts as well as polars and high mountain cold deserts. It explains the different climatic and geomorphological processes that lead to the formation of deserts and also addresses soils, vegetation and fauna. In the regional section it describes in detail individual deserts such as Sahara, Namib and Kalahari in Africa, the South American deserts, the Australian deserts and semi-deserts, Takla Makan and Gobi in Asia as well as the cold deserts of the polar regions. In addition to geomorphological and climatic aspects, it also deals with cultural history. With outlook on the future of the deserts. Goods and deserts are very much known.
content.title_en: Deserts : Origin, characteristics, habitat ; 26 tables

content.text: Future green : Architecture and design for a better future. Sustainable design, the need to consider the environment and resource scarcity, is the connecting theme of the informative illustrated book. Well-known architects, designers and curators have selected over 100 projects in the fields of architecture and urban planning, but also product design and landscape architecture from all over the world, to which the definition applies. In addition to generous imaging, texts that describe the speciality and functionality are presented. On 2-4 pages each, everything is described so comprehensively that the reader gets an idea of what the future can look like in everyday life according to designers. Technical areas are only touched, the aesthetics and value for sustainability are at the center. With an essay on design as necessary good, register and short biographies of the participating designers and architects
content.title_en: Future green : Architecture and design for a better future

content.text: Hydrogen and fuel cells: on the road with the cleanest fuel. Why is hydrogen an energy source? How do fuel cells work? How do we use hydrogen in future vehicles? How safe is technology? The compact book describes the physical and chemical foundations of hydrogen technology in a comprehensible way and explains the expected technical solutions. It presents the problems and enables us to better understand the efforts of industry and research to implement this technology. The authors explain clearly the functioning of the most important components in the transformation chain from renewable electricity to vehicle propulsion and show their technical development potential. Taking into account reliability and economic efficiency, they evaluate the sustainability of the energy cycle that can be realized with the hydrogen energy source.
content.title_en: Hydrogen and fuel cells: on the road with the cleanest fuel

content.text: The mobile wave: how the revolutionary developments of the mobile web will completely change our world. The mobile device in the pocket, data, product information on the net, means of payment an app as well as the stocks of large libraries or the transmission of health data - the new network world with its intelligent devices revolutionizes technology, society and industrial production. (Harald Pilzer) Saylor is a smart MIT graduate and successful software entrepreneur who is pursuing here 2 passions: the science story - that makes e.g. the chapter about paper very readable - and an entrepreneurial approach of "creative destruction" of old industries and processes in favor of new. Also new jobs. In the world of "mobile computing" and the pocket computer, whether app phones or tablets, everything becomes software or has already become: books, music, money, personnel card, news, advertising, travel agencies, libraries, the product information and shopping, education (e-learning with the best [!] 2,000 teachers). Actually, in many industries, only the one-to-one-marketing of the N-marketing of the bin-market are "the big change-buy."

content.text: Observers among themselves: a cultural theory. The philosophers of German idealism Kant, Fichte, Schelling and Hegel have developed concepts which can be regarded as preliminary stages of a theory of the observer. They culminate in the idea of an empty ego, which is precisely why it is referred to a world. In this world theoretical knowledge and practical action never come to the fore, so that the observation and the observer can be formulated as a difference, as complexity. For cultural theory this is a stroke of luck, because it lives from the relationship between the observer and not only other observers, but also to what he observes.
content.title_en: Observers among themselves : a cultural theory

content.text: Fork instead of scalpel: healthy by diet on plant basis. Colin is the author of the much cited "China Study" (Verlag Systemische Medizin, 2nd edition 2011, not shown here). The book is based on the 2012 eponymous documentary. It explains why a purely vegetable diet is good for humans, animals and the environment. Diseases such as stroke, cancer, heart attack, diabetes, Alzheimer's, erectile dysfunction should be avoided or improved. There are tips for switching to a vegan lifestyle and finally 125 recipes. The recipes make some of the pleasure to try out, some of the ingredients are probably only available in natural food or Asia stores. Calorie indications are not necessary, there are also no information on the preparation time and no illustrations. In the text scattered (and disturbing the reading flow) portraits are to the "faces of fork instead of scalpel" and under the title "The amazing results" people report how they were cured by food conversion. content.text: The study examines the possibilities and limits of participation in all its forms (legislation, administration, courts, consumer trade, various forms of informal participation). Besides a general clarification of this question, the study aims at an analysis of the various forms of participation mentioned above at international level, since this area (also) is largely underrepresented in the debates since Stuttgart 21. content.text: Schema coaching : Introduction and practice: basics, methods, case studies. Schema therapy has proved to be very successful in psychotherapy. He explains in general terms where the differences and similarities between psychotherapy and coaching lie. He explains how schema therapy has developed and introduces many short cases and examples into the practice of schema work based on living theory. With this book, he presents a "red thread" of how coaches can skillfully link different methods and thus lead their clients to a positive change in 15 steps. From the content: coaching and psychotherapy - differences and common features Development history of the schema approach Childish basic needs as a starting point Internal basic patterns: Schema work with emotions, inner parts, thoughts, imaginations as well as with the body Mindfulness and self-esteemphasis, training, feedback The sequence as a red thread (manual with step 1-15)

content.text: What is it that means city? : 50 years of urban discourse using the example of the urban building world since 1964. What is a good city? Can it be built? And what do people in Atlanta, Berlin or Shanghai think about the nature of their metropolis? For 50 years, the authors of the magazine Stadtbauwelt have been addressing such questions. Brigitte Schultz, a specialist journalist, has researched the development and ideas history of the most important independent urban building magazine in Germany for the first time. Using a variety of original quotes of influential planners and theoreticians, she shows how the idea of the ideal city from the 1960s to today has radically changed. The book takes the reader on a journey through half a century of urban building coverage, from the feasibility euphoria of the 60s to the planning skepticism of the zeros.
content.title_en: What does this mean city? : 50 years of urban discourse on the example of the urban development world since 1964

content.text: Linked to love : Two-way relationships and parenthood in popular counsellors from the 1950s to today. Despite the pluralization of life forms, lasting love and shared parenthood continue to be among the most important goals of life. To overcome the many uncertainties associated with social change and to ensure the continuity of their relationships, more and more couples and parents resort to counselors. But what guiding principles of love, two-way relationship, parenthood and gender do the counselors convey? The contributions of this volume examine for the first time a large number of relationship and education counselors in comparison with time and reveal their respective cultural legitimization patterns.
content.title_en: Connected to Love : Two-way Relationships and Parenthood in Popular Counselors from the 1950s to the present day

content.text: The Night of the Physicists: Heisenberg, Hahn, Weizsäcker and the German bomb. "Richard von Schirach, a son of the Nazi Reichsjugendführer, illuminates the development of the German "machine", but also the "Manhattan project" of the Americans. In his book he jumps forward and backward, he mixes facts with narrative passages, is sometimes historian, sometimes literary. The author, that is, shows himself undecided in the design of the story. But compared to many historical work this seems a valid lack: From Schirach's work pleasant reading, fresh, exciting, entertaining. The reader experiences a drama of Hybris and vanity, guilt and displacement. And bang he wonders: What if the geniuses in the beer cellar of Haigerloch had come to the goal?
content.title_en: The Night of the Physicists : Heisenberg, Hahn, Weizsäcker and the German Bomb

content.text: Life in retirement: to renegotiate old age in active society. We live in a time of far-reaching transformation of the social society: in politics and economy, a human image emerges that expects each individual to behave flexibly and precautionously, self-employed and self-responsible. This new political economy of active society also extends to previously spared spheres of life and phases. Thus, the political program formula of active aging has long since become part of the foreign and self-description of older people. The volume examines the change of the political-medial age picture, confronts it with the narratives of older people to their retirement life and translates the findings into an original time diagnosis of ageing society. (Source: www.buchhandel.de 02.01.2013) We live in a time of far-reaching transformation of the social sphere: in politics and economy, a human image that expects each individual to behave flexibly and precautionally, self-active and self-responsible. content.text: Ageing in the social transition: the return of old age poverty?. The future threat of an increase in old age poverty is on the agenda at the latest since the paradigm shift in retirement provision. At the same time, the elderly never had on average such extensive material prosperity as today. "The elderly were thus the profiteers of the former expansion of social state security in the focus of the debates about generational justice. Poverty in old age was hardly discussed and is widely regarded as overcome at the beginning of the 21st century. However, the poverty of single older women is still high and the changing earning and family biographies also affect the age-assurance and life situation in old age. So is it likely that the return of old age poverty will be expected? And what sociological, old-age and social implications have the diagnoses, especially for the future development of the life phase of old age and the requirements for social policy? These questions are being answered by this volume. Dr. Claudia Vogel is a research assistant at the German Center for Age Questions. PD Andreas Motel-Klingebiel is head of the Institute for Age and the German Center for Age.
content.title_en: Ageing in social change: the return of old age poverty?

content.text: Makers: the Internet of Things; the next industrial revolution. Everyone can communicate, publish and inform themselves on the Internet today. But the actual revolution is still ahead of us: the "Internet of Things". With little effort and at low cost, everyone can design and manufacture products themselves - jewellery and model components, tools, household items and much more. Whoever has a clever product idea can compete with established manufacturers, the power of brand companies is broken. In his new book, bestseller author and internet visionary Chris Anderson presents the perhaps most fascinating megatrend that will change our world from scratch: the trend to self-production. Chris Anderson was chief editor of the renowned magazine "Wired" from 2001 to 2012. Previously, he wrote for the magazines "The Economist", "Nature" and "Science". He studied physics and science journalism and lives in Berkeley, California. His best-selling "The Long Tail" reached a million audience worldwide. content.text: Coastal navigation in northern Germany : 1926 - 1945 ; on the traces of Rendsburg freighter Hans Johann and his crew. Almost forgotten is the importance that Rendsburg had as a stronghold of coastal navigation 50 years ago, which operated with sailing ships and concentrated mainly on transport within the country, but also on coastal transports to the ports of the North and Baltic Sea region. The author living in Westerrönfeld describes the development of this specialized division until its decline after the Second World War. Tales of Rendsburg captains, the memories of their relatives and former crew members have been incorporated into the varied representation, as well as the results of a personal search for traces by the author, in whose center is Captain Johann Friedrich Kolb (1892-1953).
content.title_en: Coastal navigation in Northern Germany : 1926 - 1945 ; on the trail of Rendsburg freighter Hans Johann and his crew

content.text: Rebuilding of infrastructure in line with the old age: investment needs of cities and municipalities : final report. The central result of the written survey of municipalities, the focus group discussion and the expert interviews is that the largest investment needs exist in the residential buildings, roads and public transport. Here the municipalities also see the highest need for appropriate funding programmes. The same result is also the analytical investment needs estimate. Here, too, roads, public transport and residential buildings are the areas with the greatest investment needs. Support programmes that consider these infrastructures integrally as the living environment of older people, go beyond the sectoral consideration of individual measures and plan old-age-oriented adaptations as an overall concept, should therefore represent a high added value for the municipalities.
content.title_en: Rebuilding infrastructure in line with the old age: investment needs of towns and cities : Final report

content.text: Discover the electronic world with Raspberry Pi: [with Raspberry Pi measure, control and play; cleverly expand the Raspberry Pi; program the Raspberry Pi with Python and C]. The author of the book is known for a inexpensive introduction to the topic (ID-A 51/12). Now he presents a compendium that he consciously considers as an extended re-issue of his earlier book; the extension concerns in particular the electronic basics and the slightly modified new version 2 of Raspberry Pi. No special knowledge is expected from the reader, only experimentation. The special personal style has been preserved; the fictional RasPi accompanies the reader and asks questions that, according to the author, impose themselves on each reader. Helpful are also the many colored illustrations, short tabular summaries, tips and warning notes. Focus is placed on electronic bases, on the diverse connection and extension possibilities, in cooperation with Arduino, in the use of Raspberry Pi as a server and in programming (Python and C). 22 large projects, which are gradually built and explained in detail (if the existing work is not available) should not be replaced.
content.title_en: Discover the electronic world with Raspberry Pi: [with the Raspberry Pi measure, control and play; cleverly expand the Raspberry Pi; program the Raspberry Pi with Python and C]

content.text: Energy transition. But fair! : how the energy future can be made socially sustainable. Do you also have to afford a juicy additional payment for electricity and heating costs? Energy becomes more expensive - this hurts especially those who already have to turn every euro twice. Should we therefore again rely on (meaning cheap) nuclear power? Michael Kopatz shows that it is going beyond flat polemics. He presents measures with which the energy transition can be realized fairly and socially compatible. The central point is a national action programme against energy poverty. It includes, among other things, the prevention of electricity barriers, socially oriented renovation programmes for buildings and professional energy consulting in the household. Only if the energy transition is fair and accepted in the population can it succeed.
content.title_en: Energy transition. But fair! : how to make the future of energy socially sustainable

content.text: Renewable energy systems: Technology – Calculation – Simulation. Renewable energy must ensure our entire energy supply by the middle of the century if we want to exit nuclear energy and successfully halt climate change. The 8th, updated and expanded edition of this textbook covers the full range of renewable energy systems and now also addresses current developments such as photovoltaic own-use systems, power-to-gas technology and necessary technology paths for a successful complete energy transition. Numerous calculation examples and graphics illustrate the different technologies and calculation methods. This edition is continuously coloured. This standard textbook is suitable for students at universities of applied sciences, technical universities and universities as well as scientists and engineers in research and industry. The DVD contains a comprehensive collection of demo programs and full versions for the simulation of renewable energy systems. The illustrations of the book in electronic format, additional photos and user-friendly navigation help make the DVD a valuable addition.
content.title_en: Renewable energy systems : Technology – Calculation – Simulation
