content.text: The restlessness of the world. Once the lasting rest was considered a condition of happiness. Today, however, unrest is rewarded, the being on the road, the permanent change. The well-known cultural philosopher Ralf Konersmann reconstructs how Western culture revolutionized its system of opinion and passed from the preference of calm to the preference of restlessness. With a genealogical view, he does not simply take the restlessness as given, but works out how it has ever achieved its status. For the restlessness is neither merely subject nor merely object, it is neither inside nor outside, neither means nor purpose, but at all times both at the same time. A journey through the historical stations of an idea that keeps us constantly running today and which seems so self-evident that no one questions it in principle.
content.title_en: The world's unrest

content.text: Children and adolescents in schools and kindergartens are exposed to a wide range of risks. In addition to developmental tasks, health, social, disability or mental stress can be present, the effects of which are manifested in the further development, experience and behaviour of children and adolescents. The book presents practical information on the topics of attachment, child welfare, neurological development, nutrition, social integration and social development, concentration and attention, learning motivation, school absentism, stress management and addiction behaviour. The book presents basic knowledge on development psychology, risk and protection factors and prevention options and the thematically arranged chapters are framed by a case study. Dr. Armin Castello is professor of psychology and diagnostics at the European University of Flensburg and Psychological Psychotherapist.
content.title_en: Developmental risks for children and adolescents : Prevention in pedagogical everyday life

content.text: The language of the birds: Roman. On the escape from his guilt feelings Paul comes to Afghanistan in 2003 as a German military paramedic. There he lives for months in a camp, which he is not allowed to leave. In his free time he gives himself to his great passion, the observation of birds. But the past catch him up. (Katja Buchholz)
content.title_en: The language of birds : Roman

content.text: The Urban Design Institute of the University of Stuttgart has fundamentally revised the introductory work "Teaching Building Stones Urban Design – Basic Knowledge for Design and Planning". The new edition involved not only staff and lecturers of the Institute, but also colleagues of neighbouring institutes and faculties as well as other universities. The working materials serve as an introduction to architecture and urban planning for urban design designs and seminars as well as reference works.
content.title_en: Teaching blocks Urban construction : basic knowledge for design and planning

content.text: The Islamic State: IS-Military, al-Qaeda and the German Brigades. Under the eyes of the astonishing world public, Islamists of the militia «Islamic State» (IS) have recently published a huge area in Iraq and Syria with cities, arsenals of weapons and oil deposits under their control - a «Kalifat» which should once dominate the entire Islamic world and subjugate all «infidels». The huge terrorist organization destroys peace in the region, threatens Israel, ruthlessly persecutes Christians, Alevis, Jezidis, Shiites and in general all those who do not profess to be «Islamic State» and destroys their cultural heritage. The Jihadist expert Behnam T. Said investigates the background of this danger. He explains how in Syria for decades all the Islamic groups have emerged in secret, who have been able to establish themselves in the shadow of the uprisings against the Asad regime, and how it is represented by a less dangerous one of the al-Qaida - and who has not seen the danger for the Islamists.
content.title_en: Islamic State : IS-Military, al-Qaeda and the German Brigades

content.text: MATLAB for Dummies. Step by step introduction to numerical calculation and technical simulation with the software package Matlab. For students from mathematics, engineering and natural sciences. Review: Matlab is a universally applicable commercial software for data evaluation and simulation for all common operating systems. While similar widely used tools such as Mathematica (K. Lorenzen: 2014) or R (A. De Vries: 2015) focus on symbolic mathematics or statistics, Matlab's strengths are based on matrix operations in numerical calculations. The volume from the "Für Dummies" series speaks to the reader typically salopply and directly. Unfortunately, the content design is poor because they are based on the operating structure of the software and not on possible technical scenarios (such as Josef Hoffmann: 2013). For the newcomer, however, the gentle and gradual introduction is well suited. Typical industrial areas of application of the program package are in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or construction with corresponding introductions to the technical programming in the study program.
content.title_en: MATLAB for Dummies

content.text: The reinvention of cities: metropolises secure our future. Our schools are maraudous, the daycare centres are crowded, libraries and theatres are closed, bus lines are stopped in short: our cities are bleeding out. At the same time, more and more people are attracted to the cities and metropolises. How does this work together? Petra Roth shows why countries are becoming increasingly superfluous and instead it must be called: All power to cities! Because here, in metropolitan regions, integration, climate protection, coping with demographic change are decided, i.e.: about our future. (publication advertising) id : (3)
content.title_en: The reinvention of cities: metropolises secure our future

content.text: Sexuality and Gender: Psychosocial, cultural and sexual perspectives; a festive publication for Hertha Richter-Appelt. Although sexuality and gender are omnipresent in our society, the confrontation with deviations from the supposed norm leads to a serious examination of these topics. The sex researcher and psychoanalyst Hertha Richter-Appelt, who is dedicated to this volume, has dealt with various forms of human sex in therapy and research. - On the occasion of her 65th birthday, her companions illuminate sexuality and gender from different perspectives and relate, among other things, to religion, politics, body, identity, partnership and German history. This versatile collection stimulates a discourse between critical sexology, psychoanalysis, medicine, psychology, self-help, legal, cultural and social sciences and wants to inspire both customers and interested parties for the diversity of sexuality and gender. Content: Gender and sexuality in society and politics -- Psychoanalytic views on gender diversity -- Gender diversity: People, medicine and life worlds -- Sexuality, body and gender in psychotherapy - Sexuality - Sexuality and gender - Sexuality - Personal and gender - Contributions
content.title_en: Sexuality and gender : psychosocial, cultural and sexual perspectives; a commemorative for Hertha Richter-Appelt

content.text: The art of making the city and the country speak. Main description: Between architecture, city and landscape there is an interrelationship that is constantly coming out of view. Corboz deciphers the educational and design processes that are converging in the city as developments within a dynamic universe.
content.title_en: The art of making the city and the country speak

content.text: Outliers in science: Pioneers - Signposts - Reformers. Again and again, revolutionary scientific contributions are made by cross-reinforcers. Their ideas allow us to understand the historical developments in the natural sciences, where success is much less linked to strict legal laws than suspected. Science theorist Prof. Franz Wuketits (most recently ID-G 21/15, ID-A 17/14) sheds light on the influence of unusual life processes on the course of scientific history in 35 biographical essays. The courageous approach to open questions away from the path of the past allows a deep insight into the dynamics of research and critical knowledge gain. The individual contributions are very scarce and pointed. They offer - also through references - an ideal introduction to the world of thought of known and unknown spirits, especially from the life sciences. Some contemporaries also find themselves in "Genially Failed" (ID-A 49/12) or comprehensively illustrated in "Fascination Research" (ID-B 47/13). Overall, an innovative approach in the field of scientific collection biographies (2).
content.title_en: Outsiders in Science : Pioneers - Guides - Reformers

content.text: The anti-political. Saint Victor analyses the connection between anti-political currents and their demands for direct democracy by means of Web 2.0. He describes the dangers that arise if "directly" are to be called to eliminate the representative instances, insofar as they want to go beyond participatory democracy. The consequences would be a "click" democracy, which can lead to a sharpening of the dictatorship of the majority. It is only a small step from direct democracy to direct demagogy. The much-invited swarm intelligence, according to Saint Victor, is uncontrollably affine, a mass is moving emotively and thus structurally explosively violent.
content.title_en: The anti-political

content.text: Sea monsters and monster fish: fabulous creatures on old maps. The maps of the Middle Ages and the Renaissance are a special eye-catcher in the depiction of the sea monsters. These monsters point to the dangers of the oceans that are still hardly explored and are on the other hand a decorative element of the artistic skills of the cartographer. The author analyses in detail the most important examples of sea monsters on the maps created in Europe and also provides a contribution to the history of cartography and the art of animal representations during this time. A thorough, source-oriented representation, which is not least impressive with the excellent illustration with 147 mostly colored illustrations. Extensive note-making apparatus; name and factual register. The large-format volume is a highly recommended addition to the temporally broader overall view of sea monsters by R. Ellis (BA 10/97). (2) (Heino Karth) Excellently illustrated, well-founded representation of the sea monsters on the maps of the Middle Ages and the Renaissance. (Heino Karth)

content.text: School without teachers? : back to the future. By the further development of IT and current tendencies of knowledge transfer, the author fears major changes in our school system. Without denying the positive sides, he clearly points out the dangers and damages for pupils and teachers. The author became known by the abandonment of his appointment as a teacher, what he described in the book "Teacher - Dream Job or Horror Job" (ID-B 13/13). The new title is the call for help of the teacher who has been working for over 10 years. With regard to the development of IT in the last 20 years and the expected rapid development as well as the current tendencies for knowledge transfer in schools (see also Viktor Mayer-Schönberger: "Learning with Big Data", ID-A 50/14), he suspects that students will become independent learners in the foreseeable future through iPad and laptop and that the teachers become companions or learning coaches and soon become completely superfluous. First, however, the author never fanatically examines the various dangers, consequences and backgrounds of such development by means of school leaders.

Over long distances, this book by the "Young World" editor (most recently ID-G 40/14) is a technology and ideology-critical examination of the actual (e.g. Ray Kurzweil: "How to Create a Mind", 2012) or subordinate apologists of transhumanism (N. Bostrom: ID-B 10/15), i.e. a state in which self-reproducing machines using artificial intelligence (AI) turn against humanity - one should not dream of a fundamentally human-friendly AI. Autoreproductive nanotechnology, modified biotechnology and AI could enter a dramatic liaison. There is one, and this is described by the author in several chapters, idea, interest and power alliance from military complex (intelligent weapons), Internet billionaires (see also E. Keen: "The digital disaster"), think tanks and university research, which work on this topic, and for the societies, however, one would certainly not follow the big-bright of the left.

content.text: The focus of the study is on the human nature of the medical world: the ethical ethics of the medical world: an introduction to the ethics of care. Good medicine must be thoughtful In the revised and updated edition of his well-known textbook, renowned medical ethics expert Giovanni Maio intervenes in the debates of recent times on IBM and systematically examines the respective reasoning. The public-minded topics of organ transplantation take a special place, the discussion about the new methods of reproductive medicine and prenatal diagnostics (social freezing, surrogate motherhood, non-invasive prenatal test) as well as the circumcision of minors and the help of death, including assisted suicide. Maio also undergoes less media-present but ethically essential topics of a deeper analysis, such as the care of dementia patients, the forced treatment of mentally ill people and the deep brain stimulation. Another focus is on the new developments in the healthcare industry, which refer to fundamental questions.
content.title_en: Human centre : textbook of ethics in medicine : with an introduction to ethics of care

content.text: The volume deals with a group of phenomena that are constantly becoming current in educational fields of action. In numerous practitioners they trigger ambivalent sensations and lead to uncertainties in pedagogical action. The book deals with both substance-bound and non-substantial dependencies. It informs about specific appearances and explanatory models and presents action options at a preventive and intervening level. The aim is to enable readers to understand the phenomena covered and to offer ideas for the practical handling of those affected. Hannah Schott is a research assistant in the Department of Education Sciences at Goethe University Frankfurt and focuses on prevention of drug dependence.
content.title_en: Promotion of addiction and addiction

content.text: The main topics of the course are: basics, concepts, system programming. This textbook provides a comprehensive introduction to the basics of operating systems and system programming. The main focus is on the principles of modern operating systems and the use of their services for system-related programming. Methodically, a path is developed between the consideration of problems and their solutions on a theoretical and a practical basis. The author is oriented towards the two most common system worlds, Unix/Linux and Windows. In addition, the most important processor basics are explained, as far as they are helpful for understanding the internal functioning of an operating system. The 3rd edition is revised in numerous details, supplemented in some places and generally updated. The new chapters »Mobile Operating Systems« and »Virtualization« take up current developments. In addition, the call mechanisms of Shared Libraries and DLLs, UEFI-BIOS, the GPT (GUID Partition Table) and the file ZFS are also supplemented by the call mechanisms of the program.
content.title_en: Operating systems : basics, concepts, system programming

content.text: Residential towers. With the increasing concentration of cities, residential buildings in the high-rise building are becoming more relevant. Climate, constructive and social challenges often led to highly innovative solutions in the young, constantly evolving building type residential high-rise. A selection of 80 architecturally exemplary high-rise buildings from five continents allows a comparative examination of the different approaches. The buildings that were created from the 1930s to the present day are presented with plans, photographs and in short texts, supplemented by biographical information on the architects. The introduction and three essays cover various facets of the development and significance of the high-rise building in an international context.
content.title_en: Residential towers

content.text: Equivalence of terms : Development and research of a diagnostic-guided teaching-learning arrangement in the mathematics class of the 8th grade. Larissa Zwetzschler investigates the question of how the understanding difficulties of algebraic terms and term transformations can be overcome in research and how the development of viable content concepts on the equivalence of terms can be supported. The author has developed a prototype of a teaching-learning-range and developed different development lines in the development of ideas. Dr. Larissa Zwetzschler received a doctorate as a scholarship from the Research and Junior Research Training Group for Subject-Teaching Development Research (FUNKEN) at Prof. Dr. Susanne Prediger at the IEEM of the Technical University Dortmund.
content.title_en: Equivalence of terms : Development and research of a diagnostic teaching-learning arrangement in mathematics lessons of the 8th grade

content.text: Discount contract tenders in the generic industry in Germany: impact on market structure, supplier diversity and competition. Since 2003, health insurance companies have been able to agree on discounts on pharmaceuticals. Especially in the generic sector, the conclusion of corresponding discount contracts has since become an important tool for cost savings by health insurance companies.For generic manufacturers, discount contracts have led to structural changes in demand, as doctors, pharmacists and patients no longer primarily choose the medicine. Rather, health insurance companies are making far-reaching decisions about the distribution of demand among manufacturers by structuring the tender for discount contracts and choosing the contracting parties. Against this background, the study examines the effects of discount contracts on the generic industry in Germany with a particular focus on market structure, supplier diversity and competition. The causalities between legal changes, which have been made since 2009, in particular in the field of procurement and competition law, or changes in tendering practice on the one hand, and the market structure on the other hand, are also examined.
content.title_en: Discount contract invitations to tender in the generic industry in Germany : impact on market structure, diversity of suppliers and competition

In the re-course to the latest findings of relevant theoretical concepts and empirical studies, the editors bring together the leading academics for the first time. content.text: Instruments of knowledge transfer in mathematics lessons: the process of instrumental genesis of historical drawing devices. In the age of smartphone and computer, graphics-capable calculator and computer algebra system, spreadsheet calculation and dynamic geometry software etc., there are also good reasons why the interest in the use of historical mathematical instruments is still worthwhile today. If it is also about the use of such devices in today's mathematics lessons, it is also necessary to name didactic goals. This book deals with real and digital replicas of historical drawing devices, e.g. the parabolic circle and the pantograph. In pupils the drawing devices presented here arouse curiosity, their use in mathematics lessons enables them to make their own decoctions. For mathematics lessons are worthwhile, however, the occupation with historical drawing devices is particularly because pupils can uncover the underlying mathematical theme. Each drawing instrument is based on a mathematical idea. However, this idea is usually only visible after a more precise examination of the device. This is a didactic idea that is connected with the research of the instrument - the teacher's scientific group - the teacher's mathematical instrument - the teacher's mathematical instrument.
content.title_en: Instruments of knowledge transfer in mathematics lessons : the process of instrumental genesis of historical drawing devices

content.text: The Chaussee Altona-Kiel: the first art street in Schleswig-Holstein. With the construction of the first "art street" between Altona and Kiel, which is now part of Hamburg, in the years 1830 to 1833, the duchys Schleswig and Holstein succeeded relatively late in leaping into modernism - a transport infrastructure serving the growing trade and trade exchange of goods was only possible through the Chausseebau in the country. Ten years later, however, the newly built railway took over important transport functions. - - In more than 40 contributions by about 20 authors the historical conditions as well as the breakdown and construction of this important traffic-technical infrastructure measure of the 19th century are explained, the most important elements such as the walkways and the Chausseegeld-take-houses, the new bridges and milestones as well as the alleplantation are presented. Also the soon-initiated change of the road is taken into consideration. Curvetling straightenings, guest houses and extension, the post station in Quickborn, tree fällungs and new plantings are discussed in an exemplary way. Finally, the development of the road management of the building management of the past 180 years are described in the whole of the whole of the Chaus.
content.title_en: The Chaussee Altona-Kiel : the first art street in Schleswig-Holstein

content.text: Theater in Psychiatry: from transformations, daring and cheerful failure. Theater in Psychiatry - "playing crazy" and getting healthy - A theatre project with mentally ill people poses very special challenges to all involved. The LWL University Hospital Bochum and the LWL Clinic Herten have already been very successful for some years, but what unsuspected opportunities open up with it. Patients not only deal with a literary template, but also with themselves and also carry their experiences with mental illnesses into the public in a playful and artistic way. - This book offers fascinating insights into the experiences of all involved: acting patients and employees as well as viewers, stage managers or the medical directors of the clinics are also spoken out. The chosen expressions range from process reflections and analyses to poems and interviews. The focus is not on the deficits, but on the resources and abilities of the patients - a clear exclamation against the stigmatization of mental illness. - An exciting book for medical and psychological professionals as well as on the subject of new therapeutic and mental therapy.

Jana Kreckler investigates realistic problems with regard to geometry from the field of optimization with regard to the focus on location planning and prepares them for an authentic mathematics lesson. She developed a four-hour teaching unit to promote the global modelling competence of students in an authentic mathematics lesson. In a study of 332 students of the 10th grade, this teaching unit was evaluated and evaluated with regard to its effectiveness. The study results show a significant increase in global modelling competence, regardless of the factors of gender, topic and testimonial.
content.title_en: Location planning and geometry : mathematical modelling in general instruction

content.text: Legal issues of medical tourism: International jurisdiction and applicable law in cases of a patient treated abroad for a medical or educational error. An increasing number of German patients are specifically entering abroad for medical treatment. This phenomenon is an occasion for investigating international jurisdiction and applicable law in cross-border medical liability cases. In particular, the question of opening a court in Germany according to the regulations of the ECGVVO and analogous §§ 12 et seq. ZPO. With regard to the determination of the applicable law, the regulations Rome I (Contract Statute) and Rome II (Delict Statute) are the focus of the discussion. The work is rounded off by the submission of legal policy proposals, as a high level of patient protection can be ensured in cross-border treatments without losing sight of the interests of doctors and clinics.
content.title_en: Legal issues relating to medical tourism: International jurisdiction and applicable law in proceedings against the patient treated abroad for a mistreatment or clarification error

content.text: Exegesis of the New Testament : a workbook for teaching and practice. The great temporal distance, the unusual language and uncertainties in the use of suitable methods make it difficult for many students to access the texts of the Bible. This book of methods by Martin Ebner and Bernhard Heininger arouses interest in the study of the New Testament in a contemporary way. At the same time it offers sound knowledge for seminars or exams and trains the independent use of biblical texts in the preparation of teaching and sermon. Both authors are experienced practitioners who have introduced new students to the methods of New Testament exegesis over many years.
content.title_en: Exegesis of the New Testament : a workbook for teaching and practice

content.text: Water: scarcity, climate change, world nutrition. The author, expert of the worldwide renowned Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK), analyses the global water crisis against the background of climate change and a further increase in demand for food. He shows that water scarcity is rarely the inevitable consequence of dwindling water supplies, but also the result of the (unreliable high) demand of humans. From the beginning, humanity has demonstrated an overwhelming inventiveness to manage water and to draw it from increasingly distant areas. Today we need a new water ethos: It respects the limits set by local and planetary environmental conditions and restores the water ecosystems to an intact state. It also includes fair access to clean water for all people, thus also working on the abolition of the global water distribution and water quality crisis. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Water : scarcity, climate change, world food

content.text: A world of signs: the history of Scripture. Science journalist Kuckenburg is already present here with numerous publications on early and early history, namely with representations of Celtic culture, but also with non-fiction books on language and writing history (BA 5/10, 9/96, 1/90). Now he has presented a generally understandable history of Scripture, which rattles down essential stations: short pre-stages of Scripture, detailed the ancient Egyptian hieroglyphics, the Old Oriental cuneiform and the emergence of letter writing and its development in Europe until the invention of book printing. Chinese writing, like Kuckenburg, is also being scrambled to look at America before Columbus. The author's preview for the future is rather meager with just under 2 pages. His richly illustrated representation is less theoretically burdensome and challenging than H. Haarmann (BA 1/03) or Andrew Robinson ("Images, Signs, Alphabet", ID-B 19/13; e.T. also "The History of Scripture", BA 4/97) and the culturally-gradual context, thus the generalized textual development learns much about the meaning of the ancient script.
content.title_en: A world of signs: the history of Scripture

content.text: Indicators of sustainable development: elements of their economic theory foundation. The concept of sustainable development was introduced into public discussion by the report "Our Common Future" of the United Nations. In economic theory, the concept of sustainability played a significant role earlier. Here, aspects of (integrative and intergenerative) distribution justice are strongly emphasized. It is a question of finding a path of economic development that does not affect the welfare of subsequent generations. A central research task of economic science is to contribute to making the idea of sustainable development an operable scientific and political concept. -- Essential prerequisite for a non-decreasing welfare in the course of time is that the (current) generation of present-day generations leaves an untasteed capital stock as a source of welfare for future generations. Here, the first concern is not the physical capital stock, but a constant capital stock composed of human and natural assets. - In order to determine the ways of operating sustainability indicators, the concept of sustainability is to be considered.
content.title_en: Indicators of sustainable development: elements of their economic theory

content.text: The challenges of the economic policy at the threshold of the 21st century are: the festival for Lutz Hoffmann on his 65th birthday. On the threshold of the new century, the economic policy is facing great challenges. Against the background of globalization, the transformation to a service society, the change of demographic structures and the transition of the planned economic systems into market economy oriented, it is important to make forward-looking economic policy choices in the industrial, transformation and developing countries. -- Among the most pressing economic problems of the Western industrialized countries are unemployment, an increasing income inequality and the ageing of the population. In many developing countries the concern is dominated by the fact that development is catching up with globalization and knowledge-intensive production processes. While the Eastern and Central European transition countries are on the way to the EU, the transformation process in the other countries of the former Eastern bloc is causing considerable disruption to the minds of the politicians; in particular Russia seems to be faced with almost indisputable economic and political problems. Financial and monetary crises cast shadows on economic development in other regions of the world.
content.title_en: Challenges to economic policy on the threshold of the 21st century : Festschrift für Lutz Hoffmann zum 65th Geburtstag

content.text: The business approach to the Internet is becoming more and more important. In particular, "Online shopping", the online shopping market, is becoming more and more popular. The authors identify and investigate the factors that contribute to the success of such offers in the USA and ask how they are transferable to the German market. -- Based on interviews with experts in the USA and Germany, which were conducted in 1998, different aspects of e-commerce are considered: development of market volume, organization of online shopping, security and reliability of transactions, product range design and the advantages of e-commerce compared to conventional purchasing offers. In addition, regulatory issues and economic policy promotion measures for online shopping are discussed. The focus is on the qualitative representation of problems and their solutions in the two reference countries. - The success factors that apply to the American market are essentially aimed at achieving a critical mass of buyers and sellers, starting from online shopping. Here, the focus is on the reduction of contact factors and providers' interest in the issue of success.
content.title_en: E-Commerce - Success factors of online shopping in the USA and Germany

content.text: Environmental innovation through levies: the impact of price stimulus in the institutional framework of private and public actors. The suitability of steering levies to stimulate environmentally friendly innovations is still controversially discussed. While price incentives are considered crucial for innovation in traditional environmental economics, critical voices are also found that estimate environmental levies as not very effective. Despite the long discussion on eco-taxes and existing steering levies, a meaningful empiricism to this issue is not available. -- Against this background, the Financial Research Institute at the University of Cologne has investigated previous application experiences based on the innovative effects of environmental levies under real conditions. -- In principle, it is shown that an increase in environmental charges and their impact on municipalities and private households, and secondly, the waste and waste taxes in industry. The hypothesis extraction is based on new theoretical approaches that distinguish a differentiated picture of the innovation process. -- In principle, it is shown that an increase in environmentally harmful activities in all stakeholders concerned can stimulate innovation activities. However, the impact strength depends on the respective use of the barriers and the reduction of the barriers to their implementation.
content.title_en: Environmental innovation through levies: the impact of price stimulus in the institutional framework of private and public actors

content.text: Design attractive beds : 100 ideas for impressive plantings. Among the aspects of structures, colours, combinations, subtle tones in the shade and strong soloists, she presents very concrete examples with planting plans and tables of the plants used. The three components, which are the basis for an exciting design for her, namely arrangement of color and shapes, variety of flower times and the staggered planting are always taken into consideration. The outstanding photos of the author and the well-understood, informative texts make this picture book a source of inspiration for ambitious hobby gardeners. (2)
content.title_en: Design attractive beds : 100 ideas for impressive plantings

content.text: Simple Rules : simple rules for complex situations. The British university professors from the business sector are convinced that with simple rules most of the complex problems can be solved efficiently and successfully. The author duo shows in detail how the criteria and rules that are really important for decision-making are found. There are not "the" simple rules for all areas of life, but it is sensitized to find the respective rules for the corresponding areas. The high-level guide ranges a wide range of examples for clarification: from comparison of Scott and Amundsen in their South Pole race to modern success strategies for television stations. As a conclusion, you will find an extensive list of notes ordered by chapter and a keyword register. Reading-worthy but text-intensive motivational readings for interested parties.
content.title_en: Simple Rules : simple rules for complex situations

content.text: I am not the brain: philosophy of the mind for the 21st century. Is there human freedom? Is our entire life form just an illusion? Is the presence of a brain sufficient to be a spiritual being? Starting from the natural sciences, a neurocentrism has emerged in the last years, based on the assumption that I am the same brain. Markus Gabriel, on the other hand, has justified doubts that we can recognize ourselves in this way. He attacks the scientific world picture and invites us to self-reflection using central terms such as I, consciousness or freedom with the help of Kant, Schopenhauer and Nagel, but also Dr. Who, The Walking Dead and Fargo. - With his passionate plea against neurocentrism, Markus Gabriel presents a new defense of free will and provides a timely guide to philosophical reflection on ourselves - with verve, humor and flash-scathed knowledge.
content.title_en: I am not brain : philosophy of the mind for the 21st century

content.text: The climate debate has produced its own vocabulary, whose terms transport a structurally conservative agenda: market-based climate protection instruments, green technology and global management are intended to preserve the vital functions of the atmosphere while enabling unbridled growth. However, this ideal of industrial societies has caused climate change and is now being reinterpreted to its solution. In the »Debate on Climate Change«, experts from social, political and cultural sciences analyse over 40 key concepts of climate discourse that make this utopia plausible and unaltered, and show the necessary perspectives beyond a neoliberal climate policy
content.title_en: Climate debate dictionary

content.text: Mindfulness training: [MBSR, the recognized anti-stress method]. How is it possible not to lose your own center in the midst of the many challenges of our everyday life? To preserve inner peace? The Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction-Methide - in English: Stress reduction through mindfulness - shows you a way to master stress situations calmer and calmer and thus strengthen health and well-being. Jan Thorsten Esswein, physiotherapist, yoga and mindfulness trainer, presents in his book the central elements of the MBSR concept: Get to know the ways of action. Then, guided in word and image, start with the formal mindfulness exercises such as body scan, exercise, pack-packing, walking and sitting meditation. In addition, there are suggestions on how to become more mindful in everyday life with small changes. In the tried-and-tested 8-week program you will learn how to best combine the various elements. On the 70-minute exercise CD, all formal mindfulness exercises are detailedly guided.
content.title_en: Mindfulness training : [MBSR, the recognized anti-stress method]

content.text: From ways: reflections on the free city of the future. There is an alternative to urban capitalism that can break with rent madness, precarious services and gated communities. Experiments on this are everywhere. The path to this utopia requires cunning and determination. But the goal is worthwhile: the free city of the future, the place where people take their affairs into their own hands together. The future of capitalism decides in the city. Since the crash of 2008, more and more people have been running against the impositions of a city as an investment object, which completely transform urban spaces into profit and security machines. They demand: 'Right to city' for all. Against the 'gentrifidingsbum' they set up meetings, re-possession of public spaces, real participation in the design of cities. The outlines of another city are already evident. Niels Boeing, himself an activist in urban disputes, describes the playrooms and gives them a clever and thoughtful basis. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: From Paths : Reflections on the Free City of the Future

While clothing is omnipresent in advertising and everyday life, however, its production from Germany is almost gone. content.text: Cybermobbing at schools: solution-oriented prevention measures and intervention programs. The use of the new communication techniques has become an integral part of the lives of young people and poses numerous new challenges to our society. This development offers a lot of positive aspects, but also carries a multitude of dangers. Meanwhile, a large number of cybermobbing cases are known in schools and it is becoming increasingly clear that there is an urgent need for action here. On the one hand, there is a lack of education of the pupils regarding the dangers and risks and criminal consequences that lurk in the handling of the new media. On the other hand, teachers often have insufficient knowledge in this area. In particular in the technical handling of the new media, many students are far superior to the teachers. Communication skills, conflict control strategies and self-confident teachers are needed. Another important point is the structure within the institution school. However, there is often a lack of defined process procedures for occurrences in the field of cybermobbing and clear rules. How do we deal with cybermobbing at our school. Many questions are about the causes, possible risk factors and consequences of the use of cybermobbing are implemented in schools.
content.title_en: Cyberbulbing in schools: solution-oriented prevention and intervention programmes

content.text: Damage analysis of metallic components : a collection of 31 real examples from practice. The failure of safety-relevant parts can have catastrophic consequences for aircraft, rail vehicles, cable cars, lifts and power plants. Damages occurring are thoroughly analysed to avoid them in the future. The present collection is a compilation of 34 representative damage cases from the journal Praktische Metallographie. The damages are categorized according to VDI guideline 3822 according to mechanical, corrosive, thermal and tribological cause. The main focus of the damage cases discussed is the metallographic assessment of the causes of damage, remedial measures and prevention. 'lessons learned' allows the case studies to be easily transferred to other areas of mechanical engineering.
content.title_en: Damage analysis of metallic components : a collection of 31 real examples from practice

content.text: Stage and lighting : Stage, stage construction and stage lighting in school and amateur theatre. Practical book for the stage design in amateur areas; with numerous technical and manual tips and instructions. (LK/PB: Grümpe-Aßmann) The fact that this book is already subtitled by the emphasis on amateur and school theatre is very pleasing. Because in this theatre area there is a great need to deal with the details of the possibilities and options of stage design. And this happens here, by discussing every little thing in detail and providing the most accurate instructions. Stage design elements and the tools to build them and all necessary technical equipment are presented in detail. In doing so, attention is always paid to the limited resources and insufficient technical possibilities of schools and amateur theatres and to ensure the necessary support that is needed in these areas.
content.title_en: Stage and lighting : Stage, stage construction and stage light in school and amateur theatre

content.text: Jihadism : Ideology, prevention and deradicalization. Besides his scientific work, the Viennese political scientist Schmidinger is co-founder of a network for jihadism prevention. His biographies of Austrian youths, who have taken the path into jihadism, are based on these concrete experiences and research. There are common political and social experiences that led to radicalization, very rarely only religiously motivated starting points. In order to identify radicalized youths in time, there are a number of indications that are conclusively derived and at the same time show possibilities for recovering sympathizers but also jihadist criminals. In this biographical and social pedagogical part lies the great strength of the book. In the first part, it deals with the demarcation between political Islam, Salafism and jihadism. Al-Qaida and ISIS are analysed in their political context and with their strategic and ideological differences. Many interesting considerations in a well-readable form. (2)
content.title_en: Jihadism : Ideology, Prevention and Deradicalization

content.text: The German publisher "Bildhoschenpolitik in der junge Bundesrepublik" (German Gay Policy in the Young Federal Republic): Kurt Hiller, Hans Giese and the Frankfurter Wissenschaftlich-humanitäre Komitee. After 1945, Germany failed to build a powerful and self-contained movement against antihomosexual criminal law and to build on the successes and merits of the first German homosexual movement before 1933. This was due, among other things, to the restorative social climate of the post-war era. But not only to the outside one encountered resistance, but also internally there were inconsistencies and conflicts. Hans Giese tried to rebuild the scientific-humanitarian community (WhK) in Frankfurt from 1949 onwards, and asked Kurt Hiller in London exile for his support. Diverging ideas regarding tactics and goals of the new movement soon led to a discordance between the two prominent activists. Woraus resulted in their differences? Raimung Wolfert wrote a letter between Hans Giese and Kurt Hiller and other protagonists of the German homosexual movement around 1950 and whose different views were worked out in the newspaper "Dibelifant Hill.
content.title_en: Gay policy in the young Federal Republic: Kurt Hiller, Hans Giese and the Frankfurt Scientific-Humanitarian Committee

content.text: Urbanism and Transport: Building blocks for architects, urban and traffic planners. The book provides an interdisciplinary overview of the connections between urban/space development and transport. Methodically, it has a historically structured structure and thus also provides an insight into the history of traffic and urbanity. The book draws the "spirit" and momentum from its critical and - in some cases new - interdisciplinary perspective. Thus, so far rarely thematized - and also interesting for architects - insights into the interaction of urban design/communication and traffic are possible. The second edition was reviewed and supplemented by the chapters "Mobility future: change of consciousness or technology" and "The hype around mobility". The importance of this book not only for education and the professional world, but also for citizens' initiatives and environmental organisations is further highlighted in a preface by Wolfgang Lohbeck of Greenpeace Germany. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Urbanism and Transport : Building blocks for architects, urban and transport planners

content.text: Fascination of green gardens: the most beautiful design ideas with 50 extensive plant portraits. Using the example of 18 private gardens, almost exclusively designed with woody plants and leafy shrubs, the variety of green gardens is represented. A sophisticated picture book with many suggestions and detailed plant portraits. (Georg Braun) This picture book presents gardens that are almost exclusively designed with green plants (woody plants and leafy shrubs). Green gardens are in trend, as they are relatively easy to care for and - with proper plant selection - attractive all year round. 18 garden owners provide insight into their green oases. The compositions from many nuances of green show varied, fascinating gardens of different sizes. The excellent photos of the renowned garden photographer Marion Nickig convey interesting design ideas to friends of green gardens. In addition, the interested reader finds in the second part of the book extensive plant portraits of recommended green plants. Since the majority of the gardens presented have a rather park-like character, the contents of the book are rather as an inspiration, less suitable for practical implementation in his own garden. Recommendable as a complement to a well-developed stock (3)Georg.
content.title_en: Fascination of green gardens : the most beautiful design ideas with 50 detailed plant portraits

content.text: Houses of the Year : [the 50 best single-family houses of the year 2015]. "The Callwey Award 'Houses of the Year' awards the best and most interesting single-family houses each year. As different as their materiality, shape and location, as different as the budget and number and the demands of the inhabitants may be -- all the houses presented in this book have one thing in common: an outstanding architectural quality. This diversity shows that in the dialogue between architect and builder, the very individual dream house, regardless of construction costs and size, can be created"---Page 4 of cover
content.title_en: Houses of the Year : [the 50 best single-family houses of the year 2015]

content.title_en: Lighting planning and design : Concepts - Technology - Examples : with 285 illustrations and 15 tables

content.text: The book describes the current state of knowledge and the experience of anaerobic processes for treating industrial and municipal waste water, for sludge stabilization and for fermentation of renewable raw and waste materials. In addition to the biological and chemical principles of the anaerobic conversion processes, a variety of practical application examples are explained in detail. Compared to the previous requirements, this 3rd new edition gives the agricultural fermentation plants a higher priority. Furthermore, the basics and examples of the anaerobic processes for nitrogen elimination (deammonification) have been added.The target groups Planning offices, specialist companies, operators, approval authorities and research facilities for the areas of wastewater and sludge treatment as well as biogas technology The editors Prof. Dr.-Ing. Karl-Heinz Rosenwinkel, Head of Business Management of the Institute for Settlement Water Management and Waste Technology at the Leibniz University Hannover Univ.-Prof. Dipl.-Ing. Dr. Helmut Kroiss, Emerituswirtschaft am Abfallwirtschaft.
content.title_en: Anaerobic engineering : Waste water, sludge and residual material treatment, biogas production

content.text: For children and adolescents, the developmental psychology for Bachelors. More developmental psychology is not possible: Read, audio contributions, videos and learning tools ... Human beings develop rapidly especially in early childhood and in adolescence. But when does what develop - and how exactly? How do you measure changes or the state of development? What role do genetics and the environment play? This textbook answers the most important questions of the versatile basic subject »Development Psychology« compactly and comprehensible. Detailed and compact theories, methods and diagnostics Development in central functional areas: motorics, sensors, cognition, intelligence, emotion, language, self-concept, morals and many more. Parent-child interaction and binding, plant-environment-problematics Developmental deviations in childhood and adolescence Learning-friendly, multimedial and fast Book: case studies, definitions, practice tips, learning goals, control questions, short summaries in the border column Website (www.lehrbuch-psychologie.de): Glossary, learning cards, quiz questions, forum for exchange with other students Free for download on the edge of psychology Videos For illustrations and questions for students
content.title_en: Developmental psychology of the child and adolescence for Bachelor

content.text: Nature conservation ethics: an introduction to practice. Why should people protect nature? Should nature be preserved in a certain state or is it free to develop? Today, it is necessary to develop a new ethics in order to place nature at the centre of human protection efforts or are traditional reasons sufficient? How do moral arguments for nature conservation and concrete protection strategies are combined? The philosophical literature available so far is not very helpful for practice: because of its great abstraction, concrete references are largely lacking.Those interested in nature conservation and ethics can now gain a general overview with the work of Eser/Potthast. Scientific theoretical foundations of ecology and moral philosophical prerequisites of nature conservation are presented here in practice-oriented terms and illustrated by concrete examples; central concepts and questions are explained in clear diagrams.The volume is aimed at all those involved in nature conservation: be it in authorities, associations, environmental policy or conservation centres.
content.title_en: Nature conservation ethics : an introduction to practice

content.text: Business analysis - simple and effective : understanding business requirements and implementing them into IT solutions. Companies must be able to change and adapt quickly to the respective market and economic conditions. Business analysis and its organisational anchoring in demand management are key success factors for this. The necessary changes are recognized, designed and implemented. The project portfolio as well as the individual projects and maintenance measures are aligned to the business requirements and productivity is increased. The number and scope of business requirements are significantly reduced by early examination to sense, consistency and importance. Unnecessary double work and value-destroying projects are avoided. Thus, free space for strategic projects is created. Inge HANSCHKE has been a senior business analyst in 26 years as an IT manager for user companies, an ERP product house and various IT service providers strategically and aligned IT to business requirements and professionalized IT management. Gunnar GIESINGER is a senior business analyst. As a consultant, he supports companies in implementing business requirements in an adequate IT solution and has successfully aligned IT via enterprise architecture management to the business community.
content.title_en: Business analysis - simple and effective : Understanding business requirements and implementing them into IT solutions

content.text: Diversity Education in the training of early-educational professionals. Against the background of current challenges of educational institutions, various fundamental perspectives on diversity education and inclusion are brought together to address the challenges for educational professionals, to consider training content and structures, and to discuss possible solutions. Current challenges of educational institutions, for example through children with a migration biography or the debate about inclusive educational institutions for all children, lead to the question of how the educational settings can adequately promote the different potentials of the adolescents. The focus is also on the training content and structures for educational staff. The aim of the volume is to bring together various fundamental perspectives on diversity education and inclusion in order to address the challenges for educational professionals, to consider training content and structures, and to discuss possible solutions.

content.text: Competence orientation in school books for the natural sciences: an analysis using the example of Switzerland. Katrin Bölsterli Bardy, in the first of three sub-studies, creates empirically based standards for competence-oriented school books for the natural sciences. These standards form the competence-oriented school book grid (KOS), which serves for the analysis of school books and for the development of new competence-oriented teaching materials. In the second study, the author examines the different demands on a competence-oriented school book due to the profession. In the third study, she analyses further factors influencing the demands on a competence-oriented school book, including the influence of teaching/learning comprehension and the attitude towards competence orientation.The content State of book research The role of school books in educational reforms and in competence-oriented teaching Mixed Methods Design for the formation of a competence-oriented school book grid Different demands on a school book The target groups Dozierende and students of the didactics of the natural sciences Teachers of the secondary school I of natural sciences, primary school teachers The author Dr. Katrin Bölster Bardy is a lecturer in the field of science and chemistry.
content.title_en: Competence orientation in textbooks for the natural sciences : an analysis using the example of Switzerland

content.text: Examples of the design according to Eurocode 2 : Volume 2: Engineering. Eurocode 2 - DIN EN 1992 "Measuring and construction of reinforced concrete and prestressed concrete structures" with its National Annexes was introduced in 2012 for construction supervision. Since 2013 the Eurocodes are also mandatory for the bridge and engineering construction of the federal highways and the railways of the federal government. For understanding and the incorporation into the Eurocode 2 the German Concrete and Construction Technology Association E. V. presents an updated sample collection. Volume 2 contains eight calculated examples for typical components of bridge, engineering and building construction. These correspond to the examples known from the DBV sample collection to DIN 1045-1 and thus allow a direct comparison of the design rules and the results according to both standards. The tasks are more complex than in the first volume (spannbeton road bridges, prestressing of flat ceilings, building stiffening) and thus for special proofs (plastic and non-linear calculation procedures, bending, earthquake measurement) the authors have tried to describe the essential features and the analysis of the structural analysis and the results obtained in the survey.
content.title_en: Examples of design according to Eurocode 2 : Volume 2: Engineering

content.text: Urban planning cultures in the mirror of conflicts, protests and initiatives. In urban development, different actors meet with their views and views, values and ideals, which leads to conflicts and protests or also promotes the emergence of civil society initiatives. What possibilities does urban planning have to deal with them? And to what extent do urban planning cultures change in the mirror of conflicts, protests and initiatives? The volume is dedicated to these questions.
content.title_en: Urban planning cultures in the mirror of conflicts, protests and initiatives

content.text: Physics with Excel and Visual Basic : Basics, examples and tasks. In this book problems from different areas of physics - mechanics, optics, acoustics and measurement technology - are treated with spreadsheets and computer programming. Gradually the author discusses the physical problem, then a solution is developed with MS-Excel and Visual Basic and finally exercises on examples. A development environment for Visual Basic is integrated in each version of Excel. After working through the book students are able to independently work on physical problems that they encounter during their studies. Students who have found interest in Computational Physics will fall into more specific program packages more easily. The book sets on simple solutions, where the physical justification is comprehensible in the individual steps. One focus of the book is on the linking of invoices and graphic representations, another on the linking of table calculations and visual basic macros. The target groups of this book are students with main or secondary physics, who are interested in computer procedures and at the same time want to deepen their physics skills. On the other hand, the teacher also finds a teaching office, the teacher's training in this computer study, the teacher's training method, the teacher's training in physics and the teacher's training.
content.title_en: Physics with Excel and Visual Basic : Basics, examples and tasks

content.text: Mathematics for engineers : Basics - Applications in Maple. Verl.Beschr.. The book in the completely revised and extended third edition is very well suited as a textbook and for self-study. Mathematical basics are treated vividly and easily understandable, and comprehensive proof is largely omitted. The large number of calculated examples and the extensive collection of tasks with solutions allow students to consolidate the material and prepare themselves optimally for the examination. Numerous application examples from technical fields make the use of mathematics transparent in practice. The CD contains: all MAPLE sample files, programs in C++, the powerful C++ compiler OpenWATCOM with graphical development environment, the free C++ compiler Dev-C++, the FEM program SANFEX with examples, freeware mathematics programs and text editors
content.title_en: Mathematics for Engineers : Basics - Applications in Maple

content.text: The economic effects of participation in Germany: an update. The article gives a current overview of the economic effects of participation at the company and company level. Since the overview of Jirjahn (2006), numerous new studies have been published, in particular on works councils. While the effects on productivity and wages continue to play an important role, new aspects such as the influence on family-friendly personnel policy have also become a focus of research. Current studies also indicate positive profitability and employment effects of participation in the company. The estimated effects tend to be more important when the endogenity of works councils is taken into account. At the same time, a number of differentiations are shown. Thus, current studies indicate that the effects of works councils not only depend on collective bargaining but also on the presence of foreign owners and on internal wage inequality. Finally, the first evidence is that organizational learning processes play a role in the effects. While a number of questions overall indicate convergence of results, there is still a clear need for research into certain questions. Thus, current studies show very different results, although the results of the company are not yet positive.
content.title_en: Economic effects of codetermination in Germany : an update

content.text: The author describes the main differences between education systems in Western OECD democracies. He presents methodological and theoretical approaches to the analysis of education policy. Using concrete case studies, the specificities of the German education system are elaborated and located in an international context. In addition, the author discusses the interactions between education and social policy.
content.title_en: Education policy in an international comparison

content.text: Shrinking regions - dynamic universities : university strategies in demographic change. Politics and other actors in the (especially East German) regions are faced with the task of shaping demographic change. At the same time, they are to create the conditions for 'self-supporting developments' and 'equal living conditions' - and this under conditions of significantly lowered state budgets until 2020. Against the background of these challenges, options for regional development are presented, which are in connection with universities. Prof. Dr. Michael Fritsch teaches at the Friedrich Schiller University Jena. Prof. Dr. Peer Pasternack heads the Institute for University Research Halle-Wittenberg (HoF). Dr. Mirko Titze is a Senior Economist at the Leibniz Institute for Economic Research Halle (IWH).

content.text: Archives, libraries, publishers and scientific institutes are not only commissioned to keep records but also to preserve them for future generations. The standard manual, now available in fifth edition, contains recommendations and basic standards for the preservation of the written cultural property. The measures range from the traditional, manual restoration of individual pieces to the mechanical preservation in mass processes to the conversion of the information to other media. The 5th edition contains new standards for deacidification, storage, photographic activity testing and pest control.
content.title_en: Conservation in archives and libraries

content.text: Microsoft Access for beginners. Practical, compact introduction to the database system Access and the programming language VBA for beginners without any prior knowledge. With practice tasks and more detailed solutions. (Eva Hans) The compact introduction to the database system Access in the current version 2016 for beginners shows the tools to build and use a database of their own - from the first steps to building a database to the many possible applications for forms or reports. The author, known for many introductions for programmers, begins with working in a finished application before describing the interface of MS Access and gradually explaining how first data is entered, queries created and sorting set. Other chapters go to views, importing or exporting external data or the pros and cons of assistants such as templates, while a larger section deals with modules in the programming language VBA. The volume includes more detailed solutions to the exercise tasks. As a first current introduction to the program, it is possible to add a star: "No fear of Microsoft Access!" (ID-A 28/13) and the deeper B. Held: "VBA with access" (VBA with access) to the market at present (Ekurz.

content.title_en: Material data sheets - Copper

content.text: The basics of joining technology: welding, soldering and bonding. In almost every production, the assembly of individual parts represents the decisive step for the production of subassemblies, assemblies and finished products. In addition to the strength and form-locking joining processes, the material-locking joining processes are often used here for the purpose of welding, bonding and soldering. The authors aim is to impart the necessary basic knowledge to select a material-locking joining process suitable for the respective application. In addition to all important welding processes, the related methods "löten" and "Kleben" which are used in technical competition are discussed in excursions. The book is addressed in particular to the field of tension between the technical possibilities and the necessity of joining processes, materials, design and economic boundary conditions. Also, occupational safety and quality assurance are taken into account. The book addresses engineers and technicians with tasks in design, work planning, production and quality assurance from industry and craft, which have limited knowledge of the field of material-locking joining technology, as well as to engineering students.
content.title_en: Basics of joining technology : welding, soldering and bonding

content.text: The German Federal Transport Infrastructures (Bundesautobahnen, Bundesstraßen, Bahnenwege der Deutsche Bahn AG, Bundeswasserstraßen) represented a considerable economic asset with a gross investment assets of DM 633 billion at the end of 1998. Due to the deteriorating age structure of the infrastructure infrastructure, the necessary resources for material maintenance and modernisation are inevitably increased. Likewise, in the case of East German transport infrastructure, the expenditure on quality adjustment of this network to West German standard is mandatory. This increasing demand for replacement investment is countered by the need for capacity expansion, so that in the long-term investment planning for the federal transport infrastructure, with declining or stagnating financial resources, an allocation problem of replacement and new construction projects is to be solved. A study prepared by the German Federal Transport Infrastructure Planning Agency (DIW) in connection with the Federal Transport Infrastructure Planning showed that in some areas the replacement investments actually made in the 1990s were below the demand for qualified material value assurance. For the period 1999 to 2020, the German Federal Transport Infrastructure Investments (DIW) forecast a cumulative replacement demand of DM 3 billion, which would be estimated from 2/3.
content.title_en: Forecast of replacement investment requirements for federal transport routes by 2020

content.text: The international business environment: nine countries in comparison of their basic conditions for business start-ups and business start-ups. Potential business founders encounter a complex system of economic and social framework conditions that can support or hinder the respective startup project. These framework conditions were examined in a series of individual studies - in France, the Netherlands, Sweden, UK, Poland, the USA, Malaysia and Singapore - and summarized in the present work with reference to the situation in Germany. -- Initially, the founding process and the founding success as a result of the interaction of framework conditions and actors in the participating countries are presented in particular on the basis of official statistics. With the help of different primary surveys (e.g. analyses of television series and reading books, expert discussions, written student surveys) and other secondary studies are presented $aFounding infrastructure$z (founding aid, foundation support programmes, foundation training) and $aGrundungskontextion$z (political environment, entrepreneurial image, motives and reservations of the foundation, conjunctural situation, cost-related aspects, participation-involvement) with the exception of the innovative activities, in the case of the present years of the present years of the present years of the present years of the business.
content.title_en: The international founding climate: nine countries compared with their framework conditions for business start-ups and start-ups

content.text: A new method for systematic market, industry and competition analyses. There is a wide discrepancy between the need for analytical methods for markets, economic sectors and competitive situations and what has been offered to economic science so far in this regard. Business and competition researchers, business managers and consultants are largely self-sufficient when it comes to carrying out appropriate studies. The analysis results also have strong individual characteristics. Therefore, attempts have begun in the 1990s to remedy this maladministration. The result of this method project is the so-called ORANK Schema and the ORANK analysis based on it. They have now proven themselves in a variety of empirical studies and practical applications. -- Based on a critical overview of conventional analysis concepts, the author pursues two objectives: Firstly, the new method is intended to be presented for the first time comprehensively and application-oriented to a wider scientific and practical approach. At the same time, the statements can serve as guidance for the concrete implementation of market, industry or competition analyses. -- On the other hand, the current state of development of the ORANK method and on the open future can be systematically overtaken over and over the traditional approaches.
content.title_en: A new method for systematic market, industry and competition analyses

content.text: In the future, Germany will continue to be a major target for immigration in Europe. However, given the longer-term labour market needs and the enlargement of the EU east, the public will discuss increased management of immigration. The new immigration law recognises for the first time in Germany's history the need for comprehensive regulation. In this study, different immigration scenarios are discussed from the economic point of view and labour market-specific control criteria are formulated. In this context, the question is not only about the importance of economic activity and growth of the economy for the management concept, but also about the technological development and "globalisation". Furthermore, the authors analyse the operationality and verifiableness of control criteria - also with regard to the "classical" immigration countries, such as Australia, Canada and the United States, and about the transferability of the experiences there on Germany. Finally, the legal and institutional aspects of the topic address questions such as which institutions should select new arrivals and to what extent any immigration regulations can be incorporated into the EU legal framework and must compare the future context of immigration with the context of immigration.
content.title_en: Labour market-led immigration : scenarios of immigration and legal and institutional aspects of its governance

content.text: The authors present the concept of a service gap and its possible definitions and discuss quantifications in international comparison. They strongly relativize the frequently found assumption that the employment problems in Germany are predominantly those of the service sector. As possible explanatory factors, differences in productivity developments and outsourcing of service functions are discussed and the specific demand level analysed, whereby the structure of the final demand and the time budgets have a special role to play. Furthermore, the authors examine the specific influence of information and communication technology. Whether insufficient utilisation of potential in the service sector is also linked to insufficient spread of labour income is reviewed by evaluations of the European Household Panel (ECHP). A comparison with corresponding OECD studies, which also include the USA, completes the evaluation.
content.title_en: The service gap : service patterns in international comparison

content.text: The business community at the threshold of the information society is also concerned with the business community, the business community at the threshold of the information society. They are addressing a topic of the medium-sized society discussion which has gained in relevance in the 1990s. Although the euphoria is about dot.com, the "information society" is becoming more reality every day. The world is also changing for the small and medium-sized society, where the spread of new technologies is reflected less in short-term productivity gains than in new forms of business and business organization as well as in relations with customers, suppliers and competitors. This is accompanied by an increasing networking in and between companies, as the advance of new ICT technologies has radically changed the technological basis for complex corporate cooperation. -- Information technologies in the medium-sized society and SMEs in networks are topics that address the nervous current economic policy discussions and a highly interesting research field. Both topics were addressed by the Round Table SMEs in two of their meetings in 2001 and 2002; this volume presents the issues of the new technologies which are discussed in the context of the new business community and the new business community's future.
content.title_en: SMEs on the threshold of the information society

content.text: Regional and administrative structures in transition: contributions to the reform discussion from experiences in Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia. Extensive measures to restructure the administration are often justified by demographic change and the financial distress of the municipalities and the Länder. Only larger units, according to the argument, could in future be guaranteed a high-quality municipal service offer at reasonable costs. The tendency to increase municipal units fits into the overall picture of the measures in the field of municipal reform that had been practised in Germany since 1945, but which were previously largely linked to concentration and centralisation efforts. In the overall spectrum of administrative reforms, however, regional reclassifications are only one element: the reform of the stock of public tasks (discipline criticism), the shift of responsibilities between levels (functional reform) and a change in the definition of the financing arrangements in relation to the services transferred to the public sector (financing reform) are further elements of an administrative (new) division. The present publication contains the results of the working group "administrative and territorial reforms" (AG VGR) of the regional employment community Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia have been able to make the Academy of Regional Planning for Regional Planning and Regional Planning more effective.
content.title_en: Regional and administrative structures in transition: Contributions to the reform discussion from experience in Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia

content.text: Building culture in Germany: from the quality of architecture in everyday life to the icons of architecture. "With its eleventh design award, the Wüstenrot Foundation aims to contribute to further clarifying the criteria of building culture in Germany and to provide a current overview, provide suggestions and gain examples for a broad discussion of the understanding of building culture. The results of the competition and other remarkable buildings submitted to the competition are documented in this book."
content.title_en: Building culture in Germany : from the quality of architecture in everyday life to the icons of architecture

content.text: Fundamentals of Robotics. 4207 This book deals with all the essential basics of robotics: historical developments, robot types, autonomy in mobile robots, robot laws, mechanical components and kinematics, position control and path measurement, coordinate systems, industrial robots, effectors and grippers, safety and protection devices in robotics, programming and programming languages, sensors, humanoid robots, artificial intelligence and future developments.
content.title_en: Fundamentals of Robotics

content.text: Work in computerized capitalism : Essays 1976 - 2015. Klappentext: This volume contains contributions by sociologist Rudi Schmiede from the last four decades, which are dedicated to the theoretical and empirical analysis of the change of work and employment against the background of upheavals in the capitalist mode of production. Particular emphasis is placed on the location and the multiplicity of the essays to the theoretical traditions of Marx, Max Weber and the Frankfurt Critical Theory including son-rethels. The theoretical efforts are centered on the development of theory and empiricism of computerization, which is examined in terms of its economic, technical and organizational dimensions and its interlinking with the changes of work and employment. The spectrum of the analyses therefore ranges from theoretical discussions of central critical concepts and concepts to concrete analyses of current knowledge work and the dangers of over-consumption and health risk. Finally, the author discusses options for the practical design of work, organization and technologies.
content.title_en: Work in computerized capitalism : Articles 1976 - 2015

content.text: The regulation of the electricity grids and the regulation of the energy grids are, however, likely to be more appropriate to the implementation of the infrastructure infrastructure.The Federal Network Agency has been responsible for ensuring non-discriminatory access to the grid and adequate network charges since mid-2005.The primary cost-oriented control of grid charges will be replaced in future by a system of modern incentive regulation, which promises above all efficiency benefits. In essence, each network operator will be given dynamic price and revenue ceilings. Based on theoretical foundations of grid pricing regulation and the experience in other countries, this contribution will be used to discuss essential elements of incentive regulation such as cost assessment, efficiency comparison, adaptation formula and quality regulation. Depending on the design of these elements, different incentives for network operators will be set to reward and reduce unwanted activities.
content.title_en: Regulation of electricity grids in Germany : Economic incentives for efficiency and quality of a sustainable grid infrastructure

content.text: Hartz-Reform and laws on new services on the labour market. The project examines the relationships between Hartz-Reform and social-space-oriented, municipal labour market and employment policies and asks the question of the necessary demarcations and networks. One thing becomes obvious: the implementation of the Hartz-Reform should continue to be accompanied by an active municipal employment policy.
content.title_en: Hartz reform and legislation on new services in the labour market
