However, with increasing crime this cannot be explained. The contributions from urban research and critical crime geography show that the differentiations of safe and insecure places are the result of social and discursive constructions and disclose strategies and mechanisms for the construction of (un)security. This allows new perspectives on the connection between (un)security and city.
content.title_en: Discourse - City - Crime : Urban (Un)Securities from the Perspective of Urban Research and Critical Crime Geography

content.text: Promoting biodiversity in the settlement area: good examples and success factors. Settlement areas are growing in area worldwide and are becoming increasingly important for the conservation and promotion of biodiversity. In the future, settlements must be upgraded in such a way that they provide a large variety of plants and animals with a habitat. This book presents examples that have succeeded in bringing biodiversity promotion into line with the needs of the beneficiaries. The success factors that characterize these examples are also described 26 criteria that are suitable for the evaluation of exemplary projects. A checklist is intended to help planners to better exploit the ecological and social potential of the settlement area. The book is aimed at experts who deal with settlement nature, and at all those interested in the current state of knowledge and implementation.
content.title_en: Promoting biodiversity in the settlement area: good examples and success factors

content.text: Quantum mechanics for scientists: a textbook with numerous tasks and solutions. Introductory textbook on quantum mechanics for exam preparation, especially for scientists. Although quantum mechanics is becoming increasingly important, which is why it is often taught in lectures in the first semesters, many students lack the necessary mathematical knowledge. This is taken into account by the author, who is a physics professor in Basel, in this textbook by scattering numerous calculated examples into the text. In addition, 100 exercise tasks with solution instructions and examination questions ensure that the students can prepare themselves optimally for the exam. After a short introduction, the historical development of quantum mechanics is addressed starting from the decisive experiments, followed by the Schrödinger equation, the mathematical foundations, the harmonic oscillator, the properties of the rotary impulse operator, the approximation methods in quantum mechanics and finally problems of interpretation of quantum mechanics.

content.text: Probability and measurement theory. A long and long term approach to probability calculation for students of mathematics, physics and computer science. Review: Probability theory deals with the mathematical description of random events and the study of the underlying structures. Modern probability calculation is based on abstract mass theory concepts. Mass theory is particularly abstract and demanding. Therefore, such access to the classical and not necessarily mass theory parts of probability calculation without sound mathematical competences is unnecessarily demanding for many target groups. This work now provides students of mathematics, but also prospective physicists and computer scientists with access to probability calculation, which avoids mass theory concepts and concepts as long as possible. Nevertheless, it includes an independent representation of mass theory, axiomatic probability theory and stochastic processes in a sufficiently large scale for the study of mathematics. The area is more demanding.

content.text: Homo deus : a story of tomorrow. What will happen to us and our planet when new technologies give man godlike abilities - creative as well as destructive - and lift life itself to a completely new level of evolution? How will Homo Sapiens fare?
content.title_en: Homo deus : a story of tomorrow

content.text: The blossoms of the extravagant: about the tendency to speak in contemporary architectural criticisms. For several decades, the use of language has changed in architectural critiques. It is a development from a factual language style to over-extended formulations that are not even metaphorically to be interpreted. A general cultural phenomenon that seems to be due to the ever-increasing dominance of the pictorial in communication. This new language is analysed by Jan Büchsenschuss in an exemplary manner by the critics of the architectural magazine "bauwelt" of the year 2008 and structures the abundance of strange formulations used linguistically. Based on this analysis, he asks what this new language, which is difficult to interpret for architecture as art and for the reflective reader of architectural criticisms means.
content.title_en: The blossoms of the extravagant : about the tendency to speak in contemporary architectural criticisms

content.text: Machine Learning - Media, Infrastructures and Technologies of Artificial Intelligence. No less than a revolution is currently being discussed. Newer artificial intelligence processes intervene in all areas of social and cultural life: machines learn to recognize images and language, master autonomous control of vehicles as well as financial investments and medical diagnostics. In digital change, learning is no longer a privilege of humans. Rather, machine learning processes shift the relations between possibilities of knowledge, technical environments and human actors. This volume provides an overview of the media, infrastructure and historical prerequisites of machine learning for the first time in the German-speaking world. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Machine Learning - Media, Infrastructures and Technologies of Artificial Intelligence

content.text: Marketing excellence in tourism : Concepts - Case studies - Best Practices. "Why should I book with you?" is one of the typical customer questions to which every tourism company should have a convincing answer. But why are some providers more successful than others? What is the characteristic of targeted marketing work in tourism and how does an above-average "marketing performance" arise? How successful tourism companies develop a strong market-oriented self-image and achieve customer-related 'leads' in their relevant target segments, this book considers. The experienced marketing experts around Marco A. Gardini show how - differentiated positions in tourism can be built up and maintained, - tourism-specific marketing approaches and strategies consistently integrated into management, - already used proven success factors and transferred to their own organization. From brand formation and experience staging to new opportunities through big data and digitalization: Who searches for concrete, innovative marketing concepts, case studies and best practices in tourism, hotel industry and leisure economy, is found here. (publisher)
content.title_en: Marketing excellence in tourism : Concepts - Case Studies - Best Practices

content.text: Housing and real estate markets in Germany ... ; 2016. With the Housing and Real Estate Market Report 2016, the Federal Institute for Building, Urban and Spatial Research is once again publishing a comprehensive presentation of the current trends and the expected developments in the housing and real estate markets in Germany. The publication illustrates the regional diversity of housing supply and demand, rents and real estate prices, as well as transactions and vacancy. Currently, the public discussion is not able to get out of sight the supply shortages and the scarcity of particularly low-cost housing in dynamic and economically strong cities and regions. However, the report shows one thing: the further housing and real estate challenges - especially in the balanced and shrinking regions - cannot be addressed. The adaptation of the stocks to energy and climate policy requirements, the age-appropriate modernization for self-determined housing for senior citizens, but also the handling of vacant buildings are central issues for future-proof housing supply (source: BBSR).
content.title_en: Housing and real estate markets in Germany ... ; 2016

content.text: Shaping cities : emerging models of planning practice. Urban habitats are now confronted with ever-growing mobility, recurring economic crises and natural disasters. In response, new hybrid forms have developed in urban planning that go beyond traditional procedures. By incorporating methods from other disciplines, planning practice has become increasingly complex and depended on impulses from information, ideas and measures from various economic systems, societies and geographical areas. -- The richly illustrated essay collection offers a comprehensive introduction to new approaches to urban planning worldwide with case studies from demographic, political, cultural and social very diverse regions such as Central and South America, Europe, the Middle East and East Asia. In addition to conventional planning methods, the volume presents experimental and interdisciplinary approaches to urban planning.
content.title_en: Shaping cities : emerging models of planning practice

content.text: Against elections: why voting is not democratic. It is strange with democracy. Everyone is in favour, but no one believes it is so right that it works, at least not through elections. If the results are different than desired, the accusation of populism in the area is quickly. Few people are voting, the membership numbers of political parties are dramatically decreasing. How can democracy work efficiently and make long-term viable decisions, if politicians have to do their job first of all: at the next election they want to be re-elected. David Van Reybrouck describes this mechanism with strikingly clear arguments as 'democratic fatigue syndrome'. How can we get away from it? Perhaps completely new ways are needed, even if they seem completely alien at first sight? David Van Reybrouck's proposals take on a very old democratic principle, which was practiced already in ancient Athens: the lot. Until the French revolution this democratic means was often applied, for example in flourishing republics such as Venice or Florence at the time of the Renaissance. David Van Reybrouck shows how this can make democracy more vivid today (the publisher is also making it more democratic).
content.title_en: Against elections: why votes are not democratic

content.text: The positive and negative constitutional reservation : Considerations on a regulatory theory in the borderline of constitutional law dogmatics and constitutional theory. What happens when and why in constitutional texts, what does not get into it when and why? Are there necessary constitutional contents? What constitutional and constitutional theoretical standards are there for the "high-level zoning of content from simple law to the stage of the constitution? Christian Waldhoff's treatise deals with these questions that have not been studied so far. The constitutional reservation is treated as both a figure of legal dogmatics and constitutional theory. The examples examined are from the Basic Law, from foreign constitutions as well as from the constitutional history.
content.title_en: The positive and negative constitutional reservation : Considerations on a regulatory theory in the borderline of constitutional law dogmatics and constitutional theory

content.text: Reformation and Book : Actors and strategies of early reformatory printed products. Libraries are important institutions of cultural memory. They transmit printed and handwritten documents and media of all kinds and make them available to science as source material. History and organization of libraries are also the object of research as well as the holdings that they preserve. The Library and Science yearbook publishes studies of individual texts, collections and genres of sources as well as cultural and scientific historical contributions to the history and method of library work and bibliography. Library and Science is the cross-disciplinary forum for the process of cultural tradition through libraries. The contributions in volume 49, published by Elmar Mittler, are based on the lectures of the conference "Reformation and Book" held in Göttingen on 22 and 23 February 2016, which was thankfully supported by the Fritz Thyssen Foundation.

As mobile devices (such as smartphones and tablet PCs) and the parallel increasing importance of social networks (such as Facebook and Twitter) are spread, learning habits and the expectations of the growing generations of educational opportunities of universities and company education and training are changing: In addition to the now established electronic teaching and learning forms such as computer/web-based training and virtual seminars, mobile learning with smart devices and learning support and support in social networks are becoming increasingly important. content.text: The oceans, man and life: the balance of an existential relationship. The oceans are the basis of our existence and our most important resource. And they are the origin of all life on earth, a fascinating and often unknown world whose destruction has been achieved for years undreamt of mass. Mojib Latif, the renowned climate and marine researcher, explores existential questions in his book: What role do the oceans play in climate change? What consequences do the oceans have in terms of acidification? Where does the pollution of oil lead? How can the role of plastic waste be assessed? And how is the burden of radioactivity? Mojib Latif presents a pressing plea for the preservation of our basis of life, which can hardly be avoided. (publication info)

content.text: Europe's dawn: an essay. After 1989 maps were suddenly no longer fashionable. The borders were to be opened for people, goods, capital and ideas. The old maps replaced graphics that illustrated the economic interdependence within the EU. Today we are experiencing an ideological change in tides: where the majority of Europeans looked optimistically at globalisation a few years ago, they felt migration and the return of geopolitics as a source of uncertainty. Ivan Krastev examines the causes of this change and discusses what forms European disintegration could take. A breakdown of the EU, Krastev said, would be a tragedy that would condemn the continent to international insignificance.
content.title_en: European dawn: an essay

content.text: What are the monuments of what modernism? : to deal with buildings of the 1960s and 70s. "The church, castle and half-timbered house are still considered as the epitome of the architectural monument. But what about large housing estates, shopping centres or campus universities? For over two decades, the preservation of monuments throughout Europe has been increasingly focusing on the buildings of the years 1960 to 1980. Nevertheless, they remain a difficult legacy: often too large, difficult to use and in poor condition. Thus, the architecture of an entire generation threatens to disappear before society could become aware of its potential historical or artistic significance. What values and perceptions are linked to the architecture of late modernism? What reasons and inventory strategies do buildings of this time use the monument lists? The volume examines these questions for the first time in European comparison and in an interdisciplinary perspective.
content.title_en: What monuments of what modernism? : to deal with buildings of the 1960s and 70s

content.text: CUBITY : energy-plus and modular future student living. CUBITY is the first modular housing cluster for students in the world's Plus Energy Standard. This innovative room concept follows a house-in-house principle, where highly minimized individual spaces and maximized communal areas with different temperature zones are below a shell. This allows transitions from individual to communal, from small to large, from undivided to divided? as a synthesis of the guiding principles 'cube', 'city' and 'community'. The publication documents various stages of the development of the room concept at the Department of Architecture of TU Darmstadt as well as the construction at the Solar Decathlon Europe 2014 in Versailles. CUBITY offers model solutions for social science and energy issues and links contemporary forms of communal living with aspects of sustainability.
content.title_en: CUBITY : energy-plus and modular future student living

content.text: Globalization in a split: the post-global misery and ways to overcome it. For several decades, globalization has shaped the world - politically, economically and socially. This changed many life-related issues considerably, both in positive and negative. As a result, discord and a post-global misery emerged that must be overcome. Jürgen Turek's analysis investigates the reasons for the destabilization of the civilization conditions in the field of economic dynamics, social-cultural excitement and political uncertainty.
content.title_en: Globalization in a Disparity: the Postglobal Misere and Ways to Cope With It

content.text: Social design - urban change : arts as urban innovation. Urban change investigates the massive processes of change in urban space. content.text: The future of the 20th century: dimensions of historical research for the future. In historical science, a turning point can be observed in recent years on questions of temporality. In particular, future designs receive great attention: for historians, they represent an opportunity to approach historical system breaks from completely new perspectives. Classical historiography tends to regard the past as the precursor of the present; however, rejected or unimplemented ideas and projects give little attention. In the analysis of past concepts for the future, the yield is thus not in closed historical images, but in the dissolution of historical change into a plurality of historical narratives.
content.title_en: The Future of the 20th Century : Dimensions of Historical Future Research

content.text: Introduction to physical geography. The basics of the most important areas of physical geography - geomorphology, climate, hydro, soil and vegetation geography - are explained in a compact way. Current developments and research of the subject are taken into account. Ideal as an introduction and as a companion through the Bachelor's degree programme!
content.title_en: Introduction to physical geography

content.text: Turtle and Lyra : in the workshop of mythology. How did the great myths of antiquity come about? The latest research takes a concrete path in the so-called ›material turn‹, investigating words and objects. Take a new look at the founding myths of Athens or Rome with two luminaries of science – or the myth of the turtle that once gave the Lyra its sound body.
content.title_en: Turtle and Lyra : in the workshop of mythology

content.text: Revolutions and counter-revolutions : 1917 and its aftermath from a global perspective. 1917 was an important year of historical upheaval on a world scale, in which the foundation stone for the shaping structures of the 20th century was laid. Contemporaries were aware of these global contexts, but in the history that was limited to national interests they played little role for decades. This volume combines new research that shows the transnational connections between the countless uprisings, rebellions and revolutions and the violent reactions to them in the years between 1917 and 1920 in all parts of the world. Stefan Rinke is Professor of History of Latin America at the FU Berlin. Michael Wildt is Professor of German History in the 20th century with a focus on National Socialism at the HU Berlin.
content.title_en: Revolutions and counter-revolutions : 1917 and its aftermath from a global perspective

content.text: Europe's end, Europe's beginning: new perspectives for the European Union. Is the hopeful, globally admired European integration project today facing failure? The conflicts and tensions surrounding the stability of the monetary union ("Eurocrisis") and the enormous challenges of the refugee crisis have shaken the foundations of the European Union. The referendum-based withdrawal of Britain from the European Union ("Brexit") is regarded by many observers as a precursor to a retreat into national sovereignty. Recognised experts from various disciplines are dedicated in this volume to the search for the decisive adjustment screws in the European fabric and the development of innovative ideas to ensure the future viability of the European Union. Because the current crisis-like transition situation may be the chance for a new start to European unification. With contributions by Udo Di Fabio, Dieter Grimm, Karl Lamers, Jan-Werner Müller, Herfried Münkler, Fritz W. Scharpf, Gesine Schwan, Philipp Ther, Antoine Vauchez, Werner Weidenfeld and others.
content.title_en: Europe's end, Europe's beginning: new perspectives for the European Union

content.text: The importance of the labour market is not only a question of the importance of the labour market, but also of the need for the labour market to be able to develop and develop the skills of the labour market.
content.title_en: Working world of the future: how digitalization changes the labour market

content.text: Psychogeography: how the environment affects our behavior and our choices. Why are the tables on the edge more quickly than in the middle? Why are hospital patients getting better when they look into the green? Why are churches shy of us? Colin Ellard takes us on an exciting journey of discovery into the world of psychogeography and explains how the environment affects our behavior every day IBM, whether at home, at work, on the way through the city or outdoors. As one of the leading experts in the field of experimental psychology, he gives insight into the mechanisms that are effective in doing so, and shows what we can learn from it in everyday life.
content.title_en: Psychogeography: how the environment affects our behavior and our decisions

content.text: Build attractively with a small budget: with systematic planning at low costs. Very understandable, practical guide for builders. Structured by strategies, planning and construction process, components and construction technology, possibilities for saving construction costs are shown by thorough planning and sensible rationalization measures. Compared to the predecessor (ID-A 19/11), some project examples and images were exchanged or supplemented and the cost data were continuously updated with the 2016 status. For first purchase or as replacement for shattered copies highly recommended. According to the comprehensive advisors "Our builder manual" (ID-A 14/16) and Beate Bühl: "We plan and build our house" (ID-A 43/16), before the idea collection of the author "Better build, better live" (ID-A 15/15). (2)
content.title_en: Build attractively with small budget : with systematic planning at low cost

content.text: The country in which we want to live: how the Germans imagine their future. How do people want to live in Germany? What do they want for the future, for the lives of their children? Where do they seek change, where do they hold on to traditions, where are social blockades? In their unique, large-scale "bequest study", sociologist Jutta Allmendinger looks the German into the soul and asks about their values and wishes, hopes and worries in the here and now and for the future. The country in which we want to live shows that we often think, wish and feel differently in questions of family, career, health and technology, as we assume
content.title_en: The country we want to live in: how the Germans imagine their future

content.text: The decoding of aging: the telomer effect. Telomers are the protective caps of our chromosomes and thus directly linked to the cell aging as well as the emergence of many diseases such as cancer, diabetes and cardiovascular problems. Nobel Prize winner Dr. Elizabeth Blackburn and her colleague Dr. Elissa Epel have found out in years of research what our telomers consist of and how we can obtain them. Scientifically sound and practical explains: In this book you will find the guide for a vital body. Stay young and healthy - for a lifetime
content.title_en: Decryption of aging : the Telomer effect

content.text: Seven-story village: living experiments for a better future. When Barbara Nothegger became a mother, she dared the experiment and joined a joint house project with her family. 100 people built a house with flexible apartments, gardens, free spaces for children and an ecological lifestyle. The residents wanted to be there for each other - just like in the village before. But how can a living together in a world characterized by individualism succeed? Are communal houses an answer to pressing questions such as loneliness, high rents and waste of resources? Barbara Nothegger shows from comparable houses in Germany and Switzerland how good neighbourhood leads to more sustainability, and describes humorously how she got happy in her community house.
content.title_en: Seven floor village : residential experiments for a better future

content.text: The revenge of the analogue: why we yearn for real things. On the way to digital utopia something strange happens: We are again developing a weakness for analogue products and ideas whose superfluidity had been conjured up by the tech gurus. Industries that recently seemed old-fashioned – from record production to bookstores around the corner – are now more in demand than ever. The revenge of the analogue is there. David Sax has spoken with numerous entrepreneurs, owners of small businesses and large corporations, who serve a market away from apps or virtual solutions: they sell real products to touch. Sax-E book reveals that a through and through digital existence is not worth striving for and a future in the real world is attractive to all of us.
content.title_en: The Revenge of the Analog : Why We Long for Real Things

content.text: Textbook of Building Physics : Sound - Heat - Humidity - Light - Fire - Climate. "The proven teaching and reference work of Building Physics was updated and moderately supplemented for the 8th edition; it thus represents the state of the art in this field."--
content.title_en: Textbook of Building Physics : Sound - Heat - Humidity - Light - Fire - Climate

content.text: Roofing spaces: Design, construction, living. The re-condensation in urban space is currently an important topic in urban development as well as in architectural practice. In particular, the expansion of the roofs has great potential for the much needed additional living space. But the new building of inclined roofs with its possibilities is also increasingly becoming the focus of the architectural discussion. On, under and in the roof attractive apartments with special spatial compositions can be realized, but here the most diverse complex planning requirements and framework conditions apply, which relate especially to the handling of the existing building substance when expanding. This publication is therefore intended to inform the planner comprehensively about the basic planning rules, which derive from the corresponding laws, norms, regulations and technical guidelines. In the sense of a building theory, the spatial basic building blocks of the functions of living, eating, cooking, sleeping, working, cleaning and care in connection with the special spatial geometry of inclined roofs are processed. - Project catalogue with 40 implemented examples - Basic information on building law, thermal and acoustic construction physics, fire protection and static - Overview of construction materials to be used - Basic construction principles - Appliance of roof construction principles, Appliance of roof construction.
content.title_en: Roofing : Design, Design, Living

content.text: Evolution: a cultural history. When Charles Darwin published his theory of evolution of species by natural selection in 1859, he already anticipated a great debate, but not its radiance and longevity. At the beginning, the consequences for the sciences, faith in God and moral concepts were in the foreground. Considerations about society, politics, international relations and interventions down to the level of the individual and his genetic material, his genes were soon added. Social Darwinism, eugenics, racism were sometimes regarded as scientifically legitimate areas of discussion and politics. Fears of supposed decline can still be underscored in view of the biologization of thought apparently scientifically-objective. Currently, the controversy is even more diverse, involving far more people than in the late 19th century, have far more serious consequences. The authors from eleven countries distinguish the facets of an exciting debate, and even more topically in the present day, and ask about the future of the "strike Evolution" from different disciplinary perspectives.
content.title_en: Evolution Dispute : a Cultural History

content.text: Python Crash Course : a practical project-based program introduction. Introductions to the easy-to-learn, object-oriented programming language Python for beginners without any major prior knowledge in their current version, which unfortunately is not backward-compatible to previous versions, have been discussed several times. This book is very much based on language and is therefore an interesting alternative to St. Kaminski. The author of the book starts with a comprehensive basic part (installation under Linux, OS X and Windows; data types, lists, if- and while instructions, functions, dictionary, libraries, testing of codes, ...) and then comes to an application part with 3 large interactive projects (alien invasion - a game similar to space invaders; the visualization of data and the creation of web apps, among others an online learning book). Many illustrations, graphically highlighted note sets, summaries of each chapter. Very useful is also the annex on text editors (Geany, Sublime Text, IDLE)
content.title_en: Python Crash Course : a practical, project-based program introduction

content.text: Java for Dummies. In the introduced series, a revised and updated version of a proven Java introduction is available (last edition, may continue). The usual version of the text comes from the predecessor in large part, but also takes into account elements of the recently released release Java 9. This includes the helpful tool JShell (read-evaluation-output-loop). Barry also integrated examples for programming graphical applications, deleted 2 chapters (including Java applets), but also added a new one (reference types). The last chapter was strongly modified, for the construction and use of database connections. Less exciting are the converted (and supplemented) symbols and the moving of information from the top ten part into the main part of the book. Also besides the introduction of Philipp Ackermann and Kai Günster
content.title_en: Java for Dummies

content.text: This is how we create this - a civil society in the process of departure : 90 pioneering projects with refugees. German civil society has re-established itself in its struggle with flight. Between 2015 and 2016, around 15,000 projects were created, in which creative answers to the many challenges of immigration were found. They form an alternative to panic reactions, which see the only way to deal with flight in controls and deterrence. This volume presents 90 exemplary projects. They show the strength to deal with social problems in the current civil society – and what potential for a new relationship is not only in the handling of immigrants but also within civil society. This publication was supported by the Federal Government Commissioners for Migration, Refugees and Integration.
content.title_en: This is how we do it - a civil society on the rise: 90 pioneering projects with refugees

content.text: The concept of appropriation is revival in discourses on the theory, practice and politics of urban development: In view of the dynamics of late modern economy and politics, it is about the availability and self-determined use of urban space and life. This discourse also includes the "selber make" of urban free spaces, "downside urban development" is to determine the urban free spaces of tomorrow.
content.title_en: Appropriation of urban spaces: a discourse on urban space

content.text: Transformation Design : Ways into a sustainable modern age. The blatant over-use of nature in the western industrialized countries means a "structural" non-sustainableness. The necessary transformation requires a conversion and dismantling in many areas, for which various examples are discussed (as of mid-2014). (2-3)
content.title_en: Transformation Design : Towards a Future-ready Modernism

content.text: The Humus Revolution : how we heal the soil, save the climate and create the food transition. Review (ekz): The Humus Revolution is like the fight of David against Goliath: Small farmers and small gardeners can oppose soil destruction with regenerative agriculture by the world-wide intertwined agricultural industry. Political scientist and journalist Ute Scheub follows her critical paper "Terra Preta" (2013) in which she points out the desolate state of the soils of this world and explains the basic principles of climate gardening. A global humus construction of only 1% would suffice to reduce the CO2 content of the atmosphere to a safe level, according to her statement. Using numerous example projects in Germany and worldwide, she shows how entire landscapes can be regenerated. Everyone can participate in it. Her journalistic style also opens up the topic to the less informed reader and makes the book worth reading. (2)
content.title_en: The Humus Revolution: how we heal the soil, save the climate and create the food transition

content.text: Landhaus & Cottage Gardens : the practical book : especially for our local climate. Verl. Beschr.: the picture book for active designers. Opulent photos, design examples for large and small gardens, planting plans for redesign. Especially adapted to local climate conditions. Portraits of suitable plants that thrive well with care tips
content.title_en: Country house & Cottage gardens : the practical book : especially for our local climate

content.text: The Heureka-Principle of the New Kingdom of the Gods is to be found in the New Kingdom of the Gods. The New Kingdom of the Gods is to be found in the New Kingdom of the Gods. The New Kingdom of the Gods is to be found in the New Kingdom of the Gods. The New Kingdom of the Gods is to be found in the New Kingdom of the Gods. The New Kingdom of the Gods is to be found in the New Kingdom of the Gods. The New Kingdom of the Gods is to be found in the New Kingdom of the Gods. The New Kingdom of the Gods is to be found in the New Kingdom of the Gods. The New Kingdom of the Gods is to be found in the New Kingdom of the Gods.
content.title_en: The Heureka Principle : Discover the scientist in you

content.text: The Dacha - 600 m2 of luck. Photo book on the Dacha, a piece of Russian everyday culture. Review: The standardized parcels (600 mALI) in compensation for the narrowness of the urban communal cassocks (apartments that shared several families) of the Soviet era had little in common with their name-giving princely country gifts (dat', russian for give). Nevertheless, they belong to the Russian everyday culture like the Samowar, Wodka and Father Frost, in which the master photographer Makarov visually and the poet Rubinstein let us share with his text about the soul of the Dacha. And so the reader and viewer creates an idea of a dacha, which despite many commonalities differs considerably from the Schreberg species or well-kept weekend-end plot with bungalows, to which unfortunately she loses increasingly on terrain. The atmospheric color photos - matt reproduced - are expressive even if they show only small excerpts of ordinary motifs.
content.title_en: The Dacha - 600 m2 of happiness

content.text: The Internet in our hands! : from digital capitalism to data democracy. Google, Facebook, Twitter and others are no longer to be thought out of our everyday lives. Internet corporations have become so powerful that their bosses are treated by democratically elected governments as heads of sovereign states. In his disputation Thomas Wagner explains how it could happen. The dynamics of the digital economy favors the formation of super monopolies. How can their ever-growing power be reduced? A democratic realignment of technological development is necessary so that the digitalisation that has just begun can unfold its liberation potential, instead of ending in the dead end of an economic and political data bondage. The development of a reform strategy is required. It is about the recapture of the public space that is under pressure from private interests. The construction of a public-law Internet would be an important step on the path from digital monopoly capitalism to data democracy.
content.title_en: The web in our hands! : from digital capitalism to data democracy

content.text: Digital addictions: do you already app or do you still live?. Folding text: More and more people say goodbye to real relationships today and instead enter into close ties with their laptops, tablets and smartphones. They spend more time with these than with their love partners, children and other people of their social environment. Many people simply can't imagine a life without these auxiliary machines anymore. Real contacts are gradually replaced by artificial, indirect contacts. All this happens in the interest of a cyber elite who seems to care little about the fact that countless people depend on their products and lose sight of their neighbors, and instead has the maximum profit in focus. Why do we all play this game with and how can one be dependent on a smartphone? The psychologist and philosopher Gisela Kaiser tries to answer these and many other questions. From the content: The users - The children: We play where the sockets are - The adults: Not without my mobile phone! The families: Everyone for themselves in his own world - The effects - Digital dependencies and addictions - Changed communication standards - The new revolution - The revolution - The new I play where the plugs are - The adults: The adults: Not without my mobile phone! The families: The families: The families for themselves - The psychologistsss - The psychologistss - The psychos - The psychoss - The psychos - The psychos
content.title_en: Digital addictions : Are you already using or still alive?

content.text: Archive construction and archive relocation. An archive (new) construction and an archive relocation are extraordinary challenges that most people face only once in their professional lives. In this volume, the various project participants (architects, archivists, builders, IT specialists, project controllers, shelf planners, restorers, relocation logistics, etc.) are told, who with their expertise have contributed to the successful construction and relocation of one of the largest archives in Germany, the department of the Rhineland of the State Archives North Rhine-Westphalia, to Duisburg. The experience gathered here from the cooperation in construction and relocation is intended to help to support future projects of this kind in the preparation, planning and implementation of practically and communicatively.
content.title_en: Archives and archive relocations

content.text: Violence and bullying in schools: how violence and bullying have developed, how teachers intervene and what skills they need. How do teachers react to violence and bullying? What role do knowledge, beliefs or empathy play in this? And: How has the extent of violence and bullying developed in German schools in recent years? Research has so far had little answers to these questions. The volume presents the results of the project "Teacher Trade in Violence and Bullying", funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG), which has examined these questions in a large-scale study involving over 2000 pupils and 550 teachers. Both from a teacher and from a pupil perspective, it is first analysed how frequently teachers intervene in violence incidents and what exactly they do with what aim and with what success. The research results cover, in addition to development trends, in particular, what intervention strategies are helpful and what distinguishes competent teachers. Consequences for teacher formation and school development are drawn. The volume is aimed at a broad audience of researchers, teachers' training and school practice.
content.title_en: Violence and bullying in schools: how violence and bullying have developed, how teachers intervene and what skills they need

content.text: Strategies for the library as a place: Festschrift für Petra Hauke zum 70. Geburtstag. This volume congratulates colleagues from all over the world as well as lecturers and students of the Institute for Library and Information Science of the Humboldt University of Berlin Dr. Petra Hauke on his 70th birthday. A personality who has been a lecturer, lecturer, editor and at international level as a member of various specialist commissions of IFLA – and will continue to work in this broad range. The range of topics of this volume is oriented towards the diversity of areas in which Petra Hauke has provided unmistakably impulses for library and information science. In addition to library architecture, the library will be presented as a place of encounter, as a place of learning, as a "green" place, as a pedagogical place, as a place for young professionals and as a place for voluntary engagement with the latest approaches.
content.title_en: Strategies for the Library as a Place : Festschrift for Petra Hauke on 70th Birthday

content.text: Digital Business Modelling: Develop digital business models and strategically anchor them. The Digital Value Creation Framework gives you a model that allows you to develop successful, new digital business models and check existing ones. Find out what customers really want! - Concrete approach for digital business models - All things worth knowing about digital economy - With a particularly vivid presentation and numerous practical examples. The changes that are taking place through digitalization are fundamental, disruptive and revolutionary. Companies have enormous risks here, but also enormous opportunities. The central question is: How can new and value-rich transformation approaches be created in a digital and intangible network economy? This work also provides the relevant basic knowledge about digital business models and presents the tool "Digital Value Creation Framework" (DVC Framework). Using the DVC Framework, new and value-rich transformation approaches can be developed and realized. However, existing business or organizational models can also be tested and further developed to ensure value. The reader receives a concrete approach, such as the tool can be used in his own company and in the case of the new business model publishing.
content.title_en: Digital Business Modelling : Developing and strategically anchoring digital business models

content.text: Scenarios of a digital world - today and tomorrow : how digital transformation changes our lives. What does "digital transformation" mean, how and where does it express itself? How do hardware, software and digital services affect us, our private, business and social, cultural and political environment? How do they affect our social relationships, our work, mobility, our home, health, leisure, media, consumption and commitment? What changes, what arises, what disappears and what can or must we adapt to and what should we do? These questions are central to this book. - Future scenarios, scenarios
content.title_en: Scenarios of a digital world - today and tomorrow: how digital transformation changes our lives

content.text: Partial Least Squares Structure Equation Modeling : an application-oriented introduction. SmartPLS is the leading software program for estimating PLS-based structure equation models. The explanations and the methods proposed in the book reflect the current state of research. Partial Least Squares Structure Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) has claimed to be a suitable method for estimating causal models in economic and social science research. Thanks to the user-friendliness of the process and the existing software, it is now also established in practice. This book provides an application-oriented introduction to PLS-SEM. The focus is on the basics of the process and its practical implementation using SmartPLS software. The concept of the book relies on simple explanations of statistical approaches and the clear presentation of numerous application examples based on a uniform case study. Many graphics, tables and illustrations facilitate the understanding of PLS-SEM. In addition, the reader is offered downloadable data sets, videos, tasks and other specialist articles for further development. Thus, the book is ideally suited to students and practitioners to use the PLS-S-S-based models for their own data.
content.title_en: Partial Least Squares Structural equation modeling : an application-oriented introduction

content.text: Qualitative methods in organisational and management research: an application-oriented guide for data collection and analysis. Each chapter first gives a general overview of the respective subject before practical examples are presented using two studies carried out by the author team. Finally, each chapter also offers the possibility to reflect on the respective methodological step and apply it for their own thesis using selected exercises. The book is thus written on the one hand for students of economics and related social sciences (e.g. sociology, psychology and political sciences) who write various seminar papers during their studies and, on the other hand, especially for those who have to write a bachelor's or master's thesis at the end of their studies. In both cases, there is the possibility of a qualitative study design. This book deals with the methods of qualitative organizational and management research and is intended in particular to represent an application-oriented guide. The approach of a qualitative study, which is common from a process perspective, serves as a structural basis for the book and covers the following chapters: case selection and definition (chapter 2); data collection (chapter 3); data analysis (chapter 4) as well as a preparation of results (chapter 5).
content.title_en: Qualitative methods in organisational and management research: an application-oriented guide for data collection and analysis

content.text: Digital transformation : why the German economy is sleeping out of the digital future and what needs to be done now!. From the content: Digitalization - Networking as a company principle - Business models - Customer, customer loyalty - Social Selling - The new way to the customer - Smart products need smart manufacturers - The new employee - Employer as a brand - Data, big data - Trends
content.title_en: Digital transformation: why the German economy is drowsy and what needs to be done now!

content.text: The following are the main findings of the research: The results of international research networks on continuing education, the establishment and expansion of which are the leading scientific director of the German Institute for Adult Education (DIE), Ekkehard Nuissl, who is dedicated to this book. Rolf Arnold is a professor at the Chair of Pedagogy, especially vocational and adult education, at the TU Kaiserslautern and Chairman of the DIE Board of Directors. The importance of learning for the curriculum has changed significantly in recent years. Learning crosses a borderline by moving from institutions into everyday life and becoming an integral and important part of biography. This change requires new educational policy foundations and new forms of knowledge and competence transfer by educational institutions. The volume focuses on the topic of "Disclosure of learning" and links relevant research findings from abroad with the development lines of German continuing education research.
content.title_en: Disintegration of learning: international perspectives for adult education

content.text: Reflection on self-education: Festschrift für Rolf Arnold. Wiltrud Gieseke is Professor of Adult Education at Humboldt University in Berlin. Ekkehard Nuissl is Professor of Adult Education at the Universities of Florence, Timisoara and Kaiserslautern. Ingeborg Schüßler is Professor of Adult Education and Educational Management at the Ludwigsburg University of Education. Chapter 1: Organization and Emotion Chapter 2: Didactics and Methodology Chapter 3: Vocational Education and Training Chapter 4: Profession and Professionalization Chapter 5: Criticism and Discourse Chapter 6: Access and Access Chapter 7: Written Communication Not Teaching and Teaching but Making It Possible and Space for Self-Approval: On the 60th birthday of the important adult educator Rolf Arnold, the collection volume presents his innovative approach to systemic-constructivist adult education. Naming representatives of vocational and further education, including Philipp Gonon, Horst Siebert, Rudolf Tipfelt and Peter Faulstich, critically examine the extent to which the approach to organizational development, coaching, emotions and subjects, didactics and methods are used in this interview.
content.title_en: Reflection on self-education : Festschrift für Rolf Arnold

content.text: After migration: post-migrant perspectives beyond the parallel society. Migration creates a variety of forms of mobility that combine different places, ways of life and visions. People who migrate create spaces that are different from those who left them and those who have been re-acquired. Thus, structures, cultures and forms of communication are created that would be hardly conceivable without impulses through migration. Life practice shows that people have several homelands and belongings, can create diverse cultural and social networks and that they can deal creatively and subversively with negative attributions from outside. In this way, post-migrant, multi-local, hybrid and transcultural everyday practices develop, which have so far been hardly appreciated. The contributions of this volume therefore understand themselves as a plea for a different view of things and as a rejection of the precipitous mistrust with which migration-related phenomena are frequently encountered.This reader contains contributions, among others, by Wolf-Dietrich Bukow, Sabine Hes, Regina Römhild and Mark Terkessidis.
content.title_en: After migration : post-migrant perspectives beyond the parallel society

content.text: Spanish: Phonetics and Phonology: an introduction. The book gives students of Spanish an accessible basic work on the sound teaching of their subject, in which proven basic knowledge (which also includes the use of the language analysis software Praat) is linked to recent theoretical developments (e.g. characteristic geometry, autosegmental phonology and optimality theory as well as in the field of prosody the autosegmental-metric model of intonation research and various methods of analysis for language rhythm).Spanish is not considered as homogeneous language, but the European standard (castilian standard language) is treated equally with other varieties (e.g. from Latin America). The Romanesque background is the neighbouring Portuguese and Catalan language, but also French and Italian are used in comparative terms, while German serves as contrast foil. In this way, a variety of differentiational linguistic and linguistically comparative insights into the vocal structure and development of Spanish are obtained.
content.title_en: Spanish: Phonetics and Phonology : an Introduction

content.text: Internationalization of teacher education : Perspectives from theory and practice. Against the background of an increasingly diverse society, it is crucial for the professionalization of prospective teachers to reflect on the central importance, attitudes and values of their own teacher role. Here, the approach of an internationalization of teacher education constitutes a decisive contribution. Whether "at home" or "abroad", the view across the board can provide a central added value for future teachers in heterogeneous settings, by promoting intercultural skills, socio-cultural awareness and the knowledge of other education systems. In this book, perspectives from theory and practice in an international context are illuminated. It combines different perspectives on teacher education with actors involved in it. Against the background of an increasingly diverse society, it is essential for the professionalization of prospective teachers to reflect on their own teacher role. Here, the approach of an internationalization of teacher education forms a decisive contribution. Whether "at home" or "abroad", the view over the edge of the plate can provide a central added value for future teachers in heterogeneous settings, by promoting the understanding of socio-cultural skills and by integrating the context of teacher education into the teaching system.
content.title_en: Internationalization of teacher education : Perspectives from theory and practice

content.text: The next one is the "Business Process Management" and the "Business Process Management" in the real estate industry. The far jump is at least fundamentally different from the high jump in the long jump. When jumping far, the athlete tries to reach a maximum range at each jump. In the end, the broad jump counts the farthest jump. In contrast, the approach of the high jump is quite different: successively, the height is increased. Every athlete has to skip every height within three attempts. If he, he, is not. A nice metaphor for the introduction of BPM into companies: One company tries to make a long jump, the other one is in a high jump. There, however, the latte is already quite high. Only one methodical and systematic approach, a targeted use of computer science and endurance leads to the next height. Each jump means not only to have mastered a step in the learning curve of the individual employee, but also to have a good start with the whole organization.
content.title_en: Business Process Management 2014 – Status quo and perspectives of integrated business process management: from isolated to integrated. Crossing Borders. Results of an empirical study and focus on "Business Process Management in the Real Estate Industry"

content.text: IT-Sourcing-Management-Studie : vom Kosten- zum Erfolgsfaktor ; Crossing Borders ; Results of a qualitative study. The Institute of Business Informatics (IWI) of the School of Management and Law of the Zurich University of Applied Sciences (ZHAW) has set itself the goal with this empirical study on the topic of IT-Sourcing to investigate and show the degree of maturity and diffusion as well as timely and medium-term trends in German-speaking Europe (DACH).
content.title_en: IT-Sourcing-Management-Study : from cost to success factor ; Crossing Borders ; Results of a qualitative study

content.text: Psychology in environmental protection: Handbook on the promotion of sustainable action. Biographical note: Karen Hamann is the chairman of the board of the "Initiative Psychologie im Umweltschutz (IPU) e.V.), and coach of university sustainability initiatives. She studies psychology at the Friedrich Schiller University Jena in the master's degree program. Anna Baumann is an expert in environmental communication and moderator for children's and youth participation. She studied environmental and sustainability sciences in Lüneburg and is an inclusion officer and managing director of the children's and youth parliament Herdecke. Daniel Löschinger, psychologist and therapist, studied at the Friedrich Schiller University Jena and Pennsylvania State University. As a long-standing member of the "Initiative Psychologie im Umweltschutz e.V., he intensively focuses on environmental psychology issues in research and practice. Whether we are vegetarian food, cycling or building a solar system, we are able to continue making decisions in the sense of the environment – or not. What guides and motivates us in this context, research environmental psychology. The handbook of psychology in environmental protection explains how we can better understand sustainable behaviour and promote the use of the environment.
content.title_en: Psychology in environmental protection : Handbook on the promotion of sustainable action

content.text: The problem case is that the crisis is not the problem of the crisis in the nuclear industry. How can it be explained that the crisis is not yet a problem in the nuclear industry? How is it possible that the nuclear power plant will be able to generate electricity in these large-scale nuclear plants for decades without the question of disposal? The experience of Chernobyl (1986) or Fukushima (2011) has made it clear how risky the technology is and how important it is to keep radioactivity safe from humans and the environment. The collection volume deals with the technical, political, social and economic dimensions of the disposal. It also addresses questions on the socio-technical state of the disposal, as well as those related to the democratic needs of participation and new participation formats, without which the location search will not lead to the goal.
content.title_en: Problem trap Final storage: societal challenges in dealing with nuclear waste

content.text: 1917/2017 : Revolution & Counterrevolution. The author puts the October Revolution in the context of the long cycle of revolution, which was opened with the French Revolution in 1789 and with the victory of the Bolsheviks in 1917 (and finally with the Chinese Revolution) the question of the importance of the "Great Revolutions" or the "Leitrevolutions" for the development of bourgeois-capitalist society has repeatedly raised. The cycle of the rise and decline of the Soviet Union is examined in the context of the great world political and world-historical contradiction constellations of the 20th century. What revolution in the developed capitalist countries can mean today is the subject of the final chapter.
content.title_en: 1917/2017 : Revolution & Counterrevolution

content.text: Learn to argue against right. Representation and argumentative refutation of right-wing argumentation patterns in political education. - Review : This title is a tool of argument against right-wing choice. First, it underlies the usual explanatory patterns (severe, social dissatisfaction etc.) of a sound critique, as well as the reaction of the established parties against the right-wing shift. Afterwards, essential elements of right-wing thinking (nationalism, racism, xenophobia) are presented, considered and refuted by current quotations. The authors point to continuity of right-wing extremist ideas. Thus, the pattern of biologism as the basis of national identity is also found in Erdogan's propaganda. The final chapter, which takes place in the "wooden paths of political education against right", would have been more detailed. Nevertheless, unconditional recommendation!
content.title_en: Learn to argue against law

content.text: The successful introduction and integration of new employees, also known as "onboarding", is of central importance for every company and a core task of human resources work. If they succeed, they will not only avoid mistakes, accidents and stress, but also initiate learning processes and promote the development of commitment and team spirit among employees. This book makes clear that onboarding begins already during recruitment and needs to be set up according to the target group very different priorities. As essential measures that can contribute to a successful integration of new employees, are described: realistic activity preview, the use of informal recruitment methods, integration by supervisors and colleagues, training and orientation programs, godparent and mentoring systems, coaching and supervision, trainee programs, team development, the use of social media and financial incentives. In each case, basic principles, mechanisms, evaluation results and case examples are presented. In addition, their classification into the company's strategy, but also the limits of methods for integrating new employees are discussed. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Onboarding - integrating new employees

content.text: One or zero: how you can lead your company into the digital future with Digital@Scale. Digitization is changing our world quickly and irrevocably. The switch to digital transformation requires a fundamental renewal - a transformation Digital@Scale. Digitization is not an IT problem. If you don't check structures, processes and products across the board - at Scale - for their digital possibilities and initiate the switch, you won't be able to compete. McKinsey Senior Partner Dr. Jürgen Meffert and marketing expert Professor Heribert Meffert will show how a fundamental adaptation can be successfully managed. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: One or zero: how to lead your business into the digital future with Digital@Scale

content.text: Every year millions of people visit our national parks, nature parks, museums and cultural sites. But what is the reason for this? How does a tree, a monument or an exhibition object become meaningful for people? On behalf of the US National Park Service, Freeman Tilden visited numerous parks and museums in the USA to find answers to these questions. He summarized his experiences in 1957 in his book 'Interpreting Our Heritage'. To this day, it is considered to be indispensable entry-level literature worldwide when it comes to the question of how the encounter of visitors with their natural and cultural heritage can lead to connections that lead to an attitude of appreciation. The book, which has given the concept of nature and cultural interpretation a structure, is now also available for the first time in German.
content.title_en: Communicating natural and cultural heritage: the concept of interpretation

content.text: Lightning and overvoltage protection : Basics and practical implementation according to DIN VDE 0100-443 and -534. Changes in technical structures (electrical systems have become more complex and therefore more vulnerable) have led to an increase in the damage caused by overvoltages in recent years. The requirements for overvoltage protection have had to be increased, i.e. it is now mandatory. The corresponding standards had to be changed and thus entered into force in October 2016. In this book, the emphasis is on commenting on these standards; afterwards, some problems with solutions are presented (the author is a specialist in this field). It is important for planners and installers of an installation (architects, craftsmen in the field of electrical engineering); (2-3)
content.title_en: Lightning and surge protection : Basics and practical implementation according to DIN VDE 0100-443 and -534

content.text: Metamusic. As "metaphysics" has long been referring to the concept of a wide field of ideas, facts and terms that is beyond physics, so "metamusic" in analog variety means everything connected with music that exists beyond the audible and can therefore be understood as "music via music". Metamusic uses numerous sub-concepts to point out that one can not only perceive music as auditory, but also invent, explore, write, describe, paint, think and imagine music. Overall, research on metamusic, musical self-reflection, self- or meta-reference of music in the history of science is still at the beginning. Therefore, it remains open which term will prevail in future to the designation of the common. By drawing attention to metamusic in this book, he wants to give thought to a readership that wants to penetrate self-referentiality into music - in works as well as in theory.
content.title_en: Metamusic

content.text: Serial interfaces. The book here deals with the data exchange between microcontrollers and peripheral devices via serial interfaces and addresses technically interested readers who enjoy electronic handicrafts and the corresponding skills (lots, ...). As literature on the topic, W. Klaas (ID-B 4/16) or the somewhat older works "I/O-Projects for the PC" (ID-G 50/04) and H. Wouters (ID-G 13/98) are recommended. Based on many examples, the author deals with the 3 serial interfaces IIC (Inter-Integrated Circuit), SPI (Serial Peripheral Interface) and One-Wire and compares them with regard to their special possibilities of use and performance. He relies on 2 self-built boards (Demoboard 2015 and the easier EasyMaster 2016), which allow to experiment and re-examine the examples of the book.
content.title_en: Serial interfaces

content.text: Microsoft Excel Pivot Tables: The Practical Book : Ideas and Solutions for Data Analysis with PivotTables and PivotCharts with intensive entry into Power Pivot for Version 2010, 2013 and 2016. Pivoting is part of the special tool of the very advanced Excel user, and since Power Pivot, very large amounts of data from different data sources can be grouped, selective, redesigning and calculating evaluated in an interactive table. The author is an expert in this field, his book first discussed and recommended in 2011 and last 2013. The reader finds exercise files on the net. The title is suitable for self-study up to expert level and the volume is also stable. For replacement and for further needs, the pre-press does not have to be replaced.
content.title_en: Microsoft Excel pivot tables: the practical book : Ideas and solutions for data analysis with pivot tables and pivot charts with intensive entry into Power pivot for version 2010, 2013 and 2016

content.text: Tasks and solutions for higher mathematics. Verl.Beschr.: This book provides an overview of all fundamental problems in exercises and exams of the basic mathematics lectures for engineers, natural scientists and economists. It contains a selection of more than 400 typical tasks, divided into 50 topics, with detailed solution sketches and descriptions of the relevant mathematical methods. Additional examples and explanations can be found in an internet-based collection of teaching materials, which can also be used by lecturers in their lectures.
content.title_en: Tasks and solutions for higher mathematics

content.text: Abort - Breakthrough: global media change and local media crises. In the course of the media change, the business model of the current press has entered into a crisis. Due to the absence of advertising, the financial viability of enlightened and democratic journalism is questioned. 16 articles that are oriented towards journalism analyse this profound structural change and put the performance of classical and digital media to the test. In this context, the tensions between commercial interests and social orders manifest themselves in all three parts of the book. Both the structural change from a European perspective and the media-entrepreneurial reactions to the media crisis in Switzerland are analysed. Further contributions deal with the journalistic-professional and individual reactions to the media change.The inventorying of current research contributes not only to the public discourse on the future of democracy-relevant media, but also opens up possibilities for a critical discussion about the performance of journalistic research in the course of fundamental upheavals.
content.title_en: Abortion - Breaking- Up : Global Media Change and Local Media Crisis

content.text: Diversity in teacher education: International dimensions of diversity in research and practice. Dealing with diversity is one of the elementary skills of teachers who are already active. However, although this view is now largely shared in science and practice, there are still insufficient answers and concepts to the related theoretical and practical challenges. The present volume, taking into account international perspectives, focuses on the various facets of diversity in research and practice. The focus of the contributions is deliberately broad: besides linguistic diversity, questions of migration-related diversity are taken up as well as the challenges of inclusion in school. Up to now, rather marginal topics such as sexual diversity are presented. The aim of the volume is to thematicise diversity as an always existing condition factor for school teaching and learning and to show concepts for the positive handling of diversity in educational situations.
content.title_en: Diversity in Teacher Education : International Dimensions of Diversity in Research and Practice

content.text: Basics of probability calculation and statistics : an introduction for students of computer science, engineering and economics. Verl.Beschr.: This book introduces application-oriented statistics, probability calculation and stochastic modelling, and is aimed at students of computer science, engineering and business engineering as well as economics. It is designed as an accompanying text to a one-semester event. The authors present the essential contents and aspects in a short and concise form and therefore deliberately dispense with detailed motivations. In the context of the new edition, additions, graphic representations and especially sample tasks with detailed solutions were inserted. Thus, the book is the ideal companion of every basic lecture in statistics
content.title_en: Basics of probability calculation and statistics : an introduction for students of computer science, engineering and economics

content.text: The social revolution!. Thirteen renowned thinkers analyze today's working world and show ways to a new social system. The ideas range from unconditional basic income to new tax models to peer-to-peer insurances
content.title_en: Social Revolution!

content.text: Introduction to machine learning with Python : Practical knowledge Data Science. "Machine learning" is a new method for gaining new insights with computers from very large data sets; it is used for example in automated medical diagnostic procedures. The present book focuses on "machine learning" algorithms and uses Python as a programming language with its libraries NumPy and matplotbib. It is an interesting counterpart to S. Raschka, who also introduces machine learning with Python but also goes into mathematical foundations. The book here requires only a few previous knowledge in Python and relies on algorithms frequently used in practice, which are included in the open source Python library among others scikit-learn. The authors start with basic concepts of "machine learning" concepts and then quickly get to the preliminary and disadvantages of the presented algorithms. Good consideration is also given to the chaining of different models using pipelines and working methods for the analysis of text files in the download section.
content.title_en: Introduction to Machine Learning with Python : Practical Knowledge Data Science

content.text: The basics of data analysis with R : an application-oriented introduction. Verl.Beschr.: This book provides an application-oriented introduction to data analysis with the free statistical environment R. It covers descriptive evaluations as comprehensively as inferential statistical analyses. In addition to classical univariate methods, the book takes into account nonparametric tests, resampling methods and multivariate statistics. It also covers the many possibilities of preparing data and creating diagrams. The statistical methods are explained using examples and illustrated in many places with diagrams. The book is aimed at all those who want to get to know R and use it in concrete tasks without having to have previous experience with command-controlled programs or programming languages. In the fourth edition both the innovations of R 3.3.2 and recent developments in the supplementary packages are incorporated. At the same time the text was revised and extended to include a separate chapter on diagrams with ggplot2. The text now also covers general numerical methods such as zero-point search, numerical integration and derivative as well as numerical optimization.
content.title_en: Basics of data analysis with R : an application-oriented introduction

content.text: Globalization in a split: the post-global misery and ways to overcome it. For several decades, globalization has shaped the world - politically, economically and socially. This changed many life-related issues considerably, both in positive and negative. As a result, discord and a post-global misery emerged that must be overcome. Jürgen Turek's extensive analysis investigates the reasons for the destabilization of the civilization conditions in the field of economic dynamics, social-cultural excitement and political uncertainty. His differentiated inventory provides orientation and proposes concrete political solution strategies.
content.title_en: Globalization in a Disparity: the Postglobal Misere and Ways to Cope With It

content.text: Empirical Social Research : Models and Methods of Standardized Data Collection and Data Evaluation with Annotations from a qualitative-interpretative perspective. The standard work on empirical social research, fundamentally revised and didactically prepared in the 13th edition. Starting from scientific theoretical questions, all relevant steps of the real research process are explained in detail and applied as well as differences to the qualitative-interpretative perspective are shown. The book is suitable for both a deeper understanding and for the entry into empirical social research without prior knowledge.
content.title_en: Empirical Social Research : Models and Methods of Standardized Data Collection and Data Evaluation with Annotations from a qualitative-interpretative perspective

content.text: The German Government considers organic farming as a particularly resource-efficient and environmentally friendly form of economy. It therefore pursues the objective of extending organic farming to a proportion of 20 percent of agricultural land. Against this background, the DAFA worked together with a broad alliance of representatives from industry, science and administration to develop the present research strategy in a process of more than two years of thematic identification and prioritisation. It shows how German agricultural research can make a substantial contribution to significantly improving the efficiency and competitiveness of the ecological food industry while at the same time helping the industry to meet its claim as a particularly sustainable economic form in the sense of the four IFOAM principles of ecological farming ("Health, Ecology, Fairness, Care"). [...] (Source: Verf.)
content.title_en: Expert Forum on the Ecological Food Industry : Research Strategy of the German Agricultural Research Alliance

content.text: Electrical machines : with 449 images, 78 examples, 60 tasks with solutions. General basics of electrical machines -- DC machines -- Transformers -- General basics of three-phase machines -- Asynchronous machines -- Synchronous machines -- Current turners for alternating and three-phase current -- Operating conditions of electrical machines -- Annex
content.title_en: Electrical machines : with 449 pictures, 78 examples, 60 tasks with solutions

content.text: Erdoğanistan: the fall of Turkey and the consequences for Germany. Turkey - that was until recently a country whose accession to the EU seemed possible: a reliable NATO partner, the goal of countless tourists, the "tiger on the Bosporus", whose economic growth was hoped for a bright future. Today, all this has turned into the opposite. Turkey is a country on the way to dictatorship, in which all those who oppose the president must fear their freedom. Hasan Cobanli, a German-Turkish border worker, has experienced numerous turning points in the recent Turkish history himself and knows many protagonists personally. In this book he tells how it could get so far, leads the reader into the heart of Erdoganistan and shows what the new Sultan is doing in Germany. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Erdoğanistan: the crash of Turkey and the consequences for Germany
