content.text: What is at stake. Freedom, democracy, justice: the ideas of the modern state emerged during the Enlightenment. In the 21st century we have long become accustomed to it. The fact that populists organize majorities with the promise of an authoritarian society is a new experience. The historian Philipp Blom sees Western societies as a precarious choice: radical market liberals on the one hand, authoritarian populists on the other. They give us simple solutions to the global challenges. Only with an illusionless, historically informed view of the present and with the conviction that all people have a free life can we save our human society.
content.title_en: What's at stake

content.text: In the end, nothingness? : about resurrection and eternal life. Is the Christian hope of resurrection still alive or has it become tired? How can one speak today about resurrection? Gerhard Lohfink presents himself in this book to the subject of death and resurrection. He argues against the dazzling background of today's ideas and expectations. His answers come from the Holy Scriptures, Christian tradition and reason. With his characteristic language - neither pious nor precipitating - he lets the power of Christian resurrection shine out. He shows: It is not about events that lie in the distant future, but that are incomprehensible to us. They have long since begun and reach us fully in their own death. "The thinking through and making of this book has led me again to see how liberating the Christian faith in the resurrection of the dead is. Whoever establishes himself in this faith can live without worries in the biblical "today" because now every hour of his life has weight and hope. And he can invest strength in the construction of a just society, because the world of resurrection is the end figure given by God Lohard here, who fights for this world in history."
content.title_en: In the end the nothingness? : about Resurrection and Eternal Life

content.text: The capsule: AIDS in the Federal Republic. "Gib Aids no chance" - almost every German over thirty knows the slogan of this campaign, which was launched in 1987 by the Federal Centre for Health Education. "Truvada" means the miracle medicine with which this demand is now to be met. The capsule, which HIV infected people have been prescribed for therapy for some time now, is now also used for prophylaxis. What the majority of Germans do not know is the pain and isolation that many people had to experience before the reconnaissance and prevention work and the development of effective drugs. Martin Reichert tells the story of these people, such as those homosexual men who, encapsulated by society, had to cope with the loss of their partner alone: disinherited from the Pfälzian family, unburdened from the funeral in the Black Forest and stigmatized by their fellows. AIDS has profoundly changed the way we live and how we love. "The capsule" reports how the disease found its way into the Federal Republic of Germany's consciousness.
content.title_en: The capsule : AIDS in the Federal Republic

content.text: Design Thinking and the new spirit of capitalism: sociological considerations of an innovation culture. >>Design Thinking<< is considered a universally applicable problem solving concept. An emphatic approach is designed to create goods and services that satisfy true needs. This involves the self-image to change the world. Tim Seitz was an ethnographer in the world of a Berlin innovation agency, where he was confronted with knowledge practices and transformation promises alike. He analyses the relationship between these practices and discourses and comes from practice theory to pragmatism in a theoretical search movement. >>Design Thinking< becomes thus understood as a phenomenon of the present and as a child of the new spirit of capitalism.
content.title_en: Design Thinking and the New Spirit of Capitalism : Sociological Observations of an Innovation Culture

content.text: The coming-out of the states: Europe's sexual minorities and the politics of visibility. In the last two decades, the LGBT movement (Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual and Transgender) has grown at an unprecedented rate compared to other human rights movements. Phillip M. Ayoub traces the recent history of this transnational movement in Europe. He shows how the "coming-out" put the marginalized social group at the centre of the political debate and helped it to have long-due rights. In addition to the analysis of the norms represented by the movement, the main question is why the social recognition of LGBT minorities in the respective states is so different. (Verlag text)
content.title_en: The Coming Out of States : Europe's Sexual Minorities and the Politics of Visibility

content.text: Reclaim autonomy : Self-empowerment in the digital world order. Not even twenty years ago, digitalisation still fostered the hope of a universal liberation of people. Not much of this remained: The fear of surveillance has become a constant companion. Facebook, Twitter and other social media (social media) brought a new form of incitement into the public sphere. And the permanent availability of information was followed by the struggle of established media against the digital continuous shooting with fake news. So it was high time for a critical inventory. In this volume, some of the most important thinkers of the present day are investigating pressing questions: How can digital capitalism tame itself? Does the Internet pose a danger to democracy? And how can we regain autonomy in a digitalized world? With contributions by Martin Schulz, Jakob Augstein, Gerhart Baum, Yvonne Hofstetter, Evgeny Morozov and others.
content.title_en: Reclaim autonomy : Self-empowerment in the digital world order

content.text: Resilience : Promoting the resilience of children in day care centres : Contributions to educational quality. Life is not always easy, this experience is already made by children: changes in the family, poverty or migration can put a heavy strain on them. The educational concept has to respond to this, to strengthen and promote the children. This volume explains how you can help children develop strength and resilience in order to resist stressful circumstances. The extensive work focuses on the development and characteristics of the resilience concept, the central characteristics of the resilience paradigm and empirical research findings. (Verlagstext)
content.title_en: Resilience : Promoting child resilience in day care facilities : Contributions to educational quality

content.text: Manual Resilience Training : Resistance and Flexibility for Companies and Employees. Clearly Structured Training Levels for Personal and Organisational Resilience Targeted Burnout Prevention With contributions by Erik Händeler, Susanne Leithoff, Dr. Rudolf Kast and Reinhard Feichter This manual sets out at various levels in companies and organizations: It offers background knowledge, exercises and practical examples to strengthen resistance and flexibility of - individual employees, - teams and - organizations. The many practical examples, the clearly structured training levels for personal and organizational resilience as well as the numerous exercises make it easy to transfer the training into practice. With contributions by Erik Händeler, Susanne Leithoff, Dr. Rudolf Kast and Reinhard Feichter Aus dem Inhalt Resilience - Resistance and Flexibility in Times of Constant Change The targeted development of personal resilience The comprehensive training of organizational resilience The special position of the leadership The interaction in the team and at the interfaces Burnout prevention and health management The responsibility of the management
content.title_en: Manual Resilience Training : Resistance and Flexibility for Companies and Employees

content.text: The arrogance of power: pride comes before the fall. Is democracy perhaps a "any whim of the people?" Plato was convinced that a "reasonable" government can only function if it keeps away from these whims. Otherwise, a decision of the people with far-reaching consequences, such as the British vote, threatens to leave the EU (Brexit). Does Richard Rorty's pessimistic view apply that the elites are convinced that only a destruction of democracy will save them?In this current analysis of politics as a reaction to the upheaval, Rüdiger Voigt is concerned with tracking the recent upheavals in the political landscape.
content.title_en: The arrogance of power : pride comes before the fall

content.text: Mechanics and strength theory: with 530 pictures, 266 teaching examples and a supplement with 42 tables, 25 diagrams and numerous formulas. Dr.-Ing. Peter Möhler is a student council member at the State Technician School Berlin. Dipl.-Ing. Bernd Kretschmer was working as a study director at the State Technician School Berlin. Both employees develop the concept of Karlheinz Kabus further and deepen the current learning content. The proven textbook on the most important theoretical principles of well-founded knowledge of mechanics and strength teaching are indispensable for technicians and engineers. This textbook offers students the opportunity to develop the theoretical basics and to check them out on the basis of practical tasks. The book takes the form of didactical examples, which have been won and tested in many years of teaching practice. No comprehensive mathematical knowledge is required. Multiple support of the reader through: - learning objectives for each section - questions on learning goal control - specific practical advice - 266 practice-related examples from many areas of technology - recommended work steps as a solution to the tasks - separate supplement with all necessary tables, diagrams and formulas.
content.title_en: Mechanics and strength theory : with 530 pictures, 266 examples of teaching and a supplement with 42 tables, 25 diagrams and numerous formulas

content.text: In the new chapter on the composition of plastic and elastomer components, the new chapter on the composition of plastic and elastomer components is presented. Prof. Dr. E.-Ing. Markus Stommel received his doctorate in 1999 at RWTH Aachen. Since 2014, he has been Managing Director of PART Engineering GmbH in Bergisch Gladbach. Dr. Wolfgang Korte received his doctorate in engineering at RWTH Aachen in 1996. Since 1999 he has been Managing Director of PART Engineering GmbH in Bergisch Gladbach Standard Tool FEM In the development process of technical plastic and elastomer components, the finite elements method has an ever greater significance. In addition to test data and user experience, simulation results are often valuable help to assess the technical performance of the planned product. Comprehensive practical guidelines The reader is to be able to solve problems arising from the practice independently, to be methodologically comprehensible and to be able to evaluate the significance of a simulation. Now in 2nd edition: significantly extended and completely revised - The topic of material modelling, in particular of the scope of the individual parts, is described in the new section on the compositional structure of the composition.
content.title_en: FEM for the calculation of plastic and elastomer components

content.text: In addition to the rhythm of life, the Internet, social media and the 24-hour economy have largely flexibilised our approach to time. Communication and consumption are increasingly no longer tied to fixed time corridors, just as they are to work. This development does not only mean a gain in freedom and self-determination – it is also a loss story. Going lost threatens the change of calm and activity, which is made possible by rhythms of sense of time, the social cohesion supported by common time structures. Marli Huijer shows us the importance of regular change and 'recurring time' for man and society, and where the meaningful rhythm of life is acutely endangered today. At the same time, she invites us to look for a rhythm that makes our own life succeed and shows what we can do concretely so that life gains rhythm again and not get out of the beat.
content.title_en: Out of measure : in search of the rhythm of life

content.text: Officina Humana: the office as a habitat for potential development. The office is the master tool of economics, but it is severely neglected. Due to the total dominance of economic rationality, offices have become dead dreams that weaken and deforce people, rather than spur their work. Creative spirit and creativity – the most important resources of future work – cannot unfold, human and economic potentials are broken. The book encourages companies and organizations to combine poetry and functionality in a coherent way, in order to transform work spaces into habitats for potential development. Since the call for help from the offices has become inaudible, the ASC wants to proactively promote offices in such a way that they meet the requirements of working as well as the needs of the human being.
content.title_en: Officina Humana : the office as a habitat for potential development

metadata.authors: Kulick, Andreas; Arbeiter Samariter Bund (ASB) Hessen

content.text: Neuroarchitecture. Neuroarchitecture links neuroscience, theory of perception and gestalt psychology, music, art and architecture to a holistic approach that focuses on the laws of structural formation and the movement of man in space. Christoph Metzger, author of Bauen for dementia and architecture and resonance, analyses buildings by Alvar Aalto, Son Fujimoto, Hugo Häring, Philip Johnson, Hermann Muthesius, Juhani Pallasmaa, James Stirling, Frank Lloyd Wright and Peter Zumthor in the context of the Amsterdam School of Architecture and its critique of functionalism, in order to develop the foundations and criteria of a contemporary, anthropologically shaped architecture that is committed to neuroscientific insights.
content.title_en: Neuroarchitecture

content.text: Introduction to Python 3 : for beginners and transitioners. Python is considered an easy-to-learn programming language with a very clear syntax. The claim "Light to Learning" aims to bring beginners to programming with Python within a week, so the approach of the first edition is at least. Since then the work has grown by 115 pages and 7 chapters; among other things by means of a separate part on the topic "object orientation" and that on the status of versions 3.5 and 3.6. It could therefore take a little longer with the learning. The then free e-book has now given way to a personal retrieval code for known financial reasons. Furthermore, the many exercises with commented solutions are a characteristic of this book. The examples and exercises often serve as a building block for own applications. In addition to the "entry into Python" by Thomas Theis. In more detail however, Johannes Ernesti is also significantly more expensive: "Python 3 - the comprehensive manual".
content.title_en: Introduction to Python 3 : for beginners and changers

content.text: Project management with Excel for Dummies. The book is so versatile that it is informative and instructive for project participants with different levels of knowledge both on Excel and project management. The authors, a business manager with IT project experience and a physicist specializing in project and portfolio management in companies, explain in their latest book (according to "120+ rules for project managers"), how the calculation program (version 2016, also 2010 and 2013) can be used from the planning to the completion for professional project management. As a trademark for the didactically prepared "... for Dummies" titles, the content is clearly, structured, understandable, illustrated with practical relevance and increasing complexity and illustrated by illustrations, above all screenshots. The chapter preview gives orientation in the modularly built book, which can only be read in excerpts and used as reference work, depending on the previous knowledge. With best-of the program functionalities and formatting tips. (2)
content.title_en: Project management with Excel for dummies

content.text: Raspberry Pi is programming with C/C++ and Bash: more than 50 photo, video & audio programs. The author is concerned with the single-platinum minicomputer Raspberry Pi under the special aspect of image processing and pattern recognition. The introduction is based on numerous sample projects from the fields of photo, video and audio, their programming and electronic implementation. With its detailed explanations based on many illustrations, the book is accessible to beginners without any prior knowledge. The book is therefore an interesting alternative to M. Kofler with a special photographic accent. However, T. Will introduces more comprehensively into the programming with C/C++. The book starts with a comprehensive compilation of all Raspberry Pi models, then explains the operating system Raspian, the most important Linux commandos and the electronics (GPIO port). Further focus is on recording and playback of video data, sensors for infrared and ultrasound, camera modules for the Raspberry Pi and automatic data transfer. - All programs of the book are available on the network.
content.title_en: Raspberry Pi programming with C/C++ and Bash : more than 50 photo, video & audio programs

content.text: Statistics with SPSS : everything in one volume for dummies. Verl.Beschr.: To understand and analyse real facts statistically is a great art. The program package SPSS is a powerful tool for this. In this book you will learn from numerous examples which statistical methods exist and when which method is appropriate. Immediately afterwards you will learn how these procedures are implemented in SPSS and how you can use them in your field of expertise. This way you will find correlations in your data, which are statistically significant
content.title_en: Statistics with SPSS : all in one band for dummies

content.text: Literature studies in crisis: the role and relevance of literary practices in global crisis times. In an age of numerous global upheavals, climate, political and financial crises and the resulting wars and conflicts are destabilizing social structures and cultural values patterns worldwide. In these circumstances, literature studies must ask themselves critical questions: What relevance do philological, historical and contextual research projects have in the light of a crisis-ridden present and an uncertain future? What role can literature play, can the teaching of literary techniques play in educational systems that consider economically usable results as the main legitimation criterion of education? Which ethical and political imperatives must be formulated in a rewording and what role do literary sciences play in this? In their contributions, literary, media and cultural scientists, with their own literary practice and the importance of their subject in and for the current crisis situations, explore a new order of the social role and relevance of literary sciences beyond specialist and national boundaries.
content.title_en: Literature in the Crisis: on the Role and Relevance of Literary Practices in Global Crisis Times

content.text: Foreigners in their country: a journey to the heart of the American right. How could and could there be a situation where right-wing populist movements and politicians are on the rise in many countries? The author finds impressive and illuminating answers because she talks at eye level with supporters of the American right and not about them
content.title_en: Foreigners in their country: a journey to the heart of the American Right

content.text: Marketing 4.0 : the guide to marketing of the future. Contemporary Marketing: digital instead of traditional Written by the world's leading marketing typhies, this book answers all questions about successful marketing in the age of networking and digitalization. It shows, among other things, how to play according to the new rules of marketing, o how to create WOW moments, which attract positive attention, o how to build a loyal customer base. The indispensable tool for the future of your company! (publishing text)
content.title_en: Marketing 4.0 : the guide to the marketing of the future

content.text: E-mail is the best self-defense against mobile phone terror, e-mail madness and digital permanent distraction. Eggler is a journalist and a successful speaker. She has made a name for herself by analyzing and commenting on the accompanying phenomena of the digital revolution ("Facebook makes stupid" (2013)). Humorous, with a large portion of irony and always with socio-critical depth, she reflects on our handling of smartphones, social media and e-mails. She gives a checklist to the hand for the digital legacy, makes demands, delivers sentences in aphorism quality. She encourages not to leave less, but better with the digital world. It depends much on how we deal with data collections, of course also politically. Her conclusion: "It's all about everything." The paperback is worth seeing, from the cover to the graphics to the paper and cover selection. There is currently no enough of these books. The volume is an equivalent supplement to M. Albers: "Digital exhaustion" (1 J,S).
content.title_en: Keep mail! : the best self-defense against cell phone terror, email madness & digital permanent distraction

content.text: CityTrop : Projects and plants for greener cities of tomorrow. Numerous examples from Germany and the whole world show that even small urban areas can produce lush green. 40 suitable plants for different plant species are presented separately. Review: Uncontested that cities are becoming more livable by plants. The possibilities to create parks and plant large trees are often limited. In order to make inner cities greener, new approaches are needed. The author (2014) has compiled numerous examples from Germany and the whole world, which show that even small urban areas can develop lush green. The selection includes roof gardens, vertical gardens, planting in train stations and shopping arcades, in backyards, on forecourts, transport islands etc. Rif argues that special accents should be set with selected exotic plants. 40 suitable plants for different plant species he presents vividly in text and image. Suggestions not only for city planners and architects, but also for residents of large cities. Individual aspects can also be found in "Designing green walls themselves" (2010), "CityGreen" (2014) and W. Kolb (2017)
content.title_en: CityTrop : Projects and Plants for Greener Cities of Tomorrow

content.text: IGLU & TIMSS 2011 : Scales manual for documentation of survey instruments and work with data sets. In 2011 the survey dates of the studies IGLU (International Primary School Reading Study) and TIMSS (Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study) were merged for the first time. This manual documents the survey instruments used in both studies in Germany. This volume includes the instruments that are part of the international study design as well as national supplements for Germany. Descriptive statistics and scale parameters of the instruments allow an assessment of the distributions of data and data quality. In order to facilitate work with the data sets of the studies, system, organisational and linking variables as well as generated indices are documented. The scale manual is intended to complement materials that are extensively documented in other places by the international study management. It is intended to facilitate work with the data sets of both studies.
content.title_en: IGLU & TIMSS 2011 : Scales manual for documentation of survey tools and working with data sets

content.text: The new reporting tools for SAP BW – Design Studio, Analysis Office and Lumira. This book brings you closer to the new front-end applications of the SAP Business Objects series. Based on selected practical examples, the authors provide application scenarios, integration possibilities and important functions. For example, you can create dashboards and evaluations on the current state of SAP technology, which are either developed on the desktop in Excel or as mobile presentation on the smartphone. Design Studio, Analysis for Office and Lumira were published over the past four years and primarily as solutions for newer Business Warehouse (BW) versions and for use with the SAP HANA database technology. The book is based on BW 7.4 SP8 and is mainly aimed at BI/BW consultants and developers whose task is the conception and realization of reporting requirements. SAP's author team has been working for many years in the business intelligence environment and with this practical guide gives you many valuable information about the IT architecture as well as tips and tricks for your daily work with the new reporting tools for BDre's business manager. Christoph Antre is responsible for the business management for the business news at BDre.
content.title_en: The new reporting tools for SAP BW – Design Studio, Analysis Office and Lumira

content.text: Introduce the SAP® Interactive Forms and Adobe® LiveCycle Designer practice book. Are you currently facing the task of adapting the Interactive Forms supplied by SAP? Or should your employees create new print forms with their own form layout and are not familiar with the current tools to integrate them into business processes in a precise manner? Then you will have to use this treasure chest full of valuable practical tips for dealing with the Adobe LiveCycle Designer and SAP Interactive Forms/LiveCycle ES/AEM Forms. Whether you are a beginner, designer or manager of a form project or even need to create an SAP Interactive Form as an ABAP developer: The experienced authors will guide you through numerous examples of everyday business life illustrated through all stations of a form project – from the initial setup of the LiveCycle Designer to the presentation of the various form objects and a description of how to assemble them into a complete form, up to the checklist for the roll-out phase. The book is chronologically structured after the lifecycle of a form project.
content.title_en: Practice book SAP® Interactive Forms and Adobe® LiveCycle Designer

content.text: Adobe Interactive Forms - Interactive Forms in SAP. SAPScript and SmartForms have soon become obsolete, and SAP only develops and adapts to SAP Interactive Forms (IFbA) forms that have been used to date. So it's high time to deal with this new technology! Learn how to create, design and integrate Adobe Interactive Forms within applications.The author uses an example scenario to slowly approach the more complex design of the form with tables and page breaks.You will learn about the development environment Adobe Live Cycle Designer and learn about the new possibilities of interacting with JavaScript to dynamize forms.In this context, the author will teach you how to integrate parts of the form with or hide the form during data input. Additional validations harmonize the process with the business logic running in the background. A short technical guide to integrating forms into ABAP Dynpros and optimization of the form.
content.title_en: Adobe Interactive Forms - Interactive forms in SAP

content.text: Exercise book Mathematics for Engineers for Dummies. Exercise book and task collection on "Mathematics for Engineers I for Dummies", with short repetition of the contents of linear algebra and one-dimensional analysis and many tasks with detailed calculated solutions. Review: To the volume "Mathematics for Engineers ... for Dummies" (Part 1: 2014; same author), designed for students of technical disciplines, a task collection has now appeared, which refers to the same topics from linear algebra and one-dimensional analysis, but which can be used independently of the textbook and also for self-study, because the matter dealt with in the tasks is combined with examples. The solutions to the tasks are explained in detail, the book also contains the series usual "Top 10" and "Dos and Don'ts", in this case practical tips for dealing with engineering mathematicals.
content.title_en: Maths for Engineers for Dummies

content.text: Technical Chemistry for Dummies. Compact introductory course for students with technical chemistry in secondary and practical subjects; in part also suitable for teachers and students at vocational high schools with technical profiles. (2-3S)
content.title_en: Technical Chemistry for Dummies

content.text: Brewing beer: basics, raw materials, brewing process. Those who like to optimize and experiment with home brewing, want to brew their own, special and excellent beer need an adequate reference work for their art, in which everything important is to be found. The engineer for brewing Jan Brücklmeier provides the ambitious hobby brewer with detailed and at the same time vivid and entertaining expertise in all important areas of home brewing: equipment, raw materials, brewing process, yeast breeding, disinfection, beer tasting, troubleshooting. Refined recipes in 20-litre scale stimulate for his own recipe development. (Verlagtext)
content.title_en: Beer brewing : basics, raw materials, brewing process

content.text: The overburdened brain: with stone age tools in the high-tech world. Gazzaley and Rosen - a neuroscientist and a psychologist - explain why our brains are not made for multitasking. Distractions, interruptions and technological "interferences" overwhelm our brains. We are simply not programmed to such a networked world. The authors show how science can make us more considerate of our "old" brains. They offer practical strategies to overcome today's challenges - with mediation, video games, fitness exercises and behavioral changes. It is not about living completely offline and withdrawn. It is about finding a good balance between our possibilities and the high-tech world.
content.title_en: The overburdened brain: with stone age tool in the high-tech world

content.text: The book contains everything you can expect on the subject: it is about the skepticism and distrust of a group of citizens, about the question of how to deal with it, about the ethos of journalism, also about self-criticism, legal aspects and even about physical attacks on journalists in Germany. The role of Facebook and satire pages is also investigated. The articles are generally written in a comprehensible and interesting way. A conclusion of the book: "Feelings are harder than facts". His cover is meaningful and striking. The publication is a sober, successful counter-project to Ulfkotte's controversial bestseller "Bought Journalists". It is generally relevant for media consumers, for (aspiring) journalists and students of several disciplines. (1)
content.title_en: Liespresse : Anatomy of a political combat concept

content.text: Intimate publics: Pöbeleien, Shitstorms and emotions on Facebook. In times of the Internet, private and public are subject to profound change: While privateness is more and more regarded as endangered and despised, a bourgeois public on the web is changing increasingly - Pöbeleien, Shitstorms or Candystorms have partially replaced rational discourse. Specific writing practices and symbol systems (Emoticons, Memes) transform the practice of communication. Elke Wagner takes up this current discussion and analyses the newly created intimateised publics on the social web. (Verlag)
content.title_en: Intimate Publics : Pöbeleien, Shitstorms and Emotions on Facebook

content.text: Transit Mexico : Migration, Violence, Human Rights. Publishers: The plans for the border wall of US President Trump are also directed against thousands of children, young people, women and men from Central America who flee from violence in their countries and try to cross Mexico - under danger of life. Some lose their lives in kidnappings, others disappear without trace. The Mexican state, as an enforcer of US security policy, surpasses these in the deportation of irregular migrants. The book accompanies migrants in their dangerous ways through Mexico. Transit migrants, successful and failed, speak to people in the border cities as well as in the places of departure. (Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador)
content.title_en: Transit Mexico : Migration, violence, human rights

content.text: Neoliberal urbanization: urban development processes in the Arab world. « Urban development in the Arab world has been following ever more neoliberal patterns since the 2000s: a new and remodelling of the city is being carried out with a focus on marketing strategies and maximizing profits in the real estate sector. The framework for conceptualizing the city as an economic commodity and brand is the authoritarian political systems, the rapid rise of the population, the revolts and uprisings of recent years and the considerable investments in large urban projects. In this volume theoretical and practical aspects of neoliberal urban development are presented on selected case studies from Tangier, Cairo, Ramallah, Beirut, Amman, Tunis, Muscat, Manama and Doha. « (description of the publisher)
content.title_en: Neoliberal Urbanization : Urban Development Processes in the Arab World

content.text: Sustainable tourism: Introduction. Sustainable tourism in balance with nature and society. Since the 1980s, tourism has been seeking new ways to reconcile regional economic development with environmental and nature conservation, fair working conditions and the appreciation of culture. Today, many tourism destinations and companies are already focusing on sustainable development. Sustainable development goals identify sustainable tourism as an option for development.The second edition of the successful textbook presents the basic principles and practical approaches for sustainable tourism. It addresses responsible corporate governance, sustainable destination management, tourism policy and the role of critical consumers. It also discusses the challenges of climate change, nature conservation and social sustainability.
content.title_en: Sustainable tourism : Introduction

content.text: Born of was - born of war : Europe's denied children. When the Wehrmacht withdrew from the countries occupied by it at the end of World War II, it left not only death and destruction, but also hundreds of thousands of children who had begotten German soldiers with native women. Women were usually despised by their surroundings and not seldom punished harder than collaborators. But what has become of the children? In this book, people from all over Europe tell of their lives as "children of the enemy". They tell of the difficult relationship with their mothers, who often concealed their true origin. And of the laborious search for the fathers, who sometimes knew nothing about the existence of their children - or even wanted to know nothing later. Moreover, Germans, who were born in "Lebensborn" homes, describe similar experiences. They are deeply moving stories about rejection and mistreatment, uncertainty and shame as well as the painful search for their own identity. But sometimes also about the happiness of finding a second family late on the occasion.
content.title_en: Born of war - born of war : Europe's denied children

content.text: 1618 : the beginning of the Thirty Years' War. Review: A reading-worthy addition to the relevant publications published in recent times is this collection, whose contributions by (early) modern historians - among them 4 professors - were written. The authors choose different approaches, whereby the person-centered approach (contributions by Kaiser and Höbelt) laymen should facilitate access to matter. Grades of non-expert readers may also feel addressed by the passages that form a bow in today's time, such as in A. Gotthard's contribution, which asks whether modern politics can learn from history. According to the preface, the volume wants to address a broad audience, but not all contributions are able to fulfill this promise. In this respect, a book is more of a deepening than an entry. No illustrations, useful bibliography, personal and factual registers. (3)
content.title_en: 1618 : the beginning of the Thirty Years' War

content.text: Hitler's special order Ostmark: Art robbery and museum politics in National Socialism. The book is dedicated to Hitler's distribution program of in-house art collections, which the dictator, after the "connection" of Austria to the German Reich in 1938, laid out for the "Ostmark" and extended it to the entire Great German Reich. After a first phase of divergent concepts Hitler himself took over the management of the project in June 1939. Then, his special representative Hans Posse and his assistant Gottfried Reimer, supported by the Vienna Memorial Authority, conducted the distribution of 5000 high-ranking works of art from Jewish possession. Against the background of a situation marked by fierce competition between Vienna and the East Moravian Reichsgauen, the construction of the "Guide Museum" in Linz and the expectations of museums in the "Old Reich" Hitler's profile becomes visible as a museum politician.
content.title_en: Hitler's Special Order Ostmark: Art Robbery and Museum Politics in National Socialism

content.text: Life 3.0 : Being human in the age of artificial intelligence. Will the learning-able, self-optimizing and self-reproducing artificial intelligence overtake humanity and end its "singularity" as intelligent beings? And if so, in what scenarios? Will humanity become obsolete and suppressed or is there a life in peaceful coexistence? Is AI friendly or hostile? Or does humanity first disband itself from superintelligence in a "roll back" of superintelligence? Or does humanity itself in atomic overkill before? The MIT-astrophysicist Tegmark works on these questions as a natural scientist without "technology openness" and takes AI seriously as an ethical and fundamental challenge of humanity. One of the crucial questions is whether AI can develop something like morality and consciousness. Demanding and extensive reading, comments, registers and registers are also important.
content.title_en: Life 3.0 : Being human in the age of artificial intelligence

content.text: Reform of Islam : 40 Theses. A debate is still polarizing the country: Is Islam part of Germany or not? Abdel-Hakim Ourghi takes a clear position. An Islam of submission, radicalism and lack of self-criticism does not fit into our modern society. Rather, it needs a contemporary interpretation of the Koran and the courage to question the tradition of the Prophet. Only a humanist Islam can belong to the Western world. The theses of this book give the most explosive discussion of our time new perspectives.
content.title_en: Reform of Islam : 40 Theses

content.text: Mobitecture : mobile architecture. "An inspiring and amusing collection of mobile and transportable architecture: houseboats, caravans, tents and huts for the beach, desert, sea, mountains and big city show how exciting life can be. Mobitecture presents many examples of constructions that can be moved by motorcycle or bicycle, car or tractor, donkey or shopping cart and even with pure human power."
content.title_en: Mobitecture : mobile architecture

content.text: Decker Maschinenelemente - Formulan. Decker Maschinenelemente - Formulansammlung is the proven classic for quick help in your studies and engineering everyday life. All relevant formulas for machine elements at a glance. This formulan collection contains all relevant calculations and equations for machine elements that students need in engineering fields at universities, technical universities, vocational academies and technical schools as well as engineers working in practice. The formulan collection is particularly suitable as a working aid in solving test or exercise tasks. The book is a supplement to the long-proven textbook "Decker Maschinenelemente" and "Decker Maschinenelemente - Tasks" and completes the Decker-Gesamtwerk. The important area of strength calculations is completely reworked and explained in more detail in this edition.
content.title_en: Decker Machine Elements - Formulas

content.text: EU conformity assessment - in eight project phases directly to the goal: the recipe book for designers, product managers and CE coordinators. The path to EU conformity step by step explains you develop, construct and build machines and plants and are never completely sure whether everything is EU-compliant with changes and innovations? Then you are right here. The author trains for over 15 years experienced practitioners as you deal with the correct handling of the EU directives' regulatory work. He makes available to you with this book a project-based approach with which you are guaranteed to come to the goal. Without detours, misguided paths, without too much and without too little. Simply in eight project phases, divided into individual steps, for EU declaration of conformity and CE marking: 1. Define responsibilities, develop checklists, develop security strategy 2. Gather all necessary data and facts 3. Conduct law, guidelines and standards searches 4. Organize internal technical documentation 5. Perform risk assessment 6. Create and adapt operational instructions 7. Create and sign EU conformity declaration 8. Develop project preparation and archive Secure this systematic documentation!
content.title_en: EU conformity assessment - in eight project phases directly to the target : the recipe book for designers, product managers and CE coordinators

content.text: The following are some of the most important examples of the latest developments in the field of security: the digital approaches to all today's threat scenarios and the involvement of all actors in the digital world. The presidents of BND, Constitutional Protection, BKA, BSI and Interpol as well as selected experts present their views on the challenges of the future.With contributions by:Rainer Franosch (OStA and Head of Unit at the Federal Office for Security in Information Technology)
content.title_en: Security in a digital world

content.text: Does the truth or freedom come true? : a disputation. "In Catholic theology a dramatic polarization has been noticeable for some time. The contrary positions concern issues such as celibacy, women's priesthood, admission of civilly remarried divorced persons to the sacraments, "homo marriage" or questions of a hierarchically or participatoryly organized community. But who thinks it is about changes in this or that point of sexual morality or the self-understanding of the Church, has not understood the seriousness of the situation. It is no longer about turning to the adjustment or liberalisation of the adjustment, but rather about answering the fundamental question of whether the truth of Karl-Heinz Menke, free or freedom, is true."- Back cover
content.title_en: Does the truth come true or freedom? : a disputation

content.text: The Duden in twelve volumes : the standard work on the German language ; Volume 12: Duden - quotations and statements. Review: After 2008 the 4th, revised, modernized and significantly extended edition of the standard work is now published. In the 1st part the origin and meaning of the most important 7,500 classical and modern quotations are explained in alphabetical order, in the 2nd part there are suitable quotations for every occasion. The graphically and haptically high-quality presentation and the scarce, clear language, together with many illustrations, are almost appealing to browse the voluminous work. Source list and registers round off the volume. The preliminary edition should be replaced as possible.
content.title_en: The Duden in twelve volumes : the standard work on the German language ; Volume 12: Duden - Quotations and pronouncements

content.text: New immigration and education : an interdisciplinary perspective on transitions into the German education system. Migration to Germany is currently receiving great public attention not least through global mobility. Challenges that arise for educational institutions are controversially discussed. But what possibilities are newly immigrated children, young people and young adults in the German education system at all available? The volume combines contributions from various disciplines that address discourses in the field of education and re-migration as well as discuss research results.
content.title_en: New immigration and education: an interdisciplinary perspective on transitions into the German education system

content.text: Outside play : textbook. Children who play outside unguided move a lot, experience natural and self-effects and train their social skills. This aspect of childhood is wrongly marginalized. Outdoor play is an important part of informal education. Children need stimulating free spaces that they can achieve through their own mobility. What is outdoor play? What biological roots are there, and how has it been culturally integrated? Why are so few children playing outside today? What developmental effects does it have? How can an inclusion of children's play needs into everyday life, into public space, be achieved throughout the day? These are the topics of this book. With a preface by Lothar Krappmann. Christiane Richard-Elsner, Jg. 1962, Dr-Ing., M.A., the working group Dr Outdoor Children in the ABA Fachverband leads.
content.title_en: Playing outside : Textbook

content.text: Parkstadt Karlshorst : Model of a residential city. The park town Karlshorst in Berlin Lichtenberg with over 1000 apartments is a model project for housing with affordable rents in Berlin in its striking urban structure. The master plan of Klaus Theo Brenner Stadtarchitektur and the realization in cooperation with the architects Eckert, Negwer, Susebbeek, Eingartner, Khorrami and Stephan Höhne show a city model that stands in concept and claim in the tradition of the Berlin reform housing building
content.title_en: Parkstadt Karlshorst : Model of a residential city

content.text: Fit for the study program – Statistics. Introduction to key concepts and methods of descriptive and inductive statistics and probability theory, which is only necessary for the analysis of empirical data, is required for statistical events. Review: Statistics provides effective methods and instruments for the analysis of empirical data. This work is therefore a central auxiliary science of empirical disciplines. The present work now provides students with empirical subjects that are far from mathematically descriptive and inductive for a statistical event. The basic knowledge of descriptive and inductive statistics as well as probability theory is therefore also available as a bridge course. The presentation, which requires only basic knowledge of upper-level mathematics and is provided with numerous examples and illustrations, is inductively and illustrative. Concepts and procedures are therefore developed from examples in an understandable way and the structures recognized are then generalized. An exact mathematically based treatment of the subjects is dispensed with in favour of illustrative approaches. Simulations and data material for practical work are available online. With exercise tasks including solutions, the target group is very similar to the content of Michael and Müller2010.
content.title_en: Fit for study – Statistics

content.text: Applied data analysis : the Bayes's path. This book offers a systematically structured introduction to applied data analysis, Bayes' statistics and modern simulation methods with the computer. Starting from the objective of not directly measurable sizes and calculating forecasts for future values of uncertain sizes, it describes and explains the approaches - from the systematic collection of data to quantification of uncertainty based on probabilities to the application of regression models. With numerous reflection tasks and examples from practice and its didactics proven in many courses, the book is ideal for students in applied sciences such as engineering, natural sciences and economics. For the new edition, several chapters have been revised. In addition, a section on hierarchical models has been added and the book has been supplemented with a chapter on plausibility of models and hypotheses. Both the data sets and program codes used and the solutions to the reflection tasks are available online as additional material.
content.title_en: Applied data analysis : the Bayes' way

content.text: Dealing with sexual violence in facilities for children and adolescents : a practical guide for pedagogical professionals. Guide for pedagogical professionals in facilities where children and adolescents live, with recommendations for action on dealing with sexual abuse
content.title_en: Dealing with sexual violence in facilities for children and young people : a practical guide for pedagogical professionals

content.text: Internet law. Information and law: the core terms -- Legal classification of domain assignment -- Copyright -- Online marketing: Advertising law issues -- Conclusion of contract with the customer -- Data protection law -- Liability of online services -- International aspects of Internet law -- Internet criminal law.
content.title_en: Internet law

content.text: Reporting in SAP® controlling. Basics of reporting concept in SAP controlling - Development of internal reporting in SAP ERP CO - Variants for selecting motion data - Export of reports to Excel
content.title_en: Reporting in SAP® controlling

content.text: The political systems of the world. Argentina and Brazil, India and Thailand, Iran and Israel, Algeria and South Africa, Russia and Japan, the USA and Europe: The states of the world have come close to us in the age of globalization. Nevertheless, we are often only inaccurately informed about their forms of government. This book is a competent guide through the political systems of the world, their current problems and their theoretical foundations. (publisher advertising)
content.title_en: The political systems of the world

content.text: Prevention of sexual abuse: Treatment manual for working with (potential) offenders. With e-book inside and work material. As part of the Göttingen therapy project for the prevention of sexual abuse, an outpatient therapy offer has been developed for persons who notice a sexual interest in children and/or adolescents in themselves and thus have an increased risk for the committing of crimes. Group and individual therapy are based on a cognitive-behavior therapeutic therapy concept, which focuses on a resource- and need-oriented approach. The therapy manual provides a detailed structure and recommendations for the course of the individual therapy modules as well as the sessions. With extensive worksheets, information material and flipchart pattern templates for download. Therapy modules: 1 motivation for change/group constitution • 2 life story • 3 risk factors • 4 victim empathy • 5 victim empathy • 6 self-value • 7 consequences of abuse • 8 binding & intimacy • 9 handling of emotions and problem coping • 10 normative and deviant sexuality • 11 crime scenario II • 12 back-up plan • 13
content.title_en: Prevention of sexual abuse : Treatment manual for working with (potential) offenders. With e-book inside and work material

content.text: The technical brochure Connecting materials in wood construction assembles the various joining techniques in wood construction and explains their particularities, the possible and optimal application areas and the correct handling of the connection materials used in wood construction. It offers the reader an extensive overview of the basics of the joining techniques in a compact and comprehensible written form.
content.title_en: Liaison in timber construction : basics and background knowledge

content.text: Stiff wooden panels : Disc design in wooden frame construction : with 41 illustrations, 6 pre-design tables and 95 formulas. The work explains the design and design of panels in wooden panel construction. It provides practical explanations for the design of panels in wooden panel construction and also provides practical pre-design tables.
content.title_en: Stiff wooden panels : Disc design in wooden frame construction : with 41 illustrations, 6 pre-design tables and 95 formulas

content.text: Einstein and Heisenberg: Founders of modern physics. Albert Einstein (1879-1955) and Werner Heisenberg (1901-1976) are among the founders of modern physics. While Albert Einstein predicted a wealth of novel phenomena in the cosmos with his general and special theory of relativity, precisely according to the rules of causality, Heisenberg in his quantum physics dealt with the atomic world, for which only probabilities can be described. Both great physicists received the Nobel Prize, were professors at various universities and met again and again, last in Princeton in 1954. During this conversation Einstein could not find himself in the way that the quantum theory of classical physics was deprived of the ground. In his double biography, the author, who himself is professor of experimental physics, also speaks about the relationship between the two physicists and women, religion and music. Both are passionate musicians, but both are very critical of religion. Thus, both the similarities and the opposites are expressed. A well-readable work.
content.title_en: Einstein and Heisenberg : Founder of modern physics

content.text: We can make our pain more bearable by our will. But how and where does my I (my soul) affect my body? Doctors, neurophysiologists, physicists, philosophers and psychologists show in this book that the dualism felt by all of us does not exist between body and soul. Both are inseparable a unity formed over millions of years by adaptive self-organization of the neuron network brain.
content.title_en: From the freedom to feel pain

content.text: Nomadic homes : architecture on the move ; architecture on the move ; l'architecture mobile. Philip Jodidio presents a variety of forms of mobile living in this volume, from classic campers to luxurious houseboats to Shigeru Ban refugee shelters. Each of the multi-faceted dwellings in this volume is explained with interior and exterior shots as well as a profile of concept, designer and owner.
content.title_en: Nomadic homes : architecture on the move ; architecture in motion ; l'architecture mobile

content.text: Urban ecology : Building blocks of the urban ecosystem. In the sign of increasing urbanization and climate change, the information needs in the field of sustainable and ecological planning in urban spaces are growing. This is reflected by this current introduction to the urban ecosystem. The authors are relevant and have many years of experience in research and teaching
content.title_en: Urban ecology : Building blocks of the urban ecosystem

content.text: Corporate Data Quality: Prerequisite for successful business models. Data is the strategic resource of the 21st century. No business process, no communication between business partners, no added value takes place without the persons, machines and IT systems involved using, generating or changing data. Trends such as digitalization, Industry 4.0 and social media also contribute to the fact that data management has become a core competence for successful companies of this time. In order for data to develop its full value, they must always be available in appropriate quality. This applies especially to master data, the central business objects of a company. This book shows a holistic approach to quality-conscious management of master data and thus addresses both practitioners and scientists. The "Framework for master data quality management" has been developed and improved in a number of practical applications in collaboration with companies from different industries since 2006 within the framework of the "Competence Center Corporate Data Quality" of St. Gallen University. In addition to the theoretical foundations, the book of practical view with 10 case studies provides a great space for successfully executed data quality projects. Finally, the book still introduces methods and tools for supporting operational data management in the context of the company's business data management.
content.title_en: Corporate Data Quality : Prerequisite for successful business models

content.text: PERFAG 3D - Specification for multi-layer PCBs. PERFAG 3D applies to the specification of new multilayers for the PCB manufacturer. The specification is the result of a voluntary cooperation between the PERFAG company and its connected PCB producers. The content of the specification is a recommendation that can be voluntarily followed. Nor is the PERFAG company liable for consequences arising from the application of this specification.
content.title_en: PERFAG 3D - Specification for Multilayer PCBs

content.text: Paper Dictionary of PCBs : English/German - German/English. The printed circuit board industry uses its own specialist words and terms, which differ considerably from the basic vocabulary of the respective national language. Furthermore, the rapid technical progress of printed circuit board technology has produced universal technical terms, which have been adopted without translation into the technical vocabulary. It is the task of our specialist dictionary to reproduce these technical terms as understandable as possible. The printed circuit board technology is extremely dynamic, which is reflected in continuously new technologies and procedures. Accordingly, the vocabulary has also expanded. The present 3rd edition of the paper dictionary has been extended by about 3000 terms in both languages. Due to multiple wishes and suggestions, this edition now also contains specialist terms from the process engineering and installation of printed circuit board systems.
content.title_en: Paper Dictionary PCB Technology : English/German - German/English

content.text: The transition from lead-free to lead-free soldering technology in electronics has raised a number of questions that all the parts involved in the process chain have to deal with. This begins with the component manufacturer and the PCB designer, affects the producer of soldering equipment, paste and flux, influences the design and quality of the soldering plant, requires adapted temperature measurement methods for process assurance and optimization of the temperature profile of the soldering plant and has effects on the repair and soldering stations. This complex topic is addressed by Prof. Armin Rahn in his new book, in which he gives scientifically sound and very concrete advice and advice on the work in production. Large space is given to the hidden sources of defects and the practically applicable temperature measurement methods. This work is likely to pay off many times even if only one additional non-sample construction group series leaves the soldering plant. The main chapters of the book: Introduction Basic effects on machines and tools Support of the soldering process, activation of the heat station control elements Application group of thermometers Examples of thermoprofiles
content.title_en: Recording of solder profiles : methodology, sources of error, measurement tolerances; with 18 tables

content.text: Manual of process and soldering errors : with ... 21 tables. The confusing variety of so-called soldering errors has its origin in the very different methods of the different productions. Due to the worldwide branching of electronic production, a collection of names for the individual errors has established itself and often the same errors are documented with different names or different appearances with the same name traded. This specialized book gives valuable tips and help around the topic soldering errors and is recommended to every practitioner
content.title_en: Manual of process and soldering errors : with ... 21 tables

content.text: In the face of crises that have shaken the European Union for several years, from the financial crisis to the refugee crisis and the Brexit vote, there is a growing scepticism and rejection; an impending legitimation crisis forces the analysis not only of the causes but also of the potential for strengthening legitimacy. This volume is based on the contributions and discussions of two conferences of the European Constitutional Law Network (ECLN) on democratic theory, an analysis of the causes of the financial crisis and the role of the courts in their management, the protection of the fundamental rights of citizens and the strengthening of citizens' proximity and participation through digitalization, and concrete proposals for reform. A dialogueal epilogue by Joseph Weiler and some of the authors gives suggestions for further discussion and reflection, which will be important in the coming years, when the EU as a democratic union of citizens emerges from the crises and develops further. With contributions by Giacinto della Cangola, Tomci Ebsky, Fabri, G.
content.title_en: Legitimacy issues of the European Union in the face of crisis : Dimitris Tsatsos in memorian

content.text: The standard work on Austrian democracy with original contributions by leading representatives of political science and its neighbouring disciplines is now in a completely updated new edition, which also takes into account the latest challenges and developments of Austrian and European politics from the "refugee crisis" to the memorable presidential election.
content.title_en: Austrian democracy compared

content.title_en: Accomplices of the recognition service : the self in digital culture

content.text: Blender 2.7 : Step by step towards a 3D animation. Blender is a free open source software for modeling and animating 3-dimensional objects and figures. Compared to Thomas Beck's large manual "Blender 2.7", also published by Rheinwerk, the present title does not fundamentally introduce the 3-D animation with Blender, but rather focuses on certain central topics such as the construction of an object, whose surface design, lighting and animation. The explanations are scarce, but sufficiently detailed, the work steps are clearly and rigorously described, but rather fragmented in small parts, which makes it easy to work on concretely. Theoretical background information is rare. Since it is often also about design questions, it is helpful that the numerous images are continuously coloured. The data of the exemplary projects are available for download on the web. Conclusion: Well-proven textbook on the central areas of work with Blender for concrete reworking.
content.title_en: Blender 2.7 : Step by step to your own 3D animation

content.text: Wood physics : Physics of wood and wood materials. Prof. Dr.-Ing. habil. Peter Niemz is Professor of Wood Physics at ETH Zurich, Department of Construction, Environment and Geomatics, Institute of Building Materials. He is author/co-author of 7 specialist books, 486 publications in specialist journals and 168 lectures at specialist conferences The book provides important basic physical knowledge of wood and wood materials as a basis for use and processing. Examples of practical application of wood physics are presented.The book is addressed to students of wood technology at universities and universities of applied sciences and serves as a reference work for industrial workers.
content.title_en: Wood physics : Physics of wood and wood materials

content.text: Building history : architectural reconstruction and national formation from the 19th century to the present day. The reconstruction of symbolic, destroyed monuments and ensembles has always been given an important role for nation-building and national self-assertion. This is particularly true for emerging, young and in transition nation-states. The staging of the architecture of past epochs serves here to strengthen national consciousness, often also the legitimization of state sovereignty and territorial claims. At the center of the volume, which strikes a wide arc from the 19th century to the immediate present, are the national political motives of reconstruction projects in Central and Eastern Europe. From this point of view, some prominent reconstructions are analyzed in their historical political functions. A special focus of the case studies brought together here from different countries between the Baltic Sea, the Adriatic Sea and the Black Sea is on projects that are hardly known or largely forgotten in Germany.
content.title_en: Building history : architectural reconstruction and nation formation from the 19th century to the present day

content.text: Empirical research into internet-based communication. "This volume presents seven research contributions that have been made in connection with the interdisciplinary DFG network "Empirical research into internet-based communication". Questions of modelling and analysis of language and interaction in the network are addressed on the basis of written and multimodal data"--
content.title_en: Empirical research on internet-based communication

content.text: upTOWNHOUSES : build the city for the 21st century: the city house and Hamburg urban development. The ubiquitous housing congestion in the German metropolises raises the question of how we want to live and live in urban areas today. Of course, the problem cannot be solved by large projects alone. We need to consider a fair housing system for all, which does not destroy the beauty, sustainability and quality of life of our cities in the post-condensation process. 0The example of the conversion area of the former Finkenau Women's Hospital in Hamburg shows how a city worth living can be created for all. The focus is on the upTownhouses project. In it, the city house, which has a long tradition in London, Bremen or Hamburg, experiences a Renaissance. The typology of the town house between home and floor building can give answers to the housing question and is therefore more than a mere residential or building form. It embodies a crucial building block of the anthropological city, which is primarily related to the needs of the human being and thus stands for a new metropolitane 21st century living environment in the 21st century.
content.title_en: upTOWNHOUSES : build the city for the 21st century : the townhouse and Hamburg urban development

content.text: Rindermarkthalle und Schanzen-Höfe : historische Viehmärkte 1864 bis heute. Verlagsinfo: Die historische Viehhöfe - heute: Rindermarkthalle St. Pauli und Schanzen-Höfe - lost its original purpose in the 1970s. A market place for cattle and sheep had already been established in 1864 on the Heiligengeistfeld. Two years later an equivalent for calves and pigs followed on the Sternschanze. Both areas were opened from 1886 - in the middle of the central slaughterhouse - with solid buildings. Both the Rindermarkthalle, which has experienced changing uses as a shopping complex to this day, and the Schanzen-Höfe, which could only be secured by the renovation from 2008 onwards, represent controversial transformation and conversion processes.
content.title_en: Rindermarkthalle and Schanzen-Höfe : historical cattle markets 1864 to today

content.text: New non-discrimination for the digital world?. The progressive digitization process leads to fundamental changes in economic and social coexistence. Digital change generates numerous advantages for consumers and producers with its innovations, but established business models are questioned and new competition is exposed. However, the concern about concentration of power and new risks is even more present in the discussion than the dangers seen in vehicles without horses a good 100 years ago - whose use was then considerably made more difficult by excessive regulation. Against this background, the Kronberg Circle, scientific advisory board of the Foundation Market Economy, warns in its study of over-hasty regulatory impulses. The current tendency to further prohibitions of discrimination and neutrality is an expression of a popular but blurred debate on justice, which is often guided by diffuse feelings rather than facts and empirical evidence. What is called discrimination is often a legitimate entrepreneurial differentiation, which also brings advantages to consumers. Conversely, strict prohibitions of differentiation restrict free competition and innovations. The attempt to create a political ideal of equality in general, which is often seen as a risk of being transferred to the economic world as a multifaceted phenomenon.
content.title_en: New non-discrimination for the digital world?

content.text: The sustainable republic : outlines of another modern era. A collection of scenarios ("future pictures") of a sustainable society on a global scale, will be discussed, among others, the aspects of architecture and urban planning, mobility and transport, democratic participation, ecological economy, digitalization, tourism and international trade relations. (2S)
content.title_en: The Sustainable Republic: Outline of a Different Modernism

content.text: Augmented and Mixed Reality : for marketing, media and public relations. Augmented Reality (AR) and Mixed Reality (MR) merge real and digital worlds into an interactive and immersive experience. Whether information or entertainment - the new realities completely change the way we interact with content. For companies and agencies, fascinating applications arise - on smartphones, tablets or AR and MR glasses. Learn with this book how the technologies work and how they can be used. With numerous best practice examples, ten milestones of app development help in the practical re-settlement of AR and MR projects.
content.title_en: Augmented and Mixed Reality : for marketing, media and public relations

content.text: Rethinking surveillance and control : beyond the "Security versus Privacy" debate. The book's starting point is that the common metaphor of a balance between security and privacy is conceptually inadequate and conceals central aspects of surveillance and control measures. The authors, on the other hand, emphasize the symbiotic relationship between freedom and security and reveal the emptiness of both concepts as soon as they are isolated from each other and understood outside concrete power relations. By means of a stronger contextualization of risk concepts, surveillance and control practices, they show the value of privacy and data protection. As a kaleidoscope of perspectives ranging from critical studies to international relations, legal sciences and philosophy to sociology, the book makes clear that surveillance and control techniques by no means imply more and more security and less privacy – and vice versa, that the protection of privacy is not only a cause for security.
content.title_en: Rethinking surveillance and control : beyond the "Security versus Privacy" debate

content.text: Forest ownership and nature conservation: the constitutional protection of forest ownership in the Land Nature Conservation Act North Rhine-Westphalia. Today, the forest is the owner of the basis of economic use, recreation, the development of nature and the environment. However, at present, a nature protection law threatens to displace the forest owner from his rights. Therefore, the constitutional protection of private property, the European regulations of species protection as well as the federal and national regulations of nature protection must be combined into guiding principles that ensure a natural development of the forest by sustainable, environmentally conscious forestry. The owner must retain the right to select the tree species in the forest and to determine them via dead wood. The external use of the forest by riders and cyclists must be in line with the requirements of the forest, the protection of species and biotope to be adapted to sustainable forest management. The participation of nature conservation organisations must be re-regulated.
content.title_en: Forest property and nature conservation : the constitutional protection of forest property in the State Nature Protection Act North Rhine-Westphalia

content.text: The Working Group on Building Technology of the Association of Monument Peasants of the Federal Republic of Germany (VDL) already took a position in 1982 with the leaflet 1 "Window Renovation" on 35 pages on fundamental questions and practice of window monument plege. This work aid, which was published in 1984 in the second exhibition, has long since been out of print. It followed in 1991 work sheet No. 8 with the title "Instructions for the treatment of historical windows in architectural monuments", which summarized on three pages construction technical questions and monument legging principles of window preservation, which have not lost their validity. After more than 25 years, a new version of the window paper appeared necessary, which now appeared as an extensive work booklet No. 1 with the title "Wood windows in architectural monument - Indications for the proper handling of monuments".
content.title_en: Wooden windows in the monument : Notes on the appropriate handling of the monument

content.text: The constitutional admissibility of a significant increase in the federal subsidy to the statutory pension insurance scheme is foreseeable in the legal pension insurance scheme (GRV). It is predicted that the net pre-tax pension level will decrease from currently 48.0 to 41.7 percent in 2045, while at the same time the contribution rate will rise from 18.7 to 23.6 percent. One of the considerations regarding the prevention or mitigation of this scenario is the increase in the state subsidy, which currently accounts for around 25 percent of the GRV's income. This raises the question whether there is a constitutional ceiling for this and where it may be. The authors conclude that Article 120(1) sentence 4 GG, the right of ownership (Art. 14 GG) to social insurance entitlements, the General Equality Rate (Art. 3 Abs. 1 GG) and the Union Law (Art. 101 TFEU) will only conflict with an increase in federal subsidies if a limit of 50 percent is exceeded.
content.title_en: The constitutional admissibility of a significant increase in the federal grant to statutory pension insurance

content.text: Governance and interdependence of education : international studies and comparisons. We observe an increasing internationalisation of education. What effects do education exports have? How can interdependence between education policy and other policy fields, e.g. social and labour market policy, be analysed? What determinants and dynamics can be identified in (inter)national comparison?
content.title_en: Governance and Interdependence of Education : International Studies and Comparisons

content.text: The computer looks into the brain: Discovering, understanding and thinking across. The textbook offers a wealth of evidence, very well thought-out illustrations and explanatory examples of the history of the computer. The author writes at the beginning that he will be very happy to use examples from biology because of his own studies. He does so and so this volume is particularly suitable for biology and also medical students, in order to be able to imagine the corresponding mechanisms of computer technology as analogies particularly well. The volume is based on the simplest computing devices, such as the abacus and mechanical calculating machines. Zitzler explains switches, relays and neural circuits. Thus, he gets from computer plants, main storage via software such as assemblers to the hardware anatomical of a computer, where the BUS is compared with the backbone of a person. From small networks it goes to the Internet, often with many useful details. A late chapter on problem solving gives hints on computer algorithms.
content.title_en: Computers in the brain: Discovering, understanding and thinking across the board

content.text: Car sharing in Germany: Potentials and challenges, business models and electric mobility. Both electromobility and car sharing concepts are of great importance in the context of sustainable mobility concepts and the energy transition in Germany. Therefore, it is worth looking at the current situation, the potentials and the success factors with regard to the use of electric vehicles in car sharing offerings. Where does the car sharing principle stand today and what conditions it offers for the use of electric vehicles: How can car sharing and the use of electric vehicles in car sharing advance the development of new forms of mobility, what are the operating and business models? What possible hurdles must be overcome, when car sharing is economical and what are other key success factors for eCar sharing in Germany? (Verlagstext)

content.text: Otto Häuselmayer - urban architecture : urban planning, buildings and projects 1976-2018. Two churches, 1,500 apartments and the planning of urban quarters for around 5,000 apartments include the work of Otto Häuselmayer. In addition, there is a bridge, utility buildings, space design and the internationally well-respected roofing of the archaeological excavations in Ephesos, which seems like a retrospective city intervention. The book documents Häuselmayer's buildings for the first time, which are very popular among users.
